Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Achileus was jointly designed by scientists from the Free Worlds League and Word of Blake with the goal of creating a light battle armor suit that could be mass produced. Inspired by the Federated Commonwealth's ultimately flawed Infiltrator Mk. I, the research team used the Blakist Tornado PA(L) as the basis for the new suit while seeking to overcome some of its defects. The resulting Achileus manages to add armoring, weaponry and integrated jump jets while still maintaining its stealth aspects. Quirk: Ambusher Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.886 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 阿喀琉斯由自由世界联盟与布雷克之言的科学家联合设计，目标是在制造可以量产的轻量战斗装甲服。受联邦联邦最终存在缺陷的"渗透者 Mk. I"启发，研究团队以布雷克派的"龙卷风"轻动力装甲为基础研制新装甲服，同时力图克服其部分缺陷。成品的阿喀琉斯在保持其隐身特性的同时，成功加装了装甲、武器和一体化跳跃推进器。 特质：伏击者 投放费用倍率：0.886 可挂载全能单位，可近战，可蜂群攻击。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Reportedly piloted by Dirk Radick, the Adder Hero 'Mech, the Cinder mounts an ER Large Laser in each arm supported by a Machine Gun in each side torso complimented by the head mounted Flamer. Carrying two and half tons of machine gun rounds, five extra Double Heat Sinks maintain a high rate of laser fire. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 据称由Dirk Radick驾驶的Adder英雄机甲Cinder，在每只手臂各装备一门增程大型激光，每侧躯干各有一挺机枪作为辅助，另有头部安装的火焰喷射器作为补充。它携带两吨半机枪弹药，五具额外的双散热器则维持着高频率的激光射击。 特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：1.03 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: TReportedly piloted by Dirk Radick, the Adder Hero 'Mech, the Cinder mounts an ER Large Laser in each arm supported by a Machine Gun in each side torso complimented by the head mounted Flamer. Carrying two and half tons of machine gun rounds, five extra Double Heat Sinks maintain a high rate of laser fire.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 据说由德克·拉迪克驾驶的蝰蛇英雄机甲"煤渣"在双臂各装一门增程大型激光器，两侧躯干各配一挺机枪，再辅以头部的火焰喷射器。它携带两吨半机枪弹，另有五具额外双重散热器以维持激光的高射速。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The E configuration has two ATM-9 launchers which can fire ammunition specialized for long, medium, and short ranges. For close combat, the 'Mech has an additional four Micro Pulse Lasers. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.01 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: E 配置装有两具 ATM-9 发射器，可发射专为远、中、近距离设计的弹药。为应对近距离战斗，该机甲另有四门微型脉冲激光。 特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：1.01 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The E configuration has two ATM-9 launchers which can fire ammunition specialized for long, medium, and short ranges. For close combat, the 'Mech has an additional four Micro Pulse Lasers.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: E配置有两具ATM-9发射器，可发射专为远、中、近距离设计的弹药。近距离作战时，该机甲另有四门微型脉冲激光器。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The E2 configuration of the Adder mounts a Large Pulse Laser in each arm and a Flamer in the center torso. All the weapon are synchronized through an advanced targeting computer. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.01 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Adder 的 E2 配置在每臂各装一门大型脉冲激光，中央躯干装一具火焰喷射器。所有武器都通过先进的瞄准计算机进行同步。 特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：1.01 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Khan Marthe Pryde decided to upgrade the 'Mechs her Clan fielded. Rather than waste precious resources designing a new OmniMech from the ground up, she instructed her scientists to improve upon existing designs. The design the scientists chose to modify was the Adder. Though the two 'Mechs are visually similar and share the same weight, the Cougar is slower and better armed.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 玛尔特·普莱德可汗决定升级其氏族装备的机甲。为不浪费宝贵资源从头设计新型全能机甲，她指示科学家改良现有设计。科学家选择改造的是蝰蛇。尽管两款机甲外观相似且重量相同，美洲狮更慢但武装更强。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The G configuration is focused on medium range engagements with its two Streak SRM-6 and four ER Medium Laser. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.01 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: G配置专注于中距离交战，依靠2具连发SRM-6和4门增程中型激光。 <特性：狭小/低矮外形 <投放费用倍率：1.01 <手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 玛尔特·普莱德可汗决定升级其氏族装备的机甲。为不浪费宝贵资源从头设计新型全能机甲，她指示科学家改良现有设计。科学家选择改造的是蝰蛇。尽管两款机甲外观相似且重量相同，美洲狮更慢但武装更强。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Codenamed Puma by Inner Sphere forces who first engaged it, the Adder is a light Clan OmniMech that serves as a direct or an indirect fire-support unit in most of its configurations. The Primary configuration has a basic but powerful arsenal of two ER PPCs which are linked to an advanced Targeting Computer, allowing the Primary configuration of the Adder to strike at long range with deadly accuracy. It also sports a flamer. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.01 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 被首次交战的内天体部队代号为"美洲狮"，蝰蛇是一款轻型氏族全能机甲，在多数配置中充当直接或间接火力支援单位。主配置装备一套基础但强大的两门 ER PPC，联接一台先进瞄准计算机，使蝰蛇主配置能以致命精度在远距离打击。它还配有一具火焰喷射器。 特质：窄小低矮轮廓 投放费用倍率：1.01 臂部驱动器限制：全能

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The only true brawling configuration of the Adder, the Adder H has two highly destructive Heavy Large Lasers as its primary weapons backed up only by the fixed Flamer. To help dissipate the 'Mech's heat, it has six additional double heat sinks. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.01 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 蝰蛇唯一真正意义上的近身近战配置，蝰蛇 H 以两门极具破坏性的重型大型激光为主武器，仅有固定的火焰喷射器作为补充。为帮助散发机甲热量，它额外安装了六台双散热器。 特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：1.01 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The only true brawling configuration of the Adder, the Adder H has two highly destructive Heavy Large Lasers as its primary weapons backed up only by the fixed Flamer. To help dissipate the 'Mech's heat, it has six additional double heat sinks.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为蝰蛇唯一真正的近战配置，蝰蛇H以两门破坏力极强的重型大型激光器为主武器，仅由固接的火焰喷射器提供后援。为帮助散发机甲热量，它另有六具额外双重散热器。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This mech was salvaged in the later stages of the wars against the clans by a innately lucky mercenary who managed to pilfer it without his employers catching wind of his new found mech. He promptly emblazoned a Large orange Corgi, a terran creature on the side of the mech and fashioned on as many of his horded parts as the poor mech engineers could jury rg on to the frame to create this monstrosity with no thought for if they SHOULD do it. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这台机甲是在对部族战争的后期被打捞出来的，打捞者是一位天生走运的雇佣兵，他把它顺手牵走而雇主毫不知情。他立刻在机甲侧面刷上一只巨大的橙色柯基——一种地球生物，并让可怜的机甲技师在机架上东拼西凑了他囤积的尽可能多的零件，造出这头怪物，全然不顾他们是否“应该”这么做。 特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：1.03

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: What has someone done to this poor Adder?
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 有人对这只可怜的蝰蛇做了什么？

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Adder-S is a is a scout configuration mounting a pair of Medium Pulse Lasers in each arm and sixteen Machine Guns to exploit any holes opened up in armor by the pulse lasers. The Adder-S also includes an Active Probe and ECM Suite to aid in detection and evasion. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.01 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 蝰蛇-S是一种侦察配置，每只手臂装有2门中型脉冲激光，另有16挺机枪，用来打击脉冲激光在装甲上撕开的缺口。蝰蛇-S还配有1具主动探测器和1套电子对抗套件，以协助探测与规避。 <特性：狭小/低矮外形 <投放费用倍率：1.01 <手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Adder-S is a is a scout configuration mounting a pair of Medium Pulse Lasers in each arm and sixteen Machine Guns to exploit any holes opened up in armor by the pulse lasers. The Adder-S also includes an Active Probe and ECM Suite to aid in detection and evasion.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 蝰蛇-S是侦察配置，每只手臂装一对中型脉冲激光，另有十六挺机枪以利用脉冲激光在装甲上打开的破口。蝰蛇-S还带一台主动探测器和一套电子对抗套件，以协助探测与规避。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A variant designed for hunting infantry and vehicles, the Adder TC was created specifically for Tukayyid. Diamond Shark politics limited the variant to a single unit, which fought and died on Tukayyid, covering the retreat of Alpha and Gamma galaxies. Powered by a 210-rated XL Engine and built with a combination of Ferro-Fibrous and Endo Steel, the Adder TC has 16 tons of pod space. 10 Machine Guns and a Small Pulse Laser make up the Anti Infantry weapons, while a Large Pulse Laser gives the TC some range. A Targeting Computer, Active Probe and an AMS fill out the remaining pod space. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.01 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Adder TC 是为猎杀步兵和车辆而设计的变型，专为图卡伊德之战打造。钻石鲨部族的内部政治使该变型仅生产了一台，它参与了图卡伊德之战并最终战损，其间掩护了阿尔法与伽马星系的撤退。Adder TC 由一台 210 级 XL 引擎驱动，采用铁纤维与内骨架的组合，拥有 16 吨挂载空间。10 挺机枪和一门小型脉冲激光构成其反步兵武器，一门大型脉冲激光则赋予 TC 一定的射程。瞄准计算机、主动探测器和一套 AMS 填满了剩余的挂载空间。 特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：1.01 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A loadout mainly fielded by the Wolf's Dragoons. Two ER Large Lasers are the main damage dealers, while a C3 slave computer and a basic ECM suite provides some extra performance. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.01 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这套配置主要由狼之龙骑兵使用。两门增程大型激光是主要的伤害输出，C3 从属计算机和一套基础电子对抗套件则提供额外性能。 特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：1.01 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A prototype LAM, the Ajax was a next generation Star League design. Following relatively successful initial trials, the Amaris Civil War rendered the design extinct, with production and testing ceasing due to the war. Designed to be easy to maintain, the Ajax uses pod mounted weapons similar to the modular weapons designed for the Mercury scout 'Mech. Though able to switch modes faster than standard LAM designs, particularly heavy loadouts still hinder the Ajax's speed and versatility. Quirk: Land Air Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为原型 LAM，阿贾克斯是星盟的次世代设计。在相对成功的初期试验之后，阿马里斯内战使该设计绝迹——生产与测试因战争而中止。阿贾克斯设计上便于维护，使用类似水星侦察机甲模块化武器的吊舱式武器。虽然它能比标准 LAM 设计更快切换模式，但过重的载荷仍会拖累阿贾克斯的速度与灵活性。 特质：陆空机甲 投放费用倍率：1.05

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: At the end of the Amaris Civil War advances in land air mechs were starting to take shape. They say that the Spider found one of these advanced prototypes and used it in a very infamous ambush on Terra in the year 3025.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 阿马里斯内战末期，陆空机甲的技术进步开始成形。据说蜘蛛找到了一台这样的先进原型机，并在 3025 年泰拉上一场臭名昭著的伏击中使用了它。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Akuma AKU-1X carries an ER PPC and a powerful LB-X Autocannon/10 as its primary long-range weapons. The latter weapon gives it a good amount of flexibility in engaging targets as the autocannon can fire both solid and cluster ammunition. For medium to close range combat, the Akuma has a MRM-30 launcher and two highly accurate short range missile launchers; a Streak SRM-6 and a Streak SRM-4 launcher. Finally, a medium laser and a Medium Pulse Laser round out the Akuma's eclectic and effective weapons payload. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 恶鬼AKU-1X以一门增程粒子炮和一门强力LB-X自动炮/10作为主要远程武器。后者让它交战时相当灵活，因为该自动炮既可发射实心弹也可发射集束弹。中近距离作战时，恶鬼有一具MRM-30发射器和两具高精度的短程火箭发射器——一具连发SRM-6和一具连发SRM-4。最后，一门中型激光和一门中型脉冲激光为恶鬼这套杂而有效的武器载荷收尾。 特性：易于维护 投放费用倍率：1.16 手臂驱动器限制：左下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Created in 3058 in response to a call from Kurita to build more cost-effective BattleMechs with which to combat the Clans, the Akuma was designed by Independence Weaponry as a low-cost alternative to their Atlas variant. The Akuma actually shares several components with the Atlas and, much like that design, also features a head design intended to evoke fear in its enemies. The Akuma is built on a Foundation AKU Endo Steel chassis and is powered by a rugged and reliable GM 270 fusion engine that allows the 'Mech to reach a top speed of 54.0 km/h. The 'Mech has thirteen double heat sinks to dissipate waste heat and carries seventeen and a half tons of Durallex Special Heavy armor for protection from enemy fire.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 恶鬼于3058年应库瑞塔家族的号召而造，当时需要更经济的战斗机甲来对抗部族；它由独立武器公司设计，作为其阿特拉斯变型的低成本替代品。恶鬼实际上与阿特拉斯共用若干部件，并与其相似地采用了意在让敌人心生恐惧的头部造型。恶鬼建在基础AKU内骨架底盘上，由一台坚固可靠的GM 270聚变引擎驱动，最高速度54.0公里/小时。它有十三个双散热器散发废热，并带十七吨半杜拉莱克斯特种重型装甲抵御敌方火力。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 2XU is an early, limited run prototype variant of what would eventually become the 2X series of the Akuma. It manages to fit an ER PPC, one LB 10-X autocannon, one MRM-40 launcher for primary firepower. As if that wasn't enough, the 'Mech also carries a Streak SRM-6 and two Medium Pulse Lasers as secondary weapons. The design does suffer from huge struggles with heat management as the cooling is far from adequate. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 2XU是阿库玛2X系列早期限量生产的原型变型。它成功塞入了一门增程粒子炮、一门LB 10-X自动炮以及一具MRM-40发射器作为主要火力。仿佛这还不够，该机甲还搭载了连发SRM-6和两门中型脉冲激光作为次要武器。由于散热能力远远不足，该设计在热量管理上极为吃力。 特性：易于维护 投放费用倍率：1.16 手臂驱动器限制：左下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Álfar AL-A1 fielded an impressive amount of firepower for its size. A PPC mounted on its right arm was the main weapon. Three medium lasers, two on the left arm and one in the head, plus a SRM-6 missile rack with 1 ton of ammo, all in the left shoulder, provided ample backup and close-range punch. Fifteen heat sinks provided good battlefield endurance. Quirk: Nimble Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 阿尔法AL-A1就体型而言火力相当可观：右臂一门粒子炮是主武器，三门中型激光（左臂两门、头部一门）加上左肩一具SRM-6导弹挂架（配1吨弹药）提供充足的后手与近程打击力。十五个散热器带来良好的战场持续力。 特性：灵巧 投放费用倍率：1.03

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Álfar, named for the elves of Germanic legend, was developed on Coventry during the reign of Archon Tracial Steiner to improve the Lyran Commonwealth Armed Forces performance in mobile BattleMech warfare, and to provide a homegrown competitor to widespread standard designs like the Griffin and Shadow Hawk. Thanks to its good speed, a jumping distance of 90 meters, 10 tons of then-cutting-edge ferro-fibrous armor, and some serious firepower, the design was popular with its pilots. It was, however, liked much less by the technical crews. Ironically, Coventry Metal Works' desire to outdo their competition proved the Álfar's downfall. The design used so many nonstandard parts that repairs and logistics quickly became a big problem. Of all the Star League Defense Force Álfars lost in the war, a full third were scrapped solely because repairing them was deemed too difficult.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 阿尔法以日耳曼传说中的精灵命名，由考文垂在大公特雷西尔·施泰纳统治时期研制，意在提升莱兰联邦武装部队在机动作战中的表现，并为狮鹫、影子鹰这类普及的标准设计提供一个本土竞争者。凭借良好的速度、90米的跳跃距离、10吨当时最前沿的铁纤维装甲以及可观的火力，该设计深受飞行员喜爱，却远不为技术地勤所喜。讽刺的是，考文垂金属厂想要压过竞争对手的愿望恰恰成了阿尔法的败因：该设计使用了太多非标准部件，使维修与后勤很快成为大问题。在战争中损失的SLDF阿尔法中，整整三分之一仅仅因为维修被判定过于困难而被拆解报废。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Nicknamed \"baby Warhammer\", this less common Dark Elf variant replaced all lasers and the SRM with a second PPC to provide a cheap fire support option at the cost of short-range capability and heat endurance. Quirk: Nimble Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这款较少见的黑暗精灵变型绰号“小风暴之锤”，它以第二门粒子炮取代所有激光和SRM，提供廉价的火力支援选项，代价是近程能力与耐热性。 特性：灵巧 投放费用倍率：1.03

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Álfar, named for the elves of Germanic legend, was developed on Coventry during the reign of Archon Tracial Steiner to improve the Lyran Commonwealth Armed Forces performance in mobile BattleMech warfare, and to provide a homegrown competitor to widespread standard designs like the Griffin and Shadow Hawk. Thanks to its good speed, a jumping distance of 90 meters, 10 tons of then-cutting-edge ferro-fibrous armor, and some serious firepower, the design was popular with its pilots. It was, however, liked much less by the technical crews. Ironically, Coventry Metal Works' desire to outdo their competition proved the Álfar's downfall. The design used so many nonstandard parts that repairs and logistics quickly became a big problem. Of all the Star League Defense Force Álfars lost in the war, a full third were scrapped solely because repairing them was deemed too difficult.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The original variant of the Ambassador was fully unarmed, but as the StarLeague started fracturing some basic defensive firepower was adding in the form of a single Small Laser. Quirk: Easy to Pilot Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.97
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Ambassador 的原始变型完全没有武装，但随着星际联盟开始分崩离析，人们以一门小型激光的形式为其添加了基本的自卫火力。 特性：易于驾驶 投放费用倍率：0.97

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Ambassador is one of the most unusual, yet luxurious, BattleMechs every built. The 15-ton ultralight 'Mech was initally custom built for diplomatic and ambassadorial duties by the StarLeague's high-ranking officers, but with time it spread through the Inner Sphere and many powerful officials and leaders started using it as a means to handle face-to-face diplomacy.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 大使是有史以来建造过的最不寻常、却又最豪华的战斗机甲之一。这种15吨超轻型机甲最初由星盟高级军官为外交与大使命而定制建造，但随着时间推移它流传至内天体各处，许多有权势的官员与领袖开始用它作为面对面外交的手段。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Debuting in 3055, the Anvil is an FWL Mech designed to work with the light Hammer fire support Mech. A heavy brawler, the Anvil is a 60-ton mech with a 300-rated Fusion Core and an Endo Steel chassis. The Anvil ANV-3M is armed with a pair of Large Pulse Lasers and a pair of Medium Lasers. A Guardian ECM Suite distorts enemy sensors. Quirk: Extended Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 铁砧于3055年首次亮相，是自由世界联盟的一款机甲，设计用于配合轻型锤式火力支援机甲作战。作为重型斗士，铁砧是60吨机甲，带300额定聚变核心和内骨架底盘。铁砧ANV-3M装有一对大型脉冲激光和一对中型激光。一套守护者电子对抗套件可干扰敌方传感器。 特性：扩展躯干旋转 投放费用倍率：1.08

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Debuting in 3055, the Anvil is an FWL Mech designed to work with the light Hammer fire support Mech. A Guardian ECM Suite distorts enemy sensors. Quirk: Extended Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Anvil 于 3055 年首次亮相，是自由世界联盟的机甲，设计上用于与轻型火力支援机甲 Hammer 协同作战。作为一款重型近身近战机甲，Anvil 重 60 吨，配备额定 300 的聚变引擎和内骨架。Anvil ANV-6M 装有两门大型脉冲激光、一门中型激光和一具 TAG。一具 Guardian 电子对抗套件可扰乱敌方传感器。 特性：扩展躯干旋转 投放费用倍率：1.08

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Debuting in 3055, the Anvil is an FWL Mech designed to work with the light Hammer fire support Mech. A heavy brawler, the Anvil is a 60-ton mech with a 300-rated Fusion Core and an Endo Steel chassis. The Anvil ANV-6M is armed with a pair of Large Pulse Lasers, a Medium Laser and a TAG. A Guardian ECM Suite distorts enemy sensors.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Debuting in 3055, the Anvil is an FWL Mech designed to work with the light Hammer fire support Mech. A heavy brawler, the Anvil is a 60-ton mech with a 240-rated Fusion Core and an Endo Steel chassis. The Anvil ANV-8M is armed with an Arrow IV and an ER Large Laser. A pair of ER Medium Lasers round out the armament, while MASC and Guardian ECM enhance the Mechs speed and defensive capabilities. Quirk: Extended Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 铁砧于3055年亮相，是自由世界联盟的机甲，设计上用于配合轻型锤式火力支援机甲作战。作为一台重型近战近战机甲，铁砧重60吨，装备一台额定240的聚变核心与内骨架底盘。铁砧ANV-8M装备一门箭IV导弹和一门增程大型激光。两门增程中型激光补全了武装，而MASC与守护者电子对抗套件则提升了该机甲的速度与防御能力。 特性：扩展躯干旋转 投放费用倍率：1.08 手臂驱动器限制：左上

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Debuting in 3055, the Anvil is an FWL Mech designed to work with the light Hammer fire support Mech. A heavy brawler, the Anvil is a 60-ton mech with a 240-rated Fusion Core and an Endo Steel chassis. The Anvil ANV-8M is armed with an Arrow IV and an ER Large Laser. A pair of ER Medium Lasers round out the armament, while MASC and Guardian ECM enhance the Mechs speed and defensive capabilities.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Created by Wolf's Dragoons in the early 3060s, this mech has a unique Prototype Light Fusion Engine alongside early production models of the Multi-Missile Launcher and an assortment of tactical munitions. Quirk: Variable Range Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.07
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这台机甲由狼之龙骑兵在3060年代初打造，配有独特的原型轻型聚变引擎，以及早期量产型多用途导弹发射器和各类战术弹药。 特性：可变距离瞄准 投放费用倍率：1.07

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Created by Wolf's Dragoons in the early 3060s, this mech has a unique Prototype Light Fusion Engine alongside early production models of the Multi-Missile Launcher and an assortment of tactical munitions.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这台机甲由狼之龙骑兵在3060年代初打造，配有独特的原型轻型聚变引擎，以及早期量产型多用途导弹发射器和各类战术弹药。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The APN-1J is armed with two medium lasers and a machine gun, which is a surprising amount of weapons for 15-ton BattleMech considering it also sports 3 tons of standard armor. The drawback is the 90 rated engine core which leads to a - for ultralights - slow movement across the battlefield. Quirk: Ubiquitous Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.97
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: APN-1J 装备两门中型激光和一挺机枪；考虑到它还披挂 3 吨标准装甲，这对一台 15 吨战斗机甲来说已是相当可观的武器配置。它的短板在于额定 90 的引擎核心，导致它在战场上的移动速度——对于超轻型机甲而言——相当缓慢。 特性：随处可见 投放费用倍率：0.97

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: As House Marik was running low of funds after the long fighting of the Reunification War they tried to find new ways to cut costs. The Apollon was born from once such project, creating a cheap 15 ton ultralight 'Mech. The design was never liked by the armed forces of the Free Worlds League due to its obvious cost-cutting measures, but although most of the produced 'Mechs have been lost as the years passed a surprising amount has somehow still stayed relevant and even found their way to other Great Houses.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 由于马里克家族在统一战争的长期作战后资金匮乏，他们试图寻找削减成本的新办法。阿波罗就诞生于这样一个项目，造出一种廉价的15吨超轻型机甲。由于明显的削减成本措施，该设计从未受到自由世界联盟武装部队的喜爱，但尽管随着岁月流逝大部分已生产的机甲都已损失，仍有数量惊人的一些不知怎么地保持了适用性，甚至流入了其他大贵族家族。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: For long range combat, the Arcas carries a ER Large Laser in each arm. When the Arcas' opponent closes, it can bring three Streak SRM-4s and a pair of Medium Pulse Lasers to bear. These accurate weapons help the second-line warrior once an enemy gets close. Fifteen double heat sinks help keep the 'Mech cool. Quirk: Protected Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 远程作战时，阿卡斯每只手臂各带一门增程大型激光。当对手逼近，阿卡斯可动用三具连发SRM-4和一对中型脉冲激光。这些精准武器在敌人靠近后帮助二线战士。十五个双散热器帮助机甲保持凉爽。 特性：受保护驱动器 投放费用倍率：1.15 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Following the move of Clan Ghost Bear to the Inner Sphere, Khan Bjorn Jorgensson ordered the creation of a new BattleMech. The Arcas was designed as a symbol to mark the beginning of a new era, so Loremaster Laurie Tseng named it after a character in the mythology of the Greeks who eventually became the constellation known as Ursa Minor. First produced in 3061, the Arcas is expensive for a second-line 'Mech. It utilizes an XL engine that enables it to move up to 86 km/h and jump jets for a maximum jump capacity of one hundred fifty meters at a time. The Arcas mounts thirteen and a half tons of standard armor, the most a 'Mech of its size can carry.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在 Ghost Bear 部族迁入内层星域之后，可汗 Bjorn Jorgensson 下令研制一款新的战斗机甲。Arcas 被设计为一个象征，用以标志新时代的开端，因此学识大师 Laurie Tseng 以希腊神话中的人物为它命名——那人最终化作了名为小熊座的星座。Arcas 于 3061 年首次投产，作为二线机甲而言价格昂贵。它采用 XL 引擎，最高可移动至 86 km/h，并配备跳跃推进器，单次最大跳跃距离可达一百五十米。Arcas 搭载十三点五吨标准装甲，这是该体型的机甲所能携带的极限。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This variant is used primarily when far from supply lines. It removes the missiles and ER Large Lasers for a pair of ER PPCs and additional double heat sinks. Quirk: Protected Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 此变型主要在远离补给线时使用。它拆掉导弹和增程大型激光，换成一对增程粒子炮和额外双散热器。 特性：受保护驱动器 投放费用倍率：1.15 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

The Arcas was designed as a symbol to mark the beginning of a new era, so Loremaster Laurie Tseng named it after a character in the mythology of the Greeks who eventually became the constellation known as Ursa Minor. First produced in 3061, the Arcas is expensive for a second-line 'Mech. It utilizes an XL engine that enables it to move up to 86 km/h and jump jets for a maximum jump capacity of one hundred fifty meters at a time. The Arcas mounts thirteen and a half tons of standard armor, the most a 'Mech of its size can carry.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A customized variant of the Arctic Cheetah piloted by Eva Hordwon, the Shard carries two ER Medium Lasers in each arm, supported by twin Heavy Machine Guns in the right torso and a left torso-mounted Streak SRM-4. A single ton of Streak missiles and a ton and a half of HMG ammo give the Shard good endurance. Quirk: Protected Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.02 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 由伊娃·霍德翁驾驶的 Arctic Cheetah 定制改型，Shard 每臂各带两门增程中型激光，右躯干配双联重型机枪，左躯干装有一具连发 SRM-4。一吨连发导弹和一吨半的重型机枪弹药让 Shard 具备良好的持续作战能力。 特性：受保护驱动器 投放费用倍率：1.02 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A sleek, mobile, and versatile design, the Clan Arctic Cheetah was long suspected to be one of the first OmniMechs produced by the Clans.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为一款流线型、机动且多用途的设计，氏族极地猎豹长期被认为是最早由氏族生产的全能机甲之一。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A special configuration of the Arctic Cheetah used for batchall, the ritualistic combat challenge between Clan warriors. Two Heavy Medium Lasers and two SRM-6 launchers are the main damage dealers, but a pair of Micro Pulse Lasers and a Flamer gives better close combat capabilities. Quirk: Protected Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Arctic Cheetah 用于 batchall（部族战士之间仪式性的战斗挑战）的特殊配置。两台重型中型激光和两部 SRM-6 发射器是主要的输出手段，而两门微型脉冲激光和一门火焰喷射器则提升了近战能力。 特性：受保护驱动器 投放费用倍率：0.99 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A sleek, mobile, and versatile design, the Clan Arctic Cheetah was long suspected to be one of the first OmniMechs produced by the Clans.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为一款流线型、机动且多用途的设计，氏族极地猎豹长期被认为是最早由氏族生产的全能机甲之一。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The design of the Arctic Wolf is simple: get close, unleash a torrent of missiles, and get out. To do this, it is armed with six Type 1 SRM Six-Shooters and two Type 1 Cross-Pattern SRM-4 Launchers. Aiding the accuracy of these missiles is the Tracker Series Narc Missile Beacon. The Arctic Wolf also boasts an impressive four tons of ammunition for its launchers. The 'Mech has ten double heat sinks which can be overwhelmed, but only if a MechWarrior insists on staying in the fight or going full-tilt for long periods. The Arctic Wolf is protected by six tons of standard armor. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Short Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 北极狼（Arctic Wolf）的设计思路很简单：贴近、倾泻导弹、然后撤离。为此，它装备了六具 1 型 SRM 六连发器和两具 1 型交叉弹道 SRM-4 发射器。追踪者系列 Narc 导弹信标则提升了这些导弹的命中精度。北极狼还拥有令人瞩目的四吨发射器弹药储备。该机甲装有十台双散热器，只有当机甲战士执意长时间持续作战或全力输出时，散热器才可能不堪重负。北极狼由六吨标准装甲提供防护。 特性：改进瞄准 - 近距 投放费用倍率：1.08 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The design of the Arctic Wolf is simple: get close, unleash a torrent of missiles, and get out. To do this, it is armed with six Type 1 SRM Six-Shooters and two Type 1 Cross-Pattern SRM-4 Launchers. Aiding the accuracy of these missiles is the Tracker Series Narc Missile Beacon. The Arctic Wolf also boasts an impressive four tons of ammunition for its launchers. The 'Mech has ten double heat sinks which can be overwhelmed, but only if a MechWarrior insists on staying in the fight or going full-tilt for long periods. The Arctic Wolf is protected by six tons of standard armor.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This variant replaces the SRM-4s and two SRM-6s with an Alpha Series large pulse laser. This gives the 'Mech some long-range capability and provides it with a punch weapon, as well as increased accuracy and a reduction on ammunition dependency. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Short Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该变型用一门Alpha系列大型脉冲激光替换了SRM-4和两具SRM-6。这为机甲带来了一定的远程作战能力，也赋予它一件重击武器，同时提升了精度并降低了对弹药的依赖。 特性：改进瞄准 - 短距 投放费用倍率：1.08 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The very first Argus Design spec's that was rejected by the AFFCS, while being a lot more flexible then contemporary Chassis did its more advanced and rare components make it unfit for larger Engagements. Quirk: Advanced Missile TTS Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是最早被 AFFCS 否决的 Argus 设计方案。虽然它比同时代的底盘灵活得多，但其更先进、更稀有的组件令它不适合大规模交战。 特性：高级导弹瞄准系统 投放费用倍率：1.03 手臂驱动器限制：全向机甲

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The very first Argus Design spec's that was rejected by the AFFCS, while being a lot more flexible then contemporary Chassis did its more advanced and rare components make it unfit for larger Engagements.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是阿格斯设计规格的最初版本，被AFFCS否决；虽然它比同时代底盘灵活得多，但更先进、更稀有的部件使它不适合大规模交战。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: One of several variants that attempt to modernize the weaponry of the AS7-D. The AS7-8D replaces the AC/20 with a Gauss Rifle, adds Artemis IV support to the LRM launcher and upgrade to Medium Pulse Lasers over the standard ones. Further, the SRM is replaced with a Streak SRM and both a Guardian ECM Suiote and a Beagle Active Probe were added. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是在为 AS7-D 的武器进行现代化改造的若干变型之一。AS7-8D 以高斯步枪取代 AC/20，为 LRM 发射器加装 Artemis IV 辅助系统，并将标准中型激光升级为中型脉冲激光。此外，SRM 被换成连发 SRM，同时还加装了一套 Guardian ECM 套件和一台 Beagle 主动探测器。 特性：战拳 投放费用倍率：1.18

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Atlas is the king of the battlefield, capable of bringing a dizzying array of weapons to bear on targets at any range. It is also noteworthy for normally mounting the maximum amount of armor possible. Few opponents can survive even brief contact with this monster.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 阿特拉斯是战场之王，能在任何距离上向目标倾泻令人目眩的各类武器。它还以通常装备可容纳的最大装甲量而著称。很少有对手能在与这头怪物短暂接触后幸存。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An upgrade of the original -D, this variant uses an Endo Steel chassis to fit more Lasers and add Artemis IV FCS to the missile launchers. The Autocannon is also switch to a more accurate Gauss Rifle. The downside of all the energy weapons is the fact the 'Mech overheats very easily, event after the switch to Double Heat Sinks. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是对原版-D的升级，此变型采用内骨架底盘以装入更多激光，并为导弹发射器加装阿尔忒弥斯IV火控系统；自动炮也换成更精准的高斯步枪。这些能量武器的缺点是该机甲极易过热，即便改用了双散热器也是如此。 特性：战拳 投放费用倍率：1.18

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Atlas is the king of the battlefield, capable of bringing a dizzying array of weapons to bear on targets at any range. It is also noteworthy for normally mounting the maximum amount of armor possible. Few opponents can survive even brief contact with this monster.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 阿特拉斯是战场之王，能在任何距离上向目标倾泻令人目眩的各类武器。它还以通常装备可容纳的最大装甲量而著称。很少有对手能在与这头怪物短暂接触后幸存。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The AS7 'Boar's Head' is a little-seen trial Atlas run that attempted to make a more mobile striker assault 'Mech while still maintaining the dreaded reputation of the Atlas. Among Defiance's changes included routing all the energy weapon power couplings to the arms - 3 in each - and a massive XL engine. Ultimately, the AS7-BH proved too fragile and vulnerable to weapons loss for it's weight and altogether excessive cost. Quirk: Intimidating Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.2
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: AS7“野猪头”是一批鲜为人知的试验型阿特拉斯，试图在保留阿特拉斯令人畏惧的名声的同时，打造一台更具机动性的突击机甲。Defiance所做的改动包括将所有能量武器的供电耦合全部改走手臂——每条手臂三组——以及一具巨大的XL引擎。最终，AS7-BH被证明对于其吨位而言过于脆弱、极易损失武器，而且造价高得离谱。 特性：威慑 投放费用倍率：1.2

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The AS7 'Boar's Head' is a little-seen trial Atlas run that attempted to make a more mobile striker assault 'Mech while still maintaining the dreaded reputation of the Atlas. Among Defiance's changes included routing all the energy weapon power couplings to the arms - 3 in each - and a massive XL engine. Ultimately, the AS7-BH proved too fragile and vulnerable to weapons loss for it's weight and altogether excessive cost.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: AS7"野猪头"是一种鲜为人知的试验型阿特拉斯型号，试图在保持阿特拉斯那可怕名声的同时，把它做成更具机动性的打击型突击机甲。反抗所做的改动包括把所有能量武器的电力耦合线路都引向双臂——每臂3条——以及一具巨大的XL引擎。最终，AS7-BH被证明就其重量而言过于脆弱、太容易损失武器，而且成本过高。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Atlas C is the result of the first rudimentary refit protocol created for the Atlas C, which upgraded the weapons, and was later commonly implemented on captured Inner Sphere Atlases during Operation Revival Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Atlas C 源于为 Atlas C 制订的第一套初级改装方案，该方案升级了武器，后来在复兴行动期间被广泛用于改装缴获的内层星域 Atlas。 特性：战拳 投放费用倍率：1.16

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Atlas is the king of the battlefield, capable of bringing a dizzying array of weapons to bear on targets at any range. It is also noteworthy for normally mounting the maximum amount of armor possible. Few opponents can survive even brief contact with this monster.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: After the success of the initial conversion protocol of the Atlas C, the C-2 is a more thorough upgrade that replaces the LRMs with an additional ER PPC and the rest of the weapons with superior clan versions. The C-2 protocol is the most common conversion to be implemented on Atlases and Atlas IIs in Clan space. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.22
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在 Atlas C 的初步改装方案取得成功之后，C-2 是一次更为彻底的升级：它用一门额外的增程粒子炮取代了 LRM，并将其余武器全部更换为性能更优的部族版本。C-2 改装方案是部族领地上 Atlas 与 Atlas II 最常采用的改装形式。 特性：战拳 投放费用倍率：1.22

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Atlas is the king of the battlefield, capable of bringing a dizzying array of weapons to bear on targets at any range. It is also noteworthy for normally mounting the maximum amount of armor possible. Few opponents can survive even brief contact with this monster.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 阿特拉斯是战场之王，能在任何距离上向目标倾泻令人目眩的各类武器。它还以通常装备可容纳的最大装甲量而著称。很少有对手能在与这头怪物短暂接触后幸存。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A more uncommon clan conversion than the C 2, the Atlas C 3 removes some of the original weapon systems to fit a giant Arrow IV artillery system in the left torso. In the right torso a Gauss Rifle is mounted, and each arm also carries a ER Large Laser. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.22
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Atlas C 3 是比 C 2 更为罕见的部族改装型。它拆除了部分原有武器系统，以便在左躯干内安装一套巨大的 Arrow IV 火炮系统。右躯干内装有一门高斯步枪，每条手臂还各携有一门增程大型激光。 特性：战拳 投放费用倍率：1.22

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Atlas is the king of the battlefield, capable of bringing a dizzying array of weapons to bear on targets at any range. It is also noteworthy for normally mounting the maximum amount of armor possible. Few opponents can survive even brief contact with this monster.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 阿特拉斯是战场之王，能在任何距离上向目标倾泻令人目眩的各类武器。它还以通常装备可容纳的最大装甲量而著称。很少有对手能在与这头怪物短暂接触后幸存。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The personal 'Mech of General Caesar Steiner of the Lyran Alliance, the Duke of Furilo and son to Margrave Iris Steiner. The 'Mech is ostensibly designated AS7-CS, but referred to as the 'Dämmerung' by most. It mounts a massive weaponry spread thanks to it’s advanced XL engine. Using the weight savings, the Medium Lasers that once rested in the forearms are replaced by Large Pulse Lasers, mounted underslung on the forearms. Regarding the Gauss rifle as the next evolution of heavy-bore ballistic weapons, the Archon requested that one with an ample ammo supply replaced the Atlas' AC/20. The SRM magazine was completely removed and the LRM magazine downsized to make room for an ER Large Laser along the ‘Mech’s centerline, and the arsenal is rounded out by hip-mounted Medium Lasers. This broad spread of weapons allows for the design to bring the bulk of its weapons to bear at any range Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.2
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是莱兰联盟 Caesar Steiner 将军的私人座机——他是 Furilo 公爵，也是边区伯爵 Iris Steiner 之子。该机甲名义上的编号为 AS7-CS，但大多数人称其为“Dämmerung”。凭借先进的 XL 引擎，它搭载了极为庞大的武器配置。利用节省下来的重量，曾置于前臂的中型激光被替换为吊挂在前臂下方的大型脉冲激光。执政官将高斯步枪视为大口径实弹武器的下一步进化，因此要求用一门弹药充足的高斯步枪取代 Atlas 的 AC/20。SRM 弹仓被完全拆除，LRM 弹仓则缩减容量，以便沿机甲中轴线装入一门增程大型激光；其武器库最后由臀侧安装的中型激光补足。如此广泛的武器分布使该设计能在任何距离上倾泻其大部分火力。 特性：战拳 投放费用倍率：1.2

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Atlas is the king of the battlefield, capable of bringing a dizzying array of weapons to bear on targets at any range. It is also noteworthy for normally mounting the maximum amount of armor possible. Few opponents can survive even brief contact with this monster.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 阿特拉斯是战场之王，能在任何距离上向目标倾泻令人目眩的各类武器。它还以通常装备可容纳的最大装甲量而著称。很少有对手能在与这头怪物短暂接触后幸存。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A Clan-tech retrofit of the AS7-D Atlas, the Atlas C replaced the older autocannon and missile launchers with a Clan standard Ultra AC/20, Swarm LRM compatible LRM-20, and Streak SRM-6 launchers; but the Inner Sphere Medium Lasers remained unchanged. Lighter Clan components allowed the Atlas C to carry 3 tons of autocannon ammunition. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Atlas C是AS7-D Atlas的部族科技改装型，以部族标准型Ultra AC/20、兼容Swarm LRM的LRM-20以及连发SRM-6发射器取代了旧式的自动炮与导弹发射器；但内层星域的中型激光则保持不变。更轻的部族部件让Atlas C得以携带3吨自动炮弹药。 特性：指挥机甲 投放费用倍率：1.18

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A Clan-tech retrofit of the AS7-D Atlas, the Atlas C replaced the older autocannon and missile launchers with a Clan standard Ultra AC/20, Swarm LRM compatible LRM-20, and Streak SRM-6 launchers; but the Inner Sphere Medium Lasers remained unchanged. Lighter Clan components allowed the Atlas C to carry 3 tons of autocannon ammunition.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 阿特拉斯 C 是 AS7-D 阿特拉斯的氏族技术改装型，它把较旧的自动炮和导弹发射器换成氏族标准超速 AC/20、兼容蜂群 LRM 的 LRM-20 和连续 SRM-6 发射器；但内天体中型激光保持不变。更轻的氏族组件使阿特拉斯 C 能携带 3 吨自动炮弹药。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Piloted by Wolf's Dragoons Captain Danielle Rondema, this modified Atlas carried three medium lasers in each arm, trading away the SRM rack to do so. The additional heat was dissipated by two additional heat sinks that replaced the rear-firing medium lasers. Quirk: Intimidating Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.2
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这台改装过的阿特拉斯由沃尔夫龙骑兵的丹妮尔·隆德马上尉驾驶，为此每只手臂各装了三门中型激光，代价是舍弃了SRM发射巢。由此产生的额外热量由两个额外散热器散逸，它们取代了朝后射击的中型激光。 特性：威慑 投放费用倍率：1.2

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Piloted by Wolf's Dragoons Captain Danielle Rondema, this modified Atlas carried three medium lasers in each arm, trading away the SRM rack to do so. The additional heat was dissipated by two additional heat sinks that replaced the rear-firing medium lasers.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 由狼族龙骑兵上尉丹妮尔·龙德玛驾驶，这台改装阿特拉斯在双臂各装三门中型激光器，为此拆掉了SRM架。额外的热量由两具额外散热器散发——它们替换了向后开火的中型激光器。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Used by Vayil Oonthrax on Solaris VII this variant of the Atlas removed the LRM-20 for another SRM-6, more SRM-6 ammunition and Heat Sinks. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这款Atlas改型由Vayil Oonthrax在Solaris VII上使用，它拆除了LRM-20，换装另一具SRM-6、更多SRM-6弹药以及散热器。 特性：战拳 投放费用倍率：1.18

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Atlas is the king of the battlefield, capable of bringing a dizzying array of weapons to bear on targets at any range. It is also noteworthy for normally mounting the maximum amount of armor possible. Few opponents can survive even brief contact with this monster.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 阿特拉斯是战场之王，能在任何距离上向目标倾泻令人目眩的各类武器。它还以通常装备可容纳的最大装甲量而著称。很少有对手能在与这头怪物短暂接触后幸存。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Atlas AS7-D-CE replaces the AC/20 from the standard model with the newly developed LB 20-X autocannon, and the LRM and SRM launchers with improved versions. To lower weight of the new technology even makes it possible to add two more heat sinks and more ammunition. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Atlas AS7-D-CE 用新研制的 LB 20-X 自动炮替换了标准型号的 AC/20，并将 LRM 与 SRM 发射器换成改进型。新技术带来的重量下降甚至使其可以再加装两台散热器和更多弹药。 特性：战拳 投放费用倍率：1.16

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: When the Star League Defense Force left the Inner Sphere under Commanding General Aleksandr Kerensky during Operation Exodus, they brought with them many of the most common 'Mechs. As the SLDF-in-exile slowly started turning into the Clans, they started developing improved weapons, which they mounted on their existing armies of 'Mech. These weapons are commonly called Clan Early, and as such the Mech's using them got the -CE suffix added to their designation.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 当星盟防卫军在"出埃及"行动中随总指挥官亚历山大·克伦斯基离开内天体时，他们带走了许多最常见的机甲。随着流亡的星盟防卫军逐渐演变为氏族，他们开始研发改进型武器，并装到已有的机甲部队上。这类武器通常被称为"氏族早期型"，使用它们的机甲编号因此带上了 -CE 后缀。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The AS7-DRR is a refit of the AS7-D, replacing the AC/20 with a Gauss Rifle, allowing the addition of two more Medium Lasers and Artemis IV Support for the launchers. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: AS7-DRR是AS7-D的改装型，以一门高斯步枪取代AC/20，从而得以加装两门额外的中型激光，并为发射器增加Artemis IV支援。 特性：战拳 投放费用倍率：1.18

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A classic variant of the AS7-D used by the Lyran Commonwealth, the AS7-H trades the autocannon and LRM 20 for a smaller LRM 10, a trio of Large Lasers and a huge hatchet. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是莱兰联邦所使用的 AS7-D 经典变型。AS7-H 以更小的 LRM 10、三门大型激光和一把巨大的战斧替换了自动炮与 LRM 20。 特性：战拳 投放费用倍率：1.16

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Atlas is the king of the battlefield, capable of bringing a dizzying array of weapons to bear on targets at any range. It is also noteworthy for normally mounting the maximum amount of armor possible. Few opponents can survive even brief contact with this monster.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 阿特拉斯是战场之王，能在任何距离上向目标倾泻令人目眩的各类武器。它还以通常装备可容纳的最大装甲量而著称。很少有对手能在与这头怪物短暂接触后幸存。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A partial clan refit used by some of the high-end mercenary outfits, based of their gathered loot. A few have also been stolen by Pirates or gone missing under suspicious circumstances. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一种部分采用部族技术改装的型号，由一些高端雇佣兵部队根据其搜集到的战利品改造而成。也有少数被海盗盗走，或在可疑的情况下不翼而飞。 特性：战拳 投放费用倍率：1.18

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为Solaris VII的定制机甲登场，“Kraken”与该型号非常相似，很可能是在标准AS7-K的底盘上建造的，只是将中型脉冲激光换成了标准型号。 特性：威慑 投放费用倍率：1.2

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A Large Laser refit of the AS7-D, reducing the LRM launcher to 15 tubes and the Autocannon to an AC/10 to be able to fit a Large Laser in each arm. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是 AS7-D 的大型激光改装型：将 LRM 发射器减少到 15 管，自动炮改为 AC/10，从而能在每条手臂各装入一门大型激光。 特性：战斗铁拳 投放费用倍率：1.16

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A mercenary refit of the Atlas, mounting a Gauss Rifle, the stock LRM-20 launcher and two ER Large Lasers. Two Medium Pulse Lasers provide close fire support. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是Atlas的雇佣兵改装版，搭载一门高斯步枪、原装LRM-20发射器和两门增程大型激光。两门中型脉冲激光提供近距离火力支援。 特性：战拳 投放费用倍率：1.18

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Atlas AS7-MCJ is similar to the -MCA, but drops a ton of armor and uses an endo steel chassis to fit three Jump Jets. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Another typical Export from the Gamesworld is this Atlas redesigned around an Articulated and 3 Directional Jump Jets, to close in and punch the Enemy with its Hydraulic Fists. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.2
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 又一款来自游戏世界的典型出口型号：这台阿特拉斯围绕铰接式结构与3台定向跳跃推进器重新设计，以便逼近敌人，用它的液压铁拳痛击对手。 特性：战斗铁拳 投放费用倍率：1.2

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为游戏世界的另一种典型出口产品，这台阿特拉斯围绕一具铰接式与3具定向跳跃推进器重新设计，以便逼近并用液压拳击打敌人。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The personal 'Mech of Galedon Military District commander Warlord Grieg Samsonov during the DCMS's Third Succession War invasion of Galtor III in 3025, only the massive autocannon remains, with the rest of the standard weaponry replaced with a PPC mounted in each arm. The remaining weight and space is devoted to six additional heat sinks. Quirk: Intimidating Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.2
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这台机甲是加勒登军区指挥官、军阀格里格·萨姆索诺夫在3025年DCMS第三次继承战争入侵加尔托III时的座机，它只保留了那门巨大的自动炮，其余标准武器被替换为每条手臂各装一门粒子炮。剩余的重量和空间则用于加装六台额外散热器。 特性：威吓 投放费用倍率：1.2

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The personal 'Mech of Galedon Military District commander Warlord Grieg Samsonov during the DCMS's Third Succession War invasion of Galtor III in 3025, only the massive autocannon remains, with the rest of the standard weaponry replaced with a PPC mounted in each arm. The remaining weight and space is devoted to six additional heat sinks. While lacking much of the close-range weaponry of the AS7-D, this unusual, modified variant was highly effective in a Direct Fire Support Role.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是加勒登军区指挥官格雷格·萨姆索诺夫领主在3025年DCMS第三次继承战争入侵加尔特III时的私人机甲，如今只剩下那门巨大的自动炮，其余标准武器被替换为双臂各一门PPC。剩余重量与空间用于六具额外散热器。虽然缺少AS7-D的大部分近距离武器，这一不寻常的改装改型在直射火力支援角色上极为有效。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Atlas AS7-ZL was originally part of the the DCMS, but it was converted to the personal 'Mech of Zackary Lee by Free Rasalhague engineers after its capture. Due to its severe damage much of its equipment had to be either painstakingly restored or completely scrapped. The internal structure and 300-rated Fusion powerplant was kept the same, but most of the weapons were either replaced by similar ones of a different make or new ones. The main weapon of the original Atlas AS7-D was too damage to repair, and instead got replaced with a Gauss Rifle for increased precision. Since most of the armor was practically missing, the technicians took the chance to upgrade the 'Mech to use Ferro-Fibrous armor. For similar reasons the cooling system was rebuilt from scratch using double heat sinks rather than standard. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.2
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 阿特拉斯AS7-ZL原本隶属于龙脉联合体军方，但在被缴获后，由自由拉塞哈格的工程师改装成扎卡里·李的专属机甲。由于损伤严重，它的许多设备要么被费尽心力地修复，要么被彻底废弃。内部结构与额定300的聚变动力装置保持不变，但大部分武器不是被不同厂商的同类产品替换，就是换成了全新的型号。原版阿特拉斯AS7-D的主武器损伤过重而无法修复，于是被换成一门高斯步枪以提升精准度。由于装甲几乎荡然无存，技术人员趁机将机甲升级为铁纤维装甲。出于类似的原因，冷却系统也从头重建，改用双散热器而非标准散热器。 特性：战斗铁拳 投放费用倍率：1.2

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An late Clan Invasion era variant created as an attempt to counter certain Clan 'Mechs. Each side torso carries a Gauss Rifle and both arms an ER Large Laser. A chest mounted LRM-10 provides some indirect fire capabilities. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是部族入侵晚期的一种变型，为对抗某些部族机甲而造。两侧躯干各装一门高斯步枪，双臂各一门增程大型激光，胸口一具LRM-10提供一定的间接火力。 特性：战拳 投放费用倍率：1.18

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Atlas is the king of the battlefield, capable of bringing a dizzying array of weapons to bear on targets at any range. It is also noteworthy for normally mounting the maximum amount of armor possible. Few opponents can survive even brief contact with this monster.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The custom version used by Nicholas Kerensky, this version of the Atlas II retains the weapon array of the original but swaps the Inner Sphere components for more advanced Clan equivalents. It also adds a second SRM launcher. All the missile systems are equipped with Artemis IV fire control systems. Double heat sinks were replaced with their less bulky Clan equivalents and increased to nineteen. The ferro-fibrous armor protection remains the same, but again was replaced by more compact Clan version. To handle electronic warfare duties, a small ECM Suite and Active Probe were added to the center torso. The CASE systems were integrated into the side torsos, as was common to all Clan designs. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.24
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是尼古拉斯·克伦斯基使用的定制版本，这台阿特拉斯II保留了原型的武器阵列，但把内层星域的部件换成更先进的部族同类产品。它还增加了一具SRM发射器。所有导弹系统都配备了Artemis IV火控系统。双散热器被替换为体积更小的部族同类产品，数量增至十九台。铁纤维装甲的防护水平保持不变，但同样换成了更紧凑的部族版本。为承担电子战任务，中央躯干加装了一套小型电子对抗套件和主动探测器。CASE系统被整合进左右躯干，这也是所有部族设计的通行做法。 特性：战拳 投放费用倍率：1.24

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: First fielded in 2765, the Atlas II was designed by the Hegemony Research and Development Department, Weapons Division of the original Star League to maintain the technological edge over the other Great Houses. It was exclusively for the SLDF's Royal Regiments. In 2785, when General Aleksandr Kerensky put out his call for loyal forces to join him in his Exodus, every Atlas II pilot responded and left with him. The Atlas II is armed with an array of weaponry, including an LB-X Autocannon/10, a pair of ER Large Lasers, and a 20-tube Long Range Missile Launcher for long range attacks. For close range combat, the 'Mech is equipped with a pair of Medium Pulse Lasers and a Holly Six Pack. In addition, the 'Mech has been given CASEfor both sides of the torso in order to keep an ammunition cook-off from consuming the 'Mech.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 阿特拉斯 II 于 2765 年首次投入战场，由原星盟的霸权研发部武器司设计，以维持对各大议院的技术优势。它专供星盟防卫军皇家团使用。2785 年亚历山大·克伦斯基将军号召忠诚部队随他出埃及时，每一位阿特拉斯 II 飞行员都响应并随他离开。阿特拉斯 II 装备一系列武器，包括一门 LB-X 自动炮/10、两门 ER 大型激光和一具 20 管远程导弹发射器用于远程攻击。近距离战斗则配备两门中型脉冲激光和一具冬青六联装。此外，机甲两侧躯干都装有 C.A.S.E.，以防弹药殉爆吞噬整机。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A customized variant of the stock AWS-9M model that was utilized by Adam Steiner during the 1st Somerset Strikers' liberation of Somerset in the midst of the Clan Invasion. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是库存 AWS-9M 型号的定制变型，曾在部族入侵期间由亚当·施泰纳在第一萨默塞特突击队解放萨默塞特的行动中使用。 特性：指挥机甲 投放费用倍率：1.16 手臂驱动器限制：右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Awesome is traditionally used in a vanguard role when penetrating enemy defenses. The Awesome's massive firepower also lends it to defensive actions, acting as a mobile turret when necessary. Because of its reliance on PPCs, the Awesome is able to act independently for extended periods of time. This trait is also useful in siege situations where the 'Mech can keep up a constant barrage, allowing it to win battles of attrition through bleeding an enemy dry. The only downsides to the Awesome is its low maneuverability and lack of rear-facing weaponry, making it vulnerable to being outflanked and surrounded by lighter 'Mechs, although good intelligence and a well-deployed screening force can mitigate this issue.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 神奇传统上在突破敌方防御时担任先锋。神奇庞大的火力也使它适合防御行动，必要时充当移动炮塔。由于依赖 PPC，神奇能够长时间独立作战。这一特性在围攻情境中也很有用，机甲可以持续不断地轰击，通过放干敌人的血来赢下消耗战。神奇唯一的缺点是机动性低、缺乏后向武器，因此容易被轻型机甲侧翼包抄并包围，尽管良好的情报与部署得当的屏护部队可以缓解这一问题。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Danielle Peterson's Awesome, the 'Pretty Baby' Hero 'Mech has some unexpected speed, achieved through the use of an 340-rated Extralight Engine. The Pretty Baby (serial number AWS8V99TG-2957) also features a unique weapon loadout as well - mounting a standard PPC in the right arm, a LRM-15 in the right torso, a Medium Laser in the head, Large Laser in the left torso and an SRM-4 in the left arm. 19 Double Heat Sinks, two tons of LRM and three of SRM missiles keep it in the thick of battle. Quirk: Combat Computer Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 丹妮尔·彼得森的 Awesome，即英雄机甲“Pretty Baby”，拥有出人意料的速度，这得益于一台 340 级超轻型引擎。Pretty Baby（序列号 AWS8V99TG-2957）还拥有独一无二的武器配置：右臂一门标准粒子炮、右躯干一门 LRM-15、头部一门中型激光、左躯干一门大型激光，左臂一具 SRM-4。19 个双散热器、两吨 LRM 弹药和三吨 SRM 导弹让它能在激战中持续作战。 特性：战斗计算机 投放费用倍率：1.16 手臂驱动器限制：右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Danielle Peterson's Awesome, the 'Pretty Baby' Hero 'Mech has some unexpected speed, achieved through the use of an 340-rated Extralight Engine. The Pretty Baby (serial number AWS8V99TG-2957) also features a unique weapon loadout as well - mounting a standard PPC in the right arm, a LRM-15 in the right torso, a Medium Laser in the head, Large Laser in the left torso and an SRM-4 in the left arm. 19 Double Heat Sinks, two tons of LRM and three of SRM missiles keep it in the thick of battle.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 丹妮尔·彼得森的恐怖，"俏宝贝"英雄机甲有着出人意料的速度，这是靠一具340级超轻型引擎实现的。俏宝贝（序列号AWS8V99TG-2957）还有一套独特的武器载荷——右臂装一门标准PPC，右躯干一具LRM-15，头部一门中型激光器，左躯干一门大型激光器，左臂一具SRM-4。19具双重散热器、两吨LRM和三吨SRM导弹让它留在激战中心。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Bandersnatch, named after the monster in Lewis Carroll's 'Wonderland' series, is the brainchild of Felifious Bander and is built around the concept of an affordable and effective BattleMech for sale to mercenary units. The Bandersnatch shares most of its components with the Marauder, making the 'Mech cheaper and easier to repair. The Bandersnatch uses double heat sinks for superior heat dissipation capabilities, allowing a heavier weapons payload. Further, the Bandersnatch carries a respectable eleven tons of armor. While not the maximum amount of armor that the chassis can handle, the 'Mech is still well protected. The primary armaments are for long to medium range combat, a trio of Holly LRM-5 missile launchers and a pair of Armstrong Class-B ClusterGuns LB-X Autocannon/10s that fire both solid and cluster rounds. In the event that an enemy does close to short ranges, the 'Mech carries six Magna Mk II Medium Lasers, two of which are rear mounted, giving it good close range protection. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Bandersnatch 得名于刘易斯·卡罗尔《仙境》系列中的怪物，是 Felifious Bander 的心血之作，其设计理念是为雇佣兵部队提供一款价格适中且战力可靠的战斗机甲。Bandersnatch 的大部分组件与 Marauder 通用，因此造价更低，也更易于维修。它采用双散热器，散热能力出色，可承载更重的武器载荷。此外，Bandersnatch 还披挂令人称道的十一吨装甲。虽然尚未达到该底盘所能承受的最大装甲量，这台机甲的防护仍相当完备。主要军备面向中远距交战：三具 Holly LRM-5 导弹发射器和两门 Armstrong Class-B ClusterGuns LB-X 自动炮/10，可发射实心弹与集束弹。一旦敌人逼近到近距离，该机甲还携有六门 Magna Mk II 中型激光，其中两门朝后安装，为其提供良好的近距离防护。 特性：稳定 投放费用倍率：1.11 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Ware the frumious Bandersnatch, because a terror she is to all, dangerous as the knout. Passing through quick, as a minute on yonder clock, she speeds ahead with fang and claw soon at your throat. Best to lie down it is, otherwise her meal you are, crossing the Styx faster than on Charon's boat. Ware the Bandersnatch, deadly and fast, leaving none the room to gloat.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 当心那只暴躁的班德斯纳奇，因为她对众生皆是恐怖，危险如同皮鞭。她一闪而过，快如钟上的一分钟，獠牙与利爪旋即抵上你的咽喉。最好还是躺下吧，否则你就会成为她的餐食，跨过冥河比坐卡戎的船还快。当心班德斯纳奇，致命而迅捷，不留任何人得意的时间。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A unique customized Bandersnatch which was created for ex-Nova Cat MechWarrior Horus. Equipped with Endo Steel, the 'Mech's weaponry had been almost completely refitted with the exception of the rear-firing Medium Lasers. In each arm, the 'Mech has been given a Class 20 Autocannon. It has 2 tons of CASE protected ammunition for the cannons in each side torso. For long-range firepower, it was fitted with a torso-mounted ER Large Laser. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.13 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一具独一无二的定制 Bandersnatch，专为新星猫部族的前机甲战士 Horus 打造。该机甲配备内骨架，除朝后射击的中型激光外，武器几乎全部重新改装。每只手臂各装有一门 20 级自动炮。两侧躯干各有 2 吨受 CASE 保护的自动炮弹药。为获得远程火力，它还搭载了一具安装在躯干上的增程大型激光。 特性：稳定 投放费用倍率：1.13 手臂驱动器限制：左下臂、右下臂

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: I can see what the guy was aiming for, Boss. I just am not sure this was the right way to do it. Sure, the 'Mech can cause a big thud, but what if you miss...
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我能看出那家伙想干什么，老大。我只是不确定这是不是正确的做法。的确，这台机甲能砸出很大的动静，可要是你没打中呢……

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A custom design of the Bandersnatch from an mostly unknown designer know as 'Tricky Dick'. Very little is known of this 'Mech beyond its basic parameters. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.13 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是Bandersnatch的一款定制设计，出自一位几乎无人知晓、人称“滑头迪克”的设计师之手。除了基本参数之外，人们对这台机甲几乎一无所知。 特性：稳定 投放费用倍率：1.13 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Huh. Where did you find this one, Boss? Don't think I ever seen a Bandersnatch like it before. No idea why the changes though, it doesn't seem that different from the normal variants.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 嗯。你从哪儿找到这台，老板？我觉得自己从没见过这样的班德斯纳奇。不过我不知道为什么会有这些改动，它似乎和常规变型没多大差别。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Bane is a BattleMech that is based upon a Star League prototype that was never put into production. Tagged the Kraken by Inner Sphere forces who opposed it, the Bane was first built in 2827. It was originally a significant part of many Clan toumans, but was gradually relegated to second-line status following the introduction of the OmniMech. As such, it is still critical to many defensive units. Quirk: Extended Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.22 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 灾星是一款以从未投产的星际联盟原型为基础的战斗机甲。它被对抗它的内层星域部队称作“海怪”，于2827年首次建造。它原本是许多部族部队的重要组成部分，但在全向机甲出现后逐渐被降为二线地位，即便如此，对许多防御单位而言它仍至关重要。 特性：扩展躯干旋转 投放费用倍率：1.22 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Bane is a BattleMech that is based upon a Star League prototype that was never put into production. Tagged the Kraken by Inner Sphere forces who opposed it, the Bane was first built in 2827. It was originally a significant part of many Clan toumans, but was gradually relegated to second-line status following the introduction of the OmniMech. As such, it is still critical to many defensive units.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 灾祸是一款以星盟从未投产的原型为基础的战斗机甲。它被对抗它的内天体部队冠以"海怪"之名，于 2827 年首次建造。它原本是许多氏族图曼的重要组成部分，但随着全能机甲的引入逐渐退居二线。即便如此，它对许多防御单位仍至关重要。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Designed for medium and short range combat, the Bane 2 trades out the Ultra Autocannon/2s for four Ultra Autocannon/10s. Fourteen tons of ammunition allow the Bane 2 to stay in the fight for a long time. Quirk: Extended Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.22 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Bane 2 专为中近距离作战而设计，它把 Ultra 自动炮/2 换成了四门 Ultra 自动炮/10。十四吨弹药让 Bane 2 能在战斗中坚持很长时间。 特性：扩展躯干旋转 投放费用倍率：1.22 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Designed for medium and short range combat, the Bane 2 trades out the Ultra Autocannon/2s for four Ultra Autocannon/10s. Fourteen tons of ammunition allow the Bane 2 to stay in the fight for a long time.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为中近距离战斗设计，灾星2以四门超级自动炮/10取代超级自动炮/2。十四吨弹药让灾星2能长时间留在战斗中。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Designed for fire support, the Bane 3 is a radical rework of the Bane. Eight LRM-15 provide the bulk of the designs fire, with sixteen tons of ammunition supplying the launchers. A Streak SRM-4 provides limited close support. Nineteen double heat sinks are up to the task of keeping the design cool. Quirk: Extended Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.22 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 灾星3为火力支援而设计，是对灾星的激进重做。八具LRM-15构成该设计火力的大部分，十六吨弹药为这些发射器供弹；一具连发SRM-4提供有限的近距支援。十九个双散热器足以让该设计保持凉爽。 特性：扩展躯干旋转 投放费用倍率：1.22 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Designed for fire support, the Bane 3 is a radical rework of the Bane. Eight LRM-15 provide the bulk of the designs fire, with sixteen tons of ammunition supplying the launchers. A Streak SRM-4 provides limited close support. Nineteen double heat sinks are up to the task of keeping the design cool.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 为火力支援而设计，灾祸3是对灾祸的一次彻底重制。八具LRM-15提供该设计的大部分火力，十六吨弹药供应这些发射器。一具连发SRM-4提供有限的近距离支援。十九具双重散热器足以让该设计保持凉爽。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An unusual variant of the Bane acting as a missile boat rather the usual long range direct attack weapons. A total of eight LRM-15 launchers can fire 120 missiles in each volley, enough to penetrate even the most powerful AMS defenses. Four Machine Guns acts as close range defense against any infantry or squads trying to engage the 'Mech directly. Quirk: Extended Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.22 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Bane 的一个不寻常变型，它不承担惯常的远程直射角色，而是充当导弹平台。八具 LRM-15 发射器每轮齐射可发射 120 枚导弹，足以突破即便最强大的 AMS 防御。四挺机枪则负责近距离自卫，应对任何试图直接攻击该机甲的步兵或小队。 特性：扩展躯干旋转 投放费用倍率：1.22 手臂驱动器限制：左上臂、右上臂

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Bane is a BattleMech that is based upon a Star League prototype that was never put into production. Tagged the Kraken by Inner Sphere forces who opposed it, the Bane was first built in 2827. It was originally a significant part of many Clan toumans, but was gradually relegated to second-line status following the introduction of the OmniMech. As such, it is still critical to many defensive units.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 灾祸是一款以星盟从未投产的原型为基础的战斗机甲。它被对抗它的内天体部队冠以"海怪"之名，于 2827 年首次建造。它原本是许多氏族图曼的重要组成部分，但随着全能机甲的引入逐渐退居二线。即便如此，它对许多防御单位仍至关重要。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This modified Bane 1 is configured for one thing only: rattling a 'Mech's armor so hard that things start breaking on the inside. Quirk: Extended Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这台改装灾星1只为唯一一个目的而配置：把机甲的装甲震得内部零件都开始散架。 特性：扩展躯干旋转 投放费用倍率：1.18 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This modified Bane 1 is configured for one thing only: rattling a 'Mech's armor so hard that things start breaking on the inside.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这台经过改装的灾祸1只为一件事配置：把机甲装甲震得如此厉害，以致内部开始崩坏。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An unusual variant of the Bane acting as a close range missile boat rather the usual long range direct attack weapons. A total of twelve SRM-6 launchers can fire 72 SRM missiles in each volley, a formidable attack that is able to cripple all but the most heavily armored 'Mechs. Four Heavy Machine Guns acts as close range defense against any infantry or squads trying to engage the 'Mech directly. Quirk: Extended Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.22 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是 Bane 的一款不寻常变型，它不再充当常规的远程直射火力平台，而是担任近程导弹艇。十二具 SRM-6 发射器每轮齐射可发射 72 枚 SRM 导弹，这种可怕的攻击足以重创除装甲最厚重者之外的所有机甲。四挺重型机枪则提供近程防御，对付任何试图直接接战的步兵或小队。 特性：扩展躯干旋转 投放费用倍率：1.22 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Bane is a BattleMech that is based upon a Star League prototype that was never put into production. Tagged the Kraken by Inner Sphere forces who opposed it, the Bane was first built in 2827. It was originally a significant part of many Clan toumans, but was gradually relegated to second-line status following the introduction of the OmniMech. As such, it is still critical to many defensive units.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 灾祸是一款以星盟从未投产的原型为基础的战斗机甲。它被对抗它的内天体部队冠以"海怪"之名，于 2827 年首次建造。它原本是许多氏族图曼的重要组成部分，但随着全能机甲的引入逐渐退居二线。即便如此，它对许多防御单位仍至关重要。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A heavily re-designed and improved variant, the -1DM is based on an Endo Steel skeleton and powered by a 380 XL engine, but trades battlefield longevity for an expanded weapons loadout and a brand new Targeting Computer. The primary guns are a pair of ER PPC and a RAC-5. Finally, the -1DM carries an LRM-10 Long Range Missile rack supplied with a single ton of ammo. Protecting the 'Mech is a full sixteen and a half tons of standard armor, and sixteen Double Heat Sinks helps cool it all down. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.17 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: -1DM 是一款经过大幅重新设计并改进的变型，以内骨架为基础，搭载一台 380 XL 引擎，但以牺牲战场续航能力为代价，换来了扩充的武器配置和一台全新的瞄准计算机。主要火力为一对增程粒子炮和一门 RAC-5。最后，-1DM 还携带一具 LRM-10 远程导弹发射架，配一吨弹药。保护机甲的是整整十六吨半的标准装甲，而十六个双散热器则帮助它整体降温。 特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1.17 手臂驱动器限制：右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This is really a huge difference to the base -3E and its constant heat woes. The combination of the PPCs, with their signature long reach and solid damage, and the RAC-5, with its respectable range, massive damage potential and a decent three-ton supply of ammunition, makes for a powerful strike. The LRM10 launcher only has ammunition for two minutes worth of missile fire, but this is acceptable in light of the added Targeting Computer. There's even enough cooling to ensure this variant need never suffer from debilitating heat buildup of its cousins - the pilot can fire both ER PPCs while at a dead run and remain cool in the cockpit.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 与基础-3E及其持续的热量困扰相比，这真是天差地别。PPC那招牌的远程触及与扎实伤害，加上RAC-5可观的射程、巨大的伤害潜力和充足的三吨弹药供给，组合成一次强力打击。LRM10发射器只够打两分钟的导弹，但考虑到加装的瞄准计算机，这是可以接受的。散热甚至足以确保这一改型永不会像它的表亲那样受制于令人衰弱的积热——飞行员可以一边全力奔跑一边发射两门增程PPC，座舱里仍然凉爽。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Exclusive to Noisiel and serving as one of the 'Queens' in the Noisiel Summer Games' famed 'BattleChess' matches, the low technology BNC-3EA trades the standard BNC-3E's PPC for a Large Laser, saving weight to add a single rear-facing Small Laser to each side torso and forward facing Medium Laser in the center torso. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: BNC-3EA为努瓦西尔所独有，是努瓦西尔夏季运动会著名“战棋”比赛中的“女王”之一。这款低技术机甲以一门大型激光取代标准BNC-3E的粒子炮，省下的重量用于在两侧躯干各加一门后向小型激光，并在中央躯干加装一门前向中型激光。 特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1.15

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An utterly useless variant, why would you ruin the -3E to produce this?
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一个完全没用的改型，你干嘛要毁掉-3E来造这个？

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A battlefield refit of the -3E, the -3ER replaces the PPC and head-mounted small laser with eight Medium Lasers mounted in the Right Torso. The 'Mech also carries a C3 slave computer and CASE for the AC/5 ammunition. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.17
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: -3ER 是 -3E 的战地改装型，它将粒子炮和头部安装的小型激光替换为八门安装在右躯干的中型激光。该机甲还携带一台 C3 从属计算机，并为 AC/5 弹药配备了 CASE。 特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1.17

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: I just can't see this work at all, it must be hotter than the deepest parts of Hell inside that cockpit when all the weapons fire.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我完全看不出这怎么行得通，所有武器一起开火时，座舱里肯定比地狱最深处还热。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A customized BNC-3S geared toward close combat. The PPCs are removed in favor of a left arm Hatchet and a right arm Large Laser. Also, the SRM-6 is swapped for an LRM-10. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.17
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是面向近距离战斗定制的 BNC-3S。粒子炮被拆除，换成左臂的一把战斧和右臂的一门大型激光。此外，SRM-6 也被换成 LRM-10。 特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1.17

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: So, if this one catches you in melee range it will hurt. A lot. Other than that it is just a weaker -3S.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 所以，如果这一个在近战距离抓到你，那会很痛。非常痛。除此之外它只是一台更弱的-3S。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A refit for the -3S, replacing two of the Medium Lasers with an Armored Cowl and C3 slave unit for better battlefield performance. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是-3S的改装，以装甲机罩和C3从机取代其中两门中型激光，以获得更好的战场表现。 特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1.15 手臂驱动器限制：左下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Nothing special really, just another example of taking what you have available when you need the 'Mech back in the fight as soon as possible.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 其实没什么特别的，不过是又一个例子——当你需要尽快让机甲重回战斗时，手头有什么就用什么。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An attempted upgrade of the -3S that never was produced beyond a very low number initial run, making this variant quite rare to see. Amongst 'Mech collectors the -4S is almost seen as a white whale, many have attempted to acquire one from not-so-legal sources only to be disappointed to find it a false refit instead of an actual production unit. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.17
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: -3S 的一次升级尝试，除极少量初始批次外从未量产，因此这一变型相当罕见。在机甲收藏者眼中，-4S 几乎如同白鲸一般；许多人试图通过不太合法的渠道弄到一台，结果却失望地发现那不过是假的改装货，而非真正的量产机型。 特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1.17

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: It's an assault 'Mech with a LB 10-X AC, six medium Pulse Lasers and two ER PPC, what else is there to say? Except that it gets very, very hot.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是一台突击机甲，装一门LB 10-X自动炮、六门中型脉冲激光和两门增程粒子炮，还能说什么？只补充一点：它会变得非常非常热。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Based on a heavily modified -5S, this custom refit replaces the Lasers with an ER PPC and two medium Pulse Lasers, and the SRM-6 launcher with a Streak counterpart. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.17 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这套定制改装以经过大幅改造的 -5S 为基础，把激光换成了一门增程粒子炮和两门中型脉冲激光，并把 SRM-6 发射器换成了连发型号。 特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1.17 手臂驱动器限制：左臂下部

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Supposedly created by a mercenary company to improve their Banshee BNC-5S, a few other companies have applied the same refit to their 'Mechs.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 据说是一家雇佣兵公司为了改进他们的女妖BNC-5S而创的，另有几家公司也对自家机甲采用了同样的改装。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A customized BNC-5S that sacrifices weaponry for mobility. An ER PPC and heat sink are removed to add four jump jets. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.19
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一台为追求机动性而牺牲武器的定制 BNC-5S。拆下一门 ER PPC 和一个散热器，换来四个跳跃推进器。 特性：战拳 投放费用倍率：1.19

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A customized BNC-5S that sacrifices weaponry for mobility. An ER PPC and heat sink are removed to add four jump jets.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是定制版BNC-5S，以武器换取机动性：拆掉一门增程粒子炮和一个散热器，加装四具跳跃推进器。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Banshee HK mounts two Hydraulic Fists and is outfitted with a selection of newly developed defensive technologies. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.19
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Banshee HK 搭载两个液压拳，并配备了一系列新研发的防御技术。 特性：战拳 投放费用倍率：1.19

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Banshee HK mounts two Hydraulic Fists and is outfitted with a selection of newly developed defensive technologies.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 女妖HK装有两具液压拳，并配备了一系列新研发的防御技术。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The unique “La Malinche” variant is a powerful war machine, and with the Aztec-inspired art of old Terra, she is both as beautiful, as she is deadly. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.19
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 独一无二的“La Malinche”变型是一台强大的战争机器；她饰有旧地球阿兹特克风格的艺术纹饰，既美丽动人，又致命无比。 特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1.19

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The unique “La Malinche” variant is a powerful war machine, and with the Aztec-inspired art of old Terra, she is both as beautiful, as she is deadly.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 独特的"拉马林切"改型是一台强力战争机器，配上古地球阿兹特克风格的涂装，她既美丽又致命。
机密 特质：战斗铁拳 投放费用倍率：1.11

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The -1T carries two ER Large Lasers that allow the Barghest to hit a target at up to five hundred and seventy meters. For medium to close range combat, the 'Mech carries a powerful LB-X Autocannon/20 that is capable of firing both standard ammunition and cluster rounds that act like 'Mech-sized shotgun shells. The 'Mech's simplicity is also a weakness, as the Barghest has only the two ER Large Lasers if the autocannon falls silent from a lack of ammunition or a jam. Quirk: Improved Cooling Jacket - Laser Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: -1T 搭载两门增程大型激光，使 Barghest 能够击中远达五百七十米外的目标。在中近距离作战中，该机甲配备一门威力强大的 LB-X 自动炮/20，既能发射标准弹药，也能发射霰弹弹，后者如同机甲大小的霰弹枪弹药。机甲设计的简洁同时也是弱点：一旦自动炮因弹药耗尽或卡壳而哑火，Barghest 就只剩下那两门增程大型激光了。 特性：改进散热套件 - 激光 投放费用倍率：1.1

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Katherine Steiner-Davion decided during her reign over the Lyran Alliance that she wanted a four legged BattleMech that would evoke fear in its enemies in a similar vein to the classic Atlas and Banshee designs. To do this, the Barghest is built on an Earthwerk GRF Quad chassis that supports a Magna 350 XL engine that saves weight and allows the 'Mech to carry a heavy weapons payload. The Barghest is protected by thirteen tons of Durallex Heavy armor that protects it from all but the heaviest enemy fire. To handle the 'Mech's heat buildup from its weapons, the Barghest has ten double heat sinks.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 凯瑟琳·斯坦纳-戴维安在统治莱兰联盟期间决定，她要一台四足战斗机甲，能像经典的 Atlas 和 Banshee 那样令敌人闻风丧胆。为此，Barghest 以 Earthwerk GRF 四足底盘为基础，搭载一台 Magna 350 XL 引擎，既减轻了重量，又让机甲能够携带沉重的武器负载。Barghest 由十三吨 Durallex 重型装甲保护，除最猛烈的敌方火力外均可抵挡。为应对武器产生的热量积聚，Barghest 配备了十个双散热器。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 2T removes the weapons of the 1T model and replaces them with a single ER PPC and an Ultra Autocannon/20. The ultra autocannon is capable of firing at twice the rate as a standard autocannon, giving the 2T an incredible amount of short range firepower. The Barghest has also gained an additional ton of armor protection, making the 'Mech even harder to take down on the battlefield. Quirk: Improved Cooling Jacket - Laser Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 2T拆掉1T型号的武器，换成一门增程粒子炮和一门超级自动炮/20。超级自动炮的射速可达标准自动炮的两倍，赋予2T惊人的近程火力。巴尔杰斯特还额外获得一吨装甲防护，使它在战场上更难被击倒。 特性：改进冷却套 - 激光 投放费用倍率：1.1

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The PFT variant of the Barghest utilizes the power of cheese. Quirk: Improved Cooling Jacket - Laser Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 犬妖的PFT变型动用了奶酪之力。 特性：改进冷却套件（激光） 投放费用倍率：1.06

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Hey boss, do you believe in the <color=#f5b247>power of cheese</color>?
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 嘿老板，你相信<color=#f5b247>奶酪之力</color>吗？

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Battle Cobra makes use of Endo Steel and Ferro-Fibrous technologies, but uses a standard Fusion Engine for increased durability. The A variant excels at close range with a variety of smaller pulse lasers. It wields four Medium Pulse Lasers and six Small Pulse Lasers. This armament forces unarmored infantry to be especially wary. Quirk: Extended Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 战斗眼镜蛇利用内骨架与铁纤维技术，但采用标准聚变引擎以提高耐久性。A变型以多种较小的脉冲激光在近距表现出色，装备四门中型脉冲激光和六门小型脉冲激光。这套武器迫使无装甲步兵格外警惕。 特性：扩展躯干旋转 投放费用倍率：1.03 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Battle Cobra was already in the prototype stages when Clan Steel Viper introduced their first OmniMech, the Crossbow. The Battle Cobra prototypes were quickly redesigned to allow similar arm-mounted Omni-Pods, debuting only a few years later. Like the Crossbow, the Battle Cobra does not mount fixed jump jets and cannot mount them in their arms - therefore, early Battle Cobras would not be jump-capable.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 战斗眼镜蛇在钢蝰氏族推出其首款全能机甲"弩炮"时已处于原型阶段。战斗眼镜蛇的原型机被迅速重新设计以兼容类似的臂载全能吊舱，仅几年后便首次亮相。与弩炮一样，战斗眼镜蛇不装固定跳跃推进器，也无法在臂部安装——因此早期战斗眼镜蛇不具备跳跃能力。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Battle Cobra makes use of Endo Steel and Ferro-Fibrous technologies, but uses a standard Fusion Engine for increased durability. This B loadout is popular with the Clan Blood Spirit warriors who use a Battle Cobra. It mounts twin ER PPCs and Small Pulse Lasers. However, it lacks additional heat sinks to cope with the heat generated by the cannons. Quirk: Extended Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 战斗眼镜蛇利用内骨架与铁纤维技术，但采用标准聚变引擎以提高耐久性。这一B载荷在使用战斗眼镜蛇的血灵部族战士中颇受欢迎：它装双联增程粒子炮和几门小型脉冲激光，但缺少额外散热器来应对这些炮产生的热量。 特性：扩展躯干旋转 投放费用倍率：1.03 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The first native Battlemech to be built by the FedSuns, the 70 ton Battleaxe debuted in 2459. Based off of the technology used in the Mackie, the Battleaxe would be constantly updated with new technology, before being retired after the Reunification War when newer designs such as the Hammerhands and Warhammer entered service. The Battleaxe BKX-1X is the original prototype model. Built around a 255-rated Fusion Core, the BKX-1X is armed with a pair of Large Lasers and a pair of LRM-5’s. An SRM-6 and a pair of Machine Guns give the Mech some close range firepower. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.88 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Battleaxe 是联邦太阳国建造的第一款本土战斗机甲，70 吨的它于 2459 年首次亮相。它以 Mackie 所用的技术为基础，此后不断以新技术进行更新，直到统一战争结束后，Hammerhands 和 Warhammer 等更新的设计服役，它才退出现役。Battleaxe BKX-1X 是最初的原型型号，以 255 级聚变核心为核心，装备两门大型激光和两具 LRM-5。一具 SRM-6 和两挺机枪为机甲提供了一定的近距离火力。 特性：稳定 投放费用倍率：0.88 手臂驱动器限制：左臂下部、右臂下部

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Classified Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This command version of the BattleMaster mounts a Command Console and is equipped with 20 Heat Sinks. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.13
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这款 BattleMaster 的指挥型安装了指挥控制台，并配备 20 个散热器。 特性：指挥机甲 投放费用倍率：1.13

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Versatile and powerful, the BattleMaster is one of the best known 'Mechs in existence. Originally designed to be the largest and most powerful 'Mech for the Star League armies in the 27th century, the sheer size of the BattleMaster, combined with the cost and resources needed to build one, meant the 'Mech can only be manufactured on a few planets. Still, those lucky enough to pilot a BattleMaster can attest to some of the stories surrounding the 'Mech. With good reliability, firepower and armoring, the BattleMaster is equally adept anchoring an assault lance or serving as a command vehicle.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 多才多艺且强大，战将是现存最知名的机甲之一。它最初在二十七世纪被设计为星盟军队中最大最强的机甲，但战将庞大的体积加上建造一艘所需的成本与资源，意味着它只能在少数星球上制造。尽管如此，有幸驾驶战将的人都能印证围绕这台机甲的种种传说。凭借良好的可靠性、火力与装甲，战将既能稳固地充当突击小队的核心，也能胜任指挥车辆。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A Starleague Royals version of the BLR-1C, exchanging the Command Console for a Dual Cockpit, removing the Machine Guns in favor of an Anti-Missile System and upgrading the PPC to an Extended Range version. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.17
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: BLR-1C 的星际联盟皇家版本，把指挥控制台换成双人座舱，以反导弹系统取代机枪，并将粒子炮升级为增程型号。 特性：指挥机甲 投放费用倍率：1.17

Sixteen double heat sinks keep the 'Mech cool, and the 'Mech's armor is upgraded to Ferro-Fibrous armor. An extra half ton of armor is also installed. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.17
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这款星际联盟时代的变型拆除了两门朝前的中型激光、两挺机枪、SRM 发射器及其弹药。取而代之的是三部连发 SRM-2 发射器（配一吨弹药），并在左臂加装了一门额外的粒子炮。十六个双散热器为机甲提供冷却，其装甲也升级为铁纤维装甲，此外还额外安装了半吨装甲。 特性：指挥机甲 投放费用倍率：1.17

In place of the SRM launcher are three Streak SRM-2 launchers with a single ton of ammunition with an extra PPC mounted in the left arm. Sixteen double heat sinks keep the 'Mech cool, and the 'Mech's armor is upgraded to Ferro-Fibrous armor. An extra half ton of armor is also installed.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Versatile and powerful, the BattleMaster is one of the best known 'Mechs in existence. Originally designed to be the largest and most powerful 'Mech for the Star League armies in the 27th century, the sheer size of the BattleMaster, combined with the cost and resources needed to build one, meant the 'Mech can only be manufactured on a few planets. Still, those lucky enough to pilot a BattleMaster can attest to some of the stories surrounding the 'Mech. With good reliability, firepower and armoring, the BattleMaster is equally adept anchoring an assault lance or serving as a command vehicle.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 多才多艺且强大，战将是现存最知名的机甲之一。它最初在二十七世纪被设计为星盟军队中最大最强的机甲，但战将庞大的体积加上建造一艘所需的成本与资源，意味着它只能在少数星球上制造。尽管如此，有幸驾驶战将的人都能印证围绕这台机甲的种种传说。凭借良好的可靠性、火力与装甲，战将既能稳固地充当突击小队的核心，也能胜任指挥车辆。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Another upgrade of the BattleMaster using lost technology from the Star League, the 3S was introduced in 3050 by Red Devil Industries for the Federated Commonwealth. These changes along with the inclusion of an 340 XL engine make room for a LRM-20 launcher as its primary weapon backed up by six Medium Pulse Lasers for fighting close in, with two of the lasers being rear facing. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 3S是战斗大师借助星际联盟失落科技进行的又一次升级，由红魔工业于3050年为联邦共和国推出。它仍使用标准散热器，实际上还拆掉了半吨装甲、粒子炮与一挺机枪，但仍保留SRM-6。这些改动，再加上一具340 XL引擎，为作为主武器的LRM-20发射器腾出了空间，另有六门中型脉冲激光用于近距离作战，其中两门朝后。 特性：指挥机甲 投放费用倍率：1.15

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Unique among Wolfs Dragoon's, this is apparently a downgraded Stone Rhino equipped with locally made Inner Sphere technology. The sole known example was lost at the battle of Misery and the Dragoon's have been unusually reticent about the mech or it's origins, refusing to confirm where the mech came from or whether they posses anymore. Quirk: Distracting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这台机甲在狼之龙骑兵中独一无二，显然是一台降级版石犀牛，换装了本地制造的内层星域技术。唯一已知的样机在苦难星之战中损失，而龙骑兵对这台机甲及其来历异常默口，既不愿确认它的出处，也不肯透露是否还拥有更多。 <特性：扰敌 <投放费用倍率：1.18 <手臂驱动器限制：左臂下段，右臂下段
