Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 骑士战斗装甲服是为应对联邦联邦武装部队士气低落而建造的，这在很大程度上源于莱兰邦从联邦联邦中脱离。虽然它在最初很大程度上以"内天体标准型"为基础，但这次重新设计远不止外观改动：装甲板的重新分配以牺牲上半身防护为代价增强了腿部防护。尽管当时存有疑虑，但最终分析发现这些改动还使士兵的灵活性优于标准型。主管军官们不情愿地承认利大于弊，批准了该装甲服量产，并于同年六月开始。 特质：灵活 投放费用倍率：0.89 可挂载全能单位，可近战，可蜂群攻击。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Cavalier is a battle armor suit built in response to sagging morale in the Armed Forces of the Federated Commonwealth, due in large part to the secession of the Lyran state from the Federated Commonwealth. Although originally heavily based on the Inner Sphere Standard, the redesign turned out to be more than cosmetic: the redistribution of armor plating had increased leg protection at the expense of upper body protection. While there were some misgivings, in the final analysis it was discovered these alterations also gave superior dexterity to the trooper compared to that of the Standard. Reluctantly the officers in charge agreed that the benefits outweighed the drawbacks and approved mass production of the suit, which started in June of that same year.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 骑士战斗装甲服是为应对联邦联邦武装部队士气低落而建造的，这在很大程度上源于莱兰邦从联邦联邦中脱离。虽然它在最初很大程度上以"内天体标准型"为基础，但这次重新设计远不止外观改动：装甲板的重新分配以牺牲上半身防护为代价增强了腿部防护。尽管当时存有疑虑，但最终分析发现这些改动还使士兵的灵活性优于标准型。主管军官们不情愿地承认利大于弊，批准了该装甲服量产，并于同年六月开始。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: While not mounting any defensive weaponry, the Celerity CLR-02-X-D's head is equipped with a Drone Remote Control System and carries a C3i module. The fact the 'Mech has no MechWarrior piloting it is a good thing given the Celerity's single ton of armor and the fragile nature of its XXL engine and XL gyro, even a single skid following a misstep would almost cripple the design let alone combat fire on the battlefield. The standard design carries no weapon, but this version has been altered to mount a single Small Laser. Quirk: Quad Mech (Squad) Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 迅捷CLR-02-X-D虽然没有安装任何防御武器，其头部却配备了无人机遥控系统，并携带1个C3i模块。由于迅捷仅有1吨装甲，其XXL引擎和XL陀螺仪又极为脆弱，机甲里没有机甲战士驾驶反倒是件好事——哪怕是一次失足后的打滑都几乎足以让这台设计报废，更不用说战场上的火力了。标准型号不携带任何武器，但这个版本经过改装，安装了1门小型激光。 <特性：四足机甲（小队） <投放费用倍率：0.99

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The ultralight OmniMech Celerity was initially ComStar's attempt at creating an expendable drone reconnaissance BattleMech right after the Battle of Tukayyid. The 'Mech' is built on an endo steel frame and is powered by a massive 240-rated XXL fusion engine, the bulky engine making the animalistic drone capable of high-speed sprints, further enhanced by the addition of MASC to make it among the fastest ground units in existence.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 超轻型全方位机甲迅捷最初是康星在图卡伊德战役之后不久，尝试打造一种可消耗的无人机侦察战斗机甲。这台"机甲"建在内层钢框架上，由一台巨大的240级XXL聚变引擎驱动，笨重的引擎让这具兽形无人机能高速冲刺，再加上MASC，使它齐身现存最快的地面单位之列。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: One of the best first generation ProtoMechs, the Centaur combines high speed, decent armor, and a varied weapons mix. These features make it a flexible combatant, able to keep up with scout 'Mechs while supporting them. The SRM and LRM missile launchers provide much of the striking power of the Centaur, backed up ER Micro Laser. Quirk: Nimble Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为最优秀的第一代原型机甲之一，Centaur 兼具高速度、尚可的装甲和多样化的武器组合。这些特点使它成为一具多面手，既能跟上侦察机甲的步伐，又能为其提供支援。SRM 和 LRM 导弹发射器提供了 Centaur 大部分的打击力，微型增程激光则作为补充。 特性：灵活 投放费用倍率：0.98

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: One of the best first generation ProtoMechs, the Centaur combines high speed, decent armor, and a varied weapons mix. These features make it a flexible combatant, able to keep up with scout 'Mechs while supporting them. The SRM and LRM missile launchers provide much of the striking power of the Centaur, backed up ER Micro Laser.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为最好的第一代原型机甲之一，半人马兼具高速度、可靠的装甲与多样的武器组合。这些特点使它成为灵活的战斗单位，能跟上侦察机甲同时为其提供支援。SRM与LRM导弹发射器提供半人马大部分打击力，另有一门增程微型激光器作为后援。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A heavier 55-ton version of the venerable Centurion, the CN10-J was built in 3057 and uses an Endo Steel chassis to save weight on the design while retaining the CN9-A's original ground speed through the use of a 220-rated standard fusion engine. Much like the CN9-D, the 10-J carries an LB-X Autocannon/10 as its primary weapon with an LRM-10 launcher with an Artemis IV fire control system, but these are backed up by a Medium Laser and a Medium Pulse Laser. Quirk: Easy to Pilot Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 百夫长的55吨加重版本，CN10-J于3057年制造，采用内骨架底盘以减轻重量，同时通过一台220额定标准聚变引擎保持CN9-A原有的地面速度。与CN9-D很像，10-J以一门LB-X自动炮/10为主武器，配一具带阿尔忒弥斯IV火控系统的LRM-10发射器，另有中型激光和中型脉冲激光作为后手。 特性：易于驾驶 投放费用倍率：1.05 手臂驱动器限制：右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A heavier 55-ton version of the venerable Centurion, the CN10-J was built in 3057 and uses an Endo Steel chassis to save weight on the design while retaining the CN9-A's original ground speed through the use of a 220-rated standard fusion engine. Much like the CN9-D, the 10-J carries an LB-X Autocannon/10 as its primary weapon with an LRM-10 launcher with an Artemis IV fire control system, but these are backed up by a Medium Laser and a Medium Pulse Laser.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 百夫长的55吨加重版本，CN10-J于3057年制造，采用内骨架底盘以减轻重量，同时通过一台220额定标准聚变引擎保持CN9-A原有的地面速度。与CN9-D很像，10-J以一门LB-X自动炮/10为主武器，配一具带阿尔忒弥斯IV火控系统的LRM-10发射器，另有中型激光和中型脉冲激光作为后手。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A heavier 55-ton version of the venerable Centurion, the CN10-W was built in 3057 and uses an Endo Steel chassis to save weight on the design while retaining the CN9-A's original ground speed through the use of a 220-rated XL engine. Much like the CN9-D, the 10-W carries an LB-X Autocannon/10 as its primary weapon with an LRM-10 launcher with an Artemis IV fire control system, but these are backed up by a PPC. Quirk: Easy to Pilot Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 百夫长的55吨加重版本，CN10-W于3057年制造，采用内骨架底盘以减轻重量，同时通过一台220额定XL引擎保持CN9-A原有的地面速度。与CN9-D很像，10-W以一门LB-X自动炮/10为主武器，配一具带阿尔忒弥斯IV火控系统的LRM-10发射器，另有粒子炮作为后手。 特性：易于驾驶 投放费用倍率：1.05 手臂驱动器限制：右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A heavier 55-ton version of the venerable Centurion, the CN10-W was built in 3057 and uses an Endo Steel chassis to save weight on the design while retaining the CN9-A's original ground speed through the use of a 220-rated XL engine. Much like the CN9-D, the 10-W carries an LB-X Autocannon/10 as its primary weapon with an LRM-10 launcher with an Artemis IV fire control system, but these are backed up by a PPC.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为古老百夫长的加重55吨版本，CN10-W造于3057年，采用内层钢底盘减轻设计重量，同时通过一具220级XL引擎保留CN9-A原有的地面速度。与CN9-D很像，10-W以一门LB-X自动炮/10为主武器，另配一具带阿尔忒弥斯IV火控系统的LRM-10发射器，但还有一门PPC作为后援。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Yen-Lo-Wang, named after the Chinese god of death, is a famous individual BattleMech. Its serial number is FS1010-031X. Yen-Lo-Wang has been modified and customized into a variety of different configurations over the years. Quirk: Yen Lo Wang Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: “阎罗王”以中国死神命名，是一台著名的独立战斗机甲。它的序列号为FS1010-031X。多年来，阎罗王被改装并定制成多种不同配置。 特性：阎罗王 投放费用倍率：1.04 手臂驱动器限制：右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Yen-Lo-Wang, named after the Chinese god of death, is a famous individual BattleMech. Its serial number is FS1010-031X. Yen-Lo-Wang has been modified and customized into a variety of different configurations over the years.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 阎罗王以中国死神命名，是一台著名的特有战斗机甲。它的序列号是FS1010-031X。多年来阎罗王被改装和定制成各种不同配置。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A second, later configuration of the Yen-Lo-Wang. Commonly referred to as the CN9-YLW2, it is still based upon a CN9-A chassis but uses more modern equipment. Keeping the speed the same, the engine was changed to an extra-light version. The AC/10 has been upgraded to a Gauss Rifle with two tons of ammunition. Three medium pulse lasers, two in the left arm and another rear-mounted in the center torso, replace the old standard ones. A left arm Hatchet is paired with Triple-Strength Myomer. Quirk: Yen Lo Wang Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Yen-Lo-Wang的第二种也是更晚的配置，通常被称为CN9-YLW2，它仍以CN9-A底盘为基础，但使用了更现代的装备。速度保持不变，引擎更换为超轻型版本。AC/10升级为一门高斯步枪，配两吨弹药。三门中型脉冲激光——两门在左臂，另一门朝后安装在中央躯干——取代了旧式标准激光。左臂的战斧与三重强度肌纤维搭配使用。 特性：Yen Lo Wang 投放费用倍率：1.06 手臂驱动器限制：右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A second, later configuration of the Yen-Lo-Wang. Commonly referred to as the CN9-YLW2, it is still based upon a CN9-A chassis but uses more modern equipment. Keeping the speed the same, the engine was changed to an extra-light version. The AC/10 has been upgraded to a Gauss Rifle with two tons of ammunition. Three medium pulse lasers, two in the left arm and another rear-mounted in the center torso, replace the old standard ones. A left arm Hatchet is paired with Triple-Strength Myomer.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是阎罗王的第二套、也是较晚的一套配置。通常被称为CN9-YLW2，它仍以CN9-A底盘为基础，但使用更现代的装备。速度保持不变，引擎改为超轻型。AC/10升级为一门磁轨炮配两吨弹药。三门中型脉冲激光器——左臂两门，中央躯干后向一门——取代了旧的标准型号。左臂的斧头配以三倍强度肌纤维。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The primary weapons on the MR-5M are a pair of Gauss rifles, each of which is capable of taking one ton of armor off of an enemy at long range. In the event that an enemy does move into short range, the Cerberus is ready for them because it carries four Medium Pulse Lasers and two rear-mounted Machine Guns. Additionally, for increased defense against missile attacks, the Cerberus carries an anti-missile system. Quirk: Barrel Fist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.17 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: MR-5M的主要武器是两门高斯步枪，每一门都能在远距离上削掉敌人一吨装甲。若敌人真的逼近到近距离，Cerberus也早有准备：它装有四门中型脉冲激光和两挺后置机枪。此外，为加强对导弹攻击的防御，Cerberus还配备了一套反导弹系统。 特性：炮管拳 投放费用倍率：1.17 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Designed to compete with 'Mechs like the Atlas and King Crab, the Cerberus is a 'Mech designed around speed and firepower. The Cerberus uses a massive GM 380 XL engine to propel it to a top speed of 64.8 km/h. The 'Mech is also armored with eleven tons of Heavy ferro-fibrous armor, which provides more protection per ton than standard armor. The large amount of free weight on the 'Mech, almost half of its mass, is dedicated to its weapons systems, which are designed to do as much damage to an enemy at as great a distance as possible.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Cerberus 是为与 Atlas、King Crab 这类机甲一较高下而设计的机甲，以速度与火力为核心。它采用一台巨大的 GM 380 XL引擎，将其推进至 64.8 km/h 的最高速度。该机甲还披挂十一吨重型铁纤维装甲，每吨提供的防护优于标准装甲。机甲上充裕的富余重量几乎占其质量的一半，全部投入武器系统，而这些武器旨在尽可能远的距离上对敌人造成尽可能大的伤害。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The primary weapons on the Cerberus are a pair of Grizzard Model 200 Gauss rifles, each of which is capable of taking one ton of armor off of an enemy at long range. In the event that an enemy does move into short range, the Cerberus is ready for them because it carries four Blankenburg Medium Pulse Lasers and two rear-mounted Sperry Browning Machine Guns. Additionally, for increased defense against missile attacks, the Cerberus carries a McArthur anti-missile system. Quirk: Barrel Fist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.17 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 地狱犬的主武器是两门格里扎德200型高斯步枪，每门都能在远距离上剥掉敌人一吨装甲。若敌人真的逼近近距，地狱犬也已做好准备：它带四门布兰肯堡中型脉冲激光和两挺后向斯佩里-勃朗宁机枪。此外，为加强对导弹攻击的防御，地狱犬还带一套麦克阿瑟反导弹系统。 特性：炮管拳 投放费用倍率：1.17 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Designed to compete with 'Mechs like the Atlas and King Crab, the Cerberus is a 'Mech designed around speed and firepower. The Cerberus uses a massive GM 380 XL engine to propel it to a top speed of 64.8 km/h. The 'Mech is also armored with eleven tons of Heavy ferro-fibrous armor, which provides more protection per ton than standard armor. The large amount of free weight on the 'Mech, almost half of its mass, is dedicated to its weapons systems, which are designed to do as much damage to an enemy at as great a distance as possible.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Cerberus 是为与 Atlas、King Crab 这类机甲一较高下而设计的机甲，以速度与火力为核心。它采用一台巨大的 GM 380 XL引擎，将其推进至 64.8 km/h 的最高速度。该机甲还披挂十一吨重型铁纤维装甲，每吨提供的防护优于标准装甲。机甲上充裕的富余重量几乎占其质量的一半，全部投入武器系统，而这些武器旨在尽可能远的距离上对敌人造成尽可能大的伤害。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Cestus 6X was produced for the SLDF in 2603. Considered a failure due to abysmal heat sinking on an energy-exclusive loadout, the Cestus design would eventually see an overhaul into the 6Y, albeit half a century later. Quirk: Stable Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Cestus 6X于2603年为SLDF生产。由于全能量载荷的散热能力糟糕透顶而被视为失败之作，Cestus设计最终在半个世纪后被彻底翻新为6Y。 特性：武器稳定 投放费用倍率：1.09

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Whoever designed this thing apparently never got the memo that energy weapons generate heat. I wouldn't recommend firing more than a single weapon at a time on this thing, Boss. Not unless you want to fry your pilots.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 不管是谁设计的这东西，显然从没收到"能量武器会产生热量"这条备忘录。我不建议在这玩意儿上同时发射超过一件武器，老大。除非你想把飞行员烤熟。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Designed for the SLDF in 2766, the Cestus production was plagued with delays and setbacks. The 6Y is considered a design correction over the original 6X, which ran notoriously hot, by replacing some of the energy weapons with ballistics. Quirk: Stable Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Cestus于2766年为SLDF设计，其生产却饱受延误与挫折。6Y被认为是对原始6X的设计修正——后者以过热问题臭名昭著——做法是用实弹武器替换了部分能量武器。 特性：稳定武器 投放费用倍率：1.09

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Cestus moves at a slower clip than most 65-tonners, but it puts that extra tonnage where it counts. More armor and an arsenal that's threatening at all ranges make it a solid choice.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Cestus的移动比大多数65吨机甲更慢，但它把额外的吨位用在了关键处。更多的装甲与一套在任何射程上都有威胁的武库，使它成为一个扎实的选择。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A Clan-tech retrofit performed by Clan Fire Mandrill. While the original loadout remains identical to the base Cestus 6Y, the 6Y-EC benefits from the early fruits of Clan weapons research. Despite proving to be a success, the redesigned Cestus was overshadowed by further advancements in Clan technology and by 3020 was all but forgotten. Quirk: Stable Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是火沸沸部族进行的部族技术改装。虽然原始配置与基础Cestus 6Y完全相同，但6Y-EC得益于部族武器研究的早期成果。尽管被证明是成功的，重新设计的Cestus仍被部族技术的进一步进步所掩盖，到3020年已几乎被遗忘。 特性：武器稳定 投放费用倍率：1.09

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Interesting. Very interesting. So, what we've got here looks to be a sort of middle ground between the technology that the SLDF left with, and the technology that they came back with. This thing is like a peek into the history of Clan weapons tech, Boss.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 有意思。非常有意思。那么我们这里拿到的，看起来是SLDF离开时所带技术与他们归来时所带技术之间的某种中间形态。这东西就像一窥氏族武器技术史，老大。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Created for the Federated Commonwealth during the Clan Invasion, the 6Z variant of the Cestus returns to the original energy-exclusive loadout of the BattleMech, this time with better cooling. Quirk: Stable Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 6Z 变型是部族入侵期间为联邦共和国打造的，Cestus 借此回归了该战斗机甲最初的全能量武器配置，而这一次散热更为出色。 特性：武器稳定 投放费用倍率：1.09

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 6Z runs hot, but it's a massive improvement over the original 6X. As long as you don't have Mechjocks firing weapons at targets beyond their ranges, the heat should be manageable.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 6Z跑起来很热，但相比原来的6X是巨大的改进。只要别让机师朝超出射程的目标开火，热量应该可控。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 5C is a weird one, no official creator exists in the records of the design but the 'Mech was produced at several factories at one point of time. A slight rebuild of the classic TRC-4B, the variant does not introduce any major changes except moving the internals around. Quirk: Easy to Pilot Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.02
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 5C 是一个古怪的型号：设计档案中查不到任何官方设计者，但该机甲曾一度在多家工厂同时生产。它是对经典 TRC-4B 的小幅重构，除了调整内部构件的布局之外，并没有引入任何重大改动。 特性：易于驾驶 投放费用倍率：1.02

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Chameleon carried a basic arsenal that allowed a MechWarrior-in-training to learn the skill of heat management. The 'Mech's reliable low-tech arsenal had proven effective when forced into combat. The primary weapon was a Cyclops Eye Large Laser. This was backed up by two Intek Medium Lasers and a trio of Defiance B3S Small Lasers. To make the threat of overheating more real to the new MechWarrior, the 'Mech carried two Scatter Gun Light Machine Guns that can be used for anti-infantry training.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 变色龙携带基础武器库，让受训中的机甲战士学习散热管理技巧。机甲可靠的低技术武器库在被拖入战斗时证明有效。主武器是一门"独眼巨人眼"大型激光。它由两门英泰克中型激光和三门"迪法恩斯 B3S"小型激光支援。为使过热威胁对新手机甲战士更真实，机甲携带两挺"散射枪"轻型机枪，可用于反步兵训练。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A Clan refurbished version of the TRC-4B, replacing its internals with Clan versions but keeping all weapon systems from the original 'Mech. Quirk: Easy to Pilot Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是 TRC-4B 的部族翻新型，其内部构件全部换为部族版本，但保留了原机甲的全部武器系统。 特性：易于驾驶 投放费用倍率：1.08

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: (also referred to as the CHM-3 Chameleon Training Scout) A formerly common but now obscure training 'Mech, the TRC-4B was armed with one Large Laser, two Medium Lasers, four Small Lasers and two Machine Guns. With only 10 normal heat sinks this 'Mech was quite prone to overheating.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: （又称 CHM-3 变色龙训练侦察型）TRC-4B 曾是常见而如今鲜为人知的训练机甲，装备一门大型激光、两门中型激光、四门小型激光和两挺机枪。由于只有 10 台普通散热器，这台机甲极易过热。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The personal 'Mech of Force Commander Pasi Irin assigned to the First Free Worlds Legionnaires, this custom variant replaces the SRM-6 w/Artemis IV with a pair of Streak SRM-2 and additional armor. Quirk: Stable Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是配属第一自由世界军团的部队指挥官 Pasi Irin 的专属机甲。这款定制改型用一对连发 SRM-2 和额外装甲取代了带阿尔忒弥斯 IV 的 SRM-6。 特性：稳定武器 投放费用倍率：1.1 手臂驱动器限制：左上臂、右上臂

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The personal 'Mech of Force Commander Pasi Irin assigned to the First Free Worlds Legionnaires, this custom variant replaces the SRM-6 w/Artemis IV with a pair of Streak SRM-2 and additional armor.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是配属第一自由世界步兵团的部队指挥官帕西·伊林的私人机甲，这一定制改型把带阿尔忒弥斯IV的SRM-6换成两具连发SRM-2，并增加装甲。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: One of the so-called \"Clanbuster\" variants developed in 3052 by ComStar in the lead-up to the Battle of Tukayyid, this variant is a major upgrade that replaces the standard fusion engine with a lighter but more vulnerable 300-rated ExtraLight engine, the heat sinks have been upgraded to double heat sinks and two Large Lasers, surplus from the Clanbuster upgrade of the Wyvern, have been added to the 'Mech's unoccupied arms. Quirk: Stable Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是通讯之星在Tukayyid战役前夕于3052年研发的所谓“部族克星”变型之一。该变型是一次重大升级：标准聚变引擎被替换为更轻但更脆弱的300级超轻型引擎，散热器升级为双散热器，并将Wyvern部族克星升级中富余的两门大型激光加装到机甲空置的双臂上。 特性：稳定武器 投放费用倍率：1.08 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: One of the so-called \"Clanbuster\" variants developed in 3052 by ComStar in the lead-up to the Battle of Tukayyid, this variant is a major upgrade that replaces the standard fusion engine with a lighter but more vulnerable 300-rated ExtraLight engine, the heat sinks have been upgraded to double heat sinks and two Large Lasers, surplus from the Clanbuster upgrade of the Wyvern, have been added to the 'Mech's unoccupied arms.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是3052年图卡伊迪战役前夕由通讯之星研制的所谓“部族克星”变型之一。它是一次重大升级：以更轻但更脆弱的300额定超轻型引擎取代标准聚变引擎，散热器升级为双散热器，并在机甲空置的手臂上加装两门大型激光——它们来自飞龙的部族克星升级项目余料。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 3P is the newest variant of the Champion, introduced in 3061. The 'Mech's arsenal has been completely upgraded to modern standards with the complete removal of all of its weapons. In their place this version of the Champion carries four ER Medium Lasers, one in each arm. An Ultra Autocannon/10 replaces the LB-X Autocannon and the SRM-6 has been replaced by an improved Narc Missile Beacon. In addition, the ExtraLight engine used in the 3N has been retained and an improved C3 computer was added to allow the Champion to work as part of a 6-unit C3 network. Quirk: Stable Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 3P是Champion最新的变型，于3061年推出。该机甲的武库已按现代标准全面升级，原有武器被尽数拆除。取而代之的是，这一版本的Champion搭载四门增程中型激光，每臂各一门。一门Ultra自动炮/10替换了LB-X自动炮，SRM-6则被改进型Narc导弹信标取代。此外，3N所使用的超轻型引擎得以保留，并增设了一台改进型C3计算机，使Champion能够作为6单位C3网络的一环运作。 特性：稳定武器 投放费用倍率：1.08 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 3P is the newest variant of the Champion, introduced in 3061. The 'Mech's arsenal has been completely upgraded to modern standards with the complete removal of all of its weapons. In their place this version of the Champion carries four ER Medium Lasers, one in each arm. An Ultra Autocannon/10 replaces the LB-X Autocannon and the SRM-6 has been replaced by an improved Narc Missile Beacon. In addition, the ExtraLight engine used in the 3N has been retained and an improved C3 computer was added to allow the Champion to work as part of a 6-unit C3 network.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 3P是冠军的最新改型，于3061年推出。该机甲的武库已完全按现代标准升级，所有武器都被彻底替换。取而代之的是，这一版冠军携带四门增程中型激光器，每臂一门。一门超速自动炮/10取代LB-X自动炮，SRM-6则换成一具改进型Narc导弹信标。此外，3N使用的超轻型引擎被保留，并加装一台改进型C3计算机，让冠军能作为6单位C3网络的一部分运作。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An upgraded Champion with Clantech, the Champion C is simply an updated Champion 1N2. Built in 2867 it uses an XL engine with the weight saved going into the addition of 5 jump jets that enable the 'Mech to jump up to 150 meters at a time. The medium lasers were upgraded to Medium Pulse Lasers and a pair of ER Medium Lasers were added. The small lasers are also upgraded to Small Pulse Lasers. The rest of the weaponry is upgraded to Clan standards and the remaining tonnage went to additional armor. Quirk: Stable Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 冠军 C（Champion C）是采用部族科技升级的冠军，实质上就是更新版的冠军 1N2。它于 2867 年建造，使用 XL 引擎，节省下来的重量用于加装 5 具跳跃推进器，使该机甲一次最多可跳跃 150 米。中型激光升级为中型脉冲激光，并新增了两门增程中型激光。小型激光也升级为小型脉冲激光。其余武器均升级至部族标准，剩余的吨位则用于增加装甲。 特性：稳定武器 投放费用倍率：1.14 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An upgraded Champion with Clantech, the Champion C is simply an updated Champion 1N2. Built in 2867 it uses an XL engine with the weight saved going into the addition of 5 jump jets that enable the 'Mech to jump up to 150 meters at a time. The medium lasers were upgraded to Medium Pulse Lasers and a pair of ER Medium Lasers were added. The small lasers are also upgraded to Small Pulse Lasers. The rest of the weaponry is upgraded to Clan standards and the remaining tonnage went to additional armor.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 冠军C是用部族技术升级的冠军式，本质上就是更新版的冠军1N2。它制造于2867年，采用XL引擎，节省下来的重量用于加装5个跳跃推进器，使机甲一次可跳跃至多150米。中型激光升级为中型脉冲激光，并新增两门增程中型激光。小型激光也升级为小型脉冲激光。其余武器均升级至部族标准，剩余吨位则用于增加装甲。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An upgrade of the 3K, the Charger CGR-C was modified to carry a C3 Slave unit that allowed it to share targeting data with other 'Mechs in its unit. In order to add the slave unit, a medium pulse laser had to be removed from the design. The left over mass went towards extra ammunition for the LRM launcher. Quirk: Barrel Fist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为3K的升级型，Charger CGR-C经过改装以搭载C3从属单元，使其能够与本单位内其他机甲共享瞄准数据。为了加装该从属单元，设计上不得不移除一门中型脉冲激光。剩下的重量则用于为LRM发射器增加额外弹药。 特性：枪管拳 投放费用倍率：1.14 手臂驱动器限制：左下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An upgrade of the 3K, the Charger CGR-C was modified to carry a C3 Slave unit that allowed it to share targeting data with other 'Mechs in its unit. In order to add the slave unit, a medium pulse laser had to be removed from the design. The left over mass went towards extra ammunition for the LRM launcher.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为3K的升级版，冲锋者CGR-C经过改装以携带一套C3从属系统，使它能与本单位其他机甲共享瞄准数据。为了加装从属系统，必须从设计中拆除一门中型脉冲激光器。剩余的重量则用于为LRM发射器增加弹药。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A simple refit of the -1A1, replacing three of the Small Lasers and some of the armor for a Medium Laser and a C3 slave unit. Quirk: Barrel Fist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.12 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 对-1A1的简易改装：拆除三具小型激光和部分装甲，换装一具中型激光和一个C3从属单元。 特性：枪管拳 投放费用倍率：1.12 手臂驱动器限制：左下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Because the designers of the Charger wanted to discourage any activities that would put the 'Mech in danger, the engineers at Wells Technologies equipped the Charger with five Magna Mk I Small Lasers, mounted in its arms, torso and head. As these leave the 'Mech dangerously undergunned, arguably its most potent weapons are its fists; if the Charger is able to close the distance and get within hand-to-hand combat, it is more than capable of pounding to pieces other 'Mechs, especially lightweight ones.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 由于冲锋者的设计者想阻止任何让机甲陷入危险的活动，威尔斯科技的工程师为冲锋者装备了五门玛格纳 Mk I 小型激光，装在臂部、躯干和头部。这让机甲火力严重不足，因此可以说它最有力的武器是拳头；若冲锋者能拉近距离进入肉搏，它完全有能力把其他机甲——尤其是轻型机甲——砸成碎片。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An attempt to make the early Charger models more successful by downgrading the 400 engine to a 320 core. The freed up weight allows both considerably more armor as a much different weapons mix of weapons - a Large Laser, a PPC and three Medium Lasers. Quirk: Barrel Fist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.12 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 通过将400引擎降级为320核心，试图让早期型的Charger型号获得更好的表现。省下的重量既带来了大幅增加的装甲，也带来了截然不同的武器组合——一门大型激光、一门粒子炮和三门中型激光。 特性：枪管拳 投放费用倍率：1.12 手臂驱动器限制：左下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Because the designers of the Charger wanted to discourage any activities that would put the 'Mech in danger, the engineers at Wells Technologies equipped the Charger with five Magna Mk I Small Lasers, mounted in its arms, torso and head. As these leave the 'Mech dangerously undergunned, arguably its most potent weapons are its fists; if the Charger is able to close the distance and get within hand-to-hand combat, it is more than capable of pounding to pieces other 'Mechs, especially lightweight ones.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 由于冲锋者的设计者想阻止任何让机甲陷入危险的活动，威尔斯科技的工程师为冲锋者装备了五门玛格纳 Mk I 小型激光，装在臂部、躯干和头部。这让机甲火力严重不足，因此可以说它最有力的武器是拳头；若冲锋者能拉近距离进入肉搏，它完全有能力把其他机甲——尤其是轻型机甲——砸成碎片。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A melee-focused variation of the CGR-1A5 model introduced in 3028, the 1P5 retains the lasers and SRM racks but downgrades the AC/20 for an much smaller AC/5 to free up the weight for an assault Battle Axe carried in the right arm. Quirk: Barrel Fist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.12 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 1P5是3028年推出的CGR-1A5型号的近战向变体，它保留了激光与SRM发射槽，但把AC/20降级为小得多的AC/5，以腾出重量在右臂携带一把突击型战斧。 特性：枪管拳 投放费用倍率：1.12 手臂驱动器限制：左下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Because the designers of the Charger wanted to discourage any activities that would put the 'Mech in danger, the engineers at Wells Technologies equipped the Charger with five Magna Mk I Small Lasers, mounted in its arms, torso and head. As these leave the 'Mech dangerously undergunned, arguably its most potent weapons are its fists; if the Charger is able to close the distance and get within hand-to-hand combat, it is more than capable of pounding to pieces other 'Mechs, especially lightweight ones.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A very unusual total refit of the Charger, it's origins uncertain but likely some blackshop in the periphery as it is only used by pirates and other unsavory groups. Quirk: Barrel Fist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是对 Charger 一次极为罕见的大改，来历不明，很可能出自外围地区的某家黑作坊，因为只有海盗和其他不三不四的团体才使用它。 特性：炮管铁拳 投放费用倍率：1.14 手臂驱动器限制：左下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Because the designers of the Charger wanted to discourage any activities that would put the 'Mech in danger, the engineers at Wells Technologies equipped the Charger with five Magna Mk I Small Lasers, mounted in its arms, torso and head. As these leave the 'Mech dangerously undergunned, arguably its most potent weapons are its fists; if the Charger is able to close the distance and get within hand-to-hand combat, it is more than capable of pounding to pieces other 'Mechs, especially lightweight ones.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Terry Ford's \"Number Seven\" is built around an 320-rated standard engine, the slower engine allows it to retain the 'Mech's ten tons of armor and head mounted small laser while freeing up weight to carry a Large Laser in each side torso supported by a Medium Laser in each arm and the right torso. Twenty-five single heat sinks and four jump jets ensure Number Seven surprising mobility and endurance in battle. Quirk: Barrel Fist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 特里·福特的“七号”围绕额定 320 的标准引擎打造。较慢的引擎使它得以保留机甲原有的十吨装甲和头部安装的小型激光，同时腾出重量，在两侧躯干各装一门大型激光，并由每条手臂和右躯干各一门中型激光提供支援。二十五个单散热器和四具跳跃推进器，使“七号”在战斗中拥有出人意料的机动性与续航能力。 特性：炮管拳 投放费用倍率：1.14 手臂驱动器限制：左下臂

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Terry Ford's \"Number Seven\" is built around an 320-rated standard engine, the slower engine allows it to retain the 'Mech's ten tons of armor and head mounted small laser while freeing up weight to carry a Large Laser in each side torso supported by a Medium Laser in each arm and the right torso. Twenty-five single heat sinks and four jump jets ensure Number Seven surprising mobility and endurance in battle.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 特里·福特的“七号”围绕一台320额定标准引擎建造。较慢的引擎让它得以保留机甲的十吨装甲和头部小型激光，同时腾出重量在两侧躯干各装一门大型激光，并由每只手臂和右躯干的中型激光支援。二十五个单散热器和四具跳跃推进器确保“七号”在战斗中拥有惊人的机动性与持续力。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Punch Bot started as an standard CGR-1A1 of a lance sized merc unit with limited funds available. The first pilot repeatedly threw his 'Mech first into every tough situation hoping to to be able to collect the insurance on the Charger, but the 'Mech just wouldn't die. Eventually the unit realized they could save over 10 tons by replacing the LTV 400 Engine with a GM 380 out of a salvaged Banshee. The then dropped 5 of those tons of the 'Mech's overall weight to keep the same top speed. The extra tonnage allowed them to embrace Punch Bot's usual tactics by mounting Jump Jets, a ton and a half extra armor and upgraded arm actuators. Quirk: Protected Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.13
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 拳击机器人起初是一个经费有限的排级雇佣兵单位的一台标准CGR-1A1。首位飞行员反复把机甲第一个扔进每个险境，指望能靠冲锋者拿到保险金，可这台机甲就是死不了。最终该部队意识到，用一台从废弃女妖上拆下的GM 380替换LTV 400引擎，能省下十吨以上。他们随后又削掉其中5吨总重量以保持同样的最高速度。多出的吨位让他们得以拥抱拳击机器人的惯用战术：装跳跃推进器、一吨半额外装甲，并升级手臂驱动器。 特性：受保护驱动器 投放费用倍率：1.13

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An interesting departure from standard 'Mech design, deciding to use the Chargers speed and dedicate it to beating heavy and assault 'Mechs into scrap with it's fists.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是对标准机甲设计一次有趣的偏离——决定利用冲锋者的速度，把它专门用于用拳头把重型与突击机甲砸成废铁。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 2G is a Clan conversion of the Cicada, although its purpose is unknown it does allow the 'Mech to perform better and fit more advanced electronic warfare components. Quirk: Improved Sensors Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 2G是蝉式机甲经部族技术改造而成的型号。尽管其用途不明，但它确实让这台机甲性能更佳，并能容纳更先进的电子战部件。 特性：改进传感器 投放费用倍率：1.06 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Introduced in 2740, the 40 ton Cicada was developed as a competitor to the Locust. Slightly better armed and just as fast, the Cicada’s heavier armor and better melee capabilities enable it to function as an effective Light Mech hunter and scout. Powered by a 320-rated Fusion Core, the Cicada 2A is armed with a pair of Medium Lasers and a Small Laser.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 40吨的蝉于2740年推出，是为与蝗虫竞争而研制。它武装略强、速度相当，而更厚的装甲与更好的近战能力使它成为有效的轻型机甲猎手与侦察机。蝉2A由一台320额定聚变核心驱动，装有两门中型激光和一门小型激光。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Introduced in 2740, the 40 ton Cicada was developed as a competitor to the Locust. Slightly better armed and just as fast, the Cicada’s heavier armor and better melee capabilities enable it to function as an effective Light Mech hunter and scout. Powered by a 320-rated XL Engine, the prototype Cicada X5 is armed with quad Medium Lasers and a pair of SRM-2’s. Quirk: Nimble Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 40吨的蝉于2740年推出，是为与蝗虫竞争而研制。它武装略强、速度相当，而更厚的装甲与更好的近战能力使它成为有效的轻型机甲猎手与侦察机。原型蝉X5由一台320额定XL引擎驱动，装四门中型激光和两具SRM-2。 特性：灵巧 投放费用倍率：1.04 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Introduced in 2740, the 40 ton Cicada was developed as a competitor to the Locust. Slightly better armed and just as fast, the Cicada’s heavier armor and better melee capabilities enable it to function as an effective Light Mech hunter and scout. Powered by a 320-rated XL Engine, the prototype Cicada X5 is armed with quad Medium Lasers and a pair of SRM-2’s.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 蝉于2740年推出，这种40吨机甲是作为蝗虫的竞争者而研发的。武装略好、速度相当，蝉更厚的装甲与更强的近战能力使它成为有效的轻型机甲猎手与侦察兵。蝉X5原型由一具320级XL引擎驱动，武装为四门中型激光器和两具SRM-2。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Clint was primarily designed as a cheap recon unit, with the capabilities of a well-armed, low-end medium weight 'Mech, and in this regard it served well. With a top speed of 97.2 km/h and a jumping capability of one hundred and eighty meters, the Clint can easily keep up with other recon elements and maneuver through mountainous or urban terrain. This custom model exchanges the Autocannon/5 with a Large Laser and four Heat Sinks. Quirk: Variable Range Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.02 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Clint 最初是作为廉价侦察单位设计的，却具备武装精良的低端中型机甲的作战能力，在这方面它表现相当出色。其最高速度为 97.2 km/h，跳跃距离达一百八十米，能轻松跟上其他侦察单位，并在山地或城市地形中灵活机动。这款定制型号用一门大型激光和四具散热器换掉了自动炮/5。 特性：可变距离瞄准 投放费用倍率：1.02 手臂驱动器限制：右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Clint was primarily designed as a cheap recon unit, with the capabilities of a well-armed, low-end medium weight 'Mech, and in this regard it served well. With a top speed of 97.2 km/h and a jumping capability of one hundred and eighty meters, the Clint can easily keep up with other recon elements and maneuver through mountainous or urban terrain. This custom model exchanges the Autocannon/5 with a Large Laser and four Heat Sinks.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 克林特主要被设计为一种廉价的侦察单位，具备武装良好、低端中型机甲的作战能力，在这点上它表现出色。凭借97.2公里/小时的最高速度和一百八十米的跳跃能力，克林特能轻松跟上其他侦察单位，并在山地或城市地形中机动。这台定制型号把自动炮/5换成了一门大型激光器和四具散热器。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A battlefield refit of the CLNT-2-3T, replacing one of the medium lasers for a small laser and CASE protection to the autocannon ammunition. Two jump jets are also removed to enable the use of a C3 Slave unit. Quirk: Variable Range Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是 CLNT-2-3T 的战场改装：将其中一门中型激光换为小型激光，并为自动炮弹药加装 CASE 防护。此外还拆除了两具跳跃推进器，以便使用 C3 从属单元。 特性：可变距离瞄准 投放费用倍率：1 手臂驱动器限制：右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Clint was primarily designed as a cheap recon unit, with the capabilities of a well-armed, low-end medium weight 'Mech, and in this regard it served well. With a top speed of 97.2 km/h and a jumping capability of one hundred and eighty meters, the Clint can easily keep up with other recon elements and maneuver through mountainous or urban terrain. The Clint 2-3T equipped with one Autocannon/5 with one ton of ammunition. As secondary weapons, the Clint carries two Martell Medium Lasers. This well-balanced mix of weapons when combined with the Clint's above-average maneuverability for its size make the Clint a highly effective multi-role BattleMech.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 克林特主要被设计为廉价的侦察单位，具备武装良好的入门级中量级机甲的能力，在这方面它表现出色。凭借 97.2 公里/小时的最高速度和一百八十米的跳跃能力，克林特能轻松跟上其他侦察单位，并能穿越山地或城市地形。克林特 2-3T 装备一门自动炮/5，配一吨弹药。作为次要武器，克林特携带两门马特尔中型激光。这种均衡的武器搭配结合克林特同尺寸中高于平均的机动性，使克林特成为极为高效的多用途战斗机甲。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A full conversion of the standard Clint to Clan tech, used by the famous elite mercenary unit the Gray Death Legion. By using both Ferro-Fibrous armor and an Endo-Steel chassis the design manages to fit an Ultra AC/5 and three ER Medium Lasers, making the 40 ton 'Mech capable to deliver an unexpectedly heavy strike. Quirk: Variable Range Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是将标准型克林特全面改装为部族科技的产物，由著名精锐雇佣兵部队灰死军团使用。通过同时采用铁纤维装甲与内骨架底盘，该设计成功装下了一门超级AC/5和三门增程中型激光，让这台40吨机甲能够打出出人意料的沉重一击。 特性：可变距离瞄准 投放费用倍率：1.08 手臂驱动器限制：右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Clint was primarily designed as a cheap recon unit, with the capabilities of a well-armed, low-end medium weight 'Mech, and in this regard it served well. With a top speed of 97.2 km/h and a jumping capability of one hundred and eighty meters, the Clint can easily keep up with other recon elements and maneuver through mountainous or urban terrain. Produced by the Taurian Concordat at the outbreak of the Jihad, the 3-3T modifies the original 2-3T. It adds Ferro-Fibrous armor to the design and swaps out the AC/5 with a Light AC/5, presumably supplied to them by the Word of Blake. This lighter weapon makes room for the inclusion of CASE and two tons of ammunition, ensuring it is able to carry various types of munitions.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 克林特主要被设计为一种廉价的侦察单位，具备武装良好、低端中型机甲的作战能力，在这点上它表现出色。凭借97.2公里/小时的最高速度和一百八十米的跳跃能力，克林特能轻松跟上其他侦察单位，并在山地或城市地形中机动。由陶里安协约国在圣战爆发时生产，3-3T改装自原本的2-3T。它为该设计增加了铁纤装甲，并把AC/5换成轻型AC/5——想必是布雷克之言提供给他们的。这件更轻的武器为加装CASE和两吨弹药腾出了空间，确保它能携带多种弹药。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A mercenary refit of the Clint CLNT-3-3T using acquired clan tech. Mounting an Ultra AC/5 and three ER Medium Lasers, made possibly by use of both Ferro-Fibrous armor and Endo Steel structure, making it considerably better armed than its base variant. Quirk: Variable Range Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.02 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是雇佣兵利用取得的部族技术对克林特CLNT-3-3T的改装。它装有一门超级AC/5和三门增程中型激光，靠铁纤维装甲与内骨架结构才得以实现，武装明显优于基础变型。 特性：可变距离瞄准 投放费用倍率：1.02 手臂驱动器限制：右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Clint was primarily designed as a cheap recon unit, with the capabilities of a well-armed, low-end medium weight 'Mech, and in this regard it served well. With a top speed of 97.2 km/h and a jumping capability of one hundred and eighty meters, the Clint can easily keep up with other recon elements and maneuver through mountainous or urban terrain. The Clint 2-3T equipped with one Autocannon/5 with one ton of ammunition. As secondary weapons, the Clint carries two Martell Medium Lasers. This well-balanced mix of weapons when combined with the Clint's above-average maneuverability for its size make the Clint a highly effective multi-role BattleMech.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 克林特主要被设计为廉价的侦察单位，具备武装良好的入门级中量级机甲的能力，在这方面它表现出色。凭借 97.2 公里/小时的最高速度和一百八十米的跳跃能力，克林特能轻松跟上其他侦察单位，并能穿越山地或城市地形。克林特 2-3T 装备一门自动炮/5，配一吨弹药。作为次要武器，克林特携带两门马特尔中型激光。这种均衡的武器搭配结合克林特同尺寸中高于平均的机动性，使克林特成为极为高效的多用途战斗机甲。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The CRH-2B distinguishes itself through an unusual density of reinforced components, including an armored cockpit, armored engine shielding, a defensive-rated gyro, and reinforced leg and arm actuators that resist crippling damage. Ferro-Fibrous armor plating keeps weight manageable despite this added bulk, while internal spall liners reduce the risk of catastrophic crew or component loss from penetrating hits. Armed with twin PPCs and three Medium Lasers, and fitted with assault-class jump jets for repositioning, the CRH-2B remains a stubbornly difficult mech to put down for good. Quirk: Reinforced Structure Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: CRH-2B的独特之处在于强化部件密度异常之高：装甲座舱、装甲引擎屏蔽、防御级陀螺仪，以及能抵抗致残伤害的加固腿部与手臂驱动器。尽管增加了这些体积，铁纤维装甲板仍让重量保持可控，而内部崩落衬层则降低了穿透命中导致乘员或部件灾难性损失的风险。CRH-2B装双粒子炮与三门中型激光，并配突击级跳跃推进器用于重新站位，是一台顽固得难以彻底击倒的机甲。 特性：加固结构 投放费用倍率：1.14

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Designed in the waning years of the Star League to bolster SLDF garrisons amid mounting civil unrest, the Cockroach prioritized survivability above all else, trading offensive punch for unmatched resilience under fire. Following the Amaris Civil War, production blueprints scattered across the Inner Sphere, picked up intermittently by various manufacturers ever since. Now an uncommon but unsurprising sight in garrison forces of nearly every major faction, with scattered units even reaching Periphery militias.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 蟑螂在星盟末期设计，用于在内乱加剧之际强化星盟防卫军驻军，它把生存性置于一切之上，以牺牲进攻打击力换取无与伦比的抗打击能力。阿马里斯内战之后，其生产蓝图散落内天体各地，此后被各家制造商断断续续地拾起。如今它几乎在每个主要势力的驻军中都能见到——虽不常见却也并不令人意外，零星机体甚至流入外围区民兵手中。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The CRH-2Br is a common field refit of the original CRH-2B, replacing its single heat sinks with double heat sinks throughout. This simple upgrade allows the Cockroach's twin PPCs to fire more frequently without risking shutdown, meaningfully improving sustained combat performance while leaving the chassis's signature armor, reinforced actuators, and defensive systems entirely untouched. Quirk: Reinforced Structure Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: CRH-2Br是CRH-2B常见的野战改装，把单散热器全面换成双散热器。这项简单升级让蟑螂的双粒子炮能更频繁地射击而不必担心停机，显著改善持续战斗表现，同时完全不动其标志性装甲、加固驱动器和防御系统。 特性：加固结构 投放费用倍率：1.16

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Designed in the waning years of the Star League to bolster SLDF garrisons amid mounting civil unrest, the Cockroach prioritized survivability above all else, trading offensive punch for unmatched resilience under fire. Following the Amaris Civil War, production blueprints scattered across the Inner Sphere, picked up intermittently by various manufacturers ever since. Now an uncommon but unsurprising sight in garrison forces of nearly every major faction, with scattered units even reaching Periphery militias.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The CRH-4H represents a significant rework of the original CRH-2B, upgrading its twin PPCs to ER PPCs for greater range and replacing single heat sinks with double heat sinks throughout to support them. A Guardian ECM Suite has been added for electronic protection, and Reinforced Internal Structure further bolsters the chassis's already formidable durability. These additions come at a slight cost to armor coverage, though the CRH-4H remains every bit as difficult to bring down as its predecessor. Quirk: Reinforced Structure Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: CRH-4H 是对原始 CRH-2B 的一次重大改造：将成对的粒子炮升级为增程粒子炮以获得更大射程，并全面以双散热器替换单散热器来支撑它们。它还加装了 Guardian 电子对抗套件以提供电子防护，而强化内部结构则进一步增强了机体本就强悍的耐用性。这些改动以略微削减装甲覆盖为代价，不过 CRH-4H 依旧如前代一样难以被击倒。 特性：强化结构 投放费用倍率：1.16

Following the Amaris Civil War, production blueprints scattered across the Inner Sphere, picked up intermittently by various manufacturers ever since. Now an uncommon but unsurprising sight in garrison forces of nearly every major faction, with scattered units even reaching Periphery militias.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The CRH-4H2 builds directly on the CRH-4H, upgrading all three Medium Lasers to Medium Pulse Lasers and adding a fourth in the center torso for substantially improved close-range accuracy and output. An Advanced Targeting Computer and additional energy and heat tracking systems further sharpen its weapons' effectiveness, supported by extra heat sinks in both arms. To accommodate this expanded and refined arsenal, the CRH-4H2 sacrifices its jump jets entirely — a trade-off that grounds the design but leaves its renowned armor and defensive systems fully intact. Quirk: Reinforced Structure Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: CRH-4H2直接以CRH-4H为基础，把三门中型激光全部升级为中型脉冲激光，并在中央躯干加装第四门，近距精度与输出显著提升。一台先进瞄准计算机与额外的能量和热量追踪系统进一步强化了武器效能，双臂还加了额外散热器。为容纳这套扩充且精炼的武器，CRH-4H2完全牺牲了跳跃推进器——这一取舍让该设计失去了跳跃能力，但其著名的装甲与防御系统完好无损。 特性：加固结构 投放费用倍率：1.16

Following the Amaris Civil War, production blueprints scattered across the Inner Sphere, picked up intermittently by various manufacturers ever since. Now an uncommon but unsurprising sight in garrison forces of nearly every major faction, with scattered units even reaching Periphery militias.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The original Colossus design, introduced in 3053, carried a standard AC/20, and a Large Pulse Laser teamed with a Medium Pulse Laser in each arm. Like the updated version, this prototype could jump 90 meters. The armor protection remained the same, but it carried three Coolant Pods in the right and left torsos instead of the shields that would later appear on the CLS-4S. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.17 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 最初的巨像设计于3053年推出，带一门标准AC/20，每只手臂则有一门大型脉冲激光配一门中型脉冲激光。与更新版本一样，此原型可跳跃90米。装甲防护保持不变，但它在左右躯干装了三个冷却剂罐，而非后来出现在CLS-4S上的护盾。 特性：稳定 投放费用倍率：1.17 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A Solaris VII BattleMech, the Colossus was one of the first 'Mechs to use X-Pulse Lasers. Bethel Labs, the developers of the X-Pulse technology, wanted a demonstrator for their new technology. Omnitech Industries brushed off their Colossus design and the rest is history. Using a standard engine, Endo Steel chassis, and armor, the Colossus can take enormous amounts of damage. Though not a particularly fast 'Mech, it does move at the same rate as the Atlas and other assault 'Mechs. In addition it has a 90 meter jump capability which can maneuver it out of trouble.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为一台索拉里斯VII战斗机甲，巨像是首批使用X脉冲激光器的机甲之一。X脉冲技术的开发者贝塞尔实验室想为他们的新技术做一个展示机。全能科技工业翻出他们的巨像设计，余下的就成了历史。它采用标准引擎、内层钢底盘和装甲，能承受巨量伤害。虽然不算特别快，它的移动速度与阿特拉斯及其他突击机甲相当。此外它还有90米的跳跃能力，可以机动脱离麻烦。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 2A is an unofficial refit of the 2D, adding one and a half ton of armor and switching from single to double heat sinks. The SRM-6 launcher is converted to a hand-mounted SRM-4, and the Medium Laser moved to a side torso. The 'Mech also adds protection against internal ammunition explosions in form of a C.A.S.E. system. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.96
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 2A是对2D的非官方改装，增加了一吨半装甲，并将单散热器换成双散热器。SRM-6发射器被改为手持式SRM-4，中型激光则移至侧躯干。该机甲还以C.A.S.E.系统的形式增添了针对内部弹药爆炸的防护。 特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：0.96

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 2A is an unofficial refit of the 2D, adding one and a half ton of armor and switching from single to double heat sinks. The SRM-6 launcher is converted to a hand-mounted SRM-4, and the Medium Laser moved to a side torso. The 'Mech also adds protection against internal ammunition explosions in form of a C.A.S.E. system.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 2A是2D的非官方改装，增加一吨半装甲，并把单重散热器改为双重散热器。SRM-6发射器被改为手持式SRM-4，中型激光器移到侧躯干。该机甲还以C.A.S.E.系统的形式增加了对内部弹药爆炸的防护。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A refit of the 2D chassis removing all the missiles and instead adds three more Medium Lasers and six Small Lasers, along with an extra ton of armor. Quirk: Improved Cooling Jacket - Laser Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.96
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 2D 底盘的改装型，拆除了全部导弹，改为加装三具中型激光和六具小型激光，并额外增加一吨装甲。 特性：改进冷却套 - 激光 投放费用倍率：0.96

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: When the say Inferno, no one realized they were referring to the temperature inside the cockpit.  I suggest removing some of the lasers and adding a heat sink or two.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 当人们说"燃烧弹"时，没人意识到他们指的是驾驶舱内的温度。我建议移除一些激光，加一两台散热器。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A variant of the -2D that drops the Medium Laser to replace it with a C3 slave unit. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.96
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是-2D的变型，拆掉中型激光，换成一台C3从机。 特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：0.96

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A variant of the -2D that drops the Medium Laser to replace it with a C3 slave unit.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是-2D的一个改型，拆掉中型激光器，换上一套C3从属系统。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A battlefield refit of the 2D, the 2J mounts 6 jump jets and replaces the SRM-6 with a SRM-4 launcher. The 'Mech further uses double heat sinks to support the increased heat build up from the jump jets. To be able to carry the weight of the jump jets, the 2J uses an XL engine core and Ferro-Fibrous armor. This does however mean that an extra ton of armor and a C.A.S.E. system can be added. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 2J 是 2D 的战地改装型，安装了 6 台跳跃推进器，并以 SRM-4 发射器取代 SRM-6。该机甲还采用双散热器，以应对跳跃推进器带来的额外热量积聚。为了承受跳跃推进器的重量，2J 使用 XL 引擎核心和铁纤维装甲，不过这也意味着还能额外增加一吨装甲并加装 C.A.S.E. 系统。 特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：0.98

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A battlefield refit of the 2D, the 2J mounts 6 jump jets and replaces the SRM-6 with a SRM-4 launcher. The 'Mech further uses double heat sinks to support the increased heat build up from the jump jets. To be able to carry the weight of the jump jets, the 2J uses an XL engine core and Ferro-Fibrous armor. This does however mean that an extra ton of armor and a C.A.S.E. system can be added.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为2D的战地改装，2J装6个跳跃推进器，并把SRM-6换成SRM-4发射器。该机甲还使用双重散热器以应对跳跃推进器带来的额外积热。为承载跳跃推进器的重量，2J采用XL引擎核心和铁纤装甲。不过这确实意味着可以加装额外一吨装甲和一套C.A.S.E.系统。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Another common refit of the COM-2D is the 2P, which adds a Large Laser at the cost of only keeping a downgraded SRM-2 launcher. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.96
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: COM-2D 另一种常见的改装是 2P，它增加了一门大型激光，代价是仅保留一具降级的 SRM-2 发射器。 特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：0.96

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Another common refit of the COM-2D is the 2P, which adds a Large Laser at the cost of only keeping a downgraded SRM-2 launcher.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: COM-2D另一个常见的改装是2P，它以只保留降级版SRM-2发射器为代价，加装了一门大型激光器。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Five tons of Ferro-Fibrous armor, an XL engine, double heat sinks, C.A.S.E. system and an extra Medium laser makes the 2W quite a refit of the 2D. To make it even more interesting the SRM-6 has been replaced by a Streak SRM-4 launcher. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 五吨铁纤维装甲、一台XL引擎、双散热器、C.A.S.E.系统和一门额外中型激光，使2W成为对2D相当彻底的改装。更有意思的是，SRM-6被换成了连发SRM-4发射器。 特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：0.98

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Five tons of Ferro-Fibrous armor, an XL engine, double heat sinks, C.A.S.E. system and an extra Medium laser makes the 2W quite a refit of the 2D. To make it even more interesting the SRM-6 has been replaced by a Streak SRM-4 launcher.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 五吨铁纤装甲、一具XL引擎、双重散热器、C.A.S.E.系统和一门额外中型激光器，使2W成为对2D相当大的一次改装。为了更有意思，SRM-6被换成了连发SRM-4发射器。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A strange variant of the Commando that is focused more on durability than most other variants, the 3H only mounts a single Large Laser. Instead, it carries a full 2 extra tons of armor and an extra heat sink. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.96
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 3H 是 Commando 的一个特殊变型，相比其他大多数变型更注重耐用性，因此仅安装了一门大型激光，取而代之的是整整多出两吨的装甲和一具额外散热器。 特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：0.96

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A strange variant of the Commando that is focused more on durability than most other variants, the 3H only mounts a single Large Laser. Instead, it carries a full 2 extra tons of armor and an extra heat sink.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是突击队员一种奇怪的改型，比大多数改型更注重耐久，3H只装有一门大型激光器。取而代之的是，它携带了整整多出2吨的装甲和一具额外散热器。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 3H2 mounts a Large Laser and a Small Laser, protected by 5.5 tons of armor. This makes it more durable than a 2D, allowing it to remain scouting for a longer time on the battlefield. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.96
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 3H2装有一门大型激光和一门小型激光，由5.5吨装甲保护。这使它比2D更耐久，能够在战场上坚持侦察更长时间。 特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：0.96

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 3H2 mounts a Large Laser and a Small Laser, protected by 5.5 tons of armor. This makes it more durable than a 2D, allowing it to remain scouting for a longer time on the battlefield.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 3H2装有一门大型激光和一门小型激光，由5.5吨装甲保护。这使它比2D更耐久，能在战场上保持更久的侦察状态。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The best armored of the of the -7 series, the -7A still manages to fit a total of 200 C.A.S.E. protected SRM missiles for its two SRM-4 launchers. A single Medium Laser in the Left Arm is the only other weapon of the variant. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.96
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: -7A是-7系列中装甲最厚的一款，却仍能为其两具SRM-4发射器携带总计200枚受C.A.S.E.保护的SRM导弹。左臂的一门中型激光是该变型唯一的其他武器。 特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：0.96

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Long the darling of the Lyran Commonwealth's scouting formations, the Commando has enjoyed vast success over its seven centuries of service. Once exclusively Lyran, the Succession Wars spread the capable little 'Mech to various mercenary companies, where a score of variants commonly called the -7 series emerged. Thrifty mercenaries often swap missile racks for energy independence, and the Commando is a common sight in Mech-it-Lube franchise refit bays.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为莱兰联邦侦察编队长期的心头好，突击队员在其七个世纪服役中取得了巨大成功。它曾为莱兰独有，继承战争把这款能干的小机甲传播到各家佣兵部队，并涌现出被称为"-7 系列"的众多变体。节俭的佣兵常用导弹挂架换取能量武器的后勤独立性，因此突击队员在"Mech-it-Lube"连锁改装店里随处可见。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Similar to the -7A in weapons loadout with two SRM-4 launchers and a Medium Laser, the -7J mounts five jump jets instead of the extra armor and ammunition of the -7A. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.96
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: -7J的武器配置与-7A相似，同为2具SRM-4发射器和1门中型激光，但它用5具跳跃推进器替代了-7A上额外的装甲与弹药。 <特性：狭小/低矮外形 <投放费用倍率：0.96

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The -7W reaches for longevity with extra ammo and a Streak SRM-2 launcher. Task Force Serpent used these variants to great effect on Huntress, prompting Coventry Metal Works to dedicate factory space to producing official re-creations. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: -7W以额外弹药和一具连发SRM-2发射器追求持久力。蛇特遣队在享特雷斯上大量使用这些变型并效果卓著，促使考文垂金属厂专门腾出厂房生产官方复刻版。 特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：0.98

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A 4th Succession war variant that saw limited production, the 7X variant exchanges the SRM-4 for an additional 2 medium lasers but is otherwise identical to the standard Commando. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.96
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 7X是第四次继承战争时期产量有限的变型，以额外2门中型激光取代SRM-4，其余与标准突击兵完全相同。 特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：0.96

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A 4th Succession war variant that saw limited production, the 7X variant exchanges the SRM-4 for an additional 2 medium lasers but is otherwise identical to the standard Commando.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是第四次继承战争中产量有限的改型，7X把SRM-4换成额外两门中型激光器，其余与标准突击队员完全相同。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The COM-7Y swaps the -2D's SRM-4 for two more medium lasers and another ton of armor in an attempt to improve the Commando's longevity on the battlefield. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.96
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: COM-7Y以两门额外中型激光和另一吨装甲取代-2D的SRM-4，意在提升突击兵在战场上的存续力。 特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：0.96

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The -7Y2 is more than just a sub-variant of the -7Y, it has become so famous and beloved it earned its own nickname of the 'Blazing Inferno'. It sacrifices the SRM launchers, but instead adds 6 small lasers. The only downside of the variant is its quite bad cooling capabilities considering all its weapons. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.96
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: -7Y2 不只是 -7Y 的子改型，它已经太过出名、太受欢迎，以至于获得了自己的绰号“炽烈地狱”。它舍弃了 SRM 发射器，改为加装 6 门小型激光。该改型唯一的缺点在于，考虑到它的全部武器，其散热能力相当糟糕。 特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：0.96

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The recovery of Cellular Ammunition Storage Equipment technology saw the emergence of a new more durable variant of the Commando, the -7Z. To fit the C.A.S.E. system the variant drops one of the -7Y's Medium Lasers, but also adds a bit more armor. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.96
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 随着细胞式弹药储存设备技术的重获，Commando出现了一种更耐用的新型改款——7Z。为了容纳C.A.S.E.系统，该改型舍弃了7Y的一门中型激光，但也增加了一些装甲。 特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：0.96

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A sub-variant of the -7Z, the Commando COM-7Z2 downgrades the two Medium Lasers to Small Lasers to be able to fit a Beagle Active Probe. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Commando COM-7Z2是7Z的子改型，将两门中型激光降级为小型激光，以便装下一具Beagle主动探测器。 特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：0.98

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Built on an Endo Steel chassis, the 9D combines a 200 XL engine with 5 tons of Ferro-Fibrous armor, two Medium Lasers and a Streak SRM-6 launcher. A ton of streak ammunition and an Beagle Active Probe finishes the design. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 9D 以内骨架底盘打造，整合了 200 XL 引擎、5 吨铁纤维装甲、两门中型激光和一部连发 SRM-6 发射器。一吨连发弹药和一部 Beagle 主动探测器构成了这套设计的收尾。 特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：0.98

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Built on an Endo Steel chassis, the 9D combines a 200 XL engine with 5 tons of Ferro-Fibrous armor, two Medium Lasers and a Streak SRM-6 launcher. A ton of streak ammunition and an Beagle Active Probe finishes the design.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 9D建在内层钢底盘上，把一具200 XL引擎与5吨铁纤装甲、两门中型激光器和一具连发SRM-6发射器结合起来。一吨连发弹药和一个比格犬主动探测器补全该设计。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A refresh of the 9D, the 9DA replaces the Medium Lasers with Small Pulse Lasers. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 9DA是9D的改良型，用小型脉冲激光替换了中型激光。 特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：0.98

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A refresh of the 9D, the 9DA replaces the Medium Lasers with Small Pulse Lasers.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为9D的更新版，9DA把中型激光器换成小型脉冲激光器。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Commando R2D2, except for having a very strange designation, is a pretty standard looking refit of the 2D replacing the Medium Laser with a C3 slave unit. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.96
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 突击兵R2D2除了有个非常奇怪的编号之外，就是对2D相当标准的改装，以一台C3从机取代中型激光。 特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：0.96

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A unique Commando piloted by Captain Bono Duganmare of the 22nd Skye Rangers, the \"Death's Knell\"; is refitted with recovered LosTech. Swapping the standard SRM racks for an additional 3 Medium lasers, allows the TDK’s engine to be refitted with a 175 core. The inclusion of DHS keeps the mech comfortably cool. An extra half ton of armor round out the design. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 第22斯凯游骑兵上尉博诺·杜根梅尔驾驶的一台独特突击兵“丧钟”，装上了回收的失落科技。它以额外3门中型激光取代标准SRM挂架，使这台TDK的引擎得以换装175核心。双散热器的加入让机甲保持舒适的温度，另加半吨装甲为该设计收尾。 特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：1.03

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A unique Commando piloted by Captain Bono Duganmare of the 22nd Skye Rangers, the \"Death's Knell\"; is refitted with recovered LosTech. Swapping the standard SRM racks for an additional 3 Medium lasers, allows the TDK’s engine to be refitted with a 175 core. The inclusion of DHS keeps the mech comfortably cool. An extra half ton of armor round out the design.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是第22斯凯游骑兵的博诺·杜根梅尔上尉驾驶的一台独特突击队员，名为"丧钟"；它以回收的失传科技改装。把标准SRM架换成额外3门中型激光器，使TDK的引擎得以改配175核心。加入双重散热器让该机甲保持舒适凉爽。另加半吨装甲补全设计。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Designed as a successor to the Wolverine, the Conjurer is a 50-ton Mech seen in Clan Second Line formations. Powered by a 300-rated Fusion Core, the Conjurer CJR-7 mounts 6 Jump jets. A Large Pulse Laser and 2 LRM-5’s form the bulk of the CJR-7’s weapons, with a pair of ER Medium Lasers for close combat. Quirk: Extended Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 幻术师作为狼獾的后继型号而设计，是部族二线编队中得见的50吨机甲。它由一台300额定聚变核心驱动，幻术师CJR-7装6具跳跃推进器。一门大型脉冲激光和2具LRM-5构成CJR-7武器的大部分，另有一对增程中型激光用于近战。 特性：扩展躯干旋转 投放费用倍率：1.1

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Designed as a successor to the Wolverine, the Conjurer is a 50-ton Mech seen in Clan Second Line formations. Powered by a 300-rated Fusion Core, the Conjurer CJR-7 mounts 6 Jump jets. A Large Pulse Laser and 2 LRM-5’s form the bulk of the CJR-7’s weapons, with a pair of ER Medium Lasers for close combat.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为狼獾的后继者而设计，咒术师是一种出现在氏族二线编队中的50吨机甲。咒术师CJR-7由一具300级聚变核心驱动，装6个跳跃推进器。一门大型脉冲激光器和2具LRM-5构成CJR-7的主要武器，另有一对增程中型激光器用于近战。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Corona is a battle armor design that was created by Clan Star Adder following the Trials to determine which Clans would take part in Operation REVIVAL. The idea was to build the battlesuit around a weapon that could threaten 'Mechs from a distance. The mass necessary to mount such a heavy weapon resulted in a twenty percent armor decrease and the removal of the jump pack, despite a fifty percent overall increase in mass. Quirk: Intimidating Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.935 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can not swarm.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 科罗娜是星蝰部族在决定哪些部族参与“复兴行动”的试炼之后所创造的战斗装甲设计。其构想是围绕一件能从远处威胁机甲的武器来打造这套战斗服。安装如此沉重的武器所需的重量，导致装甲减少百分之二十并取消了跳跃背包，尽管整体重量增加了百分之五十。 特性：威慑 投放费用倍率：0.935 可搭载全向单位，可进行近战，无法发动蜂群攻击。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Corona is a battle armor design that was created by Clan Star Adder following the Trials to determine which Clans would take part in Operation REVIVAL. The idea was to build the battlesuit around a weapon that could threaten 'Mechs from a distance. The mass necessary to mount such a heavy weapon resulted in a twenty percent armor decrease and the removal of the jump pack, despite a fifty percent overall increase in mass.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 日冕是星蝰氏族在确定哪些氏族参加复兴行动的试炼之后创造的战斗装甲设计。其理念是围绕一件能从远距离威胁机甲的武器来打造整套战斗服。为承载如此重型的武器所需的质量，导致装甲减少了百分之二十并拆除了跳跃背包，尽管整体质量增加了百分之五十。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Jake Kalmar's infamous Ravager was built around a 285-rated XL Engine to save weight to carry eighteen tons of armor and fifteen double heat sinks. Offensively the Ravager is armed with a Gauss Rifle in the left arm and a Ultra AC/5 in the right torso, supported by a center torso mounted Large Pulse Laser, a standard Large Laser in the left torso and right arm, rounded out by a Medium Laser in the head and each arm. Two tons each of Gauss and UAC reloads gave it good endurance. The 'Mech was salvaged by Chloe's Cavaliers after they tracked Kalmar to Sigurd in 3037 and killed him there. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.19 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 杰克·卡尔马（Jake Kalmar）那台臭名昭著的“揉躏者”（Ravager）以额定 285 的 XL 引擎为核心，从而省下重量来携带十八吨装甲和十五台双散热器。在攻击方面，揉躏者的左臂装有一门高斯步枪，右躯干装有一门超速 AC/5，并由中央躯干的大型脉冲激光、左躯干与右臂的标准大型激光提供支援，头部与每条手臂各一门中型激光则补齐了配置。高斯弹药与 UAC 弹药各两吨，使它具备良好的持续作战能力。3037 年，克洛伊骑兵团（Chloe's Cavaliers）追踪卡尔马至西格德（Sigurd）并将其击毙后，回收了这台机甲。 特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1.19 手臂驱动器限制：右上

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Boss, what on earth is this thing? I'm all one for a challenge but this thing looks like a pirate deathtrap. Somehow it works but I couldn't begin to tell you why or how it works.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 老板，这玩意儿到底是什么？我不怕挑战，但这东西看起来像个海盗死亡陷阱。它不知怎么就能用，但我完全说不出它为什么、以及怎么能用。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Corvis 1 is built on a Model MH-24 endo steel chassis, protected by seven tons of ferro-fibrous armor; a good thing since it is so slow. This low speed is due to the 160-rated fusion engine that powers the 'Mech. Thankfully this low speed is augmented by four jump jets, giving the Corvis a jump range of 120 meters. The main gun of the Corvis is its UAC/10, backed up by a pair of medium pulse lasers. These guns enable the Corvis to operate effectively in medium to short ranges. Between the generous supply of autocannon ammunition and 10 double heat sinks that keep the 'Mech chilled, the Corvis can operate without resupply for a respectable amount of time. Quirk: Modular Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Corvis 1 以 Model MH-24 内骨架机体建造，由七吨铁纤维装甲保护；鉴于它的速度如此之慢，这倒是件好事。低速源于为机甲提供动力的 160 级聚变引擎。所幸四具跳跃推进器弥补了这一缺陷，使 Corvis 拥有 120 米的跳跃距离。Corvis 的主炮是 UAC/10，辅以两门中型脉冲激光。这些武器让 Corvis 在中近距离都能有效作战。凭借充裕的自动炮弹药和 10 具让机甲保持凉爽的双散热器，Corvis 能够在相当长的时间内无需补给持续作战。 特性：模块化武器 投放费用倍率：1.08 手臂驱动器限制：右臂下部

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Corvis was one of the predecessors to the OmniMech, utilizing the same semi-modular ports as the Star League Mercury BattleMech. Clan technicians eventually expanded upon this design to create the Stormcrow, and with the development of that front-line OmniMech, all of the Clans save the Horses lost interest in the Corvis, which was often derided as too slow for its weight class. In fact, the Corvis' only saving grace is its use of jump jets, because they allow the medium-range 'Mech to be useful when on restricting terrain, such as urban environments. The Corvis was often deployed as support for conventional troops, such as combat vehicles and infantry, so it only seems natural that the Horses would want to keep producing it.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 科维斯是全方位机甲的前身之一，使用了与星盟水星战斗机甲相同的半模块化接口。氏族技师最终在这一设计上扩展创造出暴风鸦，而随着那台前线全方位机甲的研发，除地狱马之外的所有氏族都对科维斯失去了兴趣，它常被嘲笑为对其重量级而言太慢。事实上，科维斯唯一可取之处就是它对跳跃推进器的使用，因为它们让这台中型机甲在受限制的地形（如城市环境）中仍有用处。科维斯常被部署为常规部队（如战斗车辆与步兵）的支援，所以地狱马想继续生产它似乎也很自然。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: With a focus on indirect fire support, the COU-A fields a pair of Artemis IV guided LRM-20s. If the pilot finds itself in a position with direct line of sight he or she can also rely on a pair of ERML's and a single backup Small Pulse Laser. In total this makes for a lot of firepower in a very small package. Quirk: Advanced Optics Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.01 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: COU-A专注间接火力支援，装备两具由阿尔忒弥斯IV制导的LRM-20。若机师获得直视射界，还可依靠两具增程中型激光和一具备用的小型脉冲激光。总体而言，这让它在极小的机体中汇聚了相当可观的火力。 特性：高级光学 投放费用倍率：1.01 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: With a focus on indirect fire support, the COU-A fields a pair of Artemis IV guided LRM-20s. If the pilot finds itself in a position with direct line of sight he or she can also rely on a pair of ERML's and a single backup Small Pulse Laser. In total this makes for a lot of firepower in a very small package.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: COU-A 聚焦间接火力支援，装备一对 Artemis IV 制导的 LRM-20。若飞行员处于有直射视野的位置，还可依靠两门 ER 中型激光和一门备用小型脉冲激光。总而言之，这在极小的机体中汇聚了极其可观的火力。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Cougar-B is a classic clan direct fire support / sniper build. Dual ERPPCs and a backup ERML make for a formidable punch. With a set of six additional Double Heatsinks the COU-B runs reasonably cool and is able to keep its barrage up for quite a while. Quirk: Advanced Optics Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.01 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 美洲狮-B 是典型的部族直射火力支援/狙击配置。两门增程粒子炮加上一门作为备份的增程中型激光，构成相当可观的打击力。额外的六个双散热器让 COU-B 运行得相当凉爽，能够长时间持续倾泻火力。 特性：先进光学系统 投放费用倍率：1.01 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Cougar-B is a classic clan direct fire support / sniper build. Dual ERPPCs and a backup ERML make for a formidable punch. With a set of six additional Double Heatsinks the COU-B runs reasonably cool and is able to keep its barrage up for quite a while.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 美洲狮-B 是经典的氏族直射火力支援/狙击配置。双 ER PPC 加一门备用 ER 中型激光构成强大的打击力。凭借六台额外双倍散热器，COU-B 散热相当理想，能长时间维持火力倾泻。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A custom Cougar configuration, the Blood Adder is armed with a pair of ATM-9’s. A pair of torso mounted HMG’s back the ATM’s up at closer ranges while a head mounted AMS enhances the configurations defensive capabilities. Quirk: Advanced Optics Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为美洲狮的定制配置，血蝰蛇装有一对ATM-9。两挺躯干机枪在较近距离为ATM提供后手，头部一套反导弹系统则增强该配置的防御能力。 特性：先进光学 投放费用倍率：1.03 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A custom Cougar configuration, the Blood Adder is armed with a pair of ATM-9’s. A pair of torso mounted HMG’s back the ATM’s up at closer ranges while a head mounted AMS enhances the configurations defensive capabilities.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为美洲狮的定制配置，血蝰武装为两具ATM-9。两挺装在躯干的重型机枪在更近距离为ATM提供后援，而头部的AMS增强该配置的防御能力。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A mix of long and medium range weaponry is what makes the Cougar-C variant quite unique. A Gauss Rifle is an absolutely scary main weapon system for a mech of just 35 tons and even the backup weapons are more than enough to strike fear in its enemies heart: 5 ERML will allow the COU-C to stay active and dangerous even after the ammo for the Gauss is depleted. Quirk: Advanced Optics Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.01 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 远程与中程武器的混装使美洲狮-C变型相当独特。就一台仅35吨的机甲而言，高斯步枪是绝对可怕的主武器系统，就连后备武器也足以在敌人心中种下恐惧：5门ERML让COU-C即便在高斯弹药耗尽后仍能保持活跃与危险。 特性：先进光学 投放费用倍率：1.01 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A mix of long and medium range weaponry is what makes the Cougar-C variant quite unique. A Gauss Rifle is an absolutely scary main weapon system for a mech of just 35 tons and even the backup weapons are more than enough to strike fear in its enemies heart: 5 ERML will allow the COU-C to stay active and dangerous even after the ammo for the Gauss is depleted.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 长中程武器的混合让美洲狮-C 变体相当独特。对一台仅 35 吨的机甲而言，一门高斯步枪绝对是令人恐惧的主武器系统，而备用武器也足以让敌人心中生畏：5 门 ER 中型激光使 COU-C 在高斯弹药耗尽的仍能保持活跃与危险。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Conceptualized to be a sniper with a good near field defense the Cougar-D variant relies on a single ERLL and an Ultra Autocannon/10 for long range and dual SRM4 launchers for close range fire. The COU-D might not be quick, but if he closes in after ripping the armor open, these Short Range Missiles have great finishing potential. Quirk: Advanced Optics Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.01 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 美洲狮-D变型的设计构想是兼具优秀近距防御的狙击手：远程依靠一门ERLL和一门超级自动炮/10，近程则用双联SRM4发射器。COU-D也许不算快，但如果它撕开装甲后逼近，这些近程导弹的收割能力极强。 特性：先进光学 投放费用倍率：1.01 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Conceptualized to be a sniper with a good near field defense the Cougar-D variant relies on a single ERLL and an Ultra Autocannon/10 for long range and dual SRM4 launchers for close range fire. The COU-D might not be quick, but if he closes in after ripping the armor open, these Short Range Missiles have great finishing potential.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 美洲狮-D 变体的构想是具备良好近场防御的狙击手，它依靠一门 ER 大型激光和一门超速自动炮/10 负责远程，双联 SRM4 发射器负责近程。COU-D 也许不算迅速，但如果它撕开装甲后贴近，这些短程火箭有很强的收尾能力。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This configuration was introduced during the 3060s. It was equipped with four Jump Jets and an ECM suite. This variant is armed with an Ultra Autocannon/5 and a trio of Heavy Medium Lasers for when any opponent tries to close range. It also has three additional double heat sinks to deal with heat the trio of heavy lasers produce. Quirk: Advanced Optics Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.01 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 此配置于3060年代推出，配备四具跳跃推进器和一套电子对抗套件。它装有一门超级AC/5和三门重型中型激光，以应对任何试图逼近的对手，另有三个额外双散热器处理三门重型激光产生的热量。 特性：先进光学 投放费用倍率：1.01 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A configuration focused on medium and short distance engagements, can do a fair amount of damage if used properly.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是一个专注中近距离交战的配置，使用得当能造成相当可观的伤害。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Huntress configuration of the Cougar is a rare sight, designed to be a scout hunter and Heavy Hitter is most of its capability shifted to advanced electronics and the ability to detect and effectively kill even stealthed units in a single devastating Blow. Quirk: Advanced Optics Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.01 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Cougar 的 Huntress 配置十分罕见，它的定位是猎杀侦察兵的“重击手”，大部分性能都转移到了先进电子设备上，并具备侦测乃至一击摧毁隐身单位的能力。 特性：高级光学 投放费用倍率：1.01 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Huntress configuration of the Cougar is a rare sight, designed to be a scout hunter and Heavy Hitter is most of its capability shifted to advanced electronics and the ability to detect and effectively kill even stealthed units in a single devastating Blow.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 美洲狮的"女猎手"配置十分罕见，旨在作为侦察猎手与重击手，其大部分能力都转向先进电子设备以及侦测并一击致命地干掉即使处于隐形状态的单位。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The primary configuration in the MC custom line of Cougars, based on an upgraded 210 XL engine instead of the stock 175 XL. The MCA's purpose is long rage attacks, carrying a LRM-15 and a Large Pulse Laser. For defensive purposes it mounts an Anti Missile System and to deal with infantry attacks the MCA also mounts a Flamer. Quirk: Advanced Optics Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.01 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是美洲狮MC定制品系列的主配置，基于升级的210 XL引擎而非原装175 XL。MCA的用途是远程打击，带一具LRM-15和一门大型脉冲激光。为自卫它装有一套反导弹系统，为应对步兵袭击还装有一具火焰喷射器。 特性：先进光学 投放费用倍率：1.01 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Khan Marthe Pryde decided to upgrade the 'Mechs her Clan fielded. Rather than waste precious resources designing a new OmniMech from the ground up, she instructed her scientists to improve upon existing designs. The design the scientists chose to modify was the Adder. Though the two 'Mechs are visually similar and share the same weight, the Cougar is slower and better armed.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 玛尔特·普莱德可汗决定升级其氏族装备的机甲。为不浪费宝贵资源从头设计新型全能机甲，她指示科学家改良现有设计。科学家选择改造的是蝰蛇。尽管两款机甲外观相似且重量相同，美洲狮更慢但武装更强。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Another configuration in the MC custom line of Cougars, based on an upgraded 210 XL engine instead of the stock 175 XL. The addition of six jump jets makes the MCJ one of the most mobile configurations of the Cougar, at the cost of only being able to mount a single LRM-15 launcher and a Large Pulse Laser for combat, with a chest mounted Flamer for defensive purposes. Quirk: Advanced Optics Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.01 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是Cougar的MC定制系列中的另一款构型，以升级的210 XL引擎取代原来的175 XL引擎。六具跳跃推进器的加入使MCJ成为Cougar中机动性最强的构型之一，代价是作战时只能装备一具LRM-15发射器与一门大型脉冲激光，并在胸部装一具火焰喷射器用于自卫。 特性：高级光学 投放费用倍率：1.01 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Khan Marthe Pryde decided to upgrade the 'Mechs her Clan fielded. Rather than waste precious resources designing a new OmniMech from the ground up, she instructed her scientists to improve upon existing designs. The design the scientists chose to modify was the Adder. Though the two 'Mechs are visually similar and share the same weight, the Cougar is slower and better armed.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 玛尔特·普莱德可汗决定升级其氏族装备的机甲。为不浪费宝贵资源从头设计新型全能机甲，她指示科学家改良现有设计。科学家选择改造的是蝰蛇。尽管两款机甲外观相似且重量相同，美洲狮更慢但武装更强。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Another configuration in the MC custom line of Cougars, based on an upgraded 210 XL engine instead of the stock 175 XL. Mounting four LRM-5 launchers and double Large Pulse Lasers, the damage profile is higher than expected. Quirk: Advanced Optics Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.01 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是美洲狮MC定制品系列的又一配置，基于升级的210 XL引擎而非原装175 XL。它装四具LRM-5发射器和双联大型脉冲激光，伤害曲线高于预期。 特性：先进光学 投放费用倍率：1.01 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Khan Marthe Pryde decided to upgrade the 'Mechs her Clan fielded. Rather than waste precious resources designing a new OmniMech from the ground up, she instructed her scientists to improve upon existing designs. The design the scientists chose to modify was the Adder. Though the two 'Mechs are visually similar and share the same weight, the Cougar is slower and better armed.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Coyotl has the honor of being the first OmniMech. Developed by Clan Coyote with some help from Clan Sea Fox, the Coyotl was first fielded in 2854. By using an XL Engine and Endo Steel chassis, the scientists were able to create a medium 'Mech that could carry a great deal of equipment. In addition, the high ground speed of the Coyotl allowed it to rush from one area of a battlefield to another, providing support for its teammates. The A configuration was introduced during a conflict against Clan Cloud Cobra. Seven Jump Jets gave the Coyotl A much greater maneuverability, while the long range weapons were traded for a Large Pulse Laser, Small Pulse Laser, and an additional Streak SRM-4 launcher. This version also dropped the Medium Pulse Laser of the original. Quirk: Extended Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Coyotl 拥有作为首款全向机甲的荣耀。它由郊狼部族在海洋狐部族的协助下开发，于 2854 年首次投入战场。通过采用 XL 引擎和内骨架机体，科学家们得以打造出一具能携带大量装备的中型机甲。此外，Coyotl 的高地面速度使其能够迅速从战场一处奔赴另一处，为队友提供支援。A 配置是在与云眼镜蛇部族的冲突中推出的。七具跳跃推进器大幅提升了 Coyotl A 的机动性，远程武器则被换成了一门大型脉冲激光、一门小型脉冲激光和一具额外的连发 SRM-4 发射器。该版本还去掉了原型的中型脉冲激光。 特性：扩展躯干旋转 投放费用倍率：1.03 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This is the first of them all. The Grandfather that paved the path for the Omni revolution. Too bad it isn't that great a 'Mech compared to later designs. But at least it has historical value.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是它们中的第一款，是为全向机甲革命铺平道路的鼻祖。可惜与后来的设计相比，它算不上出色的机甲。但至少它有历史价值。

The B configuration uses an Ultra AC/10 in the right arm as its main firepower, supported by an ER Medium Laser and SRM-6 launcher. Quirk: Extended Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Coyotl has the honor of being the first OmniMech. Developed by Clan Coyote with some help from Clan Sea Fox, the Coyotl was first fielded in 2854. By using an XL Engine and Endo Steel chassis, the scientists were able to create a medium 'Mech that could carry a great deal of equipment. In addition, the high ground speed of the Coyotl allowed it to rush from one area of a battlefield to another, providing support for its teammates. The primary version of the Coyotl used an ER PPC and LRM-10 as the primary long range weapons, while a Medium Pulse Laser and Streak SRM-4 provided short range firepower. Originally the engineers thought they would build each variant around the PPC, but this proved to be too limiting, particularly with the high heat it caused. The missile systems were added to provide firepower at a lower heat cost. Quirk: Extended Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Coyotl 有幸成为史上第一款全向机甲。它由郊狼族在海狐族的协助下研发，于 2854 年首次投入战场。通过采用 XL 引擎和内骨架，科学家们得以打造出一款能携带大量装备的中型机甲。此外，Coyotl 出众的地面速度使其能够迅速在战场各处穿梭，为队友提供支援。Coyotl 的主配置以一门增程粒子炮和一具 LRM-10 作为主要远程武器，一门中型脉冲激光和一具连发 SRM-4 则提供近距离火力。最初工程师们打算围绕粒子炮来打造每一个变型机，但这被证明限制过多，尤其是粒子炮产生的高热量。导弹系统正是为了以更低的热量代价提供火力而加入的。 特性：扩展躯干旋转 投放费用倍率：1.03 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This is the first of them all. The Grandfather that paved the path for the Omni revolution. Too bad it isn't that great a 'Mech compared to later designs. But at least it has historical value.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是它们中的第一款，是为全向机甲革命铺平道路的鼻祖。可惜与后来的设计相比，它算不上出色的机甲。但至少它有历史价值。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A Star League era training mech, the Crockett was introduced in 2735. An 85-ton mech with a mix of weapon types alongside double heat sinks, the Crockett would go on to see frontline service as a command mech and assault mech. The CRK-5003-0 is a downgrade resulting from the Succession War’s decline in technology and features a 255-rated engine alongside a trio of Jump Jets. A pair of Large Lasers and an AC/10 form the bulk of the mechs weapons, with paired SRM-6's Lasers and Small Lasers surprising opponents at close range. Quirk: Easy to Pilot Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.13 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Crockett是星际联盟时代的训练机甲，于2735年推出。这台85吨机甲混合了多种武器类型并配备双散热器，后来更作为指挥机甲与突击机甲在前线服役。CRK-5003-0是继承战争导致科技衰退后产生的降级版本，配备一具255级引擎与三具跳跃推进器。两门大型激光与一门AC/10构成这台机甲的主要武器，而配对的SRM-6、激光与小型激光则能在近距离让对手措手不及。 特性：易于驾驶 投放费用倍率：1.13 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

The CRK-5003-0 is a downgrade resulting from the Succession War’s decline in technology and features a 255-rated engine alongside a trio of Jump Jets. A pair of Large Lasers and an AC/10 form the bulk of the mechs weapons, with paired SRM-6's Lasers and Small Lasers surprising opponents at close range.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为星盟时代的教练机甲，克罗基特于2735年推出。作为一台85吨机甲，混合使用多种武器类型并配双重散热器，克罗基特后来作为指挥机甲与突击机甲执行前线任务。CRK-5003-0是继承战争技术衰退导致的降级版本，采用一具255级引擎和三个跳跃推进器。两门大型激光器和一门AC/10构成该机甲武器的主体，另有成对的SRM-6和小型激光器在近距离给对手一个惊喜。
