The Sharks spared no expense in weight-saving materials, making use of an XL Engine, Endo Steel structure, and seven and a half tons of Ferro-Fibrous armor. The incredible speed of the Grendel is not terribly helpful in most zellbrigen duels, but it is effective in large-scale actions. The primary configuration uses an ER Large Laser at long range, but really excels at closer ranges. It mounts three ER Medium Lasers that can be devastating to light 'Mechs and a Streak SRM-6 that exploits any holes the lasers make. An ER Small Laser that is effective at point-blank range seems an afterthought. This design is best using its large laser to soften up an opponent, then dash closer in a flurry of lasers and missiles. Two extra double heat sinks help to keep the design mostly cool.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 格伦德尔配备一台强力的315级引擎，使其能以119公里/小时的迅捷速度移动，机架上固接的跳跃推进器足以让它一跃达210米。鲨鱼在减重材料上不惜成本，采用XL引擎、内层钢结构以及七吨半铁纤装甲。格伦德尔惊人的速度在大多数泽尔布林根决斗中帮助不大，但在大规模行动中很有效。主配置在远距离使用一门增程大型激光器，但在更近距离上才真正出色。它装有三门增程中型激光器，对轻型机甲足以造成毁灭打击，另有一具连发SRM-6用以利用激光打出的任何破口。一门在贴身距离有效的增程小型激光器看来是事后加上的。这套设计最好先用大型激光器削弱对手，然后在一连串激光与导弹中冲刺逼近。两具额外双重散热器帮助该设计大体保持凉快。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The original Griffin produced by Maxwell Manufacturing, Inc. weighed sixty tons (thus technically falling into the Heavy category of BattleMechs) and used primitive components. It could reach a top speed of 64 km/h and cover ninety meters with Prototype Jump Jets. It also carried a Prototype PPC and a single LRM-5 with a ton of ammunition. It was protected by fourteen and a half tons of Primitive Armor and equipped with eleven single heat sinks. A Primitive Cockpit was provided for the pilot. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.86 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 麦克斯韦制造公司生产的原版狮鹫重六十吨（因此技术上属于重型战斗机甲）并使用原始部件。它最高可达64公里/小时，用原型跳跃推进器能跨越九十米；另带一门原型粒子炮和一具LRM-5（配一吨弹药），由十四吨半原始装甲保护，并配十一个单散热器。飞行员使用原始座舱。 特性：战拳 投放费用倍率：0.86 手臂驱动器限制：右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A Griffin as primitive as can be. Do not expect much performance from this one.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一台能有多原始就有多原始的格里芬。别指望这台有什么好表现。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Designed after the personal ‘Mech of Elle Bennett of the 5th Donegal Guards, the GRF-1E 'Sparky' is a radical departure from standard Griffin design ethos. In place of its typical missile rack, the 1E features enough power couplings to mount a cluster of Medium Lasers - five of them, in fact - alongside the typical PPC. In a curious design decision, the engineers behind the Sparky opted for an innovative radiator pattern instead of more sophisticated heat sinks, likely as a cost-saving experiment. While this does give the 'Mech above-average heat dissipation, it's provided complement of standard heat sinks is still woefully inadequate for such a high heat load. This means that, while powerful, this 'Mech needs an equally disciplined pilot to avoid cooking alive. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.07
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: GRF-1E“闪电”以第5多尼戈尔卫队埃勒·班尼特的私人机甲为蓝本设计，是对标准狮鹫设计理念的一次激进背离。1E以其典型的导弹挂架位置，改装了足够的动力接头来装一组中型激光——实际上是五门——外加标准粒子炮。一个令人费解的设计决定是，闪电背后的工程师选择了一种创新的散热片布置，而非更精密的散热器，很可能是出于省钱的实验。虽然这确实赋予机甲高于平均的散热能力，但它配装的标准散热器对如此高的热负荷仍远远不够。这意味着它虽然强力，却需要同样自律的飞行员才能避免被活活烤熟。 特性：战拳 投放费用倍率：1.07

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Designed after the personal ‘Mech of Elle Bennett of the 5th Donegal Guards, the GRF-1E 'Sparky' is a radical departure from standard Griffin design ethos. In place of its typical missile rack, the 1E features enough power couplings to mount a cluster of Medium Lasers - five of them, in fact - alongside the typical PPC. In a curious design decision, the engineers behind the Sparky opted for an innovative radiator pattern instead of more sophisticated heat sinks, likely as a cost-saving experiment. While this does give the 'Mech above-average heat dissipation, it's provided complement of standard heat sinks is still woefully inadequate for such a high heat load. This means that, while powerful, this 'Mech needs an equally disciplined pilot to avoid cooking alive.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: GRF-1E"火花"以第五多尼戈尔卫队的艾尔·班尼特的私人机甲为蓝本设计，是对标准格里芬设计理念的激进背离。1E用足够的电力耦合线路替代其典型的导弹架，以在标准PPC之外挂载一组中型激光器——事实上是五门。在一个奇怪的设计决定中，火花背后的工程师选择了创新的散热片样式而非更精密复杂的散热器，大概是作为一项省成本的实验。虽然这确实赋予该机甲高于平均的散热能力，它所配备的标准散热器对这种高热负荷仍然远远不足。这意味着，尽管它威力强大，这台机甲需要一名同样自律的飞行员，以免被活活烤熟。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Ares was the 'Mech of the gladiator Peter Armstrong before his eventual loss to Justin Allard in a duel set in The Factory. The 'Mech was so heavily damaged that Armstrong suffered fatal injuries and passed away. The 'Mech was eventually recovered and restored by a former close friend of his, the gladiator Roger Boll. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 战神是角斗士彼得·阿姆斯特朗的机甲，直到他最终在“工厂”决斗中败给贾斯汀·阿拉德。该机甲损毁严重，阿姆斯特朗伤重不治身亡。机甲后来由他的生前好友、角斗士罗杰·博尔寻回并修复。 特性：战拳 投放费用倍率：1.05

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Ares was the 'Mech of the gladiator Peter Armstrong before his eventual loss to Justin Allard in a duel set in The Factory. The 'Mech was so heavily damaged that Armstrong suffered fatal injuries and passed away. The 'Mech was eventually recovered and restored by a former close friend of his, the gladiator Roger Boll.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 战神是角斗士彼得·阿姆斯特朗的机甲，直到他最终在"工厂"举行的一场决斗中败给贾斯汀·阿拉德。那台机甲损毁过重，阿姆斯特朗身负致命伤并因此去世。这台机甲最终被他的一位生前好友、角斗士罗杰·博尔回收修复。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A battlefield refit of the 1N, adding a small laser for anti-infantry protection and a C3 slave unit at the cost of dropping the extra heat sinks. The 1NR also protects the LRM ammunition with a C.A.S.E. system. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是1N的野战改装，加装一门小型激光用于反步兵防护，并以拆掉额外散热器为代价加装一台C3从机。1NR还用C.A.S.E.系统保护LRM弹药。 特性：战拳 投放费用倍率：1.03

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Griffin family of 'Mechs use their Jump Jets to stay at range and pelt their opponents from relative safety. They can run hot if they spend all their time bounding around the battlefield taking potshots, though.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 格里芬系列的机甲利用它们的跳跃推进器保持距离，在相对安全的位置痛击对手。不过如果它们一直绕着战场蹦跳打冷枪，也会过热。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An anti-infantry refit of the Griffin, mounting three medium and two small lasers and two machine guns. One Large Laser is used for dealing with heavier targets. To be able to fit all the weapons, the Jump Jets have been removed, reducing the mobility of the 'Mech quite a bit. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 狮鹫的反步兵改装型，装有三具中型激光、两具小型激光和两挺机枪，另用一具大型激光对付较重的目标。为容纳全部武器，跳跃推进器被拆除，机甲的机动性因此下降不少。 特性：战拳 投放费用倍率：1.03

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An anti-infantry refit of the Griffin, mounting three medium and two small lasers and two machine guns. One Large Laser is used for dealing with heavier targets. To be able to fit all the weapons, the Jump Jets have been removed, reducing the mobility of the 'Mech quite a bit.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是格里芬的反步兵改装，装有三门中型、两门小型激光器和两挺机枪。一门大型激光器用于对付更重的目标。为了装下所有武器，跳跃推进器被拆除，机甲的机动性因此下降不少。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A battlefield refit of the GRF-1RG, removing half a ton of machine gun ammunition to upgrade one of the small lasers to a medium lasers and also move it to the center torso. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是GRF-1RG的野战改装，拆掉半吨机枪弹药，把其中一门小型激光升级为中型激光，并移到中央躯干。 特性：战拳 投放费用倍率：1.03

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A battlefield refit of the GRF-1RG, removing half a ton of machine gun ammunition to upgrade one of the small lasers to a medium lasers and also move it to the center torso.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是GRF-1RG的战地改装，拆掉半吨机枪弹药，把其中一门小型激光器升级为中型激光器，并把它移到中央躯干。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The -2N2 is a major refit of the original Griffin 2N. It exchanges the 10 tons of Ferro-Fibrous armor for 9.5 tons of standard, and replaces the two SRM-6 launchers with a Streak SRM-6 instead. It further exchanges the Guardian ECM for a Beagle Active Probe and removes one heat sink, but adds two Medium Pulse Lasers. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: -2N2是对原版狮鹫2N的大幅改装：它把10吨铁纤维装甲换成9.5吨标准装甲，并以一具连发SRM-6取代两具SRM-6发射器；还把守护者电子对抗套件换成比格犬主动探测器，拆掉一个散热器，但加装两门中型脉冲激光。 特性：战拳 投放费用倍率：1.05

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The -2N2 is a major refit of the original Griffin 2N. It exchanges the 10 tons of Ferro-Fibrous armor for 9.5 tons of standard, and replaces the two SRM-6 launchers with a Streak SRM-6 instead. It further exchanges the Guardian ECM for a Beagle Active Probe and removes one heat sink, but adds two Medium Pulse Lasers.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: -2N2是对原版格里芬2N的一次重大改装。它把10吨铁纤装甲换成9.5吨标准装甲，并把两具SRM-6发射器换成一具连发SRM-6。它还进一步把守卫者ECM换成比格犬主动探测器，并拆掉一具散热器，但加装两门中型脉冲激光器。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A Clan Invasion era version of the GRF-1RG, the 3RG retains the right-arm medium laser and torso machine guns but swaps the remaining lasers for their pulse laser equivalents. This swap is made possible in part by dropping one ton of machine gun ammo and removing three heat sinks though a swap to double strength models compensates somewhat for the reduction. Just like its predecessor the 3RG is mostly used to guard the leaders of the Lyran Commonwealth. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是部族入侵时期的GRF-1RG版本，3RG保留右臂中型激光和躯干机枪，其余激光则换成脉冲型号。这一更换部分得益于拆掉一吨机枪弹药和移除三个散热器，而改用双倍强度型号在一定程度上弥补了减少的损失。与其前身一样，3RG主要用于护卫莱兰联邦的领导人。 特性：战拳 投放费用倍率：1.05

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 3M Griffin was an upgraded version of the design built for House Marik by Earthwerks and Brigadier Corps starting in 3049. With production lines on Keystone and Oliver this variant sought to enhance the original's long-range capabilities. The engine was exchanged for a Hermes 275 extralight model and carried fourteen double heat sinks to improve heat management. The normal PPC was replaced by a Fusigon Longtooth ER PPC, for longer reach at the expense of more heat, and the LRM launcher had been upgraded to a Doombud LRM-20 launcher, for more indirect fire support capabilities. Finally a ChrisComp Small Laser was mounted in the head and the two tons of LRM reloads in the left torso were protected by CASE. While intended for the Free Worlds League Military the capture of Oliver by FedCom forces meant the 3M also appeared in large numbers in the Armed Forces of the Federated Commonwealth.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 3M 狮鹫是为马里克家族打造的升级版，由地球工厂与准将兵团自 3049 年起生产。借助基斯通与奥利弗的生产线，该变体力图强化原版的远程能力。引擎换成赫尔墨斯 275 超轻型，并携带十四台双倍散热器以改善散热管理。标准 PPC 换成"富西贡长牙"ER PPC，以更多热量换取更远射程；LRM 发射器升级为末日芽 LRM-20，以增强间接火力支援能力。最后，头部安装一门克里斯康小型激光，左躯干的两吨 LRM 再装填由 C.A.S.E. 保护。虽然原为自由世界联盟军队设计，但联邦联邦部队夺取奥利弗意味着 3M 也大量出现在联邦联邦武装部队中。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A custom modified Griffin used by the Kell Hounds. Using exclusively clan weapons allows the 'Mech the ability to cause far more damage than expected with its LRM-20 and ER PPC combo. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是凯尔猎犬使用的定制改装狮鹫。由于独用部族武器，该机甲能借其LRM-20与增程粒子炮的组合造成远超预期的伤害。 特性：战拳 投放费用倍率：1.05

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A custom modified Griffin used by the Kell Hounds. Using exclusively clan weapons allows the 'Mech the ability to cause far more damage than expected with its LRM-20 and ER PPC combo.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是凯尔猎犬使用的一台定制改装格里芬。完全采用氏族武器使该机甲凭借其LRM-20与增程PPC的组合，能造成远超预期的伤害。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Clans upgraded and lightened the venerable Griffin design until the BattleMech now known as the Griffin IIC emerged. Seven tons of Ferro-Fibrous armor are mounted on an Endo Steel frame, giving the Griffin IIC almost maximum armor protection for its size. It is slightly faster than its antecedent, and it correspondingly mounts enough jump jets to leap up to 180 meters at a time. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 氏族对经典的狮鹫设计不断升级减重，最终诞生了如今被称为狮鹫 IIC 的战斗机甲。七吨铁纤维装甲装在内骨骼框架上，使狮鹫 IIC 拥有接近其尺寸上限的装甲防护。它比前身略快，也相应装足了可一次跃出 180 米的跳跃推进器。 特质：战斗铁拳 投放费用倍率：1.06

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A Griffin sporting ClanTech upgrades, they've stuffed roughly the equivalent of an Inner Sphere Griffin into a package 15 tons lighter.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一台装备氏族技术升级的狮鹫，他们把一个内天体狮鹫的等价战力塞进了轻 15 吨的机体里。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Similar to the IIC 2, this variant retains the large laser, but trades out the rest of the armament for a Heavy Small Laser, two Streak SRM-2s and two Heavy Medium Lasers. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 与IIC 2类似，这一变型保留了大型激光，但把其余武装换成一门重型小型激光、两具连发SRM-2与两门重型中型激光。 特性：战拳 投放费用倍率：1.06

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A Griffin sporting ClanTech upgrades, they've stuffed roughly the equivalent of an Inner Sphere Griffin into a package 15 tons lighter.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一台装备氏族技术升级的狮鹫，他们把一个内天体狮鹫的等价战力塞进了轻 15 吨的机体里。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This upgrade was first designed by Clan Nova Cat with assistance from Clan Diamond Shark and Clan Cloud Cobra. It retains the Series 7NC ER Large Laser and Series 1NC ER Small Laser, but replaces the missile launchers with a pair of ATM 3s. Three tons of ammunition allow for maximum flexibility. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这一升级最初由新星猫部族设计，钻石鲨部族与云眼镜蛇部族提供了协助。它保留了 7NC 系列增程大型激光和 1NC 系列增程小型激光，但把导弹发射器换成了两具 ATM-3。三吨弹药带来了最大的灵活性。 特性：战拳 投放费用倍率：1.06

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A Griffin sporting ClanTech upgrades, they've stuffed roughly the equivalent of an Inner Sphere Griffin into a package 15 tons lighter.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一台装备氏族技术升级的狮鹫，他们把一个内天体狮鹫的等价战力塞进了轻 15 吨的机体里。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Clans upgraded and lightened the venerable Griffin design until the BattleMech now known as the Griffin IIC emerged. Seven tons of Ferro-Fibrous armor are mounted on an Endo Steel frame, giving the Griffin IIC almost maximum armor protection for its size. It is slightly faster than its antecedent, and it correspondingly mounts enough jump jets to leap up to 180 meters at a time. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 部族对历史悠久的 Griffin 设计进行了升级和减重，最终诞生了如今被称为 Griffin IIC 的战斗机甲。七吨铁纤维装甲安装在内骨架上，使 Griffin IIC 获得了接近其体量极限的装甲防护。它比前代机型略快，并相应配备了足以一次跃出 180 米的跳跃推进器。 特性：战拳 投放费用倍率：1.08

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This one's a bit unusual for a Griffin, sporting only short to mid range brawling weapons instead of being built for fire support.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这一台对格里芬来说有点不寻常，它只装短到中程的近战武器，而不是为火力支援而建。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The primary configuration of the Grotesque mounts a Gauss Rifle in the left arm and the combination of an ER PPC and a SRM 4 launcher in the right. A single center torso mounted ER Medium Laser provides extra firepower as needed. The 'Mech also carries a 4 ton targeting computer to improve its battlefield performance. Quirk: Stable Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 怪诞的主配置在左臂安装一门高斯步枪，右臂则是增程粒子炮与一具SRM 4发射器的组合。中央躯干单独安装的一门增程中型激光可在需要时提供额外火力。该机甲还搭载一台重4吨的瞄准计算机，以提升其战场表现。 特性：稳定武器 投放费用倍率：1.15 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Grotesque is an 80 ton Clan OmniMech designed by Clan Diamond Shark. An offshoot of the Gargoyle program, it was an attempt to branch out into more varied designs. Besides using the same basic setup of a 400 XL engine and ferro-fibrous armor as the Gargoyle, the Grotesque further attempts to free up more pod capacity by using an Endo Steel structure. As the original production run of the 'Mech never saw much success, its production was not continued for very long before the project was abandoned.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 怪诞是钻石鲨部族设计的一款80吨部族全向机甲，是石像鬼计划的分支，意在拓展出更多样化的设计。除沿用石像鬼的400 XL引擎与铁纤维装甲基本方案外，怪诞还进一步尝试用内骨架结构释放更多挂载容量。由于最初的量产从未取得多大成功，它的生产并未持续多久，项目便被放弃。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Guardian GRD-1N is armed with five machine guns, one mounted in each arm, in each torso side and in the center torso, respectively. Two and a half tons of ammunition in the right torso provide an ample supply of ammunition. Quirk: Accurate Weapon - MG Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.97
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 守卫者GRD-1N装有5挺机枪，分别安装在左右手臂、左右侧躯干和中央躯干各1挺。右躯干内的2.5吨弹药为其提供了充足的补给。 <特性：精准武器（机枪） <投放费用倍率：0.97

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Although a BattleMech by design (and not an IndustrialMech, like most SecurityMechs), the ultralight Guardian was not made for the military. Instead, it was marketed as a SecurityMech and sold to large corporations and law enforcement agencies. Its relatively small size and low weight allows it to go where other 'Mechs could not, giving it somewhat better mobility in urban environments. However, its relatively slow speed means that almost all other 'Mechs can run it down.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 虽然按设计来说是战斗机甲（而非大多数保安机甲那样的工业机甲），超轻型的守卫者并非为军用而造，而是作为保安机甲营销，卖给大型企业与执法机构。它相对小巧轻便，能去其他机甲去不了的地方，在城市环境中机动性略好；但相对缓慢的速度意味着几乎所有其他机甲都能追上它。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A frequent field refit for Guardians is to drop half a ton of ammunition to replace one machine gun with a medium laser, to give it at least a chance to stand against other 'Mechs. It remains a poor fighting machine when compared to virtually any other BattleMech. Quirk: Accurate Weapon - MG Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.97
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 卫士常见的战场改装方式是削减半吨弹药，用一门中型激光替换一挺机枪，好让它至少有机会与其他机甲一较高下。但即便如此，与几乎任何其他战斗机甲相比，它依然是一台糟糕的战斗机器。 特性：精准武器 - 机枪 投放费用倍率：0.97

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Although a BattleMech by design (and not an IndustrialMech, like most SecurityMechs), the ultralight Guardian was not made for the military. Instead, it was marketed as a SecurityMech and sold to large corporations and law enforcement agencies. Its relatively small size and low weight allows it to go where other 'Mechs could not, giving it somewhat better mobility in urban environments. However, its relatively slow speed means that almost all other 'Mechs can run it down.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 虽然按设计来说是战斗机甲（而非大多数保安机甲那样的工业机甲），超轻型的守卫者并非为军用而造，而是作为保安机甲营销，卖给大型企业与执法机构。它相对小巧轻便，能去其他机甲去不了的地方，在城市环境中机动性略好；但相对缓慢的速度意味着几乎所有其他机甲都能追上它。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Designed in 2499 for the Terran Hegemony and later the SLDF, the Guillotine served as a heavy raider; using a combination of speed and Jump Jets to out manoeuvre opponents. The Guillotine 3N is armed with a Large Laser and a quartet of Medium Lasers, backed up by an SRM-6 for close range engagements. Quirk: Integrated Searchlight Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08 Arm Actuator Limits: Right Lower, Left Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 断头台（Guillotine）于 2499 年为地球霸权设计，后来也装备了 SLDF，担任重型袭击机甲，依靠速度与跳跃推进器的结合在机动上压制对手。断头台 3N 装备一门大型激光和四门中型激光，并有一具 SRM-6 作为近距离交战的补充火力。 特性：内置探照灯 投放费用倍率：1.08 手臂驱动器限制：右下、左上

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Designed in 2499 for the Terran Hegemony and later the SLDF, the Guillotine served as a heavy raider; using a combination of speed and Jump Jets to out manoeuvre opponents. The Guillotine 3N is armed with a Large Laser and a quartet of Medium Lasers, backed up by an SRM-6 for close range engagements.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 断头台于 2499 年为地球霸权设计，后来也服务于 SLDF，担任重型袭击机甲，结合速度与跳跃推进器在机动性上压倒对手。断头台 3N 装备一门大型激光和四门中型激光，并配有一具 SRM-6 用于近距离交战。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Delivered to Kapten Harald Estridsen of the Free Rasalhague Republic, this Guillotine variant was initially designed by ComStar. It has been updated with double heat sinks and upgraded weaponry. Kapten Estridsen suspects that it was a prototype for a new Com Guard variant that was shipped to him by mistake. Quirk: Integrated Searchlight Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14 Arm Actuator Limits: Right Lower, Left Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这台断头台变型交付给了自由拉什哈格共和国的哈拉尔德·埃斯特里德森上尉，最初由通讯之星设计。它已更新为双散热器并升级了武器。埃斯特里德森上尉怀疑，它本是通讯之星卫队某个新型变型的原型机，却被误送到了他手上。 特性：集成探照灯 投放费用倍率：1.14 手臂驱动器限制：右下、左上

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Designed in 2499 for the Terran Hegemony and later the SLDF, the Guillotine served as a heavy raider; using a combination of speed and Jump Jets to out manoeuvre opponents. The Guillotine 3N is armed with a Large Laser and a quartet of Medium Lasers, backed up by an SRM-6 for close range engagements.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 断头台于 2499 年为地球霸权设计，后来也服务于 SLDF，担任重型袭击机甲，结合速度与跳跃推进器在机动性上压倒对手。断头台 3N 装备一门大型激光和四门中型激光，并配有一具 SRM-6 用于近距离交战。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 4L Guillotine is a downgraded version of the original 3N model introduced in 2825. Although 3N used a significant number of off-the-shelf components, the two exceptions were its Endo Steel internal structure and CASE to protect its ammunition bay. The 4L was a simple redesign that consisted of utilizing a standard internal structure, removing its CASE system and three single heat sinks to free up the necessary tonnage. Quirk: Integrated Searchlight Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08 Arm Actuator Limits: Right Lower, Left Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 4L Guillotine 是 2825 年推出的原始 3N 型号的降级版本。虽然 3N 大量采用现成部件，但有两处例外——采用内骨架的内部结构，以及保护弹药舱的 CASE。4L 只是一次简单的重新设计：改用标准内部结构，拆除 CASE 系统和三具单散热器，以腾出所需的吨位。 特性：集成探照灯 投放费用倍率：1.08 手臂驱动器限制：右下、左上

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Designed in 2499 for the Terran Hegemony and later the SLDF, the Guillotine served as a heavy raider; using a combination of speed and Jump Jets to out manoeuvre opponents. The Guillotine 4L is armed with a Large Laser and a quartet of Medium Lasers, backed up by an SRM-6 for close range engagements.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 断头台于2499年为地球霸权、后来为SLDF设计，充当重型袭扰者；利用速度与跳跃推进器的组合机动压制对手。断头台4L武装为一门大型激光器和四门中型激光器，另有一具SRM-6作为近距离交战的后援。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This variant of the 4L model was introduced in 2833. While few pilots were willing to tamper with the original design, this refit replaces the Large Laser with a PPC at the expense of two tons of armor. Results with this variant have been mixed. Quirk: Integrated Searchlight Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08 Arm Actuator Limits: Right Lower, Left Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该变型属于 4L 型号，于 2833 年推出。虽然很少有飞行员愿意改动原始设计，但这次改装仍以牺牲两吨装甲为代价，用粒子炮替换了大型激光。该变型的实战表现褒贬不一。 特性：内置探照灯 投放费用倍率：1.08 手臂驱动器限制：右臂下部、左臂上部

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Designed in 2499 for the Terran Hegemony and later the SLDF, the Guillotine served as a heavy raider; using a combination of speed and Jump Jets to out manoeuvre opponents. The Guillotine 4P is armed with a PPC and a quartet of Medium Lasers, backed up by an SRM-6 for close range engagements.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 断头台于2499年为地球霸权、后来为SLDF设计，充当重型袭扰者；利用速度与跳跃推进器的组合机动压制对手。断头台4P武装为一门PPC和四门中型激光器，另有一具SRM-6作为近距离交战的后援。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 5M model is a redesign performed after the technological renaissance that started in the late 3040s. Introduced in 3049 the 5M is a 'Mech that is nearly identical to the original 3N. With the sole exception of the primary weapon being upgraded to a Sunbeam ER Large Laser model for extended reach, the 5M has an almost identical weaponry configuration, speed profile, and armor coverage as the 3N. Quirk: Integrated Searchlight Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1 Arm Actuator Limits: Right Lower, Left Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 5M 型号是 3040 年代末开始的技术复兴之后重新设计的产品。5M 于 3049 年推出，与原版 3N 几乎一模一样。除了主武器升级为射程更远的 Sunbeam 增程大型激光型号之外，5M 的武器配置、速度特性和装甲覆盖量都与 3N 几乎完全相同。 特性：集成探照灯 投放费用倍率：1.1 手臂驱动器限制：右下臂、左上臂

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Designed in 2499 for the Terran Hegemony and later the SLDF, the Guillotine served as a heavy raider; using a combination of speed and Jump Jets to out manoeuvre opponents. The Guillotine 3N is armed with an ER Large Laser and a quartet of Medium Lasers, backed up by an SRM-6 for close range engagements.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 断头台于2499年为地球霸权设计，后来也为SLDF效力，充当重型袭掠者：以速度与跳跃推进器的组合在机动上压过对手。断头台3N装有一门增程大型激光和四门中型激光，另有一具SRM-6用于近距交战。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An unofficial refresh of the basic Guillotine, mainly used by mercenaries, pirates and the occasional deep periphery militia. Quirk: Integrated Searchlight Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1 Arm Actuator Limits: Right Lower, Left Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是对基础断头台的民间翻新，主要被雇佣兵、海盗以及偶尔出现的外围纵深民兵使用。 特性：内置探照灯 投放费用倍率：1.1 手臂驱动器限制：右下、左上

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Designed in 2499 for the Terran Hegemony and later the SLDF, the Guillotine served as a heavy raider; using a combination of speed and Jump Jets to out manoeuvre opponents. The Guillotine 3N is armed with a Large Laser and a quartet of Medium Lasers, backed up by an SRM-6 for close range engagements.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 断头台于 2499 年为地球霸权设计，后来也服务于 SLDF，担任重型袭击机甲，结合速度与跳跃推进器在机动性上压倒对手。断头台 3N 装备一门大型激光和四门中型激光，并配有一具 SRM-6 用于近距离交战。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A Clan built upgrade of the Guillotine, the Guillotine IIC is assigned to second line units and solahma troops. The Guillotine IIC is armed with a pair of Large Pulse Lasers and an ER PPC. 2 ER Medium Lasers and an SRM-6 give the mech a nasty punch at closer ranges. Quirk: Integrated Searchlight Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是部族制造的断头台升级版，断头台IIC配属给二线单位与索拉马部队。它装有一对大型脉冲激光和一门增程粒子炮；2门增程中型激光和一具SRM-6在更近的距离上给该机甲凶狠的打击力。 特性：内置探照灯 投放费用倍率：1.14 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A Clan built upgrade of the Guillotine, the Guillotine IIC is assigned to second line units and solahma troops. The Guillotine IIC is armed with a pair of Large Pulse Lasers and an ER PPC. 2 ER Medium Lasers and an SRM-6 give the mech a nasty punch at closer ranges.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为断头台机甲的氏族升级版，断头台IIC配属二线单位与索拉赫玛部队。断头台IIC武装为两门大型脉冲激光器和一门增程PPC。2门增程中型激光器和一具SRM-6让该机甲在更近的距离上打出狠辣一击。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Jointly developed by the Federated Commonwealth and the Draconis Combine, the 85 ton Gunslinger entered production in 3053. Powered by a 255-rated XL Engine, the Gunslinger 1ERD is armed with a pair of Gauss Rifles. 4 Medium Lasers, a pair of Medium Pulse Lasers and a Small laser add additional firepower at close ranges. A Guardian ECM Suite and a Beagle Active Probe enhance the Mechs capabilities, while a pair of Jump Jets increase mobility. Quirk: Cowl Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 85吨的枪手由联邦共和国与龙脉联合体联合研制，于3053年投产。枪手1ERD由一台255额定XL引擎驱动，装有一对高斯步枪；4门中型激光、一对中型脉冲激光和一门小型激光在近距提供额外火力。一套守护者电子对抗套件和一台比格犬主动探测器增强机甲能力，两具跳跃推进器则提升机动性。 特性：机罩 投放费用倍率：1.15 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Jointly developed by the Federated Commonwealth and the Draconis Combine, the 85 ton Gunslinger entered production in 3053. Powered by a 255-rated XL Engine, the Gunslinger 1ERD is armed with a pair of Gauss Rifles. 4 Medium Lasers, a pair of Medium Pulse Lasers and a Small laser add additional firepower at close ranges. A Guardian ECM Suite and a Beagle Active Probe enhance the Mechs capabilities, while a pair of Jump Jets increase mobility.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 85吨的枪手由联邦共和国与龙脉联合体联合研制，于3053年投产。枪手1ERD由一台255额定XL引擎驱动，装有一对高斯步枪；4门中型激光、一对中型脉冲激光和一门小型激光在近距提供额外火力。一套守护者电子对抗套件和一台比格犬主动探测器增强机甲能力，两具跳跃推进器则提升机动性。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A missile boat, the Ha Otoko 1 uses a pair of torso-mounted LRM-20s and a pair of arm-mounted LRM-10 launchers. However, it only incorporates thirteen single heat sinks, so MechWarriors must carefully manage their heat. Many only fire the LRM-10s when enemies attempt to flank them. Quirk: Protected Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.13
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为一台导弹平台，Ha Otoko 1使用两具安装在躯干上的LRM-20和两具安装在手臂上的LRM-10发射器。然而它只配备十三台单散热器，因此机甲战士必须谨慎管理热量。许多人在敌人试图包抄时才会发射LRM-10。 特性：受保护驱动器 投放费用倍率：1.13

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Ha Otoko (Bladed Man in Japanese) is primarily a defensive, second-line BattleMech. Clan Diamond Shark first fielded the cheap 'Mech when they helped Clan Nova Cat evacuate from Clan space in 3060. Clan Jade Falcon merchants were the first to point out that the Ha Otoko name and oriental aspect and style of combat were meant to be sold to the Inner Sphere, being easily modified to accommodate similar Inner Sphere weaponry, in addition to the Oriental styling of the 'Mech's exterior. The Ha Otoko is protected by thirteen tons of armor.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Ha Otoko（日语意为"刀男"）主要是一款用于防御的二线战斗机甲。3060年，钻石鲨部族在协助新星猫部族从部族领域撤离时首次将其投入战场。翡翠猎鹰部族的商人最先指出，Ha Otoko这一名称、东方化的外观与战斗风格本就是为了向内层星域推销而设计的——它很容易改装以适配内层星域的同类武器，机甲的外形也带有东方风格。Ha Otoko由十三吨装甲提供防护。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This variant is the Draconis Combine model that Clan Jade Falcon merchants predicted would appear. The variant replaces the Clan weaponry with missile launchers of Inner Sphere manufacture. In order to account for the increased weight, this Ha Otoko variant makes use of an extralight fusion engine and double heat sinks. Quirk: Protected Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.07
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 此变型正是玉猫部族商人预言会出现的那种龙脉联合体型号。它以内层星域制造的导弹发射器替换部族武器。为应对增加的重量，这款羽鸦变型采用超轻型聚变引擎和双散热器。 特性：受保护驱动器 投放费用倍率：1.07

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Hades is an exclusive design to Wolf's Dragoons developed from the Loki and is an attempt to rectify that design's poor armor problems while retaining its offensive capabilities. The standard chassis is replaced with an Endo Steel model and the armor is upgraded to Ferro-Fibrous. The Hades maintains the same mobility of the original Loki. Quirk: Integrated Searchlight Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 哈迪斯是狼之龙骑兵的专属设计，由洛基发展而来，试图在保留其进攻能力的同时纠正该设计装甲薄弱的缺陷。标准底盘换成内骨骼型号，装甲升级为铁纤维。哈迪斯保持与原版洛基相同的机动性。 特质：内置探照灯 投放费用倍率：1.06 臂部驱动器限制：全能

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An early FedSuns BattleMech, the 75 ton Hammerhands debuted in 2475 and served as one of the progenitor designs that would influence the iconic Warhammer. Powered by a 225-rated Fusion Core, the Hammerhands HMH-3D is armed with a pair of AC/10’s, with a pair of Medium Lasers and an SRM-6 for close range combat. Quirk: Barrel Fist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为联邦太阳国的早期战斗机甲，75吨的锤手于2475年首次登场，是影响了经典战锤的先行设计之一。锤手HMH-3D由225额定聚变核心驱动，装备2门AC/10，并配2门中型激光和1具SRM-6用于近距交战。 <特性：炮管拳 <投放费用倍率：1.09 <手臂驱动器限制：左臂下段，右臂下段

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An early FedSuns BattleMech, the 75 ton Hammerhands debuted in 2475 and served as one of the progenitor designs that would influence the iconic Warhammer. Powered by a 225-rated Fusion Core, the Hammerhands HMH-3D is armed with a pair of AC/10’s, with a pair of Medium Lasers and an SRM-6 for close range combat.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为一种早期联邦太阳战斗机甲，75吨的锤手于2475年首次亮相，是影响后来标志性重锤的始祖设计之一。锤手HMH-3D由一具225级聚变核心驱动，武装为两门AC/10，另有一对中型激光器和一具SRM-6用于近距离作战。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An early FedSuns BattleMech, the 75 ton Hammerhands debuted in 2475 and served as one of the progenitor designs that would influence the iconic Warhammer. Powered by a 225-rated Fusion Core, the customised Hammerhands HMH-3D used by Lorn Kessem is armed with a pair of LB-10X’s, with a pair of Medium Lasers and an SRM-6 for close range combat. Quirk: Barrel Fist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.13 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Hammerhands 是联邦太阳国的早期战斗机甲，重 75 吨，于 2475 年首次亮相，也是影响了标志性机型 Warhammer 的先行设计之一。Lorn Kessem 所使用的定制型 Hammerhands HMH-3D 由 225 额定聚变核心驱动，装备两门 LB-10X，并以两门中型激光和一具 SRM-6 应付近距离战斗。 特性：炮管铁拳 投放费用倍率：1.13 手臂驱动器限制：左下臂、右下臂

Powered by a 225-rated Fusion Core, the Hammerhands HMH-4D is armed with a pair of AC/10’s and a PPC. A pair of Medium Lasers support the bigger guns at close range. Quirk: Barrel Fist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为联邦太阳国早期的战斗机甲，75 吨的锤手于 2475 年首次亮相，是影响了标志性机型战锤的原型设计之一。锤手 HMH-4D 由一台 225 级聚变核心驱动，装备两门 AC/10 和一门 PPC。近距离时由两门中型激光为这些主炮提供支援。 特性：炮筒拳 投放费用倍率：1.09 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为一种早期联邦太阳战斗机甲，75吨的锤手于2475年首次亮相，是影响后来标志性重锤的始祖设计之一。锤手HMH-4D由一具225级聚变核心驱动，武装为两门AC/10和一门PPC。一对中型激光器在近距离支援这些更大的火炮。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Harpy, the first ProtoMech ever created, it is about as effective as a single elemental, it did however show that Protomechs could be a effective weapon. This Variant carries a MG and 20 rounds of ammo. Quirk: Nimble Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.95
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 鹰身女妖是有史以来第一台原生机甲，效能大致相当于一个元素，但它证明了原生机甲可以成为有效武器。此变型带一挺机枪和20发弹药。 特性：灵巧 投放费用倍率：0.95

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: So boss. We got our hands on a two ton ProtoMech. I would ask what you plan on doing with this thing but frankly there is so very little you can put on this thing, but your the boss.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 所以老板。我们弄到了一台两吨的原生机甲。我本想问你打算拿这东西怎么办，但说实话，这东西能装的东西实在太少，不过你是老板。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Mech Daniel received was a bridging design between the early field-test HTM-26T and the later production HTM-27T. Dropping two tons of armor and outfitted with a bulkier and less refined Endo-Steel chassis, enough weight was saved to mount a pair of experimental Luthien Armor Works developed LB 10-X AC prototypes in it arms and a pair of Telos SRM-4 launchers in its chest. Quirk: Way of the Samurai Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Daniel收到的这台机甲是早期野战测试型HTM-26T与后来量产型HTM-27T之间的过渡设计。它减掉两吨装甲，并装上更笨重、工艺更粗糙的内骨架底盘，由此省下的重量足以在双臂安装两门实验性的Luthien Armor Works研发的LB 10-X AC原型，以及在胸部装设两具Telos SRM-4发射器。 特性：武士之道 投放费用倍率：1.16

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Mech Daniel received was a bridging design between the early field-test HTM-26T and the later production HTM-27T. Dropping two tons of armor and outfitted with a bulkier and less refined Endo-Steel chassis, enough weight was saved to mount a pair of experimental Luthien Armor Works developed LB 10-X AC prototypes in it arms and a pair of Telos SRM-6 launchers in its chest.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 丹尼尔收到的机甲是早期实地测试型HTM-26T与后期量产型HTM-27T之间的过渡设计。它减去两吨装甲，换装更笨重、更粗糙的内层钢底盘，省出的重量足以在双臂装上一对卢西恩装甲厂研发的实验性LB 10-X AC原型，并在胸部装上两具泰洛斯SRM-6发射器。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Refitted in the relative quiet of the Sabres' guard duty years on Luthien after the initial Clan Invasion, the prototype chassis and autocannons were swapped for production-grade components, while the power plant was swapped for a lighter model. Though reducing the 'Mech's maximum ground speed to 50 km/h, this frees up the weight to increase the armor to fifteen and half tons, add a C3 master computer and swap the SRM-4s for a pair of Streak SRM-6 launchers, while retaining the same volume of missile and autocannon ammunition. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在部族入侵初期之后，Sabres 于 Luthien 执行守备任务的那段相对平静的岁月里，该机体接受了改装：原型底盘与自动炮换成量产级部件，动力装置也换成更轻的型号。虽然这将机甲的最大地面速度降至 50 km/h，但省出的重量得以把装甲增至十五吨半、加装一套 C3 主控计算机，并把 SRM-4 换成两组连发 SRM-6 发射器，同时保持导弹与自动炮弹药的数量不变。 特性：易于维护 投放费用倍率：1.16

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A melding of the popular Star League era Thug and the poorly regarded Charger, the samurai-themed Hatamoto-Chi was the first post–Succession Wars Draconis Combine BattleMech constructed utilizing recovered LosTech. Tasked by Kanrei Theodore Kurita to reverse engineer examples of the advanced Star League Defense Force BattleMechs provided by ComStar in 3035 for future production, Luthien Armor Works secretly mated the weaponry of the Thug to the form of the maligned Charger. While initially unable to mass produce the advanced Endo Steel chassis required to match the Thug, the appearance of the early Hatamoto-Chi and their endless variations born of the Charger's spacious torso sent the combined Armed Forces of the Federated Commonwealth into confusion during the War of 3039.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 武士主题的旗本-智是星盟时代广受欢迎的恶棍与评价不佳的冲锋者的融合体，也是继承战争后德拉科尼斯联合体首款使用找回的失传技术建造的战斗机甲。在政务官西奥多·库瑞塔的委派下，鲁西恩装甲工厂着手对康星于 3035 年提供的先进星盟防卫军战斗机甲样机进行逆向工程以备未来生产，并秘密地把恶棍的武器装进了遭人垢病的冲锋者躯壳。虽然最初无法量产与恶棍匹配的先进内骨骼底盘，但早期旗本-智凭借冲锋者宽敞躯干衍生出的无尽变体，在 3039 年战争期间令联邦联邦联合武装部队陷入混乱。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 27U, also known as the Hatamoto-Hi, is almost identical to the 27T. The differences in the designs come in with the removal of the two SRM-6 launchers and the addition of four Medium Pulse Lasers and an additional heat sink to help with the additional heat burden. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 27U 也被称为 Hatamoto-Hi，与 27T 几乎完全相同。两者的差异在于拆除了两具 SRM-6 发射器，并加装四门中型脉冲激光和一台额外的散热器，以应对额外的热负荷。 特性：易于维护 投放费用倍率：1.14 手臂驱动器限制：左下臂

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 27Y, known as the Hatamoto-Mizo, removes both of the SRM-6 launchers and replaces them with a single ER Large Laser. This 'Mech is a powerful long range combat 'Mech and can keep an enemy at range and slowly take the armor off of a 'Mech. By the time an enemy is able to close with the Hatamoto-Mizo it can usually be taken out in physical combat. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 27Y 又名 Hatamoto-Mizo，它拆除了两具 SRM-6 发射器，代之以一具增程大型激光。这具机甲是强大的远程战斗机甲，能将敌人压制在远处，慢慢剥去其装甲。等到敌人终于能逼近 Hatamoto-Mizo 时，通常已经可以在近身近战中将其解决。 特性：易于维护 投放费用倍率：1.14 手臂驱动器限制：左下臂

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A 3059 upgrade of the 27T model, the 28T exchanges the two PPCs for two ER PPCs. The 'Mech also upgrades the two SRM-6 launchers to Streak SRM-6 launchers. Finally, the 'Mech is armed with two ER medium lasers and carries a C3 slave unit to allow it to share targeting data with other friendly units. The 'Mech achieves this by reducing its top speed to 54 km/h and makes up for some of the 'Mech's lost maneuverability by adding three jump jets, giving it a jumping distance of ninety meters. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是27T型号的3059年升级版，28T把两门粒子炮换成两门增程粒子炮，并把两具SRM-6发射器升级为连发SRM-6，最后还装了两门增程中型激光并带一台C3从机，以便与其他友军单位共享瞄准数据。为达成这些，该机甲把最高速度降到54公里/小时，并通过加装三具跳跃推进器（跳跃距离九十米）弥补部分损失的机动性。 特性：易于维护 投放费用倍率：1.14 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A complete rearmament of an HTM-28T, only the C3 slave remains. A gauss rifle is fitted in the left arm with three tons of ammunition riding in the left torso. The left torso also holds six medium pulse lasers. The right arm carries a large sword. Triple-Strength Myomer greatly increase the damage done by the blade. Only ten double heat sinks are used, allowing the TSM to remain active. Quirk: Way of the Samurai Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是对HTM-28T的彻底重新武装，仅保留了C3辅助单元。左臂装有一门高斯步枪，左躯干携带三吨弹药。左躯干还装有六门中型脉冲激光。右臂携带一把大型剑。三倍强度肌纤维大幅提升了剑刃造成的伤害。整机仅使用十台双散热器，从而使三倍强度肌纤维得以保持激活状态。 特性：武士道 投放费用倍率：1.16

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The HTM-56K, also known as the Hatamoto-Ni or Hatamoto-Chi II, mounts two ER PPC as the main damage dealers, one in each arm. Four side torso mounted Medium Lasers and a Streak SRM-2 act as reserve firepower as needed, while an AMS and a Small Laser provide defensive capabilities. The 'Mech also carries a Guardian ECM and a C3 Slave computer. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: HTM-56K 又称 Hatamoto-Ni 或 Hatamoto-Chi II，双臂各装一门增程粒子炮作为主要伤害输出。位于侧躯干的四门中型激光和一具连发 SRM-2 在需要时充当后备火力，而一套反导弹系统（AMS）和一门小型激光则提供防御能力。该机甲还配有一具守护者电子对抗系统和一台 C3 从属计算机。 特性：易于维护 投放费用倍率：1.14

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: HTM-27T 的雇佣兵变型，升级为 增程粒子炮。虽然龙脉联合体并未正式出售该型号，仍有数台不知怎么地辗转流落到了银河各处。 特性：易于维护 投放费用倍率：1.14 手臂驱动器限制：左下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A melding of the popular Star League era Thug and the poorly regarded Charger, the samurai-themed Hatamoto-Chi was the first post–Succession Wars Draconis Combine BattleMech constructed utilizing recovered LosTech. Tasked by Kanrei Theodore Kurita to reverse engineer examples of the advanced Star League Defense Force BattleMechs provided by ComStar in 3035 for future production, Luthien Armor Works secretly mated the weaponry of the Thug to the form of the maligned Charger. While initially unable to mass produce the advanced Endo Steel chassis required to match the Thug, the appearance of the early Hatamoto-Chi and their endless variations born of the Charger's spacious torso sent the combined Armed Forces of the Federated Commonwealth into confusion during the War of 3039.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 武士主题的旗本-智是星盟时代广受欢迎的恶棍与评价不佳的冲锋者的融合体，也是继承战争后德拉科尼斯联合体首款使用找回的失传技术建造的战斗机甲。在政务官西奥多·库瑞塔的委派下，鲁西恩装甲工厂着手对康星于 3035 年提供的先进星盟防卫军战斗机甲样机进行逆向工程以备未来生产，并秘密地把恶棍的武器装进了遭人垢病的冲锋者躯壳。虽然最初无法量产与恶棍匹配的先进内骨骼底盘，但早期旗本-智凭借冲锋者宽敞躯干衍生出的无尽变体，在 3039 年战争期间令联邦联邦联合武装部队陷入混乱。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A unsanctioned variant of the Hatamoto-Ku, which replaces the cooling to use double heat sinks. The freed up weight capacity is used to exchange the PPCs for ER version as well as adding two Medium Lasers. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The HTM-60Z, or the Hitamoto-Samurai, carries a large Katana-like vibro sword, mainly to bring fear to its opponents. The 'Mech still manages to fit two ER Large Lasers, four Medium Pulse Lasers, three Medium Lasers and two Small Lasers, as well as a C3 slave unit. Quirk: Way of the Samurai Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: HTM-60Z，又称“旗本武士”，携带着一柄类似武士刀的大型振动剑，主要是为了震慑对手。这台机甲仍设法装下了两门增程大型激光、四门中型脉冲激光、三门中型激光与两门小型激光，以及一台C3从属机。 特性：武士道 投放费用倍率：1.14

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Constructed with an Earthwerks VOL Endo Steel chassis, fitted with CASE protected ammo bins and clad in fifteen and a half tons of Mitchell Argon armor, the Hatamoto-Chi shared the features which made its parent design a nearly indestructible zombie 'Mech. The main area that Combine was unable to replicate the Thug was the older design's advanced Double Heat Sinks, eighteen standard Heat Sinks giving the Hatamoto-Chi a high heat curve in heavy combat.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 旗本-血采用地球工厂 VOL 内骨骼底盘建造，装有 C.A.S.E. 保护的弹药箱，披挂十五吨半米切尔氢装甲，共享了使其母设计成为近乎不可摧毁的"僵尸"机甲的特征。联合体唯一无法复制"暴徒"的地方是那款老设计的先进双倍散热器，十八台标准散热器使旗本-血在激烈战斗中热量曲线偏高。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A further variation of the Hatamoto-Hi, the C variant is identical to the 27U with the exception of the removal of a single heat sink. The HTM-C also carries a C3 slave unit into battle. The 'Mech is an excellent sniper 'Mech because of the ability to share targeting data with friendly units. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为旗本-飞进一步衍生的变型，C型除拆掉一个散热器外与27U完全相同。HTM-C还带一台C3从机参战。由于能与友军共享瞄准数据，该机甲是一款出色的狙击机甲。 特性：易于维护 投放费用倍率：1.14 手臂驱动器限制：左下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The HTM-CM is also based on the Hatamoto-Hi variant and carries a C3 master computer into battle, allowing it to coordinate an entire C3 lance. This is done by removing two of the Medium Pulse Lasers and a heat sink. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: While many may attribute the model code of this 'Mech to the term \"samurai,\" this Hatamoto-Chi was in fact piloted by Samuel Yoshida of the Second Sword of Light. Yoshida was a known lover of puns, which may explain why the 'Mech holds two prototype assault katana blades - two \"swords of light\". Quirk: Way of the Samurai Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 许多人或许会把这台机甲的型号代码归因于“武士”一词，但这台旗本·智实际上由第二光之剑的塞缪尔·吉田驾驶。吉田是出了名的双关语爱好者，这或许能解释为何这台机甲手持两把原型突击武士刀——两把“光之剑”。 特性：武士之道 投放费用倍率：1.16

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: You'd think the Dracs would be a little less on the nose with slapping \"dash S A M\" onto a 'Mech modeled after a samurai, but what do I know? Cool swords, though. Shame they're fused to the hands.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 你会以为龙脉人在给一台以武士为原型的机甲刷上“dash S A M”时会稍微含蓄一点，但我知道什么呢？剑挺酷的。可惜焊死在手上了。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Alpha configuration of the Havoc is a pure short range alpha striker. Two Large Pulse Lasers and ten SRM-6 launchers means the sudden damage can be quite substantial. The 'Mech also carries a NARC launcher to assist with targeting. Quirk: Experimental TC Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 浩劫的 A 型配置是纯粹的近程爆发打击手。两门大型脉冲激光和十具 SRM-6 发射器意味着瞬间伤害相当可观。这台机甲还装有一具 NARC 发射器以辅助瞄准。 特性：实验性瞄准计算机 投放费用倍率：1.15 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Developed by Clan Diamond Shark but sold all through the clans, the Havoc is a not very advanced but still carries an impressive arsenal of weapons. Created as a cheap line 'Mech, the goal is to dish out maximum damage at close to medium ranges.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 浩劫由钻石鲨氏族开发，却销往各氏族。它技术不算先进，却携带可观的武器库。作为廉价一线机甲设计，目标是在近中距离输出最大伤害。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The B loadout carries a massive Autocannon/20 in the Left Arm and three large pulse lasers in the right. A targeting computer help coordinate the firing sequences of the weapons. Quirk: Experimental TC Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: B配置在左臂搭载一门巨大的自动炮/20，右臂则装有三门大型脉冲激光。一台瞄准计算机帮助协调各武器的射击时序。 特性：实验性瞄准计算机 投放费用倍率：1.15 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The C configuration serves as the long range missile boat of the chassis. Four LRM-20 ensures that any missile volley will be quite hard to counter even with AMS protection. Quirk: Experimental TC Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: C 配置是该底盘的远程导弹平台。四具 LRM-20 确保任何一轮导弹齐射都极难被拦截，即便有 AMS 防护也不例外。 特性：实验型瞄准计算机 投放费用倍率：1.15 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A product of the brief détente between the Circinus Federation and the Marian Hegemony, the Hazard is a rarity in the Periphery; a brand new mech model built from scratch. While much hyped by both parties, the breakdown of diplomatic relations lead to the mechs near extinction, with only a couple of dozen models produced. The Hazard HZD-1A is a 45-ton mech designed to hunt Infantry and Battle Armor in an Urban Environment. The 1A is armed with 4 Flamers, a pair of SRM-4’s and a pair of Medium Lasers. Quirk: Distracting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.01 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为切尔西努斯联邦与马里亚纳霸权短暂缓和期的产物，哈扎德在外围地区十分罕见：一款从零打造的全新机甲型号。虽然双方都大肆宣传，但外交关系破裂使这款机甲几近灭绝，只造出二十来台。哈扎德HZD-1A是45吨机甲，设计用于在城市环境中猎杀步兵与战斗装甲。1A装有4具火焰喷射器、一对SRM-4和两门中型激光。 特性：扰敌 投放费用倍率：1.01 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A product of the brief détente between the Circinus Federation and the Marian Hegemony, the Hazard is a rarity in the Periphery; a brand new mech model built from scratch. While much hyped by both parties, the breakdown of diplomatic relations lead to the mechs near extinction, with only a couple of dozen models produced. The Hazard HZD-1B is a 45-ton mech designed to hunt Infantry and Battle Armor in an Urban Environment. The 1B is armed with 4 Flamers, a pair of SRM-4’s and 4 Small Lasers.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为奇尔奇努斯联邦与马里安霸权短暂缓和期的产物，危险在外缘实属罕见：一个从零开始打造的全新机甲型号。虽然双方都大肆宣传，但外交关系破裂导致该机甲几近灭绝，只造出了二三十台。危险HZD-1B是一种45吨机甲，设计用于在城市环境中猎杀步兵与战斗装甲。1B武装为4具火焰喷射器、两具SRM-4和4门小型激光器。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A 3050's era design, the Hecatoncheires is the FWL's attempt to produce a dedicated heavy scout suitable for the modern battlefield. Based on a previously rejected redesign of the venerable Cyclops, the Hecatoncheires downsizes the classic cyclops to 65 tons in weight. A Beagle Active probe, paired with a C3 unit make up the mechs specialist electronics. 4 Medium Lasers and a pair of SRM-6's with Artemis IV provide a nasty punch at close range, while a Gauss Rifle covers longer ranges. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Hecatoncheires 是 3050 年代的设计，是 FWL（自由世界联盟）为打造适用于现代战场的专用重型侦察机甲所做的尝试。它以早先被否决的 Cyclops 改进方案为基础，将这台经典机甲缩小至 65 吨。机甲的特种电子设备由一部 Beagle 主动探测器与一套 C3 单元组成。4 门中型激光与两套带 Artemis IV 的 SRM-6 在近距离能打出凶猛的打击，而一门高斯步枪则负责较远距离的交战。 特性：指挥机甲 投放费用倍率：1.09

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A 3050's era design, the Hecatoncheires is the FWL's attempt to produce a dedicated heavy scout suitable for the modern battlefield. Based on a previously rejected redesign of the venerable Cyclops, the Hecatoncheires downsizes the classic cyclops to 65 tons in weight. A Beagle Active probe, paired with a C3 unit make up the mechs specialist electronics.  4 Medium Lasers and a pair of SRM-6's with Artemis IV provide a nasty punch at close range, while a Gauss Rifle covers longer ranges.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 百臂是3050年代的设计，是自由世界联盟为打造适合现代战场的专职重型侦察机所作的尝试。它基于此前被否决的对古老独眼巨人的重新设计，把经典的独眼巨人缩减到65吨。一台比格犬主动探测器配一台C3单元构成机甲的专业电子设备；4门中型激光和一对带阿尔忒弥斯IV的SRM-6在近距提供凶狠打击，一门高斯步枪则覆盖较远距离。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A 3050's era design, the Hecatoncheires is the FWL's attempt to produce a dedicated heavy scout suitable for the modern battlefield. Based on a previously rejected redesign of the venerable Cyclops, the Hecatoncheires downsizes the classic cyclops to 65 tons in weight. The 4-Cm is a command variant intended to lead lances of Hecatoncheires or other C3 equipped mechs in combat. Downsizing the SRM-6's to a pair of SRM-4's allows the C3 Slave to swapped out for a Master unit. The mech is otherwise the same as the standard configuration. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 百臂是3050年代的设计，是自由世界联盟为打造适合现代战场的专职重型侦察机所作的尝试。它基于此前被否决的对古老独眼巨人的重新设计，把经典的独眼巨人缩减到65吨。4-Cm是用于率领百臂或其他装备C3机甲小队的指挥变型。把SRM-6缩减为一对SRM-4，使C3从机得以换成主机；除此之外该机甲与标准配置相同。 特性：指挥机甲 投放费用倍率：1.09

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An export model of the Hecatoncheires, the 4H was an unpopular failure. Intended to compliment the C3 lances, the 4H strips out the C3 and Probe to replace them with Jump Jets. A UAC/10 replaces the Gauss Rifle and Streak SRMs are mounted in place of the standard models. Whilst more mobile and possessing a heavier punch at close range, the design was unpopular with most of the production run sold to the Mercenary market. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为百臂巨人的外销型号，4H 是一次不受欢迎的失败之作。它本意是作为 C3 小队的补充，却拆掉了 C3 与探测器，换装跳跃推进器。一门 UAC/10 取代了高斯步枪，连发 SRM 也取代了标准型号。虽然机动性更好，近距离打击也更沉重，但该设计并不受欢迎，大部分产量都卖到了雇佣兵市场。 特性：指挥机甲 投放费用倍率：1.09

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An export model of the Hecatoncheires, the 4H was an unpopular failure. Intended to compliment the C3 lances, the 4H strips out the C3 and Probe to replace them with Jump Jets. A UAC/10 replaces the Gauss Rifle and Streak SRMs are mounted in place of the standard models. Whilst more mobile and possessing a heavier punch at close range, the design was unpopular with most of the production run sold to the Mercenary market.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The second BattleMech model introduced by the Free Worlds League, the Hector entered service in 2471, only one year after the original Icarus. Built by Corean Enterprises on Stewart, it used a simple design suited for mass production and quickly became the workhorse of the Free Worlds League. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.88 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 赫克托是自由世界联盟推出的第二款战斗机甲型号，于 2471 年服役，仅比原始伊卡洛斯晚一年。它由斯图尔特上的科里安企业建造，设计简洁、适合量产，很快成为自由世界联盟的主力。 特质：窄小低矮轮廓 投放费用倍率：0.88 臂部驱动器限制：左下臂、右下臂

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Designed to support Assault Mechs such as the Victor and the Emperor, the 60 ton Helios is a St. Ives Compact design that entered production in 3058. Powered by a 240-rated Fusion Core and built on an Endo Steel chassis, the Helios HEL-3D is armed with a Gauss Rifle. Paired ER Medium Lasers and SRM-6’s make for a potent combo should anyone try to close range. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A 65-ton design that emphasizes overwhelming firepower over speed or armor, the Hellbringer is a Clan OmniMech. Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 地狱犬是翡翠隼氏族的中型机甲，跑得比它打不过的任何东西都快。它在与狼氏族交战之后创造、在内天体行星上建造，如今已进入许多军队。 特质：灵活 投放费用倍率：1.1 臂部驱动器限制：左上臂、右上臂

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Hellhound is a Clan Jade Falcon medium 'Mech that can outrun practically anything it cannot outgun. Created after their war with Clan Wolf and built on Inner Sphere planets, it has found its way into many armies.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 地狱犬是玉鹰部族的中型机甲，凡是它打不过的对手，几乎都跑不过它。它诞生于玉鹰与狼族部族交战之后，并在内层星域的行星上建造，如今已流入许多军队。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Quirk: Nimble Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 特性：灵巧 投放费用倍率：1.08 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Hellion is a product of Clan Ice Hellion and their philosophy that espouses speed above all else. Based on the Mist Lynx, the Hellion is a fast OmniMech that has respectable firepower. This light 'Mech is rather difficult to kill, incorporating five and a half tons of Ferro-Fibrous armor. To save weight, the Hellion also uses an Endo Steel chassis. While it is not especially fast for its size, the Hellion does use MASC to allow for bursts of additional speed. The Hellion sports no fixed weapons on its chassis. A mobile harassment configuration, the Hellion A has a trio of LRM-10 launchers, allowing it to harass an enemy from long range. For close combat, the 'Mech has a single ER Medium Laser. Quirk: Nimble Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 地狱狮是冰地狱狮部族及其“速度至上”理念的产物。它以雾森猁为基础，是一款火力可观的快速全向机甲。这台轻型机甲相当难以击杀，装备五吨半铁纤维装甲；为减轻重量，它还采用内骨架底盘。虽然就体型而言不算特别快，地狱狮却装有MASC，可获得额外的速度爆发。它的底盘上没有固定武器。作为机动骚扰配置，地狱狮A装有三具LRM-10发射器，能从远距离骚扰敌人；近战时则有一门增程中型激光。 特性：灵巧 投放费用倍率：0.98 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A very formidable and mobile light unit, as most Clan designs tend to be. Enough armor so that a single alpha strike usually is not able to cripple it, and enough speed to get away from trouble, it can be as persistent as a cockroach at times. Oh, and it sports quite the bite too.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一个极其强悍且机动性出色的轻型单位，部族设计大多如此。它的装甲足以让单次全弹齐射通常无法将其击残，速度也足以脱离险境，有时就像蟑螂一样难以摆脱。哦，而且它的咬合力也相当惊人。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Hellion is a product of Clan Ice Hellion and their philosophy that espouses speed above all else. Based on the Mist Lynx, the Hellion is a fast OmniMech that has respectable firepower. This light 'Mech is rather difficult to kill, incorporating five and a half tons of Ferro-Fibrous armor. To save weight, the Hellion also uses an Endo Steel chassis. While it is not especially fast for its size, the Hellion does use MASC to allow for bursts of additional speed. The Hellion sports no fixed weapons on its chassis. A dangerous heavy laser configuration, the Hellion B has a Heavy Large Laser, four Heavy Medium Lasers, and a Heavy Small Laser. Added to all this laser power are three additional double heat sinks. Even with the extra heat sinks, the Hellion B will not last long firing all of its weapons. Quirk: Nimble Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Hellion是冰地狱部族的产物，体现了他们推崇“速度高于一切”的理念。Hellion以Mist Lynx为基础，是一款速度飞快、火力可观的机甲。这台轻型机甲相当难以击毁，配有五吨半的铁纤维装甲。为节省重量，Hellion还采用了内骨架结构。尽管以同吨位而言它算不上特别快，但Hellion确实使用MASC来实现短时间的额外加速。Hellion的底盘上没有任何固定武器。Hellion B是一种危险的重型激光配置，装有一门重型大型激光、四门重型中型激光和一门重型小型激光。在这些激光火力之外，它还额外加装了三台双散热器。即便有这些额外散热器，Hellion B在齐射全部武器后也撑不了多久。 特性：灵巧 投放费用倍率：0.98 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A very formidable and mobile light unit, as most Clan designs tend to be. Enough armor so that a single alpha strike usually is not able to cripple it, and enough speed to get away from trouble, it can be as persisent as a cockroach at times. Oh, and it sports quite the bite too.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A very formidable scout unit, as most Clan designs tend to be. Enough armor so that a single alpha strike usually is not able to cripple it, and enough speed to get away from trouble, it can be as persistent as a cockroach at times. Oh, and it sports quite the bite too.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一支非常可怕的侦察单位，就像大多数氏族设计那样。装甲足以让一次全弹齐射通常无法将其打残，速度足以脱离麻烦，有时它能像蟑螂一样缠人。哦，它的咬合力也相当了得。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Hercules HRC-LS-9000 carries a wide variety of weapons. For long-range firepower, the 'Mech is armed with a ER PPC. The ER PPC is backed up at intermediate ranges by an LB-X Autocannon/10 that can fire both standard and cluster rounds, making it effective against a wide range of combat units. For close-range combat, the Hercules carries a Streak SRM-2 launcher, an Medium Pulse Laser, and two Small Pulse Lasers. For added protection from missile attacks, the 'Mech also carried an anti-missile system. Quirk: Stable Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 大力神HRC-LS-9000搭载种类繁多的武器。远程火力方面，该机甲装备1门增程粒子炮。在中距离上，增程粒子炮由1门LB-X自动炮/10提供支援，它既能发射标准弹也能发射集束弹，对各种作战单位都颇具威胁。近距交战时，大力神携带1具连发SRM-2发射器、1门中型脉冲激光和2门小型脉冲激光。为进一步防御导弹袭击，该机甲还装有1套反导弹系统。 <特性：稳定武器 <投放费用倍率：1.1 <手臂驱动器限制：右臂下段

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Hercules was built in response to a request by the Free Worlds League for a 'Mech with balanced mobility and firepower. The Hercules is powered by a 350 XL engine that propels the 'Mech up to speeds of 86.4 km/h. The Hercules is also well armored, with eleven tons of Heavy ferro-fibrous for protection. Overall, the Hercules has turned out to be a good all-around trooper 'Mech that can handle a variety of combat roles, from air defense to long-range direct fire support.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 大力神是为响应自由世界联盟提出的“机动性与火力均衡”需求而建造的。大力神由一台 350 XL 引擎驱动，最高时速可达 86.4 km/h。它的装甲也相当厚实，以十一吨重型铁纤维提供防护。总体而言，大力神是一款出色的全能型主力机甲，能够胜任从防空到远程直射火力支援等多种战斗角色。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A basic field modification of the Hercules, the -9001 model removed the anti-missile system to add a second streak SRM-2 launcher. Quirk: Stable Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是大力神的基础野战改装：-9001型号拆掉反导弹系统，加装第二具连发SRM-2发射器。 特性：武器稳定 投放费用倍率：1.1 手臂驱动器限制：右下

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 赫尔墨斯于2632年首次为SLDF建造，是一种30吨专用侦察机甲，由伊里安战斗机甲无限公司制造。HER-3S2由一具270级聚变核心驱动，只装一门中型激光器。左躯干装有TAG，使3S2能为友军单位标定目标。守卫者ECM提升该机甲的侦察能力，MASC提升其速度。

A C3 slave unit is also added to integrate into the Combine's C3 network. Armor is removed to make room for all this equipment and an ER small laser. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 4S Hermes was introduced in 3057 and based on the 3S1 variant. It carries over the MASC and endo steel chassis from the 3S1 model, but has had a complete upgrade of its weapons and engine. The original standard engine has been replaced with an extralight engine, and the armor protection has been upgraded to five and a half tons. The weapons on board the Hermes have also been replaced by three medium pulse lasers, giving the Hermes an unprecedented amount of firepower in its long history. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 赫尔墨斯（Hermes）4S 型于 3057 年推出，以 3S1 变型为基础。它沿用了 3S1 型的 MASC 与内骨架底盘，但对武器和引擎进行了全面升级。原本的标准引擎被替换为超轻型引擎，装甲防护也提升至五点五吨。赫尔墨斯机上的武器同样被替换为三门中型脉冲激光，使赫尔墨斯在其漫长历史中获得了前所未有的火力。 特性：改进通信 投放费用倍率：0.99 手臂驱动器限制：左下

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 赫尔墨斯于 2632 年首次为星盟防卫军建造，是伊里安战斗机甲公司制造的一款 30 吨专用侦察机甲。由 270 额定聚变核心驱动，HER-3S 装备两门中型激光。比格犬主动探测器提升机甲的侦察能力，MASC 则提升其速度。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Also known as the 'Mercury', this variant of the Hermes II was introduced in 2802 and used primarily by SAFE's Dark Shadows units. A larger VOX 280 engine was installed to bring the 'Mech's top speed up to 118.8 km/h, although this necessitated the removal of the AC/5, eliminating the 'Mech's long-range firepower. To make up for this, short-range firepower was increased with two additional medium lasers and two machine guns mounted in the right torso. Half a ton of machine gun ammo was stored in the left torso while an additional single heat sink was added. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.02 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该变型也被称为“水星”（Mercury），是 Hermes II 的一款变型，于 2802 年推出，主要装备 SAFE 的暗影部队。它换装了更大的 VOX 280 引擎，将机甲的最高速度提升至 118.8 km/h，但为此不得不拆除 AC/5，从而使机甲彻底失去了远程火力。作为弥补，其近距离火力得到加强，右躯干加装了两门中型激光和两挺机枪。左躯干储存了半吨机枪弹药，并额外增加了一个单散热器。 特性：易于维护 投放费用倍率：1.02 手臂驱动器限制：左下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Hermes II was first produced in 2798, based on the original Hermes BattleMech that had been used by the Star League. A heavy scout, the Hermes II boasted respectable weaponry, armoring, and speed, allowing it to easily brawl with lighter 'Mechs or survive an encounter with heavier 'Mechs and retreat. Out of all medium-weight 'Mechs at the time the Hermes II was the easiest to perform field maintenance on, leading to its nickname 'old reliable.' As combination scout and light strike platforms, Hermes II 'Mechs often operated alone, employed for missions for which lighter 'Mechs were too fragile and heavier 'Mechs too clumsy. The Hermes II was in its element when operating in a restrictive environment like a forest or city, where it could employ a most unusual tactic of setting its surroundings on fire to escape pursuit. Since most 'Mech pilots would naturally avoid a fire to prevent overheating and the flames interfered with most thermal scanners, starting a blaze allowed the Hermes II to more easily slip away.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 赫尔墨斯 II 于 2798 年首次生产，基于星盟曾使用的原版赫尔墨斯战斗机甲。作为重型侦察机甲，赫尔墨斯 II 拥有可观的武器、装甲和速度，使其能轻松与轻型机甲缠斗，或在遭遇重型机甲后存活并撤退。在当时所有中型机甲中，赫尔墨斯 II 是最容易进行野战维护的，因此获得"老可靠"的绰号。作为侦察与轻型打击平台的结合体，赫尔墨斯 II 常单独行动，用于那些轻型机甲过于脆弱、重型机甲过于笨拙的任务。在森林或城市之类的受限环境中，赫尔墨斯 II 如鱼得水，可以采用一种极为罕见的战术：点燃周围环境以摆脱追击。由于大多数机甲飞行员会本能地避开火焰以防过热，而火焰又会干扰大多数热扫描仪，放火能让赫尔墨斯 II 更轻易地溜走。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Hermes II HER-2R is a late 28th century refit of the classic Hermes II, replacing almost everything except the flamer with more modern technology. The switch to double heat sinks allowed two Extended Range Large Lasers as its main weapons. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.02 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Hermes II HER-2R 是 28 世纪后期对经典 Hermes II 的改装型号，除了火焰喷射器之外几乎全部换装了更为现代的技术。改用双散热器后，它得以将两具增程大型激光作为主武器。 特性：易于维护 投放费用倍率：1.02 手臂驱动器限制：左下臂

Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.02 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A lostech era downgrade of the HER-2R distinct enough to earn it the separate designation of Hermes III, the HER-4K was introduced in 3025. Although based on the Hermes II, it replaces the autocannon of the design with two Large Lasers to not be ammunition dependant, and uses single heat sinks instead of the original's double heat sinks. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.02
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: HER-4K是失落科技时代对HER-2R的一次降级改造，改动之大足以让它获得独立编号“赫尔墨斯III”，于3025年推出。它虽以赫尔墨斯II为基础，却以两门大型激光取代该设计的自动炮，从而不依赖弹药，并用单散热器取代原来的双散热器。 特性：易于维护 投放费用倍率：1.02

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Hermes III was created by Ostmann Industries by taking a Hermes II HER-2S and adapting it to the available technology in the Draconis Combine at that time. Its main goal was to act as a smaller companion to the Ostsol line, retaining the scouting and light skirmisher role of the original Hermes and Hermes II. As the demand for more upgraded mechs in these roles started growing, Luthien Armor Works upgraded a number of ageing first generation Hermes III to modern standards.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 赫尔墨斯III由奥斯特曼工业打造：他们取一台赫尔墨斯II HER-2S，将其改装以适配当时龙脉联合体可用的技术。其主要目标是作为奥斯特索系列的较小伙伴，保留原版赫尔墨斯与赫尔墨斯II的侦察与轻型散兵角色。随着这些角色对升级机甲的需求开始增长，卢西恩装甲厂把若干老化的第一代赫尔墨斯III升级到现代标准。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A refit of the -4K, adding an Armored Cowl cockpit and upgrading to the use of Double heatsinks. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.02 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是对-4K的改装，加装装甲机罩座舱并升级为双散热器。 特性：易于维护 投放费用倍率：1.02 手臂驱动器限制：左下

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是暗影单位使用的升级版水星，“水星精英”只装一门轻型高斯步枪（但配两吨弹药），把赫尔墨斯II变成了狙击手，代价是两吨装甲。 特性：易于维护 投放费用倍率：1.02 手臂驱动器限制：左下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Hermes II was first produced in 2798, based on the original Hermes BattleMech that had been used by the Star League. A heavy scout, the Hermes II boasted respectable weaponry, armoring, and speed, allowing it to easily brawl with lighter 'Mechs or survive an encounter with heavier 'Mechs and retreat. Out of all medium-weight 'Mechs at the time the Hermes II was the easiest to perform field maintenance on, leading to its nickname 'old reliable.' As combination scout and light strike platforms, Hermes II 'Mechs often operated alone, employed for missions for which lighter 'Mechs were too fragile and heavier 'Mechs too clumsy. The Hermes II was in its element when operating in a restrictive environment like a forest or city, where it could employ a most unusual tactic of setting its surroundings on fire to escape pursuit. Since most 'Mech pilots would naturally avoid a fire to prevent overheating and the flames interfered with most thermal scanners, starting a blaze allowed the Hermes II to more easily slip away.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 赫尔墨斯 II 于 2798 年首次生产，基于星盟曾使用的原版赫尔墨斯战斗机甲。作为重型侦察机甲，赫尔墨斯 II 拥有可观的武器、装甲和速度，使其能轻松与轻型机甲缠斗，或在遭遇重型机甲后存活并撤退。在当时所有中型机甲中，赫尔墨斯 II 是最容易进行野战维护的，因此获得"老可靠"的绰号。作为侦察与轻型打击平台的结合体，赫尔墨斯 II 常单独行动，用于那些轻型机甲过于脆弱、重型机甲过于笨拙的任务。在森林或城市之类的受限环境中，赫尔墨斯 II 如鱼得水，可以采用一种极为罕见的战术：点燃周围环境以摆脱追击。由于大多数机甲飞行员会本能地避开火焰以防过热，而火焰又会干扰大多数热扫描仪，放火能让赫尔墨斯 II 更轻易地溜走。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 5S variant of the Hermes II was an upgrade of the design incorporating the recovery of lostech. Its standard chassis has been replaced with an Endo Steel one, freeing up mass for a number of changes. The original AC/5 was replaced with an UAC/5, although it still only carries one ton of ammo, and the medium laser with an Medium Pulse Laser. The original Flamer was kept, while the single heat sinks were replaced with doubles. Although this change was met with some criticism since the original design was not known to cause heat management problems in the first place, the double heat sinks allow pilots to redline their machines even after significant engine damage. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.02 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Hermes II 的 5S 变型是结合失落科技复兴成果的升级设计。它的标准底盘被内骨架底盘取代，从而腾出质量进行多项改动。原有的 AC/5 换成 UAC/5——尽管仍只携带一吨弹药——中型激光则换成中型脉冲激光。原有火焰喷射器予以保留，单散热器则替换为双散热器。尽管这一改动招致一些批评，毕竟原设计本就不以散热管理问题著称，但双散热器让机师即便在引擎严重受损后也能把机甲压到极限运转。 特性：易于维护 投放费用倍率：1.02 手臂驱动器限制：左臂下部

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Highlander is one of the most well-known Star League Defense Force assault 'Mechs, serving with distinction for almost two centuries since first entering service in 2592. This version replaced the standard weaponry with an ER PPC, a Streak SRM-6, twin Medium Pulse Lasers, and a pair of LRM-15 missile launchers. Fourteen double heat sinks keep everything cool. Quirk: Reinforced Legs Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Highlander 是最著名的星际联盟防御部队突击机甲之一，自 2592 年首次服役以来，已出色地服役了近两个世纪。此版本将标准武器替换为一门增程粒子炮、一具连发 SRM-6、双联中型脉冲激光和一对 LRM-15 导弹发射器。十四台双散热器让一切保持冷却。 特性：强化腿部 投放费用倍率：1.18 手臂驱动器限制：右下臂

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Highlander is one of the most well-known Star League Defense Force assault 'Mechs, serving with distinction for almost two centuries since first entering service in 2592. This version replaced the standard weaponry with an ER PPC, a Streak SRM-6, twin Medium Pulse Lasers, and a pair of LRM-15 missile launchers. Fourteen double heat sinks keep everything cool.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 高地人是星盟防卫部队最著名的突击机甲之一，自2592年首次服役以来近两个世纪功勋卓著。这一版本把标准武器换成了一门增程PPC、一具连发SRM-6、双中型脉冲激光器和两具LRM-15导弹发射器。十四具双重散热器让一切保持凉爽。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Highlander is one of the most well-known Star League Defense Force assault 'Mechs, serving with distinction for almost two centuries since first entering service in 2592. The original model featured a variety of weaponry along with fifteen and a half tons of Ferro-Fibrous armor. Used by Clan Widowmaker Khan Cal Jorgensson, this Highlander uses two Clan spec ER Large Lasers and a Clan spec Gauss Rifle for its armament. It also has an Artemis IV enhanced LRM-20 and thirteen double heat sinks. Quirk: Reinforced Legs Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 高地人是星际联盟防卫军最知名的突击机甲之一，自2592年首次服役以来已光荣征战近两个世纪。原型机装备了多种武器以及十五吨半的铁纤维装甲。这台高地人由寡妇制造者部族的可汗卡尔·约根森驾驶，以两门部族规格的增程大型激光和一支部族规格的高斯步枪为武装，此外还装有带阿尔忒弥斯IV的LRM-20和十三具双散热器。 特性：强化腿部 投放费用倍率：1.18 手臂驱动器限制：右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Highlander is one of the most well-known Star League Defense Force assault 'Mechs, serving with distinction for almost two centuries since first entering service in 2592. The original model featured a variety of weaponry along with fifteen and a half tons of Ferro-Fibrous armor. Used by Clan Widowmaker Khan Cal Jorgensson, this Highlander uses two Clan spec ER Large Lasers and a Clan spec Gauss Rifle for its armament. It also has an Artemis IV enhanced LRM-20 and thirteen double heat sinks.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 高地人是星盟防卫部队最著名的突击机甲之一，自2592年首次服役以来近两个世纪功勋卓著。最初型号配备各式武器以及十五吨半铁纤装甲。这台高地人由寡妇制造者氏族可汗卡尔·约根森使用，武装为两门氏族规格增程大型激光器和一门氏族规格磁轨炮。它还装有一具带阿尔忒弥斯IV的LRM-20和十三具双重散热器。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Heavy Metal model of the Highlander is the signature ride of Rhonda Snord of the Snord's Irregulars mercenary unit. This customized Highlander features a number of recently reintroduced Lostech technologies. The most expensive example is the 275 XL Engine which saves weight for a heavy weapons payload, a Gauss Rifle in the right arm provides respectable punch at long range, while 13 Double Heat Sinks keep the design running cool. Quirk: Reinforced Legs Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Highlander 的 Heavy Metal 型号是雇佣兵部队斯诺德非正规军的朗达·斯诺德的标志性座机。这台定制 Highlander 采用了多项近期重新问世的失落科技。其中最昂贵的一项是 275 XL 引擎，它节省下来的重量可用于搭载沉重的武器载荷；右臂的一门高斯步枪在远距离上提供可观的打击力，而 13 台双散热器则让整个设计保持低温运转。 特性：强化腿部 投放费用倍率：1.18 手臂驱动器限制：右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Heavy Metal model of the Highlander is the signature ride of Rhonda Snord of the Snord's Irregulars mercenary unit. This customized Highlander features a number of recently reintroduced Lostech technologies. The most expensive example is the 275 XL Engine which saves weight for a heavy weapons payload, a Gauss Rifle in the right arm provides respectable punch at long range, while 13 Double Heat Sinks keep the design running cool.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 高地人的重金属型号是斯诺德非正规军雇佣兵部队的朗达·斯诺德的标志性座机。这台定制高地人采用了若干近来重新引入的失传科技。最昂贵的例子是275 XL引擎，它减轻重量以承载重型武器载荷；右臂的磁轨炮在远距离提供可观的打击力，而13具双重散热器让该设计保持凉爽运行。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Reportedly piloted by Star Colonel Hazel of Clan Star Adder, this Highlander IIC is armed with a Gauss Rifle in the right arm and left torso, supported at short-range by a pair of Streak SRM-4 launchers in left arm and right torso. In case the four tons of Gauss rounds and five tons of Streak reloads run out, the left-arm also carries an ER Large Laser. Keeper is built around an 280-rated XL engine and an Endo Steel frame, fitted with three jump jets and twelve double heat sinks and clad in fourteen and a half tons of standard armor. Quirk: Reinforced Legs Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.24 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 据说由星蛇部族的星上校 Hazel 驾驶，这具 Highlander IIC 在右臂和左躯干各装备一门高斯步枪，近距离由左臂和右躯干的两具连发 SRM-4 发射器支援。万一那四吨高斯弹药和五吨连发弹药耗尽，左臂还搭载着一具增程大型激光。Keeper 以一台 280 级 XL 引擎和一副内骨架为基础，配备三具跳跃推进器、十二具双散热器，并披挂十四点五吨标准装甲。 特性：强化腿部 投放费用倍率：1.24 手臂驱动器限制：右下臂

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Reportedly piloted by Star Colonel Hazel of Clan Star Adder, this Highlander IIC is armed with a Gauss Rifle in the right arm and left torso, supported at short-range by a pair of Streak SRM-4 launchers in left arm and right torso. In case the four tons of Gauss rounds and five tons of Streak reloads run out, the left-arm also carries an ER Large Laser. Keeper is built around an 280-rated XL engine and an Endo Steel frame, fitted with three jump jets and twelve double heat sinks and clad in fourteen and a half tons of standard armor.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 据报由星蝰氏族的黑兹尔星上校驾驶，这台高地人IIC在右臂和左躯干各装一门磁轨炮，近距离由左臂与右躯干的成对连发SRM-4发射器支援。万一四吨磁轨炮弹和五吨连发备用弹打光，左臂还装有一门增程大型激光器。守门人围绕一具280级XL引擎和内层钢框架建造，装三个跳跃推进器、十二具双重散热器，并披挂十四吨半标准装甲。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A Wolf Dragoons refit if the classic Hoplite, the 5W mounts both a Gauss Rifle and an MRM-40 launcher. A C3 slave unit was also added. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是经典Hoplite的狼龙骑兵团改装版，5W同时装备一门高斯步枪和一座MRM-40发射器。此外还加装了一台C3从属单元。 特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1.11 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Conceived by Martinson Armaments of Terra in 2578 as an infantry support 'Mech, the Hoplite first saw service with the newly formed Star League Defense Force during the Reunification War before being relegated to Terran Hegemony militia units in the twenty-seventh century. Intended for infantry support, the Hoplite is slow for a medium 'Mech with a top speed of only 64.8 km/h. However its eleven and a half tons of armor and heavy arsenal, both impressive for a 'Mech of its size, makes the Hoplite a rugged machine able to fight its way out of most situations using superior firepower. The original Reunification War era model, save for using an older Dalban Sniper targeting and tracking system, was all but identical to the 4C.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 重装步兵由泰拉的马丁森军械于 2578 年构想为步兵支援机甲，在统一战争中首次随新成立的星盟防卫军服役，后在二十七世纪被降级至地球霸权民兵单位。作为步兵支援机甲，重装步兵对中型机甲而言偏慢，最高速度仅 64.8 公里/小时。然而其十一吨半装甲与重型武器库对如此尺寸的机甲都堪称出色，使重装步兵成为一台凭借优势火力就能从大多数困境中杀出重围的坚固机器。统一战争时代的原始型号除了使用较老的达尔班狙击瞄准追踪系统外，与 4C 几乎完全相同。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Armed with a single large pulse laser in the center torso and a medium pulse laser in each arm, the Horned Owl HOW-1's devastatingly accurate fire can quickly destroy other light 'Mechs. Quirk: Stable Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Horned Owl HOW-1 在中央躯干装有一门大型脉冲激光，每条手臂各有一门中型脉冲激光，其精准得可怕的射击能迅速摧毁其他轻型机甲。 特性：武器稳定 投放费用倍率：1.04

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Horned Owl, or Peregrine as the Inner Sphere designated it, is a light, fast second-line BattleMech capable of highly accurate fire. It was designed by Clan Goliath Scorpion as a rugged submersible construction ’Mech and was later rebuilt for combat[1]. A harassing platform, the Horned Owl is also a capable dueling 'Mech. Five tons of ferro-fibrous armor provide adequate protection for the light 'Mech.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 角枭（Horned Owl）——内层星域将其编号为“游隼”（Peregrine）——是一种轻便、高速的二线战斗机甲，能够实施极高精度的射击。它由歌利亚蝎部族设计，原本是一种坚固耐用的潜水工程机甲，后来被改装用于作战[1]。作为一种骚扰平台，角枭同时也是一台出色的决斗机甲。五吨铁纤维装甲为这台轻型机甲提供了充足的防护。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This variant trades in its lasers for six LRM-5s and four tons of ammunition. Though it is entirely ammunition-dependent, this model can provide light Stars with sustained support, as it will not build up heat under normal circumstances. Quirk: Stable Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该变型用六具 LRM-5 和四吨弹药换掉了全部激光。尽管它完全依赖弹药，但该型号能为轻型星群提供持续支援，因为在正常情况下它不会积热。 特性：武器稳定 投放费用倍率：1.04

It was designed by Clan Goliath Scorpion as a rugged submersible construction ’Mech and was later rebuilt for combat[1]. A harassing platform, the Horned Owl is also a capable dueling 'Mech. Five tons of ferro-fibrous armor provide adequate protection for the light 'Mech.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Unlike the 2, this variant returns to a design similar to the original. In place of the large pulse laser there is an ER PPC tied to a targeting computer, allowing this variant to snipe efficiently. In place of the medium pulse lasers are two trios of light machine guns, allowing the design to deal with infantry should it need to. Quirk: Stable Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 与 2 型不同，这一变型回归了接近原版的设计。它用一门与瞄准计算机相连的 ER PPC 取代了大型脉冲激光，使这一变型能够高效狙击。中型脉冲激光的位置则换成两组、每组三挺的轻型机枪，让该设计在需要时能够对付步兵。 特性：武器稳定 投放费用倍率：1.04

It was designed by Clan Goliath Scorpion as a rugged submersible construction ’Mech and was later rebuilt for combat[1]. A harassing platform, the Horned Owl is also a capable dueling 'Mech. Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A NAIS sponsored modification to the 171 Hornet model, the 172 transforms the mech into a close range ambush fighter. Mounting a pair of experimental Medium X-Pulse lasers and a SRM-2, the 172 is designed to hunt and harass enemy recon units in urban environments. Never entering full production, the limited production of the experimental lasers quickly shelved the 172 design with only a dozen units entering field trials with frontline units. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.97 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 172 是由 NAIS 资助、基于 171 Hornet 型号的改装型，将该机甲改造成近程伏击战机。172 装有两门实验性中型 X 脉冲激光和一具 SRM-2，设计用于在城市环境中猎杀和骚扰敌方侦察单位。它从未进入全面生产，实验性激光的产量有限，使 172 的设计很快被束之高阁，仅有十几台在一线部队中参加野外试验。 特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：0.97 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上
