Using narrowband communications and enhanced sensor arrays, the Mite could get electronic intelligence, transmit the data, and then get out of danger in a hurry. The Mite is armed with a single small laser in the center torso. Quirk: Improved Sensors Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 螨只有10吨重，在战斗中敌不过任何其他机甲，但它的设计目的就是观测后跑路。凭借高速度与机动性，它是天生的侦察机。通过窄带通讯与增强传感器阵列，螨能获取电子情报、发送数据，然后迅速脱离危险。螨在中央躯干装有一门单独的小型激光。 特性：改进传感器 投放费用倍率：0.99

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: So boss. These are those famed ultralight mechs I've heard rumors about. Mites, are they? They look fast at least.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 那么老大。这些就是那些我听传闻说的著名超轻型机甲。螨虫，是吗？至少它们看起来很快。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Based on the personal Grasshopper of Tor Miraborg, the Mjölnir is primarily armed with a PPC in the right arm and Gauss Rifle on the left arm, retaining the GHR-5H's jump jets, side torso mounted Medium and center torso mounted Large Lasers. Built around a fragile 280-rated XL Engine, an Endo Steel frame and near maximum standard armor, three tons of Gauss rounds and thirteen double heat sinks give Mjölnir more than adequate field endurance. Quirk: Aerial Assault Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.12
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Mjölnir 以托尔·米拉博格的私人 Grasshopper 为基础，主要武器为右臂的一门粒子炮和左臂的一门高斯步枪，并保留了 GHR-5H 的跳跃推进器、装于侧躯干的中型激光以及装于中央躯干的大型激光。它采用脆弱的 280 级 XL 引擎与内骨架框架，披挂接近最大值的标准装甲；三吨高斯弹药和十三台双散热器赋予 Mjölnir 绰绰有余的战场续航能力。 特性：空中突击 投放费用倍率：1.12

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Based on the personal Grasshopper of Tor Miraborg, the Mjölnir is primarily armed with a PPC in the right arm and Gauss Rifle on the left arm, retaining the GHR-5H's jump jets, side torso mounted Medium and center torso mounted Large Lasers. Built around a fragile 280-rated XL Engine, an Endo Steel frame and near maximum standard armor, three tons of Gauss rounds and thirteen double heat sinks give Mjölnir more than adequate field endurance.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 以托尔·米拉博格的私人蚱猛为基础，雷神之锤主武装为右臂的PPC和左臂的磁轨炮，保留了GHR-5H的跳跃推进器、侧躯干中型激光器与中央躯干大型激光器。它围绕脆弱的280级XL引擎、内层钢框架与接近最大量的标准装甲建造，三吨磁轨炮弹和十三具双重散热器让雷神之锤拥有绰绰有余的战场续航力。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An upgrade to the ageing 68 model, this Mongoose was one of the first models to trial the Combines new C3 Slave unit. Featuring a characteristically minimalist upgrade package, this Mongoose variant served with distinction during Operation Bulldog. An ER Large Laser serves as the sole weapons system, augmented by a new fire control system and the C3 unit. A cheap upgrade, this is a favorite of pilots who were previously assigned a 68; with many praising the enhanced range and accuracy of the Laser. Paired into demi lances, and assigned a C3 Master equipped mech to coordinate, these Mongoose's are deployed as head hunters and long range harassers; both roles that make use of their high ground speed and manoeuvrability. Fast and deadly, they have already made a name for themselves, with one Mongoose formation accounting for 5 kills, including a Star Colonel in a Timberwolf during the Great Refusal. Quirk: Easy to Pilot Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为对老旧68型的升级，这台Mongoose是最早试装龙脉联合体新型C3从属单元的型号之一。它采用了典型的极简升级方案，在“斗牛犬行动”中表现卓著。它唯一的武器系统是一门增程大型激光，并辅以新的火控系统和C3单元。作为一项廉价的升级，它深受此前驾驶68型的飞行员喜爱，许多人称赞这门激光的射程与精度都有提升。它们以半分队编组，并配属一台装备C3主控单元的机甲进行协调，被部署为猎头者与远程骚扰单位——这两个角色都能充分发挥其出色的地面速度和机动性。它们快速而致命，如今已声名鹊起：在大拒绝之战中，一支Mongoose编队取得了5个战果，其中包括一名驾驶Timberwolf的星团长。 特性：易于驾驶 投放费用倍率：0.98

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An upgrade to the ageing 68 model, this Mongoose was one of the first models to trial the Combines new C3 Slave unit. Featuring a characteristically minimalist upgrade package, this Mongoose variant served with distinction during Operation Bulldog. An ER Large Laser serves as the sole weapons system, augmented by a new fire control system and the C3 unit. A cheap upgrade, this is a favorite of pilots who were previously assigned a 68; with many praising the enhanced range and accuracy of the Laser. Paired into demi lances, and assigned a C3 Master equipped mech to coordinate, these Mongoose's are deployed as head hunters and long range harassers; both roles that make use of their high ground speed and manoeuvrability. Fast and deadly, they have already made a name for themselves, with one Mongoose formation accounting for 5 kills, including a Star Colonel in a Timberwolf during the Great Refusal.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为对老旧68型号的升级，这台猫鼬是最早试用联合体新型C3从属系统的型号之一。它以标志性的极简升级包为特色，在斗牛犬行动中功勋卓著。一门增程大型激光器是它唯一的武器系统，另有新火控系统和C3单元的加持。作为一次廉价升级，它深受此前配属68型号飞行员的喜爱；许多人称赞这门激光器提升后的射程与精度。它们成对编入半分队并配属一台C3主机机甲来协调，被部署为猎头者与远程袭扰者；这两个角色都充分利用了它们的高地面速度与机动性。快速而致命，它们已经闯出了名声——在大拒绝期间，一支猫鼬编队创下5个击杀，其中包括一名驾驶铁木狼的星上校。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A Clantech upgrade to the again Royal Mongoose, that debuted during the Golden Age. The C2 was a Clan Mongoose model developed as a testbed for the newly developed Targeting Computers. Removing 2 heat sinks allowed Mongoose engineers to install the targeting computer, otherwise this design is unchanged from the standard MON-C. Quirk: Easy to Pilot Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是对再度成为皇家机型的 Mongoose 进行的部族科技升级，于黄金时代首次亮相。C2 是部族 Mongoose 的一个型号，作为新研制的瞄准计算机的试验平台而开发。拆除 2 具散热器让 Mongoose 的工程师得以安装瞄准计算机，除此之外该设计与标准 MON-C 完全相同。 特性：易于驾驶 投放费用倍率：1.04

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A Clantech upgrade to the again Royal Mongoose, that debuted during the Golden Age. The C2 was a Clan Mongoose model developed as a testbed for the newly developed Targeting Computers. Removing 2 heat sinks allowed Mongoose engineers to install the targeting computer, otherwise this design is unchanged from the standard MON-C.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是对再次回归的皇家猫鼬的部族技术升级，于黄金时代首次亮相。C2是猫鼬部族的型号，作为新研制的瞄准计算机的试验平台。拆掉2个散热器让猫鼬工程师得以装入瞄准计算机，除此之外该设计与标准MON-C没有差别。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The original Morpheus carried a medium laser, pair of Medium Pulse Lasers, and an anti-missile system. It also carried a Beagle active probe and Guardian ECM suite. Quirk: Protected Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 最初的Morpheus装有一门中型激光、两门中型脉冲激光和一套反导弹系统，此外还配有猎犬主动探测器和守护者电子对抗套件。 特性：受保护驱动器 投放费用倍率：1.09

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A Solaris VII BattleMech, the Morpheus is a heavily-armored combatant. The high ground speed allow the Morpheus to close quickly, while the heavy armor protects the 'Mech and pilot from enemy fire. The Morpheus is basically a larger version of the Tsunami medium arena fighter, and the engineers of Omnitech Industries learned many lessons from the Tsunami's disappointing appearance. Strangely, one thing they didn't bring over to the Morpheus was triple strength myomer.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为一台索拉里斯VII战斗机甲，摩耳甫斯是重装甲的战斗者。高地面速度让摩耳甫斯能迅速逼近，而厚重的装甲保护机甲与飞行员免受敌方火力。摩耳甫斯基本上是海啸中型竞技机甲的放大版，全技工业的工程师们从海啸令人失望的表现中学到了许多教训。奇怪的是，他们没有移植到摩耳甫斯身上的一样东西是三倍强度肌纤维。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Mosquito mounts two small and one medium laser, a C3 Slave and a MASC. To free the space required, the 'Mech uses both lighter Ferro-Fibrous armor and an Endo Steel chassis. Quirk: Accurate Weapon - Laser Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.97
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Mosquito 装备两门小型激光和一门中型激光，外加一套 C3 从机和一套 MASC。为腾出所需空间，该机甲同时采用了更轻的铁纤维装甲和内骨架底盘。 特性：精准武器 - 激光 投放费用倍率：0.97

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Mosquito is a 15-ton ultralight 'Mech created by several different companies within the Inner Sphere. It is often seen used for crowd control and garrison duties, but is also decent in a more battle oriented role.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 蚊子是内天体数家不同公司创造的15吨超轻型机甲。它常用于人群控制与驻防任务，但在更偏战斗的角色上也表现不错。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This apparent precursor to the Phoenix Hawk LAM may have had a different name originally, but in any case became known as the Munin LAM. The only samples known to exist were those recovered from a cache by the Tyr Resistance Movement shortly before the Fourth Succession War. Unbeknownst to many, recovered blueprints and manufacturing manuals not only allowed production to resume, but aided in Upgraded Designs. Quirk: Land Air Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这台显然是凤凰鹰 LAM 前身的设计可能原本另有其名，但无论如何后来被称为穆宁 LAM。已知存在的唯一样本，是第四次继承战争前不久由提尔抵抗运动从一处储藏库中取回的。许多人不知道的是，取回的蓝图与制造手册不仅让生产得以重启，还帮助了升级设计。 特质：陆空机甲 投放费用倍率：1.05

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This apparent precursor to the Phoenix Hawk LAM may have had a different name originally, but in any case became known as the Munin LAM. The only samples known to exist were those recovered from a cache by the Tyr Resistance Movement shortly before the Fourth Succession War. Unbeknownst to many, recovered blueprints and manufacturing manuals not only allowed production to resume, but aided in Upgraded Designs.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这种显然是凤凰鹰 LAM 前身的机型最初可能另有其名，但无论如何，它后来被称为穆宁 LAM。已知存在的唯一一批样品，是泰尔抵抗运动在第四次继承战争前不久从一处储藏点中回收的。鲜为人知的是，回收到的蓝图和制造手册不仅让生产得以恢复，还对升级设计有所助益。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The primary configuration of the Naga II combines an Ultra AC/10 in the right arm with an LB 10-X AC in the left for its primary damage. A single side torso mounted LRM-20 launcher allows for secondary fire support and indirect engagements. A single ER Small Laser in the center torso provide some very limited anti-infantry defense capabilities. Quirk: Extended Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.13 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 娜迦 II 的主配置以右臂一门超速 AC/10 搭配左臂一门 LB 10-X AC 作为主要伤害来源。单具装在侧躯干的 LRM-20 发射器用于次要火力支援与间接交战。中央躯干的一门 ER 小型激光提供非常有限的反步兵防御能力。 特质：强化躯干扭转 投放费用倍率：1.13 臂部驱动器限制：全能

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Naga II is a further continuation from Clan Wolf's first OmniMech, the Woodsman. What originally was a technical failure during the first batches of production of the Woodsman got converted into the Naga, later refined into the Naga II, but still suffering from bad reputation as a partial failure. The Naga II keeps much of of the core design the same as the original Naga; an Endo Steel internal structure, 9 tons of standard armor and a 400 XL engine.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 娜迦 II 是狼氏族首款全能机甲"林中人"的进一步延续。林中人最初几批生产中存在的技术缺陷被转化成娜迦，后又精炼为娜迦 II，但仍背负着"部分失败"的坏名声。娜迦 II 保留原版娜迦的大部分核心设计：内骨骼内部结构、9 吨标准装甲与 400 XL 引擎。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The primary configuration of the Naga II combines an Ultra AC/10 in the right arm with an LB 10-X AC in the left for its primary damage. A single side torso mounted LRM-20 launcher allows for secondary fire support and indirect engagements. A single ER Small Laser in the center torso provide some very limited anti-infantry defense capabilities. Quirk: Extended Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.13 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The primary configuration of the Naga II combines an Ultra AC/10 in the right arm with an LB 10-X AC in the left for its primary damage. A single side torso mounted LRM-20 launcher allows for secondary fire support and indirect engagements. A single ER Small Laser in the center torso provide some very limited anti-infantry defense capabilities. Quirk: Extended Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.13 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 娜迦 II 的主配置以右臂一门超速 AC/10 搭配左臂一门 LB 10-X AC 作为主要伤害来源。单具装在侧躯干的 LRM-20 发射器用于次要火力支援与间接交战。中央躯干的一门 ER 小型激光提供非常有限的反步兵防御能力。 特质：强化躯干扭转 投放费用倍率：1.13 臂部驱动器限制：全能

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Naga II is a further continuation from Clan Wolf's first OmniMech, the Woodsman. What originally was a technical failure during the first batches of production of the Woodsman got converted into the Naga, later refined into the Naga II, but still suffering from bad reputation as a partial failure. The Naga II keeps much of of the core design the same as the original Naga; an Endo Steel internal structure, 9 tons of standard armor and a 400 XL engine.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 娜迦 II 是狼氏族首款全能机甲"林中人"的进一步延续。林中人最初几批生产中存在的技术缺陷被转化成娜迦，后又精炼为娜迦 II，但仍背负着"部分失败"的坏名声。娜迦 II 保留原版娜迦的大部分核心设计：内骨骼内部结构、9 吨标准装甲与 400 XL 引擎。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Naga is a fire-support successor to the first-generation Woodsman OmniMech, but is an oddity in many ways. Most of what could be pod space for the design is actually taken up by a pair of fixed Arrow IV Artillery Systems. Quirk: Extended Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.13 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 娜迦是第一代"林中人"全能机甲的火力支援后继者，但在许多方面都颇为古怪。该设计本可用于吊舱的空间，实际上大部分被一对固定安装的箭矢 IV 火炮系统占据。 特质：强化躯干扭转 投放费用倍率：1.13 臂部驱动器限制：全能
重型火力支援与防御者

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This fast assault 'Mech mounts a meager nine tons of armor, but tactical doctrine keeps it far from the front lines. The Naga is often derided because it rarely allows for the glory that comes from an individual kill.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这款快速突击机甲只装九吨装甲，但战术条令让它远离前线。娜迦常被嘲笑，因为它很少带来个人击杀所能获得的荣耀。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Naginata NG-C3A serves in the dual role of command and fire support 'Mech. The C3 master computer allows the 'Mech to share the targeting data of its lancemates and to take advantage of their targeting information, making the three LRM-15s with Artemis IV fire control systems and the ER PPC extremely accurate. The Artemis IV fire control system gives the 'Mech increased missile accuracy. Quirk: Cowl Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.17 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 薙刀NG-C3A兼具指挥与火力支援两种角色。C3主控计算机让它能共享小队成员的瞄准数据并利用他们的目标信息，使三门配备阿尔忒弥斯IV火控系统的LRM-15和增程粒子炮具备极高的精准度。阿尔忒弥斯IV火控系统进一步提升了机甲的导弹精度。 特性：头罩 投放费用倍率：1.17 手臂驱动器限制：左下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Naginata is designed as a command and fire support 'Mech. The 'Mech is built using a massive 285 fusion engine, giving it a top speed of 54 km/h. The Naginata makes use of double heat sink technology for its added heat dissipation capabilities to handle the waste heat that is produced by the 'Mech's massive arsenal. For protection, the Naginata carries fifteen tons of armor and includes CASE to protect against an ammunition explosion. The mix of heavy armor, CASE, and a standard engine make the Naginata a zombie of a 'Mech that can take a tremendous amount of damage.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 薙刀被设计为指挥与火力支援机甲。该机甲采用一台巨大的285聚变引擎，最高速度54公里/小时。薙刀利用双重散热器技术增强散热能力，以处理该机甲庞大武库产生的废热。防护方面，薙刀携带十五吨装甲并配备CASE以防弹药爆炸。厚甲、CASE与标准引擎的组合使薙刀成为一台能承受巨量伤害的僵尸机甲。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An early Clan Mech, the Naja was built by the Cloud Cobras, using the Royal Kintaro as the base chassis. Designed to showcase the Cobras new missile technology, the Naja is armed with a Clan LRM-20, along with paired Improved SRM-2's, a pair of Improved SRM-6's, and 3 lasers supplementing this. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 纳迦是部族早期机甲，由云眼镜蛇部族以皇家金太郎为底盘基础建造。为展示云眼镜蛇的新型导弹技术，纳迦装有一具部族LRM-20，另有成对的改进型SRM-2、两具改进型SRM-6，以及3门激光作为补充。 特性：易于维护 投放费用倍率：1.05

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An early Clan Mech, the Naja was built by the Cloud Cobras, using the Royal Kintaro as the base chassis. Designed to showcase the Cobras new missile technology, the Naja is armed with a Clan LRM-20, along with paired Improved SRM-2's, a pair of Improved SRM-6's, and 3 lasers supplementing this.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为早期氏族机甲，娜迦由云眼镜蛇建造，以皇家金太郎为基础底盘。它旨在展示眼镜蛇的新型导弹技术，武装为一具氏族LRM-20，另有成对的改进型SRM-2、两具改进型SRM-6，以及3门激光器作为补充。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An early Clan mech used by Clan Cloud Cobra, the Naja is built on the Kintaro chassis sporting an LRM-20, and a trio of ER Lasers. A pair of Improved SRM2's and Improved SRM6's are retained from the first generation Naja. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Naja 是云眼镜蛇部族早期使用的一款机甲，以 Kintaro 底盘为基础建造，装备一具 LRM-20 和三门增程激光。第一代 Naja 的改进型 SRM2 与改进型 SRM6 各一对被保留了下来。 特性：易于维护 投放费用倍率：1.09

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An early Clan mech used by Clan Cloud Cobra, the Naja is built on the Kintaro chassis sporting an LRM-20, and a trio of ER Lasers. A pair of Improved SRM2's and Improved SRM6's are retained from the first generation Naja.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为云眼镜蛇氏族使用的一种早期氏族机甲，娜迦建在金太郎底盘上，装有一具LRM-20和三门增程激光器。两具改进型SRM2和改进型SRM6从第一代娜迦保留下来。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: As a recon 'Mech intended to rarely engage an enemy in a pitched battle, the Nexus is armed with a Medium Laser backed up by two highly accurate Medium Pulse Lasers. As a weapon of last resort, the Nexus also has two Small Lasers. For added protection against missile attacks, the Nexus has an AMS. The Nexus has a top speed of 119 km/h and is powered by a 175-rated fusion engine which is both light and rugged. To save weight without the vulnerability of an XL engine, the Nexus is built on a Endo Steel chassis. For protection, the 'Mech carries a light two tons of Ferro-Fibrous armor, relying on its speed and maneuverability, which is enhanced with a jumping capability of up to one hundred and twenty meters. Finally, to handle the heat from the arsenal of energy weapons, the Nexus carries ten double heat sinks. Quirk: Nimble Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Nexus 是一款侦察机甲，设计中极少在正面会战中与敌交战。它装备一门中型激光，辅以两门精准度极高的中型脉冲激光。作为最后手段，Nexus 还配有两门小型激光。为加强对导弹攻击的防护，Nexus 装有一具 AMS。Nexus 的最高时速为 119 km/h，由一台额定 175 的聚变引擎驱动，既轻便又坚固。为在不承受 XL 引擎脆弱性的前提下减轻重量，Nexus 采用内骨架打造。防护方面，该机甲仅携带轻量的两吨铁纤维装甲，依靠自身的速度与机动性——其跳跃能力可达一百二十米。最后，为应对大量能量武器产生的热量，Nexus 配备十个双散热器。 特性：灵活 投放费用倍率：0.98 手臂驱动器限制：左下臂、右下臂

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The BattleMech known as the Nexus was originally based on the Jackrabbit, a light scout and combat vehicle and infantry support 'Mech built for the Star League Defense Force by Skobel MechWorks. Ironically, the Jackrabbit ended testing two weeks before Stefan Amaris seized power on Terra and was instead primarily used by units loyal to Amaris against the SLDF in General Kerensky's drive to liberate the Terran Hegemony. Though the SLDF captured Skobel's plant relatively intact, thanks to the stigma of being used against his forces Kerensky ordered it shutdown and the unloved Jackrabbit disappeared into history outside of ComStar's records. With the Com Guards looking to recoup their grievous losses in the wake of the Battle of Tukayyid, in 3054 Precentor Martial Anastasius Focht ordered the Skobel plant reactivated, reworking the slower Jackrabbit into a fast and highly mobile recon striker 'Mech he renamed the Nexus.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这台被称为联结的战斗机甲最初以豺兔为基础——那是斯考贝尔机械厂为星盟防卫部队建造的轻型侦察兼战斗车辆与步兵支援机甲。讽刺的是，豺兔在斯特凡·阿马里斯于地球夺权前两周就结束了测试，结果反倒主要被忠于阿马里斯的部队用来对抗SLDF，在克伦斯基将军解放地球霸权的进军中登场。尽管SLDF相对完整地夺取了斯考贝尔的工厂，但由于该机型曾被用来对付自己的部队这一污名，克伦斯基下令将其关停，不受待见的豺兔从此从历史中消失，只存在于康星的记录之外。图卡伊德战役之后，康卫队力图弥补惨重损失，3054年，尚武主教阿纳斯塔修斯·福赫特下令重启斯考贝尔工厂，把较慢的豺兔重造为一台快速且高度机动的侦察打击机甲，并将其更名为联结。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The alternate loadout of the Night Chanter combines an LRM-10 launcher with an ER Medium Laser and an ER PPC as primary weapons, while mounting two A-Pods and two Machine guns to deal with vehicles and infantry. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.02
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 夜吟者的备用配置以LRM-10发射器、一具增程中型激光和一具增程粒子炮为主武器，同时装有两具A-Pod和两挺机枪以对付车辆与步兵。 特性：易于维护 投放费用倍率：1.02

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: As the knowledge of how to build OmniMechs spread throughout the clans although Coyote had tried to keep it for themselves, they quickly realized they needed to bolster their 'Mech forces and started the Pueblo Initiative to remodel older SLDF 'Mechs into OmniMechs. The Night Chanter was the first result of the initiative, using the Crab as its base. However, the rushed development led to a somewhat dubious design, and the 'Mech was easily beaten by other Omnis of the same size. Despite this compromise, the Night Chanter still spread through the clans quickly and became the most used of the Pueblo Initiative designs.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 随着制造全向机甲的技术在部族间流传开来——尽管 Coyote 曾试图将其据为己有——他们很快意识到必须充实自己的机甲部队，于是启动了 Pueblo 计划，将较老的 SLDF 机甲改造为全向机甲。Night Chanter 是该计划的首个成果，以 Crab 为基础。然而仓促的研发导致设计略显可疑，这台机甲很容易被同级别的其他全向机甲击败。尽管存在这些妥协，Night Chanter 仍迅速在部族中流传，成为 Pueblo 计划设计中使用最广泛的一款。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Primary loadout of the Night Chanter is a combination of pulse and extended range lasers, making the 'Mech somewhat able to deal damage at most ranges. The varied loadout does mean it lacks the weapon profile to excel at any particular range, but the idea of the design is that any intended engagement does not occur within only a limited amount of ranges, and instead it is a constant flow back and forth. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.02
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 夜吟者的主配置结合了脉冲激光与增程激光，使这台机甲在大多数距离上都能造成一定伤害。这种多样化的配置确实意味着它缺乏在某一特定距离上出类拔萃的武器组合，但该设计的理念本就是不让交战只发生在有限的几段距离内，而是持续不断地来回游走。 特性：易于维护 投放费用倍率：1.02

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: As the knowledge of how to build OmniMechs spread throughout the clans although Coyote had tried to keep it for themselves, they quickly realized they needed to bolster their 'Mech forces and started the Pueblo Initiative to remodel older SLDF 'Mechs into OmniMechs. The Night Chanter was the first result of the initiative, using the Crab as its base. However, the rushed development led to a somewhat dubious design, and the 'Mech was easily beaten by other Omnis of the same size. Despite this compromise, the Night Chanter still spread through the clans quickly and became the most used of the Pueblo Initiative designs.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 随着制造全向机甲的技术在部族间流传开来——尽管 Coyote 曾试图将其据为己有——他们很快意识到必须充实自己的机甲部队，于是启动了 Pueblo 计划，将较老的 SLDF 机甲改造为全向机甲。Night Chanter 是该计划的首个成果，以 Crab 为基础。然而仓促的研发导致设计略显可疑，这台机甲很容易被同级别的其他全向机甲击败。尽管存在这些妥协，Night Chanter 仍迅速在部族中流传，成为 Pueblo 计划设计中使用最广泛的一款。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The A variant is a short-range powerhouse. It mounts an Ultra Autocannon/20 to breach opponent's armor and a pair of Streak SRM-6s to exploit those holes. A Large Pulse Laser and a trio of Medium Pulse Lasers are highly accurate weapons that can help to minimize collateral damage in an urban environment. Even with four additional double heat sinks, this variant can be quickly overwhelmed by heat. Quirk: Combat Computer Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.12 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: A变型是近程重炮。它装一门超级自动炮/20撕裂对手装甲，两具连发SRM-6利用这些破口；一门大型脉冲激光和三门中型脉冲激光是高精度武器，有助于在城市环境中尽量减少附带损伤。即便有四个额外双散热器，此变型也可能迅速被热量压倒。 特性：战斗计算机 投放费用倍率：1.12 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The primary configuration is hard-hitting, mounting a pair of ER PPCs located in the left arm and an Ultra Autocannon/10 in the right. This blistering firepower can often take down an opponent before they are in range. Three Medium Pulse Lasers serve as accurate backups. Eight additional double heat sinks keep the 'Mech fairly cool.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 主配置打击凶猛，左臂装一对 ER PPC，右侧装一门超速自动炮/10。这种炽烈火力常常能在对手进入射程前将其击倒。三门中型脉冲激光作为精准的备用武器。八台额外双倍散热器使机甲保持相当凉爽。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Another long-range variant, the C mounts three Ultra Autocannon/2s and two ER Large Lasers. A pair of ER Medium Lasers are present for backup. All of these weapons are linked to a Targeting Computer. Six extra heat sinks ensure the 'Mech stays mostly cool. Quirk: Combat Computer Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.12 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为另一款远程变型，C配置装三门超级AC/2和两门增程大型激光，另有两门增程中型激光作为后手。这些武器全部联动一台瞄准计算机。六个额外散热器确保机甲大体保持凉爽。 特性：战斗计算机 投放费用倍率：1.12 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The primary configuration is hard-hitting, mounting a pair of ER PPCs located in the left arm and an Ultra Autocannon/10 in the right. This blistering firepower can often take down an opponent before they are in range. Three Medium Pulse Lasers serve as accurate backups. Eight additional double heat sinks keep the 'Mech fairly cool.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 主配置打击凶猛，左臂装一对 ER PPC，右侧装一门超速自动炮/10。这种炽烈火力常常能在对手进入射程前将其击倒。三门中型脉冲激光作为精准的备用武器。八台额外双倍散热器使机甲保持相当凉爽。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This variant uses massed pulse lasers, two large and six medium, in conjunction with an ATM 6 and an SRM-6. The ATM only mounts two tons of ammunition, limiting its flexibility. Quirk: Combat Computer Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.12 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该变型集中配备脉冲激光，两具大型与六具中型，并搭配一具ATM 6和一具SRM-6。ATM仅携带两吨弹药，灵活性因此受到限制。 特性：战斗计算机 投放费用倍率：1.12 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The primary configuration is hard-hitting, mounting a pair of ER PPCs located in the left arm and an Ultra Autocannon/10 in the right. This blistering firepower can often take down an opponent before they are in range. Three Medium Pulse Lasers serve as accurate backups. Eight additional double heat sinks keep the 'Mech fairly cool.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 主配置打击凶猛，左臂装一对 ER PPC，右侧装一门超速自动炮/10。这种炽烈火力常常能在对手进入射程前将其击倒。三门中型脉冲激光作为精准的备用武器。八台额外双倍散热器使机甲保持相当凉爽。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A customized variant of the Night Gyr. The Jade Kite uses a pair of Ultra Autocannon/2s in its left arm, supported by a pair of ammo. The left torso carries a pair of Machine Guns, each with one ton of autocannon ammo and a half-ton of machine gun ammo. The right arm carries a pair of ER PPCs. In the right torso, two Streak SRM-6s with two tons of ammo. Quirk: Combat Computer Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是夜鹫的定制变型。碧玉风筝左臂装一对超级AC/2，配两吨弹药；左躯干带一对机枪，各配一吨自动炮弹药和半吨机枪弹药；右臂装一对增程粒子炮；右躯干内有两具连发SRM-6，配两吨弹药。 特性：战斗计算机 投放费用倍率：1.14 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A customized variant of the Night Gyr. The Jade Kite uses a pair of Ultra Autocannon/2s in its left arm, supported by a pair of ammo. The left torso carries a pair of Machine Guns, each with one ton of autocannon ammo and a half-ton of machine gun ammo. The right arm carries a pair of ER PPCs. In the right torso, two Streak SRM-6s with two tons of ammo.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 夜隼的定制改型。翠绿风筝在左臂装一对超速自动炮/2，配两吨弹药支援。左躯干携带一对机枪，各配一吨自动炮弹药和半吨机枪弹药。右臂携带一对增程PPC。右躯干内有两具连发SRM-6，配两吨弹药。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Nighthawk Mk. XXI is a PA(L) design and the progenitor of modern battle armor. The original Nighthawk was based upon exoskeletons originally used for commercial purposes during the Star League. It took fifteen years and twenty prototypes before the SLDF finally perfected the design that would eventually be produced. A working prototype was first introduced in 2718, which was followed by two years of field testing and, finally, full production, entering service with the Special Forces Command. Quirk: Power Armor Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.8832 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A fast reaction mech designed to hunt down enemy scouts and raiding units, the 35 ton Night Hawk was developed by Mountain Wolf Battlemechs in 2656. Built around a 210-rated XL Engine, the Night Hawk NTK-2Q is armed with an ER Large Laser and a Large Laser. A Medium Pulse Laser provides additional firepower should enemies close in. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为一款用于猎杀敌方侦察与袭掠单位的快速反应机甲，35吨的夜鹰由山狼机甲公司于2656年研制。夜鹰NTK-2Q围绕一台210额定XL引擎建造，装有一门增程大型激光和一门大型激光；敌人逼近时，一门中型脉冲激光提供额外火力。 特性：易于维护 投放费用倍率：1.05 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The original variant of the Nightsky is built around a massive 300 XL engine, propelling the 'Mech up to speeds of 97.2 km/h. Superb ground speed and the added maneuverability provided by six jump jets allows the Nightsky to jump up to 180 meters. The 'Mech is protected with nine and a half tons of armor, considered good protection for its size. Besides the massive hatchet, the Nightsky carries two Medium and one Large Pules Laser, with a single Small Pulse Lasers as backup. Quirk: Melee Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 夜天最初变型围绕一台庞大的300 XL引擎建造，把机甲推到97.2公里/小时。出色的地面速度加上六具跳跃推进器带来的额外机动性，让夜天可跳跃至多180米。该机甲由九吨半装甲保护，就体型而言算是不错的防护。除那把大战斧外，夜天带两门中型和一门大型脉冲激光，另有一门小型脉冲激光作为后手。 特性：近战驱动器 投放费用倍率：1.04

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Nightsky is the successor to the Hatchetman and Axeman developed by Defiance Industries. As with its predecessors, the centerpiece of the Nightsky is a massive four-ton hatchet that is built into its right arm, which allows the 'Mech to cut through another 'Mech's armor.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 夜天是迪法恩斯工业开发的斧手与伐木者的后继者。与其前辈一样，夜天的核心是右臂内置的一柄巨大四吨战斧，能让机甲劈开另一台机甲的装甲。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 4T is a variant of the Nightsky that looks to make the 'Mech more powerful in both long and close range combat. This is done by swapping the Large Pulse Laser for an ER Large Laser and an Anti-Missile System, for added defense against enemy missiles. The 'Mech also adds an additional Small Laser for added close range firepower. Quirk: Melee Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 4T是夜天的变型，力求让该机甲在远程与近程战斗中更强大：它以一门增程大型激光和一套反导弹系统取代大型脉冲激光，以加强对敌方导弹的防御，并额外加装一门小型激光以提升近程火力。 特性：近战驱动器 投放费用倍率：1.04

As with its predecessors, the centerpiece of the Nightsky is a massive four-ton hatchet that is built into its right arm, which allows the 'Mech to cut through another 'Mech's armor.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A simple upgrade of the Nightsky, the 5S looks to make the 'Mech more heat efficient. This is achieved by removing the jump jets and replacing them with three additional double heat sinks. Quirk: Melee Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 5S是Nightsky的一次简单升级，目的是让机甲散热更高效。做法是拆除跳跃推进器，代之以三台额外的双散热器。 特性：近战驱动器 投放费用倍率：1.04

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Nightsky is the successor to the Hatchetman and Axeman developed by Defiance Industries. As with its predecessors, the centerpiece of the Nightsky is a massive four-ton hatchet that is built into its right arm, which allows the 'Mech to cut through another 'Mech's armor.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 5T is a modification of the 4S that replaces the large pulse laser with an ER PPC, but is otherwise identical to the 4S model. This modification of the 'Mech makes the Nightsky capable of targeting an enemy 'Mech at extreme ranges and wearing them down until the 'Mech can bring its hatchet to bear on its target. Quirk: Melee Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 5T 是 4S 的改型，用一门增程粒子炮替换了大型脉冲激光，除此之外与 4S 型号完全相同。这一改动让 Nightsky 能够在极远距离上锁定敌方机甲并不断消磨它，直到战斧能够劈向目标为止。 特性：近战驱动器 投放费用倍率：1.04

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Nightsky is the successor to the Hatchetman and Axeman developed by Defiance Industries. As with its predecessors, the centerpiece of the Nightsky is a massive four-ton hatchet that is built into its right arm, which allows the 'Mech to cut through another 'Mech's armor.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 夜天是迪法恩斯工业开发的斧手与伐木者的后继者。与其前辈一样，夜天的核心是右臂内置的一柄巨大四吨战斧，能让机甲劈开另一台机甲的装甲。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Reconfigured for greater speed, the 9FC variant of the Nightstar replaces the two Gauss Rifles with a pair of LB-X Autocannon/10s that are not as destructive as the weapons they replace, but can use both standard and cluster ammunition, making them effective in a variety of roles. The Small Laser has also been upgraded and the Medium Pulse Lasers downgraded, giving the Nightstar a total of three medium lasers. To make the 'Mech fit better into the mobile warfare doctrine of the Federated Suns and Federated Commonwealth, the 9FC model has used the saved weight to upgrade its engine, giving it a top speed of 64.8 km/h. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.17
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 为追求更高速度而重新配置的夜星9FC变型以一对LB-X自动炮/10取代两门高斯步枪；它们不如被替换的武器那样具破坏性，却可使用标准弹与集束弹，因而胜任多种角色。小型激光也被升级、中型脉冲激光则降级，使夜星共带三门中型激光。为使该机甲更契合联邦太阳国与联邦共和国的机动作战理念，9FC用省下的重量升级引擎，把最高速度提升到64.8公里/小时。 特性：指挥机甲 投放费用倍率：1.17

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The genesis of the Nightstar lies in the Amaris Civil War. The 'Mech itself was only produced until the the First Succession War, when both of the factories and engineers capable of producing the Nightstar were destroyed or killed. The Nightstar is armed to keep an enemy at standoff ranges. The primary weapons carried are a pair of Gauss Rifles, each of which can strip almost a ton of armor off an enemy unit. These are backed up by a ER PPC that is capable of hitting a target at six hundred and ninety meters. For defense at short ranges, the 'Mech has two Medium Pulse Lasers and an Small Laser.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 夜星的起源在阿马里斯内战。该机甲只生产到第一次继承战争，能制造夜星的两座工厂与工程师或被毁或被杀。夜星的武装意在把敌人压制在远距离。主武器为两门高斯步枪，每门都能削掉敌人近一吨装甲。它们由一门能在六百九十米外击中目标的 ER PPC 支援。近距离防御则有两门中型脉冲激光和一门小型激光。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The personal machine of Shelly Brubaker, this Nightstar variant replaced the standard weapons with Clan-spec weapons: Two Gauss Rifles, three Large Pulse Lasers, and an ER Small Laser. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.19
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是 Shelly Brubaker 的专属座机。这款 Nightstar 变型以部族规格武器取代了标准武器：两门高斯步枪、三门大型脉冲激光和一门增程小型激光。 特性：指挥机甲 投放费用倍率：1.19

The 'Mech itself was only produced until the the First Succession War, when both of the factories and engineers capable of producing the Nightstar were destroyed or killed. The Nightstar is armed to keep an enemy at standoff ranges. The primary weapons carried are a pair of Gauss Rifles, each of which can strip almost a ton of armor off an enemy unit. These are backed up by a ER PPC that is capable of hitting a target at six hundred and ninety meters. For defense at short ranges, the 'Mech has two Medium Pulse Lasers and an Small Laser.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The No-Dachi was designed by Cosby as a test bed for two new technologies. The first was the Sword. The seven-meter long katana that the 'Mech wields was designed to counter the Hatchet used by some Federated Commonwealth 'Mechs. Because the samurai mindset had been so successfully drilled into the warriors of the Draconis Combine, they were loathe to use a ''barbaric'' ax. The second new technology was the Triple Strength Myomer that had been pioneered by the Federated Suns. The new melee weapon, combined with the improved myomers, make the No-Dachi a dangerous in-fighter. Quirk: Melee Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: No-Dachi 由 Cosby 设计，用作两项新技术的试验平台。第一项是剑。该机甲所持的长达七米的武士刀，是为了对抗联邦共和国部分机甲所使用的战斧而设计的。由于武士道精神已被成功地灌输到龙脉联合体的战士心中，他们不愿使用“野蛮的”斧头。第二项新技术是由联邦太阳国率先采用的三倍强度人造肌肉。这种新型近战武器与改进后的人造肌肉相结合，使 No-Dachi 成为危险的近身缠斗者。 特性：近战驱动器 投放费用倍率：1.1 手臂驱动器限制：左下臂

The second new technology was the Triple Strength Myomer that had been pioneered by the Federated Suns. The new melee weapon, combined with the improved myomers, make the No-Dachi a dangerous in-fighter.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 野太刀由科斯比设计，用作两项新技术的试验平台。第一项是剑：这台机甲挥舞的七米长武士刀，专门用来对抗某些联邦共和国机甲所使用的战斧。由于武士道精神已被深深灌输进龙脉联合体的战士心中，他们对这种“野蛮的”斧头深恶痛绝。第二项新技术是联邦太阳国率先采用的三倍强度肌纤维。新型近战武器与改良后的肌纤维相结合，使野太刀成为危险的近身近战机甲。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 2K variant has been altered to be even more dangerous in close quarters. The advantages are at the expense of its long-range weaponry, however. The ER PPC is downgraded to an ER Large Laser and the MRM-20s to MRM-10s. The resulting weight savings are used to upgrade the medium laser to a Medium Pulse Laser and add four more of the same. The remaining tonnage is devoted to an additional double heat sink, a Guardian ECM Suite, a single Small Laser, and more armor. Quirk: Melee Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 2K 变型经过改造，在近距离战斗中更加危险，不过这些优势是以牺牲其远程武器为代价的。增程粒子炮被降级为增程大型激光，MRM-20 则换成 MRM-10。由此节省下来的重量被用于把中型激光升级为中型脉冲激光，并再增加四门同类武器。剩余的吨位则用于加装一台双散热器、一套守护者电子对抗套件、一具小型激光以及更多装甲。 特性：近战驱动器 投放费用倍率：1.1 手臂驱动器限制：左上

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The No-Dachi was designed by Cosby as a test bed for two new technologies. The first was the Sword. The seven-meter long katana that the 'Mech wields was designed to counter the Hatchet used by some Federated Commonwealth 'Mechs. Because the samurai mindset had been so successfully drilled into the warriors of the Draconis Combine, they were loathe to use a ''barbaric'' ax. The second new technology was the Triple Strength Myomer that had been pioneered by the Federated Suns. The new melee weapon, combined with the improved myomers, make the No-Dachi a dangerous in-fighter.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The newer 2KO was designed to be even more lethal up-close than the 2K. This variant removes the MRMs entirely and changes the Large Laser to a Large Pulse Laser. An additional Medium Pulse Laser and Small Pulse Laser were added, as well as a Flamer and three more double heat sinks. A ton and a half of armor has been added to the 'Mech's rear to provide addition protection as has a pair of ER Medium Lasers. Quirk: Melee Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 更新的2KO被设计得比2K在近距离更致命。此变型完全拆掉MRM，并把大型激光换成大型脉冲激光，另加一门中型脉冲激光和一门小型脉冲激光，以及一具火焰喷射器和三个额外双散热器。机甲后方加了一吨半装甲以提供额外防护，另加一对增程中型激光。 特性：近战驱动器 投放费用倍率：1.1 手臂驱动器限制：左下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The NDA-2U replaces all the Pulser Laser of the 2K with standard variants, allowing replacing the two MRM-10 with one LRM-15 and one MRM-20. The variant also replaces the ER Large Laser with an ER PPC and drops the Small Laser. The Guardian ECM is further exchanged for a C3 slave computer. Quirk: Melee Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: NDA-2U将2K的所有脉冲激光全部换成标准型号，从而得以把两具MRM-10替换为一具LRM-15和一具MRM-20。该改型还以增程粒子炮取代增程大型激光，并去掉了小型激光。此外，Guardian电子对抗套件也被换成一具C3从属计算机。 特性：近战驱动器 投放费用倍率：1.1 手臂驱动器限制：左下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This custom configuration of Nova Cat was first spotted during the escalation of the FedCom civil war. Quirk: Extended Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.13 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 新星猫的这一定制配置最早在联邦共和内战升级期间被发现。 特性：扩展躯干旋转 投放费用倍率：1.13 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This custom configuration of Nova Cat was first spotted during the escalation of the FedCom civil war.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这一新猫定制配置首次现身于联邦共同体内战升级期间。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: One of several prototype rebuilds of the Prime configuration with the goal of making it run less hot. This was done by shifting the weapons more towards ballistics with two LB-X 20 Autocannons, but still mounting three Medium Pulse Lasers. Further, the A prototype mounts a MASC instead of jump jets to keep some mobility. These prototypes eventually lead to the standardized M configuration. Quirk: Extended Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是Prime构型的几种原型改造之一，目标在于让它的运行温度更低。为此，武器配置向实弹类偏移，装有两门LB-X 20自动炮，但仍保留三门中型脉冲激光。此外，A原型以MASC取代跳跃推进器，以保持一定的机动性。这些原型最终催生出标准化的M构型。 特性：扩展躯干旋转 投放费用倍率：1.11 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Long regarded as a pocket Assault OmniMech, the Nova Cat sacrifices speed for firepower. With over half of its tonnage dedicated to weapons, ammunition, and equipment, the Nova Cat packs a punch in all configurations. Some recent configurations increased the speed and agility that Clan customers typically desire.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 长期以来被视为袖珍突击全能机甲，新星猫以速度换取火力。它把超过一半的吨位用于武器、弹药和装备，因此在所有配置下都打击沉重。近期的一些配置提升了氏族客户通常看重的速度与灵活性。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: One of several prototype rebuilds of the Prime configuration with the goal of making it run less hot. This was done by shifting the weapons more towards ballistics with two LB-X 20 Autocannons, but still mounting three Medium Pulse Lasers. Further, the J prototype added Ferro-Fibrous structuring to free enough weight capacity to keep the jump jets. These prototypes eventually lead to the standardized M configuration. Quirk: Extended Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是主配置若干原型重建之一，目标是让它运行时不那么热。为此把武器更多地转向弹道，采用两门LB-X 20自动炮，但仍装三门中型脉冲激光。此外J原型加入铁纤维结构以腾出足够重量容量保留跳跃推进器。这些原型最终催生了标准化的M配置。 特性：扩展躯干旋转 投放费用倍率：1.11 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A customized Hero 'Mech configuration of the Nova supposedly piloted by Mar Helmer, the Breaker mounts a Streak SRM-4 and a Streak SRM-6 rack in the left arm, supported by five ER medium lasers with three in the right arm and the remaining two in the left torso. Rounded out with twin machine guns in the right torso, three tons of Streak missiles, half a ton of machine gun rounds and two extra double heat sinks keep Breaker in the thick of combat. Quirk: Combat Computer Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.07 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Breaker 是 Nova 的定制英雄机甲配置，据称由 Mar Helmer 驾驶。它于左臂搭载一组连发 SRM-4 与一组连发 SRM-6 发射架，并以五门增程中型激光为支援，其中三门位于右臂，其余两门位于左侧躯干。右躯干的双联机枪、三吨连发导弹、半吨机枪弹药，再加上两具额外的双散热器，让 Breaker 能始终坚守激战中心。 特性：战斗计算机 投放费用倍率：1.07 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A sleek, mobile, and versatile design, the Clan nova was long suspected to be one of the first OmniMechs produced by the Clans.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为一款流线型、机动且多用途的设计，氏族诺瓦长期被认为是最早由氏族生产的全能机甲之一。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The E2 configuration of the Nova focuses on Medium lasers, and lots of them. A total of 7 ER Medium standard and 3 Medium Pulse Lasers, spread over both arms and side torsos, provide good accuracy and damage at closer ranges, but also presents a new problem with managing the heat. Quirk: Combat Computer Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Nova 的 E2 配置专注于中型激光，而且数量众多。共 7 门标准增程中型激光与 3 门中型脉冲激光，分布于双臂与两侧躯干，在较近的距离上兼顾良好的精度与伤害，但也带来了散热管理的新难题。 特性：战斗计算机 投放费用倍率：1.05 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The F2 loadout carries only two weapons, one Ultra AC/5 and one LBX AC/5. Quirk: Combat Computer Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: F2 配装仅携带两件武器：一门 Ultra AC/5 与一门 LBX AC/5。 特性：战斗计算机 投放费用倍率：1.05 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The G2 configuration mounts three Medium Pulse Lasers in each arm, cooled by 15 double heat sinks. To improve the performance a targeting computer in the right torso is linked to the weapons. Quirk: Combat Computer Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: G2配置在每只手臂上装三门中型脉冲激光，由15个双散热器降温。为提升效能，右躯干内的瞄准计算机与这些武器联动。 特性：战斗计算机 投放费用倍率：1.05 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The P1 loadout carries 5 ER Medium Lasers in the right arm, a LRM-20 in the left arm and a single Medium Pulse Laser in the left torso. Quirk: Combat Computer Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: P1 配置在右臂搭载 5 具增程中型激光，左臂搭载一具 LRM-20，左躯干搭载一具中型脉冲激光。 特性：战斗计算机 投放费用倍率：1.05 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A modified A configuration used by Samson Furey, a Clan Smoke Jaguar abtakha fighting for Wolf's Dragoons in Delta Regiment, dropped the pair of anti-missile systems in the shoulders for two additional double heat sinks. It also drops the medium pulse laser for two ER medium lasers. Quirk: Combat Computer Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.07 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是萨姆森·富里所使用的改进型A配置——他是一名出身部族烟虎、被沃尔夫龙骑兵收编的战士（abtakha），服役于三角洲团。该配置拆除了双肩的一对反导弹系统，换装为两个额外的双散热器，同时以两门增程中型激光取代了中型脉冲激光。 特性：战斗计算机 投放费用倍率：1.07 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The O-Bakemono weighs in at eighty tons and has a top speed of 64.8 km/h, which is considered a good ground speed for an assault 'Mech. Quirk: Modular Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 大鬼面重达八十吨，最高速度64.8公里/小时，对突击机甲而言算是不错的地面速度。 特性：模块化武器 投放费用倍率：1.14 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上
重型火力支援与防御者

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The primary weapons on the O-Bakemono are a pair of Shigunga Arrow IV Systems. The Arrow IVs have an effective range of up to three kilometers, allowing the O-Bakemono to stay at extreme ranges and rain missiles onto the battlefield while friendly units spot for it.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: O-Bakemono 的主武器是一对"紫郡"箭矢 IV 系统。箭矢 IV 的有效射程可达三公里，使 O-Bakemono 能待在极远距离上向战场倾泻导弹，由友军单位为其指示目标。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: For close combat, the A configuration has six medium pulse lasers; two in each arm and two in the center torso. A Streak SRM-6 and one ton of ammunition is mounted in each side torso. A small pulse laser is mounted in the head for anti-infantry work. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在近战方面，A配置装有六门中型脉冲激光：每只手臂各两门，中央躯干两门。两侧躯干各装有一具连发SRM-6及一个吨位的弹药。头部装有一门小型脉冲激光，用于反步兵作战。 特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：1.05 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Omni-Corvis is an early prototype of OmniMech technology that was developed by Clan Hell's Horses. Based on the Corvis BattleMech, it carries the modular systems first introduced in the Mercury to the logical extreme. After Clan Ghost Bear took control of Tokasha MechWorks in 2921 they released the plans for the Omni-Corvis on the Chatterweb to punish the Horses for the death of Khan Kilbourne Jorgensson. The only Clan to take advantage of the design was Clan Snow Raven, who used the plans to create the Stormcrow.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Omni-Corvis 是全向机甲技术的早期原型，由地狱之马部族开发。它以 Corvis 战斗机甲为基础，把最早在水星上引入的模块化系统推向了极致。2921 年幽灵熊部族接管 Tokasha 机甲工厂后，为惩罚地狱之马部族害死可汗 Kilbourne Jorgensson，他们在 Chatterweb 上公布了 Omni-Corvis 的图纸。唯一利用了这一设计的部族是雪鸦部族，他们用这些图纸创造了风暴鸦。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A long range fire support model, the B configuration has an LRM-20 and three tons of ammunition in each arm. These are supported by a right torso Narc missile beacon with two tons of ammunition. A pair of machine guns with a half-ton of ammunition are carried in the left torso. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: B 型配置是远程火力支援型号，每条手臂各有一具 LRM-20 和三吨弹药。它们由右躯干的一具 NARC 导弹信标提供支援，配两吨弹药。左躯干则携带两挺机枪和半吨弹药。 特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：1.05 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Omni-Corvis is an early prototype of OmniMech technology that was developed by Clan Hell's Horses. Based on the Corvis BattleMech, it carries the modular systems first introduced in the Mercury to the logical extreme. After Clan Ghost Bear took control of Tokasha MechWorks in 2921 they released the plans for the Omni-Corvis on the Chatterweb to punish the Horses for the death of Khan Kilbourne Jorgensson. The only Clan to take advantage of the design was Clan Snow Raven, who used the plans to create the Stormcrow.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Omni-Corvis 是全向机甲技术的早期原型，由地狱之马部族开发。它以 Corvis 战斗机甲为基础，把最早在水星上引入的模块化系统推向了极致。2921 年幽灵熊部族接管 Tokasha 机甲工厂后，为惩罚地狱之马部族害死可汗 Kilbourne Jorgensson，他们在 Chatterweb 上公布了 Omni-Corvis 的图纸。唯一利用了这一设计的部族是雪鸦部族，他们用这些图纸创造了风暴鸦。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The default configuration is inspired by the Corvis. A UAC/10 with four tons of ammunition is supported by an ER large laser and an ER medium laser. Two additional pod-mounted double heat sinks are installed as well. This allows the Omni-Corvis to operate in the same medium range brackets that Corvis pilots are used to. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 默认配置的灵感来自Corvis。一门UAC/10配四吨弹药，辅以一门增程大型激光和一门增程中型激光。此外还安装了两台额外的挂载式双散热器。这让Omni-Corvis能够在Corvis机师所熟悉的中距离区间内作战。 特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：1.05 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Based on the Corvis BattleMech, it carries the modular systems first introduced in the Mercury to the logical extreme. After Clan Ghost Bear took control of Tokasha MechWorks in 2921 they released the plans for the Omni-Corvis on the Chatterweb to punish the Horses for the death of Khan Kilbourne Jorgensson. The only Clan to take advantage of the design was Clan Snow Raven, who used the plans to create the Stormcrow.
