Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This is the original version of the Onslaught. It is protected by only 12 tons of armor and is armed with an Ultra AC/5, Large Laser two SRM-6 and six Machine Guns. Quirk: Protected Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是猛攻的原始版本，仅有12吨装甲防护，武装为一门超级AC/5、一门大型激光、两具SRM-6和六挺机枪。 特性：受保护驱动器 投放费用倍率：1.11 手臂驱动器限制：左上

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A Solaris VII BattleMech, the Onslaught was originally designed as a technology testing platform. Approximately one hundred of these 'Mechs were built. A capable heavy BattleMech, the Onslaughts most noticeable feature was its high speed. Its cruising speed of 58 km/h was more commonly seen on medium 'Mechs.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Onslaught 是一具 Solaris VII 战斗机甲，最初是作为技术测试平台设计的，总共建造了约一百具。作为一具有实力的重型战斗机甲，Onslaught 最引人注目的特点就是速度快，其 58 km/h 的巡航速度通常多见于中型机甲。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This slight modification of the original SA-OS removes one of the C.A.S.E. systems, allowing the increase of Machine Gun ammunition. Quirk: Protected Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是对原版SA-OS的小幅改动，拆掉其中一套C.A.S.E.系统，从而得以增加机枪弹药。 特性：受保护驱动器 投放费用倍率：1.11 手臂驱动器限制：左上

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A Solaris VII BattleMech, the Onslaught was originally designed as a technology testing platform. Approximately one hundred of these 'Mechs were built. A capable heavy BattleMech, the Onslaughts most noticeable feature was its high speed. Its cruising speed of 58 km/h was more commonly seen on medium 'Mechs.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Onslaught 是一具 Solaris VII 战斗机甲，最初是作为技术测试平台设计的，总共建造了约一百具。作为一具有实力的重型战斗机甲，Onslaught 最引人注目的特点就是速度快，其 58 km/h 的巡航速度通常多见于中型机甲。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Orion ON1-AJA slaps. Quirk: Anti-Air Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.07 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 猎户座 ON1-AJA 强得离谱。 特性：防空瞄准 投放费用倍率：1.07 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Orions don't have hands, but this thing slaps
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 猎户座没有手，但这东西能扇人。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Orion ON1-E is a seldom seen variant of the Orion heavy 'Mech. As its main loadout the ON1-E mounts a LB-X 10 in the right torso and an Artemis IV enabled LRM-15 in the left torso. For close quarters combat and defense, the variant also has a Streak SRM-6 launcher in the left arm and an ER Medium Laser in each arm. To be able to comfortably carry the weapons, the chassis uses an Endo Steel structure. Quirk: Anti-Air Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 猎户座ON1-E是重型机甲猎户座中较为罕见的变型。作为主要武装，ON1-E在右躯干装有一门LB-X 10，左躯干装有带阿尔忒弥斯IV的LRM-15。为应对近身近战与防御，该变型还在左臂装有一具连发SRM-6发射器，每只手臂各有一具增程中型激光。为了从容承载这些武器，其机身采用内骨架结构。 特性：防空瞄准 投放费用倍率：1.11 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Orion K was the first true heavy 'Mech. As a multirole brawler, the Orion can engage enemies at a variety of ranges, and with plenty of armor, it can survive combined fire for quite some time. Slow, yes, but powerful.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 猎户座 K 是首款真正的重型机甲。作为多用途缠斗者，猎户座能在多种距离上交战，凭借充裕装甲，它能在集中火力下存活相当长时间。慢，是的，但强大。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Terran Hegemony's Royal Division's variant of the ON1-K, the ON1-Kb upgrades the base design with a better heat sink kit. Quirk: Anti-Air Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.13 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是地球霸权皇家师的ON1-K变型，ON1-Kb以更好的散热器套件升级了基础设计。 特性：防空瞄准 投放费用倍率：1.13 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Orion K was the first true heavy 'Mech. As a multirole brawler, the Orion can engage enemies at a variety of ranges, and with plenty of armor, it can survive combined fire for quite some time. Slow, yes, but powerful.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 猎户座 K 是首款真正的重型机甲。作为多用途缠斗者，猎户座能在多种距离上交战，凭借充裕装甲，它能在集中火力下存活相当长时间。慢，是的，但强大。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Eager to test the brand new LB 2-X autocannon prototypes, the Orion ON1-K had its AC/10 replaced with two of the Clan Early LB-X. Using the fact that Clan Early missile launchers are considerably lighter, it was also possible to upgrade them to an Improved SRM-6 and an Improved LRM-20 - with two tons of ammunition each. Even then, enough capacity remained to add two more heat sinks. Quirk: Anti-Air Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 为急于测试全新的LB 2-X自动炮原型，猎户座ON1-K的AC/10被换成两门部族早期LB-X。利用部族早期导弹发射器重量大幅减轻这一点，它还得以把导弹升级为改进型SRM-6和改进型LRM-20——各配两吨弹药。即便这样，仍余下足够容量加装两个散热器。 特性：防空瞄准 投放费用倍率：1.09 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: When the Star League Defense Force left the Inner Sphere under Commanding General Aleksandr Kerensky during Operation Exodus, they brought with them many of the most common 'Mechs. As the SLDF-in-exile slowly started turning into the Clans, they started developing improved weapons, which they mounted on their existing armies of 'Mech. These weapons are commonly called Early Clan, and as such the Mech's using them got the -EC suffix added to their designation.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 当星盟防卫部队在统帅亚历山大·克伦斯基率领下执行出走行动、离开内天体时，他们带走了许多最常见的机甲。随着流亡的SLDF逐渐演变成氏族，他们开始研发改进型武器，并装到现有的机甲部队上。这些武器通常被称为"早期氏族"武器，因此使用它们的机甲在型号后缀加上了-EC。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This Orion was used by the commanding general Aleksandr Kerensky himself in the war against the Usurper. This mech carries an experimental snub nose PPC. Quirk: Anti-Air Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这台猎户座曾在对抗篡位者的战争中被指挥官亚历山大·克伦斯基亲自使用。该机甲装备一门实验性的短管粒子炮。 特性：防空瞄准 投放费用倍率：1.15 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This Orion was used by the commanding general Aleksandr Kerensky himself in the war against the Usurper. This mech carries an experimental snub nose PPC.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是指挥官亚历山大·克伦斯基本人在对抗篡位者战争中所用的猎户座。这台机甲装有一门实验型短鼻粒子炮。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This Orion was inspired by the original customized Orion used by the commanding general Aleksandr Kerensky in the war against the Usurper. It was further upgraded with advanced components such as Endo Composite structure and a Command Console cockpit. Quirk: Anti-Air Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这台猎户座灵感来自指挥官亚历山大·克伦斯基在对抗篡位者战争中所用的原始定制猎户座。它进一步升级了内骨架复合结构与指挥控制台座舱等先进部件。 特性：防空瞄准 投放费用倍率：1.15 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This Orion was inspired by the original customized Orion used by the commanding general Aleksandr Kerensky in the war against the Usurper. It was further upgraded with advanced components such as Endo Composite structure and a Command Console cockpit.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这台猎户座的灵感来自亚历山德尔·克伦斯基统帅在对篡位者战争中使用的原始定制猎户座。它进一步以先进组件升级，例如内层复合结构和指挥控制台式座舱。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A battlefield refit of the ON1-K, replacing the SRM-4 with a Small Laser. This leaves enough room to add an Artemis IV FCS for the LRM launcher, C.A.S.E. protection for the ammunition, as well as a C3 Slave computer. Quirk: Anti-Air Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是ON1-K的野战改装，以一具小型激光取代SRM-4。这样便腾出足够空间为LRM发射器加装阿尔忒弥斯IV火控系统、为弹药加装C.A.S.E.防护，以及一台C3从机计算机。 特性：防空瞄准 投放费用倍率：1.09 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Orion K was the first true heavy 'Mech. As a multirole brawler, the Orion can engage enemies at a variety of ranges, and with plenty of armor, it can survive combined fire for quite some time. Slow, yes, but powerful.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 猎户座 K 是首款真正的重型机甲。作为多用途缠斗者，猎户座能在多种距离上交战，凭借充裕装甲，它能在集中火力下存活相当长时间。慢，是的，但强大。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A minor variant of the ON1-M introduced in 3058. The designers removed both missile racks and Narc launcher to make room for two Medium Range Missile launchers. In place of the LRM-20 is an MRM-20, while a larger MRM-30 is crammed in the torso where the SRM-4 formerly sat. Enough room is left to add a head-mounted C3 Slave Unit. This variant was much-used by the Draconis Combine. Quirk: Anti-Air Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是3058年推出的ON1-M的小变型。设计者拆掉两组导弹挂架和Narc发射器，为两具中程导弹发射器腾出空间：LRM-20的位置换成MRM-20，而更大的MRM-30则塞进原来SRM-4所在的躯干。剩下的空间足以加装一台头部C3从机。此变型被龙脉联合体大量使用。 特性：防空瞄准 投放费用倍率：1.11 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Orion K was the first true heavy 'Mech. As a multirole brawler, the Orion can engage enemies at a variety of ranges, and with plenty of armor, it can survive combined fire for quite some time. Slow, yes, but powerful.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 猎户座 K 是首款真正的重型机甲。作为多用途缠斗者，猎户座能在多种距离上交战，凭借充裕装甲，它能在集中火力下存活相当长时间。慢，是的，但强大。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Introduced in 3053, this 1-M sub-variant trades one ton each of SRM and Narc ammunition plus one double heat sink for a Command Console. Quirk: Anti-Air Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 于 3053 年推出的这款 1-M 子改型，用一吨 SRM 弹药、一吨纳克弹药和一台双散热器换取了一座指挥控制台。 特性：防空瞄准 投放费用倍率：1.11 手臂驱动器限制：左下臂、右下臂

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Orion K was the first true heavy 'Mech. As a multirole brawler, the Orion can engage enemies at a variety of ranges, and with plenty of armor, it can survive combined fire for quite some time. Slow, yes, but powerful.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 猎户座 K 是首款真正的重型机甲。作为多用途缠斗者，猎户座能在多种距离上交战，凭借充裕装甲，它能在集中火力下存活相当长时间。慢，是的，但强大。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Based on General Kerensky's custom variant, the 'Protector' carries an almost identical weapons loadout. The most notable difference is its use of a standard PPC in the place of the still-lostech snub-nosed version, dropping the CASE and volume of ferro-fibrous armor carried to free up the weight for the heavier weapon. Quirk: Anti-Air Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.13 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: “保护者”以克伦斯基将军的定制变型为基础，武器配置几乎完全相同。最显著的差异是它用标准粒子炮取代了仍属失落科技的短鼻版本，并拆掉CASE和部分铁纤维装甲，以腾出重量容纳更重的武器。 特性：防空瞄准 投放费用倍率：1.13 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Based on General Kerensky's custom variant, the 'Protector' carries an almost identical weapons loadout. The most notable difference is its use of a standard PPC in the place of the still-lostech snub-nosed version, dropping the CASE and volume of ferro-fibrous armor carried to free up the weight for the heavier weapon.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: “保护者”以克伦斯基将军的定制变型为基础，武器配置几乎完全相同。最显著的差异是它用标准粒子炮取代了仍属失落科技的短鼻版本，并拆掉CASE和部分铁纤维装甲，以腾出重量容纳更重的武器。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Piloted by Aditi Whidbey, a MechWarrior who had been driven to madness by a cult known as the Will of Kali, she claimed that the Orion had fallen out of the sky and styled it 'Yad al-Jauza' or 'Hand of Orion'. The 'Yad al-Jauza' is built upon a XL engine. A large laser is mounted in each arm, with the right arm additionally mounting a LRM-10; two LRM-10s are mounted in the left torso, along with another large laser. Fifteen double heatsinks keep the 'Mech cold. Quirk: Anti-Air Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.13 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 驾驶者 Aditi Whidbey 是一名被名为“迦梨之意志”的邪教逼疯的机甲战士，她声称这具 Orion 是从天上坠落下来的，并将其命名为“Yad al-Jauza”，意为“猎户座之手”。“Yad al-Jauza”以一台 XL 引擎为基础建造。每只手臂各装有一具大型激光，右臂还额外搭载一具 LRM-10；左躯干装有两具 LRM-10，以及另一具大型激光。十五具双散热器让这具机甲保持低温。 特性：防空瞄准 投放费用倍率：1.13 手臂驱动器限制：左下臂、右下臂

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Orion K was the first true heavy 'Mech. As a multirole brawler, the Orion can engage enemies at a variety of ranges, and with plenty of armor, it can survive combined fire for quite some time. Slow, yes, but powerful.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 猎户座 K 是首款真正的重型机甲。作为多用途缠斗者，猎户座能在多种距离上交战，凭借充裕装甲，它能在集中火力下存活相当长时间。慢，是的，但强大。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The original SLDF model created in 2738, the Osprey OSP-15 mounted the same M-7 Gauss Rifle as the modern models, but had an LRM-10 Launcher backed up by three Medium Lasers in place of the MML and ER Medium Lasers. Quirk: Stable Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.07 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是2738年制造的原始SLDF型号，鱼鹰OSP-15装与现代型号相同的M-7高斯步枪，但以一门LRM-10发射器和三门中型激光取代了MML与增程中型激光。 特性：武器稳定 投放费用倍率：1.07 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The original SLDF model created in 2738, the Osprey OSP-15 mounted the same M-7 Gauss Rifle as the modern models, but had an LRM-10 Launcher backed up by three Medium Lasers in place of the MML and ER Medium Lasers.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 最初的SLDF型号造于2738年，鱼鹰OSP-15装的是与现代型号相同的M-7磁轨炮，但用一具LRM-10发射器配三门中型激光器，取代了MML和增程中型激光器。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: When Ostmann Industries first tried creating a heavier 'Mech than the Ostwar it resulted in the OstLord. It used much of the same components as the Ostwar but with size increased as needed. This 80 ton prototype assault 'Mech carried double LRM15 launchers, a Large Laser and two Medium Lasers and used a 320 rating fusion core. However, the design never went past prototype stage as it showed severe reliability problems during its trials and Ostmann Industries sold the few prototypes created on the second hand market before shutting the project down. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.12
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 当Ostmann工业公司首次尝试打造一款比Ostwar更重的机甲时，结果便是OstLord。它沿用了Ostwar的大部分部件，只是按需放大了尺寸。这台80吨的原型突击机甲装备两具LRM15发射器、一门大型激光和两门中型激光，并采用额定320的聚变核心。然而，该设计在试车中暴露出严重的可靠性问题，始终未能走出原型阶段；Ostmann工业公司将仅有的几台原型机转手到二手市场，随后终止了该项目。 特性：易于维护 投放费用倍率：1.12

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This is just an oversized Ostwar, Boss. And a damn bad job at one, I could assemble a better one myself!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这不过是一台加大号的奥斯特瓦，老大。而且是糟糕透顶的一台，我自己都能装出更好的！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Ostroc Mk II swaps the SRM-4 for one SRM-2 launcher in each side torso, with one ton of ammunition in the center torso. Half a ton of armor was added to the front torso and legs (adding one point to each leg and side torso, and four to center torso), and four more heat sinks were installed along with three jump jets for a jump capacity of 90 meters. To make room for these components, the engine had to be changed to a Pitban 240, reducing the top speed to 64.8 km/h. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 奥斯特罗克Mk II以两侧躯干各一具SRM-2发射器取代SRM-4，中央躯干带一吨弹药。前躯干与腿部增加半吨装甲（每条腿与每侧躯干各加一点，中央躯干加四点），并加装四个散热器和三具跳跃推进器，跳跃能力达90米。为给这些部件腾出空间，引擎不得不换成皮特班240，最高速度降到64.8公里/小时。 特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：1.06 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This 'Mech might as well be considered a new, different design from the old Ostroc. Just like the Grand Dragon evolved from the Dragon, the Mauler from the Daboku or the Hatamoto-Chi from the Charger.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这台机甲简直该被视作与旧奥斯罗克完全不同的新设计。就像巨龙从龙演化而来、猛击者从打木而来，或旗本千从冲锋者而来一样。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Piloted by Michi Noketsuna in the fighting on Misery against Wolf's Dragoons in 3028, this customized Ostroc had a top speed of 64 km/h. The reduced engine size allowed the Ostroc Michi to jump 120 meters and replace the SRM-4 with an SRM-6 launcher. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 3028年在米泽里星对抗狼之龙骑兵的战斗中，这台定制奥斯特罗克由米奇·诺克茨纳驾驶，最高时速可达64 km/h。引擎功率的缩减让米奇型奥斯特罗克能跳跃120米，并以一具SRM-6发射器取代了原来的SRM-4。 特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：1.08

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Piloted by Michi Noketsuna in the fighting on Misery against Wolf's Dragoons in 3028, this customized Ostroc had a top speed of 64 km/h. The reduced engine size allowed the Ostroc Michi to jump 120 meters and replace the SRM-4 with an SRM-6 launcher.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 由道口道纲在3028年米泽里对抗狼之龙骑兵的战斗中驾驶，这台定制奥斯特索最高速度64公里/小时。引擎缩小使奥斯特索道口得以跳跃120米，并以一具SRM-6发射器取代SRM-4。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A variant of the Ostroc OSR-2C adding a C3 slave unit and replacing the single heat sink with doubles. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是奥斯特罗克OSR-2C的变型，加装了1台C3从属单元，并将单散热器更换为双散热器。 <特性：狭小/低矮外形 <投放费用倍率：1.08

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A variant of the Ostroc OSR-2C adding a C3 slave unit for better lance performance.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是奥斯特罗克OSR-2C的变型，加装一台C3从机以提升小队表现。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The custom 'Mech of Major Kira Tang, the Ostroc OSR-2X, is a full rebuild of the original mech. Sporting 4 Medium Pulse Lasers, 2 Small Lasers, a NARC and a supercharged 360 XL fusion engine, this 'Mech is in fact a lot deadlier than it seems at first glance. Using Endo-Steel structure and Ferro-Fibrous armor still leaves room for a MASC and both a Beagle Active Probe and a Guardian ECM Suite. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 奥斯特罗克OSR-2X是基拉·唐少校的专属机甲，是对原版机体的彻底重建。它配备4门中型脉冲激光、2门小型激光、一具NARC以及一台增压的360 XL聚变引擎，实际上比乍看之下要致命得多。采用内骨架结构与铁纤维装甲之后，仍有空间容纳MASC、一套小猎犬主动探测器以及一套守护者电子对抗套件。 特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：1.08 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: To say that Ostroc OSR-2X is a custom machine would be something of an understatement. Taking the 'Mech’s pilot, Command Sergeant Major Kira Tang's orders to \"make a 'Mech that people would remember\" to the limit, the technicians and researchers truly pushed the envelope of 'Mech capabilities.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 说奥斯罗克OSR-2X是一台定制机，都算是相当保守的说法。技师与研究员们把该机甲飞行员、军士长基拉·唐"造一台让人铭记的机甲"的命令执行到了极限，真正把机甲性能的边界推到了极致。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Ostscout was designed as a pure recon BattleMech by Ostmann Industries. To that end, it was built entirely around gathering data and getting out of trouble, tasks for which it is exceptional; the Ostscout is quick enough to escape most traps, and very few other designs can match it in terms of speed and maneuverability. The 7R is a variant of the OTT-7J that replaces two of the Jump Jets with a C3 slave unit and some extra armor. Quirk: Improved Sensors Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Ostscout是Ostmann工业公司设计的纯侦察战斗机甲。为此，它的全部设计都围绕收集情报与摆脱困境展开，而它在这两项任务上表现卓越；Ostscout的速度足以逃脱大多数陷阱，在速度与机动性方面很少有其他设计能与之匹敌。7R是OTT-7J的变型，用一台C3从属单元和额外的装甲替换了两台跳跃推进器。 特性：改进传感器 投放费用倍率：0.98

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This 'Mech is quick as hell, but the Ostscout would be hard-pressed to win a fight against all but the lightest of opposition.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这台机甲快得要命，但东探除了对付最轻的对手，很难赢下任何战斗。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Ostsol OTL-4DR was an attempt by Ostmann Industries to create a version of the 'Mech that could be built faster and handled hot environments better. Replacing all weapons with a pair of ER PPCs, switching to Double Heat Sinks and adding a C3 Slave unit did not meet the goals and the variant was never built in any larger volumes. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Ostsol OTL-4DR是Ostmann Industries的一次尝试，意在打造一台能更快建造、也更能适应高温环境的机甲版本。它的做法是以两门增程粒子炮替换全部武器、改用双散热器并加装一个C3从属单元，但这些并未达到既定目标，该改型也从未进行过任何大规模生产。 特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：1.08 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Why would they do this...? It makes no sense, this one's practically useless with just the PPCs. At least it can be used for spare parts, I suppose.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 他们为什么要这么做……？完全说不通，这台只有粒子炮的话几乎没用。至少还能当备件用，我想。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A refresh of the Ostwar OWR-2M, the OWR-2MX replaces the LRM and Medium Lasers with an upgrade to double SRM6 launchers and 3 Extended Range Large Lasers. Using an XL engine and Endo Steel structure allows the switch to Double Heat Sinks for better cooling performance as well as an upgrade to a 325-rated fusion core. One large oddity is the fact the SRM6 launchers are in the legs, leading a strange angle of launching that can surprise enemy Mech Warriors. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是对奥斯特瓦ORW-2M的翻新，OWR-2MX以双联SRM6发射器和3门增程大型激光取代LRM和中型激光。采用XL引擎与内骨架结构后，它得以换装双散热器以改善冷却，并升级为325额定聚变核心。特别古怪的一点是SRM6发射器装在腿部，形成奇特的发射角度，足以让敌方机甲战士措手不及。 特性：易于维护 投放费用倍率：1.09 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A refresh of the Ostwar OWR-2M, the OWR-2MX replaces the LRM and Medium Lasers with an upgrade to double SRM6 launchers and 3 Extended Range Large Lasers. Using an XL engine and Endo Steel structure allows the switch to Double Heat Sinks for better cooling performance as well as an upgrade to a 325-rated fusion core. One large oddity is the fact the SRM6 launchers are in the legs, leading a strange angle of launching that can surprise enemy Mech Warriors.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为奥斯特瓦OWR-2M的更新版，OWR-2MX把LRM和中型激光器换成升级后的双SRM6发射器与3门增程大型激光器。采用XL引擎和内层钢结构使其得以改用双重散热器以获得更好的散热性能，并将聚变核心升级到325级。一个很大的怪处在于SRM6发射器装在腿部，导致一种奇怪的发射角度，能打敌方机师一个措手不及。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Jenner Hero 'Mech, the Oxide mounts an SRM-4 in each arm supported by a pair of LRM-5s in the center torso. Fitted with ten double heat sinks and carrying a ton of reloads for each missile launcher, such a heavy weapons loadout is made possible through the use of Endo Steel chassis, a downgrade to a 235-rated engine and the removal of Jenner's signature jump jets. Quirk: Improved Lifesupport Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.02 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 詹纳（Jenner）英雄机甲“氧化物”（Oxide）在每条手臂各装有一具 SRM-4，并由中央躯干的两具 LRM-5 提供支援。它装有十台双散热器，并为每具导弹发射器各配备一吨备用弹药；如此沉重的武器配置之所以能够实现，靠的是内骨架底盘的使用、引擎降级为额定 235 型号，以及拆除詹纳标志性的跳跃推进器。 特性：改进生命维持系统 投放费用倍率：1.02 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Jenner Hero 'Mech, the Oxide mounts an SRM-4 in each arm supported by a pair of LRM-5s in the center torso. Fitted with ten double heat sinks and carrying a ton of reloads for each missile launcher, such a heavy weapons loadout is made possible through the use of Endo Steel chassis, a downgrade to a 235-rated engine and the removal of Jenner's signature jump jets.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为詹纳英雄机甲，氧化在双臂各装一具SRM-4，并有两具LRM-5置于中央躯干支援。它装有十具双重散热器，每个导弹发射器各带一吨备用弹；如此沉重的武器配置之所以可行，得益于内层钢底盘、降级为235级引擎以及拆除詹纳标志性的跳跃推进器。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Pack Hunter is the first new design produced by Clan Wolf-in-Exile on Arc-Royal. It also represents a new partnership between Phelan's Wolves and the Kell Hounds, as the armor and communications gear are Kell Hound products, traded to the Wolves in exchange for Endo Steel. Reflecting their Khan's bias towards light, fast designs, Wolf scientists designed the Pack Hunter to be fast and have a sharp bite. Though its four tons of armor are light, the BattleMech is supposed to use its speed and maneuverability to stay out of trouble. Quirk: Reinforced Legs Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 集群猎手是狼族流亡者在弧王家研制出的首款新设计。它也代表着费伦之狼与凯尔猎犬的新伙伴关系：装甲与通讯设备是凯尔猎犬的产品，用来与狼族交换内骨架。出于其可汗对轻型、快速设计的偏好，狼族科学家把集群猎手设计得又快又利。虽然四吨装甲偏薄，但该战斗机甲本应靠速度与机动性避开麻烦。 特性：加固腿部 投放费用倍率：1.05

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Pack Hunter is the first new design produced by Clan Wolf-in-Exile on Arc-Royal. It also represents a new partnership between Phelan's Wolves and the Kell Hounds, as the armor and communications gear are Kell Hound products, traded to the Wolves in exchange for Endo Steel. Reflecting their Khan's bias towards light, fast designs, Wolf scientists designed the Pack Hunter to be fast and have a sharp bite. Though its four tons of armor are light, the BattleMech is supposed to use its speed and maneuverability to stay out of trouble.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 猎群者是流亡狼氏族在弧-皇家星生产的第一款新设计。它也代表费兰的狼群与凯尔猎犬之间的新合作——装甲与通讯设备均为凯尔猎犬的产品，用来向狼群换取内骨骼。狼族科学家遵循其可汗对轻型快速设计的偏爱，把猎群者设计得又快又利齿。尽管四吨装甲偏薄，这台战斗机甲本应依靠速度与机动性避免陷入麻烦。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The original Paladin features seven Machine Guns and a single Large Pulse Laser providing long range firepower, and the Machine Guns are backed up by an Artemis IV-equipped SRM-6 and a pair of Streak SRM-2 missile launchers. It features a standard engine, standard ferro-fibrous armor and an Endo Steel chassis. Quirk: Protected Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08 Arm Actuator Limits: Right Lower, Left Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 初代 Paladin 拥有七挺机枪，以及一门提供远程火力的大型脉冲激光；机枪的后盾则是一部配备阿尔忒弥斯 IV 的 SRM-6 和两具连发 SRM-2 导弹发射器。它采用标准引擎、标准铁纤维装甲和内骨架底盘。 特性：受保护驱动器 投放费用倍率：1.08 手臂驱动器限制：右下、左上

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A Solaris VII BattleMech, the Paladin was created by Innovative Design Concepts as their entry into the heavy 'Mech weight class. Equipped with an XXL fusion engine, the modern Paladin can move through the battlefield quickly and keep enemy forces in the ideal range band.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为一台索拉里斯VII战斗机甲，圣骑士由创新设计理念公司打造，是他们进军重型机甲重量级的作品。它装备XXL聚变引擎，现代化的圣骑士能快速穿行战场，并让敌军停留在理想的距离区间内。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An early draft for an upgraded Panther by the Draconis Combine. Only a few units were ever produced and ended up in the hands of various mercenary units despite its too high maintenance cost for House Kurita. Utilizing an XL engine and Endo Steel allows mounting three Streak SRM-2 launchers, one ER PPC, one medium laser and 5 Jump Jets. The cooling is handled by double heat sinks and a C3 slave unit is installed for better battlefield awareness. Quirk: Aerial Assault Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是龙脉联合体为升级版Panther绘制的早期草案。由于对栗田家族而言维护成本过高，最终只生产了少数几台，并流落到多支雇佣兵部队手中。借助XL引擎与内骨架，它得以安装三具连发SRM-2发射器、一门增程粒子炮、一门中型激光和5台跳跃推进器。散热由双散热器负责，并安装了C3从属单元以提升战场态势感知。 特性：空降突击 投放费用倍率：0.98

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Sure, it has some good weapons, but the cooling is just not sufficient for all those weapons and 5 jump jets. Good heat management is a must for any MechWarrior piloting this one.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 当然，它有一些好武器，但散热对那些武器和5个跳跃推进器来说根本不够。良好的热量管理对驾驶这台机甲的机师来说必不可少。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Custom variant used by the mercenary unit 'Kell Hounds', one of the most renowned in the Inner Sphere. Most of the standard equipment has been replaced by Clan tech, resulting in a considerably better performing light 'Mech. Quirk: Aerial Assault Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是雇佣兵部队“凯尔猎犬”——内层星域最负盛名的部队之一——所使用的定制变型。大部分标准装备都被部族技术取代，使这台轻型机甲的性能显著提升。 特性：空中突击 投放费用倍率：1.04

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A Stream SRM-6 and an ER PPC is not really a bad weaponry for such a small 'Mech, but it doesn't suddenly make it good.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一具连发SRM-6和一门增程PPC对这么小的机甲来说不算糟糕的武器，但这并不会让它突然变好。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An early attempted design of the Panther by Draconis Combine, using a SRM-4 launcher and a Large Laser. Was never produced in large quantities. Quirk: Aerial Assault Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是龙脉联合体早期对黑豹的尝试设计，使用一具SRM-4发射器和一门大型激光，从未大量生产。 特性：空中突击 投放费用倍率：0.98

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Pretty much close to the same thing as a Panther PNT-9R if you compare the actual performance.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 如果比较实际性能，它和黑豹PNT-9R几乎差不多。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The personal 'Mech of Hohiro 'T-Bone' Tanaka, a Solaris Arena Pilot and member of the 'Mavericks'. His Panther has been modified for use in the close confines of the dueling arena. The PPC was removed from the right arm, and a large laser, medium laser, and one heat sink were installed. Quirk: Aerial Assault Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.02
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是 Solaris 竞技场飞行员、'Mavericks' 成员 Hohiro 'T-Bone' Tanaka 的专属机甲。他的 Panther 经过改装，以适应决斗竞技场狭窄的场地。右臂的粒子炮被拆除，改为安装一门大型激光、一门中型激光和一具散热器。 特性：空中突击 投放费用倍率：1.02

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Tanaka apparently had success with this custom refit in the Solaris Arena as a close-range Skirmisher. He and his other teammate, Jason 'Equalizer' Yasbek were considered a favored 'Unlimited Class' team in the dueling arenas of Solaris City.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 田中显然在索拉里斯竞技场靠这套定制改装作为近距游击手取得了成功。他和他另一位队友、"平衡器"杰森·亚斯贝克，在索拉里斯城的决斗竞技场中被视为"无限制级"的夺冠热门队伍。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The -9RR is a refit of the -9R that by switching to double Heat Sinks allow the addition of a medium and a small laser, while still improving the cooling. Quirk: Aerial Assault Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: -9RR是-9R的改装型，通过换装双散热器，得以加装一门中型激光和一门小型激光，同时散热能力反而有所改善。 特性：空降突击 投放费用倍率：0.98

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: So it is a slightly better -9R. Nothing to write home to grandma about, still a weak 'Mech I'd say.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 所以它是一台略好的-9R。没什么值得写信告诉奶奶的，我还是会说它是台弱机甲。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Penetrator PTR-4D has an all energy weapons arsenal and uses twelve double heat sinks to handle the massive heat load from its weapons. The 'Mech uses a Vlar 300 fusion engine for its combat durability, giving the 'Mech a top speed of 64.8 km/h. To help offset the 'Mech's lack of mobility, the Penetrator has four Anderson 398 jump jets giving it added mobility with a jumping distance of one hundred and twenty meters. The Penetrator also carries a respectable thirteen tons of armor. The 'Mech's heavy armor protection, combined with its standard engine and limited amounts of ammunition, make for a 'Mech that is very rugged and hard to kill. The primary weapons are a pair of arm mounted Diverse Optics Sunbeam ER Large Lasers for long range firepower. For close range combat, the 'Mech carries six Sutel Precision Line Medium Pulse Lasers which are mounted in its right and left torsos. Finally, the 'Mech carries its only ammunition based weapon, a Yori Flyswatter Anti-Missile System, for added defense against missile attacks. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 穿透者PTR-4D采用全能量武器，并使用十二个双散热器处理武器带来的巨大热负荷。该机甲采用弗拉尔300聚变引擎以保证战斗耐久性，最高速度64.8公里/小时。为弥补机动性不足，穿透者装四具安德森398跳跃推进器，跳跃距离一百二十米。它还带可观的十三吨装甲。厚重的装甲防护、标准引擎与有限的弹药量，使该机甲极为坚固、难以击杀。主要武器是装在双臂的一对Diverse Optics日束增程大型激光，负责远程火力；近战中，它带六门苏特尔精密线中型脉冲激光，装在左右躯干。最后，该机甲唯一的弹药类武器是一套尤里苍蝇拍反导弹系统，用于加强对导弹攻击的防御。 特性：稳定 投放费用倍率：1.11 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This is the base model of the Penetrator, Boss. It is not a bad mech for its purpose and when it was designed, but it lacks anything special to make it stand out over newer designs. The all Laser load out can be both a strength and a weakness depending on the opposing forces composition and the biome the battle is in. Over all, not a 'Mech I'd keep around in the long run but might have its uses short-term.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是穿透者的基础型号，老大。就其用途和设计年代而言它不算坏机甲，但它缺乏任何能让它在更新设计面前脱颖而出的特别之处。全激光载荷既可以是优势也可以是弱点，取决于对手部队构成和战斗所在的生物群系。总的来说，不是我会长期保留的机甲，但短期内也许有它的用处。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Penetrator became the trademark 'Mech of AFFC officer Archer Christifori, who piloted one through the FedCom Civil War and Operation BULLDOG. Originally a stock example, Christifori's 'Mech was eventually upgraded with salvaged Clan-tech ER Large Lasers. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.13 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 穿透者成为AFFC军官阿彻·克里斯蒂福里的标志性机甲，他在联邦共和国内战与“斗牛犬行动”期间一直驾驶这台机甲。它原本是标准型号，后来克里斯蒂福里的机甲用回收来的部族技术增程大型激光进行了升级。 特性：稳定 投放费用倍率：1.13 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A typical field upgrade with capture tech, it improves the mech slightly but that is about it. Nothing special here.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是一次典型的带缴获技术的野战升级，它略微提升了机甲，差不多就这样。没什么特别的。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Intended to act as a fire support 'Mech, The PTR-4F Penetrator sacrifices two of its Medium Pulse Lasers and the ER Large Lasers, freeing enough tonnage to add two LRM-10 missile launchers. The LRM-10s were then mated to Artemis IV fire control systems for added accuracy. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: PTR-4F Penetrator 旨在充当火力支援机甲，它牺牲了两门中型脉冲激光和增程大型激光，腾出足够的吨位加装两具 LRM-10 导弹发射器。这两具 LRM-10 随后配上了 Artemis IV 火控系统以提高精度。 特性：稳定 投放费用倍率：1.11 手臂驱动器限制：左下臂、右下臂

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A base Penetrator with two LRM launchers instead of some lasers. That doesn't change the fact the 'Mech itself isn't very interesting, but at least it can act as a longe range support to better ones.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是基础型穿透者，以两具LRM发射器取代部分激光。这并不能改变该机甲本身并不有趣的事实，但至少它能作为更优秀机甲的远程支援。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: In an attempt to make the -4F more durable, the -4FX variant was a field modification of the Penetrator. Replacing the 4 Medium Pulse Lasers with 6 Medium Lasers allowed the addition of CASE in both side torsos, which after moving the Anti-Missile System ammunition from Center Torso to the Left Torso ensured any ammo explosion should not be able to penetrate the Center Torso. The 0.5 ton weight capacity still remaining was used to improve the armor of the legs and side torsos. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 为了让-4F更加耐用，-4FX变型是对Penetrator的一次野战改装。用6门中型激光替换4门中型脉冲激光，从而能够在两个侧躯干加装CASE；而在将反导弹系统弹药从中央躯干移至左躯干之后，任何弹药爆炸都无法再穿透中央躯干。剩余的0.5吨载重则用于加强腿部和侧躯干的装甲。 特性：稳定 投放费用倍率：1.11 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: No amount of changes will prevent some hothead pilot getting too close to the fray in this support 'Mech, but I guess at least they might survive long enough to shot another salvo.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 再多的改动也无法阻止某个热血飞行员把这台支援机甲开得太靠近战团，不过我猜至少他们可能活得够久，能再打一轮齐射。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 6M is a variant of the Penetrator that looks to alleviate the 'Mech's heat build up by removing two of the Medium Pulse Lasers and replacing them with five additional double heat sinks. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 6M是穿透者的变型，试图通过拆掉两门中型脉冲激光并换成五个额外双散热器来缓解机甲的热量积累。 特性：稳定 投放费用倍率：1.11 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A needed improvement to the cooling of the Penetrator, but the trade-off of less firepower makes the mech considerable worse as a frontline brawler.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是穿透者散热的一次必要改进，但火力的减少使其作为前线近战者明显变差。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A simple modification of the Penetrator, the 6S model removes one and a half tons of armor. This frees enough weight to add a Guardian ECM Suite to the 'Mech, protecting the 'Mech from foes' advanced electronics. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 6S 型号是对 Penetrator 的简单改动，拆除了一吨半装甲。这腾出了足够的重量为该机甲加装一具守卫者电子对抗套件，使其免受敌方先进电子设备的威胁。 特性：稳定 投放费用倍率：1.11 手臂驱动器限制：左下臂、右下臂

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Not sure this was a wise move, Boss. All it takes is one ECCM and that ECM is useless and suddenly the removed 1.5 ton of armor will be very missed.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我不确定这是个明智的举动，老大。只要来一个ECCM，那套ECM就废了，而那时被拆掉的那1.5吨装甲就会让人非常怀念。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Perseus is the product of a program begun by the League Central Coordination and Command to create an OmniMech completely indigenous to the Free Worlds League from concept to production. The Perseus shares much with the venerable Orion, a staple of Free Worlds League Military, both broadly resembling the older design visually and using a number of the same components. This similarity prompted more than a few FWLM technicians to nickname the new design the Omni-Orion and the deployment of Perseus has largely been to front-line units that fielded large concentrations of its progenitor, replacing older Orions on a one-for-one basis. Built on a lightweight Endo Steel chassis, the Perseus is powered by a Hermes 300 XL engine helping save even more weight and giving the 'Mech a top speed of 64.8 km/h. The advanced structure and engine save a great deal of weight for weapons and equipment. The Perseus is protected by fourteen tons of Valiant Lamellor armor, giving it around average armor protection for a 'Mech of its size. It also has twelve double heat sinks that are fixed on the chassis. Quirk: Anti-Air Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 英仙座是联盟中央协调与指挥部发起的一项计划的产物，旨在从概念到生产打造一款完全属于自由世界联盟的全能机甲。英仙座与备受尊崇的猎户座共享诸多特征——后者是自由世界联盟军队的中坚，两者在外观上大体相似，并使用若干相同部件。这种相似性让不少 FWLM 技师把新设计戏称为"全能猎户座"；英仙座的部署主要给那些大量装备其前身的一线部队，一对一替换较老的猎户座。英仙座基于轻量化内骨骼底盘建造，由一台赫尔墨斯 300 XL 引擎驱动，进一步节省重量，最高速度 64.8 公里/小时。先进的底盘与引擎为武器和装备省下大量重量。英仙座由十四吨"勇武拉梅洛"装甲保护，防护约处于同尺寸机甲的平均水平。它还固定装有十二台双倍散热器。 特质：防空瞄准 投放费用倍率：1.06 臂部驱动器限制：全能

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The primary configuration of the Perseus shares a great deal with the Orion. For long range direct and indirect fire support, the Perseus carries an LRM-20 with Artemis IV for increased missile accuracy. For long range direct fire, the Perseus carries a powerful Ultra Autocannon/10 that is capable of firing at twice the rate as a standard autocannon. The Perseus has a devastating short range arsenal with a highly accurate Medium Pulse Laser, four ER Medium Lasers , an ER Small Laser, and finally an SRM-4 launcher that is linked to an Artemis IV FCS. The primary configuration mounts two tons each of both Ultra Autocannon and LRM munitions as well as single ton of SRM reloads in CASE protected ammunition bays in both its side torsos.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 英仙座主配置与猎户座有诸多共通之处。远程直接与间接火力支援方面，英仙座携带一具带 Artemis IV 以提升导弹精度的 LRM-20。远程直射火力方面，英仙座携带一门强力超速自动炮/10，射速可达标准自动炮的两倍。英仙座拥有毁灭性的近程武器库：一门极为精准的中型脉冲激光、四门 ER 中型激光、一门 ER 小型激光，最后一具联接 Artemis IV 火控系统的 SRM-4 发射器。主配置在两侧躯干受 C.A.S.E. 保护的弹药舱中各携带两吨超速自动炮弹药和两吨 LRM 弹药，以及一吨 SRM 再装填。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Configured for long range fire support, the A configuration carries a pair of LRM-20 launchers in its arm, both of which are linked to an Artemis IV FCS for increased accuracy. For close range defense, the 'Mech carries two Medium Pulse Lasers and has an SRM-6 launcher linked to an Artemis IV FCS. The 'Mech also has a leg-mounted TAG laser designator, allowing it to call in Semi-Guided LRM and Arrow IV attacks from friendly units and has an ECM Suite to defend itself from enemy electronic warfare systems.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: A 配置为远程火力支援而设，臂部装一对 LRM-20 发射器，均联接 Artemis IV 火控系统以提升精度。近程防御方面，机甲携带两门中型脉冲激光和一具联接 Artemis IV 火控系统的 SRM-6 发射器。机甲还有一具装在腿部的 TAG 激光指示器，使其能召唤友军单位的半制导 LRM 和箭矢 IV 攻击，并有一套 ECM 套件防御敌方电子战系统。

The Perseus B is also capable of handling close combat with two Large Pulse Lasers and has an Anti-Missile System to protect itself from missile attacks.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: B 配置能在近程与远程作战：远程有一门高斯步枪和一门 ER 大型激光，不过仅一吨再装填使高斯更宜作次要而非主要武器。英仙座 B 也能以两门大型脉冲激光应对近战，并有一套反导系统防御导弹攻击。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An all around configuration, the C is built to be capable of engaging an enemy at both long and short ranges. To do this, the Perseus C carries a Light Gauss Rifle, giving the 'Mech an extremely long reach. This is backed up by an Ultra Autocannon/10 capable of engaging the enemy as they close. For close combat, the Perseus C has three ER Medium Lasers, a Medium Pulse Laser, and a Streak SRM-2 launcher. Two tons of gauss reloads, three tons of Ultra autocannon ammunition and a ton of missile reloads give the design adequate field endurance.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: C 配置是全方位配置，能在远程与近程交战。为此，英仙座 C 携带一门轻型高斯步枪，赋予机甲极远的射程。它由一门能在敌人接近时交战的超速自动炮/10 支援。近战方面，英仙座 C 有三门 ER 中型激光、一门中型脉冲激光和一具连续 SRM-2 发射器。两吨高斯再装填、三吨超速自动炮弹药和一吨导弹再装填为设计提供足够的战场续航力。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 英仙座是联盟中央协调与指挥部发起的一项计划的产物，旨在从概念到生产打造一款完全属于自由世界联盟的全能机甲。英仙座与备受尊崇的猎户座共享诸多特征——后者是自由世界联盟军队的中坚，两者在外观上大体相似，并使用若干相同部件。这种相似性让不少 FWLM 技师把新设计戏称为"全能猎户座"；英仙座的部署主要给那些大量装备其前身的一线部队，一对一替换较老的猎户座。英仙座基于轻量化内骨骼底盘建造，由一台赫尔墨斯 300 XL 引擎驱动，进一步节省重量，最高速度 64.8 公里/小时。先进的底盘与引擎为武器和装备省下大量重量。英仙座由十四吨"勇武拉梅洛"装甲保护，防护约处于同尺寸机甲的平均水平。它还固定装有十二台双倍散热器。 特质：防空瞄准 投放费用倍率：1.06 臂部驱动器限制：全能

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Configured specifically for close combat, the D configuration has an LRM-20 launcher with an Artemis IV FCS for increased accuracy as well as an LB-X Autocannon/10 for long range combat. For close ranges, the 'Mech has an SRM-6 launcher linked to an Artemis IV FCS, three ER Medium Lasers, and a ER Small Laser. The D also has an ECM suite to protect itself from enemy electronic warfare systems and a Beagle Active Probe that allows it to find hidden units in close combat situation.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Debuting by Clan Wolf in 3052, the Phantom is a 40 ton Clan Omnimech designed as scout and light mech hunter. A combination of an Endo Steel chassis and a 360-rated XL Engine allow the Phantom to achieve speeds of 151 km/h and maintain 6.5 tons of pod space. The Phantom A carries 5 ER Small Lasers, alongside an ER Medium Laser and a pair of LRM-5’s. Quirk: Improved Sensors Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A first generation BattleMech, the 50 ton Phoenix was the first native BattleMech to be built by the Rim Worlds Republic. Built with primitive components and powered by a 240-rated Fusion Core, the Phoenix 1R carried a PPC and a pair of SRM-2’s. 3 Jump Jets gave the Phoenix limited jump capability, at the cost of the original SRM-4s being downgraded. Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Phoenix Hawk LAM was the largest Land-Air 'Mech produced during the Star League. Allied Aerospace reworked their designs for conversion equipment and the size of the LAM, learning from their mistake with the Shadow Hawk LAM and the success of the Stinger LAM. The resulting LAM was the largest LAM ever constructed capable of remaining in AirMech mode. Unfortunately, large Land-Air 'Mech conversion technology was not fully researched before the fall of the Star League, and the Phoenix Hawk LAM frequently met its end due to the occasional glitch. The end of the Star League and destruction of the Allied Aerospace facilities at the beginning of the First Succession War prevented further development and refinement. Quirk: Land Air Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Phoenix Hawk LAM 是星际联盟时期生产的最大型陆空机甲。Allied Aerospace 借鉴了 Shadow Hawk LAM 的失败教训与 Stinger LAM 的成功经验，重新设计了变形设备以及 LAM 的尺寸。由此诞生的 LAM 是有史以来建造的、能够在空中机甲形态下维持飞行的最大型陆空机甲。遗憾的是，大型陆空机甲的变形技术在星际联盟覆灭前尚未被充分研究，Phoenix Hawk LAM 常常因偶发的故障而折戟。星际联盟的终结，以及第一次继承战争初期 Allied Aerospace 设施的毁灭，使进一步的研发与改进无从进行。 特性：陆空机甲 投放费用倍率：1.04

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Phoenix Hawk LAM was the largest Land-Air 'Mech produced during the Star League. Allied Aerospace reworked their designs for conversion equipment and the size of the LAM, learning from their mistake with the Shadow Hawk LAM and the success of the Stinger LAM. The resulting LAM was the largest LAM ever constructed capable of remaining in AirMech mode. Unfortunately, large Land-Air 'Mech conversion technology was not fully researched before the fall of the Star League, and the Phoenix Hawk LAM frequently met its end due to the occasional glitch. The end of the Star League and destruction of the Allied Aerospace facilities at the beginning of the First Succession War prevented further development and refinement.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 凤凰鹰 LAM 是星盟时期生产的最大陆空机甲。联合航空重做了其变身设备与 LAM 尺寸的设计，吸取了影鹰 LAM 的教训与毒刺 LAM 的成功经验。成品是有史以来最大的、能在机甲空中模式维持飞行的 LAM。遗憾的是，大型陆空机甲变身技术在星盟覆灭前未获充分研究，凤凰鹰 LAM 常因偶发故障而殒命。星盟的终结与第一次继承战争初期联合航空设施的毁灭，阻断了进一步的开发与改良。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: House Marik produced a variant of the Phoenix Hawk LAM which replaces the Large Laser and Machine Guns with a Holly LRM-10. Quirk: Land Air Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 马里克家族生产了一款凤凰鹰LAM变型，以一门霍利LRM-10取代大型激光和机枪。 特性：陆空机甲 投放费用倍率：1.04

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: House Marik produced a variant of the Phoenix Hawk LAM which replaces the Large Laser and Machine Guns with a Holly LRM-10.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 马里克家族生产了一款凤凰鹰 LAM 变体，将大型激光和机枪换成冬青 LRM-10。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The original Pillager, designed in 2575 and fielded for the first two decades of the Reunification War, uses a standard fusion engine instead of the extralight model that later went into production. Other limitations include a 60 meter jump range and 17 tons of armor. The weapons suite was also different, relying on twin torso mounted Autocannon/20s, a single SRM-4, and three medium lasers; one mounted in each arm and a head-mounted laser firing to the rear. Sixteen single heat sinks kept the heat under control. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 最初的Pillager设计于2575年，在统一战争的头二十年里投入使用，它采用标准聚变引擎，而非后来投产的超轻型型号。其他限制还包括60米的跳跃距离与17吨装甲。武器配置也有所不同，主要依靠躯干上的一对自动炮/20、一具SRM-4以及三门中型激光；其中每只手臂各装一门，另有一门装在头部朝后射击。十六具单散热器把热量控制在范围内。 特性：战拳 投放费用倍率：1.18

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The largest BattleMech ever built by HildCo Interplanetary, the Pillager is built as a larger version of the Victor, and is intended for assaulting urban centers and hardened fortifications. These design parameters were paramount as the SLDF mobilized to wage the Reunification War. Later Pillagers were upgraded with more cutting-edge Star League technology. Production of the Pillager halted not because its facility was destroyed, but the advanced Gauss rifle and XL engine production lines had been obliterated by the end of the Second Succession War. Curiously, HildCo did not restart production of the original PLG-1N, rather the Pillager lines only began production again in 3058 when advanced components were once again available for the PLG-3Z.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 劫掠者是HildCo星际行星公司建造过的最大战斗机甲，作为维克托的放大版本打造，用于攻打城市中心与坚固工事。在SLDF动员发动统一战争时，这些设计指标被置于首位。后来的劫掠者以更尖端的星际联盟技术进行了升级。劫掠者停产并非因为工厂被毁，而是到第二次继承战争结束时，先进的高斯步枪与XL引擎生产线已被彻底摧毁。耐人寻味的是，HildCo并未重新生产最初的PLG-1N，而是直到3058年先进部件再次可供PLG-3Z使用时，劫掠者的生产线才重新开工。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The PLG-3Z Pillager is built using a 300 XL engine, which weighs half as much as a standard fusion engine and gives the Pillager a top speed of 54 km/h. The small mass of the engine allows the 'Mech to mount an obscene array of weapons. The 'Mech's mobility is enhanced with three jump jets that allow it to jump up to ninety meters. The Pillager has excellent armor protection at nineteen and a half tons and has fourteen double heat sinks that provide more than enough heat dissipation capability for the Pillager's needs. The primary weapons on the Pillager are a pair of Gauss rifles, which allows the 'Mech' to engage an enemy at very long ranges. The Gauss rifles were supported at intermediate to close range by a Large laser and four Medium lasers. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: PLG-3Z Pillager采用一具300 XL引擎建造，其重量只有标准聚变引擎的一半，使Pillager的最高时速达到54 km/h。引擎体积小巧，让这台机甲得以装载一套夸张的武器阵列。机甲的机动性由三具跳跃推进器增强，最远可跳跃九十米。Pillager拥有十九吨半的出色装甲防护，并配备十四具双散热器，散热能力远超其所需。Pillager的主要武器是两具高斯步枪，使这台机甲能够在极远距离上与敌人交战。在中近距离，高斯步枪则由一门大型激光与四门中型激光提供支援。 特性：战拳 投放费用倍率：1.18

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The largest BattleMech ever built by HildCo Interplanetary, the Pillager is built as a larger version of the Victor, and is intended for assaulting urban centers and hardened fortifications. These design parameters were paramount as the SLDF mobilized to wage the Reunification War. Later Pillagers were upgraded with more cutting-edge Star League technology. Production of the Pillager halted not because its facility was destroyed, but the advanced Gauss rifle and XL engine production lines had been obliterated by the end of the Second Succession War. Curiously, HildCo did not restart production of the original PLG-1N, rather the Pillager lines only began production again in 3058 when advanced components were once again available for the PLG-3Z.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An early clan Mech dating from the days of Operation Klondike, the Pillager PLG-3Z-EC was an upgrade of the PLG-3Z that replaced the weapons with Early Clan variants. It would be discontinued and forgotten as modern clan spec weapons entered production. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 掠夺者PLG-3Z-EC是一款可追溯到克朗代克行动时期的部族早期机甲，是对PLG-3Z的升级，以部族早期型号替换了武器。随着现代部族规格武器投产，它被停产并逐渐被遗忘。 特性：战拳 投放费用倍率：1.18

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An early clan Mech dating from the days of Operation Klondike, the Pillager PLG-3Z-EC was an upgrade of the PLG-3Z that replaced the weapons with Early Clan variants. It would be discontinued and forgotten as modern clan spec weapons entered production.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为可追溯到克朗代克行动时期的一种早期氏族机甲，掠夺者PLG-3Z-EC是PLG-3Z的升级版，把武器换成了早期氏族变体。随着现代氏族规格武器投产，它被停产并逐渐被遗忘。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Piranha's main threat is its twelve Series XII Rotary Machine Guns. These are a serious threat to any foe on such a speedy 'Mech, especially if a Star of Piranhas operate in a pack, and such a large array allows the 'Mech to chew through an opponent's rear armor almost instantly. They are most deadly, however, to unarmored infantry, capable of wiping out an entire company in seconds. For work against hardened targets, the Piranha mounts a pair of Mk. 3 ER Medium Lasers and a single Series 1 ER Small Laser. Since the design only uses ten single heat sinks, the MechWarrior must still manage heat levels. The ammunition dependency of the Machine Guns ensure that Piranhas must stay close to supply lines, so most have been relegated to solahma or garrison roles. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Short Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.01
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 食人鱼的主要威胁来自它的十二挺 XII 系列旋转机枪。在如此高速的机甲上，这些武器对任何敌人都构成严重威胁，尤其是在一个“星”的食人鱼成群行动时；如此庞大的阵列让这台机甲几乎能瞬间撕开对手的后部装甲。然而，它们对无装甲步兵最为致命，几秒钟内就能消灭整整一个连。为对付坚固目标，食人鱼还装有两门 Mk. 3 增程中型激光和一门 1 系列增程小型激光。由于该设计只使用十个单散热器，机甲战士仍须管理热量水平。机枪对弹药的依赖使食人鱼必须靠近补给线，因此大多数已被降格到 solahma 或驻防任务。 特性：改进瞄准 - 近程 投放费用倍率：1.01

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Piranha's main threat is its twelve Series XII Rotary Machine Guns. These are a serious threat to any foe on such a speedy 'Mech, especially if a Star of Piranhas operate in a pack, and such a large array allows the 'Mech to chew through an opponent's rear armor almost instantly. They are most deadly, however, to unarmored infantry, capable of wiping out an entire company in seconds. For work against hardened targets, the Piranha mounts a pair of Mk. 3 ER Medium Lasers and a single Series 1 ER Small Laser. Since the design only uses ten single heat sinks, the MechWarrior must still manage heat levels. The ammunition dependency of the Machine Guns ensure that Piranhas must stay close to supply lines, so most have been relegated to solahma or garrison roles.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 食人鱼的主要威胁是它的十二挺 XII 系列旋转机枪。在一台如此快速的机甲上，这对任何敌人都是严重威胁，尤其当一个"星"的食人鱼成群作战时；如此庞大的阵列让机甲几乎瞬间啃穿对手的背部装甲。不过它们对无装甲步兵最为致命，能在数秒内歼灭一整连。对付硬化目标时，食人鱼装有双联 Mk. 3 ER 中型激光和一门 1 系列 ER 小型激光。由于该设计仅使用十台单散热器，机甲战士仍须管理热量水平。机枪对弹药的依赖使食人鱼必须靠近补给线，因此大多数被降级到索拉马或驻防任务。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A 'Batchall' version of the Pouncer, seldom seen outside the Clan honor fights. Quirk: Aerial Assault Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是投掷者的“战前叫阵”版本，在部族荣誉战之外极少见到。 特性：空中突击 投放费用倍率：1.03 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Pouncer was originally a test bed design that was upgraded to combat specifications on the orders of then-IlKhan Ulric Kerensky, as it was realized that a more mobile 'Mech was needed when combating Inner Sphere forces. The Pouncer is built on a lightweight DSAM Endo 4 Endo Steel chassis and is powered by a 240 XL engine which gives it a maximum speed of 97.2 km/h. The 'Mech's mobility is enhanced with five Grandthrust Mk. Four jump jets that allow it to jump up to one hundred and fifty meters. For protection from enemy fire, the Pouncer has a respectable six tons of Forging ZM15 Ferro-Fibrous armor. Overall, the Pouncer is an excellent OmniMech with fifteen and a half tons of pod space, allowing it to carry a wide variety of weapons payloads.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 猛扑者原本是试验台设计，因意识到对抗内天体部队需要更机动的机甲，遂奉时任伊尔汗乌尔里克·克伦斯基之命升级至作战规格。它采用轻量化的 DSAM Endo 4 内骨骼底盘，由 240 XL 引擎驱动，最大速度 97.2 公里/小时。五个 Grandthrust Mk. Four 跳跃推进器使其机动性提升，可跳跃至一百五十米。为抵御敌方火力，猛扑者装备了可观的六吨 Forging ZM15 铁纤维装甲。总体而言，猛扑者是一款出色的全能机甲，拥有十五吨半的吊舱空间，可搭载多种武器配置。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Predator II 1 combines a large Gauss Rifle with four Medium Pulse Lasers, enabling a surprising amount of damage for what can fool the inexperienced MechWarrior as a simple 'Mech design. Quirk: Advanced Optics Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.13 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 捕食者II 1将一支大型高斯步枪与四具中型脉冲激光结合在一起，能造成惊人的伤害——经验不足的机甲战士甚至会误以为这只是一款普通的机甲设计。 特性：高级光学 投放费用倍率：1.13 手臂驱动器限制：左下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Predator II slightly increases its tonnage compared to the original Predator, and switches the 'Mech's role more towards a longer range sniper.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 掠夺者 II 相比原版掠夺者略增吨位，并把机甲角色更偏向远程狙击手。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Predator II 2 replaces the gauss rifle of the original variant with a LB 10-X Autocannon and an extra Medium Pulse Laser. Quirk: Advanced Optics Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.13 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 捕食者II 2将原型的高斯步枪替换为一门LB 10-X自动炮和一具额外中型脉冲激光。 特性：高级光学 投放费用倍率：1.13 手臂驱动器限制：左下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Predator II slightly increases its tonnage compared to the original Predator, and switches the 'Mech's role more towards a longer range sniper.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 掠夺者 II 相比原版掠夺者略增吨位，并把机甲角色更偏向远程狙击手。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Roughly a third of the Predator's mass is consumed by two LB 10-X Autocannons. These have ample ammunition for most Clan Trials and usually stock both cluster and slug rounds. They are supported by a pair of ER Medium Lasers and paired ER Small Lasers. Not only can the lasers keep the symmetrical design in the fight after its autocannon ammunition runs out, they do not create a burden on the 'Mech's ability to control heat under normal circumstances. Ten double heat sinks is all the Predator needs to keep its heat in check. Quirk: Advanced Optics Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.12 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 掠食者约三分之一的质量被两门LB 10-X自动炮占据。它们弹药充足，足以应付大多数部族试炼，通常同时装填集束弹与实心弹。两门增程中型激光和成对的增程小型激光为其提供支援。这些激光不仅能在自动炮弹药耗尽后让这套对称设计继续作战，在正常情况下也不会给机甲的热量控制能力造成负担。十个双散热器便是掠食者控制热量所需的全部。 特性：先进光学 投放费用倍率：1.12 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Predator is a second-line BattleMech that is the product of a cooperative venture between the various Clan Fire Mandrill Kindraa. It is protected by eleven and a half tons of armor and can move at a respectable speed for a heavy 'Mech. Useful as either a medium-range duelist or as a close-up skirmisher, it can use its autocannons to deal a strong punch, then follow up with cluster rounds that exploit holes in an enemy 'Mech's armor.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 掠食者是二等战斗机甲，是火沸氏族各金德拉之间合作项目的产物。它由十一吨半装甲保护，对其重型机甲的身份而言速度相当可观。无论用作中距离决斗者还是近距离游击手都很有用，它可以用自动炮打出沉重一击，然后用集束弹去利用敌方机甲装甲上的破口。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Initially created as a ClanTech test bed by the AFFC, the Prometheus is more known for its legendary run in the Solaris 7 arenas. Stolen by the notorious Professor Burke Kale, the Prometheus was fitted with an illegal Direct Neural Interface and a Virtual Reality Piloting Pod; allowing the Professor to control the Mech as easily as if it were his own body. Powered by a 375-rated XL Engine and built around a clan made Endo Steel skeleton, the Prometheus had a top speed of 80km/h and nearly 12 tons of Ferro-Fibrous armor. The Prometheus's weapons were all ClanTech and consisted of an ER PPC and Large Pulse Laser paired with 2 LRM-15's. For close range combat, it mounted a Medium Pulse Laser, 2 SRM-6's and 6 Machine Guns. Quirk: Distracting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Prometheus最初是AFFC打造的部族技术试验平台，但它更以在索拉里斯7竞技场上的传奇战绩闻名。它被臭名昭著的伯克·凯尔教授盗走，并装上了非法的直接神经接口与虚拟现实驾驶舱，让教授操控这台机甲如同支配自己的身体一般轻松。Prometheus由额定375的XL引擎驱动，采用部族制造的内骨架结构，最高速度达80km/h，并披挂近12吨铁纤维装甲。其武器全部为部族技术，包括一门增程粒子炮、一门大型脉冲激光以及2具LRM-15。近战则装有一门中型脉冲激光、2具SRM-6和6挺机枪。 特性：分散注意力 投放费用倍率：1.11 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Initially created as a ClanTech test bed by the AFFC, the Prometheus is more known for its legendary run in the Solaris 7 arenas. Stolen by the notorious Professor Burke Kale, the Prometheus was fitted with an illegal Direct Neural Interface and a Virtual Reality Piloting Pod; allowing the Professor to control the Mech as easily as if it were his own body. Powered by a 375-rated XL Engine and built around a clan made Endo Steel skeleton, the Prometheus had a top speed of 80km/h and nearly 12 tons of Ferro-Fibrous armor. The Prometheus's weapons were all ClanTech and consisted of an ER PPC and Large Pulse Laser paired with 2 LRM-15's. For close range combat, it mounted a Medium Pulse Laser, 2 SRM-6's and 6 Machine Guns.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 普罗米修斯最初是AFFC创立的氏族科技试验台，但它更以在索拉里斯7竞技场的传奇战绩闻名。它被臭名昭著的伯克·凯尔教授窃取后，装上了非法的直接神经接口和虚拟现实驾驶舱；让教授能像控制自己的身体一样轻松地操控机甲。普罗米修斯由一具375级XL引擎驱动，围绕氏族制造的内层钢骨架建造，最高速度80公里/小时，披挂近12吨铁纤装甲。普罗米修斯的武器全是氏族科技，包括一门增程PPC和一门大型脉冲激光器，配以2具LRM-15。近距离作战时，它装有一门中型脉冲激光器、2具SRM-6和6挺机枪。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Built for long-range firepower, the Pulverizer relied on a modified ER PPC and LRMs to strike at a distance, while ECM systems and large lasers discouraged enemy sensors and kept wary opponents at arm’s length. More than 15 tons of armor, CASE and a standard fusion engine made the Pulverizer extremely hard to kill compared to more sophisticated early Clan machines. Quirk: Accurate Weapon - PPC Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 粉碎者专为远距离火力而生，依靠一门改进型增程粒子炮与LRM在远处发起打击，同时以电子对抗套件和大型激光干扰敌方传感器，让心存戒备的对手不敢近身。超过15吨的装甲、CASE以及标准聚变引擎，使粉碎者相比早期部族那些更精密的机型极难被击毁。 特性：精准武器（粒子炮） 投放费用倍率：1.14

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Built for long-range firepower, the Pulverizer relied on a modified ER PPC and LRMs to strike at a distance, while ECM systems and large lasers discouraged enemy sensors and kept wary opponents at arm’s length. More than 15 tons of armor, CASE and a standard fusion engine made the Pulverizer extremely hard to kill compared to more sophisticated early Clan machines.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 粉碎者为远程火力而建，依靠一门改装增程PPC和LRM在远处打击，同时以ECM系统与大型激光器干扰敌方传感器、把谨慎的对手挡在一臂之外。超过15吨的装甲、CASE和一台标准聚变引擎，使粉碎者与更精巧的早期氏族机型相比极难被击毁。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Developed by Clan Snow Raven this configuration trades the standard Large Lasers for Improved Large Lasers. The armor has also been replaced by Clan spec Ferro-Fibrous armor. The weight savings from these changes allows the Pulverizer to carry eighteen double heat sinks. Quirk: Accurate Weapon - PPC Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该配置由雪鸦部族研发，将标准大型激光换成改进型大型激光。装甲也已更换为部族规格的铁纤维装甲。这些改动省下的重量，让Pulverizer得以搭载十八台双散热器。 特性：精准武器 - 粒子炮 投放费用倍率：1.14

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Developed by Clan Snow Raven this configuration trades the standard Large Lasers for Improved Large Lasers. The armor has also been replaced by Clan spec Ferro-Fibrous armor. The weight savings from these changes allows the Pulverizer to carry eighteen double heat sinks.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这一配置由雪鸦氏族研发，把标准大型激光器换成改进型大型激光器。装甲也换成了氏族规格铁纤装甲。这些改动省下的重量让粉碎者得以携带十八具双重散热器。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The PUL-C has been fully upgraded with clan tech from the previous mixed variants. A Clan ER PPC has replaced the early Enhanced ER PPC and the Large Lasers have been upgraded to Clan Large Pulse Lasers giving the PUL-C the ability to deal and withstand damage at long ranges. Quirk: Accurate Weapon - PPC Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.22
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: PUL-C 已在此前混装变型的基础上全面换装部族科技。部族增程粒子炮取代了早期的强化增程粒子炮，大型激光也升级为部族大型脉冲激光，使 PUL-C 具备在远距离输出与承受伤害的能力。 特性：精准武器 - 粒子炮 投放费用倍率：1.22

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The PUL-C has been fully upgraded with clan tech from the earlier mixed variants.  A Clan ER PPC has replaced the early Enhanced ER PPC and the Large Lasers have been upgraded to Clan Large Pulse Lasers giving the PUL-C the ability to deal and withstand damage at long ranges.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: PUL-C已用部族技术从早期的混合变型全面升级：部族增程粒子炮取代了早期增强型增程粒子炮，大型激光升级为部族大型脉冲激光，使PUL-C能在远距离上输出并承受伤害。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Quasit's main long range weapon is its LRM-5 launcher, mounted in the center torso. Its close range weapons are an SRM-4 launcher mounted on left hand actuator and a medium laser in the right hand actuator. For handling infantry, the 'Mech has a machine gun mounted in its right torso. Seven and a half tons of Lexington Limited Heavy Industrial armor provides a surprisingly strong defense for the MilitiaMech. Quirk: Improved Lifesupport Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.76
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 奎西特的主要远程武器是装在中央躯干的LRM-5发射器；近程武器则是一具装在左手驱动器上的SRM-4发射器和右手驱动器上的一门中型激光。为对付步兵，该机甲右躯干装有一挺机枪。七吨半列克星敦有限重工业装甲为这台民兵机甲提供了出人意料坚固的防御。 特性：改进生命维持 投放费用倍率：0.76

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Quasit was an Industrial Mech armed with military-grade weapons, created in 2517 by Concordat Telecom and the TransStellar Company. Initially, the design was sold to unsuspecting settlements in the Periphery as a BattleMech, but once the new owners had the Quasit face a proper BattleMech, the truth was revealed by its limitations. After a brief setback, once the CTT decided to sell it as a MilitiaMech to support militia troops, the design worked well in this role.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 奎西特是一款装有军用级武器的工业机甲，由协约电信与跨星公司于2517年创造。它最初被当作战斗机甲卖给外围地区毫无戒心的定居点，但当新主人们让奎西特正面对上一台真正的战斗机甲时，其局限便揭穿了真相。在短暂的挫折之后，CTT决定把它作为民兵机甲出售以支援民兵部队，该设计在这一角色上表现出色。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A simple refit of the -4G, adding a C3 Slave unit by dropping one of the Medium Lasers. Quirk: Hyper-Extending Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: -4G 的简单改装型，通过拆下一门中型激光加装了一个 C3 从属单元。 特性：超伸展驱动器 投放费用倍率：1.06

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Quickdraw was originally built in 2779 as a replacement for the Rifleman BattleMech. While it was unsuccessful in supplanting the Rifleman, over time the Quickdraw proved itself to be a good generalist 'Mech. Packing excellent firepower, solid armor protection and above-average speed, it quickly earned the respect of many MechWarriors and status as a workhorse in every Successor State's military.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 快手最初于 2779 年建造，意在取代步枪手战斗机甲。虽然它未能成功顶替步枪手，但随着时间推移，快手证明自己是一台优秀的通用机甲。凭借出色的火力、扎实的装甲防护和高于平均的速度，它迅速赢得了许多机甲战士的尊重，并在每个继承国的军队中获得了主力机型的地位。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The -4P is an uncommon variant of the Quickdraw, made largely obsolete by more modern mechs and therefore only seen with mercenary bands low on luck, pirates or deep periphery garrisons. The largest drawback of the 'Mech is the giant Electronic Warfare Equipment fixed to its side torso, weighing in at 7.5 tons while providing considerably worse EWS capabilities then the most basic modern system. Quirk: Hyper-Extending Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: -4P是迅捷的不常见变型，由于更现代的机甲使其大多过时，因而只见于运气不佳的雇佣兵团、海盗或外围纵深驻军。该机甲最大的缺点是侧躯干固定安装的巨型电子战设备：重达7.5吨，其电子战能力却明显不如最基本的现代系统。 特性：超伸展驱动器 投放费用倍率：1.06

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是3057年推出的对5K武器组的小幅改动：后向中型激光改为朝前射击，SRM-4则改为朝后安装。 特性：超伸展驱动器 投放费用倍率：1.08

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A periphery refit of a QKD-5M, the -5P combines the standard four medium lasers with a large Hatchet and a Supercharger, to bring the 'Mech quickly into melee range. Quirk: Hyper-Extending Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是外围地区对QKD-5M的改装，-5P把标准的四门中型激光与一把大战斧和一台增压器结合起来，让机甲迅速进入近战距离。 特性：超伸展驱动器 投放费用倍率：1.06

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The -6KH is a clan conversion of the Quickdraw, initially seen amongst the mercenary band the Kell Hounds. A total of four ER Medium Lasers and an Artemis IV enabled LRM-10 missile launcher as the primary armament, while a Streak SRM-4 provides secondary close range firepower. The design even manages to fit both a C3 slave and a small targeting computer. Quirk: Hyper-Extending Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: -6KH是迅捷的部族化改装，最早见于雇佣兵团体凯尔猎犬。它的主要武器是四门增程中型激光和一具带阿尔忒弥斯IV的LRM-10导弹发射器，另有一具连发SRM-4提供次要近程火力。该设计甚至设法同时装下了一台C3从机和一台小型瞄准计算机。 特性：超伸展驱动器 投放费用倍率：1.06

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The C is a modified version of the 5K Quickdraw first fielded in 3053. One of the rear-facing lasers is replaced with a C3 slave unit, allowing it to work as part of a C3 lance. Quirk: Hyper-Extending Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: C 型是 5K Quickdraw 的改进版本，于 3053 年首次列装。它把一门朝后的激光替换为 C3 从属单元，使其能够作为 C3 小队的一员协同作战。 特性：超伸展驱动器 投放费用倍率：1.08

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A Clan IIC variant of the Quickdraw, utilizing the smaller and lighter Clan based technology to fit a total of nine ER Medium Lasers. However, the design never passed trials and is very seldom used by except piloting it into battle as a punishment. Quirk: Hyper-Extending Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.12
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Quickdraw的部族IIC变型，利用更小更轻的部族科技，容纳了总共九门增程中型激光。然而该设计从未通过试炼，极少被使用，除了作为惩罚被驾驶上战场。 特性：超伸展驱动器 投放费用倍率：1.12

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The custom mode Quickdraw variant piloted by the MechWarrior Ivy Upsalom, more commonly known as 'The Ladykiller'. The -IV4 features a plentitude of advanced systems not commonly available, showing the owner's determination to let no cost stop the the dream of the perfect 'Mech. Despite its impressive firepower through twin Imperator AC/5s, two Valiant SRM-6 launchers and two Medium Pulse Lasers, the 'Mech still suffers from being easily forced off the battlefield due to the somewhat mediocre armor and XL engine. Quirk: Hyper-Extending Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Quickdraw 的定制变型，由机甲战士 Ivy Upsalom 驾驶，人送绰号“淑女杀手”。-IV4 配备了大量并不常见的先进系统，足见其主人不惜代价追求完美机甲的心志。尽管凭借双联 Imperator AC/5、两具 Valiant SRM-6 发射器与两门中型脉冲激光拥有可观的火力，该机甲仍因装甲平平与 XL引擎而容易被逐出战场。 特性：超伸展驱动器 投放费用倍率：1.1

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Scrapper was the personal 'Mech of Solaris gladiator Signe Hague, up until their recent demise. Although fully focused on Melee fighting and arena combat with its large Sword and very thick armor, it still manages to mount three SRM launchers and a Medium Laser. Quirk: Hyper-Extending Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Scrapper 曾是索拉里斯角斗士西格妮·哈格的专属机甲，直到其不久前殒命。该机虽完全专注于近身近战与竞技场战斗，配备巨剑与极厚的装甲，却仍设法装设了三具 SRM 发射器和一门中型激光。 特性：超伸展驱动器 投放费用倍率：1.1

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Raiden is a battle armor design that hails from the Draconis Combine. It is essentially the Combine's take on the Inner Sphere Standard which, though debuting first and also produced by the Kuritans themselves, represents an improvement on the design. Quirk: Well Designed Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.888 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 雷电是一款来自德拉科尼斯联合体的战斗装甲设计。它本质上是联合体对"内天体标准型"的诠释——后者虽然更早问世且同样由库瑞塔人生产，但雷电代表了该设计的改进。 特质：设计精良 投放费用倍率：0.888 可挂载全能单位，可近战，可蜂群攻击。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Raijin is designed to be highly mobile and capable of engaging an enemy at a variety of ranges. The Raijin is built around a 300 XL Engine that gives it a top speed of 97.2 km/h. For added mobility, the Raijin carries six jump jets, allowing the 'Mech to jump up to one hundred and eighty meters. The Raijin carries seven tons of Ferro-Fibrous armor. The 'Mech's relatively light armor can be a liability if it is engaged in close combat or finds itself in a protracted engagement. To handle the heat from the weapons onboard, the Raijin carries ten double heat sinks. For long-range striking power, the Raijin carries a ER PPC that can be used to engage a target at up to six hundred and ninety meters. For close combat, the Raijin has three Medium Pulse Lasers. Additionally, to seek out any weak points in an enemy's armor, the Raijin has a SRM-6 and an ammunition efficient Streak SRM-2 Quirk: Extended Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 雷神被设计为高度机动，能在多种距离上与敌人交战。它围绕一台300 XL引擎建造，最高速度97.2公里/小时。为进一步提升机动性，雷神带六具跳跃推进器，可跳跃至多一百八十米。雷神带七吨铁纤维装甲。若陷入近身战或持久交战，其相对轻薄的装甲会成为隐患。为处理武器热量，雷神带十个双散热器。远程打击方面，雷神装有一门增程粒子炮，可在六百九十米外攻击目标；近战方面则有三门中型脉冲激光。此外，为寻找敌方装甲的弱点，雷神还带有一具SRM-6和一具弹药效率极高的连发SRM-2。 特性：扩展躯干旋转 投放费用倍率：1.04 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Raijin was designed after the Battle of Tukayyid to rearm ComGuard units that had suffered losses in the campaign. Despite having stockpiled Star League-era BattleMechs at his disposal, Precentor Martial Focht wanted something unfamiliar to both the Inner Sphere and the Clans.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 雷神是在图卡伊德战役之后设计的，用于为在这场战役中损失惨重的通讯之星卫队重新装备。尽管军事大导师福赫特手头库存着星际联盟时代的战斗机甲，他却想要一种对内层星域和部族都陌生的东西。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A failed prototype to improve the survivability rate of the MechWarriors piloting Raijins. By converting the SRM6 launcher to a one shot, a CASE system was added to protected the Streak SRM ammunition. However, in real battle scenarios this only meant that the Mech's firepower got considerably nerfed for a minimal durability improvement. Quirk: Extended Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是一款旨在提高Raijin机甲战士生存率的失败原型机。它把SRM6发射器改为一次性发射，从而腾出空间加装CASE系统保护连发SRM弹药。然而在实际战斗中，这仅仅意味着机甲的耐久度只得到微乎其微的提升，火力却被大幅削弱。 特性：扩展躯干旋转 投放费用倍率：1.04 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Produced by the Rim Worlds Republic in 2735, the Rampage 2G was a standard line unit in the Rim Worlds Army. The 2G model was basic, but effective in its role, carrying a wide assortment of weapons to handle threats at any range of engagement. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.13 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 由边缘世界共和国于 2735 年生产，Rampage 2G 是边缘世界军队的标准一线单位。2G 型号虽然基础，但在其定位上相当有效，配备种类繁多的武器，足以应对任何交战距离上的威胁。 特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1.13 手臂驱动器限制：左下臂

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: I know this is an old 'Mech and all, Boss, but ... c'mon. This thing is like somebody looked at the Victor and went \"hey, let me copy your homework,\" and then didn't even improve on the design.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我知道这是台老机甲，老大，可是……得了吧。这东西就像有人看了胜利者一眼，说"嘿，借我抄抄作业"，然后连设计都没改进一下。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Built in 2750, the Rampage 4G was a massive overhaul to the original 2G model, upgrading many of the components to modern equivalents. Most notable was the addition of a Gauss rifle at the expense of the missile tubes, giving the 4G considerable punch at longer ranges. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 狂暴 4G 于 2750 年制造，是对原始 2G 型号的大规模改造，把许多部件升级为现代型号。最引人注目的是以牺牲导弹发射管为代价加装了一门高斯步枪，使 4G 在较远距离上也拥有相当可观的打击力。 特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1.15 手臂驱动器限制：左下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Rampage 4G is a long range powerhouse. It's not very often that you see 'Mechs come off the factory line capable of the same one-two punch that the Gauss Rifle and LB 10-X AC can manage here.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 暴走4G是远程重炮。很少见到有机甲能出厂就打出高斯步枪与LB 10-X自动炮这样的连环重拳。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The personal BattleMech of Rim Worlds Army General Viktoria Benbaoudaoud. Based on the Rampage 5G, the 4G \"Benbaoudaoud\" was a minor custom refit, most notably removing the MASC for additional missile tubes. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.17 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是边境世界军将军维克托里娅·本鲍达乌德的私人战斗机甲。4G“本鲍达乌德”以暴走5G为基础，是一次小幅定制改装，最显著之处是拆掉MASC以增加导弹发射管。 特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1.17 手臂驱动器限制：左下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Small touch-ups like these aren't too unheard of, even back from the Star League days. Every MechWarrior's got their preferences, and some of them have the pull and the cash to make them happen. Sound familiar, Boss?
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这种小修小补其实并不罕见，甚至在星盟时代也是如此。每个机师都有自己的偏好，而其中一些人既有门路又有钱把它变成现实。听着耳熟吗，老大？

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: While the original Rampage had its debut in 2735 as a standard line unit, it saw a large scale redesign following the Amaris Coup in 2767. Taking advantage of the newly acquired SLDF R&D facilities, the Rampage 5G was outfitted with state-of-the-art weaponry previously unheard of in the Rim Worlds Republic. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 最初的暴走于2735年作为标准战列单位首次亮相，在2767年阿马里斯政变后经历了大规模重新设计。凭借新取得的SLDF研发设施，暴走5G装备了此前在边境世界共和国闻所未闻的最先进武器。 特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1.15 手臂驱动器限制：左下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Origins aside, the Rampage 5G is a solid assault 'mech. Big slabs of armor, weapons leagues ahead of its peers at the time. The tally marks next to the flamer do make me a little nervous, though. I think we'll just buff those out.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 撇开来历不谈，狂怒5G是一台扎实的突击机甲。厚重的装甲板，武器在当时远超同齐。不过火焰喷射器旁的那些计数刻痕让我有点紧张。我想我们干脆把它们磨掉。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An offshoot of the Jenner, the 35 ton Rattlesnake JR7-31 was developed as part of the joint MIIO-LIC Trapdoor Project during the early years of the Clan Invasion. Meant primarily as a disinformation campaign targeted at House Kurita, few Rattlesnakes were ever manufactured, with the design becoming extinct within 30 years. Built around a 245-rated XL Engine and 7 Jump Jets, the Rattlesnake mounts 7 Medium Lasers. Guardian ECM is included and the remaining tonnage devoted to additional armor. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Rattlesnake JR7-31 是 Jenner 的分支机型，这台 35 吨机甲是部族入侵初期 MIIO 与 LIC 联合开展的“活板门计划”（Trapdoor Project）的产物。它主要被用作针对库瑞塔家族的虚假情报行动，因此制造的 Rattlesnake 数量极少，该设计在 30 年内便告绝迹。Rattlesnake 以一台 245 级 XL 引擎和 7 具跳跃推进器为核心，装有 7 门中型激光。它还配有一具守护者电子对抗系统，剩余吨位则全部用于增加装甲。 特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：0.98 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An offshoot of the Jenner, the 35 ton Rattlesnake JR7-31 was developed as part of the joint MIIO-LIC Trapdoor Project during the early years of the Clan Invasion. Meant primarily as a disinformation campaign targeted at House Kurita, few Rattlesnakes were ever manufactured, with the design becoming extinct within 30 years. Built around a 245-rated XL Engine and 7 Jump Jets, the Rattlesnake mounts 7 Medium Lasers. Guardian ECM is included and the remaining tonnage devoted to additional armor.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 响尾蛇 JR7-31 是詹纳的分支，35 吨，作为 MIIO 与 LIC 联合"活板门计划"的一部分在氏族入侵初期开发。它主要用于针对库瑞塔家族的假情报行动，因此制造数量极少，该设计在 30 年内便绝迹。响尾蛇围绕一台 245 额定 XL 引擎和 7 个跳跃推进器建造，装 7 门中型激光，另有守护者 ECM，剩余吨位全部用于增加装甲。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The JR7-31B is a slightly cheaper version of the JR7-31P. By dropping one of the heat sinks, the armor was able to be switched from the more expensive Ferro-Fibrous to standard grade. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: JR7-31B 是 JR7-31P 的略微廉价版本。通过拆除一具散热器，装甲得以从更昂贵的铁纤维更换为标准型号。 特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：0.98
