Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An offshoot of the Jenner, the 35 ton Rattlesnake JR7-31P was developed as part of the joint MIIO-LIC Trapdoor Project during the early years of the Clan Invasion. Meant primarily as a disinformation campaign targeted at House Kurita, few Rattlesnakes were ever manufactured, with the design becoming extinct within 30 years. Built around a 245-rated XL Engine and 7 Jump Jets, the Rattlesnake mounts 7 Medium Lasers. A C3 Slave is included and the remaining tonnage devoted to additional armor. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为迅捷的分支，35吨的响尾蛇JR7-31P是部族入侵早期MIIO-LIC“活板门计划”的产物。它主要针对库瑞塔家族进行假情报行动，制造的响尾蛇极少，该设计在30年内便灭绝。响尾蛇围绕一台245额定XL引擎和7具跳跃推进器建造，装7门中型激光，另带一台C3从机，其余吨位用于额外装甲。 特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：0.98 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An offshoot of the Jenner, the 35 ton Rattlesnake JR7-31P was developed as part of the joint MIIO-LIC Trapdoor Project during the early years of the Clan Invasion. Meant primarily as a disinformation campaign targeted at House Kurita, few Rattlesnakes were ever manufactured, with the design becoming extinct within 30 years. Built around a 245-rated XL Engine and 7 Jump Jets, the Rattlesnake mounts 7 Medium Lasers. A C3 Slave is included and the remaining tonnage devoted to additional armor.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为詹纳的一个分支，35吨的响尾蛇JR7-31P是在氏族入侵初期作为MIIO-LIC"活板门计划"的联合项目研发的。它主要是一场针对栗田家族的假情报行动，响尾蛇从未大量制造，该设计在30年内就灭绝了。响尾蛇围绕一具245级XL引擎和7个跳跃推进器建造，装7门中型激光器。它还装有一套C3从属系统，剩余吨位则用于增加装甲。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 31PX is the early prototype version of what eventually got introduced as the JR7-31P. The C3 slave computer of the later version is missing in the PX, but instead an extra Medium Laser is mounted in the head. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 31PX是后来定型为JR7-31P的早期原型版本。PX上没有后续型号的C3从属计算机，取而代之的是头部加装的一具中型激光。 特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：0.98

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An offshoot of the Jenner, the 35 ton Rattlesnake JR7-31 was developed as part of the joint MIIO-LIC Trapdoor Project during the early years of the Clan Invasion. Meant primarily as a disinformation campaign targeted at House Kurita, few Rattlesnakes were ever manufactured, with the design becoming extinct within 30 years. Built around a 245-rated XL Engine and 7 Jump Jets, the Rattlesnake mounts 7 Medium Lasers. Guardian ECM is included and the remaining tonnage devoted to additional armor.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 响尾蛇 JR7-31 是詹纳的分支，35 吨，作为 MIIO 与 LIC 联合"活板门计划"的一部分在氏族入侵初期开发。它主要用于针对库瑞塔家族的假情报行动，因此制造数量极少，该设计在 30 年内便绝迹。响尾蛇围绕一台 245 额定 XL 引擎和 7 个跳跃推进器建造，装 7 门中型激光，另有守护者 ECM，剩余吨位全部用于增加装甲。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The JR7-31U switches to an endo steel chassis to free enough weight capacity to increase the amount of armor. The Guardian ECM of the original JR7-31 is also replaced by a C3 Slave computer. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: JR7-31U改用内骨架底盘，腾出足够重量容量以增加装甲。原JR7-31的守护者电子对抗套件也被换成一台C3从机。 特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：0.98 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An offshoot of the Jenner, the 35 ton Rattlesnake JR7-31 was developed as part of the joint MIIO-LIC Trapdoor Project during the early years of the Clan Invasion. Meant primarily as a disinformation campaign targeted at House Kurita, few Rattlesnakes were ever manufactured, with the design becoming extinct within 30 years. Built around a 245-rated XL Engine and 7 Jump Jets, the Rattlesnake mounts 7 Medium Lasers. Guardian ECM is included and the remaining tonnage devoted to additional armor.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 响尾蛇 JR7-31 是詹纳的分支，35 吨，作为 MIIO 与 LIC 联合"活板门计划"的一部分在氏族入侵初期开发。它主要用于针对库瑞塔家族的假情报行动，因此制造数量极少，该设计在 30 年内便绝迹。响尾蛇围绕一台 245 额定 XL 引擎和 7 个跳跃推进器建造，装 7 门中型激光，另有守护者 ECM，剩余吨位全部用于增加装甲。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Razor Jaw carries an ATM-9 in each side torso and a Medium Pulse Laser in each arm. Five Jump Jets improves mobility enough to compensate for its lack of a high max speed. Quirk: Improved Lifesupport Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 剃刀颚在左右躯干各装有一具ATM-9，每条手臂各有一门中型脉冲激光。五个跳跃推进器充分提升了机动性，弥补了最高速度不足的缺陷。 特性：改进生命维持系统 投放费用倍率：1.11 手臂驱动器限制：左臂上部、右臂上部

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Razor Jaw is a 55 ton mobile medium to long range striker. Originally created by Clan Nova Cat, it soon spread within all the Clans that headed to the Inner Sphere. Although early production runs of the 'Mech had some reliability issues, once they were ironed out the 'Mech was considered quite efficient .
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 剃刀颚是一种55吨机动中型至远程打击者。它最初由新猫氏族创造，很快便流传到所有前往内天体的氏族中。虽然该机甲早期生产批次有些可靠性问题，但问题解决之后，它被认为相当高效。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: As a BattleMech design the Reconquista was a mixed-bag. Its numerous faulty components included the internal combustion engine, myomer, chassis, spare parts, controls and software. The Reconquista's slow speed and limited agility were also severe weaknesses exploited by Umayyad artillery and tanks. On the other hand, the armor, heat sinks and mix of weaponry (autocannon, machine gun and long-range missiles) proved adequate, and the 'Mech could be built in (relatively) large enough numbers at a critical time of the invasion. Quirk: Ubiquitous Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.89 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为一款战斗机甲设计，再征服是好坏参半的。它众多有缺陷的部件包括内燃机、人造肌、底盘、备件、控制系统和软件。再征服缓慢的速度与有限的灵活性也是倭马亚火炮与坦克所利用的严重弱点。另一方面，它的装甲、散热器和武器组合（自动炮、机枪与远程导弹）被证明是够用的，而且该机甲能在入侵的关键时刻以（相对）足够大的数量生产出来。 特性：无处不在 投放费用倍率：0.89 手臂驱动器限制：右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Reconquista was the first BattleMech produced by Nueva Castile, created as a response to the Umayyad invasion. While this design was hardly equal to the Mackie, let alone the Star League-level 'Mechs used by the Umayyads, the Reconquista did redress the battlefield imbalance enough that the Castilians were able to halt the Umayyad advance. The Reconquista also had the virtue of being easy enough to manufacture that the Castilians could deploy them in company strength at a time when the Umayyads still couldn't replace their own 'Mech losses.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 再征服是新卡斯蒂利亚生产的第一种战斗机甲，为应对倭马亚入侵而创造。虽然这一设计远不及麦基，更不用说倭马亚人使用的星盟级机甲，但再征服确实足以纠正战场上的失衡，使卡斯蒂利亚人得以阻止倭马亚的推进。再征服还有一个优点：它足够易于制造，使卡斯蒂利亚人能在倭马亚人仍无法补充自身机甲损失之时，以连级规模部署它们。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Rhino was an early attempt made by Clan Hell's Horses to develop true battle armor during the Golden Century. The Rhino's weapons layout and equipment was similar to the Elemental (Battle Armor), but was not as capable as the later machine. Its weapons ranges were shorter and it lacked maneuverability and speed. However, the armor was greater than what the Elemental battlesuit would carry. In addition, while the suit's SRM 2 was easy to use and reload, it had a significant jamming issue. This issue would cause catastrophic ammo explosions dealing major damage to the suit and the pilot (for an example, see Bertram). Engineers tried to resolve the issue, but the Rhino was shelved before the issue could be rectified. Quirk: Armored Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.935 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can not swarm.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 犀牛是地狱马部族在黄金世纪早期尝试研制真正的战斗装甲的产物。犀牛的武器布局与装备与元素（战斗装甲）相似，但能力不及后来的型号：武器射程更短，也缺乏机动性与速度。不过它的装甲比元素战斗装甲更厚。此外，虽然该装甲的SRM 2易于使用和再装填，却存在严重的卡壳问题，会引发灾难性的弹药爆炸，对装甲与飞行员造成重大伤害（示例见伯特伦）。工程师曾试图解决该问题，但问题未能修正，犀牛便被束之高阁。 特性：装甲化 投放费用倍率：0.935 可搭载全向单位，可近战，不可蜂拥攻击。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Rhino was an early attempt made by Clan Hell's Horses to develop true battle armor during the Golden Century. The Rhino's weapons layout and equipment was similar to the Elemental (Battle Armor), but was not as capable as the later machine. Its weapons ranges were shorter and it lacked maneuverability and speed. However, the armor was greater than what the Elemental battlesuit would carry. In addition, while the suit's SRM 2 was easy to use and reload, it had a significant jamming issue. This issue would cause catastrophic ammo explosions dealing major damage to the suit and the pilot (for an example, see Bertram). Engineers tried to resolve the issue, but the Rhino was shelved before the issue could be rectified.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 犀牛是地狱马氏族在黄金世纪早期尝试研发真正战斗装甲的产物。犀牛的武器布局与装备与元素战斗装甲相似，但能力不如后来的机型。它的武器射程更短，也缺乏机动性与速度。不过它的装甲比元素战斗服携带的更多。此外，虽然该战斗服的SRM 2易于使用与再装填，却有严重的卡壳问题。这一问题会导致灾难性的弹药爆炸，对战斗服与飞行员造成重大伤害（例子见伯特伦）。工程师曾试图解决这个问题，但犀牛在该问题得到修正之前就被搁置了。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Rhino's main armament is a Large Laser mounted in the center torso, while it also carries a Medium Laser in each leg, one rear-facing one in the left torso and another in the head. A basic 300-rated fusion core keeps mobility up just enough to not be easily flanked. Quirk: Accurate Weapon - Laser Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 犀牛的主要武器是装在中央躯干的一门大型激光，同时每条腿各装一门中型激光，左躯干一门后向、头部另一门。一台基本的300额定聚变核心让机动性刚好够用，不至于轻易被包抄。 特性：精准武器 - 激光 投放费用倍率：1.06

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A 60-ton QuadMech similar to the Goliath in appearance, created specifically for the export market outside the Inner Sphere. Using only basic technology the cost is kept low enough for even the most back-water garrisons and the maintenance needs are kept very simple. Although the 'Mech shares the name of the 50-ton Clan QuadMech, they have no relation to each other.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一种外观类似歌利亚的60吨四足机甲，专为内天体之外的出口市场打造。它只使用基础技术，成本低到连最偏远的驻军也负担得起，维护需求也极为简单。虽然该机甲与那台50吨氏族四足机甲同名，两者并无关联。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Rifleman IIC Chironex carries an Ultra AC/2 and ATM 3 rack in each arm, supported by head mounted ER Small Laser and a Large Pulse Laser in each side torso. Built around a 195-rated standard engine, Endo Steel frame and thirteen tons of Ferro-Fibrous armor, the Chironex is fitted with fourteen Double Heat Sinks, three Jump Jets, three tons of ATM reloads and two tons of UAC rounds. Quirk: Integrated Searchlight Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.17 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 步枪兵 IIC“奇罗内克斯”（Chironex）每条手臂各装有一门 Ultra AC/2 和一具 ATM 3 发射架，并由头部安装的增程小型激光以及两侧躯干各一门大型脉冲激光提供支援。它以额定 195 的标准引擎、内骨架结构及十三吨铁纤维装甲为基础建造，装设了十四台双散热器、三具跳跃推进器、三吨 ATM 备用弹药和两吨 UAC 弹药。 特性：内置探照灯 投放费用倍率：1.17 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Rifleman IIC Chironex carries an Ultra AC/2 and ATM 3 rack in each arm, supported by head mounted ER Small Laser and a Large Pulse Laser in each side torso. Built around a 195-rated standard engine, Endo Steel frame and thirteen tons of Ferro-Fibrous armor, the Chironex is fitted with fourteen Double Heat Sinks, three Jump Jets, three tons of ATM reloads and two tons of UAC rounds.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 步枪兵IIC喀戎在双臂各装一门超速AC/2和一具ATM 3架，由头部的增程小型激光器和两侧躯干各一门大型脉冲激光器支援。它围绕一具195级标准引擎、内层钢框架和十三吨铁纤装甲建造，装十四具双重散热器、三个跳跃推进器、三吨ATM备用弹和两吨UAC弹药。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Developed for the Emperor Stefan Amaris's occupying army, the Rifleman III was an experimental prototype which was rushed into service to defend against the invading Star League Defense Force Army led by General Aleksandr Kerensky in 2777. Only a single prototype was produced after years of development, and it was destroyed during the battle for Terra. Used in the role of an ambusher before being destroyed, the 'Mech's Battle ROM would recount that it had downed nine SLDF BattleMechs before it was rendered inoperable by battle damage. Quirk: Multi Trac Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Rifleman III 是为斯特凡·阿马里斯皇帝的占领军开发的实验性原型机，于 2777 年被匆忙投入使用，以抵御亚历山大·克伦斯基将军率领的入侵中的星际联盟防卫军。历经多年研发，最终只生产出一台原型机，它也在争夺泰拉的战火中被摧毁。这台机甲在被摧毁前担任伏击手，其战斗记录仪记载，它曾击落九台 SLDF 战斗机甲，最终因战损而彻底失去战斗力。 特性：多重追踪 投放费用倍率：1.18 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Although the Rifleman III carries an insufficient supply of both armor and ammunition it is perfectly designed for its role — that is, to burst from concealment and demolish the nearest enemies with incredible physical and psychological firepower.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 虽然步枪兵III携带的装甲与弹药都不足，它却为其角色设计得恰到好处——即从隐蔽处暴起，以惊人的物理与心理火力摧毁最近的敌人。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The personally built 'Mech of Cranston Snord's Irregulars member 'Shorty' Sneede, his Rifleman is a FrankenMech featuring a Phoenix Hawk head, Warhammer right arm and the left torso and arm from an Archer, with only the center and right torsos and both legs left from the parent design. Built around the 3N's standard 240-rated engine, much of the weapons and ammunition from the donor 'Mechs was retained, Sneede's custom being armed with a right-arm mounted PPC, left-torso mounted LRM-20 with two tons of ammo, and three Medium Lasers - one fitted to the right torso and two to the left arm. Carrying a total of fourteen single heat sinks, Sneede's patchwork Rifleman is clad in nine tons of armor. Quirk: Anti-Air Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是克兰斯顿·斯诺德“非正规军”成员“矮子”斯尼德的私人座驾；他的 Rifleman 是一具拼装机甲，装有 Phoenix Hawk 的头部、Warhammer 的右臂，以及来自 Archer 的左躯干和左臂，只有中央躯干、右躯干和双腿是原设计的部件。它以 3N 的标准 240 级引擎为核心，保留了供体机甲的大部分武器和弹药：斯尼德的定制机右臂装有一门粒子炮，左躯干装有一具带两吨弹药的 LRM-20，另有三门中型激光——一门装在右躯干，两门装在左臂。斯尼德这具拼凑而成的 Rifleman 共携带十四具单散热器，披挂九吨装甲。 特性：防空瞄准 投放费用倍率：1.08 手臂驱动器限制：左臂上部、右臂上部

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The personally built 'Mech of Cranston Snord's Irregulars member 'Shorty' Sneede, his Rifleman is a FrankenMech featuring a Phoenix Hawk head, Warhammer right arm and the left torso and arm from an Archer, with only the center and right torsos and both legs left from the parent design. Built around the 3N's standard 240-rated engine, much of the weapons and ammunition from the donor 'Mechs was retained, Sneede's custom being armed with a right-arm mounted PPC, left-torso mounted LRM-20 with two tons of ammo, and three Medium Lasers - one fitted to the right torso and two to the left arm. Carrying a total of fourteen single heat sinks, Sneede's patchwork Rifleman is clad in nine tons of armor.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是克朗斯顿·斯诺德非正规军成员"矮子"斯尼德亲手拼装的机甲，他的步枪兵是一台拼装机甲：装凤凰鹰的头、重锤的右臂，以及弓箭手的左躯干和左臂，只有中央与右躯干和双腿仍属原设计。它围绕3N标准的240级引擎建造，来自捐赠机甲的许多武器与弹药都被保留，斯尼德的定制机武装为右臂一门PPC、左躯干一具LRM-20配两吨弹药，以及三门中型激光器——一门装在右躯干，两门装在左臂。斯尼德这台拼装步枪兵总共携带十四具单重散热器，披挂九吨装甲。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Originally conceived by Clan Jade Falcon during the Clans' Golden Century, the Emerald Harrier is a 15-ton BattleMech. It was out of production by the time of the Clan Invasion of the Inner Sphere and, as such, was only sparsely deployed there. ComStar ROM operatives gave it the reporting name RD-1R Roadrunner when they first observed it in the Jade Falcon occupation zone. It was last reported with Eyrie units on Coventry in 3058 and is thought to have been meant as a training 'Mech. Quirk: Easy to Pilot Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Emerald Harrier 最初由翡翠猎鹰部族在部族黄金世纪期间构想，是一台 15 吨的战斗机甲。到部族入侵内层星域时它已经停产，因此在内层星域只有少量部署。通讯之星 ROM 特工在翡翠猎鹰占领区首次观察到它时，为其取了个代号 RD-1R Roadrunner。它最后一次被记录是 3058 年随 Eyrie 单位出现在考文垂，据信其设计初衷是作为训练机甲。 特性：易于驾驶 投放费用倍率：1.03

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Jesus.. how fast does this go? Meep Meep Commander?
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 天哪……这玩意儿能跑多快？哔哔，指挥官？

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Roc is considered one of the best of the first generation ProtoMechs, and most known successful, as it was produced, operative and fighting for almost a century. In a sense a 'super-Elemental', a Roc carries a single ER Medium Laser and is equipped with sufficient Jump Jets to leap 150 meters at a time. Quirk: Accurate Weapons - Energy Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.972
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Roc 被视为第一代原生型机甲（ProtoMech）中最优秀的型号之一，也是最广为人知的成功之作，它的生产、服役与作战延续了近一个世纪。从某种意义上说，Roc 是一台“超级元素”，搭载一门增程中型激光，并配备足以一次跳跃 150 米的跳跃推进器。 特性：精准武器 - 能量 投放费用倍率：0.972

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Roc is considered one of the best of the first generation ProtoMechs, and most known successful, as it was produced, operative and fighting for almost a century. In a sense a 'super-Elemental', a Roc carries a single ER Medium Laser and is equipped with sufficient Jump Jets to leap 150 meters at a time.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 洛克被视为第一代原生机甲中最优秀、也是已知最成功的一款，因为它被生产、使用并作战了近一个世纪。在某种意义上它是“超级元素”：洛克装有一门增程中型激光，并配有足以一次跃升150米的跳跃推进器。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The SA-RN model uses four Artemis IV FCS-guided SRM-4 launchers protected by CASE. It also sports a prototype claw in the left arm and a Large Pulse Laser in the right. Quirk: Protected Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: SA-RN型号使用四具带阿尔忒弥斯IV火控系统的SRM-4发射器，由CASE保护。它的左臂还装有一具原型爪，右臂一门大型脉冲激光。 特性：受保护驱动器 投放费用倍率：1.04 手臂驱动器限制：右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A Solaris VII BattleMech introduced by Solaris Arms in the mid-3050. As their entry in the medium range weight class arenas, the original Ronin was based on a Centurion chassis. By using an existing chassis rather than building a custom one, Solaris Arms was able to reduce development time and costs. This design philosophy, pioneered with the Ronin, remains in place today. The 'Mech features balanced speed, armor, and weaponry, making it very popular with the Solaris stables, but it is a rare sight on any other world.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Ronin 是 Solaris Arms 于 3050 年代中期推出的索拉里斯七号战斗机甲。作为该厂进军中量级竞技场的参赛机型，初代 Ronin 以 Centurion 的骨架为基础。通过沿用现有骨架而非另行设计专用骨架，Solaris Arms 得以缩短开发周期并降低成本。这一由 Ronin 开创的设计理念沿用至今。该机甲在速度、装甲和武器之间取得了均衡，因而深受索拉里斯各竞技马疚的欢迎，但在其他任何星球上都难得一见。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The SA-RNS is almost identical to the SA-RN, but drops one ton of SRM ammunition to increase the armoring of the 'Mech. Quirk: Protected Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: SA-RNS与SA-RN几乎相同，只是拆掉一吨SRM弹药以增加机甲装甲。 特性：受保护驱动器 投放费用倍率：1.04 手臂驱动器限制：右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A Solaris VII BattleMech introduced by Solaris Arms in the mid-3050. As their entry in the medium range weight class arenas, the original Ronin was based on a Centurion chassis. By using an existing chassis rather than building a custom one, Solaris Arms was able to reduce development time and costs. This design philosophy, pioneered with the Ronin, remains in place today. The 'Mech features balanced speed, armor, and weaponry, making it very popular with the Solaris stables, but it is a rare sight on any other world.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Ronin 是 Solaris Arms 于 3050 年代中期推出的索拉里斯七号战斗机甲。作为该厂进军中量级竞技场的参赛机型，初代 Ronin 以 Centurion 的骨架为基础。通过沿用现有骨架而非另行设计专用骨架，Solaris Arms 得以缩短开发周期并降低成本。这一由 Ronin 开创的设计理念沿用至今。该机甲在速度、装甲和武器之间取得了均衡，因而深受索拉里斯各竞技马疚的欢迎，但在其他任何星球上都难得一见。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Rook relies on its many weapons and substantial amount of armor rather than speed, but to improve mobility it has three Assault-class Jump Jets. The two PPC, three SRM-6 and three Medium Lasers are cooled by a total of 22 heat sinks, which despite the large number of sinks is far from enough to cool a full alpha strike of the 'Mech. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 车堡依靠其众多武器与厚实装甲而非速度，但为提升机动性，它装了三具突击级跳跃推进器。两门粒子炮、三具SRM-6和三门中型激光由总共22个散热器降温；尽管散热器数量众多，仍远不足以支撑该机甲一次全力齐射。 特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1.16

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A 100-ton Inner Sphere 'Mech created just a few years before the Helm Memory Core was found, resulting in the rediscovery of many lost technologies. As a result the Rook was quickly found obsolete, and as a result only a single variant was designed.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是亥姆记忆核心被发现前几年创造的一台100吨内天体机甲，而那次发现重新找回了许多失传技术。结果乌鸦很快就被认定过时，也因此只设计了一个改型。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An assault grade fire support mech, the Salamander entered production in 3055. An 80-ton mech, the Salamander is built around a 320-rated XL Engine and an Endo Steel Skeleton, allowing it to carry 43 tons of weapons and equipment. The Salamander PPR-5S is armed with a trio of LRM-20’s. A pair of Medium Lasers act as back up weapons. Quirk: Accurate Weapon - Missiles Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为一台突击级火力支援机甲，火蜥蜴于3055年投产。这台80吨的机甲围绕320额定XL引擎和内骨架建造，可携带43吨武器与装备。火蜥蜴PPR-5S装备3具LRM-20，并由2门中型激光充当备用武器。 <特性：精准武器（导弹） <投放费用倍率：1.14 <手臂驱动器限制：左臂下段

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The PPR-6U Salamander is a sidegrade kit for the 6S, removing the Artemis IV systems and instead fits a Large Pulse Laser. The two Medium Pulse Lasers also had to be downgraded to standard versions. The kit is mainly used by mercenary outfits when advanced electronics like the Artemis IV FCS are rare or difficult to maintain. Quirk: Accurate Weapon - Missiles Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: PPR-6U火蜥蜴是6S的侧级改装套件，拆掉阿尔忒弥斯IV系统，改为一门大型脉冲激光，两门中型脉冲激光也不得不降级为标准型号。该套件主要被雇佣兵部队使用——当阿尔忒弥斯IV火控系统这类先进电子设备稀少或难以维护时。 特性：精准武器 - 导弹 投放费用倍率：1.14 手臂驱动器限制：左下

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 火蜥蜴（Salamander）是一种突击级火力支援机甲，于 3055 年投产。这台 80 吨机甲以额定 320 的 XL 引擎和内骨架结构为基础，可携带 43 吨武器与装备。PPR-5S 型火蜥蜴装备了三具 LRM-20，另有两门中型激光作为备用武器。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Salamander the design incorporates fire-based weapons; its primary armaments being a pair of Flamers slung under the arms and a single, one-shot short-range missile strapped to the shoulder, invariably one with an Inferno payload. This makes the Salamander especially potent against infantry and combat vehicles, though that does not mean it is less intimidating to MechWarriors: few would want to get caught in the sights of a Salamander Point. Quirk: Fire Demon Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.93 Can mount any unit, can melee, can swarm.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Salamander 的设计以火焰类武器为核心；其主要武器是挂在双臂下方的两具火焰喷射器，以及绑在肩部的一枚一次性近程导弹，且弹头无一例外都是燃烧弹。这使 Salamander 对步兵和战斗车辆尤为致命，但这并不意味着它对机甲战士的威慑力会小一些：很少有人愿意被一支 Salamander 小队盯上。 特性：火焰恶魔 投放费用倍率：0.93 可搭乘任何单位，可近战，可蜂拥攻击。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Salamander the design incorporates fire-based weapons; its primary armaments being a pair of Flamers slung under the arms and a single, one-shot short-range missile strapped to the shoulder, invariably one with an Inferno payload. This makes the Salamander especially potent against infantry and combat vehicles, though that does not mean it is less intimidating to MechWarriors: few would want to get caught in the sights of a Salamander Point.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 火蜥蜴的设计融入了火焰类武器；其主要武装是吊在双臂下的两具火焰喷射器和一具绑在肩上的单发短程火箭，且必定是地狱火战斗部。这使火蜥蜴对步兵与战斗车辆尤其致命，但这并不意味着它对机师就少了几分威慑：很少有人愿意被一支火蜥蜴小队瞄上。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Sarissa MN1-K was armed simply. It carried a battery of lasers, one large and several medium, and mounted as much armor as could be fi tted with the remaining weight budget. Though truly a BattleMech, it drew heavily on a century of IndustrialMech construction experience and was often assembled in civilian facilities. The result was a mechanically reliable and durable machine ideal for Marik militias with little BattleMech training, but otherwise not terribly impressive. Quirk: Ubiquitous Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.82
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Sarissa MN1-K的武器配置十分简单。它搭载一组激光——一门大型激光和若干门中型激光——并在剩余重量预算内尽可能多地安装装甲。虽然它确确实实是一台战斗机甲，却大量借鉴了长达一个世纪的工业机甲制造经验，并常常在民用设施中组装。其结果是机械可靠、坚固耐用，非常适合缺乏战斗机甲训练的马尔克民兵，但除此之外并不特别出众。 特性：随处可见 投放费用倍率：0.82

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: One of the first primitive BattleMechs produced by the Free Worlds League, the Sarissa is one of many centuries-old Age of War designs reborn during the desperation of the Jihad. A contemporary of the Icarus and Mackie, the original MN1-K Sarissa, designed sometime shortly after 2470, was intended as a stopgap that could be readily manufactured in civilian IndustrialMech facilities to bolster the League's member state militias in the face of Lyran Commonwealth and Capellan Confederation newborn BattleMech forces. This philosophy would also make the Sarissa very appealing in 3080 as the Principality of Regulus suffered increasing losses during the Word of Blake Jihad, favoring even a primitive BattleMech over even more simple to build combat vehicles for propaganda purposes.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为自由世界联盟最早生产的原始战斗机甲之一，萨里沙是众多在圣战绝境中重生的数百年战火时代设计之一。作为伊卡洛斯与麦基的同时代产物，最初的MN1-K萨里沙设计于2470年之后不久的某个时候，本意是一种权宜之计，可在民用工业机甲设施中迅速制造，以在莱兰联邦与卡佩兰联邦新生战斗机甲部队面前增强联盟成员国的民兵。这一理念也使萨里沙在3080年极具吸引力——当时雷古兰公国在布雷克之言圣战中损失日增，出于宣传目的，哪怕一台原始战斗机甲也胜过更易于建造的战斗车辆。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The original Sasquatch model produced in 3054, the 001 would infamously be stolen resulting in VEST creating the 002 model to hunt down and destroy the prototype. Hand made for the Solaris arenas, the Sasquatch SQS-TH-001 is an 85 ton Assault Mech powered by a 340-rated XL Engine. Primarily armed with a Gauss Rifle, the 001 has 4 Medium Pulse Lasers and an SRM-6 for close range combat. A pair of Machine Guns and a Small Laser are added as an after thought. AMS is mounted in the right torso and 6 Jump Jets improve mobility. Quirk: Protected Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 001是3054年生产的大脚怪初代型号，它后来因被盗而臭名昭著，VEST公司因此制造出002型去追捕并摧毁原型机。大脚怪SQS-TH-001为索拉里斯竞技场手工打造，是一台85吨的突击机甲，由一具340级XL引擎驱动。它以一支高斯步枪为主要武器，另有4具中型脉冲激光和一具SRM-6用于近战，还顺手加装了两挺机枪和一具小型激光。右躯干装有反导弹系统，6具跳跃推进器则提升了机动性。 特性：受保护驱动器 投放费用倍率：1.15 手臂驱动器限制：右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The original Sasquatch model produced in 3054, the 001 would infamously be stolen resulting in VEST creating the 002 model to hunt down and destroy the prototype. Hand made for the Solaris arenas, the Sasquatch SQS-TH-001 is an 85 ton Assault Mech powered by a 340-rated XL Engine. Primarily armed with a Gauss Rifle, the 001 has 4 Medium Pulse Lasers and an SRM-6 for close range combat. A pair of Machine Guns and a Small Laser are added as an after thought. AMS is mounted in the right torso and 6 Jump Jets improve mobility.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为3054年生产的原始大脚怪型号，001因被盗窃而臭名昭著，此事促使VEST造出002型号去追捕并摧毁原型机。大脚怪SQS-TH-001为索拉里斯竞技场手工打造，是85吨突击机甲，由一具340级XL引擎驱动。它主要以一门磁轨炮为武装，另有4门中型脉冲激光器、一具SRM-6用于近距离作战。事后又加装了两挺机枪和一门小型激光器。右躯干装有AMS，6个跳跃推进器提升机动性。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The SQS-TH-001U adds more heat sinks for improved cooling at the cost of dropping some armor and replacing the SRM-6 launcher with two Small Pulse Lasers. Quirk: Protected Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: SQS-TH-001U增加了更多散热器以改善散热，代价是削减部分装甲，并把SRM-6发射器换成两门小型脉冲激光。 特性：受保护驱动器 投放费用倍率：1.15 手臂驱动器限制：右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A Solaris VII BattleMech, the Sasquatch was to be VEST's entry into the Assault 'Mech category.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为一台索拉里斯 VII 战斗机甲，大脚怪本应是 VEST 进军突击机甲类目的作品。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The SQS-TH-007 upgrades the original Sasquatch with ferro-fibrous armor, allowing more protection. One additional ton each of Gauss and AMS ammunition is also added. Quirk: Protected Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: SQS-TH-007 将初代 Sasquatch 升级为铁纤维装甲，从而获得更强的防护。此外还各增加了一吨高斯步枪弹药和 AMS 弹药。 特性：受保护驱动器 投放费用倍率：1.15 手臂驱动器限制：右下臂

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A Solaris VII BattleMech, the Sasquatch was to be VEST's entry into the Assault 'Mech category.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为一台索拉里斯 VII 战斗机甲，大脚怪本应是 VEST 进军突击机甲类目的作品。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Satyr ProtoMech was designed to serve as a deep raider and reconnaissance unit. Offering only slightly more protection than a Harpy or Siren, the Satyr's best defense is to remain hidden from enemy units. The Satyr's single ER Small Laser allows it to inflict moderate damage on any enemy unit that gets too close. It also carries a Light Active Probe in its torso, allowing it to more easily find hidden units. Quirk: Nimble Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.97
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 萨提尔原生机甲被设计为纵深袭掠与侦察单位。它的防护只比鹰身女妖或塞任稍好，因此最好的防御就是不被敌方单位发现。萨提尔那门单独的增程小型激光能对任何靠得太近的敌方单位造成中等伤害；它躯干内还带一台轻型主动探测器，使其更容易发现隐藏单位。 特性：灵巧 投放费用倍率：0.97

The Satyr's single ER Small Laser allows it to inflict moderate damage on any enemy unit that gets too close. It also carries a Light Active Probe in its torso, allowing it to more easily find hidden units.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 萨提尔原型机甲被设计为纵深袭扰与侦察单位。它提供的防护仅比鹰身女妖或塞任略多，最好的防御就是躲开敌方单位。萨提尔唯一的一门增程小型激光器能对任何靠得太近的敌方单位造成中等伤害。它的躯干还装有一个轻型主动探测器，使其更容易发现隐蔽单位。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Though the first alternate configuration is focused on close-range combat, it carries an ER Large Laser and Gauss Rifle for long-range work. Three ATM 6s are effective at all ranges, while a trio of Medium Pulse Lasers aid with the devastating attack. Enough jump jets to vault up to ninety meters at a time helps MechWarriors get into close range, while an Anti-Missile System grants added defensive capability. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 第一套备用配置虽然以近程作战为重点，却仍携带一门增程大型激光和一门高斯步枪用于远程打击。三具 ATM 6 在各射程上都有效，而三门中型脉冲激光则为这场毁灭性攻势助力。足以一次跃出九十米的跳跃推进器帮助机甲战士迅速接近对手，一套反导弹系统则额外增强了防御能力。 特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1.16 手臂驱动器限制：全向机甲

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Savage Coyote OmniMech was created as a showcase OmniMech. The 'Mech was also part of Khan Koga's attempts to revitalize the fading Clan that invented the OmniMech.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 野蛮郊狼全向机甲是作为展示用全向机甲而造的，也是可汗科加试图重振这个发明了全向机甲却日渐衰落的部族的一部分努力。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This variant is effective at all ranges. A pair of ER Large Lasers and a Large Pulse Laser combine with an Ultra Autocannon/5 to provide an effective long-range punch. Six Small Pulse Lasers aid at knife-fighting range and can quickly devastate conventional infantry. Two pairs of ATM 3s provide support at all ranges. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 此变型在任意距离上都有效：一对增程大型激光和一门大型脉冲激光，配合一门超级AC/5提供有效的远程重拳；六门小型脉冲激光在贴身距离上协助作战，能迅速歼灭常规步兵；两对ATM 3则在所有距离上提供支援。 特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1.16 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Savage Coyote OmniMech was created as a showcase OmniMech. The 'Mech was also part of Khan Koga's attempts to revitalize the fading Clan that invented the OmniMech.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 野蛮郊狼全向机甲是作为展示用全向机甲而造的，也是可汗科加试图重振这个发明了全向机甲却日渐衰落的部族的一部分努力。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The personal 'Mech of Khan Sullivan Koga, it mimics her trends in leading the Coyotes; a strong base, upgraded and enhanced by new features. Building off of the classic Awesome loadout, three ER PPCs provide long range firepower without ammo constraints, or thanks to the 23 double heatsinks, heat worries. Running relatively minimal ammo considering the heat produced by the ER PPCs, the UAC/10 and ATM 9 are more support weapons; available to finish off a target, instead of waiting for the PPCs to recharge. Khan Koga used this to great effect when attacking the Nova Cats on Huntress, splitting fire between a distant target with two PPCs, and finishing off a closer 'Mech with the UAC/10 and ATM 9. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是可汗沙利文·科加的专属机甲，延续了她统领郊狼部族时的风格：扎实的基础，再以新装备升级强化。本机在经典的"敬畏"配置上发展而来，三门增程粒子炮带来不受弹药限制的远程火力，而23具双散热器则让它无需担心过热。考虑到增程粒子炮产生的热量，它携带的弹药相对有限，UAC/10与ATM 9更像是支援武器，用于终结目标，而不必等待粒子炮重新冷却。科加可汗在进攻享特雷斯星的新星猫部族时充分发挥了本机的威力：以两门粒子炮攻击远处目标，再用UAC/10与ATM 9解决逼近的机甲。 特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1.18 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: It's a solid 'Mech, Boss. Triple ER PPCs, enough heatsinks to keep them cool; there's a reason everyone loves the Awesome and tries to mimic it.  That UAC/10 and ATM 9 are more of an afterthought, they don't really have enough ammo to be primary weapons, but are great at finishing off targets. You do have to admit, this Khan Koga was really ahead of their time; the mech doesn't overheat that badly on an Alpha, and most of the weaponry is ammo independent. If the other Khans were as forward thinking as her, maybe they would have won their invasion...
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是台扎实的机甲，老大。三兄弟增程PPC，散热器足够让它们保持凉爽；大家喜爱恐怖并试图模仿它是有原因的。那门UAC/10和ATM 9更像是事后加的，它们的弹药不足以作为主武器，但在收尾目标上很棒。你得承认，这位可汗科加真是超前于她的时代；这台机甲全弹齐射时过热并不严重，而且大部分武器都不依赖弹药。要是其他可汗也像她那样有远见，也许他们就能赢下入侵了……

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Clan Coyote created the LUNA experimental model as a reminder of their history with the Inner Sphere and Star League, borrowing heavily from Native American lore; they had foolishly left their love when trying to impress them, and their nightly howl is their eternal promise to return. The howl of the HAG 40, the burning display of the Laser Heatsinks, all reinforce the theme of announcing their love for, and sorrow for leaving, their love. Outside of the handful of Coyotes who know the stories though, the LUNA designator is assumed to be related to the effectiveness of the unit on low-atmospheric worlds, perfectly masking the feelings of those who feel the decision to stay with the Clan Homeworlds was not the right choice. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 郊狼部族创造了LUNA实验型号，以纪念他们与内层星域和星际联盟的过往，大量借用美洲原住民的传说：他们曾愚蠢地在试图讨好爱人时离开了所爱，而每夜的嗥叫便是他们永世归来的承诺。HAG 40的啸声、激光散热器的灼热光芒，都在强化这一主题：宣告他们对爱人的爱，以及离开的悲伤。不过除了少数知晓这些故事的郊狼成员之外，LUNA这个编号被外界认为与该单位在低大气星球上的效能有关，恰好完美掩盖了那些认为留在部族母星世界的决定并不正确之人的心绪。 特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1.18 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This is definitely dangerous on any moon.  The laser heatsinks are ideal in that low atmosphere environment, and the Ferro Lamellor armor prevents any accidental through-armor-criticals that could cause the 'Mech to suffer fatal damage, while also reducing any taken. The sextuple SRM6's are lethal to anything that gets close, while the HAG 40 allows the pilot to reach out and touch someone.  Only thing this mech needs, is something stripping armor off, so it can crit the insides of the target reliably, instead of sandpapering them.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在任何卫星上这都绝对是危险的。激光散热器在那种低大气环境中最为理想，而铁甲装甲可防止任何意外的穿甲致命伤导致机甲遭受致命损伤，同时也减少所受伤害。六具SRM6对任何靠近的东西都是致命的，而HAG 40则让飞行员能伸手触到别人。这台机甲唯一缺的，就是能剥掉装甲的东西，好让它可靠地对目标内部打出致命伤，而不是拿砂纸慢慢磨。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The SCP-1B model uses a smaller engine and replaces the PPC with a blazer, a second SRM rack, and additional heat sinks Quirk: Improved Lifesupport Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: SCP-1B型使用更小的引擎，并以一门双联激光炮、第二具SRM发射架和额外的散热器取代粒子炮 特性：改进生命维持 投放费用倍率：1.03

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: One of the first mass production QuadMechs, the 55 ton Scorpion entered production in 2570 as an infantry support unit. Shunned by most MechWarriors due to its notoriously unstable gait, the Scorpion would nevertheless see uninterrupted use throughout the Succession Wars and beyond. The Scorpion 1N is powered by a 330-rated Fusion Core giving it a top speed of 97 km/h. A PPC and an SRM-6 form the Mechs weapons load.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为首批量产四足机甲之一，55 吨的蝎式于 2570 年作为步兵支援单位投产。由于出了名的不稳步态，蝎式被大多数机甲战士嫌弃，却仍在继承战争及之后被不间断地使用。蝎式 1N 由 330 额定聚变核心驱动，最高速度 97 公里/小时，武器为一门 PPC 和一具 SRM-6。

The design replaces most of the technology in the 'Mech with Clan-grade equivalents, considerably improving the performance compared to the original Scorpion designs. Quirk: Improved Lifesupport Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这台机甲曾在狼之龙骑兵于内层星域的征战中使用。该设计把机甲上的大部分技术替换为部族级同类装备，性能比原版蝎子设计有了显著提升。 <特性：改进生命维持系统 <投放费用倍率：1.09

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Sentinel is a medium BattleMech built by Defiance Industries, originally under exclusive contract for the Lyran Commonwealth, as an infantry support and installation defense 'Mech. While initially pleased to have a then Terran Hegemony controlled factory manufacturing the 'Mech exclusively for the LCAF, the Lyrans were less so when a Star League Council amendment in 2652 permitted the Star League Defense Force to purchase a highly advanced version of the design which Houses Steiner, Marik and Davion would not receive until years later. The Sentinel was one of many designs to suffer from the technological decline of the Succession Wars era, with Defiance first losing the ability to manufacture its advanced weapon systems before discontinuing production entirely in 3014 due to lack of both parts and interest. Rather than disappear from the battlefield, the Sentinel now began to appear in increasing numbers thanks to ComStar and its massive stockpile of SLDF material, both providing the design to the Draconis Combine prior to the War of 3039 and using it to help outfit its Com Guards. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 哨兵是迪法恩斯工业建造的中型战斗机甲，最初依莱兰联邦独家合同作为步兵支援与设施防御机甲。莱兰人起初为有一家当时由地球霸权控制的工厂专为 LCAF 制造该机甲而欣喜，但当 2652 年星盟理事会修正案允许星盟防卫军采购该设计的高度先进版本、而施泰纳、马里克与达维昂家族要多年后才能获得时，他们的喜悦便大打折扣。哨兵是继承战争时代技术衰退的众多受害者之一：迪法恩斯先失去制造其先进武器系统的能力，随后于 3014 年因零件与需求双双匮乏而彻底停产。然而哨兵并未从战场消失——凭借康星及其庞大的星盟防卫军物资储备，它反而越来越多地出现：康星既在 3039 年战争前把该设计提供给德拉科尼斯联合体，也用它装备自己的康卫。 特质：改进型通讯 投放费用倍率：1 臂部驱动器限制：左上臂

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 1S Sentinel was the original production model commissioned by House Steiner in 2651. The 1S lacked the advanced technologies of the 3L, mounting an Defiance Model F AC/5 instead of the advanced Ultra model and a Conventry Quad-Rack SRM-4 instead of the Streak Missile Launcher. The 1S also mounted a half ton more armor, but is otherwise identical to the 3L. After years of hassles and bureaucratic maneuvering, all Lyran 1S Sentinels were eventually upgraded to 3L, only to be all but destroyed during the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 1S哨兵是斯坦纳家族于2651年委托建造的原始量产型号。1S缺乏3L的先进技术，装的是反抗F型AC/5而非先进的超速型号，以及一具考文垂四联SRM-4而非连发导弹发射器。1S还多装了半吨装甲，但除此之外与3L相同。经过多年麻烦与官僚运作，所有莱兰1S哨兵最终都被升级为3L，却只是在继承战争中几乎全部被摧毁。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Star League Sentinel carried a somewhat unique and highly advanced armament for its time. Its primary weapon was a Kawabata Weapons Industries Ultra Autocannon/5. Developed especially for the 3L, this advanced weapon was capable of firing at double the rate of a standard AC/5, at the cost of slightly increased possibility of jamming the weapon until it can be overhauled. The Sentinel also mounted an advanced Defiance Streak SRM-2, the launcher designed to only fire if it gains a lock, saving ammo until the entire salvo is virtually guaranteed to hit. However the weapon's benefits were hampered by the companion Small laser, the swap from the fragile A-1 for more sturdy Defiance B-1A moved the launcher's ammo feed by half a meter, resulting in ammo jams during abrupt maneuvers. Though MechWarriors discovered that they could clear a jam in the field by thumping the 'Mech's chest with its right fist, opponents quickly learned to concentrate fire on any Sentinel performing this, forcing pilots to retreat from battle anyway.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 星际联盟的哨兵在当时携带了一套颇为独特且高度先进的武器。主武器是一门川端武器工业超级自动炮/5。这门专为3L研制的先进武器射速可达标准AC/5的两倍，代价是卡壳直到彻底检修前无法使用的几率略高。哨兵还装有一具先进的挑战连发SRM-2，该发射器只在锁定后才开火，从而节省弹药、直到整次齐射几乎必中。然而这门武器的优势被其配套的小型激光拖累：从脆弱的A-1换成更坚固的挑战B-1A，使发射器供弹位置移动了半米，导致急机动时弹药卡滞。虽然机甲战士发现可以用右拳猛击机甲胸口来现场排除卡滞，对手很快学会集中火力打击任何这样做的哨兵，迫使飞行员无论如何都得退出战斗。

While initially pleased to have a then Terran Hegemony controlled factory manufacturing the 'Mech exclusively for the LCAF, the Lyrans were less so when a Star League Council amendment in 2652 permitted the Star League Defense Force to purchase a highly advanced version of the design which Houses Steiner, Marik and Davion would not receive until years later. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Sentinel 是由 Defiance Industries 制造的中型战斗机甲，最初依据独家合同为莱兰联邦打造，用作步兵支援与设施防御机甲。起初莱兰人还很满意——那座当时由地球霸权掌控的工厂专为 LCAF 生产该机甲；但当星际联盟议会于 2652 年通过修正案，允许星际联盟国防军采购该设计的高度先进版本，而施泰纳、马里克和达维昂家族还要再等数年才能获得时，莱兰人就不那么高兴了。Sentinel 是众多受继承战争时代技术衰退拖累的设计之一：Defiance 先是丧失了制造其先进武器系统的能力，随后又因缺少零件且缺乏兴趣，于 3014 年彻底停产。但 Sentinel 并未从战场上消失，反而开始以越来越多的数量出现——这要归功于通讯之星及其庞大的星际联盟国防军物资储备：它既在 3039 年战争前夕把该设计提供给龙脉联合体，又用它来装备自己的通讯之星卫队。 特性：改进通讯 投放费用倍率：1.04 手臂驱动器限制：左臂上部

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Royal version of the Sentinel featured a significantly upgraded weapon load-out, mounting a Gauss Rifle in place of the autocannon and a Medium Laser in place of the Streak rack, retaining the small laser. To handle the weight of the Gauss Rifle, it was almost entirely rebuilt using a XL engine and Endo-Steel structure, with the one and a half tons of Ferro-Fibrous plate enhancing its protection.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 哨兵的皇家版本拥有显著升级的武器载荷，以一门磁轨炮取代自动炮、一门中型激光器取代连发SRM架，保留小型激光器。为承受磁轨炮的重量，它几乎完全重建，采用XL引擎与内层钢结构，另以一吨半铁纤装甲板增强防护。

Prodcution of the Mech was discontinued when modern clan spec weapons entered production. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.01 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Upper

While House Kurita was angered as much as the loss of the LosTech system as the use of a `foreign` Magistracy of Canopus manufactured launcher, the swap allowed the small laser to be upgraded to Magna Mk II Medium Laser.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为"玫瑰花蕾行动"的一部分，由康星提供给龙尼斯联合体的降级版STN-3M型号兼具3L与3K哨兵的特征，保留了先进机甲的超速自动炮，但把连发SRM架换成标准马金迷你SRM-2发射器。虽然栗田家族既为失去失传科技系统、也为使用一件"外国"卡诺帕治安官辖区制造的发射器而愤怒，这一更换却使小型激光器得以升级为玛格纳Mk II中型激光器。

Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A 45 ton Clan OmniMech, the Shadow Cat was designed as a replacement for the Ice Ferret. Debuting in 3003, the OmniMech is powered by a 270-rated XL Engine with a combination of Endo Steel and Ferro-Fibrous providing the free weight for 17 tons of pod space. 6 Jump Jets and MASC are hardwired to the chassis, enhancing it’s mobility. The Shadow Cat TC was originally a custom variant, but made a name for itself on Tukayyid; fighting against the massed tanks and infantry of the Comguard. An LB-10X, supported by a pair of Small Pulse Lasers and an SRM-4 make up the TC’s weapons, while an Active Probe allows the TC to scout enemy positions. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 影猫是一款 45 吨的部族全向机甲，设计初衷是替代冰貂。该全向机甲于 3003 年首次亮相，由一台额定 270 的 XL 引擎驱动，并借助内骨架与铁纤维的组合腾出重量，提供 17 吨挂载空间。6 台跳跃推进器与 MASC 硬接在底盘上，进一步增强了机动性。影猫 TC 原本只是一款定制变型，却在图卡伊德一战中声名鹊起，当时它与通讯之星卫队的大批坦克和步兵交战。TC 的武器包括一门 LB-10X，辅以两门小型脉冲激光和一部 SRM-4，而一个主动探测器则让 TC 能够侦察敌方阵地。 特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：1.04 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A 45 ton Clan OmniMech, the Shadow Cat was designed as a replacement for the Ice Ferret. Debuting in 3003, the OmniMech is powered by a 270-rated XL Engine with a combination of Endo Steel and Ferro-Fibrous providing the free weight for 17 tons of pod space. 6 Jump Jets and MASC are hardwired to the chassis, enhancing it’s mobility. The Shadow Cat TC was originally a custom variant, but made a name for itself on Tukayyid; fighting against the massed tanks and infantry of the Comguard. An LB-10X, supported by a pair of Small Pulse Lasers and an SRM-4 make up the TC’s weapons, while an Active Probe allows the TC to scout enemy positions.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为45吨氏族全方位机甲，影猫被设计为冰貂的替代品。它于3003年首次亮相，由一具270级XL引擎驱动，内层钢与铁纤的组合提供了17吨吊舱空间的自由重量。6个跳跃推进器和MASC固接在底盘上，增强其机动性。影猫TC原本是定制改型，但在图卡伊德打出了名声；它在对抗康卫队集结的坦克与步兵时大放异彩。一门LB-10X，配以两门小型脉冲激光器和一具SRM-4构成TC的武器，而一个主动探测器让TC能侦察敌方阵地。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The U loadout drops both the MASC and the Jump Jets, which allows the 'Mech to carry more armor and better cooling. The mounted weapons are two Large Pulse Lasers and two ER Medium Lasers. To save costs the chassis is also downgraded to standard specification instead of using Endo Steel. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: U配置拆除了MASC和跳跃推进器，使机甲能够携带更多装甲并拥有更好的散热能力。装备的武器为两门大型脉冲激光和两门增程中型激光。为节省成本，底盘也降级为标准规格，不再使用内骨架。 特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：1.04 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Shadow Cat is a heavily-armed and maneuverable medium OmniMech developed by Clan Nova Cat to replace the Ice Ferret in the early 31st century during preparations for Operation Revival. The primary configuration of the Shadow Cat wields a Gauss Rifle allowing it to handily defeat smaller opponents, often before they can get within range. A pair of smaller ER Medium Lasers back up the rifle, and an Active Probe gives the Shadow Cat the ability to detect hidden units, making it a capable scout.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 影猫是新星猫氏族在三十一世纪初"复兴行动"筹备期间为取代冰貂而开发的重视武装且机动的中型全能机甲。影猫主配置装备一具高斯步枪，使它轻松击败较小的对手——往往在对方进入射程之前。两门较小的 ER 中型激光为步枪提供后备，主动探测器让影猫能发现隐藏单位，使其成为能干的侦察机甲。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The V configuration mounts two Large Pulse Laser and two ER Medium Lasers, making it an all energy weapon build. To handle the increased heat three additional double heat sinks were added, but in turn dropped the MASC and carries no equipment for electronic warfare. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: V 配置装设两门大型脉冲激光和两门增程中型激光，是一套纯能量武器的配置。为应对增加的热量，额外加装了三具双散热器，但相应取消了 MASC，并且未携带任何电子战设备。 特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：1.04 手臂驱动器限制：全向

This allows the use of three Large Pulse Lasers as the main armament of the 'Mech, with three additional heat sinks to deal with the heat build-up. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The X loadout is used when a formal battle challenge, more commonly knows as a batchall, is used. Since the Gauss rifle of the primary configuration is too unwieldy during such combat a LBX/5 autocannon is used instead, accompanied by a Large Pulse Laser and two SRM-4 launchers. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: X 配置用于正式的战斗挑战——通常称为“batchall”（议战）——的场合。由于主配置的高斯步枪在此类战斗中过于笨重，因此改用一门 LBX/5 自动炮，并搭配一门大型脉冲激光和两具 SRM-4 发射器。 特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：1.04 手臂驱动器限制：全向机甲

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Shadow Hawk IIC is a second-line Clan BattleMech based upon the Shadow Hawk that was first fielded by the Star League. The first version of the Shadow Hawk IIC is meant for close-range fighting, and appears to be designed with urban warfare in mind. It is armed with a Medium Pulse Laser in each arm, two Streak SRM-2 launchers in each side torso, an ER Medium Laser in the head, and an ER Small Laser in the torso. Ten double heat sinks take care of most heat, especially since the Streaks will build no heat if they do not achieve a lock and fire. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.07
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 影子鹰 IIC 是以星际联盟最初投入战场的影子鹰为基础开发的二线部族战斗机甲。影子鹰 IIC 的第一个版本专为近距离近战设计，其思路显然针对城市战。它在每只手臂各装一门中型脉冲激光，每个侧躯干各装两部连发 SRM-2 发射器，头部一门 ER 中型激光，躯干一门 ER 小型激光。十台双散热器足以应付大部分热量，尤其是连发导弹在未能锁定而未发射时不会产生任何热量。 特性：战拳 投放费用倍率：1.07

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Boss, these Shadow Hawk IICs are a sleek redesign of the classic Shadow Hawk.  They are lighter and faster than the original but still manage to pack a similar punch.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 老板，这些暗影鹰 IIC 是经典暗影鹰的全新流线设计。它们比原版更轻更快，却仍保有相近的打击力。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Shadow Hawk IIC is a second-line Clan BattleMech based upon the Shadow Hawk that was first fielded by the Star League. The second variant is designed for long-range, direct-fire support using two ER Large Lasers as its primary weapons. The ER Small Laser is retained and supplemented by three Small Pulse Lasers for close in work. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.07
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 影子鹰IIC是一款以星际联盟最初装备的影子鹰为基础的部族二线战斗机甲。其第二种变型专为远程直射支援而设计，以两具增程大型激光为主武器；原有的增程小型激光被保留，并增配三具小型脉冲激光用于近距离作战。 特性：战拳 投放费用倍率：1.07

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Boss, these Shadow Hawk IICs are a sleek redesign of the classic Shadow Hawk.  They are lighter and faster than the original but still manage to pack a similar punch.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 老板，这些暗影鹰 IIC 是经典暗影鹰的全新流线设计。它们比原版更轻更快，却仍保有相近的打击力。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Shadow Hawk IIC is a second-line Clan BattleMech based upon the Shadow Hawk that was first fielded by the Star League. A newer variant that dates to the late 3050s, the IIC 3's primary weapon is a Heavy Large Laser, supplemented by a Medium Pulse Laser. The 'Mech carries paired ER Micro Lasers and Micro Pulse Lasers should it find itself in a close range fight. Four additional double heat sinks keep down the heat generated by the all-laser complement. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Shadow Hawk IIC 是部族的二线战斗机甲，以星际联盟最初投入战场的 Shadow Hawk 为基础。作为可追溯至 3050 年代末的较新变型，IIC 3 的主武器是一门重型大型激光，并以一门中型脉冲激光作为补充。若陷入近距离交战，该机甲还配备成对的增程微型激光与微型脉冲激光。四具额外的双散热器用于压制这套全激光武器配置产生的热量。 特性：战拳 投放费用倍率：1.09

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Boss, these Shadow Hawk IICs are a sleek redesign of the classic Shadow Hawk.  They are lighter and faster than the original but still manage to pack a similar punch.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 老板，这些暗影鹰 IIC 是经典暗影鹰的全新流线设计。它们比原版更轻更快，却仍保有相近的打击力。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Shadow Hawk IIC is a second-line Clan BattleMech based upon the Shadow Hawk that was first fielded by the Star League. First fielded in 3060, the IIC 4 was a joint effort by Clan Nova Cat and Clan Diamond Shark to upgrade their second-line forces. The result was a 'Mech that is visually very different from the design it is considered a variant of. This 'Mech carries a ATM 6 System with three tons of varied ammunition to allow for flexibility of choice. The missile launcher is backed up by two Medium Pulse Lasers and an ER Medium Laser. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.07
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Shadow Hawk IIC是基于星际联盟最初投入使用的Shadow Hawk而开发的部族二线战斗机甲。IIC 4于3060年首次投入使用，是Nova Cat部族与Diamond Shark部族为升级其二线部队而联合推出的成果。其成品在视觉上与它所被视为改型的那款设计大不相同。这台机甲装有ATM 6系统，配有3吨不同种类的弹药以提供选择上的灵活性。导弹发射器则由两门中型脉冲激光与一门增程中型激光作为后盾。 特性：战拳 投放费用倍率：1.07

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Boss, these Shadow Hawk IICs are a sleek redesign of the classic Shadow Hawk.  They are lighter and faster than the original but still manage to pack a similar punch.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 老板，这些暗影鹰 IIC 是经典暗影鹰的全新流线设计。它们比原版更轻更快，却仍保有相近的打击力。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The original and considerably flawed prototypes were completed in 2680. Based on the Shadow Hawk SHD-2H, the 'Mech carried a Class 2 Autocannon in place of the Class 5. The SHD-X1 carried only 6.5 tons of armor for protection. Only one chassis survived multiple crashes caused by its faulty schematics. It had a top ground speed of 86.4 km/h like its progenitor, the SHD-2H, and used ten single heat sinks. Field refits to increase firepower with wing-mounted weapons were common, but often caused more problems than they solved. Quirk: Land Air Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 最初的原型机于 2680 年完成，缺陷相当明显。这台机甲以 Shadow Hawk SHD-2H 为基础，用 2 级自动炮取代了 5 级自动炮。SHD-X1 仅携带 6.5 吨装甲作为防护。由于图纸存在缺陷，多台原型机接连坠毁，最终只有一个底盘幸存下来。它的最高地面速度与其鼻祖 SHD-2H 相同，为 86.4 km/h，并使用十台单散热器。为增强火力而在翼端加装武器的野战改装十分常见，但往往带来的麻烦比解决的问题更多。 特性：陆空机甲 投放费用倍率：1.05

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The original and considerably flawed prototypes were completed in 2680. Based on the Shadow Hawk SHD-2H, the 'Mech carried a Class 2 Autocannon in place of the Class 5. The SHD-X1 carried only 6.5 tons of armor for protection. Only one chassis survived multiple crashes caused by its faulty schematics. It had a top ground speed of 86.4 km/h like its progenitor, the SHD-2H, and used ten single heat sinks. Field refits to increase firepower with wing-mounted weapons were common, but often caused more problems than they solved.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 最初那批缺陷颇多的原型于2680年完成。基于影子鹰SHD-2H，该机甲以一门2级自动炮取代5级自动炮。SHD-X1只携带6.5吨装甲作为防护。只有一台底盘在其故障图纸造成的多次坠毁中幸存。它像其前身SHD-2H一样最高地面速度86.4公里/小时，并使用十具单重散热器。用翼载武器提升火力的战地改装很常见，但往往带来的问题多于解决的。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Allied Aerospace won the SLDF's contract to produce a series of Land-Air mechs with a design based on the venerable Shadow HawkBattleMech. Allied gave their new Land-Air 'Mech the ability to convert directly into an Aerospace Fighter. While construction was completed in 2680, thanks to the chassis' numerous flaws, lackluster performance and a number of ill-fated and publicly witnessed test-flights disasters during SLDF reviews in 2682, Allied Aerospace was forced to go back to the drawing board. The more refined X2 variant faced considerable scrutiny by SLDF evaluators in 2684, successfully meeting the SLDF's requirements but still rejected thanks to its high fuel consumption and the bad press generated by the earlier X1. Twenty SHD-X2 were built for trials with potential customers, but failed to attract any interest. Ultimately Allied scrapped the Shadow Hawk LAM program in favor of what became the considerably more successful Phoenix Hawk LAM. Quirk: Land Air Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 同盟航空航天公司赢得了 SLDF 的合同，要以久负盛名的 Shadow Hawk 战斗机甲为基础设计一系列陆空机甲。同盟为他们的新型陆空机甲赋予了直接变形成航空航天战斗机的能力。虽然建造工作于 2680 年完成，但由于底盘存在诸多缺陷、性能乏善可陈，加上 2682 年 SLDF 审查期间发生的多起结局不幸且被公开目睹的试飞事故，同盟航空航天公司被迫回到设计图前重新来过。经过进一步改进的 X2 改型在 2684 年接受了 SLDF 评估人员的严格审查，虽然成功满足了 SLDF 的要求，却仍因燃料消耗过高以及早期 X1 造成的负面舆论而被否决。共有二十台 SHD-X2 被制造出来供潜在客户试用，却未能引起任何兴趣。最终，同盟放弃了 Shadow Hawk LAM 项目，转而发展后来取得更大成功的 Phoenix Hawk LAM。 特性：陆空机甲 投放费用倍率：1.05

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Allied Aerospace won the SLDF's contract to produce a series of Land-Air mechs with a design based on the venerable Shadow HawkBattleMech. Allied gave their new Land-Air 'Mech the ability to convert directly into an Aerospace Fighter. While construction was completed in 2680, thanks to the chassis' numerous flaws, lackluster performance and a number of ill-fated and publicly witnessed test-flights disasters during SLDF reviews in 2682, Allied Aerospace was forced to go back to the drawing board. The more refined X2 variant faced considerable scrutiny by SLDF evaluators in 2684, successfully meeting the SLDF's requirements but still rejected thanks to its high fuel consumption and the bad press generated by the earlier X1. Twenty SHD-X2 were built for trials with potential customers, but failed to attract any interest. Ultimately Allied scrapped the Shadow Hawk LAM program in favor of what became the considerably more successful Phoenix Hawk LAM.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 联合航空赢得星盟防卫军生产一系列陆空机甲的合同，设计以古老的影鹰战斗机甲为基础。联合航空让新型陆空机甲能直接变身为航空战斗机。虽然制造于 2680 年完成，但由于底盘缺陷众多、性能不佳，加上 2682 年星盟防卫军评审期间一系列不幸且公开可见的试飞灾难，联合航空被迫重头再来。更精细的 X2 变体于 2684 年接受了星盟评审员的严格审查，虽然成功满足星盟要求，却仍因高燃料消耗和早期 X1 造成的负面报道而被否决。二十台 SHD-X2 被造出来供潜在客户试用，却未能引起任何兴趣。最终联合航空放弃了影鹰 LAM 项目，转而投向后来相当成功的凤凰鹰 LAM。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The original and considerably flawed prototypes were completed in 2680. Based on the Shadow Hawk SHD-2H, the 'Mech carried a Pair of SRM-6 Valiant in place of the Class 5 Autocannon. The SHD-X3 carried only 6.5 tons of armor for protection. Only one chassis survived multiple crashes caused by its faulty schematics. It had a top ground speed of 86.4 km/h like its progenitor, the SHD-2H, and used ten single heat sinks. Field refits to increase firepower with wing-mounted weapons were common, but often caused more problems than they solved. Quirk: Land Air Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05

Only one chassis survived multiple crashes caused by its faulty schematics. It had a top ground speed of 86.4 km/h like its progenitor, the SHD-2H, and used ten single heat sinks. Field refits to increase firepower with wing-mounted weapons were common, but often caused more problems than they solved.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 最初那批缺陷颇多的原型于2680年完成。基于影子鹰SHD-2H，该机甲以一对SRM-6"勇敢"取代5级自动炮。SHD-X3只携带6.5吨装甲作为防护。只有一台底盘在其故障图纸造成的多次坠毁中幸存。它像其前身SHD-2H一样最高地面速度86.4公里/小时，并使用十具单重散热器。用翼载武器提升火力的战地改装很常见，但往往带来的问题多于解决的。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Introduced in 3024, this variant of the Shadow Hawk drops the SHD-2H's SRM-2 rack to free up the weight for a medium claw fitted in the SHD-1P's left arm. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该影子鹰变型于3024年推出，它拆去SHD-2H的SRM-2发射架以腾出重量，在SHD-1P的左臂上安装了一具中型爪。 特性：战拳 投放费用倍率：1.03

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A multirole BattleMech developed in 2550 during the Golden Age, the Shadow Hawk is a powerful fusion of maneuverability and firepower. With a mix of long-range and short-range weapons, good maneuverability thanks to jump jets, and excellent endurance, the Shadow Hawk has long been regarded as one of the best 'Mechs in its weight class. The Shadow Hawk is equally adept whether commanding a reconnaissance company or serving as a spotter for heavy and assault lances.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 暗影鹰是黄金时代 2550 年开发的多用途战斗机甲，是机动性与火力的强效融合。远程与近程武器的搭配、借助跳跃推进器获得的良好机动性、以及出色的续航力，使暗影鹰长期以来被视为同重量级中最好的机甲之一。无论是指挥侦察连，还是为重型与突击小队担任目标指示，暗影鹰都同样胜任。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 2D2 is an upgrade of the -2D Shadow Hawk introduced in 3049, born of the Federated Commonwealth buying original-model 2Hs from Majesty Metals and refitting them for use by militia forces or for sale to mercenaries. Like the 2D this upgrade adds another SRM launcher to the center torso and a medium laser to the left arm, however both center torso and head launchers are Federated SuperStreak Streak SRM-2s. Besides carrying slightly more armor, a total of six and a half tons, and one ton of Streak ammo in the right torso, it is otherwise identical to the 2D Shadow Hawk. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A heavily modified variant of the Shadow Hawk, using Clan tech to improve its performance greatly. Originally conceptualized by Grey Death Legion, the variant has seen some spread to other mercenaries as well. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Shadow Hawk 的重度改装变型，运用部族科技大幅提升了性能。该变型最初由灰死军团构想，后来也流传到了其他雇佣兵手中。 特性：战拳 投放费用倍率：1.11

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An early clan Mech dating from the days of Operation Klondike, the Shadow Hawk SHD-2Hb-EC was an upgrade of the Royal SHD-2Hb that replaced the weapons with Early Clan variants. It would be discontinued and forgotten as modern clan spec weapons entered production. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为一款可追溯到“克朗代克行动”时代的早期部族机甲，Shadow Hawk SHD-2Hb-EC 是皇家型 SHD-2Hb 的升级版，将武器替换为早期部族型号。随着现代部族规格武器投入生产，它被停产并逐渐被人遗忘。 特性：战拳 投放费用倍率：1.05

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An early clan Mech dating from the days of Operation Klondike, the Shadow Hawk SHD-2Hb-EC was an upgrade of the Royal SHD-2Hb that replaced the weapons with Early Clan variants. It would be discontinued and forgotten as modern clan spec weapons entered production.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A refit of the 2H, dropping 2 heat sinks to mount CASE protection for the ammunition and a C3 slave unit. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是2H的改装，拆掉2个散热器以加装弹药CASE防护和一台C3从机。 特性：战拳 投放费用倍率：1.03

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A Clan Buster upgrade, the Shadow Hawk 2Ht was a Comstar refit built with scrapped SLDF plans and modified for use as an Elemental hunter. Built on the standard SHD-2H chassis, the original 275-rated Fusion Core is retained along with the pair of arm mounted Medium Lasers. Replacing the AC/5 is a Large Laser, while 5 Streak SRM-2’s and a ton of ammo replace the original missile launchers. DHS replaces the original SHS, freeing up weight for CASE and an extra pair of Jump Jets. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为一项“反部族”升级，影鹰2Ht是通讯之星利用废弃的星际联盟防卫军图纸打造、并改造为元素猎手的改装型。它沿用标准SHD-2H底盘，保留275额定聚变核心和2门装在手臂上的中型激光。AC/5被1门大型激光取代，原有的导弹发射器则由5具连发SRM-2和1吨弹药顶替。双散热器取代了原来的单散热器，腾出的重量用于安装CASE和2具额外的跳跃推进器。 <特性：战拳 <投放费用倍率：1.05

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A Clan Buster upgrade, the Shadow Hawk 2Ht was a Comstar refit built with scrapped SLDF plans and modified for use as an Elemental hunter. Built on the standard SHD-2H chassis, the original 275-rated Fusion Core is retained along with the pair of arm mounted Medium Lasers. Replacing the AC/5 is a Large Laser, while 5 Streak SRM-2’s and a ton of ammo replace the original missile launchers. Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Introduced in 2846, this variant of the Shadow Hawk replaces its AC/5 with a medium rifle, supplied by two tons of ammunition. Further changes include an additional ton of ammunition for the LRM-5 launcher, the removal of two single heat sinks and the installation of a supercharger. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是2846年推出的影子鹰变型，以一门中型步枪（配两吨弹药）取代AC/5。其他改动还包括为LRM-5发射器增加一吨弹药、拆掉两个单散热器，并安装一台增压器。 特性：战拳 投放费用倍率：1.03

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A multirole BattleMech developed in 2550 during the Golden Age, the Shadow Hawk is a powerful fusion of maneuverability and firepower. Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A rare ''upgrade'' to the classic Shadow Hawk, the SHD-3H arose out of the political manoeuvring that surrounded the development of the Royal Shadow Hawk. Created as cover for the 2Hb program, the SHD-3H is a stock Shadow Hawk refitted for anti-insurgent work. A pair of Machine Guns and a ton of ammo replace the original SRM-2. The design can still be seen well into the 31st century with units lacking supplies often being forced to convert damaged 2H models to the 3H standard. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为对经典影子鹰的一次罕见“升级”，SHD-3H源于围绕皇家影子鹰研制而展开的政治运作。3H是为2Hb计划作掩护而造，是把现成影子鹰改装用于反叛乱工作的产物。一对机枪和一吨弹药取代了原来的SRM-2。直到31世纪仍能看到这一设计，缺乏补给的部队往往被迫把受损的2H型号改成3H标准。 特性：战拳 投放费用倍率：1.03

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A rare ''upgrade'' to the classic Shadow Hawk, the SHD-3H arose out of the political manoeuvring that surrounded the development of the Royal Shadow Hawk. Created as cover for the 2Hb program, the SHD-3H is a stock Shadow Hawk refitted for anti-insurgent work. A pair of Machine Guns and a ton of ammo replace the original SRM-2. The design can still be seen well into the 31st century with units lacking supplies often being forced to convert damaged 2H models to the 3H standard.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为对经典影子鹰的一次稀有"升级"，SHD-3H源自围绕皇家影子鹰研发的政治运作。它作为2Hb项目的掩护而创，是一台为反叛乱工作改装的现有影子鹰。两挺机枪和一吨弹药取代了原有的SRM-2。直到三十一世纪仍可见到该设计，缺乏补给的部队常被迫把受损的2H型号改装为3H标准。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An offshoot of the SHD-3H design, the Shadow Hawk SHD-3H2 is a full redesign of the 3H model. Intended for Terran Hegemony militia units, the 3H2 is optimised for anti-vehicle and anti-insurgent warfare. Somewhat slower then a standard Shadow Hawk due to the replacement of the 275 rated engine with a 220 rated one, the 3H2 uses the extra weight to pack in a pair of Small Lasers, 3 SRM-4 launchers and a Vehicular Grenade Launcher. Leftover Ferro-Fibrous armour from the Royal SHD-2Hb production line is used to improve armour protection. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为 SHD-3H 设计的分支，暗影鹰 SHD-3H2 是对 3H 型号的全面重新设计。3H2 面向地球霸权民兵部队，针对反车辆与反叛乱作战进行了优化。由于 275 级引擎被替换为 220 级，它比标准暗影鹰稍慢一些，3H2 便利用多出的重量塞进了两门小型激光、3 具 SRM-4 发射器和一具车载榴弹发射器。皇家 SHD-2Hb 生产线上剩余的铁纤维装甲被用于加强装甲防护。 特性：战拳 投放费用倍率：1.03

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An offshoot of the SHD-3H design, the Shadow Hawk SHD-3H2 is a full redesign of the 3H model. Intended for Terran Hegemony militia units, the 3H2 is optimised for anti-vehicle and anti-insurgent warfare. Somewhat slower then a standard Shadow Hawk due to the replacement of the 275 rated engine with a 220 rated one, the 3H2 uses the extra weight to pack in a pair of Small Lasers, 3 SRM-4 launchers and a Vehicular Grenade Launcher. Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 5S2 has the same layout as the 5S, expect a slightly adjusted armor profile. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 5S2的布局与5S相同，只是装甲分布略有调整。 特性：战拳 投放费用倍率：1.05

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 5SF is a variant of the 5M used by the Special Forces. It replaces all standard weapons with one Large Laser, one medium pulse laser and four medium lasers. In addition, it carries a Beagle Active Probe and an ECM Suite. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 5SF是特种部队使用的5M变型。它以一门大型激光、一门中型脉冲激光和四门中型激光取代全部标准武器，此外还带一台比格犬主动探测器和一套电子对抗套件。 特性：战拳 投放费用倍率：1.05

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 5SF is a variant of the 5M used by the Special Forces. It replaces all standard weapons with one Large Laser, one medium pulse laser and four medium lasers. In addition, it carries a Beagle Active Probe and an ECM Suite.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A Clan-tech retrofit of the classic Shadow Hawk and intended for second-line and solahma troops, the Shadow Hawk C replaces all Inner Sphere–tech weaponry with Clan equivalents. The C mounts an LB 5-X AC, an LRM-5 equipped with Swarm LRM munitions, a Streak SRM-2, and an ER medium laser. Two additional jump jets were added, extending the jump radius to 150 meters, as well as one additional single heat sink. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 影子鹰C是对经典影子鹰的部族技术改装，供二线与索拉玛部队使用，它以部族同类武器替换了全部内层星域技术的武器。C型装备一门LB 5-X自动炮、一具使用蜂群LRM弹药的LRM-5、一具连发SRM-2和一具增程中型激光。它还加装了两具跳跃推进器，把跳跃半径扩大到150米，并增加了一具单散热器。 特性：战拳 投放费用倍率：1.03

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A custom variant supposedly created by Grayson Death Carlyle, despite the fact that neither Grayson nor second Shadow Hawk pilot Sharyl piloted such a variant, the Gray Death swaps the AC/5 for an AC/10 with two tons of ammunition, and carries two medium lasers in each arm. The LRM-5 and SRM-2 are kept, along with the three jump jets, and cooling is handled by 12 double heat sinks. The tonnage required for the heavier weapons loadout is freed up by using a 275-rated XL engine. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这个定制变型据称出自格雷森·戴斯·卡莱尔之手，尽管格雷森本人和二号 Shadow Hawk 机师莎莉尔都从未驾驶过这样的变型。Gray Death 以一门 AC/10 和两吨弹药替换了 AC/5，并在每条手臂各装两门中型激光。LRM-5 和 SRM-2 得以保留，三具跳跃推进器也一并留下，散热则由 12 具双散热器负责。更重武器配置所需的吨位，通过换装 275 级 XL 引擎腾出。 特性：战拳 投放费用倍率：1.05

The Shadow Hawk is equally adept whether commanding a reconnaissance company or serving as a spotter for heavy and assault lances.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This custom Shadow Hawk mounts a trio of LB 2-X ACs in it's right torso supported by a pair of MRM-10 racks in the left torso. Built around an 255-rated XL engine, double heat sinks, endo steel frame and clad in light ferro-fibrous armor, the Scattershot carries a total of three tons of LBX rounds and three tons of MRM reloads. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.07
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这台定制影子鹰在右躯干装三门LB 2-X自动炮，左躯干则以两具MRM-10挂架支援。它围绕一台255额定XL引擎、双散热器与内骨架框架建造，披挂轻型铁纤维装甲，总共携带三吨LBX弹药与三吨MRM再装填弹药。 特性：战拳 投放费用倍率：1.07

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A multirole BattleMech developed in 2550 during the Golden Age, the Shadow Hawk is a powerful fusion of maneuverability and firepower. With a mix of long-range and short-range weapons, good maneuverability thanks to jump jets, and excellent endurance, the Shadow Hawk has long been regarded as one of the best 'Mechs in its weight class. The Shadow Hawk is equally adept whether commanding a reconnaissance company or serving as a spotter for heavy and assault lances.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Sheepdog is more advanced than its first deceiving appearance, using Ferro-Fibrous armor, Endo Steel structure and an 100 XL engine - all to save weight. One medium laser and one small laser are accompanied by a strong sensor suite, a C3 slave and a MASC system for even faster movement. Quirk: Improved Sensors Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Sheepdog 比它初看之下极具迷惑性的外表要先进得多：它采用铁纤维装甲、内骨架结构和一台 100 XL 引擎，一切都是为了减轻重量。一门中型激光和一门小型激光之外，还搭配了强大的传感器套件、一个 C3 从属单元以及一套 MASC 系统，使移动更加迅捷。 特性：改进传感器 投放费用倍率：0.99

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Sheepdog is a 10-ton ultralight 'Mech commonly seen sprinting across the battlefield throughout the Inner Sphere. Although both lightly armored and under-armed, its sheer speed makes it a decently competent scout - as long as the 'Mech never stops moving.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 牧羊犬是一种10吨超轻型机甲，常见于内天体各处疾驰过战场。虽然装甲轻薄、武装不足，但它纯粹的速度使它成为相当称职的侦察兵——只要这台机甲永不停止移动。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Downgraded by the Dragoons to Succession Wars era technology the 2E simply carries a PPC in place of the ER PPC. Otherwise, the 2E is completely identical to the 2F model. Ironically, because the 2E uses an older PPC model, the PPC produces less heat at the cost of a shorter range than the 2F model, making the 'Mech's waste heat easier to manage. Quirk: Barrel Fist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 龙骑兵将该机降级至继承战争时代的技术水平，2E 仅以粒子炮取代增程粒子炮。除此之外，2E 与 2F 型完全相同。颇具讽刺意味的是，由于 2E 使用较老的粒子炮型号，其粒子炮产生的热量更少，但射程比 2F 型更短，反而让机甲废热的管控更为容易。 特性：炮管拳 投放费用倍率：1.15 手臂驱动器限制：左下臂、右下臂

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Shogun began production before the Star League fell and eventually was thought to be lost to the Succession Wars. The 'Mech suddenly reappeared when Wolf's Dragoons showed up in 3005, bringing a sizable number of Shoguns with them. The 'Mech was intended to be used as an urban combat 'Mech where its jumping distance and slow speed makes it able to easily traverse the close confines of a city. Though the Dragoons brought Shoguns with them from the Clan Homeworlds, they could not reach a deal with any manufacturer that met their desires, so by 3068 the total count of the 'Mech in the Inner Sphere was reduced to two, both of which were in the hands of Wannamaker's Widowmakers, taken as salvage from the Dragoons.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 将军在星盟陨落之前就已投产，最终被认为已随继承战争失传。当狼之龙骑兵于 3005 年现身时，这台机甲突然重现，龙骑兵带来了数量可观的将军。该机甲本意是用作城市战机甲，其跳跃距离与缓慢速度使它能在城市的狭窄空间中轻松穿行。尽管龙骑兵从氏族母星带来了将军，他们却未能与任何制造商达成符合期望的协议，因此到 3068 年，内天体的将军总数降至两台，且都在"瓦纳梅克的寡妇制造者"手中，是从龙骑兵那里缴获的。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Though built for close combat, the weapons payload on the Shogun is built for long range combat. The 'Mech carries as its primary weapon a ER PPC and two LRM-15 launchers which allow the 'Mech to engage an enemy very effectively at long ranges. The 'Mech does also carry two SRM-6 launchers for close combat, allowing the 'Mech to find any weak spots in an enemy's armor when they do get to close ranges with the Shogun. Quirk: Barrel Fist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 尽管将军是为近战而生，其武器配置却是围绕远距离交战打造的。该机甲的主武器是一门 增程粒子炮和两部 LRM-15 发射器，使其能在远距离上极为有效地压制敌人。此外它还携带两部 SRM-6 发射器用于近战，一旦敌人贴近将军，便能借此在敌方装甲上寻找任何薄弱之处。 特性：炮管拳 投放费用倍率：1.15 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The original 2777 Shogun model is similar to the 3050's era SHG-2F, adding Artemis IV fire control systems to the LRM racks. The SRM-6 racks are replaced with four Streak SRM-2 launchers, which share a single ton of ammunition. A head-mounted Medium Pulse Laser and a medium laser in the center torso rounds out the weapons. Armorscale ferro-fibrous armor and CASE protect the 'Mech. Quirk: Barrel Fist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 最初的2777年将军型与3050年代的SHG-2F相似，为LRM发射巢加装了阿尔忒弥斯IV火控系统。SRM-6发射巢被替换为四具连发SRM-2发射器，它们共用一个吨位的弹药。头部安装的一门中型脉冲激光与中央躯干的一门中型激光补全了武器配置。装甲鳞式铁纤维装甲与CASE保护着这台机甲。 特性：炮管铁拳 投放费用倍率：1.15 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An unofficial refresh of the SHG-2F, the 4F places the SRM launchers with Streak SRM-4s and adds an Artemis IV FCS for each LRM launcher. The design is obviously inspired the Shogun C the Wolf's Dragoons introduced to the Inner Sphere, but due to having no access to Clan-level technology the 4F is slightly worse in most regards. Quirk: Barrel Fist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为SHG-2F的非官方改良版，4F将SRM发射器换成连发SRM-4，并为每具LRM发射器加装一套Artemis IV火控系统。该设计显然受到狼之龙骑兵引入内层星域的幕府将军C的启发，但由于无法获得部族级技术，4F在多数方面都略逊一筹。 特性：炮管拳 投放费用倍率：1.15

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 4W is a custom variant of the Shogun brought by the Wolf's Dragoons to the Inner Sphere prior to the Clan Invasion. The fact it uses far more advanced technology than was available to the Great Houses meant its more efficient weapons loadout of two LRM-15 and four Streak SRM-6, combined with an ER PPC, really stood out. Quirk: Barrel Fist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.21 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 4W 是狼之龙骑兵在部族入侵之前带到内层星域的 Shogun 定制变型。它所使用的技术远比各大家族的现役装备先进，因此其更高效的武器配置——两门 LRM-15 和四部连发 SRM-6，再加上一门增程粒子炮——格外引人注目。 特性：炮管拳 投放费用倍率：1.21 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A complete redesign of the Shogun using Clan technology that is used exclusively by Wolf's Dragoons, the Shogun C is armed with two LRM-20 missile racks with an Artemis IV fire control system for greater missile accuracy. The 'Mech also carries an ER PPC and four Streak SRM-6 launchers, giving it a devastating close range damage capability. Quirk: Barrel Fist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.21 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是用部族技术对将军做的彻底重新设计，为狼之龙骑兵独用。将军C装有两具带阿尔忒弥斯IV火控系统的LRM-20导弹挂架以提高导弹精度，另有一门增程粒子炮和四具连发SRM-6发射器，赋予它毁灭性的近程伤害能力。 特性：炮管拳 投放费用倍率：1.21 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A variant of the standard Shootist ST-8A, the ST-8A2 is a refit designed to enhance the Mech's utility as a bodyguard for Command lances. A class D refit, the 8A2 replaces the standard Medium Pulse Lasers with standard Medium Lasers. The free tonnage this creates is used to install a Beagle Active Probe and upgrade the Small Laser to a Pulse model. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.12 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为标准枪手ST-8A的变型，ST-8A2是一次改装，旨在提升该机甲作为指挥小队护卫的实用性。作为D级改装，8A2以标准中型激光取代标准中型脉冲激光，由此产生的自由吨位用于安装一台比格犬主动探测器，并把小型激光升级为脉冲型号。 特性：指挥机甲 投放费用倍率：1.12 手臂驱动器限制：左上
