A class D refit, the 8A2 replaces the standard Medium Pulse Lasers with standard Medium Lasers. The free tonnage this creates is used to install a Beagle Active Probe and upgrade the Small Laser to a Pulse model.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为标准射击手ST-8A的一个改型，ST-8A2是一次旨在提升该机甲作为指挥分队护卫效用的改装。作为D级改装，8A2把标准中型脉冲激光器换成标准中型激光器。由此产生的自由吨位用于安装一个比格犬主动探测器，并把小型激光器升级为脉冲型号。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Shrike relies on its speed to flank any foes, as it lacks the firepower to easily punch through the thicker frontal armor of most foes. Its equipped with four ER Medium Lasers and four Machine guns, and a single center torso mounted flamer. An ECM and active probe ensures the 'Mech can keep its targets locked. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Shrike 依靠速度迂回包抄敌人，因为它的火力不足以轻易击穿大多数对手较厚的正面装甲。它装备四门增程中型激光、四挺机枪，以及一具安装在中央躯干的火焰喷射器。电子对抗套件与主动探测器确保该机甲能始终锁定目标。 特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1.1

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Shrike is a 50-ton QuadMech designed and fielded by Clan Hell's Horses. The combination of a 350 XL engine, seven jump jets and a MASC makes the 'Mech extremely mobile despite its size.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 伯劳是地狱马氏族设计并部署的一种50吨四足机甲。一具350 XL引擎、七个跳跃推进器和一具MASC的组合，使该机甲尽管体型不小却极为机动。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This is Your Fault. Quirk: Aerial Assault Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.17 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是你的错。 特性：空中突击 投放费用倍率：1.17 手臂驱动器限制：左下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Intended to keep its enemies at medium to long ranges, the Shugenja is armed with an ER PPC that is capable of striking an enemy at a distance, allowing the Shugenja to snipe at its victims. For just outside medium range to short range, the 'Mech carries a MRM-30 launcher and two Large Lasers. Quirk: Cowl Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 修验者意在把敌人保持在中远程，装有一门能远距离打击敌人的增程粒子炮，使其得以狙击目标。在中距外到近距范围内，它带一具MRM-30发射器和两门大型激光。 特性：机罩 投放费用倍率：1.11 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Designed to be a heavy C3 command 'Mech the Shugenja is built around a chassis that supports a 300 XL engine which gives the 'Mech a top speed of 64.8 km/h allowing the Shugenja to keep up with most 'Mechs of its size while sacrificing durability for more free weight. The Shugenjas C3 computer allows it to act as a hub for friendly units equipped with C3 slave units to share targeting data.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为重型C3指挥机甲而设计，修验者建在一副支持300 XL引擎的底盘上，使该机甲最高速度达到64.8公里/小时，让修验者能跟上大多数同尺寸机甲，同时牺牲耐久性换取更多自由重量。修验者的C3计算机让它能充当装配有C3从属系统的友军单位的枢纽，共享瞄准数据。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Apparently based on the Timber Wolf, the Sidewinder OmniMech was developed by Clan Cloud Cobra in preparation for the Clan Invasion of the Inner Sphere. When it turned out that the Cloud Cobras would likely not be among the invader clans they became increasingly desperate and eventually fielded a Sidewinder against Clan Jade Falcon in a trial on Babylon that they lost. The Jade Falcons salvaged the heavily damaged 'Mech and all available information is based on their investigation of the design. Quirk: Improved Lifesupport Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.12 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 响尾蛇全向机甲表面上以森林狼为基础，由云眼镜蛇部族为筹备对内层星域的部族入侵而研制。当事实证明云眼镜蛇很可能不在入侵部族之列后，他们愈发绝望，最终在巴比伦星上的一场试炼中派出一台响尾蛇对抗翡翠猎鹰部族，结果落败。翡翠猎鹰回收了这台受损严重的机甲，现存的所有资料都基于他们对这一设计的调查。 特性：改进生命维持 投放费用倍率：1.12 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Apparently based on the Timber Wolf, the Sidewinder OmniMech was developed by Clan Cloud Cobra in preparation for the Clan Invasion of the Inner Sphere. When it turned out that the Cloud Cobras would likely not be among the invader clans they became increasingly desperate and eventually fielded a Sidewinder against Clan Jade Falcon in a trial on Babylon that they lost. The Jade Falcons salvaged the heavily damaged 'Mech and all available information is based on their investigation of the design.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 响尾蛇全能机甲显然以森林狼为基础，由云眼镜蛇氏族为准备氏族入侵内天体而开发。当发现云眼镜蛇很可能不在入侵氏族之列时，他们日益绝望，最终在巴比伦的一场试炼中派出响尾蛇对抗翡翠猎鹰氏族，但败北。翡翠猎鹰回收了严重受损的机甲，所有已知信息都基于他们对该设计的调查。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Siren ProtoMech was originally designed by Clan Smoke Jaguar to serve as a reconnaissance unit. Its high speed allowed it to rush forward, find enemy forces, call in a missile strike, and evacuate without the enemy being able to see them. As the Siren was intended to be a scout and observer, it only carries a Light Machine Gun in either arm. Quirk: Nimble Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.96
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 塞任原型机甲最初由烟豹部族设计，用作侦察单位。其高速度使其能够迅速前出、发现敌军、呼叫导弹打击，并在敌人察觉之前撤离。由于塞任的定位是侦察与观察，它仅在每条手臂上装有一挺轻型机枪。 特性：灵巧 投放费用倍率：0.96

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Siren ProtoMech was originally designed by Clan Smoke Jaguar to serve as a reconnaissance unit. Its high speed allowed it to rush forward, find enemy forces, call in a missile strike, and evacuate without the enemy being able to see them. As the Siren was intended to be a scout and observer, it only carries a Light Machine Gun in either arm.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 塞任原型机甲最初由烟虎氏族设计用作侦察单位。它的高速度使其能冲向前方、发现敌军、呼叫导弹打击，然后在敌人看不到它们的情况下撤离。由于塞任本意是侦察与观察单位，它只在双臂各装一挺轻机枪。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Siren ProtoMech was originally designed by Clan Smoke Jaguar to serve as a reconnaissance unit. Its high speed allowed it to rush forward, find enemy forces, call in a missile strike, and evacuate without the enemy being able to see them. Introduced during the 3060s, this variant of the Siren was upgraded with regular Machine Guns. Quirk: Nimble Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.96
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 塞任原生机甲最初由烟虎部族设计，用作侦察单位。它的高速度让它能冲上前去、发现敌军、呼叫导弹打击，然后在敌人来不及看清的情况下撤离。此变型于3060年代推出，塞任被升级为装备标准机枪。 特性：灵巧 投放费用倍率：0.96

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Siren ProtoMech was originally designed by Clan Smoke Jaguar to serve as a reconnaissance unit. Its high speed allowed it to rush forward, find enemy forces, call in a missile strike, and evacuate without the enemy being able to see them. Introduced during the 3060s, this variant of the Siren was upgraded with regular Machine Guns.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 塞任原生机甲最初由烟虎部族设计，用作侦察单位。它的高速度让它能冲上前去、发现敌军、呼叫导弹打击，然后在敌人来不及看清的情况下撤离。此变型于3060年代推出，塞任被升级为装备标准机枪。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Introduced in 3060, the 95-ton Sirocco was conceived as a replacement for the older Goliath QuadMech. Built by Corean Enterprises, the Sirocco is powered by a 285-rated Fusion Core giving it a top speed of 50 km/h. The Sirocco SRC-3C is armed with a pair of UAC/10s and a quad of ER Medium Lasers. A Medium Pulse Laser, two Anti-Personnel Pods and a Guardian ECM round out the arsenal. Quirk: Multi Trac Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.17
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 95吨的沙洛科于3060年推出，构想为老式歌利亚四肢机甲的替代品，由科林企业建造。沙洛科由一台285额定聚变核心驱动，最高速度50公里/小时。沙洛科SRC-3C装有一对UAC/10和四门增程中型激光，另有一门中型脉冲激光、两具反人员舱和一具守护者电子对抗套件补全武装。 特性：多目标追踪 投放费用倍率：1.17

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Introduced in 3060, the 95-ton Sirocco was conceived as a replacement for the older Goliath QuadMech. Built by Corean Enterprises, the Sirocco is powered by a 285-rated Fusion Core giving it a top speed of 50 km/h. The Sirocco SRC-3C is armed with a pair of UAC/10s and a quad of ER Medium Lasers. A Medium Pulse Laser, two Anti-Personnel Pods and a Guardian ECM round out the arsenal.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 西罗科于3060年推出，95吨，被构想为老旧歌利亚四足机甲的替代品。西罗科由科雷恩企业建造，装有一具285级聚变核心，最高速度50公里/小时。西罗科SRC-3C武装为两门UAC/10和四门增程中型激光器。另有一门中型脉冲激光器、两个反人员吊舱和一套守卫者ECM补全了武备。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Introduced in 3060, the 95-ton Sirocco was conceived as a replacement for the older Goliath QuadMech. Built by Corean Enterprises, the Sirocco is powered by a 285-rated Fusion Core giving it a top speed of 50 km/h. The Sirocco SRC-5C is armed with a pair of Light Gauss Rifles and a quad of ER Medium Lasers. A Medium Pulse Laser, two Anti-Personnel Pods and a Guardian ECM round out the arsenal. Quirk: Multi Trac Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.17
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 于 3060 年推出的 95 吨 Sirocco，最初是为取代较老的 Goliath 四足机甲而构想。Sirocco 由科林企业制造，搭载额定 285 的聚变核心，最高速度可达 50 km/h。Sirocco SRC-5C 装备一对轻型高斯步枪和四门增程中型激光，另有一门中型脉冲激光、两个反步兵吊舱和一具守卫者电子对抗套件，使武器配置趋于完整。 特性：多目标追踪 投放费用倍率：1.17

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Introduced in 3060, the 95-ton Sirocco was conceived as a replacement for the older Goliath QuadMech. Built by Corean Enterprises, the Sirocco is powered by a 285-rated Fusion Core giving it a top speed of 50 km/h. The Sirocco SRC-5C is armed with a pair of Light Gauss Rifles and a quad of ER Medium Lasers. A Medium Pulse Laser, 2 Anti-Personnel Pods and a Guardian ECM round out the arsenal.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 西罗科于3060年推出，95吨，被构想为老旧歌利亚四足机甲的替代品。西罗科由科雷恩企业建造，装有一具285级聚变核心，最高速度50公里/小时。西罗科SRC-5C武装为两门轻型磁轨炮和四门增程中型激光器。另有一门中型脉冲激光器、两个反人员吊舱和一套守卫者ECM补全了武备。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Reportedly piloted by Star Colonel Jaela Ward, the Orion IIC Hero 'Mech retains the right torso mounted Gauss Rifle unchanged but swaps the LRM rack for an ER PPC, upgrades the SRM-4 rack with Artemis IV FCS and downgrades the arm lasers to ER Medium Lasers. Carrying three tons of Gauss rounds and two of SRM reloads, the weight saved allows the mounting of two extra double heat sinks and MASC. Quirk: Anti-Air Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.17 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 据称由星上校杰拉·沃德驾驶的猎户座IIC英雄机甲保留了右躯干上的高斯步枪，但把LRM发射架换成了增程粒子炮，为SRM-4发射架加装阿尔忒弥斯IV火控系统，并将手臂激光降级为增程中型激光。它携带三吨高斯炮弹和两吨SRM备弹，节省下来的重量用于加装两具双散热器和MASC。 特性：防空瞄准 投放费用倍率：1.17 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Reportedly piloted by Star Colonel Jaela Ward, the Orion IIC Hero 'Mech retains the right torso mounted Gauss Rifle unchanged but swaps the LRM rack for an ER PPC, upgrades the SRM-4 rack with Artemis IV FCS and downgrades the arm lasers to ER Medium Lasers. Carrying three tons of Gauss rounds and two of SRM reloads, the weight saved allows the mounting of two extra double heat sinks and MASC.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 据报由星上校贾艾拉·沃德驾驶，猎户座IIC英雄机甲保留右躯干磁轨炮不变，但把LRM架换成增程PPC，将SRM-4架升级为带阿尔忒弥斯IV火控的型号，并把臂部激光器降级为增程中型激光器。它携带三吨磁轨炮弹和两吨SRM备用弹，节省下的重量则用于加装两具额外双重散热器和MASC。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Inner Sphere adapted to battle armor quickly after being introduced to the concept by the Clan Elemental suit, so much so that the IS started innovating and testing the limits of what was possible almost immediately. In the 3050s the Lyran Commonwealth led the charge with this, the Sloth, the first quadruped battle armor. The Lyrans armed each suit with two Small Lasers and a BA-scale Pop-Up Mine, a weapon designed to penetrate armor and deal direct internal damage. The Sloth proved dangerous but unwieldy to control, making it unpopular with pilots. Quirk: Standard Parts Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.892 Can only be transported by internal bays, can not melee, can not swarm.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在部族元素战斗装甲服让内层星域接触到这一概念后，内层星域很快便适应了战斗装甲，甚至几乎立刻就开始创新并试探各种可能性的极限。3050 年代，莱兰联邦率先推出了这款 Sloth——首款四足战斗装甲。莱兰人为每套装甲配备两门小型激光和一枚战斗装甲级弹出式地雷，这种武器专门用于穿透装甲并直接造成内部伤害。Sloth 威力惊人，但操控起来十分笨拙，因此不受机师欢迎。 特性：标准零件 投放费用倍率：0.892 只能通过内部舱室运输，无法近战，无法攀附。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Inner Sphere adapted to battle armor quickly after being introduced to the concept by the Clan Elemental suit, so much so that the IS started innovating and testing the limits of what was possible almost immediately. In the 3050s the Lyran Commonwealth led the charge with this, the Sloth, the first quadruped battle armor. The Lyrans armed each suit with two Small Lasers and a BA-scale Pop-Up Mine, a weapon designed to penetrate armor and deal direct internal damage. The Sloth proved dangerous but unwieldy to control, making it unpopular with pilots.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 内天体在经元素战斗服引入战斗装甲概念后迅速适应，适应之快甚至让内天体几乎立刻开始创新并试探可能性的极限。3050年代，莱兰联邦带头推出这款"树懒"——首款四足战斗装甲。莱兰人为每套战斗服配备两门小型激光器和一具战斗装甲规格的弹出式地雷，一种为穿透装甲并直接造成内部伤害而设计的武器。树懒被证明危险但难以操控，因此不受飞行员欢迎。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Slowpoke is armed with a single medium laser in the center torso. With a movement profile matching the infamous UrbanMech, its two and a half tons of armor is woefully inadequate even though it provides near maximum protection for a 'Mech of this small size. The jump jets can vault the Slowpoke 65 meters. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Slowpoke 在中央躯干装有一门中型激光。它拥有与臭名昭著的 UrbanMech 相同的机动性能，两吨半的装甲即便对如此小型的机甲而言已接近最大防护，却依然严重不足。跳跃推进器能让 Slowpoke 跃出 65 米。 特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：0.99

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The third Great House to develop an ultralight BattleMech, after House Davion and House Kurita, House Liao created the Slowpoke in response to the appearance of the Federated Suns' Junior in the twenty-fifth century. An altogether unimpressive design due to poor planning and implementation of its conception and manufacture, the Slowpoke never reached any greater success and was often relegated to secondary duties.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为继戴维恩家族与库瑞塔家族之后第三个开发超轻型战斗机甲的大望族，廖氏家族在25世纪为回应联邦太阳国“少年”的出现而打造了懒汉。由于构想与制造的计划与执行都很差，该设计毫无亮点，从未取得更大成功，常被降级用于次要任务。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Snake is a 'Mech that was built under the aegis of an Elemental hunter. With the power of hindsight though the Snake is clearly designed to hunt Inner Sphere Battle Armor suits. The 'Mech is built using a Vox 225 XL Engine to move at a top speed of 86.4 km/h. The Snake also has a jumping capability of one hundred and fifty meters making it capable of outmaneuvering any battle armor suit and also keeping it on par with most medium 'Mechs. The Snake is also armored with seven tons of armor and uses double heat sinks to cool the 'Mech's excess heat. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Short Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 蛇式最初是在“元素猎手”的名目下打造的。不过事后看来，蛇式显然是为猎杀内层星域的战斗装甲而设计的。这台机甲采用 Vox 225 XL 引擎，最高速度可达 86.4 km/h。蛇式还能跳跃一百五十米，这使它能够以机动性压制任何战斗装甲，同时也与大多数中型机甲不相上下。蛇式还配有七吨装甲，并使用双散热器来冷却机甲多余的热量。 特性：改进瞄准 - 近程 投放费用倍率：1.05 手臂驱动器限制：右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A customized variant produced for House Marik MechWarrior Alexi Danisov. During Operation Guerrero, his Liao-built Snake was always running out of ammunition. With ammunition scarce, Alexi had his BattleMech's LB-X 10 Class Autocannon replaced with a pair of Large Lasers. The 'Mech performed well, and Alexi retained these weapons and upgraded the lasers to Extended Range Models.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是为马里克家族机师亚历克西·丹尼索夫生产的定制改型。在格雷罗行动期间，他那台廖氏制造的蛇总是打光弹药。由于弹药紧缺，亚历克西把机甲上的LB-X 10级自动炮换成两门大型激光器。该机甲表现出色，亚历克西保留了这些武器，并把激光器升级为增程型号。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Armed with only a head-mounted Series ER Medium Laser and a pair of ER Small Lasers, the Snow Fox excels at making high-speed passes. Though the 'Mech uses standard heat sinks, it takes an extremely bad pilot to cause the Snow Fox any overheating problems. Finally, it is protected as well as it can be by four tons of Ferro-Fibrous armor. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.01
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 雪狐只装有头部一门系列增程中型激光和两门增程小型激光，擅长高速掠袭。虽然该机甲使用标准散热器，但要让它过热得有个极差劲的飞行员才行。最后，它由四吨铁纤维装甲提供尽可能好的防护。 特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：1.01

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Snow Fox was designed by Clan Ice Hellion as a fast 'Mech that is capable of fulfilling a number of roles. Its primary weapon is its speed, which it uses to quickly close with enemies, swiftly damage them, and get out before repeating the process. It has also found use as a Battle Armor hunter. The Hellions scientists were also gauging warrior interest in a quad design and saw the Snow Fox as a test bed for a future quad OmniMech, but the interest was not there. Not only are bipedal 'Mechs more intuitive to operate, the fast quad takes getting used to and lacks hands.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 雪狐由冰地狱狮部族设计为一款能胜任多种角色的快速机甲。它的主要武器就是速度：用它迅速逼近敌人、快速造成伤害，然后在重复这一过程之前撤离。它也常用于猎杀战斗装甲。地狱狮的科学家还在试探战士对四足设计的兴趣，把雪狐当作未来四足全向机甲的试验平台，但兴趣并不存在——不仅双足机甲操作更直观，快速的四足机体也需要时间适应，而且没有手。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The first known variant of the Snow Fox introduced 3015 during the Succession Wars era or Golden Century. This variant replaces the lasers with an LRM-10, creating a very mobile support 'Mech. It is also incapable of building any noticeable amount of heat before it starts taking damage. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.01
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Snow Fox首个已知变型，于3015年推出，时值继承战争时代或黄金世纪。该变型以LRM-10取代激光，打造出一款机动性极强的支援机甲。此外，它在开始承受损伤之前也不会积累起任何明显的热量。 特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：1.01

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Snow Fox was designed by Clan Ice Hellion as a fast 'Mech that is capable of fulfilling a number of roles. Its primary weapon is its speed, which it uses to quickly close with enemies, swiftly damage them, and get out before repeating the process. It has also found use as a Battle Armor hunter. The Hellions scientists were also gauging warrior interest in a quad design and saw the Snow Fox as a test bed for a future quad OmniMech, but the interest was not there. Not only are bipedal 'Mechs more intuitive to operate, the fast quad takes getting used to and lacks hands.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 雪狐由冰地狱狮部族设计为一款能胜任多种角色的快速机甲。它的主要武器就是速度：用它迅速逼近敌人、快速造成伤害，然后在重复这一过程之前撤离。它也常用于猎杀战斗装甲。地狱狮的科学家还在试探战士对四足设计的兴趣，把雪狐当作未来四足全向机甲的试验平台，但兴趣并不存在——不仅双足机甲操作更直观，快速的四足机体也需要时间适应，而且没有手。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: StarCorps Industries’s Project: SORCERER was shrouded in such secrecy that the first Sorcerer Battlemechs just seemed to appear in Star League Defense Force ranks where they were met with varying degrees of suspicion. The 95-ton Sorcerer 1A is built around a PlasmaStar 380XL engine to propel it to a respectable 64.8 km/h which enables the Sorcerer to bring its arsenal and Guardian ECM Suite to the enemy. The design carries a pair of Ceres Arms Smasher PPCs, a pair of Donal Snub-Nose PPCs, a pair of Magna MkII Medium Lasers, and a Magna MkI Small Laser. A staggering twenty Double Heat Sinks is barely enough to keep the weapons’ heat generation in check. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.17
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: StarCorps Industries 的“SORCERER 计划”笼罩在重重保密之中，以至于首批 Sorcerer 战斗机甲仿佛是凭空出现在星际联盟防御部队的序列里，引来程度不一的猜疑。95 吨的 Sorcerer 1A 围绕一台 PlasmaStar 380XL 引擎打造，可推进至相当可观的 64.8 km/h，使 Sorcerer 得以为敌人送上其全套武器与 Guardian 电子对抗套件。该设计装有两门 Ceres Arms Smasher 粒子炮、两门 Donal 短鼻粒子炮、两门 Magna MkII 中型激光和一门 Magna MkI 小型激光。惊人的二十具双散热器也仅勉强能将武器产生的热量控制住。 特性：战拳 投放费用倍率：1.17

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: That's a lot of lightning, boss. You play your cards right, this monster will be spitting out four PPCs without breaking much sweat. Oh, and it's pretty quick on its feet too.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 那可是不少闪电啊，老板。只要你牌打得好，这头怪物一口气喷出四门粒子炮都不带喘的。哦对了，它腿脚还挺利索。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Shortly after the Sorcerer 1A began walking off of the StarCorps Industries production lines on Fletcher, the Sorcerer 1B began production in the satellite facility on Crofton. The 1B variant trades in the array of PPCs and Lasers for a Blankenburg Technologies ER PPC, a pair of Artemis IV-enhanced Holly LRM15s, and a trio of Defiance P5M Medium Pulse Lasers. The reduced Heat generation of this payload allowed designers to remove the five external Double Heat Sinks and freed up room for CASE in the right torso. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.17
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Sorcerer 1A开始从Fletcher的StarCorps Industries生产线上下线后不久，Sorcerer 1B也在Crofton的卫星工厂投产。1B改型用一门Blankenburg Technologies增程粒子炮、两具经Artemis IV增强的Holly LRM15以及三门Defiance P5M中型脉冲激光，换掉了原有的整组粒子炮与激光。这套配置产生的热量更低，让设计人员得以拆掉那五具外挂双散热器，并腾出空间在右侧躯干加装CASE。 特性：战拳 投放费用倍率：1.17

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: I've heard these Sorcerer 1B's called 'That other Sorcerer' a few times. Despite being produced around the same time as the 1A, the 1B's weapon payload is notably different; primarily that is trades the array of PPCs for an ER PPC and a pair of LRM launchers. If someone tries to under-run your LRMs, this thing's three Medium Pulse Lasers and Battlefists should help correct the issue.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我听过有人把这种术士1B叫做"那另一台术士"好几次。尽管它与1A大约同期生产，1B的武器载荷明显不同；主要是它把那一排PPC换成了增程PPC和两具LRM发射器。如果有人试图钻进你的LRM最小射程，这东西的三门中型脉冲激光器和战斗拳应该能纠正这个问题。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Despite being designed for Urban and close-quarters warfare, the Sorcerer 1C variant drops the pair Snub-Nosed PPCs of the original Sorcerer 1A in favor of the easier-to-obtain Blankenburg Large Pulse Lasers. Less surprisingly, the 1A’s PPC and laser complement is replaced by a quartet of Magna 400P Medium Pulse Lasers and a pair of Holly Streak SRM2s. The Sorcerer 1C dedicates eight tons to mount four Pitban LFT-50 jump jets to propel it 120 meters in short bursts and utilizes only sixteen Double Heat Sinks. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.17
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 尽管是为城市与近距作战而设计，巫师1C变型却拆掉原版巫师1A的一对短鼻粒子炮，改用更易获得的布兰肯堡大型脉冲激光。不那么令人意外的是，1A的粒子炮与激光组合被四门马格纳400P中型脉冲激光和两具霍利连发SRM2取代。巫师1C腾出八吨装四具皮特班LFT-50跳跃推进器，可在短促爆发中推进120米，并且只使用十六个双散热器。 特性：战拳 投放费用倍率：1.17

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: I don't know if I would have put four jump jets on something this big, boss, but I guess someone thought it was a good idea. This thing has got a load of pulse lasers that give it a much shorter range than its other Sorcerer cousins but what it lacks in range it makes up for in numbers and supplements the whole lot with a pair of Stream SRM launchers.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我不知道我会不会给这么大的东西装上四个跳跃推进器，老大，不过我猜有人觉得这是个好主意。这东西装了一堆脉冲激光器，射程比它其他的术士表亲短得多，但射程上的不足由数量弥补，并且还有两具连发SRM发射器为整套武器加成。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Of the relatively few Sorcerers built before the Amaris Coup, the Sorcerer 1CC variant was considered an exceptionally rare design. Originally planned as a replacement for the 90 ton Cyclops, it quickly became apparent that the design teams at StarCorps Industries were not going to be able to best its incredible computer systems. Rather than spending several more decades of development, the design team decided that modifying the Sorcerer 1A would be a suitable method to cut corners. The 1CC drops the Snub-Nose PPCs, lasers and five Double Heat Sinks in order to mount an additional Ceres Arms Smasher PPC, a quintet of Magna 400P Medium Pulse Lasers, and the advanced Command Console. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.19
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在阿马里斯政变之前建造的 Sorcerer 数量本就不多，其中 Sorcerer 1CC 变型更被视为极其罕见的设计。它原本计划作为 90 吨 Cyclops 的替代型号，但人们很快发现，StarCorps Industries 的设计团队根本无法超越 Cyclops 那套出色的计算机系统。与其再耗费数十年继续开发，设计团队决定改造 Sorcerer 1A 作为走捷径的办法。1CC 拆除了短管粒子炮、激光和五个双散热器，改为加装一门额外的 Ceres Arms Smasher 粒子炮、五门 Magna 400P 中型脉冲激光以及先进的指挥控制台。 特性：战拳 投放费用倍率：1.19

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This one's pretty exceptional, boss. Not many Sorcerers were made back in the day and these 1CC's were only a small fraction of them. That Command Console is a damn fine piece of equipment to have orchestratn' everything and the trio of PPCs aren't something to scoff at either.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这一台相当特别，老大。当年术士造得并不多，而这些1CC只占其中一小部分。那台指挥控制台是统筹指挥一切的好装备，而那三兄弟PPC也不容小觑。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: StarCorps Industries’s Project: SORCERER is considered one of the best examples of effective counter-industrial espionage techniques; despite being in development for nearly two decades, the various intelligence agencies of the Great Houses never managed to collect any meaningful data on the program. The project’s primary goal was to create an assault BattleMech capable of slipping behind and operations behind enemy lines for an indefinite period of time and if at all possible, do this task undetected. Produced in exceptionally small quantities up until Amaris forces overran their facilities on Fletcher, the 95-ton Sorcerer 1X sports a combination of a Null Signature System and a Chameleon Light Polarization Shield. The 1X carries a pair of Ceres Arms Smasher PPCs, a pair of Donal Snub-Nose PPCs, and pair of Magna 400P Medium Pulse Lasers which in combination with the stealth systems onboard can easily overpower the Mech’s nineteen Double Heat Sinks. Few remember the 1X variant as the more widely-produced and fielded 1A variant stepped off of the manufacturing lines on the same day. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.19
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: StarCorps Industries的“SORCERER计划”被视为有效反工业间谍技术的典范之一；尽管该计划已研发近二十年，各大家族的各情报机构却始终未能收集到任何有关该计划的有价值情报。该计划的首要目标是打造一型能够潜入敌后、并在敌后无限期作战的突击战斗机甲，如有可能，还要在无人察觉的情况下完成这一任务。直到Amaris部队占领其在Fletcher的设施之前，这款机甲都以极小的产量生产。95吨的Sorcerer 1X同时配备了一具零点特征系统与一面变色龙光偏振护盾。1X装有两门Ceres Arms Smasher粒子炮、两门Donal短鼻粒子炮，以及两门Magna 400P中型脉冲激光，这些武器与机上隐身系统相结合，很容易就压过这台机甲十九具双散热器的散热能力。很少有人记得1X改型，因为产量更大、装备更普及的1A改型与它同一天走下生产线。 特性：战拳 投放费用倍率：1.19

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: That's a lot of lightning, boss. You play your cards right, this monster will be spitting out four PPCs without breaking much sweat. Oh, and it's pretty quick on its feet too.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 那可是不少闪电啊，老板。只要你牌打得好，这头怪物一口气喷出四门粒子炮都不带喘的。哦对了，它腿脚还挺利索。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Like many designs lost during the Succession Wars, the Sorcerer design saw new life in the decades after the discovery of the Helm Memory Core. The Draconis Combine was the first to create a new variant of the aged SLDF design utilizing technologies at their disposal in 3058. The Sorcerer 2D retains the 380XL Engine, Guardian ECM Suite, one of the original PPCs, and thirteen of the original Double Heat Sinks and adds a pair of Shigunga MRM40s fed by four tons of ammo. A Small Laser is also added to the right arm for anti-personnel work. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 与许多在继承战争中失传的设计一样，巫师在发现地狱记忆核心之后的几十年里重获新生。龙脉联合体是首个在3058年利用其掌握的技术为这款老旧SLDF设计打造新变型的势力。巫师2D保留380XL引擎、守护者电子对抗套件、原有粒子炮中的一门，以及原有双散热器中的十三个，并加装一对紫郡MRM40（配四吨弹药）。右臂还加装一门小型激光用于反人员。 特性：战拳 投放费用倍率：1.15

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Boss, I get it. Missiles are cool and all, but letting loose with 80 of them at a time might be a bit over-zealous. Leave it to the Dracs to slap a pair of MRM40s on one of these brutes; at least they kept one of the PPCs for some longer range work.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 老大，我懂。导弹是很酷没错，但一口气放80枚可能有点过于热情了。也只有龙尼斯人会往这种蛮物上塞两具MRM40；至少他们还留了一门PPC做点远程活。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Spartan C is the result of Clan-tech improvements by Clan Fire Mandrill to the original design. The C variant saw usage by a handful of the Clans, although only Clan Fire Mandrill continued to field the 'Mech through the invasion of the Inner Sphere. Quirk: Improved Sensors Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 斯巴达C是火沸沸部族对原始设计进行部族技术改进的成果。C变型被少数几个部族使用过，但只有火沸沸部族在入侵内层星域期间持续投入该机甲。 特性：改进传感器 投放费用倍率：1.18

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: So, this is the final evolution of the Spartan, huh? Kind of fitting that it left with the SLDF and returned reborn with the Clans. Poetic, almost.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 那么，这就是斯巴达的最终演化，是吧？它随SLDF离去、又随氏族重生归来，倒也挺相称。几乎有种诗意。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The earliest model of the Spartan assault 'Mech. The N1 suffered from inadequate cooling for its advanced weapons systems, which led to the design being revised into the more heat-efficient N2 in 2765. Despite this, a handful of N1 models still made their way into the hands of various buyers across the Sphere. Quirk: Improved Sensors Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 斯巴达突击型机甲的最早型号。N1的先进武器系统因散热不足而备受困扰，这促使该设计在2765年被修订为散热效率更高的N2。尽管如此，仍有少数N1流入内层星域各地买家的手中。 特性：改进传感器 投放费用倍率：1.14

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Do you have any idea how rare this 'Mech is, Boss? You're looking at one of the last remaining Spartan assault 'Mechs. Not only that, but this is one of the original N1 models! I mean — it's worse in every single way than the N2, but hey! It's rarer!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 你知道这台机甲有多稀有吗，老大？你眼前的是最后残存的斯巴达突击机甲之一。不止如此，这是最初的N1型号之一！我是说——它每一个方面都比N2差，但嘿！它更稀有！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Designed in 2765 as a response to rising hostility in the Periphery, the Spartan is a fast-moving assault 'Mech. During the Amaris Coup, the Martinson production line was destroyed, resulting in the Spartan's almost complete extinction; less than two dozen are known to still be in service. Quirk: Improved Sensors Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 斯巴达于2765年设计，是对外围地区日益增长的敌意的回应，是一款快速机动的突击机甲。阿马里斯政变期间马丁森产线被毁，导致斯巴达几乎灭绝；已知仍在服役的不足二十台。 特性：改进传感器 投放费用倍率：1.14

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Do you have any idea how rare this 'Mech is, Boss? You're looking at one of the last remaining Spartan assault 'Mechs. These bad boys were known for their speed, their firepower, and their durability. They did it all.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 你知道这台机甲有多稀有吗，老大？你眼前的是最后残存的斯巴达突击机甲之一。这些猛家伙以速度、火力以及耐久著称。它们样样都行。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The NF variant of the Spartan is an upgrade of the standard N2 variant. The NF was fielded almost exclusively by the Star League Defense Force's Royal Divisions. Following the destruction of the Martinson production lines during the Amaris Coup, and the subsequent exodus of the SLDF, the design is considered extinct. Quirk: Improved Sensors Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Spartan 的 NF 变型是标准 N2 变型的升级版。NF 几乎只装备于星际联盟防卫军的皇家师。在阿马里斯政变期间 Martinson 生产线被摧毁、SLDF 随后踏上大逃亡之后，该设计被认为已经绝迹。 特性：改进传感器 投放费用倍率：1.16

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: And I thought the original Spartan was rare! The NF doesn't boast much over the regular N2. Like most Star League upgrades, it just does what the original did, but better.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我还以为原来的斯巴达就够稀有了！NF相比普通N2并没有多少优势。像大多数星盟升级一样，它只是把原版能做的做得更好。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Spider IIC is armed with two ER Small Lasers and two Medium Pulse Lasers, with all of them linked through an advanced targeting computer. Ten double heat sinks are just barely enough to keep the 'Mech fully cooled in most situations. Quirk: Nimble Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 蜘蛛IIC装有两门增程小型激光和两门中型脉冲激光，全部联动一台先进瞄准计算机。十个双散热器刚刚够在大多数情况下让机甲完全冷却。 特性：灵巧 投放费用倍率：1.03

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Spider IIC is a clan conversion of the venerable Spider. Much of the original design was kept, such as it's very large 240 XL engine and many jump jets to ensure an extremely mobile 'Mech. Thanks to the conversion to Clan technologies the 'Mech has considerably more armor, making it both unexpectedly durable and persistent.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 蜘蛛IIC是古老蜘蛛的氏族改造版。原设计的许多部分被保留，例如它那台巨大的240 XL引擎和众多跳跃推进器，以确保机甲极其机动。得益于改用氏族技术，该机甲装甲显著增加，使它出人意料地既耐久又难缠。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A simple refit of the Spider SDR-5V, this variant drops two jump jets to fit a C3 slave computer. Quirk: Nimble Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.97
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是蜘蛛SDR-5V的简单改装，此变型拆掉两具跳跃推进器以装入一台C3从机。 特性：灵巧 投放费用倍率：0.97

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Spider 5V and 5VR are hands down the most maneuverable 'Mechs you can field, but they're made of paper. Though excellent scouts, and even able to jump into the rear arc of most enemies for surprise back shots, their low durability makes them often take crippling damage in the smallest of engagements.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 蜘蛛5V和5VR无疑是你能派上场的最机动机甲，但它们脆得像纸。它们虽是出色的侦察兵，甚至能跳到大多数敌人的后方弧线上打冷枪，但耐久度低下使它们在最小的交战中都会受到致残性损伤。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A major upgrade of the 5V, this custom variant used by the mercenary outfit Wolf's Dragoons make the Spider be a far more capable 'Mech by upgrading almost all the equipment with Clan tech. However, even with more tons being added due to the use of Ferro-Fibrous armor, the main flaw of it still remains in the lack of proper protection. Quirk: Nimble Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是 5V 的大幅升级版，由雇佣兵部队 Wolf's Dragoons 使用的定制变型。通过将几乎所有装备升级为部族科技，它使 Spider 成为一台性能强得多的机甲。然而，即便因采用铁纤维装甲而增加了数吨重量，它最大的缺陷依然存在——缺乏像样的防护。 特性：灵活 投放费用倍率：1.05

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Spider is hands down the most maneuverable 'Mech you can field, but it's made of paper. It's an excellent scout, though, and can even jump into the rear arc of most enemies for surprise back shots.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 蜘蛛无疑是你能派上场的最机动机甲，但它脆得像纸。不过它是极出色的侦察兵，甚至能跳到大多数敌人的后方弧线上打冷枪。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Spider 6V, precursor to the Venom spider variants, features upgraded armor and Jump Jets, as well as a Medium Pulse Laser, but it's still one of the most fragile targets on the battlefield. Quirk: Nimble Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.01
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Spider 6V是Venom系列蛛型改型的前身，拥有升级的装甲与跳跃推进器，还装有一门中型脉冲激光，但它依然是战场上最脆弱的目标之一。 特性：灵巧 投放费用倍率：1.01

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Spider 6V, precursor to the Venom spider variants, features upgraded armor and Jump Jets, as well as a Medium Pulse Laser, but it's still one of the most fragile targets on the battlefield.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 蜘蛛6V是毒液蜘蛛改型的前身，拥有升级的装甲与跳跃推进器，以及一门中型脉冲激光器，但它仍是战场上最脆弱的目标之一。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Alpha loadout of the Spirit Walker is mainly focused on powerful, direct engagements head on. A combination of lasers, machine guns and even a Gauss Rifle ensures the 'Mech can deliver damage at practically any distance of engagements. However, it's relative slow speed makes it vulnerable to being flanked or outmaneuvered by more agile units. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Spirit Walker 的 Alpha 配装主要着眼于正面硬碰硬的强力交战。激光、机枪乃至一门高斯步枪的组合，确保该机甲几乎能在任何交战距离上造成伤害。然而，它相对迟缓的速度使其容易被更灵活的部队侧翼包抄或以机动压制。 特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1.1

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: As the knowledge of how to build OmniMechs spread throughout the clans although Coyote had tried to keep it for themselves, they quickly realized they needed to bolster their 'Mech forces and started the Pueblo Initiative to remodel older SLDF 'Mechs into OmniMechs. The Spirit Walker was one of the results of the initiative, creating a more rugged front liner from the Black Knight. Due to its heavy armor the 'Mech was quite vulnerable against faster flankers, but if faced head on could pack a punch for its size.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 随着建造全向机甲的知识在部族间传播开来——尽管郊狼（Coyote）部族曾试图将其据为己有——他们很快意识到必须扩充自己的机甲部队，于是发起了“普韦布洛计划”（Pueblo Initiative），把较旧的 SLDF 机甲改造成全向机甲。幽灵行者（Spirit Walker）正是该计划的成果之一，它以黑骑士（Black Knight）为基础打造出一台更为坚固的前线机甲。由于装甲厚重，该机甲面对速度更快的侧翼包抄者时相当吃亏，但若正面交锋，其火力对于自身吨位而言相当可观。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Primary configuration requires a very skilled MechWarrior to operate properly, using advanced volley and engage tactics. During the volley phase the 'Mech should engage with some of its ER Large Lasers, but keeping heat under control. As the engagement distance shrinks, the use of the Large Lasers should be switched to the Medium Pulse Lasers instead. If at any point all lasers will be fire together, the 'Mech will most likely instantly go into overheat shutdown. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 主配置需要一名技艺极其娴熟的机甲战士才能正确操控，需运用进阶的齐射与接战战术。在齐射阶段，机甲应以部分增程大型激光接战，同时将热量控制在安全范围内。随着交战距离缩短，大型激光应改用中型脉冲激光。若在任何时候所有激光同时开火，机甲极有可能立即因过热而停机。 特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1.1

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: As the knowledge of how to build OmniMechs spread throughout the clans although Coyote had tried to keep it for themselves, they quickly realized they needed to bolster their 'Mech forces and started the Pueblo Initiative to remodel older SLDF 'Mechs into OmniMechs. The Spirit Walker was one of the results of the initiative, creating a more rugged front liner from the Black Knight. Due to its heavy armor the 'Mech was quite vulnerable against faster flankers, but if faced head on could pack a punch for its size.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 随着建造全向机甲的知识在部族间传播开来——尽管郊狼（Coyote）部族曾试图将其据为己有——他们很快意识到必须扩充自己的机甲部队，于是发起了“普韦布洛计划”（Pueblo Initiative），把较旧的 SLDF 机甲改造成全向机甲。幽灵行者（Spirit Walker）正是该计划的成果之一，它以黑骑士（Black Knight）为基础打造出一台更为坚固的前线机甲。由于装甲厚重，该机甲面对速度更快的侧翼包抄者时相当吃亏，但若正面交锋，其火力对于自身吨位而言相当可观。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The so-called Stag II incorporated a prototype version of the ER PPC that was roughly comparable to the Clan version of the weapon, though it was slightly less destructive. This upgrade of the large laser necessitated removal of the MASC, though the top speed was upgraded to 119 km/h. Additionally, Ferro-Fibrous weave was incorporated into the armor, though at an overall decrease in protection. The SRMs were removed in favor of an additional Medium Laser, two Medium Pulse Lasers, and two Small Lasers. This gave the 'Mech greater battlefield longevity, though the potential for excessive heat buildup was much greater. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 所谓的“雄鹿II”采用了增程粒子炮的原型版本，性能大致可与该武器的部族版本相比，只是破坏力略低。用这种大型激光的升级型号替换原有武器，使MASC不得不被拆除，不过最高时速提升到了119 km/h。此外，装甲中加入了铁纤维编织层，整体防护却有所下降。SRM被拆掉，换来1门额外的中型激光、2门中型脉冲激光和2门小型激光。这让该机甲在战场上更耐久，但过热的风险也大得多。 <特性：改进通讯 <投放费用倍率：1.03 <手臂驱动器限制：右臂下段

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The so-called Stag II incorporated a prototype version of the ER PPC that was roughly comparable to the Clan version of the weapon, though it was slightly less destructive. This upgrade of the large laser necessitated removal of the MASC, though the top speed was upgraded to 119 km/h. Additionally, Ferro-Fibrous weave was incorporated into the armor, though at an overall decrease in protection. The SRMs were removed in favor of an additional Medium Laser, two Medium Pulse Lasers, and two Small Lasers. This gave the 'Mech greater battlefield longevity, though the potential for excessive heat buildup was much greater.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 所谓“雄鹿II”整合了一版原型增程粒子炮，性能大致可与部族版本的该武器相比，只是破坏力略低。这次对大型激光的升级迫使它拆掉MASC，不过最高速度提升到119公里/小时。此外装甲中加入了铁纤维织层，尽管整体防护有所下降。SRM被拆掉，改为额外一门中型激光、两门中型脉冲激光和两门小型激光。这赋予该机甲更强的战场持续力，尽管热量过度积累的可能性也大得多。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Stag was built on an Endo Steel frame and powered by an XL Engine. Ten tons of armor provided the 'Mech with the maximum possible protection. The long-range threat from the cavalry 'Mech comes from one ER Large Laser. At close range it is supplemented by paired Medium Lasers and SRM-4s. Two, CASE-protected tons of ammunition gives MechWarriors the flexibility to use different types of munitions, making the Stag a threat to a variety of units. Twelve double heat sinks handles all of the heat generated by the weapons. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 雄鹿采用内骨架结构，由XL引擎驱动。十吨装甲为机甲提供了最大限度的防护。这台骑兵机甲的远程威胁来自一门增程大型激光。近距离则由成对的中型激光和SRM-4作为补充。两吨由CASE保护的弹药让机甲战士能够灵活选用不同类型的弹种，使雄鹿足以威胁多种单位。十二台双散热器足以处理武器产生的全部热量。 特性：改进通讯 投放费用倍率：1.03 手臂驱动器限制：右臂下部

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Stag was built on an Endo Steel frame and powered by an XL Engine. Ten tons of armor provided the 'Mech with the maximum possible protection. The long-range threat from the cavalry 'Mech comes from one ER Large Laser. At close range it is supplemented by paired Medium Lasers and SRM-4s. Two, CASE-protected tons of ammunition gives MechWarriors the flexibility to use different types of munitions, making the Stag a threat to a variety of units. Twelve double heat sinks handles all of the heat generated by the weapons.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 雄鹿建在内层钢框架上，由一具XL引擎驱动。十吨装甲为该机甲提供最大可能的防护。这台骑兵机甲的远程威胁来自一门增程大型激光器。在近距离，它由成对的中型激光器和SRM-4补充。两吨CASE保护的弹药让机师能灵活使用不同弹药类型，使雄鹿对各类单位都构成威胁。十二具双重散热器处理武器产生的所有热量。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The personal 'Mech of Sho-sho Jagawen Torisobo of the Eigth Sword of Light. Designed for close combat, this custom Stalker replaces the LRM launchers with twin SRM-6 racks in each torso and installed six additional heat sinks. Quirk: Combat Computer Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.17 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是第八光之剑少将贾加文·托里索博的私人机甲。这款定制潜行者专为近战而设，以每侧躯干内的双联SRM-6挂架取代LRM发射器，并加装了六个散热器。 特性：战斗计算机 投放费用倍率：1.17 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上
巨无霸、近距支援与远程突击

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The personal 'Mech of Sho-sho Jagawen Torisobo of the Eigth Sword of Light. Designed for close combat, this custom Stalker replaced the LRM launchers with twin SRM-6 racks in each torso and installed six additional heat sinks.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是第八光之剑少将贾加文·托里索博的私人机甲。这款定制潜行者专为近战而设，以每侧躯干内的双联SRM-6挂架取代LRM发射器，并加装了六个散热器。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Stalker 3F mounts a ridiculous amount of weaponry, even for an assault 'Mech. It is also notable for its incredibly poor heat management, which is the cost it pays for such amazing damage output. Powerful, but to be used wisely. Quirk: Combat Computer Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.23 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Stalker 3F 搭载的武器多到离谱，即便以突击机甲的标准来看也是如此。它还以散热管理极其糟糕而闻名，这正是它为如此惊人的伤害输出所付出的代价。威力强大，但需善加运用。 特性：战斗计算机 投放费用倍率：1.23 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: It's not flashy. It's not the cutting edge. It just keeps coming.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 它不炫目。它不是最前沿的。它就是源源不断地打过来。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A unit used by the 4th Sword of Light, this variant of the Stalker replaces the heat sinks with Double Heat Sinks, adds Artemis IV FCS to the LRM-10 launchers, and replaces the SRM-6 packs with four Streak SRM-2 systems. Quirk: Combat Computer Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是第4光之剑使用的单位，此潜行者变型把散热器换成双散热器，为LRM-10发射器加装阿尔忒弥斯IV火控系统，并以四套连发SRM-2系统取代SRM-6包。 特性：战斗计算机 投放费用倍率：1.15 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: It's not flashy. It's not the cutting edge. It just keeps coming.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 它不炫目。它不是最前沿的。它就是源源不断地打过来。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A battlefield refit of the -3F, adding some more protection for the MechWarriors piloting the 'Mech in form of CASE protection for the ammunition and an armored cowl for the cockpit. Quirk: Combat Computer Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.13 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: -3F 的战地改装型，为弹药加装 CASE 防护、为座舱加装装甲护罩，从而为驾驶该机甲的机甲战士提供更多保护。 特性：战斗计算机 投放费用倍率：1.13 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: It's not flashy. It's not the cutting edge. It just keeps coming.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 它不炫目。它不是最前沿的。它就是源源不断地打过来。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A total refit of the -3F, replacing much of the equipment and weapons with aquired clan tech. Mainly seen amongst the more prominent Mercenary outfits, such as the Wolf's Dragoons or Kell Hounds. Quirk: Combat Computer Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是对-3F的全面改装，将大部分设备与武器替换为获取来的部族科技。它主要出现在较为知名的雇佣兵部队中，例如沃尔夫龙骑兵或凯尔猎犬。 特性：战斗计算机 投放费用倍率：1.15 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: It's not flashy. It's not the cutting edge. It just keeps coming.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 它不炫目。它不是最前沿的。它就是源源不断地打过来。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The -4F is a refresh of the -3F, updating its weaponry and using an Endo Steel chassis. The build is focused around two MRM-30 launchers and two ER Large Lasers, with four Medium Pulse Lasers providing extra firepower as needed. However, the design struggles majorly with heat even with 5 external double heat sinks, reducing its combat effectiveness. Quirk: Combat Computer Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: -4F 是 -3F 的翻新版，更新了武器配置并采用内骨架底盘。其构型以两具 MRM-30 发射器和两门增程大型激光为核心，另有四门中型脉冲激光在需要时提供额外火力。然而，即便装有 5 具外部双散热器，该设计仍严重受困于散热问题，战斗力因此打了折扣。 特性：战斗计算机 投放费用倍率：1.15 手臂驱动器限制：左上臂、右上臂

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: It's not flashy. It's not the cutting edge. It just keeps coming.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 它不炫目。它不是最前沿的。它就是源源不断地打过来。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A field refit of the -3H, upgrading the SRM6 launchers to Streak models and the Medium lasers to Pulse variants. Taking the design back to the root of the -3F model, two ER Large Lasers are added by changing to an Endo Steel chassis and downgrading the LRM launchers to 10 tubes each. Quirk: Combat Computer Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: -3H的战地改装型，将SRM6发射器升级为连发型号，中型激光升级为脉冲型号。为让设计回归-3F型号的本源，通过改用内骨架底盘并把LRM发射器降级为每具10管，又加装了两门增程大型激光。 特性：战斗计算机 投放费用倍率：1.15 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: It's not flashy. It's not the cutting edge. It just keeps coming.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 它不炫目。它不是最前沿的。它就是源源不断地打过来。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Outfitted with the relatively recently rediscovered Star League technology of circa 3050, the FedCom 5S can be characterized primarily by its tendency to overheat. The designers behind this variant took the simple expedient of upgrading its engine and firepower without taking heat build-up into consideration. The 'Mech has had its engine replaced with an XL Engine and the large lasers have been removed and replaced with two Thunderbolt-12 Large Pulse Lasers. For protection against ammunition explosions, CASE has been added to both side torsos, and an Deprus Swarmshot Anti-Missile System has been added for protection against incoming missiles. Quirk: Combat Computer Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: FedCom 5S 装备了 3050 年前后才被重新发现的星际联盟技术，其最显著的特点便是极易过热。该变型机的设计者只图方便，升级了引擎与火力，却未考虑热量的累积。机甲的引擎已更换为 XL 引擎，大型激光被拆除，代之以两门 Thunderbolt-12 大型脉冲激光。为防范弹药殉爆，两侧躯干均加装了 CASE；为抵御来袭导弹，还加装了一套 Deprus Swarmshot 反导系统。 特性：战斗计算机 投放费用倍率：1.15 手臂驱动器限制：左上臂、右上臂

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: It's not flashy. It's not the cutting edge. It just keeps coming.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 它不炫目。它不是最前沿的。它就是源源不断地打过来。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Implied to be a Stalker piloted by J. Elliot Jamison, the Misery Hero 'Mech retains the STK-3F's twin Medium Lasers in each arm, right torso mounted SRM-6 and center torso mounted Large Laser but removes the remaining SRM-6 and LRM-10s to mount a mammoth Gauss Rifle in the left torso. Carrying two tons each of Gauss rounds and SRM missiles, twenty-two single heat sinks strive to keep the Misery in the thick of combat. Quirk: Combat Computer Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 相传是由J. Elliot Jamison驾驶的一台跟踪者，这台名为苦难的英雄机甲保留了STK-3F每条手臂上的两门中型激光、右躯干的SRM-6与中央躯干的大型激光，但拆除了其余的SRM-6与LRM-10，以便在左躯干安装一门巨型高斯步枪。它分别携带两吨高斯弹药与两吨SRM导弹，二十二具单散热器则竭力让苦难始终冲杀在战斗最激烈处。 特性：战斗计算机 投放费用倍率：1.15 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Implied to be a Stalker piloted by J. Elliot Jamison, the Misery Hero 'Mech retains the STK-3F's twin Medium Lasers in each arm, right torso mounted SRM-6 and center torso mounted Large Laser but removes the remaining SRM-6 and LRM-10s to mount a mammoth Gauss Rifle in the left torso. Carrying two tons each of Gauss rounds and SRM missiles, twenty-two single heat sinks strive to keep the Misery in the thick of combat.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 据推测是一台由J·埃利奥特·贾米森驾驶的潜行者，苦难英雄机甲保留了STK-3F双臂各一对中型激光器、右躯干的SRM-6和中央躯干的大型激光器，但拆掉了其余的SRM-6和LRM-10，以在左躯干装上一门巨型磁轨炮。它各携带两吨磁轨炮弹和SRM导弹，二十二具单重散热器努力让苦难留在激战中心。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The big gun on the Stalking Spider is its ER PPC, which allows it deal a strong strike from long ranges. For close-up work, it has a pair of SRM-4 launchers and a pair of Medium Pulse Lasers. While the design can build a significant amount of heat if the MechWarrior constantly alpha strikes, an experienced pilot should be able to manage the Stalking Spider's heat easily. The design can stay at long range and snipe with its ER PPC, then quickly close to finish off an opponent with its pulse lasers and missiles. Quirk: Stable Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 潜行蜘蛛的大杀器是它的增程粒子炮，能在远距离上打出强力一击。近身作战时，它有一对SRM-4发射器和一对中型脉冲激光。虽然若机甲战士不停全力齐射会积累相当多的热量，但老练的飞行员应该能轻松管理潜行蜘蛛的热量。该设计可以停留在远距离用增程粒子炮狙击，然后迅速逼近用脉冲激光和导弹了结对手。 特性：武器稳定 投放费用倍率：1.1

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: After obtaining the husk of an Inner Sphere Tarantula, Clan Cloud Cobra scientists decided to use it as the basis for a quadruped BattleMech. The 'Mech received the name Stalking Spider because it mounts enough jump jets in the legs to rocket it to 150 meters in one jump. Because the MechWarrior must move the legs during the jump, it appears that the design is crawling through the air like a spider, making it very impressive during drops. The Stalking Spider also uses MASC to move up to 119 km/h in short bursts.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 云眼镜蛇部族的科学家在获得一具内层星域狼蛛的残骸后，决定以它为基础打造一台四足战斗机甲。这台机甲得名“潜行蜘蛛”，因为它的腿部装有足够的跳跃推进器，一次跳跃便能将它送上150米高空。由于机甲战士在跳跃过程中必须摆动腿部，看起来就像这台设计正以蜘蛛般的姿态在空中爬行，在空降时极为壮观。潜行蜘蛛还装有MASC，可在短时间内加速至119 km/h。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This variant of the Stalking Spider, introduced 3060, removes the PPC and missiles, but retains the pulse lasers. It adds a Heavy Large Laser and a Targeting Computer to direct the 'Mech's laser fire. This hunter-killer is aided by the inclusion of an Active Probe and TAG. An additional double heat sink keeps heat levels manageable. Quirk: Stable Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是3060年推出的潜行蜘蛛变型，拆掉粒子炮与导弹，但保留脉冲激光；它加装一门重型大型激光和一台瞄准计算机来引导机甲的激光火力。这台猎杀者还得益于主动探测器与TAG的加入。一个额外双散热器让热量水平保持可控。 特性：武器稳定 投放费用倍率：1.1

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: After obtaining the husk of an Inner Sphere Tarantula, Clan Cloud Cobra scientists decided to use it as the basis for a quadruped BattleMech. The 'Mech received the name Stalking Spider because it mounts enough jump jets in the legs to rocket it to 150 meters in one jump. Because the MechWarrior must move the legs during the jump, it appears that the design is crawling through the air like a spider, making it very impressive during drops. The Stalking Spider also uses MASC to move up to 119 km/h in short bursts.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 云眼镜蛇部族的科学家在获得一具内层星域狼蛛的残骸后，决定以它为基础打造一台四足战斗机甲。这台机甲得名“潜行蜘蛛”，因为它的腿部装有足够的跳跃推进器，一次跳跃便能将它送上150米高空。由于机甲战士在跳跃过程中必须摆动腿部，看起来就像这台设计正以蜘蛛般的姿态在空中爬行，在空降时极为壮观。潜行蜘蛛还装有MASC，可在短时间内加速至119 km/h。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The primary loadout of the Starhawk brings an Ultra AC/10 in each arm, with a right shoulder mounted SRM 6 for some extra short range punch. An active probe and an ECM suite provides some basic EWS capabilities. Quirk: Well Balanced Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Starhawk 的主配装在每侧手臂各配备一门 Ultra AC/10，右肩安装的 SRM 6 则提供额外的近距离打击力。主动探测器与电子对抗套件赋予其基本的电子战能力。 特性：良好平衡 投放费用倍率：1.11 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: After winning the design to the Timberwolf legs from Clan Wolf during a Trial of Possession, Clan Snow Raven quickly combined the legs with the torso  of a Hellbringer. The result was the 70 ton OmniMech called the Starhawk. It sports a 350 XL engine to carry, making it adequately agile for the Clan's needs, but not much of the design made it stand out compared to other already established 'Mechs. The Starhawk was never seen as a success and are now rare to spot outside of garrison duties.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在占有试炼中从狼族赢得铁木狼腿部设计后，雪鸦氏族迅速把这些腿与地狱使者的躯干结合起来。结果就是这台名为星鹰的70吨全方位机甲。它配有350 XL引擎以承载重量，机动性足以满足氏族需求，但该设计相较其他已成型的机甲并无太多突出之处。星鹰从未被视为成功之作，如今在驻防任务之外已很少见到。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A Star League era mech, the Starslayer was intended to replace the Crab as the SLDF’s standard medium chassis, though politics kept it from seeing full production until 2781. A 50 ton medium mech, the Starslayer is powered by a 250-rated fusion core and has 5 JJ’s for maximum mobility. The STY-2C carries 2 Large Lasers, with a pair of Medium Lasers and a Small laser for closer ranged combat. An SRM-4 with a ton of ammo rounds out the design. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Starslayer 是星际联盟时代的机甲，本打算取代 Crab 成为 SLDF 的标准中型底盘，但政治因素使其直到 2781 年才得以全面量产。这具 50 吨的中型机甲由一台 250 级聚变核心驱动，并配备 5 具跳跃推进器以实现最大机动性。STY-2C 搭载 2 具大型激光，另有两具中型激光和一具小型激光用于近距离作战。一具 SRM-4 及一吨弹药使整个设计更趋完善。 特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1.04 手臂驱动器限制：右上臂

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Stealth STH-2U combines both energy and missile weapons for a varied weapons profile. One SRM-6 and one Streak SRM-2 launcher provides short range punch, while the two Medium Lasers and Small Laser provides more consistent damage, not being ammunition reliant. Quirk: Improved Sensors Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 隐形STH-2U把能量与导弹武器结合起来，形成多样的武器组合。一具SRM-6和一具连发SRM-2发射器提供近程打击力，而两门中型激光与一门小型激光则提供更稳定的伤害，不依赖弹药。 特性：改进传感器 投放费用倍率：1.03

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 2D removes the weapons from the Stealth and retains the Active Probe. The Stealth has been re armed with a Streak SRM-6 launcher and a trio of ER Medium Lasers, making the 'Mech devastatingly powerful at short to medium ranges.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 2D 移除了潜行者的武器但保留主动探测器。潜行者重新武装为一具连续 SRM-6 发射器和三门 ER 中型激光，使这台机甲在中近距离强得可怕。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The STL-7CE Stiletto was one of very few ultralight BattleMechs designed for a specific combat role: to fight short-range delaying actions and to engage the Lyran Commonwealth's new COM-2D Commando reconnaissance 'Mech. During the 2460s and 2470s, quantities of Commandos began appearing in regiments along the Steiner/Kurita border, a situation that concerned Lord Kurita greatly. Deciding to assume the offensive, he ordered a new BattleMech design constructed, cheaper than its intended adversary and available in quantity. The result, the Stiletto, entered full-scale production in 2473. This Variant of the Stiletto has been Used in Solaris for Exclusive Use in Ultralight Mech Combat. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.97
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: STL-7CE Stiletto 是为数不多为特定作战角色而设计的超轻型战斗机甲之一：执行近距离迟滞作战，并对抗莱兰联邦新型的 COM-2D Commando 侦察机甲。在 2460 年代和 2470 年代，大量 Commando 开始出现在斯坦纳/库瑞塔边境的军团中，这一情况令库瑞塔领主深感忧虑。他决定转入攻势，下令设计一款新型战斗机甲，要求比预定对手更便宜且能大量供应。成果便是 Stiletto，它于 2473 年进入全面生产。该 Stiletto 变型曾被用于 Solaris 的超轻型机甲近战专属赛事。 特性：易于维护 投放费用倍率：0.97

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The STL-7S Stiletto was one of very few ultralight BattleMechs designed for a specific combat role: to fight short-range delaying actions and to engage the Lyran Commonwealth's new COM-2D Commando reconnaissance 'Mech. During the 2460s and 2470s, quantities of Commandos began appearing in regiments along the Steiner/Kurita border, a situation that concerned Lord Kurita greatly. Deciding to assume the offensive, he ordered a new BattleMech design constructed, cheaper than its intended adversary and available in quantity. The result, the Stiletto, entered full-scale production in 2473. This Variant of the Stiletto has been Used in Solaris for Exclusive Use in Ultralight Mech Combat.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: As all the other 3-series variants, the Stiletto STO-3A is focused on longer range indirect fire, as its three LRM-5 launchers makes evident. For short range defense a single Stream SRM-2 is mounted in the center torso. Quirk: Multi Trac Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 与其他3系列变型一样，短剑STO-3A着重于较远距离的间接火力——三具LRM-5发射器便是明证。近程防御方面，中央躯干装有一具溪流SRM-2。 特性：多目标追踪 投放费用倍率：1.05 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Stiletto was engineered in a similar vein as the Black Hawk-KU or the Rakshasa, using examples of Fire Falcon OmniMechs salvaged from the battlefield immediately following the Battle of Coventry. The Stiletto has an identical speed profile as the Fire Falcon with a VOX 280 Light Engine giving it a top speed of 129.6 km/h.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 短剑的设计思路与黑鹰-KU 或罗刹相似，采用了在考文垂战役后立即从战场回收的火隼全能机甲样本。短剑的速度曲线与火隼相同，VOX 280 轻型引擎赋予它 129.6 公里/小时的最高速度。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Stiletto 3J adds ferro-fibrous armor and an endo steel chassis to enable the addition of 8 jump jets. Another sacrifice that had to be made was the removal of the C.A.S.E. protection for the two tons of missile ammunition kept in the right torso. Quirk: Multi Trac Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Stiletto 3J 增加了铁纤维装甲和内骨架机体，从而得以加装 8 具跳跃推进器。另一个不得不做出的牺牲，是取消了右躯干中两吨导弹弹药的 C.A.S.E. 防护。 特性：多目标追踪 投放费用倍率：1.05 手臂驱动器限制：左臂上部、右臂上部

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 3W trades one LRM-5 launcher and the Stream SRM launcher for a Large Pulse Laser, making the 'Mech capable to handles prolonged engagements without the MechWarrior having to worry about being complexly defenseless once all the ammunition is used up. Quirk: Multi Trac Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 3W以一具LRM-5发射器和连发SRM发射器换取一门大型脉冲激光，使这台机甲能够应付持久交战，机甲战士无需担心弹药耗尽后彻底失去自卫能力。 特性：多重追踪 投放费用倍率：1.05 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: In 2680, the Star League requested designers to develop 'Mechs which could fly as well as function as standard 'Mechs. The first Land-Air 'Mech off the drawing board, the Shadow Hawk LAM, proved so fatally flawed, the concept was almost shelved. However, LexaTech Industries reworked the conversion equipment and unveiled the first viable LAM, the Stinger LAM in 2688, based on the old Stinger design. LexaTech's reworking of the concept proved so successful, the Land-Air 'Mech became highly sought after, especially for space combat operations. In fact, the Stinger LAM first saw combat destroying a nuclear weapons facility in the Oort Cloud orbiting Sol, Terra's star. Found in the Draconis Combine, this variant uses two pairs of Martell Small Lasers on the arms instead of a single Medium Laser. Quirk: Land Air Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 2680年，星际联盟要求设计者研制既能飞行又能作为标准机甲运作的机甲。第一台走下图纸的陆空机甲——影子鹰LAM——缺陷致命，几乎使整个构想被搁置。然而莱克萨科技工业重新设计了变形设备，并于2688年基于老式蛰针设计推出了第一台可行的LAM：蛰针LAM。莱克萨对这套构想的重做极为成功，陆空机甲随即备受追捧，尤其是在太空作战中。事实上，蛰针LAM的首次战斗，是摧毁了绕地球恒星太阳运行的奥尔特云中的一处核武器设施。此变型见于龙脉联合体，以两对马特尔小型激光取代了单门中型激光。 特性：陆空机甲 投放费用倍率：0.99

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Stinger STG-3GD is a custom Clan-tech full conversion fielded by the mercenary command known as Grey Death Legion. One ER Medium Laser and two Heavy Machine Guns combined with its mobility fulfills the role of an anti-squad and infantry capable scout 'Mech. Quirk: Ubiquitous Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.97
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Stinger STG-3GD 是由名为 Grey Death Legion 的雇佣兵部队装备的部族科技全套改装定制机。一门增程中型激光和两挺重型机枪，再加上其机动性，使它足以胜任一台能对抗步兵班组的侦察机甲。 特性：随处可见 投放费用倍率：0.97

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Based on the 3P variant and introduced in 3076, this model also uses Endo Steel chassis and adds an XL Engine. The engine gives the STG-5G a top speed of 111 km/h and provides enough weight savings to add more armor and an advanced PPC Capacitor.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 基于 3P 变体并于 3076 年推出，此型号同样使用内骨骼底盘并加装 XL 引擎。该引擎让 STG-5G 的最高速度达到 111 公里/小时，并省出足够重量加装更多装甲和一台先进 PPC 电容器。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A common field refit of the 3R, replacing the Machine Guns with an extra Medium Laser and a C3 slave unit. Quirk: Ubiquitous Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.95
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是3R常见的战场改装，以一门额外的中型激光与一个C3从属单元取代机枪。 特性：随处可见 投放费用倍率：0.95

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Created in 3057, the Stinger 3T is a product of a joint project between Pinard Protectorates and Vandenburg Mechanized Industries to develop an upgraded Stinger for use by the TDF. Based on the STG-3R, the 3T swaps the Machine Guns for Small Lasers and the Medium Laser for a Pulse model. Ferro-Fibrous armor is used to increase protection. Quirk: Ubiquitous Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.97
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 蛰针3T于3057年问世，是皮纳尔保护国与范登堡机械化工业联合项目的成果，旨在为TDF研制一款升级版蛰针。3T以STG-3R为基础，把机枪换成小型激光，中型激光换成脉冲型号，并用铁纤维装甲提升防护。 特性：无处不在 投放费用倍率：0.97

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Created in 3057, the Stinger 3T is a product of a joint project between Pinard Protectorates and Vandenburg Mechanized Industries to develop an upgraded Stinger for use by the TDF. Based on the STG-3R, the 3T swaps the Machine Guns for Small Lasers and the Medium Laser for a Pulse model. Ferro-Fibrous armor is used to increase protection.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Stinger Cs emerging from the Wolf Empire's Keystone factory mirror those of the early Clans. Initially developed by the Hell's Horses as a training unit, other Clans found the Stinger to be a competent fighter, especially useful when Trials did not necessitate wasting larger, more valuable BattleMechs. An ER Medium Laser, two Machine Guns and a Small Pulse Laser makes for an surprising amount of damage potential from such a light 'Mech. Quirk: Ubiquitous Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.01
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 狼帝国内基斯通工厂出产的蛰针C，与早期部族的版本如出一辙。它最初由地狱马部族作为训练单位研制，其他部族却发现蛰针是称职的战斗机，尤其在试炼不必浪费更大、更宝贵的战斗机甲时格外有用。一门增程中型激光、两挺机枪和一门小型脉冲激光，使这样一台轻型机甲拥有出人意料的伤害潜力。 特性：无处不在 投放费用倍率：1.01

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The C 2, created by the Blood Spirits, swaps the machine guns for another laser. The Wolves deploy this variant as a harasser, reserving the primary version for scouting and anti-piracy duties. Quirk: Ubiquitous Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.01
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 由血灵部族打造的C 2以另一门激光取代机枪。狼部族将此变型用作骚扰车，把主型号留作侦察与反海盗任务。 特性：无处不在 投放费用倍率：1.01

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The M1, nicknamed 'First Modification' by the techs on Chara III, is a field modification of the STG-3R that exchanges both machine guns and their ammunition for four small lasers, two mounted in each arm. Quirk: Ubiquitous Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.97

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The design featured Large Pulse Lasers in each arm, twin Gauss Rifles mounted behind flip-open circular firing ports on each side torso, and an almost superfluous Small Pulse Laser located above the cockpit. The Stone Rhino also sported an interesting feature; each arm contained a retractable, shock-absorbing cowl covering the weapon barrels. This allowed MechWarriors to use the arms as battering rams without damaging the weaponry. Quirk: Distracting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.22 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该设计在每臂各装一门大型脉冲激光，两侧躯干各在可翻转的圆形射击口后方装有两门高斯步枪，驾驶舱上方还有一门几乎多余的 Small Pulse Laser。Stone Rhino 还有一项有趣的特点：每条手臂都带有可收放、能吸收冲击的护罩，将炮管遮盖起来。这让机甲战士能够用双臂充当撞锤，而不必担心损坏武器。 特性：干扰 投放费用倍率：1.22 手臂驱动器限制：左上臂、右上臂

The Stone Rhino also sported an interesting feature; each arm contained a retractable, shock-absorbing cowl covering the weapon barrels. This allowed MechWarriors to use the arms as battering rams without damaging the weaponry.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该设计在每臂装备大型脉冲激光，两侧躯干各在翻开式圆形射击口后安装两门高斯步枪，驾驶舱上方还有一门近乎多余的轻型脉冲激光。石犀牛还有一个有趣特征：每臂都包含一个可伸缩的减震罩盖住炮管，使机甲战士能把手臂当攻城锤使用而不损坏武器。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: In order to plug holes in their touman, Clan Goliath Scorpion scientists revisited the Behemoth. Like Clan Smoke Jaguar before them, they upgraded and improved upon the design. This version used an Extra-light Engine to mount a pair of Thunderstroke Series 2b Gauss Rifles along the top of the 'Mech. Each arm carried a Series 4D-2 Heavy Large Laser, a Series 22a Heavy Medium Laser, and a General Systems Heavy Small Laser. It retained the shock-absorbing cowls of the original. Another pair of Heavy Mediums protected the rear of the 'Mech. A head-mounted Shield-3 Anti-Missile System defended against missiles, while an Anti-Personnel Pod in each leg discouraged unarmored infantry. This design had jump jets, nineteen tons of armor, and a meager sixteen double heat sinks. Quirk: Distracting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.24 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper

Each arm carried a Series 4D-2 Heavy Large Laser, a Series 22a Heavy Medium Laser, and a General Systems Heavy Small Laser. It retained the shock-absorbing cowls of the original. Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A variable range variant, the Stone Rhino 4 uses an XL Engine to provide weight savings for four LRM 10s to lay down impressive long range fire. Backing these up are a pair of Ultra AC-10s for mid-range engagements. From there, four ER Medium Lasers provide a solid short range punch. Lastly, four Machine Guns provide anti-infantry support. These combine to make a solid and well rounded configuration. Quirk: Distracting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.22 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Stone Rhino 4 是一款可变射程变型，它采用 XL 引擎节省重量，从而装下四具 LRM 10 倾泻出可观的远程火力。为其提供支援的是两门 Ultra AC-10，负责中距离交战；再往近处，四门增程中型激光提供扎实的近距离打击力；最后，四挺机枪提供反步兵支援。这些武器结合起来，构成了一套稳健而均衡的配置。 特性：扰敌 投放费用倍率：1.22 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A variable range variant, the Stone Rhino 4 uses an XL Engine to provide weight savings for four LRM 10s to lay down impressive long range fire. Backing these up are a pair of Ultra AC-10s for mid-range engagements. From there, four ER Medium Lasers provide a solid short range punch. Lastly, four Machine Guns provide anti-infantry support. These combine to make a solid and well rounded configuration.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 石犀牛 4 是一款全能射程变体，它使用 XL 引擎节省重量以搭载四具 LRM 10，倾泻可观远程火力。中距离交战由两门超速 AC-10 支援，四门 ER 中型激光提供扎实的近距离打击，最后四挺机枪提供反步兵支援。这些组合成一套扎实而均衡的配置。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A design based off of early specifications for Amaris's Folly, the Stone Rhino 5 uses a 400XL engine to reach speeds up up to 64.8 km/h. It is armed with four LB-5X Autocannons mounted in the torsos backed up by six ER Medium Lasers in the arms. Quirk: Distracting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.22 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是基于“阿马里斯之愚”早期规格的设计，石犀牛5采用一台400XL引擎达到最高64.8公里/小时。它装有四门装在躯干的LB-5X自动炮，并以六门臂载增程中型激光支援。 特性：扰敌 投放费用倍率：1.22 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A close combat design based on the Stone Rhino 5, the Stone Rhino 6 is armed with a simple yet effective loadout of 14 Medium Pulse Lasers. These are backed up by a single ER Small Laser. Quirk: Distracting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.22 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 石犀牛 6 是基于石犀牛 5 的近战设计，装备了简单而高效的 14 门中型脉冲激光，另有一门增程小型激光作为补充。 特性：扰敌 投放费用倍率：1.22 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A close combat design based on the Stone Rhino 5, the Stone Rhino 6 is armed with a simple yet effective loadout of 14 Medium Pulse Lasers. These are backed up by a single ER Small Laser.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 石犀牛 6 是基于石犀牛 5 的近战设计，装备简单却有效的 14 门中型脉冲激光，并由一门 ER 小型激光支援。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: With the STR-7 variant being designed for space operations, its full weaponry is energy based as to work efficiently in a vacuum environment, and the leg actuators have been reinforced to handle higher loads. The variant mounts a Large Pulse Laser on each Arm, a ER Larger Laser in each torso location and a Small Pulse Laser in the Head. 14 external Double Heat Sinks allows the STR-7 to operate its weapons and three Jump Jets inside an atmosphere. Quirk: Distracting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.22 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 由于STR-7变型为太空作战而设计，其武器全部为能量武器以便在真空环境中高效运作，腿部驱动器也经过加固以承受更高载荷。该变型每只手臂装一门大型脉冲激光，两侧躯干各一门增程大型激光，头部一门小型脉冲激光。14个外置双散热器让STR-7能在大气层内使用武器和三具跳跃推进器。 特性：扰敌 投放费用倍率：1.22 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

The variant mounts a Large Pulse Laser on each Arm, a ER Larger Laser in each torso location and a Small Pulse Laser in the Head. 14 external Double Heat Sinks allows the STR-7 to operate its weapons and three Jump Jets inside an atmosphere.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A direct-fire support loadout, the A uses a pair of ER PPCs. It retains the jump jets of the primary configuration to aid in finding a spot to snipe from. The variant also mounts seven additional double heat sinks to keep the heat buildup controlled. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为直射支援配置，A 型采用两具增程粒子炮。它保留了主配置的跳跃推进器，以便寻找合适的狙击位置。该变型还额外搭载七具双散热器，以控制积热。 特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1.06 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Despite Khan Ceana Boques's demand for a low-cost and rugged design, the Blood Spirit scientist caste built the Stooping Hawk around a more expensive Endo Steel frame and ferro-fibrous armor to enhance Pod Space, but even they did not dare attempt the inclusion of an extralight fusion engine recognizing that this would be a step too far. While not as affordable as the Spirits would have preferred, the Stooping Hawk is a sturdy 'Mech with twenty-one and a half tons pod space and a ground speed maxing out at 86 km/h.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 尽管可汗塞安娜·博克斯要求一款低成本、坚固的设计，血灵科学家种姓仍围绕更昂贵的内骨骼框架与铁纤维装甲建造俯冲鹰以增强吊舱空间，但即便是他们也不敢尝试加入超轻型聚变引擎——他们认识到那会是太过分的一步。虽然不如血灵所愿那样便宜，俯冲鹰仍是一台结实的机甲，拥有二十一吨半吊舱空间，地面速度最高 86 公里/小时。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The B configuration is a missile boat that is capable of delivering forty-five long-range missiles through its three LRM-15 launchers, each of which is aided by an Artemis IV FCS. Four tons of ammunition keep it well supplied, while a single ER Large Laser keeps it in the fight should ammunition run out. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: B配置是一艘导弹母舰，通过三具LRM-15发射器能投送四十五枚远程导弹，每具都由一套阿尔忒弥斯IV火控系统辅助。四吨弹药让它供应充足，而一门增程大型激光让它在弹药耗尽时仍能留在战斗中。 特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1.06 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Stooping Hawk C comes equipped with two ER Large Lasers and two ER Medium Lasers, all of which are guided by an advanced Targeting Computer. It also uses jump jets to vault up to 150 meters, like the A, and it makes use of seven additional double heat sinks, like the A. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This D configuration uses heavy laser technology captured from Clan Star Adder. This all-energy variant uses an ER Large Laser, two ER Medium Lasers, and an ER Small Laser, but its punch comes from three Heavy Medium Lasers. In order to combat the massive heat buildup this design can produce, twelve double heat sinks are added. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Stooping Hawk's primary configuration uses jump jets to vault up to 150 meters at a time. Its main gun is an Ultra Autocannon/10 that has enough rounds to keep it supplied throughout a traditional Trial. It is supported by four medium lasers, two extended range versions, and two pulses. The medium-range weaponry allows the 'Mech to excel at Trials where it can use cover (and its jumping ability) to its advantage. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Stooping Hawk 的主配置利用跳跃推进器一次可跃出 150 米。其主炮为一门超级自动炮/10，备弹充足，足以应付一场传统试炼的全过程。支援武器为四具中型激光——两具增程型、两具脉冲型。这些中距离武器让该机甲在能借助掩体（以及自身跳跃能力）的试炼中占尽优势。 特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1.06 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Predating the development of the OmniMech, the Storm Giant was an early Steel Viper mech commissioned by the then Khan, Sanra Mercer. Developed specifically to operate in the tropical environments of New Kent, the Storm Giant STG-1 is a 100-ton Mech with a 400-rated XL Engine. A pair of LRM-20’s make up the bulk of the Mechs firepower, with a pair of SSRM-6’s and a UAC/20 for close range combat. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.22 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A common sight in Clan Toumans, the 55 ton Stormcrow is a second generation OmniMech that entered production in 2930. Powered by a 330-rated XL Engine, a combination of Ferro-Fibrous and Endo Steel give the OmniMech 23 tons of Pod Space. The Stormcrow Attwater is the personal configuration of Mia Attwater of the Nova Cats. An anti aircraft specialist, her Stormcrow was reconfigured to improve its effectiveness in this role. A pair of LB-5X’s and a pair of LRM-5’s augmented by Artemis IV make up the Attwater’s armament with 6 Jump Jets filling the remaining pod space. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为部族部队中常见的存在，55吨的暴风鸦是第二代全向机甲，于2930年投产。它由一台330额定XL引擎驱动，铁纤维与内骨架的组合为这款全向机甲提供23吨挂载空间。暴风鸦阿特沃特是云豹部族米娅·阿特沃特的私人配置。作为防空专家，她的暴风鸦经过重新配置以提升该角色效能：一对LB-5X和一对加装阿尔忒弥斯IV的LRM-5构成阿特沃特的武装，其余挂载空间由6具跳跃推进器填满。 特性：稳定 投放费用倍率：1.08 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This unique configuration was the personal 'Mech of Star Captain Brone Kotare of Clan Smoke Jaguar. The Ryoken 'Kotare' carries a quintet of ER medium lasers in the right arm and a pair of Streak SRM-6 launchers in the left torso. The right torso houses a single LRM-20. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这一独特配置是部族烟虎（Clan Smoke Jaguar）星队长 Brone Kotare 的座机。Ryoken“Kotare”于右臂搭载五门增程中型激光，左侧躯干装有两组连发 SRM-6 发射器，右侧躯干内则安置一具 LRM-20。 特性：稳定 投放费用倍率：1.08 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A sleek, mobile, and versatile design, the Clan Stormcrow was long suspected to be one of the first OmniMechs produced by the Clans.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为一款流线型、机动且多用途的设计，氏族风暴鸦长期被认为是最早由氏族生产的全能机甲之一。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A sleek, mobile, and versatile design, the Lacerator comes equipped with 2 Clan AC/5's with 2 medium lasers as backup. An AMS is installed for defense. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Lacerator 造型流畅、机动灵活且用途多样，装备两门部族 AC/5，并以两门中型激光作为备用。另装有一套 AMS 用于防御。 特性：稳定 投放费用倍率：1.08 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A sleek, mobile, and versatile design, the Lacerator comes equipped with 2 Clan AC/5's with 2 medium lasers as backup. An AMS is installed for defense.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为一款线条流畅、机动灵活、用途广泛的设计，裂解者装有两门部族AC/5，另有2门中型激光作为后手，并安装了反导弹系统用于防御。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A 55 ton OmniMech that blends a lethal cocktail of speed and firepower, the Stormcrow is a common sight in many clan Toumans. Powered by a 330-rated XL Engine and built with a combination of an Endo Steel chassis and Ferro-Fibrous armor, the Stormcrow has 19 tons of pod space available. The Stormcrow P is armed with paired ER Large Lasers and Streak SRM-6’s. A trio of Medium Pulse Lasers round out the variant. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一款 55 吨的全向机甲，将速度与火力调成致命的组合，Stormcrow 在许多部族的 Touman 中都十分常见。它由额定 330 的 XL引擎驱动，采用内骨架底盘与铁纤维装甲的组合，拥有 19 吨可用吊舱空间。Stormcrow P 装备成对的增程大型激光和连发 SRM-6，另有三门中型脉冲激光补足该改型。 特性：稳定 投放费用倍率：1.06 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A 55 ton OmniMech that blends a lethal cocktail of speed and firepower, the Stormcrow is a common sight in many clan Toumans. Powered by a 330-rated XL Engine and built with a combination of an Endo Steel chassis and Ferro-Fibrous armor, the Stormcrow has 19 tons of pod space available. The Stormcrow P is armed with paired ER Large Lasers and Streak SRM-6’s. A trio of Medium Pulse Lasers round out the variant.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为一台把速度与火力调成致命鸡尾酒的55吨全方位机甲，暴风鸦在许多氏族图曼中都司空见惯。暴风鸦由一具330级XL引擎驱动，以底层钢底盘与铁纤装甲的组合建造，拥有19吨可用吊舱空间。暴风鸦P武装为成对的增程大型激光器和连发SRM-6。三兄弟中型脉冲激光器补全了该改型。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A common sight in Clan Toumans, the 55 ton Stormcrow is a second generation OmniMech that entered production in 2930. Powered by a 330-rated XL Engine, a combination of Ferro-Fibrous and Endo Steel give the OmniMech 23 tons of Pod Space. The Stormcrow TC is a modification to the B variant, that trades the UAC/20 for a Gauss Rifle and Targeting Computer. 4 ER Medium Lasers are the TC’s only other weapons. First seen at Tukayyid, the TC trades raw damage for increased accuracy and a smaller heat curve. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The W configuration of the Stormcrow shifts the role of the 'Mech towards a longer distance fire support 'Mech thanks to its four LRM-15 launchers. Two Medium Pulse Lasers provide some closer range protection if needed. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Stormcrow的W配置凭借四具LRM-15发射器，将机甲的角色转向更远距离的火力支援。如有需要，两门中型脉冲激光可提供一定的近距离防护。 特性：稳定 投放费用倍率：1.06 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A sleek, mobile, and versatile design, the Clan Stormcrow was long suspected to be one of the first OmniMechs produced by the Clans.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Designed for close combat, the Strider E carries a pair of highly accurate Streak SRM-6 launchers and a single Medium Laser. Quirk: Easy to Pilot Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.97 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Strider E 专为近距离战斗而设计，搭载两组命中精度极高的连发 SRM-6 发射器与一门中型激光。 特性：易于驾驶 投放费用倍率：0.97 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Designed for close combat, the Strider E carries a pair of highly accurate Streak SRM-6 launchers and a single Medium Laser.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 为近战而设计的阔步者E装有一对高精度连发SRM-6发射器和一门中型激光。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The F configuration of the Strider is intended for close range combat but unlike the Strider E it is not as dependent on ammunition based weapons. The primary weapons are a pair of Streak SRM-4 launchers backed up by two Medium Lasers. The 'Mech has also had six jump jets added, allowing it to jump up to one hundred and eighty meters. Quirk: Easy to Pilot Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.97 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Strider 的 F 配置专为近距离战斗设计，但与 Strider E 不同，它对弹药类武器的依赖没那么强。主武器为两具连发 SRM-4 发射器，另有两具中型激光作为支援。该机甲还加装了六具跳跃推进器，使其跳跃距离可达一百八十米。 特性：易于驾驶 投放费用倍率：0.97 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The F configuration of the Strider is intended for close range combat but unlike the Strider E it is not as dependent on ammunition based weapons. The primary weapons are a pair of Streak SRM-4 launchers backed up by two Medium Lasers. The 'Mech has also had six jump jets added, allowing it to jump up to one hundred and eighty meters.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 阔步者的F配置为近距离战斗而设，但不同于阔步者E，它不那么依赖弹药类武器。主武器是两具连发SRM-4发射器，由两门中型激光器提供后援。该机甲还加装了六个跳跃推进器，使其跳跃距离可达一百八十米。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The R loadout is a field upgrade developed in the midst of Operation Bulldog. This configuration utilized captured Clan Smoke Jaguar weapons to help bolster the SLDF forces in later waves. Based off the Strider E, thanks to lighter Clan weaponry it is able to mount two Clan-tech Streak SRM-6 launchers and a pair of Clan Medium Pulse Lasers. Quirk: Easy to Pilot Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.97 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: R 配置是在“斗牛犬行动”（Operation Bulldog）期间研发的战场升级。这套配置利用缴获的烟美洲豹部族武器，为后续几波攻势中的 SLDF 部队提供助力。它以步行者（Strider）E 型为基础，凭借更轻的部族武器，得以装设两具部族科技连发 SRM-6 发射器和两门部族中型脉冲激光。 特性：易于驾驶 投放费用倍率：0.97 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Strider OmniMech is based on the older Cicada BattleMech. The Strider is built on an Alshain Type KR240 Endo Steel chassis to help save on weight. Built with the rugged GM 240 fusion engine, the Strider has a top speed of 97.2 km/h. Outfitted with CASE, built around the durable GM 240, and protected with seven and a half tons of armor, the Strider is a durable 'Mech for its weight class; capable of suffering considerable damage before being disabled or destroyed.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 疾行者全能机甲以较老的蝉战斗机甲为基础。它采用 Alshain KR240 型内骨骼底盘以减轻重量。配备坚固的 GM 240 聚变引擎，疾行者最高速度达 97.2 公里/小时。它装有 C.A.S.E.、以耐用的 GM 240 为核心，并有七吨半装甲防护，在同重量级中属耐久型机甲；在瘫痪或被摧毁前能承受相当可观的损伤。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Striker STC-2C is built using rugged, off-the-shelf technologies that allow it to stand up to a great deal of punishment and enable easy repair. The 2C has a top speed of 64.8 km/h, provided by a 320-rated Fusion engine. For protection, it carries thirteen and a half tons of armor, solidly average for a 'Mech of the Striker's size. The Striker STC-2C dissipates the heat from its arsenal with fifteen standard heat sinks. It has an arsenal that is capable of engaging an enemy at a variety of ranges. At maximum range, the 2C brings its PPC and a AC/5 to bear. As the enemy closes, it can also make use of its Large Laser, though the unit's pilot will need to monitor their heat generation carefully. Finally, for close range defense, it has three Medium Lasers. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.12 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 打击者STC-2C采用坚固的现成技术建造，能承受大量打击且易于修理。2C由一台320额定聚变引擎驱动，最高速度64.8公里/小时。防护方面它带十三吨半装甲，对打击者这一尺寸的机甲而言正好是平均水平。打击者STC-2C用十五个标准散热器散发武器热量。它的武器组合能在多种距离上交战：最大射程上，2C可用粒子炮和一门AC/5攻击；敌人逼近后还可以动用大型激光，不过飞行员需要小心监控热量。最后，近距防御由三门中型激光负责。 特性：易于维护 投放费用倍率：1.12 手臂驱动器限制：左下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Striker was originally commissioned by the SLDF high command in 2571 for non-Royal SLDF units. Along with the Stalker, the Striker became one of the most common 'Mechs in service. The Striker was built with the intent of being rugged and reliable, but more importantly, allowed House Lords to reserve their precious and limited numbers of assault BattleMechs for their own personal armies. In this way, the Striker may have been the show of good faith the House Lords needed to make the Star League work. In spite of the 'Mech's dependability, the Striker was marginal compared with later assault BattleMechs, and was eventually relegated to serving in militia units, with the highest concentration ending up on the rimward edge of the Terran Hegemony. After the destruction of the Stormvanger lines in 2867, fewer than 300 Strikers were known to exist in 3058.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Striker 最初由 SLDF 最高指挥部于 2571 年委托研制，供非皇家 SLDF 部队使用。与 Stalker 一样，Striker 成为服役数量最多的机甲之一。Striker 的设计初衷是坚固可靠，但更重要的是，它让各家族领主得以把数量稀少而宝贵的突击战斗机甲保留给自己的私人军队。从这个意义上说，Striker 或许正是家族领主们为了让星际联盟得以运转所需的诚意之举。尽管该机甲可靠性出众，但与后来的突击战斗机甲相比仍显平庸，最终被降级到民兵部队服役，其中部署最集中的地区位于地球霸权靠近外围的边缘地带。在 2867 年 Stormvanger 生产线被摧毁之后，到 3058 年已知仅存不到 300 台 Striker。
