The removal of 5 heat sinks, allows a second Medium Laser to be mounted alongside an extra ton of armor.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为一种不常见的改装，维护者2V常见于无力更换或维修昂贵PPC的雇佣兵手中。维护者2V以标准的180引擎驱动，把PPC换成一门AC/5配2吨弹药。拆掉5具散热器后，得以在额外一吨装甲之外再装第二门中型激光器。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An uncommon refit, the Vindicator 2X is often seen in the hands of Mercenaries who lack the ability to replace or repair the expensive PPC. Powered by the standard 180 engine, the Vindicator 2X swaps the PPC for an AC/10 with a single ton of ammo. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.01 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为一种不常见的改装型号，Vindicator 2X 常出现在无力更换或维修昂贵粒子炮的雇佣兵手中。该机由标准 180 引擎驱动，用一门 AC/10 搭配一吨弹药取代了粒子炮。 特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1.01 手臂驱动器限制：右下臂

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An uncommon refit, the Vindicator 2X is often seen in the hands of Mercenaries who lack the ability to replace or repair the expensive PPC. Powered by the standard 180 engine, the Vindicator 2X swaps the PPC for an AC/10 with a single ton of ammo.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为一种不常见的改装，维护者2X常见于无力更换或维修昂贵PPC的雇佣兵手中。维护者2X以标准的180引擎驱动，把PPC换成一门AC/10配一吨弹药。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 5L variant is a more basic upgrade than the 4L and represents Ceres' attempt to produce a close-combat 'Mech superior to the FS9-0 Firestarter. Introduced in 3060 the 5L uses a standard engine, armor, and structure. The changes and advancements come in the weapons and the addition of a TSM system. The 'Mech's new weapons include an ER PPC, two ER medium lasers, two medium pulse lasers, a single Small Pulse Laser, and a small laser. This varied mix of energy weapons allows the MechWarrior piloting the 'Mech to balance their heat load to keep the TSM working at its optimum efficiency. In so doing, the Vindicator can deal a fair amount of damage with its Sword. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 5L变型是比4L更基础的升级方案，代表了Ceres试图打造一款优于FS9-0 Firestarter的近战机甲。5L于3060年推出，采用标准引擎、装甲与结构。变化与进步体现在武器上，并加装了TSM系统。机甲的新武器包括一门增程粒子炮、两门增程中型激光、两门中型脉冲激光、一门小型脉冲激光和一门小型激光。这种多样化的能量武器组合让驾驶机甲的机甲战士能够平衡热负荷，使TSM始终以最佳效率运作。如此一来，Vindicator便能以其佩剑造成相当可观的伤害。 特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1.03 手臂驱动器限制：右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Vindicator is one of the most well-known Capellan Confederation BattleMechs. This workhorse of the CCAF was originally built in 2826 between the First and Second Succession War to maximize the effectiveness of the Confederation's surviving production capabilities and fulfill as many roles as possible. Designed by committee, the Vindicator's 'jack-of-all-trades' nature means it does not excel in any one role but fulfills them adequately. With almost all of its components produced on Capella, the Vindicator is also cheap, easy to mass produce, and quick to repair with a ready supply of spare parts.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 维护者是卡佩兰邦联最知名的战斗机甲之一。它作为 CCAF 的主力机于 2826 年——第一次与第二次继承战争之间——建成，以最大化邦联幸存的产能、并尽可能承担更多角色。由委员会设计的"样样通"特性意味着它在任何单一角色上都不出众，却都能胜任。由于几乎所有部件都在卡佩拉生产，维护者还造价低廉、易于量产，且因备件充足而修理迅速。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Duncan Fisher once said the Butcher was the natural product of Solaris' sweaty and testosterone driven battles. Forged in the heat of battle and adorned with the remains of other Gladiator's Mechs. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 邓肯·费雪曾说，屠夫是索拉里斯那些汗水与高同驱动之战斗的自然产物——在战火中锻造，并以其他角斗士机甲的残骸为装饰。 特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1.05 手臂驱动器限制：右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Duncan fisher once said, the Butcher was the natural product of Solaris' sweaty and testosterone driven battles. Forged in the heat of battle and adorned with the remains of other Gladiator's Mechs.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 邓肯·费舍尔曾说，屠夫是索拉里斯那些汗水淋漓、高同驱动的战斗的自然产物。在战场的热度中锻造，并以其他角斗士机甲的残骸为饰。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: For similar reasons of its suboptimal but extensive armor layout, its brute-force primary armament of a pair of binary laser cannons was thermally inefficient but could be produced inhouse, whereas the originally planned ER PPCs were already growing scarce. The rest of the layout, three Medium Pulse Lasers, were still readily available in large quantities when originally designed. A 280 XL engine and four Jump Jets ensured that the 'Mech was mobile enough to quickly adapt on the battlefield, further helped by its extra strong communications suite. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 同样由于其欠佳但覆盖面广的装甲布局，它那套粗暴的双联激光炮主武器在热能上并不高效，却能自行生产——而原本计划的增程粒子炮当时已日渐稀缺。布局的其余部分，三门中型脉冲激光，在设计之初仍能大量获得。一台280 XL引擎和四具跳跃推进器确保该机甲足够机动，能在战场上迅速应变，其格外强大的通讯套件更助一臂之力。 特性：改进通讯 投放费用倍率：1.1

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The attrition of the First Succession War made commanders desperate for every BattleMech they could lay hands on. The horrific devastation of three decades of unremitting war drove the Free Worlds League Military in 2828 to issue a tender for a low-maintenance heavy 'Mech that could be manufactured quickly. The winner was the Viper by Kallon Industries. Their design chassis was slightly upsized from the Crusader, a rugged, proven 'Mech that enjoyed a good reputation amongst FWLM technicians. The scaleup was a bit crude, wasting weight on larger, hastily designed armor baffles that give it a ponderous look but provide impressive protection.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 第一次继承战争的消耗，让指挥官们极度渴求任何能到手的战斗机甲。三十年不间断战争带来的惨重破坏，促使自由世界联盟军队在 2828 年发出招标，寻求一款易于维护、可快速量产的重型机甲。中标者是 Kallon Industries 的 Viper。其设计骨架是在 Crusader 的基础上略微放大的，后者是一款坚固可靠、久经考验的机甲，在自由世界联盟军队的技术人员中口碑颇佳。这次放大处理略显粗糙，重量被浪费在仓促设计的、更大型的装甲隔板上，使该机看上去笨重，却带来了令人印象深刻的防护能力。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: As the wars continued after the fall of the Star League, it became harder and harder to find the components to keep building the Viper. Eventually the Kallon Industries had to accept that it had no choice but start downgrading the design, eventually landing on the VP-5, an improvised Third Succession War-era downgrade with only standard components and lasers. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 星际联盟覆亡之后战事绵延不绝，要继续建造毒蛇所需的部件越来越难找到。最终卡隆工业不得不承认别无选择，只能开始对该设计进行降级，最后推出了VP-5——一款为第三次继承战争时期临时拼凑的降级型号，仅使用标准部件与激光。 特性：改进通讯 投放费用倍率：1.08

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Viper's main weapon is a massive LBX AC/10 in the right torso, with two tons of ammunition in the right torso. A Streak SRM-2 and Small Laser are available to deal with any enemies too close for the large autocannon. Quirk: Improved Jammer Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Viper 的主武器是右躯干内的一门巨型 LBX AC/10，右躯干内备有两吨弹药。对于距离过近、大型自动炮无从应对的敌人，则可使用一具连发 SRM-2 和一门小型激光。 特性：改进干扰器 投放费用倍率：1.1

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Viper is a 35 ton BattleMech designed just before the Clan invasion started. When faced up against the much superior Clan 'Mechs, the Viper just didn't survive long enough to make it worth the cost due to its relatively slow speed for a 'Mech its size. As a result they design stayed mostly unknown, and only one production run was ever done. Most of the 'Mechs were sold to various Mercenary forces, where some are still found.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 毒蛇是一种35吨战斗机甲，就在氏族入侵开始前设计。面对远远优越的氏族机甲时，毒蛇因其相对于自身尺寸较为缓慢的速度，根本活不够久以证明其成本值得，因此该设计大多无人知晓，只进行过一次量产。大部分机甲卖给了各路雇佣兵部队，其中一些至今仍能见到。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The E2 loadout mounts two Medium Pulse Lasers in the left arm together with three Small Pulse Lasers in the right. One ER Medium and one ER small laser act as secondary firepower. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Long Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: E2挂载在左臂装两门中型脉冲激光，右臂三门小型脉冲激光，另有一门增程中型和一门增程小型激光作为次要火力。 特性：改进瞄准 - 远程 投放费用倍率：1.03 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Introduced in 2940, the Viper is a 40-ton OmniMech that emphasizes speed and armor, with only 8.5 tons of podspace available for weapons. A 320-rated XL Engine powers the Viper and 8 Jump Jets are hardwired into the chassis, further improving the mobility. The Viper Prime is armed with an SRM-6 and a pair of Medium Pulse Lasers. A pair of Machine Guns and an AMS fill the remaining podspace. Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 蝰蛇于 2940 年推出，是一款 40 吨全能机甲，强调速度与装甲，仅有 8.5 吨吊舱空间可用于武器。蝰蛇由一台 320 额定 XL 引擎驱动，底盘硬接了 8 个跳跃推进器，进一步提升机动性。蝰蛇主型号装备一具 SRM-6 和一对中型脉冲激光。两挺机枪和一套 AMS 填满剩余吊舱空间。投放费用倍率：1.03。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The F2 configuration of the Viper is focused on medium to close range engagements. Two ER Medium Laser provide longer range cover, while four SRM-4 and an ER Small Laser are used once the 'Mech has closed in on its enemies. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Long Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Viper 的 F2 配置侧重于中近距离交战。两门增程中型激光提供较远距离的火力掩护，而四具 SRM-4 和一门增程小型激光则在机甲逼近敌人后投入使用。 特性：改进瞄准 - 远程 投放费用倍率：1.03 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: V配置全部装能量武器，共五门脉冲激光和两门增程激光。 特性：改进瞄准 - 远程 投放费用倍率：1.03 手臂驱动器限制：全向

A head mounted ER Small Laser can be used if need for extra defense is required. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Long Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: W载荷极度偏重极近距离交战，装四具SRM-4发射器和两门增程中型激光。若需要额外防御，还可用头部一门增程小型激光。 特性：改进瞄准 - 远程 投放费用倍率：1.03 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: As the fight for the Inner Sphere started with the Clans' invasion, over time a number of Vipers were captured or recovered. A most of them very heavily damaged and no reliable supplies of replacements exist, the 'Mechs were quickly converted to use Inner Sphere weapons in form of a LB 10-X Autocannon and three Streak SRM-2 launchers. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Long Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.97 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 随着部族入侵拉开内层星域战事的序幕，日积月累有不少Viper被缴获或回收。由于其中大多受损严重，且没有可靠的替换零件来源，这些机甲很快被改装为使用内层星域武器，即一门LB 10-X自动炮和三具连发SRM-2发射器。 特性：改进瞄准 - 远程 投放费用倍率：0.97 手臂驱动器限制：全向

A pair of Machine Guns and an AMS fill the remaining podspace. Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An early Clan mech introduced by the Nova Cats, the Vision Quest was the first Clan mech to mount the new ER Large Lasers. Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An Age of War Mech, the 65 ton Von Rohrs was one of the first non-primitive Mechs to be fielded by the Draconis Combine. Powered by a 325-rated Fusion Core, the Von Rohrs VON 4RH-5 was armed with a PPC, an LRM-10 and a Flamer. Quirk: Cowl Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.07

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Wakazashi uses a Gauss rifle and an ER PPC to provide long range firepower. An opponent who closes with the Wakazashi, hoping to get under the minimum range of these weapons, is in for a rude shock: a massive AC/20 and a pair of ER Medium Lasers are used in order to deter any opponent that would close in. With three tons of ammunition for the Gauss Rifle and Autocannon, the Wakazashi is able to inflict large amounts of damage on a multitude of enemy forces. Quirk: Missile Jammer Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.19 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 胁差以一门高斯步枪和一门增程粒子炮提供远程火力。若对手为了钻到这些武器的最小射程内而逼近，就会迎来一个措手不及的惊喜：一门庞大的AC/20和两门增程中型激光专门用来震慑任何想靠近的敌人。凭借高斯步枪与自动炮共三吨弹药，胁差能对大量敌军造成巨大伤害。 特性：导弹干扰器 投放费用倍率：1.19 手臂驱动器限制：左下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Designed during the early years of the Golden Century, the Wakazashi (the sister sword of the katana) allowed Clan Jade Falcon the time to rebuild their then weakened touman. Never intended as a long-term production design, the durable Wakazashi was relatively easy to build but was difficult to repair or modify. Subsequently, the Wakazashi's reputation suffered with the appearance of the OmniMech. When the Falcon's fortunes improved in the early thirtieth century, Wakazashi production was shut down in favor of other designs.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 若狭（武士刀的姊妹刀）在黄金世纪早期被设计出来，让翡翠猎鹰氏族有时间重建当时被削弱的图曼。它从未被打算作为长期生产型号，耐用的若狭相对容易建造，但难以维修或改装。随后，随着全方位机甲的出现，若狭的名声受损。当三十世纪初猎鹰的运势好转时，若狭的生产被关停，转而生产其他设计。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The War Dog carries the long ranged and capable Gauss rifle as its primary weapon. It is backed up at short to medium ranges by a highly accurate Large Pulse Laser. For close combat situations, the 'Mech is armed with two Medium Pulse Lasers, a Small Pulse Laser, and two Streak SRM-2 One Shot Packs. For added defense against missile attacks, the 'Mech carries a anti-missile system. Quirk: Accurate Weapon - Gauss Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 战犬（War Dog）以射程远、性能可靠的高斯步枪作为主武器，并在中近距离由一门极为精准的大型脉冲激光提供支援。在近身战斗的情况下，这台机甲装备了两门中型脉冲激光、一门小型脉冲激光以及两具连发 SRM-2 单发弹包。为加强对导弹攻击的防御，该机甲还装有一套反导弹系统。 特性：精准武器 - 高斯 投放费用倍率：1.11 手臂驱动器限制：右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The War Dog is a 'Mech that was originally designed by the Star League for use by the SLDF and was thought to be lost to time. Plans for the War Dog were rediscovered by Snord's Irregulars and were turned over to the Blackwell Corporation. The War Dog has since become a powerful and respected force on the modern battlefield.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: War Dog 最初由星际联盟设计供 SLDF 使用，曾被认为已随时光湮没。War Dog 的图纸被斯诺德游骑兵重新发现，并移交给了布莱克威尔公司。此后，War Dog 成为现代战场上一股强大而受人敬重的力量。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A full clan conversion of the War Dog, used by the mercenary outfit the Wolf's Dragoons. Although all weapons were upgraded to Clan specification, the 'Mech keeps the same weapon configuration as the original -02FC, except for replacing the one-shot streak launchers with Streak SRM-6 ones. A C3 Slave computer was also added, a common occurance for Wolf's Dragoons rebuilds. Quirk: Accurate Weapon - Gauss Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.17 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是战犬的完全部族化改装，由雇佣兵部队狼之龙骑兵使用。所有武器虽已按部族规格升级，机甲却仍保持与原版-02FC相同的武器配置，只是把一次性连发发射器换成了连发SRM-6。此外还加装了1台C3从属计算机——这在狼之龙骑兵的重建机甲中十分常见。 <特性：精准武器（高斯） <投放费用倍率：1.17 <手臂驱动器限制：右臂下段

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The War Dog is a 'Mech that was originally designed by the Star League for use by the SLDF and was thought to be lost to time. Plans for the War Dog were rediscovered by Snord's Irregulars and were turned over to the Blackwell Corporation. The War Dog has since become a powerful and respected force on the modern battlefield.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Jade Falcon commanders were shocked to find themselves suffering losses from an unknown LAM that resembled a small Warhammer. Insulted that the Inner-Sphere forces disgraced the Warhammer lineage with a half-baked LAM, and being a bit more open minded on units, Jade Falcon scientists went to work, producing a 70t version loaded with Clan tech. Fielding the same powerful combo of twin ER PPCs, as well as a pair of Arrow Anti-Air missiles, these Warhammer LAMs provide withering fire on ground targets, and are able to defend themselves from modest aerospace defenses. Coupled with the improved maneuverability of a LAM, these units are finding themselves to be the backbone of quick-response anti-militia garrisons across Jade Falcon territory. Quirk: Land Air Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 翡翠猎鹰的指挥官们震惊地发现，己方竟因一架外形酷似小型 Warhammer 的未知 LAM 而蒙受伤亡。内层星域势力用一架半吊子的 LAM 玷污了 Warhammer 的血统，这让翡翠猎鹰的科学家们感到受辱；加上他们对各种单位的态度更为开放，于是着手研发，造出了一款满载部族科技的 70 吨型号。这些 Warhammer LAM 配备了同样强大的双增程粒子炮组合以及两枚箭式防空导弹，能对地面目标倾泻凶猛火力，同时也有能力抵御中等程度的航空航天防御力量。凭借 LAM 更出色的机动性，这些单位正逐渐成为翡翠猎鹰领地内各快速反应反民兵驻防部队的中坚力量。 特性：陆空机甲 投放费用倍率：1.16 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Well They did it again commander.. made a terrifying mech into a REALLY terrifying mech.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 呃，他们又干了一次，指挥官……把一台恐怖的机甲变成了一台真·恐怖的机甲。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The original Warhammer was designed as an assault BattleMech. However, it had been superseded by later and heavier 'Mech designs, though it remained a powerful weapons platform. The Clans wisely maintained and built on this solid frame a real assault 'Mech, the Warhammer IIC. This version drops the ER PPCs and replaces them with a pair of LB-10X's. The LBXs are backed up by paired ER Medium Lasers and Streak SRM-6's. Quirk: Integrated Searchlight Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.2 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 最初的风暴之锤是作为突击战斗机甲设计的。尽管后来被更重型的机甲设计取代，它依然是强力的武器平台。部族明智地维护并在这副坚固框架上发展出真正的突击机甲——风暴之锤IIC。此版本拆掉增程粒子炮，换成一对LB-10X。这些LBX由成对的增程中型激光和连发SRM-6支援。 特性：内置探照灯 投放费用倍率：1.2 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

However, it had been superseded by later and heavier 'Mech designs, though it remained a powerful weapons platform. The LBXs are backed up by paired ER Medium Lasers and Streak SRM-6's. Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.2.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The original Warhammer was designed as an assault BattleMech. However, it had been superseded by later and heavier 'Mech designs, though it remained a powerful weapons platform. The Clans wisely maintained and built on this solid frame a real assault 'Mech, the Warhammer IIC. The IIC-BL is a custom variant of the IIC-1 replaces the Medium Pulse Lasers with a pair of ER Medium lasers and removes the original SRM-6 for an ATM-6 with 3 tons of ammo. The IIC-BL is otherwise identical to the IIC-1 with the exception of a trio of Jump Jets added to the Torsos. Quirk: Integrated Searchlight Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.22 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Developed as part of Project Thor's Hammer, the Warhammer LAM aims to merge the effectiveness of the Warhammer's twin PPCs, with the mobility of a LAM, in hopes of aiding the fight against the Clans. While weight requirements forced the PPCs to be downsized to Light PPCs, they are equipped with PPC Capacitors for that extra punch, and the expansion of SRMs to twin SRM4's, as well as a sizable bomb bay, provide devastating short range firepower. This allows the Warhammer LAM to inflict serious damage on a flyover, then pepper the target at range with the Light PPCs from the rear, until enough gaps open up for the SRMs to exploit. Quirk: Land Air Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 战锤LAM作为“托尔之锤计划”的一部分研制，目标是融合战锤双粒子炮的效能与LAM的机动性，以期助力对抗部族。虽然重量要求迫使粒子炮缩小为轻型粒子炮，但它们加装了粒子炮电容器以保留那一击之力；SRM也扩充为双联SRM4，再加上一个可观的弹舱，提供了毁灭性的近程火力。这让战锤LAM能在掠袭飞行中造成严重伤害，随后从后方用轻型粒子炮在远距离上持续骚扰目标，直到打开足够多的缺口供SRM利用。 特性：陆空机甲 投放费用倍率：1.05 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Wow Boss, a Thor's Hammer production model? These things were rare as hell, considering the Clans took great offense to having LAMs built to fight them. They went out of their way to track down and destroy all the factories, and their warriors would focus on them even if it meant ignoring bigger threats. This is the basic model, pretty good at what it was set out to do: bomb, rear attack, then crit the enemy out. But remember, it's a LAM; none of that 'stand and shoot' stuff you might pull off in a Warhammer will work with this.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 哇老大，托尔之锤的量产型号？这些东西罕见得要命，因为氏族对有人造LAM来打他们极为恼怒。他们不遗余力地追踪并摧毁所有工厂，他们的战士就算要放过更大的威胁也会优先打它们。这是基础型号，很擅长它本来的任务：轰炸、后方袭击，然后把敌人打出致命伤。但要记住，它是LAM；你在重锤上可能玩出来的那种"站着对射"都不适用。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Developed as part of Project Thor's Hammer, the Warhammer LAM aims to merge the effectiveness of the Warhammer's twin PPCs, with the mobility of a LAM, in hopes of aiding the fight against the Clans. The B variant replaces the bomb bay and SRMs for MMLs, providing 16 tubes in total, and was marketed towards Mercenary groups. The lack of PPC Capacitors aids in repairs, and the loss of damage is replaced by the MMLs providing long range fire support with the LRMs. For close range combat, the quadrupling of SRMs fired offsets the loss of the bomb bay, but allows for a few more short range passes as the MMLs can fire multiple times. Quirk: Land Air Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Warhammer LAM作为“雷神之锤计划”的一部分研发，旨在将Warhammer双粒子炮的威力与LAM的机动性融为一体，以期助力对抗部族。B变型以MML替换弹舱和SRM，共提供16个发射管，并面向雇佣兵团体销售。省去粒子炮电容器有利于维修，损失的伤害则由MML发射LRM提供的远程火力支援弥补。近距战斗方面，SRM发射量增至四倍，弥补了弹舱的损失，同时还能多进行几次短程突袭，因为MML可以多次发射。 特性：陆空机甲 投放费用倍率：1.05 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A Merc's Hammer? These were never as popular as the advertisements claimed; the minimal ammo for the MMLs meant most Mercs would immediately buy a refit package to drop one of the leg MMLs for some extra ammunition. Though, they are great fire support units once you get past that ammo issue; anything that could outrange them, was often too slow to keep them in range, which meant they would often survive traps that would eliminate other fire support lances.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 雇佣兵之锤？这些从来没有广告宣称的那么受欢迎；MML的弹药极少，意味着大多数雇佣兵会立刻买一套改装包，拆掉一具腿部MML以换取额外弹药。不过，一旦你解决了弹药问题，它们就是极佳的火力支援单位；任何能在射程上超过它们的东西，往往又太慢而无法把它们留在射程内，这意味着它们常能在会消灭其他火力支援分队的陷阱中幸存。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Fulfilling the initial goal of Project Thor's Hammer, the Warhammer LAM ver. C is able to take out a Clan's Thor Omnimech with a single pass, and survive the encounter. While single-kill mechs were often relegated to the trashbin in the planning stages, the necessity of defeating a mech, and then claiming the salvage during the early Clan Invasion, saw such units come to the forefront of battle for a brief period. Quirk: Land Air Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 战锤LAM ver. C实现了“托尔之锤计划”的初衷：它能在一次通场中击杀部族的托尔全向机甲并全身而退。虽然“单位击杀型机甲”在规划阶段常被丢进废纸篓，但在部族入侵早期，既击败机甲又夺取战利品的必要性让这类单位短暂地走到了战斗前沿。 特性：陆空机甲 投放费用倍率：1.05 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Boss, you got a pilot you hate, but still want to rack up some kills with? If so, this is the mech for them. Those bombs will definitely destroy something, but then you're looking at either melee combat, or running interference, if not retreating, considering the lack of weaponry. I still can't believe this was a production model, what were the engineers thinking?!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 老大，你有个讨厌的飞行员，但又想攒点击杀数吗？那么，这就是给他准备的机甲。那些炸弹肯定会炸掉点东西，但考虑到缺乏武器，之后你要么打近战，要么就去干扰，不然就是撤退。我还是不敢相信这是量产型号，工程师当时在想什么？！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A battlefield refit of the 6R, switching the armor to Ferro-Fibrous allowing the upgrade of side torso mounted small lasers to Medium Pulse Lasers. An extra Small Laser was added to the center torso, and the cooling switched to use Double Heatsinks. Quirk: Integrated Searchlight Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是6R的野战改装，把装甲换成铁纤维，从而把侧躯干的小型激光升级为中型脉冲激光。中央躯干再加一门小型激光，冷却也改用双散热器。 特性：内置探照灯 投放费用倍率：1.1 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: One of the mainstays of the heavy 'Mechs. Solid, dependable, and heavy hitting.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 重型机甲的中坚之一。扎实、可靠、打击沉重。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A custom variant used by the Gray Death Legion mercenary outfit. Converting the Warhammer to full Clan technology greatly improved its combat potential, making it a proper line unit for the mercenaries. Two ER PPC, two ER Medium and two ER Small Lasers, a single SRM-6, and three Heavy Machine Guns allows the design to handle both large and small targets. Quirk: Integrated Searchlight Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是灰死军团雇佣兵部队使用的定制变型。把风暴之锤改为全部部族技术后，其作战潜力大幅提升，成为这支部队名副其实的战列单位。两门增程粒子炮、两门增程中型和两门增程小型激光、一具SRM-6以及三挺重型机枪，让该设计既能对付大型也能对付小型目标。 特性：内置探照灯 投放费用倍率：1.16 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: One of the mainstays of the heavy 'Mechs. Solid, dependable, and heavy hitting.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 重型机甲的中坚之一。扎实、可靠、打击沉重。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Piloted by Chu-sa Fengo Olesko, commander of Third Battalion of the Fifth Amphigean Light Assault Group replaced the SRM and ammunition with four tons of Communications Equipment to coordinate her forces. The only weapons remaining were the arm-mounted PPCs and torso-mounted medium lasers. Quirk: Integrated Searchlight Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 由第五Amphigean轻型突击群第三营营长Fengo Olesko中佐驾驶的这台机甲，把SRM及其弹药换成了四吨通讯设备，以便协调她的部队。剩下的武器只有安装在手臂上的粒子炮与装在躯干上的中型激光。 特性：集成探照灯 投放费用倍率：1.1 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: One of the mainstays of the heavy 'Mechs. Solid, dependable, and heavy hitting.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 重型机甲的中坚之一。扎实、可靠、打击沉重。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Known and revered across the Inner Sphere and beyond, the Warhammer is the pre-eminent heavy Mech. Debuting in 2515, the 70-ton Mech is a solid blend of firepower and mobility designed to outfight almost any opponent. Powered by a 350 XL Engine, the Warhammer WHM-6Rk is armed with a pair of PPC’s. A pair of Medium Lasers, Small Lasers, Machine Guns and an SRM-6 deter opponents from closing in. Double Heat Sinks round out the variant. Quirk: Integrated Searchlight Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Warhammer在内层星域乃至更远之处都闻名遐尔、备受尊崇，是最杰出的重型机甲。这款70吨的机甲于2515年首次亮相，是火力与机动性的坚实结合，设计目标就是要击败几乎所有对手。Warhammer WHM-6Rk由一台350 XL引擎驱动，装备一对粒子炮。一对中型激光、小型激光、机枪和一具SRM-6则阻止对手近身。双散热器构成了该变型的最后一块拼图。 特性：集成探照灯 投放费用倍率：1.1 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Known and revered across the Inner Sphere and beyond, the Warhammer is the pre-eminent heavy Mech. Debuting in 2515, the 70-ton Mech is a solid blend of firepower and mobility designed to outfight almost any opponent. Powered by a 350 XL Engine, the Warhammer WHM-6Rk is armed with a pair of PPC’s. A pair of Medium Lasers, Small Lasers, Machine Guns and an SRM-6 deter opponents from closing in. Double Heat Sinks round out the variant. Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在内天体及更远处广为人知、备受尊崇，重锤是最杰出的重型机甲。它于2515年首次亮相，这种70吨机甲是火力与机动性的坚实融合，设计上要打败几乎任何对手。重锤WHM-6Rk由一具350 XL引擎驱动，武装为两门PPC。一对中型激光器、小型激光器、机枪和一具SRM-6阻止对手逼近。双重散热器补全了该改型。投放成本倍率：1.1。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A refit of the 6R, freeing 6 tons of weight capacity by switching to double heat sinks. This allowed adding both more armor and CASE protection, improving the durability greatly. Further, a C3 slave unit was added for improved lance communications. Quirk: Integrated Searchlight Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是 6R 的改装型，通过换装双散热器腾出了 6 吨重量容量。这使其既能增加装甲，又能加装 CASE 防护，大幅提升了耐用性。此外还加装了一具 C3 从属单元，以改善小队通讯。 特性：集成探照灯 投放费用倍率：1.08 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: One of the mainstays of the heavy 'Mechs. Solid, dependable, and heavy hitting.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 重型机甲的中坚之一。扎实、可靠、打击沉重。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A fully Clan converted variant of the Warhammer, mainly seen with the Wolf's Dragoons mercenaries. Two ER PPC are the main damage source, with two ER Medium Laser, Medium Pulse Laser and Streak SRM-6 as extra firepower as needed at various ranges. An advanced targeting computer and ECM suite were also fitted. Quirk: Integrated Searchlight Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是风暴之锤的完全部族化变型，主要见于狼之龙骑兵雇佣兵部队。两门增程粒子炮是主要伤害来源，两门增程中型激光、中型脉冲激光和一具连发SRM-6则在不同距离上按需提供额外火力。它还配有一台先进瞄准计算机和一套电子对抗套件。 特性：内置探照灯 投放费用倍率：1.16 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: One of the mainstays of the heavy 'Mechs. Solid, dependable, and heavy hitting.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 重型机甲的中坚之一。扎实、可靠、打击沉重。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A subvariant of the WHM-6W, which adds a C3 slave computer by dropping the ECM suite. Quirk: Integrated Searchlight Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: WHM-6W的子变型，通过拆除电子对抗套件来加装一台C3从属计算机。 特性：集成探照灯 投放费用倍率：1.16 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: One of the mainstays of the heavy 'Mechs. Solid, dependable, and heavy hitting.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 重型机甲的中坚之一。扎实、可靠、打击沉重。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An experimental upgrade of the 6D done by Apple for the Lyran Alliance military forces. It mounts two cutting edge ER PPC, two Medium Lasers and two Machine Guns - all cooled by 18 single heat sinks. Quirk: Integrated Searchlight Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是Apple为莱兰联盟军队打造的6D实验性升级版。它装备两门最前沿的增程粒子炮、两门中型激光和两挺机枪，全部由18台单散热器冷却。 特性：集成探照灯 投放费用倍率：1.1 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: One of the mainstays of the heavy 'Mechs. Solid, dependable, and heavy hitting.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 重型机甲的中坚之一。扎实、可靠、打击沉重。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A Clan Buster upgrade, the Warhammer 7CS was developed specifically for Tukayyid. Designed as a general purpose unit designed for offence and defensive roles, the Warhammer 7CS mounts a 280-rated XL Engine and DHS. A pair of ER PPC’s and 4 Medium Lasers make up the bulk of the 7CS’s load out. A trio of Streak SRM-2’s with a ton of CASE protected ammo round out the weapons, while 4 Jump Jets offer additional mobility. Quirk: Integrated Searchlight Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Warhammer 7CS是专为图凯伊德之战研发的“部族杀手”升级型号。作为一款兼顾进攻与防御的通用单位，Warhammer 7CS搭载额定280的XL引擎和双散热器。两门增程粒子炮和4门中型激光构成7CS武器的主体。三具连发SRM-2外加一吨CASE保护的弹药补全了武器配置，另有4台跳跃推进器提供额外机动性。 特性：集成探照灯 投放费用倍率：1.1 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A Clan Buster upgrade, the Warhammer 7CS was developed specifically for Tukayyid. Designed as a general purpose unit designed for offence and defensive roles, the Warhammer 7CS mounts a 280-rated XL Engine and DHS. A pair of ER PPC’s and 4 Medium Lasers make up the bulk of the 7CS’s load out. A trio of Streak SRM-2’s with a ton of CASE protected ammo round out the weapons, while 4 Jump Jets offer additional mobility.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为一款"灭族者"升级，重锤7CS专为图卡伊德研发。7CS被设计为兼顾攻防的通用单位，装有一具280级XL引擎和双重散热器。两门增程PPC和4门中型激光器构成7CS负载的主体。三具连发SRM-2配一吨CASE保护的弹药补全武器，另有4个跳跃推进器提供额外机动性。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An alteration of the 6R model introduced in 2835, the 6D removed the machine guns and the SRM-6 launcher to add an additional four tons of armor to the design, increasing its leg protection, as well as two more heat sinks. The 6D was particularly favored by the Federated Suns. Quirk: Integrated Searchlight Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 6D 是 2835 年推出的 6R 型号改动版，它移除机枪和 SRM-6 发射器，为设计增加四吨装甲（提升腿部防护）以及两台额外散热器。6D 尤其受联邦太阳系青睐。 特质：内置探照灯 投放费用倍率：1.08 臂部驱动器限制：左下臂、右下臂

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: One of the mainstays of the heavy 'Mechs. Solid, dependable, and heavy hitting.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 重型机甲的中坚之一。扎实、可靠、打击沉重。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A house Kurita refresh of the 7K, using double heat sinks and Endo Steel to fit an impressive amount of weapons yet remain very well armored. Two ER PPC, four ER lasers and a Streak SRM-6 ensures the 'Mech can handle most threats at anything except extremely long ranges. Quirk: Integrated Searchlight Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是库瑞塔家族对7K的翻新，使用双散热器和内骨架，装入可观数量的武器同时保持极为出色的装甲。两门增程粒子炮、四门增程激光和一具连发SRM-6，确保该机甲除极远距离外几乎能应付大多数威胁。 特性：内置探照灯 投放费用倍率：1.1 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: One of the mainstays of the heavy 'Mechs. Solid, dependable, and heavy hitting.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 重型机甲的中坚之一。扎实、可靠、打击沉重。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Known and revered across the Inner Sphere and beyond, the Warhammer is the pre-eminent heavy Mech. Debuting in 2515, the 70-ton Mech is a solid blend of firepower and mobility designed to outfight almost any opponent. Powered by a 280 Fusion Core, the Warhammer WHM-7M-DC is armed with a pair of ER PPC’s. A Medium Laser, Machine Gun and SRM-6 deter opponents from closing in. A Command Console rounds out the design. Quirk: Integrated Searchlight Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Warhammer 闻名于内层星域内外并备受尊崇，是最杰出的重型机甲。这台 70 吨机甲于 2515 年首次亮相，将火力与机动性扎实地融为一体，旨在击败几乎任何对手。Warhammer WHM-7M-DC 由一台 280 聚变核心驱动，装备两门增程粒子炮。一门中型激光、一挺机枪和一具 SRM-6 可阻止对手逼近。指挥控制台则让该设计更为完善。 特性：集成探照灯 投放费用倍率：1.1 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Known and revered across the Inner Sphere and beyond, the Warhammer is the pre-eminent heavy Mech. Debuting in 2515, the 70-ton Mech is a solid blend of firepower and mobility designed to outfight almost any opponent. Powered by a 280 Fusion Core, the Warhammer WHM-7M-DC is armed with a pair of ER PPC’s. A Medium Laser, Machine Gun and SRM-6 deter opponents from closing in. A Command Console rounds out the design.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 风暴之锤在内层星域内外广为人知并备受崇敬，是最杰出的重型机甲。这台70吨机甲于2515年首次亮相，是火力与机动性的扎实融合，设计用于压制几乎任何对手。风暴之锤WHM-7M-DC由一台280聚变核心驱动，装有一对增程粒子炮；一门中型激光、一挺机枪和一具SRM-6阻止对手逼近；另有一座指挥控制台为该设计收尾。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A seemingly average Warhammer, the 'Widows Whammy', was rumoured to be the configuration piloted by the Black Widow Natasha Kerensky herself. Quirk: Improved Cooling Jacket - PPC Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.12 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这台看似普通的“寡妇之锤”风暴之锤，据传正是“黑寡妇”娜塔莎·克伦斯基本人驾驶的配置。 特性：改进冷却套 - 粒子炮 投放费用倍率：1.12 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A seemingly average Warhammer, the 'Widows Whammy', was rumoured to be the configuration piloted by the Black Widow Natasha Kerensky herself.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一台看似平平无奇的重锤，"寡妇重击"，据传正是黑寡妇娜塔莎·克伦斯基亲自驾驶的配置。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A Clan-tech retrofit of the venerable Warhammer intended for second-line and solahma troops, this variant replaced most of the Inner Sphere-tech weaponry of the original WHM-6R with Clan equivalents and used the weight savings to add two more heat sinks. The PPCs were replaced with Large Pulse Lasers, the SRM-6 was upgraded to a Streak SRM-6, and all of the lasers were upgraded to ER medium and ER small lasers. Only the machine guns were not replaced with Clan-tech models. Quirk: Integrated Searchlight Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是为二线与索拉马部队进行的一次古老风暴之锤部族技术改装，以部族同类武器替换原版WHM-6R的大部分内层星域武器，并用省下的重量加装两个散热器。粒子炮换成大型脉冲激光，SRM-6升级为连发SRM-6，所有激光升级为增程中型和增程小型激光。只有机枪没有换成部族技术型号。 特性：内置探照灯 投放费用倍率：1.08 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: One of the mainstays of the heavy 'Mechs. Solid, dependable, and heavy hitting.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 重型机甲的中坚之一。扎实、可靠、打击沉重。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The C2 is a further upgrade of previously upgraded Inner Sphere Warhammers. Retaining its Inner Sphere engine, internal structure, armor, and 18 double heat sinks the C2 completely upgrades the weaponry to Clan standards. Clan ER PPCs sit in the arms. Each side torso houses a Clan Medium Pulse Laser, and both a pulse and ER Small Laser. A Streak SRM-6 replaces the typical shoulder-mounted SRMs; its one ton of ammo is in the right torso. Both the lack of CASE and low amount of armor makes this Warhammer a bit of a glass cannon. Quirk: Integrated Searchlight Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: C2 是在此前已升级过的内层星域 Warhammer 之上做的进一步升级。C2 保留其内层星域的引擎、内部结构、装甲与 18 具双散热器，却把武器全面升级至部族标准。双臂装设部族增程粒子炮。每侧躯干各有一门部族中型脉冲激光，以及脉冲小型激光与增程小型激光各一门。一具连发 SRM-6 取代了惯常的肩载 SRM，其弹药一吨位于右躯干。由于既没有 CASE、装甲又偏薄，这台 Warhammer 多少有点“玻璃大炮”的味道。 特性：内置探照灯 投放费用倍率：1.08 手臂驱动器限制：左臂下部、右臂下部

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: One of the mainstays of the heavy 'Mechs. Solid, dependable, and heavy hitting.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 重型机甲的中坚之一。扎实、可靠、打击沉重。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A Golden Century refit popular with Wolf's Dragoons, this Warhammer was rebuilt from the ground up with Clan technology. Built using an endo steel internal structure and XL engine, the C 3 has plenty of space for weapons and heat sinks. An ER PPC is carried in each arm. Both side torsos carry an ER Medium Laser, a Medium Pulse Laser, and a Streak SRM-6. An ECM Suite protects this variant, while a Targeting Computer makes the already fearsome weaponry even more dangerous. 17 double heat sinks cannot keep the 'Mech cool unless the pilot fires either its long range or short range weapons. Quirk: Integrated Searchlight Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这款战锤在"黄金世纪"时期翻新，深受狼之龙骑兵青睐，以部族技术从头重建。它采用内骨架结构和XL引擎，C 3因此有充裕空间容纳武器与散热器。每只手臂各装备一门增程粒子炮，两侧躯干各装有一具增程中型激光、一具中型脉冲激光和一具连发SRM-6。该变型由电子对抗套件提供防护，而瞄准计算机则让本已可怕的武器更加致命。17具双散热器不足以让机甲保持凉爽，除非机师只使用远程或近程武器中的一种。 特性：集成探照灯 投放费用倍率：1.16 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: One of the mainstays of the heavy 'Mechs. Solid, dependable, and heavy hitting.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 重型机甲的中坚之一。扎实、可靠、打击沉重。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The TD variant of the Warhammer is focused on long to medium range engagements, using its two ER PPC and four Medium Pulse Lasers to overwhelm any foes. A SRM-6 provides extra punch at closer range together with a single Small Laser, and an AMS provides some extra defense. Quirk: Integrated Searchlight Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 风暴之锤的TD变型专注中远程交战，用两门增程粒子炮和四门中型脉冲激光压倒任何敌人。一具SRM-6与一门单独的小型激光在较近距离提供额外打击力，一套反导弹系统则提供额外防御。 特性：内置探照灯 投放费用倍率：1.1 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: One of the mainstays of the heavy 'Mechs. Solid, dependable, and heavy hitting.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 重型机甲的中坚之一。扎实、可靠、打击沉重。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The personal OmniMech of Star Colonel Anwen, this Warhawk shows the warrior's penchant for energy-based weapons may have given way to an obsession. Beginning with its primary weapons array, this Warhawk boasts four ER Large Lasers. Another grouping of energy weapons make up Anwen's secondary weapons system, a pair of Medium Pulse Lasers mounted on the 'Mech's center torso. Furthermore, one ER Medium Laser and one ER Small Laser offer even more added damage potential. Anwen kept the Warhawk’s integrated targeting computer, but had to make some modifications to allow for an increased weapons load. Mounting only energy-weapons makes heat dissipation a primary concern. In an attempt to solve the problem, Blood Spirit technicians equipped the 'Mech with 26 high efficiency heat sinks. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Long Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这台战鹰是星上校安文的专属全向机甲，显示出这位战士对能量武器的偏爱或许已演变为痴迷。它的主武器阵列以四门增程大型激光傲视群雄；副武器同样由能量武器组成——两具中型脉冲激光安装在机甲的中躯干。此外，一具增程中型激光和一具增程小型激光进一步增强了伤害潜力。安文保留了战鹰内置的瞄准计算机，但为增加武器负载不得不做了一些改动。由于全身只装能量武器，散热成为首要难题；血灵部族的技术人员为此为机甲配备了26具高效散热器。 特性：改进瞄准（远程） 投放费用倍率：1.18 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Introduced at the turn of the century, the Warhawk was created by the Smoke Jaguars in anticipation of the Clans' return to the Inner Sphere.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 战鹰于世纪之交推出，由烟虎氏族为迎接氏族重返内天体而研制。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An alternate take on the C configuration replaces the two ER PPCs with another pair of Large Pulse Lasers. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Long Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是C配置的另一种做法，以另一对大型脉冲激光取代两门增程粒子炮。 特性：改进瞄准 - 远程 投放费用倍率：1.16 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Introduced at the turn of the century, the Warhawk was created by the Smoke Jaguars in anticipation of the Clans' return to the Inner Sphere.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 战鹰于世纪之交推出，由烟虎氏族为迎接氏族重返内天体而研制。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Warhawk I mounts one Large Laser and one ER PPC in each arm, with the addition of a SRM-6 and a LRM-5 in the center torso. A total of 24 heatsinks tries to cool it, but it still runs quite hot. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Long Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Warhawk I 于每侧手臂各装一门大型激光与一门增程粒子炮，中央躯干另加装一具 SRM-6 与一具 LRM-5。总共 24 具散热器试图为其散热，但它运行时依然相当高温。 特性：改进瞄准 - 远程 投放费用倍率：1.16 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Introduced at the turn of the century, the Warhawk was created by the Smoke Jaguars in anticipation of the Clans' return to the Inner Sphere.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 战鹰于世纪之交推出，由烟虎氏族为迎接氏族重返内天体而研制。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The J configuration mounts four jump jets, allowing the 'Mech to flank enemies easier to unleash its weaponry. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Long Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: J配置装有四具跳跃推进器，让机甲更容易绕到敌人侧翼倾泻火力。 特性：改进瞄准 - 远程 投放费用倍率：1.16 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Introduced at the turn of the century, the Warhawk was created by the Smoke Jaguars in anticipation of the Clans' return to the Inner Sphere.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 战鹰于世纪之交推出，由烟虎氏族为迎接氏族重返内天体而研制。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A customized variant of the Warhawk, reportedly piloted by Hunter Tseng from Clan Ghost Bear. The Nanuq uses a trio of ER Medium Lasers in its left arm. The center torso carries a Active Probe. In it's right torso carries a LRM-15 with two tons of ammo and one ton of ultra autocannon ammo. The right arm carries a pair of Ultra Autocannon/10s with two tons of ammo. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Long Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是战鹰的定制变型，据报由鬼熊部族的猎人曾格驾驶。纳努克左臂装三门增程中型激光，中央躯干带一台主动探测器；右躯干带一具LRM-15（配两吨弹药）和一吨超级自动炮弹药；右臂则装一对超级AC/10（配两吨弹药）。 特性：改进瞄准 - 远程 投放费用倍率：1.18 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Introduced at the turn of the century, the Warhawk was created by the Smoke Jaguars in anticipation of the Clans' return to the Inner Sphere.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 战鹰于世纪之交推出，由烟虎氏族为迎接氏族重返内天体而研制。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An the R configuration replaces two of the ER PPC from the primary configuration of the Warhawk with Large Pulse Lasers. Two added flamers also provide anti-infantry defense. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Long Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: R配置将Warhawk主配置中的两门增程粒子炮替换为大型脉冲激光。另加装的两具火焰喷射器还可提供反步兵防御。 特性：改进瞄准 - 远距 投放费用倍率：1.16 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Introduced at the turn of the century, the Warhawk was created by the Smoke Jaguars in anticipation of the Clans' return to the Inner Sphere.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 战鹰于世纪之交推出，由烟虎氏族为迎接氏族重返内天体而研制。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The S configuration is similar to the Warhawks primary configuration, but replaces the LRM-10 with a Small Laser, allowing the 'Mech to pack three more heat sinks. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Long Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: S配置与战鹰主配置相似，但以一具小型激光取代LRM-10，让机甲能多带三个散热器。 特性：改进瞄准 - 远程 投放费用倍率：1.16 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Introduced at the turn of the century, the Warhawk was created by the Smoke Jaguars in anticipation of the Clans' return to the Inner Sphere.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 战鹰于世纪之交推出，由烟虎氏族为迎接氏族重返内天体而研制。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The V configuration carries four medium pulse lasers and an ER PPC as the main damage dealers, while four Jump Jets allow more maneuverability. For close quarters combat a flamer and three Streak SRM-6s are also available. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Long Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: V配置以4门中型脉冲激光和1门增程粒子炮作为主要输出手段，4具跳跃推进器则带来更强的机动性。近身缠斗时，还可动用1具火焰喷射器和3具连发SRM-6。 <特性：改进瞄准（远程） <投放费用倍率：1.16 <手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Introduced at the turn of the century, the Warhawk was created by the Smoke Jaguars in anticipation of the Clans' return to the Inner Sphere.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 战鹰于世纪之交推出，由烟虎氏族为迎接氏族重返内天体而研制。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Mounting a Gauss Rifle and an ER PPC in each arm, the Warhawk W is one of the more unusual configurations. The 'Mech still keeps the LRM-10 launcher from the Primary configuration. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Long Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 战鹰 W 在每条手臂上各装一门高斯步枪和一门 ER PPC，是较为少见的配置之一。这台机甲仍保留了主要配置的 LRM-10 发射器。 特性：改进瞄准 - 远程 投放费用倍率：1.16 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Introduced at the turn of the century, the Warhawk was created by the Smoke Jaguars in anticipation of the Clans' return to the Inner Sphere.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 战鹰于世纪之交推出，由烟虎氏族为迎接氏族重返内天体而研制。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The X configuration is seldom seen outside Clan space, as it is the main configuration for a Batchall. The combination of two heavy large lasers and an Ultra AC/20 makes the damage potential high enough at most ranges that it suits the needs of most warriors. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Long Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: X配置在部族领地之外难得一见，因为它是用于Batchall的主要配置。两门重型大型激光与一门Ultra AC/20的组合，让它在多数距离上都能造成足够高的伤害潜力，从而满足大多数战士的需求。 特性：改进瞄准 - 远程 投放费用倍率：1.16 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Smoke Jaguar claims this world. Identify the forces that defend it so that we from the mists of space may know on whom we pounce.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 烟虎宣称拥有这个世界。查明防守它的部队，好让我们从太空迷雾中知晓该扑向谁。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Warlord carries its main damage dealers on the right side of the 'Mech, a Gauss rifle in the arm and an ER PPC in the side torso. A center torso mounted ER Large Laser is able to provide extra damage at range as needed, but needs to be overused due to the limited cooling from the 'Mechs twelve double heat sinks. At closer ranges the 'Mech can switch to use its seven Medium Lasers, with an SRM-6 as an extra punch. The final weapon is an Artemis IV-enabled LRM-20, able to provide accurate missile fire at most ranges. Quirk: Accurate Weapon - Energy Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 战帅把主要伤害输出集中在机甲右侧：手臂上的高斯步枪和侧躯干里的增程粒子炮。安装在中央躯干上的增程大型激光能在需要时提供额外的远程伤害，但由于该机十二台双散热器的散热能力有限，不宜过度使用。距离拉近后，机甲可改用七门中型激光，并以一具SRM-6作为额外重击。最后一件武器是一具配备Artemis IV的LRM-20，能在多数距离上提供精准的导弹火力。 特性：精准武器 - 能量 投放费用倍率：1.18

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Created by Black Rooster Mechanical Development, (also knows as BRoMeD) as their first foray into the 100-ton 'Mech bracket, the Warlord took a lot of inspiration from the Pillager 5L in both appearance and weapons configuration. However, since Arrow IV systems were seen as too expensive, it was replaced by both a long and a short range missile launcher. The design was quickly challenged by Hellespont Industrials on Betelguese, the main supplier of Pillagers to the Capellan Confederation. After negotiations broke down, Hellespont started a very successful smear campaign that eventually drove the BRoMeD out of business. No more Warlords were produced, and some of the 'Mech's spare components are quite hard to find as a result.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 由黑公鸡机械开发公司（简称BRoMeD）打造，作为其首次进军100吨机甲领域的尝试，军阀在外观与武器配置上都大量借鉴了掠夺者5L。但由于箭IV系统被认为过于昂贵，它改用一具远程和一具短程火箭发射器。该设计很快遭到贝特尔吉斯上的赫勒斯庞特工业公司质疑——后者是卡佩兰联邦掠夺者的主要供应商。谈判破裂后，赫勒斯庞特发起了一场极为成功的抹黑行动，最终迫使BRoMeD破产。再没有军阀被生产出来，因此该机甲的一些备件如今相当难找。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The WLD-1P is armed only with two Large and three Medium Pulse Lasers, but is very mobile thanks to its large 300 XL engine, MASC and five jump jets. This allows the 'Mech to maneuver around and flank foes, hitting them with the pulse lasers at weaker locations that are easily penetrated. The 'Mech is cooled by twelve double heat sinks, meaning some care in regards to heat build up has to be taken. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: WLD-1P只装两门大型和三门中型脉冲激光，但凭借其庞大的300 XL引擎、MASC和五具跳跃推进器而极为机动。这使该机甲能绕行并包抄敌人，用脉冲激光打击其容易被击穿的薄弱部位。该机甲由十二个双散热器降温，意味着必须对热量积累多加留意。 特性：易于维护 投放费用倍率：1.08 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Warlord WLD-1P is a 60-ton mobile cavalry 'Mech mainly found in the Periphery. Originally created by Pinard Protectorates Limited on the Pinard, in the middle of the Taurian Concordat, the design has since been sold to various manufacturers spread throughout the periphery. One of the main design goals of the 'Mech was easy access to replace all components and weapons in case of damage, greatly reducing its maintenance times. As a result the 'Mech quickly spread to mercenaries, who appreciated the ease of maintenance as it saves both time and money.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 军阀WLD-1P是一种60吨机动骑兵机甲，主要见于外缘。它最初由皮纳德保护国有限公司在陶里安协约国中部的皮纳德创造，此后该设计被卖给了遍布外缘的各家制造商。该机甲的主要设计目标之一是受损时便于接触替换所有组件与武器，大幅缩短维护时间。因此该机甲迅速流布到雇佣兵手中，他们欣赏这种维护便利，因为它既省时间又省钱。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This variant, used by the SLDF, has a LTV 150 engine, slightly lower maximum ground speed (84 km/h), a 120 meter jump capability, and replaces the SRM-2 with a rear-facing One-Shot version. In exchange the WSP-100 was equipped with a five ton bomb bay. This Bomb Bay allowed the WSP-100 to carry Arrow IVmissiles and conventional bombs without losing any speed. Quirk: Land Air Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这一变型供 SLDF 使用，搭载 LTV 150 引擎，最高地面速度略低（84 km/h），可跳跃 120 米，并以一具朝后的单发型 SRM-2 取代了标准 SRM-2。作为交换，WSP-100 装设了一个五吨重的弹舱。这个弹舱使 WSP-100 能在不损失任何速度的情况下携带 Arrow IV 导弹与常规炸弹。 特性：陆空机甲 投放费用倍率：0.99 手臂驱动器限制：右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This variant, used by the SLDF, has a LTV 150 engine, slightly lower maximum ground speed (84 km/h), a 120 meter jump capability, and replaces the SRM-2 with a rear-facing One-Shot version. In exchange the WSP-100 was equipped with a five ton bomb bay. This Bomb Bay allowed the WSP-100 to carry Arrow IVmissiles and conventional bombs without losing any speed.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是SLDF使用的变型：采用一台LTV 150引擎，最高地面速度略低（84公里/小时），跳跃能力120米，并以一具后向一次性SRM取代SRM-2。作为交换，WSP-100配备了五吨炸弹舱，使其能携带箭IV导弹与常规炸弹而不损失速度。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This version of the Wasp LAM replaces the bomb bay with an LRM-10 launcher and an extra jump jet. This variant was later used as the inspiration for the Valkyrie. Quirk: Land Air Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Wasp LAM的这一型号用一具LRM-10发射器和一台额外的跳跃推进器取代了弹舱。该变型后来成为Valkyrie的设计灵感来源。 特性：陆空机甲 投放费用倍率：0.99 手臂驱动器限制：右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This version of the Wasp LAM replaces the bomb bay with an LRM-10 launcher and an extra jump jet. This variant was later used as the inspiration for the Valkyrie.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 此版黄蜂 LAM 将炸弹舱换成一具 LRM-10 发射器和一个额外跳跃推进器。该变体后来成为瓦尔基里的灵感来源。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This variant was designed for the SLDF's \"Blackhearts\" teams. Based on the standard WSP-100, it replaced the medium laser and bomb bay with an extra jump jet, Medium Pulse Laser, Streak SRM-2, and Guardian ECM Suite. The armor protection was also increased slightly. Quirk: Land Air Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 此变型为SLDF的“黑心”小队设计，以标准WSP-100为基础，用一具额外跳跃推进器、一门中型脉冲激光、一具连发SRM-2和一套守护者电子对抗套件取代了中型激光与弹舱，装甲防护也略有提升。 特性：陆空机甲 投放费用倍率：0.99 手臂驱动器限制：右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This variant was designed for the SLDF's \"Blackhearts\" teams. Based on the standard WSP-100, it replaced the medium laser and bomb bay with an extra jump jet, Medium Pulse Laser, Streak SRM-2, and Guardian ECM Suite. The armor protection was also increased slightly.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 此变体为星盟防卫军"黑心"小队设计。以标准 WSP-100 为基础，它将中型激光和炸弹舱换成一个额外跳跃推进器、一门中型脉冲激光、一具连续 SRM-2 和守护者 ECM 套件。装甲防护也略有增强。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Quirk: Land Air Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 特性：陆空机甲 投放费用倍率：0.98 手臂驱动器限制：右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A very rare version of the Wasp, upgrading it to a total of 25 tons. The extra weight is used to fit a larger, 150 rated engine core, a total of four tons of armor and more weapons. Quirk: Extended Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.96
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 黄蜂极为罕见的一个版本，总重量升级到 25 吨。多出的重量用于安装更大的额定 150 引擎核心、总共四吨装甲以及更多武器。 特性：扩展躯干旋转 投放费用倍率：0.96

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A big focus on short range missiles and not really much else.  Kind of fell of out favor with none of the specialized munitions anymore.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 重点全在近程导弹上，别的几乎没什么。随着特种弹药不再可用，它有点失宠了。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An uncommon battlefield refit of the 1A, dropping a ton of armor for a TAG and replaces one of the Medium Lasers with two Small lasers instead. Quirk: Extended Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.95 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是1A不多见的野战改装：削掉一吨装甲换装一具TAG，并把其中一门中型激光换成两门小型激光。 特性：扩展躯干旋转 投放费用倍率：0.95 手臂驱动器限制：右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A big focus on short range missiles and not really much else.  Kind of fell of out favor with none of the specialized munitions anymore.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 重点全在近程导弹上，别的几乎没什么。随着特种弹药不再可用，它有点失宠了。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A Clan tech rebuild of the Wasp, seen amongst the Kell Hounds. Carries a Medium Pulse Laser and an SRM-2 launcher, with the addition of a C3 Slave for better performance. Quirk: Extended Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 凯尔猎犬中可见的一款采用部族科技重造的 Wasp。它携带一门中型脉冲激光和一具 SRM-2 发射器，并加装了一台 C3 从属单元以提升表现。 特性：扩展躯干旋转 投放费用倍率：1.03 手臂驱动器限制：右下臂

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Manufactured by Achernar for Wolf's Dragoons in 3050, the Clan Invasion era 3W upgraded the armor to ferro-fibrous and carried two Sutel Precision Line small pulse lasers in the right arm and four ChisComp 32 small lasers split between left leg and left torso. This increased firepower came at the cost of reducing armor protection to just two tons. Quirk: Extended Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.97 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该机由 Achernar 于 3050 年为狼之龙骑兵制造，属于部族入侵时期的 3W 型。它将装甲升级为铁纤维，并在右臂装设两门 Sutel Precision Line 小型脉冲激光，在左腿与左躯干共装设四门 ChisComp 32 小型激光。火力增强的代价，是装甲防护被削减至仅两吨。 特性：扩展躯干旋转 投放费用倍率：0.97 手臂驱动器限制：右下臂

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A big focus on short range missiles and not really much else.  Kind of fell of out favor with none of the specialized munitions anymore.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 重点全在近程导弹上，别的几乎没什么。随着特种弹药不再可用，它有点失宠了。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Together model is an upgrade of the 3W, an alternative to the more common 4W, and is mainly used by the Wolf's Dragoons. The upgrade replaces all the weapons with a single Medium Pulse Laser and five ER Small Lasers, and adds another half ton of armor and a C3 Slave unit. Quirk: Extended Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Together型是3W的升级型号，作为较常见的4W的替代方案，主要由狼之龙骑兵使用。该升级把全部武器替换为一具中型脉冲激光和五具增程小型激光，并额外增加半吨装甲和一个C3从属单元。 特性：扩展躯干旋转 投放费用倍率：1.03 手臂驱动器限制：右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A big focus on short range missiles and not really much else.  Kind of fell of out favor with none of the specialized munitions anymore.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 重点全在近程导弹上，别的几乎没什么。随着特种弹药不再可用，它有点失宠了。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This variant, nicknamed 'First Modification' by the the techs on Chara III, is a field modification of the WSP-1A that exchanges the SRM-2 and ammunition for one medium laser in the left leg and a ton of armor. Quirk: Extended Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.95 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这一变型被卡拉III星的技术人员昵称为“第一改装”，是WSP-1A的战地改装型，用左腿的一门中型激光与一吨装甲换掉了SRM-2及其弹药。 特性：扩展躯干旋转 投放费用倍率：0.95 手臂驱动器限制：右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A big focus on short range missiles and not really much else.  Kind of fell of out favor with none of the specialized munitions anymore.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 重点全在近程导弹上，别的几乎没什么。随着特种弹药不再可用，它有点失宠了。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This variant, nicknamed 'Second Modification' by the the techs on Chara III, is a further modification of the M1 that exchanges the jump jets for three medium lasers, one each installed in the head, center torso, and left arm. Quirk: Extended Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.95 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这一变型被卡拉III星的技术人员昵称为“第二改装”，是对M1的进一步改装，用头部、中央躯干与左臂各一门的三门中型激光换掉了跳跃推进器。 特性：扩展躯干旋转 投放费用倍率：0.95 手臂驱动器限制：右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A big focus on short range missiles and not really much else.  Kind of fell of out favor with none of the specialized munitions anymore.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 重点全在近程导弹上，别的几乎没什么。随着特种弹药不再可用，它有点失宠了。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The original Weevil variant, the -L31, mounts an AC/2 in the right arm and a ER Large Laser in the left. Due to only mounting ten single heatsinks, the 'Mech still runs quite hot even with just a single energy weapon. Quirk: Advanced Optics Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是象鼻虫最初的变型，-L31在右臂装一门AC/2，左臂装一门增程大型激光。由于只装十个单散热器，即便只有一件能量武器，该机甲运行起来依然相当热。 特性：先进光学 投放费用倍率：0.98 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An attempt to create a light long range support fire platform, the Weevil was never a success and is seldom brought out of storage anymore. The main issue is the lack of weight capacity for the proper long range support weapons and cooling, meaning all variants tend to suffer from either being under-gunned or very overheat prone.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 象鼻虫（Weevil）是为了打造一种轻型远程支援火力平台而进行的尝试，但从未取得成功，如今已极少被人从仓库中取出使用。主要问题在于缺乏足够的承重能力来搭载合适的远程支援武器与散热设备，这意味着它的所有变型要么火力不足，要么极易过热。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The -P14 was introduced solely for the Periphery market. Armed with only a single LBX AC/5, it runs quite cool even in the more common lunar and martian biomes spread out in the periphery. The design also mounts an AMS Mk.2 for better defense. Quirk: Advanced Optics Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: -P14专为外围地区市场推出。它仅装备一门LBX AC/5，即便在外围地区常见的月球与火星环境中也能保持相当低的温度。该设计还安装了AMS Mk.2以强化防御。 特性：先进光学 投放费用倍率：0.98 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An attempt to create a light long range support fire platform, the Weevil was never a success and is seldom brought out of storage anymore. The main issue is the lack of weight capacity for the proper long range support weapons and cooling, meaning all variants tend to suffer from either being under-gunned or very overheat prone.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: After the -P14 proved more popular than the -L31, the -R2 was created as an updated Weevil for the Inner Sphere. Instead of the LBX of the -P14, its only weapon is an Ultra AC/5. However, the 'Mech also fits an Active Probe, improving its sensor capabilities. Quirk: Advanced Optics Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在 -P14 被证明比 -L31 更受欢迎之后，-R2 作为面向内层星域的更新版 Weevil 被制造出来。它不像 -P14 那样装有 LBX，其唯一的武器是一门 Ultra AC/5。不过，该机甲还装有一具主动探测器，提升了其传感器能力。 特性：高级光学 投放费用倍率：0.98 手臂驱动器限制：左上臂、右上臂

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An attempt to create a light long range support fire platform, the Weevil was never a success and is seldom brought out of storage anymore. The main issue is the lack of weight capacity for the proper long range support weapons and cooling, meaning all variants tend to suffer from either being under-gunned or very overheat prone.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The WER-LF-004 carries a Medium Pulse Laser, a pair of Small Pulse Lasers, a standard SRM-6 launcher and a Machine Gun. Four jump jets are enough to propel the 'Mech considerable distances. Quirk: Improved Cooling Jacket - Laser Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.02
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: WER-LF-004装有一门中型脉冲激光、一对小型脉冲激光、一具标准SRM-6发射器与一挺机枪。四台跳跃推进器足以让这台机甲跨越相当远的距离。 特性：改进冷却外套（激光） 投放费用倍率：1.02

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A Solaris VII BattleMech, the Werewolf was introduced in 3056. Designed as an ambush 'Mech, the Werewolf was a huge hit with pilots who favored the dense jungle or industrial scrapyard arenas because it mounted a Null Signature System. This system allows a skilled pilot to hide in plain sight, striking an opponent quickly and often fatally. The eight tons of armor provide decent protection against most foes and the Werewolf's speed allows it to evade anything it can't outfight. The Werewolf mounts Jump Jets, which provide it with a limited jump capability. This capability is most frequently used by arena MechWarriors to launch a Death From Above attack, but it is also useful when evading a foe.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 狼人（Werewolf）是一台索拉里斯 VII 的战斗机甲，于 3056 年问世。作为一款专为伏击而设计的机甲，狼人深受那些偏爱茂密丛林或工业废料场竞技场的机师欢迎，因为它装备了零信号系统。这套系统能让技艺娴熟的机师隐匿于众目睽睽之下，迅速而往往致命地打击对手。八吨装甲足以抵御大多数敌人，而狼人的速度让它能够避开任何无法正面击败的对手。狼人还装设了跳跃推进器，赋予它有限的跳跃能力。竞技场的机甲战士最常用这一能力发动“从天而降”攻击，但在躲避敌人时同样十分实用。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The WER-LF-004P is the prototype of the WER-LF-004, similar in almost all regards as the eventual final version. The only difference is slightly more armor at the cost of one less jump jet. Quirk: Improved Cooling Jacket - Laser Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: WER-LF-004P是WER-LF-004的原型，在几乎所有方面都与最终定型版本相似。唯一的区别是装甲略多，代价是少一具跳跃推进器。 特性：改进冷却夹套 - 激光 投放费用倍率：1.04

All of these close-in weapons were chosen because they encourage the pilot to attack from closer ranges. Quirk: Improved Cooling Jacket - Laser Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.02
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 狼人WE-LF-005的主武器是它的大型X脉冲激光，辅以一具连发SRM-6发射器和两具磁射枪。选用这些近程武器，是为了鼓励飞行员从更近的距离发起攻击。 特性：改进冷却套 - 激光 投放费用倍率：1.02

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A simple refit of the WTH-1 that trades its jump jets for a C3 slave and C.A.S.E. protection for the LRM ammunition. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 惠特沃斯 WTH-1 的简单改装，把跳跃推进器换成一套 C3 从属单元，并为 LRM 弹药加装 C.A.S.E. 防护。 特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A somewhat mediocre Scout and Light Strike platform, the Whitworth has been in service across the Inner Sphere since the end of the Age of War. A 40-ton Mech, the Whitworth is powered by a 160-rated Fusion Core and mounts 4 Jump Jets. The Whitworth WTH-1 is armed with a trio of Medium Lasers and a pair of LRM-10s.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 惠特沃斯是一台略显平庸的侦察与轻型打击平台，自战争年代结束以来一直在整个内层星域服役。这台 40 吨机甲由一台 160 额定聚变核心驱动，并装备 4 台跳跃推进器。惠特沃斯 WTH-1 配备三门中型激光和两具 LRM-10。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A solaris special, someone has torn out the original LTV 160 fusion engine; replacing it is a Nissan 200 torn out of a scrapped Hunchback. In order to cram in the larger engine, the LRM-10s were downgraded to a pair of smaller LRM-5s fed by a single ton of ammo. A Large Laser replaces the left arm Medium Laser. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是一台 Solaris 特色改装机：有人拆掉了原来的 LTV 160 聚变引擎，换上从一台报废 Hunchback 上拆下的 Nissan 200。为了塞进更大的引擎，LRM-10 被降级为两具更小的 LRM-5，共用一吨弹药供弹。左臂的中型激光则被一门大型激光取代。 特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1 手臂驱动器限制：左下臂、右下臂

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A solaris special, someone has torn out the original LTV 160 fusion engine; replacing it is a Nissan 200 torn out of a scrapped Hunchback. In order to cram in the larger engine, the LRM-10s were downgraded to a pair of smaller LRM-5s fed by a single ton of ammo. A Large Laser replaces the left arm Medium Laser.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一台索拉里斯特制品，有人把原本的LTV 160聚变引擎扯了出来；换上的是一台从报废驼背上拆下的日产200。为了塞进更大的引擎，LRM-10被降级为两具更小的LRM-5，共用一吨弹药。一门大型激光器取代了左臂的中型激光器。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A refit of the 1S, upgrading the 'Mech to use double heat sinks. The increased cooling capacity allows dropping four of the heat sinks, and the freed space is used to add a C3 slave, C.A.S.E. protection and Artemis IV FCS. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.02 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 1S 的改装型，将机甲升级为使用双散热器。散热能力的提升使其可以拆除四个散热器，而腾出的空间则用于加装 C3 从属单元、C.A.S.E. 防护和阿尔忒弥斯 IV 火控系统。 特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1.02 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A somewhat mediocre Scout and Light Strike platform, the Whitworth has been in service across the Inner Sphere since the end of the Age of War. A 40-ton Mech, the Whitworth is powered by a 160-rated Fusion Core and mounts 4 Jump Jets. The Whitworth WTH-1 is armed with a trio of Medium Lasers and a pair of LRM-10s.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 惠特沃斯是一台略显平庸的侦察与轻型打击平台，自战争年代结束以来一直在整个内层星域服役。这台 40 吨机甲由一台 160 额定聚变核心驱动，并装备 4 台跳跃推进器。惠特沃斯 WTH-1 配备三门中型激光和两具 LRM-10。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Wildfire P1-WF traded the Crusader's long range firepower for speed and armor protection. Intended to pursue fast-moving opponents, the Wildfire used a suite of pulse lasers as its primary armament. When in close combat with an enemy, the pair of Streak SRM-2 launchers provided additional firepower without being wasteful. The Machine Guns were very useful for defending against enemy infantry units. Defensively, the Wildfire mounted CASE in the right torso to protect the 'Mech from ammunition explosions. Quirk: Well Balanced Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Wildfire P1-WF以Crusader的远程火力换取了速度与装甲防护。Wildfire意在追击高速移动的对手，因此以一套脉冲激光作为主武器。与敌人近身交战时，两具连发SRM-2发射器能提供额外火力而不会浪费弹药。机枪则在抵御敌方步兵单位时非常有用。防护方面，Wildfire在右侧躯干安装了CASE，以保护机甲免受弹药爆炸之害。 特性：平衡良好 投放费用倍率：1.09 手臂驱动器限制：左下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Designed at the same facility that birthed Burke Kale’s Direct Neural Interface project, the Wildfire was designed from the ground up to use a Torso Cockpit. Based on the 3050 era Crusader, the Wildfire was intended to show the new cockpit technology in use. As a result, it became the first documented headless BattleMech. Equipped with a suite of close range weapons, the Wildfire was intended to be a close combat fighter. The lack of any significant long-range firepower made the Wildfire rely on its heavy armor to bring it into effective range.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 野火诞生于伯克·凯尔直接神经接口项目所在的那处设施，从设计之初便是为了使用躯干驾驶舱。它以3050年时代的十字军为基础，意在展示这种新驾驶舱技术的实际应用，也因此成为有记录以来第一台无头战斗机甲。野火装备了一整套近距武器，定位是近身近战机型；由于缺乏任何可观的远程火力，它不得不依赖厚重装甲把自己送入有效射程。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Wildfire P7-WF drops the torso mounted cockpit, returning to a standard head mounted one, and replaces one of the Machine Guns with an AMS. Quirk: Well Balanced Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 野火P7-WF拆掉躯干座舱，恢复为标准头部座舱，并把其中一挺机枪换成一具反导弹系统。 特性：平衡良好 投放费用倍率：1.09 手臂驱动器限制：右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Designed at the same facility that birthed Burke Kale’s Direct Neural Interface project, the Wildfire was designed from the ground up to use a Torso Cockpit. Based on the 3050 era Crusader, the Wildfire was intended to show the new cockpit technology in use. As a result, it became the first documented headless BattleMech. Equipped with a suite of close range weapons, the Wildfire was intended to be a close combat fighter. The lack of any significant long-range firepower made the Wildfire rely on its heavy armor to bring it into effective range.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 野火诞生于伯克·凯尔直接神经接口项目所在的那处设施，从设计之初便是为了使用躯干驾驶舱。它以3050年时代的十字军为基础，意在展示这种新驾驶舱技术的实际应用，也因此成为有记录以来第一台无头战斗机甲。野火装备了一整套近距武器，定位是近身近战机型；由于缺乏任何可观的远程火力，它不得不依赖厚重装甲把自己送入有效射程。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Wisp is only armed with a single Medium Laser supported by a small laser, which are more useful at starting fires and harassing the enemy rather than being true anti-'Mech weapons. Pilots of the Wisp should always remember that he who spies then runs away may live to spy another day. Quirk: Improved Jammer Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 鬼火只装一门中型激光，辅以一门小型激光；这些武器更适合放火和骚扰敌人，而非真正的反机甲武器。鬼火的飞行员应始终牢记：窥探之后撒腿就跑的人，才能活到下一次窥探。 特性：改进干扰器 投放费用倍率：0.99

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Wisp is a recon 'Mech first and foremost. Though it does have some capabilities as an infantry support 'Mech, its light armor and limited armament makes it unsuitable for any save the most limited of missions. Its extremely high speed allows it to act as a scout, withdrawing at the first sign of danger utilizing its MASC circuitry.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 微光是彻头彻尾的侦察机甲。虽然它作为步兵支援机甲也有一些能力，但其轻薄装甲与有限武装使它除最有限的任务外都不适用。它极高的速度让它能充当侦察兵，一有危险迹象便利用其MASC电路撤离。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Wolf Trap carries as its main weapon an LB-X autocannon/10, which allows it to fire both standard solid shells or cluster shells that act like a shotgun and cause damage all over the enemy. For added long range firepower, the Wolf Trap carries a LRM-10 launcher which allows it to fire directly and also give indirect fire support when needed. Finally, for close combat, the 'Mech carries a pair of medium lasers. This varied arsenal lets the Wolf Trap effectively engage an enemy at any range. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Wolf Trap的主武器是一门LB-X自动炮/10，既可发射标准实心弹，也可发射如同霰弹般散射、在敌人身上造成全面伤害的集束弹。为增强远程火力，Wolf Trap还装有一具LRM-10发射器，既能直瞄射击，也能在需要时提供间接火力支援。最后，为应对近身战斗，机甲还配备了两门中型激光。这套多样化的武器组合让Wolf Trap能在任何距离上有效打击敌人。 特性：易于维护 投放费用倍率：1.03 手臂驱动器限制：右上

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Wolf Trap is a BattleMech that the Draconis Combine designed to be used as a long-range combat 'Mech. Originally called the Tora, Luthien Armor Works hastily rechristened it the Wolf Trap, the name Federated Commonwealth analysts had given it, to downplay its association with the Combine. The 'Mech is built on an endo steel chassis and protects any ammunition stores that it carries onboard with CASE that redirects the force of the explosion when an ammunition bin is hit by enemy fire. The 'Mech has a very respectable speed of 97.2 km/h, which it achieves through the use of a 270 XL engine.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 捕狼夹是龙脉联合体设计用作远程作战的战斗机甲。它最初名为 Tora，卢西恩装甲工厂匆忙把它改名为捕狼夹——也就是联邦共和国分析人员给它起的名字——以淡化它与联合体的关联。这台机甲以内骨架底盘为基础，并用 CASE 保护机上携带的弹药储备，当弹药箱被敌方火力击中时，CASE 会引导爆炸的冲击力。机甲最高速度达到相当可观的 97.2 km/h，这要归功于 270 XL 引擎。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A uniquely customized Wolf Trap created for former Kurita MechWarrior Daitama Muraki, refitted by Star League Defense Force techs from the shell of a Wolf Trap given to him. The tech fitted a 270-rated XL fusion engine and 10 double heat sinks into the 'Mech. The design retained the 'Mech's two medium lasers and LRM 10 Launcher, while adding an extended-range PPC in place of the autocannon. The Second Star League techs then added a Beagle active probe and C3i computer to the 'Mech. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这台独一无二的定制捕狼夹是为前栗田机甲战士 Daitama Muraki 打造的，由星际联盟防卫军的技师在他获赠的一具捕狼夹机壳基础上改装而成。技师为这台机甲装上了 270 级 XL 聚变引擎和10个双散热器。该设计保留了机甲原有的两门中型激光和一具 LRM-10 发射器，同时以一门增程粒子炮取代了自动炮。随后第二星际联盟的技师又为它加装了猎犬主动探测器和 C3i 计算机。 特性：易于维护 投放费用倍率：1.05 手臂驱动器限制：右上

Originally called the Tora, Luthien Armor Works hastily rechristened it the Wolf Trap, the name Federated Commonwealth analysts had given it, to downplay its association with the Combine. Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A field modification of the Wolf Trap, the C model is modified to carry a C3 slave unit onto the battlefield, allowing the Wolf Trap to share targeting telemetry with other friendly units. The 'Mech achieves this by removing one of the medium lasers that it carries. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 狼阱的C型是一种野战改装型号，能够把C3从属单元带上战场，让狼阱与其他友军单位共享瞄准遥测数据。为此它拆除了自身携带的其中一具中型激光。 特性：易于维护 投放费用倍率：1.03 手臂驱动器限制：右上
