Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Phelan Kell and his Wolfhound, nicknamed Grinner, were captured by the forces of Clan Wolf during Operation Revival. When Phelan was inducted into the Wolf Clan as a Warrior, Khan Ulric Kerensky ordered his 'Mech be upgraded using Clan technology. Quirk: Accurate Weapon - Energy Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 费伦·凯尔和他的 Wolfhound（绰号“咧嘴者”）在复兴行动期间被狼族部队俘获。当费伦作为战士被接纳进入狼族时，可汗乌尔里克·克伦斯基下令用部族技术升级他的机甲。 特性：精准武器 - 能量 投放费用倍率：1.08 手臂驱动器限制：右下臂

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Phelan Kell and his Wolfhound, nicknamed Grinner, were captured by the forces of Clan Wolf during Operation Revival. When Phelan was inducted into the Wolf Clan as a Warrior, Khan Ulric Kerensky ordered his 'Mech be upgraded using Clan technology.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 费兰·凯尔和他的狼犬（绰号"咧嘴"）在复兴行动期间被狼族部队俘获。当费兰作为战士被引入狼族时，可汗乌尔里克·克伦斯基下令用氏族科技升级他的机甲。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Based off Phelan Kell's 'Mech 'Grinner', the Wolfhound IIC 3 is a Clan tech version of the Wolfhound. The design includes Endo Steel structure, Ferro-Fibrous armor and XL engine, combined with an ECM suite. The weapons are fully energy based, consisting of two ER Medium Lasers, one ER Large Laser and three Medium Pulse Lasers. Quirk: Accurate Weapon - Energy Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Wolfhound IIC 3 以 Phelan Kell 的座机“Grinner”为蓝本，是 Wolfhound 的部族科技版本。该设计采用内骨架结构、铁纤维装甲和 XL 引擎，并配有电子对抗套件。其武器全部为能量武器，包括两门增程中型激光、一门增程大型激光和三门中型脉冲激光。 特性：精准武器 - 能量 投放费用倍率：0.98 手臂驱动器限制：右下臂

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A clan version of the Wolfhound, how filthy. Those damned clanners just have to taint everything!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 氏族版狼犬，真恶心。那些该死的氏族佬就是要把什么都污染一遍！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Based off Phelan Kell's 'Mech 'Grinner', the Wolfhound IIC 3A is a Clan tech version of the Wolfhound. The design includes Endo Steel structure, Ferro-Fibrous armor and XL engine, combined with an ECM suite. The weapons are fully energy based, consisting of one Large Pulse Laser and four Medium Pulse Lasers. Quirk: Accurate Weapon - Energy Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 猎狼犬IIC 3A以菲兰·凯尔的座机“咧嘴者”为基础，是猎狼犬的部族技术版本。该设计采用内骨架结构、铁纤维装甲和XL引擎，并整合了1具电子对抗套件。武器全为能量型，包括1门大型脉冲激光和4门中型脉冲激光。 <特性：精准武器（能量） <投放费用倍率：1.06 <手臂驱动器限制：右臂下段

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A clan version of the Wolfhound, how filthy. Those damned clanners just have to taint everything!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 氏族版狼犬，真恶心。那些该死的氏族佬就是要把什么都污染一遍！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A mixed tech refit of the Wolfhound, using aquired Clan tech to improve its performance. Mainly used by the mercenary outfit the Kell Hounds. Quirk: Accurate Weapon - Energy Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 狼犬的混合科技改装型，利用缴获的部族科技提升其性能。主要由雇佣兵部队“凯尔猎犬”使用。 特性：精准武器 - 能量 投放费用倍率：0.98 手臂驱动器限制：右下臂

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Rare variant with a mix of Tech. Usually only way to get them is to capture one the battlefield.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 技术混搭的稀有改型。通常唯一的获取方式就是在战场上俘获一台。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A battlefield refit of the WLF-1R, switching from single to double heat sinks and trading one medium laser for a C3 slave unit. Quirk: Accurate Weapon - Energy Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: WLF-1R的战地改装型，将单散热器换成双散热器，并以一门中型激光换取一台C3从属机。 特性：精准武器（能量） 投放费用倍率：0.98 手臂驱动器限制：右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: It's a -1R with more cooling and less weapons. Oh, and a C3.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 它是台-1R，散热更多、武器更少。哦，还有一套C3。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A mixed tech refit of the Wolfhound, using acquired Clan tech to improve its performance. Mainly used by the mercenary outfit the Wolf Dragoons. Quirk: Accurate Weapon - Energy Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 猎狼犬的混合技术改装型，利用取得的部族技术提升性能。主要由雇佣兵部队狼之龙骑兵使用。 特性：精准武器 - 能量 投放费用倍率：1.04 手臂驱动器限制：右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Another custom refit by mercenaries. You can't call our kind anything but resourceful.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是雇佣兵们的又一次定制改装。我们这类人除了“脑子活”还能说什么呢。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Star League changed so much from the WVR-6R that they called this the Wolverine II. It carries a similar weapon load but enhanced by the Star League's superior technology, making this a far deadlier machine. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.07
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 星际联盟对 WVR-6R 做了如此大的改动，以至于把它称为 Wolverine II。它携带的武器载荷与之相似，但在星际联盟更优越的技术加持下得到强化，使其成为一台致命得多的机器。 特性：改进通讯 投放费用倍率：1.07

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Star League changed so much from the WVR-6R that they called this the Wolverine II. It carries a similar weapon load but enhanced by the Star League's superior technology, making this a far deadlier machine.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 星盟对 WVR-6R 的改动如此之大，以至于他们把它称为狼獾 II。它携带相似武器载荷，但在星盟优越技术的强化下，成为一台致命得多的机器。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: When the Clan Jade Falcon designers took a Wolverine II WVR-7H and started replacing parts of it with clan tech in several configurations, this was one of the resulting prototype designs. Eventually the result was the Conjurer, since they could not name a 'Mech after the Not-Named Clan. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 当玉猫部族的设计者取来一台狼獾II WVR-7H，并开始用部族技术在多种配置中替换其部件时，这就是由此产生的原型设计之一。最终成果便是幻术师，因为他们不能用一个“不可提及的部族”来命名机甲。 特性：改进通讯 投放费用倍率：1.11

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A Wolverine with a bunch of Clan tech can never go wrong, I'll have one please.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一台装了氏族科技的狼獾永远不会出问题，我要一台。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An uncommon refit of some of the Wolverines the SLDF brought with them during their exodus from the Inner Sphere, the goal was to bring them in line with the more clear IIC versions of 'Mechs. However, very few were actually kept once Clan Wolverine was annihilated due to their name. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是对一些SLDF在大逃亡离开内层星域时带走的狼獾所做的不常见改装，目的是让它们与更明确的IIC版本机甲保持一致。然而，狼獾部族因其名号被消灭之后，真正保留下来的极少。 特性：改进通讯 投放费用倍率：1.11

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Not the best refit ever done by the Clans, I can understand why it was dropped even beyond the naming issue.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这不是氏族做过的最好的改装，我能理解为什么除了命名问题之外它也被放弃了。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Entering production in 2490, the primitive 3R was built in response to the Terran Hegemony creating new versions of the 'Mechs the Wolverine was originally based on. It traded in 3 tons of armor and a ton of autocannon ammunition for a shoulder-mounted six-pack SRM launcher with one ton of reloads - a loadout that would remain essentially unchanged for the later 'modernized' 6R. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.83
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 原始型3R于2490年投产，其研制是为了回应地球霸权为狼獾最初所依据的几款机甲推出新版本。它用3吨装甲和一个吨位的自动炮弹药，换取了一具装在肩部的六联装SRM发射器及一个吨位的备用弹药——这一配置在后来“现代化”的6R上基本保持不变。 特性：改进通讯 投放费用倍率：0.83

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Upgrade of the 1R, this still is a 'Mech not even worth its weight as scrap metal. Everything is so outdated...
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为1R的升级版，这仍是一台连当废铁卖都不值其重量的机甲。一切都太过时了……

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Introduced in 2834, the 6D drops the SRM and one heat sink of the 6R to upgrade the AC/5 to an Autocannon/10, mounted in the left arm. Two tons of ammunition in the left side supply it, spread through the arm and torso. One jump jet is moved from each leg to the corresponding side torso. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 6D 于 2834 年推出，它去掉了 6R 的 SRM 和一具散热器，将 AC/5 升级为安装在左臂的自动炮/10。左侧的两吨弹药为其供弹，弹药分布在手臂和躯干之中。每条腿各有一具跳跃推进器移至对应的侧躯干。 特性：改进通讯 投放费用倍率：1.03

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The -6D has it uses like most Wolverines, it is neither great nor horrible - just somewhere inbetween.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: -6D与大多数狼獾一样有它的用处，它既不出色也不糟糕——只是在两者之间。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A variant used by the Mercenary unit Gray Death Legion before their demise. Using mostly stolen or looted Clan tech they can upgrade the firepower considerable, including an Ultra AC/5 and Medium Pulse Lasers. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是雇佣兵部队灰死军团在其覆灭前使用的变型。他们大多用偷来或缴获的部族技术，把火力大幅升级，包括一门超级AC/5和几门中型脉冲激光。 特性：改进通讯 投放费用倍率：1.11

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The unit did not survive long, but they did leave some good 'Mechs behind. This is one of them.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这支单位没能撑多久，但他们确实留下了一些不错的机甲。这就是其中一台。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Wolverine WVR-6KH was made popular when the mercenary unit Kell Hounds used this custom design of theirs to infiltrate a pirate base by painting them in the same color scheme as the pirates own Wolverines. The mercenaries then opened fire without warning once inside, unleashing their advanced weaponry to great success at point blank range. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 狼獾WVR-6KH之所以出名，是因为雇佣兵部队凯尔猎犬用他们的这款定制设计潜入了一处海盗基地——把它涂成与海盗自己的狼獾相同的配色。进入后，这些雇佣兵毫无预警地开火，在零距离上倾泻他们的先进武器，大获成功。 特性：改进通讯 投放费用倍率：1.05

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The reputation this variant gained after that raid has made it sound amazing to those who don't know better. In reality it is just some more advanced tech put on a -6R 'Mech as base.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这次袭掠之后该变型获得的名声，让不明就里的人觉得它了不起。实际上它只是在一台-6R机甲基础上加了些更先进的技术。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Another of the many custom refits of the Wolverine WVR-6R by a mercenary outfit, the -6MR was the preferred variant of the famous McCarron's Armored Cavalry unit. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: -6MR是某支雇佣兵部队对Wolverine WVR-6R进行的众多定制改装之一，也是著名的麦卡伦装甲骑兵团偏爱的变型。 特性：改进通讯 投放费用倍率：1.05

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Unlike other mercenary refits, this one is mostly using standard equipment. My guess would be that they wanted easier and cheaper maintenance.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 与其他雇佣兵改装不同，这一款主要使用标准装备。我猜他们想要更简便、更便宜的维护。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 'Renata' has some interesting upgrades over a stock Wolverine WVR-6R, it replaces both the generic autocannon and the medium laser with a more advanced versions, and uses Ferro-Fibrous armor to increase the amount of armor plating the 'Mech can carry. The FCS and sensors of the 'Mech have also been upgraded with improved aftermarket models. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: “Renata”相比原厂的 Wolverine WVR-6R 有几项颇有意思的升级：它把通用型自动炮和中型激光都换成了更先进的型号，并使用铁纤维装甲来增加机甲可携带的装甲板数量。该机甲的火控系统与传感器也换装了改进型的售后改装件。 特性：改进通讯 投放费用倍率：1.05

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This customized Wolverine WVR-6R was originally commissioned by Major Miraslova Renata during the SLDF expeditionary force's Operation Smother during the Davion Succession war. However, when Major Renata answered the call of Kerensky and joined the Exodus, the 'Mech was abandoned in a Star League mint on Nouveau Toulouse. The Wolverine was eventually found there by Lawrence Helmund Nelson, who claimed it as his personal 'Mech from that point forwards.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这台定制版狼獾WVR-6R最初是米拉斯洛娃·雷娜塔少校在SLDF远征军执行"窒息"行动期间（达维昂继承战争时期）委托建造的。然而当雷娜塔少校响应克伦斯基的号召加入出走时，这台机甲被遗弃在新图卢兹的一处星盟造币厂里。狼獾最终在那里被劳伦斯·赫尔蒙德·尼尔森发现，此后他便将其据为自己的座机。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This Clan Early variant of the 6R exchanges the AC/5 for two LB 2-X Autocannons and upgrades the SRM-6 to an Improved version. Two of the heat sinks are dropped as a result of the lowered cooling needs. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是6R的部族早期变型，以两门LB 2-X自动炮取代AC/5，并把SRM-6升级为改进型。由于冷却需求下降，拆掉了两个散热器。 特性：改进通讯 投放费用倍率：1.03

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: When the Star League Defense Force left the Inner Sphere under Commanding General Aleksandr Kerensky during Operation Exodus, they brought with them many of the most common 'Mechs. As the SLDF-in-exile slowly started turning into the Clans, they started developing improved weapons, which they mounted on their existing armies of 'Mech. These weapons are commonly called Clan Early, and as such the Mech's using them got the -CE suffix added to their designation.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 当星盟防卫军在"出埃及"行动中随总指挥官亚历山大·克伦斯基离开内天体时，他们带走了许多最常见的机甲。随着流亡的星盟防卫军逐渐演变为氏族，他们开始研发改进型武器，并装到已有的机甲部队上。这类武器通常被称为"氏族早期型"，使用它们的机甲编号因此带上了 -CE 后缀。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A Mercenary refit of the -6R which adds more durability in form of CASE protection to both side torsos and a C3 slave at the cost of two heat sinks. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: -6R的雇佣兵改装型，以牺牲两具散热器为代价，在两侧躯干加装CASE防护并提供一台C3从属机，从而提升了生存能力。 特性：改进通讯 投放费用倍率：1.03

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Not a fan of this change, it just runs too hot now. But it is a common Merc thing to do to cram more stuff in and worry about heat later.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我不太喜欢这个改动，现在它跑起来实在太热了。但雇佣兵常干这种事：先往里塞更多东西，热量以后再说。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A high tech, high cost refit of the -6R initially by a small mercenary outfit called 'Silver Lining', but eventually caught attention of the larger units and as a result there are a number of them out there. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是 -6R 的高技术、高成本改装型，最初由一支名为“Silver Lining”的小型雇佣兵部队完成，但最终引起了更大规模部队的关注，因此如今存世的这类机甲数量不少。 特性：改进通讯 投放费用倍率：1.05

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Built out of only Inner Sphere tech, this still manages to be an impressive refit. It could almost go toe-to-toe with one of the Clan tech refits.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 它完全用内天体科技建成，却仍是一次令人印象深刻的改装。它几乎能与氏族科技的改装型正面较量。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The first 'Mech used by famous arena MechWarrior Victor Vandergriff as he defeated Drago 'Death from Above' Alldredge. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.07
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是著名竞技场机甲战士维克托·范德格里夫使用的第一台机甲，他驾驶它击败了绰号“天降死神”的德拉戈·奥德里奇。 特性：改进通讯 投放费用倍率：1.07

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Wow. I understand how he won with this. It has a lot of rare tech for the time when he first used it.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 哇。我明白他当初是怎么靠这个赢的了。在他头一次用它的时候，上面有很多当时的稀有科技。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A prototype version of the later mass produced -8K variant. Mounting a ER Large Laser, three Medium Pulse Lasers and an SRM-4 combined with a Guardian ECM Suite and a master C3 computer. The produced units of the variant eventually were sold off to mainly mercenary units or acquired in underhanded ways by pirates. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是后来量产的-8K变型的原型版本，装有一门增程大型激光、三门中型脉冲激光和一具SRM-4，并配合一套守护者电子对抗套件和一台C3主计算机。该变型产出的机体最终主要卖给了雇佣兵部队，或被海盗以不正当手段获取。 特性：改进通讯 投放费用倍率：1.05

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Nothing special with this prototype really. Use it for parts or move it to the battlefield, nothing of value risked.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这个原型其实没什么特别的。拿它当零件用，或者送到战场上，没什么有价值的东西会受风险。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Quarantine Hero 'Mech is built around 275-rated XL engine and an Endo Steel frame, fitted with three jump jets and clad in near maximum armor. Using its entire left-side as a shield, the Quarantine carries an AC/5 and a trio of Medium Lasers in its right arm supported by two right torso mounted SRM-6 launchers. Carrying only twelve double heat sinks, the 'Mech stores three tons worth of SRM and autocannon reloads split between both legs. Quirk: Extended Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.07
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Quarantine 英雄机甲以一台 275 级 XL 引擎和内骨架框架为核心，装有 3 台跳跃推进器，并披挂接近最大值的装甲。Quarantine 以整个左侧作为盾牌，右臂搭载一门 AC/5 和三门中型激光，并有两具装在右躯干的 SRM-6 发射器提供支援。这台机甲仅携带十二台双散热器，三吨重的 SRM 与自动炮弹药则分装在两条腿中。 特性：扩展躯干旋转 投放费用倍率：1.07

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Quarantine Hero 'Mech is built around 275-rated XL engine and an Endo Steel frame, fitted with three jump jets and clad in near maximum armor. Using its entire left-side as a shield, the Quarantine carries an AC/5 and a trio of Medium Lasers in its right arm supported by two right torso mounted SRM-6 launchers. Carrying only twelve double heat sinks, the 'Mech stores three tons worth of SRM and autocannon reloads split between both legs.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 隔离英雄机甲围绕一具275级XL引擎和内层钢框架建造，装三个跳跃推进器并披挂接近最大量的装甲。它用整个左侧当盾牌，右臂装一门AC/5和三兄弟中型激光器，由右躯干的两具SRM-6发射器支援。这台机甲只带十二具双重散热器，三吨SRM与自动炮备用弹分置双腿。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A refit by the design entity known as Tricky Dick. Based on the -7K, the TD replaces the SRM-6 racks with Streak SRM-6 tubes, and the Large Pulse Laser was turned into an ER PPC to make the 'Mech more viable for longer ranged attacks. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是名为“狡猾迪克”的设计机构所进行的改装。该型号以-7K为基础，将SRM-6发射巢更换为连发SRM-6发射管，并把大型脉冲激光改为增程粒子炮，使这台机甲在远距离攻击时更具优势。 特性：改进通讯 投放费用倍率：1.05

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Not much is known about this 'Tricky Dick'. Is it a person? Or several? I have no idea!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 关于这个"滑头迪克"知道的并不多。它是一个人？还是好几个人？我完全不知道！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The A loadout upsizes the LBX from the primary configuration to an LBX AC/20, but drops the Ultra AC/10 to instead mount two ER Large Laser. The LRM launcher is exchanged for a Streak SRM-6. Four additional heat sinks were also added. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: A载荷把主配置的LBX升级为LBX AC/20，但拆掉超级AC/10，改为装两门增程大型激光。LRM发射器换成连发SRM-6，另加四个散热器。 特性：易于维护 投放费用倍率：1.15 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Woodsman II's introduction followed shortly after original Woodsman, acting as a longer range sniper and support 'Mech. At 80-tons total, the 'Mech is slightly larger than its predecessor, which is used to fit a considerable larger 400 XL engine. As a result the 'Mech can easier be repositioned to keep its distance from main engagements or strike from unexpected angles.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 樵夫 II 在原版樵夫问世后不久推出，担任射程更远的狙击与支援机甲。它总重 80 吨，比前代略大，多出的体量用于容纳大得多的 400 XL 引擎。因此，这台机甲能更容易地转移位置，以远离主战场或从意想不到的角度发起打击。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Bravo configuration switches the 'Mech to a missile boat role, with four LRM-20 launchers as the main weapons. The 'Mech also mounts a Narc launcher and an AMS. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Bravo 配置将这台机甲转为导弹平台角色，以四部 LRM-20 发射器为主武器。它还装有一部 Narc 发射器和一套 AMS。 特性：易于维护 投放费用倍率：1.15 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Woodsman II's introduction followed shortly after original Woodsman, acting as a longer range sniper and support 'Mech. At 80-tons total, the 'Mech is slightly larger than its predecessor, which is used to fit a considerable larger 400 XL engine. As a result the 'Mech can easier be repositioned to keep its distance from main engagements or strike from unexpected angles.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 樵夫 II 在原版樵夫问世后不久推出，担任射程更远的狙击与支援机甲。它总重 80 吨，比前代略大，多出的体量用于容纳大得多的 400 XL 引擎。因此，这台机甲能更容易地转移位置，以远离主战场或从意想不到的角度发起打击。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Primary configuration of the Woodsman II mounts both an LBX AC/10 and an Ultra AC/10, for the capability of a devastating hit at long range. An LRM-20 launcher can provide both direct or indirect fire as needed. The only short range weapon is a small ER Laser in the right torso. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Woodsman II的主配置同时搭载LBX AC/10和Ultra AC/10，具备在远距离发动毁灭性打击的能力。一具LRM-20发射器可按需提供直瞄或间接火力。唯一的近程武器是右躯干上的一门增程小型激光。 特性：易于维护 投放费用倍率：1.15 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Woodsman II's introduction followed shortly after original Woodsman, acting as a longer range sniper and support 'Mech. At 80-tons total, the 'Mech is slightly larger than its predecessor, which is used to fit a considerable larger 400 XL engine. As a result the 'Mech can easier be repositioned to keep its distance from main engagements or strike from unexpected angles.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 樵夫 II 在原版樵夫问世后不久推出，担任射程更远的狙击与支援机甲。它总重 80 吨，比前代略大，多出的体量用于容纳大得多的 400 XL 引擎。因此，这台机甲能更容易地转移位置，以远离主战场或从意想不到的角度发起打击。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The most common alternate configuration in the Woodsman's long career mounted two ER PPCs, two Medium Pulse Lasers, and a Large Pulse Laser and ER Small Laser for backup. It keeps the same number of double heat sinks as the primary configuration, but relocates them across the torso. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.12 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在 Woodsman 漫长的服役生涯中，最常见的备用配置装设两门增程粒子炮、两门中型脉冲激光，以及作为辅助的一门大型脉冲激光和一门增程小型激光。它保留了与主配置相同数量的双散热器，但将其重新分布到躯干各处。 特性：易于维护 投放费用倍率：1.12 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The first heavy OmniMech developed by Clan Wolf, the Woodsman was one of the most heavily tested weapons ever produced by the Clan. Every last detail was considered and problems were eliminated before production began. This resulted in a chassis that would not only function well in the Clan's front line forces for nearly a century, but also inspire the Timber Wolf, Gargoyle, and Naga OmniMechs. Heavy armor provided excellent protection, while a standard fusion engine improved longevity on the battlefield. The light Endo Steel chassis allowed the Woodsman to devote 27 tons to pod space, allowing many mission specific loadouts and prototype weapon configurations. The permanently installed MASC system allowed a pilot to briefly exceed 80 km/h to either withdraw or capitalize on breaches in enemy ranks.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Wraith marked Curtiss Militech's entry into BattleMech production. When the design was announced, many felt that the design would be little more than a walking water cooler. What the critics got was a shock. The Wraith is a 'Mech that, when properly employed, can wreak havoc on an enemy with its astounding speed and maneuverability. It is built around a massive LTV 385 XL Engine that allows it to reach speeds of just under 119 km/h. The Wraith has a simple, yet effective, pulse weapons payload. Pulse laser weaponry allows the Mech to negate most of the side effects on accuracy that are introduced by the Wraith's heavy use of jump jets, making it incredibly accurate and powerful for such a lightly armed Mech. Quirk: Ubiquitous Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 幽灵标志着柯蒂斯军工正式进军战斗机甲生产领域。当该设计公布时，许多人认为它不过是个会走路的饮水机；而批评者们得到的却是一记重击。幽灵是一台在运用得当时，能凭借惊人的速度与机动性在敌阵中肆虐的机甲。它以一台庞大的LTV 385 XL引擎为核心，最高速度略低于119 km/h。幽灵的脉冲武器配置简单而高效——脉冲激光武器让机甲能够抵消大量使用跳跃推进器所带来的命中率副作用，使其在如此轻装的机甲中拥有难以置信的精准度与威力。 特性：随处可见 投放费用倍率：1.05

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A second line Clan mech, the 45 ton Wyvern IIC is an upgrade of the SLDF Wyverns that survived the Exodus. Built using a cache of Wyverns, Clan Burrock upgraded every aspect of the original mech with Clan tech. Retaining the original 180-rated Fusion Core, the Wyvern IIC is armed with a mix of weapons. An ER Large Laser and an LRM-10 make up the Mechs long range firepower, with a pair of ER Medium Lasers and an SRM-6 for medium range combat. A pair of MG’s, a Flamer and a pair of ER Smalls give additional firepower at close range. Quirk: Protected Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.07

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 45 吨的 Wyvern 为城市战而设计，融合了厚重装甲、跳跃推进器和多样的武器组合。Wyvern 9N 由额定 180 的聚变核心驱动，装备一门大型脉冲激光和一具 LRM-10。为进行近距离战斗，该机甲携带两门中型脉冲激光和一具 SSRM-2。 特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1.03

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Designed for Urban combat, the 45 ton Wyvern blends heavy armor, jump jets and a versatile weapons package. Powered by a 180-rated Fusion Core, the Wyvern 9N is armed with a Large Pulse Laser and an LRM-10. For close range combat, the Mech carries a pair of Medium Pulse Lasers and a SSRM-2.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 为城市战设计的45吨飞龙兼顾重装甲、跳跃推进器与多用途武器组合。飞龙9N由一具180级聚变核心驱动，武装为一门大型脉冲激光器和一具LRM-10。近距离作战时，该机甲携带两门中型脉冲激光器和一具SSRM-2。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An early, primitive prototype introduced in 2564, the 2O used Age of War technology. In particular, the engine, cockpit and armor were all primitive technology. It could reach a top speed of 54 km/h and was protected by fifteen tons of primitive armor. Eighteen single heat sinks dissipated the heat produced by an Autocannon/10, SRM-4, Large Laser, and two medium and Small Lasers. Quirk: Protected Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.96
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 2O 是 2564 年推出的早期原始型原型机，采用战争年代的技术。尤其是引擎、座舱与装甲全部为原始技术。它的最高速度可达 54 km/h，由十五吨原始装甲提供防护。十八具单散热器用于散发一门 AC/10、SRM-4、大型激光以及两门中型与小型激光产生的热量。 特性：受保护驱动器 投放费用倍率：0.96

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Xanthos was first introduced by the Capellan Confederation in 2564, designed by a young engineer named Dr. David Harrison. Working for Hollis Inc., he pioneered the technology to create four-legged BattleMechs. This technological advancement that later allowed the research into the Scorpion and Goliath enabled the Xanthos to get on the field. It was presented to the Terran Hegemony for review after the cancellation of the Catapult. Hollis pushed to have this 'Mech presented against Dr. Harrison's wishes in a bid to maintain financial solvency. Clumsy and stiff, the 'Mech failed to win the contract from the Star League purchasing committee.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 桑托斯由卡佩兰联邦于2564年首次推出，设计者是年轻工程师大卫·哈里森博士。他在霍利斯公司工作期间开创了制造四足战斗机甲的技术。这项技术进步后来也让蝎式与歌利亚的研究成为可能，并让桑托斯得以登场。弹射器项目取消后，它被提交给地球霸权审查。霍利斯不顾哈里森博士的意愿力推这款机甲，以求维持财务上的偿付能力。但该机甲笨拙僵硬，未能赢得星际联盟采购委员会的合同。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An Autocannon/20 with three tons of ammunition provides substantial close hitting power. It is backed up with three Medium Lasers, a six-tube SRM Pack, and a rear-firing small laser. A single PPC rounds out this design's weaponry, giving it some range. Quirk: Protected Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一门AC/20配三吨弹药提供可观的近程打击力，辅以三门中型激光、一组六管SRM包和一门后向小型激光。一门单独的粒子炮为该设计的武器收尾，赋予它一定的射程。 特性：受保护驱动器 投放费用倍率：1.16

Working for Hollis Inc., he pioneered the technology to create four-legged BattleMechs. This technological advancement that later allowed the research into the Scorpion and Goliath enabled the Xanthos to get on the field. It was presented to the Terran Hegemony for review after the cancellation of the Catapult. Hollis pushed to have this 'Mech presented against Dr. Harrison's wishes in a bid to maintain financial solvency. Clumsy and stiff, the 'Mech failed to win the contract from the Star League purchasing committee.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Designed specifically as a fire support 'Mech by Curtis Militech, the Yeoman uses a combination of Endo Steel and Ferro-Fibrous armor, allowing paired LRM-15 launchers and LRM-10 launchers to be mounted in each side torso. 6 tons of ammunition are stored in CASE protected magazines. Quirk: Accurate Weapon - Missiles Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 自耕农由柯蒂斯·米尔泰克专门设计为火力支援机甲，采用内骨架与铁纤维装甲的组合，使每侧躯干都能装下成对的LRM-15和LRM-10发射器。6吨弹药储存在CASE防护的弹药舱中。 特性：精准武器 - 导弹 投放费用倍率：1.08 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Designed specifically as a fire support 'Mech by Curtis Militech, the Yeoman uses a combination of Endo Steel and Ferro-Fibrous armor, allowing paired LRM-15 launchers and LRM-10 launchers to be mounted in each side torso. 6 tons of ammunition are stored in CASE protected magazines.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为柯蒂斯军工专门设计的火力支援机甲，自耕农采用内层钢与铁纤装甲的组合，使每侧躯干都能装成对的LRM-15发射器和LRM-10发射器。6吨弹药储存在CASE保护的弹仓中。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The base production version, the BWP-2B was a bit of a generalized work horse. The 'Mech design mounts an Autocannon 5, four SRM-2 launchers, two LRM-5 launchers and a Large Laser. A Small Laser was also added to use up some spare space. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为基础生产版本，BWP-2B算是一台泛用主力。该机甲设计装有一门自动炮5、四具SRM-2发射器、两具LRM-5发射器和一门大型激光，另加一门小型激光以用掉些多余空间。 特性：稳定 投放费用倍率：1.14 手臂驱动器限制：左下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Ymir was the Lyran Commonwealth's first homegrown BattleMech, designed during the Age of War.  Named for the frost giants of Scandinavian mythology, the Ymir was developed by Coventry Defense Conglomerate by taking the basic frame of the Mackie, shaving ten tons from it and then modifying it to form a sleeker design, that offered greater stability and the ability to maneuver more easily.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 伊米尔是莱兰联邦首款自研战斗机甲，设计于战锤时代。它以斯堪的纳维亚神话中的霜巨人命名，由考文垂防务集团以麦基的基本框架为基础，削去十吨后改装成更流线的设计，带来更好的稳定性与更灵活的机动能力。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An \"upgunned\" version of the 2B , the 2E replaced the LRMs with a single LRM-10 and the SRMs with one SRM-6. The Small Laser was replaced with an extra half-ton of armor. The Large Laser and autocannon were swapped out for two PPCs. Because they did not upgrade the heat dissipation system along with the weapons, MechWarriors had to use volley fire, leading to displeasure with the design. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为2B的“加炮”版本，2E以一门单独的LRM-10取代LRM，以一具SRM-6取代SRM，小型激光换成额外半吨装甲，大型激光和自动炮则换成两门粒子炮。由于没有随武器一起升级散热系统，机甲战士不得不采用交替齐射，这引发了对该设计的不满。 特性：稳定 投放费用倍率：1.14 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Ymir was the Lyran Commonwealth's first homegrown BattleMech, designed during the Age of War.  Named for the frost giants of Scandinavian mythology, the Ymir was developed by Coventry Defense Conglomerate by taking the basic frame of the Mackie, shaving ten tons from it and then modifying it to form a sleeker design, that offered greater stability and the ability to maneuver more easily.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 伊米尔是莱兰联邦首款自研战斗机甲，设计于战锤时代。它以斯堪的纳维亚神话中的霜巨人命名，由考文垂防务集团以麦基的基本框架为基础，削去十吨后改装成更流线的设计，带来更好的稳定性与更灵活的机动能力。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 3A is an upgrade of the 2E Ymir using Star League technology and was developed in 2733. It downgraded the PPCs to standard Large Lasers even as double heat sinks were used. An Artemis IV Fire Control System was added to each missile launcher. The remaining tonnage went towards a Medium Laser and additional armor. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 3A是2E伊米尔采用星际联盟技术的升级型号，于2733年研制完成。它把粒子炮降级为标准大型激光，同时改用双散热器，并为每具导弹发射器加装了阿尔忒弥斯IV火控系统。剩余的吨位则用于一具中型激光和额外装甲。 特性：稳定 投放费用倍率：1.16 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Ymir was the Lyran Commonwealth's first homegrown BattleMech, designed during the Age of War.  Named for the frost giants of Scandinavian mythology, the Ymir was developed by Coventry Defense Conglomerate by taking the basic frame of the Mackie, shaving ten tons from it and then modifying it to form a sleeker design, that offered greater stability and the ability to maneuver more easily.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 伊米尔是莱兰联邦首款自研战斗机甲，设计于战锤时代。它以斯堪的纳维亚神话中的霜巨人命名，由考文垂防务集团以麦基的基本框架为基础，削去十吨后改装成更流线的设计，带来更好的稳定性与更灵活的机动能力。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The original Ymir, the X1 prototype could only reach 53 km/h due to its primitive engine. The cockpit and armor were also both primitive, but the design mounted fifteen and a half tons of armor in total. Mounting sixteen heat sinks, the X1 was equipped with two LRM-5s in the right torso,a large laser in the right arm and an AC/5 in the left arm for long-range work. Four SRM-2s were mounted in the left torso for short range work - the designers believing that multiple small systems would be easier to maintain and adapt than larger systems - along with two vehicle flamers mounted in the right hand arm. The vehicle flamers were chosen for the design because of concerns about the safety of taking plasma directly from the reactor, although protecting and shielding the flamers caused problems. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.94 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为最初的伊米尔，X1原型机因采用原始引擎，最高时速只能达到53 km/h。驾驶舱与装甲同样是原始型号，但该设计的装甲总重达到十五吨半。X1装有十六台散热器，右躯干配备两具LRM-5，右臂装有一门大型激光，左臂装有一门AC/5用于远程作战。左躯干装有四具SRM-2用于近程作战——设计师认为多个小型系统比大型系统更易维护和改装——右手臂上还装有两具车辆用火焰喷射器。该设计之所以选用车辆用火焰喷射器，是因为担心直接从反应堆抽取等离子体的安全性，不过为火焰喷射器提供防护与屏蔽也带来了不少麻烦。 特性：稳定 投放费用倍率：0.94 手臂驱动器限制：左臂下部、右臂下部

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Ymir was the Lyran Commonwealth's first homegrown BattleMech, designed during the Age of War.  Named for the frost giants of Scandinavian mythology, the Ymir was developed by Coventry Defense Conglomerate by taking the basic frame of the Mackie, shaving ten tons from it and then modifying it to form a sleeker design, that offered greater stability and the ability to maneuver more easily.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Yu Huang Y-H11F has a mixed weapons loadout, aimed to cover most ranges of engagement. For long rang attacks, the 'Mech carries an ER PPC and LRM-10. Two ER Medium Lasers cover medium range, and as the foes get closer an Ultra AC/20 is ready to finish them off. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 玉皇Y-H11F采用混装武器，意在覆盖大多数交战距离。远程攻击用一门增程粒子炮和一具LRM-10；两门增程中型激光覆盖中距离；敌人逼近后，一门超级AC/20随时准备解决他们。 特性：指挥机甲 投放费用倍率：1.16 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Yu Huang, named for the Jade Emperor that rules the Heavenly Court in the ancient Chinese pantheon, debuted with the promise from Sun-Tzu Liao that \"it shall sit in judgment over a battlefield, meting out justice to those who would transgress against us\". To live up to the promise of the Chancellor of the Capellan Confederation, the Yu Huang carries some of the most advanced technologies available at the time of its initial production. The Yu Huang is built on an Endo Steel chassis and carries a 360 XL engine that gives the 'Mech a top speed of 64.8 km/h. The 'Mech is capable of jumping up to one hundred and twenty meters with its four jump jets.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 玉皇以上古中国神系中掌管天庭的玉皇大帝命名，它的首次亮相伴随着孙慈廖的承诺："它将坐镇战场之上，对那些敢侵犯我们的人施以审判。"为了不负这位卡佩兰联邦议长的承诺，玉皇携带了其最初投产时最先进的一些技术。玉皇建在内层钢底盘上，携带一台360 XL引擎，使该机甲最高速度达64.8公里/小时。该机甲凭借四个跳跃推进器可跳跃至多一百二十米。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Zeus was first built by the Lyran Commonwealth in 2787, just as the First Succession War began. Built at the request of Lyran Commonwealth Armed Forces commanders for a new light-assault 'Mech, the Zeus is fast enough to keep up with most heavy 'Mechs, and is equally capable of defeating them. Introduced in 2940, and an apparent precursor to the 6T, the 6A sports a PPC and Large Laser backed up by considerable short range firepower in the form of three SRM6 launchers and two Medium Lasers. Quirk: Barrel Fist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.12 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 宙斯最早由莱兰联邦于2787年建造，当时第一次继承战争刚刚爆发。应莱兰联邦武装部队指挥官之请而开发的这款新型轻型突击机甲，速度足以跟上大多数重型机甲，也完全有能力击败它们。6A于2940年问世，显然是6T的前身，它装有一门粒子炮与一门大型激光，并以三门SRM6发射器与两门中型激光所构成的强大近距离火力作为后盾。 特性：炮管拳 投放费用倍率：1.12 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Ah, the Zeus. These fine machines were designed to be a fast light-assault 'Mech capable of a wide variety of roles with its mix of hardpoints and speed. The old joke aside, this is the REAL Steiner Scout 'Mech.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 啊，宙斯。这些精良的机器被设计为一款快速的轻型突击机甲，凭借其挂点组合与速度能胜任多种角色。抛开那个老笑话不谈，这才是真正的施泰纳侦察机甲。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The -6SR is a battlefield refit from the standard -6S. It replaces the AC/5 with an Ultra AC/5, switches to use double heat sinks and adds C.A.S.E. protection for all ammunition. To improve its defensive strengths, the 'Mech also adds a C3 Slave computer to the center torso and an Armored Cowl to its head. Quirk: Barrel Fist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: -6SR是由标准-6S改来的野战改装。它把AC/5换成超级AC/5，改用双散热器，并为全部弹药加装C.A.S.E.防护。为增强防御，该机甲还在中央躯干加装一台C3从机计算机，并为头部加装机罩。 特性：炮管拳 投放费用倍率：1.14 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Ah, the Zeus. These fine machines were designed to be a fast light-assault 'Mech capable of a wide variety of roles with its mix of hardpoints and speed. The old joke aside, this is the REAL Steiner Scout 'Mech.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 啊，宙斯。这些精良的机器被设计为一款快速的轻型突击机甲，凭借其挂点组合与速度能胜任多种角色。抛开那个老笑话不谈，这才是真正的施泰纳侦察机甲。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Zeus was first built by the Lyran Commonwealth in 2787, just as the First Succession War began. Built at the request of Lyran Commonwealth Armed Forces commanders for a new light-assault 'Mech, the Zeus is fast enough to keep up with most heavy 'Mechs, and is equally capable of defeating them. The 9S was an upgrade using Star League technology, debuting in 3048. It carried as its main weapon an ER PPC in its left arm, retained as back-up for long-range combat an LRM-15 launcher and an ER Large Laser. For close combat, the 9S is equipped with two Medium Pulse Lasers. Quirk: Barrel Fist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 宙斯最早由莱兰联邦于2787年建造，当时第一次继承战争刚刚爆发。应莱兰联邦武装部队指挥官之请而开发的这款新型轻型突击机甲，速度足以跟上大多数重型机甲，也完全有能力击败它们。9S是采用星际联盟技术的升级型号，于3048年首次亮相。它以左臂的增程粒子炮为主武器，并保留了一具LRM-15发射器与一门增程大型激光作为远距离战斗的后备。近距离作战时，9S装备两门中型脉冲激光。 特性：炮管拳 投放费用倍率：1.14 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Ah, the Zeus. These fine machines were designed to be a fast light-assault 'Mech capable of a wide variety of roles with its mix of hardpoints and speed. The old joke aside, this is the REAL Steiner Scout 'Mech.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 啊，宙斯。这些精良的机器被设计为一款快速的轻型突击机甲，凭借其挂点组合与速度能胜任多种角色。抛开那个老笑话不谈，这才是真正的施泰纳侦察机甲。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Zeus was first built by the Lyran Commonwealth in 2787, just as the First Succession War began. Built at the request of Lyran Commonwealth Armed Forces commanders for a new light-assault 'Mech, the Zeus is fast enough to keep up with most heavy 'Mechs, and is equally capable of defeating them. The 9S2 was a modified version of the 9S. The armor and twelve double heat sinks of original were retained, but the engine was changed to an XL. A Gauss Rifle took the place of the ER PPC while the right arm carried a pair of LRM-15s. Though the Cyclops XII extended range laser was kept, the medium pulse lasers had to be removed to provide enough space for the modifications. Quirk: Barrel Fist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.12 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 宙斯由莱兰联邦于2787年首次建造，正值第一次继承战争爆发。它应莱兰联邦武装部队指挥官对新型轻型突击机甲的要求而生，速度足以跟上大多数重型机甲，同样有能力击败它们。9S2是9S的改进版：原版的装甲和十二个双散热器被保留，但引擎换成XL。一门高斯步枪取代了增程粒子炮，右臂则装一对LRM-15。虽然独眼巨人XII增程激光被保留，但中型脉冲激光不得不拆除，以腾出足够空间完成改装。 特性：炮管拳 投放费用倍率：1.12 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Ah, the Zeus. These fine machines were designed to be a fast light-assault 'Mech capable of a wide variety of roles with its mix of hardpoints and speed. The old joke aside, this is the REAL Steiner Scout 'Mech.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 啊，宙斯。这些精良的机器被设计为一款快速的轻型突击机甲，凭借其挂点组合与速度能胜任多种角色。抛开那个老笑话不谈，这才是真正的施泰纳侦察机甲。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Zeus was first built by the Lyran Commonwealth in 2787, just as the First Succession War began. Built at the request of Lyran Commonwealth Armed Forces commanders for a new light-assault 'Mech, the Zeus is fast enough to keep up with most heavy 'Mechs, and is equally capable of defeating them. The 9S-DC is a sub-variant of the 9S introduced in 3049 designed to include a Command Console. It carried as its main weapon an ER PPC in its left arm, retained as back-up for long-range combat an LRM-15 launcher and an ER Large Laser. The inclusion of a Command Console necessitated the removal of one of the two Medium pulse Lasers. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 宙斯由莱兰联邦于2787年首次建造，正值第一次继承战争爆发。它应莱兰联邦武装部队指挥官对新型轻型突击机甲的要求而生，速度足以跟上大多数重型机甲，同样有能力击败它们。9S-DC是3049年推出的9S子变型，设计上包含一座指挥控制台。它的主武器是左臂一门增程粒子炮，远程战斗的后手则保留一具LRM-15发射器和一门增程大型激光。加装指挥控制台迫使它拆掉两门中型脉冲激光中的一门。 特性：指挥机甲 投放费用倍率：1.14 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Ah, the Zeus. These fine machines were designed to be a fast light-assault 'Mech capable of a wide variety of roles with its mix of hardpoints and speed. The old joke aside, this is the REAL Steiner Scout 'Mech. This model appears to have been a purpose built command 'Mech, its cockpit has been enlarged to all that huge command module and an operator for them.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 啊，宙斯。这些精良的机器被设计为一种快速轻型突击机甲，凭借其硬点组合与速度能胜任各式各样的角色。抛开老笑话不谈，这才是真正的施泰纳侦察机甲。这个型号看起来是一台专门建造的指挥机甲，座舱被扩大到能容纳那个巨大的指挥模块以及一名操作员。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Zeus was first built by the Lyran Commonwealth in 2787, just as the First Succession War began. Built at the request of Lyran Commonwealth Armed Forces commanders for a new light-assault 'Mech, the Zeus is fast enough to keep up with most heavy 'Mechs, and is equally capable of defeating them. The personal 'Mech of Hauptmann-General Leonidas Brannock, commander of the 4th Skye Guards during their assault on Glengarry, the Zeus Leonidas was based on the ZEU-9S. It carried an Artemis IV enhanced LRM-20 and a Gauss Rifle in place of the PPC and LRM-15. The rest of the weapons remained the same. Quirk: Barrel Fist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Zeus ZEU-P-X is a prototype version of the Zeus that would eventually be further developed into the Zeus X. It mounts the same LBX AC/20, MRM-30 and two ER Medium Lasers as the eventual Zeus X ZEU-X, but uses a standard chassis and has considerably less armor. However, the ZEU-X-P mounts a C3 Slave computer, something the ZEU-X is lacking. Quirk: Barrel Fist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 宙斯ZEU-P-X是宙斯的原型版本，后来进一步发展成了宙斯X。它装与最终版宙斯X ZEU-X相同的LBX AC/20、MRM-30和两门增程中型激光，但使用标准底盘，装甲也少得多。不过ZEU-X-P带一台C3从机计算机，而ZEU-X没有。 特性：炮管拳 投放费用倍率：1.14 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Ah, the Zeus. These fine machines were designed to be a fast light-assault 'Mech capable of a wide variety of roles with its mix of hardpoints and speed. The old joke aside, this is the REAL Steiner Scout 'Mech.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 啊，宙斯。这些精良的机器被设计为一款快速的轻型突击机甲，凭借其挂点组合与速度能胜任多种角色。抛开那个老笑话不谈，这才是真正的施泰纳侦察机甲。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Zeus was first built by the Lyran Commonwealth in 2787, just as the First Succession War began. Built at the request of Lyran Commonwealth Armed Forces commanders for a new light-assault 'Mech, the Zeus is fast enough to keep up with most heavy 'Mechs, and is equally capable of defeating them. The Shokomish is the custom variant of the 6S designed to emulate the capabilities of the MechWarrior known as Sealth. Mounting the stock AC/5 and Medium Laser, this variant also features a PPC, twin SRM6 , and twin LRM10 launchers. Included on the Shokomish is a MASC in order to allow nearly any MechWarrior to emulate the famed Sealth, if not replicate him. Quirk: Barrel Fist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Zeus 于 2787 年由莱兰联邦首次建造，恰逢第一次继承战争爆发。它是应莱兰联邦武装力量指挥官的要求而打造的轻型突击机甲；Zeus 的速度足以跟上大多数重型机甲，也完全有能力击败它们。Shokomish 是 6S 的定制改型，旨在复现被称为 Sealth 的机甲战士的能力。它保留原装的 AC/5 和中型激光，同时还配备一门粒子炮、双联 SRM6 和双联 LRM10 发射器。Shokomish 还装有一具 MASC，让几乎任何机甲战士都能效仿那位著名的 Sealth，即便无法完全复制他。 特性：炮管拳 投放费用倍率：1.14 手臂驱动器限制：左下臂、右下臂

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Boss, whoever built this thing went through a lot of trouble to try and replicate the capabilities of a Lyran MechWarrior from the Succession Wars named Sealth who was said to possess unnatural agility and speed on the battlefield. I don't know that this will make the MechWarrior in it any better but that MASC sure will make it move pretty good!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 老大，不管是谁造了这东西，都费了很大功夫去复制一位名叫希尔斯的继承战争时期莱兰机师的能力——据说他在战场上拥有非自然的灵活与速度。我不知道这能不能让坐在里面的人变得更强，但那套MASC肯定会让它跑得相当漂亮！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Manufactured on Kwangjong-ni by Defiance, the Zeus X was both a poster child for excellence in production engineering and an innovative high-technology platform. The first of what became commonly referred to as the Zeus X series, the ZEU-X was a variant of the venerable Zeus BattleMech developed using Experimental Technology to push the envelope of the original design. The 'Mech was armed with an LB-X Autocannon/20 as its primary weapon, backed up by an MRM-30 launcher. The ZEU-X carried three tons of ammunition for the LB-X AC/20 and two tons for the MRM-30, stored in the right torso and protected by CASE II. For close combat, the Zeus had two Medium X-Pulse Lasers. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Zeus X 由 Defiance 在 Kwangjong-ni 星制造，既是生产工程卓越水准的典范，也是一款创新的高技术平台。ZEU-X 是后来被通称为 Zeus X 系列的首个型号，是经典 Zeus 战斗机甲的变型，采用实验性技术研制，以突破原始设计的极限。该机甲以一门 LB-X 自动炮/20 为主武器，辅以一具 MRM-30 发射器。ZEU-X 为 LB-X AC/20 携带三吨弹药，为 MRM-30 携带两吨弹药，均储存于右躯干并由 CASE II 保护。近距离作战方面，Zeus 装有两门中型 X 脉冲激光。 特性：指挥机甲 投放费用倍率：1.16 手臂驱动器限制：左下臂、右下臂

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Boss, this thing looks to be a limited production prototype Zeus variant of some kind and is stuffed full of unique cockpit gear. I'm not sure how you got this thing but there probably isn't but a couple in the whole galaxy!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 老板，这东西看起来是某种限量生产的宙斯原型变型，还塞满了独特的座舱设备。我不知道你是怎么弄到它的，但整个银河大概也就那么几台！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Achileus was jointly designed by scientists from the Free Worlds League and Word of Blake with the goal of creating a light battle armor suit that could be mass produced. Inspired by the Federated Commonwealth's ultimately flawed Infiltrator Mk. I, the research team used the Blakist Tornado PA(L) as the basis for the new suit while seeking to overcome some of its defects. The resulting Achileus manages to add armoring, weaponry and integrated jump jets while still maintaining its stealth aspects. Quirk: Ambusher Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.886 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 阿喀琉斯由自由世界联盟与布雷克之言的科学家联合设计，目标是在制造可以量产的轻量战斗装甲服。受联邦联邦最终存在缺陷的"渗透者 Mk. I"启发，研究团队以布雷克派的"龙卷风"轻动力装甲为基础研制新装甲服，同时力图克服其部分缺陷。成品的阿喀琉斯在保持其隐身特性的同时，成功加装了装甲、武器和一体化跳跃推进器。 特质：伏击者 投放费用倍率：0.886 可挂载全能单位，可近战，可蜂群攻击。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Reportedly piloted by Dirk Radick, the Adder Hero 'Mech, the Cinder mounts an ER Large Laser in each arm supported by a Machine Gun in each side torso complimented by the head mounted Flamer. Carrying two and half tons of machine gun rounds, five extra Double Heat Sinks maintain a high rate of laser fire. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 据称由Dirk Radick驾驶的Adder英雄机甲Cinder，在每只手臂各装备一门增程大型激光，每侧躯干各有一挺机枪作为辅助，另有头部安装的火焰喷射器作为补充。它携带两吨半机枪弹药，五具额外的双散热器则维持着高频率的激光射击。 特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：1.03 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The E configuration has two ATM-9 launchers which can fire ammunition specialized for long, medium, and short ranges. For close combat, the 'Mech has an additional four Micro Pulse Lasers. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.01 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: E 配置装有两具 ATM-9 发射器，可发射专为远、中、近距离设计的弹药。为应对近距离战斗，该机甲另有四门微型脉冲激光。 特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：1.01 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The E2 configuration of the Adder mounts a Large Pulse Laser in each arm and a Flamer in the center torso. All the weapon are synchronized through an advanced targeting computer. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.01 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Adder 的 E2 配置在每臂各装一门大型脉冲激光，中央躯干装一具火焰喷射器。所有武器都通过先进的瞄准计算机进行同步。 特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：1.01 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The G configuration is focused on medium range engagements with its two Streak SRM-6 and four ER Medium Laser. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.01 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: G配置专注于中距离交战，依靠2具连发SRM-6和4门增程中型激光。 <特性：狭小/低矮外形 <投放费用倍率：1.01 <手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Codenamed Puma by Inner Sphere forces who first engaged it, the Adder is a light Clan OmniMech that serves as a direct or an indirect fire-support unit in most of its configurations. The Primary configuration has a basic but powerful arsenal of two ER PPCs which are linked to an advanced Targeting Computer, allowing the Primary configuration of the Adder to strike at long range with deadly accuracy. It also sports a flamer. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.01 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 被首次交战的内天体部队代号为"美洲狮"，蝰蛇是一款轻型氏族全能机甲，在多数配置中充当直接或间接火力支援单位。主配置装备一套基础但强大的两门 ER PPC，联接一台先进瞄准计算机，使蝰蛇主配置能以致命精度在远距离打击。它还配有一具火焰喷射器。 特质：窄小低矮轮廓 投放费用倍率：1.01 臂部驱动器限制：全能

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The only true brawling configuration of the Adder, the Adder H has two highly destructive Heavy Large Lasers as its primary weapons backed up only by the fixed Flamer. To help dissipate the 'Mech's heat, it has six additional double heat sinks. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.01 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 蝰蛇唯一真正意义上的近身近战配置，蝰蛇 H 以两门极具破坏性的重型大型激光为主武器，仅有固定的火焰喷射器作为补充。为帮助散发机甲热量，它额外安装了六台双散热器。 特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：1.01 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This mech was salvaged in the later stages of the wars against the clans by a innately lucky mercenary who managed to pilfer it without his employers catching wind of his new found mech. He promptly emblazoned a Large orange Corgi, a terran creature on the side of the mech and fashioned on as many of his horded parts as the poor mech engineers could jury rg on to the frame to create this monstrosity with no thought for if they SHOULD do it. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这台机甲是在对部族战争的后期被打捞出来的，打捞者是一位天生走运的雇佣兵，他把它顺手牵走而雇主毫不知情。他立刻在机甲侧面刷上一只巨大的橙色柯基——一种地球生物，并让可怜的机甲技师在机架上东拼西凑了他囤积的尽可能多的零件，造出这头怪物，全然不顾他们是否“应该”这么做。 特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：1.03

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Adder-S is a is a scout configuration mounting a pair of Medium Pulse Lasers in each arm and sixteen Machine Guns to exploit any holes opened up in armor by the pulse lasers. The Adder-S also includes an Active Probe and ECM Suite to aid in detection and evasion. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.01 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 蝰蛇-S是一种侦察配置，每只手臂装有2门中型脉冲激光，另有16挺机枪，用来打击脉冲激光在装甲上撕开的缺口。蝰蛇-S还配有1具主动探测器和1套电子对抗套件，以协助探测与规避。 <特性：狭小/低矮外形 <投放费用倍率：1.01 <手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A variant designed for hunting infantry and vehicles, the Adder TC was created specifically for Tukayyid. Diamond Shark politics limited the variant to a single unit, which fought and died on Tukayyid, covering the retreat of Alpha and Gamma galaxies. Powered by a 210-rated XL Engine and built with a combination of Ferro-Fibrous and Endo Steel, the Adder TC has 16 tons of pod space. 10 Machine Guns and a Small Pulse Laser make up the Anti Infantry weapons, while a Large Pulse Laser gives the TC some range. A Targeting Computer, Active Probe and an AMS fill out the remaining pod space. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.01 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Adder TC 是为猎杀步兵和车辆而设计的变型，专为图卡伊德之战打造。钻石鲨部族的内部政治使该变型仅生产了一台，它参与了图卡伊德之战并最终战损，其间掩护了阿尔法与伽马星系的撤退。Adder TC 由一台 210 级 XL 引擎驱动，采用铁纤维与内骨架的组合，拥有 16 吨挂载空间。10 挺机枪和一门小型脉冲激光构成其反步兵武器，一门大型脉冲激光则赋予 TC 一定的射程。瞄准计算机、主动探测器和一套 AMS 填满了剩余的挂载空间。 特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：1.01 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A loadout mainly fielded by the Wolf's Dragoons. Two ER Large Lasers are the main damage dealers, while a C3 slave computer and a basic ECM suite provides some extra performance. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.01 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这套配置主要由狼之龙骑兵使用。两门增程大型激光是主要的伤害输出，C3 从属计算机和一套基础电子对抗套件则提供额外性能。 特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：1.01 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A prototype LAM, the Ajax was a next generation Star League design. Following relatively successful initial trials, the Amaris Civil War rendered the design extinct, with production and testing ceasing due to the war. Designed to be easy to maintain, the Ajax uses pod mounted weapons similar to the modular weapons designed for the Mercury scout 'Mech. Though able to switch modes faster than standard LAM designs, particularly heavy loadouts still hinder the Ajax's speed and versatility. Quirk: Land Air Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为原型 LAM，阿贾克斯是星盟的次世代设计。在相对成功的初期试验之后，阿马里斯内战使该设计绝迹——生产与测试因战争而中止。阿贾克斯设计上便于维护，使用类似水星侦察机甲模块化武器的吊舱式武器。虽然它能比标准 LAM 设计更快切换模式，但过重的载荷仍会拖累阿贾克斯的速度与灵活性。 特质：陆空机甲 投放费用倍率：1.05

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A prototype LAM, the Ajax was a next generation Star League design. Following relatively successful initial trials, the Amaris Civil War rendered the design extinct, with production and testing ceasing due to the war. Designed to be easy to maintain, the Ajax uses pod mounted weapons similar to the modular weapons designed for the Mercury scout 'Mech. Though able to switch modes faster than standard LAM designs, particularly heavy loadouts still hinder the Ajax's speed and versatility. Quirk: Land Air Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Akuma AKU-1X carries an ER PPC and a powerful LB-X Autocannon/10 as its primary long-range weapons. The latter weapon gives it a good amount of flexibility in engaging targets as the autocannon can fire both solid and cluster ammunition. For medium to close range combat, the Akuma has a MRM-30 launcher and two highly accurate short range missile launchers; a Streak SRM-6 and a Streak SRM-4 launcher. Finally, a medium laser and a Medium Pulse Laser round out the Akuma's eclectic and effective weapons payload. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 恶鬼AKU-1X以一门增程粒子炮和一门强力LB-X自动炮/10作为主要远程武器。后者让它交战时相当灵活，因为该自动炮既可发射实心弹也可发射集束弹。中近距离作战时，恶鬼有一具MRM-30发射器和两具高精度的短程火箭发射器——一具连发SRM-6和一具连发SRM-4。最后，一门中型激光和一门中型脉冲激光为恶鬼这套杂而有效的武器载荷收尾。 特性：易于维护 投放费用倍率：1.16 手臂驱动器限制：左下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 2XU is an early, limited run prototype variant of what would eventually become the 2X series of the Akuma. It manages to fit an ER PPC, one LB 10-X autocannon, one MRM-40 launcher for primary firepower. As if that wasn't enough, the 'Mech also carries a Streak SRM-6 and two Medium Pulse Lasers as secondary weapons. The design does suffer from huge struggles with heat management as the cooling is far from adequate. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 2XU是阿库玛2X系列早期限量生产的原型变型。它成功塞入了一门增程粒子炮、一门LB 10-X自动炮以及一具MRM-40发射器作为主要火力。仿佛这还不够，该机甲还搭载了连发SRM-6和两门中型脉冲激光作为次要武器。由于散热能力远远不足，该设计在热量管理上极为吃力。 特性：易于维护 投放费用倍率：1.16 手臂驱动器限制：左下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Álfar AL-A1 fielded an impressive amount of firepower for its size. A PPC mounted on its right arm was the main weapon. Three medium lasers, two on the left arm and one in the head, plus a SRM-6 missile rack with 1 ton of ammo, all in the left shoulder, provided ample backup and close-range punch. Fifteen heat sinks provided good battlefield endurance. Quirk: Nimble Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 阿尔法AL-A1就体型而言火力相当可观：右臂一门粒子炮是主武器，三门中型激光（左臂两门、头部一门）加上左肩一具SRM-6导弹挂架（配1吨弹药）提供充足的后手与近程打击力。十五个散热器带来良好的战场持续力。 特性：灵巧 投放费用倍率：1.03

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Nicknamed \"baby Warhammer\", this less common Dark Elf variant replaced all lasers and the SRM with a second PPC to provide a cheap fire support option at the cost of short-range capability and heat endurance. Quirk: Nimble Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这款较少见的黑暗精灵变型绰号“小风暴之锤”，它以第二门粒子炮取代所有激光和SRM，提供廉价的火力支援选项，代价是近程能力与耐热性。 特性：灵巧 投放费用倍率：1.03

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The original variant of the Ambassador was fully unarmed, but as the StarLeague started fracturing some basic defensive firepower was adding in the form of a single Small Laser. Quirk: Easy to Pilot Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.97
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Ambassador 的原始变型完全没有武装，但随着星际联盟开始分崩离析，人们以一门小型激光的形式为其添加了基本的自卫火力。 特性：易于驾驶 投放费用倍率：0.97

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Debuting in 3055, the Anvil is an FWL Mech designed to work with the light Hammer fire support Mech. A heavy brawler, the Anvil is a 60-ton mech with a 300-rated Fusion Core and an Endo Steel chassis. The Anvil ANV-3M is armed with a pair of Large Pulse Lasers and a pair of Medium Lasers. A Guardian ECM Suite distorts enemy sensors. Quirk: Extended Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 铁砧于3055年首次亮相，是自由世界联盟的一款机甲，设计用于配合轻型锤式火力支援机甲作战。作为重型斗士，铁砧是60吨机甲，带300额定聚变核心和内骨架底盘。铁砧ANV-3M装有一对大型脉冲激光和一对中型激光。一套守护者电子对抗套件可干扰敌方传感器。 特性：扩展躯干旋转 投放费用倍率：1.08

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Debuting in 3055, the Anvil is an FWL Mech designed to work with the light Hammer fire support Mech. A heavy brawler, the Anvil is a 60-ton mech with a 300-rated Fusion Core and an Endo Steel chassis. The Anvil ANV-5M is armed with a pair of ER Large Lasers and 4 Medium Lasers. A Guardian ECM Suite distorts enemy sensors. Quirk: Extended Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 铁砧于3055年首次亮相，是自由世界联盟的一款机甲，设计用于配合轻型锤式火力支援机甲作战。作为重型斗士，铁砧是60吨机甲，带300额定聚变核心和内骨架底盘。铁砧ANV-5M装有一对增程大型激光和4门中型激光。一套守护者电子对抗套件可干扰敌方传感器。 特性：扩展躯干旋转 投放费用倍率：1.08

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Debuting in 3055, the Anvil is an FWL Mech designed to work with the light Hammer fire support Mech. A heavy brawler, the Anvil is a 60-ton mech with a 300-rated Fusion Core and an Endo Steel chassis. The Anvil ANV-6M is armed with a pair of Large Pulse Lasers, a Medium Laser and a TAG. A Guardian ECM Suite distorts enemy sensors. Quirk: Extended Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Anvil 于 3055 年首次亮相，是自由世界联盟的机甲，设计上用于与轻型火力支援机甲 Hammer 协同作战。作为一款重型近身近战机甲，Anvil 重 60 吨，配备额定 300 的聚变引擎和内骨架。Anvil ANV-6M 装有两门大型脉冲激光、一门中型激光和一具 TAG。一具 Guardian 电子对抗套件可扰乱敌方传感器。 特性：扩展躯干旋转 投放费用倍率：1.08

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Debuting in 3055, the Anvil is an FWL Mech designed to work with the light Hammer fire support Mech. A heavy brawler, the Anvil is a 60-ton mech with a 240-rated Fusion Core and an Endo Steel chassis. The Anvil ANV-8M is armed with an Arrow IV and an ER Large Laser. A pair of ER Medium Lasers round out the armament, while MASC and Guardian ECM enhance the Mechs speed and defensive capabilities. Quirk: Extended Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 铁砧于3055年亮相，是自由世界联盟的机甲，设计上用于配合轻型锤式火力支援机甲作战。作为一台重型近战近战机甲，铁砧重60吨，装备一台额定240的聚变核心与内骨架底盘。铁砧ANV-8M装备一门箭IV导弹和一门增程大型激光。两门增程中型激光补全了武装，而MASC与守护者电子对抗套件则提升了该机甲的速度与防御能力。 特性：扩展躯干旋转 投放费用倍率：1.08 手臂驱动器限制：左上

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Created by Wolf's Dragoons in the early 3060s, this mech has a unique Prototype Light Fusion Engine alongside early production models of the Multi-Missile Launcher and an assortment of tactical munitions. Quirk: Variable Range Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.07
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这台机甲由狼之龙骑兵在3060年代初打造，配有独特的原型轻型聚变引擎，以及早期量产型多用途导弹发射器和各类战术弹药。 特性：可变距离瞄准 投放费用倍率：1.07

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The APN-1J is armed with two medium lasers and a machine gun, which is a surprising amount of weapons for 15-ton BattleMech considering it also sports 3 tons of standard armor. The drawback is the 90 rated engine core which leads to a - for ultralights - slow movement across the battlefield. Quirk: Ubiquitous Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.97
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: APN-1J 装备两门中型激光和一挺机枪；考虑到它还披挂 3 吨标准装甲，这对一台 15 吨战斗机甲来说已是相当可观的武器配置。它的短板在于额定 90 的引擎核心，导致它在战场上的移动速度——对于超轻型机甲而言——相当缓慢。 特性：随处可见 投放费用倍率：0.97

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: For long range combat, the Arcas carries a ER Large Laser in each arm. When the Arcas' opponent closes, it can bring three Streak SRM-4s and a pair of Medium Pulse Lasers to bear. These accurate weapons help the second-line warrior once an enemy gets close. Fifteen double heat sinks help keep the 'Mech cool. Quirk: Protected Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 远程作战时，阿卡斯每只手臂各带一门增程大型激光。当对手逼近，阿卡斯可动用三具连发SRM-4和一对中型脉冲激光。这些精准武器在敌人靠近后帮助二线战士。十五个双散热器帮助机甲保持凉爽。 特性：受保护驱动器 投放费用倍率：1.15 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This variant is used primarily when far from supply lines. It removes the missiles and ER Large Lasers for a pair of ER PPCs and additional double heat sinks. Quirk: Protected Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 此变型主要在远离补给线时使用。它拆掉导弹和增程大型激光，换成一对增程粒子炮和额外双散热器。 特性：受保护驱动器 投放费用倍率：1.15 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A customized variant of the Arctic Cheetah piloted by Eva Hordwon, the Shard carries two ER Medium Lasers in each arm, supported by twin Heavy Machine Guns in the right torso and a left torso-mounted Streak SRM-4. A single ton of Streak missiles and a ton and a half of HMG ammo give the Shard good endurance. Quirk: Protected Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.02 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 由伊娃·霍德翁驾驶的 Arctic Cheetah 定制改型，Shard 每臂各带两门增程中型激光，右躯干配双联重型机枪，左躯干装有一具连发 SRM-4。一吨连发导弹和一吨半的重型机枪弹药让 Shard 具备良好的持续作战能力。 特性：受保护驱动器 投放费用倍率：1.02 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A special configuration of the Arctic Cheetah used for batchall, the ritualistic combat challenge between Clan warriors. Two Heavy Medium Lasers and two SRM-6 launchers are the main damage dealers, but a pair of Micro Pulse Lasers and a Flamer gives better close combat capabilities. Quirk: Protected Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Arctic Cheetah 用于 batchall（部族战士之间仪式性的战斗挑战）的特殊配置。两台重型中型激光和两部 SRM-6 发射器是主要的输出手段，而两门微型脉冲激光和一门火焰喷射器则提升了近战能力。 特性：受保护驱动器 投放费用倍率：0.99 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The design of the Arctic Wolf is simple: get close, unleash a torrent of missiles, and get out. To do this, it is armed with six Type 1 SRM Six-Shooters and two Type 1 Cross-Pattern SRM-4 Launchers. Aiding the accuracy of these missiles is the Tracker Series Narc Missile Beacon. The Arctic Wolf also boasts an impressive four tons of ammunition for its launchers. The 'Mech has ten double heat sinks which can be overwhelmed, but only if a MechWarrior insists on staying in the fight or going full-tilt for long periods. The Arctic Wolf is protected by six tons of standard armor. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Short Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 北极狼（Arctic Wolf）的设计思路很简单：贴近、倾泻导弹、然后撤离。为此，它装备了六具 1 型 SRM 六连发器和两具 1 型交叉弹道 SRM-4 发射器。追踪者系列 Narc 导弹信标则提升了这些导弹的命中精度。北极狼还拥有令人瞩目的四吨发射器弹药储备。该机甲装有十台双散热器，只有当机甲战士执意长时间持续作战或全力输出时，散热器才可能不堪重负。北极狼由六吨标准装甲提供防护。 特性：改进瞄准 - 近距 投放费用倍率：1.08 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This variant replaces the SRM-4s and two SRM-6s with an Alpha Series large pulse laser. This gives the 'Mech some long-range capability and provides it with a punch weapon, as well as increased accuracy and a reduction on ammunition dependency. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Short Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该变型用一门Alpha系列大型脉冲激光替换了SRM-4和两具SRM-6。这为机甲带来了一定的远程作战能力，也赋予它一件重击武器，同时提升了精度并降低了对弹药的依赖。 特性：改进瞄准 - 短距 投放费用倍率：1.08 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The very first Argus Design spec's that was rejected by the AFFCS, while being a lot more flexible then contemporary Chassis did its more advanced and rare components make it unfit for larger Engagements. Quirk: Advanced Missile TTS Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是最早被 AFFCS 否决的 Argus 设计方案。虽然它比同时代的底盘灵活得多，但其更先进、更稀有的组件令它不适合大规模交战。 特性：高级导弹瞄准系统 投放费用倍率：1.03 手臂驱动器限制：全向机甲

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: One of several variants that attempt to modernize the weaponry of the AS7-D. The AS7-8D replaces the AC/20 with a Gauss Rifle, adds Artemis IV support to the LRM launcher and upgrade to Medium Pulse Lasers over the standard ones. Further, the SRM is replaced with a Streak SRM and both a Guardian ECM Suiote and a Beagle Active Probe were added. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是在为 AS7-D 的武器进行现代化改造的若干变型之一。AS7-8D 以高斯步枪取代 AC/20，为 LRM 发射器加装 Artemis IV 辅助系统，并将标准中型激光升级为中型脉冲激光。此外，SRM 被换成连发 SRM，同时还加装了一套 Guardian ECM 套件和一台 Beagle 主动探测器。 特性：战拳 投放费用倍率：1.18

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An upgrade of the original -D, this variant uses an Endo Steel chassis to fit more Lasers and add Artemis IV FCS to the missile launchers. The Autocannon is also switch to a more accurate Gauss Rifle. The downside of all the energy weapons is the fact the 'Mech overheats very easily, event after the switch to Double Heat Sinks. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是对原版-D的升级，此变型采用内骨架底盘以装入更多激光，并为导弹发射器加装阿尔忒弥斯IV火控系统；自动炮也换成更精准的高斯步枪。这些能量武器的缺点是该机甲极易过热，即便改用了双散热器也是如此。 特性：战拳 投放费用倍率：1.18

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The AS7 'Boar's Head' is a little-seen trial Atlas run that attempted to make a more mobile striker assault 'Mech while still maintaining the dreaded reputation of the Atlas. Among Defiance's changes included routing all the energy weapon power couplings to the arms - 3 in each - and a massive XL engine. Ultimately, the AS7-BH proved too fragile and vulnerable to weapons loss for it's weight and altogether excessive cost. Quirk: Intimidating Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.2
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: AS7“野猪头”是一批鲜为人知的试验型阿特拉斯，试图在保留阿特拉斯令人畏惧的名声的同时，打造一台更具机动性的突击机甲。Defiance所做的改动包括将所有能量武器的供电耦合全部改走手臂——每条手臂三组——以及一具巨大的XL引擎。最终，AS7-BH被证明对于其吨位而言过于脆弱、极易损失武器，而且造价高得离谱。 特性：威慑 投放费用倍率：1.2

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Atlas C is the result of the first rudimentary refit protocol created for the Atlas C, which upgraded the weapons, and was later commonly implemented on captured Inner Sphere Atlases during Operation Revival Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Atlas C 源于为 Atlas C 制订的第一套初级改装方案，该方案升级了武器，后来在复兴行动期间被广泛用于改装缴获的内层星域 Atlas。 特性：战拳 投放费用倍率：1.16

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: After the success of the initial conversion protocol of the Atlas C, the C-2 is a more thorough upgrade that replaces the LRMs with an additional ER PPC and the rest of the weapons with superior clan versions. The C-2 protocol is the most common conversion to be implemented on Atlases and Atlas IIs in Clan space. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.22
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在 Atlas C 的初步改装方案取得成功之后，C-2 是一次更为彻底的升级：它用一门额外的增程粒子炮取代了 LRM，并将其余武器全部更换为性能更优的部族版本。C-2 改装方案是部族领地上 Atlas 与 Atlas II 最常采用的改装形式。 特性：战拳 投放费用倍率：1.22

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A more uncommon clan conversion than the C 2, the Atlas C 3 removes some of the original weapon systems to fit a giant Arrow IV artillery system in the left torso. In the right torso a Gauss Rifle is mounted, and each arm also carries a ER Large Laser. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.22
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Atlas C 3 是比 C 2 更为罕见的部族改装型。它拆除了部分原有武器系统，以便在左躯干内安装一套巨大的 Arrow IV 火炮系统。右躯干内装有一门高斯步枪，每条手臂还各携有一门增程大型激光。 特性：战拳 投放费用倍率：1.22

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The personal 'Mech of General Caesar Steiner of the Lyran Alliance, the Duke of Furilo and son to Margrave Iris Steiner. The 'Mech is ostensibly designated AS7-CS, but referred to as the 'Dämmerung' by most. It mounts a massive weaponry spread thanks to it’s advanced XL engine. Using the weight savings, the Medium Lasers that once rested in the forearms are replaced by Large Pulse Lasers, mounted underslung on the forearms. Regarding the Gauss rifle as the next evolution of heavy-bore ballistic weapons, the Archon requested that one with an ample ammo supply replaced the Atlas' AC/20. The SRM magazine was completely removed and the LRM magazine downsized to make room for an ER Large Laser along the ‘Mech’s centerline, and the arsenal is rounded out by hip-mounted Medium Lasers. This broad spread of weapons allows for the design to bring the bulk of its weapons to bear at any range Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.2
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是莱兰联盟 Caesar Steiner 将军的私人座机——他是 Furilo 公爵，也是边区伯爵 Iris Steiner 之子。该机甲名义上的编号为 AS7-CS，但大多数人称其为“Dämmerung”。凭借先进的 XL 引擎，它搭载了极为庞大的武器配置。利用节省下来的重量，曾置于前臂的中型激光被替换为吊挂在前臂下方的大型脉冲激光。执政官将高斯步枪视为大口径实弹武器的下一步进化，因此要求用一门弹药充足的高斯步枪取代 Atlas 的 AC/20。SRM 弹仓被完全拆除，LRM 弹仓则缩减容量，以便沿机甲中轴线装入一门增程大型激光；其武器库最后由臀侧安装的中型激光补足。如此广泛的武器分布使该设计能在任何距离上倾泻其大部分火力。 特性：战拳 投放费用倍率：1.2

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A Clan-tech retrofit of the AS7-D Atlas, the Atlas C replaced the older autocannon and missile launchers with a Clan standard Ultra AC/20, Swarm LRM compatible LRM-20, and Streak SRM-6 launchers; but the Inner Sphere Medium Lasers remained unchanged. Lighter Clan components allowed the Atlas C to carry 3 tons of autocannon ammunition. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Atlas C是AS7-D Atlas的部族科技改装型，以部族标准型Ultra AC/20、兼容Swarm LRM的LRM-20以及连发SRM-6发射器取代了旧式的自动炮与导弹发射器；但内层星域的中型激光则保持不变。更轻的部族部件让Atlas C得以携带3吨自动炮弹药。 特性：指挥机甲 投放费用倍率：1.18

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Piloted by Wolf's Dragoons Captain Danielle Rondema, this modified Atlas carried three medium lasers in each arm, trading away the SRM rack to do so. The additional heat was dissipated by two additional heat sinks that replaced the rear-firing medium lasers. Quirk: Intimidating Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.2
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这台改装过的阿特拉斯由沃尔夫龙骑兵的丹妮尔·隆德马上尉驾驶，为此每只手臂各装了三门中型激光，代价是舍弃了SRM发射巢。由此产生的额外热量由两个额外散热器散逸，它们取代了朝后射击的中型激光。 特性：威慑 投放费用倍率：1.2

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Used by Vayil Oonthrax on Solaris VII this variant of the Atlas removed the LRM-20 for another SRM-6, more SRM-6 ammunition and Heat Sinks. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这款Atlas改型由Vayil Oonthrax在Solaris VII上使用，它拆除了LRM-20，换装另一具SRM-6、更多SRM-6弹药以及散热器。 特性：战拳 投放费用倍率：1.18

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Atlas AS7-D-CE replaces the AC/20 from the standard model with the newly developed LB 20-X autocannon, and the LRM and SRM launchers with improved versions. To lower weight of the new technology even makes it possible to add two more heat sinks and more ammunition. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Atlas AS7-D-CE 用新研制的 LB 20-X 自动炮替换了标准型号的 AC/20，并将 LRM 与 SRM 发射器换成改进型。新技术带来的重量下降甚至使其可以再加装两台散热器和更多弹药。 特性：战拳 投放费用倍率：1.16

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The AS7-DRR is a refit of the AS7-D, replacing the AC/20 with a Gauss Rifle, allowing the addition of two more Medium Lasers and Artemis IV Support for the launchers. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: AS7-DRR是AS7-D的改装型，以一门高斯步枪取代AC/20，从而得以加装两门额外的中型激光，并为发射器增加Artemis IV支援。 特性：战拳 投放费用倍率：1.18

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A classic variant of the AS7-D used by the Lyran Commonwealth, the AS7-H trades the autocannon and LRM 20 for a smaller LRM 10, a trio of Large Lasers and a huge hatchet. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是莱兰联邦所使用的 AS7-D 经典变型。AS7-H 以更小的 LRM 10、三门大型激光和一把巨大的战斧替换了自动炮与 LRM 20。 特性：战拳 投放费用倍率：1.16

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A partial clan refit used by some of the high-end mercenary outfits, based of their gathered loot. A few have also been stolen by Pirates or gone missing under suspicious circumstances. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一种部分采用部族技术改装的型号，由一些高端雇佣兵部队根据其搜集到的战利品改造而成。也有少数被海盗盗走，或在可疑的情况下不翼而飞。 特性：战拳 投放费用倍率：1.18

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Featured as a custom Solaris VII 'Mech the 'Kraken' Is very similar too and likely built upon the chassis of a standard AS7-K, switching out the Medium Pulse Lasers for standard models. Quirk: Intimidating Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.2
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为Solaris VII的定制机甲登场，“Kraken”与该型号非常相似，很可能是在标准AS7-K的底盘上建造的，只是将中型脉冲激光换成了标准型号。 特性：威慑 投放费用倍率：1.2

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A Large Laser refit of the AS7-D, reducing the LRM launcher to 15 tubes and the Autocannon to an AC/10 to be able to fit a Large Laser in each arm. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是 AS7-D 的大型激光改装型：将 LRM 发射器减少到 15 管，自动炮改为 AC/10，从而能在每条手臂各装入一门大型激光。 特性：战斗铁拳 投放费用倍率：1.16

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A mercenary refit of the Atlas, mounting a Gauss Rifle, the stock LRM-20 launcher and two ER Large Lasers. Two Medium Pulse Lasers provide close fire support. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是Atlas的雇佣兵改装版，搭载一门高斯步枪、原装LRM-20发射器和两门增程大型激光。两门中型脉冲激光提供近距离火力支援。 特性：战拳 投放费用倍率：1.18

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Atlas AS7-MCJ is similar to the -MCA, but drops a ton of armor and uses an endo steel chassis to fit three Jump Jets. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Atlas AS7-MCJ与-MCA相似，但减少了一吨装甲，并采用内骨架底盘以容纳三台跳跃推进器。 特性：战拳 投放费用倍率：1.18

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Another refit of the AS7-D similar to the -MCA and MCJ, this variant replaces the Large Lasers with two ER PPCs. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是AS7-D的另一款改装，与-MCA和MCJ类似，以两门增程粒子炮取代大型激光。 特性：战拳 投放费用倍率：1.18 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Another typical Export from the Gamesworld is this Atlas redesigned around an Articulated and 3 Directional Jump Jets, to close in and punch the Enemy with its Hydraulic Fists. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.2
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 又一款来自游戏世界的典型出口型号：这台阿特拉斯围绕铰接式结构与3台定向跳跃推进器重新设计，以便逼近敌人，用它的液压铁拳痛击对手。 特性：战斗铁拳 投放费用倍率：1.2

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The personal 'Mech of Galedon Military District commander Warlord Grieg Samsonov during the DCMS's Third Succession War invasion of Galtor III in 3025, only the massive autocannon remains, with the rest of the standard weaponry replaced with a PPC mounted in each arm. The remaining weight and space is devoted to six additional heat sinks. Quirk: Intimidating Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.2
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这台机甲是加勒登军区指挥官、军阀格里格·萨姆索诺夫在3025年DCMS第三次继承战争入侵加尔托III时的座机，它只保留了那门巨大的自动炮，其余标准武器被替换为每条手臂各装一门粒子炮。剩余的重量和空间则用于加装六台额外散热器。 特性：威吓 投放费用倍率：1.2

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Atlas AS7-ZL was originally part of the the DCMS, but it was converted to the personal 'Mech of Zackary Lee by Free Rasalhague engineers after its capture. Due to its severe damage much of its equipment had to be either painstakingly restored or completely scrapped. The internal structure and 300-rated Fusion powerplant was kept the same, but most of the weapons were either replaced by similar ones of a different make or new ones. The main weapon of the original Atlas AS7-D was too damage to repair, and instead got replaced with a Gauss Rifle for increased precision. Since most of the armor was practically missing, the technicians took the chance to upgrade the 'Mech to use Ferro-Fibrous armor. For similar reasons the cooling system was rebuilt from scratch using double heat sinks rather than standard. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.2
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 阿特拉斯AS7-ZL原本隶属于龙脉联合体军方，但在被缴获后，由自由拉塞哈格的工程师改装成扎卡里·李的专属机甲。由于损伤严重，它的许多设备要么被费尽心力地修复，要么被彻底废弃。内部结构与额定300的聚变动力装置保持不变，但大部分武器不是被不同厂商的同类产品替换，就是换成了全新的型号。原版阿特拉斯AS7-D的主武器损伤过重而无法修复，于是被换成一门高斯步枪以提升精准度。由于装甲几乎荡然无存，技术人员趁机将机甲升级为铁纤维装甲。出于类似的原因，冷却系统也从头重建，改用双散热器而非标准散热器。 特性：战斗铁拳 投放费用倍率：1.2

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An late Clan Invasion era variant created as an attempt to counter certain Clan 'Mechs. Each side torso carries a Gauss Rifle and both arms an ER Large Laser. A chest mounted LRM-10 provides some indirect fire capabilities. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是部族入侵晚期的一种变型，为对抗某些部族机甲而造。两侧躯干各装一门高斯步枪，双臂各一门增程大型激光，胸口一具LRM-10提供一定的间接火力。 特性：战拳 投放费用倍率：1.18

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The custom version used by Nicholas Kerensky, this version of the Atlas II retains the weapon array of the original but swaps the Inner Sphere components for more advanced Clan equivalents. It also adds a second SRM launcher. All the missile systems are equipped with Artemis IV fire control systems. Double heat sinks were replaced with their less bulky Clan equivalents and increased to nineteen. The ferro-fibrous armor protection remains the same, but again was replaced by more compact Clan version. To handle electronic warfare duties, a small ECM Suite and Active Probe were added to the center torso. The CASE systems were integrated into the side torsos, as was common to all Clan designs. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.24
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是尼古拉斯·克伦斯基使用的定制版本，这台阿特拉斯II保留了原型的武器阵列，但把内层星域的部件换成更先进的部族同类产品。它还增加了一具SRM发射器。所有导弹系统都配备了Artemis IV火控系统。双散热器被替换为体积更小的部族同类产品，数量增至十九台。铁纤维装甲的防护水平保持不变，但同样换成了更紧凑的部族版本。为承担电子战任务，中央躯干加装了一套小型电子对抗套件和主动探测器。CASE系统被整合进左右躯干，这也是所有部族设计的通行做法。 特性：战拳 投放费用倍率：1.24
阿特拉斯II AS7-D-H '克伦斯基'

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A customized variant of the stock AWS-9M model that was utilized by Adam Steiner during the 1st Somerset Strikers' liberation of Somerset in the midst of the Clan Invasion. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是库存 AWS-9M 型号的定制变型，曾在部族入侵期间由亚当·施泰纳在第一萨默塞特突击队解放萨默塞特的行动中使用。 特性：指挥机甲 投放费用倍率：1.16 手臂驱动器限制：右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Danielle Peterson's Awesome, the 'Pretty Baby' Hero 'Mech has some unexpected speed, achieved through the use of an 340-rated Extralight Engine. The Pretty Baby (serial number AWS8V99TG-2957) also features a unique weapon loadout as well - mounting a standard PPC in the right arm, a LRM-15 in the right torso, a Medium Laser in the head, Large Laser in the left torso and an SRM-4 in the left arm. 19 Double Heat Sinks, two tons of LRM and three of SRM missiles keep it in the thick of battle. Quirk: Combat Computer Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 丹妮尔·彼得森的 Awesome，即英雄机甲“Pretty Baby”，拥有出人意料的速度，这得益于一台 340 级超轻型引擎。Pretty Baby（序列号 AWS8V99TG-2957）还拥有独一无二的武器配置：右臂一门标准粒子炮、右躯干一门 LRM-15、头部一门中型激光、左躯干一门大型激光，左臂一具 SRM-4。19 个双散热器、两吨 LRM 弹药和三吨 SRM 导弹让它能在激战中持续作战。 特性：战斗计算机 投放费用倍率：1.16 手臂驱动器限制：右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Bandersnatch, named after the monster in Lewis Carroll's 'Wonderland' series, is the brainchild of Felifious Bander and is built around the concept of an affordable and effective BattleMech for sale to mercenary units. The Bandersnatch shares most of its components with the Marauder, making the 'Mech cheaper and easier to repair. The Bandersnatch uses double heat sinks for superior heat dissipation capabilities, allowing a heavier weapons payload. Further, the Bandersnatch carries a respectable eleven tons of armor. While not the maximum amount of armor that the chassis can handle, the 'Mech is still well protected. The primary armaments are for long to medium range combat, a trio of Holly LRM-5 missile launchers and a pair of Armstrong Class-B ClusterGuns LB-X Autocannon/10s that fire both solid and cluster rounds. In the event that an enemy does close to short ranges, the 'Mech carries six Magna Mk II Medium Lasers, two of which are rear mounted, giving it good close range protection. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Bandersnatch 得名于刘易斯·卡罗尔《仙境》系列中的怪物，是 Felifious Bander 的心血之作，其设计理念是为雇佣兵部队提供一款价格适中且战力可靠的战斗机甲。Bandersnatch 的大部分组件与 Marauder 通用，因此造价更低，也更易于维修。它采用双散热器，散热能力出色，可承载更重的武器载荷。此外，Bandersnatch 还披挂令人称道的十一吨装甲。虽然尚未达到该底盘所能承受的最大装甲量，这台机甲的防护仍相当完备。主要军备面向中远距交战：三具 Holly LRM-5 导弹发射器和两门 Armstrong Class-B ClusterGuns LB-X 自动炮/10，可发射实心弹与集束弹。一旦敌人逼近到近距离，该机甲还携有六门 Magna Mk II 中型激光，其中两门朝后安装，为其提供良好的近距离防护。 特性：稳定 投放费用倍率：1.11 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A unique customized Bandersnatch which was created for ex-Nova Cat MechWarrior Horus. Equipped with Endo Steel, the 'Mech's weaponry had been almost completely refitted with the exception of the rear-firing Medium Lasers. In each arm, the 'Mech has been given a Class 20 Autocannon. It has 2 tons of CASE protected ammunition for the cannons in each side torso. For long-range firepower, it was fitted with a torso-mounted ER Large Laser. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.13 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一具独一无二的定制 Bandersnatch，专为新星猫部族的前机甲战士 Horus 打造。该机甲配备内骨架，除朝后射击的中型激光外，武器几乎全部重新改装。每只手臂各装有一门 20 级自动炮。两侧躯干各有 2 吨受 CASE 保护的自动炮弹药。为获得远程火力，它还搭载了一具安装在躯干上的增程大型激光。 特性：稳定 投放费用倍率：1.13 手臂驱动器限制：左下臂、右下臂

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A custom design of the Bandersnatch from an mostly unknown designer know as 'Tricky Dick'. Very little is known of this 'Mech beyond its basic parameters. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.13 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是Bandersnatch的一款定制设计，出自一位几乎无人知晓、人称“滑头迪克”的设计师之手。除了基本参数之外，人们对这台机甲几乎一无所知。 特性：稳定 投放费用倍率：1.13 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Bane is a BattleMech that is based upon a Star League prototype that was never put into production.
