Tagged the Kraken by Inner Sphere forces who opposed it, the Bane was first built in 2827. It was originally a significant part of many Clan toumans, but was gradually relegated to second-line status following the introduction of the OmniMech. As such, it is still critical to many defensive units. Quirk: Extended Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.22 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 灾星是一款以从未投产的星际联盟原型为基础的战斗机甲。它被对抗它的内层星域部队称作“海怪”，于2827年首次建造。它原本是许多部族部队的重要组成部分，但在全向机甲出现后逐渐被降为二线地位，即便如此，对许多防御单位而言它仍至关重要。 特性：扩展躯干旋转 投放费用倍率：1.22 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Designed for medium and short range combat, the Bane 2 trades out the Ultra Autocannon/2s for four Ultra Autocannon/10s. Fourteen tons of ammunition allow the Bane 2 to stay in the fight for a long time. Quirk: Extended Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.22 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Bane 2 专为中近距离作战而设计，它把 Ultra 自动炮/2 换成了四门 Ultra 自动炮/10。十四吨弹药让 Bane 2 能在战斗中坚持很长时间。 特性：扩展躯干旋转 投放费用倍率：1.22 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Designed for fire support, the Bane 3 is a radical rework of the Bane. Eight LRM-15 provide the bulk of the designs fire, with sixteen tons of ammunition supplying the launchers. A Streak SRM-4 provides limited close support. Nineteen double heat sinks are up to the task of keeping the design cool. Quirk: Extended Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.22 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 灾星3为火力支援而设计，是对灾星的激进重做。八具LRM-15构成该设计火力的大部分，十六吨弹药为这些发射器供弹；一具连发SRM-4提供有限的近距支援。十九个双散热器足以让该设计保持凉爽。 特性：扩展躯干旋转 投放费用倍率：1.22 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An unusual variant of the Bane acting as a missile boat rather the usual long range direct attack weapons. A total of eight LRM-15 launchers can fire 120 missiles in each volley, enough to penetrate even the most powerful AMS defenses. Four Machine Guns acts as close range defense against any infantry or squads trying to engage the 'Mech directly. Quirk: Extended Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.22 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Bane 的一个不寻常变型，它不承担惯常的远程直射角色，而是充当导弹平台。八具 LRM-15 发射器每轮齐射可发射 120 枚导弹，足以突破即便最强大的 AMS 防御。四挺机枪则负责近距离自卫，应对任何试图直接攻击该机甲的步兵或小队。 特性：扩展躯干旋转 投放费用倍率：1.22 手臂驱动器限制：左上臂、右上臂

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This modified Bane 1 is configured for one thing only: rattling a 'Mech's armor so hard that things start breaking on the inside. Quirk: Extended Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这台改装灾星1只为唯一一个目的而配置：把机甲的装甲震得内部零件都开始散架。 特性：扩展躯干旋转 投放费用倍率：1.18 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An unusual variant of the Bane acting as a close range missile boat rather the usual long range direct attack weapons. A total of twelve SRM-6 launchers can fire 72 SRM missiles in each volley, a formidable attack that is able to cripple all but the most heavily armored 'Mechs. Four Heavy Machine Guns acts as close range defense against any infantry or squads trying to engage the 'Mech directly. Quirk: Extended Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.22 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是 Bane 的一款不寻常变型，它不再充当常规的远程直射火力平台，而是担任近程导弹艇。十二具 SRM-6 发射器每轮齐射可发射 72 枚 SRM 导弹，这种可怕的攻击足以重创除装甲最厚重者之外的所有机甲。四挺重型机枪则提供近程防御，对付任何试图直接接战的步兵或小队。 特性：扩展躯干旋转 投放费用倍率：1.22 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A heavily re-designed and improved variant, the -1DM is based on an Endo Steel skeleton and powered by a 380 XL engine, but trades battlefield longevity for an expanded weapons loadout and a brand new Targeting Computer. The primary guns are a pair of ER PPC and a RAC-5. Finally, the -1DM carries an LRM-10 Long Range Missile rack supplied with a single ton of ammo. Protecting the 'Mech is a full sixteen and a half tons of standard armor, and sixteen Double Heat Sinks helps cool it all down. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.17 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: -1DM 是一款经过大幅重新设计并改进的变型，以内骨架为基础，搭载一台 380 XL 引擎，但以牺牲战场续航能力为代价，换来了扩充的武器配置和一台全新的瞄准计算机。主要火力为一对增程粒子炮和一门 RAC-5。最后，-1DM 还携带一具 LRM-10 远程导弹发射架，配一吨弹药。保护机甲的是整整十六吨半的标准装甲，而十六个双散热器则帮助它整体降温。 特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1.17 手臂驱动器限制：右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Exclusive to Noisiel and serving as one of the 'Queens' in the Noisiel Summer Games' famed 'BattleChess' matches, the low technology BNC-3EA trades the standard BNC-3E's PPC for a Large Laser, saving weight to add a single rear-facing Small Laser to each side torso and forward facing Medium Laser in the center torso. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: BNC-3EA为努瓦西尔所独有，是努瓦西尔夏季运动会著名“战棋”比赛中的“女王”之一。这款低技术机甲以一门大型激光取代标准BNC-3E的粒子炮，省下的重量用于在两侧躯干各加一门后向小型激光，并在中央躯干加装一门前向中型激光。 特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1.15

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A battlefield refit of the -3E, the -3ER replaces the PPC and head-mounted small laser with eight Medium Lasers mounted in the Right Torso. The 'Mech also carries a C3 slave computer and CASE for the AC/5 ammunition. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.17
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: -3ER 是 -3E 的战地改装型，它将粒子炮和头部安装的小型激光替换为八门安装在右躯干的中型激光。该机甲还携带一台 C3 从属计算机，并为 AC/5 弹药配备了 CASE。 特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1.17

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A customized BNC-3S geared toward close combat. The PPCs are removed in favor of a left arm Hatchet and a right arm Large Laser. Also, the SRM-6 is swapped for an LRM-10. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.17
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是面向近距离战斗定制的 BNC-3S。粒子炮被拆除，换成左臂的一把战斧和右臂的一门大型激光。此外，SRM-6 也被换成 LRM-10。 特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1.17
女妖 BNC-3S '赖内斯布拉特'

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A refit for the -3S, replacing two of the Medium Lasers with an Armored Cowl and C3 slave unit for better battlefield performance. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是-3S的改装，以装甲机罩和C3从机取代其中两门中型激光，以获得更好的战场表现。 特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1.15 手臂驱动器限制：左下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An attempted upgrade of the -3S that never was produced beyond a very low number initial run, making this variant quite rare to see. Amongst 'Mech collectors the -4S is almost seen as a white whale, many have attempted to acquire one from not-so-legal sources only to be disappointed to find it a false refit instead of an actual production unit. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.17
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: -3S 的一次升级尝试，除极少量初始批次外从未量产，因此这一变型相当罕见。在机甲收藏者眼中，-4S 几乎如同白鲸一般；许多人试图通过不太合法的渠道弄到一台，结果却失望地发现那不过是假的改装货，而非真正的量产机型。 特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1.17

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Based on a heavily modified -5S, this custom refit replaces the Lasers with an ER PPC and two medium Pulse Lasers, and the SRM-6 launcher with a Streak counterpart. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.17 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这套定制改装以经过大幅改造的 -5S 为基础，把激光换成了一门增程粒子炮和两门中型脉冲激光，并把 SRM-6 发射器换成了连发型号。 特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1.17 手臂驱动器限制：左臂下部

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A customized BNC-5S that sacrifices weaponry for mobility. An ER PPC and heat sink are removed to add four jump jets. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.19
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一台为追求机动性而牺牲武器的定制 BNC-5S。拆下一门 ER PPC 和一个散热器，换来四个跳跃推进器。 特性：战拳 投放费用倍率：1.19

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Banshee HK mounts two Hydraulic Fists and is outfitted with a selection of newly developed defensive technologies. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.19
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Banshee HK 搭载两个液压拳，并配备了一系列新研发的防御技术。 特性：战拳 投放费用倍率：1.19

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The unique “La Malinche” variant is a powerful war machine, and with the Aztec-inspired art of old Terra, she is both as beautiful, as she is deadly. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.19
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 独一无二的“La Malinche”变型是一台强大的战争机器；她饰有旧地球阿兹特克风格的艺术纹饰，既美丽动人，又致命无比。 特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1.19
机密 特质：战斗铁拳 投放费用倍率：1.11

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The -1T carries two ER Large Lasers that allow the Barghest to hit a target at up to five hundred and seventy meters. For medium to close range combat, the 'Mech carries a powerful LB-X Autocannon/20 that is capable of firing both standard ammunition and cluster rounds that act like 'Mech-sized shotgun shells. The 'Mech's simplicity is also a weakness, as the Barghest has only the two ER Large Lasers if the autocannon falls silent from a lack of ammunition or a jam. Quirk: Improved Cooling Jacket - Laser Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: -1T 搭载两门增程大型激光，使 Barghest 能够击中远达五百七十米外的目标。在中近距离作战中，该机甲配备一门威力强大的 LB-X 自动炮/20，既能发射标准弹药，也能发射霰弹弹，后者如同机甲大小的霰弹枪弹药。机甲设计的简洁同时也是弱点：一旦自动炮因弹药耗尽或卡壳而哑火，Barghest 就只剩下那两门增程大型激光了。 特性：改进散热套件 - 激光 投放费用倍率：1.1

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 2T removes the weapons of the 1T model and replaces them with a single ER PPC and an Ultra Autocannon/20. The ultra autocannon is capable of firing at twice the rate as a standard autocannon, giving the 2T an incredible amount of short range firepower. The Barghest has also gained an additional ton of armor protection, making the 'Mech even harder to take down on the battlefield. Quirk: Improved Cooling Jacket - Laser Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 2T拆掉1T型号的武器，换成一门增程粒子炮和一门超级自动炮/20。超级自动炮的射速可达标准自动炮的两倍，赋予2T惊人的近程火力。巴尔杰斯特还额外获得一吨装甲防护，使它在战场上更难被击倒。 特性：改进冷却套 - 激光 投放费用倍率：1.1

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The PFT variant of the Barghest utilizes the power of cheese. Quirk: Improved Cooling Jacket - Laser Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 犬妖的PFT变型动用了奶酪之力。 特性：改进冷却套件（激光） 投放费用倍率：1.06

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Battle Cobra makes use of Endo Steel and Ferro-Fibrous technologies, but uses a standard Fusion Engine for increased durability. The A variant excels at close range with a variety of smaller pulse lasers. It wields four Medium Pulse Lasers and six Small Pulse Lasers. This armament forces unarmored infantry to be especially wary. Quirk: Extended Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 战斗眼镜蛇利用内骨架与铁纤维技术，但采用标准聚变引擎以提高耐久性。A变型以多种较小的脉冲激光在近距表现出色，装备四门中型脉冲激光和六门小型脉冲激光。这套武器迫使无装甲步兵格外警惕。 特性：扩展躯干旋转 投放费用倍率：1.03 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Battle Cobra makes use of Endo Steel and Ferro-Fibrous technologies, but uses a standard Fusion Engine for increased durability. This B loadout is popular with the Clan Blood Spirit warriors who use a Battle Cobra. It mounts twin ER PPCs and Small Pulse Lasers. However, it lacks additional heat sinks to cope with the heat generated by the cannons. Quirk: Extended Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 战斗眼镜蛇利用内骨架与铁纤维技术，但采用标准聚变引擎以提高耐久性。这一B载荷在使用战斗眼镜蛇的血灵部族战士中颇受欢迎：它装双联增程粒子炮和几门小型脉冲激光，但缺少额外散热器来应对这些炮产生的热量。 特性：扩展躯干旋转 投放费用倍率：1.03 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Battle Cobra makes use of Endo Steel and Ferro-Fibrous technologies, but uses a standard Fusion Engine for increased durability. A mid-range Jump Jet equipped brawler, the F config mounts an Ultra AC/5 and single ton of reloads in its right arm supported by a trio of ER Medium Lasers in its left. Quirk: Extended Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 战眼镜蛇（Battle Cobra）采用了内骨架与铁纤维技术，但使用标准聚变引擎以提升耐用性。作为一台装备跳跃推进器的中距离近战机甲，F 配置在右臂装有一门超速 AC/5 及一吨备用弹药，并以左臂的三门增程中型激光提供支援。 特性：扩展躯干旋转 投放费用倍率：1.03 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Battle Cobra makes use of Endo Steel and Ferro-Fibrous technologies, but uses a standard Fusion Engine for increased durability. Instead of the pulse lasers common to the other variants, the H configuration mounts a pair each of ER Large Lasers and Heavy Medium Lasers. Four additional double heat sinks help to keep heat levels manageable. Quirk: Extended Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Battle Cobra 采用了内骨架与铁纤维技术，但使用标准聚变引擎以提升耐用性。H 配置没有采用其他变型常见的脉冲激光，而是各装一对大型增程激光和重型中型激光。四具额外的双散热器有助于将热量控制在可管理的范围内。 特性：扩展躯干旋转 投放费用倍率：1.03 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Battle Cobra makes use of Endo Steel and Ferro-Fibrous technologies, but uses a standard Fusion Engine for increased durability. The primary configuration uses a pair of Large Pulse Lasers and Small Pulse Lasers. With these, it is capable of highly accurate fire that is effective against armored and unarmored targets alike. Quirk: Extended Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 战斗眼镜蛇利用内骨架与铁纤维技术，但采用标准聚变引擎以提高耐久性。主配置使用一对大型脉冲激光和几门小型脉冲激光，凭借这些能实现高精度射击，对装甲与非装甲目标同样有效。 特性：扩展躯干旋转 投放费用倍率：1.03 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The first native Battlemech to be built by the FedSuns, the 70 ton Battleaxe debuted in 2459. Based off of the technology used in the Mackie, the Battleaxe would be constantly updated with new technology, before being retired after the Reunification War when newer designs such as the Hammerhands and Warhammer entered service. The Battleaxe BKX-1X is the original prototype model. Built around a 255-rated Fusion Core, the BKX-1X is armed with a pair of Large Lasers and a pair of LRM-5’s. An SRM-6 and a pair of Machine Guns give the Mech some close range firepower. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.88 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Battleaxe 是联邦太阳国建造的第一款本土战斗机甲，70 吨的它于 2459 年首次亮相。它以 Mackie 所用的技术为基础，此后不断以新技术进行更新，直到统一战争结束后，Hammerhands 和 Warhammer 等更新的设计服役，它才退出现役。Battleaxe BKX-1X 是最初的原型型号，以 255 级聚变核心为核心，装备两门大型激光和两具 LRM-5。一具 SRM-6 和两挺机枪为机甲提供了一定的近距离火力。 特性：稳定 投放费用倍率：0.88 手臂驱动器限制：左臂下部、右臂下部

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Classified Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 机密 特性：稳定 投放费用倍率：1.06 手臂驱动器限制：左臂下部、右臂下部

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This command version of the BattleMaster mounts a Command Console and is equipped with 20 Heat Sinks. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.13
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这款 BattleMaster 的指挥型安装了指挥控制台，并配备 20 个散热器。 特性：指挥机甲 投放费用倍率：1.13

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A Starleague Royals version of the BLR-1C, exchanging the Command Console for a Dual Cockpit, removing the Machine Guns in favor of an Anti-Missile System and upgrading the PPC to an Extended Range version. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.17
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: BLR-1C 的星际联盟皇家版本，把指挥控制台换成双人座舱，以反导弹系统取代机枪，并将粒子炮升级为增程型号。 特性：指挥机甲 投放费用倍率：1.17

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Produced by the Federated Suns during the Star League era, this variant drops the machine guns and ammunition while all the forward firing medium lasers are replaced by Medium Pulse Lasers. Sixteen double heat sinks keep the 'Mech cool. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该变型由联邦太阳国在星际联盟时代生产，它拆除了机枪与弹药，所有前射的中型激光则替换为中型脉冲激光。十六具双散热器为机甲保持低温。 特性：指挥机甲 投放费用倍率：1.15

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This Star League era variant removes two of the forward-facing medium lasers, both machine guns, the SRM launcher and their ammunition. In place of the SRM launcher are three Streak SRM-2 launchers with a single ton of ammunition with an extra PPC mounted in the left arm. Sixteen double heat sinks keep the 'Mech cool, and the 'Mech's armor is upgraded to Ferro-Fibrous armor. An extra half ton of armor is also installed. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.17
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这款星际联盟时代的变型拆除了两门朝前的中型激光、两挺机枪、SRM 发射器及其弹药。取而代之的是三部连发 SRM-2 发射器（配一吨弹药），并在左臂加装了一门额外的粒子炮。十六个双散热器为机甲提供冷却，其装甲也升级为铁纤维装甲，此外还额外安装了半吨装甲。 特性：指挥机甲 投放费用倍率：1.17

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This Star League era variant removes two of the forward medium lasers, both machine guns, the SRM launcher and their ammunition. In place of the SRM launcher are three Streak SRM-2 launchers with a single ton of ammunition with an extra PPC mounted in the left arm. Sixteen double heat sinks keep the 'Mech cool, and the 'Mech's armor is upgraded to ferro-fibrous armor. An extra half ton of armor is also installed. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.17
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这一星际联盟时代的变型拆除了两门前射中型激光、两挺机枪、SRM 发射器及其弹药。取而代之的是三组连发 SRM-2 发射器与一吨弹药，并在左臂加装一门粒子炮。十六具双散热器为机甲保持低温，同时机甲装甲升级为铁纤维装甲，还额外加装了半吨装甲。 特性：指挥机甲 投放费用倍率：1.17
战斗大师 BLR-1GHE '地狱投手'

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The BLR-1GR is an attempt to restore old disused or damage BattleMaster chassis using surplus parts. Mainly found in the less controlled parts of the Periphery, the variant does pack an unexpected amount of weapons and even a C3 slave unit. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: BLR-1GR是试图用剩余零件修复废旧或受损BattleMaster底盘的尝试。该变型主要见于外围地区管控较弱的区域，却搭载了出人意料的武器数量，甚至还有一台C3从属单元。 特性：指挥机甲 投放费用倍率：1.15

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Originating as the heavily customized and personal 'Mech of General Gregor Tucker, the 1GT become a rare but favoured favourite of the Free Rasalhague Republic's elite MechWarriors. The weapons layout has been reworked almost from scratch, moving the medium Lasers to the arms and two PPC in the side torsos. A single SRM-4 launcher in the center torso can provide some unexpected close range damage. The 'Mech further utilizes both Ferro-Fibrous armor and an XL Engine, allowing increased armor and a total of 18 double heat sinks. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 1GT最初是格雷戈尔·塔克将军重度定制化的私人机甲，后来成为自由拉沙尔哈格共和国精英机甲战士中稀有却受青睐的宠儿。武器布局几乎从头重做：中型激光移到手臂，两侧躯干装两门粒子炮；中央躯干一具单独的SRM-4发射器可提供出人意料的近程伤害。该机甲还同时采用铁纤维装甲与一台XL引擎，得以增加装甲并带总共18个双散热器。 特性：指挥机甲 投放费用倍率：1.15

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The BLR-1HD is named after First Prince Hanse Davion, and created as a thank you for funding the successful development project of the Medium Pulse Lasers. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: BLR-1HD以第一王子汉斯·戴维恩命名，是作为对其资助中型脉冲激光研发项目成功的致谢而打造。 特性：指挥机甲 投放费用倍率：1.15

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A heavily upgraded version of the BLR-1G, using a downgraded engine size to allow the addition of both Jump Jets and an extra PPC. The variant is even able to increase the armor to a total of 16.5 tons, the chassis practical limit. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.13
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是 BLR-1G 的大幅升级版本，通过缩小引擎尺寸，为同时加装跳跃推进器和一门额外的粒子炮创造了条件。该变型甚至能将装甲总量提升至 16.5 吨，达到底盘的实际上限。 特性：指挥机甲 投放费用倍率：1.13

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A Mercenary conversion of the BattleMaster, using mostly Clan grade equipment. The weapons loadout consists of six ER Medium Lasers, one ER PPC and one Streak SRM-6 launcher. A C3 Slave provides increased combat capabilities. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.19
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是雇佣兵对战法师的改装，大多使用部族级装备。武器包括六门增程中型激光、一门增程粒子炮和一具连发SRM-6发射器。一台C3从机提升了作战能力。 特性：指挥机甲 投放费用倍率：1.19

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This melee-focused BattleMaster mounts arm-mounted large laser in place of the PPC, adding a small laser beside the classic twin medium lasers in each side torso along with a left shoulder–mounted SRM-4, the saved weight allowing it to carry an assault claymore in its left hand. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.13
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这款偏重近战的战法师以一门臂载大型激光取代粒子炮，并在每侧躯干经典的双联中型激光旁各加一门小型激光，左肩另装一具SRM-4；省下的重量让它左手能握一把突击克莱莫大剑。 特性：指挥机甲 投放费用倍率：1.13

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This version of the BattleMaster comes with Angel ECM and a Bloodhound Active Probe. A single machine gun is located in each arm, with an additional large laser mounted in the right arm, the right torso contains the electronic warfare equipment along with two medium lasers, and two medium lasers along with a SRM-4 sit in the left torso. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这一版战斗大师装备天使电子对抗套件与血犬主动探测器。每只手臂各装有一挺机枪，右臂另有一具大型激光；右躯干容纳电子战设备与两具中型激光；左躯干则有两具中型激光和一具SRM-4。 特性：指挥机甲 投放费用倍率：1.15

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A Prototype that was modified For Hanse Davions personal use. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.17
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一台为汉斯·戴维昂个人使用而改装的原型机。 特性：指挥机甲 投放费用倍率：1.17

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Dating back from 2925, this designated command vehicle sported a Command Console and a Beagle Active Probe wired into the targeting system. Instead of the machine guns it carries an anti-missile system installed in the left arm; the rearward firing lasers are retained. Like with the BLR-1C, House Kurita received at least one BLR-2C from ComStar in full working condition and used it to good effect in the War of 3039. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这种被指定为指挥车辆的型号可追溯至 2925 年，配有指挥控制台以及一台接入瞄准系统的比格犬主动探测器。它以安装在左臂的反导弹系统取代了机枪，向后射击的激光则予以保留。与 BLR-1C 一样，栗田家族（House Kurita）从通讯之星手中至少获得了一台处于完全可用状态的 BLR-2C，并在 3039 年战争中取得了良好战果。 特性：指挥机甲 投放费用倍率：1.15

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An variant of the BLR-2C used by the SLDF Royal Divisions. The design replaces the Command Console with the smaller Dual Cockpit, using the saved weight to add two Small Lasers and extra external armoring. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.17
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是SLDF皇家师使用的BLR-2C变型。它把指挥控制台换成更小的双人座舱，并用省下的重量加装两门小型激光和额外外部装甲。 特性：指挥机甲 投放费用倍率：1.17

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A command version of the Battle Master, mounting a Dual Cockpit allowing the battlefield Commander to focus on commanding. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 战斗大师的指挥型号，装有双人驾驶舱，让战场指挥官能够专注于指挥。 特性：指挥机甲 投放费用倍率：1.15

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Used by Colonel Wayne Rogers of Waco Rangers during the Coventry campaign, this BattleMaster drops five heat sinks, the single machine gun, and the SRM-6 of a BLR-3M and replaces them with seven Streak SRM-2 launchers. The loss of some armor is compensated for by using ferro-fibrous armor instead. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.17
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在考文垂战役期间由韦科游骑兵的韦恩·罗杰斯上校使用，这台战斗大师拆除了五台散热器、那挺机枪以及BLR-3M的SRM-6，并换装七具连发SRM-2发射器。装甲上的一些损失则通过改用铁纤维装甲得到补偿。 特性：指挥机甲 投放费用倍率：1.17

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The BattleMaster 3NC (C) is a strange clan rebuild of the chassis. Although the design lowers the chassis tonnage to only 75 ton, using all Clan technology weapons allows the 'Mech to mount an impressive all energy loadout. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: BattleMaster 3NC (C) 是对该底盘一次奇特的部族重建。尽管设计将底盘吨位降至仅75吨，但采用全部族科技武器后，这台机甲得以搭载令人印象深刻的纯能量武装。 特性：指挥机甲 投放费用倍率：1.15

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Another upgrade of the BattleMaster using lost technology from the Star League, the 3S was introduced in 3050 by Red Devil Industries for the Federated Commonwealth. Still using standard heat sinks it actually removes a half-ton of armor along with the PPC and one of the machine guns, although it still retains the SRM-6. These changes along with the inclusion of an 340 XL engine make room for a LRM-20 launcher as its primary weapon backed up by six Medium Pulse Lasers for fighting close in, with two of the lasers being rear facing. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 3S是战斗大师借助星际联盟失落科技进行的又一次升级，由红魔工业于3050年为联邦共和国推出。它仍使用标准散热器，实际上还拆掉了半吨装甲、粒子炮与一挺机枪，但仍保留SRM-6。这些改动，再加上一具340 XL引擎，为作为主武器的LRM-20发射器腾出了空间，另有六门中型脉冲激光用于近距离作战，其中两门朝后。 特性：指挥机甲 投放费用倍率：1.15

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The -3W is a full Clan conversion of the Battlemaster that sometimes can be spotted on the battlefield for Clan forces close the Inner Sphere. Mounting an impressive combined loadout of two ER PPC, a Large Pulse Laser, four Medium Pulse Lasers and three ER Medium Lasers - all of the Clan variety - means it can deliver a lot of damage if not dealt with, but it does suffer from heat management limiting factors like many other Clan designs. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.19
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: -3W是Battlemaster的完全部族化改造型，偶尔会出现在内层星域附近部族部队的战场上。它拥有令人瞩目的组合武器配置——两门增程粒子炮、一门大型脉冲激光、四门中型脉冲激光和三门增程中型激光，全部为部族型号——若放任不管，它就能造成巨大伤害，但与许多部族设计一样，它也受制于散热管理的瓶颈。 特性：指挥机甲 投放费用倍率：1.19

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 5R is a modernization of the more classic BattleMasters. Besides the LB 10-X autocannon mounted in the right arm as the main weapon, the variant replaces all of the Medium Lasers with Pulse variants and the PPC with an ER Large Laser. Four jump jets makes the -5M one of the few models that can jump. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 5R是对较经典战法师的现代化改造。除右臂安装的LB 10-X自动炮作为主武器外，该变型把所有中型激光换成脉冲版本，并把粒子炮换成增程大型激光。四具跳跃推进器使-5M成为少数能跳跃的型号之一。 特性：指挥机甲 投放费用倍率：1.15

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: No real information exists on who created the design of this variant and why the unusual name. One theory is that it's a dig at the Clans use of IIC variants, attempting to one-up them. The 'Mech itself caries a combination of Pulse Lasers and ER PPC, combined with a single SRM-6 launcher with an attached Artemis IV Fire Control System. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 关于这一变型由谁设计、为何取了这样一个古怪的名字，并没有确切的资料。一种说法是，这是对部族滥用IIC变型的做法进行讥讽，试图压他们一头。这台机甲本身结合了脉冲激光与增程粒子炮，并配有一具附带阿尔忒弥斯IV火控系统的SRM-6发射器。 特性：指挥机甲 投放费用倍率：1.15

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: By replacing the BattleMaster's 350 fusion engine with a 255 engine, the BLR-TD is slightly slower but allow for 14 more tons of weapons. A second PPC was added as well as the additional heat sink kits to fire it. To compensate for the slower speed, Jump Jets where placed in the Legs and Center Torso. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.13
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: BLR-TD 将 BattleMaster 的 350 聚变引擎换成 255 引擎，速度因此略有下降，却腾出了额外 14 吨用于武器。它加装了一门粒子炮，以及为发射它所需的额外散热套件。为弥补速度的降低，腿部与中央躯干内装设了跳跃推进器。 特性：指挥机甲 投放费用倍率：1.13
机密 特质：指挥机甲 投放费用倍率：1.09

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A Clan IIC variant, created from the Battlemasters the SLDF took with them during the exodus from the Inner Sphere - but upsized to 90 ton. To fit the two ER PPC, six ER Medium Lasers and two Streak SRM-6 launchers the variant uses an Endo Steel chassis and an XL engine. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.2
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是一款部族IIC变型，由星际联盟防卫军在大逃亡期间带离内层星域的战斗大师改造而来，但体型放大到了90吨。为容纳两门增程粒子炮、六具增程中型激光和两具连发SRM-6发射器，该变型采用内骨架底盘和XL引擎。 特性：指挥机甲 投放费用倍率：1.2

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Unique among Wolfs Dragoon's, this is apparently a downgraded Stone Rhino equipped with locally made Inner Sphere technology. The sole known example was lost at the battle of Misery and the Dragoon's have been unusually reticent about the mech or it's origins, refusing to confirm where the mech came from or whether they posses anymore. Quirk: Distracting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这台机甲在狼之龙骑兵中独一无二，显然是一台降级版石犀牛，换装了本地制造的内层星域技术。唯一已知的样机在苦难星之战中损失，而龙骑兵对这台机甲及其来历异常默口，既不愿确认它的出处，也不肯透露是否还拥有更多。 <特性：扰敌 <投放费用倍率：1.18 <手臂驱动器限制：左臂下段，右臂下段

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Debuting soon after the Mackie, the Bellerophon was Defiance Industries attempt at creating their own Battlemech. Basing the prototype on an earlier generation Mackie prototype, the project would prove to be fundamentally flawed. While 20% faster than the Mackie, the Bellerophon BEL-1X only mounted 60% of the armor carried by the Mackie. Even worse, the Mech suffered from balance issues stemming from the early generation gyroscope and the concentration of firepower on the right of the Mech. Despite an attempt to market the Mech to the Terran Hegemony, the project was eventually abandoned and the fate of the original prototypes is unknown. Quirk: Cowl Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.86 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Bellerophon 在 Mackie 问世后不久便首次登场，是 Defiance Industries 打造自家战斗机甲的尝试。该项目以前一代 Mackie 原型机为基础，最终被证明存在根本性缺陷。虽然 Bellerophon BEL-1X 比 Mackie 快 20%，但其装甲量仅为 Mackie 的 60%。更糟的是，由于采用早期型号的陀螺仪，且火力集中在机甲右侧，这款机甲存在平衡性问题。尽管曾试图向地球霸权推销，该项目最终还是被放弃，原型机的下落至今不明。 特性：座舱护罩 投放费用倍率：0.86 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右上

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The primary weapon on the Beowulf is a highly accurate large pulse laser, supported by two ER medium lasers. To make it easier for the 'Mech to hunt down its targets, the Beowulf also mounts a Beagle active probe, and a TAG target designator allows the 'Mech to designate targets for artillery attacks. To save weight on the 'Mech and still allow for high speeds, the Beowulf is powered by a 270 XL engine that weighs half as much as a standard fusion engine. It also mounts MASC, enhancing its top speed of 129.6 km/h to allow it to keep up with most light 'Mechs. To traverse rough terrain, the Beowulf has six jump jets that allow it to jump up to 180 meters. For protection from enemy fire, the Beowulf carries eight and a half tons of ferro-fibrous armor. Quirk: Extended Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Beowulf 的主武器是一门精度极高的大型脉冲激光，辅以两门中型增程激光。为便于机甲追猎目标，Beowulf 还安装了 Beagle 主动探测器，而 TAG 目标指示器则让机甲能够为炮击指定目标。为了在减轻重量的同时仍保持高速度，Beowulf 由 270 XL 引擎驱动，其重量仅为标准聚变引擎的一半。它还装有 MASC，使其 129.6 km/h 的最高时速进一步提升，从而能跟上大多数轻型机甲。为穿越崎岖地形，Beowulf 配备六具跳跃推进器，最远可跳跃 180 米。为抵御敌方火力，Beowulf 携带八吨半铁纤维装甲。 特性：扩展躯干旋转 投放费用倍率：1.03

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Designed to engage in close range brawls, the 100 ton Berserker debuted in 3056. A 400-rated XL Engine paired with MASC allows the BRZ-A3 to outrun almost any other heavy or assault grade Mech. An ER PPC and a pair of Large Pulse Lasers make up the Mech’s ranged armament while a colossal 10 ton Hatchet is lethal at close range. AMS and Guardian ECM keep the Mech safe as it closes in, while a head mounted Flamer adds to the Mechs intimidation factor. Quirk: Melee Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 100 吨的 Berserker 专为近距离搏斗而生，于 3056 年首次登场。400 额定的 XL引擎搭配 MASC，使 BRZ-A3 几乎能跑赢任何其他重型或突击级机甲。机甲的中远距离武装由一门增程粒子炮与两门大型脉冲激光组成，而一把重达 10 吨的巨型战斧在近距离足以致命。机体逼近时，AMS 与 Guardian 电子对抗套件为其提供保护，头部安装的火焰喷射器则进一步增添了威慑力。 特性：近战驱动器 投放费用倍率：1.18

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Designed to engage in close range brawls, the 100 ton Berserker debuted in 3056. A 400-rated XL Engine paired with MASC allows the BRZ-B3 to outrun almost any other heavy or assault grade Mech. An ER PPC and a pair of LRM-10’s make up the Mech’s ranged armament while a colossal 10 ton Hatchet is lethal at close range. AMS and Guardian ECM keep the Mech safe as it closes in, while a head mounted Flamer adds to the Mechs intimidation factor. Quirk: Melee Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为一款为近身近战而设计的机甲，100吨的狂战士于3056年首次亮相。一台400额定XL引擎配MASC，使BRZ-B3能跑赢几乎任何其他重型或突击级机甲。一门增程粒子炮和两具LRM-10构成机甲的远程武装，而一把十吨重的巨型战斧在近距致命无比。反导弹系统与守护者电子对抗套件在它逼近时提供保护，头部一具火焰喷射器更增添了它的威慑力。 特性：近战驱动器 投放费用倍率：1.18

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Engineers had clearly intended for the BSN-3K to engage its enemies at short to medium ranges. The primary weapon on the 'Mech is a MRM-20 launcher, backed up by a pair of ER Medium Lasers and two highly accurate Medium Pulse Lasers. While the 'Mech is vulnerable to long-range attacks, when engaged in close quarters the Bishamon is an extremely dangerous 'Mech to face. Quirk: Advanced Optics Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 工程师们显然打算让BSN-3K在短到中距离上与敌人交战。该机甲的主武器是一具MRM-20发射器，辅以两门增程中型激光和两门高精度中型脉冲激光。虽然该机甲易受远程攻击压制，但在近距离交战中，毗沙门天是极为危险的对手。 特性：先进光学 投放费用倍率：1.03

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 4K variant of the Bishamon is intended to command a C3 lance. In order to accomplish this, the 'Mech has had the MRM-20 launcher downgraded to an MRM-10 launcher, and replaces its two ER medium lasers with two ER small lasers. Quirk: Advanced Optics Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 毗沙门的 4K 变型旨在指挥一个 C3 小队。为此，这台机甲的 MRM-20 发射器被降级为 MRM-10 发射器，两门增程中型激光也换成了两门增程小型激光。 特性：先进光学系统 投放费用倍率：1.03

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Formerly known as the Bulldog variant, this configuration is a field upgrade developed in the midst of Operation Bulldog. It utilized captured Clan Smoke Jaguar weapons to help bolster the SLDF forces in later waves. A mix of arm-mounted short and long range weapons, this configuration mounts two Clan-tech ER Large Lasers mounted in the right, with two Clan Streak SRM-6 launchers in the left. Carrying a ton of reloads of each Streak Missile Launcher, a C3 Slave unit allows further enhances its abilities. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这一构型原称斗牛犬改型，是在斗牛犬行动期间开发的战场升级方案。它利用缴获的Smoke Jaguar部族武器，帮助增强后续几波攻势中的SLDF部队。这一构型混合了臂挂式近程与远程武器，右侧装有两门部族科技增程大型激光，左侧则装有两具部族连发SRM-6发射器。每具连发导弹发射器都携带一吨再装填弹药，而一个C3从属单元则进一步增强了它的能力。 特性：易于维护 投放费用倍率：1.03 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This variant carries seven medium lasers in each arm and a C3 Slave next to the cockpit. To keep the BHKU-OX cool, it carries an experimental Coolant Pod in the left and right torsos. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该变型在每条手臂各携带七门中型激光，驾驶舱旁装有一台 C3 从属计算机。为给 BHKU-OX 降温，它还在左右躯干各携带一个实验性冷却剂罐。 特性：易于维护 投放费用倍率：1.03 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This dedicated fire-support model uses a pair of LRM-20s, though they can only call upon three tons of ammunition. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这款专职火力支援型号使用一对LRM-20，但只能依靠三吨弹药。 特性：稳定 投放费用倍率：1.04 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Black Lanner 'Bellonarius' is a custom designed 'Mech, carrying a Streak SRM-4 in each side torso, supported by three machine guns in each arm, a heavy medium laser in the left torso, and a heavy small laser in the head. Two tons of Streak ammunition and four tons of machine gun reloads give the Bellonarius reasonable field endurance. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 黑隼"贝罗纳里乌斯"是一台定制设计的机甲，两侧躯干各装有一具连发SRM-4，每只手臂另有三挺机枪，左躯干装有一具重型中型激光，头部则装有一具重型小型激光。两吨连发导弹弹药与四吨机枪备弹让"贝罗纳里乌斯"拥有相当不错的战场续航能力。 特性：稳定 投放费用倍率：1.06 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Black Lanner's F2 loadout is currently only used with the Jade Falcon Clan. It is a general-purpose design, intended to take on recon patrols and disrupt supply lines on an intermittent basis. The choice of weapons suggests a need to minimize the burden on the Jade Falcon support and technical training pipelines. Unfortunately, while it is capable of many routine assignments, the F2 will do none of them well. It is presumed the Jade Falcons will exercise caution, fielding this configuration only when they are sure there are no massed formations of Battlemechs in the target area. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 黑兰纳的F2配置目前仅供翡翠猎鹰部族使用。这是一种通用设计，用于执行侦察巡逻，并间歇性地破坏补给线。其武器选择表明，该设计有意将对翡翠猎鹰后勤与技术人员培养体系的负担降到最低。遗憾的是，尽管F2能胜任许多常规任务，却没有一项能做得很好。可以推测，翡翠猎鹰使用时也会相当谨慎，只有在确信目标区域内没有大规模战斗机甲编队时，才会投入这一配置。 特性：稳定 投放费用倍率：1.04 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The ability to close quickly on large, slow-moving Assault 'Mechs, combined with the potential to kill such foes with a single headshot, makes it abundantly clear the Black Lanner G2 configuration is intended for brutal sledgehammer operations. Deployed in pure Stars, the G2 can quickly gain the upper hand and go on to dominate the battlefield, moving about at will. Jade Falcon Commanders who make proper use of this threat can force an opponent into defensive strategies which will ultimately lead to defeat. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 能迅速逼近庞大而行动迟缓的突击机甲，再加上一记爆头即可击杀这类敌人的潜力，充分说明黑鹞G2配置是为残酷的“大锤”作战而设。以纯星队部署时，G2能迅速占据上风并进而主宰战场，随心所欲地机动。善用这一威胁的玉猫指挥官可以迫使对手转入防御策略，最终走向失败。 特性：稳定 投放费用倍率：1.04 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The H configuration mounts four additional double heat sinks to combat the heat that the heavy large laser and pair of medium pulse lasers build; it also has an ECM suite. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: H构型额外加装了四具双散热器，以应对重型大型激光与两门中型脉冲激光产生的热量；它还配备了一套电子对抗套件。 特性：稳定 投放费用倍率：1.04 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The S loadout is a hunter-killer designed primarily to take out enemy support 'Mechs. It can easily deal with enemy recon patrols, rapidly bypass front lines and bring the fight to softer targets in the rear or close in quickly on large, slow-moving ‘missile boats’ and artillery support vehicles - all depending on the current needs. Seventy-two percent of the weapons systems are energy-based, giving the Lanner S respectable battlefield endurance. This, combined with its impressive mobility, translates to chaos and carnage when it reaches the back field Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: S配置是一种猎杀者构型，主要用于清除敌方的支援机甲。它能轻松应对敌方侦察巡逻队，迅速绕过前线，把战斗带到后方更脆弱的目标身上，或快速逼近庞大迟缓的“导弹艇”与炮击支援车辆——一切视当下需要而定。其武器系统有百分之七十二为能量武器，让Lanner S拥有相当不错的战场续航力。再加上其出色的机动性，这意味着当它突入后方时，带来的便是混乱与屠杀。 特性：稳定 投放费用倍率：1.04 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This variant was introduced by Clan Steel Viper. It replaces the traditional weaponry with a pair of ER PPCs, a Gauss rifle, and two Machine Guns. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Short Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.17
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该变型由钢蝰蛇部族推出，它以2门增程粒子炮、1门高斯步枪和2挺机枪取代了传统武器。 <特性：改进瞄准（近程） <投放费用倍率：1.17

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 7R carries a Light Gauss Rifle as its primary weapon, allowing the 'mech to engage an enemy at up to seven hundred and fifty meters. This is backed up by an Ultra Autocannon/10 that can fire at twice the rate of a standard autocannon. For medium to short ranges, the Black Watch has a MRM-40 launcher. The Black Watch has received some criticism due to its heavy reliance on ammunition based weapons. To make the most of them, the Black Watch carries a C3 slave unit to allow it to share targeting data with friendly units through a C3 network. Quirk: Easy to Pilot Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 7R的主武器是一门轻型高斯步枪，使机甲能够在最远七百五十米的距离上交战。它的补充火力是一门超级自动炮/10，射速可达标准自动炮的两倍。在中近距离上，Black Watch配备一具MRM-40发射器。由于过度依赖弹药类武器，Black Watch也招致了一些批评。为充分发挥这些武器的效能，Black Watch搭载了C3从属单元，可通过C3网络与友军单位共享瞄准数据。 特性：易于驾驶 投放费用倍率：1.15 手臂驱动器限制：右上

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Blackjack 1s are solid, well-rounded 'Mechs for their tonnage. The 1B is a typical example of a battlefield refit, swapping the autocannons and arm-mounted medium lasers for two LRM-15 launchers and three tons of reloads between them. In addition, two jumpjets and one ton of armor were removed. Quirk: Extended Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.01 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 就吨位而言，二十一点（Blackjack）1 系列都是扎实而全面的机甲。1B 型是战场改装的典型例子：它把自动炮和臂装中型激光换成两具 LRM-15 发射器，并为其配备三吨备用弹药。此外，还拆除了两具跳跃推进器和一吨装甲。 特性：扩展躯干旋转 投放费用倍率：1.01 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A common refit of the standard BJ-2, the BJ-2t replaces the streak launchers with standard SRM-2 launchers. This frees up the space for another ton of ammunition, as well allows the addition of C.A.S.E. protection in both side torsos to lower the impact of internal ammo explosions. Quirk: Extended Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: BJ-2t 是标准 BJ-2 的常见改装，它用标准 SRM-2 发射器取代连发发射器。这腾出了空间以增加一吨弹药，同时还得以在两侧躯干加装 C.A.S.E. 防护，以减轻内部弹药爆炸造成的冲击。 特性：扩展躯干旋转 投放费用倍率：1.03 手臂驱动器限制：左臂上部、右臂上部

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Michael Ubodo's Arrow is armed with a trio of Machine Guns in each arm supplied with two tons of ammo, supported by a Medium Laser in side torso and a Large Pulse Laser mounted in the center torso. Mounting a 235 standard engine, its varation of the Arrow is clad in Ferro-Fibrous armor on an Endo Steel frame, carrying eleven Double Heat Sinks and just two Jump Jets. Quirk: Extended Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 迈克尔·乌博多的箭在每只手臂上装三挺机枪（配两吨弹药），侧躯干一门中型激光、中央躯干一门大型脉冲激光辅助。它采用235标准引擎，该变型的箭披挂铁纤维装甲、建在内骨架框架上，带十一个双散热器和仅两具跳跃推进器。 特性：扩展躯干旋转 投放费用倍率：1.05 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Given to Ross McKinnon upon his father's retirement in 3051, the family 'Mech continued to be upgraded with the latest technology. By the FedCom Civil War the right arm and torso weaponry of Ross's 'Mech was upgraded to extended range models, with the triple strength myomers and hatchet retained. The use of production grade ferro-fibrous and double heat sinks, along with downgrading the large lasers to medium pulse lasers and the left arm medium for an ER Small Laser, freed up enough weight for a Targeting Computer to be added. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.13
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这台家族机甲在 3051 年其父退役时传给了罗斯·麦金农，此后不断以最新科技进行升级。到联邦共和国内战时期，罗斯机甲的右臂和躯干武器已升级为增程型号，三倍强度肌纤维和战斧则予以保留。量产级铁纤维和双散热器的使用，加上将大型激光降级为中型脉冲激光、把左臂中型激光换成增程小型激光，腾出了足够的重量来加装一台瞄准计算机。 特性：指挥机甲 投放费用倍率：1.13

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Downgraded during the technological decline of the Succession Wars era, the personal 'Mech of the McKinnon family was selected to receive among the first experimental weapons developed from the Helm Memory Core by the New Avalon Institute of Science, thanks to the exploits of Fox's Teeth commander Ian McKinnon. When piloted by Ian during the War of 3039, the 'Mech was clad in prototype ferro-fibrous armor and the standard heat sinks outside the engine were replaced with corrosive 3039-era double heat sinks. These weight savings, along with the removal of the head-mounted small laser, allowed the 'Mech to carry a Hatchet whose damage was boosted by the addition of Triple Strength Myomer. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.13
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 麦金农（McKinnon）家族的座机在继承战争时期的技术衰退中遭到降级，但凭借“狐牙”（Fox's Teeth）指挥官伊恩·麦金农的战绩，它被选中，成为新阿瓦隆科学研究所依据地狱核心（Helm Memory Core）研发的首批实验性武器之一的搭载平台。3039 年战争期间由伊恩驾驶时，这台机甲披挂原型铁纤维装甲，引擎之外的标准散热器则被替换为 3039 年代那批具有腐蚀性的双散热器。这些减重措施，再加上拆除头部安装的小型激光，使该机甲得以携带一把战斧，其伤害因加装三重强度人造肌而进一步提升。 特性：指挥机甲 投放费用倍率：1.13

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Black Knight BL-6-KNT-K is a full conversion of the classic Black Knight to use Clan technology. Originally designed and ordered by Kell's Hounds, it can lately also sometimes be seen with other mercenary forces. The full energy weapons loadout combines an ER PPC with a Large Pulse Laser and an ER Large Laser as the main damage dealers, four ER Medium Lasers are available as secondary firepower. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.17
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 黑骑士BL-6-KNT-K是把经典黑骑士全面改装为部族技术的版本。它最初由凯尔猎犬设计并订购，近来有时也能在其他雇佣兵部队中见到。这套全能量武器载荷以一门增程粒子炮、一门大型脉冲激光和一门增程大型激光为主要伤害来源，四门增程中型激光则作为次要火力。 特性：指挥机甲 投放费用倍率：1.17

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A mysterious variant sighted in 3057 on an uninhabited world in the Spinward Periphery near Antallos, the so-called BL-6-RR swaps out the standard medium lasers and PPC of the BL-6-KNT for more deadly Clan ER medium lasers and an ER PPC. The lighter particle cannon allows an additional single heat sink to be added. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.13
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这台被称为 BL-6-RR 的神秘变型于 3057 年在安塔洛斯（Antallos）附近的顺旋臂外围地区一颗无人星球上现身。它把 BL-6-KNT 的标准中型激光和粒子炮换成了更致命的部族增程中型激光与增程粒子炮。更轻的粒子炮还让它可以额外加装一台单散热器。 特性：指挥机甲 投放费用倍率：1.13

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Introduced in 3040, this variant retains the side torso–mounted large lasers and right arm medium laser, replacing the PPC with another large laser and upgrading the head-mounted small laser to another medium. The weight saved allows the BL-7-KNT-P to carry a heavy longsword in its left arm. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是3040年推出的变型，保留侧躯干大型激光和右臂中型激光，以另一门大型激光取代粒子炮，并把头部小型激光升级为另一门中型激光。省下的重量让BL-7-KNT-P左手能握一把重型长剑。 特性：指挥机甲 投放费用倍率：1.09

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An updated version of the classic BL-7-KNT using modern Ferro-Fibrous armor and double heat sinks. The saved weight allows the 'Mech to mount an Beagle Active Probe and considerably more armor. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是对经典BL-7-KNT的更新版本，采用现代铁纤维装甲与双散热器。省下的重量让机甲得以装设一台比格犬主动探测器和多得多的装甲。 特性：指挥机甲 投放费用倍率：1.09

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The BL-8W-KNT is a further enhancement of the 7W, replacing its active probe with two more double heat sinks to address the subpar cooling. The design is otherwise the same. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: BL-8W-KNT是7W的进一步强化型，它用两台额外的双散热器取代了主动探测器，以解决散热不佳的问题。除此之外设计保持不变。 特性：指挥机甲 投放费用倍率：1.09

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This variant is based on Ian McKinnon's Black Knight. The only difference is the Hatchet being replaced by an Autocannon/5 and SRM-2. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.13 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该变型以伊恩·麦金农的黑骑士为基础，唯一的区别是战斧被替换为一门 AC/5 自动炮和一具 SRM-2。 特性：指挥机甲 投放费用倍率：1.13 手臂驱动器限制：左上

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Bloedhond BLH-6D carries several lasers, utilizing its high speed and small size to repeatedly flank and hit an enemy in less protected locations. Quirk: Easy to Pilot Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.97
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 血犬BLH-6D装有多门激光，凭借其高速度与小体型反复包抄并打击敌人防护较弱的部位。 特性：易于驾驶 投放费用倍率：0.97

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Bloedhond BLH-7D replaces the medium pulse laser of the 6D with two standard medium lasers. Otherwise the 'Mech configuration is the same as -6D. Quirk: Easy to Pilot Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.97
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 血犬BLH-7D以两门标准中型激光取代6D的中型脉冲激光，其余配置与-6D相同。 特性：易于驾驶 投放费用倍率：0.97

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Alpha loadout has a single weapon, an ER PPC mounted in the left arm. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Alpha载荷只有一件武器：左臂安装的一门增程粒子炮。 特性：易于维护 投放费用倍率：0.98 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The B configuration of the Blood Ferret mounts three ATM-3 launchers. A single ER Small Laser in the center torso works as backup firepower. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Blood Ferret 的 B 配置装有三具 ATM-3 发射器。中央躯干的一门增程小型激光充当备用火力。 特性：易于维护 投放费用倍率：0.98 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The C configuration is all energy based; two ER Medium Lasers in each Side Torso together with two ER Small Lasers in each arm. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: C配置为全能量配置：每侧躯干各装两具增程中型激光，每只手臂各装两具增程小型激光。 特性：易于维护 投放费用倍率：0.98 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The primary configuration of the Blood Ferret combines three Streak SRM-2 launchers with a single Small Pulse Laser and a TAG. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 血貂的主配置把三具连发SRM-2发射器与一门小型脉冲激光和一具TAG结合起来。 特性：易于维护 投放费用倍率：0.98 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Blood Kite does not use advanced electronic targeting systems or expensive weaponry. For long range, it mounts a trio of ER Large Lasers and three LRM-15 launchers. The missile launchers each contain enough ammunition for protracted engagements, though the twenty-one double heat sinks preclude continuous fire of all six weapons. At short range, three SRM-4 launchers give the 'Mech the ability to score critical damage against exposed components. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.21 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 血鸢不使用先进的电子瞄准系统或昂贵武器。远程方面它装三门增程大型激光和三具LRM-15发射器；每具导弹发射器都带足弹药以支持持久交战，不过二十一个双散热器不足以支撑全部六件武器持续开火。近程方面，三具SRM-4发射器让该机甲能对已暴露的部件造成致命伤害。 特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1.21 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 10D variant of the Bombardier is a refit performed by Earthwerks Incorporated during the Succession Wars as many advanced components became lostech; while Wakazashi were content not to manufacture any more Bombardiers, the company was prepared to license Earthwerks to produce parts for existing 'Mechs, resulting in the 10D refit. While the Delphinius and Arrowlight launchers were swapped out for low-tech Doombud and Hovertech models, the AMS system was completely replaced with a Machine Gun. Perhaps the biggest difference was the replacement of VOX 325 XL engine with the smaller Magna 260, giving the design a top speed of 64.8 km/h and cruising speed of 43 km/h. In addition, the CASE that protected the vulnerable ammunition stores has been removed from the design, while the armor protection itself has not changed. As a part of the refit performed by Earthwerks in their Calloway VI plant the communications system was replaced with the Neil 5000 system and the targeting and tracking system was replaced with the RCA Instatrac Mark XII system. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.07
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 轰炸机的10D变型是Earthwerks Incorporated在继承战争期间进行的改装，当时许多先进部件已成为失落科技；Wakazashi满足于不再生产轰炸机，但愿意授权Earthwerks为现有机甲生产零件，10D改装因此诞生。Delphinius和Arrowlight发射器被换成低技术的Doombud和Hovertech型号，而AMS系统则被一挺机枪彻底取代。或许最大的变化是用更小的Magna 260替换了VOX 325 XL引擎，使该设计的最高时速为64.8 km/h、巡航速度为43 km/h。此外，用于保护脆弱弹药库的CASE已被从设计中移除，装甲防护本身则没有变化。作为Earthwerks在其卡洛威VI工厂进行改装的一部分，通讯系统被更换为Neil 5000系统，瞄准与跟踪系统则更换为RCA Instatrac Mark XII系统。 特性：稳定 投放费用倍率：1.07

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Continuing the trend toward specialized BattleMechs, the Bombardier was proposed to the Star League in 2735 by Wakazashi Enterprises as an \"artillery 'Mech.\" The concept behind the design was to make a BattleMech that could replace less-mobile artillery vehicles, which might fall behind in an advance or be destroyed by counter-battery fire. It would be well-protected with twelve and a half tons of armor and use specialized missile racks which could carry diverse types of advanced missiles. Over years of testing and field exercises the Bombardier proved itself extremely effective at fulfilling the long-range fire support role, easily surpassing its vehicular counterparts and even inspiring talks of disbanding the SLDF's artillery arm once enough Bombardiers were operational. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在机甲专用化的潮流之中，Wakazashi 企业于 2735 年向星际联盟提出轰炸机的方案——一款“炮击机甲”。这一设计的理念是打造一种能够取代机动性较差的炮击车辆的战斗机甲，因为那些车辆在推进时可能掉队，或被反炮兵火力摧毁。它将拥有十二吨半装甲的优异防护，并使用可携带多种先进导弹的特制导弹发射架。经过多年的测试与野外演习，轰炸机在远程火力支援任务中证明自己极为高效，轻松超越了同类车辆，甚至引发了解散 SLDF 炮兵部队的讨论——只要足够数量的轰炸机投入服役。 特性：稳定 投放费用倍率：1.09

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An early clan Mech dating from the days of Operation Klondike, the Bombardier BMB-12D-EC was an upgrade of the BMB-12D that replaced the weapons with Early Clan variants. It would be discontinued and forgotten as modern clan spec weapons entered production. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Bombardier BMB-12D-EC 是源自克朗代克行动时期的早期部族机甲，它是对 BMB-12D 的升级，将武器替换为早期部族型号。随着现代部族规格武器投入生产，它最终停产并被人们遗忘。 特性：稳定 投放费用倍率：1.09

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Bowman utilizes an XL engine to maintain its rapid pace, as well an Endo Steel internal structure to save weight. An ECM Suite protects it from some forms of electronic warfare, while twelve and a half tons of armor protect it from weapons fire. The primary armament on the Bowman is a Class 16 Arrow IV Artillery launcher. Enough ammunition is included to allow for various types to be utilized. Though the original design incorporated two artillery pieces, the modern version accedes to modern demands by utilizing a LRM-20, though it has a limited amount of ammunition. Three ER Medium Lasers are meant for anti-vehicle use, while two Anti-Personnel Pods on each leg keep conventional infantry at bay. Fourteen double heat sinks keep heat levels down for the most part. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 弓手利用XL引擎保持其迅捷节奏，并采用内骨架内部结构减轻重量。一套电子对抗套件保护它免受某些形式的电子战，十二吨半装甲则抵御武器火力。弓手的主要武器是一门16型箭IV火炮发射器，配足量弹药以使用多种弹种。虽然原设计整合了两门火炮，现代版本顺应需求改用一具LRM-20，尽管弹药量有限。三门增程中型激光用于反车辆，每条腿两具反人员舱则把常规步兵挡在外面。十四个双散热器大体上压住了热量水平。 特性：稳定 投放费用倍率：1.16 手臂驱动器限制：右上

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This variant abandons any hope of the Bowman being an ArtilleryMech. The remaining artillery is replaced with a second LRM-20 launcher, three additional tons of ammunition, and an ER Large Laser. More heat sinks are added to keep the heat in check. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这个变型彻底放弃了让弓手充当火炮机甲的可能：剩余的火炮被替换为第2具LRM-20发射器、3吨额外弹药和1门增程大型激光，并加装更多散热器以控制热量。 <特性：稳定 <投放费用倍率：1.16 <手臂驱动器限制：右臂上段

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This is the original Bowman configuration introduced in 2923, carrying a pair of Arrow IV missile artillery systems. Its only other defense are a pair of A-Pods in each leg. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是 Bowman 于 2923 年推出的原始配置，携带两套 Arrow IV 导弹炮击系统。它仅有的其他防御手段是每条腿上的两具 A-Pod。 特性：稳定 投放费用倍率：1.16 手臂驱动器限制：右臂上部

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Designed primarily for short range combat, the Buccaneer carries a single ER large laser to give it some striking capability at long ranges. With the elevation of physical combat to an art in the Inner Sphere, the Buccaneer's most fearsome weapon is its four ton hatchet, supported at medium to close ranges by four medium lasers, a highly accurate medium pulse laser, and a SRM-6 with an Artemis IV guidance system for increased missile accuracy. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 海盗主要设计用于近程战斗，却带有一门增程大型激光，使它在远距离上也具备一定的打击能力。随着肉搏战在内层星域被提升为一门艺术，海盗最令人畏惧的武器是它那把四吨重的战斧；中近距离则由四门中型激光、一门高精度中型脉冲激光和一具带阿尔忒弥斯IV制导系统的SRM-6支援，以提高导弹精度。 特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1.05

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A derivative variant of the old Bushwacker prototypes, the High Roller uses an XL275 engine and Endo-Steel structure to field an AC/10, LRM-5, three Medium Lasers, and a pair of Machine Guns. While it's enhancements increase the damage output of these weapons, it still suffers from the prototype models' electronic systems, especially in its TTS and FCS. This means that while powerful, the High Roller requires an above-average warrior to land a hit. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.07 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为早期 Bushwacker 原型机的衍生变型，High Roller 采用 XL275 引擎和内骨架结构，得以装备一门 AC/10、一具 LRM-5、三具中型激光和两挺机枪。虽然它的改进提升了这些武器的伤害输出，但它仍然受累于原型型号的电子系统，尤其是其 TTS 和 FCS。这意味着 High Roller 虽然威力强大，却需要一位水准高于常人的战士才能命中目标。 特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：1.07 手臂驱动器限制：左下臂、右下臂

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A Kell Hounds refit, the -3KH carries all Clan weapons. The mercenary outfit kept most of the 'Mech the same, but did manage to squeeze in a C3 Slave unit in the head. Quirk: Hyper-Extending Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 凯尔猎犬的改装版，-3KH搭载的全是部族武器。这支雇佣兵部队让机甲的大部分保持原样，但设法在头部塞进了一台C3从属单元。 特性：超伸展驱动器 投放费用倍率：1.1

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The personal 'Mech of Marcus GioAvanti, commander of Avanti's Angels, all of Archangel's weapons are upgraded to Clantech equivalents with the right arm medium pulse laser moved to the left arm and an extra Clan medium pulse laser added to the center torso. The resulted weight and space saved allowed the mounting of an extra double heat sink as well as additional armor. Quirk: Hyper-Extending Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.12
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是阿万蒂之天使指挥官马库斯·乔阿万蒂的私人机甲，大天使的所有武器都升级为部族同类，右臂的中型脉冲激光移到左臂，中央躯干再加一门部族中型脉冲激光。由此节省的重量与空间让它得以多装一个双散热器以及额外装甲。 特性：超伸展驱动器 投放费用倍率：1.12

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The energy weapons on the Canis are four arm-mounted Series 7Ja ER Large Lasers. While these pack a powerful, long-range punch, they often overload the design's sixteen double heat sinks. For medium-range support, the Canis utilizes a pair of torso-mounted Type 9 Ultra Autocannon/10s, though it only carries enough ammunition for approximately a minute and a half of sustained firing. Quirk: Stable Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.2 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Canis 的能量武器是四门安装在手臂上的 Series 7Ja 增程大型激光。它们虽然拥有强大的远程打击力，却常常让该设计配备的十六具双散热器不堪重负。中距离支援方面，Canis 使用两门安装在躯干上的 Type 9 超级自动炮/10，不过其携带的弹药仅够持续射击约一分半钟。 特性：武器稳定 投放费用倍率：1.2 手臂驱动器限制：左下臂、右下臂

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Cataphract Hero 'Mech, Grigori Kovalenko's custom Cataphract 'Ilya Muromets', Identification Number CTF2X0042A-1013, is armed with an AC/5 in each arm, supported by a right arm Small Laser, a Medium Laser in each side torso and a right torso mounted AC/10. Such a heavy autocannon loadout is made possible through the use of 280-rated XL engine, while three tons of AC/5 rounds and two of AC/10 reloads keep those cannons firing. Quirk: Protected Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.12 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Cataphract 英雄机甲——格里戈里·科瓦连科的定制型 Cataphract“Ilya Muromets”，识别编号 CTF2X0042A-1013——两条手臂各装备一门 AC/5，并有右臂一门小型激光、两侧躯干各一门中型激光以及右躯干的 AC/10 提供支援。如此沉重的自动炮配置之所以能够实现，得益于 280 级 XL 引擎的使用；三吨 AC/5 炮弹和两吨 AC/10 弹药则保证了这些火炮的持续射击。 特性：受保护驱动器 投放费用倍率：1.12 手臂驱动器限制：右下
甲胄 CTF-IM '伊利亚·穆罗梅茨'

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The personal ride of MechWarrior Jenny Templeton of the Chesterton Reserves. This custom variant of the Catapult C1, the Quirk: Accurate Weapon - Missiles Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是切斯特顿预备役机甲战士珍妮·坦普尔顿的私人座机。这款弹射器C1的定制变型，其 特性：精准武器 - 导弹 投放费用倍率：1.11 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A field refit given popularity after repeated sightings in combat piloted by MechWarrior Leigh Voss, the CLPT-Jester typically begins life as a refit kit for a CPLT-K2 or similar variant. Stripping out the PPCs, the Jester manages to run enough power couplings to cram a laser into each arm, each side torso, and two in the center torso, with additional fittings for support weapons if available. It also mounts an AMS system and advanced TTS systems, allowing for lethally accurate fire even beyond traditional weapon ranges. The only major advanced piece of kit is its Endo-Steel structure; the engine and armor are both standard, making the Jester quite tough. With a plethora of double heat sinks keeping its weapons cool and the ability to lay down volley after pinpoint volley of fire, the Jester is simple, but not to be underestimated. Quirk: Accurate Weapon - Energy Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这种战地改装因机甲战士莉·沃斯多次驾驶它现身战场而流行起来，小丑（CLPT-Jester）通常以CPLT-K2或类似变型的改装套件为基础。它拆除粒子炮，设法布设足够的动力耦合，把激光装进每条手臂、左右躯干各一门，中央躯干则有两门，并在条件允许时预留加装支援武器的额外接口。它还装有AMS系统和先进的TTS系统，即便在传统武器射程之外也能打出致命精准的射击。唯一重要的先进部件是它的内骨架结构；引擎和装甲均为标准型，这使小丑相当耐打。凭借大量双散热器保持武器低温，以及接连不断打出精准齐射的能力，小丑结构简单，却绝不可小觑。 特性：精准武器 - 能量 投放费用倍率：1.11 手臂驱动器限制：左臂上部、右臂上部

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The CattleMaster was created at the turn of the thirty-first century as an IndustrialMech to handle large herd animals. The concept for the Rancher 'Mech dates back to the twenty-fourth century. The 'Mech is noted for its durability and flexible Internal Combustion Engine. Quirk: Easy to Pilot Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.71
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 牧牛人于三十一世纪之交被制造为工业机甲，用于处置大型畜群。这类"牧场主"机甲的概念可追溯至二十四世纪。此机甲以其耐用性和灵活的内燃引擎著称。 特质：易于驾驶 投放费用倍率：0.71

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The CattleMaster was created at the turn of the thirty-first century as an IndustrialMech to handle large herd animals. Being fed up by local Troublemakers and Pirates trying to steal his livestock, one farmer went and upgraded his Cattlemaster. Quirk: Easy to Pilot Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.71
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 牧牛大师于31世纪之交作为管理大群牲畜的工业机甲而造。由于受够了当地捣乱分子与海盗不断偷他的牲口，一位农场主索性把自己的牧牛大师升级了。 特性：易于驾驶 投放费用倍率：0.71

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Cavalier is a battle armor suit built in response to sagging morale in the Armed Forces of the Federated Commonwealth, due in large part to the secession of the Lyran state from the Federated Commonwealth. Although originally heavily based on the Inner Sphere Standard, the redesign turned out to be more than cosmetic: the redistribution of armor plating had increased leg protection at the expense of upper body protection. While there were some misgivings, in the final analysis it was discovered these alterations also gave superior dexterity to the trooper compared to that of the Standard. Reluctantly the officers in charge agreed that the benefits outweighed the drawbacks and approved mass production of the suit, which started in June of that same year. Quirk: Nimble Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.888 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 骑士战斗装甲服是为应对联邦联邦武装部队士气低落而建造的，这在很大程度上源于莱兰邦从联邦联邦中脱离。虽然它在最初很大程度上以"内天体标准型"为基础，但这次重新设计远不止外观改动：装甲板的重新分配以牺牲上半身防护为代价增强了腿部防护。尽管当时存有疑虑，但最终分析发现这些改动还使士兵的灵活性优于标准型。主管军官们不情愿地承认利大于弊，批准了该装甲服量产，并于同年六月开始。 特质：灵活 投放费用倍率：0.888 可挂载全能单位，可近战，可蜂群攻击。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: While not mounting any defensive weaponry, the Celerity CLR-02-X-D's head is equipped with a Drone Remote Control System and carries a C3i module. The fact the 'Mech has no MechWarrior piloting it is a good thing given the Celerity's single ton of armor and the fragile nature of its XXL engine and XL gyro, even a single skid following a misstep would almost cripple the design let alone combat fire on the battlefield. The standard design carries no weapon, but this version has been altered to mount a single Small Laser. Quirk: Quad Mech (Squad) Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 迅捷CLR-02-X-D虽然没有安装任何防御武器，其头部却配备了无人机遥控系统，并携带1个C3i模块。由于迅捷仅有1吨装甲，其XXL引擎和XL陀螺仪又极为脆弱，机甲里没有机甲战士驾驶反倒是件好事——哪怕是一次失足后的打滑都几乎足以让这台设计报废，更不用说战场上的火力了。标准型号不携带任何武器，但这个版本经过改装，安装了1门小型激光。 <特性：四足机甲（小队） <投放费用倍率：0.99

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: One of the best first generation ProtoMechs, the Centaur combines high speed, decent armor, and a varied weapons mix. These features make it a flexible combatant, able to keep up with scout 'Mechs while supporting them. The SRM and LRM missile launchers provide much of the striking power of the Centaur, backed up ER Micro Laser. Quirk: Nimble Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为最优秀的第一代原型机甲之一，Centaur 兼具高速度、尚可的装甲和多样化的武器组合。这些特点使它成为一具多面手，既能跟上侦察机甲的步伐，又能为其提供支援。SRM 和 LRM 导弹发射器提供了 Centaur 大部分的打击力，微型增程激光则作为补充。 特性：灵活 投放费用倍率：0.98

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A heavier 55-ton version of the venerable Centurion, the CN10-J was built in 3057 and uses an Endo Steel chassis to save weight on the design while retaining the CN9-A's original ground speed through the use of a 220-rated standard fusion engine. Much like the CN9-D, the 10-J carries an LB-X Autocannon/10 as its primary weapon with an LRM-10 launcher with an Artemis IV fire control system, but these are backed up by a Medium Laser and a Medium Pulse Laser. Quirk: Easy to Pilot Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 百夫长的55吨加重版本，CN10-J于3057年制造，采用内骨架底盘以减轻重量，同时通过一台220额定标准聚变引擎保持CN9-A原有的地面速度。与CN9-D很像，10-J以一门LB-X自动炮/10为主武器，配一具带阿尔忒弥斯IV火控系统的LRM-10发射器，另有中型激光和中型脉冲激光作为后手。 特性：易于驾驶 投放费用倍率：1.05 手臂驱动器限制：右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A heavier 55-ton version of the venerable Centurion, the CN10-W was built in 3057 and uses an Endo Steel chassis to save weight on the design while retaining the CN9-A's original ground speed through the use of a 220-rated XL engine. Much like the CN9-D, the 10-W carries an LB-X Autocannon/10 as its primary weapon with an LRM-10 launcher with an Artemis IV fire control system, but these are backed up by a PPC. Quirk: Easy to Pilot Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 百夫长的55吨加重版本，CN10-W于3057年制造，采用内骨架底盘以减轻重量，同时通过一台220额定XL引擎保持CN9-A原有的地面速度。与CN9-D很像，10-W以一门LB-X自动炮/10为主武器，配一具带阿尔忒弥斯IV火控系统的LRM-10发射器，另有粒子炮作为后手。 特性：易于驾驶 投放费用倍率：1.05 手臂驱动器限制：右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Yen-Lo-Wang, named after the Chinese god of death, is a famous individual BattleMech. Its serial number is FS1010-031X. Yen-Lo-Wang has been modified and customized into a variety of different configurations over the years. Quirk: Yen Lo Wang Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: “阎罗王”以中国死神命名，是一台著名的独立战斗机甲。它的序列号为FS1010-031X。多年来，阎罗王被改装并定制成多种不同配置。 特性：阎罗王 投放费用倍率：1.04 手臂驱动器限制：右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A second, later configuration of the Yen-Lo-Wang. Commonly referred to as the CN9-YLW2, it is still based upon a CN9-A chassis but uses more modern equipment. Keeping the speed the same, the engine was changed to an extra-light version. The AC/10 has been upgraded to a Gauss Rifle with two tons of ammunition. Three medium pulse lasers, two in the left arm and another rear-mounted in the center torso, replace the old standard ones. A left arm Hatchet is paired with Triple-Strength Myomer. Quirk: Yen Lo Wang Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Yen-Lo-Wang的第二种也是更晚的配置，通常被称为CN9-YLW2，它仍以CN9-A底盘为基础，但使用了更现代的装备。速度保持不变，引擎更换为超轻型版本。AC/10升级为一门高斯步枪，配两吨弹药。三门中型脉冲激光——两门在左臂，另一门朝后安装在中央躯干——取代了旧式标准激光。左臂的战斧与三重强度肌纤维搭配使用。 特性：Yen Lo Wang 投放费用倍率：1.06 手臂驱动器限制：右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The primary weapons on the MR-5M are a pair of Gauss rifles, each of which is capable of taking one ton of armor off of an enemy at long range. In the event that an enemy does move into short range, the Cerberus is ready for them because it carries four Medium Pulse Lasers and two rear-mounted Machine Guns. Additionally, for increased defense against missile attacks, the Cerberus carries an anti-missile system. Quirk: Barrel Fist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.17 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: MR-5M的主要武器是两门高斯步枪，每一门都能在远距离上削掉敌人一吨装甲。若敌人真的逼近到近距离，Cerberus也早有准备：它装有四门中型脉冲激光和两挺后置机枪。此外，为加强对导弹攻击的防御，Cerberus还配备了一套反导弹系统。 特性：炮管拳 投放费用倍率：1.17 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The primary weapons on the Cerberus are a pair of Grizzard Model 200 Gauss rifles, each of which is capable of taking one ton of armor off of an enemy at long range. In the event that an enemy does move into short range, the Cerberus is ready for them because it carries four Blankenburg Medium Pulse Lasers and two rear-mounted Sperry Browning Machine Guns. Additionally, for increased defense against missile attacks, the Cerberus carries a McArthur anti-missile system. Quirk: Barrel Fist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.17 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 地狱犬的主武器是两门格里扎德200型高斯步枪，每门都能在远距离上剥掉敌人一吨装甲。若敌人真的逼近近距，地狱犬也已做好准备：它带四门布兰肯堡中型脉冲激光和两挺后向斯佩里-勃朗宁机枪。此外，为加强对导弹攻击的防御，地狱犬还带一套麦克阿瑟反导弹系统。 特性：炮管拳 投放费用倍率：1.17 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Cestus 6X was produced for the SLDF in 2603. Considered a failure due to abysmal heat sinking on an energy-exclusive loadout, the Cestus design would eventually see an overhaul into the 6Y, albeit half a century later. Quirk: Stable Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Cestus 6X于2603年为SLDF生产。由于全能量载荷的散热能力糟糕透顶而被视为失败之作，Cestus设计最终在半个世纪后被彻底翻新为6Y。 特性：武器稳定 投放费用倍率：1.09

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Designed for the SLDF in 2766, the Cestus production was plagued with delays and setbacks. The 6Y is considered a design correction over the original 6X, which ran notoriously hot, by replacing some of the energy weapons with ballistics. Quirk: Stable Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Cestus于2766年为SLDF设计，其生产却饱受延误与挫折。6Y被认为是对原始6X的设计修正——后者以过热问题臭名昭著——做法是用实弹武器替换了部分能量武器。 特性：稳定武器 投放费用倍率：1.09

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A Clan-tech retrofit performed by Clan Fire Mandrill. While the original loadout remains identical to the base Cestus 6Y, the 6Y-EC benefits from the early fruits of Clan weapons research. Despite proving to be a success, the redesigned Cestus was overshadowed by further advancements in Clan technology and by 3020 was all but forgotten. Quirk: Stable Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是火沸沸部族进行的部族技术改装。虽然原始配置与基础Cestus 6Y完全相同，但6Y-EC得益于部族武器研究的早期成果。尽管被证明是成功的，重新设计的Cestus仍被部族技术的进一步进步所掩盖，到3020年已几乎被遗忘。 特性：武器稳定 投放费用倍率：1.09

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Created for the Federated Commonwealth during the Clan Invasion, the 6Z variant of the Cestus returns to the original energy-exclusive loadout of the BattleMech, this time with better cooling. Quirk: Stable Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 6Z 变型是部族入侵期间为联邦共和国打造的，Cestus 借此回归了该战斗机甲最初的全能量武器配置，而这一次散热更为出色。 特性：武器稳定 投放费用倍率：1.09

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 5C is a weird one, no official creator exists in the records of the design but the 'Mech was produced at several factories at one point of time. A slight rebuild of the classic TRC-4B, the variant does not introduce any major changes except moving the internals around. Quirk: Easy to Pilot Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.02
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 5C 是一个古怪的型号：设计档案中查不到任何官方设计者，但该机甲曾一度在多家工厂同时生产。它是对经典 TRC-4B 的小幅重构，除了调整内部构件的布局之外，并没有引入任何重大改动。 特性：易于驾驶 投放费用倍率：1.02

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A Clan refurbished version of the TRC-4B, replacing its internals with Clan versions but keeping all weapon systems from the original 'Mech. Quirk: Easy to Pilot Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是 TRC-4B 的部族翻新型，其内部构件全部换为部族版本，但保留了原机甲的全部武器系统。 特性：易于驾驶 投放费用倍率：1.08

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The personal 'Mech of Force Commander Pasi Irin assigned to the First Free Worlds Legionnaires, this custom variant replaces the SRM-6 w/Artemis IV with a pair of Streak SRM-2 and additional armor. Quirk: Stable Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是配属第一自由世界军团的部队指挥官 Pasi Irin 的专属机甲。这款定制改型用一对连发 SRM-2 和额外装甲取代了带阿尔忒弥斯 IV 的 SRM-6。 特性：稳定武器 投放费用倍率：1.1 手臂驱动器限制：左上臂、右上臂

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: One of the so-called \"Clanbuster\" variants developed in 3052 by ComStar in the lead-up to the Battle of Tukayyid, this variant is a major upgrade that replaces the standard fusion engine with a lighter but more vulnerable 300-rated ExtraLight engine, the heat sinks have been upgraded to double heat sinks and two Large Lasers, surplus from the Clanbuster upgrade of the Wyvern, have been added to the 'Mech's unoccupied arms. Quirk: Stable Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是通讯之星在Tukayyid战役前夕于3052年研发的所谓“部族克星”变型之一。该变型是一次重大升级：标准聚变引擎被替换为更轻但更脆弱的300级超轻型引擎，散热器升级为双散热器，并将Wyvern部族克星升级中富余的两门大型激光加装到机甲空置的双臂上。 特性：稳定武器 投放费用倍率：1.08 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 3P is the newest variant of the Champion, introduced in 3061. The 'Mech's arsenal has been completely upgraded to modern standards with the complete removal of all of its weapons. In their place this version of the Champion carries four ER Medium Lasers, one in each arm. An Ultra Autocannon/10 replaces the LB-X Autocannon and the SRM-6 has been replaced by an improved Narc Missile Beacon. In addition, the ExtraLight engine used in the 3N has been retained and an improved C3 computer was added to allow the Champion to work as part of a 6-unit C3 network. Quirk: Stable Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 3P是Champion最新的变型，于3061年推出。该机甲的武库已按现代标准全面升级，原有武器被尽数拆除。取而代之的是，这一版本的Champion搭载四门增程中型激光，每臂各一门。一门Ultra自动炮/10替换了LB-X自动炮，SRM-6则被改进型Narc导弹信标取代。此外，3N所使用的超轻型引擎得以保留，并增设了一台改进型C3计算机，使Champion能够作为6单位C3网络的一环运作。 特性：稳定武器 投放费用倍率：1.08 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An upgraded Champion with Clantech, the Champion C is simply an updated Champion 1N2. Built in 2867 it uses an XL engine with the weight saved going into the addition of 5 jump jets that enable the 'Mech to jump up to 150 meters at a time. The medium lasers were upgraded to Medium Pulse Lasers and a pair of ER Medium Lasers were added. The small lasers are also upgraded to Small Pulse Lasers. The rest of the weaponry is upgraded to Clan standards and the remaining tonnage went to additional armor. Quirk: Stable Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 冠军 C（Champion C）是采用部族科技升级的冠军，实质上就是更新版的冠军 1N2。它于 2867 年建造，使用 XL 引擎，节省下来的重量用于加装 5 具跳跃推进器，使该机甲一次最多可跳跃 150 米。中型激光升级为中型脉冲激光，并新增了两门增程中型激光。小型激光也升级为小型脉冲激光。其余武器均升级至部族标准，剩余的吨位则用于增加装甲。 特性：稳定武器 投放费用倍率：1.14 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An upgrade of the 3K, the Charger CGR-C was modified to carry a C3 Slave unit that allowed it to share targeting data with other 'Mechs in its unit. In order to add the slave unit, a medium pulse laser had to be removed from the design. The left over mass went towards extra ammunition for the LRM launcher. Quirk: Barrel Fist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为3K的升级型，Charger CGR-C经过改装以搭载C3从属单元，使其能够与本单位内其他机甲共享瞄准数据。为了加装该从属单元，设计上不得不移除一门中型脉冲激光。剩下的重量则用于为LRM发射器增加额外弹药。 特性：枪管拳 投放费用倍率：1.14 手臂驱动器限制：左下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A simple refit of the -1A1, replacing three of the Small Lasers and some of the armor for a Medium Laser and a C3 slave unit. Quirk: Barrel Fist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.12 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 对-1A1的简易改装：拆除三具小型激光和部分装甲，换装一具中型激光和一个C3从属单元。 特性：枪管拳 投放费用倍率：1.12 手臂驱动器限制：左下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An attempt to make the early Charger models more successful by downgrading the 400 engine to a 320 core. The freed up weight allows both considerably more armor as a much different weapons mix of weapons - a Large Laser, a PPC and three Medium Lasers. Quirk: Barrel Fist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.12 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 通过将400引擎降级为320核心，试图让早期型的Charger型号获得更好的表现。省下的重量既带来了大幅增加的装甲，也带来了截然不同的武器组合——一门大型激光、一门粒子炮和三门中型激光。 特性：枪管拳 投放费用倍率：1.12 手臂驱动器限制：左下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A melee-focused variation of the CGR-1A5 model introduced in 3028, the 1P5 retains the lasers and SRM racks but downgrades the AC/20 for an much smaller AC/5 to free up the weight for an assault Battle Axe carried in the right arm. Quirk: Barrel Fist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.12 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 1P5是3028年推出的CGR-1A5型号的近战向变体，它保留了激光与SRM发射槽，但把AC/20降级为小得多的AC/5，以腾出重量在右臂携带一把突击型战斧。 特性：枪管拳 投放费用倍率：1.12 手臂驱动器限制：左下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A very unusual total refit of the Charger, it's origins uncertain but likely some blackshop in the periphery as it is only used by pirates and other unsavory groups. Quirk: Barrel Fist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是对 Charger 一次极为罕见的大改，来历不明，很可能出自外围地区的某家黑作坊，因为只有海盗和其他不三不四的团体才使用它。 特性：炮管铁拳 投放费用倍率：1.14 手臂驱动器限制：左下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Terry Ford's \"Number Seven\" is built around an 320-rated standard engine, the slower engine allows it to retain the 'Mech's ten tons of armor and head mounted small laser while freeing up weight to carry a Large Laser in each side torso supported by a Medium Laser in each arm and the right torso. Twenty-five single heat sinks and four jump jets ensure Number Seven surprising mobility and endurance in battle. Quirk: Barrel Fist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 特里·福特的“七号”围绕额定 320 的标准引擎打造。较慢的引擎使它得以保留机甲原有的十吨装甲和头部安装的小型激光，同时腾出重量，在两侧躯干各装一门大型激光，并由每条手臂和右躯干各一门中型激光提供支援。二十五个单散热器和四具跳跃推进器，使“七号”在战斗中拥有出人意料的机动性与续航能力。 特性：炮管拳 投放费用倍率：1.14 手臂驱动器限制：左下臂

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Punch Bot started as an standard CGR-1A1 of a lance sized merc unit with limited funds available. The first pilot repeatedly threw his 'Mech first into every tough situation hoping to to be able to collect the insurance on the Charger, but the 'Mech just wouldn't die. Eventually the unit realized they could save over 10 tons by replacing the LTV 400 Engine with a GM 380 out of a salvaged Banshee. The then dropped 5 of those tons of the 'Mech's overall weight to keep the same top speed. The extra tonnage allowed them to embrace Punch Bot's usual tactics by mounting Jump Jets, a ton and a half extra armor and upgraded arm actuators. Quirk: Protected Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.13
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 拳击机器人起初是一个经费有限的排级雇佣兵单位的一台标准CGR-1A1。首位飞行员反复把机甲第一个扔进每个险境，指望能靠冲锋者拿到保险金，可这台机甲就是死不了。最终该部队意识到，用一台从废弃女妖上拆下的GM 380替换LTV 400引擎，能省下十吨以上。他们随后又削掉其中5吨总重量以保持同样的最高速度。多出的吨位让他们得以拥抱拳击机器人的惯用战术：装跳跃推进器、一吨半额外装甲，并升级手臂驱动器。 特性：受保护驱动器 投放费用倍率：1.13

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 2G is a Clan conversion of the Cicada, although its purpose is unknown it does allow the 'Mech to perform better and fit more advanced electronic warfare components. Quirk: Improved Sensors Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 2G是蝉式机甲经部族技术改造而成的型号。尽管其用途不明，但它确实让这台机甲性能更佳，并能容纳更先进的电子战部件。 特性：改进传感器 投放费用倍率：1.06 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Introduced in 2740, the 40 ton Cicada was developed as a competitor to the Locust. Slightly better armed and just as fast, the Cicada’s heavier armor and better melee capabilities enable it to function as an effective Light Mech hunter and scout. Powered by a 320-rated XL Engine, the prototype Cicada X5 is armed with quad Medium Lasers and a pair of SRM-2’s. Quirk: Nimble Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 40吨的蝉于2740年推出，是为与蝗虫竞争而研制。它武装略强、速度相当，而更厚的装甲与更好的近战能力使它成为有效的轻型机甲猎手与侦察机。原型蝉X5由一台320额定XL引擎驱动，装四门中型激光和两具SRM-2。 特性：灵巧 投放费用倍率：1.04 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Clint was primarily designed as a cheap recon unit, with the capabilities of a well-armed, low-end medium weight 'Mech, and in this regard it served well. With a top speed of 97.2 km/h and a jumping capability of one hundred and eighty meters, the Clint can easily keep up with other recon elements and maneuver through mountainous or urban terrain. This custom model exchanges the Autocannon/5 with a Large Laser and four Heat Sinks. Quirk: Variable Range Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.02 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Clint 最初是作为廉价侦察单位设计的，却具备武装精良的低端中型机甲的作战能力，在这方面它表现相当出色。其最高速度为 97.2 km/h，跳跃距离达一百八十米，能轻松跟上其他侦察单位，并在山地或城市地形中灵活机动。这款定制型号用一门大型激光和四具散热器换掉了自动炮/5。 特性：可变距离瞄准 投放费用倍率：1.02 手臂驱动器限制：右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A battlefield refit of the CLNT-2-3T, replacing one of the medium lasers for a small laser and CASE protection to the autocannon ammunition. Two jump jets are also removed to enable the use of a C3 Slave unit. Quirk: Variable Range Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是 CLNT-2-3T 的战场改装：将其中一门中型激光换为小型激光，并为自动炮弹药加装 CASE 防护。此外还拆除了两具跳跃推进器，以便使用 C3 从属单元。 特性：可变距离瞄准 投放费用倍率：1 手臂驱动器限制：右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A full conversion of the standard Clint to Clan tech, used by the famous elite mercenary unit the Gray Death Legion. By using both Ferro-Fibrous armor and an Endo-Steel chassis the design manages to fit an Ultra AC/5 and three ER Medium Lasers, making the 40 ton 'Mech capable to deliver an unexpectedly heavy strike. Quirk: Variable Range Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是将标准型克林特全面改装为部族科技的产物，由著名精锐雇佣兵部队灰死军团使用。通过同时采用铁纤维装甲与内骨架底盘，该设计成功装下了一门超级AC/5和三门增程中型激光，让这台40吨机甲能够打出出人意料的沉重一击。 特性：可变距离瞄准 投放费用倍率：1.08 手臂驱动器限制：右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A mercenary refit of the Clint CLNT-3-3T using acquired clan tech. Mounting an Ultra AC/5 and three ER Medium Lasers, made possibly by use of both Ferro-Fibrous armor and Endo Steel structure, making it considerably better armed than its base variant. Quirk: Variable Range Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.02 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是雇佣兵利用取得的部族技术对克林特CLNT-3-3T的改装。它装有一门超级AC/5和三门增程中型激光，靠铁纤维装甲与内骨架结构才得以实现，武装明显优于基础变型。 特性：可变距离瞄准 投放费用倍率：1.02 手臂驱动器限制：右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The CRH-2B distinguishes itself through an unusual density of reinforced components, including an armored cockpit, armored engine shielding, a defensive-rated gyro, and reinforced leg and arm actuators that resist crippling damage. Ferro-Fibrous armor plating keeps weight manageable despite this added bulk, while internal spall liners reduce the risk of catastrophic crew or component loss from penetrating hits. Armed with twin PPCs and three Medium Lasers, and fitted with assault-class jump jets for repositioning, the CRH-2B remains a stubbornly difficult mech to put down for good. Quirk: Reinforced Structure Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: CRH-2B的独特之处在于强化部件密度异常之高：装甲座舱、装甲引擎屏蔽、防御级陀螺仪，以及能抵抗致残伤害的加固腿部与手臂驱动器。尽管增加了这些体积，铁纤维装甲板仍让重量保持可控，而内部崩落衬层则降低了穿透命中导致乘员或部件灾难性损失的风险。CRH-2B装双粒子炮与三门中型激光，并配突击级跳跃推进器用于重新站位，是一台顽固得难以彻底击倒的机甲。 特性：加固结构 投放费用倍率：1.14

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The CRH-2Br is a common field refit of the original CRH-2B, replacing its single heat sinks with double heat sinks throughout. This simple upgrade allows the Cockroach's twin PPCs to fire more frequently without risking shutdown, meaningfully improving sustained combat performance while leaving the chassis's signature armor, reinforced actuators, and defensive systems entirely untouched. Quirk: Reinforced Structure Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16
