Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: CRH-2Br是CRH-2B常见的野战改装，把单散热器全面换成双散热器。这项简单升级让蟑螂的双粒子炮能更频繁地射击而不必担心停机，显著改善持续战斗表现，同时完全不动其标志性装甲、加固驱动器和防御系统。 特性：加固结构 投放费用倍率：1.16

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The CRH-4H represents a significant rework of the original CRH-2B, upgrading its twin PPCs to ER PPCs for greater range and replacing single heat sinks with double heat sinks throughout to support them. A Guardian ECM Suite has been added for electronic protection, and Reinforced Internal Structure further bolsters the chassis's already formidable durability. These additions come at a slight cost to armor coverage, though the CRH-4H remains every bit as difficult to bring down as its predecessor. Quirk: Reinforced Structure Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: CRH-4H 是对原始 CRH-2B 的一次重大改造：将成对的粒子炮升级为增程粒子炮以获得更大射程，并全面以双散热器替换单散热器来支撑它们。它还加装了 Guardian 电子对抗套件以提供电子防护，而强化内部结构则进一步增强了机体本就强悍的耐用性。这些改动以略微削减装甲覆盖为代价，不过 CRH-4H 依旧如前代一样难以被击倒。 特性：强化结构 投放费用倍率：1.16

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The CRH-4H2 builds directly on the CRH-4H, upgrading all three Medium Lasers to Medium Pulse Lasers and adding a fourth in the center torso for substantially improved close-range accuracy and output. An Advanced Targeting Computer and additional energy and heat tracking systems further sharpen its weapons' effectiveness, supported by extra heat sinks in both arms. To accommodate this expanded and refined arsenal, the CRH-4H2 sacrifices its jump jets entirely — a trade-off that grounds the design but leaves its renowned armor and defensive systems fully intact. Quirk: Reinforced Structure Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: CRH-4H2直接以CRH-4H为基础，把三门中型激光全部升级为中型脉冲激光，并在中央躯干加装第四门，近距精度与输出显著提升。一台先进瞄准计算机与额外的能量和热量追踪系统进一步强化了武器效能，双臂还加了额外散热器。为容纳这套扩充且精炼的武器，CRH-4H2完全牺牲了跳跃推进器——这一取舍让该设计失去了跳跃能力，但其著名的装甲与防御系统完好无损。 特性：加固结构 投放费用倍率：1.16

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The original Colossus design, introduced in 3053, carried a standard AC/20, and a Large Pulse Laser teamed with a Medium Pulse Laser in each arm. Like the updated version, this prototype could jump 90 meters. The armor protection remained the same, but it carried three Coolant Pods in the right and left torsos instead of the shields that would later appear on the CLS-4S. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.17 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 最初的巨像设计于3053年推出，带一门标准AC/20，每只手臂则有一门大型脉冲激光配一门中型脉冲激光。与更新版本一样，此原型可跳跃90米。装甲防护保持不变，但它在左右躯干装了三个冷却剂罐，而非后来出现在CLS-4S上的护盾。 特性：稳定 投放费用倍率：1.17 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 2A is an unofficial refit of the 2D, adding one and a half ton of armor and switching from single to double heat sinks. The SRM-6 launcher is converted to a hand-mounted SRM-4, and the Medium Laser moved to a side torso. The 'Mech also adds protection against internal ammunition explosions in form of a C.A.S.E. system. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.96
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 2A是对2D的非官方改装，增加了一吨半装甲，并将单散热器换成双散热器。SRM-6发射器被改为手持式SRM-4，中型激光则移至侧躯干。该机甲还以C.A.S.E.系统的形式增添了针对内部弹药爆炸的防护。 特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：0.96

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A refit of the 2D chassis removing all the missiles and instead adds three more Medium Lasers and six Small Lasers, along with an extra ton of armor. Quirk: Improved Cooling Jacket - Laser Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.96
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 2D 底盘的改装型，拆除了全部导弹，改为加装三具中型激光和六具小型激光，并额外增加一吨装甲。 特性：改进冷却套 - 激光 投放费用倍率：0.96

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A variant of the -2D that drops the Medium Laser to replace it with a C3 slave unit. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.96
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是-2D的变型，拆掉中型激光，换成一台C3从机。 特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：0.96

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A battlefield refit of the 2D, the 2J mounts 6 jump jets and replaces the SRM-6 with a SRM-4 launcher. The 'Mech further uses double heat sinks to support the increased heat build up from the jump jets. To be able to carry the weight of the jump jets, the 2J uses an XL engine core and Ferro-Fibrous armor. This does however mean that an extra ton of armor and a C.A.S.E. system can be added. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 2J 是 2D 的战地改装型，安装了 6 台跳跃推进器，并以 SRM-4 发射器取代 SRM-6。该机甲还采用双散热器，以应对跳跃推进器带来的额外热量积聚。为了承受跳跃推进器的重量，2J 使用 XL 引擎核心和铁纤维装甲，不过这也意味着还能额外增加一吨装甲并加装 C.A.S.E. 系统。 特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：0.98

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Another common refit of the COM-2D is the 2P, which adds a Large Laser at the cost of only keeping a downgraded SRM-2 launcher. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.96
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: COM-2D 另一种常见的改装是 2P，它增加了一门大型激光，代价是仅保留一具降级的 SRM-2 发射器。 特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：0.96

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Five tons of Ferro-Fibrous armor, an XL engine, double heat sinks, C.A.S.E. system and an extra Medium laser makes the 2W quite a refit of the 2D. To make it even more interesting the SRM-6 has been replaced by a Streak SRM-4 launcher. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 五吨铁纤维装甲、一台XL引擎、双散热器、C.A.S.E.系统和一门额外中型激光，使2W成为对2D相当彻底的改装。更有意思的是，SRM-6被换成了连发SRM-4发射器。 特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：0.98

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A strange variant of the Commando that is focused more on durability than most other variants, the 3H only mounts a single Large Laser. Instead, it carries a full 2 extra tons of armor and an extra heat sink. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.96
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 3H 是 Commando 的一个特殊变型，相比其他大多数变型更注重耐用性，因此仅安装了一门大型激光，取而代之的是整整多出两吨的装甲和一具额外散热器。 特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：0.96

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 3H2 mounts a Large Laser and a Small Laser, protected by 5.5 tons of armor. This makes it more durable than a 2D, allowing it to remain scouting for a longer time on the battlefield. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.96
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 3H2装有一门大型激光和一门小型激光，由5.5吨装甲保护。这使它比2D更耐久，能够在战场上坚持侦察更长时间。 特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：0.96

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The best armored of the of the -7 series, the -7A still manages to fit a total of 200 C.A.S.E. protected SRM missiles for its two SRM-4 launchers. A single Medium Laser in the Left Arm is the only other weapon of the variant. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.96
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: -7A是-7系列中装甲最厚的一款，却仍能为其两具SRM-4发射器携带总计200枚受C.A.S.E.保护的SRM导弹。左臂的一门中型激光是该变型唯一的其他武器。 特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：0.96

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Similar to the -7A in weapons loadout with two SRM-4 launchers and a Medium Laser, the -7J mounts five jump jets instead of the extra armor and ammunition of the -7A. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.96
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: -7J的武器配置与-7A相似，同为2具SRM-4发射器和1门中型激光，但它用5具跳跃推进器替代了-7A上额外的装甲与弹药。 <特性：狭小/低矮外形 <投放费用倍率：0.96

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The -7W reaches for longevity with extra ammo and a Streak SRM-2 launcher. Task Force Serpent used these variants to great effect on Huntress, prompting Coventry Metal Works to dedicate factory space to producing official re-creations. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: -7W以额外弹药和一具连发SRM-2发射器追求持久力。蛇特遣队在享特雷斯上大量使用这些变型并效果卓著，促使考文垂金属厂专门腾出厂房生产官方复刻版。 特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：0.98

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A 4th Succession war variant that saw limited production, the 7X variant exchanges the SRM-4 for an additional 2 medium lasers but is otherwise identical to the standard Commando. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.96
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 7X是第四次继承战争时期产量有限的变型，以额外2门中型激光取代SRM-4，其余与标准突击兵完全相同。 特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：0.96

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The COM-7Y swaps the -2D's SRM-4 for two more medium lasers and another ton of armor in an attempt to improve the Commando's longevity on the battlefield. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.96
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: COM-7Y以两门额外中型激光和另一吨装甲取代-2D的SRM-4，意在提升突击兵在战场上的存续力。 特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：0.96

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The -7Y2 is more than just a sub-variant of the -7Y, it has become so famous and beloved it earned its own nickname of the 'Blazing Inferno'. It sacrifices the SRM launchers, but instead adds 6 small lasers. The only downside of the variant is its quite bad cooling capabilities considering all its weapons. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.96
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: -7Y2 不只是 -7Y 的子改型，它已经太过出名、太受欢迎，以至于获得了自己的绰号“炽烈地狱”。它舍弃了 SRM 发射器，改为加装 6 门小型激光。该改型唯一的缺点在于，考虑到它的全部武器，其散热能力相当糟糕。 特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：0.96
突击队员 COM-7Y2 '炽热地狱'

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The recovery of Cellular Ammunition Storage Equipment technology saw the emergence of a new more durable variant of the Commando, the -7Z. To fit the C.A.S.E. system the variant drops one of the -7Y's Medium Lasers, but also adds a bit more armor. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.96
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 随着细胞式弹药储存设备技术的重获，Commando出现了一种更耐用的新型改款——7Z。为了容纳C.A.S.E.系统，该改型舍弃了7Y的一门中型激光，但也增加了一些装甲。 特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：0.96

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A sub-variant of the -7Z, the Commando COM-7Z2 downgrades the two Medium Lasers to Small Lasers to be able to fit a Beagle Active Probe. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Commando COM-7Z2是7Z的子改型，将两门中型激光降级为小型激光，以便装下一具Beagle主动探测器。 特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：0.98

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Built on an Endo Steel chassis, the 9D combines a 200 XL engine with 5 tons of Ferro-Fibrous armor, two Medium Lasers and a Streak SRM-6 launcher. A ton of streak ammunition and an Beagle Active Probe finishes the design. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 9D 以内骨架底盘打造，整合了 200 XL 引擎、5 吨铁纤维装甲、两门中型激光和一部连发 SRM-6 发射器。一吨连发弹药和一部 Beagle 主动探测器构成了这套设计的收尾。 特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：0.98

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A refresh of the 9D, the 9DA replaces the Medium Lasers with Small Pulse Lasers. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 9DA是9D的改良型，用小型脉冲激光替换了中型激光。 特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：0.98

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Commando R2D2, except for having a very strange designation, is a pretty standard looking refit of the 2D replacing the Medium Laser with a C3 slave unit. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.96
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 突击兵R2D2除了有个非常奇怪的编号之外，就是对2D相当标准的改装，以一台C3从机取代中型激光。 特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：0.96

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A unique Commando piloted by Captain Bono Duganmare of the 22nd Skye Rangers, the \"Death's Knell\"; is refitted with recovered LosTech. Swapping the standard SRM racks for an additional 3 Medium lasers, allows the TDK’s engine to be refitted with a 175 core. The inclusion of DHS keeps the mech comfortably cool. An extra half ton of armor round out the design. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 第22斯凯游骑兵上尉博诺·杜根梅尔驾驶的一台独特突击兵“丧钟”，装上了回收的失落科技。它以额外3门中型激光取代标准SRM挂架，使这台TDK的引擎得以换装175核心。双散热器的加入让机甲保持舒适的温度，另加半吨装甲为该设计收尾。 特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：1.03

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Designed as a successor to the Wolverine, the Conjurer is a 50-ton Mech seen in Clan Second Line formations. Powered by a 300-rated Fusion Core, the Conjurer CJR-7 mounts 6 Jump jets. A Large Pulse Laser and 2 LRM-5’s form the bulk of the CJR-7’s weapons, with a pair of ER Medium Lasers for close combat. Quirk: Extended Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 幻术师作为狼獾的后继型号而设计，是部族二线编队中得见的50吨机甲。它由一台300额定聚变核心驱动，幻术师CJR-7装6具跳跃推进器。一门大型脉冲激光和2具LRM-5构成CJR-7武器的大部分，另有一对增程中型激光用于近战。 特性：扩展躯干旋转 投放费用倍率：1.1

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Corona is a battle armor design that was created by Clan Star Adder following the Trials to determine which Clans would take part in Operation REVIVAL. The idea was to build the battlesuit around a weapon that could threaten 'Mechs from a distance. The mass necessary to mount such a heavy weapon resulted in a twenty percent armor decrease and the removal of the jump pack, despite a fifty percent overall increase in mass. Quirk: Intimidating Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.935 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can not swarm.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 科罗娜是星蝰部族在决定哪些部族参与“复兴行动”的试炼之后所创造的战斗装甲设计。其构想是围绕一件能从远处威胁机甲的武器来打造这套战斗服。安装如此沉重的武器所需的重量，导致装甲减少百分之二十并取消了跳跃背包，尽管整体重量增加了百分之五十。 特性：威慑 投放费用倍率：0.935 可搭载全向单位，可进行近战，无法发动蜂群攻击。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Jake Kalmar's infamous Ravager was built around a 285-rated XL Engine to save weight to carry eighteen tons of armor and fifteen double heat sinks. Offensively the Ravager is armed with a Gauss Rifle in the left arm and a Ultra AC/5 in the right torso, supported by a center torso mounted Large Pulse Laser, a standard Large Laser in the left torso and right arm, rounded out by a Medium Laser in the head and each arm. Two tons each of Gauss and UAC reloads gave it good endurance. The 'Mech was salvaged by Chloe's Cavaliers after they tracked Kalmar to Sigurd in 3037 and killed him there. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.19 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 杰克·卡尔马（Jake Kalmar）那台臭名昭著的“揉躏者”（Ravager）以额定 285 的 XL 引擎为核心，从而省下重量来携带十八吨装甲和十五台双散热器。在攻击方面，揉躏者的左臂装有一门高斯步枪，右躯干装有一门超速 AC/5，并由中央躯干的大型脉冲激光、左躯干与右臂的标准大型激光提供支援，头部与每条手臂各一门中型激光则补齐了配置。高斯弹药与 UAC 弹药各两吨，使它具备良好的持续作战能力。3037 年，克洛伊骑兵团（Chloe's Cavaliers）追踪卡尔马至西格德（Sigurd）并将其击毙后，回收了这台机甲。 特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1.19 手臂驱动器限制：右上

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Corvis 1 is built on a Model MH-24 endo steel chassis, protected by seven tons of ferro-fibrous armor; a good thing since it is so slow. This low speed is due to the 160-rated fusion engine that powers the 'Mech. Thankfully this low speed is augmented by four jump jets, giving the Corvis a jump range of 120 meters. The main gun of the Corvis is its UAC/10, backed up by a pair of medium pulse lasers. These guns enable the Corvis to operate effectively in medium to short ranges. Between the generous supply of autocannon ammunition and 10 double heat sinks that keep the 'Mech chilled, the Corvis can operate without resupply for a respectable amount of time. Quirk: Modular Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Corvis 1 以 Model MH-24 内骨架机体建造，由七吨铁纤维装甲保护；鉴于它的速度如此之慢，这倒是件好事。低速源于为机甲提供动力的 160 级聚变引擎。所幸四具跳跃推进器弥补了这一缺陷，使 Corvis 拥有 120 米的跳跃距离。Corvis 的主炮是 UAC/10，辅以两门中型脉冲激光。这些武器让 Corvis 在中近距离都能有效作战。凭借充裕的自动炮弹药和 10 具让机甲保持凉爽的双散热器，Corvis 能够在相当长的时间内无需补给持续作战。 特性：模块化武器 投放费用倍率：1.08 手臂驱动器限制：右臂下部

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: With a focus on indirect fire support, the COU-A fields a pair of Artemis IV guided LRM-20s. If the pilot finds itself in a position with direct line of sight he or she can also rely on a pair of ERML's and a single backup Small Pulse Laser. In total this makes for a lot of firepower in a very small package. Quirk: Advanced Optics Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.01 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: COU-A专注间接火力支援，装备两具由阿尔忒弥斯IV制导的LRM-20。若机师获得直视射界，还可依靠两具增程中型激光和一具备用的小型脉冲激光。总体而言，这让它在极小的机体中汇聚了相当可观的火力。 特性：高级光学 投放费用倍率：1.01 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Cougar-B is a classic clan direct fire support / sniper build. Dual ERPPCs and a backup ERML make for a formidable punch. With a set of six additional Double Heatsinks the COU-B runs reasonably cool and is able to keep its barrage up for quite a while. Quirk: Advanced Optics Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.01 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 美洲狮-B 是典型的部族直射火力支援/狙击配置。两门增程粒子炮加上一门作为备份的增程中型激光，构成相当可观的打击力。额外的六个双散热器让 COU-B 运行得相当凉爽，能够长时间持续倾泻火力。 特性：先进光学系统 投放费用倍率：1.01 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A custom Cougar configuration, the Blood Adder is armed with a pair of ATM-9’s. A pair of torso mounted HMG’s back the ATM’s up at closer ranges while a head mounted AMS enhances the configurations defensive capabilities. Quirk: Advanced Optics Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为美洲狮的定制配置，血蝰蛇装有一对ATM-9。两挺躯干机枪在较近距离为ATM提供后手，头部一套反导弹系统则增强该配置的防御能力。 特性：先进光学 投放费用倍率：1.03 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A mix of long and medium range weaponry is what makes the Cougar-C variant quite unique. A Gauss Rifle is an absolutely scary main weapon system for a mech of just 35 tons and even the backup weapons are more than enough to strike fear in its enemies heart: 5 ERML will allow the COU-C to stay active and dangerous even after the ammo for the Gauss is depleted. Quirk: Advanced Optics Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.01 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 远程与中程武器的混装使美洲狮-C变型相当独特。就一台仅35吨的机甲而言，高斯步枪是绝对可怕的主武器系统，就连后备武器也足以在敌人心中种下恐惧：5门ERML让COU-C即便在高斯弹药耗尽后仍能保持活跃与危险。 特性：先进光学 投放费用倍率：1.01 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Conceptualized to be a sniper with a good near field defense the Cougar-D variant relies on a single ERLL and an Ultra Autocannon/10 for long range and dual SRM4 launchers for close range fire. The COU-D might not be quick, but if he closes in after ripping the armor open, these Short Range Missiles have great finishing potential. Quirk: Advanced Optics Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.01 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 美洲狮-D变型的设计构想是兼具优秀近距防御的狙击手：远程依靠一门ERLL和一门超级自动炮/10，近程则用双联SRM4发射器。COU-D也许不算快，但如果它撕开装甲后逼近，这些近程导弹的收割能力极强。 特性：先进光学 投放费用倍率：1.01 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This configuration was introduced during the 3060s. It was equipped with four Jump Jets and an ECM suite. This variant is armed with an Ultra Autocannon/5 and a trio of Heavy Medium Lasers for when any opponent tries to close range. It also has three additional double heat sinks to deal with heat the trio of heavy lasers produce. Quirk: Advanced Optics Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.01 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 此配置于3060年代推出，配备四具跳跃推进器和一套电子对抗套件。它装有一门超级AC/5和三门重型中型激光，以应对任何试图逼近的对手，另有三个额外双散热器处理三门重型激光产生的热量。 特性：先进光学 投放费用倍率：1.01 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Huntress configuration of the Cougar is a rare sight, designed to be a scout hunter and Heavy Hitter is most of its capability shifted to advanced electronics and the ability to detect and effectively kill even stealthed units in a single devastating Blow. Quirk: Advanced Optics Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.01 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Cougar 的 Huntress 配置十分罕见，它的定位是猎杀侦察兵的“重击手”，大部分性能都转移到了先进电子设备上，并具备侦测乃至一击摧毁隐身单位的能力。 特性：高级光学 投放费用倍率：1.01 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The primary configuration in the MC custom line of Cougars, based on an upgraded 210 XL engine instead of the stock 175 XL. The MCA's purpose is long rage attacks, carrying a LRM-15 and a Large Pulse Laser. For defensive purposes it mounts an Anti Missile System and to deal with infantry attacks the MCA also mounts a Flamer. Quirk: Advanced Optics Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.01 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是美洲狮MC定制品系列的主配置，基于升级的210 XL引擎而非原装175 XL。MCA的用途是远程打击，带一具LRM-15和一门大型脉冲激光。为自卫它装有一套反导弹系统，为应对步兵袭击还装有一具火焰喷射器。 特性：先进光学 投放费用倍率：1.01 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Another configuration in the MC custom line of Cougars, based on an upgraded 210 XL engine instead of the stock 175 XL. The addition of six jump jets makes the MCJ one of the most mobile configurations of the Cougar, at the cost of only being able to mount a single LRM-15 launcher and a Large Pulse Laser for combat, with a chest mounted Flamer for defensive purposes. Quirk: Advanced Optics Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.01 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是Cougar的MC定制系列中的另一款构型，以升级的210 XL引擎取代原来的175 XL引擎。六具跳跃推进器的加入使MCJ成为Cougar中机动性最强的构型之一，代价是作战时只能装备一具LRM-15发射器与一门大型脉冲激光，并在胸部装一具火焰喷射器用于自卫。 特性：高级光学 投放费用倍率：1.01 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Another configuration in the MC custom line of Cougars, based on an upgraded 210 XL engine instead of the stock 175 XL. Mounting four LRM-5 launchers and double Large Pulse Lasers, the damage profile is higher than expected. Quirk: Advanced Optics Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.01 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是美洲狮MC定制品系列的又一配置，基于升级的210 XL引擎而非原装175 XL。它装四具LRM-5发射器和双联大型脉冲激光，伤害曲线高于预期。 特性：先进光学 投放费用倍率：1.01 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Khan Marthe Pryde decided to upgrade the 'Mechs her Clan fielded. Rather than waste precious resources designing a new OmniMech from the ground up, she instructed her scientists to improve upon existing designs. The design the scientists chose to modify was the Adder. Though the two 'Mechs are visually similar and share the same weight, the Cougar is slower and better armed. Quirk: Advanced Optics Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.01 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 可汗玛尔特·普赖德决定升级其部族列装的机甲。与其耗费宝贵资源从头设计一款新的全向机甲，她指示科学家改进现有设计。科学家们选择改造的是蝰蛇。虽然两款机甲外观相似且重量相同，美洲狮更慢、武装更好。 特性：先进光学 投放费用倍率：1.01 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Coyotl has the honor of being the first OmniMech. Developed by Clan Coyote with some help from Clan Sea Fox, the Coyotl was first fielded in 2854. By using an XL Engine and Endo Steel chassis, the scientists were able to create a medium 'Mech that could carry a great deal of equipment. In addition, the high ground speed of the Coyotl allowed it to rush from one area of a battlefield to another, providing support for its teammates. The A configuration was introduced during a conflict against Clan Cloud Cobra. Seven Jump Jets gave the Coyotl A much greater maneuverability, while the long range weapons were traded for a Large Pulse Laser, Small Pulse Laser, and an additional Streak SRM-4 launcher. This version also dropped the Medium Pulse Laser of the original. Quirk: Extended Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Coyotl 拥有作为首款全向机甲的荣耀。它由郊狼部族在海洋狐部族的协助下开发，于 2854 年首次投入战场。通过采用 XL 引擎和内骨架机体，科学家们得以打造出一具能携带大量装备的中型机甲。此外，Coyotl 的高地面速度使其能够迅速从战场一处奔赴另一处，为队友提供支援。A 配置是在与云眼镜蛇部族的冲突中推出的。七具跳跃推进器大幅提升了 Coyotl A 的机动性，远程武器则被换成了一门大型脉冲激光、一门小型脉冲激光和一具额外的连发 SRM-4 发射器。该版本还去掉了原型的中型脉冲激光。 特性：扩展躯干旋转 投放费用倍率：1.03 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Coyotl has the honor of being the first OmniMech. Developed by Clan Coyote with some help from Clan Sea Fox, the Coyotl was first fielded in 2854. By using an XL Engine and Endo Steel chassis, the scientists were able to create a medium 'Mech that could carry a great deal of equipment. In addition, the high ground speed of the Coyotl allowed it to rush from one area of a battlefield to another, providing support for its teammates. The B configuration uses an Ultra AC/10 in the right arm as its main firepower, supported by an ER Medium Laser and SRM-6 launcher. Quirk: Extended Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 郊狼有幸成为史上第一台全向机甲，由郊狼部族在海狐部族的一些协助下研制，于2854年首次投入战场。借助XL引擎和内骨架底盘，科学家们得以造出一台能携带大量装备的中型机甲。此外，郊狼较高的地面速度使其能快速从战场一处奔赴另一处，为队友提供支援。B配置以右臂的1门超级自动炮/10为主要火力，并配1门增程中型激光和1具SRM-6发射器。 <特性：扩展躯干旋转 <投放费用倍率：1.03 <手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Coyotl has the honor of being the first OmniMech. Developed by Clan Coyote with some help from Clan Sea Fox, the Coyotl was first fielded in 2854. By using an XL Engine and Endo Steel chassis, the scientists were able to create a medium 'Mech that could carry a great deal of equipment. In addition, the high ground speed of the Coyotl allowed it to rush from one area of a battlefield to another, providing support for its teammates. The primary version of the Coyotl used an ER PPC and LRM-10 as the primary long range weapons, while a Medium Pulse Laser and Streak SRM-4 provided short range firepower. Originally the engineers thought they would build each variant around the PPC, but this proved to be too limiting, particularly with the high heat it caused. The missile systems were added to provide firepower at a lower heat cost. Quirk: Extended Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Coyotl 有幸成为史上第一款全向机甲。它由郊狼族在海狐族的协助下研发，于 2854 年首次投入战场。通过采用 XL 引擎和内骨架，科学家们得以打造出一款能携带大量装备的中型机甲。此外，Coyotl 出众的地面速度使其能够迅速在战场各处穿梭，为队友提供支援。Coyotl 的主配置以一门增程粒子炮和一具 LRM-10 作为主要远程武器，一门中型脉冲激光和一具连发 SRM-4 则提供近距离火力。最初工程师们打算围绕粒子炮来打造每一个变型机，但这被证明限制过多，尤其是粒子炮产生的高热量。导弹系统正是为了以更低的热量代价提供火力而加入的。 特性：扩展躯干旋转 投放费用倍率：1.03 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A Star League era training mech, the Crockett was introduced in 2735. An 85-ton mech with a mix of weapon types alongside double heat sinks, the Crockett would go on to see frontline service as a command mech and assault mech. The CRK-5003-0 is a downgrade resulting from the Succession War’s decline in technology and features a 255-rated engine alongside a trio of Jump Jets. A pair of Large Lasers and an AC/10 form the bulk of the mechs weapons, with paired SRM-6's Lasers and Small Lasers surprising opponents at close range. Quirk: Easy to Pilot Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.13 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Crockett是星际联盟时代的训练机甲，于2735年推出。这台85吨机甲混合了多种武器类型并配备双散热器，后来更作为指挥机甲与突击机甲在前线服役。CRK-5003-0是继承战争导致科技衰退后产生的降级版本，配备一具255级引擎与三具跳跃推进器。两门大型激光与一门AC/10构成这台机甲的主要武器，而配对的SRM-6、激光与小型激光则能在近距离让对手措手不及。 特性：易于驾驶 投放费用倍率：1.13 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A Star League era training mech, the Crockett was introduced in 2735. An 85-ton mech with a mix of weapon types alongside double heat sinks, the Crockett would go on to see frontline service as a command mech and assault mech. The CRK-5003-1 is the original SLDF training model and features a 255-rated engine alongside a trio of Jump Jets. A pair of ER Large Lasers and an LB-10X form the bulk of the mechs weapons, while a pair of SRM-6's and Small Lasers surprise enemies closing in. Quirk: Easy to Pilot Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.13 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为星际联盟时期的训练机甲，克罗基特于2735年推出。这台85吨机甲混装多种武器并配双散热器，后来还作为指挥机甲与突击机甲投入一线服役。CRK-5003-1是最初的SLDF训练型号，配备一台255额定引擎和三具跳跃推进器。两门增程大型激光和一门LB-10X构成机甲武器的绝大部分，而两具SRM-6和小型激光则能让逼近的敌人吃一惊。 特性：易于驾驶 投放费用倍率：1.13 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A Star League era training mech, the Crockett was introduced in 2735. An 85-ton mech with a mix of weapon types alongside double heat sinks, the Crockett would go on to see frontline service as a command mech and assault mech. The CRK-5003-1b is an upgrade model used by the SLDF Royal regiments and features a 255-rated engine alongside an Endo Steel skeleton and a trio of Jump Jets. A pair of ER Large Lasers and a Gauss Rifle form the bulk of the mechs weapons, with 2 Medium Lasers and 4 Medium Pulses surprise opponents at close range. Quirk: Easy to Pilot Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.17 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为星际联盟时期的训练机甲，克罗基特于2735年推出。这台85吨机甲混装多种武器并配双散热器，后来还作为指挥机甲与突击机甲投入一线服役。CRK-5003-1b是SLDF皇家团使用的升级型号，配备一台255额定引擎、内骨架结构和三具跳跃推进器。两门增程大型激光和一门高斯步枪构成机甲武器的绝大部分，另有2门中型激光和4门中型脉冲激光在近距给对手一个惊喜。 特性：易于驾驶 投放费用倍率：1.17 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Crosscut is a popular type of LoggerMech, praised for operating efficiency in woodlands and dominating commercial forestry. The X2M is a militarized crosscut on the cheap, with only minor modifications to the base industrial model. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.72
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 横切是受欢迎的伐木机甲类型，以在林地作业高效、称霸商业林业而受赞誉。X2M是一款低成本的军用化横切，仅对基础工业型号做了少量改动。 特性：易于维护 投放费用倍率：0.72

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Crosscut is a popular type of LoggerMech, praised for operating efficiency in woodlands and dominating commercial forestry. The X4X is the dual-chainsaw version (not to be confused with the dual-saw version, which is different). It's particularly popular in forestry with dense tree coverage. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.72
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 横切是受欢迎的伐木机甲类型，以在林地作业高效、称霸商业林业而受赞誉。X4X是双链锯版本（不要与双锯版本混淆，那是不一样的东西）。它在树冠茂密的林区尤其受欢迎。 特性：易于维护 投放费用倍率：0.72

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Used by 'Crusading Crael', the reigning champion of the DeathRain Arena in Port Krin on Antallos in 3057, this heavily modified Crusader had huge spikes protruding from its chest and shoulders; the latter served to conceal missile launchers and fall off as soon as the shoulder-mounted SRMs were fired for the first time. The shoulder-mounted LRM-15 launchers of the original were replaced with two more SRM-6 racks (mounted in the side torso sections) to boost short-range firepower over the LRM's long range that was less useful in arena combat, and maximized the infighter capabilities by installing Claws on each arm. Quirk: Stable Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这台机甲由“十字军克雷尔”使用——他是3057年安塔洛斯克林港“死亡雨竞技场”的卫冕冠军。这台大幅改装的十字军胸口与肩部伸出巨大尖刺；肩部那些还用来隐藏导弹发射器，在肩载SRM首次发射后便会脱落。原本的肩载LRM-15发射器被换成另外两组SRM-6挂架（装在侧躯干），以在竞技场战斗中用处不大的LRM远程火力换取更强的近程火力，并给每只手臂装上爪，最大限度发挥近身近战能力。 特性：武器稳定 投放费用倍率：1.11

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A refit of the -3R that replaces the Machine Guns with a C3 slave unit and CASE protection to improve battlefield performance against other Mechs and Vehicles. Quirk: Stable Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.07
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是 -3R 的改装型，以一套 C3 从机和 CASE 防护替换了机枪，以提升在战场上对付其他机甲和车辆的表现。 特性：武器稳定 投放费用倍率：1.07

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Custom refit of the Crusader CRD-3R used by the mercenary band Wolf's Dragoons. The main features are the replacement of all the weapons with Clan tech versions and the use of a Clan XL engine core, combined with four JumpJets and an Artemis IV system. Quirk: Stable Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是雇佣兵部队沃尔夫龙骑兵所使用的 Crusader CRD-3R 定制改装版。主要特点是将全部武器换成部族科技型号，并采用部族 XL 引擎核心，同时配备四台跳跃推进器和一套 Artemis IV 系统。 特性：稳定武器 投放费用倍率：1.09

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: One of several custom designs used by the famous mercenary company Wolf's Dragoons. Based off the -3R but heavily improved with Clan tech, the design uses a 360 XL Clan Engine core to be able to fit better weapons, a C3 slave unit, jumpjets and better cooling. Quirk: Stable Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是著名雇佣兵公司沃尔夫龙骑兵所使用的数款定制设计之一。它以-3R为基础，但用部族科技大幅改良，采用额定360的部族XL引擎核心，从而能装下更好的武器、一套C3从属单元、跳跃推进器以及更强的散热系统。 特性：稳定武器 投放费用倍率：1.09

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A Star League-tech retrofit of the classic CRD-3R developed by Bander BattleMechs for the mercenary market in 3054, the 4BR switches to double heat sinks and replaces the SRM-6 launchers with a pair of Streak SRM-2s. The weight saved allows an extra ton of LRM reloads for each launcher to be carried, protected by the addition of CASE in each torso. Quirk: Stable Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 4BR 是 Bander BattleMechs 于 3054 年为雇佣兵市场开发的、经典 CRD-3R 的星际联盟技术改装型。它换装双散热器，并以两具连发 SRM-2 取代 SRM-6 发射器。节省下来的重量使每具发射器都能多携带一吨 LRM 备用弹药，并由各躯干新增的 CASE 提供保护。 特性：武器稳定 投放费用倍率：1.09

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The -4Db was an initial alternative upgrade route from the -3R before -4D design was fully finished. However, due the use of Artemis IV FCS, Streak SRM-4s rather than Streak SRM-2s and Endo Steel structure made the design far too expensive for the intended market. Only a few units were ever produced. Quirk: Stable Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: -4Db是-4D设计完全定型之前，-3R的一条早期替代升级路线。然而，由于采用阿尔忒弥斯IV火控系统、连发SRM-4而非连发SRM-2以及内骨架结构，该设计对目标市场而言过于昂贵，只生产了少数几台。 特性：武器稳定 投放费用倍率：1.09

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A Capellan Confederation specific variant, similar to the CRD-4D except for a slightly different paintjob. Quirk: Stable Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 卡佩兰联邦专属的变型，与CRD-4D相似，只是涂装略有不同。 特性：稳定武器 投放费用倍率：1.09

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A production-model upgrade of the Crusader utilizing Star League equipment, the 5S was built by TharHes industries on Tharkad for FedCom forces starting in 3049. It varies little from the 3R model, instead removing the machine guns to make room for double heat sinks, CASE to protect the missile reloads, and the addition of a Flamer in the right arm. Quirk: Stable Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 5S是Crusader采用星际联盟装备的量产升级型，自3049年起由Tharkad上的TharHes工业为联邦共和国部队制造。它与3R型差别不大，只是拆除了机枪以腾出空间安装双散热器、保护导弹弹药的CASE，并在右臂增设了一门火焰喷射器。 特性：稳定武器 投放费用倍率：1.09

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A Kallon variant with a top speed of 86 km/h thanks to an XL engine. Each arm carries six medium lasers and the leg mounted weapons are a flamer in each hip mount. Seventeen double heat sinks struggle to keep things cool, but twelve and a half tons of armor protect the 'Mech. A C3 slave unit is mounted in the head, allowing this Crusader to share targeting data. Quirk: Stable Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Kallon 出品的变型，凭借 XL 引擎最高速度可达 86 km/h。每只手臂搭载六具中型激光，腿部武器则是每个髋部安装座内的一具火焰喷射器。十七具双散热器勉力维持散热，十二点五吨装甲则为该机甲提供防护。头部装有一具 C3 从属单元，使这具 Crusader 能够共享瞄准数据。 特性：稳定武器 投放费用倍率：1.09

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Cudgel 1B was the first of a handful of BattleMechs designed off of the Charger chassis by Solarian manufacturer Innovative Design Concepts. By mounting all weaponry in the torsos, IDC found that MechWarriors were able to make melee strikes without sacrificing any firepower. Quirk: Melee Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 短棍1B是索拉里斯制造商创新设计概念公司基于冲锋者底盘设计的少数战斗机甲中的第一款。通过把所有武器装进躯干，IDC发现机甲战士能在不牺牲任何火力的情况下进行近战打击。 特性：近战驱动器 投放费用倍率：1.14

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The original flagship model, the Cyclone A1 began mass-manufacture in 2631 and proved to be the most expensive variant until the 3060s. Sporting a Magna 210XL Fusion engine, the Cyclone A1 can reach and maintain speeds up to 118km/h. Sold as a Scout Mech, the A1 features both a Guardian ECM Suite and a Beagle Active Probe which leaves just enough space for its light weapons payload consisting of a pair of Longfire V LRM 5s in the arms and a pair of Magna Mk II Medium Lasers in the side torsos. Quirk: Nimble Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为最初的旗舰型号，Cyclone A1 于 2631 年开始量产，并在此后直到 3060 年代一直是价格最高的改型。它搭载 Magna 210XL 聚变引擎，最高可达到并维持 118km/h 的速度。作为侦察机甲发售的 A1 同时配备守卫者电子对抗套件和鱼鹰主动探测器，留下的空间恰好够装它那套轻量武器：双臂各一具 Longfire V LRM 5，两侧躯干各一门 Magna Mk II 中型激光。 特性：灵活 投放费用倍率：0.99 手臂驱动器限制：左上臂、右上臂

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A downgrade of the original A1 variant, the Cyclone A3 was produced throughout the Amaris Civil War and all four Succession Wars. Replacing the 210XL Fusion engine with an ultra-reliable Magna 150 Fusion engine made the A3 cost half as much as the A1 variant. While the A3 retains the Magna MkII Medium Lasers and Longfire V LRM 5s, the ECM Suite and Active Probe are replaced by a pair of Sperry Browning Machine Guns and a Zippo Flamer. Quirk: Nimble Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.97 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Cyclone A3 是原 A1 变型的降级版，其生产贯穿了阿马里斯内战与全部四次继承战争。它用极为可靠的 Magna 150 聚变引擎替换了 210XL 聚变引擎，使 A3 的成本只有 A1 变型的一半。A3 保留了 Magna MkII 中型激光与 Longfire V LRM 5，但 ECM 套件和主动探测器被一对 Sperry Browning 机枪和一具 Zippo 火焰喷射器所取代。 特性：灵巧 投放费用倍率：0.97 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Cyclone A3P refit became popular in the late 2960s and became the primary variant produced, under license, by Luthien Armor Works in the Draconis Combine until the design was retired in the 3060s. The A3P retains the Magna 150 Fusion engine and Magna Mk II Medium lasers of the A3 but replaces the remainder of the weapons payload for a Magna Hellstar PPC and an extra heat sink. The Luthien production runs of the A3P variant were the first Cyclones to feature lower arm and hand actuators. Quirk: Nimble Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.97
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 旋风A3P改装在2960年代后期流行起来，并成为龙脉联合体内卢西恩装甲厂授权生产的主力变型，直到该设计在3060年代退役。A3P保留了A3的马格纳150聚变引擎和马格纳Mk II中型激光，其余武器则换成一门马格纳地狱星粒子炮和一个额外散热器。卢西恩生产的A3P变型是首批配备下臂与手部驱动器的旋风。 特性：灵巧 投放费用倍率：0.97

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: After the discovery of the Helm Memory Core and the development of several additional key technologies, Magna Metals Inc. revisited the Cyclone design in 3058. The B2 variant features an Endo-Steel chassis paired with a 180L Fusion Engine to make room for a pair of experimental Hellcat Class 5 Thunderbolt 5 launchers with a ton of ammunition each and a pair of Magna Mk VI ER Medium Lasers. Further differences from the previous A3 variant come in the form of Double Heat Sinks, lower arm and hand actuators, and the reintroduction of the Guardian ECM Suite. The Cyclone B2 found only a tepid response from military buyers as the Thunderbolt missiles are susceptible to being rendered ineffectual by Anti-Missile Systems. Quirk: Nimble Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在地狱记忆核心被发现并发展出若干关键附加技术之后，马格纳金属公司于3058年重新审视了旋风设计。B2变型采用内骨架底盘配一台180L聚变引擎，为两具实验型地狱猫5级雷神之锤5发射器（各配一吨弹药）和两门马格纳Mk VI增程中型激光腾出空间。相较此前的A3变型，它还有双散热器、下臂与手部驱动器，以及重新引入的守护者电子对抗套件。旋风B2在军方买家中反响平平，因为雷神之锤导弹容易被反导弹系统化为无效。 特性：灵巧 投放费用倍率：0.99

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: After the lack-luster reaction to the Cyclone B2 in most markets, Magna Metals Inc., in collaboration with Hollis Incorporated, developed the C1 variant. The Cyclone C1 is built around the same Magna 210XL engine of the A1 variant. Using the same Endo-Steel chassis of the B2, the C1 replaces the weapons payload of the B2 with a Magna Firestar ER PPC, a pair of Magna Mk VI ER Medium Lasers, a Guardian ECM Suite, and an additional Double Heat Sink. Quirk: Nimble Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在 Cyclone B2 于大多数市场反响平平之后，Magna Metals 公司与霍利斯公司合作开发了 C1 改型。Cyclone C1 围绕与 A1 改型相同的 Magna 210XL 引擎打造。它沿用 B2 的内骨架底盘，把 B2 的武器配置换成了一门 Magna Firestar 增程粒子炮、一对 Magna Mk VI 增程中型激光、一具守卫者电子对抗套件和一台额外的双散热器。 特性：灵活 投放费用倍率：0.99

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The original Daedalus carried a large pulse laser, machine gun, small laser, SRM-6, and a pair of SRM-4 missile launchers. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 最初的 Daedalus 搭载一门大型脉冲激光、一挺机枪、一门小型激光、一具 SRM-6，以及两组 SRM-4 导弹发射器。 特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1.03 手臂驱动器限制：右臂下部

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The original Dagoth design was meant to be a competitor to Defiance's Berserker but never made it to full production. However, the original design did see a few prototypes dubbed the Dagoth DG-UR-1. A 380XL engine with supercharger strains to move the over 30 tons of Hardened armor at reasonable speeds to bring the sword and Snub-Nose PPC into range. Quirk: Well Balanced Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.17
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 最初的达戈斯设计意在成为挑战公司狂战士的竞争者，却从未进入量产。不过该原始设计确实造出了几台被称为达戈斯DG-UR-1的原型。一台380XL引擎配增压器，勉力推动超过30吨的硬化装甲以尚可的速度移动，把长剑和短鼻粒子炮带入射程。 特性：平衡良好 投放费用倍率：1.17

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The DAI-01 is built around long-range firepower. The primary weapon the 'Mech carries is a ER PPC backed up by a pair of Ultra autocannon/5s. This combination of weapons gives the Daikyu a devastating long-range punch. The 'Mech also carries a LRM-5 launcher, giving it limited indirect fire support capabilities. For close combat, the Daikyu carries a single medium laser. Quirk: Extended Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: DAI-01 以远程火力为核心。该机甲的主武器是一具增程粒子炮，辅以两门超级自动炮/5。这一武器组合赋予 Daikyu 毁灭性的远程打击力。该机甲还搭载一具 LRM-5 发射器，具备有限的间接火力支援能力。近距离作战方面，Daikyu 装有一具中型激光。 特性：扩展躯干旋转 投放费用倍率：1.1

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A variant made to address concerns of a lack of short-range firepower, the 02 variant was built soon after Operation Bulldog. The 'Mech carries a pair of Streak SRM-6 launchers in place of the two Ultra autocannon/5s. Additionally, for close combat, the 02 variant of the Daikyu has two ER medium lasers. It is also outfitted with a C3 slave unit to share targeting information with other friendly units. It also has the addition of jump jets, giving it a jumping capacity of 150 meters. Quirk: Extended Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 02改型是为解决近距离火力不足的担忧而打造，在斗牛犬行动结束后不久便投入生产。这台机甲以两具连发SRM-6发射器取代了两门Ultra自动炮/5。此外，为应付近战，Daikyu的02改型还装有两门增程中型激光。它还配备了C3从属单元，可与其他友军单位共享瞄准信息。它还加装了跳跃推进器，使其跳跃能力达到150米。 特性：扩展躯干旋转 投放费用倍率：1.1

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The original prototype Defiance produced on Hesperus II, this version was powered by an 300 XL engine and used an experimental compact gyro, which freed up space to mount a second SRM-6 rack in the center torso. As extended-range versions of medium and small lasers were not yet available to the Federated Commonwealth, it carried two pairs of small and medium pulse lasers instead, the increased weight devoted to weapons limiting the armor to twelve tons. Quirk: Hyper-Extending Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.13 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是挑战公司在赫斯佩鲁斯II生产的原始原型，由一台300 XL引擎驱动并使用实验型紧凑陀螺仪，从而腾出空间在中央躯干加装第二具SRM-6挂架。由于当时联邦共和国还无法获得中型与小型激光的增程版本，它改为带两对小型与中型脉冲激光；投入武器的重量增加，使装甲被限制在十二吨。 特性：超伸展驱动器 投放费用倍率：1.13 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The customized 'Mech of fierce Azami warrior Ukla Mauck, Mauck stripped the missile launchers from his 'Mech and replaced them with a trio of MRM-10s. The further addition of Triple Strength Myomer makes Mauck's nearly 200-year-old Dervish a terror in close-range combat. Quirk: Hyper-Extending Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.07 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是凶悍的阿扎米战士乌克拉·毛克的定制机甲。毛克拆掉机甲上的导弹发射器，换成三具MRM-10，并进一步加装三倍强度人造肌，使这台近两百年历史的苦行僧在近距战斗中成为恐怖的存在。 特性：超伸展驱动器 投放费用倍率：1.07 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The DV-6MRU - or Minor Resilience Upgrade - was an upgrade program provided for a while for the original DV-6M, replacing one of the Medium Lasers with a C3 slave unit and C.A.S.E. protection for the ammunition. Quirk: Hyper-Extending Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: DV-6MRU——“小型韧性升级”——曾为原版DV-6M提供过一段时间的升级，以一台C3从机替换其中一门中型激光，并为弹药加装C.A.S.E.防护。 特性：超伸展驱动器 投放费用倍率：1.03 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 7S is in practice a 6M with one of the medium lasers exchanged for two small ones and some relocation of the 'Mechs components and weapons. Quirk: Hyper-Extending Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 7S实际上就是一台6M，把其中一门中型激光换成两门小型激光，并对机甲的部件与武器做了些位置调整。 特性：超伸展驱动器 投放费用倍率：1.03 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Frenzy is built around an 275-rated extralight engine and an endo steel frame, carrying an SRM-4 in each arm in support of LRM-20 in each side torso. Clad in seven and half tons of standard armor and fitted with five jump jets and ten double heat sinks, the Frenzy carries two tons each of LRM and SRM missile reloads. Quirk: Hyper-Extending Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.07 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Frenzy 以 275 级超轻型引擎和内骨架框架打造，每条手臂各携带一具 SRM-4，用以辅助两侧躯干中的 LRM-20。它披挂七吨半标准装甲，配备五具跳跃推进器和十具双散热器，并携带 LRM 与 SRM 导弹各两吨备用弹药。 特性：超伸展驱动器 投放费用倍率：1.07 手臂驱动器限制：左臂下部、右臂下部

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A Star League era mech designed to correct the flaws of the original Titan, the Devastator was rediscovered by the FedSuns in 3023. Powered by a 300-rated engine, the Devastator DVS-1D carries a pair of AC/10’s, with 2 Large Lasers and 4 Medium Lasers as secondary weapons. 18 tons of armor and 15 heat sinks round out the design. Quirk: Hyper-Extending Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Devastator是星际联盟时代为修正初代Titan的缺陷而设计的机甲，3023年被联邦太阳国重新发现。DVS-1D由额定300的引擎驱动，装备两门AC/10，副武器为2门大型激光和4门中型激光。18吨装甲和15台散热器补全了整体设计。 特性：超伸展驱动器 投放费用倍率：1.16 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A Star League era mech designed to correct the flaws of the original Titan, the Devastator was rediscovered by the FedSuns in 3023. Powered by a 300-rated XL engine, the Devastator DVS-2 carries a pair of Gauss Rifles, with 2 PPC’s and 4 Medium Lasers as secondary weapons. 18.5 tons of armor and 14 DHS round out the design. Quirk: Hyper-Extending Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 毁灭者是星际联盟时代为修正原始泰坦的缺陷而设计的机甲，3023年被联邦太阳国重新发现。由一具额定300的XL引擎驱动，毁灭者DVS-2装有两门高斯步枪，并以2门粒子炮与4门中型激光作为次要武器。18.5吨装甲与14具双散热器构成了该设计的其余部分。 特性：超伸展驱动器 投放费用倍率：1.18 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Several Devastators were hand-built by Clan technicians for Operation Klondike. These used Improved Gauss Rifles and carried two more tons of Gauss ammunition (four tons total). Later Clan Wolverine would overhaul the weapons completely, leaving the Improved Gauss Rifles in place (adding CASE to the arms for protection), but trading the PPCs for Enhanced ER PPCs and the medium lasers for ER medium lasers. To handle the massive heat load, twenty Clan-spec double heat sinks were installed. Quirk: Hyper-Extending Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.22 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 为“克朗代克行动”，部族技术员手工组装了数台Devastator。它们采用改进型高斯步枪，并多携带两吨高斯弹药（共计四吨）。后来狼獾部族将武器彻底翻修：保留改进型高斯步枪（为双臂加装CASE作为防护），但把粒子炮换成增强型增程粒子炮，把中型激光换成增程中型激光。为应对庞大的热量负荷，还安装了二十台部族规格的双散热器。 特性：超伸展驱动器 投放费用倍率：1.22 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A Star League era mech designed to correct the flaws of the original Titan, the Devastator was rediscovered by the FedSuns in 3023. Powered by a 300-rated XL engine, the Devastator DVS-3S carries a pair of Gauss Rifles and 2 PPC’s. A Medium laser and a Small Laser round out the Mechs weapons. 18.5 tons of armor and 14 DHS round out the design. Quirk: Hyper-Extending Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 揉躏者是星际联盟时期为纠正原版泰坦缺陷而设计的机甲，3023年由联邦太阳国重新发现。揉躏者DVS-3S由一台300额定XL引擎驱动，装有一对高斯步枪和2门粒子炮，另有一门中型激光和一门小型激光补全武器。18.5吨装甲和14个双散热器为该设计收尾。 特性：超伸展驱动器 投放费用倍率：1.18 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A Snow Raven variation on the original Howler chassis, the 30 ton Devil entered service in 2911. Gaining 10 tons over it’s predecessor, it is powered by a 300-rated XL Engine; enabling it to accelerate to higher speeds then the Baboon. A combination of Ferro-Fibrous armor and Endo Steel provide the free weight for an ER PPC and a Targeting Computer. Quirk: Extended Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 魔鬼（Devil）是雪鸦部族在原版嗥叫者（Howler）底盘基础上推出的变体，重 30 吨，于 2911 年服役。它比前代增重 10 吨，由一台额定 300 的 XL 引擎驱动，可加速到比沸沸（Baboon）更高的速度。铁纤维装甲与内骨架的组合省下了足够的重量，用于安装一门增程粒子炮和一台瞄准计算机。 特性：扩展躯干旋转 投放费用倍率：1.05

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The loadout on this Dire Wolf more closely resembles that of a short-range strike vehicle, carrying devastating damage potential but very limited ammunition. Capable of launching a ton and a half of mortar ammunition at once, it presents a lethal threat until its ammo runs dry. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Long Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.13 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这套Dire Wolf的配置更像是一台近程突击车辆，拥有毁灭性的伤害潜力，但弹药极为有限。它能一次性发射一吨半的迫击炮弹药，在弹药耗尽之前都是致命的威胁。 特性：改进瞄准 - 远距 投放费用倍率：1.13 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The C2 configuration of the Dire Wolf brings a combination of energy and ballistic weapons. Two Ultra AC/2, two LBX AC/2 and three Large Pulse Lasers are the main damage dealers, while two Medium Pulse Lasers and an ER Small Laser can provide extra defensive capabilities if needed. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Long Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.19 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 恐狼C2配置带来能量与弹道武器的组合。两门超级AC/2、两门LBX AC/2和四门大型脉冲激光是主要伤害来源，而两门中型脉冲激光和一门增程小型激光可在需要时提供额外防御能力。 特性：改进瞄准 - 远程 投放费用倍率：1.19 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The OmniMech configuration designated D2 for the Dire Wolf carries on of the scariest weapons on the battlefield, an Ultra AC/20. But even if the large autocannon misses, the loadout still has two ER PPC, one Large Pulse Laser, four ER Medium Lasers and two Medium Pulse Lasers as followup damage. The largest drawback of the D2 is the fact that even with 24 Double heat sinks, the cooling is seldom enough for repeated full alpha strikes. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Long Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.19 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Dire Wolf 代号 D2 的全向机甲配置搭载了战场上最令人胆寒的武器之一——一门 Ultra AC/20。但即便这门大型自动炮打空，这套配置仍有两门增程粒子炮、一门大型脉冲激光、四门增程中型激光和两门中型脉冲激光作为后续伤害。D2 最大的缺陷在于：即便拥有 24 具双散热器，其散热能力也很少足以支撑反复的全力齐射。 特性：改进瞄准 - 远程 投放费用倍率：1.19 手臂驱动器限制：全向机甲

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Dire Wolf is one of the OmniMechs that became feared throughout the Inner Sphere during the initial Clan Invasion and rightly so. The Dire Wolf weighs in at an impressive one hundred tons and has a relatively slow cruising speed of 54 km/h provided by a 300 XL engine. Its speed and armor protection matches that of an Atlas, but it has superior potential firepower with fifty and a half tons of free pod space for weapons and equipment. It is these traits which saw the 'Mech christened Daishi (pseudo-Japanese for 'Great Death') by the criminal underbelly of the Draconis Combine, a name that would be proven grimly accurate time and time again. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Long Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.21 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 恐狼是部族入侵初期在整个内层星域中令人闻风丧胆的全向机甲之一，而这份恐惧并非空穴来风。恐狼重达惊人的一百吨，由一台300 XL引擎提供动力，巡航速度相对缓慢，仅为54 km/h。它的速度与装甲防护与阿特拉斯相当，但潜在火力更强，拥有五十五吨半的自由舱位空间用于搭载武器与装备。正是这些特质，让龙脉联合体的黑社会给它取了“大师”这个名字（Daishi，伪日语中的“伟大之死”）——而事实证明，这个名字一次又一次地准确得令人胆寒。 特性：改进瞄准 - 远程 投放费用倍率：1.21 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The E2 loadout is all energy-based except for its two AMS. Two Large Pulse Lasers and six Medium ones provide a scary amount of damage potential when paired with the advanced targeting computer mounted in the left torso. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Long Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.19 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: E2 配装除两具 AMS 外全部为能量武器。两门大型脉冲激光与六门中型脉冲激光，在左躯干先进的瞄准计算机配合下，具备惊人的伤害潜力。 特性：改进瞄准 - 远程 投放费用倍率：1.19 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Dire Wolf F2 is configured for close quarters combat with its six Stream SRM-6 and 6 Medium Pulse Lasers. The loadout still manages to fit two ER Large Laser to use while closing to closer range, and a leg mounted A-Pod provides defense against infantry attacks. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Long Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.19 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Dire Wolf F2 的配置专为近距离近战而设，搭载六具连发 SRM-6 和 6 门中型脉冲激光。这套配置还设法装下了两门大型增程激光，供逼近目标的途中开火；腿部安装的 A-Pod 则用来防御步兵攻击。 特性：改进瞄准（远程） 投放费用倍率：1.19 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Dire Wolf F3 configuration is presently used mostly with front line regiments and a few reserves. Most other Clans are restricting their 'rookie-resistant' designs to reserve units only. However, Clan Diamond Shark seems determined to correct their past conservative strategy by swinging wildly in the opposite direction, dropping the new design right on the front lines. Some rumours claim this is due to the clan lacking the resources to conduct a full field test of the Dire Wolf F2 before committing it to combat. Only time will tell. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Long Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.19 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Dire Wolf F3配置目前主要配属一线团和少数预备队。其他多数部族都将这类“对新手友好”的设计仅限于预备部队使用。然而，钻石鲨部族似乎决心以向相反方向猛烈摆动来纠正其过去保守的策略，将这款新设计直接放到前线上。有传言称，这是因为该部族缺乏资源，无法在将Dire Wolf F2投入战斗之前进行完整的实地测试。只有时间才能给出答案。 特性：改进瞄准 - 远程 投放费用倍率：1.19 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Part of the Dire Wolf Forward program, the F/C loadout replaces the one-shot SRM from the standard C configuration with a Streak SRM-4. To free the weight capacity for this change, one heat sink had to be removed. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Long Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.19 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为恐狼前瞻计划的一部分，F/C载荷以具连发SRM-4取代标准C配置中的一次性SRM。为腾出重量完成这一改动，不得不拆掉一个散热器。 特性：改进瞄准 - 远程 投放费用倍率：1.19 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The second configuration of the Dire Wolf Forward program, the F/C2 replaces the SRM launcher with a NARC Launcher. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Long Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.19 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为恐狼“前锋”计划的第二种配置，F/C2 以 NARC 发射器替换了 SRM 发射器。 特性：改进瞄准 - 远程 投放费用倍率：1.19 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A customized variant of the Dire Wolf. Piloted by Jin Mehta, the Ultraviolet uses a quartet of Ultra Autocannon/2s, two in each arm, supported with two tons of ammo. Both side torsos utilize an ER PPC, supported by a Medium Pulse Laser. Finally, the center torso sports an LRM 10 with a ton of ammo. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Long Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.21 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 恐狼的定制变型。由金·梅塔驾驶的“紫外线”装备四门 Ultra 自动炮/2，每臂两门，配两吨弹药。两个侧躯干各使用一部 增程粒子炮，并由一门中型脉冲激光支援。最后，中央躯干装有一部 LRM 10 和一吨弹药。 特性：改进瞄准 - 远程 投放费用倍率：1.21 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 'Götterfunken', translating to 'Divine Spark' in common parlance, was the personal Dire Wolf of Hohiro Kurita. The 'Mech was one of the very first produced by Wolf's Dragoons and was a personal gift from Jamie Wolf to Hohiro, amazing the latter with its vastly superior performance compared the common Inner Sphere 'Mechs he had piloted so far. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Long Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.21 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: “神之火花”（俗语中意为“神圣火花”）是库瑞塔宏广的私人恐狼。该机甲是狼之龙骑兵最早生产的机甲之一，由海梅·沃尔夫作为私人礼物赠予宏广；与其此前驾驶的普通内层星域机甲相比，它优越得多的性能令宏广惊叹。 特性：改进瞄准 - 远程 投放费用倍率：1.21 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Hohiro configuration of the Dire Wolf is used by Hohiro Kurita and has a mixed long and short range weapons profile. For long range hitting power, an ER PPC and a Gauss Rifle provide overwhelming punch. To engage enemies at long to medium ranges, three Large Pulse Lasers are carried. One ER Small Laser and one Streak SRM-6 round out this configuration with some short range punch. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Long Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.21 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 恐狼的宏广配置由库瑞塔宏广使用，兼具远程与近程武器。远程打击方面，一门增程粒子炮和一门高斯步枪提供压倒性重拳；中远程交战则有三门大型脉冲激光。一门增程小型激光和一具连发SRM-6为该配置补上近程打击力。 特性：改进瞄准 - 远程 投放费用倍率：1.21 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 'Lone Wolf 2' is inspired by the original Lone Wolf loadout used by Phelan Wolf at his Trial of Position. Downgrading the LRM launchers to only 10 tubes each and removing their Artemis IV FCS, combined with replacing the SRM-6 with an SRM-4 one-shot, allowed adding 5 more heat sinks, greatly improving the heat handling of the 'Mech. Enough weight capacity remained to increase the amount of LB-X ammunition, which could run dry sometimes in the original design. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Long Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.21 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: “Lone Wolf 2”的灵感来自 Phelan Wolf 在其定位试炼中所使用的原始 Lone Wolf 配置。将 LRM 发射器降级为每具仅 10 管并拆除其 Artemis IV 火控系统，再加上用一次性 SRM-4 替换 SRM-6，使得该机得以加装 5 具散热器，大幅改善了热量管理。剩余的重量容量还足以增加 LB-X 弹药数量——在原设计中这些弹药有时会打光。 特性：改进瞄准 - 远程 投放费用倍率：1.21 手臂驱动器限制：全向机甲

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The preferred configuration of Archon-Prince Victor Ian Steiner-Davion, the Prometheus configuration carries a blistering array of weapons that increases its damage potential as it closes range. The primary long range weapons are a pair of ER Large Lasers supported by three Large Pulse Lasers. For close combat, an Ultra Autocannon/20 and an SRM-6 launcher are carried. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Long Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.21 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为大公-亲王维克托·伊恩·斯坦纳-戴维安的首选配置，Prometheus 配置搭载了一套凶猛无比的武器，随着交战距离拉近，其伤害潜力也不断攀升。主要远程武器是两门增程大型激光，并由三门大型脉冲激光提供支援。近战方面，则配备了一门超级自动炮/20 和一部 SRM-6 发射器。 特性：改进瞄准 - 远程 投放费用倍率：1.21 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The personal 'Mech of the Khan of Clan Blood Spirit, William 'Northwind' Campbell, formally named 'Sanguine Essence'. Each arm of the 'Mech carries two Medium Pulse Lasers and one Extended Range Large Laser. These trios of energy weapons gives the 'Mech great close combat hitters as well as a long reach with good punch. A Gauss rifle is installed in the right torso, which, combined with the hitting power of the ERLLs, provides excellent long-range power. Sixteen shots of ammo is split into two bins, one in the right torso and one in the left. The offensive weapons are rounded out with a torso-mounted Extended Range Small Laser. The Sanguine Essence is also outfitted with a highly advanced battlefield electronics, both en ECM suite in the head and an advanced Clan targeting computer in the left torso. The most surprising feature of the 'Mech, though, are the three installed jump jets providing unexpected mobility. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Long Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.21 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是血灵氏族可汗威廉·“北风”·坎贝尔的私人机甲，正式命名为“Sanguine Essence”。机甲每条手臂各装有两门中型脉冲激光和一门增程大型激光。这三组能量武器使该机甲既拥有强悍的近战打击手段，又具备射程远、威力足的远程火力。右躯干内装有一门高斯步枪，与增程大型激光的打击力相结合，提供了极佳的远程威力。十六发弹药分装在两个弹药箱中，一个位于右躯干，一个位于左侧。躯干上的一门增程小型激光进一步完善了进攻武器。Sanguine Essence 还配备了极为先进的战场电子设备：头部的 ECM 套件与左躯干内先进的部族瞄准计算机。不过这台机甲最令人惊奇之处，是它所安装的三台跳跃推进器所带来的出乎意料的机动性。 特性：改进瞄准 - 远程 投放费用倍率：1.21 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: So far Dire Wolf W2 has only been seen in use inside Crusader Clan Wolf and only in the hands of a few bloodnamed warriors. Speculation surrounds this variant and its deployment, and so far it seems the Widowmaker program has only limited support inside the Clan itself. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Long Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.19 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 迄今为止，恐狼W2只见于十字军狼部族内部使用，且仅在少数有血名的战士手中。围绕此变型及其部署有诸多猜测，而到目前为止，“寡妇制造者”计划在部族内部似乎只获得有限支持。 特性：改进瞄准 - 远程 投放费用倍率：1.19 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A custom loadout for the Dire Wolf used by the Wolf's Dragoons, the infamous mercenary outfit. A Gauss Rifle and two ER PPC provides pinpoint long range damage, while two Medium Pulse Lasers add extra firepower at closer ranges. A single ER Small Laser and two AMS provides considerable defensive strength, and a C3 Slave unit makes sure the unit is constantly sharing its targeting information. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Long Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.19 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是狼之龙骑兵团——那支声名狼藉的雇佣兵部队——所使用的恐狼定制配置。一门高斯步枪和两门增程粒子炮提供精确的远程打击，而两门中型脉冲激光则增强近距离火力。一门增程小型激光和两套AMS提供了相当可观的防御能力，一具C3辅助单元则确保该机持续共享其瞄准信息。 特性：改进瞄准 - 远程 投放费用倍率：1.19 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The preferred configuration of the Black Widow Natasha Kerensky, the Widowmaker can do a great deal of damage at any range. For long range combat, an ER PPC backed up by a Large Pulse Laser mounted in each arm. For close combat, the Widowmaker carries three ER Medium Lasers, an ER Small Laser, and an Ultra Autocannon/20. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Long Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.21 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 黑寡妇娜塔莎·克伦斯基偏爱的配置，“寡妇制造者”能在任何距离上造成巨大伤害。远程作战时，它以一门 增程粒子炮为主，并在每只手臂各配一门大型脉冲激光。近距离作战时，“寡妇制造者”携带三门 ER 中型激光、一门 ER 小型激光和一门 Ultra 自动炮/20。 特性：改进瞄准 - 远程 投放费用倍率：1.21 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The configuration of Dire Wolf piloted by Natasha Kerensky at her Trial of Position to test out as a MechWarrior. For long range combat, the ER PPCs are replaced by shoulder-mounted twin LRM-20 launchers with 24 racks, first half being Swarm LRMs and backed up by a Large Pulse Laser mounted in each arm. For close combat, the left torso carries three ER Medium Lasers in triangular configuration in the chest and the stubby LB-X AC/20 with 10 cluster rounds underslung on the right torso. For when things gets dicey, a 'fire and forget' SRM-6 one-shot launcher above cockpit, just aft of the hatch and only 20 double strength heat sinks. This configuration was created just for her Trial of Position and seldom used again. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Long Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.21 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是娜塔莎·克伦斯基在晋升试炼中为考核机甲战士资格所驾驶的恐狼配置。远程作战方面，增程粒子炮被换成肩载双联LRM-20发射器（共24联），前半为蜂群LRM，并由装在双臂的大型脉冲激光支援；近战时，左躯干以三角布局在胸前装三门增程中型激光，右躯干下方则悬挂那门短粗的LB-X AC/20（配10发集束弹）；万一情况棘手，座舱上方、舱门后方还有一具“发射后不管”的一次性SRM-6发射器，而双倍强度散热器仅有20个。这一配置专为她的晋升试炼而造，此后很少再用。 特性：改进瞄准 - 远程 投放费用倍率：1.21 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A loadout of the Dire Wolf normally only used for Batchalls between clans. A large combination of weapons allows for handling of most situations that can arise, but without providing the resilience for extended engagements. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Long Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.19 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是恐狼（Dire Wolf）的一套配置，通常只用于部族之间的“议战”（Batchall）。大量的武器组合足以应对大多数可能出现的情况，但无法提供长时间交战所需的持久力。 特性：改进瞄准 - 远距 投放费用倍率：1.19 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Dragon DRG-1ALAG is a custom variant developer for the Amphigean Light Assault Group mercenary forced during the long contract to the DCMS. The variant replaces the LRM-10 launcher with a much shorter range SRM-4 and a Flamer, but this in turn allows upgrading the AC/5 to an AC/10. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Dragon DRG-1ALAG 是雇佣兵部队 Amphigean Light Assault Group 在与 DCMS 长期签约期间自行开发的定制变型。该变型用射程短得多的 SRM-4 和一门火焰喷射器取代了 LRM-10 发射器，而这反过来又使其得以把 AC/5 升级为 AC/10。 特性：稳定 投放费用倍率：1.06 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Dragon DRG-2ALAG drops the flamer of the DRG-1ALAG to instead fit another ton of ammunition for the Autocannon/10. Otherwise the designs are identical. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 龙DRG-2ALAG拆掉DRG-1ALAG的火焰喷射器，改为多带一吨自动炮/10弹药，其余设计完全相同。 特性：稳定 投放费用倍率：1.06 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This Custom Dragon was piloted by Warlord Syovo Yorioshi from 25th May to 26th September 3025 during the Battle of Galtor III. Only the left-arm mounted Medium Laser remains, with Large Laser in the right arm and an SRM4 and Flamer mounted in the Center. A Small Laser was also installed next to the Cockpit, with an additional 5 Heat Sinks and 3 more tons of armor. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这台定制 Dragon 由军阀 Syovo Yorioshi 在 3025 年 5 月 25 日至 9 月 26 日的高尔特三世战役期间驾驶。它只保留左臂的中型激光，右臂装大型激光，中央则装 SRM4 与火焰喷射器。座舱旁还加装了一门小型激光，并额外增加 5 具散热器与 3 吨装甲。 特性：稳定 投放费用倍率：1.1 手臂驱动器限制：左臂下部、右臂下部

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The DRG-5ALAG is the Amphigean Light Assault Group's take on improving the previous Dragon DRG-1ALAG with the updates introduced by the DRG-5N for their purposes. By replacing the AC/10 with a Gauss Rifle they found it considerably more useful due its increased range, while also allowing for more colling and two more lasers. The success of this variant eventually led to parts of the DRG-7N design. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: DRG-5ALAG是两栖轻突击集团对改进前代龙DRG-1ALAG的理解，把DRG-5N引入的更新按自身需要加以应用。以一门高斯步枪取代AC/10后，他们发现由于射程提升，该机甲实用得多，同时也腾出空间用于更多冷却和另外两门激光。此变型的成功最终促成了DRG-7N设计的一部分。 特性：稳定 投放费用倍率：1.08 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A 28th century design that first saw production in 3058, the Dragon Fire is a 75-ton mech designed for brawling. The DRG-3F is armed with a Gauss Rifle and an LB-10X, with a Large Laser and a pair of Medium Pulse Lasers as secondary weapons. A 300-rated XL Engine and an Endo Steel Skeleton provide the weight need for the heavy payload, while CASE and Guardian ECM add to the designs survivability. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 龙火是28世纪的设计，于3058年首次投产，是75吨的近战机甲。DRG-3F装有一门高斯步枪和一门LB-10X，次要武器为一门大型激光和一对中型脉冲激光。一台300额定XL引擎与内骨架结构提供了这套重载荷所需的重量，CASE与守护者电子对抗套件则提升该设计的生存性。 特性：易于维护 投放费用倍率：1.11 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A 28th century design that first saw production in 3058, the Dragon Fire is a 75-ton mech designed for brawling. The DRG-4F is armed with a Gauss Rifle and an LB-10X, with an ER Large Laser and a pair of Medium Pulse Lasers as secondary weapons. A 300-rated XL Engine and an Endo Steel Skeleton provide the weight need for the heavy payload, while CASE and Guardian ECM add to the designs survivability. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 龙火是28世纪的设计，于3058年首次投产，是75吨的近战机甲。DRG-4F装有一门高斯步枪和一门LB-10X，次要武器为一门增程大型激光和一对中型脉冲激光。一台300额定XL引擎与内骨架结构提供了这套重载荷所需的重量，CASE与守护者电子对抗套件则提升该设计的生存性。 特性：易于维护 投放费用倍率：1.11 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Dragoon AEM-01 is armed with only a few, but powerful, weapons in the 'Mech's arms. The main damage is provided by a pair of LB 10-X Autocannons with a long-reaching ER PPC as backup. Powered by a 280-rated XL Fusion Engines, the 'Mech is able to achieve a modest pace of 64 km/h. Its defenses include a Guardian ECM Suite, while its hull is protected by 11.5 tons of Ferro-Fibrous armor. Quirk: Modular Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 龙骑兵AEM-01只在机甲手臂上装少数但强力的武器：主要伤害来自一对LB 10-X自动炮，以一门远程增程粒子炮作为后手。它由一台280额定XL聚变引擎驱动，能达到64公里/小时的不快速度。防御方面有一套守护者电子对抗套件，车体由11.5吨铁纤维装甲保护。 特性：模块化武器 投放费用倍率：1.1 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Designed as a short-ranged fighter, the -02 is armed with a single ER PPC, the remaining weapons space is filled by five medium lasers, a small pulse laser, and an AC/20. At the price of dropping its jump jets, the 'Mech's engine has been upgraded to an XL 350 to allow the 'Mech to close in quicker than the original model. Quirk: Modular Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: -02被设计为近程战斗机，装一门单独的增程粒子炮，其余武器空间则由五门中型激光、一门小型脉冲激光和一门AC/20填满。以放弃跳跃推进器为代价，该机甲的引擎升级为XL 350，使其能比原型更快地逼近。 特性：模块化武器 投放费用倍率：1.1 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Designed as a long-range fire support unit, the Dragoon -03 retains the same engine specifications of the Dragoon -01 model. Its principal weaponry includes 3 Artemis IV FCS-guided 15-tubed LRM Launchers with 2 tons of CASE-protected ammunition. Backup weapons include a single medium laser, with a duo of medium and small pulse lasers for close-in defense. Quirk: Modular Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Dragoon -03被设计为远程火力支援单位，保留了Dragoon -01型相同的引擎规格。其主要武器包括3具由Artemis IV火控系统制导的15管LRM发射器，配2吨受CASE保护的弹药。副武器包括一门中型激光，以及中型和小型脉冲激光各一对，用于近距防御。 特性：模块化武器 投放费用倍率：1.1 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Based on a weapon-stripped -01 model, -04's long-ranged weapons come in the form of a single Gauss rifle and an ER PPC. Its short-ranged weapons include four SRM 4s and a pair of Medium Lasers. Quirk: Modular Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: -04 以拆除武器的 -01 型为基础，其远程武器为一门高斯步枪和一门增程粒子炮；近程武器包括四具 SRM 4 和两门中型激光。 特性：模块化武器 投放费用倍率：1.1 手臂驱动器限制：左上臂、右上臂

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The first Ice Hellion mech to be built entirely of Clan tech, the 30 ton Drift Shag entered production in the early Golden Age. A conversion of the older Falcon BattleMech, the Drift Shag is built around a 210-rated XL Engine and armed with an ER Large Laser. A quartet of ER Small Lasers and a Medium Pulse Laser support the ER Large at close range. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是冰地狱狮首款完全由部族技术打造的机甲，30吨的漂白鸬鹚在黄金时代早期投产。它是较旧猎鹰战斗机甲的改造版，围绕一台210额定XL引擎建造，装有一门增程大型激光；四门增程小型激光和一门中型脉冲激光在近距支援这门增程大型激光。 特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：1.03

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Duan Gung D9-G9's primary weapon is a LRM-10 launcher, which allows the 'Mech to hit targets at up to 630 meters, while also giving the Duan Gung indirect fire support capabilities. For close-range engagements, the 'Mech has two medium lasers. Quirk: Protected Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 段弓D9-G9的主武器是一具LRM-10发射器，使该机甲能打击远达630米的目标，同时赋予段弓间接火力支援能力。近距交战时，该机甲有两门中型激光。 特性：受保护驱动器 投放费用倍率：0.98

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Produced in 3058 by Curtiss Militech, the Eagle is an effort to create a balanced mix of speed and firepower on a 25-ton chassis. The 1M sports an ER large laser and an ER small laser, along with an anti-missile system. Five jump jets allow it to maintain decent mobility, but its overland speed is lacking compared to similarly weighted BattleMechs. Quirk: Extended Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.96 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 柯蒂斯·米尔泰克于3058年生产的鹰，力求在25吨底盘上实现速度与火力的平衡。1M装有一门增程大型激光和一门增程小型激光，另有一套反导弹系统。五具跳跃推进器让它保持不错的机动性，但越野速度相比同重量级战斗机甲有所不足。 特性：扩展躯干旋转 投放费用倍率：0.96 手臂驱动器限制：右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Produced in 3058 by Curtiss Militech, the Eagle is an effort to create a balanced mix of speed and firepower on a 25-ton chassis. The 2M sports an ER large laser and an ER medium laser, along with a TAG laser designator to spot for its lancemates. Five jump jets allow it to maintain decent mobility, but its overland speed is lacking compared to similarly weighted BattleMechs. Quirk: Extended Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.96 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 柯蒂斯·米尔泰克于3058年生产的鹰，力求在25吨底盘上实现速度与火力的平衡。2M装有一门增程大型激光和一门增程中型激光，另有一具TAG激光指示器为同小队成员指示目标。五具跳跃推进器让它保持不错的机动性，但越野速度相比同重量级战斗机甲有所不足。 特性：扩展躯干旋转 投放费用倍率：0.96 手臂驱动器限制：右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Once fielded in great numbers by the Smoke Jaguars, the Ebon Jaguar has proliferated to many of Kerensky's Clans, though some, like the Wolves, Jade Falcons and Coyotes, continue to field Hellbringers instead. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 乌木美洲豹曾被烟虎氏族大量装备，如今已扩散到克伦斯基的众多氏族，尽管有些氏族（如狼、翡翠隼和郊狼）仍继续使用地狱使者。 特质：窄小低矮轮廓 投放费用倍率：1.1 臂部驱动器限制：全能

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The primitive Eisenfaust EFT-2 model was intended to carry the AC/10 into a siege or defensive engagement. This simple design mandate was quickly warped into an entirely different machine. For close work the 'Mech carried two medium lasers while a large laser provided long range and ammunition free firepower. The Coventry Defense Conglomerate was unable to overcome the inherent limitations of primitive technology however, resulting in a thinly armored and clumsy 'Mech that could only reach a top speed of 32 km/h. The single ton of ammunition provided to the Eisenfaust's main weapon didn't help. The CDC only produced one prototype unit for the LCAF. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.83
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 原始型的Eisenfaust EFT-2原本打算把AC/10带入攻城或防御作战。但这项简单的设计要求很快被扭曲成了一台完全不同的机器。近战方面，这台机甲装有两门中型激光，而一门大型激光则提供无需弹药的远程火力。然而Coventry Defense Conglomerate无法克服原始技术的固有局限，最终造出一台装甲单薄、动作笨拙、最高时速仅32 km/h的机甲。而Eisenfaust主武器只配一吨弹药的配置也帮不上忙。CDC只为LCAF生产了一台原型机。 特性：易于维护 投放费用倍率：0.83

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This Eisenfaust model was the original prototype developed in 2515. Though several were produced, Defiance Industries only used them to test weapons and equipment configurations for the EFT-7X. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.01 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这款铁拳是2515年研制的原始原型机。尽管生产了数台，迪法恩斯工业只将它们用于为EFT-7X测试武器与装备配置。 特性：易于维护 投放费用倍率：1.01 手臂驱动器限制：左上

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The standard against which all battle armor is measured, the Elemental battle armor was first introduced in 2868 by Clan Wolf in a Trial of Possession against the Nova Cats. It was a marvel of Clan engineering that allowed a small group of operators to take down large 'Mechs and survive the encounter. While it is possible for a normal-sized human to use the battle armor, this design is tailored for the Clans' giant Elemental warriors and only they can bring out its fullest potential. Quirk: Standard Parts Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.93 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为衡量一切战斗装甲的标准，元素战斗装甲于 2868 年由狼氏族在与新星猫的占有试炼中首次推出。它是氏族工程的奇迹，让一小队操作员能击倒大型机甲并全身而退。虽然普通体型的人也能使用这套装甲，但该设计是为氏族巨大的元素战士量身定制，只有他们才能发挥其全部潜力。 特质：标准部件 投放费用倍率：0.93 可挂载全能单位，可近战，可蜂群攻击。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This variant was created by Clan Wolf in 3050 to carry out decapitation strikes against Inner Sphere command personnel during the Clan Invasion. It removes the missile launcher to include an additional Power Pack, Heat and Improved Sensors, a Remote Sensor Dispenser, and a pair of extra Fuel Tanks for its jump jets, while mounting a fixed anti-personnel Machine Gun in addition to the anti-personnel weapon mount. Quirk: Standard Parts Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.93 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该变型由狼族部族于3050年创造，用于在部族入侵期间对内层星域的指挥人员实施斩首打击。它移除导弹发射器，以加装额外的动力包、热感应器与改进传感器、1具遥控传感器撒布器，以及2只为其跳跃推进器准备的额外燃料箱，同时在反步兵武器挂架之外固定安装1挺反步兵机枪。 <特性：标准零件 <投放费用倍率：0.93 <可搭载全向单位，可近战，可攀爬攻击。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The standard against which all battle armor is measured, the Elemental battle armor was first introduced in 2868 by Clan Wolf in a Trial of Possession against the Nova Cats. It was a marvel of Clan engineering that allowed a small group of operators to take down large 'Mechs and survive the encounter. While it is possible for a normal-sized human to use the battle armor, this design is tailored for the Clans' giant Elemental warriors and only they can bring out its fullest potential. Quirk: Standard Parts Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.93 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.
