Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A unique variant of the Emperor which was discovered in a Brian Cache by Clan Goliath Scorpion MechWarrior Nerran. The Clan warrior restored the ancient 'Mech by refitting the right arm's LB 10-X Autocannons with Clan produced Gauss Rifle and placed a Star League tech ER PPC in the right torso. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.2 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是皇帝的一个独特变型，由部族歌利亚蝎的机甲战士尼兰在一处布莱恩库中发现。这位部族战士让这台古老机甲重获新生：将右臂的LB 10-X自动炮改装为部族生产的高斯步枪，并在右躯干装上一门星际联盟科技的增程粒子炮。 特性：指挥机甲 投放费用倍率：1.2 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Carries Clan-spec ER large lasers, an LB 10-X and LB 5-X, supported by a prototype Streak SRM-4. Used extensively by Clan Star Adder before getting replaced by various Highlander variants. Quirk: Improved Cooling Jacket - Laser Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 搭载部族规格的增程大型激光、一门 LB 10-X 和一门 LB 5-X，并由一具原型连发 SRM-4 提供支援。星蝰部族曾大量使用，后来被各种 Highlander 变型取代。 特性：改进冷却护套 - 激光 投放费用倍率：1.16 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Using a mixture of newly developed or prototype weapons paired with older SLDF surplus, the Emperor EC was produced by the Star Adders before being supplanted by the development of the Highlander IIC. Quirk: Improved Cooling Jacket - Laser Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 皇帝EC混合使用新研制的武器或原型武器与较旧的星际联盟防卫军剩余装备，由星蝰部族生产，后来随着高地人IIC的研制而被取代。 特性：改进冷却套件（激光） 投放费用倍率：1.16 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Created during the Golden Age by Clan Mongoose, the Enfield END-6J-EC incorporates newly developed technology into the original END-6J design. Powered by a 250-rated Fusion Core, the Enfield END-6J-EC is armed with an Improved Large Laser and a prototype UAC/10, with a Medium Laser filling the remaining tonnage. Quirk: Extended Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.02 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 恩菲尔德END-6J-EC由猫鼬部族在黄金时代打造，把新开发的技术融入原END-6J设计。它由一台250额定聚变核心驱动，装有一门改进型大型激光和一原型UAC/10，余下吨位则由一门中型激光填补。 特性：扩展躯干旋转 投放费用倍率：1.02 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An attempted modernization of the Enforcer that never was mass produced, the -4D carries a ER PPC and a LB 10-X Autocannon, with a Guardian ECM for sensor protection. With the launch of the Enforcer III this variant was quickly forgotten. Quirk: Improved Cooling Jacket - AC Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是对执行者的一次现代化尝试，但从未量产。该型号搭载1门增程粒子炮和1门LB 10-X自动炮，并配1具守护者电子对抗套件保护传感器。随着执行者III的推出，这一变型很快就被遗忘了。 <特性：改进冷却套（自动炮） <投放费用倍率：1.04 <手臂驱动器限制：左臂下段，右臂下段

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A Kell Hound's custom upgrade, replacing most of the internals and equipment with Clan tech. Sporting Clan Ferro-Fibrous armor allows a better protection for only 8 ton weight. With the improved cooling of using Clan Double Heat Sinks, the -4KH can mount a Large Pulse Laser together with the Ultra AC/10 and an ER Small Laser for anti-infantry protection. Quirk: Improved Cooling Jacket - AC Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是凯尔猎犬的定制升级，把大部分内部结构与设备换成部族技术。采用部族铁纤维装甲，仅八吨重量便获得更好的防护。凭借部族双散热器带来的冷却改善，-4KH能装一门大型脉冲激光，外加超级AC/10，以及一门增程小型激光用于反步兵防护。 特性：改进冷却套 - 自动炮 投放费用倍率：1.1 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Only retaining the 4R's torso mounted Small Laser, the 4P instead mounts an AC/20 in the right arm and a pair of Medium Lasers in the left arm. Carrying three tons of autocannon ammunition and eleven Double Heat Sinks, the 4P is powered by 250-rated standard engine, saving weight through the use of Ferro-Fibrous armor and Endo-Steel internal structure. Quirk: Improved Cooling Jacket - AC Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 4P只保留4R躯干上的小型激光，右臂改装一门AC/20，左臂一对中型激光。它带三吨自动炮弹药和十一个双散热器，由一台250额定标准引擎驱动，并借助铁纤维装甲与内骨架内部结构减轻重量。 特性：改进冷却套 - 自动炮 投放费用倍率：1.04 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The personal 'Mech of Fox's Teeth member Daniel Waylen, after his unit was selected to receive among the first experimental weapons developed from the Helm Memory Core by the New Avalon Institute of Science in the lead-up to the War of 3039, his Enforcer was chosen as the test bed for an experimental NAIS Mk. I Gauss Rifle prototype. To free up the mass required for this weapon and two tons of reloads, the NAIS engineers adopted the laser armament from the original design, mounting a pair of ChisComp 39 Medium Lasers in the left arm in place of the large laser. Quirk: Accurate Weapon - Gauss Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是“狐牙”成员丹尼尔·韦伦的专属机甲。在 3039 年战争前夕，新阿瓦隆科学院利用地狱核心开发出首批实验性武器，韦伦所在的部队被选中接收其中一部分，他的 Enforcer 也被选为实验型 NAIS Mk. I 高斯步枪原型的测试平台。为腾出这门武器以及两吨弹药所需的重量，NAIS 工程师沿用了原始设计的激光武器配置，在左臂以两门 ChisComp 39 中型激光取代大型激光。 特性：精准武器（高斯） 投放费用倍率：1.06 手臂驱动器限制：左臂下部、右臂下部

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A battlefield refit of the -4R upgrading the cooling to double heat sinks, a change that allows dropping two external heat sinks and still improve the overall cooling performance. The saved weight is used for a second Small Laser, a C3 unit and a CASE system for the AC/10 ammunition. Quirk: Improved Cooling Jacket - AC Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是-4R的野战改装，把冷却升级为双散热器；这一改动使它可以拆掉两个外部散热器而仍然改善整体散热表现。省下的重量用于加装第二门小型激光、一台C3单元，以及为AC/10弹药加装CASE系统。 特性：改进冷却套 - 自动炮 投放费用倍率：1.04 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The -4R-WDR is a custom refit of the stock variant by the mercenary outfit the Wolf's Dragoons, improving the 'Mech considerably by using Clan tech. Using a 200 XL engine allows extra free weight, used to improve the cooling and a mounting C3 unit. Quirk: Improved Cooling Jacket - AC Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: -4R-WDR是雇佣兵部队狼之龙骑兵对现成变型的定制改装，使用部族技术大幅改进该机甲。采用200 XL引擎腾出额外自由重量，用于改善冷却并加装一台C3单元。 特性：改进冷却套 - 自动炮 投放费用倍率：1.1 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: While the body of his 'Mech was factory refitted to the 5D standard after the initial Clan Invasion, Waylen adopted a more modern version of its War of '39 weapons loadout, carrying a now refined Gauss Rifle, two ER Medium Lasers in the left arm and a single torso mounted ER Small Laser. Quirk: Accurate Weapon - Gauss Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在部族入侵初期，他的机甲机体被厂方改装到5D标准，但韦伦采用了其“39年战争”武器载荷的更现代版本：一门经过改进的高斯步枪、左臂两门增程中型激光，以及躯干上一门单独的增程小型激光。 特性：精准武器 - 高斯 投放费用倍率：1.06 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An alternate loadout to the -5D, the -5DR exchanges the ER Large Laser for an ER PPC, dropping the Ferro-Fibrous armor but instead using an Endo Steel structure and finally switches to double heat sinks. These changes further allows the addition of an Beagle active probe. Quirk: Improved Cooling Jacket - AC Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是-5D的另一种载荷，-5DR以一门增程粒子炮取代增程大型激光，放弃铁纤维装甲而改用内骨架结构，并最终改用双散热器。这些改动还进一步允许加装一台比格犬主动探测器。 特性：改进冷却套 - 自动炮 投放费用倍率：1.04 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The -5P is an uncommon variant mounting twin Ultra AC/5s at the cost of less armor and only 2 Jump Jets. Quirk: Improved Cooling Jacket - AC Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: -5P是一种少见变型，装双联超级AC/5，代价是装甲更薄且只有2具跳跃推进器。 特性：改进冷却套 - 自动炮 投放费用倍率：1.04 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Enforcer 7S is an NAIS prototype carrying a mostly functional Gauss rifle prototype. This one seems to be stolen. Quirk: Accurate Weapon - Gauss Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Enforcer 7S 是 NAIS 的原型机，搭载一门基本可用的高斯步枪原型。这一台似乎是偷来的。 特性：精准武器 - 高斯 投放费用倍率：1.05 手臂驱动器限制：左臂下部、右臂下部

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 'Ghillie' is built for Davion's NAIS' Team Banzai, named after the camouflage suits often worn by snipers. It carries an Improved Gauss Rifle and Electronics to be formidable Skirmisher and Scout. Quirk: Accurate Weapon - Gauss Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.07 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: “吉利服”（Ghillie）是为 Davion 的 NAIS 下属 Banzai 小队打造的，名字取自狙击手常穿着的伪装服。它搭载改进型高斯步枪与电子设备，因而成为强悍的游击与侦察机甲。 特性：精准武器 - 高斯 投放费用倍率：1.07 手臂驱动器限制：左臂下部、右臂下部

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A research variant of the Enforcer by the New Avalon Institute of Science for Worst Case, a scenario created to deal with any situation by using the latest and greatest technology. The result was not as great as hoped, as the ENF-NAIS-WC never got far beyond prototype stage. Lessons learned during its design were however used for later models and their improvements. Quirk: Improved Cooling Jacket - AC Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是新阿瓦隆科学研究所为“最坏情况”项目打造的研究型 Enforcer 变型——该项目旨在运用最新、最强的技术应对任何局面。结果并未达到预期，ENF-NAIS-WC 始终没能走出原型阶段。不过，其设计过程中获得的经验被用于后续型号及其改进。 特性：改进冷却套 - 自动炮 投放费用倍率：1.04 手臂驱动器限制：左下臂、右下臂

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The aging Enforcer was commissioned to be redesigned by then First Prince Victor Steiner-Davion in an effort to rebuild his image within the sundered Federated Commonwealth. The resulting Enforcer III is built on a Endo Steel chassis, with further weight savings achieved through the use of a 250 XL Engine. Five jump jets grants a jumping capability of one hundred and fifty meters. The Enforcer III is armored with ten tons of standard armor that gives it good armor protection for its size. The Enforcer III carries as its primary weapon a UAC/10, backed up by an ER Large Laser and an ER Small Laser. This balanced mix of weapons makes the Enforcer III a powerful medium 'Mech. Quirk: Barrel Fist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 为在分裂的联邦共和国中重塑形象，时任第一王子维克托·施泰纳-达维昂下令对老旧的 Enforcer 进行重新设计。由此诞生的 Enforcer III 采用内骨架机体，并通过换装 250 XL 引擎进一步减轻重量。五具跳跃推进器赋予其一百五十米的跳跃能力。Enforcer III 披挂十吨标准装甲，就体型而言防护相当出色。它的主武器是一门 UAC/10，辅以一门大型增程激光和一门小型增程激光。这种均衡的武器搭配使 Enforcer III 成为一具强大的中型机甲。 特性：炮管拳 投放费用倍率：1.04 手臂驱动器限制：左臂下部、右臂下部

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Epimetheus was equipped with Clan armor and weaponry. As the cockpit was moved to the torso, extra space was available in the 'Mech's head. This space was filled by an Ultra AC/10. Each arm mounted an ER Large Laser and Medium Pulse Laser. All the weapons were tied into a Clan Targeting Computer that made the weapons extraordinarily accurate. Quirk: Multi Trac Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.22
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 厄庇墨透斯配备了部族装甲与武器。由于驾驶舱被移至躯干，机甲头部因此空出了额外空间，而这部分空间由一门超级AC/10填补。每只手臂各安装一门增程大型激光和一门中型脉冲激光。所有武器都接入一台部族瞄准计算机，使其精准度异常出众。 特性：多目标追踪 投放费用倍率：1.22

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A slightly modified version for Solaris 7 arenas. It removes the torso mounted cockpit to fit one more heat sink. Quirk: Multi Trac Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.22
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 为 Solaris 7 竞技场稍作修改的版本。它拆除了躯干座舱，以便多装一具散热器。 特性：多重追踪 投放费用倍率：1.22

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 3BK is a refurbished version of older Excalibur B2 models mainly sold to the periphery states. It drops the AMS for a C3 slave and some more armor. Quirk: Breaching Shot Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 3BK是较旧的神剑B2型号的翻新版本，主要卖给外围国家。它拆掉反导弹系统，换装一台C3从机和更多装甲。 特性：破甲射击 投放费用倍率：1.1 手臂驱动器限制：右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Excalibur BattleMech was designed to blend range and mobility, boasting an impressive top speed for its tonnage. The name comes from the unique appearance of its lower right arm actuator, reminiscent of a medieval Terran sword. The B1 was the first model of Excalibur to be produced and served as a solid basis for all models to follow. Quirk: Breaching Shot Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 神剑战斗机甲的设计意在融合射程与机动性，就其吨位而言最高速度相当可观。它的名字来自右下臂驱动器独特的外观——让人想起中世纪地球的剑。B1是神剑首款量产型号，为此后所有型号奠定了坚实基础。 特性：破甲射击 投放费用倍率：1.1 手臂驱动器限制：右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Excalibur BattleMech was designed to blend range and mobility, boasting an impressive top speed for its tonnage. The name comes from the unique appearance of its lower right arm actuator, reminiscent of a medieval Terran sword. The B2 is the standard model of Excalibur adopted by the SLDF in 2620, serving well during Operation Smother and the Amaris Civil War. Quirk: Breaching Shot Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 神剑战斗机甲的设计意在融合射程与机动性，就其吨位而言最高速度相当可观。它的名字来自右下臂驱动器独特的外观——让人想起中世纪地球的剑。B2是SLDF于2620年采用的神剑标准型号，在“窒息行动”与阿马里斯内战期间表现良好。 特性：破甲射击 投放费用倍率：1.08 手臂驱动器限制：右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Excalibur BattleMech was designed to blend range and mobility, boasting an impressive top speed for its tonnage. The name comes from the unique appearance of its lower right arm actuator, reminiscent of a medieval Terran sword. The B2b model was utilised by the Star League's Royal Divisions and boasted more advanced components over the stock B2. Quirk: Breaching Shot Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 神剑战斗机甲的设计意在融合射程与机动性，就其吨位而言最高速度相当可观。它的名字来自右下臂驱动器独特的外观——让人想起中世纪地球的剑。B2b型号由星际联盟皇家师使用，相较标准B2配备了更先进的部件。 特性：破甲射击 投放费用倍率：1.1 手臂驱动器限制：右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A Clan-tech overhaul of the original SLDF Royal Excalibur B2b. The B2b-EC enjoys the early fruits of Clan weapons research, but otherwise retains the original Spheroid technology. Quirk: Breaching Shot Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是对原SLDF皇家Excalibur B2b进行的部族技术全面翻修。B2b-EC享受到了部族武器研究的早期成果，其余部分则保留了原本的内层星域技术。 特性：穿透射击 投放费用倍率：1.1 手臂驱动器限制：右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Excalibur BattleMech was designed to blend range and mobility, boasting an impressive top speed for its tonnage. The name comes from the unique appearance of its lower right arm actuator, reminiscent of a medieval Terran sword. The C1 is a later model of the Excalibur produced during the Clan Invasion Era. The redesign aimed to address the notorious lack of armor present on the B2. Quirk: Breaching Shot Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Excalibur 战斗机甲的设计旨在兼顾射程与机动性，就其吨位而言最高速度相当惊人。其名称源自它右臂下部驱动器独特的外观，形似中世纪地球的剑。C1 是部族入侵时代生产的较晚型号的 Excalibur，这次重新设计旨在解决 B2 上臭名昭著的装甲不足问题。 特性：穿透射击 投放费用倍率：1.08 手臂驱动器限制：右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A customized variant of the Executioner supposedly piloted by Gorman Bekker, the Cherbi carries a massive Ultra AC/20 in its right arm, supported by a trio of ER Small Lasers in the left arm and a Streak SRM-6 rack in the left torso. A single LRM-20 launcher int he right torso provides some ranged firepower, with Cherbi carrying two tons each of Ultra Autocannon and Long Range Missile reloads with a single ton for the ammo-efficient Streak Missile Launcher. Quirk: Intimidating Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.2 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 据称由戈尔曼·贝克尔驾驶的刽子手定制变型，“切尔比”在右臂装有一门巨型 Ultra AC/20，左臂以三门 ER 小型激光支援，左躯干则有一组连发 SRM-6。右躯干的一部 LRM-20 发射器提供了一定的远程火力；“切尔比”为 Ultra 自动炮和远程导弹各携带两吨再装填弹药，而弹药效率极高的连发导弹发射器只用一吨。 特性：威吓 投放费用倍率：1.2 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Using recently developed heavy laser technology, the Executioner H specializes in close combat, and mounts a Heavy Large Laser for prodigious medium-range firepower. Complementing the laser is a devastatingly powerful Ultra Autocannon/20. Supporting this heavy firepower is a pair of ER Medium Lasers and a Flamer, which is very effective against infantry, and is also a powerful tactical weapon. Quirk: Intimidating Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Executioner H 运用新近研发的重型激光技术，专精于近距离战斗，搭载一具重型大型激光，可提供惊人的中距离火力。与之相配的是一门威力骇人的超级自动炮/20。为这一重型火力提供支援的是两具增程中型激光和一具火焰喷射器；后者对步兵极为有效，同时也是一种强力战术武器。 特性：威吓 投放费用倍率：1.18 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The N configuration of the Executioner was an attempt to make the 'Mech less ammunition reliant. However, instead it created major issues with heat management and the practically all energy loadout never got produced in any larger batches. Quirk: Intimidating Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 行刑者的N配置试图让该机甲减少对弹药的依赖，结果却在热量管理上造成了重大问题，这套几乎全能量的载荷从未大批量生产。 特性：威吓 投放费用倍率：1.18 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A Missile Boat version of the Executioner, the O carries two side torso mounted ATM 12 launchers combined with an assortment of lasers - the largest which is a Large Pulse Laser. Four tons of various ATM ammunition allows the loadout some further flexibility. Quirk: Intimidating Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: O是Executioner的导弹平台版本，两侧躯干各装一具ATM 12发射器，并搭配多种激光，其中最大的是大型脉冲激光。四吨各式ATM弹药为这套配置提供了更多灵活性。 特性：威慑 投放费用倍率：1.18 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Q configuration has a slight focus on more survivability, in the way of an Anti-Missile System and an ECM Suite. Besides this the 'Mech also carries a four ton Targeting Computer to support the two Large and four Medium Pulse Lasers. Quirk: Intimidating Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Q 配置略微侧重提升生存能力，为此加装了反导弹系统和一套电子对抗套件。除此之外，该机甲还搭载了一台四吨重的瞄准计算机，用于辅助两门大型脉冲激光和四门中型脉冲激光。 特性：威吓 投放费用倍率：1.18 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An unofficial configuration mostly used by Mercenary bands that somehow managed to aquire the 'Mech. The weapons consist of a Light Gauss Rifle, two ER Large Lasers and one LRM10 launcher, and a C3 slave unit rounds out the build. Quirk: Intimidating Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一种非官方配置，主要被那些不知用什么办法弄到这台机甲的雇佣兵团使用。武器包括一门轻型高斯步枪、两门增程大型激光和一具LRM10发射器，另有一台C3从属单元补全整套配置。 特性：威慑 投放费用倍率：1.18 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A command configuration of the Executioner, combining a C3 Master system with advanced ECM and Sensors. The 'Mech still manages to fit a combination of ER and Pulse Lasers to defend itself, or even help with the actual battle in times of crisis. Quirk: Intimidating Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是行刑者的指挥配置，把C3主机系统与先进电子对抗和传感器结合。该机甲仍设法装下增程与脉冲激光的组合用于自卫，危机时刻甚至能直接参与战斗。 特性：威吓 投放费用倍率：1.18 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A Battle of Tukayyid 'temporary configuration' that became a standard variant, the TC is an energy boat with limited recon capabilities. The right arm carries the customary pair of energy weapons, in this case Large Pulse Lasers. The left arm carries an ER PPC, an ER Small Laser, and an additional heat sink. Two more ER Small Lasers are mounted in the right torso. The right torso also carries an additional heat sink and an Active Probe that allows the TC to detect hidden enemy units. Drastically increasing the lethality of the TC, a Targeting Computer in the left torso helps ensure the 'Mech hits what it shoots at. Quirk: Intimidating Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: TC 是图卡伊德战役中的“临时配置”，后来成了标准变型；它是一台能量武器平台，具备有限的侦察能力。右臂装有一贯成对配置的能量武器，此处为大型脉冲激光。左臂装有一门 ER PPC、一门增程小型激光和一个额外的散热器。右躯干另装有两门增程小型激光。右躯干还带有一个额外的散热器和一个主动探测器，使 TC 能侦测隐藏的敌方单位。左躯干中的瞄准计算机大幅提升了 TC 的致命性，帮助机甲确保打中它瞄准的目标。 特性：威吓 投放费用倍率：1.18 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A configuration almost fully focused on ballistic weapons, the Executioner-B A brings a LB 10-X and an Ultra AC/10 in each arm. Two ER Small Lasers provide some improved anti-infantry defense. Although the heavy focus on ballistic reduces the flexibility of the design, this configuration still is amongst the more favored as it actually has excessive cooling capacity. Quirk: Distracting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这一配置几乎完全专注于弹道武器，Executioner-B A 每臂各带一门 LB 10-X 和一门 Ultra AC/10。两门增程小型激光提供了一定的反步兵防御能力。尽管对弹道武器的重度偏重降低了这一设计的灵活性，但它仍是较受欢迎的配置之一，因为它的散热能力实际上相当过剩。 特性：干扰 投放费用倍率：1.18 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The B configuration of the Executioner-B mounts a Gauss Rifle in each arm as well as two ER Large Lasers for long range engagements. Four Medium Pulse Lasers provide extra damage at closer ranges. Even with 18 double heat sinks the 'Mech still suffers from easy overheating due to the many energy weapons. Quirk: Distracting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 行刑者-B 的 B 型配置在每条手臂上各装一门高斯步枪，另有两门增程大型激光用于远距离交战。四门中型脉冲激光在更近的距离上提供额外伤害。即使有18个双散热器，由于能量武器众多，这台机甲依然很容易过热。 特性：扰敌 投放费用倍率：1.18 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The C configuration is focused at long-range assaults with its four ER PPC and two Ultra AC/5. To help with protection at close range, two SRM-2 launchers were added, but they seldom see much use in practice due to the far too weak cooling capabilities of the 'Mech. Quirk: Distracting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: C 型配置以四门增程粒子炮和两门 Ultra AC/5 专注于远程强攻。为增强近距离自卫能力，加装了两具 SRM-2 发射器，但由于该机甲散热能力实在过弱，实战中它们很少派上用场。 特性：扰敌 投放费用倍率：1.18 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The primary configuration of the Executioner-B mounts an Ultra AC/20 in the left arm, two Large Pulse Lasers in the right, and one ER PPC and two Ultra AC/2 in the side torsos. All together this makes for a formidable weapons loadout, but as the cooling is insufficient for repeated alpha strikes the 'Mech seldom reaches its maximum damage potential as listed on paper. Quirk: Distracting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 行刑者-B的主配置左臂装一门超级AC/20，右臂两门大型脉冲激光，两侧躯干各一门增程粒子炮和两门超级AC/2。合起来是一套强悍的武器配置，但由于冷却不足以支持反复的全力齐射，该机甲很少能达到纸面所列的最大伤害潜力。 特性：扰敌 投放费用倍率：1.18 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The personal 'Mech of Vlad Ward before he achieved fame and rose to the title of Khan, a customized version of the B loadout of the Executioner-B. Keeping the same weaponry, but adding some advanced systems and sensors to improved battlefield performance. Quirk: Distracting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.2 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是弗拉德·沃德成名并升任可汗之前的私人机甲，是行刑者-B的B挂载的定制版本。它保留相同武器，但加装了一些先进系统与传感器以提升战场表现。 特性：扰敌 投放费用倍率：1.2 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A Succession Wars era downgrade of the original EXT-4D model, the Exterminator 4A model was created in 3007 by Kallon Industries as a potential replacement for their Wolverine line. While packing nearly the same weapons array as the original 4D, engineers were forced to substitute the AMS for a conventional Machine Gun and downgrade the engine to a smaller 325-rated model. Lacking the advanced stealth systems and high speed of its progenitor model, the design was considered a failure and only 25 models were constructed. Quirk: Nimble Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.07
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 灭虫者（Exterminator）4A 型是原版 EXT-4D 在继承战争时期的降级版本，由 Kallon 工业公司于 3007 年打造，意在作为其狼獾（Wolverine）生产线的潜在替代品。虽然武器配置与原版 4D 几乎相同，但工程师们被迫将反导弹系统换成一挺常规机枪，并将引擎降级为较小的额定 325 型号。由于缺少原型机所具备的先进隐形系统与高速度，该设计被认为是一次失败，仅建造了 25 台。 特性：迅捷 投放费用倍率：1.07

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A variant of the EXT-4D, the Exterminator EXT-4C incorporates a Chameleon Light Polarisation Shield. Entering production at the same time as the EXT-4D, the 4C is otherwise unchanged from its parent design. Quirk: Nimble Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为EXT-4D的变型，灭绝者EXT-4C整合了1面变色龙光偏振护盾。它与EXT-4D同时投产，除此之外与母型设计没有任何差别。 <特性：灵活 <投放费用倍率：1.11

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An early clan Mech dating from the days of Operation Klondike, the Exterminator EXT-4Db-EC was an upgrade of the EXT-4Db that replaced the Medium Lasers with prototype ER Mediums. It would be discontinued and forgotten as modern clan spec weapons entered production. Quirk: Nimble Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为一款可追溯到“克朗代克行动”时代的早期部族机甲，Exterminator EXT-4Db-EC 是 EXT-4Db 的升级型，用原型增程中型激光替换了中型激光。随着现代部族规格武器投入生产，它被停产并逐渐被人遗忘。 特性：灵活 投放费用倍率：1.09

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A unique Exterminator variant refitted as specifically as a dueling Mech, the EXT-4DX was piloted by Lieutenant Caine Barclay of the SLDF's Forty-First Assault Battalion. Designed for close range combat, the 4DX mounts 6 Medium Pulse Lasers and a headmounted AMS. To fit the battery of Lasers, engineers replaced the 390-rated XL Engine with a smaller 325-rated model. Offsetting the slower speed is a Supercharger paired with MASC; allowing the 4DX to theoretically outrun a Locust. Laser Insulators are attached to each MPL, reducing the heat load to managable levels. Quirk: Nimble Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.13
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为一款被专门改装成决斗机甲的独特灭绝者变型，EXT-4DX由SLDF第四十一突击营的凯恩·巴克利中尉驾驶。为近距离战斗而设计，4DX装有6门中型脉冲激光以及一具安装在头部的AMS。为容纳这批激光，工程师把390级XL引擎换成更小的325级型号。为弥补速度下降，该机配备了一台超级增压器并与MASC搭配，理论上能让4DX跑得比蝗虫式还快。每门中型脉冲激光都装有激光绝缘器，将热量负荷降至可控水平。 特性：灵巧 投放费用倍率：1.13

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Introduced in 3060, the Exterminator EXT-5E is a modernisation of the 4D model built for Comstar and the Word of Blake. A 390-rated Xl Engine and Endo Steel allow the designers to mount an iNarc and 4 ER Medium Lasers. The Jump Jets were removed to make space for C3i and MASC fitted to compensate for the loss of agility. Quirk: Nimble Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 灭绝者EXT-5E于3060年推出，是为通讯之星与布莱克之词建造的4D型号的现代化版本。一台390额定XL引擎与内骨架让设计者得以装设一具iNarc和4门增程中型激光。跳跃推进器被拆除以腾出空间给C3i，并加装MASC以补偿损失的灵活性。 特性：灵巧 投放费用倍率：1.09

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A IIC version of the Exterminator used by the Clans that invaded the Inner Sphere. Rebuilt almost from scratch the design is fully Clan technology based, mounting six ER Medium Lasers and an LRM-10 with attached Artemis IV FCS. Two Anti-Missile Systems provide self-defense. Quirk: Nimble Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.13
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 入侵内层星域的部族所使用的 Exterminator 的 IIC 版本。该设计几乎从零重造，全面基于部族科技，装有六门增程中型激光和一具带阿尔忒弥斯 IV 火控系统的 LRM-10。两套反导弹系统提供自卫能力。 特性：灵活 投放费用倍率：1.13

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Designed for the SLDF in the wake of the Reunification War, the Falcon is a Scout Mech hunter and an anti-infantry Mech. A 30 ton Light Mech, the Falcon is powered by a 180-rated Fusion Core. The Falcon FLC-4Nb-Saho is armed with a Medium Laser and a Large Pulse Laser. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Falcon 是在统一战争之后为 SLDF 设计的，既是侦察机甲的猎手，也是一款反步兵机甲。Falcon 是 30 吨的轻型机甲，由一台 180 级聚变核心驱动。Falcon FLC-4Nb-Saho 装备一门中型激光和一门大型脉冲激光。 特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：1.03

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Falcon FLC-5P2 mounts a Large Laser in the left arm and two ER Medium Lasers in the right. A Single head-mounted Small Laser act as backup. The 'Mech carries six jump jets for increased mobility. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Falcon FLC-5P2 在左臂搭载一具大型激光，右臂搭载两具增程中型激光。头部安装的一具小型激光作为备用武器。该机甲配备六具跳跃推进器以提升机动性。 特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：0.99

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A rebuild of the Falcon by the Wolf's Dragoons, utilizing Clan technology to much improve its systems. Two ER Medium Lasers and one Medium Pulse Lasers are connected through a small Targeting Computer to provide some basic firepower, but the 'Mechs main purpose is utilizing its TAG and C3 slave to scout out enemy foes for artillery strikes and indirect fire. To stay hidden the design carries a Guardian ECM, and an AMS protects it in case it is engaged. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是沃尔夫龙骑兵对猎鹰的重新建造，利用部族科技大幅改进了它的各项系统。两门增程中型激光与一门中型脉冲激光通过一台小型瞄准计算机联动，提供基本的火力；但这台机甲的主要用途是凭借TAG与C3从属单元侦察敌情，为炮火打击和间接射击标定目标。为保持隐蔽，该设计搭载了守护者电子对抗套件，并配备AMS以便在遭遇交战时保护自身。 特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：1.05 手臂驱动器限制：右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Falcon Hawk 9K is armed with an ER PPC as its primary weapon, which allows engage targets at up to 690 meters. For close range combat the 'Mech carries two medium pulse lasers and a small pulse laser. In the event that an enemy is able to circle into its rear arc, the Falcon Hawk is prepared with a medium laser to defend its rear armor. Quirk: Well Balanced Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Falcon Hawk 9K以一门增程粒子炮为主武器，可在最远690米外交战。近距近战方面，机甲搭载两门中型脉冲激光和一门小型脉冲激光。若敌人绕入其后方弧区，Falcon Hawk也备有一门中型激光来保护后部装甲。 特性：平衡良好 投放费用倍率：0.98 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The discontinued 9K1A variant of the Falcon Hawk reduces its long-range capabilities, but increases the raw firepower available. The ER PPC has been removed as well as the two medium pulse lasers. These have been replaced with an ER large laser, a standard large laser, and a medium laser; the original medium laser was retained. This weapons configuration provides the Falcon Hawk with a capable medium to long-range arsenal. Quirk: Well Balanced Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Falcon Hawk 已停产的 9K1A 变型削弱了远程能力，却提高了可用火力。它拆除了增程粒子炮以及两门中型脉冲激光，代之以一门增程大型激光、一门标准大型激光和一门中型激光，原有的那门中型激光则予以保留。这一武器配置为 Falcon Hawk 提供了堪用的中远距离武器库。 特性：配重均衡 投放费用倍率：0.98 手臂驱动器限制：左下臂、右下臂

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Falconer FLC-8R carries a weapons mix that attempts to negate the range advantage of the weapons used by the Clans. The primary weapon on the 'Mech is a Gauss rifle, which is capable of stripping a ton of armor off an enemy unit at extreme ranges. It is backed up by an ER PPC, having a similar range profile to the Gauss Rifle and doing about a third less damage, but not dependent upon ammunition. Finally, the Falconer carries four medium lasers to give it a powerful close range punch. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 隼人FLC-8R的武器组合试图抵消部族武器的射程优势。该机甲的主武器是一门高斯步枪，能在极远距离上剥掉敌方单位一吨装甲。它由一门增程粒子炮支援——射程表现与高斯步枪相近，伤害约少三分之一，却不依赖弹药。最后，隼人带四门中型激光，赋予它强力的近程重拳。 特性：稳定 投放费用倍率：1.11 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Named for the demonic wolf of Germanic myth, the Fenrir was less a traditional battle suit and more a mobile fire support platform. The trooper controlling the suit was situated inside a cramped \"cockpit\" and piloted the Fenrir like a small walking tank. The single, configurable turret mounted on the suit could accept a wide variety of weapon configurations and the Fenrir's sturdy, powerful legs could propel it to much greater speeds than the Sloth. Quirk: Accurate Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.896 Can only be transported by internal bays, can not melee, can not swarm.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 芬里尔以日耳曼神话中的魔狼命名，它与其说是传统战斗服，不如说是一座机动火力支援平台。操控这套装甲的士兵坐在狭窄的"驾驶舱"里，像驾驶一台小型步行坦克那样操纵芬里尔。装甲上那座可配置的单一炮塔能接受多种武器配置，而芬里尔结实有力的腿部能让它跑得远比史莱格快。 特质：精准 投放费用倍率：0.896 只能由内部舱室运输，不可近战，不可蜂群攻击。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Named for the demonic wolf of Germanic myth, the Fenrir was less a traditional battle suit and more a mobile fire support platform. The trooper controlling the suit was situated inside a cramped \"cockpit\" and piloted the Fenrir like a small walking tank. The single, configurable turret mounted on the suit could accept a wide variety of weapon configurations and the Fenrir's sturdy, powerful legs could propel it to much greater speeds than the Sloth.
