Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Kanazuchi, Japanese for 'hammer', is a Draconis Combine battle armor design, one of the heaviest to come from that realm. Quirk: Armored Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.896 Can only be transported by internal bays, can melee, can not swarm.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Kanazuchi 在日语中意为“锤子”，是龙脉联合体的战斗装甲设计，也是该势力所推出过的最重型战斗装甲之一。 特性：装甲强化 投放费用倍率：0.896 只能通过内部舱室运输，可以近战，无法攀附。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A highly unusual version, the 50003-2OS is only found amongst mercenaries and in the periphery. No official sales was ever recorded of the variant, which makes it likely an unlicensed reproduction. Quirk: Easy to Pilot Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是极为罕见的版本，50003-2OS只出现在雇佣兵与外围地区。该变型从未有过任何官方销售记录，因而很可能是一次未获授权的仿制。 特性：易于驾驶 投放费用倍率：1.15 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: In the CRK-5003-2's left torso is a LB-X Autocannon/10 which draws from a two-ton ammo bin in the right torso. A pair of Large Lasers split between both arms take the place of the extended-range versions found in the Crockett. For close-range combat the CRK-5003-2 carries two SRM-6s in either side torso, with two tons of reloads concentrated in the right side, and for point blank defense the 'Mech carries two Small Lasers mounted co-axially with the large lasers. Quirk: Easy to Pilot Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: CRK-5003-2的左躯干内是一门LB-X自动炮/10，由右躯干一个两吨弹药舱供弹。两门大型激光分装在双臂，取代了克罗基特上的增程版本。近距交战时，CRK-5003-2两侧躯干各装两具SRM-6，两吨再装填弹药集中在右侧；零距离防御则由两门与大型激光同轴安装的小型激光负责。 特性：易于驾驶 投放费用倍率：1.15 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The CRK-5003-2OS is the personal BattleMech of Warlord Oruko Saki. It has a configuration very close to the standard CRK-5003-2 with only a few upgrades. The 'Mech's primary weapons systems remain the same: two Large Lasers backed up by a single LB 10-X Autocannon. The 'Mech also retains the two standard Short Range Missile racks. A secondary system of small lasers rounds out the 'Mech's offensive powers, mounted one in each arm and one in the rear torso. One of the few upgrades to Saki's Katana comes in the form of C.A.S.E. installed into the 'Mech's right torso. The other upgrade comes in the form of fifteen high-efficiency heat sinks replacing the CRK-5003-2's normal twenty heat sinks. Quirk: Easy to Pilot Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.17 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: CRK-5003-2OS是军阀奥鲁科·萨基的专属战斗机甲。它的配置与标准型CRK-5003-2非常接近，只有少数几处升级。机甲的主武器系统保持不变：两门大型激光，辅以一门LB 10-X自动炮。该机甲同样保留了原有的两具标准短程火箭发射巢。一套小型激光的次要系统补全了机甲的攻击火力，每只手臂各装一门，后躯干装一门。萨基的武士刀少数升级之一，是在机甲右躯干加装了C.A.S.E.；另一项升级则是用十五个高效散热器替换了CRK-5003-2原有的二十个散热器。 特性：易于驾驶 投放费用倍率：1.17 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下
武士刀 CRK-5003-2 '奥鲁科萨基'

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A simple variant of the Katana introduced in 3057, the 5003-C variant is a modification intended to carry a C3 Slave unit into battle. In order to achieve this, the 'Mech has removed both of the small lasers from the chassis, freeing up the needed room for the slave unit and allowing the Katana to share targeting data with friendly units. Quirk: Easy to Pilot Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 5003-C变型是武士刀于3057年推出的简单变型，为携带C3从属机投入战斗而改装。为此，这台机甲拆除了底盘上的两门小型激光，为从属机腾出所需空间，使武士刀能够与友军单位共享瞄准数据。 特性：易于驾驶 投放费用倍率：1.15 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Introduced at the same time as the C variant, this modification is intended to carry a C3 Computer onto the battlefield to coordinate a C3 Lance. The CM variant does this by removing both of the small lasers and one of the SRM-6 launchers to make room for the master computer. This also allows the 'Mech to share targeting data with friendly units. Quirk: Easy to Pilot Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这一改装与C变型同时推出，意在把一台C3计算机带上前线以协调一个C3小队。CM变型为此拆掉两门小型激光和其中一具SRM-6发射器，为这台主机腾出空间，也让机甲能与友军单位共享瞄准数据。 特性：易于驾驶 投放费用倍率：1.15 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The King Crab's primary weapons are two massive Autocannon/20s, among the most powerful BattleMech weapons ever created. Each arm carries one of these massive weapons, and they are fed by two tons of ammo split between the side torsos. The firepower of these weapons is enough to destroy a medium 'Mech in one salvo. To protect the autocannons in combat, engineers designed the King Crab with simple hand actuators. In appearance and movement, the actuators are very similar to pincers or claws found on real crabs, a contributing factor to the 'Mech's name. To back up the autocannons, and provide some long-range capabilities, the King Crab carries a LRM-15 launcher, mounted in the left torso and fed by one ton of reloads in the same location, and a Large Laser in the right torso. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 帝王蟹的主武器是两门庞大的自动炮/20，这是有史以来最强大的战斗机甲武器之一。每只手臂各携一门这种巨炮，由分装在两侧躯干的两吨弹药供弹。这些武器的火力足以一次齐射摧毁一台中型机甲。为在战斗中保护自动炮，工程师为帝王蟹设计了简单的手部驱动器：外观与动作都极像真螃蟹的钳或爪，这也是该机甲得名的一个原因。为给自动炮提供后手及一定远程能力，帝王蟹带一具LRM-15发射器（装在左躯干，配同位置一吨再装填弹药）和右躯干一门大型激光。 特性：指挥机甲 投放费用倍率：1.16

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: One of the so-called Clanbuster variants developed in 3052 during the lead-up to the Battle of Tukayyid, ComStar's techs replaced the twin autocannons with two M-7 Gauss Rifles and four tons of ammo in the arms, trading a minor reduction in destructive capacity for greatly increased range. While retaining the LRM launcher the large laser was upgraded to a Tronel XIII Large Pulse Laser and two Hovertec Streak SRM-2s, split between the side torsos with a single ton of reloads each, were added. These changes were accomplished by using an extralight engine in place of the standard model. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是3052年图卡伊德战役前夕研制的所谓“部族克星”变型之一，通讯之星的技术人员以两门M-7高斯步枪和四吨臂载弹药取代双联自动炮，用轻微的破坏力下降换来大幅提升的射程。它保留LRM发射器，但大型激光升级为特罗内尔XIII大型脉冲激光，并加装两具霍弗泰克连发SRM-2，分装两侧躯干，各配一吨再装填弹药。这些改动通过以超轻型引擎取代标准型号得以实现。 特性：指挥机甲 投放费用倍率：1.18 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: One of the most heavily armed and armored 'Mechs ever constructed, the King Crab 0002 variant mounts twin UAC/10 with MRM's. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为有史以来武装与装甲最厚重的机甲之一，帝王蟹0002变型装双联UAC/10与MRM。 特性：指挥机甲 投放费用倍率：1.18 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The unusual KGC-0KP variant of the King Crab carries a PPC and a Light Blazer in each arm, while a large AC/20 resides in its right torso. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: King Crab 的 KGC-0KP 变型颇为罕见，每条手臂各装有一门粒子炮和一门轻型 Blazer，右躯干中则安置着一门大型 AC/20。 特性：指挥机甲 投放费用倍率：1.16 手臂驱动器限制：左臂上部、右臂上部

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The King Crab 200 is a precursor to what would later become the 005. Rather than the two Streak SRM-4 launchers the 005 carries, the 200 instead mounts an ER PPC and adds slightly more armor. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: King Crab 200 是后来成为 005 的型号的前身。与 005 所携带的两具连发 SRM-4 发射器不同，200 改为一门增程粒子炮，并略微增加了装甲。 特性：指挥机甲 投放费用倍率：1.18

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Named after monsters of old, the King Crab 'Kaiju' is truly a beast of the sea, mounting four hot PPCs and an Ultra AC/5, an LRM15 for indirect fire, and 15 double heatsinks to keep it running, its foes should run screaming. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.2 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: King Crab“Kaiju”以远古巨兽命名，堪称真正的海中之兽：它装有四门炽热的粒子炮、一门超级 AC/5，以及一具用于间接射击的 LRM15；15 具双散热器维持其运转，敌人见了只应尖叫着逃命。 特性：指挥机甲 投放费用倍率：1.2 手臂驱动器限制：左臂上部、右臂上部

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Pretty Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.12 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 漂亮。 特性：指挥机甲 投放费用倍率：1.12 手臂驱动器限制：左臂下部、右臂下部

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: One of the earliest second generation OmniMech designs, the Kingfisher debuted in 2887 and is reputed to have influenced all subsequent Clan Assault OmniMech designs. A 90-ton mech powered by a 360-rated Fusion Engine, the Kingfisher has 24 tons of podspace provided by a combination of Ferro-Fibrous armor and an Endo Steel skeleton. The Kingfisher A is armed with an LB-10X and an ER PPC. At closer ranges, the A can bring to bear an SRM-6, an ER Small Laser, an ER Medium laser and a Medium Pulse Laser. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.17 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 翠鸟是最早的第二代全向机甲设计之一，于2887年首次登场，据称影响了此后所有部族突击型全向机甲的设计。这台90吨的机甲由一具额定360的聚变引擎驱动，凭借铁纤维装甲与内骨架的结合，共拥有24吨荚舱空间。翠鸟A型装备一门LB-10X与一门增程粒子炮。在更近的距离上，A型还能动用一具SRM-6、一门增程小型激光、一门增程中型激光以及一门中型脉冲激光。 特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1.17 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: One of the earliest second generation OmniMech designs, the Kingfisher debuted in 2887 and is reputed to have influenced all subsequent Clan Assault OmniMech designs. A 90-ton mech powered by a 360-rated Fusion Engine, the Kingfisher has 24 tons of podspace provided by a combination of Ferro-Fibrous armor and an Endo Steel skeleton. The Kingfisher B is armed with a UAC/20 and an ER Large Laser. 5 ER Medium Lasers and an ER Small offer additional firepower, while an AMS helps defensively. Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An alternative configuration of the F designation that existed mainly in the design stages. The goal was to achieve a more flexible profile during engagements than the E configuration by combining three ATM 9 pods with 5 ER Medium Laser pods. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.17 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni

The Kingfisher Prime is armed with a pair of Large Pulse Lasers and a LRM-10. At closer ranges, the Prime can bring to bear a Streak SRM-6, an ER Small Laser and a pair of Medium Pulse Lasers. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.17 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为最早的第二代全向机甲设计之一，翠鸟于2887年首次亮相，据称影响了此后所有部族突击全向机甲的设计。这台90吨机甲由一台360额定聚变引擎驱动，铁纤维装甲与内骨架结构的组合提供24吨挂载空间。翠鸟主型号装有一对大型脉冲激光和一具LRM-10；在更近的距离上，主型号还能动用一具连发SRM-6、一门增程小型激光和一对中型脉冲激光。 特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1.17 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A simple refit of the standard Kintaro KTO-19 that moves one of the Medium Lasers to the opposite arm for MechWarriors that prefer the more balanced weapon distribution. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是标准 Kintaro KTO-19 的简单改装，将其中一门中型激光移到对侧手臂，以迎合偏爱更均衡武器分布的机甲战士。 特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1.05

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Kiso was created as a \"command\" construction vehicle for large planetary construction projects in the Draconis Combine. This particular Kiso, however, was destined for greater things when modifications by mercenary company \"Harkness' Horde\" elevated it to something resembling a 100-ton Assault 'Mech. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.93
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Kiso最初是作为龙脉联合体大型行星建设工程的“指挥”施工车辆而制造的。然而，这辆特别的Kiso注定肩负更重大的使命——经过雇佣兵连队“哈克尼斯之群”的改装，它被提升到接近100吨突击机甲的水平。 特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：0.93

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A Light Clan OmniMech, the 30 ton Kit Fox was introduced in 2890 by Clan Cloud Cobra. Favouring a mix of firepower and armor over speed, the Kit Fox is powered by a 180 XL Engine and features a mix of Endo Steel and Ferro-Fibrous; giving it 16 tons of pod space. The Kit Fox C is armed with an ER Large Laser. A Small Pulse Laser, a pair of Machine Guns and a pair of A-Pods provide protection at close range. 3 Anti Missile Systems, a TAG, Guardian ECM and an Active Probe round out the variant. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 30 吨的 Kit Fox 是一款轻型部族全向机甲，由云眼镜蛇部族于 2890 年推出。Kit Fox 更看重火力与装甲的平衡，而非速度，它采用 180 XL 引擎，并混合使用内骨架与铁纤维材料，从而获得 16 吨挂载空间。Kit Fox C 装备一门增程大型激光；近距离防护由一门小型脉冲激光、两挺机枪和两具 A 型反步兵荚舱提供。该变型还配备 3 套反导弹系统、一部 TAG、一套 Guardian 电子对抗套件和一部主动探测器。 特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：0.99 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A Light Clan OmniMech, the 30 ton Kit Fox was introduced in 2890 by Clan Cloud Cobra. Favouring a mix of firepower and armor over speed, the Kit Fox is powered by a 180 XL Engine and features a mix of Endo Steel and Ferro-Fibrous; giving it 16 tons of pod space. The Kit Fox COL is armed with paired SRM-6’s and SRM-4’s. Dual ER Medium Lasers, 3 Machine Guns and a Laser AMS round out the variant. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.02 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为一款轻型部族全向机甲，30吨的Kit Fox由云眼镜蛇部族于2890年推出。Kit Fox偏爱火力与装甲的平衡而非速度，由一台180 XL引擎驱动，并采用内骨架与铁纤维装甲的组合，从而获得16吨挂载空间。Kit Fox COL装备成对的SRM-6与SRM-4。双门增程中型激光、3挺机枪和一套激光AMS构成了这一变型的完整武装。 特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：1.02 手臂驱动器限制：全向

The Kit Fox E is armed with an ER PPC and an ATM-3. An ER Small Laser, and 6 Jump Jets round out the variant. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The E2 configuration of the Kit Fox mounts one Large Pulse Laser in each arm, with a Stream SRM-4 launcher in the left torso as support. To fit the weapons the 'Mech drops two of the heat sinks, and as a result suffers from subpar cooling. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 小狐的 E2 型配置在每条手臂上各装一门大型脉冲激光，左躯干则有一具连发 SRM-4 发射器作为支援。为容纳这些武器，该机甲拆掉了两个散热器，因此散热表现欠佳。 特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：0.99 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An all energy configuration, the F2 has a total of four Medium Pulse Lasers, two residing in each arm. A single Small Pulse Laser helps deal with close range targets. The loadout also adds an ECM suite in the left torso. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: F2 是全能量配置，共装有四门中型脉冲激光，每条手臂各两门。一门小型脉冲激光有助于应对近距离目标。该配置还在左躯干加装了一套 ECM 套件。 特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：0.99 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The main weapon of the F3 configuration is an ER PPC, with three ER Medium Lasers and one Medium Pulse Laser as support. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: F3配置的主武器是一门增程粒子炮，另有三门增程中型激光和一门中型脉冲激光作为辅助。 特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：0.99 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The G2 loadout combines three Medium with one Large Pulse Laser, while also adding an Active Probe. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: G2载荷把三门中型脉冲激光与一门大型脉冲激光组合，并加装一台主动探测器。 特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：0.99 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A Light Clan OmniMech, the 30 ton Kit Fox was introduced in 2890 by Clan Cloud Cobra. Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A Light Clan OmniMech, the 30 ton Kit Fox was introduced in 2890 by Clan Cloud Cobra. Favouring a mix of firepower and armor over speed, the Kit Fox is powered by a 180 XL Engine and features a mix of Endo Steel and Ferro-Fibrous; giving it 16 tons of pod space. The Kit Fox J is armed with a UAC/5. A pair of ER Medium Lasers and a Streak SRM-2 make up the close range firepower. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为一款轻型部族全向机甲，30 吨的狐貂由云眼镜蛇部族于 2890 年推出。狐貂更看重火力与装甲的平衡而非速度，采用一台 180 XL 引擎，并混用内骨架与铁纤维，从而获得 16 吨挂载空间。狐貂 J 装备一门 UAC/5。两门 ER 中型激光和一部连发 SRM-2 构成其近距离火力。 特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：0.99 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The M1 configuration drops the jump jets and the Endo Steel chassis is converted to standard specification. An Ultra AC/5 in the right arm is matched with a Stream SRM-4 launcher in the left, and one ER Medium Laser in each side torso. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: M1 配置去掉了跳跃推进器，内骨架机体也改回标准规格。右臂的超级 AC/5 与左臂的连发 SRM-4 发射器搭配，两侧躯干各有一门中型增程激光。 特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：0.99 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The M2 configuration adds the Jump Jets back that the M1 removed, but at the cost of downgrading the Streak SRM-4 to a Streak SRM-2. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: M2配置重新装回了M1取消的跳跃推进器，代价是把连发SRM-4降级为连发SRM-2。 特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：0.99 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The M3 configuration is similar to the M1, but is able to add another Streak SRM-4 by keeping the Endo Steel chassis. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: M3 配置与 M1 相似，但凭借保留内骨架底盘，得以再加装一具连发 SRM-4。 特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：0.99 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A Light Clan OmniMech, the 30 ton Kit Fox was introduced in 2890 by Clan Cloud Cobra. Favouring a mix of firepower and armor over speed, the Kit Fox is powered by a 180 XL Engine and features a mix of Endo Steel and Ferro-Fibrous; giving it 16 tons of pod space. The Kit Fox V is armed with an Arrow IV. A pair of ER Small Lasers provide close range firepower. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为一款轻型部族全向机甲，30吨的狐套由云眼镜蛇部族于2890年推出。它更看重火力与装甲而非速度，由一台180 XL引擎驱动，采用内骨架与铁纤维混合结构，拥有16吨挂载空间。狐套V装有一具箭IV，另有两门增程小型激光提供近程火力。 特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：0.99 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A Light Clan OmniMech, the 30 ton Kit Fox was introduced in 2890 by Clan Cloud Cobra. Favouring a mix of firepower and armor over speed, the Kit Fox is powered by a 180 XL Engine and features a mix of Endo Steel and Ferro-Fibrous; giving it 16 tons of pod space. The Kit Fox W is armed with paired Large and Medium Pulse Lasers. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 30 吨的 Kit Fox 是一款轻型部族全向机甲，由云眼镜蛇部族于 2890 年推出。它更看重火力与装甲的平衡而非速度，由 180 XL 引擎驱动，并采用内骨架与铁纤维的组合，从而拥有 16 吨挂载空间。Kit Fox W 装备成对的大型脉冲激光和中型脉冲激光。 特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：0.99 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This XP configuration mounts a UAC/5 as its primary weapon in the left arm, backed up by an SRM-4 in each arm and three ER medium lasers. For anti-infantry work and increased close-range firepower, the 'Mech mounts a machine gun in each torso. A laser AMS in the right arm supplements the defensive capabilities of this configuration. All ammo-dependent weapons have one ton of ammunition allocated. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这一 XP 配置以左臂的一门 UAC/5 为主武器，辅以每臂各一具 SRM-4 和三门增程中型激光。为执行反步兵任务并增强近距离火力，该机甲在两侧躯干各装一挺机枪。右臂的激光反导弹系统进一步增强了此配置的防御能力。所有依赖弹药的武器均配有一吨弹药。 特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：0.99 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Reportedly piloted by Brett Andrews, the Kit Fox XPR, also known as the Purifier, mounts an ER large laser and ER small laser in each side torso, supported by a machine gun carried in each arm, fed by two and half tons of machine gun ammunition. Four extra double heat sinks maintain a high rate of laser fire. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.02 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 据说由 Brett Andrews 驾驶的 Kit Fox XPR，又称“净化者”，在两侧躯干各搭载一具增程大型激光和一具增程小型激光，并由每只手臂上的一挺机枪提供支援，这些机枪由两点五吨机枪弹药供弹。四具额外的双散热器使其能够维持高频率的激光射击。 特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：1.02 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A prototype of the late stages of design of what would eventually become the Kodiak. Main differences are a slightly different armor profile to the production version, weapons are a mix of what eventually be the primary and fifth loadout configuration, a combination of a Gauss Rifle, nine ER Lasers and two Streak SRM-6 launchers. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.24
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是最终成为科迪亚克的设计在晚期阶段的原型。主要差异是装甲分布与量产版略有不同；武器混合了后来成为主配置和第五配置的内容——一门高斯步枪、九门增程激光和两具连发SRM-6发射器。 特性：战拳 投放费用倍率：1.24

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: One of two early concept models for the Kodiak. With the prototype being only 85 ton, it has considerably less armor and a smaller engine. It also contains less powerful weapons, with a single LB-X AC/10 being the main weapon, two ER PPC as support and a LRM-10 for indirect fire. Quirk: Anti-Air Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.19 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是科迪亚克两款早期概念型号之一。由于原型机仅重85吨，它的装甲明显更少，引擎也更小。它的武器威力同样较弱：一门LB-X AC/10作为主武器，两门增程粒子炮作为支援，外加一具LRM-10用于间接射击。 特性：对空瞄准 投放费用倍率：1.19 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The second version of the 85 ton prototype by Clan Ghost Bear before the final design at 100 tons was finalized. The main difference was the attempt to not have to use an XL Engine by use of a smaller 255-rated engine core. Quirk: Anti-Air Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.19 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是幽灵熊部族在最终敲定 100 吨设计之前所制造的第二版 85 吨原型机。主要区别在于，它尝试通过采用更小的 255 级引擎核心来避免动用 XL 引擎。 特性：防空瞄准 投放费用倍率：1.19 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Komodo IIC mounts a total of ten Medium Pulse Lasers, for an surprising amount of damage if they all manage to hit its target. An AMS protects the 'Mech from incoming missiles while a basic ECM provides rudimentary electronic warfare protection. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Komodo IIC 共搭载十门中型脉冲激光，若全部命中目标，可造成惊人的伤害。AMS 为机甲抵御来袭导弹，而基础电子对抗套件则提供初步的电子战防护。 特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：1.11 手臂驱动器限制：左臂下部、右臂下部

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Bearing the distinction of being the second Mech to be created by the Capellan Confederation, the Koschei began production in 2504 though production would cease during the Succession Wars; with production restarting during the Jihad. A 65-ton Mech, the Koschei 3I is powered by a 325-rated engine giving it a top speed of 86 km/h. An AC/10 with 2 tons of ammo is the Mechs main gun with a pair of Medium Lasers as backup weapons for close range combat. Quirk: Improved Lifesupport Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.07 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 科斯切伊拥有作为卡佩兰联邦第二款机甲的殊荣，于2504年投产，但生产在继承战争期间中断，直到圣战时期才恢复。作为65吨机甲，科斯切伊3I由一台325额定引擎驱动，最高速度86公里/小时。一门AC/10配2吨弹药是主炮，另有一对中型激光作为近战后备武器。 特性：改进生命维持 投放费用倍率：1.07 手臂驱动器限制：左上

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Bearing the distinction of being the second Mech to be created by the Capellan Confederation, the Koschei began production in 2504 though production would cease during the Succession Wars; with production restarting during the Jihad. A 65-ton Mech, the Koschei 3L is powered by a 325-rated engine giving it a top speed of 86 km/h. An LRM-15 with 2 tons of ammo and a Large Laser form the Mechs main weapons with a single Medium Laser as a backup weapon for close range combat. Quirk: Improved Lifesupport Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.07 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Koschei 拥有卡佩兰联邦所创造的第二款机甲的殊荣，于 2504 年开始生产，不过在继承战争期间一度停产，直到圣战期间才恢复生产。Koschei 3L 是一台 65 吨的机甲，由 325 额定引擎驱动，最高速度达 86 km/h。其主武器为一具带 2 吨弹药的 LRM-15 和一门大型激光，另有一门中型激光作为近距离战斗的备用武器。 特性：改进生命维持 投放费用倍率：1.07 手臂驱动器限制：左上臂

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Bearing the distinction of being the second Mech to be created by the Capellan Confederation, the Koschei began production in 2504 though production would cease during the Succession Wars; with production restarting during the Jihad. A 65-ton Mech, the Koschei 4I is powered by a 325-rated engine giving it a top speed of 86 km/h. An LB-10X with 2 tons of ammo is the Mechs main gun with paired Medium Pulse Lasers and Medium Lasers as backup weapons for close range combat. Quirk: Improved Lifesupport Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 科斯切伊拥有作为卡佩兰联邦第二款机甲的殊荣，于2504年投产，但生产在继承战争期间中断，直到圣战时期才恢复。作为65吨机甲，科斯切伊4I由一台325额定引擎驱动，最高速度86公里/小时。一门LB-10X配2吨弹药是主炮，另有成对的中型脉冲激光与中型激光作为近战后备武器。 特性：改进生命维持 投放费用倍率：1.09 手臂驱动器限制：左上

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Bearing the distinction of being the second Mech to be created by the Capellan Confederation, the Koschei began production in 2504 though production would cease during the Succession Wars; with production restarting during the Jihad. A 65-ton Mech, the Koschei 4L is powered by a 325-rated engine giving it a top speed of 86 km/h. An Artemis IV enhanced LRM-15 with 2 tons of ammo is the Mechs main weapon with a Large Pulse Laser and Medium Pulse Laser as backup weapons for close range combat. Quirk: Improved Lifesupport Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Koschei是卡佩兰联邦制造的第二种机甲，于2504年开始生产，不过在继承战争期间停产，直到圣战期间才恢复生产。这台65吨机甲的Koschei 4L由一具325级引擎驱动，最高时速达86 km/h。其主武器是一门经Artemis IV增强的LRM-15，备弹2吨，另有大型脉冲激光与中型脉冲激光作为近距离作战的后备武器。 特性：改进生命维持 投放费用倍率：1.09 手臂驱动器限制：左上

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Custom built from discarded Locust wrecks, the Koto is a 25-ton mech built exclusively for the Solaris 7 arenas by Omnitech Industries. Sharing the same basic shape as it’s parent design the Koto is extensively rebuilt with an Endo Steel skeleton, Ferro-Fibrous armor, double heat sinks and an XL Engine. Weighing 5 tons heavier then the Locust, the Koto has a significantly heavier weapons array; built for annihilating opponents in the arena. The Koto 2A is armed with a Large X-Pulse Laser, 2 ER Medium Lasers and an ER Small Laser. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Koto 由 Omnitech Industries 用废弃的 Locust 残骸定制而成，是一台专为索拉里斯 7 号竞技场打造的 25 吨机甲。Koto 与其母型设计拥有相同的基本外形，但经过大规模重建：采用内骨架结构、铁纤维装甲、双散热器以及 XL 引擎。Koto 比 Locust 重 5 吨，武器阵列却重得多，生来就是为了在竞技场中歼灭对手。Koto 2A 装备一门大型 X 脉冲激光、两门增程中型激光和一门增程小型激光。 特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：0.98

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Custom built from discarded Locust wrecks, the Koto is a 25-ton mech built exclusively for the Solaris 7 arenas by Omnitech Industries. Sharing the same basic shape as its parent design the Koto is extensively rebuilt with an Endo Steel skeleton, Ferro-Fibrous armor, double heat sinks and an XL Engine. Weighing 5 tons heavier then the Locust, the Koto has a significantly heavier weapons array; built for annihilating opponents in the arena. The Koto P2 is armed with a Large Pulse Laser, 2 Machine Guns and a Small Laser. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Koto 由 Omnitech Industries 用废弃的 Locust 残骸定制打造，是一台专为 Solaris 7 竞技场制造的 25 吨机甲。Koto 与母型设计有着相同的基本外形，但经过大规模重建，采用内骨架、铁纤维装甲、双散热器和 XL 引擎。Koto 比 Locust 重 5 吨，武器配置也沉重得多，专为在竞技场中彻底击溃对手而生。Koto P2 装备一门大型脉冲激光、2 挺机枪和一门小型激光。 特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：0.98

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: As the original production variant, the KUZ-C2 carries the heaviest armor allocation of any Kumazemi configuration, reflecting the chassis's garrison-defense roots. Its armament centers on an AC/20 paired with an LRM-15, giving it both heavy direct-fire punch and indirect support capability, while a pair of Medium Lasers and a head-mounted Machine Gun handle close-in defense. CASE installations in both side torsos protect the pilot from the risks of carrying such substantial ammunition reserves Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.12 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为最初的生产变型，KUZ-C2 拥有 Kumazemi 各变型中最厚重的装甲配比，体现了该底盘作为守备机体的出身。其武装以一门 AC/20 搭配一具 LRM-15 为核心，兼具重型直射打击与间接支援能力，而两门中型激光与一挺头部机枪负责近距离防御。两侧躯干均装有 CASE 弹仓防爆装置，保护机师免受携带如此大量弹药储备的风险。 特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1.12 手臂驱动器限制：左臂下部、右臂下部

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The KUZ-C3 refines the original Kumazemi's loadout with a trio of practical upgrades. The head-mounted Machine Gun has been replaced with a Small Laser for ammunition independent close defense, an SRM-6 has been added to the left torso for additional short range punch, and single heat sinks have given way to double heat sinks throughout. Together, these changes allow the KUZ-C3 to sustain heavier fire from its AC/20 and LRM-15 while adding a meaningful close-combat option its predecessor lacked. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: KUZ-C3以三项务实的升级完善了原版熊爪的配置：头部的机枪换成小型激光，以实现不依赖弹药的近距防御；左躯干加装一具SRM-6，增强近程打击力；单散热器全面改为双散热器。这些改动合在一起，让KUZ-C3能维持AC/20与LRM-15的更重火力，并补上了前型号所欠缺的、有实际意义的近战选项。 特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1.14 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The KUZ-D5 represents a large rework of the original Kumazemi. Endo Steel internal structure frees enough tonnage to replace the head-mounted Machine Gun with an ER Large Laser and add a centrally-mounted SRM-4, while Artemis IV fire control systems on both the LRM-15 and new SRM-4 dramatically improve missile accuracy. Double heat sinks support this expanded arsenal, though the added equipment comes at the cost of reduced armor coverage compared to earlier variants, a trade the KUZ-D5 makes in pursuit of substantially greater firepower. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: KUZ-D5是对原版熊爪的大幅重做。内骨架内部结构腾出足够吨位，把头部机枪换成增程大型激光并加装一具中央SRM-4；同时LRM-15与新SRM-4都加装了阿尔忒弥斯IV火控系统，导弹精度大幅提升。双散热器支撑这套扩充的武器，但新增设备也以比早期变型更少的装甲覆盖为代价——KUZ-D5为追求显著更强的火力作出了这一取舍。 特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1.14 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The KUZ-D7 builds on the KUZ-D5 by trading its SRM-4 and ER Large Laser for an ER PPC and a pair of additional ER Medium Lasers, giving it three ER Medium Lasers in total alongside its AC/20, Artemis-guided LRM-15, and new ER PPC. A Guardian ECM Suite has also been added for electronic protection. To accommodate these changes, the KUZ-D7 switches to Light Ferro-Fibrous armor and carries a reduced LRM ammunition reserve, though it retains the Endo Steel structure and double heat sinks introduced on the KUZ-D5. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: KUZ-D7 在 KUZ-D5 的基础上发展而来，用一门 增程粒子炮和一对额外的 ER 中型激光换掉了原有的 SRM-4 与 ER 大型激光，使其在 AC/20、Artemis 制导的 LRM-15 以及新增的 增程粒子炮之外，总共拥有三门 ER 中型激光。同时还加装了一套 Guardian 电子对抗套件以提供电子防护。为适应这些改动，KUZ-D7 改用轻型铁纤维装甲，并缩减了 LRM 弹药储备，但仍保留了 KUZ-D5 上引入的内骨架结构与双散热器。 特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1.14 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The KUZ-F2 represents an alternate development path from the original KUZ-C2, retaining its LRM-15 but replacing the AC/20 with a Gauss Rifle for comparable hitting power without the heat penalty. The head-mounted Machine Gun gives way to an ER Large Laser, while the paired Medium Lasers are replaced by a Large Pulse Laser and a Medium Pulse Laser for greater precision at range. Endo Steel structure and Ferro-Fibrous armor, along with double heat sinks, round out this substantial overhaul of the chassis's original design. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: KUZ-F2 代表着与原版 KUZ-C2 不同的一条发展路线：它保留了 LRM-15，却以高斯步枪取代 AC/20，在获得相当打击力的同时免去了热量上的负担。头部机枪让位于一门增程大型激光，而成对的中型激光则被一门大型脉冲激光和一门中型脉冲激光取代，以便在远距离上更加精准。内骨架结构与铁纤维装甲，再加上双散热器，共同构成了对这款底盘原始设计的重大改造。 特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1.14 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The -01 is the earliest known model of the Kyudo. Built using primitive components, it carries a single LRM-10 and Large Laser, with enough single heat sinks to keep it relatively cool. The -01 was fielded primarily by the Terran Hegemony during the Reunification War, but eventually went extinct during the Amaris Civil War. Quirk: Easy to Pilot Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.81 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: -01 是已知最早的弓道型号。它使用原始部件建造，装备一部 LRM-10 和一门大型激光，单散热器数量足以让它保持相对凉爽。-01 在统一战争期间主要由地球霸权使用，但最终在阿马里斯内战期间绝迹。 特性：易于驾驶 投放费用倍率：0.81 手臂驱动器限制：右上

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Kyudo was introduced by Martinson Armaments in 2625 and purchased by the Terran Hegemony with intent to support the Mackie. Topping out at 86 km/h, the Kyudo carries a single LRM-20 with Artemis IV guidance, and an ER Large Laser for direct fire support. Quirk: Easy to Pilot Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Kyudo 由 Martinson Armaments 于 2625 年推出，被地球霸权采购，意在支援 Mackie。其最高速度为 86 km/h，搭载一具配 Artemis IV 制导的 LRM-20，以及一门用于直射火力支援的增程大型激光。 特性：易于驾驶 投放费用倍率：1.03 手臂驱动器限制：右上

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Originating with the Star League Defense Force, the Lancelot is a 60-ton mech designed to keep pace with medium mechs while bringing the firepower and survivability of a heavy mech to an engagement. Built around a 360-rated XL Engine, the Lancelot LNC25-01 is armed with a pair of Large Lasers, a Medium Laser and a PPC. Quirk: Anti-Air Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 兰斯洛特（Lancelot）源自星际联盟防卫军，是一台 60 吨机甲，设计目标是在跟上中型机甲步伐的同时，为战斗带来重型机甲的火力与生存能力。它以一台额定 360 的 XL 引擎为核心，LNC25-01 型兰斯洛特装备了两门大型激光、一门中型激光和一门粒子炮。 特性：防空瞄准 投放费用倍率：1.06 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A battlefield refit of the LNC25-01, adding Endo Steel and Ferro-Fibrous armor. The freed up weight is used to increase the armoring and add three more double heat sinks. Quirk: Anti-Air Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是LNC25-01的战场改装，加装内骨架与铁纤维装甲。省下来的重量用于加强装甲，并增加三个双散热器。 特性：对空瞄准 投放费用倍率：1.06 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This Lancelot variant removes the PPC and Large Lasers of the standard model and replaces them all with ER Large Lasers. Ferro-Fibrous armor provides increased protection, while the remaining tonnage has been devoted to extra double heat sinks. Quirk: Anti-Air Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这一 Lancelot 变型拆除了标准型号的粒子炮与大型激光，全部换成增程大型激光。铁纤维装甲提供了更强的防护，而剩余的吨位则全部用于加装额外的双散热器。 特性：防空瞄准 投放费用倍率：1.06 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This prototype Lancelot variant was produced by Krupp prior to Amaris' seizure of Terra. An upgrade of the LNC25-01, it uses an Endo-Steel chassis and Ferro-fibrous armor. The weapons array is same, except the large lasers are Extended Range Type and four jump jets are added for mobility. Early field tests revealed that the inclusion of jump jets did little to improve the design, with most pilots requesting either more armoring or more heat sinks instead. Quirk: Anti-Air Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这款Lancelot原型变型由Krupp在阿马里斯夺取地球之前生产。它是LNC25-01的升级版，采用内骨架底盘和铁纤维装甲。武器阵列相同，只是大型激光改为增程型号，并加装四台跳跃推进器以提升机动性。早期实地测试表明，加装跳跃推进器对设计的改进微乎其微，多数机师反而要求增加装甲或散热器。 特性：防空瞄准 投放费用倍率：1.06 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Lancelot did not survive the loss of Star League technology as well as most of its older cousins. Manufactured by Luthien Armor Works from their huge plant on Luthien, the 02 retained the same weapons array though with different models: a Lord's Light PPC, two Sunglow Heavy Lasers, and a Victory 23R Medium Laser. This came at the expense however of a smaller Pitban 240 fusion engine and nineteen single heat sinks. With a new maximum speed of only 64.8 km/h the thin-skinned Lancelot made for an easy target for other 'Mechs of its weight class, and the less efficient heat dissipation system made it unable to unleash its full firepower safely and consistently; firing both large lasers and the PPC at the same time now entailed risking a shutdown from overheating. LAW also had to replace the Krupp electronics used in the Star League variants, installing a Sipher KIT-4 communications system and a Hawkeye B3 targeting and tracking system. Quirk: Anti-Air Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在星际联盟科技失传的过程中，Lancelot的境遇不如它大多数更古老的表亲。02型由Luthien Armor Works在其位于Luthien的巨型工厂生产，保留了相同的武器阵列，只是型号不同：一门Lord's Light粒子炮、两门Sunglow重型激光和一门Victory 23R中型激光。但代价是换装了更小的Pitban 240聚变引擎和十九台单散热器。新的最高速度仅为64.8 km/h，这身薄皮的Lancelot因而成了同重量级机甲眼中易得的目标；而降效的散热系统也使它无法安全而持续地释放全部火力——如今同时发射两门大型激光和粒子炮，就意味着要冒着过热停机的风险。LAW还不得不替换星际联盟变型所用的Krupp电子设备，改而安装Sipher KIT-4通讯系统和Hawkeye B3瞄准与追踪系统。 特性：防空瞄准 投放费用倍率：1.06 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A field refit of the 01 model owing to a lack of proper spare parts, this variant swaps out the large lasers and extra heat sinks for a pair of rugged Autocannon/5s. It is made tougher with the inclusion of additional armor, though the extra protection comes at the cost of a reduction in speed to a maximum of 85 km/h. Quirk: Anti-Air Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 由于缺少合适备件，这是01型号的野战改装：以一对坚固的AC/5取代大型激光和额外散热器。它通过加入额外装甲变得更坚韧，但这份额外防护的代价是速度降到最高85公里/小时。 特性：防空瞄准 投放费用倍率：1.06 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This variant of the Lancelot is a completely upgraded version, built to utilize the improved C3 computer in use by ComStar and the Word of Blake. In addition to using an Endo-Steel chassis and added a half-ton of armor, the particle cannon and large lasers were upgraded to Extended Range models. In order to make room for these sweeping changes the medium laser was removed. Quirk: Anti-Air Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是兰斯洛特的完全升级版本，为利用通讯之星与布莱克之词所用的改进型C3计算机而造。除采用内骨架底盘并增加半吨装甲外，粒子炮和大型激光都升级为增程型号。为给这些全面改动腾出空间，拆掉了中型激光。 特性：防空瞄准 投放费用倍率：1.08 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 25-05 is a curious variant of the traditionally energy-based Lancelot primarily aimed at fighting conventional forces. The medium laser and two heat sinks have been replaced with four Machine Guns and a full ton of ammunition. The armor has not been upgraded, and the 25-05 Lancelot has the same speed profile as the older 25-01 model. Quirk: Anti-Air Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 25-05 是一向以能量武器为主的 Lancelot 的一个奇特变型，主要针对常规部队作战。中型激光和两具散热器被四挺机枪以及整整一吨弹药所取代。装甲并未升级，25-05 Lancelot 的速度特性与更早的 25-01 型号相同。 特性：防空瞄准 投放费用倍率：1.06 手臂驱动器限制：左臂上部、右臂上部

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Introduced by Kindraa Smythe-Jewel, the all-Clan tech Lancelot C carried three Kolibri Delta Series Large Pulse Lasers into battle as a light 'Mech hunter. Sixteen double heat sinks and nine and a half tons of armor protected the Lancelot C. Quirk: Anti-Air Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.12 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 由金德拉·斯迈思-朱厄尔推出、全用部族技术的兰斯洛特C，以三门蜂鸟德尔塔系列大型脉冲激光参战，担任轻型机甲猎手。十六个双散热器和九吨半装甲保护着兰斯洛特C。 特性：防空瞄准 投放费用倍率：1.12 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This variant of the Lancelot C entered service twenty five years after the original. Similar to the original Lancelot, each arm carries an ER Large Laser while an ER PPC is mounted in the right torso. To fight infantry or create smoke, a pair of Flamers is in the center torso. Seventeen heat sinks offset the heat generated by these weapons. The Lancelot C 2 can also sprint at 120 km/h thanks to a MASC system. Quirk: Anti-Air Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.12 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这一Lancelot C变型在原版服役二十五年后入役。与原版Lancelot相似，每条手臂各搭载一门增程大型激光，右躯干则安装一门增程粒子炮。为对付步兵或制造烟雾，中央躯干装有两门火焰喷射器。十七台散热器可抵消这些武器产生的热量。得益于MASC系统，Lancelot C 2还能以120 km/h的速度冲刺。 特性：防空瞄准 投放费用倍率：1.12 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Trading the Hermes II's AC/5, medium laser and flamer for missile racks and an upgraded laser, the Liberator offered a harder punch. Carrying an LRM-5 in each arm as primary weapons supported by a center torso mounted large laser, an SRM-2 rack fitted to the 'Mech's left torso provided close-range backup. A single ton of LRM and SRM reloads gave the design reasonable endurance in the field, with designers determining on paper that volley fire alternating between the missile launchers with the laser to easily manage the 'Mech's heat load. Quirk: Improved Sensors Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.02
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 解放者以导弹挂架和升级激光取代赫尔墨斯II的AC/5、中型激光和火焰喷射器，打击力更强。每只手臂各有一具LRM-5作为主武器，中央躯干一门大型激光支援，左躯干一具SRM-2提供近距后手。一吨LRM与SRM再装填弹药让该设计具备不错的战场持续力；设计者在纸面上判定，在导弹发射器与激光之间交替齐射可以轻松控制机甲的热负荷。 特性：改进传感器 投放费用倍率：1.02

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A full missile configuration, the A loadout mounts six LRM-15 launchers, all of them with an attached Artemis IV FCS. Eight tons of artemis ammunition ensures the 'Mech can keep firing during longer engagements. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: A配置是全导弹配置，搭载六具LRM-15发射器，全部配有阿尔忒弥斯IV火控系统。八个吨位的阿尔忒弥斯弹药确保这台机甲在较长时间的交战中能够持续开火。 特性：稳定 投放费用倍率：1.1 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Bravo configuration of the Liberator mounts a LBX AC/10 and a large pulse laser in each arm, leading to a substantial damage potential. However, the LBX ammunition is limited to only a few tons, which means the 'Mech relies on either resupply or only short engagements. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 解放者的 B 型配置在每条手臂上各装一门 LBX AC/10 和一门大型脉冲激光，伤害潜力相当可观。然而 LBX 弹药仅有寥寥数吨，这意味着这台机甲要么依赖补给，要么只能进行短促交战。 特性：稳定 投放费用倍率：1.1 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The C configuration mounts a massive Ultra AC/20 in the right arm, combined with a Large Pulser Laser in the left. Three Medium Pulse Lasers in the left torso help at medium ranges, while two Stream SRM-6 launchers can provide extra punch at close range. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: C 配置在右臂装有一门巨型 Ultra AC/20，左臂则配有一门大型脉冲激光。左躯干的三门中型脉冲激光在中距离上提供协助，而两具连发 SRM-6 发射器可在近距离带来额外的打击力。 特性：稳定 投放费用倍率：1.1 手臂驱动器限制：全向机甲

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The D loadout is an unusual ones, as it combines a long range weapon like the Gauss Rifle, with short range ones like its five SRM-6 launchers. The loadout also mounts a LRM-20 and Narc launcher. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: D 配置相当独特，它把高斯步枪这样的远程武器与五具 SRM-6 发射器这类近程武器结合在一起。该配置还装有一具 LRM-20 和 Narc 发射器。 特性：稳定 投放费用倍率：1.1 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The primary configuration mounts two ER PPC in the Left Arm and an Ultra AC/10 in the Right Arm. Three Medium Pulse Lasers were mounted in the Left Torso, and a single ER Small Laser in the Head. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 主配置在左臂装两门增程粒子炮，右臂装一门超级AC/10；左躯干装三门中型脉冲激光，头部一门单独的增程小型激光。 特性：稳定 投放费用倍率：1.1 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The A2 mounts an SRM-6 in each side torso, with a ton of CASE protected ammunition, and a Medium Pulse Laser in each arm. A single Small Laser is also mounted in the Mech's head. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Medium Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: A2在两侧躯干各装一具SRM-6（配一吨CASE防护弹药），每只手臂一门中型脉冲激光，头部另有一门小型激光。 特性：改进瞄准 - 中程 投放费用倍率：1.03 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The A5 is quite similar to the original A2, but replaces the standard SRM launchers with four Streak SRM-2. The use of Streak launchers allows preserving the ammunition better during long engagements, but does decrease the total firepower. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Medium Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: A5与原始A2相当相似，但以四具连发SRM-2取代标准SRM发射器。使用连发发射器能在长时间交战中更好地保存弹药，但总体火力有所下降。 特性：改进瞄准 - 中程 投放费用倍率：1.03 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: By replacing the Medium Pulse Lasers of the A2 with two LRM-10 launchers, the D4 achieves indirect fire capabilities. The SRM launchers had to be downgraded to SRM-4 to fit the larger LRMs, but the Small Laser has instead been upgraded to a Small Pulse Laser. The CASE protection was also removed and the fusion core is of a smaller 225 rated capacity. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Medium Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 以两具LRM-10发射器取代A2的中型脉冲激光，D4获得间接火力能力。为容纳更大的LRM，SRM发射器不得不降级为SRM-4，但小型激光反而升级为小型脉冲激光。CASE防护也被拆掉，聚变核心容量则缩小为225额定。 特性：改进瞄准 - 中程 投放费用倍率：1.03 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The last design of the Liberty line, the E12 adds electronic warfare systems to the design by a Guardian ECM mounted in the center torso. Its weapons consist of four SRM-4 and two Medium Lasers. As with the A models, the ammunition for the SRM launchers is C.A.S.E. protected. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Medium Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: E12是Liberty系列的最后一款设计，它通过在中央躯干安装守护者电子对抗套件，为该设计增添了电子战系统。其武器包括四具SRM-4和两门中型激光。与A型一样，SRM发射器的弹药受到C.A.S.E.保护。 特性：改进瞄准 - 中距 投放费用倍率：1.03 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Designed as a replacement to the Timber Wolf, the 65 ton Linebacker entered production in 3052. Built around a 390-rated XL Engine, the Linebacker’s faster speed enables it to keep up with lighter star mates in running battles, something the Timber Wolf struggled to do. A combination of Ferro-Fibrous armor and Endo Steel give the OmniMech 17.5 tons of free pod space. The Linebacker LBK-C is armed with a UAC/5 and an ER Large Laser. 4 ER Medium Lasers, 2 Machine Guns and a Flamer make up the rest of the Omni’s weapons. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 65吨的Linebacker是为取代Timber Wolf而设计的，于3052年投产。它以额定390的XL引擎为核心，较快的速度使其在运动战中能跟上更轻的星队同伴，而这正是Timber Wolf难以做到的。铁纤维装甲与内骨架的结合让这台全向机甲拥有17.5吨的自由挂载空间。Linebacker LBK-C装备一门UAC/5和一门增程大型激光，其余武器包括4门增程中型激光、2挺机枪和一具火焰喷射器。 特性：稳定 投放费用倍率：1.1 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Designed as a replacement to the Timber Wolf, the 65 ton Linebacker entered production in 3052. Built around a 390-rated XL Engine, the Linebacker’s faster speed enables it to keep up with lighter star mates in running battles, something the Timber Wolf struggled to do. A combination of Ferro-Fibrous armor and Endo Steel give the OmniMech 17.5 tons of free pod space. The Linebacker LBK-E is armed with an ER Large Laser and a pair of ATM-6’s. A Light Active Probe is installed in the CT. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 65吨的线卫于3052年投产，设计目的是取代木狼。它围绕一台390额定XL引擎建造，更快的速度让它能在运动中跟上更轻的星队同伴，而这正是木狼难以做到的。铁纤维装甲与内骨架的组合为这款全向机甲提供了17.5吨自由挂载空间。线卫LBK-E装有一门增程大型激光和一对ATM-6，中央躯干装有一台轻型主动探测器。 特性：稳定 投放费用倍率：1.1 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Designed as a replacement to the Timber Wolf, the 65 ton Linebacker entered production in 3052. Built around a 390-rated XL Engine, the Linebacker’s faster speed enables it to keep up with lighter star mates in running battles, something the Timber Wolf struggled to do. A combination of Ferro-Fibrous armor and Endo Steel give the OmniMech 17.5 tons of free pod space. The Linebacker LBK-Prime is armed with a pair of ER PPC’s. An LRM-5, Streak SRM-4 and a ER Small Laser fill out the remaining free weight. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Linebacker 被设计为 Timber Wolf 的替代机型，这款 65 吨机甲于 3052 年投入生产。它以一台 390 级 XL 引擎为核心，更快的速度让它能在机动战中跟上星队里更轻的战友，而这正是 Timber Wolf 难以做到的。铁纤维装甲与内骨架相结合，使这台全向机甲拥有 17.5 吨的自由荚舱空间。Linebacker LBK-Prime 装备一对增程粒子炮，另有一具 LRM-5、一具连发 SRM-4 和一门增程小型激光填补剩余的自由重量。 特性：稳定 投放费用倍率：1.1 手臂驱动器限制：全向机甲

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Designed as a replacement to the Timber Wolf, the 65 ton Linebacker entered production in 3052. Built around a 390-rated XL Engine, the Linebacker’s faster speed enables it to keep up with lighter star mates in running battles, something the Timber Wolf struggled to do. A combination of Ferro-Fibrous armor and Endo Steel give the OmniMech 17.5 tons of free pod space. The Linebacker LBK-RL is armed with a UAC/10 and a Streak SRM-4. 3 ER Small Lasers fill out the remaining free weight. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.12 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为木狼的替代型号，65吨的线卫于3052年投产。它围绕390额定XL引擎建造，更快的速度让线卫在运动战中能跟上星编队中更轻的同伴，而这正是木狼难以做到的。铁纤维装甲与内骨架的组合为这台全向机甲带来17.5吨的自由挂载空间。线卫LBK-RL装备1门UAC/10和1具连发SRM-4，剩余载重则由3门增程小型激光填满。 <特性：稳定 <投放费用倍率：1.12 <手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A loadout specifically created for battle challenges, the X configuration mounts a total of ten ER Medium Lasers, five in each arm. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: X 配置是专为战斗挑战打造的武器配置，共安装十门增程中型激光，每条手臂五门。 特性：稳定 投放费用倍率：1.1 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: At long range, the Lobo makes use of its ER large laser. As it closes, it can makes use of paired ATM-6s, paired heavy medium lasers and a heavy small laser. The meager 10 double heat sinks allotted to the design cannot hope to keep it cool, so MechWarriors have resorted to running the heat up to the red, then disengaging to cool off. Quirk: Accurate Weapon - Laser Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在远距离上，洛博使用它的增程大型激光。随着距离拉近，它可以动用成对的 ATM-6、成对的重型中型激光以及一门重型小型激光。该设计仅分配到区区10个双散热器，根本无法让它保持凉爽，因此机甲战士只好把热量逼到红区，再脱离战斗降温。 特性：精准武器 - 激光 投放费用倍率：1.08 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A Jade Falcon designed Locust IIC, as they tried to speed up production with simpler 'Mechs to recover after the losses during the failed Operation REVIVAL. Using Clan-grade Endo Steel structure and Ferro-Fibrous armor, enough weight was freed to mount two Streak SRM-2 launchers and two ER Medium Lasers. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是玉鹰部族设计的蝗虫IIC——在“复兴行动”失败、损失惨重之后，他们试图用更简单的机甲加快生产、恢复元气。该机甲采用部族级内骨架结构和铁纤维装甲，腾出的重量足以安装2具连发SRM-2发射器和2门增程中型激光。 <特性：狭小/低矮外形 <投放费用倍率：1.04 <手臂驱动器限制：左臂上段，右臂上段

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A total refit of the Locust by the infamous mercenary outfit Gray Death Legion. Trying to mimic the Locust IICs they have used large amounts of Clan tech on the base chassis, creating a fast moving 'Mech with the goal to flank other lights and quickly punch through their weakspots. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.01 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是臭名昭著的雇佣兵部队灰死军团对蝗虫的全面改装。他们试图模仿蝗虫IIC，在基础底盘上大量使用部族技术，造出一台高速机甲，目标是绕到其他轻型机甲侧翼并迅速击穿其弱点。 特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：1.01 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Like other major mercenary outfits, the Kell Hounds commonly refit their 'Mechs to suit their needs more by using Clan tech as it is usually better performing. The LCT-1KH is one of these designs, combining Endo Steel, Ferro-Fibrous and an XL engine, all in Clan spec, to reduce enough weight that the 'Mech can fit more weaponry. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 与其他主要雇佣兵部队一样，凯尔猎犬常用部族技术改装自己的机甲以适应需要，因为部族技术通常表现更好。LCT-1KH就是这类设计之一：它把内骨架、铁纤维和一台XL引擎（全为部族规格）结合起来，减掉足够重量以容纳更多武器。 特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：1.03 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The LCT-1L Locust was an attempt to allow the 'Mech to operate at even higher speeds by adding Triple Strength Myomer to the design. Introduced in 3030 the weapons are identical to those on the LCT-1V as it was a test-bed for the technology by Bergan Industries' Ares plant. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.95 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: LCT-1L蝗虫试图通过为该设计加入三倍强度人造肌，让机甲能以更高速度行动。它于3030年推出，作为伯根工业阿里斯工厂的技术试验平台，武器与LCT-1V完全相同。 特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：0.95 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Piloted by the mercenary Jostein Mouwen, the Locust 1VM is a Mech with a bloody legend. Deployed among the Rim Worlds occupation forces on Terra, the 1VM has seen combat against numerous resistance groups and SLDF survivors. Originally a standard model LCT-1V, Mouwen has used a combination of looted equipment and battlefield salvage to upgrade his LCT-1V into a murderous Infantry hunter. Retaining the standard armor and heat sinks of the 1V model, Mouwen incorporated an XL Engine and a pair of Small Pulse Lasers taken from a downed LCT-1VB. The left over free weight is devoted to a third Machine Gun and a TAG. A Supercharger allows the mercenary to outrun real opponents. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 由雇佣兵约斯泰因·穆文驾驶，蝗虫1VM是一台沾满鲜血传说的机甲。它被部署在地球上的边境世界占领军中，曾与众多抵抗组织及SLDF幸存者交战。1VM原本是标准型号LCT-1V，穆文用缴获装备与战场残骸把座机改造成凶残的步兵猎手。他保留1V的标准装甲与散热器，换装一台XL引擎和从一架坠毁的LCT-1VB上取来的两门小型脉冲激光；剩余自由重量用于第三挺机枪和一具TAG。增压器让这名雇佣兵能跑赢真正的对手。 特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：0.99 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A refit of the 1V that replaces the two Machine Guns with one more Medium Laser and a C3 slave unit. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.95 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是对1V的改装，以一门额外中型激光和一台C3从机取代两挺机枪。 特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：0.95 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A custom refit by the scrap refitters MechPros, most sold to mercenaries and less lawful areas, as the way the company acquired its inventory was questionable at best. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.95 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是废料改装商MechPros的定制改装，大部分卖给了雇佣兵和不太守法的地区，毕竟这家公司获取库存的方式本身就很有问题。 特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：0.95 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Developed by Majesty Metals in 3056 to produce an upgraded Locust model for the MAF, the Locust 3P is based on the original LCT-1V and swaps the Machine Guns for Small Lasers. The Medium Laser is upgraded to a Pulse model and armor protection increased through the use of Ferro-Fibrous armor. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.97 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Locust 3P由Majesty Metals公司于3056年为MAF研发，旨在提供一款升级版Locust。它以最初的LCT-1V为基础，将机枪换成小型激光。中型激光升级为脉冲型号，并通过采用铁纤维装甲提高防护能力。 特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：0.97 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Based on the earlier 3P model, the Locust 3T is produced by Pinard Protectorates. Introduced in 3059, the LCT-3T is a near clone of the 3P with identical levels of armor protection. Pinards engineers chose to swap the Medium Pulse Laser and 2 Small Lasers for a trio of Medium lasers for increased firepower. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.97 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Locust 3T以较早的3P型为基础，由Pinard Protectorates生产。LCT-3T于3059年推出，几乎是3P的翻版，装甲防护水平完全相同。Pinard的工程师选择把中型脉冲激光与2门小型激光换成三门中型激光，以获得更强的火力。 特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：0.97 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An anti-infantry variant of the Locust, the 4M mounts eight Small and one Medium Laser. To deal with the heat, the cooling uses double Heat Sinks. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.97 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Locust 的反步兵改型，4M 装备八门小型激光和一门中型激光。为解决散热问题，其冷却系统采用了双散热器。 特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：0.97 手臂驱动器限制：左上臂、右上臂

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A Clan-tech retrofit of the classic Locust and intended for second-line and solahma troops, the Locust C replaced each of the arm-mounted Machine Guns with a Clan ER Small Laser which frees up the weight to replace the center Medium Laser with a Clan-grade Medium Pulse Laser but leaves the structural components of the LCT-1V unaltered. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.95 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Locust C 是对经典 Locust 的部族技术改装，面向二线部队与 solahma（苏拉赫马）部队。它以一门部族增程小型激光取代了每侧手臂上的机枪，由此腾出吨位，把中央的中型激光换成部族级中型脉冲激光，但 LCT-1V 的结构部件保持不变。 特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：0.95 手臂驱动器限制：左臂上部、右臂上部

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Pirate's Bane is a light mech hunter killer built to keep the periphery pirates at bay. Keep moving and their teeth will be held at bay. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 海盗克星是专为牵制外围海盗而造的轻型机甲猎杀者。保持移动，他们的獠牙就无从下口。 特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：0.99 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A refit of the original -OW, the -OW2 is mostly similar, but instead of a head mounted Small Laser and with one ton of ammo less the armor protection is instead increased. Quirk: Anti-Air Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.13 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是对原版-OW的改装，-OW2大体相似，但不再装头部小型激光，并以少一吨弹药为代价增加装甲防护。 特性：防空瞄准 投放费用倍率：1.13 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The -10C is a refresh of the -8C, converting it to use more advanced technology. By changing to double heat sinks, 8 tons of cooling can be dropped while still improving the performance. The freed tons are used to add Artemis IV capabilities to all the LRM launchers, replacing the lasers with their extended range counterpart and adding CASE protection to the side torso. Another ton of ammo was also added, while keeping the same level of armoring. Quirk: Anti-Air Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: -10C是-8C的改良版本，改用更先进的技术。通过换装双散热器，可以在提升性能的同时省下8吨散热重量。腾出的吨位用于为所有LRM发射器加装阿尔忒弥斯IV功能，把激光更换为增程型号，并为侧躯干加装CASE保护。此外还增加了一个吨位的弹药，同时保持原有的装甲水平。 特性：对空瞄准 投放费用倍率：1.15 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A Star League era fire support platform, the Longbow is an 85 ton Assault Mech and one of the most used fire support mechs in existence. The LGB-12C is armed with paired LRM-20 and LRM-15 launchers, supported by a trio of ER Small Lasers. A 255-rated XL Engine, DHS and 12.5 tons of armor round out the design. Quirk: Anti-Air Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为星际联盟时代的火力支援平台，Longbow 是一具 85 吨的突击机甲，也是现存使用最广泛的火力支援机甲之一。LGB-12C 装备成对的 LRM-20 与 LRM-15 发射器，另有三具增程小型激光作为支援。一台 255 级 XL 引擎、双散热器和 12.5 吨装甲构成了完整的设计。 特性：防空瞄准 投放费用倍率：1.15 手臂驱动器限制：左上臂、右上臂

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An attempt to create the ultimate missile platform based on the Longbow chassis, the -12U mounts four Artemis IV enabled LRM-20 launchers and 10 tons of ammunition. Quirk: Anti-Air Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是基于长弓底盘打造终极导弹平台的尝试，-12U装四具带阿尔忒弥斯IV的LRM-20发射器和10吨弹药。 特性：防空瞄准 投放费用倍率：1.15 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An uncommon variant of the Longbow that mounts an Arrow IV artillery in each arm. A head mounted TAG helps with aquiring targets, and two ER Medium Lasers are available for defense. Quirk: Anti-Air Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 长弓的一款罕见变型，在每只手臂各装一门 Arrow IV 火炮。头部安装的 TAG 有助于捕获目标，另有两门 ER 中型激光可供自卫。 特性：防空瞄准 投放费用倍率：1.15 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Longbow LGB-8C mounts two LRM-20 and two LRM-5 launchers, combined with 4 Medium Lasers. The -8C carries a total of 22 heat sinks, but it still isn't enough to cover the heat generated from full alpha strikes. Five tons of LRM ammo rounds up the design. Quirk: Anti-Air Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.13 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Longbow LGB-8C 搭载两组 LRM-20 与两组 LRM-5 发射器，并配合 4 门中型激光。-8C 共配备 22 具散热器，但仍不足以抵消全齐射产生的热量。五吨 LRM 弹药让该设计更趋完备。 特性：防空瞄准 投放费用倍率：1.13 手臂驱动器限制：左臂上部、右臂上部

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Quirk: Anti-Air Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 特性：防空瞄准 投放费用倍率：1.09 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The confusingly named -OW variant of the Longbow is despite its similarity in designation with the more common variant -0W not actually based of it. Instead the -OW - or as it is commonly referred to due to its often garrison duties, the OverWatch - is a refit of the standard -7Q, adding two more Medium Lasers by dropping two tons of LRM ammunition. Quirk: Anti-Air Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.13 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 长弓这款命名令人困惑的-OW变型，尽管编号与更常见的-0W相似，实际上并非以其为基础。相反，-OW——或因常担任驻防任务而被称为“俯瞰”——是对标准-7Q的改装：通过拆掉两吨LRM弹药加装两门中型激光。 特性：防空瞄准 投放费用倍率：1.13 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Longinus is the Free Worlds League's attempt to duplicate Elemental Battle Armor. Though they were unable to match the original Clan-tech machine, the Longinus came the closest of any Inner Sphere attempt at the time, thanks in part to the help of the Word of Blake. Quirk: Well Designed Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.888 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 朗基努斯是自由世界联盟试图复制元素战斗装甲的成果。虽然他们无法与原始的氏族技术机器匹敌，但朗基努斯是当时所有内天体尝试中最接近的，部分得益于布雷克之言的帮助。 特质：设计精良 投放费用倍率：0.888 可挂载全能单位，可近战，可蜂群攻击。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Longinus is the Free Worlds League's attempt to duplicate Elemental Battle Armor. Though they were unable to match the original Clan-tech machine, the Longinus came the closest of any Inner Sphere attempt at the time, thanks in part to the help of the Word of Blake. Quirk: Well Designed Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.892 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.

Though they were unable to match the original Clan-tech machine, the Longinus came the closest of any Inner Sphere attempt at the time, thanks in part to the help of the Word of Blake. Quirk: Well Designed Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.892 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 朗基努斯是自由世界联盟试图复制元素战斗装甲的成果。虽然他们无法与原始的氏族技术机器匹敌，但朗基努斯是当时所有内天体尝试中最接近的，部分得益于布雷克之言的帮助。 特质：设计精良 投放费用倍率：0.892 可挂载全能单位，可近战，可蜂群攻击。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Longinus is the Free Worlds League's attempt to duplicate Elemental Battle Armor. Though they were unable to match the original Clan-tech machine, the Longinus came the closest of any Inner Sphere attempt at the time, thanks in part to the help of the Word of Blake. Quirk: Well Designed Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.888 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 朗基努斯是自由世界联盟试图复制元素战斗装甲的成果。虽然他们无法与原始的氏族技术机器匹敌，但朗基努斯是当时所有内天体尝试中最接近的，部分得益于布雷克之言的帮助。 特质：设计精良 投放费用倍率：0.888 可挂载全能单位，可近战，可蜂群攻击。

Though they were unable to match the original Clan-tech machine, the Longinus came the closest of any Inner Sphere attempt at the time, thanks in part to the help of the Word of Blake. Quirk: Well Designed Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.892 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.
