Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The original Longshot comes equipped with a Narc missile beacon system, dual SRM-6 racks, a pair of medium lasers, and a pair of small lasers. Instead of the LNG-2's reactive armor, it was instead protected by six tons of standard armor. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 最初的远射出厂即配一套Narc导弹信标系统、双联SRM-6挂架、两门中型激光和两门小型激光。它没有LNG-2的反应装甲，而是由六吨标准装甲保护。 特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：0.98 手臂驱动器限制：右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Longshot LNG-2's main armament are its dual SRM-6 launchers with Artemis IV fire control system, backed up by a pair of medium X-Pulse lasers. At close range it is protected by a pair of Innovative Design Concepts small X-Pulse lasers. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Longshot LNG-2 的主要武器是两部配备阿尔忒弥斯 IV 火控系统的 SRM-6 发射器，并由两门中型 X 脉冲激光提供辅助。在近距离，它则依靠 Innovative Design Concepts 公司的两门小型 X 脉冲激光获得保护。 特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：0.98 手臂驱动器限制：右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A hard hitting striker mech, the Lynx was one of the first mechs to mount an ER PPC. Produced by Blue Shot Weapons, the Lynx was designed as a striker mech, with a design that blended speed, armor and firepower into a fearsome package. Built around a 275-rated Fusion Core, the Lynx LNX-8Q is armed with a pair of Large Lasers. A pair of Medium Lasers provide close range firepower. Quirk: Multi Trac Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 山猫是一款打击力凶狠的突袭机甲，也是最早装设增程粒子炮的机甲之一。它由蓝射武器公司生产，被设计为突袭机甲，把速度、装甲与火力融合成一套可怕的整体。山猫LNX-8Q围绕一台275额定聚变核心建造，装有一对大型激光，另有一对中型激光提供近程火力。 特性：多目标追踪 投放费用倍率：1.03 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A hard hitting striker mech, the Lynx was one of the first mechs to mount an ER PPC. Produced by Blue Shot Weapons, the Lynx was designed as a striker mech, with a design that blended speed, armor and firepower into a fearsome package. Built around a 275-rated XL Engine, the Lynx LNX-9C is armed with an ER PPC. 4 Medium Lasers and a pair of SSRM-2’s provide close range firepower. Quirk: Multi Trac Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 山猫是一款打击力凶狠的突袭机甲，也是最早装设增程粒子炮的机甲之一。它由蓝射武器公司生产，被设计为突袭机甲，把速度、装甲与火力融合成一套可怕的整体。山猫LNX-9C围绕一台275额定XL引擎建造，装有一门增程粒子炮；4门中型激光和一对SSRM-2提供近程火力。 特性：多目标追踪 投放费用倍率：1.05 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A hard hitting striker mech, the Lynx was one of the first mechs to mount an ER PPC. Produced by Blue Shot Weapons, the Lynx was designed as a striker mech, with a design that blended speed, armor and firepower into a fearsome package. Built around a 275-rated XL Engine, the Lynx LNX-9Q is armed with an ER PPC and a Large Laser. 4 Medium Lasers provide close range firepower. Quirk: Multi Trac Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Lynx 是一款打击力强悍的突击机甲，也是最早搭载增程粒子炮的机甲之一。Lynx 由 Blue Shot Weapons 生产，定位为突击机甲，其设计将速度、装甲与火力融合为一个令人生畏的整体。Lynx LNX-9Q 以一台 275 级 XL 引擎为核心，装备一门增程粒子炮和一门大型激光，另有 4 门中型激光提供近距火力。 特性：多重追踪 投放费用倍率：1.03 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A hard hitting striker mech, the Lynx was one of the first mechs to mount an ER PPC. Produced by Blue Shot Weapons, the Lynx was designed as a striker mech, with a design that blended speed, armor and firepower into a fearsome package. Built around a 275-rated XL Engine, the Lynx LNX-9R is armed with an ER PPC and an ER Large Laser. 4 Medium Lasers provide close range firepower. Quirk: Multi Trac Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Lynx 是一具打击力强悍的突击机甲，也是最早搭载增程粒子炮的机甲之一。它由 Blue Shot Weapons 生产，设计定位为突击机甲，将速度、装甲与火力融于一身，构成令人生畏的组合。Lynx LNX-9R 以 275 级 XL 引擎为核心，装备一门增程粒子炮和一门大型增程激光，另有 4 门中型激光提供近距离火力。 特性：多目标追踪 投放费用倍率：1.05 手臂驱动器限制：左臂上部、右臂上部

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An evolution of the Star League Lynx, the Lynx C was an early Smoke Jaguar mech. Pushed out of front line service by the newly developed Omnimechs, the Lynx C was relegated to garrison and Solahma units with significant numbers of Lynx C’s still in service during the Word of Blake Jihad. Retaining the 275 XL Engine of the original Lynx, the Lynx C is a full clan tech rebuild of the older Star League design. An ER PPC is paired with an ER Large Laser and a Large Pulse Laser. A pair of ER Medium Lasers and a ER Small Laser provide close range firepower. Quirk: Multi Trac Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Lynx C 是星际联盟 Lynx 的进化型，也是烟虎部族早期的机甲。随着新研制的全向机甲将其挤出一线服役，Lynx C 被降级配属守备与 solahma 部队，而直到布莱克之词圣战期间，仍有相当数量的 Lynx C 在役。Lynx C 保留了原版 Lynx 的 275 XL引擎，是对这台较早期星际联盟设计的全面部族技术重制。一门增程粒子炮搭配一门增程大型激光与一门大型脉冲激光。两门增程中型激光与一门增程小型激光提供近距离火力。 特性：多重追踪 投放费用倍率：1.09 手臂驱动器限制：左臂上部、右臂上部

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A heavily updated Mackie, carrying a massive Gauss Rifle. Generally seen as part of periphery garrisons. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一台经过大幅升级的 Mackie，携有一门巨大的高斯步枪。通常作为外围地区驻防部队的一部分出现。 特性：易于维护 投放费用倍率：1.16 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右上

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An update of the Mackie mounting a combination of weapons for various situations; an AC-20, a Large Laser, a PPC, five Machine Guns and two Medium Lasers. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Mackie 的更新型号，搭载了可应对各种战况的武器组合：一门 AC-20、一门大型激光、一门粒子炮、五挺机枪和两门中型激光。 特性：易于维护 投放费用倍率：1.16 手臂驱动器限制：左臂上部、右臂上部

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Mackie 6S2 is a prime example of the patchwork mechs of the Deep Periphery. Battered and rusting, these Mackies are in a shoddy state of repair, maintained by people with neither the skills nor the resources for anything better than rudimentary patch jobs. The original AC/10 has been removed and replaced with a locally made knock off of the classic Thumper artillery piece, whilst the delicate PPC has been replaced with a Large Laser. Never seen in the Inner Sphere, these Mackies are found in the deepest parts of the Periphery, their existence only confirmed by the expeditions of the Explorer Corps. Other variants are rumoured to exist, but have not been confirmed at this time. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Mackie 6S2 最能体现外围地区深处那些拼凑机甲的面貌。这些 Mackie 伤痕累累、锈迹斑斑，维修状况极差，维护它们的人既无技术也无资源，只能做最粗陋的临时修补。原有的 AC/10 已被拆除，换成本地仿制的经典 Thumper 火炮；精密的粒子炮则换成了大型激光。这些 Mackie 从未出现在内层星域，只存在于外围地区最偏远的角落，其存在仅由探索军团的远征所证实。据传还有其他变型机存在，但目前尚未得到确认。 特性：易于维护 投放费用倍率：0.98 手臂驱动器限制：左上臂、右上臂

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Onee of multiple variants emerged from factories with an \"MSK-7#\" designation. Dating to the late 2400s, these variants utilized powerful autocannons and energy weapons. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是多款以“MSK-7#”编号出厂变型中的一款。它们可追溯到2400年代后期，采用强力自动炮与能量武器。 特性：易于维护 投放费用倍率：1.16 手臂驱动器限制：右上

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The unofficial mascot of the Desert Wars portion of the Martial Olympiad, Kill Roy uses two LB 10-X autocannons instead of the single AC/20. Two tons of ammunition are stored in each side torso. For protection, the torsos are equipped with CASE. To make room for these, the Beagle Active Probe has been removed. Thirteen Double Heat Sinks keep the 'Mech running. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.2 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为军事奥林匹克“沙漠战争”环节的非官方吉祥物，“杀戮罗伊”用2门LB 10-X自动炮取代了单门AC/20，两侧躯干各存放2吨弹药；为加强防护，躯干都装上了CASE。为腾出空间，比格犬主动探测器已被拆除。13具双散热器让这台机甲持续运转。 <特性：易于维护 <投放费用倍率：1.2 <手臂驱动器限制：左臂下段，右臂上段
麦基 MSK-9HKR '击杀罗伊的小伙伴'

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Classified Quirk: Land Air Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.17 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 机密 特性：陆空机甲 投放费用倍率：1.17 手臂驱动器限制：左下臂、右下臂

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Though bearing a remarkable outward resemblance to the Timberwolf, this BattleMech is a new and powerful creation. Carrying thirteen tons of ferro-fibrous armor, the Mad Cat MK II is an incredibly resilient design. A pair of arm mounted Gaussrifles supported by torso mounted LRM racks give it complete command over the battlefield. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Medium Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.24 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 尽管外形与野狼惊人地相似，这台战斗机甲却是一个全新而强大的造物。疯猫 MK II 携带十三吨铁纤维装甲，是极其坚韧的设计。两门安装在手臂上的高斯步枪，配合躯干上的 LRM 发射架，让它完全主宰战场。 特性：改进瞄准 - 中程 投放费用倍率：1.24 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An alternative version of the Mad Dog A loadout, changing its weapons to two LB-X 10 Autocannons and 4 ER Medium Lasers instead of 6 SRM-6 launchers, the LB-X 5 and the ER PPC. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Medium Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Mad Dog A 配置的另一种版本，将其武器改为两门 LB-X 10 自动炮和 4 门增程中型激光，取代原有的 6 具 SRM-6 发射器、LB-X 5 以及增程粒子炮。 特性：改进瞄准 - 中程 投放费用倍率：1.09 手臂驱动器限制：全向机甲

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The personal ride of Smoke Jaguar Galaxy Commander Russou Howell. The Bandit is armed with a mammoth Ultra Autocannon/20 in each side torso and only twin ER Small Lasers in each arm as supporting weapons, its pilot must make every shot of its combined total of two tons of reloads count. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Medium Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是烟虎部族星系指挥官拉苏·豪威尔的私人座机。强盗在两侧躯干各装一门庞大的超级AC/20，每只手臂只有双联增程小型激光作为支援武器，因此飞行员必须让总共两吨再装填弹药的每一发都打中。 特性：改进瞄准 - 中程 投放费用倍率：1.11 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The D2 loadout is an alternate version of the standard D loadout of the Mad Dog, focused on more Energy-based damage. The ATM-12 launchers are downgraded to ATM-6, but the lasers are replaced with larger ones. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Medium Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: D2 配置是疯狗标准 D 配置的替代版本，更侧重于能量武器伤害。ATM-12 发射器降级为 ATM-6，但激光则换成了更大的型号。 特性：改进瞄准 - 中程 投放费用倍率：1.09 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A subloadout of the Mad Dog D, mounting three ATM-9s and three ER Medium Lasers together with 6 tons of ATM ammunition. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Medium Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是疯狗D的子载荷，装三具ATM-9和三门增程中型激光，以及6吨ATM弹药。 特性：改进瞄准 - 中程 投放费用倍率：1.09 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An alternate to the standard 'D' version, this one sports 3 medium pulse lasers, 2 LB 2-X autocannons, a LRM-20 and a Streak SRM-6. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Medium Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是标准“D”版本的替代方案，配备 3 门中型脉冲激光、2 门 LB 2-X 自动炮、一具 LRM-20 和一具连发 SRM-6。 特性：改进瞄准 - 中程 投放费用倍率：1.09 手臂驱动器限制：全向机甲

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Mad Dog G2 loadout mounts two ER PPC, two LRM-10 launchers and a battle computer. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Medium Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Mad Dog G2 配置装有两门增程粒子炮、两具 LRM-10 发射器和一台战斗计算机。 特性：改进瞄准 - 中型 投放费用倍率：1.09 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Mad Dog J loadout is trying to be a jack-of-all-trades, mounting an assortment of ER lasers, three Machine Guns, two LRM-10 launchers and a LB-X 20 Autocannon. However, the concept didn't really work in reality so the loadout sees little actual use. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Medium Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Mad Dog J 配置试图做到样样精通，搭载了各种增程激光、三挺机枪、两具 LRM-10 发射器以及一门 LB-X 20 自动炮。然而这一理念在现实中并不奏效，因此该配置实际使用得很少。 特性：改进瞄准（中程） 投放费用倍率：1.09 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A loadout used by the mercenary band the Kell Hounds for their 'aquired' Mad Dogs. The combination of a UAC/5, two Artemis IV-enabled LRM-15 launchers and a Large Pulse Laser means the loadout brings quite the punch to the table. A C3 slave unit and a ER Medium Laser rounds up the KH. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Medium Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是雇佣兵团体凯尔猎犬为其“获取”来的疯狗所使用的配置。一门UAC/5、两具配备阿尔忒弥斯IV的LRM-15发射器加上一门大型脉冲激光，让这套配置拥有相当可观的打击力。一套C3从属单元和一门增程中型激光则为KH配置画上句号。 特性：改进瞄准 - 中程 投放费用倍率：1.09 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: One of few Mad Dog loadouts which allow jumping, the M mounts 5 JumpJets, two ER PPC, two Heavy Medium Lasers and an impressive 21 double heat sinks. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Medium Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是疯狗少数允许跳跃的载荷之一，M型装5具跳跃推进器、两门增程粒子炮、两门重型中型激光，以及令人印象深刻的21个双散热器。 特性：改进瞄准 - 中程 投放费用倍率：1.09 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The first of three redesigns of the Mad Dog chassis by the fabled design bureau 'Mek Commander'. Dropping some of the weapons and using an Endo Steel structure, allows the redesigned 'Mech to carry 11.5 tons of standard armor. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Medium Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是传奇设计局“Mek Commander”对 Mad Dog 底盘所作三次重新设计中的第一种。通过减少部分武器并采用内骨架结构，重新设计的机甲得以携带 11.5 吨标准装甲。 特性：改进瞄准（中程） 投放费用倍率：1.09 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: One of the three redesigns of the Mad Dog chassis by the fabled design bureau 'Mek Commander'. Reducing the armor to 8.5 tons and using an Endo Steel chassis allows the MC-J to combine the weapons of the MC-A with five jump jets. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Medium Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是传奇设计局“Mek Commander”对Mad Dog底盘的三款重新设计之一。将装甲减至8.5吨并采用内骨架底盘后，MC-J得以把MC-A的武器与五具跳跃推进器结合在一起。 特性：改进瞄准 - 中距 投放费用倍率：1.09 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: One of the three redesigns of the Mad Dog chassis by the fabled design bureau 'Mek Commander'. Replacing the Prime loadouts Large Pulse Lasers and changing to an Endo-Steel chassis allows the addition of five double heatsinks, greatly improving the cooling capabilities. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Medium Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是传奇设计局“机甲指挥官”对疯狗底盘的三次重新设计之一。它替换主型号载荷的大型脉冲激光并改用内骨架底盘，从而得以加装五个双散热器，大幅改善冷却能力。 特性：改进瞄准 - 中程 投放费用倍率：1.09 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An alternate base loadout for the Mad Dog, focused on pure Pulse Laser performance. Two Large and four Medium Pulse Lasers combined with a Targetting Computer and cooled by 16 double heat sinks makes it meet the intended design goal with ease. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Medium Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是疯狗的备用基础载荷，专注纯脉冲激光性能。两门大型和四门中型脉冲激光，配合一台瞄准计算机，并由16个双散热器降温，轻松达成预期设计目标。 特性：改进瞄准 - 中程 投放费用倍率：1.09 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Piloted by an ex-Smoke Jaguar turned Solaris VII MechWarrior known only as Garrett, the 'Revenant' is a long-range specialist mounting a massive 60 Long range Missile tubes in its side torsos supported by four Medium Pulse Lasers in the arms and center torso. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Medium Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: "亡魂"由一位只以加勒特之名示人的前烟豹部族成员驾驶，此人后来成为索拉里斯七号的机甲战士。它是一台远程专精机甲，两侧躯干共装有整整60管远程导弹，手臂与中躯干另有四具中型脉冲激光作为支援。 特性：改进瞄准（中型） 投放费用倍率：1.11 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Designed primarily as a fire support Mech, the Vulture emphasizes speed and firepower over armor. The 60 ton OmniMech is powered by a 300-rated XL Engine with Ferro-Fibrous Armor; giving the OmniMech, 28 tons of pod space. The Vulture S is armed with a pair of ER PPC’s and a trio of Medium Pulse Lasers. An Active Probe allows the Vulture to function as a scout, while 5 Jump Jets improve it’s mobility. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Medium Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 秃鹫主要设计为火力支援机甲，把速度与火力置于装甲之上。这台60吨全向机甲由一台300额定XL引擎驱动，配铁纤维装甲，拥有28吨挂载空间。秃鹫S装有两门增程粒子炮和三门中型脉冲激光。一台主动探测器让秃鹫能充当侦察机，5具跳跃推进器则提升其机动性。 特性：改进瞄准 - 中程 投放费用倍率：1.09 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A special loadout used by Wolf's Dragoons, the famous mercenary unit with clan ties. Used as a command 'Mech it carries a C3 master unit, but still has enough space to mount two ER Large Lasers and two Medium Lasers combined with two Streak SRM-6 launchers. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Medium Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是狼之龙骑兵使用的特殊载荷——这支与部族有渊源的著名雇佣兵部队。它作为指挥机甲带一台C3主机单元，但仍有足够空间装两门增程大型激光和两门中型激光，搭配两具连发SRM-6发射器。 特性：改进瞄准 - 中程 投放费用倍率：1.09 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A loadout used by Wolf's Dragoons, the famous mercenary unit with clan ties. Mounting two ER Large Lasers and two Medium Lasers combined with two Streak SRM-6 launchers and seven extra double heat sinks for cooling. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Medium Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是狼之龙骑兵使用的配置——这支与部族有渊源的著名雇佣兵部队。它装有两门增程大型激光和两门中型激光，搭配两具连发SRM-6发射器，并有七个额外双散热器降温。 特性：改进瞄准 - 中程 投放费用倍率：1.09 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Maelstrom was originally designed to carry on legacy of the Marauder, with its hunched-over profile and the unique ball-and-socket construction. The collapse of the Star League doomed the project and left the Maelstrom on the drawing board. With the discovery of the Helm Memory Core by the GDL, the plans for the Maelstrom were also rediscovered and production was started in the Inner Sphere. The Maelstrom is built using a weight-saving 375 XL engine that propels the 'Mech up to 86.4 km/h. For protection, the Maelstrom carries 14.5 tons of armor and uses 19 double heat sinks to handle the 'Mech's heavy heat load. The armament of the Maelstrom is a Defiance 1001 ER PPC paired up with a Cyclops XII ER Large Laser. For close combat, the Maelstrom carries two Defiance P5M Medium Pulse Lasers and a Jackson Model 12 Small Laser. Finally, the Maelstrom carries a TAG laser designator. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 漩涡最初的设计意图是继承掠夺者的血脉——同样弓背的轮廓和独特的球窝式结构。星际联盟的崩溃让这个项目夭折，漩涡也一直停留在图纸上。随着灰死军团发现地狱记忆核心，漩涡的设计方案也被重新找到，并在内层星域开始生产。漩涡采用减轻重量的 375 XL 引擎，可推动机甲达到 86.4 km/h。防护方面，漩涡携带 14.5 吨装甲，并使用19个双散热器来应对机甲沉重的热负荷。漩涡的武器是一门 Defiance 1001 ER PPC，搭配一门 Cyclops XII 增程大型激光。近身战斗方面，漩涡装有两门 Defiance P5M 中型脉冲激光和一门 Jackson Model 12 小型激光。最后，漩涡还装有一具 TAG 激光指示器。 特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：1.11 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Created by Clan Widowmaker in the Golden Century, it carries an Enhanced ER PPC and a standard Clan ER Large Laser. The small laser has been replaced by a prototype ER Medium Laser. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 由部族寡妇制造者于金世纪研制，装备一门增强型 增程粒子炮和一门标准的部族 ER 大型激光。小型激光则被一门原型 ER 中型激光取代。 特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：1.09 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Over a third of the Mandrill's tonnage is devoted to a pair of LRM-20 launchers and their attendant ammunition, which is limited, but usually enough for duels. The head-mounted ER small laser is something of an afterthought, though it does allow Mandrills to keep fighting after they run out of ammo. Quirk: Accurate Weapon - Laser Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Mandrill 超过三分之一的吨位都用于两具 LRM-20 发射器及其配套弹药，弹药量虽然有限，但通常足以应付决斗。头部安装的小型增程激光多少算是事后补上的，不过它确实让 Mandrill 在弹药耗尽后仍能继续战斗。 特性：精准武器（激光） 投放费用倍率：1.03

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Debuting in 3052, the Mantis is a light mech designed for the Mech arenas on Solaris VII. A 30-ton Mech, the Mantis is powered by a 270-rated XL Engine, giving it the speed to outrun or out-maneuver almost any other Mech. The Mantis MTS-S is armed with 3 ER Medium Lasers and a pair of ER Small Lasers. MASC and a pair of Claws allow it to tear apart other Mechs. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 螳螂于3052年首次亮相，是为索拉里斯VII机甲竞技场设计的轻型机甲。这台30吨机甲由一台270额定XL引擎驱动，速度足以跑赢或机动胜过几乎任何其他机甲。螳螂MTS-S装有三门增程中型激光和一对增程小型激光。MASC和一对爪让它能撕碎其他机甲。 特性：战拳 投放费用倍率：0.99

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Debuting in 3052, the Mantis is a light mech designed for the Mech arenas on Solaris VII. A 30-ton Mech, the Mantis is powered by a 270-rated XL Engine, giving it the speed to outrun or out-maneuver almost any other Mech. The Mantis SA-MN is armed with a pair of Small Lasers and a Medium Laser. MASC and a pair of Claws allow it to tear apart other Mechs. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 螳螂于 3052 年首次亮相，是一款为 Solaris VII 机甲竞技场设计的轻型机甲。这台 30 吨的机甲由一台额定 270 的 XL 引擎驱动，速度足以甩开或绕开几乎所有其他机甲。螳螂 SA-MN 装备两门小型激光和一门中型激光。MASC 与一对利爪让它能把其他机甲撕成碎片。 特性：战拳 投放费用倍率：0.99

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: It is unclear who this custom fitted 'Mech used to belong to, but it must've been someone low on funds or parts. The unimpressive array of weapons include only three Large and two Medium standard lasers, together with a head mounted SRM-4. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 不清楚这台定制机甲原先属于谁，但对方想必资金或零件都很紧张。这套毫不起眼的武器只有三门大型和两门标准中型激光，外加头部一具SRM-4。 特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：1.18 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Appearing in 3012, the Marauder II is a redesign of the classic Marauder, turning the 75 ton Heavy Mech into a 100 ton Assault. Originally a Wolf's Dragoons exclusive Mech, it wasn’t until after the 4th War of Succession in 3030 that the Mech would spread beyond the Dragoons. Powered by a 300-rated XL Engine, the Marauder II MAD-5A is armed with an LB-10X, paired ER PPC’s and Medium Lasers. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 掠夺者 II 于 3012 年问世，是对经典掠夺者的重新设计，把这台 75 吨的重型机甲变成了一台 100 吨的突击机甲。它最初是狼之龙骑兵的专属机甲，直到 3030 年第四次继承战争之后，这台机甲才流传到龙骑兵之外。掠夺者 II MAD-5A 由一台 300 级 XL 引擎驱动，装备一门 LB-10X、成对的 ER PPC 以及中型激光。 特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：1.18 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Appearing in 3012, the Marauder II is a redesign of the classic Marauder, turning the 75 ton Heavy Mech into a 100 ton Assault. Originally a Wolf's Dragoons exclusive Mech, it wasn’t until after the 4th War of Succession in 3030 that the Mech would spread beyond the Dragoons. Powered by a 300-rated Fusion Core, the Marauder II MAD-5B is armed with a Gauss Rifle, paired ER PPC’s and Medium Lasers. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 掠夺者 II（Marauder II）于 3012 年问世，是对经典掠夺者（Marauder）的重新设计，把这款 75 吨重型机甲变成了 100 吨的突击机甲。它最初是狼之龙骑兵（Wolf's Dragoons）的专属机甲，直到 3030 年第四次继承战争之后才流传到龙骑兵之外。MAD-5B 型掠夺者 II 由一台额定 300 的聚变核心驱动，装备一门高斯步枪、成对的增程粒子炮以及中型激光。 特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：1.18 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Appearing in 3012, the Marauder II is a redesign of the classic Marauder, turning the 75 ton Heavy Mech into a 100 ton Assault. Originally a Wolf's Dragoons exclusive Mech, it wasn’t until after the 4th War of Succession in 3030 that the Mech would spread beyond the Dragoons. Powered by a 300-rated XL Engine, the Marauder II MAD-5C is armed with a UAC/5, paired ER PPC’s and Medium Lasers. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Marauder II 于 3012 年问世，是对经典 Marauder 的重新设计，将这款 75 吨的重型机甲转变为 100 吨的突击机甲。它原本是狼之龙骑兵的专属机甲，直到 3030 年第四次继承战争结束后，才流传到龙骑兵之外。Marauder II MAD-5C 由一台 300 级 XL 引擎驱动，装备一门 UAC/5、一对增程粒子炮和若干中型激光。 特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：1.18 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Maruder II MAD-5V is mainly seen amongst mercenary outfits, as it is one of the cheapest and most accessible variants of the Marauder II. A LBX AC/10 and two ER PPC are the main damage sources, with two Medium Lasers as backup. The design also includes CASE protection, a Beagle active probe and a Guardian ECM suite. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Maruder II MAD-5V 主要出现在雇佣兵部队中，因为它是 Marauder II 最便宜、最容易获得的变型之一。其主要伤害来源为一门 LBX AC/10 和两门增程粒子炮，另有两门中型激光作为备用。该设计还包括 CASE 防护、一具 Beagle 主动探测器和一套 Guardian 电子对抗套件。 特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：1.18 手臂驱动器限制：左下臂、右下臂

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Used by the Wolf's Dragoons, the 6W is a full Clan technology conversion of the Marauder II. Besides the two ER PPC, two Large Pulse Lasers and the LBX AC/10, the variant also brings a C3 slave unit. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.24 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是狼之龙骑兵使用的6W，是把劫掠者II完全改装为部族技术的版本。除两门增程粒子炮、两门大型脉冲激光和那门LBX AC/10外，该变型还带一台C3从机。 特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：1.24 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This 'Mech features a unique loadout - an Ultra AC/10 in each arm supported by a pair of left torso-mounted Streak SRM-6 launchers and twin Medium Pulse Lasers in the right torso. Built around a 300-rated XL Engine, the 'Mech features a Beagle Active Probe, three jump jets, nineteen tons of armor, three tons each of Ultra autocannon and Streak missile reloads offer reasonable endurance. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.2 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该机甲采用独特载荷：每只手臂各一门超级AC/10，辅以左躯干的一对连发SRM-6发射器和右躯干的双联中型脉冲激光。它围绕一台300额定XL引擎建造，配备比格犬主动探测器、三具跳跃推进器、十九吨装甲；各三吨的超级自动炮与连发导弹再装填弹药提供了不错的持续力。 特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：1.2 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The personal 'Mech of Major Susan Barber, the leader of the mercenary unit known as Barber's Marauder IIs. The design contains two Clan ER PPC, two Medium Lasers and a LBX AC/10, combined with a 300 XL engine and CASE protection. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.2 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是雇佣兵部队“巴伯的劫掠者II”首领苏珊·巴伯少校的私人机甲。该设计装有两门部族增程粒子炮、两门中型激光和一门LBX AC/10，并配合300 XL引擎和CASE防护。 特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：1.2 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.12 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：1.12 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Introduced back in 3025 but unknown to Inner Sphere intelligence forces until the Jihad era, this older version replaces the ER PPC found in the left arm with the Medium Pulse Laser from the right arm. An LRM-10 with a ton of ammunition is added to the left torso and the ER Small Lasers in the center and right torsos are replaced with a single Medium Pulse Laser in each. Quirk: Hyper-Extending Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.19 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这一较早的版本于3025年推出，但直到圣战时期才被内层星域情报部门知晓。它把左臂的增程粒子炮换成右臂的中型脉冲激光，左躯干加装一具LRM-10（配一吨弹药），中央与右躯干的增程小型激光则各换成一门中型脉冲激光。 特性：超伸展驱动器 投放费用倍率：1.19 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This variant uses the ER PPCs of the standard Marauder IIC but replaces the short range weapons with two Streak SRM-4s, one in the center torso and one in the right torso. These missile launchers share a single ton of ammunition. Quirk: Hyper-Extending Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.19 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 此变型使用标准劫掠者IIC的增程粒子炮，但以两具连发SRM-4取代近程武器——中央躯干一具，右躯干一具。这些导弹发射器共用一吨弹药。 特性：超伸展驱动器 投放费用倍率：1.19 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A customized variant of the Marauder IIC, the Scorch mounts a Large Pulse Laser and Ultra AC/5 in each arm supported by four Streak SRM-6 launchers split between each side torso. Twelve tons of Ferro-Fibrous armor protect Scorch and the two-tons each of Streak and Ultra Autocannon ammo and fifteen double heat-sinks it carries. Quirk: Hyper-Extending Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.21 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为 Marauder IIC 的定制变型，Scorch 在每只手臂各搭载一具大型脉冲激光和一门超级 AC/5，另有四具连发 SRM-6 发射器分置于两侧躯干作为支援。十二吨铁纤维装甲为 Scorch 以及它携带的各两吨连发弹药、超级自动炮弹药与十五具双散热器提供防护。 特性：超伸展驱动器 投放费用倍率：1.21 手臂驱动器限制：左下臂、右下臂

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This Early Clan upgrade of the SLDF's Marauder 2R replaces the AC/5 with a prototype Ultra AC/2 and both ER PPCs with Clan Wolverine's Enhanced ER PPC. Everything else on the 'Mech remains the same as the original Royal variant. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是SLDF的Marauder 2R的早期部族升级版，以一门原型Ultra AC/2替换AC/5，并将两门增程粒子炮换成狼獾部族的增强型增程粒子炮。机甲上的其他一切与原皇家变型完全相同。 特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：1.11 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A battlefield refit of the Marauder MAD-3D, which adds both considerable more armor and a C3 slave unit by switching to Double Heat Sinks. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是劫掠者MAD-3D的野战改装，通过改用双散热器同时添加了相当多的装甲和一台C3从机。 特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：1.09 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A Marauder variant update on a Clan tech base, designed and primarily used by the Grey Death Legion mercenary forces. Two ER PPC and a single Ultra AC/5 are the main damage dealers, with two secondary Medium Pulse Lasers as support. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.17 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是掠袭者在部族科技基础上更新的变型，由灰死军团雇佣兵部队设计并主要使用。两门增程粒子炮和一门超级AC/5是主要的输出武器，另有两门中型脉冲激光作为次要支援。 特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：1.17 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The MAD-3H Marauder, dubbed the 'Fiddler Crab', abandons elegance for terror. Bristling with blazers and wielding a crushing mace, it advances relentlessly into close quarters. Its asymmetric, heavily armored frame embodies a nightmarish evolution of a once-proud command BattleMech, built to intimidate and destroy. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: MAD-3H劫掠者绰号“招潮蟹”，它抛弃优雅转向恐怖：浑身烈焰炮、手持碾压大锤，无情地推进到近身距离。它那不对称、装甲厚重的构架，体现出一台曾经骄傲的指挥战斗机甲噩梦般的演化——为恐吓与毁灭而造。 特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：1.09 手臂驱动器限制：右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The -3K is a custom Clan tech variant of the Marauder fielded by the Kell Hounds. It centers around a Gauss Rifle in the Right Torso and two ER PPC, one in each arm. Two Medium Pulse Lasers provide extra firepower as needed. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.17 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: -3K是凯尔猎犬使用的劫掠者定制部族技术变型。它以右躯干的一门高斯步枪和两臂各一门增程粒子炮为核心，两门中型脉冲激光按需提供额外火力。 特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：1.17 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A common refit of the 3R. By upgrading to Double Heat Sinks both more weapons and better protection could be added to the design. A C3 slave was also part of the additions. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是3R的常见改装。通过升级为双散热器，该设计得以加装更多武器和更好的防护，此外还加装了一台C3从机。 特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：1.09 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 3T is an uncommon variant of the Marauder, with its full energy build of four ER Large Lasers it tends to overheat easily even with 22 double heat sinks. The variant never saw any greater acceptance with MechWarriors due to this. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 3T 是掠夺者中不常见的一个变型，纯粹的能量武器配置带来四门 ER 大型激光，即使有 22 台双散热器也容易过热。正因如此，该变型从未在机甲战士中获得更广泛的认可。 特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：1.11 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 3W was used with the Wolf's Dragoons mercenary outfit as a command mech. Even though it looks like a normal Marauder on the outside, most of its internal have been replaced by Clan grade technology. The weapons consist of two ER PPC, one Large and two Medium Pulse Lasers, and a C3 Master unit is mounted in the left torso. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.17 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 3W曾被狼之龙骑兵雇佣兵部队用作指挥机甲。虽然外表看起来像普通的劫掠者，其内部大多已换成部族级技术。武器包括两门增程粒子炮、一门大型和两门中型脉冲激光，左躯干内装有一台C3主机。 特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：1.17 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Marauder 4D is, despite its variant name starting with a 4, not based on the Marauder II chassis, but the original Marauder. It combines two ER PPC with four ER Medium Lasers and a single Large Pulser Laser. A TAG is further mounted in the head. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 劫掠者4D虽然变型名以4开头，却并非以劫掠者II底盘为基础，而是原始劫掠者。它把两门增程粒子炮与四门增程中型激光和一门大型脉冲激光组合起来，头部还装有一具TAG。 特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：1.11 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Born of a collaboration between Majesty Metals and Taurus Territorial Industries, the Marauder MAD-4T is an upgrade package for the standard Marauder MAD-3R. Largely identical to the MAD-3R, the 4T swaps the standard SHS for 14 DHS. The remaining 2 tons are devoted to a CASE protected ammo bay for the autocannon and a Beagle Active Probe sourced from the Cappellans. Intended as a bodyguard Mech for Command Lances, the MAD-4T is marketed as a cheaper alternative to the newer Marauder variants appearing in the Inner Sphere. Approved for limited export by both the Magistracy and the Concordant, the MAD-4T is starting to spread to customers through out the Periphery. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Marauder MAD-4T是Majesty Metals与Taurus Territorial Industries合作的产物，是标准型Marauder MAD-3R的升级套件。4T与MAD-3R大体相同，只是把标准SHS换成了14具DHS。剩下的2吨则用于为自动炮增设一个受CASE保护的弹药舱，以及一具从卡佩兰人手中取得的Beagle主动探测器。MAD-4T定位为指挥小队的护卫机甲，以比内层星域新出现的Marauder改型更便宜的替代方案作为卖点。该型获Magistracy与Concordant双方批准限量出口，如今正开始流向整个外围地区的客户。 特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：1.11 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A Clan Buster upgrade, the Marauder 5CS was developed specifically for Tukayyid. More or less an upgrade package for the Marauder 3R, the 5CS used Star League era technology to improve it’s effectiveness against the Clans, while being designed to be for new pilots to use. Powered by a 300-rated XL Engine with DHS, the Marauder 5CS is armed with a pair of ER PPC’s, a pair of Medium Pulse Lasers and an LB-10X. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为“部族克星”升级型号，Marauder 5CS 是专为图卡伊德之战开发的。它大体可视为 Marauder 3R 的升级套件，采用星际联盟时代的技术提升对部族的作战效能，同时设计上便于新飞行员上手。Marauder 5CS 由配备双散热器的 300 级 XL 引擎驱动，装备两门增程粒子炮、两门中型脉冲激光和一具 LB-10X。 特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：1.11 手臂驱动器限制：左臂下部、右臂下部

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 5D Marauder was the first updated variant to be designed in the wake of the Helm Memory Core recovery. A direct upgrade of the 3D model, the 5D's engine was replaced with a 300 XL engine, retaining the same speed profile at a much-reduced weight, to allow the entire weapons payload to be stripped out and upgraded. The 5D's primary weapons were two ER PPCs, carried in either arm, supported by a Large Pulse Laser in place of the autocannon. The medium lasers were replaced with two Medium Pulse Lasers, while a Streak SRM-2 launcher was also added to the left torso, along with one ton of CASE-protected ammo, for more close-range firepower. The model was protected by fourteen tons of armor, and carried sixteen double heat sinks for heat management. It also had a jumping capability of up to 120 meters thanks to four jump jets mounted in its legs. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 5D Marauder 是地狱核心失而复得之后设计出的第一个升级变型。作为 3D 型号的直接升级版，5D 的引擎换成了 300 XL 引擎，在重量大幅降低的同时保持相同的速度表现，从而得以把整套武器全部拆下并加以升级。5D 的主要武器是两门增程粒子炮，分装于左右两臂，另有一门大型脉冲激光取代自动炮作为补充。中型激光被换成两门中型脉冲激光，左躯干还增设了一具连发 SRM-2 发射器，并配有一吨受 CASE 保护的弹药，以增强近距离火力。该型号披挂十四吨装甲，并搭载十六台双散热器来管理热量。得益于腿部安装的四台跳跃推进器，它还能跳跃至多 120 米。 特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：1.11 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A command version of the MAD-5D. It strips out the Streak launcher, ammunition, CASE, and one heat sink to make room for a Command Console. The rest of the design remains the same. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是MAD-5D的指挥版本。它拆掉连发发射器、弹药、CASE和一个散热器，为指挥控制台腾出空间，其余设计保持不变。 特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：1.11 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 5M variant of the Marauder was introduced in 3051 by Ronin Inc. and Free Worlds Defense Industries for the Free Worlds League. Compared to the original it replaced the standard fusion engine with an XL Engine and completely re-armed the 'Mech with recovered Star League-era weapons. The primary weapons were two Large Pulse Lasers, backed up by two Medium Pulse Lasers, in either arm. Finally, in place of the Autocannon/5, the 5M carried a LB-X Autocannon/10. The 5M had a jumping distance of up to one hundred and twenty meters thanks to four jump jets mounted in the legs and carried sixteen double heat sinks. One ton of ammunition for the LB-X was carried in the left torso and protected by CASE. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Marauder的5M变型由Ronin Inc.和自由世界国防工业于3051年为自由世界联盟推出。与原版相比，它以XL引擎替换了标准聚变引擎，并用回收的星际联盟时代武器彻底重装了机甲。主武器为两门大型脉冲激光，每臂各一门，辅以两门中型脉冲激光。最后，5M以一门LB-X自动炮/10取代了自动炮/5。得益于安装在腿部的四台跳跃推进器，5M的跳跃距离最远可达一百二十米，并搭载十六台双散热器。左躯干携带一吨LB-X弹药，由CASE保护。 特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：1.11 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Marauder 5R2 is an export model for the Periphery market. It was constructed on the same line as the 5R, but with much cheaper components, in an attempt to sell based on the relation to the actual 5R alone. Its weapons consist of only three Large and two Medium standard lasers, its cooling is using single heat sinks and the engine is a standard 300 rated core. Overall, the design is pretty much very subpar for a Marauder, but a number of 5R2 were produced and sold before this was fully realized. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 掠夺者5R2是面向外围地区市场的出口型号。它与5R共用同一条生产线，但采用便宜得多的部件，试图仅凭与真正5R的渊源来打开销路。其武器只有3门大型激光和2门中型标准激光，散热使用单散热器，引擎则是标准300额定核心。总体而言，这台设计对一台掠夺者来说相当不堪，但在人们完全意识到这点之前，已有不少5R2被生产并售出。 <特性：狭小/低矮外形 <投放费用倍率：1.09 <手臂驱动器限制：左臂下段，右臂下段

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 5S variant of the Marauder dates to the Clan Invasion, introduced in 3051 by Bowie Industries after the Draconis Combine captured plans for the 5D design. The variant was built around an XL engine to save weight and upgraded the heat sinks to double-strength models. Like the 5D, the 5S carried ER PPCs and medium pulse lasers, but replaced the autocannon with a Gauss Rifle. One ton of ammunition for this powerful, long-ranged weapon was carried in the left torso. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 劫掠者5S变型可追溯至部族入侵时期，由鲍伊工业在龙脉联合体夺取5D设计图纸后于3051年推出。该变型围绕一台XL引擎建造以减轻重量，散热器升级为双倍强度型号。与5D一样，5S装有增程粒子炮和中型脉冲激光，但以高斯步枪取代自动炮，这门强力远程武器的一吨弹药存放在左躯干。 特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：1.11 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This unusual variant piloted by the Bounty Hunter featured various lostech equipment: the standard 300 Vlar fusion engine was downgrade to a 225-rated version giving it a top speed of 54 km/h. It mounted a standard PPC and a Medium Laser in each arm while another PPC and medium laser were mounted on the right torso; additional medium lasers were mounted in the center and left torso. Sixteen double heat sinks were use to cool this beast down, allowing it to firing all 3 PPCs without even generating excess heat. It featured fourteen and a half tons of standard armor, giving it maximum armor for it's weight, and was capable of jumping over 90 meters with three jump jets. It was also painted all green with credit symbols. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.13 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是赏金猎人驾驶的一台不寻常变型，配备多种失落科技装备：标准300弗拉尔聚变引擎降级为225额定版本，最高速度54公里/小时。每只手臂装一门标准粒子炮和一门中型激光，右躯干另有一门粒子炮和一门中型激光；中央与左躯干还装了额外中型激光。十六个双散热器为这头猛兽降温，使它发射全部3门粒子炮都不产生多余热量。它带十四吨半标准装甲，为同重量提供最大装甲；三具跳跃推进器可跳跃90米以上。它还通体漆成绿色并绘有信用符号。 特性：指挥机甲 投放费用倍率：1.13 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Bounty Hunter upgraded his Marauder sometime in 3044. The fusion engine was upgrade to an extra-light version while keeping it at the same rating to save weight, though the increased size meant three heat sinks had to be removed. The standard PPCs were upgrade to ER PPCs, both the left and right torso-mounted medium lasers were removed while the center torso medium laser was moved to the head to make room for a Gauss Rifle on the right torso and two tons of ammunition. This upgrade allowed the Bounty Hunter to engage enemies at a far greater range while still able to continuously operate without fear of overheating. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.13 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 赏金猎人在3044年前后升级了他的掠夺者。聚变引擎被换成超轻型版本，同时保持额定值不变以减轻重量，尽管体积增大导致必须拆除三具散热器。标准粒子炮升级为增程粒子炮，左右躯干的中型激光均被拆除，而中央躯干的中型激光则移到头部，以便在右躯干腾出空间安装一门高斯步枪与两吨弹药。这次升级让赏金猎人能在远得多的距离上接战，同时仍可连续作战而无过热之余。 特性：指挥机甲 投放费用倍率：1.13 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A variant designed by the New Avalon Institute of Science as part of the Worst Case initiative. The right arm carries an Extended Range Particle Projection Cannon and two Medium Lasers. The left arm has two Medium Lasers as well, but the ER PPC was swapped out for an ER Large Laser. The usual AC/5 was replaced by the newly invented Gauss Rifle. With its smaller range, but a much larger hitting power, this change may be the most important. The Marauder's mobility was also upgraded by the addition of four jump jets. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是新阿瓦隆科学研究院作为“最坏情况”计划的一部分设计的变型。右臂携带一门增程粒子炮和两门中型激光。左臂同样装有两门中型激光，但增程粒子炮被换成了增程大型激光。惯用的AC/5则被新发明的高斯步枪取代。它射程较近，威力却大得多，这一改动或许最为关键。掠夺者的机动性也通过加装四个跳跃推进器得到提升。 特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：1.11 手臂驱动器限制：左臂下部、右臂下部

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The personal 'Mech of 12th Vegan Rangers Alpha Regiment commander Margrave Sheridan Douglass during the DCMS's Third Succession War invasion of Galtor III, only the arm mounted medium lasers remain, with each PPC replaced by a large laser and the autocannon swapped for a pair of SRM-4 launchers with a shared ton of reloads. The remaining weight and space was devoted to five additional heat sinks and three extra tons of armor. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是第12维根游骑兵阿尔法团指挥官、侯爵谢里丹·道格拉斯在DCMS第三次继承战争入侵加尔特III期间的私人机甲。它只保留臂载中型激光，每门粒子炮换成大型激光，自动炮换成一对共用一吨再装填弹药的SRM-4发射器。剩余重量与空间用于五个额外散热器和三吨额外装甲。 特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：1.11 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: When the Treaty of Taurus was signed, it established the New Colony Region in co-operation between the Magistracy of Canopus and the Taurian Concordat and also created the Colonial Marshals. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 《金牛座条约》签署后，卡诺普斯行政国与陶里安协约国合作建立了新殖民地地区，并组建了殖民地法警。 特性：易于维护 投放费用倍率：1.05

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Developed by Clan Coyote as a dueling machine, scientists used an Endo Steel chassis as a base. It also carries an XL engine and sixteen double heat sinks. Four jump jets allowed it to jump one hundred twenty meters at a time. The right arm carried an LB 10-X and the left arm carried a pair of Large Pulse Lasers. The right and left torsos had a Streak SRM-2 to capitalize on the damage inflicted by the heavier weapons. The right torso had an anti-missile system, while an ER small laser was mounted in the opposite torso. The AMS and Streaks each had one ton of ammunition and the LB 10-X had three tons of ammo. Quirk: Accurate Weapon - Missiles Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.17 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 由郊狼部族作为决斗机甲开发，科学家以内骨架底盘为基础。它还装有一具XL引擎与十六具双散热器。四台跳跃推进器让它每次可跳跃一百二十米。右臂装有一门LB 10-X，左臂装有一对大型脉冲激光。左右两侧躯干各有一具连发SRM-2，用以扩大重武器所造成的伤害。右躯干装有反导弹系统，对侧躯干则安装了一门增程小型激光。反导弹系统与连发SRM各有弹药一吨，LB 10-X则有三吨弹药。 特性：精准武器（导弹） 投放费用倍率：1.17 手臂驱动器限制：右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The MAL-1PT5 was one of two early variants of the Mauler produced during the initial design and testing phases. Armed with only two Medium Lasers in its arms, the 'Mech had to rely on its two LRM-15 and four AC/2 instead for the majority of its damage. Quirk: Distracting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: MAL-1PT5是Mauler在最初设计与测试阶段生产的两款早期变型之一。机甲双臂仅装备两门中型激光，其大部分伤害因此不得不依赖两具LRM-15和四门AC/2。 特性：干扰 投放费用倍率：1.18 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The MAL-1PT6 was one of two early variants of the Mauler produced during the initial design and testing phases. Armed with two Large Lasers, two LRM-15 and four AC/2 meant the 'Mech was somewhat successful at handling engagements at most medium to long distances. Quirk: Distracting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: MAL-1PT6是痛击者在设计定型与测试阶段生产的两种早期变型之一。它以两门大型激光、两具LRM-15与四门AC/2为武装，这使该机甲在大多数中远距离交战中表现尚可。 特性：扰敌 投放费用倍率：1.18 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Captured Maulers, deployed in Federated Commonwealth with the MAL-1X-AFFC designation, swapped the LRMs for quad SRM 4s.Their fewer but more pronounced missile ports are an easy identifier of the variant in early Clan Invasion footage. Quirk: Distracting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 被缴获的痛击者以MAL-1X-AFFC编号在联邦共和国服役，以四联SRM 4取代LRM。其发射口更少但更突出，是早期部族入侵影像中辨识该变型的简易标志。 特性：扰敌 投放费用倍率：1.16 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Some early MAL-1R had their ER Large Lasers replaced by standard ones due to supply shortages. These sub-variants were designated the Mauler MAL-1Y. Quirk: Distracting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 由于供应短缺，一些早期 MAL-1R 的增程大型激光被换成了标准型号。这些子变型被命名为痛击者 MAL-1Y。 特性：扰敌 投放费用倍率：1.16 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Zachary Miles Hawkins personal variant of the mauler saw use at the time of the Clan Invasion, the Knockout upgrades the torso mounted missile racks from 15s to LRM-20s and inverts the usual Mauler energy and ballistic placements with an LB 10-X AC in each arm supported by ER Larger Laser in each side torso. Fitted with an 270 XL engine and twelve and half tons of Ferro-Fibrous armor, Knockout's heavy weapons array comes at the cost of field endurance, mounting only ten double heat sinks, two tons of LB-X autocannon munitions and single ton of LRM missiles. Quirk: Distracting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 扎卡里·迈尔斯·霍金斯的个人定制猛击者变型曾在部族入侵期间投入使用。“击倒”把躯干上的导弹架从 LRM-15 升级为 LRM-20，并颠倒了猛击者惯常的能量武器与实弹武器布局：每只手臂各装一门 LB 10-X 自动炮，每个侧躯干各配一门 ER 大型激光。该机采用额定 270 的 XL 引擎与十二吨半铁纤维装甲，“击倒”强大的武器阵列以持续作战能力为代价，只装设了十台双散热器、两吨 LB-X 自动炮弹药和一吨 LRM 导弹。 特性：扰敌 投放费用倍率：1.18 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Medusa is an expensive but effective cavalry 'Mech developed by Clan Cloud Cobra during the Golden Century to act as the follow-up hammer-blow to their favored aerospace assaults. The primary variant sports a Large Pulse Laser and two ER Medium Lasers for ranged combat and uses its battery of three SRM-6s arranged around the cockpit as a devastating follow-up in close combat. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Short Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Medusa是云眼镜蛇部族在黄金世纪研发的一款昂贵却高效的骑兵机甲，用于在部族钟爱的航空航天突击之后跟进补上重锤一击。主变型在远距离作战中配备一门大型脉冲激光和两门增程中型激光，而环绕驾驶舱布置的三具SRM-6则在近战中发动毁灭性的后续打击。 特性：改进瞄准 - 短距 投放费用倍率：1.1 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Developed only a year after the original, the Medusa 2 variant is a logical companion to the Medusa 1. Unlike many fire-support designs, this variant relies on the speed and manueverability provided by its 300XL engine and six jump jets to keep pace with the Medusa-1. The Medusa 2 fields three LRM-10s and a pair of ER Medium Lasers in each arm. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Short Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Medusa 2 变型仅比原型晚一年开发，是 Medusa 1 顺理成章的搭档。与许多火力支援设计不同，该变型依靠 300XL 引擎和六具跳跃推进器提供的速度与机动性，与 Medusa-1 保持同步。Medusa 2 装备三门 LRM-10，每条手臂各有一对中型增程激光。 特性：改进瞄准（近程） 投放费用倍率：1.1 手臂驱动器限制：左臂下部、右臂下部

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Regarded by some as a survivable alternative to the Hunchback IIC, the Medusa 3 packs an incredible close-range punch while still keeping the speed, manueverability, and armor of the previous designs. The Medusa 3 hosts a massive Ultra Autocannon 20 on its right torso supplemented by an ER Medium Laser in each arm. In order to capitalize on any weaknesses in enemy armor, this variant retains an SRM-6 in the center torso. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Short Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 有人将其视为 Hunchback IIC 的生存性替代方案。Medusa 3 拥有惊人的近距离火力，同时保留了前代设计的速度、机动性和装甲。Medusa 3 的右躯干装有一门庞大的 Ultra 自动炮 20，双臂各配一门增程中型激光。为了抓住敌方装甲的任何薄弱之处，这一改型在中央躯干保留了一具 SRM-6。 特性：改进瞄准 - 短距 投放费用倍率：1.1 手臂驱动器限制：左下臂、右下臂

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Despite the animosity between Clan Cloud Cobra and Clan Coyote, it did not take long for the former to field a new variant of their venerable Medusa 'Mech once they had access to the new Advanced Tactical Missile system. The Medusa 4 carries a staggering seven ATM-3s with six tons of ammunition to allow it unparalleled flexibility during combat and all are supplemented by an ER Large Laser. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Short Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 尽管云眼镜蛇部族与郊狼部族之间存在敌意，但前者在获得新型先进战术导弹系统后，很快就为它古老的墨杜萨机甲推出了新变型。墨杜萨4装有惊人的七具ATM-3和六吨弹药，使其在战斗中拥有无与伦比的灵活性，全部由一门增程大型激光补充。 特性：改进瞄准 - 近程 投放费用倍率：1.1 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The T loadout combines two ER Medium Lasers with three Streak SRM-6 launchers, for a medium to short range engagement package. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.95 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: T挂载把两门增程中型激光与三具连发SRM-6发射器结合，构成中近距离交战组合。 特性：改进通讯 投放费用倍率：0.95 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An upgrade to the original Mercury line, Clan Wolverine spared no expense in the production of the Mercury II, including seven and a half tons of Ferro-Fibrous armor, double heat sinks and an XL Engine. Despite this the medium 'Mech is still slower than its lighter antecedent, only managing 119 km/h, though it makes up for that with jump jets that enable it to leap up to 210 meters at a time. The inclusion of a Beagle Active Probe and Guardian ECM Suite make the 'Mech a capable scout. Though the Mercury II is designed to be a scout, it can hold its own in a fight. An ER Large Laser gives it a credible ranged threat, while paired Medium Lasers and Small Lasers make it an effective hunter-killer. Quirk: Modular Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为对原始水星系列的升级，狼獾部族在生产水星II时不遗余力，包括七吨半铁纤维装甲、双散热器和一台XL引擎。尽管如此，这台中型机甲仍比它更轻的前身慢，只能跑119公里/小时；不过它用跳跃推进器弥补了这一点，一次可跃升210米。比格犬主动探测器与守护者电子对抗套件的加入让该机甲成为称职的侦察机。虽然水星II设计为侦察机，它在战斗中也能自保：一门增程大型激光赋予它可信的远程威胁，成对的中型激光与小型激光则使它成为高效的猎杀者。 特性：模块化武器 投放费用倍率：1.04 手臂驱动器限制：左下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The MCY-100P is an early prototype of what would become the Mercury II, but before it's tonnage was increased. Using an 180 XL engine and MASC, it is even faster than the MCY-99 while keeping the 3.5 tons of ferro-fibrous armor. Using double heat sinks improved the cooling enough to change the weapons to one Medium Laser and a Center Torso mounted Extended Range Large Laser. Quirk: Modular Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.97
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: MCY-100P 是后来 Mercury II 的早期原型机，当时其吨位尚未提升。它采用 180 XL 引擎和 MASC，速度甚至快于 MCY-99，同时保留了 3.5 吨铁纤维装甲。双散热器的使用大幅改善了散热能力，使其得以将武器改为一门中型激光和一门安装在中央躯干的增程大型激光。 特性：模块化武器 投放费用倍率：0.97

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The MCY-97 variant of the Mercury was created by ComStar in 3049 for recon duties. The armor, engine and MASC system are kept and one medium laser and one small laser have been dropped in favor of a Beagle Active Probe, giving the MCY-97 Mercury superior enemy detection capabilities at the cost of half of its firepower. Though an excellent scout this variant was largely discarded after the Battle of Tukayyid on account of insufficient firepower. Quirk: Modular Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.97
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 水星MCY-97变型由通讯之星于3049年研制，用于侦察任务。它保留了装甲、引擎和MASC系统，拆掉一门中型激光和一门小型激光，换装一台比格犬主动探测器，使MCY-97水星以损失一半火力为代价获得卓越的敌方探测能力。尽管是出色的侦察机，该变型在图卡伊德战役后因火力不足而被大量弃用。 特性：模块化武器 投放费用倍率：0.97

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Mercury debuted for the first time in 2742, intended as a replacement for the aging Wasps and Stingers in use by the Star League Defense Force. Hailed as the beginning of a new age in 'Mech design, the Mercury was faster and better-armed than its competition without sacrificing armor protection. It also featured an advancement in weapons installation, making use of a modular replacement system to allow for considerably faster and easier repairs. The MCY-98 is a downgraded version introduced during the Succession Wars in 2810. While it retains the same armament and engine of the original, the primary changes in the 'Mech is its armor, using standard plating in place of Ferro-Fibrous, and the MASC system, which has been removed to allow for the armor to be one ton heavier. These changes lower its maximum speed to 129.6 km/h and slightly increases the overall armor protection. Quirk: Modular Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.95
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Mercury 于 2742 年首次亮相，旨在取代星际联盟防御部队中日益老旧的 Wasp 和 Stinger。它被誉为机甲设计新时代的开端，在不牺牲装甲防护的前提下比竞争对手更快、火力更强。它在武器安装方式上也有所进步，采用模块化更换系统，使维修变得更快、更容易。MCY-98 是继承战争期间于 2810 年推出的降级版本。它保留了原有的武器配置和引擎，主要变化在于装甲——用标准装甲板取代了铁纤维——以及被拆除的 MASC 系统，腾出的重量让装甲可以多装一吨。这些改动将其最大速度降至 129.6 km/h，并略微提升了整体装甲防护。 特性：模块化武器 投放费用倍率：0.95

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Mercury debuted for the first time in 2742, intended as a replacement for the aging Wasps and Stingers in use by the Star League Defense Force. Hailed as the beginning of a new age in 'Mech design, the Mercury was faster and better-armed than its competition without sacrificing armor protection. It also featured an advancement in weapons installation, making use of a modular replacement system to allow for considerably faster and easier repairs. The Mercury carries an assortment of energy weapons which helps to extend its endurance on long campaigns. The primary weapons are two Medium Lasers in the right arm and left torso, supported by two Small Lasers in the center torso and head. The heart of the Mercury is its MASC System which, in combination with a 160 fusion engine, allows for momentary bursts of speed up to 172 km/h. Three tons of Ferro-Fibrous armor gives it superior protection compared to other 20-ton 'Mechs. Quirk: Modular Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.97
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 水星于2742年首次登场，意在替换星际联盟防卫军中使用已久、日渐老旧的黄蜂和毒刺。它被誉为机甲设计新时代的开端：在不牺牲装甲防护的前提下，水星比竞争对手更快、武装更好。它还在武器安装方式上有所创新，采用模块化更换系统，使维修显著更快、更容易。水星携带多种能量武器，这有助于延长它在长期战役中的续航。主武器是分别位于右臂和左躯干的2门中型激光，另有位于中央躯干和头部的2门小型激光支援。水星的核心是它的MASC系统，配合160聚变引擎可短时爆发到172 km/h。3吨铁纤维装甲让它在防护上优于其他20吨机甲。 <特性：模块化武器 <投放费用倍率：0.97

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Released in 3010, the Merlin was the first original design to be manufactured in over a century. Designed by mountain Wolf Battlemechs as a durable and easy to repair mech, the Merlin is powered by a 240-rated fusion engine. Clad in 10 and a half tons of standard armor, it carries 18 heatsinks and a varied weapons load, designed to engage an enemy at any range. A PPC and LRM-5 launcher provide long range firepower, with a pair of medium lasers covering the shorter ranges. Also installed a machine gun and a flamer to guard against infantry attacks. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 梅林于3010年发布，是一个多世纪以来首款原创设计。它由山狼机甲公司设计为坚固且易于维修的机甲，由一台240额定聚变引擎驱动，披挂十吨半标准装甲，带18个散热器和多样的武器载荷，设计用于在任意距离上与敌人交战。一门粒子炮和一具LRM-5提供远程火力，两门中型激光覆盖较近距离，另装一挺机枪和一具火焰喷射器防备步兵袭击。 特性：易于维护 投放费用倍率：1.06 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A rare variant of the Merlin, the 1A1 is a rebuild that strips out the expensive lasers and replaces them with cooler running Chemical alternatives. With the reduced heat burden, the LRM-5 is upgraded to an LRM-15 and a second ton of LRM ammo is added. Only seen among the poorer parts of the Periphery, its increased ammo dependency makes it a poor choice in anything other than a defensive role. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 1A1 是 Merlin 的稀有变型，这次重建拆掉了昂贵的激光，换成发热更低的化学型号。由于热量负担减轻，LRM-5 升级为 LRM-15，并增加了一吨 LRM 弹药。它只出现在外围地区较为贫困的地方；对弹药依赖的增加，使其除防御任务之外都不是好选择。 特性：易于维护 投放费用倍率：1.06 手臂驱动器限制：左臂下部、右臂下部

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An unofficial refit kit that incorporates Star League era technology, the Merlin 1Ar never entered mainstream production but was a common upgrade if the parts could be obtained. The 1A's standard PPC is swapped for an Extended Range version, whilst the Medium Lasers are exchanged for Pulse versions. To handle the extra heat load and free up the weight needed for the Pulses, double heatsinks are added to the design. With the excess free weight, the LRM-5 is upgraded to a LRM-10. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是纳入星际联盟时期技术的非官方改装套件，梅林1Ar从未进入主流量产，但只要弄得到零件就是常见的升级。1A的标准粒子炮换成增程版本，中型激光换成脉冲型号。为应对额外热负荷并腾出脉冲激光所需重量，设计中加入了双散热器。借多出的重量，LRM-5升级为LRM-10。 特性：易于维护 投放费用倍率：1.08 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Introduced in 3053, the Merlin 1B variant removes the Machine Gun and its ammunition and replaces them with an additional heat sink to help handle the Merlin's heat load. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Merlin 1B 变型于 3053 年推出，它拆除了机枪及其弹药，代之以一具额外的散热器，以帮助应对 Merlin 的热负荷。 特性：易于维护 投放费用倍率：1.06 手臂驱动器限制：左下臂、右下臂

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A field modification of the Merlin 1A, the 1B1 removes the Machine Gun and Flamer of the 1A and replaces them with an additional pair of medium lasers. Hotter running then the regular 1A or 1B designs, it nonetheless packs a greater punch at close range and is a favorite configuration for pilots assigned to long range reconnaissance or raiding operations. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 1B1 是 Merlin 1A 的野战改型，它拆除了 1A 的机枪与火焰喷射器，代之以额外两门中型激光。虽然比常规的 1A 或 1B 设计更容易过热，但它在近距离的打击力更强，是执行远程侦察或袭扰任务的机师最喜爱的配置。 特性：易于维护 投放费用倍率：1.06 手臂驱动器限制：左臂下部、右臂下部

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A uniquely customized Merlin introduced in 3064, which was created by a tech named Porter Romero on the world of Armington. He salvaged the 'Mech from a pirate raid during the 3060s. Using a wrecked militia Bulldog for parts, he replaced the ruined PPC and LRM-5 with the tank's Large Laser and SRM 4 Launcher as well as adding additional armor. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一台于3064年问世的、经过独特定制的梅林，出自阿明顿星上一位名叫波特·罗梅罗的技术人员之手。他在3060年代的一次海盗袭击中把这台机甲抢救了下来。他利用一台报废的民兵斗牛犬坦克上的部件，把损毁的粒子炮与LRM-5换成那辆坦克的大型激光与SRM 4发射器，并加装了额外的装甲。 特性：易于维护 投放费用倍率：1.08 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A prototype that never saw widespread adoption, the Merlin 2A was Mountain Wolfs next generation offering unveiled alongside the 1B variant in 3053. Built around a 240-rated XL Engine, it is armed with a pair of ER Large Lasers and a pair of Medium Pulses. The 1A's Machine Gun is retained and the LRM-5 upgraded to a LRM-10. The addition of CASE protects the ammunition bays and 14 Double Heat Sinks handle the increased heat burden. At almost 19 million CBills, the design was rejected as too expensive and too reliant on advanced technology that the Outworlds Alliance struggled to produce. Mountain Wolf shelved the design, though not before a single run of 20 2A's were produced. Most of these were fielded by the Mountain Wolf security team, but some found their way into the hands of the elite Avellar Guard. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Merlin 2A 是一款从未被广泛采用的原型机，是山地狼公司于 3053 年与 1B 改型一同发布的下一代产品。它围绕额定 240 的 XL引擎建造，装备一对增程大型激光和一对中型脉冲激光。1A 的机枪得以保留，LRM-5 升级为 LRM-10。加装 CASE 保护了弹药舱，14 台双散热器则应对增加了的热负荷。由于价格接近 1900 万 CBill，该设计被认为过于昂贵，且过度依赖外域联盟难以生产的先进技术，因而遭到否决。山地狼公司将其搁置，不过在那之前已生产了一批 20 台 2A。这些机甲大多由山地狼安保队使用，但也有一些流入了精锐的阿韦拉尔卫队手中。 特性：易于维护 投放费用倍率：1.08 手臂驱动器限制：左下臂、右下臂

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Minotaur is the 'assault class' of the first generation ProtoMechs. Weighing more than any other ProtoMech, it trades speed for armor and weaponry. Carrying a pair of ER Medium Lasers, the Minotaur has enough firepower to seriously damage any light 'Mechs foolish enough to close with it. Quirk: Resilient Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.984
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 弥诺陶洛斯是第一代原生机甲的“突击级”。它比其他任何原生机甲都重，以速度换取装甲与武器。弥诺陶洛斯装有一对增程中型激光，火力足以重创任何胆敢靠近它的轻型机甲。 特性：强韧 投放费用倍率：0.984

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: It's not easy being cheesy. Quirk: Resilient Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.984
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 当个廉价货色并不容易。 特质：坚韧 投放费用倍率：0.984

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The first Mech to be produced by the Ghost Bears, the 70 ton Minsk entered production in 2830. Surpassed in performance by newer designs, the Minsk fell out of favour and was eventually retired. Powered by a 210-rated Fusion Core, the Minsk 1 is armed with a pair of Gauss Rifles and an LRM-10. Paired SRM-6’s, Small Pulse Lasers, B-Pods and Machine Guns add additional firepower at close range. An Active Probe allows the Minsk to spot hidden opponents.n Quirk: Protected Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 明斯克是鬼熊部族生产的第一款机甲，这台70吨机体于2830年投产。由于性能被更新的设计超越，明斯克失宠并最终退役。明斯克1由一台210额定聚变核心驱动，装有一对高斯步枪和一具LRM-10。成对的SRM-6、小型脉冲激光、B-Pod和机枪在近距提供额外火力。一台主动探测器让明斯克能发现隐藏的对手。 特性：受保护驱动器 投放费用倍率：1.14 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The first Mech to be produced by the Ghost Bears, the 70 ton Minsk entered production in 2830. Surpassed in performance by newer designs, the Minsk fell out of favour and was eventually retired. Powered by a 210-rated Fusion Core, the Minsk 101 is armed with a pair of Gauss Rifles and an LRM-10. Paired SRM-6’s, Small Pulse Lasers and Machine Guns add additional firepower at close range. A Star League era Beagle Active Probe allows the Minsk to spot hidden opponents.n Quirk: Protected Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 明斯克是幽灵熊部族生产的第一款机甲，重70吨，于2830年投产。由于性能被更新的设计超越，明斯克逐渐失宠并最终退役。明斯克101由一台额定210的聚变核心驱动，装备两门高斯步枪和一具LRM-10。双联SRM-6、小型脉冲激光和机枪则增强了它的近距离火力。星际联盟时代的小猎犬主动探测器让明斯克能够发现隐藏的对手。n 特性：受保护驱动器 投放费用倍率：1.14 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A common Light OmniMech, the Mist Lynx is fielded by every Clan since its introduction in 2926. A 25-ton mech, the Mist Lynx is powered by a 175-rated XL Engine and is built with a combination of Endo Steel and Ferro-Fibrous that gives it a respectable 7.5 tons of pod space. An Active Probe is hardwired into the chassis boosting the Mist Lynx’s effectiveness as a scout. The Mist Lynx A is armed with a pair of AMS, a TAG and a Flamer. A pair of A-Pods and Machine Guns are installed to deter infantry. Quirk: Improved Sensors Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为一款常见的轻型全向机甲，雾森猁自2926年推出以来被每个部族采用。这台25吨机甲由一台175额定XL引擎驱动，采用内骨架与铁纤维组合结构，拥有可观的7.5吨挂载空间。一台主动探测器硬接在底盘上，提升了雾森猁作为侦察机的效能。雾森猁A装有两套反导弹系统、一具TAG和一具火焰喷射器，并配有两具A-Pod和机枪以遏制步兵。 特性：改进传感器 投放费用倍率：0.99 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Weighing only 10 tons, the Mite could not stand up to any other 'Mech in a fight, but it was designed to spot and run. With its high speed and maneuverability, it was a natural scout. Using narrowband communications and enhanced sensor arrays, the Mite could get electronic intelligence, transmit the data, and then get out of danger in a hurry. The Mite is armed with a single small laser in the center torso. Quirk: Improved Sensors Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 螨只有10吨重，在战斗中敌不过任何其他机甲，但它的设计目的就是观测后跑路。凭借高速度与机动性，它是天生的侦察机。通过窄带通讯与增强传感器阵列，螨能获取电子情报、发送数据，然后迅速脱离危险。螨在中央躯干装有一门单独的小型激光。 特性：改进传感器 投放费用倍率：0.99

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Based on the personal Grasshopper of Tor Miraborg, the Mjölnir is primarily armed with a PPC in the right arm and Gauss Rifle on the left arm, retaining the GHR-5H's jump jets, side torso mounted Medium and center torso mounted Large Lasers. Built around a fragile 280-rated XL Engine, an Endo Steel frame and near maximum standard armor, three tons of Gauss rounds and thirteen double heat sinks give Mjölnir more than adequate field endurance. Quirk: Aerial Assault Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.12
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Mjölnir 以托尔·米拉博格的私人 Grasshopper 为基础，主要武器为右臂的一门粒子炮和左臂的一门高斯步枪，并保留了 GHR-5H 的跳跃推进器、装于侧躯干的中型激光以及装于中央躯干的大型激光。它采用脆弱的 280 级 XL 引擎与内骨架框架，披挂接近最大值的标准装甲；三吨高斯弹药和十三台双散热器赋予 Mjölnir 绰绰有余的战场续航能力。 特性：空中突击 投放费用倍率：1.12

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An upgrade to the ageing 68 model, this Mongoose was one of the first models to trial the Combines new C3 Slave unit. Featuring a characteristically minimalist upgrade package, this Mongoose variant served with distinction during Operation Bulldog. An ER Large Laser serves as the sole weapons system, augmented by a new fire control system and the C3 unit. A cheap upgrade, this is a favorite of pilots who were previously assigned a 68; with many praising the enhanced range and accuracy of the Laser. Paired into demi lances, and assigned a C3 Master equipped mech to coordinate, these Mongoose's are deployed as head hunters and long range harassers; both roles that make use of their high ground speed and manoeuvrability. Fast and deadly, they have already made a name for themselves, with one Mongoose formation accounting for 5 kills, including a Star Colonel in a Timberwolf during the Great Refusal. Quirk: Easy to Pilot Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为对老旧68型的升级，这台Mongoose是最早试装龙脉联合体新型C3从属单元的型号之一。它采用了典型的极简升级方案，在“斗牛犬行动”中表现卓著。它唯一的武器系统是一门增程大型激光，并辅以新的火控系统和C3单元。作为一项廉价的升级，它深受此前驾驶68型的飞行员喜爱，许多人称赞这门激光的射程与精度都有提升。它们以半分队编组，并配属一台装备C3主控单元的机甲进行协调，被部署为猎头者与远程骚扰单位——这两个角色都能充分发挥其出色的地面速度和机动性。它们快速而致命，如今已声名鹊起：在大拒绝之战中，一支Mongoose编队取得了5个战果，其中包括一名驾驶Timberwolf的星团长。 特性：易于驾驶 投放费用倍率：0.98

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A Clantech upgrade to the again Royal Mongoose, that debuted during the Golden Age. The C2 was a Clan Mongoose model developed as a testbed for the newly developed Targeting Computers. Removing 2 heat sinks allowed Mongoose engineers to install the targeting computer, otherwise this design is unchanged from the standard MON-C. Quirk: Easy to Pilot Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是对再度成为皇家机型的 Mongoose 进行的部族科技升级，于黄金时代首次亮相。C2 是部族 Mongoose 的一个型号，作为新研制的瞄准计算机的试验平台而开发。拆除 2 具散热器让 Mongoose 的工程师得以安装瞄准计算机，除此之外该设计与标准 MON-C 完全相同。 特性：易于驾驶 投放费用倍率：1.04

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The original Morpheus carried a medium laser, pair of Medium Pulse Lasers, and an anti-missile system. It also carried a Beagle active probe and Guardian ECM suite. Quirk: Protected Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 最初的Morpheus装有一门中型激光、两门中型脉冲激光和一套反导弹系统，此外还配有猎犬主动探测器和守护者电子对抗套件。 特性：受保护驱动器 投放费用倍率：1.09
蚊子 MOS-1K（MechForce UK 记录表 #2）

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Mosquito mounts two small and one medium laser, a C3 Slave and a MASC. To free the space required, the 'Mech uses both lighter Ferro-Fibrous armor and an Endo Steel chassis. Quirk: Accurate Weapon - Laser Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.97
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Mosquito 装备两门小型激光和一门中型激光，外加一套 C3 从机和一套 MASC。为腾出所需空间，该机甲同时采用了更轻的铁纤维装甲和内骨架底盘。 特性：精准武器 - 激光 投放费用倍率：0.97

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This apparent precursor to the Phoenix Hawk LAM may have had a different name originally, but in any case became known as the Munin LAM. The only samples known to exist were those recovered from a cache by the Tyr Resistance Movement shortly before the Fourth Succession War. Unbeknownst to many, recovered blueprints and manufacturing manuals not only allowed production to resume, but aided in Upgraded Designs. Quirk: Land Air Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这台显然是凤凰鹰 LAM 前身的设计可能原本另有其名，但无论如何后来被称为穆宁 LAM。已知存在的唯一样本，是第四次继承战争前不久由提尔抵抗运动从一处储藏库中取回的。许多人不知道的是，取回的蓝图与制造手册不仅让生产得以重启，还帮助了升级设计。 特质：陆空机甲 投放费用倍率：1.05

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The primary configuration of the Naga II combines an Ultra AC/10 in the right arm with an LB 10-X AC in the left for its primary damage. A single side torso mounted LRM-20 launcher allows for secondary fire support and indirect engagements. A single ER Small Laser in the center torso provide some very limited anti-infantry defense capabilities. Quirk: Extended Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.13 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 娜迦 II 的主配置以右臂一门超速 AC/10 搭配左臂一门 LB 10-X AC 作为主要伤害来源。单具装在侧躯干的 LRM-20 发射器用于次要火力支援与间接交战。中央躯干的一门 ER 小型激光提供非常有限的反步兵防御能力。 特质：强化躯干扭转 投放费用倍率：1.13 臂部驱动器限制：全能

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 娜迦 II 的主配置以右臂一门超速 AC/10 搭配左臂一门 LB 10-X AC 作为主要伤害来源。单具装在侧躯干的 LRM-20 发射器用于次要火力支援与间接交战。中央躯干的一门 ER 小型激光提供非常有限的反步兵防御能力。 特质：强化躯干扭转 投放费用倍率：1.13 臂部驱动器限制：全能

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The primary configuration of the Naga II combines an Ultra AC/10 in the right arm with an LB 10-X AC in the left for its primary damage. A single side torso mounted LRM-20 launcher allows for secondary fire support and indirect engagements. A single ER Small Laser in the center torso provide some very limited anti-infantry defense capabilities. Quirk: Extended Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.13 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 娜迦 II 的主配置以右臂一门超速 AC/10 搭配左臂一门 LB 10-X AC 作为主要伤害来源。单具装在侧躯干的 LRM-20 发射器用于次要火力支援与间接交战。中央躯干的一门 ER 小型激光提供非常有限的反步兵防御能力。 特质：强化躯干扭转 投放费用倍率：1.13 臂部驱动器限制：全能

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Naga is a fire-support successor to the first-generation Woodsman OmniMech, but is an oddity in many ways. Most of what could be pod space for the design is actually taken up by a pair of fixed Arrow IV Artillery Systems. Quirk: Extended Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.13 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 娜迦是第一代"林中人"全能机甲的火力支援后继者，但在许多方面都颇为古怪。该设计本可用于吊舱的空间，实际上大部分被一对固定安装的箭矢 IV 火炮系统占据。 特质：强化躯干扭转 投放费用倍率：1.13 臂部驱动器限制：全能

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Naginata NG-C3A serves in the dual role of command and fire support 'Mech. The C3 master computer allows the 'Mech to share the targeting data of its lancemates and to take advantage of their targeting information, making the three LRM-15s with Artemis IV fire control systems and the ER PPC extremely accurate. The Artemis IV fire control system gives the 'Mech increased missile accuracy. Quirk: Cowl Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.17 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 薙刀NG-C3A兼具指挥与火力支援两种角色。C3主控计算机让它能共享小队成员的瞄准数据并利用他们的目标信息，使三门配备阿尔忒弥斯IV火控系统的LRM-15和增程粒子炮具备极高的精准度。阿尔忒弥斯IV火控系统进一步提升了机甲的导弹精度。 特性：头罩 投放费用倍率：1.17 手臂驱动器限制：左下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An early Clan Mech, the Naja was built by the Cloud Cobras, using the Royal Kintaro as the base chassis. Designed to showcase the Cobras new missile technology, the Naja is armed with a Clan LRM-20, along with paired Improved SRM-2's, a pair of Improved SRM-6's, and 3 lasers supplementing this. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 纳迦是部族早期机甲，由云眼镜蛇部族以皇家金太郎为底盘基础建造。为展示云眼镜蛇的新型导弹技术，纳迦装有一具部族LRM-20，另有成对的改进型SRM-2、两具改进型SRM-6，以及3门激光作为补充。 特性：易于维护 投放费用倍率：1.05

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An early Clan mech used by Clan Cloud Cobra, the Naja is built on the Kintaro chassis sporting an LRM-20, and a trio of ER Lasers. A pair of Improved SRM2's and Improved SRM6's are retained from the first generation Naja. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Naja 是云眼镜蛇部族早期使用的一款机甲，以 Kintaro 底盘为基础建造，装备一具 LRM-20 和三门增程激光。第一代 Naja 的改进型 SRM2 与改进型 SRM6 各一对被保留了下来。 特性：易于维护 投放费用倍率：1.09

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: As a recon 'Mech intended to rarely engage an enemy in a pitched battle, the Nexus is armed with a Medium Laser backed up by two highly accurate Medium Pulse Lasers. As a weapon of last resort, the Nexus also has two Small Lasers. For added protection against missile attacks, the Nexus has an AMS. The Nexus has a top speed of 119 km/h and is powered by a 175-rated fusion engine which is both light and rugged. To save weight without the vulnerability of an XL engine, the Nexus is built on a Endo Steel chassis. For protection, the 'Mech carries a light two tons of Ferro-Fibrous armor, relying on its speed and maneuverability, which is enhanced with a jumping capability of up to one hundred and twenty meters. Finally, to handle the heat from the arsenal of energy weapons, the Nexus carries ten double heat sinks. Quirk: Nimble Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Nexus 是一款侦察机甲，设计中极少在正面会战中与敌交战。它装备一门中型激光，辅以两门精准度极高的中型脉冲激光。作为最后手段，Nexus 还配有两门小型激光。为加强对导弹攻击的防护，Nexus 装有一具 AMS。Nexus 的最高时速为 119 km/h，由一台额定 175 的聚变引擎驱动，既轻便又坚固。为在不承受 XL 引擎脆弱性的前提下减轻重量，Nexus 采用内骨架打造。防护方面，该机甲仅携带轻量的两吨铁纤维装甲，依靠自身的速度与机动性——其跳跃能力可达一百二十米。最后，为应对大量能量武器产生的热量，Nexus 配备十个双散热器。 特性：灵活 投放费用倍率：0.98 手臂驱动器限制：左下臂、右下臂

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The alternate loadout of the Night Chanter combines an LRM-10 launcher with an ER Medium Laser and an ER PPC as primary weapons, while mounting two A-Pods and two Machine guns to deal with vehicles and infantry. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.02
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 夜吟者的备用配置以LRM-10发射器、一具增程中型激光和一具增程粒子炮为主武器，同时装有两具A-Pod和两挺机枪以对付车辆与步兵。 特性：易于维护 投放费用倍率：1.02

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Primary loadout of the Night Chanter is a combination of pulse and extended range lasers, making the 'Mech somewhat able to deal damage at most ranges. The varied loadout does mean it lacks the weapon profile to excel at any particular range, but the idea of the design is that any intended engagement does not occur within only a limited amount of ranges, and instead it is a constant flow back and forth. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.02
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 夜吟者的主配置结合了脉冲激光与增程激光，使这台机甲在大多数距离上都能造成一定伤害。这种多样化的配置确实意味着它缺乏在某一特定距离上出类拔萃的武器组合，但该设计的理念本就是不让交战只发生在有限的几段距离内，而是持续不断地来回游走。 特性：易于维护 投放费用倍率：1.02

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The A variant is a short-range powerhouse. It mounts an Ultra Autocannon/20 to breach opponent's armor and a pair of Streak SRM-6s to exploit those holes. A Large Pulse Laser and a trio of Medium Pulse Lasers are highly accurate weapons that can help to minimize collateral damage in an urban environment. Even with four additional double heat sinks, this variant can be quickly overwhelmed by heat. Quirk: Combat Computer Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.12 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: A变型是近程重炮。它装一门超级自动炮/20撕裂对手装甲，两具连发SRM-6利用这些破口；一门大型脉冲激光和三门中型脉冲激光是高精度武器，有助于在城市环境中尽量减少附带损伤。即便有四个额外双散热器，此变型也可能迅速被热量压倒。 特性：战斗计算机 投放费用倍率：1.12 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Another long-range variant, the C mounts three Ultra Autocannon/2s and two ER Large Lasers. A pair of ER Medium Lasers are present for backup. All of these weapons are linked to a Targeting Computer. Six extra heat sinks ensure the 'Mech stays mostly cool. Quirk: Combat Computer Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.12 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为另一款远程变型，C配置装三门超级AC/2和两门增程大型激光，另有两门增程中型激光作为后手。这些武器全部联动一台瞄准计算机。六个额外散热器确保机甲大体保持凉爽。 特性：战斗计算机 投放费用倍率：1.12 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This variant uses massed pulse lasers, two large and six medium, in conjunction with an ATM 6 and an SRM-6. The ATM only mounts two tons of ammunition, limiting its flexibility. Quirk: Combat Computer Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.12 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该变型集中配备脉冲激光，两具大型与六具中型，并搭配一具ATM 6和一具SRM-6。ATM仅携带两吨弹药，灵活性因此受到限制。 特性：战斗计算机 投放费用倍率：1.12 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A customized variant of the Night Gyr. The Jade Kite uses a pair of Ultra Autocannon/2s in its left arm, supported by a pair of ammo. The left torso carries a pair of Machine Guns, each with one ton of autocannon ammo and a half-ton of machine gun ammo. The right arm carries a pair of ER PPCs. In the right torso, two Streak SRM-6s with two tons of ammo. Quirk: Combat Computer Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是夜鹫的定制变型。碧玉风筝左臂装一对超级AC/2，配两吨弹药；左躯干带一对机枪，各配一吨自动炮弹药和半吨机枪弹药；右臂装一对增程粒子炮；右躯干内有两具连发SRM-6，配两吨弹药。 特性：战斗计算机 投放费用倍率：1.14 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Nighthawk Mk. XXI is a PA(L) design and the progenitor of modern battle armor. The original Nighthawk was based upon exoskeletons originally used for commercial purposes during the Star League. It took fifteen years and twenty prototypes before the SLDF finally perfected the design that would eventually be produced. A working prototype was first introduced in 2718, which was followed by two years of field testing and, finally, full production, entering service with the Special Forces Command. Quirk: Power Armor Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.8832 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 夜鹰Mk. XXI是一种PA(L)设计，也是现代战斗装甲的鼻祖。最初的夜鹰基于星际联盟时期原本用于商业用途的外骨骼。在SLDF最终完善并定型生产之前，共耗费了十五年时间和二十台原型机。首台可运作的原型机于2718年问世，随后经过两年的野战测试，最终实现量产，并进入特种部队司令部服役。 特性：动力装甲 投放费用倍率：0.8832 可搭载全向单位，可近战，可蜂拥攻击。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Nighthawk is a PA(L) design and the progenitor of modern battle armor. The original Nighthawk was based upon exoskeletons originally used for commercial purposes during the Star League. It took fifteen years and twenty prototypes before the SLDF finally perfected the design that would eventually be produced. A working prototype was first introduced in 2718, which was followed by two years of field testing and, finally, full production, entering service with the Special Forces Command. Quirk: Power Armor Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.8832 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.

The original Nighthawk was based upon exoskeletons originally used for commercial purposes during the Star League. It took fifteen years and twenty prototypes before the SLDF finally perfected the design that would eventually be produced. A working prototype was first introduced in 2718, which was followed by two years of field testing and, finally, full production, entering service with the Special Forces Command. Quirk: Power Armor Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.8832 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.
