Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A failed prototype to improve the survivability rate of the MechWarriors piloting Raijins. By converting the SRM6 launcher to a one shot, a CASE system was added to protected the Streak SRM ammunition. However, in real battle scenarios this only meant that the Mech's firepower got considerably nerfed for a minimal durability improvement. Quirk: Extended Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是一款旨在提高Raijin机甲战士生存率的失败原型机。它把SRM6发射器改为一次性发射，从而腾出空间加装CASE系统保护连发SRM弹药。然而在实际战斗中，这仅仅意味着机甲的耐久度只得到微乎其微的提升，火力却被大幅削弱。 特性：扩展躯干旋转 投放费用倍率：1.04 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Produced by the Rim Worlds Republic in 2735, the Rampage 2G was a standard line unit in the Rim Worlds Army. The 2G model was basic, but effective in its role, carrying a wide assortment of weapons to handle threats at any range of engagement. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.13 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 由边缘世界共和国于 2735 年生产，Rampage 2G 是边缘世界军队的标准一线单位。2G 型号虽然基础，但在其定位上相当有效，配备种类繁多的武器，足以应对任何交战距离上的威胁。 特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1.13 手臂驱动器限制：左下臂

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Built in 2750, the Rampage 4G was a massive overhaul to the original 2G model, upgrading many of the components to modern equivalents. Most notable was the addition of a Gauss rifle at the expense of the missile tubes, giving the 4G considerable punch at longer ranges. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 狂暴 4G 于 2750 年制造，是对原始 2G 型号的大规模改造，把许多部件升级为现代型号。最引人注目的是以牺牲导弹发射管为代价加装了一门高斯步枪，使 4G 在较远距离上也拥有相当可观的打击力。 特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1.15 手臂驱动器限制：左下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The personal BattleMech of Rim Worlds Army General Viktoria Benbaoudaoud. Based on the Rampage 5G, the 4G \"Benbaoudaoud\" was a minor custom refit, most notably removing the MASC for additional missile tubes. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.17 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是边境世界军将军维克托里娅·本鲍达乌德的私人战斗机甲。4G“本鲍达乌德”以暴走5G为基础，是一次小幅定制改装，最显著之处是拆掉MASC以增加导弹发射管。 特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1.17 手臂驱动器限制：左下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: While the original Rampage had its debut in 2735 as a standard line unit, it saw a large scale redesign following the Amaris Coup in 2767. Taking advantage of the newly acquired SLDF R&D facilities, the Rampage 5G was outfitted with state-of-the-art weaponry previously unheard of in the Rim Worlds Republic. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 最初的暴走于2735年作为标准战列单位首次亮相，在2767年阿马里斯政变后经历了大规模重新设计。凭借新取得的SLDF研发设施，暴走5G装备了此前在边境世界共和国闻所未闻的最先进武器。 特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1.15 手臂驱动器限制：左下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An offshoot of the Jenner, the 35 ton Rattlesnake JR7-31 was developed as part of the joint MIIO-LIC Trapdoor Project during the early years of the Clan Invasion. Meant primarily as a disinformation campaign targeted at House Kurita, few Rattlesnakes were ever manufactured, with the design becoming extinct within 30 years. Built around a 245-rated XL Engine and 7 Jump Jets, the Rattlesnake mounts 7 Medium Lasers. Guardian ECM is included and the remaining tonnage devoted to additional armor. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Rattlesnake JR7-31 是 Jenner 的分支机型，这台 35 吨机甲是部族入侵初期 MIIO 与 LIC 联合开展的“活板门计划”（Trapdoor Project）的产物。它主要被用作针对库瑞塔家族的虚假情报行动，因此制造的 Rattlesnake 数量极少，该设计在 30 年内便告绝迹。Rattlesnake 以一台 245 级 XL 引擎和 7 具跳跃推进器为核心，装有 7 门中型激光。它还配有一具守护者电子对抗系统，剩余吨位则全部用于增加装甲。 特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：0.98 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The JR7-31B is a slightly cheaper version of the JR7-31P. By dropping one of the heat sinks, the armor was able to be switched from the more expensive Ferro-Fibrous to standard grade. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: JR7-31B 是 JR7-31P 的略微廉价版本。通过拆除一具散热器，装甲得以从更昂贵的铁纤维更换为标准型号。 特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：0.98

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An offshoot of the Jenner, the 35 ton Rattlesnake JR7-31P was developed as part of the joint MIIO-LIC Trapdoor Project during the early years of the Clan Invasion. Meant primarily as a disinformation campaign targeted at House Kurita, few Rattlesnakes were ever manufactured, with the design becoming extinct within 30 years. Built around a 245-rated XL Engine and 7 Jump Jets, the Rattlesnake mounts 7 Medium Lasers. A C3 Slave is included and the remaining tonnage devoted to additional armor. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为迅捷的分支，35吨的响尾蛇JR7-31P是部族入侵早期MIIO-LIC“活板门计划”的产物。它主要针对库瑞塔家族进行假情报行动，制造的响尾蛇极少，该设计在30年内便灭绝。响尾蛇围绕一台245额定XL引擎和7具跳跃推进器建造，装7门中型激光，另带一台C3从机，其余吨位用于额外装甲。 特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：0.98 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 31PX is the early prototype version of what eventually got introduced as the JR7-31P. The C3 slave computer of the later version is missing in the PX, but instead an extra Medium Laser is mounted in the head. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 31PX是后来定型为JR7-31P的早期原型版本。PX上没有后续型号的C3从属计算机，取而代之的是头部加装的一具中型激光。 特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：0.98

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The JR7-31U switches to an endo steel chassis to free enough weight capacity to increase the amount of armor. The Guardian ECM of the original JR7-31 is also replaced by a C3 Slave computer. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: JR7-31U改用内骨架底盘，腾出足够重量容量以增加装甲。原JR7-31的守护者电子对抗套件也被换成一台C3从机。 特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：0.98 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Razor Jaw carries an ATM-9 in each side torso and a Medium Pulse Laser in each arm. Five Jump Jets improves mobility enough to compensate for its lack of a high max speed. Quirk: Improved Lifesupport Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 剃刀颚在左右躯干各装有一具ATM-9，每条手臂各有一门中型脉冲激光。五个跳跃推进器充分提升了机动性，弥补了最高速度不足的缺陷。 特性：改进生命维持系统 投放费用倍率：1.11 手臂驱动器限制：左臂上部、右臂上部

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: As a BattleMech design the Reconquista was a mixed-bag. Its numerous faulty components included the internal combustion engine, myomer, chassis, spare parts, controls and software. The Reconquista's slow speed and limited agility were also severe weaknesses exploited by Umayyad artillery and tanks. On the other hand, the armor, heat sinks and mix of weaponry (autocannon, machine gun and long-range missiles) proved adequate, and the 'Mech could be built in (relatively) large enough numbers at a critical time of the invasion. Quirk: Ubiquitous Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.89 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为一款战斗机甲设计，再征服是好坏参半的。它众多有缺陷的部件包括内燃机、人造肌、底盘、备件、控制系统和软件。再征服缓慢的速度与有限的灵活性也是倭马亚火炮与坦克所利用的严重弱点。另一方面，它的装甲、散热器和武器组合（自动炮、机枪与远程导弹）被证明是够用的，而且该机甲能在入侵的关键时刻以（相对）足够大的数量生产出来。 特性：无处不在 投放费用倍率：0.89 手臂驱动器限制：右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Rhino was an early attempt made by Clan Hell's Horses to develop true battle armor during the Golden Century. The Rhino's weapons layout and equipment was similar to the Elemental (Battle Armor), but was not as capable as the later machine. Its weapons ranges were shorter and it lacked maneuverability and speed. However, the armor was greater than what the Elemental battlesuit would carry. In addition, while the suit's SRM 2 was easy to use and reload, it had a significant jamming issue. This issue would cause catastrophic ammo explosions dealing major damage to the suit and the pilot (for an example, see Bertram). Engineers tried to resolve the issue, but the Rhino was shelved before the issue could be rectified. Quirk: Armored Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.935 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can not swarm.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 犀牛是地狱马部族在黄金世纪早期尝试研制真正的战斗装甲的产物。犀牛的武器布局与装备与元素（战斗装甲）相似，但能力不及后来的型号：武器射程更短，也缺乏机动性与速度。不过它的装甲比元素战斗装甲更厚。此外，虽然该装甲的SRM 2易于使用和再装填，却存在严重的卡壳问题，会引发灾难性的弹药爆炸，对装甲与飞行员造成重大伤害（示例见伯特伦）。工程师曾试图解决该问题，但问题未能修正，犀牛便被束之高阁。 特性：装甲化 投放费用倍率：0.935 可搭载全向单位，可近战，不可蜂拥攻击。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Rhino's main armament is a Large Laser mounted in the center torso, while it also carries a Medium Laser in each leg, one rear-facing one in the left torso and another in the head. A basic 300-rated fusion core keeps mobility up just enough to not be easily flanked. Quirk: Accurate Weapon - Laser Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 犀牛的主要武器是装在中央躯干的一门大型激光，同时每条腿各装一门中型激光，左躯干一门后向、头部另一门。一台基本的300额定聚变核心让机动性刚好够用，不至于轻易被包抄。 特性：精准武器 - 激光 投放费用倍率：1.06

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Rifleman IIC Chironex carries an Ultra AC/2 and ATM 3 rack in each arm, supported by head mounted ER Small Laser and a Large Pulse Laser in each side torso. Built around a 195-rated standard engine, Endo Steel frame and thirteen tons of Ferro-Fibrous armor, the Chironex is fitted with fourteen Double Heat Sinks, three Jump Jets, three tons of ATM reloads and two tons of UAC rounds. Quirk: Integrated Searchlight Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.17 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 步枪兵 IIC“奇罗内克斯”（Chironex）每条手臂各装有一门 Ultra AC/2 和一具 ATM 3 发射架，并由头部安装的增程小型激光以及两侧躯干各一门大型脉冲激光提供支援。它以额定 195 的标准引擎、内骨架结构及十三吨铁纤维装甲为基础建造，装设了十四台双散热器、三具跳跃推进器、三吨 ATM 备用弹药和两吨 UAC 弹药。 特性：内置探照灯 投放费用倍率：1.17 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Developed for the Emperor Stefan Amaris's occupying army, the Rifleman III was an experimental prototype which was rushed into service to defend against the invading Star League Defense Force Army led by General Aleksandr Kerensky in 2777. Only a single prototype was produced after years of development, and it was destroyed during the battle for Terra. Used in the role of an ambusher before being destroyed, the 'Mech's Battle ROM would recount that it had downed nine SLDF BattleMechs before it was rendered inoperable by battle damage. Quirk: Multi Trac Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Rifleman III 是为斯特凡·阿马里斯皇帝的占领军开发的实验性原型机，于 2777 年被匆忙投入使用，以抵御亚历山大·克伦斯基将军率领的入侵中的星际联盟防卫军。历经多年研发，最终只生产出一台原型机，它也在争夺泰拉的战火中被摧毁。这台机甲在被摧毁前担任伏击手，其战斗记录仪记载，它曾击落九台 SLDF 战斗机甲，最终因战损而彻底失去战斗力。 特性：多重追踪 投放费用倍率：1.18 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The personally built 'Mech of Cranston Snord's Irregulars member 'Shorty' Sneede, his Rifleman is a FrankenMech featuring a Phoenix Hawk head, Warhammer right arm and the left torso and arm from an Archer, with only the center and right torsos and both legs left from the parent design. Built around the 3N's standard 240-rated engine, much of the weapons and ammunition from the donor 'Mechs was retained, Sneede's custom being armed with a right-arm mounted PPC, left-torso mounted LRM-20 with two tons of ammo, and three Medium Lasers - one fitted to the right torso and two to the left arm. Carrying a total of fourteen single heat sinks, Sneede's patchwork Rifleman is clad in nine tons of armor. Quirk: Anti-Air Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是克兰斯顿·斯诺德“非正规军”成员“矮子”斯尼德的私人座驾；他的 Rifleman 是一具拼装机甲，装有 Phoenix Hawk 的头部、Warhammer 的右臂，以及来自 Archer 的左躯干和左臂，只有中央躯干、右躯干和双腿是原设计的部件。它以 3N 的标准 240 级引擎为核心，保留了供体机甲的大部分武器和弹药：斯尼德的定制机右臂装有一门粒子炮，左躯干装有一具带两吨弹药的 LRM-20，另有三门中型激光——一门装在右躯干，两门装在左臂。斯尼德这具拼凑而成的 Rifleman 共携带十四具单散热器，披挂九吨装甲。 特性：防空瞄准 投放费用倍率：1.08 手臂驱动器限制：左臂上部、右臂上部

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Originally conceived by Clan Jade Falcon during the Clans' Golden Century, the Emerald Harrier is a 15-ton BattleMech. It was out of production by the time of the Clan Invasion of the Inner Sphere and, as such, was only sparsely deployed there. ComStar ROM operatives gave it the reporting name RD-1R Roadrunner when they first observed it in the Jade Falcon occupation zone. It was last reported with Eyrie units on Coventry in 3058 and is thought to have been meant as a training 'Mech. Quirk: Easy to Pilot Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Emerald Harrier 最初由翡翠猎鹰部族在部族黄金世纪期间构想，是一台 15 吨的战斗机甲。到部族入侵内层星域时它已经停产，因此在内层星域只有少量部署。通讯之星 ROM 特工在翡翠猎鹰占领区首次观察到它时，为其取了个代号 RD-1R Roadrunner。它最后一次被记录是 3058 年随 Eyrie 单位出现在考文垂，据信其设计初衷是作为训练机甲。 特性：易于驾驶 投放费用倍率：1.03

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Roc is considered one of the best of the first generation ProtoMechs, and most known successful, as it was produced, operative and fighting for almost a century. In a sense a 'super-Elemental', a Roc carries a single ER Medium Laser and is equipped with sufficient Jump Jets to leap 150 meters at a time. Quirk: Accurate Weapons - Energy Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.972
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Roc 被视为第一代原生型机甲（ProtoMech）中最优秀的型号之一，也是最广为人知的成功之作，它的生产、服役与作战延续了近一个世纪。从某种意义上说，Roc 是一台“超级元素”，搭载一门增程中型激光，并配备足以一次跳跃 150 米的跳跃推进器。 特性：精准武器 - 能量 投放费用倍率：0.972

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The SA-RN model uses four Artemis IV FCS-guided SRM-4 launchers protected by CASE. It also sports a prototype claw in the left arm and a Large Pulse Laser in the right. Quirk: Protected Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: SA-RN型号使用四具带阿尔忒弥斯IV火控系统的SRM-4发射器，由CASE保护。它的左臂还装有一具原型爪，右臂一门大型脉冲激光。 特性：受保护驱动器 投放费用倍率：1.04 手臂驱动器限制：右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The SA-RNS is almost identical to the SA-RN, but drops one ton of SRM ammunition to increase the armoring of the 'Mech. Quirk: Protected Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: SA-RNS与SA-RN几乎相同，只是拆掉一吨SRM弹药以增加机甲装甲。 特性：受保护驱动器 投放费用倍率：1.04 手臂驱动器限制：右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Rook relies on its many weapons and substantial amount of armor rather than speed, but to improve mobility it has three Assault-class Jump Jets. The two PPC, three SRM-6 and three Medium Lasers are cooled by a total of 22 heat sinks, which despite the large number of sinks is far from enough to cool a full alpha strike of the 'Mech. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 车堡依靠其众多武器与厚实装甲而非速度，但为提升机动性，它装了三具突击级跳跃推进器。两门粒子炮、三具SRM-6和三门中型激光由总共22个散热器降温；尽管散热器数量众多，仍远不足以支撑该机甲一次全力齐射。 特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1.16

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An assault grade fire support mech, the Salamander entered production in 3055. An 80-ton mech, the Salamander is built around a 320-rated XL Engine and an Endo Steel Skeleton, allowing it to carry 43 tons of weapons and equipment. The Salamander PPR-5S is armed with a trio of LRM-20’s. A pair of Medium Lasers act as back up weapons. Quirk: Accurate Weapon - Missiles Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为一台突击级火力支援机甲，火蜥蜴于3055年投产。这台80吨的机甲围绕320额定XL引擎和内骨架建造，可携带43吨武器与装备。火蜥蜴PPR-5S装备3具LRM-20，并由2门中型激光充当备用武器。 <特性：精准武器（导弹） <投放费用倍率：1.14 <手臂驱动器限制：左臂下段

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An assault grade fire support mech, the Salamander entered production in 3055. An 80-ton mech, the Salamander is built around a 400-rated XL Engine and an Endo Steel Skeleton. The Salamander PPR-5T is armed with a trio of LRM-15’s, with 2 Small Lasers as back up weapons. Quirk: Accurate Weapon - Missiles Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Salamander 是一款突击级火力支援机甲，于 3055 年投产。这台 80 吨的机甲围绕一台 400 额定 XL 引擎和内骨架结构建造。Salamander PPR-5T 装备三具 LRM-15，并以两门小型激光作为备用武器。 特性：精准武器 - 导弹 投放费用倍率：1.14 手臂驱动器限制：左下臂

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An assault grade fire support mech, the Salamander entered production in 3055. An 80-ton mech, the Salamander is built around a 320-rated XL Engine and an Endo Steel Skeleton, allowing it to carry 43 tons of weapons and equipment. The Salamander PPR-6S is armed with a pair of Artemis IV enhanced LRM-20’s and an Artemis IV enhanced SRM-6. A pair of Medium Pulse Lasers act as back up weapons. Quirk: Accurate Weapon - Missiles Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Salamander 是一款突击级火力支援机甲，于 3055 年投产。它重 80 吨，围绕额定 320 的 XL 引擎和内骨架打造，可携带 43 吨武器与装备。Salamander PPR-6S 装有两具配备 Artemis IV 的 LRM-20 和一具配备 Artemis IV 的 SRM-6。两门中型脉冲激光作为备用武器。 特性：精准武器 - 导弹 投放费用倍率：1.14 手臂驱动器限制：左下臂

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An assault grade fire support mech, the Salamander entered production in 3055. An 80-ton mech, the Salamander is built around a 320-rated XL Engine and an Endo Steel Skeleton, allowing it to carry 43 tons of weapons and equipment. The Salamander PPR-6T is armed with a pair of LRM-20’s. A pair of Medium Pulse Lasers and a Large Pulse Laser act as back up weapons. Quirk: Accurate Weapon - Missiles Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Salamander 是一台突击级火力支援机甲，于 3055 年投产。这台 80 吨机甲以一台 320 级 XL 引擎和内骨架结构为核心，可携带 43 吨武器与装备。Salamander PPR-6T 装备两具 LRM-20，两门中型脉冲激光和一门大型脉冲激光充当备用武器。 特性：精准武器 - 导弹 投放费用倍率：1.14 手臂驱动器限制：左下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The PPR-6U Salamander is a sidegrade kit for the 6S, removing the Artemis IV systems and instead fits a Large Pulse Laser. The two Medium Pulse Lasers also had to be downgraded to standard versions. The kit is mainly used by mercenary outfits when advanced electronics like the Artemis IV FCS are rare or difficult to maintain. Quirk: Accurate Weapon - Missiles Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: PPR-6U火蜥蜴是6S的侧级改装套件，拆掉阿尔忒弥斯IV系统，改为一门大型脉冲激光，两门中型脉冲激光也不得不降级为标准型号。该套件主要被雇佣兵部队使用——当阿尔忒弥斯IV火控系统这类先进电子设备稀少或难以维护时。 特性：精准武器 - 导弹 投放费用倍率：1.14 手臂驱动器限制：左下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Salamander the design incorporates fire-based weapons; its primary armaments being a pair of Flamers slung under the arms and a single, one-shot short-range missile strapped to the shoulder, invariably one with an Inferno payload. This makes the Salamander especially potent against infantry and combat vehicles, though that does not mean it is less intimidating to MechWarriors: few would want to get caught in the sights of a Salamander Point. Quirk: Fire Demon Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.93 Can mount any unit, can melee, can swarm.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Salamander 的设计以火焰类武器为核心；其主要武器是挂在双臂下方的两具火焰喷射器，以及绑在肩部的一枚一次性近程导弹，且弹头无一例外都是燃烧弹。这使 Salamander 对步兵和战斗车辆尤为致命，但这并不意味着它对机甲战士的威慑力会小一些：很少有人愿意被一支 Salamander 小队盯上。 特性：火焰恶魔 投放费用倍率：0.93 可搭乘任何单位，可近战，可蜂拥攻击。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Sarissa MN1-K was armed simply. It carried a battery of lasers, one large and several medium, and mounted as much armor as could be fi tted with the remaining weight budget. Though truly a BattleMech, it drew heavily on a century of IndustrialMech construction experience and was often assembled in civilian facilities. The result was a mechanically reliable and durable machine ideal for Marik militias with little BattleMech training, but otherwise not terribly impressive. Quirk: Ubiquitous Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.82
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Sarissa MN1-K的武器配置十分简单。它搭载一组激光——一门大型激光和若干门中型激光——并在剩余重量预算内尽可能多地安装装甲。虽然它确确实实是一台战斗机甲，却大量借鉴了长达一个世纪的工业机甲制造经验，并常常在民用设施中组装。其结果是机械可靠、坚固耐用，非常适合缺乏战斗机甲训练的马尔克民兵，但除此之外并不特别出众。 特性：随处可见 投放费用倍率：0.82

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The original Sasquatch model produced in 3054, the 001 would infamously be stolen resulting in VEST creating the 002 model to hunt down and destroy the prototype. Hand made for the Solaris arenas, the Sasquatch SQS-TH-001 is an 85 ton Assault Mech powered by a 340-rated XL Engine. Primarily armed with a Gauss Rifle, the 001 has 4 Medium Pulse Lasers and an SRM-6 for close range combat. A pair of Machine Guns and a Small Laser are added as an after thought. AMS is mounted in the right torso and 6 Jump Jets improve mobility. Quirk: Protected Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 001是3054年生产的大脚怪初代型号，它后来因被盗而臭名昭著，VEST公司因此制造出002型去追捕并摧毁原型机。大脚怪SQS-TH-001为索拉里斯竞技场手工打造，是一台85吨的突击机甲，由一具340级XL引擎驱动。它以一支高斯步枪为主要武器，另有4具中型脉冲激光和一具SRM-6用于近战，还顺手加装了两挺机枪和一具小型激光。右躯干装有反导弹系统，6具跳跃推进器则提升了机动性。 特性：受保护驱动器 投放费用倍率：1.15 手臂驱动器限制：右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The SQS-TH-001U adds more heat sinks for improved cooling at the cost of dropping some armor and replacing the SRM-6 launcher with two Small Pulse Lasers. Quirk: Protected Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: SQS-TH-001U增加了更多散热器以改善散热，代价是削减部分装甲，并把SRM-6发射器换成两门小型脉冲激光。 特性：受保护驱动器 投放费用倍率：1.15 手臂驱动器限制：右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The SQS-TH-007 upgrades the original Sasquatch with ferro-fibrous armor, allowing more protection. One additional ton each of Gauss and AMS ammunition is also added. Quirk: Protected Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: SQS-TH-007 将初代 Sasquatch 升级为铁纤维装甲，从而获得更强的防护。此外还各增加了一吨高斯步枪弹药和 AMS 弹药。 特性：受保护驱动器 投放费用倍率：1.15 手臂驱动器限制：右下臂

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Satyr ProtoMech was designed to serve as a deep raider and reconnaissance unit. Offering only slightly more protection than a Harpy or Siren, the Satyr's best defense is to remain hidden from enemy units. The Satyr's single ER Small Laser allows it to inflict moderate damage on any enemy unit that gets too close. It also carries a Light Active Probe in its torso, allowing it to more easily find hidden units. Quirk: Nimble Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.97
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 萨提尔原生机甲被设计为纵深袭掠与侦察单位。它的防护只比鹰身女妖或塞任稍好，因此最好的防御就是不被敌方单位发现。萨提尔那门单独的增程小型激光能对任何靠得太近的敌方单位造成中等伤害；它躯干内还带一台轻型主动探测器，使其更容易发现隐藏单位。 特性：灵巧 投放费用倍率：0.97

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Though the first alternate configuration is focused on close-range combat, it carries an ER Large Laser and Gauss Rifle for long-range work. Three ATM 6s are effective at all ranges, while a trio of Medium Pulse Lasers aid with the devastating attack. Enough jump jets to vault up to ninety meters at a time helps MechWarriors get into close range, while an Anti-Missile System grants added defensive capability. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 第一套备用配置虽然以近程作战为重点，却仍携带一门增程大型激光和一门高斯步枪用于远程打击。三具 ATM 6 在各射程上都有效，而三门中型脉冲激光则为这场毁灭性攻势助力。足以一次跃出九十米的跳跃推进器帮助机甲战士迅速接近对手，一套反导弹系统则额外增强了防御能力。 特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1.16 手臂驱动器限制：全向机甲

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This variant is effective at all ranges. A pair of ER Large Lasers and a Large Pulse Laser combine with an Ultra Autocannon/5 to provide an effective long-range punch. Six Small Pulse Lasers aid at knife-fighting range and can quickly devastate conventional infantry. Two pairs of ATM 3s provide support at all ranges. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 此变型在任意距离上都有效：一对增程大型激光和一门大型脉冲激光，配合一门超级AC/5提供有效的远程重拳；六门小型脉冲激光在贴身距离上协助作战，能迅速歼灭常规步兵；两对ATM 3则在所有距离上提供支援。 特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1.16 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The personal 'Mech of Khan Sullivan Koga, it mimics her trends in leading the Coyotes; a strong base, upgraded and enhanced by new features. Building off of the classic Awesome loadout, three ER PPCs provide long range firepower without ammo constraints, or thanks to the 23 double heatsinks, heat worries. Running relatively minimal ammo considering the heat produced by the ER PPCs, the UAC/10 and ATM 9 are more support weapons; available to finish off a target, instead of waiting for the PPCs to recharge. Khan Koga used this to great effect when attacking the Nova Cats on Huntress, splitting fire between a distant target with two PPCs, and finishing off a closer 'Mech with the UAC/10 and ATM 9. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是可汗沙利文·科加的专属机甲，延续了她统领郊狼部族时的风格：扎实的基础，再以新装备升级强化。本机在经典的"敬畏"配置上发展而来，三门增程粒子炮带来不受弹药限制的远程火力，而23具双散热器则让它无需担心过热。考虑到增程粒子炮产生的热量，它携带的弹药相对有限，UAC/10与ATM 9更像是支援武器，用于终结目标，而不必等待粒子炮重新冷却。科加可汗在进攻享特雷斯星的新星猫部族时充分发挥了本机的威力：以两门粒子炮攻击远处目标，再用UAC/10与ATM 9解决逼近的机甲。 特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1.18 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Clan Coyote created the LUNA experimental model as a reminder of their history with the Inner Sphere and Star League, borrowing heavily from Native American lore; they had foolishly left their love when trying to impress them, and their nightly howl is their eternal promise to return. The howl of the HAG 40, the burning display of the Laser Heatsinks, all reinforce the theme of announcing their love for, and sorrow for leaving, their love. Outside of the handful of Coyotes who know the stories though, the LUNA designator is assumed to be related to the effectiveness of the unit on low-atmospheric worlds, perfectly masking the feelings of those who feel the decision to stay with the Clan Homeworlds was not the right choice. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 郊狼部族创造了LUNA实验型号，以纪念他们与内层星域和星际联盟的过往，大量借用美洲原住民的传说：他们曾愚蠢地在试图讨好爱人时离开了所爱，而每夜的嗥叫便是他们永世归来的承诺。HAG 40的啸声、激光散热器的灼热光芒，都在强化这一主题：宣告他们对爱人的爱，以及离开的悲伤。不过除了少数知晓这些故事的郊狼成员之外，LUNA这个编号被外界认为与该单位在低大气星球上的效能有关，恰好完美掩盖了那些认为留在部族母星世界的决定并不正确之人的心绪。 特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1.18 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The SCP-1B model uses a smaller engine and replaces the PPC with a blazer, a second SRM rack, and additional heat sinks Quirk: Improved Lifesupport Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: SCP-1B型使用更小的引擎，并以一门双联激光炮、第二具SRM发射架和额外的散热器取代粒子炮 特性：改进生命维持 投放费用倍率：1.03

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: One of the first mass production QuadMechs, the 55 ton Scorpion entered production in 2570 as an infantry support unit. Shunned by most MechWarriors due to its notoriously unstable gait, the Scorpion would nevertheless see uninterrupted use throughout the Succession Wars and beyond. The Scorpion 1N is powered by a 330-rated Fusion Core giving it a top speed of 97 km/h. A PPC and an SRM-6 form the Mechs weapons load. Quirk: Improved Lifesupport Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为最早量产的四肢机甲之一，55吨的蝎式于2570年作为步兵支援单位投产。由于其步态以不稳著称，大多数机甲战士对它避而远之，但蝎式仍在整个继承战争及其后不间断地服役。蝎式1N由一台330额定聚变核心驱动，最高速度97公里/小时。武器为一门粒子炮和一具SRM-6。 特性：改进生命维持 投放费用倍率：1.03

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This custom variant of the Scorpion 1N was used by the leader of the mercenary band Rubinsky's Renegades. It replaces the PPC with two arrays and two dual mountings of Clan-grade Machine Guns and a MASC. Quirk: Improved Lifesupport Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这款 Scorpion 1N 的定制变型由雇佣兵部队“鲁宾斯基叛徒”（Rubinsky's Renegades）的首领使用。它用两套阵列、两座双联装的部族级机枪和一套 MASC 取代了粒子炮。 特性：改进生命维持 投放费用倍率：1.05

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: One of the first mass production QuadMechs, the 55 ton Scorpion entered production in 2570 as an infantry support unit. The Scoprion 1NW is a custom refit created by Wendall Puritan of the Smithson's Chinese Bandits. Retaining the 330-rated Fusion Core and the SRM-6, the PPC was replaced with a Large Laser and additional tonnage was dedicated to armor. Quirk: Improved Lifesupport Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This 'Mech was used by the Wolf's Dragoons during their campaigns in the Inner Sphere. The design replaces most of the technology in the 'Mech with Clan-grade equivalents, considerably improving the performance compared to the original Scorpion designs. Quirk: Improved Lifesupport Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这台机甲曾在狼之龙骑兵于内层星域的征战中使用。该设计把机甲上的大部分技术替换为部族级同类装备，性能比原版蝎子设计有了显著提升。 <特性：改进生命维持系统 <投放费用倍率：1.09

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Sentinel is a medium BattleMech built by Defiance Industries, originally under exclusive contract for the Lyran Commonwealth, as an infantry support and installation defense 'Mech. While initially pleased to have a then Terran Hegemony controlled factory manufacturing the 'Mech exclusively for the LCAF, the Lyrans were less so when a Star League Council amendment in 2652 permitted the Star League Defense Force to purchase a highly advanced version of the design which Houses Steiner, Marik and Davion would not receive until years later. The Sentinel was one of many designs to suffer from the technological decline of the Succession Wars era, with Defiance first losing the ability to manufacture its advanced weapon systems before discontinuing production entirely in 3014 due to lack of both parts and interest. Rather than disappear from the battlefield, the Sentinel now began to appear in increasing numbers thanks to ComStar and its massive stockpile of SLDF material, both providing the design to the Draconis Combine prior to the War of 3039 and using it to help outfit its Com Guards. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 哨兵是迪法恩斯工业建造的中型战斗机甲，最初依莱兰联邦独家合同作为步兵支援与设施防御机甲。莱兰人起初为有一家当时由地球霸权控制的工厂专为 LCAF 制造该机甲而欣喜，但当 2652 年星盟理事会修正案允许星盟防卫军采购该设计的高度先进版本、而施泰纳、马里克与达维昂家族要多年后才能获得时，他们的喜悦便大打折扣。哨兵是继承战争时代技术衰退的众多受害者之一：迪法恩斯先失去制造其先进武器系统的能力，随后于 3014 年因零件与需求双双匮乏而彻底停产。然而哨兵并未从战场消失——凭借康星及其庞大的星盟防卫军物资储备，它反而越来越多地出现：康星既在 3039 年战争前把该设计提供给德拉科尼斯联合体，也用它装备自己的康卫。 特质：改进型通讯 投放费用倍率：1 臂部驱动器限制：左上臂

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Sentinel 是由 Defiance Industries 制造的中型战斗机甲，最初依据独家合同为莱兰联邦打造，用作步兵支援与设施防御机甲。起初莱兰人还很满意——那座当时由地球霸权掌控的工厂专为 LCAF 生产该机甲；但当星际联盟议会于 2652 年通过修正案，允许星际联盟国防军采购该设计的高度先进版本，而施泰纳、马里克和达维昂家族还要再等数年才能获得时，莱兰人就不那么高兴了。Sentinel 是众多受继承战争时代技术衰退拖累的设计之一：Defiance 先是丧失了制造其先进武器系统的能力，随后又因缺少零件且缺乏兴趣，于 3014 年彻底停产。但 Sentinel 并未从战场上消失，反而开始以越来越多的数量出现——这要归功于通讯之星及其庞大的星际联盟国防军物资储备：它既在 3039 年战争前夕把该设计提供给龙脉联合体，又用它来装备自己的通讯之星卫队。 特性：改进通讯 投放费用倍率：1.04 手臂驱动器限制：左臂上部

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An early clan Mech dating from the days of Operation Klondike, the Sentinel STC-3L-EC was an upgrade of the standard STL-3L that replaced the weapons with Early Clan variants. Prodcution of the Mech was discontinued when modern clan spec weapons entered production. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.01 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 哨兵STC-3L-EC是可追溯到克朗代克行动时期的部族早期机甲，是对标准STL-3L的升级，以部族早期型号替换了武器。随着现代部族规格武器投产，该机甲被停产。 特性：改进通讯 投放费用倍率：1.01 手臂驱动器限制：左上

The Sentinel was one of many designs to suffer from the technological decline of the Succession Wars era, with Defiance first losing the ability to manufacture its advanced weapon systems before discontinuing production entirely in 3014 due to lack of both parts and interest. Rather than disappear from the battlefield, the Sentinel now began to appear in increasing numbers thanks to ComStar and its massive stockpile of SLDF material, both providing the design to the Draconis Combine prior to the War of 3039 and using it to help outfit its Com Guards.
