Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Strider 的 F 配置专为近距离战斗设计，但与 Strider E 不同，它对弹药类武器的依赖没那么强。主武器为两具连发 SRM-4 发射器，另有两具中型激光作为支援。该机甲还加装了六具跳跃推进器，使其跳跃距离可达一百八十米。 特性：易于驾驶 投放费用倍率：0.97 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The R loadout is a field upgrade developed in the midst of Operation Bulldog. This configuration utilized captured Clan Smoke Jaguar weapons to help bolster the SLDF forces in later waves. Based off the Strider E, thanks to lighter Clan weaponry it is able to mount two Clan-tech Streak SRM-6 launchers and a pair of Clan Medium Pulse Lasers. Quirk: Easy to Pilot Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.97 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: R 配置是在“斗牛犬行动”（Operation Bulldog）期间研发的战场升级。这套配置利用缴获的烟美洲豹部族武器，为后续几波攻势中的 SLDF 部队提供助力。它以步行者（Strider）E 型为基础，凭借更轻的部族武器，得以装设两具部族科技连发 SRM-6 发射器和两门部族中型脉冲激光。 特性：易于驾驶 投放费用倍率：0.97 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Striker STC-2C is built using rugged, off-the-shelf technologies that allow it to stand up to a great deal of punishment and enable easy repair. The 2C has a top speed of 64.8 km/h, provided by a 320-rated Fusion engine. For protection, it carries thirteen and a half tons of armor, solidly average for a 'Mech of the Striker's size. The Striker STC-2C dissipates the heat from its arsenal with fifteen standard heat sinks. It has an arsenal that is capable of engaging an enemy at a variety of ranges. At maximum range, the 2C brings its PPC and a AC/5 to bear. As the enemy closes, it can also make use of its Large Laser, though the unit's pilot will need to monitor their heat generation carefully. Finally, for close range defense, it has three Medium Lasers. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.12 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 打击者STC-2C采用坚固的现成技术建造，能承受大量打击且易于修理。2C由一台320额定聚变引擎驱动，最高速度64.8公里/小时。防护方面它带十三吨半装甲，对打击者这一尺寸的机甲而言正好是平均水平。打击者STC-2C用十五个标准散热器散发武器热量。它的武器组合能在多种距离上交战：最大射程上，2C可用粒子炮和一门AC/5攻击；敌人逼近后还可以动用大型激光，不过飞行员需要小心监控热量。最后，近距防御由三门中型激光负责。 特性：易于维护 投放费用倍率：1.12 手臂驱动器限制：左下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Striker STC-2C is built using rugged, off-the-shelf technologies that allow it to stand up to a great deal of punishment and enable easy repair. The 2C has a top speed of 64.8 km/h, provided by a 320-rated Fusion engine. For protection, it carries thirteen and a half tons of armor, solidly average for a 'Mech of the Striker's size. The Striker STC-2C dissipates the heat from its arsenal with fifteen standard heat sinks. It has an arsenal that is capable of engaging an enemy at a variety of ranges. At maximum range, the 2C brings its PPC and a AC/5 to bear. As the enemy closes, it can also make use of its Large Laser, though the unit's pilot will need to monitor their heat generation carefully. Finally, for close range defense, it has three Medium Lasers. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.12 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 打击者STC-2C采用坚固的现成技术建造，能承受大量打击且易于修理。2C由一台320额定聚变引擎驱动，最高速度64.8公里/小时。防护方面它带十三吨半装甲，对打击者这一尺寸的机甲而言正好是平均水平。打击者STC-2C用十五个标准散热器散发武器热量。它的武器组合能在多种距离上交战：最大射程上，2C可用粒子炮和一门AC/5攻击；敌人逼近后还可以动用大型激光，不过飞行员需要小心监控热量。最后，近距防御由三门中型激光负责。 特性：易于维护 投放费用倍率：1.12 手臂驱动器限制：左下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 2D variant of the Striker is a very basic upgrade of the design used by the Capellan Confederation Armed Forces. The PPC has been upgraded to an ER PPC, the three medium lasers have been replaced with a pair of Medium Pulse Lasers, and the 'Mech has had three heat sinks removed. The remaining heat sinks have been upgraded to double heat sinks. The remaining available space has been used to add two tons of armor to the 'Mech. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 打击者（Striker）2D 变型是对卡佩兰联邦武装部队所用设计的一次非常基础的升级。粒子炮升级为增程粒子炮，三门中型激光被替换为两门中型脉冲激光，该机甲还拆除了三台散热器。剩余的散热器则升级为双散热器。余下的可用空间被用于为该机甲增加两吨装甲。 特性：易于维护 投放费用倍率：1.14 手臂驱动器限制：左下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: n order to make the Striker more heat-efficient, the House Steiner variant removed the Large Laser and autocannon to incorporate an Autocannon/10 with a two-ton magazine. The result is a 'Mech that has less damage potential, but easier heat management. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.12 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 为使打击者更省热，施泰纳家族变型拆掉大型激光和自动炮，改装一门AC/10（配两吨弹匣）。结果是一台伤害潜力更低但热量管理更容易的机甲。 特性：易于维护 投放费用倍率：1.12 手臂驱动器限制：左下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Summoner is a highly mobile heavy OmniMech that is commonly used in a wide variety of roles. Barely a second generation OmniMech, the Jade Falcons introduced the Summoner just after becoming the first Clan to win OmniMech technology from Clan Coyote in 2863. The custom configuration of Aiden Pryde used during his first Trial of Position with Clan Jade Falcon in 3030, the ADN features an ER PPC and Large Pulse Laser in the right arm as primary weapons. Backing these up are the standard LRM15 in the Left Torso and a pair of ER Medium Pulse Lasers in the left arm. A single Anti-Missile System in the right torso rounds out the configuration. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.13 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Summoner 是一款机动性极强的重型全向机甲，常用于执行各种不同任务。它勉强算第二代全向机甲——2863 年，翡翠猎鹰成为首个从郊狼部族赢得全向机甲技术的部族，随后便推出了 Summoner。ADN 是艾登·普莱德在 3030 年与翡翠猎鹰部族进行首次职位试炼时所使用的定制配置，以右臂的一门增程粒子炮和一门大型脉冲激光为主力武器。其辅助火力包括左躯干的标准 LRM15 和左臂的两门增程中型脉冲激光，右躯干的一套反导弹系统则补全了整套配置。 特性：改进通讯 投放费用倍率：1.13 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Coelocanth is a heavily customized Summoner, the original creator unknown as it has changed hands many times as part of bets or gladiator fights. It mounts a large Hyper Assault Gauss/30 in the Left Arm and an ER PPC in the right arm. A single ER Small Laser provides some rudimentary anti-infantry defense. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.13 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Coelocanth 是一具经过大幅定制的 Summoner，最初的制造者已无人知晓，因为它曾在赌约和角斗中多次易主。它左臂搭载一门 Hyper Assault Gauss/30，右臂搭载一具增程粒子炮。一具增程小型激光提供最基本的反步兵防御。 特性：改进通讯 投放费用倍率：1.13 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Summoner is a highly mobile heavy OmniMech that is commonly used in a wide variety of roles. Barely a second generation OmniMech, the Jade Falcons introduced the Summoner just after becoming the first Clan to win OmniMech technology from Clan Coyote in 2863. A multi-role configuration of the Summoner, the D configuration is armed with a pair of ER Large Lasers for long range combat. These are backed up by a pair of ER Medium Lasers for short range combat. All of these lasers are linked to an advanced Targeting Computer making the 'Mech highly accurate. For anti-infantry combat, the 'Mech has a pair of Machine Guns. A pair of Anti-Missile Systems give the 'Mech protection from missile carrying 'Mechs and vehicles. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 召唤者是高度机动的重型全向机甲，常用于各类角色。它勉强算第二代全向机甲——2863年玉猫部族从郊狼部族手中赢得全向机甲技术、成为首个掌握该技术的部族后不久，便推出了召唤者。作为召唤者的多用途配置，D配置装有两门增程大型激光用于远程作战，辅以两门增程中型激光用于近战。这些激光全部联动一台先进瞄准计算机，使该机甲精度极高。反步兵方面，它有两挺机枪；两套反导弹系统则为它提供抵御携带导弹的机甲与车辆的防护。 特性：改进通讯 投放费用倍率：1.11 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Summoner is a highly mobile heavy OmniMech that is commonly used in a wide variety of roles. Barely a second generation OmniMech, the Jade Falcons introduced the Summoner just after becoming the first Clan to win OmniMech technology from Clan Coyote in 2863. Configured to take advantage of the new Advanced Tactical Missile system, the Summoner E carries an ER PPC for long range sniping capabilities. This is backed up by an ATM-6 launcher and an ATM-12 launcher which are both capable of firing a variety of specialized missiles that are configured for long, medium, and short range combat making this configuration deadly at any range. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 召唤者是一款高度机动的重型全向机甲，常用于各种不同的作战角色。它勉强算是第二代全向机甲——翡翠猎鹰部族在 2863 年成为第一个从郊狼部族手中赢得全向机甲技术的部族后不久，便推出了召唤者。为发挥新型先进战术导弹系统的优势，召唤者 E 装备一门 增程粒子炮，具备远程狙击能力。其火力还得到一部 ATM-6 发射器和一部 ATM-12 发射器的支持，两者都能发射多种专用导弹，可针对远程、中程和近程作战进行配置，使这一配置在任何距离上都极具致命威胁。 特性：改进通讯 投放费用倍率：1.11 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The E2 configuration combines three Large Pulse Lasers with a specialized targeting computer for optimal performance. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: E2配置把三门大型脉冲激光与一台专用瞄准计算机结合，以获得最佳性能。 特性：改进通讯 投放费用倍率：1.11 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Summoner is a highly mobile heavy OmniMech that is commonly used in a wide variety of roles. Barely a second generation OmniMech, the Jade Falcons introduced the Summoner just after becoming the first Clan to win OmniMech technology from Clan Coyote in 2863. The F version of the Summoner carries an Ultra AC/5 and ER Medium Laser in each arm, backed up by a torso mounted LRM-10 and ER Medium Laser. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 召唤者是高度机动的重型全向机甲，常用于各类角色。它勉强算第二代全向机甲——2863年玉猫部族从郊狼部族手中赢得全向机甲技术、成为首个掌握该技术的部族后不久，便推出了召唤者。召唤者的F版本每只手臂装一门超级AC/5和一门增程中型激光，辅以躯干一具LRM-10和一门增程中型激光。 特性：改进通讯 投放费用倍率：1.11 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This loadout combines a single Large Pulser Laser with four Medium Pulse Lasers for a decent punch. An ER Small Laser and a Streak SRM-6 serve as secondary damage dealers. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 此载荷把一门大型脉冲激光与四门中型脉冲激光组合，形成不错的打击力，另以一门增程小型激光和一具连发SRM-6作为次要伤害来源。 特性：改进通讯 投放费用倍率：1.11 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The F3 loadout is similar to the F2, but replaces two of the Medium Pulse Lasers with another Large, and the Streak SRM and Small Laser with a LRM-15. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: F3挂载与F2相似，但把其中两门中型脉冲激光换成另一门大型激光，并把连发SRM和小型激光换成一具LRM-15。 特性：改进通讯 投放费用倍率：1.11 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Summoner G2 is configuration centered around its massive LBX AC/20. A single LRM-10 and three ER Medium Lasers finish up the weapons layout. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Summoner G2是一种以其庞大LBX AC/20为核心的配置。一具LRM-10和三门增程中型激光构成了其余的武器布局。 特性：改进通讯 投放费用倍率：1.11 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Summoner is a highly mobile heavy OmniMech that is commonly used in a wide variety of roles. Barely a second generation OmniMech, the Jade Falcons introduced the Summoner just after becoming the first Clan to win OmniMech technology from Clan Coyote in 2863. Similar in concept to the D configuration, the Summoner H carries two Heavy Large Lasers as its primary weapons for incredibly powerful hitting power backed up by two ER Medium Lasers. These are all linked to an advanced Targeting Computer for greater accuracy. This configuration also carries a single Anti-Missile system for increased protection. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Summoner是一型机动性极强、用途广泛的部族重型全向机甲。它勉强算得上是第二代全向机甲；Jade Falcons在2863年从Coyote部族手中赢得全向机甲技术、成为首个掌握该技术的部族后不久，便推出了Summoner。Summoner H在理念上与D构型相似，以两门重型大型激光为主武器，打击威力惊人，另有两门增程中型激光作为补充。这些武器全都连接着一具先进的瞄准计算机以提高精度。这一构型还装有一具反导系统以增强防护。 特性：改进通讯 投放费用倍率：1.11 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The H2 is a full laser configuration, mounting two ER PPC and three Medium Pulse Lasers in its arms, and a single ER Small Laser in the center torso. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: H2 是全激光配置，双臂装有两门增程粒子炮和三门中型脉冲激光，中央躯干内则装有一门增程小型激光。 特性：改进通讯 投放费用倍率：1.11 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Summoner I brings four Medium Pulse Lasers in each arm, a SRM-6 in the right torso and two ER Small Lasers split between the center torso and head. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Summoner I 在每条手臂各配备四门中型脉冲激光，右躯干装有一具 SRM-6，另有两门小型增程激光分别布置在中央躯干和头部。 特性：改进通讯 投放费用倍率：1.11 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The only difference of the H2 and J2 layouts are the different positioning of the heat sinks, as the J2 move them to the arms for better balance during jumps. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: H2与J2配置唯一的区别在于散热器的布置位置不同：J2把它们移到手臂上，以便在跳跃时获得更好的平衡。 <特性：改进通讯 <投放费用倍率：1.11 <手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Summoner Lienet is the prized 'Mech of the Lienet bloodline, one of the legacies of Clan Blood Spirit. It mounts three Large, two Medium and one Small ER Laser, all linked together through an advanced targeting computer in the right torso. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.13 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 召唤者利耶内特是利耶内特血系的珍爱机甲，也是血灵部族的遗产之一。它装三门大型、两门中型和一门小型增程激光，全部通过右躯干的一台先进瞄准计算机联动。 特性：改进通讯 投放费用倍率：1.13 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Summoner is a highly mobile heavy OmniMech that is commonly used in a wide variety of roles. Barely a second generation OmniMech, the Jade Falcons introduced the Summoner just after becoming the first Clan to win OmniMech technology from Clan Coyote in 2863. The preferred configuration of Jade Falcon Star Colonel Nicolai Malthus, the M configuration is similar to the primary configuration in that it has an ER PPC as its primary weapon backed up by an LB 10-X Autocannon. Where it deviates is that for close combat the M configuration of the Summoner has a Streak SRM-6 and an ER Small Laser as secondary weapons in place of the standard LRM15 system. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 召唤者是一款高度机动的重型全向机甲，常被用于各种不同的角色。它几乎算不上第二代全向机甲：2863年，翡翠猎鹰部族从郊狼部族手中赢得全向机甲技术，成为首个掌握该技术的部族，随后便推出了召唤者。M配置是翡翠猎鹰部族星上校尼古拉·马尔萨斯的爱用配置，它与原装配置相似，同样以一门增程粒子炮为主武器，辅以一门LB 10-X自动炮。不同之处在于，召唤者的M配置用一具连发SRM-6和一具增程小型激光取代了标准的LRM15系统，用于近距离近战。 特性：改进通讯 投放费用倍率：1.11 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The MC/A loadout was created as part of the 'Master Creation' project, an attempt to have the best warriors create their ideal configurations. The MC/A combines a massive Ultra AC/20 with two Large and one Medium Pulse laser as well as a Streak SRM-4. To fit all the weapons the Jump Jets have been dropped. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: MC/A载荷是“大师之作”项目的产物，该项目试图让最优秀的战士打造他们理想的配置。MC/A把一门庞大的超级AC/20与两门大型脉冲激光和一门中型脉冲激光以及一具连发SRM-4组合起来。为装下全部武器，跳跃推进器被拆除。 特性：改进通讯 投放费用倍率：1.11 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The MC/J loadout was created as part of the 'Master Creation' project, an attempt to have the best warriors create their ideal configurations. The MC/J combines a large Ultra AC/10 with two Large and one Small Pulse laser, as well as a Streak SRM-4. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: MC/J 配置是“大师创作”（Master Creation）计划的产物，该计划试图让最优秀的战士打造他们理想中的配置。MC/J 将一门大型 Ultra AC/10 与两门大型脉冲激光、一门小型脉冲激光以及一具连发 SRM-4 结合在一起。 特性：改进通讯 投放费用倍率：1.11 手臂驱动器限制：全向机甲

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The MC/W loadout was created as part of the 'Master Creation' project, an attempt to have the best warriors create their ideal configurations. The MC/W combines a massive Ultra AC/20 with two Ultra AC/5, a Medium Pulse laser, as well as a Streak SRM-4. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: MC/W 配置是“大师创作”计划的一部分，该计划旨在让最优秀的战士打造他们心目中的理想配置。MC/W 将一门巨大的 Ultra AC/20 与两门 Ultra AC/5、一门中型脉冲激光以及一具连发 SRM-4 结合在一起。 特性：改进通讯 投放费用倍率：1.11 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Summoner is a highly mobile heavy OmniMech that is commonly used in a wide variety of roles. Barely a second generation OmniMech, the Jade Falcons introduced the Summoner just after becoming the first Clan to win OmniMech technology from Clan Coyote in 2863. The custom configuration of Marthe Pryde used during her Trial of Position with Clan Jade Falcon in 3030, the MT features an ER PPC and LBX10 in the right and left arms as primary weapons. Backing these up are a Streak SRM6 in the Left Torso and an ER Medium Laser in the Center Torso. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.13 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Summoner 是一款机动性极强的重型全向机甲，常用于执行各种不同任务。它勉强算第二代全向机甲——2863 年，翡翠猎鹰成为首个从郊狼部族赢得全向机甲技术的部族，随后便推出了 Summoner。MT 是玛莎·普莱德在 3030 年与翡翠猎鹰部族进行职位试炼时所使用的定制配置，以右臂的增程粒子炮和左臂的 LBX10 为主力武器。其辅助火力包括左躯干的一部连发 SRM6 和中央躯干的一门增程中型激光。 特性：改进通讯 投放费用倍率：1.13 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The O configuration combines two ER PPC with a LRM-20. A Medium Pulse Laser and ER Small Laser act as backup. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: O配置把2门增程粒子炮与1具LRM-20组合在一起，并由1门中型脉冲激光和1门增程小型激光充当备用火力。 <特性：改进通讯 <投放费用倍率：1.11 <手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The P/1 is one of three trial configurations centered around the use of an LBX AC/10. Besides the LBX, the configuration also carries a Large Pulse Laser and a LRM-15. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: P/1是三种以使用LBX AC/10为核心的试验配置之一。除LBX外，该配置还带一门大型脉冲激光和一具LRM-15。 特性：改进通讯 投放费用倍率：1.11 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The P/1 is one of three trial configurations centered around the use of an LBX AC/10. Besides the LBX, the configuration also carries an ER PPC, two lasers and a Streak SRM-6. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: P/1 是三种以 LBX AC/10 为核心的试验配置之一。除 LBX 之外，该配置还搭载了一门增程粒子炮、两门激光和一部连发 SRM-6。 特性：改进通讯 投放费用倍率：1.11 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The P/3 is one of three trial configurations centered around the use of an LBX AC/10. Besides the LBX, the configuration also carries a LRM-20, a Streak SRM-6 and one ER Small Laser. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: P/3是三种以使用LBX AC/10为核心的试验配置之一。除LBX外，该配置还带一具LRM-20、一具连发SRM-6和一门增程小型激光。 特性：改进通讯 投放费用倍率：1.11 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Summoner is a highly mobile heavy OmniMech that is commonly used in a wide variety of roles. Barely a second generation OmniMech, the Jade Falcons introduced the Summoner just after becoming the first Clan to win OmniMech technology from Clan Coyote in 2863. A customized variant of the Summoner supposedly piloted by Jade Falcon Star Colonel Aidan Pryde, the Pryde uses an Ultra Autocannon/10 in its left arm, supported by a Ultra Autocannon/5 in the right arm, each with one ton of ammo. The left torso carries an ER small Laser with two Clan Anti Missile Systems and a ton of AMS ammo. A single ER Medium Laser in the right torso rounds out the loadout. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.13 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Summoner 是一种机动性极强的重型全向机甲，常用于各类不同的任务。它勉强算得上是第二代全向机甲——2863 年，翡翠猎鹰成为第一个从郊狼部族手中赢得全向机甲技术的部族，随即推出了 Summoner。这台定制变型据称由翡翠猎鹰星际上校艾丹·普莱德驾驶；Pryde 的左臂装有一门 Ultra 自动炮/10，右臂有一门 Ultra 自动炮/5 作为支援，两者各配一吨弹药。左躯干装有一门增程小型激光、两套部族反导弹系统以及一吨 AMS 弹药。右躯干的一门增程中型激光完善了整套配置。 特性：改进通讯 投放费用倍率：1.13 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A vicious infighter, this configuration carries six ER Medium Lasers in each arm. Eleven pod-mounted double heat sinks are added to the torsos (bringing the total to twenty-three) to deal with the heat. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这一配置是凶悍的近身缠斗者，每条手臂各装有六门增程中型激光。躯干内加装了十一台荚舱式双散热器（总数达到二十三台）以应对热量。 特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1.04 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The B configuration is a long range fire support specialist. Each arm carries an ER Large Laser supported by an ER Medium Laser. Each side torso carries an LRM-20 with one ton of ammunition. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: B配置是远程火力支援专家。每条手臂各携带一门增程大型激光，辅以一门增程中型激光。左右躯干各装有一具LRM-20，备弹一吨。 特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1.04 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The primary configuration of the Sun Bear uses a massive Ultra AC/20 to quickly destroy threats. Three tons of ammunition are carried in a CASE protected bay. Each arm carries an ER Medium Laser and a Medium Pulse Laser. Protection comes from ten and a half tons of standard plate armor. Two more pod mounted heat sinks take the total to fourteen. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 太阳熊的主配置用一门庞大的超级AC/20迅速摧毁威胁，三吨弹药存放在CASE防护弹药舱中。每只手臂各带一门增程中型激光和一门中型脉冲激光。防护来自十吨半标准板式装甲。另有两个挂载式散热器使总数达到十四个。 特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1.04 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Ambush mounts an Ultra AC/10 in each arm and a pair of ER Medium lasers in each side torso. Four tons of ammunition feed the cannons, and a total of 15 double-heatsinks cool the machine. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.13 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 伏击每只手臂装一门超级AC/10，两侧躯干各装两门增程中型激光。四吨弹药为自动炮供弹，总共15个双散热器为这台机器降温。 特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：1.13 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The custom config of Star Colonel Tabok of the Fourth Scorpion Cuirassiers, the 'Manul' Hero 'Mech is a ranged energy boat with an ER PPC and ER Large Laser in each arm. Its only other weapon is an ER Small Laser in the left torso. 'Manul' is fitted with AMS and single ton of reloads, the remaining weight devoted to nine extra double heat sinks. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.13 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是第四蝎子胸甲骑兵团星上校塔博克的定制配置，“Manul”英雄机甲是一具远程能量平台，每条手臂各装有一门增程粒子炮和一门大型增程激光。它唯一的其他武器是左躯干中的一门小型增程激光。“Manul”装有 AMS 及一吨备弹，剩余重量全部用于九具额外的双散热器。 特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：1.13 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A Draconis Combine developed Omni mech, the Sunder is based on reverse engineered Loki and Thor Omnimechs. A 360-rated XL Engine allows the omnimech to carry 15 DHS along with 16.5 tons of armor and 36 tons of weapons. The Sunder SD1-O is armed with an AC/20 and a pair of Large Lasers. 2 Medium Lasers and a trio of SRM-4’s act as secondary weapons. Quirk: Extended Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为龙脉联合体研发的全向机甲，Sunder以逆向工程仿制的Loki与Thor全向机甲为基础。额定360的XL引擎让这台全向机甲能够携带15台双散热器，外加16.5吨装甲和36吨武器。Sunder SD1-O装备一门AC/20和两门大型激光，2门中型激光与三具SRM-4则充当副武器。 特性：扩展躯干旋转 投放费用倍率：1.11 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A Draconis Combine developed Omni mech, the Sunder is based on reverse engineered Loki and Thor Omnimechs. A 360-rated XL Engine allows the omnimech to carry 15 DHS along with 16.5 tons of armor and 36 tons of weapons. The Sunder SD1-OA is armed with a Gauss Rifle and an ER PPC. 2 Medium Pulse Lasers and a trio of LRM-5’s act as secondary weapons. Quirk: Extended Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 撕裂者是龙脉联合体研制的全向机甲，以逆向工程的洛基与托尔全向机甲为基础。360级XL引擎让这款全向机甲能够携带15具双散热器、16.5吨装甲和36吨武器。撕裂者SD1-OA装备一支高斯步枪和一具增程粒子炮，两具中型脉冲激光与三具LRM-5则作为次要武器。 特性：扩展躯干旋转 投放费用倍率：1.11 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A Draconis Combine developed Omni mech, the Sunder is based on reverse engineered Loki and Thor Omnimechs. A 360-rated XL Engine allows the omnimech to carry 15 DHS along with 16.5 tons of armor and 36 tons of weapons. The Sunder SD1-OB is armed with an LRM-20 and an LRM-10. 4 Medium Pulse Lasers and an LRM-5 act as secondary weapons, while a C3 Master Computer allows the mech to act as a Command Mech. Quirk: Extended Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 雷霆（Sunder）是龙脉联合体研发的全向机甲，基于对洛基（Loki）和托尔（Thor）全向机甲的反向工程。额定 360 的 XL 引擎使这台全向机甲可以携带 15 台 DHS、16.5 吨装甲以及 36 吨武器。SD1-OB 型雷霆装备一具 LRM-20 和一具 LRM-10，并以 4 门中型脉冲激光和一具 LRM-5 作为次要武器，而一台 C3 主控计算机则让该机甲能够充当指挥机甲。 特性：扩展躯干旋转 投放费用倍率：1.11 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A Draconis Combine developed Omni mech, the Sunder is based on reverse engineered Loki and Thor Omnimechs. A 360-rated XL Engine allows the omnimech to carry 15 DHS along with 16.5 tons of armor and 36 tons of weapons. The Sunder SD1-OC is armed with an MRM-40 and an MRM-30. A Medium Laser and paired Streak-4’s act as secondary weapons. Quirk: Extended Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 雷霆是龙脉联合体研制的全向机甲，以逆向仿制的洛基与托尔全向机甲为基础。一台360额定XL引擎让这款全向机甲得以携带15个双散热器、16.5吨装甲和36吨武器。雷霆SD1-OC装有一具MRM-40和一具MRM-30，一门中型激光和成对的连发-4作为次要武器。 特性：扩展躯干旋转 投放费用倍率：1.11 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A Draconis Combine developed Omni mech, the Sunder is based on reverse engineered Loki and Thor Omnimechs. A 360-rated XL Engine allows the omnimech to carry 15 DHS along with 16.5 tons of armor and 36 tons of weapons. The Sunder SD1-OR is armed with a Clan LB-10X and a pair of Clan Large Pulse Lasers. 4 Clan ER Medium Lasers and paired Clan Streak-6’s act as secondary weapons. Quirk: Extended Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 雷霆是龙脉联合体研制的全向机甲，以逆向仿制的洛基与托尔全向机甲为基础。一台360额定XL引擎让这款全向机甲得以携带15个双散热器、16.5吨装甲和36吨武器。雷霆SD1-OR装有一门部族LB-10X和一对部族大型脉冲激光，4门部族增程中型激光和成对的部族连发-6作为次要武器。 特性：扩展躯干旋转 投放费用倍率：1.11 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The GRF-2N-X Super Griffin is an evolution of the classic Griffin, a re-design that essentially produced a new BattleMech with even a different tonnage. Using a sixty ton frame, engineers fitted Prototype Improved Jump Jets to the 'Mech to compensate for its reduced speed. Quirk: Aerial Assault Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: GRF-2N-X超级狮鹫是经典狮鹫的进化型，这次重新设计实质上造就了一台全新的战斗机甲，连吨位都截然不同。工程师们采用六十吨的底盘，为这台机甲装上了原型改进型跳跃推进器，以弥补其速度上的损失。 特性：空中突击 投放费用倍率：1.1

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The WSP-2A-X Super Wasp is an evolution of the classic Wasp, a re-design that essentially produced a new BattleMech with even a different tonnage. Weighing as much as a Commando, the Super Wasp maintained the basic ground speed and jump capability of its inspiration, but also added an engine Supercharger which allowed it to sprint at speeds of up to 120 km/h. Quirk: Aerial Assault Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.96
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: WSP-2A-X超级黄蜂是经典黄蜂的演化体，一次实质上是造出全新机甲、连吨位都不同的重新设计。超级黄蜂重量与突击兵相当，保持了原型的基本地面速度与跳跃能力，但还加装了引擎增压器，使其能以高达120公里/小时的速度疾驰。 特性：空中突击 投放费用倍率：0.96

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Supernova 1's only armaments are six Clan ER Large Lasers. While this is a fair amount of firepower for a 'Mech of its size, it has a severe overheating problem. After firing no more than three full, consecutive salvos, the Supernova will force an automatic shutdown, so MechWarriors must carefully manage their heat. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Long Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.2 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 超新星1仅有的武器是六门部族增程大型激光。虽然对同尺寸机甲而言火力相当可观，但它有严重的过热问题：连续全力齐射不超过三轮，超新星就会强制自动停机，因此机甲战士必须小心管理热量。 特性：改进瞄准 - 远程 投放费用倍率：1.2 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: While feared by the Inner Sphere, the Supernova design was born out of necessity in an attempt to address ammunition shortages by changing the original King Crab design to an all-energy loadout. The Boiler is a customized Supernova variant that seeks to re-engineer the Supernova back to the original King Crab loadout using Clan technology, essentially making the Boiler a 'King Crab IIC'. It mounts an Ultra AC/20 in each arm supported by a Large Pulse Laser in the right torso and an LRM-15 rack in the left. As it was built upon the frame of the standard Supernova, it retains the jump jets but mounts only seventeen double heat sinks. Like its progenitor, the Boiler lacks field endurance, carrying only two tons of Ultra Autocannon rounds and one ton of LRM reloads. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Long Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.22 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 超新星的设计虽令内层星域忌惮，却源于无奈：为应对弹药短缺，它把原本的帝王蟹设计改为全能量配置。锅炉是一台定制的超新星变型，试图用部族技术把超新星改回原版帝王蟹的配置，实质上让它成为一台"帝王蟹IIC"。它每只手臂各装一门超级自动炮AC/20，右躯干有一具大型脉冲激光支援，左躯干则装有一具LRM-15发射架。由于以标准超新星的机架为基础，它保留了跳跃推进器，但只装有十七具双散热器。与其前身一样，锅炉缺乏战场续航能力，仅携带两吨超级自动炮弹和一吨LRM备弹。 特性：改进瞄准（远程） 投放费用倍率：1.22 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Swordsman was an early Federated Suns medium-class BattleMech which was originally built in 2463 as House Davion's third in-house BattleMech design. The design was tainted by heavy use in the Davion Civil War of 2525-2540. Eventually, production ended and the design was relegated to the dustbin of history. However, in the 3060s, the mech was put back into production by House Davion to supplement their forces in the FedCom Civil War. The SWD-2 is the stock production design, mounting heavy armor and firepower for the tonnage: 7.5 tons of armor and a grab-bag mix of guns including an AC/5, LRM-5, SRM-4, two Medium Lasers, and a Small Laser. Quirk: Integrated Searchlight Drop Cost Multiplier: 1
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 剑士是联邦太阳国早期的一款中型机甲，最初于2463年制造，是戴维恩家族第三款自研机甲设计。该设计因在2525-2540年的戴维恩内战中大量使用而蒙上污名。最终生产终止，设计被弃入历史的垃圾堆。然而在3060年代，戴维恩家族为补充联邦共和内战中的兵力，将其重新投入生产。SWD-2是标准量产型号，在同吨位下配备了厚重的装甲与火力：7.5吨装甲，以及一支拼凑而成的混合武器组合，包括一门AC/5、一具LRM-5、一具SRM-4、两门中型激光和一门小型激光。 特性：内置探照灯 投放费用倍率：1

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Swordsman was an early Federated Suns medium-class BattleMech which was originally built in 2463 as House Davion's third in-house BattleMech design. The design was tainted by heavy use in the Davion Civil War of 2525-2540. Eventually, production ended and the design was relegated to the dustbin of history. However, in the 3060s, the mech was put back into production by House Davion to supplement their forces in the FedCom Civil War. The SWD-2 is the stock production design, mounting heavy armor and firepower for the tonnage: 7.5 tons of armor and a grab-bag mix of guns including an AC/5, LRM-5, SRM-4, two Medium Lasers, and a Small Laser. Quirk: Integrated Searchlight Drop Cost Multiplier: 1
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 剑士是联邦太阳国早期的一款中型机甲，最初于2463年制造，是戴维恩家族第三款自研机甲设计。该设计因在2525-2540年的戴维恩内战中大量使用而蒙上污名。最终生产终止，设计被弃入历史的垃圾堆。然而在3060年代，戴维恩家族为补充联邦共和内战中的兵力，将其重新投入生产。SWD-2是标准量产型号，在同吨位下配备了厚重的装甲与火力：7.5吨装甲，以及一支拼凑而成的混合武器组合，包括一门AC/5、一具LRM-5、一具SRM-4、两门中型激光和一门小型激光。 特性：内置探照灯 投放费用倍率：1

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Sylph was created by Clan Cloud Cobra to augment their vast aerospace forces with a fully-airborne battle armor suit. Naming it after elemental spirits representing air, development of the suit was driven as much by the Cloud Cobra's faith as it was by Khan Din Steiner's orders. Despite their scientist caste's vast knowledge of aircraft, the Clan had a great deal of trouble getting the VTOL capabilities of the Sylph to function, with a number of test pilots dying during its secretive development. As it is, the Sylph only possesses limited flight capabilities, but even this remains an impressive accomplishment. Quirk: Nimble Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.9475 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 风精由云眼镜蛇部族创造，旨在用一套可完全空中机动的战斗装甲来增强其庞大的航空航天部队。它以代表空气的元素精灵命名，这套装甲的研发既出于云眼镜蛇的信仰，也出于可汗 Din Steiner 的命令。尽管其科学家种姓对飞行器有着渊博的知识，该部族在让风精的垂直起降功能正常运作方面却遇到了极大困难，在其秘密研发过程中有多名试飞员丧生。就实际效果而言，风精仅具备有限的飞行能力，但即便如此仍是一项令人瞩目的成就。 特性：灵活 投放费用倍率：0.9475 可搭载全向单位，可近战，可蜂拥。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Tai-sho concentrates on keeping an enemy at long range and using targeting data from friendly units to enhance its long range capabilities. The primary weapons it carries are a pair of ER PPCs capable of keeping an adversary at arms reach. These are backed up by an Ultra Autocannon/10 which can fire at twice the rate of a standard autocannon. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 大将着重把敌人挡在远处，并利用友军单位的瞄准数据增强自身远程能力。它的主要武器是一对能把对手挡在一臂之外的增程粒子炮，辅以一门能以标准自动炮两倍射速射击的超级自动炮/10。 特性：改进通讯 投放费用倍率：1.15 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 3L has a lackluster range of weapons compared to the other variants of the Talon; three Medium Lasers and one Small Laser. The 'Mech is instead focused more on the scouting role, with a Beagle Active Probe and an Angel ECM suite. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 与 Talon 的其他变型机相比，3L 的武器射程表现平平：三门中型激光和一门小型激光。该机甲反而更侧重于侦察角色，配备一具 Beagle 主动探测器和一套 Angel 电子对抗套件。 特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：0.98

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A Star League era mech, the Talon debuted in 2670 as a light fire support mech. Rendered extinct by the destruction of the Succession Wars, it re-entered production in 3056, though the Clans retain a number of SLDF models from the Exodus. Built around a 280 XL Engine, the Talon TLN-5V is armed with a PPC and a pair of Medium Lasers. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Talon 是星际联盟时代的机甲，于 2670 年作为轻型火力支援机甲首次亮相。继承战争的破坏曾使它一度绝迹，直到 3056 年才重新投产，不过部族仍保留着若干随大逃亡带出的星际联盟防御部队型号。Talon TLN-5V 围绕一台 280 XL 引擎建造，装备一门粒子炮和两门中型激光。 特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1.05 手臂驱动器限制：左上臂、右上臂

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 5VNO is a downgraded Succession Wars era version using a standard 210 engine, reducing its ground speed down to a maximum of 90 km/h with seven and a half tons of standard armor. It has a single PPC in the right arm for ranged combat, backed up pair of medium lasers in the left arm. This design has no lower arm actuators allowing it to flip its weapons into the rear arc. A few units have been reported fielded by pirates. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 5VNO 是继承战争时期的降级版本，使用标准 210 引擎，地面最高速度降至 90 km/h，装甲为七吨半标准装甲。它在右臂装有一门粒子炮用于远距离作战，左臂则有两门中型激光作为补充。这一设计没有下臂驱动器，因此可以把武器翻转朝后方射击。据报道，有少量此型机甲被海盗投入使用。 特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：0.98 手臂驱动器限制：左上臂、右上臂

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A Star League era mech, the Talon debuted in 2670 as a light fire support mech. Rendered extinct by the destruction of the Succession Wars, it re-entered production in 3056, though the Clans retain a number of SLDF models from the Exodus. Built around a 280 XL Engine, the Talon TLN-5W is armed with an ER PPC and a pair of Medium Lasers. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为星际联盟时期的机甲，利爪于2670年作为轻型火力支援机甲首次亮相。继承战争的破坏使它灭绝，直到3056年才重新投产，不过部族仍保有一些来自大逃亡的SLDF型号。它围绕一台280 XL引擎建造，利爪TLN-5W装有一门增程粒子炮和两门中型激光。 特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1.05 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A Star League era mech, the Talon debuted in 2670 as a light fire support mech. Rendered extinct by the destruction of the Succession Wars, it re-entered production in 3056, though the Clans retain a number of SLDF models from the Exodus. Built around a 280 XL Engine, the Talon TLN-5W-EC was an early Clan upgrade from the dawn of the Golden Century. The Talon 5W-EC is armed with an Enhanced ER PPC and a pair of Medium Lasers. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为星际联盟时期的机甲，利爪于2670年作为轻型火力支援机甲首次亮相。继承战争的破坏使它灭绝，直到3056年才重新投产，不过部族仍保有一些来自大逃亡的SLDF型号。它围绕一台280 XL引擎建造，利爪TLN-5W-EC是黄金世纪之初部族的早期升级型。利爪5W-EC装有一门增强型增程粒子炮和两门中型激光。 特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：0.98 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The original variant of the Tarantula is armored with four and a half tons of armor, while it only carries about three quarters of the theoretical maximum armor, the 'Mech's amazing speed makes the Tarantula capable of avoiding most damage. As the design is focused on scouting, the Tarantula carries a light armament that is common to a 'Mech of its size and role. The primary weapons are a pair of medium lasers which give the Tarantula most of its striking power. These are backed up by a Streak SRM-2 launcher, which allows the Tarantula to find any weak spots in an enemy's armor. Quirk: Easy to Pilot Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Tarantula 的原始变型披挂四点五吨装甲；虽然这只占其理论上限装甲量的约四分之三，但该机甲惊人的速度使其能够规避大部分伤害。由于该设计侧重侦察，Tarantula 的武装较为轻便，这对于同体量、同定位的机甲而言十分常见。主武器是两具中型激光，构成了 Tarantula 的主要打击力，另有一具连发 SRM-2 发射器为其提供支援，让 Tarantula 能够找出敌方装甲上的任何薄弱点。 特性：易于驾驶 投放费用倍率：0.98

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 2A variant is a simple upgrade of the Tarantula that brings the 'Mechs weapons up to current standards. This is done by replacing the two medium lasers with a pair of ER medium lasers. Quirk: Easy to Pilot Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 2A 变型是对 Tarantula 的简单升级，让该机甲的武器达到当代标准，具体做法是将两具中型激光替换为两具增程中型激光。 特性：易于驾驶 投放费用倍率：0.98

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 2C is a mercenary rebuild of the Tarantula using mainly Clan Tech. Originally introduced by the Kell Hounds, but has since seen use with other mercenary outfits as well. Quirk: Easy to Pilot Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 2C是雇佣兵主要基于部族技术对狼蛛的改造型，最初由凯尔猎犬引入，此后也为其他雇佣兵部队所用。 特性：易于驾驶 投放费用倍率：1.04

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The TMP-2X is the original prototype version of the Tempest, before the design was finalized as TMP-3M became the first mass produced variant. The -2X is quite the bit more basic than the later -3M; its only weapons are two PPC, it doesn't have the XL engine or Endo Steel chassis of the -3M and still uses single heat sinks. Quirk: Breaching Shot Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.07 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: TMP-2X 是 Tempest 最初的原型版本，后来设计定型为 TMP-3M，成为首个量产的改型。-2X 比后来的 -3M 基础得多：它的武器只有两门粒子炮，没有 -3M 的 XL引擎和内骨架底盘，使用的仍是单散热器。 特性：破甲射击 投放费用倍率：1.07 手臂驱动器限制：左下臂、右下臂

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The TMP-3G is very similar to the -3M in its configuration. In fact the only change is the replacing of the SRM-6 with an SRM-4 to fit one more box of Gauss Rifle ammunition. Quirk: Breaching Shot Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: TMP-3G的配置与-3M极为相似。事实上唯一的改动就是将SRM-6换成SRM-4，以便多容纳一箱高斯步枪弹药。 特性：穿透射击 投放费用倍率：1.09 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: For long range firepower, the Tempest TMP-3M carries a Gauss rifle, which provides a devastating long-range punch. For medium to long ranges, the 'Mech has a Large Pulse Laser. When the 'Mech closes to short ranges, it brings its three medium lasers and its SRM-6 to bear on an enemy. To make the most of the Tempest's available weight, the 'Mech is built on a Endo Steel chassis and is propelled to its top speed of 64.8 km/h by a 260 XL engine. The 'Mech's mobility has also been enhanced with four jump jets that make the Tempest capable of jumping up to one hundred and twenty meters. Finally, the Tempest carries twelve tons of armor which is a respectable amount of protection for a 65 ton 'Mech. Quirk: Breaching Shot Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Tempest TMP-3M 为远程火力搭载了一门高斯步枪，能够打出毁灭性的远程重击。在中远距离上，该机甲配备一门大型脉冲激光。当逼近至近距离时，它会用三门中型激光与 SRM-6 向敌人倾泻火力。为充分利用 Tempest 的可用吨位，该机甲采用内骨架底盘建造，并由 260 XL引擎推进至 64.8 km/h 的最高速度。其机动性还通过四个跳跃推进器得到增强，使 Tempest 能够跳跃最远一百二十米。最后，Tempest 携带十二吨装甲，对一台 65 吨机甲而言是相当可观的防护。 特性：破甲射击 投放费用倍率：1.09 手臂驱动器限制：左臂下部、右臂下部

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The -3MA variant removes the Gauss rifle and replaces it with an AC/10, two tons of ammunition, and an extra Heat Sink. Quirk: Breaching Shot Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: -3MA变型拆掉高斯步枪，换成一门AC/10、两吨弹药和一个额外散热器。 特性：破甲射击 投放费用倍率：1.09 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Using an all energy loadout, the Tempest 1 uses an ER PPC and Large Pulse Laser as the main damage dealers, with four Medium Pulse Lasers as an extra punch. Seven ER Small lasers provide anti-infantry defense at closer ranges. Although the Tempest mounts 16 double heat sinks, this is far from enough to handle the total heat build-up from all the energy weapons, so it is recommended only experienced MechWarriors who know how to manage heat properly pilots the 'Mech. Quirk: Accurate Weapon - Laser Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.21
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 暴风1型采用全能量配置，以一门增程粒子炮和一门大型脉冲激光作为主要输出，另有四门中型脉冲激光提供额外打击力。七门增程小型激光负责在较近距离提供反步兵防御。尽管暴风搭载了16个双散热器，仍远远不足以应对全部能量武器产生的热量累积，因此建议只让懂得正确管理热量的老练机甲战士驾驶这台机甲。 特性：精准武器 - 激光 投放费用倍率：1.21

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Templar CRD-1G mounts a PPC and two machine guns in the right arm, a SRM-6 in the left arm, and two medium lasers and an LRM-15 in the left torso. Both missile launchers have one ton of ammunition, while the machine guns has a half ton. Quirk: Stable Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.07
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Templar CRD-1G 在右臂安装一门粒子炮和两挺机枪，左臂安装一部 SRM-6，左躯干则有两门中型激光和一门 LRM-15。两种导弹发射器各配一吨弹药，机枪则配有半吨。 特性：稳定武器 投放费用倍率：1.07

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The -1R is a large upgrade of the original TMP-1G. It replaces the engine with a 325 XL, switches to double heat sinks and uses an Endo Steel chassis. As for its weapons, the 1R drops the PPC and machine guns of the -1G, replacing them with a second copy of both the SRM-6 and LRM-10 launchers. One more ton of LRM ammunition was also added. Quirk: Stable Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: -1R 是原型 TMP-1G 的大幅升级版。它换装了 325 XL 引擎，改用双散热器，并采用内骨架机体。武器方面，1R 去掉了 -1G 的粒子炮和机枪，取而代之的是 SRM-6 和 LRM-10 发射器各再加一具，同时还增加了一吨 LRM 弹药。 特性：武器稳定 投放费用倍率：1.09 手臂驱动器限制：左臂下部、右臂下部

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Tempest CRD-6T is not a natural evolution of the design of the original Tempests, as it completely replaces all the weapons of the Tempest. In their place a total of twelve Medium Lasers, two flamers and a C3 slave computer were added. This design is in fact a identical to the Crusader CRD-6T, but the designers claim this is just by happenstance. Quirk: Stable Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 暴风CRD-6T并非原版暴风设计的自然演进，因为它把暴风的武器全部换掉，取而代之的是十二具中型激光、两具火焰喷射器和一台C3从属计算机。事实上，该设计与十字军CRD-6T完全相同，但设计者声称这纯属巧合。 特性：稳定武器 投放费用倍率：1.09

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: For long range combat, the TSN-1C carries a single ER PPC capable of hitting enemy units at extreme ranges. For close combat, the 'Mech has a single Medium Pulse Laser with which to defend itself. Additionally, the Tessen has an Improved Narc Missile Beacon, allowing it to designate targets for missile attacks from friendly units and a TAG laser designator allowing the Tessen to spot for Arrow IV artillery missile attacks. The Tessen is built on a lightweight Endo Steel chassis and is powered by a lightweight 300 XL engine, giving the 'Mech a top speed of 97.2 km/h. The Tessen carries an improved C3 computer allowing it to share targeting data with other C3i equipped friendly units. For protection from enemy fire, the Tessen has nine tons of ferro-fibrous armor with CASE to protect against complete destruction in the event of an ammunition explosion. Quirk: Combat Computer Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 远程作战时，TSN-1C带一门增程粒子炮，能在极远距离上打击敌方单位；近战则有一门中型脉冲激光自卫。此外，铁扇装有一具改进型Narc导弹信标，可为友军单位的导弹攻击指示目标；还有一具TAG激光指示器，使其能为箭IV炮射导弹观测。铁扇建在轻量内骨架底盘上，由一台轻量300 XL引擎驱动，最高速度97.2公里/小时。它带一台改进型C3计算机，可与其他装备C3i的友军单位共享瞄准数据。防护方面，铁扇有九吨铁纤维装甲，并以CASE防止弹药爆炸时被彻底摧毁。 特性：战斗计算机 投放费用倍率：1.04 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A small rework of the -4S, the C3 Slave is removed, with all the weapons loadout the same as the C3 version. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是对-4S的小幅改动：拆掉C3从机，武器配置与C3版本完全相同。 特性：稳定 投放费用倍率：1.11 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A small rework of the -4T, the LB 20-X is replaced with an AC/20 fed by 4 tons of ammo, the C3 Slave is removed. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 对 -4T 的一次小改动：LB 20-X 被替换为由 4 吨弹药供弹的 AC/20，C3 从属单元被移除。 特性：稳定 投放费用倍率：1.11 手臂驱动器限制：左下臂、右下臂

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A 300 rated Light Fusion Engine provides improved survivability. The -5P mounts an LB 10-X Autocannon with 2 tons of ammo in the left arm, an ER PPC in the right arm, and 3 LRM-5s split between the left arm and both torsos with 3 tons of ammo feeding them. The ECM and Jump-Jets remain, with 12 Double Heat Sinks dissipating the relatively cool weapons loadout. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 额定 300 的轻型聚变引擎提升了生存能力。-5P 在左臂装有一门 LB 10-X 自动炮和 2 吨弹药，右臂装有一门增程粒子炮，另有 3 具 LRM-5 分置于左臂和两侧躯干，由 3 吨弹药供弹。电子对抗套件和跳跃推进器予以保留，12 台双散热器足以散去这套相对低温的武器配置所产生的热量。 特性：稳定 投放费用倍率：1.11 手臂驱动器限制：左下臂、右下臂

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The -5S' primary weapons are a pair of Light Gauss Rifles with 3 tons of ammo split between the torsos, with two ER medium lasers in the left arm and an LRM-10 with a ton of ammo in the right arm. A 300 rated extra-light allows these weapons to be mounted, along with the ECM and Jump-Jets, and 13 Double Heat Sinks. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: -5S 的主武器是两门轻型高斯步枪，共配 3 吨弹药，分置于两侧躯干；左臂装两门 ER 中型激光，右臂则有一部 LRM-10 及一吨弹药。一台额定 300 的 XL 引擎使这些武器得以搭载，同时还装下了 ECM 与跳跃推进器，以及 13 台双散热器。 特性：稳定 投放费用倍率：1.11 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A dedicated missile boat, the -5T mounts six MRM-10s, two in each arm, and one in each side torso, fed by 10 tons of ammo. This variant is protected by fourteen tons of armor along with Guardian ECM, with a 300 light engine further increasing durability, and four Jump-Jets increase the 'Mech's mobility. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为一台专职的导弹火力平台，-5T 装有六具 MRM-10——每条手臂两具，两侧躯干各一具——由 10 吨弹药供弹。该变型由十四吨装甲和守护者电子对抗套件提供防护，额定 300 的轻型引擎进一步提升了耐用性，四具跳跃推进器则增强了机甲的机动性。 特性：稳定 投放费用倍率：1.11 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: With a Gauss rifle in the right arm and a total of sixteen Machine Guns, the THS-4A has a highly unbalanced damage profile. It can either damage foes at a long distance or a close range, while it struggles to deal with targets at medium ranges. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: THS-4A的右臂装有一具高斯步枪，另外总共配有十六挺机枪，因此其伤害分布极不均衡。它要么能在远距离杀伤敌人，要么能在近距离发挥威力，但面对中距离目标时则颇为吃力。 特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1.05

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The original pre-endo steel model introduced in 2490 carries two Medium Lasers and a LRM-5 launcher, 4 tons of standard grade armor and uses a standard 120-rated fusion core. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.95 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是2490年推出的内骨架之前的原始型号，装两门中型激光和一具LRM-5发射器、4吨标准级装甲，并使用标准120额定聚变核心。 特性：易于维护 投放费用倍率：0.95 手臂驱动器限制：右上

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An early clan Mech dating from the days of Operation Klondike, the Thorn THE-N-EC was an upgrade of the THE-N that replaced the weapons with Early Clan variants. It would be discontinued and forgotten as modern clan spec weapons entered production. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.95 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 荆棘THE-N-EC是可追溯到克朗代克行动时期的部族早期机甲，是对THE-N的升级，以部族早期型号替换了武器。随着现代部族规格武器投产，它被停产并逐渐被遗忘。 特性：易于维护 投放费用倍率：0.95 手臂驱动器限制：左下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The largest gun on the Thresher is its Ultra Autocannon/10. The medium range weapon can dish out a fair amount of damage, but it is not a legitimate long-range threat. At closer ranges, the Thresher can bring a ER Medium Laser and a pair of accurate Medium Pulse Lasers to bear. Two SRM-6 launchers can exploit holes the other weapons make in an enemy's armor. Thirteen double heat sinks keep the 'Mech cool. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Medium Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.12 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 脱粒机上最大的炮是它的超级自动炮/10。这门中程武器能打出相当可观的伤害，却算不上真正的远程威胁。更近的距离上，脱粒机可动用一门增程中型激光和两门精准的中型脉冲激光；两具SRM-6发射器则能利用其他武器在敌方装甲上打出的破口。十三个双散热器让机甲保持凉爽。 特性：改进瞄准 - 中程 投放费用倍率：1.12 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This variant is more respectable at long range. It downgrades the autocannon to an LB-X Autocannon/5. The weight saved is used to upgrade the pulse lasers to ER Large Lasers Quirk: Improved Targeting - Medium Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.12 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该变型在远距离上要体面得多。它将自动炮降级为 LB-X 自动炮/5，节省下来的重量用于把脉冲激光升级为增程大型激光。 特性：改进瞄准 - 中级 投放费用倍率：1.12 手臂驱动器限制：左下臂、右下臂

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The personal 'Mech of Tai-sa Edward Brandon of the Fortieth Dieron Regulars, his captured Thresher has been modified with Inner Sphere technologies. Save for the removal of a heat sink, structurally the 'Mech is unchanged and the torso-mounted weapons remain intact, but all the arm mounted weaponry has been replaced with an Inner Sphere standard ER Medium Laser mounted in each arm in support of an MRM-20 and a single ton of reloads in the right. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Medium Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是第40迪耶隆正规军统帅爱德华·布兰登的私人机甲，他缴获的脱粒机已用内层星域技术改装。除拆掉一个散热器外，机甲结构未变，躯干武器完好无损，但所有臂载武器都被替换为每臂一门内层星域标准增程中型激光，以支援右臂的一具MRM-20和一吨再装填弹药。 特性：改进瞄准 - 中程 投放费用倍率：1.16 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 10E is a downgraded version of the 11E produced by Earthwerks Incorporated following the destruction of Maltex's facilities in 2835. The primary changes come from the loss of the double heat sinks, CASE, and the Endo Steel structure. To compensate for the weight needed for a standard structure, the SRMs have been downgraded from six tube launchers to SRM-4s. In addition, the Thug lost one ton of ammunition. Quirk: Accurate Weapon - Energy Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.12
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 10E是Earthwerks Incorporated在2835年Maltex的设施被毁后生产的11E降级版本。主要变化在于失去了双散热器、CASE和内骨架结构。为弥补采用标准结构所需的重量，SRM已从六管发射器降级为SRM-4。此外，Thug还减少了一吨弹药。 特性：精准武器 - 能量 投放费用倍率：1.12

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Thug was designed by Maltex Corporation as a direct competitor to the popular Warhammer BattleMech. First seeing production in 2572, the Thug sought to directly address some of the challenges which faced the Warhammer, chief of which was to increase armor protection without sacrificing firepower. The Thugs long range striking power comes from a pair of arm mounted PPC’s. Backing up the PPCs are two SRM-6 launchers mounted in either side torso with one ton of CASE-protected reloads. Eighteen double heat sinks comfortably dissipate the enormous heat generated by the PPC’s while an Endo Steel frame allows it to carry fifteen and a half tons of armor. Quirk: Accurate Weapon - Energy Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 暴徒由马尔泰克斯公司设计，用以直接竞争广受欢迎的战争锤战斗机甲。它于2572年首次投产，力图直接解决战争锤所面临的一些难题，其中最主要的一条便是要在不牺牲火力的前提下增强装甲防护。暴徒的远距离打击力来自双臂各安装的一门粒子炮。为粒子炮提供支援的是分别装在两侧躯干的两具SRM-6发射器，各有一个吨位受CASE保护的备用弹药。十八个双散热器能从容散逸粒子炮产生的巨大热量，而内骨架结构则让它能携带十五吨半的装甲。 特性：精准武器 - 能量 投放费用倍率：1.14

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 11E2 was an almost complete overhaul of the original 11E by the Clans using their original stock of Thugs and surplus gear from the Exodus. The only remaining weapon from the original design is one of the SRM-6 launchers. By switching to an XL Engine, the design can now fit two ER Large Lasers, to standard Large Lasers, two Small Lasers and a single Small Pulse Laser - besides the kept SRM-6 launcher. Quirk: Accurate Weapon - Energy Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 11E2是部族利用其原有的恶棍库存和大逃亡剩余装备对原11E进行的近乎彻底翻新。原设计中仅存的武器是其中一具SRM-6发射器。通过改用XL引擎，该设计如今除保留的SRM-6发射器外，还能装下两门增程大型激光、两门标准大型激光、两门小型激光和一门小型脉冲激光。 特性：精准武器 - 能量 投放费用倍率：1.14

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 11Eb is an upgrade of the Thug used by the SLDF Royal Brigades in 2760. It upgrades the PPCs to ER PPCs. Quirk: Accurate Weapon - Energy Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 11Eb 是 2760 年由星际联盟皇家旅使用的暴徒的升级型号。它将粒子炮升级为 增程粒子炮。 特性：精准武器 - 能量 投放费用倍率：1.14

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Piloted by mercenary Jose Magellan during the fall of the Star League, this Thug variant replaces the standard engine with an extralight model. The PPCs are replaced by ER Large Lasers. In the space freed by the XL Engine, Magellan installed three more SRM-6 launchers, for a total of five. The cockpit adds a Command Console to allow a Rim Worlds commander to see the entire battlefield. Four jump jets allow the Thug Jose to cover 120 meters at a time. Finally, a Null Signature System interfered with SLDF targeting systems. Quirk: Accurate Weapon - Energy Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在星际联盟覆灭期间，这台暴徒变型由雇佣兵 Jose Magellan 驾驶，它以超轻型引擎替换了标准引擎。PPC 被增程大型激光取代。Magellan 利用 XL 引擎腾出的空间又加装了三具 SRM-6 发射器，总数达到五具。驾驶舱内加装了一台指挥控制台，让一位边缘世界的指挥官得以纵览整个战场。四个跳跃推进器让这台“暴徒 Jose”一次可移动 120 米。最后，一套虚无签名系统还能干扰 SLDF 的瞄准系统。 特性：精准武器 - 能量 投放费用倍率：1.16 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A custom Thug piloted by ex-Com Guard and Broadsword Legion CO Kari Marita, the THG-11Em swaps the standard PPCs for Clantech ER PPCs, helping to free up weight for a C3i unit. Quirk: Accurate Weapon - Energy Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这台定制的 Thug 由前通讯之星卫队成员、阔剑军团指挥官卡莉·玛丽塔驾驶。THG-11Em 将标准粒子炮换成部族科技增程粒子炮，从而腾出重量安装一套 C3i 单元。 特性：精准武器 - 能量 投放费用倍率：1.14

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The personal 'Mech of Wild Geese member Major Sandy Reich, the ex-Com Guard's Thug has been retrofitted with Clan-spec replacement weaponry, with Clan ER PPCs and Streak SRM-6s fitting neatly into the old locations. Four jump jets are included to increase mobility. Quirk: Accurate Weapon - Energy Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这台暴徒曾是通讯之星卫队的机体，如今是野雁佣兵团成员桑迪·赖希少校的专属机甲。它经过改装，换上了部族规格的替代武器，部族增程粒子炮与连发SRM-6整齐地嵌入原有的安装位置。此外还加装了四台跳跃推进器以提升机动性。 特性：精准武器 - 能量 投放费用倍率：1.16

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The custom variant piloted by ex–Com Guard and Broadsword Legion CO Kari Marita, the standard PPCs have been swapped for Clan ER PPCs, helping to free up weight for a C3i unit. Quirk: Accurate Weapon - Energy Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是前通讯之星卫队成员、Broadsword Legion 指挥官 Kari Marita 驾驶的定制变型，标准粒子炮被换成部族增程粒子炮，从而腾出重量安装一具 C3i 单元。 特性：精准武器 - 能量 投放费用倍率：1.16

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Thunder Griffin was originally piloted by Captain Jack Lightning of the Kell Hounds. Using a lot of high-end tech improved weaponry the 'Mech served him well until he was captured by Clan Wolf together with Phelan Kell at The Rock. His 'Mech eventually was recovered although it had severe battle damage, to somehow eventually end up in pirate hands. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.07
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 雷霆狮鹫最初由凯尔猎犬的杰克·闪电上尉驾驶。凭借大量高端技术升级的武器，该机甲在他被狼部族与费伦·凯尔一同在“岩石”俘获之前一直表现出色。他的机甲最终被寻回，尽管战损严重，后来不知怎么落入了海盗之手。 特性：战拳 投放费用倍率：1.07

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Ideal for working with spotters, the Thunder Stallion mounts four LRM-15 launchers and eight tons of ammunition for them. This gives the 'Mech a significant long-range punch that can be called down from behind cover. Perhaps the largest backup weapon ever is the Thunder Stallion's LB 20-X AC. This massive gun is capable of defending against infantry or blowing holes in all but the most well-armored of opponents. Fourteen double heat sinks keep the 'Mech cooled down. This relatively inexpensive, durable design is protected by a whopping seventeen and a half tons of armor. Quirk: Distracting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.19
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 雷霆骏马非常适合与观察员配合行动，它搭载四具LRM-15发射器，并为它们准备了八个吨位的弹药。这赋予该机甲可观的远程打击力，能够从掩体后方召唤而下。或许是有史以来最大的备用武器，便是雷霆骏马的LB 20-X自动炮。这门巨炮既能抵御步兵，也能在除装甲最厚重者之外的一切对手身上轰出窟窿。十四个双散热器让这台机甲保持冷却。这款相对廉价、耐用的设计由多达十七吨半的装甲保护着。 特性：干扰注意力 投放费用倍率：1.19

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This Thunder Stallion is the personal BattleMech of Galaxy Commander Titus Mitchell, commander of Clan Hell’s Horses Beta Galaxy. While still a support ‘Mech, the Thunder Stallion Mitchell carries a unique loadout when compared to the standard Thunder Stallion, or even the common variant, the Fire Stallion. Mitchell’s ‘Mech carries an LB-X autocannon, much like the standard version, but tones it down to an LB-10X instead of the larger LB-20X. Besides the autocannon, the Thunder Stallion carries energy weapons exclusively. One Large Pulse Laser, a Medium Pulse Laser, and an ER Medium Laser were added to the left torso. On the right torso three more Medium Pulse Lasers are arrayed. Along with his weaponry upgrades, Mitchell also had a clan targeting computer added to his Thunder Stallion. Quirk: Distracting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.21
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这台 Thunder Stallion 是星系指挥官提图斯·米切尔的专属战斗机甲，他是地狱马族贝塔星系的指挥官。虽然 Thunder Stallion 仍是一款支援机甲，但米切尔的座机与标准型 Thunder Stallion、甚至与常见变型机 Fire Stallion 相比，都拥有独一无二的配置。米切尔的机甲与标准型一样装有一门 LB-X 自动炮，但将其降级为 LB-10X，而非更大的 LB-20X。除自动炮外，Thunder Stallion 只使用能量武器。左躯干加装了一门大型脉冲激光、一门中型脉冲激光和一门增程中型激光，右躯干则排列着另外三门中型脉冲激光。除了武器升级，米切尔还为他的 Thunder Stallion 加装了一台部族瞄准计算机。 特性：干扰 投放费用倍率：1.21

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This variant, introduced 2877 (also known as the Fire Stallion), lessens the ammunition dependency of the Thunder Stallion. It replaces the autocannon and its attendant ammunition with a pair of Large Pulse Lasers and two additional double heat sinks to handle the increased heat from the energy weapons. Quirk: Distracting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.19
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 此变型于2877年推出（又称火马），减轻了雷暴骏马对弹药的依赖。它以一对大型脉冲激光取代自动炮及其弹药，并加装两个额外双散热器以应对能量武器增加的热量。 特性：扰敌 投放费用倍率：1.19

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The THR-1L Thunder is the first heavy ’Mech designed and produced by a Capellan manufacturer following the Clan invasion. Powered by a 350 XL Engine, the 70 ton Thunder is armed with an AC/20 supplied with three tons of ammunition. Complementing the autocannon is an LRM-5 located in the left torso, with one ton of ammunition. Three Medium Pulse Lasers back up the autocannon at close range, and the designers installed CASE to protect against ammo detonation. Quirk: Cowl Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: THR-1L 雷霆是部族入侵之后由卡佩兰厂商设计并生产的第一款重型机甲。这台 70 吨的雷霆由一台 350 XL 引擎驱动，装备一门 AC/20，配有三吨弹药。与这门自动炮搭配的是位于左躯干的一部 LRM-5，带一吨弹药。三门中型脉冲激光在近距离为自动炮提供后备火力，设计者还装设了 CASE 以防止弹药殉爆。 特性：护罩 投放费用倍率：1.1 手臂驱动器限制：右上

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The ThunderBird 'Mech is armed with the ER Large Laser from a TRB-D36b fighter, the LRM-20 launcher from a TRB-D36 and two Streak SRM-2 of uncertain origin. Further, the Artemis IV FCS from a TRB-D46 has been attached to the LRM launcher. Quirk: Distracting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 雷鸟机甲的武装包括来自一架TRB-D36b战斗机的增程大型激光、来自一架TRB-D36的LRM-20发射器，以及两具来路不明的连发SRM-2。此外，来自一架TRB-D46的阿尔忒弥斯IV火控系统被接在LRM发射器上。 特性：扰敌 投放费用倍率：1.05

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A Grey Death Legion custom variant, replacing most of the 'Mech with Clan technology. It has a varied assortment of armaments, one ER Large Laser, three Medium Pulse Laser, one LRM-15, one Stream SRM-4 and four Machine Guns. Quirk: Multi Trac Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 灰死亡军团的定制变型，将机甲的大部分部件替换为部族科技。它的武装种类繁杂：一门增程大型激光、三门中型脉冲激光、一具LRM-15、一具Streak SRM-4和四挺机枪。 特性：多重追踪 投放费用倍率：1.15

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 5Sb2 is a slight downgrade of the standard Royal 5Sb, replacing the ER PPC with a standard PPC. This allowed the 'Mech to be exported to other parties outside the SLDF. Quirk: Multi Trac Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 5Sb2是标准皇家5Sb的轻微降级版，以标准粒子炮取代增程粒子炮。这使该机甲得以出口给SLDF之外的势力。 特性：多目标追踪 投放费用倍率：1.11

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This Star League-era Federated Suns refit of the Thunderbolt removes the LRM-15, machine guns and their ammunition and replaces them with an Ultra AC/5 with two tons of ammunition. For close in work, an extra medium laser is added and the large laser is traded for a Large Pulse Laser. It upgrades the heat sinks to twelve double-strength models. How many of these variants survived past the Star League Era is unknown. Quirk: Multi Trac Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这台星际联盟时代的联邦太阳国雷锤改装型拆除了 LRM-15、机枪及其弹药，换成一门带两吨弹药的超级 AC/5。为应对近身战斗，它增设了一门中型激光，并把大型激光换成大型脉冲激光。散热器则升级为十二个双倍强度型号。这些变型有多少熬过了星际联盟时代，至今无从知晓。 特性：多目标追踪 投放费用倍率：1.09

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A Periphery refit, the Thunderbolt-5SP does a little bit of everything. Armed primarily with a Large Chemical Laser and a LRM-10 launcher, the TDR-5SP is well suited for ranged trades. At closer ranges a trio of Medium Chemical Lasers provide support fire. At point-blank, an Inferno Rocket Launcher-20 and a pair of Machine Guns do heavy work. Quirk: Multi Trac Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.07
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: TDR-5SP 是外围地区的改装型号，样样都能来一点。它以一门大型化学激光与一具 LRM-10 发射器为主要武装，非常适合远程对射。在较近的距离上，三门中型化学激光提供支援火力。到了贴脸距离，一具 Inferno 火箭发射器-20 与两挺机枪承担起重活。 特性：多重追踪 投放费用倍率：1.07

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Thunderbolt TDR-5SR variant slightly updates the 5S design, replacing the standard heat sinks with double versions. This allows adding one more Medium Laser in the Center Torso, as well as Artemis IV FCS for both missile launchers, CASE protection and a C3 slave unit. Quirk: Multi Trac Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Thunderbolt TDR-5SR 变型对 5S 设计做了小幅更新，将标准散热器替换为双散热器。由此得以在中央躯干增设一门中型激光，并为两组导弹发射器加装 Artemis IV 火控系统、CASE 防护以及一套 C3 从属单元。 特性：多重追踪 投放费用倍率：1.09

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The personal 'Mech of Bremond DMM Commander Leftenant-General Mary Tallman during the DCMS's Third Succession War invasion of Galtor III. She had the 'Mech stripped of everything save the Large Laser, and installed a brace of 4 Medium Lasers in each torso. An additional 8 Heat Sinks were added. Quirk: Multi Trac Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是DCMS第三次继承战争入侵加尔特III期间，布雷蒙德DMM指挥官、少将玛丽·塔尔曼的私人机甲。她让人拆掉除大型激光之外的一切，并在每侧躯干装入4门中型激光，另加8个散热器。 特性：多目标追踪 投放费用倍率：1.11

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Designed with Star League technology, the 7M has been re-armored using Ferro-Fibrous armor, allowing the 'Mech's weapons to be upgraded with the freed weight. With an arsenal based on the 5S model, the 7M carries an LRM-15 missile launcher in the right torso, an ER Large Laser in the right arm, three medium lasers and a Streak SRM-2 launcher in the left torso, and a pair of machine guns in the left arm. Two tons of LRM reloads are kept in the right torso while one ton each of Streak and machine gun ammo are kept in the left torso. Additionally, the heat sinks have been upgraded to double heat sinks and CASE has been added to protect against ammunition explosion. Quirk: Multi Trac Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 7M 采用星际联盟技术设计，重新披挂铁纤维装甲，从而得以用腾出的重量升级机甲武器。其武器配置以 5S 型号为基础：右躯干一部 LRM-15 导弹发射器，右臂一门 ER 大型激光，左躯干三门中型激光和一部连发 SRM-2 发射器，左臂两挺机枪。右躯干存放两吨 LRM 再装填弹药，左躯干则各存一吨连发导弹与机枪弹药。此外，散热器已升级为双散热器，并加装 CASE 以防弹药殉爆。 特性：多目标追踪 投放费用倍率：1.09

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Earthwerks TDR-8M was released in 3058, combining aspects of established variants with then-new ER medium lasers. It was the basis for the Vicore Industries-influenced visual redesign of the Thunderbolt chassis that became the norm for all future Earthwerks models in the mid-3060s. Quirk: Multi Trac Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 地球工厂TDR-8M于3058年发布，把既有变型的若干特点与当时新型的增程中型激光结合起来。它成为受维科尔工业影响、对雷神之锤底盘进行外观重设计的基础，而这套外观在3060年代中期成为地球工厂此后所有型号的常态。 特性：多目标追踪 投放费用倍率：1.09

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Based on the older 5SS model, the 9S was built in 3050 by Olivetti Weaponry using off-the-shelf structural components and armor after extensive changes delayed production. The 'Mech is armed with an ER PPC in its right arm as its primary long-range firepower. This is supported at closer ranges by a SRM-6 in the left torso along with the original three medium lasers. While retaining the left arm machine guns, in the right torso it carries a pair of flamers and an anti-missile system, along with one ton of AMS ammo. Quirk: Multi Trac Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 9S以较老的5SS型号为基础，于3050年由奥利维蒂兵工厂使用现成的结构部件和装甲制造——此前大幅度的改动一再拖延了投产。该机甲以右臂的1门增程粒子炮作为主要远程火力，近距离则依靠左躯干的1具SRM-6以及原有的3门中型激光。它保留了左臂的机枪，同时右躯干装有2具火焰喷射器和1套反导弹系统，并配1吨AMS弹药。 <特性：多重履带 <投放费用倍率：1.09

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 9SE variant of the Thunderbolt was introduced in 3050 as the Eridani Light Horse's update to the 5SE, based primarily around an energy weapons arsenal and maneuverability. The 'Mech is armed with a LRM-10 missile launcher for long-range combat. For close to medium ranges, the 'Mech carries a Large Pulse Laser and three medium lasers. Of note is the shifting of the missile launcher and its one ton of reloads from the right torso to the left. The additional mobility of the 9SE comes from its four jump jets, giving it a jumping distance of 120 meters. Quirk: Multi Trac Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 雷霆9SE于3050年推出，是埃里达尼轻骑兵对5SE的更新版，主要围绕能量武器与机动性。该机甲装有一具LRM-10导弹发射器用于远程作战；中近距离则带一门大型脉冲激光和两门中型激光。值得注意的是，导弹发射器及其一吨再装填弹药从右躯干移到了左躯干。9SE额外的机动性来自四具跳跃推进器，跳跃距离120米。 特性：多目标追踪 投放费用倍率：1.09

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This variant was built by Blackwell Industries for Wolf's Dragoons and it was based on a configuration from the Golden Century. Four jump jets let it cover 120 meters per jump. Fifteen double heat sinks dissipate the heat from various Clan-spec weapons. The right arm carries a Clan-spec Large Pulse Laser, the three torso-mounted lasers are Clan-spec Medium Pulse Lasers, and the LRM-10 is also Clan-spec and equipped with an Artemis IV FCS. Two tons of LRM ammo are carried in the left torso in a CASE-protected bin. Twelve tons of Inner Sphere-spec ferro-fibrous armor provides maximum protection. Quirk: Multi Trac Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该变型由布莱克威尔工业公司为沃尔夫龙骑兵打造，以黄金世纪时期的一种配置为基础。四台跳跃推进器让它每次跳跃可覆盖120米。十五个双散热器负责散逸各类部族规格武器产生的热量。右臂装有一门部族规格的大型脉冲激光，躯干上的三门激光是部族规格的中型脉冲激光，LRM-10同样是部族规格并配备阿尔忒弥斯IV火控系统。两个吨位的LRM弹药装在左躯干一处受CASE保护的弹仓中。十二吨内层星域规格的铁纤维装甲提供了最大限度的防护。 特性：多目标追踪 投放费用倍率：1.09

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 9WDR, based of the 9W, is another variant created specifically for the Wolf's Dragoons. By switching to full clan armor, the CASE could be dropped and the armor weight is lowered by a ton. This allowed adding a C3 slave and an A-Pod in the right leg. Quirk: Multi Trac Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 9WDR以9W为基础，是为狼之龙骑兵专门打造的另一款变型。通过改用全部部族装甲，CASE可以拆掉，装甲重量也降低一吨，从而得以加装一台C3从机和右腿一具A-Pod。 特性：多目标追踪 投放费用倍率：1.15

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This is a field refit created by the Clans during Operation REVIVAL. Captured Inner Sphere Thunderbolts were refitted and used by garrison and solahma troops. The Thunderbolt C had a Large Pulse Laser in the right arm, an ER Large Laser in the left torso, and the left arm carried an ER medium laser and a pair of ER small lasers. Twenty-four single heat sinks are fitted to the legs and all the torsos. Quirk: Multi Trac Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.07
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是部族在复兴行动期间创造的战场改装。缴获的内层星域Thunderbolt经过改装，交由驻防部队与solahma部队使用。Thunderbolt C的右臂装有一门大型脉冲激光，左侧躯干装有一门增程大型激光，左臂则携带一门增程中型激光与两门增程小型激光。腿部与所有躯干部位共安装了二十四具单散热器。 特性：多目标追踪 投放费用倍率：1.07

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This variant was developed by Clan Jade Falcon after they recaptured Sudeten. Based on the Thunderbolt C, this model has an ER PPC in the right arm while the left arm carries an ER medium laser and a pair of ER small lasers. The left torso carries a Streak SRM-6, three ER medium lasers, and a ton of Streak ammunition. The right torso carries two small pulse lasers and an anti-missile system with a ton of ammunition. To make room for this equipment, the twenty-four heat sinks have been replaced by seventeen double heat sinks. Quirk: Multi Trac Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.13
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这一变型由翡翠猎鹰部族在重新夺回 Sudeten 之后研发。该型号以 Thunderbolt C 为基础，右臂装有一具增程粒子炮，左臂则搭载一具增程中型激光和两具增程小型激光。左躯干搭载一具连发 SRM-6、三具增程中型激光以及一吨连发弹药。右躯干搭载两具小型脉冲激光和一具反导弹系统，配一吨弹药。为腾出空间安置这些装备，原有的二十四具散热器被替换为十七具双散热器。 特性：多目标追踪 投放费用倍率：1.13

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: When the Magistracy of Canopus found an abandoned Star League facility in 3018, amongst the stored equipment was a number of Thunderbolt chassis. All of them were severely damage and missing key components such as the weapons, gyro and engine. The Magistracy had to acquire these at great cost from the open market, and therefore opted to install internal combustion engines instead of the fusion cores. The F4V was the first variant to enter service, armed only with twin Armstrong class-5 autocannons. Quirk: Multi Trac Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.87
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 3018 年，坎诺帕斯女权领地发现了一处废弃的星际联盟设施，在储存的装备中有一批 Thunderbolt 底盘。它们全都严重受损，并缺失武器、陀螺仪和引擎等关键部件。女权领地不得不花高价从公开市场购入这些部件，因此选择用内燃机替代聚变核心。F4V 是第一个服役的变型，仅装备两门 Armstrong 5 级自动炮。 特性：多重追踪 投放费用倍率：0.87

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: When the Magistracy of Canopus found an abandoned Star League facility in 3018, amongst the stored equipment was a number of Thunderbolt chassis. All of them were severely damage and missing key components such as the weapons, gyro and engine. The Magistracy had to acquire these at great cost from the open market, and therefore opted to install internal combustion engines instead of the fusion cores. The F4W was intended as a hedge against civil unrest. The planetary armory traded one AC/5 for a SRM-6 and a heavy battery of machine guns whose short range meant the F4W could only engage at close quarters – excellent for controlling unruly mobs, but nearly useless against anything else. Quirk: Multi Trac Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.87
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 3018 年，卡诺帕斯枢机国发现了一处废弃的星际联盟设施，在其储存的装备中有若干 Thunderbolt 底盘。这些底盘全都严重受损，并缺失武器、陀螺仪和引擎等关键部件。枢机国不得不花费高昂代价从公开市场上采购这些部件，因此决定用内燃机替代聚变核心。F4W 的问世是为了防备民间动乱。行星军械库用一具 SRM-6 换掉了一门 AC/5，并加装了大量机枪——其射程之短意味着 F4W 只能在近身距离交战：用于镇压不听话的暴民堪称出色，但对付其他任何目标都几乎毫无用处。 特性：多履带 投放费用倍率：0.87

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Produced in the last years of the Amaris Civil War for the SLDF, the Thunder Hawk emphasizes firepower over speed. A 100-ton mech, the Thunder Hawk TDK-7Y is built around a 300-rated XL Engine and is armed with a pair of Gauss Rifles; and an Arrow IV Missile Launcher. 4 Medium Lasers act as back up weapons. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Thunder Hawk 是在阿马里斯内战最后几年为 SLDF 生产的，其设计重火力而轻速度。这台 100 吨的机甲以一台 300 级 XL 引擎为核心，装备两门高斯步枪和一部箭式 IV 导弹发射器。4 门中型激光充当辅助武器。 特性：指挥机甲 投放费用倍率：1.18

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Produced in the last years of the Amaris Civil War for the SLDF, the Thunder Hawk emphasizes firepower over speed. A 100-ton mech, the Thunder Hawk TDK-7X is built around a 300-rated XL Engine and is armed with a trio of Gauss Rifles, with 4 Medium Lasers as back up weapons. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 雷鹰在阿马里斯内战末期专为星际联盟防卫军生产，它更强调火力而非速度。这台100吨的机甲雷鹰TDK-7X以一具300级XL引擎为核心，装备三支高斯步枪，另有4具中型激光作为备用武器。 特性：指挥机甲 投放费用倍率：1.18

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Produced in the last years of the Amaris Civil War for the SLDF, the Thunder Hawk emphasizes firepower over speed. A 100-ton mech, the Thunder Hawk TDK-7Y is built around a 300-rated XL Engine and is armed with a trio of Gauss Rifles, with a pair of Medium Pulse Lasers as back up weapons. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 雷鹰于阿马里斯内战最后几年为SLDF生产，把火力置于速度之上。作为100吨机甲，雷鹰TDK-7Y围绕一台300额定XL引擎建造，装有三门高斯步枪，并以一对中型脉冲激光作为后备。 特性：指挥机甲 投放费用倍率：1.18

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Mech's principal armament is an Ultra AC/20 in the left torso and a LBX/20 in the right torso, two weapons which together can deliver an immense punch. Two LRM-20 with attached Artemis IV systems are used until the ThunderHawk is able to close distance with its targets. Since the 'Mech only carries a 270 XL engine, as a result its largest weakness is open combat as more mobile units can easily keep it at a range of engagement where the ThunderHawk's large autocannons are not as effective. Quirk: Easy to Pilot Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.2 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该机甲的主要武装是左躯干的一门 Ultra AC/20 与右躯干的一门 LBX/20，这两件武器合在一处能打出极其沉重的一击。两具附带 Artemis IV 系统的 LRM-20 用于在 ThunderHawk 拉近与目标的距离之前开火。由于该机甲只搭载 270 XL引擎，其最大的弱点便是开阔地交战：机动性更强的单位可以轻易将它压制在 ThunderHawk 的大型自动炮发挥不佳的交战距离上。 特性：易于驾驶 投放费用倍率：1.2 手臂驱动器限制：左臂上部、右臂上部

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Built exclusively for medium to short range combat, the Ti Ts'ang TSG-9H carries a devastating array of five ER Medium Lasers backed up by four ER Small Lasers as its only ranged weapons. The 'Mech's most fearsome weapon is its Hatchet, which is capable of cleaving into an enemy's 'Mech and when the Triple Strength Myomer is active it is capable of slicing through armor like a hot knife through butter. Additionally, the Ti Ts'ang has an TAG laser designator that allows the 'Mech to call in highly accurate missile or artillery strikes. Quirk: Hyper-Extending Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 铁苍纯为中近距离战斗而造，其唯一的远程武器是五门增程中型激光，辅以四门增程小型激光，火力可怖。该机甲最令人畏惧的武器是它的战斧，能劈入敌方机甲；当三倍强度人造肌启动时，它切开装甲犹如热刀切黄油。此外，铁苍装有一具TAG激光指示器，可呼叫高精度导弹或炮火打击。 特性：超伸展驱动器 投放费用倍率：1.08 手臂驱动器限制：左下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 9J variant of the Ti Ts'ang is built with long range combat in mind. In order to allow the 'Mech to defend itself, the TAG laser as well as two ER Medium Lasers, two ER Small Lasers, and a double heat sink have been removed to make room for an ER Large Laser, allowing the Ti Ts'ang to strike at long ranges. Quirk: Hyper-Extending Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 螳螂的9J变型是着眼于远距离作战而设计的。为了让这台机甲能够自卫，设计拆除了TAG激光以及两门增程中型激光、两门增程小型激光和一个双散热器，腾出空间装上一门增程大型激光，使螳螂得以在远距离发起攻击。 特性：超伸展驱动器 投放费用倍率：1.08 手臂驱动器限制：左下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The first custom configuration used by the infamous Bounty Hunter of the time of the initial Clan Invasion, it mounted a Large Pulse Laser and a Medium Pulse Laser in each arm. It also had a Medium Pulse Laser in both the left and right torso with a Clan Light TAG in the center torso. A Light Active Probe, ECM suite, and a Targeting Computer provided stealth and increased accuracy. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Medium Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是部族入侵初期臭名昭著的赏金猎人使用的首套定制配置：每只手臂各装一门大型脉冲激光和一门中型脉冲激光，左右躯干也各有一门中型脉冲激光，中央躯干则是一具部族轻型TAG。一台轻型主动探测器、一套电子对抗套件和一台瞄准计算机提供了隐蔽性与更高精度。 特性：改进瞄准 - 中程 投放费用倍率：1.14 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Captured by Conner Sinclair of the Damocles Commandos from the Smoke Jaguars, this variant seems to be a mix of B and C, mounting twin ER large lasers in the right arm, a Gauss Rifle in the left, and finally a Streak SRM rack in each torso. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Medium Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 此变型被达摩克利斯突击队的康纳·辛克莱从烟虎部族手中缴获，似乎是B与C的混合体：右臂装双联增程大型激光，左臂一门高斯步枪，两侧躯干各一具连发SRM挂架。 特性：改进瞄准 - 中程 投放费用倍率：1.14 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The E2 loadout is full energy based with two Large and four Medium Pulse Lasers. A single ER Small Laser serves as close range anti-infantry defense. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Medium Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.12 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: E2 配置全为能量武器，配备两门大型脉冲激光和四门中型脉冲激光。一门小型增程激光则用于近距离反步兵防御。 特性：改进瞄准（中程） 投放费用倍率：1.12 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A full energy configuration, the Timber Wolf E3 loadout mounts three ER Large and five ER Small Lasers. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Medium Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.12 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是一套全能量配置，林木狼（Timber Wolf）E3 型装备装有三门增程大型激光和五门增程小型激光。 特性：改进瞄准 - 中距 投放费用倍率：1.12 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The F2 loadout mounts a massive AC/20 in the Right Arm and an ER PPC in the left. Three Medium and one Small ER Lasers provide secondary firepower as required. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Medium Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.12 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: F2 配置在右臂装有一门巨大的 AC/20，左臂装有一门增程粒子炮。三门增程中型激光和一门增程小型激光按需提供次级火力。 特性：改进瞄准 - 中型 投放费用倍率：1.12 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The F3 loadout of the Timber Wolf is a mix of two ER PPC and two LRM-10, with four ER Lasers as backup. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Medium Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.12 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 野狼的 F3 配置混合了两门 ER PPC 和两具 LRM-10，另有四门增程激光作为后备。 特性：改进瞄准 - 中程 投放费用倍率：1.12 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The G loadout brings two ER Large Lasers, four ER Medium Lasers and two Medium Pulse Lasers to the battlefield. It also mounts an Anti-Missile System and an ECM Suite for defensive purposes. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Medium Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.12 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: G配置为战场带来两具增程大型激光、四具增程中型激光和两具中型脉冲激光，另外还装有反导弹系统和电子对抗套件用于防御。 特性：改进瞄准（中型） 投放费用倍率：1.12 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The personal ride of Colonel Carlos Camacho of the 17th Recon Regiment (who captured it from the Smoke Jaguars), the Great White was later piloted by Force Commander Kali MacDougall. Seemingly a mix of the A and D configurations, the Great White mounts an ER PPC along with twin double heat sinks in each arm, and a Streak SRM-6 paired with one medium pulse laser in each torso. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Medium Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Great White 是第 17 侦察团指挥官卡洛斯·卡马乔上校的私人座机（他从烟虎氏族手中夺得此机），后来由部队指挥官卡莉·麦克杜格尔驾驶。Great White 似乎融合了 A 与 D 两种配置：每条手臂各装有一门增程粒子炮和两台双散热器，每个躯干内则装有一具连发 SRM-6 与一门中型脉冲激光。 特性：改进瞄准 - 中型 投放费用倍率：1.14 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A mainly support configuration of the Timber Wolf, the H2 mounts a total of five AMS spread throughout the 'Mech. It still is able to fit two ER Large and five ER Medium lasers, providing decent offensive firepower. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Medium Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.12 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: H2是木狼偏重支援的配置，全机上下共搭载五套AMS。它依然能装下两门增程大型激光与五门增程中型激光，提供可观的火力输出。 特性：改进瞄准 - 中程 投放费用倍率：1.12 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 'Hydra' loadout was custom selected by Star Colonel James Hydra of Clan Wolf. Two large LBX AC/10 serve as the main armaments, while three Streak SRM-4 launchers provide extra damage at shorter ranges. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Medium Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: “九头蛇”配置由狼部族的星上校詹姆斯·海德拉亲自挑选。两门大型LBX AC/10自动炮作为主要武装，三具连发SRM-4发射器则在较近距离提供额外伤害。 特性：改进瞄准（中程） 投放费用倍率：1.14 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The I configuration is unusual in that it mounts a total of eleven ER Medium Lasers, combined together through a Targeting Computer with a single ER Large Laser. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Medium Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.12 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: I配置的不同寻常之处在于它总共装了十一门增程中型激光，通过一台瞄准计算机与一门单独的增程大型激光整合在一起。 特性：改进瞄准 - 中程 投放费用倍率：1.12 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Timber Wolf J loadout mounts two Ultra AC/2 and two ER Large Lasers as the main weapons. Two ER Medium Laser act as secondary damage dealers, while an AMS provides some defense. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Medium Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.12 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 森林狼 J 配置以两门 Ultra AC/2 和两门 ER 大型激光为主武器。两门 ER 中型激光担任次要输出，而一套 AMS 则提供一定的防御。 特性：改进瞄准 - 中程 投放费用倍率：1.12 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The K loadout mounts a total of 14 LRM-5 launchers, five ER Medium Lasers and a flamer. The large amount of LRM launchers can fire at multiple targets simultaneously by the use of an advanced targeting computer. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Medium Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.12 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: K挂载共装14具LRM-5发射器、五门增程中型激光和一具火焰喷射器。大量LRM发射器可借助一台先进瞄准计算机同时攻击多个目标。 特性：改进瞄准 - 中程 投放费用倍率：1.12 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This loadout is said to have been used by the famed Natasha Kerensky before she became the Khan of Clan Wolf. Two ER PPC, two Large Pulser Lasers and plenty of advanced equipment makes sure that the damage is dealt consist and continuous to any enemy target. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Medium Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 据说这套配置曾为著名的娜塔莎·克伦斯基所用，那时她尚未成为狼族的可汗。两门增程粒子炮、两门大型脉冲激光以及大量先进设备，确保对任何敌方目标都能持续稳定地造成伤害。 特性：改进瞄准 - 中程 投放费用倍率：1.14 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A custom loadout specifically used by the mercenary outfit the Kell Hounds. It mounts two ER PPC and four Streak SRM-4 launchers. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Medium Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.12 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是雇佣兵部队凯尔猎犬（Kell Hounds）专门使用的一套定制配置。它装有两门增程粒子炮和四具连发 SRM-4 发射器。 特性：改进瞄准 - 中距 投放费用倍率：1.12 手臂驱动器限制：全向
