Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A custom loadout specifically used by the mercenary outfit the Kell Hounds. It mounts two ER PPC, two Medium Pulse Laser and two SRM-6 launchers. A C3 Master computer improves the performance of the whole lance. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Medium Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.12 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是雇佣兵部队凯尔猎犬专用的定制载荷。它装两门增程粒子炮、两门中型脉冲激光和两具SRM-6发射器，一台C3主计算机提升整个小队的表现。 特性：改进瞄准 - 中程 投放费用倍率：1.12 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Timber Wolf M/A loadout is one of three configurations used mainly for Mastery trials. Two ER PPC, two LRM-10, one Large Pulse Laser and a Flamer ensures it is able to handle any situation in a trial. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Medium Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.12 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 木狼M/A挂载是主要用于精通试炼的三种配置之一。两门增程粒子炮、两具LRM-10、一门大型脉冲激光和一具火焰喷射器，确保它能在试炼中应付任何局面。 特性：改进瞄准 - 中程 投放费用倍率：1.12 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Timber Wolf M/J loadout is one of three configurations used mainly for Mastery trials. Two ER PPC, four LRM-5, one Large Pulse Laser and a Flamer ensures it is able to handle any situation in a trial. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Medium Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.12 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 野狼 M/J 配置是主要用于“精通”试炼的三种配置之一。两门 ER PPC、四具 LRM-5、一门大型脉冲激光和一具火焰喷射器，确保它能够应对试炼中的任何局面。 特性：改进瞄准 - 中程 投放费用倍率：1.12 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Timber Wolf M/W loadout is one of three configurations used mainly for Mastery trials. Two ER Large and two Large Pulser Lasers, two LRM-10 and one Medium Pulse Laser ensures it is able to handle any situation in a trial. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Medium Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.12 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 木狼M/W配置是主要用于精通试炼的三种配置之一。两门增程大型和两门大型脉冲激光、两具LRM-10和一门中型脉冲激光，确保它能在试炼中应付任何局面。 特性：改进瞄准 - 中程 投放费用倍率：1.12 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A mix of the Prime and the D configurations, alternate configuration N mounts an ER PPC in each arm alongside an LRM-15 rack in the left and right torsos. These weapons are supported at short range by paired Machine Guns and Medium Pulse Lasers in each side torso. Two tons of LRM reloads and a half ton of machine gun rounds force a focus on the energy weapons with an extra Double Heat Sink tries to assist in managing their heat. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Medium Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.12 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 备用 N 型配置融合了 Prime 配置与 D 型配置的特点：每侧手臂各装一门增程粒子炮，左右躯干各装一具 LRM-15。近程则由每个侧躯干内成对的机枪和中型脉冲激光提供支援。两吨 LRM 备用弹药和半吨机枪弹药使作战重心偏向能量武器，而额外加装的一具双散热器则试图帮助控制它们的热量。 特性：改进瞄准 - 中级 投放费用倍率：1.12 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A non-standard alternate configuration of the Timber Wolf, this configuration was famously used by Star Colonel Aidan Pryde. The primary long range weapons are a pair of ER Large Lasers which are backed up by a pair of LRM-20s for long range combat. For close combat, two ER Medium Lasers are carried as well as an ER Small Laser. The Pryde Configuration also mounts four jump jets making it highly maneuverable. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Medium Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是 Timber Wolf 的一种非标准备用配置，因星际上校艾丹·普莱德的使用而闻名。主要远程武器是一对增程大型激光，并以一对 LRM-20 为远程交战提供补充。近战时则携有两门增程中型激光以及一门增程小型激光。普莱德配置还搭载四台跳跃推进器，使其机动性极为出色。 特性：改进瞄准 - 中型 投放费用倍率：1.14 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A highly maneuverable urban combat configuration of the Timber Wolf, the S mounts five jump jets, allowing it to jump up to one hundred and fifty meters. To offset the inaccuracy from using jump jets, the S configuration is armed with a Large Pulse Laser backed up by two Medium Pulse Lasers. The S configuration also carries four SRM-6 launchers and two Machine Guns, making it a deadly close combat fighter. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Medium Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.12 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为木狼高度机动的城市战配置，S型装五具跳跃推进器，可跳跃至多一百五十米。为抵消使用跳跃推进器带来的精度损失，S型装有一门大型脉冲激光，并以两门中型脉冲激光辅助。S型还带四具SRM-6发射器和两挺机枪，是致命的近战缠斗者。 特性：改进瞄准 - 中程 投放费用倍率：1.12 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The SG configuration combines two Heavy Large and two ER Medium Lasers with two LRM-10 launchers, while also mounting a Light TAG and a Flamer. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Medium Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.12 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: SG配置把两门重型大型激光和两门增程中型激光与两具LRM-10发射器组合起来，同时还装有一具轻型TAG和一具火焰喷射器。 特性：改进瞄准 - 中程 投放费用倍率：1.12 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Recognised and feared throughout the Inner Sphere, the Timber Wolf is a 75 ton Clan OmniMech with a deadly blend of speed, armor and firepower. Powered by a 375-rated XL Engine, a combination of Ferro-Fibrous and Endo Steel give the OmniMech 27.5 tons of Pod Space. The Timber Wolf TC is a Clan Wolf special designed for Tukayyid and the expectation of an extended campaign. Armed with a pair of Large Pulse Lasers and a pair of Streak SRM-6’s, the TC mounts a pair of ER Medium Lasers and an ER Small as secondary weapons. 5 Jump Jets enhance the TC’s mobility. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Medium Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.12 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 木狼在内层星域无人不知、无人不惧，是一台75吨部族全向机甲，把速度、装甲与火力融为一体、致命非常。它由一台375额定XL引擎驱动，铁纤维与内骨架的组合提供27.5吨挂载空间。木狼TC是狼部族为图卡伊德及预期中的长期战役而设计的特制型号，装有一对大型脉冲激光和一对连发SRM-6，另有两门增程中型激光和一门增程小型激光作为次要武器。5具跳跃推进器增强TC的机动性。 特性：改进瞄准 - 中程 投放费用倍率：1.12 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The personal mech of Vladimir Ward. A modified Prime variant, this version has swapped the medium pulse laser for twin Extended Range mediums, one in each side torso. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Medium Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是弗拉基米尔·沃德的私人机甲，是主型号的改装版，把中型脉冲激光换成两门增程中型激光，分装在两侧躯干。 特性：改进瞄准 - 中程 投放费用倍率：1.14 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A customized variant of the Timber Wolf rumored to be piloted by Vlad Ward, the Warrant uses an LB 5-X Autocannon in its left arm, with one ton of ammo. The right arm uses an ER Medium Laser and ER Large Laser. Each side torso carried an LRM-20 with one ton of ammo. The left torso supported a Medium Pulse Laser, while the right torso carries an ER Small Laser. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Medium Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是 Timber Wolf 的一种定制变型，据传由 Vlad Ward 驾驶。Warrant 的左臂装有一门 LB 5-X 自动炮，配一吨弹药；右臂装有增程中型激光和增程大型激光。每个侧躯干各承载一具 LRM-20 和一吨弹药。左躯干辅以一门中型脉冲激光，右躯干则装有一门增程小型激光。 特性：改进瞄准 - 中级 投放费用倍率：1.14 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A anti-infantry loadout used by the Wolf's Dragoons, the fabled mercenary company. The quite unique configuration mounts eight Machine Guns, ten Streak SRM-2 launchers and two Large Pulse Lasers. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Medium Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.12 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是传说中的雇佣兵部队“狼之龙骑兵”（Wolf's Dragoons）所使用的反步兵配置。这套相当独特的配置装有八挺机枪、十具连发 SRM-2 发射器和两门大型脉冲激光。 特性：改进瞄准 - 中程 投放费用倍率：1.12 手臂驱动器限制：全向机甲

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A loadout used by the Wolf's Dragoons, combining an Inner Sphere Light Gauss Rifle with two ER Large Lasers and four LRM-5 launchers. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Medium Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.12 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是狼之龙骑兵使用的一套配置，将一门内层星域轻型高斯步枪与两门增程大型激光以及四具 LRM-5 发射器结合在一起。 特性：改进瞄准 - 中距 投放费用倍率：1.12 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This Wolf's Dragoons configuration of the Timber Wolf mounts only two ER PPC as its damage dealers. Instead it focuses on a support role with a C3 Master and advanced EWS equipment. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Medium Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.12 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 狼之龙骑兵的这款森林狼配置只装两门 增程粒子炮作为输出手段，而是把重心放在支援角色上，配备一套 C3 主控单元与先进的 EWS 设备。 特性：改进瞄准 - 中程 投放费用倍率：1.12 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Designed in 2787, the Titan was a prototype assault mech that never reached full-scale production. The 1A carried two PPCs, six Medium Lasers, four SRM-4s, and an SRM-6. 22 Single Heatsinks manage the heat load. Quirk: Protected Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 泰坦于2787年设计，是一款始终未能进入量产的原型突击机甲。1A型配备两门粒子炮、六具中型激光、四具SRM-4和一具SRM-6，由22具单散热器负责散热。 特性：受保护驱动器 投放费用倍率：1.16

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The -1AD is a major refit from the -1A, replacing most of the weapons with more powerful versions. The medium lasers were upgraded to pulse versions and the three PPCs replaced by two ER PPCs. The SRM-launchers were kept the same, but their ammunition are now protected by C.A.S.E. The 'Mech was also upgraded to double heat sinks, improving its cooling even though it has one less sink than the original variant. Quirk: Protected Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: -1AD是对-1A的大幅改装，把大部分武器换成更强力的版本：中型激光升级为脉冲型，三门粒子炮换成两门增程粒子炮；SRM发射器保持不变，但其弹药现在由C.A.S.E.保护。该机甲还升级为双散热器，尽管比原变型少一个散热器，冷却仍然更好。 特性：受保护驱动器 投放费用倍率：1.18

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Titan TI-1D is a further upgrade of the -1AD, but a quite costly one as it replaces the standard engine core with an extra light one. The freed space is used to add one more pulse laser, convert the SRM-6 to two SRM-4s and also add an active probe and one more heat sink. One ton of SRM ammunition is however dropped, leaving the 'Mech with only 200 missiles total. Quirk: Protected Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 泰坦 TI-1D 是 -1AD 的进一步升级，但代价相当高昂，因为它把标准引擎核心换成了特轻引擎。腾出的空间用来加装一门脉冲激光、把 SRM-6 换成两门 SRM-4，并增加一个主动探测器和一台散热器。不过它削减了一吨 SRM 弹药，使该机甲总共只剩下 200 枚导弹。 特性：受保护驱动器 投放费用倍率：1.18

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The only difference between the -1D and -2D is the removal of the Beagle Active Probe, the 'Mech instead mounts a Guardian ECM suite. Quirk: Protected Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: -1D 与 -2D 之间唯一的区别是拆除了 Beagle 主动探测器，机甲改为装设一套 Guardian 电子对抗套件。 特性：受保护驱动器 投放费用倍率：1.18

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Tornado is a Power Armor (Light) suit, created by ComStar in the late twenty-ninth century to equip their special forces units with added protection. The Tornado is based on the Star League Defense Force Nighthawk suit which, though they had acquired several, ComStar at the time was unable to produce. It incorporates stealth armor and an adaptive Camo System which mimics the effects of a combination Camo/IR/ECM Sneak Suit, hiding the Tornado from all types of sensors. The armor is also good enough to stop small-arms fire and even heavy weapons like a Flamer from hurting the wearer. Quirk: Power Armor Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.8832 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Tornado 是通讯之星于二十九世纪末期打造的轻型动力装甲，旨在为其特种部队提供额外防护。Tornado 以 SLDF 的 Nighthawk 装甲为基础——通讯之星当时虽已获得数套，却无法自行生产。它整合了隐形装甲与自适应伪装系统，可模拟伪装/红外/电子对抗潜行服的综合效果，使 Tornado 难以被任何类型的传感器发现。其装甲防护也足以挡下轻武器火力，甚至能抵御火焰喷射器这类重型武器的伤害，保护穿戴者。 特性：动力装甲 投放费用倍率：0.8832 可搭载全向装备，可进行近战，可实施蜂拥攻击。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Tornado is a Power Armor (Light) suit, created by ComStar in the late twenty-ninth century to equip their special forces units with added protection. The Tornado is based on the Star League Defense Force Nighthawk suit which, though they had acquired several, ComStar at the time was unable to produce. It incorporates stealth armor and an adaptive Camo System which mimics the effects of a combination Camo/IR/ECM Sneak Suit, hiding the Tornado from all types of sensors. The armor is also good enough to stop small-arms fire and even heavy weapons like a Flamer from hurting the wearer. Quirk: Power Armor Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.8848 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 龙卷风是由通讯之星于二十九世纪晚期研制的动力装甲（轻型）套装，为他们的特种部队提供额外防护。龙卷风以星际联盟国防军的夜鹰套装为基础——尽管通讯之星已获得若干套，当时却无法自行生产。它整合了隐形装甲与自适应伪装系统，可模拟伪装/红外/电子对抗潜行服组合的效果，让龙卷风能对所有类型的传感器隐身。这套装甲也足以挡下轻武器火力，甚至能挡住火焰喷射器这样的重型武器，使穿着者不受伤害。 特性：动力装甲 投放费用倍率：0.8848 可搭载全向单位，可近战，可蜂拥攻击。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Tornado is a Power Armor (Light) suit, created by ComStar in the late twenty-ninth century to equip their special forces units with added protection. The Tornado is based on the Star League Defense Force Nighthawk suit which, though they had acquired several, ComStar at the time was unable to produce. It incorporates stealth armor and an adaptive Camo System which mimics the effects of a combination Camo/IR/ECM Sneak Suit, hiding the Tornado from all types of sensors. The armor is also good enough to stop small-arms fire and even heavy weapons like a Flamer from hurting the wearer. Quirk: Power Armor Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.8848 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 龙卷风是由通讯之星于二十九世纪晚期研制的动力装甲（轻型）套装，为他们的特种部队提供额外防护。龙卷风以星际联盟国防军的夜鹰套装为基础——尽管通讯之星已获得若干套，当时却无法自行生产。它整合了隐形装甲与自适应伪装系统，可模拟伪装/红外/电子对抗潜行服组合的效果，让龙卷风能对所有类型的传感器隐身。这套装甲也足以挡下轻武器火力，甚至能挡住火焰喷射器这样的重型武器，使穿着者不受伤害。 特性：动力装甲 投放费用倍率：0.8848 可搭载全向单位，可近战，可蜂拥攻击。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The original prototype of the Toro, the A-1 was based of the primitive Firebee developed by the Cappellan Confederation. It had two SRM-2s which shared a ton of ammunition and a Large Laser. Though it could only manage 64 km/h, the A-1 had more armor protection than the Firebee, with ten and a half tons of Primitive Armor protecting the mech. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.78 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Toro 的最初原型 A-1 以卡佩兰联邦开发的原始型 Firebee 为基础。它装有两具共用一吨弹药的 SRM-2 和一门大型激光。虽然最高只能跑到 64 km/h，但 A-1 的装甲防护优于 Firebee，十吨半的原始装甲保护着这台机甲。 特性：易于维护 投放费用倍率：0.78 手臂驱动器限制：左下臂

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Produced in 2546, the Toro was the Taurian Concordant’s first battlemech design. Based on captured Firebees, the Toro is a long range support mech. Armed with a PPC and a pair of LRM-5s the Toro carried two tons of ammo and 10 single heat sinks. The last Toro factory was demolished in 2598 by invading Star League troops and production would not resume until the Word of Blake Jihad. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 托罗于2546年生产，是金牛座协约的第一款战斗机甲设计。它以缴获的萤火虫为基础，是一款远程支援机甲，装有一门粒子炮和一对LRM-5，带两吨弹药和10个单散热器。最后一座托罗工厂于2598年被入侵的星际联盟部队拆毁，生产直到布莱克之词圣战才恢复。 特性：易于维护 投放费用倍率：0.98 手臂驱动器限制：左下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Trebuchet IIC 1 carries two LRM-20 launchers and three Medium Pulse Lasers. The LRM launchers are improved by the addition of Artemis IV FCS, and have a total of 5 tons of Artemis ammunition available. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Trebuchet IIC 1 搭载两组 LRM-20 发射器与三门中型脉冲激光。LRM 发射器因加装 Artemis IV 火控系统而性能提升，并有总计 5 吨的 Artemis 弹药可供使用。 特性：易于维护 投放费用倍率：1.08 手臂驱动器限制：左臂下部、右臂下部

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The IIC 2 uses an LRM-20 with Artemis FCS for long range engagements, adding three ER Medium Lasers as the 'Mech closes in on its enemies. For close range fighting the IIC 2 also mounts a Streak SRM-6. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: IIC 2在远程交战时使用一具带阿尔忒弥斯火控系统的LRM-20，并在逼近敌人时加入三门增程中型激光。近距战斗中，IIC 2还装有一具连发SRM-6。 特性：易于维护 投放费用倍率：1.08 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Trebuchet IIC 3 focuses on long range, high impact weapons. It mounts an Ultra AC/10 in the left arm and an ER PPC in the right torso. A Streak SRM-6 in the right arm can provide some extra punch at closer ranges. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 投石机 IIC 3（Trebuchet IIC 3）专注于远程高威力武器。它的左臂装有一门超速 AC/10，右躯干装有一门增程粒子炮。右臂的连发 SRM-6 则能在较近距离提供额外的打击力。 特性：易于维护 投放费用倍率：1.08 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The IIC 4 drops the ferro-fibrous armor of the earlier IIC variants in an attempt to ease its maintenance needs. The main armament are two LRM-20 launchers with attached Artemis IV FCS and six ton of ammunition. Three ER Medium Laser and one ER Small Laser can help with dealing extra damage or self-defense. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: IIC 4舍弃了早期IIC变型的铁纤维装甲，以减轻维护负担。主要武器为两具LRM-20发射器，配属阿尔忒弥斯IV火控系统和六吨弹药。三门增程中型激光和一门增程小型激光可提供额外伤害或用于自卫。 特性：易于维护 投放费用倍率：1.08 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Trebuchet TBT-5K is a custom variant originally fielded by the mercenary outfit the Kell Hounds. The variant uses only Clan-grade specification weapons; two LRM-15 with attached Artemis IV and three ER Medium Lasers. The 'Mech also upgrades the heat sinks to Clan specification and adds a C3 Slave computer mounted in the head. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 投石机TBT-5K是最初由雇佣兵部队凯尔猎犬投入使用的定制变型。该变型只用部族规格武器：两具带阿尔忒弥斯IV的LRM-15和三门增程中型激光。它还把散热器升级为部族规格，并在头部加装一台C3从机。 特性：易于维护 投放费用倍率：1.04

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The -.5NR is a battlfield refit of the -5N, dropping one Medium Laser for a C3 Slave computer. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.02 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: -.5NR是-5N的野战改装，拆掉一门中型激光换装一台C3从机。 特性：易于维护 投放费用倍率：1.02 手臂驱动器限制：右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Introduced in 3025, the -5P retains the dual right arm medium lasers, but otherwise alters the remaining loadout, downgrading the LRM racks to LRM-10s and moving the left arm launcher to the left torso, also shifting the left arm medium laser to the center torso. The weight reduction is needed to carry a medium mace in the left arm with specialized arm actuators to improve its performance. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: -5P于3025年推出，保留了右臂的两门中型激光，但其余装备全部改动：LRM发射架降级为LRM-10，左臂发射器移到左躯干，左臂的中型激光也移到中央躯干。这些减重是为了在左臂挂载一柄中型钉锤，并配以专用手臂驱动器以提升其性能。 特性：易于维护 投放费用倍率：1.04 手臂驱动器限制：右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A refit of the -7M, removing the Narc laucher to instead add Artemis IV FCS for the LRM-15 launchers. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 对-7M的改装：拆除Narc发射器，改为给LRM-15发射器加装阿尔忒弥斯IV火控系统。 特性：易于维护 投放费用倍率：1.04 手臂驱动器限制：右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The -7KR is an upgrade kit for the -7K, greatly updating its equipment. The PPC is replaced by an ER PPC and the AC/5 by an Ultra AC/5. The SRM-2 is dropped, to instead add a Small Laser. C.A.S.E. protection for the ammunition and a C3 Slave computer are also added. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: -7KR 是 -7K 的升级套件，对其装备进行了大幅更新。粒子炮被替换为增程粒子炮，AC/5 被替换为 Ultra AC/5。SRM-2 被拆除，改为加装一门小型激光。此外还增加了弹药 C.A.S.E. 防护和一台 C3 从机计算机。 特性：易于维护 投放费用倍率：1.04 手臂驱动器限制：右下臂

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A -8KL, or -8K 'Long', regears the standard -8K for longer range engagements by replacing all the lasers with a single ER Large Laser. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04 Arm Actuator Limits: Right Lower, Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: -8KL，又称 -8K“远程型”，为标准 -8K 重新配置了装备以适应更远距离的交战：它把所有激光替换为一门增程大型激光。 特性：易于维护 投放费用倍率：1.04 手臂驱动器限制：右下、右上

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Named after the largest trebuchet ever built in primitive Terra, the Warwolf packs heavy close range weaponry in the form of paired SRMs, streaks, and pulse lasers. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 战争之狼以原始地球上建造过的最大投石机命名，装有一整套重型近程武器：成对的SRM、连发导弹与脉冲激光。 特性：易于维护 投放费用倍率：1.06 手臂驱动器限制：右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Trooper delivers a lot of bang for the buck, as it's large AC/5 autocannon and three Medium Lasers are a respectable weaponry for a 'Mech of its size. The 'Mech still manages to fit an SRM-4 for short range damage bursts. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 步兵性价比极高：它那门大型AC/5自动炮和三门中型激光对如此尺寸的机甲而言是相当不错的武器，而且还设法装下了一具SRM-4用于近程伤害爆发。 特性：易于维护 投放费用倍率：1.03

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Alpha configuration of the Trooper OmniMech drops the LRM-15 launcher to instead add a five jump jets and an ER Small Laser. Quirk: Accurate Weapon - AC Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 步兵全向机甲的Alpha配置拆掉LRM-15发射器，改为加装五具跳跃推进器和一门增程小型激光。 特性：精准武器 - 自动炮 投放费用倍率：1.09 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The H loadout is focused on close to medium range fights, mounting a massive Ultra AC/20 and a Heavy Large Laser as the main damage dealers. A Heavy Medium Laser provides some extra cover if needed, while an AMS will intercept any incoming missiles. Quirk: Accurate Weapon - AC Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: H载荷专注中近距离战斗，装一门庞大的超级AC/20和一门重型大型激光作为主要伤害来源，另有一门重型中型激光在需要时提供额外掩护，一套反导弹系统则拦截来袭导弹。 特性：精准武器 - 自动炮 投放费用倍率：1.09 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The primary configuration of the Trooper uses an Ultra AC/10 in each arm as the main sources of damage, while two ER Medium Lasers and a LRM-15 launcher can be called on as needed. Four tons of autocannon ammunition and two tons of LRM missiles ensures the 'Mech can stand its ground without haveing to re-arm very often. Quirk: Accurate Weapon - AC Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 士兵的默认配置在每条手臂上各装一门超级AC/10作为主要伤害来源，另有两门增程中型激光与一具LRM-15发射器可按需调用。四吨自动炮弹药与两吨LRM导弹，让这台机甲无需频繁补充弹药就能守住阵地。 特性：精准武器（自动炮） 投放费用倍率：1.09 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The TS-P1's weaponry isn't very impressive, but is adequate for a 40-ton 'Mech. Two Medium Lasers and a Stream SRM-2 deal most of the external damage, while two Machine Guns can shred an opponents internals once the armor is breached. Six jump jets improves the mobility enough to compensate for its 240 standard fusion core. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.02
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: TS-P1 的武器配置谈不上惊艳，但对一具 40 吨的机甲而言已算够用。两门中型激光和一具连发 SRM-2 造成大部分外部伤害，而两挺机枪能在敌方装甲被击穿后撕碎其内部结构。六具跳跃推进器带来的机动性足以弥补 240 标准聚变核心的不足。 特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1.02

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Tsunami relies on its 400 XL fusion engine combined with a MASC to reach speeds such that it will surprise its enemies, enabling a flanking maneuver. Once the 'Mech is positioned for a strike, its ER PPC and five Medium Pulse Lasers can easily chew through any side or rear armor. The cooling is handled by 11 double heat sinks. Quirk: Integrated Adv. AMS Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Tsunami依靠其400 XL聚变引擎与MASC的配合，达到足以令敌人措手不及的速度，从而实现侧翼包抄。一旦机甲占好攻击位置，它的增程粒子炮和五门中型脉冲激光便能轻易撕开任何侧面或后方装甲。散热由11台双散热器负责。 特性：集成先进反导弹系统 投放费用倍率：1.14

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Envirosealed unarmored exoskeleton. Clearly unsuitable for combat, but desperate times call for desperate measures, and people had attempted to swarm mechs in exoskeletons with laser cutters and industrial drills. Quirk: Exoskeleton Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.8832 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 环境密封的无装甲外骨骼。显然不适合战斗，但非常时期需用非常手段，人们曾试图用装有激光切割器和工业钻头的外骨骼蜂拥攀附机甲。 特性：外骨骼 投放费用倍率：0.8832 可安装全向单位，可进行近战，可蜂拥攀附。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Designed for fighting Inner Sphere forces, the Turkina C is optimised for Urban combat. An LB-X Autocannon/20 and twin Large Pulse Lasers can open up holes in enemy 'Mechs, while the Streak SRM-6 and paired Medium Pulse Lasers exploit them. Paired Anti-Personnel Pods, Machine Guns, and Flamers discourage conventional forces from closing. An Active Probe finds most hidden units, ensuring the MechWarrior is rarely surprised. Quirk: Aerial Assault Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Turkina C 为对抗内层星域部队而设计，并针对城市战进行了优化。一门 LB-X 自动炮/20 与双联大型脉冲激光能在敌方机甲上撕开缺口，连发 SRM-6 和两门中型脉冲激光则趁机扩大战果。成对的反人员吊舱、机枪和火焰喷射器可阻止常规部队靠近。一具主动探测器能发现大多数隐蔽单位，使机甲战士极少遭遇突袭。 特性：空中突击 投放费用倍率：1.18 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Turkina D is armed with 4 ATM 12s. Ten tons of ammunition allow it to make use of the flexibility of Advanced Tactical Missile technology. A pair of ER Medium Lasers provide backup. Quirk: Aerial Assault Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Turkina D 装备 4 具 ATM 12。十吨弹药使它得以充分发挥先进战术导弹技术的灵活性。一对增程中型激光则作为辅助火力。 特性：空中突击 投放费用倍率：1.18 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Each arm of this Turkina configuration carries an ER Large Laser, LB 2-X, and an LB 5-X, plus a ton of ammunition for each autocannon. These are supplemented by an LRM-5 in each side torso and a center torso mounted Medium Pulse Laser. Sixteen double heat sinks are carried as well. Quirk: Aerial Assault Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该 Turkina 配置的每条手臂各装一门增程大型激光、一门 LB 2-X 和一门 LB 5-X，并为每门自动炮配备一吨弹药。此外，每个侧躯干各有一具 LRM-5，中央躯干装有一门中型脉冲激光，另配备十六具双散热器。 特性：空中突击 投放费用倍率：1.18 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The MC/A loadout was created as part of the 'Master Creation' project, an attempt to have the best warriors create their ideal configurations. The MC/A combines four LBX, two of them being AC/10 and two AC/2, together with two ER Large Lasers as the main damage dealers. A Medium Pulse Laser and LRM-5 can be used if some extra punch is needed. Quirk: Easy to Pilot Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: MC/A载荷是“大师之作”项目的产物，该项目试图让最优秀的战士打造他们理想的配置。MC/A把四门LBX——其中两门AC/10、两门AC/2——与两门增程大型激光组合为主要伤害来源，需要额外打击力时还可动用一门中型脉冲激光和一具LRM-5。 特性：易于驾驶 投放费用倍率：1.18 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The MC/J loadout was created as part of the 'Master Creation' project, an attempt to have the best warriors create their ideal configurations. The MC/J is very similar to the MC/A, as it keeps the weapons the same: two LBX AC/10, two LBX AC/2, two ER Large Lasers, one Medium Pulse Laser and one LRM-5. But by dropping some armor and converting the chassis to Endo Steel, the space for three Jump Jets were freed. Quirk: Aerial Assault Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: MC/J 配置是“大师之作”项目的产物，该项目旨在让最优秀的战士打造自己理想的配置。MC/J 与 MC/A 非常相似，武器完全相同：两门 LBX AC/10、两门 LBX AC/2、两门增程大型激光、一门中型脉冲激光和一具 LRM-5。但通过削减部分装甲并将底盘改为内骨架，它腾出了安装三个跳跃推进器的空间。 特性：空中突击 投放费用倍率：1.18 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The MC/W loadout was created as part of the 'Master Creation' project, an attempt to have the best warriors create their ideal configurations. The MC/W replaces the two LBX AC/2 from the /A and /J with two Ultra AC/2 and the ER Large Lasers with ER PPC. The rest of the configuration is kept very similar. Quirk: Easy to Pilot Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: MC/W配置是"大师创造"计划的产物，该计划旨在让最优秀的战士打造自己理想的配置。MC/W把/A与/J配置上的两门LBX AC/2换成两门超级自动炮AC/2，并把增程大型激光换成增程粒子炮，其余配置则大致保持不变。 特性：易于驾驶 投放费用倍率：1.18 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The X-B configuration is generally only used during batchalls, and is therefore very rare to ever been seen outside Clan occupied territory. It mounts twin Ultra AC/20 for impressive close range firepower, together with two ER Large Lasers for hitting targets further away. Finally it also has one SRM-4 and one LRM-5 missile launcher. Quirk: Aerial Assault Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: X-B 配置通常只在竞价决斗中使用，因此在部族占领区之外极难得见。它装有两门 Ultra AC/20，近距离火力惊人，并配有两门增程大型激光用于打击更远处的目标。最后，它还装有一具 SRM-4 和一具 LRM-5 导弹发射器。 特性：空中突击 投放费用倍率：1.18 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Undine battle armor was created by Clan Goliath Scorpion as a combat upgrade to the original \"water elementals,\" the underwater exoskeletons that inspired Clan Wolf's Elemental battle armor. This Undine version replaces the UMU with standard Elementals JJs, while retaining its signature LRM/T launcher. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.93 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Undine 战斗装甲由歌利亚蝎族打造，是对最初“水元素”的作战升级——正是那些水下外骨骼启发了狼族的元素战斗装甲。这一 Undine 版本以标准的元素跳跃推进器取代了 UMU，同时保留了其标志性的 LRM/T 发射器。 特性：改进通讯 投放费用倍率：0.93 可搭载全向单位，可近战，可攀附攻击。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Complete with a light bar, the K-9 is an UrbanMech refitted for use by a planetary police department. The standard variant's AC/10 is swapped for a UAC/5 and the left arm small laser is updated to a large laser, with two small lasers mounted in the center torso. While its ground speed remains unchanged, the K-9's heavier weapons loadout is made possible through the use of an endo steel chassis and mounting 10 double heat sinks. Quirk: 360° Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: K-9 配有警灯条，是由城市机甲改装、供行星警察部门使用的机型。标准型号的 AC/10 被换成 UAC/5，左臂的小型激光升级为大型激光，中央躯干则安装了两门小型激光。虽然地面速度保持不变，但 K-9 之所以能搭载更重的武器配置，得益于采用内骨架底盘并安装10个双散热器。 特性：360°躯干旋转 投放费用倍率：0.99 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The UM-R100 'SuburbanMech' adapts the traditional UrbanMech R60 into an energy weapon platform for higher performance. Because its weapons aren't limited by ammunition concerns, the R100 is better-suited to longer engagements. Quirk: 360° Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.01 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: UM-R100“郊区机甲”把传统的垃圾佬R60改造成性能更高的能量武器平台。由于武器不受弹药限制，R100更适合较长时间的交战。 特性：360° 躯干旋转 投放费用倍率：1.01 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This is the customized Urbie of Dennis Franken, famed leader of mercenary outfit Franken's Frankers, with a Large Laser in the left arm and a PPC in the right, and 12 heat sinks for cooling. Quirk: 360° Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是雇佣兵部队“弗兰肯的弗兰克们”著名首领丹尼斯·弗兰肯的定制垃圾佬，左臂一门大型激光，右臂一门粒子炮，另有12个散热器降温。 特性：360° 躯干旋转 投放费用倍率：0.99 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上
城市机甲 UM-R60 '丹尼斯·弗兰肯'

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Don't let the stubby 'Urbie' fool you, it may look like a walking trash can, but it can mount heavy armor and a grown-up-sized Autocannon. R60s aren't known for their speed, but they are very useful if you can draw the enemy into their firing range. Quirk: 360° Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.97 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 别被矮胖的"都市"骗了，它也许看起来像个会走路的垃圾桶，却能装备厚重装甲和成人尺寸的自动炮。R60 不以速度著称，但如果你能把敌人引到它的射程内，它们就非常有用。 特质：360° 躯干旋转 投放费用倍率：0.97 臂部驱动器限制：左上臂、右上臂

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Desperate to find any proper use of their UrbanMechs, two Improved AC/2 replaced the single AC/10 on the UM-R60-CE. The small Laser was further replaced by an Improved Large Laser, at the cost of dropping one no longer needed Heat Sink and half a ton of armor. Quirk: 360° Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.97 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 为了给手中的 UrbanMech 找到像样的用途，UM-R60-CE 上的单门 AC/10 被两门改进型 AC/2 取代。小型激光也被改进型大型激光替换，代价是拆掉一具不再需要的散热器以及半吨装甲。 特性：360°躯干旋转 投放费用倍率：0.97 手臂驱动器限制：左臂上部、右臂上部

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The R60R upgrade kit removes the Small Laser and one heat sink from the R60 to instead fit C.A.S.E. protection for the ammunition and a C3 Slave computer. Quirk: 360° Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.97 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: R60R 升级套件拆除了 R60 的小型激光和一具散热器，改为安装弹药的 C.A.S.E. 防护以及一台 C3 从属计算机。 特性：360°躯干旋转 投放费用倍率：0.97 手臂驱动器限制：左臂上部、右臂上部

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Street Cleaner is an UrbanMech utilized by a member of Philip Capet's Solaris VII stable Capellan Mafia. The 'Street Cleaner' is very similar to the standard UrbanMech, featuring an AC/10, supported by a small laser and jump jets. Quirk: 360° Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 街头清道夫是菲利普·卡佩在索拉里斯VII的卡佩兰黑手党战团成员所使用的都市机甲。它与标准型都市机甲极为相似，装备一门AC/10，并辅以一门小型激光和跳跃推进器。 特性：360°躯干旋转 投放费用倍率：0.99 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Ursus 1 is a flexible defender that mounts a variety of weapons to engage enemies at all ranges. Its weakness is in its lack of long-range capability, though the ER Large Laser and LRM-10 are respectable for a 'Mech its size. For closer work, it uses two ER Medium Lasers, two Medium Pulse Lasers, and a SRM-6 launcher. This blistering hail of weapons fire is generally effective for an Inner Sphere heavy 'Mech, so the Ursus compares favorably to the designs that it is expected to stand up against. Quirk: Distracting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 乌尔苏斯1是一款灵活的防御型机甲，装备多种武器，可在各距离上与敌人交战。它的弱点在于缺乏远程能力，不过就其体型而言，增程大型激光和LRM-10已算相当不错。近距离作战时，它使用两门增程中型激光、两门中型脉冲激光和一具SRM-6发射器。这阵炽热的火力风暴对内层星域的重型机甲而言通常相当有效，因此乌尔苏斯与预期要对抗的那些设计相比毫不逊色。 特性：扰敌 投放费用倍率：1.1 手臂驱动器限制：右臂下部

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A nice heavily armored scout, not too bad. Probably best to keep it at range however, out of harm's range. But an easy mech to find parts for and keep running. Quirk: Land Air Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一台装甲厚重、表现不错的侦察机体，相当不赖。不过最好还是让它保持在远处，远离危险范围。它也是一台容易找到零件、便于维持运转的机甲。 特性：陆空机甲 投放费用倍率：0.99

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The -Q1 is an upgrade kit for the -QA, upgrading the Medium Laser to an Extended Range version and adds Artemis IV capabilities to the LRM-10 launcher. One extra ton of LRM missiles are added, as well as C.A.S.E. protection for all of the ammunition. This was all possible by switching to double heat sinks - allowing the 'Mech to drop one sink - and upgrading the chassis to use Endo Steel. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: -Q1是-QA的升级套件，把中型激光升级为增程版本，并为LRM-10发射器加装阿尔忒弥斯IV能力。它还增加一吨LRM导弹，并为所有弹药加装C.A.S.E.防护。这一切都通过改用双散热器（使机甲得以拆掉一个散热器）并把底盘升级为内骨架而实现。 特性：改进通讯 投放费用倍率：0.99 手臂驱动器限制：右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A nice heavily armored scout, not too bad. Probably best to keep it at range however, out of harm's range. But an easy mech to find parts for and keep running. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.97 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一台装甲厚重的侦察机甲，还不错。不过最好还是让它保持距离，别待在危险范围内。但它的零件好找，也容易维持运转。 特性：改进通讯 投放费用倍率：0.97 手臂驱动器限制：右臂下部

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A battlefield refit of the VLK-QA, the -QAR switches to use ten double heat sinks, allowing the addition of a C3 Slave computer. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.97 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: QAR是VLK-QA的战场改装型，改用十具双散热器，从而得以加装一台C3从属计算机。 特性：改进通讯 投放费用倍率：0.97 手臂驱动器限制：右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The QD Valkyrie is a major overhaul of the design debuting in 3049. The chassis has been re-engineered to use Endo Steel construction and the armor has been upgraded to Ferro-Fibrous with CASE. This allowed the variant to update the laser to a Sutel Precision Line Medium Pulse Laser and add an Artemis IV fire control system to the Devastator LRM-10. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: QD 女武神是该设计于 3049 年首次亮相的重大改进版本。底盘经过重新设计，改用内骨架结构，装甲也升级为带 CASE 的铁纤维。这让该变型得以把激光换成 Sutel Precision Line 中型脉冲激光，并为 Devastator LRM-10 加装 Artemis IV 火控系统。 特性：改进通讯 投放费用倍率：0.99 手臂驱动器限制：右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The QF model of the Valkyrie trades in the medium laser for a flamer, which allows the 'Mech to work in an incendiary role and also acts as an excellent deterrent to infantry attacks. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Valkyrie 的 QF 型号用火焰喷射器换掉了中型激光，使该机甲能够执行纵火任务，同时对步兵的进攻也是极佳的威慑。 特性：改进通讯 投放费用倍率：0.99 手臂驱动器限制：右臂下部

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A custom Clan technology conversion of the Valkyrie, the -QK was originally fielded by the Kell Hounds mercenary band. It provides three ER Medium Lasers in the right arm and one LRM with Artemis IV in the left arm. In the head a C3 Slave computer is mounted. The engine is a 150 XL core and the armor has been upgraded to ferro-fibrous. The 'Mech uses ten double heat sinks to handle the produced heat. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: -QK 变型是对 Valkyrie 进行部族技术改装的定制机，最初由凯尔猎犬雇佣兵团使用。它在右臂装有三门中型增程激光，左臂装有一具配备 Artemis IV 的 LRM。头部安装了一台 C3 从属计算机。引擎为 150 XL 核心，装甲已升级为铁纤维。该机甲使用十具双散热器来处理产生的热量。 特性：改进通讯 投放费用倍率：1.05 手臂驱动器限制：右臂下部

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Vanguard mounts an LB 5-X AC in each side torso alongside a left-torso mounted ER PPC, for close range support a trio of Streak SRM-4 are carried in the arms. Two tons each of LBX and Streak ammunition provide good field endurance. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.13 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Vanguard在每个侧躯干各装备一门LB 5-X AC，左躯干另装有一门增程粒子炮；近距离火力支援则由双臂上的三具连发SRM-4负责。LBX弹药与连发弹药各两吨，赋予它出色的战场持续作战能力。 特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：1.13 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Vapor Eagle features an eclectic and close-ranged weapons load-out, mounting a Large Pulse Laser in its right arm, supported by a single Machine Gun, two Streak SRM-2s and three Medium Pulse Lasers split between its side torsos and rounded out by a trio of Machine Guns in a handgun shaped housing in the left arm. The addition of a Targeting Computer makes its firepower even more deadly as long as it can get its weapons into range. Eleven Double Heat Sinks, half a ton of machine gun ammunition and one Streak missiles are more than adequate for the average Clan trial. Quirk: Nimble Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 蒸汽鹰采用杂而近距的武器载荷：右臂一门大型脉冲激光，辅以一挺机枪、两具连发SRM-2和三门中型脉冲激光分装两侧躯干，左臂一个手枪形外壳内则有三挺机枪。加装一台瞄准计算机后，只要能把武器带入射程，其火力就更为致命。十一个双散热器、半吨机枪弹药和一吨连发导弹弹药对一般的部族试炼而言绰绰有余。 特性：灵巧 投放费用倍率：1.09

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This variant of the Vapor Eagle removes two of the Medium Pulse Lasers, both Streak Missile pods, and the Large Pulse Laser as well as one of the 'Mechs double heat sinks in exchange for an Ultra Autocannon/10. Mounted in an over the shoulder arrangement like the venerable Shadow Hawk, the weapon fires at twice the rate of a standard Autocannon/10 and carries enough ammunition to continuously fire at its maximum rate of fire for over a minute and a half. Quirk: Nimble Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 蒸汽鹰的这一变型拆掉两门中型脉冲激光、两具连发导弹巢和大型脉冲激光，以及机甲的一个双散热器，换来一门超级AC/10。该武器以类似古老影子鹰的越肩布置安装，射速是标准自动炮/10的两倍，并带足量弹药可连续以最高射速射击一分半以上。 特性：灵巧 投放费用倍率：1.09

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This variant carries three Machine Guns in the left arm, three Medium Pulse Lasers in the right arm, supported by a Machine Gun in the left torso and a Medium Pulse Laser in the right torso. It also retains the Targeting Computer. Long range fire is provided by an LRM-20 with an Artemis IV FCS. Quirk: Nimble Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 此变型左臂装三挺机枪，右臂三门中型脉冲激光，左躯干一挺机枪和右躯干一门中型脉冲激光支援，并保留瞄准计算机。远程火力由一具带阿尔忒弥斯IV火控系统的LRM-20提供。 特性：灵巧 投放费用倍率：1.09 手臂驱动器限制：右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This version keeps the arm weapons and targeting computer of the base model, but in place of the Large Pulse Laser are an Ultra AC/2 in each side torso with a ton of ammunition for each cannon. Quirk: Nimble Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 此版本保留了基础型的臂部武器与瞄准计算机，但以两侧躯干各一门Ultra AC/2取代了大型脉冲激光，并为每门自动炮配备一吨弹药。 特性：灵巧 投放费用倍率：1.09

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A customized variant of the Vapor Eagle. The Rival carries 3 Heavy Machine Guns in its left arm, while a single ER PPC is mounted in the right arm. An ATM 9s and three ton of ATM ammo is in the right torso mounted with MASC. Quirk: Aerial Assault Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是雾鹰的定制变型。“对手”在左臂装有3挺重型机枪，右臂则挂载1门增程粒子炮；右躯干内装1具ATM 9与3吨ATM弹药，并与MASC一同安装。 <特性：空降突击 <投放费用倍率：1.11

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The SDR-10K of the Venom is similar in armament to the -9K, but upgrades to use an Endo Steel chassis and double heat sinks. The saved space is used to almost double the amount of armor mounted on the 'Mech. Quirk: Nimble Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Venom的SDR-10K在武器配置上与-9K相似，但升级为使用内骨架底盘和双散热器。节省下来的空间用于将机甲搭载的装甲量几乎提高一倍。 特性：灵巧 投放费用倍率：1.05

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 9KA variant of the Venom is a simple modification that intends to increase the 'Mech's protection at the cost of firepower. Introduced in 3056, it does this by removing one of the medium pulse lasers and replacing it with an additional two tons of armor, increasing the total armor protection to five and a half tons. Quirk: Nimble Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 毒液9KA是一种简单的改型，意在牺牲火力以提升机甲防护。它于3056年问世，做法是拆除一门中型脉冲激光，代之以额外两吨装甲，使总装甲防护提升到五吨半。 特性：灵活 投放费用倍率：1.05

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 9KB variant of the Venom is intended to increase both the 'Mech's protection and its anti-infantry capabilities. This is done by removing one of the medium pulse lasers and two jumps jets and replacing them with a single machine gun with a half ton of ammunition and a heat sink. The remaining ton has been used to increase the 'Mech's armor. Quirk: Nimble Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Venom 的 9KB 变型旨在同时提升机甲的防护能力与反步兵能力。为此拆除了一门中型脉冲激光和两台跳跃推进器，换成一挺机枪（配半吨弹药）和一台散热器。余下的一吨则用于增加机甲装甲。 特性：灵巧 投放费用倍率：1.05

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The personal command 'Mech of General Rudolph Chapman, this 80 ton Victor is a heavily modified machine. Provided with some of the latest technology by NAIS, it is a walking testbed of the new and recovered technologies emerging from the Inner Sphere's intellectual hub Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是鲁道夫·查普曼将军的专属指挥机甲。这台 80 吨的 Victor 经过大幅改装，由 NAIS 提供了一部分最新技术，堪称内层星域学术中枢不断涌现的新技术与复原技术的行走试验台。 特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1.16 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上
胜利者 VTR-9A“鲁道夫·查普曼”

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A Clan-tech retrofit of SLDF VTR-9B Victors intended for second-line and solahma troops, this variant swaps the large bore autocannon for a Gauss Rifle, the SRM rack for an advanced Streak SRM-4 and standard Medium Lasers for paired ER Medium Lasers. Unlike the similarly armed 9D and 9K variants, lighter Clan weaponry allows this swap without the need to utilize an Endo Steel chassis and still leaves the refit two ton under weight. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.12 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这一变型是为二线与索拉赫马部队准备的SLDF VTR-9B维克托的部族技术改装版，它把大口径自动炮换成高斯步枪、把SRM发射巢换成先进的连发SRM-4，并把标准中型激光换成成对的增程中型激光。与武装相似的9D和9K变型不同，更轻的部族武器使这次更换无需采用内骨架底盘，而且还让改装后仍有两吨的重量余量。 特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1.12 手臂驱动器限制：右上

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This custom Victor was used by SLDF Major General Carlos Kataga. It upgrades the engine to a 320 XL, and the Chassis to Endo Steel. This allowed for a 30% increase in overall armor, which was rebalanced towards the front. The AC/20 was upgraded to a Gauss Rifle and the two Medium Lasers and SRM 4 were replaced with Large Pulse Lasers, two Medium Lasers, and a Beagle Active Probe. The heat sinks were upgraded to double strength. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这台定制 Victor 由 SLDF 少将卡洛斯·卡塔加使用。它将引擎升级为 320 XL，底盘升级为内骨架，这使整体装甲增加了 30%，并被重新平衡至正面。AC/20 升级为高斯步枪，两门中型激光和 SRM 4 则被替换为大型脉冲激光、两门中型激光和一部 Beagle 主动探测器。散热器也升级为双倍散热能力。 特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1.18 手臂驱动器限制：右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The custom Victor used by Tai-sho Li Dok To, this variant removed all the standard weapons and replaced them with a single LRM-15 mounted in the left torso and ten Medium Lasers carried in the 'Mech's right arm, greatly reducing ammo dependency. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是大将 Li Dok To 使用的定制 Victor，该变型拆除了全部标准武器，代之以左躯干的一具 LRM-15 与机甲右臂上的十门中型激光，大幅降低了对弹药的依赖。 特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1.16 手臂驱动器限制：右臂下部

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Rocky is a customized Victor VTR-9B, used by the leader of the Pirate band 'The Johnsons'. It replaces the stock AC/20 and SRM-4 with a PPC, two SRM-6 and two more medium lasers. The 'Mech also has increased armor and cooling compared to the original. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Rocky 是一台经过改装的 Victor VTR-9B，为海盗团伙“约翰逊帮”的首领所用。它以一门粒子炮、两具 SRM-6 和两门额外的中型激光取代了原有的 AC/20 和 SRM-4。与原型相比，该机甲的装甲与散热能力都有所提升。 特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1.14 手臂驱动器限制：右下臂

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Used by the 5th Benjamin Regulars commander on Royal during the War of Davion Succession, this Victor-9B variant removes the AC/20 and replaces it with an AC/10 and two more tons of ammo. The Medium Lasers have been removed and replaced with three Medium Pulse Lasers. The Victor variant is equipped with ten Double Heat sinks, and the remaining tonnage has been devoted to additional armor. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在戴维恩继承战争期间的罗亚尔之战中，这台Victor-9B变型由第五本杰明常规团的指挥官使用。它拆除了AC/20，换装一门AC/10和额外两吨弹药。中型激光被拆除，替换为三门中型脉冲激光。该维克托变型配备十台双散热器，剩余吨位全部用于增加装甲。 特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1.16 手臂驱动器限制：右臂上部

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Victor VTR-9B-CE replaces the AC/20 with a Clan Early LBX/20 and 4 tons of ammunition, and the SRM-4 launcher with an Improved SRM-6. Everything else is kept the same as on the original Victor VTR-9B. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.12 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 维克多 VTR-9B-CE 以一门部族早期型 LBX/20 和 4 吨弹药替换了 AC/20，并以一具改进型 SRM-6 替换了 SRM-4 发射器。其余部分与原版维克多 VTR-9B 保持一致。 特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1.12 手臂驱动器限制：右上

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An alternative version of the standard VTR-9B, replacing 5 heat sinks with 2 more Medium Lasers, CASE in the torsos and a C3 slave system. Its intended use is in low risk environments with high cooling capacity or where cooling trucks are available. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.12 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是标准VTR-9B的另一种版本，以2门额外中型激光、躯干内的CASE和一套C3从机系统取代5个散热器。它的预期用途是在冷却能力充足或可调用冷却车的低风险环境中作战。 特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1.12 手臂驱动器限制：右上

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An upgrade using Star League technology, the 9D replaces the Autocannon/20 with a Gauss Rifle which can do serious damage at much greater ranges. The 'Mech also carries two Medium Pulse Lasers and a SRM-4 launcher for close combat. In order to make these changes possible, the 9D is built on an Endo Steel chassis. With the weight saved the 'Mech also carries an additional ton of armor. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 9D是一次采用星际联盟技术的升级，以一门高斯步枪取代自动炮/20，能在远得多的距离上造成严重伤害。该机甲还带两门中型脉冲激光和一具SRM-4发射器用于近战。为实现这些改动，9D建在内骨架底盘上；省下的重量还让它多带一吨装甲。 特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1.14 手臂驱动器限制：右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A further upgrade, the VTR-9D-2 replaces the Gauss Rifle of the VTR-9D with a LB 20-X AC and the SRM4 with its Streak equivalent. To be able to accommodate the increased weight, the 15 single heat sinks have been replaced by 10 double. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: VTR-9D-2 是进一步升级的型号，以一门 LB 20-X 自动炮取代了 VTR-9D 的高斯步枪，并将 SRM4 更换为其连发型号。为承受增加的重量，15 具单散热器已被 10 具双散热器取代。 特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1.14 手臂驱动器限制：右下臂

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The VTR-9Db replaces the three external heat sinks of the VTR-9D with two small lasers and extra medium pulse laser, increasing its medium to close range arsenal. The increased heat and reduced cooling capacity is addressed by converting the 'Mech to use double heat sinks. A bit more added armor and the removal of the CASE in the right torso finishes up the design changes. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: VTR-9Db 以两门小型激光和一门额外的中型脉冲激光，取代了 VTR-9D 的三具外置散热器，增强了其中近距离火力。为应对增加的热量与降低的散热能力，该机甲改用双散热器。再稍加一点装甲，并拆除右躯干的 CASE，设计改动便告完成。 特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1.14 手臂驱动器限制：右下臂

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The -9G is a conversion of the traditional Victor to use Clan grade equipment, with even the armor switched to use the more weight efficient Clan Ferro-Fibrous. Its weapons have been replaced by a Gauss Rifle, two Medium Pulse Lasers and a Stream SRM-4. Three tons of Gauss ammunition and one ton of Streak SRM missiles are available. The 'Mech also carries a targeting computer, further enhancing the performance of its weapons. The -9G was originally created by and mostly seen with the Grey Death Legion mercenaries. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.2 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: -9G是将传统维克托改装为使用部族级装备的型号，连装甲也换成了重量效率更高的部族铁纤维。它的武器被替换为一门高斯步枪、两门中型脉冲激光和一具Stream SRM-4。它可携带三个吨位的高斯弹药和一个吨位的连发SRM导弹。该机甲还搭载了一台瞄准计算机，进一步提升其武器性能。-9G最初由灰死军团雇佣兵打造，也主要出现在他们手中。 特性：坚固耐用 投放费用倍率：1.2 手臂驱动器限制：右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The -9P variant drops the VTR-9B's AC/20 and one medium laser for an AC/10 and larger SRM-6 rack while freeing up the weight to carry a massive assault claymore in its left arm. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.12 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 9P改型舍弃了VTR-9B的AC/20和一门中型激光，换成一门AC/10与更大的SRM-6发射槽，同时腾出重量，在左臂携带一把巨大的突击型阔剑。 特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1.12 手臂驱动器限制：右上

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Victor VTR-9RC fits an ER PPC, two Large and three Medium Pulse Lasers by using a weight saving 320 XL engine. A Guardian ECM is also mounted in the right torso. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Victor VTR-9RC 通过采用减重的 320 XL 引擎，得以装下一具增程粒子炮、两具大型激光和三具中型脉冲激光。右躯干还搭载了一具 Guardian 电子对抗套件。 特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1.14 手臂驱动器限制：左上臂、右上臂

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The VTR-9SI is a prototype design, first piloted by Col. Alexander Knight. A combination of the 9K Endo-Steel structure with the 9S AC/20, replacing the SRM-launcher with even more lasers. The addition of a Guardian ECM system and Triple-Strength Myomer further enhanced the combat capabilities. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: VTR-9SI是一款原型设计，首度由Alexander Knight上校驾驶。它结合了9K的内骨架结构与9S的AC/20，并以更多激光取代了SRM发射器。Guardian电子对抗系统与三倍强度肌纤维的加入进一步提升了作战能力。 特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1.16 手臂驱动器限制：右上
胜利者 VTR-9SI '亚历山大·奈特'

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Piloted by Henrik Cole and his grandfather, who attempted to overthrow the then head of House Cole but failed and was forced to flee quickly. Basilisk was built upon an XL engine and is armed with two medium lasers in the left arm, three Streak SRM-2s in the left torso (with two tons of reloads), two LB 10-X AC mounted in the right arm (with two tons of reloads), and a Guardian ECM mounted in the right torso. The 'Mech is equipped with three jump jets, one in each leg along with one in the center torso. Thirteen double heat sinks keep the 'Mech cold. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 由享里克·科尔与其祖父驾驶；祖父曾试图推翻当时的科尔家族首领，但失败并被迫迅速逃亡。蛇怪建在一台XL引擎之上，左臂装两门中型激光，左躯干三具连发SRM-2（配两吨再装填弹药），右臂两门LB 10-X自动炮（配两吨再装填弹药），右躯干一套守护者电子对抗套件。该机甲配有三具跳跃推进器——每条腿各一具，中央躯干一具。十三个双散热器让机甲保持低温。 特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1.16 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Based on the 9K variant, the VTR-C was built to incorporate a C3 slave unit, allowing the 'Mech to work as part of a C3 lance. In order to do this, a heat sink was removed. Otherwise, this variant of the Victor is identical to the 9K model. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: VTR-C 以 9K 改型为基础，加入了一台 C3 从属单元，使该机甲能够作为 C3 小队的一员协同作战。为此拆除了一台散热器。除此之外，这款 Victor 改型与 9K 型号完全相同。 特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1.14 手臂驱动器限制：右下臂

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 'Dragon Slayer' mounts a 330-rated XL Engine, Endo Steel and Double Heat Sinks to support a weapons array consisting of a Gauss Rifle and PPC in its right and left arms respectively and twin Medium Pulse Lasers in the right torso and SRM-6 in the left. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: “屠龙者”搭载 330 额定的 XL引擎、内骨架与双散热器，以支撑其武器阵列：右臂高斯步枪、左臂粒子炮，右躯干双联中型脉冲激光，左躯干 SRM-6。 特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1.16 手臂驱动器限制：右臂上部

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Viking began production shortly after the Beowulf in a joint effort by the Free Rasalhague Republic and ComStar. The 'Mech is intended to take over in the role that has been traditionally filled by the Bombardier. Quirk: Multi Trac Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 维京在贝奥武夫之后不久由自由拉萨尔哈格共和国与康星联合投产。这台机甲意在接替传统上由轰炸机担任的角色。 特质：多重追踪 投放费用倍率：1.16 臂部驱动器限制：左上臂、右上臂

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Classified Quirk: Multi Trac Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 机密 特性：多目标追踪 投放费用倍率：1.1 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A mercenary refit of the -1R, replacing all weapons with acquired clan technology. Rumours originally place the redesign with the Kell Hounds, but the variant can be find with all sorts of mercenary outfits by now. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是雇佣兵对-1R的改装，以取得的部族技术替换全部武器。最初的传闻把这套重新设计归于凯尔猎犬，但如今各种雇佣兵部队都能见到该变型。 特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1.03 手臂驱动器限制：右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 1P retains the left-torso LRM-5 and head-mounted medium laser, dropping the small laser and PPC for a large laser in the right arm and a medium hatchet in the left. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.01 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 1P 保留了左躯干的 LRM-5 和头部的中型激光，去掉小型激光和 PPC，在右臂换装大型激光，左臂则加装一把中型战斧。 特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1.01 手臂驱动器限制：右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The personal Vindicator of MechWarrior Michael Jones and his father before him, St. Ives Blue is easily recognizable for the large silver trumpet painted on its chest and its replacement of the PPC with a Large Laser and LRM-5 with an LRM-10 rack. After his unit seceded to the St. Ives Compact in the wake of the Fourth Succession War the newly formed St. Ives Military Command would ultimately use Jones' altered weapons array as the basis for the VND-1SIC variant. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: St. Ives Blue 是机甲战士迈克尔·琼斯及其父亲的专属 Vindicator，它极易辨认——胸口绘有一支巨大的银色小号，并以大型激光取代了粒子炮、以 LRM-10 发射架取代了 LRM-5。在第四次继承战争之后，琼斯所在部队脱离出去并加入圣艾夫斯协约，新成立的圣艾夫斯军事指挥部最终以琼斯改动过的武器配置为基础，开发出了 VND-1SIC 变型机。 特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1.03 手臂驱动器限制：右下臂
维护者 VND-1R '圣艾夫斯蓝'

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Made in 3020, this customized Vindicator used by Major Choung Vong, in the Third Succession War, moved the head-mounted medium laser to the right arm, simply making the cockpit roomier for its brutally effective, but rather rotund pilot. It is by all accounts the same as the original 1R, retaining all its capabilities. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这台定制版Vindicator制造于3020年，由第三次继承战争中的周翁少校使用。它将头部的激光移至右臂，只是为了让驾驶舱更宽敞一些，好容纳这位作战凶狠高效、却身形圆胖的飞行员。除此之外，它与最初的1R完全相同，保留了全部性能。 特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1.05 手臂驱动器限制：右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A battlefield refit of the -1R, reducing its weaponry to just the PPC and LRM-5 launcher to be able to fit C.A.S.E. protection and a C3 slave unit. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.01 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是-1R的野战改装：把武器削减到仅剩粒子炮和LRM-5发射器，以便装下C.A.S.E.防护和一台C3从机。 特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1.01 手臂驱动器限制：右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A Clan refit of the Vindicator, replacing its Inner Sphere inferior weapons with three ER Medium Lasers, one ER PPC and one Medium Pulse Laser. In typical Clan fashion, the -2C does suffer from insufficient cooling. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是辩护者的部族改装，以内层星域劣等武器换取三门增程中型激光、一门增程粒子炮和一门中型脉冲激光。以典型的部族风格，-2C确实受困于冷却不足。 特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1.09 手臂驱动器限制：右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A rebuild of the -1R with more powerful technology, the Vindicator VND-2R replaces the PPC with an Extended Range version and upgrades the LRM launcher to 15 Artemis IV-enabled tubes. To free the needed weight capacity for the upgrades the chassis uses a Endo Steel structure, the armor to Ferro-Fibrous and the small laser was dropped. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为 -1R 采用更强大技术的重建版本，Vindicator VND-2R 以增程型取代了粒子炮，并将 LRM 发射器升级为 15 管、带 Artemis IV 的型号。为腾出升级所需的重量，机体改用内骨架结构，装甲换成铁纤维，同时取消了小型激光。 特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1.03 手臂驱动器限制：右臂下部

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An uncommon refit, the Vindicator 2V is often seen in the hands of Mercenaries who lack the ability to replace or repair the expensive PPC. Powered by the standard 180 engine, the Vindicator 2V swaps the PPC for an AC/5 with 2 tons of ammo. The removal of 5 heat sinks, allows a second Medium Laser to be mounted alongside an extra ton of armor. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.01 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为一种不常见的改装，复仇者2V常出现在无力更换或修理昂贵粒子炮的雇佣兵手中。该机由标准180引擎驱动，把粒子炮换成一门AC/5并配2吨弹药。拆除5台散热器后，得以加装第二门中型激光以及额外一吨装甲。 特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1.01 手臂驱动器限制：右臂下部

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An uncommon refit, the Vindicator 2X is often seen in the hands of Mercenaries who lack the ability to replace or repair the expensive PPC. Powered by the standard 180 engine, the Vindicator 2X swaps the PPC for an AC/10 with a single ton of ammo. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.01 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为一种不常见的改装型号，Vindicator 2X 常出现在无力更换或维修昂贵粒子炮的雇佣兵手中。该机由标准 180 引擎驱动，用一门 AC/10 搭配一吨弹药取代了粒子炮。 特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1.01 手臂驱动器限制：右下臂

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 5L variant is a more basic upgrade than the 4L and represents Ceres' attempt to produce a close-combat 'Mech superior to the FS9-0 Firestarter. Introduced in 3060 the 5L uses a standard engine, armor, and structure. The changes and advancements come in the weapons and the addition of a TSM system. The 'Mech's new weapons include an ER PPC, two ER medium lasers, two medium pulse lasers, a single Small Pulse Laser, and a small laser. This varied mix of energy weapons allows the MechWarrior piloting the 'Mech to balance their heat load to keep the TSM working at its optimum efficiency. In so doing, the Vindicator can deal a fair amount of damage with its Sword. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 5L变型是比4L更基础的升级方案，代表了Ceres试图打造一款优于FS9-0 Firestarter的近战机甲。5L于3060年推出，采用标准引擎、装甲与结构。变化与进步体现在武器上，并加装了TSM系统。机甲的新武器包括一门增程粒子炮、两门增程中型激光、两门中型脉冲激光、一门小型脉冲激光和一门小型激光。这种多样化的能量武器组合让驾驶机甲的机甲战士能够平衡热负荷，使TSM始终以最佳效率运作。如此一来，Vindicator便能以其佩剑造成相当可观的伤害。 特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1.03 手臂驱动器限制：右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Duncan Fisher once said the Butcher was the natural product of Solaris' sweaty and testosterone driven battles. Forged in the heat of battle and adorned with the remains of other Gladiator's Mechs. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 邓肯·费雪曾说，屠夫是索拉里斯那些汗水与高同驱动之战斗的自然产物——在战火中锻造，并以其他角斗士机甲的残骸为装饰。 特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1.05 手臂驱动器限制：右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: For similar reasons of its suboptimal but extensive armor layout, its brute-force primary armament of a pair of binary laser cannons was thermally inefficient but could be produced inhouse, whereas the originally planned ER PPCs were already growing scarce. The rest of the layout, three Medium Pulse Lasers, were still readily available in large quantities when originally designed. A 280 XL engine and four Jump Jets ensured that the 'Mech was mobile enough to quickly adapt on the battlefield, further helped by its extra strong communications suite. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 同样由于其欠佳但覆盖面广的装甲布局，它那套粗暴的双联激光炮主武器在热能上并不高效，却能自行生产——而原本计划的增程粒子炮当时已日渐稀缺。布局的其余部分，三门中型脉冲激光，在设计之初仍能大量获得。一台280 XL引擎和四具跳跃推进器确保该机甲足够机动，能在战场上迅速应变，其格外强大的通讯套件更助一臂之力。 特性：改进通讯 投放费用倍率：1.1

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: As the wars continued after the fall of the Star League, it became harder and harder to find the components to keep building the Viper. Eventually the Kallon Industries had to accept that it had no choice but start downgrading the design, eventually landing on the VP-5, an improvised Third Succession War-era downgrade with only standard components and lasers. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 星际联盟覆亡之后战事绵延不绝，要继续建造毒蛇所需的部件越来越难找到。最终卡隆工业不得不承认别无选择，只能开始对该设计进行降级，最后推出了VP-5——一款为第三次继承战争时期临时拼凑的降级型号，仅使用标准部件与激光。 特性：改进通讯 投放费用倍率：1.08

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Viper's main weapon is a massive LBX AC/10 in the right torso, with two tons of ammunition in the right torso. A Streak SRM-2 and Small Laser are available to deal with any enemies too close for the large autocannon. Quirk: Improved Jammer Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Viper 的主武器是右躯干内的一门巨型 LBX AC/10，右躯干内备有两吨弹药。对于距离过近、大型自动炮无从应对的敌人，则可使用一具连发 SRM-2 和一门小型激光。 特性：改进干扰器 投放费用倍率：1.1

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The E2 loadout mounts two Medium Pulse Lasers in the left arm together with three Small Pulse Lasers in the right. One ER Medium and one ER small laser act as secondary firepower. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Long Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: E2挂载在左臂装两门中型脉冲激光，右臂三门小型脉冲激光，另有一门增程中型和一门增程小型激光作为次要火力。 特性：改进瞄准 - 远程 投放费用倍率：1.03 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The F2 configuration of the Viper is focused on medium to close range engagements. Two ER Medium Laser provide longer range cover, while four SRM-4 and an ER Small Laser are used once the 'Mech has closed in on its enemies. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Long Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Viper 的 F2 配置侧重于中近距离交战。两门增程中型激光提供较远距离的火力掩护，而四具 SRM-4 和一门增程小型激光则在机甲逼近敌人后投入使用。 特性：改进瞄准 - 远程 投放费用倍率：1.03 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Introduced in 2940, the Viper is a 40-ton OmniMech that emphasizes speed and armor, with only 8.5 tons of podspace available for weapons. A 320-rated XL Engine powers the Viper and 8 Jump Jets are hardwired into the chassis, further improving the mobility. The Viper M-R (Medusa) is armed with a 6 ER Small Lasers and a Streak SRM-6. An AMS is mounted to counter incoming missiles. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Long Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 毒蛇于2940年推出，是一款40吨的全向机甲，强调速度与装甲，仅有8.5吨吊舱空间可用于武器。320级XL引擎为毒蛇提供动力，8具跳跃推进器则直接集成在机身上，进一步提升机动性。毒蛇M-R（美杜莎）装备6具增程小型激光和一具连发SRM-6，并装有AMS以拦截来袭导弹。 特性：改进瞄准（远程） 投放费用倍率：1.05 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A further adaption of the J configuration, the S loadout keeps the three ATM-3 launchers but exchanges the Micro Lasers with a single ER Medium Laser. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Long Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: S 配置是 J 配置的进一步改良，保留了三具 ATM-3 发射器，但把微型激光换成了一门增程中型激光。 特性：改进瞄准 - 远程 投放费用倍率：1.03 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The V configuration mounts all energy weapons, a total of five Pulse Lasers and two ER Lasers. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Long Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: V配置全部装能量武器，共五门脉冲激光和两门增程激光。 特性：改进瞄准 - 远程 投放费用倍率：1.03 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Heavily focused on very short range engagements, the W loadout mounts four SRM-4 launchers and two ER Medium Lasers. A head mounted ER Small Laser can be used if need for extra defense is required. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Long Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: W载荷极度偏重极近距离交战，装四具SRM-4发射器和两门增程中型激光。若需要额外防御，还可用头部一门增程小型激光。 特性：改进瞄准 - 远程 投放费用倍率：1.03 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: As the fight for the Inner Sphere started with the Clans' invasion, over time a number of Vipers were captured or recovered. A most of them very heavily damaged and no reliable supplies of replacements exist, the 'Mechs were quickly converted to use Inner Sphere weapons in form of a LB 10-X Autocannon and three Streak SRM-2 launchers. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Long Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.97 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 随着部族入侵拉开内层星域战事的序幕，日积月累有不少Viper被缴获或回收。由于其中大多受损严重，且没有可靠的替换零件来源，这些机甲很快被改装为使用内层星域武器，即一门LB 10-X自动炮和三具连发SRM-2发射器。 特性：改进瞄准 - 远程 投放费用倍率：0.97 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An early Clan mech introduced by the Nova Cats, the Vision Quest was the first Clan mech to mount the new ER Large Lasers. A 60-ton mech with a 300-rated XL Engine, the Vision Quest VQ-1 carries a UAC/20, alongside a pair of ER Large Lasers and a trio of Medium Pulse Lasers. Quirk: Combat Computer Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Vision Quest 是新星猫部族推出的早期部族机甲，也是第一台搭载新型增程大型激光的部族机甲。这台 60 吨机甲由一台 300 级 XL 引擎驱动；Vision Quest VQ-1 携有一门 UAC/20，以及一对增程大型激光和三门中型脉冲激光。 特性：战斗计算机 投放费用倍率：1.14 手臂驱动器限制：右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An early Clan mech introduced by the Nova Cats, the Vision Quest was the first Clan mech to mount the new ER Large Lasers. A 60-ton mech with a 300-rated XL Engine, the Vision Quest VQ-1NC carries an Improved Gauss Rifle, alongside a pair of ER Large Lasers and a trio of Medium Pulse Lasers. Quirk: Combat Computer Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.12 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Vision Quest 是 Nova Cats 推出的早期部族机甲，也是第一款搭载新型增程大型激光的部族机甲。这台 60 吨机甲配备 300 级 XL 引擎，Vision Quest VQ-1NC 装有一门改进型高斯步枪，以及两门增程大型激光和三门中型脉冲激光。 特性：战斗计算机 投放费用倍率：1.12 手臂驱动器限制：右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An early Clan mech introduced by the Nova Cats, the Vision Quest was the first Clan mech to mount the new ER Large Lasers. A 60-ton mech with a 300-rated XL Engine, the Vision Quest VQ-2 carries a Gauss Rifle, alongside a pair of ER Large Lasers and a trio of ER Small Lasers. A Targeting Computer enhances the weapons accuracy. Quirk: Combat Computer Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Vision Quest 是 Nova Cats 推出的早期部族机甲，也是第一款搭载新型增程大型激光的部族机甲。这台 60 吨机甲配备 300 级 XL 引擎，Vision Quest VQ-2 装有一门高斯步枪，以及两门增程大型激光和三门增程小型激光。瞄准计算机可提升武器精度。 特性：战斗计算机 投放费用倍率：1.14 手臂驱动器限制：右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An Age of War Mech, the 65 ton Von Rohrs was one of the first non-primitive Mechs to be fielded by the Draconis Combine. Powered by a 325-rated Fusion Core, the Von Rohrs VON 4RH-5 was armed with a PPC, an LRM-10 and a Flamer. Quirk: Cowl Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.07
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 冯·罗尔斯是一款战争年代的机甲，这台65吨机体是龙脉联合体最早投入的非原始机甲之一。冯·罗尔斯VON 4RH-5由一台325额定聚变核心驱动，装有一门粒子炮、一具LRM-10和一具火焰喷射器。 特性：机罩 投放费用倍率：1.07

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An Age of War Mech, the 65 ton Von Rohrs was one of the first non-primitive Mechs to be fielded by the Draconis Combine. Powered by a 325-rated Fusion Core, the Von Rohrs VON 4RH-6 was armed with a PPC, a pair of SRM-4’s and a Flamer. Quirk: Cowl Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.07
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为战争年代的机甲，65 吨的 Von Rohrs 是龙脉联合体最早列装的非原始型机甲之一。VON 4RH-6 型 Von Rohrs 由 325 额定聚变核心驱动，装备一门粒子炮、两具 SRM-4 和一门火焰喷射器。 特性：护罩 投放费用倍率：1.07

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Wakazashi uses a Gauss rifle and an ER PPC to provide long range firepower. An opponent who closes with the Wakazashi, hoping to get under the minimum range of these weapons, is in for a rude shock: a massive AC/20 and a pair of ER Medium Lasers are used in order to deter any opponent that would close in. With three tons of ammunition for the Gauss Rifle and Autocannon, the Wakazashi is able to inflict large amounts of damage on a multitude of enemy forces. Quirk: Missile Jammer Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.19 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 胁差以一门高斯步枪和一门增程粒子炮提供远程火力。若对手为了钻到这些武器的最小射程内而逼近，就会迎来一个措手不及的惊喜：一门庞大的AC/20和两门增程中型激光专门用来震慑任何想靠近的敌人。凭借高斯步枪与自动炮共三吨弹药，胁差能对大量敌军造成巨大伤害。 特性：导弹干扰器 投放费用倍率：1.19 手臂驱动器限制：左下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The War Dog carries the long ranged and capable Gauss rifle as its primary weapon. It is backed up at short to medium ranges by a highly accurate Large Pulse Laser. For close combat situations, the 'Mech is armed with two Medium Pulse Lasers, a Small Pulse Laser, and two Streak SRM-2 One Shot Packs. For added defense against missile attacks, the 'Mech carries a anti-missile system. Quirk: Accurate Weapon - Gauss Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 战犬（War Dog）以射程远、性能可靠的高斯步枪作为主武器，并在中近距离由一门极为精准的大型脉冲激光提供支援。在近身战斗的情况下，这台机甲装备了两门中型脉冲激光、一门小型脉冲激光以及两具连发 SRM-2 单发弹包。为加强对导弹攻击的防御，该机甲还装有一套反导弹系统。 特性：精准武器 - 高斯 投放费用倍率：1.11 手臂驱动器限制：右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A full clan conversion of the War Dog, used by the mercenary outfit the Wolf's Dragoons. Although all weapons were upgraded to Clan specification, the 'Mech keeps the same weapon configuration as the original -02FC, except for replacing the one-shot streak launchers with Streak SRM-6 ones. A C3 Slave computer was also added, a common occurance for Wolf's Dragoons rebuilds. Quirk: Accurate Weapon - Gauss Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.17 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是战犬的完全部族化改装，由雇佣兵部队狼之龙骑兵使用。所有武器虽已按部族规格升级，机甲却仍保持与原版-02FC相同的武器配置，只是把一次性连发发射器换成了连发SRM-6。此外还加装了1台C3从属计算机——这在狼之龙骑兵的重建机甲中十分常见。 <特性：精准武器（高斯） <投放费用倍率：1.17 <手臂驱动器限制：右臂下段

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Jade Falcon commanders were shocked to find themselves suffering losses from an unknown LAM that resembled a small Warhammer. Insulted that the Inner-Sphere forces disgraced the Warhammer lineage with a half-baked LAM, and being a bit more open minded on units, Jade Falcon scientists went to work, producing a 70t version loaded with Clan tech. Fielding the same powerful combo of twin ER PPCs, as well as a pair of Arrow Anti-Air missiles, these Warhammer LAMs provide withering fire on ground targets, and are able to defend themselves from modest aerospace defenses. Coupled with the improved maneuverability of a LAM, these units are finding themselves to be the backbone of quick-response anti-militia garrisons across Jade Falcon territory. Quirk: Land Air Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 翡翠猎鹰的指挥官们震惊地发现，己方竟因一架外形酷似小型 Warhammer 的未知 LAM 而蒙受伤亡。内层星域势力用一架半吊子的 LAM 玷污了 Warhammer 的血统，这让翡翠猎鹰的科学家们感到受辱；加上他们对各种单位的态度更为开放，于是着手研发，造出了一款满载部族科技的 70 吨型号。这些 Warhammer LAM 配备了同样强大的双增程粒子炮组合以及两枚箭式防空导弹，能对地面目标倾泻凶猛火力，同时也有能力抵御中等程度的航空航天防御力量。凭借 LAM 更出色的机动性，这些单位正逐渐成为翡翠猎鹰领地内各快速反应反民兵驻防部队的中坚力量。 特性：陆空机甲 投放费用倍率：1.16 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The original Warhammer was designed as an assault BattleMech. However, it had been superseded by later and heavier 'Mech designs, though it remained a powerful weapons platform. The Clans wisely maintained and built on this solid frame a real assault 'Mech, the Warhammer IIC. This version drops the ER PPCs and replaces them with a pair of LB-10X's. The LBXs are backed up by paired ER Medium Lasers and Streak SRM-6's. Quirk: Integrated Searchlight Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.2 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 最初的风暴之锤是作为突击战斗机甲设计的。尽管后来被更重型的机甲设计取代，它依然是强力的武器平台。部族明智地维护并在这副坚固框架上发展出真正的突击机甲——风暴之锤IIC。此版本拆掉增程粒子炮，换成一对LB-10X。这些LBX由成对的增程中型激光和连发SRM-6支援。 特性：内置探照灯 投放费用倍率：1.2 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The original Warhammer was designed as an assault BattleMech. However, it had been superseded by later and heavier 'Mech designs, though it remained a powerful weapons platform. The Clans wisely maintained and built on this solid frame a real assault 'Mech, the Warhammer IIC. The IIC-BL is a custom variant of the IIC-1 replaces the Medium Pulse Lasers with a pair of ER Medium lasers and removes the original SRM-6 for an ATM-6 with 3 tons of ammo. The IIC-BL is otherwise identical to the IIC-1 with the exception of a trio of Jump Jets added to the Torsos. Quirk: Integrated Searchlight Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.22 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 最初设计的战锤本是一台突击战斗机甲，但后来被更晚、更重的机甲设计所取代，尽管如此，它仍是一个强大的武器平台。部族明智地保留了这套坚固的框架，并在其上打造出真正的突击机甲——战锤IIC。IIC-BL是IIC-1的定制变型，用2门增程中型激光替换了中型脉冲激光，并以1具ATM-6（配3吨弹药）取代原有的SRM-6。除此之外，IIC-BL与IIC-1完全相同，只是躯干上加装了3具跳跃推进器。 <特性：内置探照灯 <投放费用倍率：1.22 <手臂驱动器限制：左臂下段，右臂下段

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The original Warhammer was designed as an assault BattleMech. However, it had been superseded by later and heavier 'Mech designs, though it remained a powerful weapons platform. The Clans wisely maintained and built on this solid frame a real assault 'Mech, the Warhammer IIC. The IIC-ML is a custom variant of the IIC-1 replaces 3 of the Medium Pulse Lasers with a pair of HMG’s and adds a second SRM-6. Quirk: Integrated Searchlight Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.22 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 最初的风暴之锤是作为突击战斗机甲设计的。尽管后来被更重型的机甲设计取代，它依然是强力的武器平台。部族明智地维护并在这副坚固框架上发展出真正的突击机甲——风暴之锤IIC。IIC-ML是IIC-1的定制变型，把其中3门中型脉冲激光换成两挺重型机枪，并加装第二具SRM-6。 特性：内置探照灯 投放费用倍率：1.22 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Developed as part of Project Thor's Hammer, the Warhammer LAM aims to merge the effectiveness of the Warhammer's twin PPCs, with the mobility of a LAM, in hopes of aiding the fight against the Clans. While weight requirements forced the PPCs to be downsized to Light PPCs, they are equipped with PPC Capacitors for that extra punch, and the expansion of SRMs to twin SRM4's, as well as a sizable bomb bay, provide devastating short range firepower. This allows the Warhammer LAM to inflict serious damage on a flyover, then pepper the target at range with the Light PPCs from the rear, until enough gaps open up for the SRMs to exploit. Quirk: Land Air Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 战锤LAM作为“托尔之锤计划”的一部分研制，目标是融合战锤双粒子炮的效能与LAM的机动性，以期助力对抗部族。虽然重量要求迫使粒子炮缩小为轻型粒子炮，但它们加装了粒子炮电容器以保留那一击之力；SRM也扩充为双联SRM4，再加上一个可观的弹舱，提供了毁灭性的近程火力。这让战锤LAM能在掠袭飞行中造成严重伤害，随后从后方用轻型粒子炮在远距离上持续骚扰目标，直到打开足够多的缺口供SRM利用。 特性：陆空机甲 投放费用倍率：1.05 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Developed as part of Project Thor's Hammer, the Warhammer LAM aims to merge the effectiveness of the Warhammer's twin PPCs, with the mobility of a LAM, in hopes of aiding the fight against the Clans. The B variant replaces the bomb bay and SRMs for MMLs, providing 16 tubes in total, and was marketed towards Mercenary groups. The lack of PPC Capacitors aids in repairs, and the loss of damage is replaced by the MMLs providing long range fire support with the LRMs. For close range combat, the quadrupling of SRMs fired offsets the loss of the bomb bay, but allows for a few more short range passes as the MMLs can fire multiple times. Quirk: Land Air Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Warhammer LAM作为“雷神之锤计划”的一部分研发，旨在将Warhammer双粒子炮的威力与LAM的机动性融为一体，以期助力对抗部族。B变型以MML替换弹舱和SRM，共提供16个发射管，并面向雇佣兵团体销售。省去粒子炮电容器有利于维修，损失的伤害则由MML发射LRM提供的远程火力支援弥补。近距战斗方面，SRM发射量增至四倍，弥补了弹舱的损失，同时还能多进行几次短程突袭，因为MML可以多次发射。 特性：陆空机甲 投放费用倍率：1.05 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Fulfilling the initial goal of Project Thor's Hammer, the Warhammer LAM ver. C is able to take out a Clan's Thor Omnimech with a single pass, and survive the encounter. While single-kill mechs were often relegated to the trashbin in the planning stages, the necessity of defeating a mech, and then claiming the salvage during the early Clan Invasion, saw such units come to the forefront of battle for a brief period. Quirk: Land Air Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 战锤LAM ver. C实现了“托尔之锤计划”的初衷：它能在一次通场中击杀部族的托尔全向机甲并全身而退。虽然“单位击杀型机甲”在规划阶段常被丢进废纸篓，但在部族入侵早期，既击败机甲又夺取战利品的必要性让这类单位短暂地走到了战斗前沿。 特性：陆空机甲 投放费用倍率：1.05 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A battlefield refit of the 6R, switching the armor to Ferro-Fibrous allowing the upgrade of side torso mounted small lasers to Medium Pulse Lasers. An extra Small Laser was added to the center torso, and the cooling switched to use Double Heatsinks. Quirk: Integrated Searchlight Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是6R的野战改装，把装甲换成铁纤维，从而把侧躯干的小型激光升级为中型脉冲激光。中央躯干再加一门小型激光，冷却也改用双散热器。 特性：内置探照灯 投放费用倍率：1.1 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A custom variant used by the Gray Death Legion mercenary outfit. Converting the Warhammer to full Clan technology greatly improved its combat potential, making it a proper line unit for the mercenaries. Two ER PPC, two ER Medium and two ER Small Lasers, a single SRM-6, and three Heavy Machine Guns allows the design to handle both large and small targets. Quirk: Integrated Searchlight Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是灰死军团雇佣兵部队使用的定制变型。把风暴之锤改为全部部族技术后，其作战潜力大幅提升，成为这支部队名副其实的战列单位。两门增程粒子炮、两门增程中型和两门增程小型激光、一具SRM-6以及三挺重型机枪，让该设计既能对付大型也能对付小型目标。 特性：内置探照灯 投放费用倍率：1.16 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Piloted by Chu-sa Fengo Olesko, commander of Third Battalion of the Fifth Amphigean Light Assault Group replaced the SRM and ammunition with four tons of Communications Equipment to coordinate her forces. The only weapons remaining were the arm-mounted PPCs and torso-mounted medium lasers. Quirk: Integrated Searchlight Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 由第五Amphigean轻型突击群第三营营长Fengo Olesko中佐驾驶的这台机甲，把SRM及其弹药换成了四吨通讯设备，以便协调她的部队。剩下的武器只有安装在手臂上的粒子炮与装在躯干上的中型激光。 特性：集成探照灯 投放费用倍率：1.1 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Known and revered across the Inner Sphere and beyond, the Warhammer is the pre-eminent heavy Mech. Debuting in 2515, the 70-ton Mech is a solid blend of firepower and mobility designed to outfight almost any opponent. Powered by a 350 XL Engine, the Warhammer WHM-6Rk is armed with a pair of PPC’s. A pair of Medium Lasers, Small Lasers, Machine Guns and an SRM-6 deter opponents from closing in. Double Heat Sinks round out the variant. Quirk: Integrated Searchlight Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Warhammer在内层星域乃至更远之处都闻名遐尔、备受尊崇，是最杰出的重型机甲。这款70吨的机甲于2515年首次亮相，是火力与机动性的坚实结合，设计目标就是要击败几乎所有对手。Warhammer WHM-6Rk由一台350 XL引擎驱动，装备一对粒子炮。一对中型激光、小型激光、机枪和一具SRM-6则阻止对手近身。双散热器构成了该变型的最后一块拼图。 特性：集成探照灯 投放费用倍率：1.1 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A refit of the 6R, freeing 6 tons of weight capacity by switching to double heat sinks. This allowed adding both more armor and CASE protection, improving the durability greatly. Further, a C3 slave unit was added for improved lance communications. Quirk: Integrated Searchlight Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是 6R 的改装型，通过换装双散热器腾出了 6 吨重量容量。这使其既能增加装甲，又能加装 CASE 防护，大幅提升了耐用性。此外还加装了一具 C3 从属单元，以改善小队通讯。 特性：集成探照灯 投放费用倍率：1.08 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A fully Clan converted variant of the Warhammer, mainly seen with the Wolf's Dragoons mercenaries. Two ER PPC are the main damage source, with two ER Medium Laser, Medium Pulse Laser and Streak SRM-6 as extra firepower as needed at various ranges. An advanced targeting computer and ECM suite were also fitted. Quirk: Integrated Searchlight Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是风暴之锤的完全部族化变型，主要见于狼之龙骑兵雇佣兵部队。两门增程粒子炮是主要伤害来源，两门增程中型激光、中型脉冲激光和一具连发SRM-6则在不同距离上按需提供额外火力。它还配有一台先进瞄准计算机和一套电子对抗套件。 特性：内置探照灯 投放费用倍率：1.16 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A subvariant of the WHM-6W, which adds a C3 slave computer by dropping the ECM suite. Quirk: Integrated Searchlight Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: WHM-6W的子变型，通过拆除电子对抗套件来加装一台C3从属计算机。 特性：集成探照灯 投放费用倍率：1.16 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An experimental upgrade of the 6D done by Apple for the Lyran Alliance military forces. It mounts two cutting edge ER PPC, two Medium Lasers and two Machine Guns - all cooled by 18 single heat sinks. Quirk: Integrated Searchlight Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是Apple为莱兰联盟军队打造的6D实验性升级版。它装备两门最前沿的增程粒子炮、两门中型激光和两挺机枪，全部由18台单散热器冷却。 特性：集成探照灯 投放费用倍率：1.1 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A Clan Buster upgrade, the Warhammer 7CS was developed specifically for Tukayyid. Designed as a general purpose unit designed for offence and defensive roles, the Warhammer 7CS mounts a 280-rated XL Engine and DHS. A pair of ER PPC’s and 4 Medium Lasers make up the bulk of the 7CS’s load out. A trio of Streak SRM-2’s with a ton of CASE protected ammo round out the weapons, while 4 Jump Jets offer additional mobility. Quirk: Integrated Searchlight Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Warhammer 7CS是专为图凯伊德之战研发的“部族杀手”升级型号。作为一款兼顾进攻与防御的通用单位，Warhammer 7CS搭载额定280的XL引擎和双散热器。两门增程粒子炮和4门中型激光构成7CS武器的主体。三具连发SRM-2外加一吨CASE保护的弹药补全了武器配置，另有4台跳跃推进器提供额外机动性。 特性：集成探照灯 投放费用倍率：1.1 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下
