Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An alteration of the 6R model introduced in 2835, the 6D removed the machine guns and the SRM-6 launcher to add an additional four tons of armor to the design, increasing its leg protection, as well as two more heat sinks. The 6D was particularly favored by the Federated Suns. Quirk: Integrated Searchlight Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 6D 是 2835 年推出的 6R 型号改动版，它移除机枪和 SRM-6 发射器，为设计增加四吨装甲（提升腿部防护）以及两台额外散热器。6D 尤其受联邦太阳系青睐。 特质：内置探照灯 投放费用倍率：1.08 臂部驱动器限制：左下臂、右下臂

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A house Kurita refresh of the 7K, using double heat sinks and Endo Steel to fit an impressive amount of weapons yet remain very well armored. Two ER PPC, four ER lasers and a Streak SRM-6 ensures the 'Mech can handle most threats at anything except extremely long ranges. Quirk: Integrated Searchlight Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是库瑞塔家族对7K的翻新，使用双散热器和内骨架，装入可观数量的武器同时保持极为出色的装甲。两门增程粒子炮、四门增程激光和一具连发SRM-6，确保该机甲除极远距离外几乎能应付大多数威胁。 特性：内置探照灯 投放费用倍率：1.1 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Known and revered across the Inner Sphere and beyond, the Warhammer is the pre-eminent heavy Mech. Debuting in 2515, the 70-ton Mech is a solid blend of firepower and mobility designed to outfight almost any opponent. Powered by a 280 Fusion Core, the Warhammer WHM-7M-DC is armed with a pair of ER PPC’s. A Medium Laser, Machine Gun and SRM-6 deter opponents from closing in. A Command Console rounds out the design. Quirk: Integrated Searchlight Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Warhammer 闻名于内层星域内外并备受尊崇，是最杰出的重型机甲。这台 70 吨机甲于 2515 年首次亮相，将火力与机动性扎实地融为一体，旨在击败几乎任何对手。Warhammer WHM-7M-DC 由一台 280 聚变核心驱动，装备两门增程粒子炮。一门中型激光、一挺机枪和一具 SRM-6 可阻止对手逼近。指挥控制台则让该设计更为完善。 特性：集成探照灯 投放费用倍率：1.1 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A seemingly average Warhammer, the 'Widows Whammy', was rumoured to be the configuration piloted by the Black Widow Natasha Kerensky herself. Quirk: Improved Cooling Jacket - PPC Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.12 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这台看似普通的“寡妇之锤”风暴之锤，据传正是“黑寡妇”娜塔莎·克伦斯基本人驾驶的配置。 特性：改进冷却套 - 粒子炮 投放费用倍率：1.12 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A Clan-tech retrofit of the venerable Warhammer intended for second-line and solahma troops, this variant replaced most of the Inner Sphere-tech weaponry of the original WHM-6R with Clan equivalents and used the weight savings to add two more heat sinks. The PPCs were replaced with Large Pulse Lasers, the SRM-6 was upgraded to a Streak SRM-6, and all of the lasers were upgraded to ER medium and ER small lasers. Only the machine guns were not replaced with Clan-tech models. Quirk: Integrated Searchlight Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是为二线与索拉马部队进行的一次古老风暴之锤部族技术改装，以部族同类武器替换原版WHM-6R的大部分内层星域武器，并用省下的重量加装两个散热器。粒子炮换成大型脉冲激光，SRM-6升级为连发SRM-6，所有激光升级为增程中型和增程小型激光。只有机枪没有换成部族技术型号。 特性：内置探照灯 投放费用倍率：1.08 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The C2 is a further upgrade of previously upgraded Inner Sphere Warhammers. Retaining its Inner Sphere engine, internal structure, armor, and 18 double heat sinks the C2 completely upgrades the weaponry to Clan standards. Clan ER PPCs sit in the arms. Each side torso houses a Clan Medium Pulse Laser, and both a pulse and ER Small Laser. A Streak SRM-6 replaces the typical shoulder-mounted SRMs; its one ton of ammo is in the right torso. Both the lack of CASE and low amount of armor makes this Warhammer a bit of a glass cannon. Quirk: Integrated Searchlight Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: C2 是在此前已升级过的内层星域 Warhammer 之上做的进一步升级。C2 保留其内层星域的引擎、内部结构、装甲与 18 具双散热器，却把武器全面升级至部族标准。双臂装设部族增程粒子炮。每侧躯干各有一门部族中型脉冲激光，以及脉冲小型激光与增程小型激光各一门。一具连发 SRM-6 取代了惯常的肩载 SRM，其弹药一吨位于右躯干。由于既没有 CASE、装甲又偏薄，这台 Warhammer 多少有点“玻璃大炮”的味道。 特性：内置探照灯 投放费用倍率：1.08 手臂驱动器限制：左臂下部、右臂下部

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A Golden Century refit popular with Wolf's Dragoons, this Warhammer was rebuilt from the ground up with Clan technology. Built using an endo steel internal structure and XL engine, the C 3 has plenty of space for weapons and heat sinks. An ER PPC is carried in each arm. Both side torsos carry an ER Medium Laser, a Medium Pulse Laser, and a Streak SRM-6. An ECM Suite protects this variant, while a Targeting Computer makes the already fearsome weaponry even more dangerous. 17 double heat sinks cannot keep the 'Mech cool unless the pilot fires either its long range or short range weapons. Quirk: Integrated Searchlight Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这款战锤在"黄金世纪"时期翻新，深受狼之龙骑兵青睐，以部族技术从头重建。它采用内骨架结构和XL引擎，C 3因此有充裕空间容纳武器与散热器。每只手臂各装备一门增程粒子炮，两侧躯干各装有一具增程中型激光、一具中型脉冲激光和一具连发SRM-6。该变型由电子对抗套件提供防护，而瞄准计算机则让本已可怕的武器更加致命。17具双散热器不足以让机甲保持凉爽，除非机师只使用远程或近程武器中的一种。 特性：集成探照灯 投放费用倍率：1.16 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The TD variant of the Warhammer is focused on long to medium range engagements, using its two ER PPC and four Medium Pulse Lasers to overwhelm any foes. A SRM-6 provides extra punch at closer range together with a single Small Laser, and an AMS provides some extra defense. Quirk: Integrated Searchlight Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 风暴之锤的TD变型专注中远程交战，用两门增程粒子炮和四门中型脉冲激光压倒任何敌人。一具SRM-6与一门单独的小型激光在较近距离提供额外打击力，一套反导弹系统则提供额外防御。 特性：内置探照灯 投放费用倍率：1.1 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The personal OmniMech of Star Colonel Anwen, this Warhawk shows the warrior's penchant for energy-based weapons may have given way to an obsession. Beginning with its primary weapons array, this Warhawk boasts four ER Large Lasers. Another grouping of energy weapons make up Anwen's secondary weapons system, a pair of Medium Pulse Lasers mounted on the 'Mech's center torso. Furthermore, one ER Medium Laser and one ER Small Laser offer even more added damage potential. Anwen kept the Warhawk’s integrated targeting computer, but had to make some modifications to allow for an increased weapons load. Mounting only energy-weapons makes heat dissipation a primary concern. In an attempt to solve the problem, Blood Spirit technicians equipped the 'Mech with 26 high efficiency heat sinks. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Long Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这台战鹰是星上校安文的专属全向机甲，显示出这位战士对能量武器的偏爱或许已演变为痴迷。它的主武器阵列以四门增程大型激光傲视群雄；副武器同样由能量武器组成——两具中型脉冲激光安装在机甲的中躯干。此外，一具增程中型激光和一具增程小型激光进一步增强了伤害潜力。安文保留了战鹰内置的瞄准计算机，但为增加武器负载不得不做了一些改动。由于全身只装能量武器，散热成为首要难题；血灵部族的技术人员为此为机甲配备了26具高效散热器。 特性：改进瞄准（远程） 投放费用倍率：1.18 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An alternate take on the C configuration replaces the two ER PPCs with another pair of Large Pulse Lasers. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Long Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是C配置的另一种做法，以另一对大型脉冲激光取代两门增程粒子炮。 特性：改进瞄准 - 远程 投放费用倍率：1.16 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Warhawk I mounts one Large Laser and one ER PPC in each arm, with the addition of a SRM-6 and a LRM-5 in the center torso. A total of 24 heatsinks tries to cool it, but it still runs quite hot. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Long Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Warhawk I 于每侧手臂各装一门大型激光与一门增程粒子炮，中央躯干另加装一具 SRM-6 与一具 LRM-5。总共 24 具散热器试图为其散热，但它运行时依然相当高温。 特性：改进瞄准 - 远程 投放费用倍率：1.16 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The J configuration mounts four jump jets, allowing the 'Mech to flank enemies easier to unleash its weaponry. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Long Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: J配置装有四具跳跃推进器，让机甲更容易绕到敌人侧翼倾泻火力。 特性：改进瞄准 - 远程 投放费用倍率：1.16 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A customized variant of the Warhawk, reportedly piloted by Hunter Tseng from Clan Ghost Bear. The Nanuq uses a trio of ER Medium Lasers in its left arm. The center torso carries a Active Probe. In it's right torso carries a LRM-15 with two tons of ammo and one ton of ultra autocannon ammo. The right arm carries a pair of Ultra Autocannon/10s with two tons of ammo. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Long Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是战鹰的定制变型，据报由鬼熊部族的猎人曾格驾驶。纳努克左臂装三门增程中型激光，中央躯干带一台主动探测器；右躯干带一具LRM-15（配两吨弹药）和一吨超级自动炮弹药；右臂则装一对超级AC/10（配两吨弹药）。 特性：改进瞄准 - 远程 投放费用倍率：1.18 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An the R configuration replaces two of the ER PPC from the primary configuration of the Warhawk with Large Pulse Lasers. Two added flamers also provide anti-infantry defense. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Long Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: R配置将Warhawk主配置中的两门增程粒子炮替换为大型脉冲激光。另加装的两具火焰喷射器还可提供反步兵防御。 特性：改进瞄准 - 远距 投放费用倍率：1.16 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The S configuration is similar to the Warhawks primary configuration, but replaces the LRM-10 with a Small Laser, allowing the 'Mech to pack three more heat sinks. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Long Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: S配置与战鹰主配置相似，但以一具小型激光取代LRM-10，让机甲能多带三个散热器。 特性：改进瞄准 - 远程 投放费用倍率：1.16 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The V configuration carries four medium pulse lasers and an ER PPC as the main damage dealers, while four Jump Jets allow more maneuverability. For close quarters combat a flamer and three Streak SRM-6s are also available. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Long Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: V配置以4门中型脉冲激光和1门增程粒子炮作为主要输出手段，4具跳跃推进器则带来更强的机动性。近身缠斗时，还可动用1具火焰喷射器和3具连发SRM-6。 <特性：改进瞄准（远程） <投放费用倍率：1.16 <手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Mounting a Gauss Rifle and an ER PPC in each arm, the Warhawk W is one of the more unusual configurations. The 'Mech still keeps the LRM-10 launcher from the Primary configuration. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Long Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 战鹰 W 在每条手臂上各装一门高斯步枪和一门 ER PPC，是较为少见的配置之一。这台机甲仍保留了主要配置的 LRM-10 发射器。 特性：改进瞄准 - 远程 投放费用倍率：1.16 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The X configuration is seldom seen outside Clan space, as it is the main configuration for a Batchall. The combination of two heavy large lasers and an Ultra AC/20 makes the damage potential high enough at most ranges that it suits the needs of most warriors. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Long Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: X配置在部族领地之外难得一见，因为它是用于Batchall的主要配置。两门重型大型激光与一门Ultra AC/20的组合，让它在多数距离上都能造成足够高的伤害潜力，从而满足大多数战士的需求。 特性：改进瞄准 - 远程 投放费用倍率：1.16 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Warlord carries its main damage dealers on the right side of the 'Mech, a Gauss rifle in the arm and an ER PPC in the side torso. A center torso mounted ER Large Laser is able to provide extra damage at range as needed, but needs to be overused due to the limited cooling from the 'Mechs twelve double heat sinks. At closer ranges the 'Mech can switch to use its seven Medium Lasers, with an SRM-6 as an extra punch. The final weapon is an Artemis IV-enabled LRM-20, able to provide accurate missile fire at most ranges. Quirk: Accurate Weapon - Energy Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 战帅把主要伤害输出集中在机甲右侧：手臂上的高斯步枪和侧躯干里的增程粒子炮。安装在中央躯干上的增程大型激光能在需要时提供额外的远程伤害，但由于该机十二台双散热器的散热能力有限，不宜过度使用。距离拉近后，机甲可改用七门中型激光，并以一具SRM-6作为额外重击。最后一件武器是一具配备Artemis IV的LRM-20，能在多数距离上提供精准的导弹火力。 特性：精准武器 - 能量 投放费用倍率：1.18

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The WLD-1P is armed only with two Large and three Medium Pulse Lasers, but is very mobile thanks to its large 300 XL engine, MASC and five jump jets. This allows the 'Mech to maneuver around and flank foes, hitting them with the pulse lasers at weaker locations that are easily penetrated. The 'Mech is cooled by twelve double heat sinks, meaning some care in regards to heat build up has to be taken. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: WLD-1P只装两门大型和三门中型脉冲激光，但凭借其庞大的300 XL引擎、MASC和五具跳跃推进器而极为机动。这使该机甲能绕行并包抄敌人，用脉冲激光打击其容易被击穿的薄弱部位。该机甲由十二个双散热器降温，意味着必须对热量积累多加留意。 特性：易于维护 投放费用倍率：1.08 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This variant, used by the SLDF, has a LTV 150 engine, slightly lower maximum ground speed (84 km/h), a 120 meter jump capability, and replaces the SRM-2 with a rear-facing One-Shot version. In exchange the WSP-100 was equipped with a five ton bomb bay. This Bomb Bay allowed the WSP-100 to carry Arrow IVmissiles and conventional bombs without losing any speed. Quirk: Land Air Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这一变型供 SLDF 使用，搭载 LTV 150 引擎，最高地面速度略低（84 km/h），可跳跃 120 米，并以一具朝后的单发型 SRM-2 取代了标准 SRM-2。作为交换，WSP-100 装设了一个五吨重的弹舱。这个弹舱使 WSP-100 能在不损失任何速度的情况下携带 Arrow IV 导弹与常规炸弹。 特性：陆空机甲 投放费用倍率：0.99 手臂驱动器限制：右下
黄蜂 LAM Mk I WSP-100
黄蜂 LAM Mk I WSP-100

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This version of the Wasp LAM replaces the bomb bay with an LRM-10 launcher and an extra jump jet. This variant was later used as the inspiration for the Valkyrie. Quirk: Land Air Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Wasp LAM的这一型号用一具LRM-10发射器和一台额外的跳跃推进器取代了弹舱。该变型后来成为Valkyrie的设计灵感来源。 特性：陆空机甲 投放费用倍率：0.99 手臂驱动器限制：右下
黄蜂 LAM Mk I WSP-100A
黄蜂 LAM Mk I WSP-100A

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This variant was designed for the SLDF's \"Blackhearts\" teams. Based on the standard WSP-100, it replaced the medium laser and bomb bay with an extra jump jet, Medium Pulse Laser, Streak SRM-2, and Guardian ECM Suite. The armor protection was also increased slightly. Quirk: Land Air Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 此变型为SLDF的“黑心”小队设计，以标准WSP-100为基础，用一具额外跳跃推进器、一门中型脉冲激光、一具连发SRM-2和一套守护者电子对抗套件取代了中型激光与弹舱，装甲防护也略有提升。 特性：陆空机甲 投放费用倍率：0.99 手臂驱动器限制：右下
黄蜂 LAM Mk I WSP-100b
黄蜂 LAM Mk I WSP-100b

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Quirk: Land Air Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 特性：陆空机甲 投放费用倍率：0.98 手臂驱动器限制：右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A very rare version of the Wasp, upgrading it to a total of 25 tons. The extra weight is used to fit a larger, 150 rated engine core, a total of four tons of armor and more weapons. Quirk: Extended Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.96
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 黄蜂极为罕见的一个版本，总重量升级到 25 吨。多出的重量用于安装更大的额定 150 引擎核心、总共四吨装甲以及更多武器。 特性：扩展躯干旋转 投放费用倍率：0.96

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An uncommon battlefield refit of the 1A, dropping a ton of armor for a TAG and replaces one of the Medium Lasers with two Small lasers instead. Quirk: Extended Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.95 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是1A不多见的野战改装：削掉一吨装甲换装一具TAG，并把其中一门中型激光换成两门小型激光。 特性：扩展躯干旋转 投放费用倍率：0.95 手臂驱动器限制：右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A Clan tech rebuild of the Wasp, seen amongst the Kell Hounds. Carries a Medium Pulse Laser and an SRM-2 launcher, with the addition of a C3 Slave for better performance. Quirk: Extended Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 凯尔猎犬中可见的一款采用部族科技重造的 Wasp。它携带一门中型脉冲激光和一具 SRM-2 发射器，并加装了一台 C3 从属单元以提升表现。 特性：扩展躯干旋转 投放费用倍率：1.03 手臂驱动器限制：右下臂

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Manufactured by Achernar for Wolf's Dragoons in 3050, the Clan Invasion era 3W upgraded the armor to ferro-fibrous and carried two Sutel Precision Line small pulse lasers in the right arm and four ChisComp 32 small lasers split between left leg and left torso. This increased firepower came at the cost of reducing armor protection to just two tons. Quirk: Extended Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.97 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该机由 Achernar 于 3050 年为狼之龙骑兵制造，属于部族入侵时期的 3W 型。它将装甲升级为铁纤维，并在右臂装设两门 Sutel Precision Line 小型脉冲激光，在左腿与左躯干共装设四门 ChisComp 32 小型激光。火力增强的代价，是装甲防护被削减至仅两吨。 特性：扩展躯干旋转 投放费用倍率：0.97 手臂驱动器限制：右下臂

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Together model is an upgrade of the 3W, an alternative to the more common 4W, and is mainly used by the Wolf's Dragoons. The upgrade replaces all the weapons with a single Medium Pulse Laser and five ER Small Lasers, and adds another half ton of armor and a C3 Slave unit. Quirk: Extended Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Together型是3W的升级型号，作为较常见的4W的替代方案，主要由狼之龙骑兵使用。该升级把全部武器替换为一具中型脉冲激光和五具增程小型激光，并额外增加半吨装甲和一个C3从属单元。 特性：扩展躯干旋转 投放费用倍率：1.03 手臂驱动器限制：右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Source: BattleTech: The Crescent Hawks' Inception
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 来源：BattleTech: The Crescent Hawks' Inception

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This variant, nicknamed 'First Modification' by the the techs on Chara III, is a field modification of the WSP-1A that exchanges the SRM-2 and ammunition for one medium laser in the left leg and a ton of armor. Quirk: Extended Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.95 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这一变型被卡拉III星的技术人员昵称为“第一改装”，是WSP-1A的战地改装型，用左腿的一门中型激光与一吨装甲换掉了SRM-2及其弹药。 特性：扩展躯干旋转 投放费用倍率：0.95 手臂驱动器限制：右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Source: BattleTech: The Crescent Hawks' Inception
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 来源：BattleTech: The Crescent Hawks' Inception

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This variant, nicknamed 'Second Modification' by the the techs on Chara III, is a further modification of the M1 that exchanges the jump jets for three medium lasers, one each installed in the head, center torso, and left arm. Quirk: Extended Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.95 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这一变型被卡拉III星的技术人员昵称为“第二改装”，是对M1的进一步改装，用头部、中央躯干与左臂各一门的三门中型激光换掉了跳跃推进器。 特性：扩展躯干旋转 投放费用倍率：0.95 手臂驱动器限制：右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The original Weevil variant, the -L31, mounts an AC/2 in the right arm and a ER Large Laser in the left. Due to only mounting ten single heatsinks, the 'Mech still runs quite hot even with just a single energy weapon. Quirk: Advanced Optics Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是象鼻虫最初的变型，-L31在右臂装一门AC/2，左臂装一门增程大型激光。由于只装十个单散热器，即便只有一件能量武器，该机甲运行起来依然相当热。 特性：先进光学 投放费用倍率：0.98 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The -P14 was introduced solely for the Periphery market. Armed with only a single LBX AC/5, it runs quite cool even in the more common lunar and martian biomes spread out in the periphery. The design also mounts an AMS Mk.2 for better defense. Quirk: Advanced Optics Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: -P14专为外围地区市场推出。它仅装备一门LBX AC/5，即便在外围地区常见的月球与火星环境中也能保持相当低的温度。该设计还安装了AMS Mk.2以强化防御。 特性：先进光学 投放费用倍率：0.98 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: After the -P14 proved more popular than the -L31, the -R2 was created as an updated Weevil for the Inner Sphere. Instead of the LBX of the -P14, its only weapon is an Ultra AC/5. However, the 'Mech also fits an Active Probe, improving its sensor capabilities. Quirk: Advanced Optics Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在 -P14 被证明比 -L31 更受欢迎之后，-R2 作为面向内层星域的更新版 Weevil 被制造出来。它不像 -P14 那样装有 LBX，其唯一的武器是一门 Ultra AC/5。不过，该机甲还装有一具主动探测器，提升了其传感器能力。 特性：高级光学 投放费用倍率：0.98 手臂驱动器限制：左上臂、右上臂

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The WER-LF-004 carries a Medium Pulse Laser, a pair of Small Pulse Lasers, a standard SRM-6 launcher and a Machine Gun. Four jump jets are enough to propel the 'Mech considerable distances. Quirk: Improved Cooling Jacket - Laser Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.02
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: WER-LF-004装有一门中型脉冲激光、一对小型脉冲激光、一具标准SRM-6发射器与一挺机枪。四台跳跃推进器足以让这台机甲跨越相当远的距离。 特性：改进冷却外套（激光） 投放费用倍率：1.02

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The WER-LF-004P is the prototype of the WER-LF-004, similar in almost all regards as the eventual final version. The only difference is slightly more armor at the cost of one less jump jet. Quirk: Improved Cooling Jacket - Laser Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: WER-LF-004P是WER-LF-004的原型，在几乎所有方面都与最终定型版本相似。唯一的区别是装甲略多，代价是少一具跳跃推进器。 特性：改进冷却夹套 - 激光 投放费用倍率：1.04

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Werewolf WE-LF-005's main armament is its Large X-Pulse Laser, which is backed up by a Streak SRM-6 launcher, and a pair of Magshots. All of these close-in weapons were chosen because they encourage the pilot to attack from closer ranges. Quirk: Improved Cooling Jacket - Laser Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.02
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 狼人WE-LF-005的主武器是它的大型X脉冲激光，辅以一具连发SRM-6发射器和两具磁射枪。选用这些近程武器，是为了鼓励飞行员从更近的距离发起攻击。 特性：改进冷却套 - 激光 投放费用倍率：1.02

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A simple refit of the WTH-1 that trades its jump jets for a C3 slave and C.A.S.E. protection for the LRM ammunition. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 惠特沃斯 WTH-1 的简单改装，把跳跃推进器换成一套 C3 从属单元，并为 LRM 弹药加装 C.A.S.E. 防护。 特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A solaris special, someone has torn out the original LTV 160 fusion engine; replacing it is a Nissan 200 torn out of a scrapped Hunchback. In order to cram in the larger engine, the LRM-10s were downgraded to a pair of smaller LRM-5s fed by a single ton of ammo. A Large Laser replaces the left arm Medium Laser. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是一台 Solaris 特色改装机：有人拆掉了原来的 LTV 160 聚变引擎，换上从一台报废 Hunchback 上拆下的 Nissan 200。为了塞进更大的引擎，LRM-10 被降级为两具更小的 LRM-5，共用一吨弹药供弹。左臂的中型激光则被一门大型激光取代。 特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1 手臂驱动器限制：左下臂、右下臂

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A refit of the 1S, upgrading the 'Mech to use double heat sinks. The increased cooling capacity allows dropping four of the heat sinks, and the freed space is used to add a C3 slave, C.A.S.E. protection and Artemis IV FCS. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.02 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 1S 的改装型，将机甲升级为使用双散热器。散热能力的提升使其可以拆除四个散热器，而腾出的空间则用于加装 C3 从属单元、C.A.S.E. 防护和阿尔忒弥斯 IV 火控系统。 特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1.02 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Wildfire P1-WF traded the Crusader's long range firepower for speed and armor protection. Intended to pursue fast-moving opponents, the Wildfire used a suite of pulse lasers as its primary armament. When in close combat with an enemy, the pair of Streak SRM-2 launchers provided additional firepower without being wasteful. The Machine Guns were very useful for defending against enemy infantry units. Defensively, the Wildfire mounted CASE in the right torso to protect the 'Mech from ammunition explosions. Quirk: Well Balanced Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Wildfire P1-WF以Crusader的远程火力换取了速度与装甲防护。Wildfire意在追击高速移动的对手，因此以一套脉冲激光作为主武器。与敌人近身交战时，两具连发SRM-2发射器能提供额外火力而不会浪费弹药。机枪则在抵御敌方步兵单位时非常有用。防护方面，Wildfire在右侧躯干安装了CASE，以保护机甲免受弹药爆炸之害。 特性：平衡良好 投放费用倍率：1.09 手臂驱动器限制：左下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Wildfire P7-WF drops the torso mounted cockpit, returning to a standard head mounted one, and replaces one of the Machine Guns with an AMS. Quirk: Well Balanced Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 野火P7-WF拆掉躯干座舱，恢复为标准头部座舱，并把其中一挺机枪换成一具反导弹系统。 特性：平衡良好 投放费用倍率：1.09 手臂驱动器限制：右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Wisp WS-P2 (BattleTechnology Special Edition - The Early Years)
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 鬼火 WS-P2（《战斗技术》特刊 - 早年）

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Wisp is only armed with a single Medium Laser supported by a small laser, which are more useful at starting fires and harassing the enemy rather than being true anti-'Mech weapons. Pilots of the Wisp should always remember that he who spies then runs away may live to spy another day. Quirk: Improved Jammer Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 鬼火只装一门中型激光，辅以一门小型激光；这些武器更适合放火和骚扰敌人，而非真正的反机甲武器。鬼火的飞行员应始终牢记：窥探之后撒腿就跑的人，才能活到下一次窥探。 特性：改进干扰器 投放费用倍率：0.99

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Wolf Trap carries as its main weapon an LB-X autocannon/10, which allows it to fire both standard solid shells or cluster shells that act like a shotgun and cause damage all over the enemy. For added long range firepower, the Wolf Trap carries a LRM-10 launcher which allows it to fire directly and also give indirect fire support when needed. Finally, for close combat, the 'Mech carries a pair of medium lasers. This varied arsenal lets the Wolf Trap effectively engage an enemy at any range. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Wolf Trap的主武器是一门LB-X自动炮/10，既可发射标准实心弹，也可发射如同霰弹般散射、在敌人身上造成全面伤害的集束弹。为增强远程火力，Wolf Trap还装有一具LRM-10发射器，既能直瞄射击，也能在需要时提供间接火力支援。最后，为应对近身战斗，机甲还配备了两门中型激光。这套多样化的武器组合让Wolf Trap能在任何距离上有效打击敌人。 特性：易于维护 投放费用倍率：1.03 手臂驱动器限制：右上

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A uniquely customized Wolf Trap created for former Kurita MechWarrior Daitama Muraki, refitted by Star League Defense Force techs from the shell of a Wolf Trap given to him. The tech fitted a 270-rated XL fusion engine and 10 double heat sinks into the 'Mech. The design retained the 'Mech's two medium lasers and LRM 10 Launcher, while adding an extended-range PPC in place of the autocannon. The Second Star League techs then added a Beagle active probe and C3i computer to the 'Mech. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这台独一无二的定制捕狼夹是为前栗田机甲战士 Daitama Muraki 打造的，由星际联盟防卫军的技师在他获赠的一具捕狼夹机壳基础上改装而成。技师为这台机甲装上了 270 级 XL 聚变引擎和10个双散热器。该设计保留了机甲原有的两门中型激光和一具 LRM-10 发射器，同时以一门增程粒子炮取代了自动炮。随后第二星际联盟的技师又为它加装了猎犬主动探测器和 C3i 计算机。 特性：易于维护 投放费用倍率：1.05 手臂驱动器限制：右上

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A field modification of the Wolf Trap, the C model is modified to carry a C3 slave unit onto the battlefield, allowing the Wolf Trap to share targeting telemetry with other friendly units. The 'Mech achieves this by removing one of the medium lasers that it carries. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 狼阱的C型是一种野战改装型号，能够把C3从属单元带上战场，让狼阱与其他友军单位共享瞄准遥测数据。为此它拆除了自身携带的其中一具中型激光。 特性：易于维护 投放费用倍率：1.03 手臂驱动器限制：右上

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Phelan Kell and his Wolfhound, nicknamed Grinner, were captured by the forces of Clan Wolf during Operation Revival. When Phelan was inducted into the Wolf Clan as a Warrior, Khan Ulric Kerensky ordered his 'Mech be upgraded using Clan technology. Quirk: Accurate Weapon - Energy Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 费伦·凯尔和他的 Wolfhound（绰号“咧嘴者”）在复兴行动期间被狼族部队俘获。当费伦作为战士被接纳进入狼族时，可汗乌尔里克·克伦斯基下令用部族技术升级他的机甲。 特性：精准武器 - 能量 投放费用倍率：1.08 手臂驱动器限制：右下臂

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Based off Phelan Kell's 'Mech 'Grinner', the Wolfhound IIC 3 is a Clan tech version of the Wolfhound. The design includes Endo Steel structure, Ferro-Fibrous armor and XL engine, combined with an ECM suite. The weapons are fully energy based, consisting of two ER Medium Lasers, one ER Large Laser and three Medium Pulse Lasers. Quirk: Accurate Weapon - Energy Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Wolfhound IIC 3 以 Phelan Kell 的座机“Grinner”为蓝本，是 Wolfhound 的部族科技版本。该设计采用内骨架结构、铁纤维装甲和 XL 引擎，并配有电子对抗套件。其武器全部为能量武器，包括两门增程中型激光、一门增程大型激光和三门中型脉冲激光。 特性：精准武器 - 能量 投放费用倍率：0.98 手臂驱动器限制：右下臂

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Based off Phelan Kell's 'Mech 'Grinner', the Wolfhound IIC 3A is a Clan tech version of the Wolfhound. The design includes Endo Steel structure, Ferro-Fibrous armor and XL engine, combined with an ECM suite. The weapons are fully energy based, consisting of one Large Pulse Laser and four Medium Pulse Lasers. Quirk: Accurate Weapon - Energy Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 猎狼犬IIC 3A以菲兰·凯尔的座机“咧嘴者”为基础，是猎狼犬的部族技术版本。该设计采用内骨架结构、铁纤维装甲和XL引擎，并整合了1具电子对抗套件。武器全为能量型，包括1门大型脉冲激光和4门中型脉冲激光。 <特性：精准武器（能量） <投放费用倍率：1.06 <手臂驱动器限制：右臂下段

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A mixed tech refit of the Wolfhound, using aquired Clan tech to improve its performance. Mainly used by the mercenary outfit the Kell Hounds. Quirk: Accurate Weapon - Energy Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 狼犬的混合科技改装型，利用缴获的部族科技提升其性能。主要由雇佣兵部队“凯尔猎犬”使用。 特性：精准武器 - 能量 投放费用倍率：0.98 手臂驱动器限制：右下臂

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A battlefield refit of the WLF-1R, switching from single to double heat sinks and trading one medium laser for a C3 slave unit. Quirk: Accurate Weapon - Energy Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: WLF-1R的战地改装型，将单散热器换成双散热器，并以一门中型激光换取一台C3从属机。 特性：精准武器（能量） 投放费用倍率：0.98 手臂驱动器限制：右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A mixed tech refit of the Wolfhound, using acquired Clan tech to improve its performance. Mainly used by the mercenary outfit the Wolf Dragoons. Quirk: Accurate Weapon - Energy Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 猎狼犬的混合技术改装型，利用取得的部族技术提升性能。主要由雇佣兵部队狼之龙骑兵使用。 特性：精准武器 - 能量 投放费用倍率：1.04 手臂驱动器限制：右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Star League changed so much from the WVR-6R that they called this the Wolverine II. It carries a similar weapon load but enhanced by the Star League's superior technology, making this a far deadlier machine. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.07
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 星际联盟对 WVR-6R 做了如此大的改动，以至于把它称为 Wolverine II。它携带的武器载荷与之相似，但在星际联盟更优越的技术加持下得到强化，使其成为一台致命得多的机器。 特性：改进通讯 投放费用倍率：1.07

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: When the Clan Jade Falcon designers took a Wolverine II WVR-7H and started replacing parts of it with clan tech in several configurations, this was one of the resulting prototype designs. Eventually the result was the Conjurer, since they could not name a 'Mech after the Not-Named Clan. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 当玉猫部族的设计者取来一台狼獾II WVR-7H，并开始用部族技术在多种配置中替换其部件时，这就是由此产生的原型设计之一。最终成果便是幻术师，因为他们不能用一个“不可提及的部族”来命名机甲。 特性：改进通讯 投放费用倍率：1.11

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An uncommon refit of some of the Wolverines the SLDF brought with them during their exodus from the Inner Sphere, the goal was to bring them in line with the more clear IIC versions of 'Mechs. However, very few were actually kept once Clan Wolverine was annihilated due to their name. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是对一些SLDF在大逃亡离开内层星域时带走的狼獾所做的不常见改装，目的是让它们与更明确的IIC版本机甲保持一致。然而，狼獾部族因其名号被消灭之后，真正保留下来的极少。 特性：改进通讯 投放费用倍率：1.11

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Entering production in 2490, the primitive 3R was built in response to the Terran Hegemony creating new versions of the 'Mechs the Wolverine was originally based on. It traded in 3 tons of armor and a ton of autocannon ammunition for a shoulder-mounted six-pack SRM launcher with one ton of reloads - a loadout that would remain essentially unchanged for the later 'modernized' 6R. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.83
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 原始型3R于2490年投产，其研制是为了回应地球霸权为狼獾最初所依据的几款机甲推出新版本。它用3吨装甲和一个吨位的自动炮弹药，换取了一具装在肩部的六联装SRM发射器及一个吨位的备用弹药——这一配置在后来“现代化”的6R上基本保持不变。 特性：改进通讯 投放费用倍率：0.83

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Introduced in 2834, the 6D drops the SRM and one heat sink of the 6R to upgrade the AC/5 to an Autocannon/10, mounted in the left arm. Two tons of ammunition in the left side supply it, spread through the arm and torso. One jump jet is moved from each leg to the corresponding side torso. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 6D 于 2834 年推出，它去掉了 6R 的 SRM 和一具散热器，将 AC/5 升级为安装在左臂的自动炮/10。左侧的两吨弹药为其供弹，弹药分布在手臂和躯干之中。每条腿各有一具跳跃推进器移至对应的侧躯干。 特性：改进通讯 投放费用倍率：1.03

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A variant used by the Mercenary unit Gray Death Legion before their demise. Using mostly stolen or looted Clan tech they can upgrade the firepower considerable, including an Ultra AC/5 and Medium Pulse Lasers. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是雇佣兵部队灰死军团在其覆灭前使用的变型。他们大多用偷来或缴获的部族技术，把火力大幅升级，包括一门超级AC/5和几门中型脉冲激光。 特性：改进通讯 投放费用倍率：1.11

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Wolverine WVR-6KH was made popular when the mercenary unit Kell Hounds used this custom design of theirs to infiltrate a pirate base by painting them in the same color scheme as the pirates own Wolverines. The mercenaries then opened fire without warning once inside, unleashing their advanced weaponry to great success at point blank range. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 狼獾WVR-6KH之所以出名，是因为雇佣兵部队凯尔猎犬用他们的这款定制设计潜入了一处海盗基地——把它涂成与海盗自己的狼獾相同的配色。进入后，这些雇佣兵毫无预警地开火，在零距离上倾泻他们的先进武器，大获成功。 特性：改进通讯 投放费用倍率：1.05

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Another of the many custom refits of the Wolverine WVR-6R by a mercenary outfit, the -6MR was the preferred variant of the famous McCarron's Armored Cavalry unit. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: -6MR是某支雇佣兵部队对Wolverine WVR-6R进行的众多定制改装之一，也是著名的麦卡伦装甲骑兵团偏爱的变型。 特性：改进通讯 投放费用倍率：1.05

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 'Renata' has some interesting upgrades over a stock Wolverine WVR-6R, it replaces both the generic autocannon and the medium laser with a more advanced versions, and uses Ferro-Fibrous armor to increase the amount of armor plating the 'Mech can carry. The FCS and sensors of the 'Mech have also been upgraded with improved aftermarket models. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: “Renata”相比原厂的 Wolverine WVR-6R 有几项颇有意思的升级：它把通用型自动炮和中型激光都换成了更先进的型号，并使用铁纤维装甲来增加机甲可携带的装甲板数量。该机甲的火控系统与传感器也换装了改进型的售后改装件。 特性：改进通讯 投放费用倍率：1.05

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This Clan Early variant of the 6R exchanges the AC/5 for two LB 2-X Autocannons and upgrades the SRM-6 to an Improved version. Two of the heat sinks are dropped as a result of the lowered cooling needs. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是6R的部族早期变型，以两门LB 2-X自动炮取代AC/5，并把SRM-6升级为改进型。由于冷却需求下降，拆掉了两个散热器。 特性：改进通讯 投放费用倍率：1.03

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A Mercenary refit of the -6R which adds more durability in form of CASE protection to both side torsos and a C3 slave at the cost of two heat sinks. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: -6R的雇佣兵改装型，以牺牲两具散热器为代价，在两侧躯干加装CASE防护并提供一台C3从属机，从而提升了生存能力。 特性：改进通讯 投放费用倍率：1.03

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A high tech, high cost refit of the -6R initially by a small mercenary outfit called 'Silver Lining', but eventually caught attention of the larger units and as a result there are a number of them out there. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是 -6R 的高技术、高成本改装型，最初由一支名为“Silver Lining”的小型雇佣兵部队完成，但最终引起了更大规模部队的关注，因此如今存世的这类机甲数量不少。 特性：改进通讯 投放费用倍率：1.05

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The first 'Mech used by famous arena MechWarrior Victor Vandergriff as he defeated Drago 'Death from Above' Alldredge. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.07
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是著名竞技场机甲战士维克托·范德格里夫使用的第一台机甲，他驾驶它击败了绰号“天降死神”的德拉戈·奥德里奇。 特性：改进通讯 投放费用倍率：1.07

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A prototype version of the later mass produced -8K variant. Mounting a ER Large Laser, three Medium Pulse Lasers and an SRM-4 combined with a Guardian ECM Suite and a master C3 computer. The produced units of the variant eventually were sold off to mainly mercenary units or acquired in underhanded ways by pirates. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是后来量产的-8K变型的原型版本，装有一门增程大型激光、三门中型脉冲激光和一具SRM-4，并配合一套守护者电子对抗套件和一台C3主计算机。该变型产出的机体最终主要卖给了雇佣兵部队，或被海盗以不正当手段获取。 特性：改进通讯 投放费用倍率：1.05

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Quarantine Hero 'Mech is built around 275-rated XL engine and an Endo Steel frame, fitted with three jump jets and clad in near maximum armor. Using its entire left-side as a shield, the Quarantine carries an AC/5 and a trio of Medium Lasers in its right arm supported by two right torso mounted SRM-6 launchers. Carrying only twelve double heat sinks, the 'Mech stores three tons worth of SRM and autocannon reloads split between both legs. Quirk: Extended Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.07
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Quarantine 英雄机甲以一台 275 级 XL 引擎和内骨架框架为核心，装有 3 台跳跃推进器，并披挂接近最大值的装甲。Quarantine 以整个左侧作为盾牌，右臂搭载一门 AC/5 和三门中型激光，并有两具装在右躯干的 SRM-6 发射器提供支援。这台机甲仅携带十二台双散热器，三吨重的 SRM 与自动炮弹药则分装在两条腿中。 特性：扩展躯干旋转 投放费用倍率：1.07

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A refit by the design entity known as Tricky Dick. Based on the -7K, the TD replaces the SRM-6 racks with Streak SRM-6 tubes, and the Large Pulse Laser was turned into an ER PPC to make the 'Mech more viable for longer ranged attacks. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是名为“狡猾迪克”的设计机构所进行的改装。该型号以-7K为基础，将SRM-6发射巢更换为连发SRM-6发射管，并把大型脉冲激光改为增程粒子炮，使这台机甲在远距离攻击时更具优势。 特性：改进通讯 投放费用倍率：1.05

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The A loadout upsizes the LBX from the primary configuration to an LBX AC/20, but drops the Ultra AC/10 to instead mount two ER Large Laser. The LRM launcher is exchanged for a Streak SRM-6. Four additional heat sinks were also added. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: A载荷把主配置的LBX升级为LBX AC/20，但拆掉超级AC/10，改为装两门增程大型激光。LRM发射器换成连发SRM-6，另加四个散热器。 特性：易于维护 投放费用倍率：1.15 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Bravo configuration switches the 'Mech to a missile boat role, with four LRM-20 launchers as the main weapons. The 'Mech also mounts a Narc launcher and an AMS. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Bravo 配置将这台机甲转为导弹平台角色，以四部 LRM-20 发射器为主武器。它还装有一部 Narc 发射器和一套 AMS。 特性：易于维护 投放费用倍率：1.15 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Primary configuration of the Woodsman II mounts both an LBX AC/10 and an Ultra AC/10, for the capability of a devastating hit at long range. An LRM-20 launcher can provide both direct or indirect fire as needed. The only short range weapon is a small ER Laser in the right torso. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Woodsman II的主配置同时搭载LBX AC/10和Ultra AC/10，具备在远距离发动毁灭性打击的能力。一具LRM-20发射器可按需提供直瞄或间接火力。唯一的近程武器是右躯干上的一门增程小型激光。 特性：易于维护 投放费用倍率：1.15 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The most common alternate configuration in the Woodsman's long career mounted two ER PPCs, two Medium Pulse Lasers, and a Large Pulse Laser and ER Small Laser for backup. It keeps the same number of double heat sinks as the primary configuration, but relocates them across the torso. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.12 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在 Woodsman 漫长的服役生涯中，最常见的备用配置装设两门增程粒子炮、两门中型脉冲激光，以及作为辅助的一门大型脉冲激光和一门增程小型激光。它保留了与主配置相同数量的双散热器，但将其重新分布到躯干各处。 特性：易于维护 投放费用倍率：1.12 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This configuration is a low-heat high damage option for pilots. A Gauss rifle is mounted in the right arm while the left arm has an ER Large Laser and ER Medium Laser. The right torso has an SRM-4 while the left torso carries an LRM-10. Both of these launchers have an Artemis IV FCS. For anti-infantry work, a Small Pulse Laser is carried in the center torso. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.12 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 此配置是给飞行员的一个低热量高伤害选项：右臂装一门高斯步枪，左臂一门增程大型激光和一门增程中型激光；右躯干一具SRM-4，左躯干一具LRM-10，这两具发射器都带阿尔忒弥斯IV火控系统。反步兵方面，中央躯干带一门小型脉冲激光。 特性：易于维护 投放费用倍率：1.12 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The primary Woodsman configuration would be mirrored in the default Timber Wolf weapon load. Each arm carried an ER Large Laser and an ER Medium Laser, and a pair of LRM-15s rounded out the configuration in each side torso. To provide anti-infantry capability, a pair of Machine Guns were mounted in the center torso. Five additional pod mounted double heat sinks brought the total up to seventeen, allowing the Woodsman to fire most of its weaponry without worrying about heat overloads. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.12 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 樵夫的主配置后来被映射为木狼的默认武器配置。每只手臂各带一门增程大型激光和一门增程中型激光，两侧躯干内各有一对LRM-15补全配置。为提供反步兵能力，中央躯干装了两挺机枪。五个额外挂载式双散热器使总数达到十七个，让樵夫能在不必担心热量过载的情况下发射大部分武器。 特性：易于维护 投放费用倍率：1.12 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Wraith marked Curtiss Militech's entry into BattleMech production. When the design was announced, many felt that the design would be little more than a walking water cooler. What the critics got was a shock. The Wraith is a 'Mech that, when properly employed, can wreak havoc on an enemy with its astounding speed and maneuverability. It is built around a massive LTV 385 XL Engine that allows it to reach speeds of just under 119 km/h. The Wraith has a simple, yet effective, pulse weapons payload. Pulse laser weaponry allows the Mech to negate most of the side effects on accuracy that are introduced by the Wraith's heavy use of jump jets, making it incredibly accurate and powerful for such a lightly armed Mech. Quirk: Ubiquitous Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 幽灵标志着柯蒂斯军工正式进军战斗机甲生产领域。当该设计公布时，许多人认为它不过是个会走路的饮水机；而批评者们得到的却是一记重击。幽灵是一台在运用得当时，能凭借惊人的速度与机动性在敌阵中肆虐的机甲。它以一台庞大的LTV 385 XL引擎为核心，最高速度略低于119 km/h。幽灵的脉冲武器配置简单而高效——脉冲激光武器让机甲能够抵消大量使用跳跃推进器所带来的命中率副作用，使其在如此轻装的机甲中拥有难以置信的精准度与威力。 特性：随处可见 投放费用倍率：1.05

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Wraith marked Curtiss Militech's entry into BattleMech production. When the design was announced, many felt that the design would be little more than a walking water cooler. What the critics got was a shock. The Wraith is a 'Mech that, when properly employed, can wreak havoc on an enemy with its astounding speed and maneuverability. It is built around a massive LTV 385 XL Engine that allows it to reach speeds of just under 119 km/h. The Wraith has a simple, yet effective, pulse weapons payload. Pulse laser weaponry allows the Mech to negate most of the side effects on accuracy that are introduced by the Wraith's heavy use of jump jets, making it incredibly accurate and powerful for such a lightly armed Mech. A simple modification of the Wraith, the TR2 simply replaces the Large Pulse Laser with an ER PPC, turning the 'Mech into a highly capable sniper. Quirk: Ubiquitous Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 幽灵标志着柯蒂斯·米尔泰克进军战斗机甲生产。该设计公布时，许多人觉得它不过是台会走路的水冷器，而批评者们随后被震住了。使用得当时，幽灵能凭借惊人的速度与机动性在敌阵中大肆破坏。它围绕一台庞大的LTV 385 XL引擎建造，速度可达略低于119公里/小时。幽灵的脉冲武器载荷简单却有效：脉冲激光几乎抵消了幽灵大量使用跳跃推进器对精度造成的负面影响，使这台武装如此轻薄的机甲异常精准而强力。幽灵的一次简单改装，TR2仅以一门增程粒子炮取代大型脉冲激光，便把该机甲变成极为出色的狙击手。 特性：无处不在 投放费用倍率：1.05

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A second line Clan mech, the 45 ton Wyvern IIC is an upgrade of the SLDF Wyverns that survived the Exodus. Built using a cache of Wyverns, Clan Burrock upgraded every aspect of the original mech with Clan tech. Retaining the original 180-rated Fusion Core, the Wyvern IIC is armed with a mix of weapons. An ER Large Laser and an LRM-10 make up the Mechs long range firepower, with a pair of ER Medium Lasers and an SRM-6 for medium range combat. A pair of MG’s, a Flamer and a pair of ER Smalls give additional firepower at close range. Quirk: Protected Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.07
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 45吨的飞龙IIC是部族二线机甲，是对挺过大逃亡的SLDF飞龙的升级。伯洛克部族利用一批飞龙库存，用部族技术升级了原机甲的各个方面。飞龙IIC保留原来的180额定聚变核心，采用混装武器：一门增程大型激光和一具LRM-10构成远程火力，一对增程中型激光和一具SRM-6用于中距作战，两挺机枪、一具火焰喷射器和两门增程小型激光在近距提供额外火力。 特性：受保护驱动器 投放费用倍率：1.07

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Designed for Urban combat, the 45 ton Wyvern blends heavy armor, jump jets and a versatile weapons package. Powered by a 180-rated Fusion Core, the Wyvern 5N is armed with a Large Laser and an LRM-10. For close range combat, the Mech carries a pair of Small Lasers and a SRM-6. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.01
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 45吨的Wyvern为城市战而设计，集厚重装甲、跳跃推进器与多样化武器于一身。Wyvern 5N由额定180的聚变核心驱动，装备一门大型激光和一具LRM-10。为应对近距离战斗，该机甲还装有两门小型激光和一具SRM-6。 特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1.01

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Designed for Urban combat, the 45 ton Wyvern blends heavy armor, jump jets and a versatile weapons package. Powered by a 180-rated XL Engine, the Wyvern 5Nb is armed with a Large Pulse Laser and an LRM-10. For close range combat, the Mech carries a Medium Laser, a Small Laser and an SRM-6. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.01
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 45吨的双足飞龙为城市战而设计，兼具厚重装甲、跳跃推进器与多样的武器组合。由一具额定180的XL引擎驱动，双足飞龙5Nb装备一门大型脉冲激光与一具LRM-10。近距离作战时，这台机甲携带一门中型激光、一门小型激光与一具SRM-6。 特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1.01

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Designed for Urban combat, the 45 ton Wyvern blends heavy armor, jump jets and a versatile weapons package. Powered by a 180-rated Fusion Core, the Wyvern 5Nsl is armed with an ER Large Laser and an LRM-10. For close range combat, the Mech carries a 4 Small Lasers and 3 SSRM-2’s. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 飞龙为城市作战而设计，这款45吨机甲融合了厚重装甲、跳跃推进器与多用途武器组合。飞龙5Nsl由一台额定180的聚变核心驱动，装备一门增程大型激光和一具LRM-10。在近距离作战方面，该机甲携带4门小型激光和3具SSRM-2。 特性：坚固耐用 投放费用倍率：1.05

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Designed for Urban combat, the 45 ton Wyvern blends heavy armor, jump jets and a versatile weapons package. Powered by a 180-rated Fusion Engine, the Wyvern 5UX is armed with an ER Large Laser. For close range combat, the Mech carries a pair of SRM-6’s and a pair of Grenade Launchers. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 45吨的双足飞龙为城市战而设计，兼具厚重装甲、跳跃推进器与多样的武器组合。由一具额定180的聚变引擎驱动，双足飞龙5UX装备一门增程大型激光。近距离作战时，这台机甲携带一对SRM-6与一对榴弹发射器。 特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1.05

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Designed for Urban combat, the 45 ton Wyvern blends heavy armor, jump jets and a versatile weapons package. Powered by a 180-rated Fusion Core, the Wyvern 6N is armed with a Large Laser and an LRM-10. For close range combat, the Mech carries a pair of Small Lasers and a SRM-6. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.01
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 45吨的翼龙专为城市战设计，把厚重装甲、跳跃推进器和多样的武器组合融为一体。翼龙6N由180额定聚变核心驱动，装备1门大型激光和1具LRM-10。近距作战方面，该机甲携带2门小型激光和1具SRM-6。 <特性：坚固 <投放费用倍率：1.01

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Designed for Urban combat, the 45 ton Wyvern blends heavy armor, jump jets and a versatile weapons package. Powered by a 180-rated Fusion Core, the Wyvern 9N is armed with a Large Pulse Laser and an LRM-10. For close range combat, the Mech carries a pair of Medium Pulse Lasers and a SSRM-2. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 45 吨的 Wyvern 为城市战而设计，融合了厚重装甲、跳跃推进器和多样的武器组合。Wyvern 9N 由额定 180 的聚变核心驱动，装备一门大型脉冲激光和一具 LRM-10。为进行近距离战斗，该机甲携带两门中型脉冲激光和一具 SSRM-2。 特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1.03

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An early, primitive prototype introduced in 2564, the 2O used Age of War technology. In particular, the engine, cockpit and armor were all primitive technology. It could reach a top speed of 54 km/h and was protected by fifteen tons of primitive armor. Eighteen single heat sinks dissipated the heat produced by an Autocannon/10, SRM-4, Large Laser, and two medium and Small Lasers. Quirk: Protected Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.96
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 2O 是 2564 年推出的早期原始型原型机，采用战争年代的技术。尤其是引擎、座舱与装甲全部为原始技术。它的最高速度可达 54 km/h，由十五吨原始装甲提供防护。十八具单散热器用于散发一门 AC/10、SRM-4、大型激光以及两门中型与小型激光产生的热量。 特性：受保护驱动器 投放费用倍率：0.96

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An Autocannon/20 with three tons of ammunition provides substantial close hitting power. It is backed up with three Medium Lasers, a six-tube SRM Pack, and a rear-firing small laser. A single PPC rounds out this design's weaponry, giving it some range. Quirk: Protected Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一门AC/20配三吨弹药提供可观的近程打击力，辅以三门中型激光、一组六管SRM包和一门后向小型激光。一门单独的粒子炮为该设计的武器收尾，赋予它一定的射程。 特性：受保护驱动器 投放费用倍率：1.16

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Designed specifically as a fire support 'Mech by Curtis Militech, the Yeoman uses a combination of Endo Steel and Ferro-Fibrous armor, allowing paired LRM-15 launchers and LRM-10 launchers to be mounted in each side torso. 6 tons of ammunition are stored in CASE protected magazines. Quirk: Accurate Weapon - Missiles Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 自耕农由柯蒂斯·米尔泰克专门设计为火力支援机甲，采用内骨架与铁纤维装甲的组合，使每侧躯干都能装下成对的LRM-15和LRM-10发射器。6吨弹药储存在CASE防护的弹药舱中。 特性：精准武器 - 导弹 投放费用倍率：1.08 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The base production version, the BWP-2B was a bit of a generalized work horse. The 'Mech design mounts an Autocannon 5, four SRM-2 launchers, two LRM-5 launchers and a Large Laser. A Small Laser was also added to use up some spare space. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为基础生产版本，BWP-2B算是一台泛用主力。该机甲设计装有一门自动炮5、四具SRM-2发射器、两具LRM-5发射器和一门大型激光，另加一门小型激光以用掉些多余空间。 特性：稳定 投放费用倍率：1.14 手臂驱动器限制：左下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An \"upgunned\" version of the 2B , the 2E replaced the LRMs with a single LRM-10 and the SRMs with one SRM-6. The Small Laser was replaced with an extra half-ton of armor. The Large Laser and autocannon were swapped out for two PPCs. Because they did not upgrade the heat dissipation system along with the weapons, MechWarriors had to use volley fire, leading to displeasure with the design. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为2B的“加炮”版本，2E以一门单独的LRM-10取代LRM，以一具SRM-6取代SRM，小型激光换成额外半吨装甲，大型激光和自动炮则换成两门粒子炮。由于没有随武器一起升级散热系统，机甲战士不得不采用交替齐射，这引发了对该设计的不满。 特性：稳定 投放费用倍率：1.14 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 3A is an upgrade of the 2E Ymir using Star League technology and was developed in 2733. It downgraded the PPCs to standard Large Lasers even as double heat sinks were used. An Artemis IV Fire Control System was added to each missile launcher. The remaining tonnage went towards a Medium Laser and additional armor. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 3A是2E伊米尔采用星际联盟技术的升级型号，于2733年研制完成。它把粒子炮降级为标准大型激光，同时改用双散热器，并为每具导弹发射器加装了阿尔忒弥斯IV火控系统。剩余的吨位则用于一具中型激光和额外装甲。 特性：稳定 投放费用倍率：1.16 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The original Ymir, the X1 prototype could only reach 53 km/h due to its primitive engine. The cockpit and armor were also both primitive, but the design mounted fifteen and a half tons of armor in total. Mounting sixteen heat sinks, the X1 was equipped with two LRM-5s in the right torso,a large laser in the right arm and an AC/5 in the left arm for long-range work. Four SRM-2s were mounted in the left torso for short range work - the designers believing that multiple small systems would be easier to maintain and adapt than larger systems - along with two vehicle flamers mounted in the right hand arm. The vehicle flamers were chosen for the design because of concerns about the safety of taking plasma directly from the reactor, although protecting and shielding the flamers caused problems. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.94 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为最初的伊米尔，X1原型机因采用原始引擎，最高时速只能达到53 km/h。驾驶舱与装甲同样是原始型号，但该设计的装甲总重达到十五吨半。X1装有十六台散热器，右躯干配备两具LRM-5，右臂装有一门大型激光，左臂装有一门AC/5用于远程作战。左躯干装有四具SRM-2用于近程作战——设计师认为多个小型系统比大型系统更易维护和改装——右手臂上还装有两具车辆用火焰喷射器。该设计之所以选用车辆用火焰喷射器，是因为担心直接从反应堆抽取等离子体的安全性，不过为火焰喷射器提供防护与屏蔽也带来了不少麻烦。 特性：稳定 投放费用倍率：0.94 手臂驱动器限制：左臂下部、右臂下部

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Yu Huang Y-H11F has a mixed weapons loadout, aimed to cover most ranges of engagement. For long rang attacks, the 'Mech carries an ER PPC and LRM-10. Two ER Medium Lasers cover medium range, and as the foes get closer an Ultra AC/20 is ready to finish them off. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 玉皇Y-H11F采用混装武器，意在覆盖大多数交战距离。远程攻击用一门增程粒子炮和一具LRM-10；两门增程中型激光覆盖中距离；敌人逼近后，一门超级AC/20随时准备解决他们。 特性：指挥机甲 投放费用倍率：1.16 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Zeus was first built by the Lyran Commonwealth in 2787, just as the First Succession War began. Built at the request of Lyran Commonwealth Armed Forces commanders for a new light-assault 'Mech, the Zeus is fast enough to keep up with most heavy 'Mechs, and is equally capable of defeating them. Introduced in 2940, and an apparent precursor to the 6T, the 6A sports a PPC and Large Laser backed up by considerable short range firepower in the form of three SRM6 launchers and two Medium Lasers. Quirk: Barrel Fist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.12 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 宙斯最早由莱兰联邦于2787年建造，当时第一次继承战争刚刚爆发。应莱兰联邦武装部队指挥官之请而开发的这款新型轻型突击机甲，速度足以跟上大多数重型机甲，也完全有能力击败它们。6A于2940年问世，显然是6T的前身，它装有一门粒子炮与一门大型激光，并以三门SRM6发射器与两门中型激光所构成的强大近距离火力作为后盾。 特性：炮管拳 投放费用倍率：1.12 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The -6SR is a battlefield refit from the standard -6S. It replaces the AC/5 with an Ultra AC/5, switches to use double heat sinks and adds C.A.S.E. protection for all ammunition. To improve its defensive strengths, the 'Mech also adds a C3 Slave computer to the center torso and an Armored Cowl to its head. Quirk: Barrel Fist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: -6SR是由标准-6S改来的野战改装。它把AC/5换成超级AC/5，改用双散热器，并为全部弹药加装C.A.S.E.防护。为增强防御，该机甲还在中央躯干加装一台C3从机计算机，并为头部加装机罩。 特性：炮管拳 投放费用倍率：1.14 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Zeus was first built by the Lyran Commonwealth in 2787, just as the First Succession War began. Built at the request of Lyran Commonwealth Armed Forces commanders for a new light-assault 'Mech, the Zeus is fast enough to keep up with most heavy 'Mechs, and is equally capable of defeating them. The 9S was an upgrade using Star League technology, debuting in 3048. It carried as its main weapon an ER PPC in its left arm, retained as back-up for long-range combat an LRM-15 launcher and an ER Large Laser. For close combat, the 9S is equipped with two Medium Pulse Lasers. Quirk: Barrel Fist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 宙斯最早由莱兰联邦于2787年建造，当时第一次继承战争刚刚爆发。应莱兰联邦武装部队指挥官之请而开发的这款新型轻型突击机甲，速度足以跟上大多数重型机甲，也完全有能力击败它们。9S是采用星际联盟技术的升级型号，于3048年首次亮相。它以左臂的增程粒子炮为主武器，并保留了一具LRM-15发射器与一门增程大型激光作为远距离战斗的后备。近距离作战时，9S装备两门中型脉冲激光。 特性：炮管拳 投放费用倍率：1.14 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Zeus was first built by the Lyran Commonwealth in 2787, just as the First Succession War began. Built at the request of Lyran Commonwealth Armed Forces commanders for a new light-assault 'Mech, the Zeus is fast enough to keep up with most heavy 'Mechs, and is equally capable of defeating them. The 9S2 was a modified version of the 9S. The armor and twelve double heat sinks of original were retained, but the engine was changed to an XL. A Gauss Rifle took the place of the ER PPC while the right arm carried a pair of LRM-15s. Though the Cyclops XII extended range laser was kept, the medium pulse lasers had to be removed to provide enough space for the modifications. Quirk: Barrel Fist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.12 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 宙斯由莱兰联邦于2787年首次建造，正值第一次继承战争爆发。它应莱兰联邦武装部队指挥官对新型轻型突击机甲的要求而生，速度足以跟上大多数重型机甲，同样有能力击败它们。9S2是9S的改进版：原版的装甲和十二个双散热器被保留，但引擎换成XL。一门高斯步枪取代了增程粒子炮，右臂则装一对LRM-15。虽然独眼巨人XII增程激光被保留，但中型脉冲激光不得不拆除，以腾出足够空间完成改装。 特性：炮管拳 投放费用倍率：1.12 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Zeus was first built by the Lyran Commonwealth in 2787, just as the First Succession War began. Built at the request of Lyran Commonwealth Armed Forces commanders for a new light-assault 'Mech, the Zeus is fast enough to keep up with most heavy 'Mechs, and is equally capable of defeating them. The 9S-DC is a sub-variant of the 9S introduced in 3049 designed to include a Command Console. It carried as its main weapon an ER PPC in its left arm, retained as back-up for long-range combat an LRM-15 launcher and an ER Large Laser. The inclusion of a Command Console necessitated the removal of one of the two Medium pulse Lasers. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 宙斯由莱兰联邦于2787年首次建造，正值第一次继承战争爆发。它应莱兰联邦武装部队指挥官对新型轻型突击机甲的要求而生，速度足以跟上大多数重型机甲，同样有能力击败它们。9S-DC是3049年推出的9S子变型，设计上包含一座指挥控制台。它的主武器是左臂一门增程粒子炮，远程战斗的后手则保留一具LRM-15发射器和一门增程大型激光。加装指挥控制台迫使它拆掉两门中型脉冲激光中的一门。 特性：指挥机甲 投放费用倍率：1.14 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Zeus was first built by the Lyran Commonwealth in 2787, just as the First Succession War began. Built at the request of Lyran Commonwealth Armed Forces commanders for a new light-assault 'Mech, the Zeus is fast enough to keep up with most heavy 'Mechs, and is equally capable of defeating them. The personal 'Mech of Hauptmann-General Leonidas Brannock, commander of the 4th Skye Guards during their assault on Glengarry, the Zeus Leonidas was based on the ZEU-9S. It carried an Artemis IV enhanced LRM-20 and a Gauss Rifle in place of the PPC and LRM-15. The rest of the weapons remained the same. Quirk: Barrel Fist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 宙斯由莱兰联邦于2787年首次建造，正值第一次继承战争爆发。它应莱兰联邦武装部队指挥官对新型轻型突击机甲的要求而生，速度足以跟上大多数重型机甲，同样有能力击败它们。这是第4斯凯卫队指挥官、上校将军列奥尼达斯·布兰诺克在进攻格伦加里时的私人机甲，宙斯列奥尼达斯以ZEU-9S为基础，以一门带阿尔忒弥斯IV的LRM-20和一门高斯步枪取代粒子炮与LRM-15，其余武器保持不变。 特性：炮管拳 投放费用倍率：1.14 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Zeus ZEU-P-X is a prototype version of the Zeus that would eventually be further developed into the Zeus X. It mounts the same LBX AC/20, MRM-30 and two ER Medium Lasers as the eventual Zeus X ZEU-X, but uses a standard chassis and has considerably less armor. However, the ZEU-X-P mounts a C3 Slave computer, something the ZEU-X is lacking. Quirk: Barrel Fist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 宙斯ZEU-P-X是宙斯的原型版本，后来进一步发展成了宙斯X。它装与最终版宙斯X ZEU-X相同的LBX AC/20、MRM-30和两门增程中型激光，但使用标准底盘，装甲也少得多。不过ZEU-X-P带一台C3从机计算机，而ZEU-X没有。 特性：炮管拳 投放费用倍率：1.14 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Zeus was first built by the Lyran Commonwealth in 2787, just as the First Succession War began. Built at the request of Lyran Commonwealth Armed Forces commanders for a new light-assault 'Mech, the Zeus is fast enough to keep up with most heavy 'Mechs, and is equally capable of defeating them. The Shokomish is the custom variant of the 6S designed to emulate the capabilities of the MechWarrior known as Sealth. Mounting the stock AC/5 and Medium Laser, this variant also features a PPC, twin SRM6 , and twin LRM10 launchers. Included on the Shokomish is a MASC in order to allow nearly any MechWarrior to emulate the famed Sealth, if not replicate him. Quirk: Barrel Fist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Zeus 于 2787 年由莱兰联邦首次建造，恰逢第一次继承战争爆发。它是应莱兰联邦武装力量指挥官的要求而打造的轻型突击机甲；Zeus 的速度足以跟上大多数重型机甲，也完全有能力击败它们。Shokomish 是 6S 的定制改型，旨在复现被称为 Sealth 的机甲战士的能力。它保留原装的 AC/5 和中型激光，同时还配备一门粒子炮、双联 SRM6 和双联 LRM10 发射器。Shokomish 还装有一具 MASC，让几乎任何机甲战士都能效仿那位著名的 Sealth，即便无法完全复制他。 特性：炮管拳 投放费用倍率：1.14 手臂驱动器限制：左下臂、右下臂

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Manufactured on Kwangjong-ni by Defiance, the Zeus X was both a poster child for excellence in production engineering and an innovative high-technology platform. The first of what became commonly referred to as the Zeus X series, the ZEU-X was a variant of the venerable Zeus BattleMech developed using Experimental Technology to push the envelope of the original design. The 'Mech was armed with an LB-X Autocannon/20 as its primary weapon, backed up by an MRM-30 launcher. The ZEU-X carried three tons of ammunition for the LB-X AC/20 and two tons for the MRM-30, stored in the right torso and protected by CASE II. For close combat, the Zeus had two Medium X-Pulse Lasers. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Zeus X 由 Defiance 在 Kwangjong-ni 星制造，既是生产工程卓越水准的典范，也是一款创新的高技术平台。ZEU-X 是后来被通称为 Zeus X 系列的首个型号，是经典 Zeus 战斗机甲的变型，采用实验性技术研制，以突破原始设计的极限。该机甲以一门 LB-X 自动炮/20 为主武器，辅以一具 MRM-30 发射器。ZEU-X 为 LB-X AC/20 携带三吨弹药，为 MRM-30 携带两吨弹药，均储存于右躯干并由 CASE II 保护。近距离作战方面，Zeus 装有两门中型 X 脉冲激光。 特性：指挥机甲 投放费用倍率：1.16 手臂驱动器限制：左下臂、右下臂

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Developed by the New Earth Trading Company in 2587, the Alacorn attracted a reputation in the SLDF as an effective and dependable tank. Introduced in 2561, the Mk I Alacorn was equipped with a trio of AC/10s with five tons of ammunition. Equipped with a standard fusion engine, it was protected by ten and a half tons of Ferro-Fibrous Armor. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 3/5 hexes / 90/150 meters. Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Developed by the New Earth Trading Company in 2587, the Alacorn attracted a reputation in the SLDF as an effective and dependable tank. The Mk II Alacorn was another design prototype introduced alongside with the Mk I. Though it used the same engine and chassis as the Mk I, the Mk II carried three AC/20s in its turret. It only carried three tons of ammunition however, and to make room for the heavier guns the armor protection was reduced to six tons. This resulted in a vehicle with a much shorter effective range, meaning it had to close with enemy forces, but the machine lacked the armor to survive a close-up fight. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 3/5 hexes / 90/150 meters. Armor: Armor Structure: Structure Values A S Front 140 50 Left 105 50 Right 105 50 Rear 80 50 Turret 115 50 Total 545 250 Quirk: Improved Communications
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 阿拉科恩由新地球贸易公司于2587年研制，在SLDF中赢得了高效可靠坦克的名声。Mk II阿拉科恩是与Mk I同期推出的另一款设计原型。虽然它与Mk I使用相同的引擎与底盘，炮塔内却装有三门AC/20。但它只带三吨弹药，且为容纳更重的火炮，装甲防护被削到六吨。结果这辆车的有效射程短得多，意味着它必须逼近敌军，而这台机器又没有在近身战中存活所需的装甲。 生态限制：无。 移动：3/5 格 / 90/150 米。 护甲： 护甲 结构：结构 数值 A S 正面 140 50 左侧 105 50 右侧 105 50 后方 80 50 炮塔 115 50 总计 545 250 特性：改进通讯

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Developed in 2587, the Alacorn attracted a reputation in the SLDF as an effective and dependable tank. Although some of the earliest versions mount various autocannons the Alacorn became famous for its array of gauss rifles. This Clan upgraded Alacorn mounts four Gauss Rifles with five tons of ammo. Their combination of heavy punch and long range makes the Alacorn a threat to any unit on the field. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 3/5 hexes / 90/150 meters. Armor: Ferro-Fibrous (C) Structure: Structure Values A S Front 350 50 Left 275 50 Right 275 50 Rear 170 50 Turret 270 50 Total 1340 250 Quirk: Improved Communications

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Boss, Alacorns are one of the few tanks you will ever hear me say can reasonably stand toe to toe with a 'Mech. Their armor is incredibly thick and they are reasonably armed, a wise MechWarrior would stay weary of them.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 老板，阿拉科恩是我会跟你说能与机甲正面叫板的少数坦克之一。它们的装甲厚得难以置信，武装也相当不错，明智的机甲战士会对它们保持警惕。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Developed by the New Earth Trading Company in 2587, the Alacorn attracted a reputation in the SLDF as an effective and dependable tank. Another prototype developed shortly after the Mk III in 2588, this variant was essentially an upgrade of the Mk. II to alleviate its armor problems. It was still outfitted with the ultimate big-gun of its era: a trio of AC/20s. Despite addressing some of the concerns of the Mk. II, it saw a limited production run. Biome Restrictions: None. Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Daimyo HQ was a heavy theater command unit utilized by the Draconis Combine. The first Daimyo was fielded in 2796 at the beginning of the Succession Wars by Jinjiro Kurita, who used the vehicle during the Kentares Massacre. While the Coordinator attended executions in person, the Daimyo HQ's crew transmitted the data to ComStar representatives on the planet who then sent the data through the whole Inner Sphere. When Jinjiro discovered the treason, the whole crew was executed. Daimyo production ceased between the years 3027 and 3063 because the unit's communication system technology become a form of Lostech. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 5/8 hexes / 150/240 meters. Armor: Armor Structure: Structure Values A S Front 245 25 Left 140 25 Right 140 25 Rear 85 25 Turret 155 25 Total 765 125 Quirk: Battle Computer B2000

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Heavy Hover APC is a larger version of its standard counterpart able to carry two full platoons of Foot Infantry or one platoon of either Motorized or Jump Infantry. No more a fighting vehicle than its 'standard' counterpart, the Heavy Tracked APC carries only two front mounted Machine Guns supplied by half a ton of ammunition each. The lack of a turret makes the APC particularly vulnerable to flanking or attacks from the rear, but most can successfully unload their troops before an enemy gets in position to launch such an attack. Biome Restrictions: This unit can not deploy in Lunar or Martian biomes due to using an ICE. Movement: 8/12 hexes / 240/360 meters. Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A durable and expensive APC, the 30 ton Trident Tracked Transport was developed by Aldis Industries, during the First Succession War and it has seen constant production ever since. Armed with a pair of LRM-5’s and a pair of Machine Guns; the Trident can ferry a full squad of troops in relative comfort and support them once they disembark. Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The backbone of any vehicular military unit, APCs have been carrying infantry since the days of pre-spaceflight Terra. Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Athena Combat Vehicle is a front-line tank produced primarily by Clan Hell's Horses. Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Randal Advanced Tactical's Candiru is not a very impressive tank viewed on it's merits. But it is impressively simple and cheap. Manufacturing one requires only basic industrialization, and many of the parts can be bought off the shelf on developed worlds. This means that virtually anyone who is anyone can field a RAT. And out on the periphery any armor is better than none. In keeping with this DIY approach to defense RAT sells the plans and offers technical consultants, but doesn't manufacture the tanks themselves. This business model has been surprisingly successful, allowing them to research and design a line of similar vehicles. Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Introduced in 3054, the Cavalry Attack Helicopter was one of a number of VTOLs developed to fight the Clans by Michaelson Heavy Industries. Suited to hit-and-run engagements rather than front-line combat situations the Cavalry gained a reputation for flawless service when used correctly. It has since seen service in former FedCom States and minor-nobles among the Chaos March. While capable of speeds up to 162 km/h, the Cavalry doesn't rely on this alone for protection and has 3.5 tons armor. The craft can handle a direct hit from a Clan-tech ER PPC on the nose and keep flying. Biome Restrictions: This unit can not deploy in Lunar or Martian biomes due to using an ICE. Movement: 10/15 hexes / 300/450 meters. Armor: Armor Structure: Structure Values A S Front 115 15 Left 65 15 Right 65 15 Rear 40 15 Total 300 75 Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 骑兵攻击直升机于3054年列装，是迈克尔森重工业公司为对抗部族而研制的众多VTOL之一。骑兵适合打了就跑的交战，而非一线正面作战；使用得当时，它以表现完美而著称。此后它曾在前联邦共和诸国以及混沌三月地区的小贵族中服役。骑兵最高速度可达162公里/小时，但并不单靠速度自保——它拥有3.5吨装甲。机首硬吃一发部族技术增程粒子炮仍能继续飞行。 生态限制：该单位使用内燃机，无法部署在月球或火星生态区。 移动：10/15 格 / 300/450 米。 护甲： 护甲 结构：结构 数值 A S 正面 115 15 左侧 65 15 右侧 65 15 后方 40 15 总计 300 75 特性：狭小/低矮外形

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Centipede Scout Car was produced by Gienah Combat Vehicles & Red Devil Industries in 3053. The vehicle is intended for reconnaissance ahead of its command unit, spotting hidden units. The standard configuration is lightly armed with a single medium laser and vehicular flamer with a ton of fuel. In support of its primary purpose, it is also equipped with a Beagle Active Probe and is capable of reaching an impressive speed of 130 km/h. Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Alleged to be the direct ascendant of the Anhur Transport, the Cobra EC was developed during Operation Klondike as a direct upgrade of the original Cobra. Clan engineers cut the cargo capacity back to a mere 7 tons and removed a ton of AMS ammo in order to mount an additional Medium Laser and a prototype ER Medium Laser. The remaining half ton of weight was devoted to protecting the AMS ammo with CASE. Successfully used by the invading Clans during Klondike, surviving examples of the Cobra EC were formally retired in the late 2830's with the Anhur entering service shortly afterwards. Biome Restrictions: This unit can not deploy in Lunar biomes. Movement: 8/12 hexes / 240/360 meters. Armor: Armor Structure: Structure Values A S Front 60 15 Left 60 15 Right 60 15 Rear 45 15 Total 240 75 Quirk: Easy to Pilot Can carry 1 Battle Armor Squads.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Despite the original being introduced in 2564 updated Condors are still in production as of the start of the 32nd Century. Substantial armor of at least six tons and various mid and long range weapon packages keep the Condor relevant. A heavy cavalry unit designed for rapid reaction to a shifting battle, the Condor was one of the few heavy hover tanks available at the time of it's introduction. This immense hovercraft is capable of a flank speed of 129 km/h and a cruising speed of 86 km/h, making it one of the fastest vehicles in its weight class. Biome Restrictions: This unit can not deploy in Lunar or Martian biomes due to using an ICE. Movement: 8/12 hexes / 240/360 meters. Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Forgotten by history, the Condor IIC was a Clan Nova Cat upgrade of the venerable Condor hover tank; and likely inspired the SM series of tank destroyers. Nova Cat technicians swapped the ICE engine for a surplus 165 rated Fusion Engine sourced from a scrapped Tyre aerospace fighter. An LB-20X AC and 3 tons of ammo take up the bulk of the weight savings. The Medium Lasers are replaced with Pulse variants and the Machine Gun is replaced with an SPL. Ferro Fibrous armour adds additional protection to the tank. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 8/12 hexes / 240/360 meters. Armor: Armor (C) Structure: Structure Values A S Front 160 25 Left 100 25 Right 100 25 Rear 85 25 Turret 130 25 Total 575 125 Quirk: Quick Off The Line

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Originally developed in 2588 during the Reunification War, the now ubiquitous Coolant Truck doubled the effective range of SLDF BattleMechs on water-poor Periphery worlds, serving a similar purpose with the depleted heat sink technology of the Succession Wars era. Coolant trucks station themselves close to the battlefield, where they can be hooked up to overheated 'Mechs for the purpose of flushing away the excess heat with super-cold liquid nitrogen and/or liquid oxygen. Biome Restrictions: This unit can not deploy in Lunar or Martian biomes due to using an ICE. Movement: 4/6 hexes / 120/180 meters. Armor: Armor Structure: Structure Values A S Front 180 15 Left 80 15 Right 80 15 Rear 70 15 Turret 100 15 Total 510 75 Quirk: Rugged
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 冷却车最初于2588年统一战争期间研制，如今已无处不在；它让SLDF战斗机甲在淡水匮乏的外围星球上的有效作战半径翻倍，在继承战争时期散热技术衰败的背景下也发挥着类似作用。冷却车部署在战场附近，可以接通过热的机甲，用超低温液氮和/或液氧冲走过剩的热量。 生态限制：该单位使用内燃机，无法部署在月球或火星生态区。 移动：4/6 格 / 120/180 米。 护甲： 护甲 结构：结构 数值 A S 正面 180 15 左侧 80 15 右侧 80 15 后方 70 15 炮塔 100 15 总计 510 75 特性：坚固

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Cyrano is armed with a Fuersturm-C Large Laser. The weapon is aimed by head movements picked up by the pilot's neurohelmet. However the weapon's 5-ton weight makes the craft unbalanced, requiring extensive pilot training to master the Cyrano's flight characteristics. Developed by the Star League in 2622 as the standard attack gunship for the Star League Defense Force. The heaviest VTOL in SLDF service, the Cyrano was used to provide air support for ground forces and fly escort for Ripper and Nightshade missions. Capable of a stunning 194 km/h, the Cyrano is an incredibly fast scout. The downside is the VTOL's meager armor in most configurations. Biome Restrictions: This unit can not deploy in Lunar biomes. Movement: 12/18 hexes / 360/540 meters. Armor: Ferro-Fibrous Structure: Structure Values A S Front 20 15 Left 20 15 Right 20 15 Rear 15 15 Total 90 75 Quirk: Accurate Weapon - Laser

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Developed by the SLDF's Fury Teams, this 2754 Cyrano variant removes the Large Laser and replaces it with a VTOL Chin Turret that carries three Medium Lasers. A single forward Anti-Missile System provides additional protection against missiles while a Machine Gun with a half-ton of ammunition covers the rear-mounted ramp used to debark the craft. A Guardian ECM Suite interferes with enemy targeting systems, and the Cyrano Fury is protected by two tons of Ferro-Fibrous Armor. To make room for all this equipment, a smaller engine was mounted. This reduced the Cyrano Fury's top speed to 150 km/h. Biome Restrictions: This unit can not deploy in Lunar biomes. Movement: 10/15 hexes / 300/450 meters. Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Tall, squat, and using four treads, the Demolisher has a well-earned reputation as one of the most deadly vehicles on the battlefield. Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Donar Assault Helicopter is a versatile VTOL that is useful in a variety of roles, similar in concept to the Inner Sphere's Warrior. The helicopter is operated by a pilot and copilot/gunner seated in a tandem configuration, with a limited amount of redundancy in both positions should one or the other be knocked out. Three tons of Compound A2F ferro-fibrous armor keeps it safe from small arms fire, and its rotary blades will remain operational even when hit by 40mm caliber weapons. The well-armored hide also gives the Donar a good survival rate in low-altitude crashes. Like most VTOLs, the Donar is fast, capable of achieving up to 151 km/h. Biome Restrictions: This unit can not deploy in Lunar biomes. Movement: 9/14 hexes / 270/420 meters. The helicopter is operated by a pilot and copilot/gunner seated in a tandem configuration, with a limited amount of redundancy in both positions should one or the other be knocked out. Three tons of Compound A2F ferro-fibrous armor keeps it safe from small arms fire, and its rotary blades will remain operational even when hit by 40mm caliber weapons. The well-armored hide also gives the Donar a good survival rate in low-altitude crashes. Like most VTOLs, the Donar is fast, capable of achieving up to 151 km/h. Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Entering service with the Lyran Commonwealth's military 3025, the Drillson is another example of the LCAF's preference for heavy vehicles. It's excellent performance during the Fourth Succession War established it as one of the best of its type. The Drillson is very heavy for a hover vehicle. Much of this weight is invested in protection. The Drillson relies mostly on the Cyclops Eye Large Laser based in its turret. This weapon and its associated fire control system were developed specifically for this vehicle by the ordnance division of Cyclops, Inc. This unconventional design uses a combination of laser energy and particle-beam technology. The unique structure of this system enables it to dispense with the relatively long barrels of standard large lasers. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 9/14 hexes / 270/420 meters. Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: As its name implies, the Epona is a fast vehicle that can chase down opponents and serve as a scout. In order to increase its survivability, the Epona is built on the largest hovercraft frame possible. It is still speedy, however, topping out at 150 km/h. This speed comes at the price of armor, as only five tons of Ferro-Fibrous weave protect the tank. The primary configuration of the Epona is meant for close-quarters combat. Four Medium Pulse Lasers provide accurate damage that even most 'Mechs will have to worry about. A Streak SRM-4 enables the Epona to act as a vehicle-killer and to damage exposed critical systems. All of the armament is located in the vehicle's turret. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 9/14 hexes / 270/420 meters. Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Estevez entered service by 2310 as one of the earliest and most effective tank designs developed outside the Terran Hegemony. With its sheer size and power the Estevez often caused lighter armed enemies to break and run, thus developing a fearsome reputation over decades of service. By the early 2400s, advancing technology had made the Estevez obsolete. Its main gun proved ineffective against more modern armor, made worse by its now-outdated fire control system. Its large crew and high fuel consumption also drained Armed Forces of the Federated Suns resources in prolonged conflicts. The Estevez was eventually taken out of front line service in the mid-25th century after a disastrous simulated battle against Draconis Combine BattleMechs on Robinson. Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 埃斯特维斯于2310年前入役，是在地球霸权之外研发的最早也最有效的坦克设计之一。凭借庞大的体型与威力，埃斯特维斯常令火力较弱的敌人溃逃，数十年服役下来积累了令人生畏的名声。到2400年代初，技术进步让埃斯特维斯过时：其主炮对更现代的装甲已无效果，而过时的火控系统更雪上加霜。它庞大的车组与高油耗也在持久冲突中消耗着联邦太阳国武装部队的资源。25世纪中期，在罗宾逊星球上对龙脉联合体战斗机甲的一场灾难性模拟战之后，埃斯特维斯最终退出一线服役。但直到今天，偶尔仍有从博物馆里被解放出来的埃斯特维斯出现在非正规部队中。 生态限制：该单位使用内燃机，无法部署在月球或火星生态区。 移动：3/5 格 / 90/150 米。 护甲： 原始装甲 结构：原始结构 数值 A S 正面 300 40 左侧 240 40 右侧 240 40 后方 200 40 炮塔 300 40 总计 1280 200 特性：坚固

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: In 3050 the Duchy of Vendôme's military realized a need for a new main battle tank. Engineers on Brekke took a shortcut and reverse engineered the legendary Estevez from surviving examples. A modern fuel cell engine allowed the gun to be replaced with a versatile Thumper, and a 10 tube SRM array for close combat. Basic but modern armor and fire control upgrades complete a simple but serviceable tank that could be manufactured with tech centuries behind the cutting edge. Named after a militia officer on New Avalon where it was built, the Estevez was the main battle tank of the Federated Suns throughout the twenty-fourth century and into the Age of War. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 4/6 hexes / 120/180 meters. Armor: Armor Structure: Structure Values A S Front 210 40 Left 150 40 Right 150 40 Rear 140 40 Turret 185 40 Total 835 200 Quirk: Rugged
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 3050年，旺多姆公国的军方意识到需要一款新的主战坦克。布雷克的工程师走了条捷径：根据幸存样车对传奇的埃斯特维斯进行逆向仿制。现代化的燃料电池引擎让主炮得以换成用途广泛的锤子炮，近战则用一组10管SRM。基础但现代的装甲与火控升级，凑成了一款简单却堪用的坦克——能用落后时代数百年的技术制造出来。它以内瓦隆上一位民兵军官命名，而该车正是在那里制造；在整个24世纪直至战争年代，埃斯特维斯都是联邦太阳国的主战坦克。 生态限制：无。 移动：4/6 格 / 120/180 米。 护甲： 护甲 结构：结构 数值 A S 正面 210 40 左侧 150 40 右侧 150 40 后方 140 40 炮塔 185 40 总计 835 200 特性：坚固

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Ferret Light Scout VTOL was first introduced to House Davion troops in 2901 and later adopted by House Marik, House Steiner and certain Periphery powers. The vehicle serves as an advanced scout with the ability to monitor enemy troop movements and radio in artillery strikes. Thanks to its speed, a single Ferret can patrol a front of up to twenty kilometers long, moving quickly from one area to the next. The vehicle is lightly armored and a hit from nearly any kind of 'Mech weaponry will destroy the Ferret. However, the Ferret's job is to avoid combat, and its agility allows it to remain outside the effective range of the enemy's weapons until reinforcements arrive. Besides reconnaissance and artillery spotting, the Ferret's cargo capacity also makes it suitable for transport and rescue operations. Biome Restrictions: This unit can not deploy in Lunar or Martian biomes due to using an ICE. Movement: 15/23 hexes / 450/690 meters.
