Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Fulcrum Hover Tank was first brought into production by Cyclops Incorporation of Skye in 3057. The vehicle was initially stationed along the Lyran Alliance's Periphery and Free Worlds League borders, where its low maintenance needs were a boon for worlds that had not seen much of the newest technological advances. The vehicle had continued to perform well during the FedCom Civil War and during the early Jihad. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 10/15 hexes / 300/450 meters. Armor: Armor Structure: Structure Values A S Front 250 25 Left 135 25 Right 135 25 Rear 100 25 Turret 210 25 Total 830 125 Quirk: Agile
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 支点悬浮坦克于3057年由斯凯的独眼巨人公司首次投产。该车最初驻扎在莱兰联盟的外围与自由世界联盟边界一带，其低维护需求对那些少见最新技术进展的星球而言是件好事。在联邦共和内战与圣战初期，该车持续表现良好。 生态限制：无。 移动：10/15 格 / 300/450 米。 护甲： 护甲 结构：结构 数值 A S 正面 250 25 左侧 135 25 右侧 135 25 后方 100 25 炮塔 210 25 总计 830 125 特性：敏捷

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Fury was a popular vehicle within the SLDF due to its weaponry and level of protection. An experimental variant built by ComStar, this Fury model replaces the weapons of the original and replaces them with a pair of LB 5-X autocannon. Intended to act as a command and control vehicle, this variant carries a cockpit command console and drone carrier control system. An Angel ECM suite and fourteen tons of reactive armor protect the Fury. The CX-17 uses a light fusion engine. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 4/6 hexes / 120/180 meters. Armor: Reactive Plating Structure: Structure Values A S Front 290 40 Left 190 40 Right 190 40 Rear 165 40 Turret 280 40 Total 1115 200 Quirk: Command Mech
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 狂怒在SLDF中因武器与防护水平而颇受欢迎。这一实验性变型由通讯之星建造，以一对LB 5-X自动炮取代了原版的武器。它意在充当指挥控制车辆，装有座舱指挥控制台与无人机车辆控制系统。一套天使电子对抗套件与十四吨反应装甲保护着狂怒。CX-17采用轻型聚变引擎。 生态限制：无。 移动：4/6 格 / 120/180 米。 护甲： 反应装甲板 结构：结构 数值 A S 正面 290 40 左侧 190 40 右侧 190 40 后方 165 40 炮塔 280 40 总计 1115 200 特性：指挥机甲

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Fury was a popular vehicle within the SLDF due to its weaponry and level of protection. With the Terran Hegemony unwilling to make the advanced Nirasaki-400X computer available outside of the SLDF Royal units, Jolassa also produced a 'dumb'' version known as the Fury II, which removed the system and a ton of Gauss ammunition in exchange for a forward facing medium laser and half-ton of extra side armor. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 4/6 hexes / 120/180 meters. Armor: Armor Structure: Structure Values A S Front 325 40 Left 225 40 Right 225 40 Rear 200 40 Turret 300 40 Total 1275 200 Quirk: Command Mech
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 狂怒在SLDF中因武器与防护水平而颇受欢迎。由于地球霸权不愿让先进的尼拉萨克-400X计算机流出SLDF皇家部队之外，乔拉萨还生产了一款“笨”版本，称为狂怒II：它拆掉该系统与一吨高斯弹药，换装一门前向中型激光和半吨侧装甲。 生态限制：无。 移动：4/6 格 / 120/180 米。 护甲： 护甲 结构：结构 数值 A S 正面 325 40 左侧 225 40 右侧 225 40 后方 200 40 炮塔 300 40 总计 1275 200 特性：指挥机甲

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An early Clan vehicle, the Fury II-EC was converted from discarded Star League Fury II's by the nascent Hell's Horses. A relatively simple switch, the Horses swapped out the Gauss Rifle for an improved version and upgraded the Medium Laser to a pair of prototype ER Mediums. Soon superseded by modern Clan tech, production of the tank ceased in the early 2830's and surviving examples were scrapped or stored away in Brian Caches. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 4/6 hexes / 120/180 meters. Armor: Ferro-Fibrous Structure: Structure Values A S Front 325 40 Left 225 40 Right 225 40 Rear 200 40 Turret 300 40 Total 1275 200 Quirk: Command Mech
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 狂怒II-EC是早期的部族车辆，由初生的地狱马部族把废弃的星际联盟狂怒II改装而成。改装相对简单：地狱马把高斯步枪换成改进型，把中型激光升级为一对原型增程中型激光。它很快被现代部族技术取代，该坦克于2830年代初停产，幸存的样车被拆解或封存于布莱恩仓库。 生态限制：无。 移动：4/6 格 / 120/180 米。 护甲： 铁纤维 结构：结构 数值 A S 正面 325 40 左侧 225 40 右侧 225 40 后方 200 40 炮塔 300 40 总计 1275 200 特性：指挥机甲

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Fury was a popular vehicle within the SLDF due to its weaponry and level of protection. The design also became famous for the inclusion of the Nirasaki-400X command computer. Bordering on AI, the system was among the fastest battlefield computers available prior to the collapse of the original Star League. This variant is protected by thirteen and a half tons of ferro-fibrous armor and has replaced the infantry bay with a turret-mounted AMS. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 4/6 hexes / 120/180 meters. Armor: Ferro-Fibrous Structure: Structure Values A S Front 320 40 Left 205 40 Right 205 40 Rear 195 40 Turret 300 40 Total 1225 200 Quirk: Command Mech
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 狂怒在SLDF中因武器与防护水平而颇受欢迎。该设计还因内置尼拉萨克-400X指挥计算机而闻名。这套近乎人工智能的系统，是原星际联盟崩溃之前可用的最快战场计算机之一。此变型由十三吨半铁纤维装甲防护，并以一具炮塔安装的反导弹系统取代了步兵舱。 生态限制：无。 移动：4/6 格 / 120/180 米。 护甲： 铁纤维 结构：结构 数值 A S 正面 320 40 左侧 205 40 右侧 205 40 后方 195 40 炮塔 300 40 总计 1225 200 特性：指挥机甲

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Gabriel's main role is reconnaissance and intelligence gathering, carrying information back to its parent unit quickly thanks to its high speed, and the vehicle mounts advanced communications and sensor equipment for longer-ranged satellite network transmissions. While the Gabriel only carries a single ton of armor, instead of standard or even ferro-fibrous plate, the designers used Ferro-Aluminum armor, normally reserved for aerospace fighters. The front, back, and turret carry the bulk of this meager protection, at the expense of the vehicle's sides. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 13/20 hexes / 390/600 meters. Armor: Armor Structure: Structure Values A S Front 55 5 Left 20 5 Right 20 5 Rear 10 5 Turret 25 5 Total 130 25 Quirk: Improved Communications
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 加百列的主要职责是侦察与情报搜集，凭借高速把情报迅速送回母单位；车上装有先进通讯与传感器设备，可进行更远距离的卫星网络传输。加百列只带一吨装甲，但设计者没有使用标准装甲甚至铁纤维，而是选用了通常为航空航天战斗机保留的铁铝装甲。这微薄防护的大部分集中在正面、后方与炮塔，车体两侧则被牺牲。 生态限制：无。 移动：13/20 格 / 390/600 米。 护甲： 护甲 结构：结构 数值 A S 正面 55 5 左侧 20 5 右侧 20 5 后方 10 5 炮塔 25 5 总计 130 25 特性：改进通讯

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A light combat vehicle that first saw production in 2692 the Galleon proved to be an economical means of supporting infantry and BattleMechs. With a top speed faster than most 'Mechs, the Galleon was mobile but generally lacked protection, early models carrying only three and a half tons of armor. After the Exodus, these tracked vehicles mostly fell into the possession of the Draconis Combine and the Free Worlds League. The Galleon is often paired with the Harasser Missile Platform. Biome Restrictions: This unit can not deploy in Lunar or Martian biomes due to using an ICE. Movement: 7/11 hexes / 210/330 meters. Armor: Armor Structure: Structure Values A S Front 90 15 Left 55 15 Right 55 15 Rear 55 15 Turret 80 15 Total 335 75 Quirk: Protected Mechanisms

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Full production of this version, known as the Goblin II Infantry Support Vehicle, began in 3053. Though the Goblin remained a capable tank during its time in the Inner Sphere, the Clan Invasion prompted Johnston Industries to redesign it. A 180 FireHeart fusion engine replaces the ICE, enabling the infantry bay to be expanded. The large laser is replaced with a Large Pulse Laser and a SRM-6 is added to increase its firepower. The redesign mounts two Johnston miniguns, providing even more defense against infantry. Finally, an anti-missile system was installed to increase its survivability. The armor protection was increased from 8 tons to 9.5 tons of ferro-fibrous. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 4/6 hexes / 120/180 meters. Armor: Ferro-Fibrous Structure: Structure Values A S Front 220 25 Left 160 25 Right 160 25 Rear 130 25 Turret 200 25 Total 870 125 Quirk: Variable Range Targeting

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Hipparch cavalry tank is perhaps most notable for being commissioned directly by the First Consul of the Rim Worlds Republic, Gregory Amaris, in 2562. The vehicle's design was unpopular with the Rim Worlds Army - particularly with those who had to crew the Hipparch - but Amaris approved the prototype and ordered thousands of the vehicles to be produced. As a result, the Hipparch served during the Reunification War in large numbers - more than 7,000 were built in total, primarily by Diplass Technologies on Apollo - and vast sums of government money ended up in the pockets of Amaris' political cronies. Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Huitzilopochtli, often referred to as the Huey, is a Clan combat vehicle that was created as a mobile artillery platform. The Clan disdain for both artillery and combat vehicles led the Huitzilopochtli to be built around an Internal Combustion Engine, which can only propel it to 32 km/h. Designers also skimped on armor protection, with a mere five and a half tons considered adequate for a unit that should be kilometers away from the battle. The reason for the Huitzilopochtli's existence is its pair of Arrow IV launchers. Four tons of ammunition allow it to vary the types of ammo it carries. The Huitzilopochtli carries a Ultra Autocannon/5, a pair Medium Pulse Lasers and an ER Small Laser for self defence. A pair of machine guns protect the sides of the vehicle. Biome Restrictions: This unit can not deploy in Lunar or Martian biomes due to using an ICE. Movement: 2/3 hexes / 60/90 meters. Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Designed as the next generation replacement to the ageing Ignis, the Ignis SSRM never saw full production. Passed over in favour of the cheaper SRM model, the SSRM model was pushed into limited production during the Amraris Coup; with production backfilling frontline units. The end of the Amaris Coup relegated the design and the Ignis itself to the pages of history. Powered by a 120-rated Fusion Engine, the Ignis SSRM boasted a pair of Vehicle Flamers and a apair of Machine Guns for anti-infantry work. A pair of SSRM-2's provided heavier firepower and a TAG allowed the tank to call in artillery or air strikes in support of its troop complement. Biome Restrictions: None. Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Retaining the infantry bay, the variant drops two of its four flamers and 3 tons of ammo. This was exchanged for a pair of SRM 2 launchers mounted in the turret with 2 tons of ammunition. Designed by United Mechanics, LLC on Apollo for the Rim Worlds Republic as an anti-insurgent vehicle. Originally based on an infantry personnel carrier, it was designed for urban assault against urban shelters. The vehicle was used to ram its target buildings so it could deliver its infantry squad into the breached structure. Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Ubiquitous across the Inner Sphere, the Igor is a name given to a generic super heavy lift platform. Originally developed to rapidly relocate heavy armor under battlefield conditions, the design has since spawned a host of imitators and copy cats with almost every developed world in the Inner Sphere and the Periphery possessing at least one Igor or Igor derived clone. Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Randal Advanced Tactical's Izula is not a very impressive tank viewed on it's merits. But it is impressively simple and cheap. Manufacturing one requires only basic industrialization, and many of the parts can be bought off the shelf on developed worlds. This means that virtually anyone who is anyone can field a RAT. And out on the periphery any armor is better than none. In keeping with this DIY approach to defense RAT sells the plans and offers technical consultants, but doesn't manufacture the tanks themselves. This business model has been surprisingly successful, allowing them to research and design a line of similar vehicles. Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Karnov UR Transport is a heavy lift VTOL which has been in service for hundreds of years. The tilt-rotor design is one of the fastest of its type in use. A reliable and hardy machine, all of the Successor State armed forces and many mercenary units employ Karnovs for supply and logistics missions. Many commercial firms also use the machine for local transportation of cargo in its sizable 6-ton bay or as a flying crane. This variant is equipped with a fusion engine, somewhat heavier armor, and mounts an AC/20. The added weight of the armament reduces the machine's cruising speed to 86 km/h. Biome Restrictions: This unit can not deploy in Lunar biomes. Movement: 8/12 hexes / 240/360 meters. Armor: Armor Structure: Structure Values A S Front 40 15 Left 35 15 Right 35 15 Rear 35 15 Total 160 75 Quirk: Quick Off The Line
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 卡诺夫UR运输机是一款已服役数百年的重型起重VTOL。其倾转旋翼设计是同类在用机型中最快者之一。作为可靠而皮实的机械，所有继承国武装部队以及许多雇佣兵单位都用卡诺夫执行补给与后勤任务。许多商业公司也用它进行本地货物运输——利用其宽裕的6吨货舱——或充当飞行吊车。此变型配备聚变引擎、略厚的装甲，并装有一门AC/20。武装带来的额外重量把该机的巡航速度降到86公里/小时。 生态限制：该单位无法部署在月球生态区。 移动：8/12 格 / 240/360 米。 护甲： 护甲 结构：结构 数值 A S 正面 40 15 左侧 35 15 右侧 35 15 后方 35 15 总计 160 75 特性：启动迅速

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Kokou Defense Tank is an early Clan Combat Vehicle utilized in the Clan Homeworlds during the Succession Wars Era. Constructed using standard Clan technologies, the Kokou is powered by a Standard engine and is protected by upwards of 8.5 tons of Ferro-Fibrous armor, with the majority of armor focused in its front and turret. The vehicle is not terribly fast, its fusion engine is only able to move it no faster than 32 km/h. Its long-range weapon is a 10-Tubed Long-Range Missile Launcher mounted in front of the tank's hull. The one ton of ammunition for the launcher is protected by CASE. While intermediate and close ranges are handled by blistering fire of three Large Pulse Lasers in its turret. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 2/3 hexes / 60/90 meters. Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Randal Advanced Tactical's Laserstrike is an upgrade of their Candiru so significant it was rebranded entirely. Taking advantage of Chemical Laser technology it delivers firepower that is a significant threat to modern armor. It is impressively simple and cheap. Manufacturing one requires only basic industrialization, and many of the parts can be bought off the shelf on developed worlds. This means that virtually anyone who is anyone can field a RAT. And out on the periphery any armor is better than none. In keeping with this DIY approach to defense RAT sells the plans and offers technical consultants, but doesn't manufacture the tanks themselves. Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Mobile Long Tom was essentially an artillery piece on tracks. Known in official Star League records as the LT-MOB-25, it is actually six vehicles all hooked together as part of a massive convoy. The purpose of this entire convoy of vehicles was to move one weapon: a Long Tom Artillery Piece. The artillery piece was capable of extremely long range fire more suited to demolishing defensive fortifications than firing into a firefight. The only short-range weapons were four, side-mounted Machine Guns that were more suited to anti-infantry than anti-'Mech duty. Biome Restrictions: This unit can not deploy in Lunar or Martian biomes due to using an ICE. Movement: 2/3 hexes / 60/90 meters. Armor: Armor Structure: Structure Values A S Front 320 50 Left 320 50 Right 320 50 Rear 320 50 Turret 270 50 Total 1550 250 Quirk: Accurate Weapon - Ballistics
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 机动长汤姆本质上是一门装在履带上的火炮。在星际联盟的官方记录中它被称为LT-MOB-25，实际上是由六辆车辆挂接而成的庞大车队。这整支车队的目的只是运载一件武器：一门长汤姆火炮。这门火炮射程极远，更适合摧毁防御工事，而不是在交火中射击。唯一的近程武器是四挺侧置机枪，更适合反步兵而非反机甲。 生态限制：该单位使用内燃机，无法部署在月球或火星生态区。 移动：2/3 格 / 60/90 米。 护甲： 护甲 结构：结构 数值 A S 正面 320 50 左侧 320 50 右侧 320 50 后方 320 50 炮塔 270 50 总计 1550 250 特性：精准武器 - 弹道

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The vehicle simply known as the 'Hover Tank' was originally developed by Lucas Technologies as a bid to gain a military contract for the Terran Hegemony's Armed forces. After years of development and proposals, the result their efforts would be the LTV-4 Hover Tank in 2464. The LTV series was the response as part of an effort to counter proliferation of BattleMech technologies stolen from the Hegemony. The vehicle was designed to swarm these early BattleMechs in groups and use their combined firepower to hold them until other forces could close and eliminate them. Biome Restrictions: This unit can not deploy in Lunar or Martian biomes due to using an ICE. Movement: 7/11 hexes / 210/330 meters. Armor: Armor Structure: Structure Values A S Front 120 25 Left 90 25 Right 90 25 Rear 75 25 Turret 100 25 Total 475 125 Quirk: Improved Targeting - Short
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这款仅被称为“悬浮坦克”的车辆最初由卢卡斯科技公司研制，意在为地球霸权武装部队赢得一份军事合同。经过多年研发与提案，他们的成果便是2464年的LTV-4悬浮坦克。LTV系列是为应对从霸权流出并扩散的战斗机甲技术而推出的对策。该车被设计为成群结队地围攻那些早期战斗机甲，以集群火力将其牵制，直到其他部队逼近并加以消灭。 生态限制：该单位使用内燃机，无法部署在月球或火星生态区。 移动：7/11 格 / 210/330 米。 护甲： 护甲 结构：结构 数值 A S 正面 120 25 左侧 90 25 右侧 90 25 后方 75 25 炮塔 100 25 总计 475 125 特性：改进瞄准 - 近程

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Slower than the Medium Tank, but possessing heavier armor and firepower, the Heavy Tank is a fearsome combatant. Armor: Ferro-Fibrous Structure: Structure Values A S Front 240 35 Left 215 35 Right 215 35 Rear 200 35 Total 870 140 Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Manticore is one of the best-designed and most powerful heavy tanks ever created, built to combat BattleMechs in support of infantry formations. Although the Manticore mounts a variety of weapons to handle a variety of combat roles and ranges, and is heavily armored for a vehicle of its weight, it is not equipped to deal with the raw firepower of Assault weight vehicles such as the Demolisher or the Behemoth. Despite this, the popularity of the Manticore has remained high, even during the Succession Wars era with its use of an expensive and rare Fusion Engine. Originally developed by TechniCorp during the Reunification War, the destruction of the company's head office on Terra during the Amaris Coup spread the Manticore across the Inner Sphere as other manufacturers absorbed their facilities. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 4/6 hexes / 120/180 meters. Armor: Armor Structure: Structure Values A S Front 230 30 Left 165 30 Right 165 30 Rear 130 30 Turret 210 30 Total 900 150 Quirk: Main Battle Tank
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 蝎狮是有史以来设计最出色、威力最强大的重型坦克之一，专为配合步兵编队对抗战斗机甲而生。尽管蝎狮搭载了多种武器以胜任不同的作战角色与交战距离，对同吨位车辆而言装甲也相当厚重，但它仍无力承受破坏者或巨兽这类突击级车辆的纯粹火力。即便如此，蝎狮的人气始终居高不下，即使在继承战争时期、仍使用昂贵而稀有的聚变引擎的情况下也是如此。该车最初由技术公司于统一战争期间研制；阿马里斯政变期间该公司位于地球的总部被毁，其设施被其他厂商接手，蝎狮也由此传遍内层星域。 生态限制：无。 移动：4/6 格 / 120/180 米。 护甲： 护甲 结构：结构 数值 A S 正面 230 30 左侧 165 30 右侧 165 30 后方 130 30 炮塔 210 30 总计 900 150 特性：主战坦克

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Merkava (meaning 'chariot' in Hebrew) was the main heavy tank of the Terran Alliance, with variants of the design in service continually since the late 23rd century. II became a key component of the Hegemony Armed Forces armored units from its introduction in 2384. The Merkava, produced by Leopard Armor of Terra, was deployed as a front line battle tank throughout the Age of War. Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Patton tank is a 65-ton armored combat vehicle, specializing in conventional armored warfare. Identical to its twin, the Rommel, in every way but armament and armor configuration, the Patton has primarily served with the Lyran Commonwealth and the Lyran Alliance. It is named after General George S. Patton, Jr., a legendary commander of armored and mechanized forces renowned for his exploits during World War II on Terra. Unlike the Rommel, which features a massive and powerful but short-ranged AC/20 as its main gun, the Patton mounts an AC/10, giving it twice the ammunition capacity and superior firing range while also enabling it to be fitted with more armor. The Patton is capable of fighting in short-ranged and urban environments, but is far more suited than the Rommel to engaging targets at medium to long range. Biome Restrictions: None. Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Pike was created at the direction of Magestrix Kyalla Centrella of the Magistracy of Canopus during the later part of the Third Succession War. Her plan was to produce an inexpensive combat vehicle so the Great Houses would wear down their BattleMech armies through attrition, and the Pike would be the tool she envisioned for the task. However, sending vehicles to market in the Inner Sphere was to be more costly than anticipated. With the Great Houses' shrinking numbers of ships in their JumpShip fleets, the vehicle did not make the impact she had hoped it would. It became a favorite of ComStar's growing garrison forces for their HPG complexes. Biome Restrictions: This unit can not deploy in Lunar or Martian biomes due to using an ICE. Movement: 3/5 hexes / 90/150 meters. Armor: Armor Structure: Structure Values A S Front 180 30 Left 125 30 Right 125 30 Rear 125 30 Turret 180 30 Total 735 150 Quirk: Protected Mechanisms
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 长矛是在第三次继承战争后期，由卡诺帕斯行政区的女执政官凯拉·森特雷拉下令研制的。她的计划是生产一种廉价战斗车辆，让各大望族通过消耗战磨损自己的战斗机甲部队，而长矛就是她设想中的工具。然而，向市面以及内层星域销售车辆的成本远超预期。由于各大望族的跃迁舰舰队船只数量不断缩减，这种车辆并未产生她所期望的影响，反倒成了通讯之星为HPG设施扩充的守备部队所青睐的装备。 生态限制：该单位使用内燃机，无法部署在月球或火星生态区。 移动：3/5 格 / 90/150 米。 护甲： 护甲 结构：结构 数值 A S 正面 180 30 左侧 125 30 右侧 125 30 后方 125 30 炮塔 180 30 总计 735 150 特性：防护机构

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: While often derided as a poor man's Rommel/Patton tank, the simply constructed and dependable Po Heavy Tank, named by Romano Liao for the mischievous and vengeful spirit of Chinese tradition, has become the principal combat vehicle on Capellan worlds lacking 'Mech units. Introduced in 3031, the Po is built around the rugged, dependable, and cheap Ceres 240 internal combustion engine, which gives the tank a maximum flank speed of 65 km/h. Ten and half tons of armor provides respectable protection for a heavy tank. Along with its ease of maintenance and decent firepower, this protection has made the Po a popular choice among cash strapped mercenaries, lower ranked garrison units, the Free Worlds League and Word of Blake, with such export sales keeping much needed funds flowing into the Confederation's coffers. Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Originally developed by Vitesse Vehicles of Terra in 2611, the Prowler Multi-Terrain-Vehicle was the most common hostile and exotic environment military-grade exploration vehicles. The Prowler was almost unsurpassed in its niche, the design proving popular enough for Vitesse to halt production and merely license the design to manufacturers across the Inner Sphere and Periphery. While never produced in large numbers, all post–Star League era Successor State militaries maintained a number of the vehicle for combat on their most inhospitable planets. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 4/6 hexes / 120/180 meters. Armor: Armor Structure: Environmental Sealing Values A S Front 145 30 Left 115 30 Right 115 30 Rear 90 30 Turret 125 30 Total 590 150 Quirk: Enhanced FPE Can carry 1 Battle Armor Squads. Has firing ports.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 潜行兽多地形车辆最初由泰拉的维泰斯车辆公司于 2611 年开发，是应对恶劣与异星环境最常用的军用级勘探车辆。潜行兽在其细分领域几乎无出其右，该设计如此受欢迎，以至于维泰斯干脆停产，只把设计授权给内天体与外围区各地的制造商。虽然从未大量生产，但星盟之后各继承国的军队都保有若干该车辆，用于在最不适宜居住的行星上作战。 生物群系限制：无。 移动：4/6 格 / 120/180 米。 装甲：装甲 结构：环境密封 数值 A S 前部 145 30 左侧 115 30 右侧 115 30 后部 90 30 炮塔 125 30 合计 590 150 特质：增强型火焰防护 可搭载 1 个战斗装甲班。有射击孔。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A heavy assault tank built to fight Battlemechs, the Puma was a product of the SLDF’s Armoured Command who feared the obsolescence of traditional tanks. Surviving through the succession wars, the Puma had the distinction of being one few Star League designs to remain in production mostly in its original configuration. The tank's main gun is its PPC, which is mounted in the turret. Each of the tank's sides mounts a single LRM-20. For close-in action the tank has pair of Medium Lasers and a SRM-4 mounted forward, with the missile launcher's twenty five volleys stored in its main hull. In the rear, the Puma is protected by a Small Laser and an anti-infantry Flamer. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 3/5 hexes / 90/150 meters. Armor: Armor Structure: Structure Values A S Front 280 50 Left 165 50 Right 165 50 Rear 120 50 Turret 255 50 Total 985 250 Quirk: Main Battle Tank
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 美洲狮是为对抗战斗机甲而建造的重型突击坦克，出自SLDF装甲司令部之手，他们担心传统坦克将被淘汰。美洲狮在继承战争中存续下来，是少数几乎以原始配置持续生产的星际联盟设计之一。主炮是炮塔内的粒子炮；车体两侧各装一具LRM-20。近战时车首有一对中型激光与一具SRM-4，该导弹发射器的二十五次齐射弹药存于主车体内。尾部则由一门小型激光与一具反人员火焰喷射器防护。 生态限制：无。 移动：3/5 格 / 90/150 米。 护甲： 护甲 结构：结构 数值 A S 正面 280 50 左侧 165 50 右侧 165 50 后方 120 50 炮塔 255 50 总计 985 250 特性：主战坦克

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This 2746 Puma variant was used by the Terran Hegenomy. Based on a proposed and rejected Star League model, it carried twin Streak SRM-2 missile launchers, replaced the standard Medium Lasers with Pulse models, and added Artemis IV fire control systems to the LRM-20s. The Small Laser was replaced by a Small Pulse Laser. To provide space and weight for these upgrades, the Puma used an XL engine. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 3/5 hexes / 90/150 meters. Armor: Armor Structure: Structure Values A S Front 280 50 Left 165 50 Right 165 50 Rear 120 50 Turret 255 50 Total 985 250 Quirk: Main Battle Tank

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Designed in 2667, the Rhino was intended as a far more heavily armored version of the ubiquitous LRM Carrier. While carrying one less 20 tube launcher, the Rhino is covered in seventeen tons of armor, a whopping fifteen more than a Quik-based carrier can boast. Designed to anchor defensive lines, the Rhino mounts two LRM-20 launchers alongside a pair of Medium Lasers in its turret, supported by a single LRM-10 mounted forward. The vehicle's total of four tons of LRM reloads compare favourably with the standard carrier, while the lasers allow it some defensive ability while retreating to rearm; however, the vehicle's extremely slow speed greatly hampers any retreat once engaged in battle. Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Rolling off the production line in 3052, the Rhino (3052) Upgrade is a complete rework of the original design, designed to make effective use of rediscovered Star League technology. The original weapons loadout has been removed and replaced with a trio of LRM-15’s augmented by Artemis IV. A pair of Medium Pulse Lasers replace the Medium Lasers. Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Ripper is armed with two nose-mounted Omicron 950 medium lasers. The weapons are used more to intimidate than to strike an enemy, the pilot firing the twin lasers around the fringes of the vehicle's intended landing zone and then as they fly off to convince an unprepared foe to steer clear. The Ripper, built from proven components for maximum reliability, uses a fusion engine to give the vehicle a significant range, as well as a high top speed, so much that the infantry compartment is equipped with special acceleration couches to handle the strain of a high speed combat insertion. Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Rommel tank is a 65-ton armored combat vehicle, specializing in close range fighting and urban combat. Identical to its twin, the Patton, in every way but armament and armor configuration, the Rommel has primarily served with the Lyran Commonwealth and the Lyran Alliance. It is named after Field Marshal Erwin Rommel, a legendary commander of armored and mechanized forces renowned for his exploits during World War II on Terra. The Rommel was designed concurrently with the Patton in the early 3000s, when Defiance Industries decided that an armored combat vehicle capable of replacing 'Mechs was needed. Shortly afterward Scarborough created two other vehicles based on the Saracen, the Scimitar and the Saladin. Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Skulker Wheeled Scout is the much larger cousin of the Swift Wind scout car and originally based on the Heavy APC design. Due to it being larger than any scout car, it can act as a mobile communication outpost. With its advanced sensor suite which is tied to both its communication and targeting systems, it can navigate with only its sensors. While hot environments would normally wreak havoc upon its advanced electronics, the heat sinks from its Medium Laser cool the sensors while the laser is not in use. This allows it to operate in even the hottest environments where other scout vehicles cannot. The Skulker comes with four and a half tons of armor as standard. Biome Restrictions: This unit can not deploy in Lunar or Martian biomes due to using an ICE. Movement: 7/11 hexes / 210/330 meters. Armor: Armor Structure: Structure Values A S Front 110 10 Left 95 10 Right 95 10 Rear 90 10 Total 390 40 Quirk: Improved Sensors

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Sprint scout helicopter is a nimble fast scout platform popular within the Inner Sphere. It was first released in 3052 with much success to the beleaguered units along the Clan invasion corridor, where it was able to keep tabs on the swift deployments of the Clans and call in artillery from afar. Such was its success that it quickly became a favored unit within scout and recon detachments throughout the Inner Sphere where it continues to see widespread use. However the nature of battlefields within the Inner Sphere often highlight the one flaw of the design, its mediocre armor. Biome Restrictions: This unit can not deploy in Lunar biomes. Movement: 13/20 hexes / 390/600 meters. Armor: Ferro-Fibrous Structure: Structure Values A S Front 40 5 Left 20 5 Right 20 5 Rear 20 5 Total 110 25 Quirk: Improved Communications

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The primary armament on the SturmFeur was a pair of SturmFeur LRM-20s. These allowed the tank to provide withering support fire, both directly and indirectly. This allowed it to stay out of range and even out of sight of most enemy units. Difficulties with targeting technology during the Third Succession War necessitated splitting up the launchers so that they didn't accidentally damage friendly units. Because of this, one LRM was mounted in a turret, and the other was mounted behind but only fires forward, over the turret in an arc. The only secondary weapons were a pair of MiniGuns attached to the turret. They provided effective anti-infantry defense, but little else. Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Svantovit Infantry Fighting Vehicle is designed for use with second-line units to deliver a Point of Elementals to the battlefield. This Svantovit is a swift hovercraft, capable of attaining speeds up to 162 km/h. The drawback of the compact combat vehicle is that it is only protected by three tons of Ferro-Fibrous armor, so it must use its speed to avoid being hit. In addition to carrying infantry, the Svantovit is designed to support those same troops. At long range it can contribute fire in the form of paired LRM-5s, which can also be fired indirectly. Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Swift Wind, built on Indicass by Ceres Metals, is a one-person scout car designed for the Capellan Confederation Armed Forces. The Swift Wind has no weapons to speak of. It is, however, equipped with two tons of powerful Communications Equipment . True to its name, the Swift Wind is quick, with a top speed of 162 km/h and cruising speed of 108 km/h thanks to it's fusion engine. Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Technicals are improvised combat vehicles. Generally a logistics truck or civilian vehicle outfitted with the heaviest armaments available. The origin of the term is lost to history, however references can be found in material dating back to pre Star League Terra. Technicals are popular with irregular forces due to their low cost and flexibility. They tend to be relatively fragile, but when used as skirmishers or light fire support, they can be remarkably effective. Biome Restrictions: This unit can not deploy in Lunar or Martian biomes due to using an ICE. Movement: 4/6 hexes / 120/180 meters. Armor: Armor Structure: Structure Values A S Front 80 10 Left 65 10 Right 65 10 Rear 50 10 Turret 40 10 Total 300 50 Quirk: Technical
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 技术车辆是临时改装的战斗车辆，通常是把后勤卡车或民用车辆装上能弄到的最重型武器。这一称法的起源已湮没于历史，但可追溯到星际联盟之前的地球文献。技术车辆因成本低廉、使用灵活而受到非正规部队的青睐。它们往往相当脆弱，但用作散兵或轻型火力支援时，效果可能出奇地好。 生态限制：该单位使用内燃机，无法部署在月球或火星生态区。 移动：4/6 格 / 120/180 米。 护甲： 护甲 结构：结构 数值 A S 正面 80 10 左侧 65 10 右侧 65 10 后方 50 10 炮塔 40 10 总计 300 50 特性：技术车辆

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Technicals are improvised combat vehicles. Generally a logistics truck or civilian vehicle outfitted with the heaviest armaments available. The origin of the term is lost to history, however references can be found in material dating back to pre Star League Terra. Technicals are popular with irregular forces due to their low cost and flexibility. They tend to be relatively fragile, but when used as skirmishers or light fire support, they can be remarkably effective. Biome Restrictions: This unit can not deploy in Lunar or Martian biomes due to using an ICE. Movement: 6/9 hexes / 180/270 meters. Armor: Armor Structure: Structure Values A S Front 70 10 Left 40 10 Right 40 10 Rear 30 10 Turret 40 10 Total 220 50 Quirk: Technical

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Thor Self Propelled Gun was created for the Star League Defense Force in 2680. Specifications called for a vehicle that could travel at speeds of 80 km/h on flat terrain and carry the Thumper Artillery Piece. The SLDF's Quartermaster Command chose the Thor because it was the only submitted design that met the 80 km/h specification and due to its advanced CASE protection system. Carrying seven and a half tons of Ferro-Fibrous armor, the vehicle relies on its speed for protection with only a pair of medium lasers available should an attacker close range. The primary armament is a Thumper Artillery Piece with forty rounds of ammunition available. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 5/8 hexes / 150/240 meters. Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Created by a Capellan Confederation design team, the Thunderer was rushed into production during the chaos of the 4th succession war. Mounted in the turret are a PPC and an AC/5 with a hull mounted Machine Gun providing additional firepower. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 3/5 hexes / 90/150 meters. Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Succeeding the massive, outdated Estevez as the Armed Forces of the Federated Suns main battle tank in the middle of the 25th century, the Tiger was designed to be lighter and faster than, yet still able to outgun, most of its rivals. After much testing, newcomers Veridian Dynamics of Torrence favored a conventional engine and a heavy autocannon to keep costs as low as possible. With its heavy engine and over a third of its total mass devoted to weapons, the Tiger's weak spot was the thin armor. Its six tons of standard armor were only a third of that of contemporaries such as the Marsden II, and barely enough to survive two heavy autocannon hits to the same location. Biome Restrictions: This unit can not deploy in Lunar or Martian biomes due to using an ICE. Movement: 4/6 hexes / 120/180 meters. Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Designed during Jonathan Camerons build up of the SLDF, the Tiger T12TH is a conversion of the stock of obsolete Tiger T12's still in use by the Hegemony Armed Forces. The original 220-rated ICE was upgraded to a 275-rated Fusion Engine. The rest of the tank remained unchanged and the combination of low ammo and poor armor caused this tank to be relegated far from the frontlines. Biome Restrictions: None. Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Vali was produced for more than fifty years and was a mainstay in the forces of the SLDF through the twenty-seventh and twenty-eighth centuries. It fought all the way though Operation LIBERATION, suffering the highest losses of any artillery units. It is unknown if any were taken on Kerensky's Exodus, but each of the Successor States were able to take possession of many of the vehicles that were left behind; these went on to participate in the Succession Wars. Biome Restrictions: This unit can not deploy in Lunar or Martian biomes due to using an ICE. Movement: 4/6 hexes / 120/180 meters. Armor: Primitive Armor Structure: Structure Values A S Front 200 20 Left 170 20 Right 170 20 Rear 100 20 Total 640 80 Quirk: Protected Mechanisms

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Technicals are improvised combat vehicles. Generally a logistics truck or civilian vehicle outfitted with the heaviest armaments available. The origin of the term is lost to history, however references can be found in material dating back to pre Star League Terra. Technicals are popular with irregular forces due to their low cost and flexibility. They tend to be relatively fragile, but when used as skirmishers or light fire support, they can be remarkably effective. Biome Restrictions: This unit can not deploy in Lunar or Martian biomes due to using an ICE. Movement: 6/9 hexes / 180/270 meters. Armor: Armor Structure: Structure Values A S Front 70 10 Left 40 10 Right 40 10 Rear 30 10 Turret 40 10 Total 220 50 Quirk: Technical

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Star League Defense Force requested the next generation of combat support VTOL in 2708. It took more than two decades with hundreds of different people being involved and only finally getting realistic specifications laid out by Aleksandr Kerensky. It was finally awarded to General Motors who created a VTOL which could replace other VTOLs in their specific roles with one design which would simplify the replacement parts process. The design also incorporated a fusion engine to power the craft and the energy weapons which would eliminate the need for a fuel source and ammunition dependency. Biome Restrictions: This unit can not deploy in Lunar biomes. Movement: 12/18 hexes / 360/540 meters. Armor: Ferro-Fibrous Structure: Structure Values A S Front 110 18 Left 90 18 Right 90 18 Rear 50 18 Turret 15 18 Total 355 90 Quirk: Improved Communications
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 星际联盟国防军于2708年提出研发下一代战斗支援VTOL的需求，历时二十余年、涉及数百名不同人员，最终由亚历山大·克伦斯基定下切实可行的规格。项目最终授予通用汽车公司，他们造出的VTOL能以单一设计取代其他VTOL在各专项角色中的用途，从而简化备件供应流程。该设计还采用聚变引擎为机体与能量武器供能，免除了对燃料与弹药的依赖。 生态限制：该单位无法部署在月球生态区。 移动：12/18 格 / 360/540 米。 护甲： 铁纤维 结构：结构 数值 A S 正面 110 18 左侧 90 18 右侧 90 18 后方 50 18 炮塔 15 18 总计 355 90 特性：改进通讯

Produced by a handful of companies in the Periphery, the Venator is a common sight on the battlefields of the Periphery where it is often fielded in large quantities. Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Created during the Age of War, the Vulture series of gunships are designed to wear targets down at range and provide direct fire support for allied units. A 30 ton gunship, the Vulture is usually built around some variation of a 100 rated engine, giving it a top speed of 120 km/h; with 4-5 tons of armour on each variant. Still in irregular production, the Vulture can be found in any number of variants across most of known space. Biome Restrictions: This unit can not deploy in Lunar or Martian biomes due to using an ICE. Movement: 8/12 hexes / 240/360 meters. Armor: Armor Structure: Structure Values A S Front 120 15 Left 85 15 Right 85 15 Rear 60 15 Total 365 75 Quirk: Easy to Pilot
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 秃鹫系列炮艇机诞生于战争年代，旨在远距离削弱目标并为友军单位提供直接火力支援。作为一款30吨炮艇机，秃鹫通常围绕某种100额定引擎的变体建造，最高速度120公里/小时，各型号装甲为4至5吨。秃鹫至今仍断续生产，在已知空间的大部分地区都能见到各式各样的变型。 生态限制：该单位使用内燃机，无法部署在月球或火星生态区。 移动：8/12 格 / 240/360 米。 护甲： 护甲 结构：结构 数值 A S 正面 120 15 左侧 85 15 右侧 85 15 后方 60 15 总计 365 75 特性：易于驾驶

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Wainreeve is a high-end transport vehicle with enough firepower to protect itself. Originally designed as the replacement for the Star League-era Titanhauler as spare parts started being hard to source during the succession wars. It is able to carry 14 tons of assorted cargo while protected by 11 tons of armor, making it one of the most heavily armored designated cargo transport vehicles seen in the Inner Sphere. Armor: Armor Structure: Structure Values A S Front 215 40 Left 175 40 Right 175 40 Rear 140 40 Turret 175 40 Total 880 200 Quirk: Rugged

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Randal Advanced Tactical's Xancudo is not a very impressive tank viewed on it's merits. But it is impressively simple, cheap and durable. Manufacturing one requires only basic industrialization, and many of the parts can be bought off the shelf on developed worlds. This means that virtually anyone who is anyone can field a RAT. And out on the periphery any armor is better than none. In keeping with this DIY approach to defense RAT sells the plans and offers technical consultants, but doesn't manufacture the tanks themselves. This business model has been surprisingly successful, allowing them to research and design a line of similar vehicles. Biome Restrictions: This unit can not deploy in Lunar or Martian biomes due to using an ICE. Movement: 3/5 hexes / 90/150 meters. Armor: Armor Structure: Structure Values A S Front 225 35 Left 180 35 Right 180 35 Rear 125 35 Turret 220 35 Total 930 175 Quirk: Main Battle Tank
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 若只看参数，兰道高级战术公司的尚库多并不出彩，但它简单、廉价且耐用得出奇。制造它只需要基础的工业化能力，许多零件在发达星球上都能直接买到。这意味着几乎任何有点份量的人都能装备一辆RAT。而在外围地区，有装甲总比没装甲强。与其DIY式防御理念一致，RAT出售图纸并提供技术顾问，但不自行制造坦克。这一商业模式出奇成功，使公司有余力研发并设计出一系列类似车辆。 生态限制：该单位使用内燃机，无法部署在月球或火星生态区。 移动：3/5 格 / 90/150 米。 护甲： 护甲 结构：结构 数值 A S 正面 225 35 左侧 180 35 右侧 180 35 后方 125 35 炮塔 220 35 总计 930 175 特性：主战坦克

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Yellow Jacket was built around the Poland Model C Gauss rifle. Subsequent version mounted other system, but it remained centered around as single heavy weapon. Though not as fast as most VTOLs, the Yellow Jacket still has greater speed than most BattleMechs and OmniMechs. The long range weapons, respectable speed and relatively heavy armor keep the vehicle safer than many of it's peers. Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: In 3030, Aldis Industries deployed the successful follow up to its venerable Demolisher design, the slightly lighter Zhukov. While it shares many of the parts and features of the design that inspired it, the Zhukov is smaller, better armored, and packs less weaponry than its predecessor. Its first major deployment was with the Wolf's Dragoons whereupon the Zhukov has since seen constant improvements and tweaks as suggested to Aldis Industries by the field units that use it. The Zhukov's strength is its relative simplicity. Two turret mounted SarLon MaxiCannon Autocannon/10s are more than adequate at providing sufficient firepower for the discriminating buyer while imitating its larger cousin the Demolisher. Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Daimyo HQ was a heavy theater command unit utilized by the Draconis Combine. The first Daimyo was fielded in 2796 at the beginning of the Succession Wars by Jinjiro Kurita, who used the vehicle during the Kentares Massacre. While the Coordinator attended executions in person, the Daimyo HQ's crew transmitted the data to ComStar representatives on the planet who then sent the data through the whole Inner Sphere. When Jinjiro discovered the treason, the whole crew was executed. Daimyo production ceased between the years 3027 and 3063 because the unit's communication system technology become a form of Lostech. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 5/8 hexes / 150/240 meters. Armor: Armor Structure: Structure Values A S Front 245 25 Left 140 25 Right 140 25 Rear 85 25 Turret 155 25 Total 765 125 Quirk: Battle Computer B2000

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Heavy Hover APC is a larger version of its standard counterpart able to carry two full platoons of Foot Infantry or one platoon of either Motorized or Jump Infantry. Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Turhan was first built for the Terran Hegemony in 2530 by Dieron's Buhallin Military Products. The company, known for its wheeled vehicles, built the Turhan to answer the HAF's need for an urban assault vehicle to support its infantry in urban environments. The vehicle acted as an Armored Personnel Carrier, deploying troops from its large infantry transport bay. The vehicle is protected by seven and a half tons of Ferro-Fibrous armor, which ensured its cargo arrived at the designation intact. Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Ares Medium Tank (LRM) is designed to stand off and take down its enemies at long range. Its top speed of 86 km/h is fast for a fire support vehicle, so it is often paired with APC to support infantry. Four and a half tons of armor protect the vehicle and its crew; this somewhat meager amount encourages Ares crews to stay out of range of most return fire. The main weapon is an ER Large Laser mounted in the turret. Mounted in the front are an LRM-15 and LRM-10 each with Artemis. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 5/8 hexes / 150/240 meters. Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Designed solely as an artillery vehicle, the Ballista mounts a Sniper Artillery piece in the turret; supplied with 3 tons of ammo. The Ballista's secondary weaponry consists of three Machine Guns, two mounted forward and one in the rear of the tank. Powered by a 165-rated Internal Combustion Engine, the vehicle is able to keep up at modest pace with other mobile support elements. Protecting the Ballista's hull is 7.5 tons of armor, giving adequate protection against enemy fire should opposing forces manage to penetrate deeply behind friendly battle lines. Biome Restrictions: This unit can not deploy in Lunar or Martian biomes due to using an ICE. Movement: 3/5 hexes / 90/150 meters. Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Introduced in 2952, the Behemoth was designed for increased firepower and heavy armor rather than speed or manoeuvrability. The design allowed the Behemoth to engage both distant and short-range targets, while allowing it to stand up to almost any type of unit possible. The two turret-mounted AC-10s enable the Behemoth to deal out a great deal of damage at a long distance. The four front-mounted LRM-5’s increase this damage potential. For closer targets, two SRM-6 packs are mounted on the turret and the Behemoth boasts two ball turrets, each mounting one SRM-2 and two Machine Guns. The final two SRM-2 packs are mounted in a half-turret on the front of tank. Biome Restrictions: This unit can not deploy in Lunar or Martian biomes due to using an ICE. Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Randal Advanced Tactical's Candiru is not a very impressive tank viewed on it's merits. But it is impressively simple and cheap. Manufacturing one requires only basic industrialization, and many of the parts can be bought off the shelf on developed worlds. This means that virtually anyone who is anyone can field a RAT. And out on the periphery any armor is better than none. In keeping with this DIY approach to defense RAT sells the plans and offers technical consultants, but doesn't manufacture the tanks themselves. This business model has been surprisingly successful, allowing them to research and design a line of similar vehicles. Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Introduced in 3054, the Cavalry Attack Helicopter was one of a number of VTOLs developed to fight the Clans by Michaelson Heavy Industries. Suited to hit-and-run engagements rather than front-line combat situations the Cavalry gained a reputation for flawless service when used correctly. It has since seen service in former FedCom States and minor-nobles among the Chaos March. While capable of speeds up to 162 km/h, the Cavalry doesn't rely on this alone for protection and has 3.5 tons armor. The craft can handle a direct hit from a Clan-tech ER PPC on the nose and keep flying. Biome Restrictions: This unit can not deploy in Lunar or Martian biomes due to using an ICE. Movement: 10/15 hexes / 300/450 meters. Armor: Armor Structure: Structure Values A S Front 115 15 Left 65 15 Right 65 15 Rear 40 15 Total 300 75 Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Alleged to be the direct ascendant of the Anhur Transport, the Cobra EC was developed during Operation Klondike as a direct upgrade of the original Cobra. Clan engineers cut the cargo capacity back to a mere 7 tons and removed a ton of AMS ammo in order to mount an additional Medium Laser and a prototype ER Medium Laser. The remaining half ton of weight was devoted to protecting the AMS ammo with CASE. Successfully used by the invading Clans during Klondike, surviving examples of the Cobra EC were formally retired in the late 2830's with the Anhur entering service shortly afterwards. Biome Restrictions: This unit can not deploy in Lunar biomes. Movement: 8/12 hexes / 240/360 meters. Armor: Armor Structure: Structure Values A S Front 60 15 Left 60 15 Right 60 15 Rear 45 15 Total 240 75 Quirk: Easy to Pilot Can carry 1 Battle Armor Squads.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The original Cobra transport VTOL was introduced by the Star League Defense Force in 2582 to assist the SLDF during the Reunification War and upgraded variants have seen constant action since that conflict. During the Succession Wars, the Cobra fell out of production, but the Word of Blake restarted the manufacturing line following their liberation of Terra in 3058. The Cobra is a rear-echelon combat vehicle that was designed for support missions. It carries a scant three tons of armor, though it can maintain speeds up to 129 km/h. Biome Restrictions: This unit can not deploy in Lunar biomes. Movement: 8/12 hexes / 240/360 meters. Armor: Armor Structure: Structure Values A S Front 60 15 Left 60 15 Right 60 15 Rear 45 15 Total 240 75 Quirk: Easy to Pilot Can Resupply/Repair Can carry 3 Battle Armor Squads.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Despite the original being introduced in 2564 updated Condors are still in production as of the start of the 32nd Century. Substantial armor of at least six tons and various mid and long range weapon packages keep the Condor relevant. A heavy cavalry unit designed for rapid reaction to a shifting battle, the Condor was one of the few heavy hover tanks available at the time of it's introduction. This immense hovercraft is capable of a flank speed of 129 km/h and a cruising speed of 86 km/h, making it one of the fastest vehicles in its weight class. Biome Restrictions: This unit can not deploy in Lunar or Martian biomes due to using an ICE. Movement: 8/12 hexes / 240/360 meters. Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Forgotten by history, the Condor IIC was a Clan Nova Cat upgrade of the venerable Condor hover tank; and likely inspired the SM series of tank destroyers. Nova Cat technicians swapped the ICE engine for a surplus 165 rated Fusion Engine sourced from a scrapped Tyre aerospace fighter. An LB-20X AC and 3 tons of ammo take up the bulk of the weight savings. The Medium Lasers are replaced with Pulse variants and the Machine Gun is replaced with an SPL. Ferro Fibrous armour adds additional protection to the tank. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 8/12 hexes / 240/360 meters. Armor: Armor (C) Structure: Structure Values A S Front 160 25 Left 100 25 Right 100 25 Rear 85 25 Turret 130 25 Total 575 125 Quirk: Quick Off The Line

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Originally developed in 2588 during the Reunification War, the now ubiquitous Coolant Truck doubled the effective range of SLDF BattleMechs on water-poor Periphery worlds, serving a similar purpose with the depleted heat sink technology of the Succession Wars era. Coolant trucks station themselves close to the battlefield, where they can be hooked up to overheated 'Mechs for the purpose of flushing away the excess heat with super-cold liquid nitrogen and/or liquid oxygen. Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Cyrano is armed with a Fuersturm-C Large Laser. The weapon is aimed by head movements picked up by the pilot's neurohelmet. However the weapon's 5-ton weight makes the craft unbalanced, requiring extensive pilot training to master the Cyrano's flight characteristics. Developed by the Star League in 2622 as the standard attack gunship for the Star League Defense Force. The heaviest VTOL in SLDF service, the Cyrano was used to provide air support for ground forces and fly escort for Ripper and Nightshade missions. Capable of a stunning 194 km/h, the Cyrano is an incredibly fast scout. The downside is the VTOL's meager armor in most configurations. Biome Restrictions: This unit can not deploy in Lunar biomes. Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An offshoot of the Decurion Cavalry Tank, the Decurion APC was created to provide transport and battlefield support for the MHAF Infantry Contuberniums. Powered by the same 125-rated ICE as the standard Decurion, the project engineers opted to remove the Large Laser. Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Donar Assault Helicopter is a versatile VTOL that is useful in a variety of roles, similar in concept to the Inner Sphere's Warrior. The helicopter is operated by a pilot and copilot/gunner seated in a tandem configuration, with a limited amount of redundancy in both positions should one or the other be knocked out. Three tons of Compound A2F ferro-fibrous armor keeps it safe from small arms fire, and its rotary blades will remain operational even when hit by 40mm caliber weapons. The well-armored hide also gives the Donar a good survival rate in low-altitude crashes. Like most VTOLs, the Donar is fast, capable of achieving up to 151 km/h. Biome Restrictions: This unit can not deploy in Lunar biomes. Movement: 9/14 hexes / 270/420 meters. Armor: Ferro-Fibrous (C) Structure: Structure Values A S Front 170 15 Left 90 15 Right 90 15 Rear 65 15 Total 430 75 Quirk: Anti-Air Targeting
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 多纳尔突击直升机是一款多用途垂直起降机，在多种角色中都有用，概念上与内天体的"武士"相似。它由一名飞行员与一名副驾驶兼炮手以串列布局操作，两个座位都有一定冗余，以便其中一个被击倒时仍能运作。三吨"复合 A2F"铁纤维装甲让它免受轻武器火力威胁，其旋翼即便被 40 毫米口径武器命中也能继续运转。这层厚实外皮也让多纳尔在低空坠机时有良好的生存率。与大多数垂直起降机一样，多纳尔很快，最高可达 151 公里/小时。 生物群系限制：该单位无法部署在月球生物群系。 移动：9/14 格 / 270/420 米。 装甲：铁纤维（氏族） 结构：结构 数值 A S 前部 170 15 左侧 90 15 右侧 90 15 后部 65 15 合计 430 75 特质：防空瞄准

This speed comes at the price of armor, as only five tons of Ferro-Fibrous weave protect the tank. The primary configuration of the Epona is meant for close-quarters combat. Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Estevez entered service by 2310 as one of the earliest and most effective tank designs developed outside the Terran Hegemony. With its sheer size and power the Estevez often caused lighter armed enemies to break and run, thus developing a fearsome reputation over decades of service. By the early 2400s, advancing technology had made the Estevez obsolete. Its main gun proved ineffective against more modern armor, made worse by its now-outdated fire control system. Its large crew and high fuel consumption also drained Armed Forces of the Federated Suns resources in prolonged conflicts. The Estevez was eventually taken out of front line service in the mid-25th century after a disastrous simulated battle against Draconis Combine BattleMechs on Robinson. However once in a while an Estevez liberated from a museum appears in irregular forces to this day. Biome Restrictions: This unit can not deploy in Lunar or Martian biomes due to using an ICE. Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: In 3050 the Duchy of Vendôme's military realized a need for a new main battle tank. Engineers on Brekke took a shortcut and reverse engineered the legendary Estevez from surviving examples. A modern fuel cell engine allowed the gun to be replaced with a versatile Thumper, and a 10 tube SRM array for close combat. Basic but modern armor and fire control upgrades complete a simple but serviceable tank that could be manufactured with tech centuries behind the cutting edge. Named after a militia officer on New Avalon where it was built, the Estevez was the main battle tank of the Federated Suns throughout the twenty-fourth century and into the Age of War. Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Ferret Light Scout VTOL was first introduced to House Davion troops in 2901 and later adopted by House Marik, House Steiner and certain Periphery powers. The vehicle serves as an advanced scout with the ability to monitor enemy troop movements and radio in artillery strikes. Thanks to its speed, a single Ferret can patrol a front of up to twenty kilometers long, moving quickly from one area to the next. The vehicle is lightly armored and a hit from nearly any kind of 'Mech weaponry will destroy the Ferret. However, the Ferret's job is to avoid combat, and its agility allows it to remain outside the effective range of the enemy's weapons until reinforcements arrive. Besides reconnaissance and artillery spotting, the Ferret's cargo capacity also makes it suitable for transport and rescue operations. Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Ferret Light Scout VTOL was first introduced to House Davion troops in 2901 and later adopted by House Marik, House Steiner and certain Periphery powers. The vehicle serves as an advanced scout with the ability to monitor enemy troop movements and radio in artillery strikes. Thanks to its speed, a single Ferret can patrol a front of up to twenty kilometers long, moving quickly from one area to the next. The vehicle is lightly armored and a hit from nearly any kind of 'Mech weaponry will destroy the Ferret. However, the Ferret's job is to avoid combat, and its agility allows it to remain outside the effective range of the enemy's weapons until reinforcements arrive. Besides reconnaissance and artillery spotting, the Ferret's cargo capacity also makes it suitable for transport and rescue operations. Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Fulcrum Hover Tank was first brought into production by Cyclops Incorporation of Skye in 3057. The vehicle was initially stationed along the Lyran Alliance's Periphery and Free Worlds League borders, where its low maintenance needs were a boon for worlds that had not seen much of the newest technological advances. The vehicle had continued to perform well during the FedCom Civil War and during the early Jihad. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 10/15 hexes / 300/450 meters. Armor: Armor Structure: Structure Values A S Front 250 25 Left 135 25 Right 135 25 Rear 100 25 Turret 210 25 Total 830 125 Quirk: Agile
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 支点悬浮坦克于3057年由斯凯的独眼巨人公司首次投产。该车最初驻扎在莱兰联盟的外围与自由世界联盟边界一带，其低维护需求对那些少见最新技术进展的星球而言是件好事。在联邦共和内战与圣战初期，该车持续表现良好。 生态限制：无。 移动：10/15 格 / 300/450 米。 护甲： 护甲 结构：结构 数值 A S 正面 250 25 左侧 135 25 右侧 135 25 后方 100 25 炮塔 210 25 总计 830 125 特性：敏捷

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Fury was a popular vehicle within the SLDF due to its weaponry and level of protection. An experimental variant built by ComStar, this Fury model replaces the weapons of the original and replaces them with a pair of LB 5-X autocannon. Intended to act as a command and control vehicle, this variant carries a cockpit command console and drone carrier control system. An Angel ECM suite and fourteen tons of reactive armor protect the Fury. The CX-17 uses a light fusion engine. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 4/6 hexes / 120/180 meters. Armor: Reactive Plating Structure: Structure Values A S Front 290 40 Left 190 40 Right 190 40 Rear 165 40 Turret 280 40 Total 1115 200 Quirk: Command Mech

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Fury was a popular vehicle within the SLDF due to its weaponry and level of protection. With the Terran Hegemony unwilling to make the advanced Nirasaki-400X computer available outside of the SLDF Royal units, Jolassa also produced a 'dumb'' version known as the Fury II, which removed the system and a ton of Gauss ammunition in exchange for a forward facing medium laser and half-ton of extra side armor. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 4/6 hexes / 120/180 meters. Armor: Armor Structure: Structure Values A S Front 325 40 Left 225 40 Right 225 40 Rear 200 40 Turret 300 40 Total 1275 200 Quirk: Command Mech

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An early Clan vehicle, the Fury II-EC was converted from discarded Star League Fury II's by the nascent Hell's Horses. A relatively simple switch, the Horses swapped out the Gauss Rifle for an improved version and upgraded the Medium Laser to a pair of prototype ER Mediums. Soon superseded by modern Clan tech, production of the tank ceased in the early 2830's and surviving examples were scrapped or stored away in Brian Caches. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 4/6 hexes / 120/180 meters. Armor: Ferro-Fibrous Structure: Structure Values A S Front 325 40 Left 225 40 Right 225 40 Rear 200 40 Turret 300 40 Total 1275 200 Quirk: Command Mech
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 狂怒II-EC是早期的部族车辆，由初生的地狱马部族把废弃的星际联盟狂怒II改装而成。改装相对简单：地狱马把高斯步枪换成改进型，把中型激光升级为一对原型增程中型激光。它很快被现代部族技术取代，该坦克于2830年代初停产，幸存的样车被拆解或封存于布莱恩仓库。 生态限制：无。 移动：4/6 格 / 120/180 米。 护甲： 铁纤维 结构：结构 数值 A S 正面 325 40 左侧 225 40 右侧 225 40 后方 200 40 炮塔 300 40 总计 1275 200 特性：指挥机甲

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Fury was a popular vehicle within the SLDF due to its weaponry and level of protection. The design also became famous for the inclusion of the Nirasaki-400X command computer. Bordering on AI, the system was among the fastest battlefield computers available prior to the collapse of the original Star League. This variant is protected by thirteen and a half tons of ferro-fibrous armor and has replaced the infantry bay with a turret-mounted AMS. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 4/6 hexes / 120/180 meters. Armor: Ferro-Fibrous Structure: Structure Values A S Front 320 40 Left 205 40 Right 205 40 Rear 195 40 Turret 300 40 Total 1225 200 Quirk: Command Mech
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 狂怒在SLDF中因武器与防护水平而颇受欢迎。该设计还因内置尼拉萨克-400X指挥计算机而闻名。这套近乎人工智能的系统，是原星际联盟崩溃之前可用的最快战场计算机之一。此变型由十三吨半铁纤维装甲防护，并以一具炮塔安装的反导弹系统取代了步兵舱。 生态限制：无。 移动：4/6 格 / 120/180 米。 护甲： 铁纤维 结构：结构 数值 A S 正面 320 40 左侧 205 40 右侧 205 40 后方 195 40 炮塔 300 40 总计 1225 200 特性：指挥机甲

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Gabriel's main role is reconnaissance and intelligence gathering, carrying information back to its parent unit quickly thanks to its high speed, and the vehicle mounts advanced communications and sensor equipment for longer-ranged satellite network transmissions. While the Gabriel only carries a single ton of armor, instead of standard or even ferro-fibrous plate, the designers used Ferro-Aluminum armor, normally reserved for aerospace fighters. The front, back, and turret carry the bulk of this meager protection, at the expense of the vehicle's sides. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 13/20 hexes / 390/600 meters. Armor: Armor Structure: Structure Values A S Front 55 5 Left 20 5 Right 20 5 Rear 10 5 Turret 25 5 Total 130 25 Quirk: Improved Communications
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 加百列的主要职责是侦察与情报搜集，凭借高速把情报迅速送回母单位；车上装有先进通讯与传感器设备，可进行更远距离的卫星网络传输。加百列只带一吨装甲，但设计者没有使用标准装甲甚至铁纤维，而是选用了通常为航空航天战斗机保留的铁铝装甲。这微薄防护的大部分集中在正面、后方与炮塔，车体两侧则被牺牲。 生态限制：无。 移动：13/20 格 / 390/600 米。 护甲： 护甲 结构：结构 数值 A S 正面 55 5 左侧 20 5 右侧 20 5 后方 10 5 炮塔 25 5 总计 130 25 特性：改进通讯

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A light combat vehicle that first saw production in 2692 the Galleon proved to be an economical means of supporting infantry and BattleMechs. With a top speed faster than most 'Mechs, the Galleon was mobile but generally lacked protection, early models carrying only three and a half tons of armor. After the Exodus, these tracked vehicles mostly fell into the possession of the Draconis Combine and the Free Worlds League. The Galleon is often paired with the Harasser Missile Platform. Biome Restrictions: This unit can not deploy in Lunar or Martian biomes due to using an ICE. Movement: 7/11 hexes / 210/330 meters. Armor: Armor Structure: Structure Values A S Front 90 15 Left 55 15 Right 55 15 Rear 55 15 Turret 80 15 Total 335 75 Quirk: Protected Mechanisms

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Full production of this version, known as the Goblin II Infantry Support Vehicle, began in 3053. Though the Goblin remained a capable tank during its time in the Inner Sphere, the Clan Invasion prompted Johnston Industries to redesign it. A 180 FireHeart fusion engine replaces the ICE, enabling the infantry bay to be expanded. The large laser is replaced with a Large Pulse Laser and a SRM-6 is added to increase its firepower. The redesign mounts two Johnston miniguns, providing even more defense against infantry. Finally, an anti-missile system was installed to increase its survivability. The armor protection was increased from 8 tons to 9.5 tons of ferro-fibrous. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 4/6 hexes / 120/180 meters. Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Hipparch cavalry tank is perhaps most notable for being commissioned directly by the First Consul of the Rim Worlds Republic, Gregory Amaris, in 2562. The vehicle's design was unpopular with the Rim Worlds Army - particularly with those who had to crew the Hipparch - but Amaris approved the prototype and ordered thousands of the vehicles to be produced. As a result, the Hipparch served during the Reunification War in large numbers - more than 7,000 were built in total, primarily by Diplass Technologies on Apollo - and vast sums of government money ended up in the pockets of Amaris' political cronies. Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Huitzilopochtli, often referred to as the Huey, is a Clan combat vehicle that was created as a mobile artillery platform. The Clan disdain for both artillery and combat vehicles led the Huitzilopochtli to be built around an Internal Combustion Engine, which can only propel it to 32 km/h. Designers also skimped on armor protection, with a mere five and a half tons considered adequate for a unit that should be kilometers away from the battle. The reason for the Huitzilopochtli's existence is its pair of Arrow IV launchers. Four tons of ammunition allow it to vary the types of ammo it carries. The Huitzilopochtli carries a Ultra Autocannon/5, a pair Medium Pulse Lasers and an ER Small Laser for self defence. A pair of machine guns protect the sides of the vehicle. Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Designed by United Mechanics, LLC on Apollo for the Rim Worlds Republic as an anti-insurgent vehicle. Originally based on an infantry personnel carrier, it was designed for urban assault against urban shelters. The vehicle was used to ram its target buildings so it could deliver its infantry squad into the breached structure. Originally named the Ram, the vehicle crews during its original time of use, came to use another name. It was referred to as the Ignis, with flamers reminding them of the Vedic god of fire. Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Designed as the next generation replacement to the ageing Ignis, the Ignis SSRM never saw full production. Passed over in favour of the cheaper SRM model, the SSRM model was pushed into limited production during the Amraris Coup; with production backfilling frontline units. The end of the Amaris Coup relegated the design and the Ignis itself to the pages of history. Powered by a 120-rated Fusion Engine, the Ignis SSRM boasted a pair of Vehicle Flamers and a apair of Machine Guns for anti-infantry work. A pair of SSRM-2's provided heavier firepower and a TAG allowed the tank to call in artillery or air strikes in support of its troop complement. Biome Restrictions: None. Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Randal Advanced Tactical's Izula is not a very impressive tank viewed on it's merits. But it is impressively simple and cheap. Manufacturing one requires only basic industrialization, and many of the parts can be bought off the shelf on developed worlds. This means that virtually anyone who is anyone can field a RAT. And out on the periphery any armor is better than none. In keeping with this DIY approach to defense RAT sells the plans and offers technical consultants, but doesn't manufacture the tanks themselves. This business model has been surprisingly successful, allowing them to research and design a line of similar vehicles. Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Kokou Defense Tank is an early Clan Combat Vehicle utilized in the Clan Homeworlds during the Succession Wars Era. Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Randal Advanced Tactical's Laserstrike is an upgrade of their Candiru so significant it was rebranded entirely. Taking advantage of Chemical Laser technology it delivers firepower that is a significant threat to modern armor. It is impressively simple and cheap. Manufacturing one requires only basic industrialization, and many of the parts can be bought off the shelf on developed worlds. This means that virtually anyone who is anyone can field a RAT. And out on the periphery any armor is better than none. In keeping with this DIY approach to defense RAT sells the plans and offers technical consultants, but doesn't manufacture the tanks themselves. Biome Restrictions: This unit can not deploy in Lunar or Martian biomes due to using an ICE. Movement: 4/6 hexes / 120/180 meters. Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Mobile Long Tom was essentially an artillery piece on tracks. Known in official Star League records as the LT-MOB-25, it is actually six vehicles all hooked together as part of a massive convoy. The purpose of this entire convoy of vehicles was to move one weapon: a Long Tom Artillery Piece. The artillery piece was capable of extremely long range fire more suited to demolishing defensive fortifications than firing into a firefight. The only short-range weapons were four, side-mounted Machine Guns that were more suited to anti-infantry than anti-'Mech duty. Biome Restrictions: This unit can not deploy in Lunar or Martian biomes due to using an ICE. Movement: 2/3 hexes / 60/90 meters. Armor: Armor Structure: Structure Values A S Front 320 50 Left 320 50 Right 320 50 Rear 320 50 Turret 270 50 Total 1550 250 Quirk: Accurate Weapon - Ballistics

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The vehicle simply known as the 'Hover Tank' was originally developed by Lucas Technologies as a bid to gain a military contract for the Terran Hegemony's Armed forces. After years of development and proposals, the result their efforts would be the LTV-4 Hover Tank in 2464. The LTV series was the response as part of an effort to counter proliferation of BattleMech technologies stolen from the Hegemony. The vehicle was designed to swarm these early BattleMechs in groups and use their combined firepower to hold them until other forces could close and eliminate them. Biome Restrictions: This unit can not deploy in Lunar or Martian biomes due to using an ICE. Movement: 7/11 hexes / 210/330 meters. Armor: Armor Structure: Structure Values A S Front 120 25 Left 90 25 Right 90 25 Rear 75 25 Turret 100 25 Total 475 125 Quirk: Improved Targeting - Short

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Manticore is one of the best-designed and most powerful heavy tanks ever created, built to combat BattleMechs in support of infantry formations. Although the Manticore mounts a variety of weapons to handle a variety of combat roles and ranges, and is heavily armored for a vehicle of its weight, it is not equipped to deal with the raw firepower of Assault weight vehicles such as the Demolisher or the Behemoth. Despite this, the popularity of the Manticore has remained high, even during the Succession Wars era with its use of an expensive and rare Fusion Engine. Originally developed by TechniCorp during the Reunification War, the destruction of the company's head office on Terra during the Amaris Coup spread the Manticore across the Inner Sphere as other manufacturers absorbed their facilities. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 4/6 hexes / 120/180 meters. Armor: Armor Structure: Structure Values A S Front 230 30 Left 165 30 Right 165 30 Rear 130 30 Turret 210 30 Total 900 150 Quirk: Main Battle Tank
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 蝎狮是有史以来设计最出色、威力最强大的重型坦克之一，专为配合步兵编队对抗战斗机甲而生。尽管蝎狮搭载了多种武器以胜任不同的作战角色与交战距离，对同吨位车辆而言装甲也相当厚重，但它仍无力承受破坏者或巨兽这类突击级车辆的纯粹火力。即便如此，蝎狮的人气始终居高不下，即使在继承战争时期、仍使用昂贵而稀有的聚变引擎的情况下也是如此。该车最初由技术公司于统一战争期间研制；阿马里斯政变期间该公司位于地球的总部被毁，其设施被其他厂商接手，蝎狮也由此传遍内层星域。 生态限制：无。 移动：4/6 格 / 120/180 米。 护甲： 护甲 结构：结构 数值 A S 正面 230 30 左侧 165 30 右侧 165 30 后方 130 30 炮塔 210 30 总计 900 150 特性：主战坦克

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Mars Assault Vehicle is one of the premier combat vehicles that the Clans field. The slow vehicle can only muster a top speed of 32 km/h, so it has eleven and a half tons of Ferro-Fibrous armor to protect it. Also protecting the Mars is an ECM Suite that impacts enemy electronics within range. With over half its mass dedicated to weaponry, the Mars is capable of swiftly dispatching enemy units. Mounted in the tanks turret is a Gauss Rifle and an ER Large Laser. An LB-X Autocannon/10 gives it additional power. Three LRM-15s, each of which is slaved to an Artemis IV Fire Control System, add even more damage potential at range. Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Odin Scout Tank is a quick combat vehicle that is one of the finest reconnaissance units in any Clan's touman. Only twenty tons, the wheeled vehicle relies upon its 130 km/h top speed to stay out of enemy fire, as its one and a half ton of Ferro-Fibrous armor is woefully insufficient to stand up to anything more substantial than small arms fire. Its main reason for existence is the Active Probe, which can detect hidden units out to one hundred fifty meters. Though the Odin is supposed to stay out of combat, it is capable of defending itself if necessary. Its turret mounts a pair of Medium Pulse Lasers and a Streak SRM-2 launcher. Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Patton tank is a 65-ton armored combat vehicle, specializing in conventional armored warfare. Identical to its twin, the Rommel, in every way but armament and armor configuration, the Patton has primarily served with the Lyran Commonwealth and the Lyran Alliance. It is named after General George S. Patton, Jr., a legendary commander of armored and mechanized forces renowned for his exploits during World War II on Terra. Unlike the Rommel, which features a massive and powerful but short-ranged AC/20 as its main gun, the Patton mounts an AC/10, giving it twice the ammunition capacity and superior firing range while also enabling it to be fitted with more armor. The Patton is capable of fighting in short-ranged and urban environments, but is far more suited than the Rommel to engaging targets at medium to long range. Biome Restrictions: None. Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: While often derided as a poor man's Rommel/Patton tank, the simply constructed and dependable Po Heavy Tank, named by Romano Liao for the mischievous and vengeful spirit of Chinese tradition, has become the principal combat vehicle on Capellan worlds lacking 'Mech units. Introduced in 3031, the Po is built around the rugged, dependable, and cheap Ceres 240 internal combustion engine, which gives the tank a maximum flank speed of 65 km/h. Ten and half tons of armor provides respectable protection for a heavy tank. Along with its ease of maintenance and decent firepower, this protection has made the Po a popular choice among cash strapped mercenaries, lower ranked garrison units, the Free Worlds League and Word of Blake, with such export sales keeping much needed funds flowing into the Confederation's coffers. Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Designed in 2667, the Rhino was intended as a far more heavily armored version of the ubiquitous LRM Carrier. Designed to anchor defensive lines, the Rhino mounts two LRM-20 launchers alongside a pair of Medium Lasers in its turret, supported by a single LRM-10 mounted forward. Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Rommel tank is a 65-ton armored combat vehicle, specializing in close range fighting and urban combat. Identical to its twin, the Patton, in every way but armament and armor configuration, the Rommel has primarily served with the Lyran Commonwealth and the Lyran Alliance. It is named after Field Marshal Erwin Rommel, a legendary commander of armored and mechanized forces renowned for his exploits during World War II on Terra. The Rommel was designed concurrently with the Patton in the early 3000s, when Defiance Industries decided that an armored combat vehicle capable of replacing 'Mechs was needed. Since 'Mech production was nearly at a standstill, the ability to produce and field armored vehicles became a necessity for every Successor State. Biome Restrictions: None. Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Sand Devil is the predecessor to the Sabaku Kaze. An ICE powered scout hover tank that resembled the local flat headed sand serpent residing in wastes of Arkab. Desert tribes and nobles of the Azami worlds used these vehicles for defense as well as desert racing. They were used to good effect against raiding Combine MechWarriors. Executives from Buda Imperial were so impressed with the nearly 200 year old Sand Devil's performance that they funded creation of the Kaze. Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Saracen is a well-designed hovercraft: it is fast and decently armored. Its weapons are designed for maximum effect against other vehicles, using a mix of long and short-range missiles mounted in its turret. It has endeared itself to its crews due to its reliability and ruggedness and forms the backbone of many striker units. The Saracen was developed towards the end of the Third Succession War by Scarborough Limited. Shortly afterward Scarborough created two other vehicles based on the Saracen, the Scimitar and the Saladin. Biome Restrictions: This unit can not deploy in Lunar or Martian biomes due to using an ICE. Movement: 8/12 hexes / 240/360 meters. Armor: Armor Structure: Structure Values A S Front 140 20 Left 105 20 Right 105 20 Rear 120 20 Turret 130 20 Total 600 100 Quirk: Rugged

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Skulker Wheeled Scout is the much larger cousin of the Swift Wind scout car and originally based on the Heavy APC design. Due to it being larger than any scout car, it can act as a mobile communication outpost. With its advanced sensor suite which is tied to both its communication and targeting systems, it can navigate with only its sensors. While hot environments would normally wreak havoc upon its advanced electronics, the heat sinks from its Medium Laser cool the sensors while the laser is not in use. This allows it to operate in even the hottest environments where other scout vehicles cannot. The Skulker comes with four and a half tons of armor as standard. Biome Restrictions: This unit can not deploy in Lunar or Martian biomes due to using an ICE. Movement: 7/11 hexes / 210/330 meters. Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Sprint scout helicopter is a nimble fast scout platform popular within the Inner Sphere. It was first released in 3052 with much success to the beleaguered units along the Clan invasion corridor, where it was able to keep tabs on the swift deployments of the Clans and call in artillery from afar. Such was its success that it quickly became a favored unit within scout and recon detachments throughout the Inner Sphere where it continues to see widespread use. However the nature of battlefields within the Inner Sphere often highlight the one flaw of the design, its mediocre armor. Biome Restrictions: This unit can not deploy in Lunar biomes. Movement: 13/20 hexes / 390/600 meters. Armor: Ferro-Fibrous Structure: Structure Values A S Front 40 5 Left 20 5 Right 20 5 Rear 20 5 Total 110 25 Quirk: Improved Communications

This gave the SturmFeur increased ability to defend itself at short range and was sometimes used as a bodyguard for standard SturmFeurs. Biome Restrictions: This unit can not deploy in Lunar or Martian biomes due to using an ICE. Movement: 3/5 hexes / 90/150 meters. Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Svantovit Infantry Fighting Vehicle is designed for use with second-line units to deliver a Point of Elementals to the battlefield. This Svantovit is a swift hovercraft, capable of attaining speeds up to 162 km/h. The drawback of the compact combat vehicle is that it is only protected by three tons of Ferro-Fibrous armor, so it must use its speed to avoid being hit. In addition to carrying infantry, the Svantovit is designed to support those same troops. At long range it can contribute fire in the form of paired LRM-5s, which can also be fired indirectly. Twin Streak SRM-2s are mounted in a turret that gives them a full 360 degree field of fire, while the sides are protected from infantry by a Machine Gun on each side. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 10/15 hexes / 300/450 meters. Armor: Ferro-Fibrous (C) Structure: Structure Values A S Front 90 20 Left 65 20 Right 65 20 Rear 55 20 Turret 65 20 Total 340 100 Quirk: Quick Off The Line Can carry 1 Battle Armor Squads. Has firing ports.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 斯万托维特步兵战车用于配属二线部队，把一个元素小队送上战场。这辆斯万托维特是快速悬浮车，速度可达162公里/小时。这款紧凑战斗车辆的缺点在于只有三吨铁纤维装甲防护，因此必须靠速度避免被击中。除运载步兵外，斯万托维特还用于支援这些部队。远距离上它以成对的LRM-5提供火力，也可进行间接射击。双联连发SRM-2装在炮塔内，拥有完整的360度射界；两侧各有一挺机枪保护，免受步兵袭击。 生态限制：无。 移动：10/15 格 / 300/450 米。 护甲： 铁纤维（C） 结构：结构 数值 A S 正面 90 20 左侧 65 20 右侧 65 20 后方 55 20 炮塔 65 20 总计 340 100 特性：启动迅速 可搭载1个战斗装甲班。设有射击孔。
