Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Swift Wind, built on Indicass by Ceres Metals, is a one-person scout car designed for the Capellan Confederation Armed Forces. The Swift Wind has no weapons to speak of. It is, however, equipped with two tons of powerful Communications Equipment . True to its name, the Swift Wind is quick, with a top speed of 162 km/h and cruising speed of 108 km/h thanks to it's fusion engine. In the event the Swift Wind does run into trouble, one and a half tons of armoring provide enough protection to shrug off moderate damage until the car can escape the danger. Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Technicals are improvised combat vehicles. Generally a logistics truck or civilian vehicle outfitted with the heaviest armaments available. The origin of the term is lost to history, however references can be found in material dating back to pre Star League Terra. Technicals are popular with irregular forces due to their low cost and flexibility. They tend to be relatively fragile, but when used as skirmishers or light fire support, they can be remarkably effective. Biome Restrictions: This unit can not deploy in Lunar or Martian biomes due to using an ICE. Movement: 4/6 hexes / 120/180 meters. Armor: Armor Structure: Structure Values A S Front 80 10 Left 65 10 Right 65 10 Rear 50 10 Turret 40 10 Total 300 50 Quirk: Technical
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 技术车辆是临时改装的战斗车辆，通常是把后勤卡车或民用车辆装上能弄到的最重型武器。这一称法的起源已湮没于历史，但可追溯到星际联盟之前的地球文献。技术车辆因成本低廉、使用灵活而受到非正规部队的青睐。它们往往相当脆弱，但用作散兵或轻型火力支援时，效果可能出奇地好。 生态限制：该单位使用内燃机，无法部署在月球或火星生态区。 移动：4/6 格 / 120/180 米。 护甲： 护甲 结构：结构 数值 A S 正面 80 10 左侧 65 10 右侧 65 10 后方 50 10 炮塔 40 10 总计 300 50 特性：技术车辆

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Thor Self Propelled Gun was created for the Star League Defense Force in 2680. Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Succeeding the massive, outdated Estevez as the Armed Forces of the Federated Suns main battle tank in the middle of the 25th century, the Tiger was designed to be lighter and faster than, yet still able to outgun, most of its rivals. After much testing, newcomers Veridian Dynamics of Torrence favored a conventional engine and a heavy autocannon to keep costs as low as possible. With its heavy engine and over a third of its total mass devoted to weapons, the Tiger's weak spot was the thin armor. Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Star League Defense Force requested the next generation of combat support VTOL in 2708. It took more than two decades with hundreds of different people being involved and only finally getting realistic specifications laid out by Aleksandr Kerensky. It was finally awarded to General Motors who created a VTOL which could replace other VTOLs in their specific roles with one design which would simplify the replacement parts process. The design also incorporated a fusion engine to power the craft and the energy weapons which would eliminate the need for a fuel source and ammunition dependency. Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Derided by critics and loved by its crews, the 25 ton Venator is a VTOL designed to hunt tanks. Produced by a handful of companies in the Periphery, the Venator is a common sight on the battlefields of the Periphery where it is often fielded in large quantities. Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Named after the Vespa Genus of insects, the Vespa gunship is well equipped to sting it's opponents to death, one hit at a time. Hand made on the world of Redondo, the 15 ton Vespa has seen success across the Inner Sphere and Periphery. Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Randal Advanced Tactical's Xancudo is not a very impressive tank viewed on it's merits. But it is impressively simple, cheap and durable. Manufacturing one requires only basic industrialization, and many of the parts can be bought off the shelf on developed worlds. This means that virtually anyone who is anyone can field a RAT. And out on the periphery any armor is better than none. In keeping with this DIY approach to defense RAT sells the plans and offers technical consultants, but doesn't manufacture the tanks themselves. This business model has been surprisingly successful, allowing them to research and design a line of similar vehicles. Biome Restrictions: This unit can not deploy in Lunar or Martian biomes due to using an ICE. Movement: 3/5 hexes / 90/150 meters. Armor: Armor Structure: Structure Values A S Front 225 35 Left 180 35 Right 180 35 Rear 125 35 Turret 220 35 Total 930 175 Quirk: Main Battle Tank
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 若只看参数，兰道高级战术公司的尚库多并不出彩，但它简单、廉价且耐用得出奇。制造它只需要基础的工业化能力，许多零件在发达星球上都能直接买到。这意味着几乎任何有点份量的人都能装备一辆RAT。而在外围地区，有装甲总比没装甲强。与其DIY式防御理念一致，RAT出售图纸并提供技术顾问，但不自行制造坦克。这一商业模式出奇成功，使公司有余力研发并设计出一系列类似车辆。 生态限制：该单位使用内燃机，无法部署在月球或火星生态区。 移动：3/5 格 / 90/150 米。 护甲： 护甲 结构：结构 数值 A S 正面 225 35 左侧 180 35 右侧 180 35 后方 125 35 炮塔 220 35 总计 930 175 特性：主战坦克

The 45 ton tank is powered by a 180 rated Fusion Engine that allows it to mount a Blazer and a single SSRM-2. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 4/6 hexes / 120/180 meters. Armor: Armor Structure: Structure Values A S Front 180 25 Left 125 25 Right 125 25 Rear 125 25 Turret 180 25 Total 735 125 Quirk: Easy to Pilot
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 扎兰是一款刻意做得平庸的主战坦克，于3053至3056年间为行星防御部队、训练编队以及亲廖氏的雇佣兵生产。这辆45吨坦克由180额定聚变引擎驱动，使其得以装上一门烈焰炮和一具SSRM-2。 生态限制：无。 移动：4/6 格 / 120/180 米。 护甲： 护甲 结构：结构 数值 A S 正面 180 25 左侧 125 25 右侧 125 25 后方 125 25 炮塔 180 25 总计 735 125 特性：易于驾驶

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: In 3030, Aldis Industries deployed the successful follow up to its venerable Demolisher design, the slightly lighter Zhukov. While it shares many of the parts and features of the design that inspired it, the Zhukov is smaller, better armored, and packs less weaponry than its predecessor. Its first major deployment was with the Wolf's Dragoons whereupon the Zhukov has since seen constant improvements and tweaks as suggested to Aldis Industries by the field units that use it. The Zhukov's strength is its relative simplicity. Two turret mounted SarLon MaxiCannon Autocannon/10s are more than adequate at providing sufficient firepower for the discriminating buyer while imitating its larger cousin the Demolisher. Biome Restrictions: This unit can not deploy in Lunar or Martian biomes due to using an ICE. Movement: 3/5 hexes / 90/150 meters. Armor: Armor Structure: Structure Values A S Front 240 40 Left 160 40 Right 160 40 Rear 120 40 Turret 230 40 Total 910 200 Quirk: Main Battle Tank
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 3030年，阿尔迪斯工业公司推出了其经典设计破坏者的成功后继型号——略轻一些的朱可夫。朱可夫沿用了启发它的设计中许多零件与特征，但体型更小、装甲更好、武器更少。它首次大规模部署于狼之龙骑兵，此后使用它的野战部队不断向阿尔迪斯提出建议，朱可夫因而持续改进与微调。朱可夫的长处在于相对简单。两门炮塔安装的萨隆巨型加农AC/10，足以满足挑剔买家的火力需求，同时模仿了它更大的表亲——破坏者。 生态限制：该单位使用内燃机，无法部署在月球或火星生态区。 移动：3/5 格 / 90/150 米。 护甲： 护甲 结构：结构 数值 A S 正面 240 40 左侧 160 40 右侧 160 40 后方 120 40 炮塔 230 40 总计 910 200 特性：主战坦克

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This variant of the Zorya was introduced during the Succession Wars era. It drops the Artemis IV FCS for increased ammunition for the LB 5X Autocannon. Additionally, the vehicle's armor was increased, mainly in the front and turret areas.. Biome Restrictions: This unit can not deploy in Lunar or Martian biomes due to using an ICE. Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Zorya Light Tank is an inexpensive combat vehicle whose biggest asset is that it is simple to use. This cheap vehicle uses an internal Combustion Engine and standard armor to save on cost. Protected by a scant three and a half tons of armor, with most of that concentrated on the vehicle's front and turret; the Zorya is armed with a LB-X Autocannon/5 and an LRM-15 launcher with an Artemis IV Fire Control System. Guardian ECM helps keep the Zorya alive in combat, Biome Restrictions: This unit can not deploy in Lunar or Martian biomes due to using an ICE. Movement: 4/6 hexes / 120/180 meters. Armor: Armor (C) Structure: Structure Values A S Front 105 20 Left 50 20 Right 50 20 Rear 50 20 Turret 85 20 Total 340 100 Quirk: Easy to Pilot

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: For a mech of just 35 tons this little turtle sports a lot of long range fire support in the form of 40 LRM tubes, which can scare away even much much larger enemies. For close range, self defense or a last effort push if the ammo bins are empty, the ADR-A carries 2 Small Pulse Lasers and the standard Flamer.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 区区 35 吨的小乌龟却拥有大量远程火力支援——40 个 LRM 发射管，足以吓退远比它庞大的敌人。近程自卫、或在弹药打空时的最后一搏，ADR-A 携带 2 门小型脉冲激光和标准火焰喷射器。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Every time the Adder-B is spotted you can't stop wondering how the clans fit all that firepower on a tiny 35 ton chassis. With an extremely accurate Large Pulse Laser this mid to long range configuration softens up the armor of an enemy to finish it at medium range with its powerful LB-X AC/5, backed up by a pair of ERMLs. Never underestimate the power of an ADR-B, it might be a mistake you can't recover from.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 每次看到 Adder-B，你都会忍不住想知道氏族是怎么把那么多火力塞进区区 35 吨底盘的。凭借一门极其精准的大型脉冲激光，这套中远程配置能软化敌方装甲，然后在中距离以强力 LB-X AC/5 予以了结，另有两门 ER 中型激光支援。永远不要低估一台 ADR-B 的实力，那可能是个你无法挽回的错误。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: As a slightly lighter armed long range bombardment variant, the Adder-C 'only' sports two LRM-15 launchers as the main armament... And also an additional launcher for a NARC Homing Beacons. You can't hide anywhere if you have one of those stuck on your hull. For CQC and as a non ammo-dependent backup weapon, a single Medium Pulse Laser can absolutely ruin the day for ambushers who think the LRM support mech might be an easy kill.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为一款搭载略轻武装的远程轰炸变体，Adder-C"仅仅"以两具 LRM-15 发射器为主武器……另外还多装了一具发射 NARC 自导信标的发射器。只要有那玩意儿粘在你船壳上，你无处可藏。用于近距近战并作为不依赖弹药的备用武器，一门中型脉冲激光足以彻底毁掉那些以为这台 LRM 支援机甲是个软柿子的伏击者的好日子。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Sticking to the general theme for this rather slow 35 tonner, the Adder-D fields a mid to long range setup in form of an ER Large Laser and an Ultra Autocannon/5. The ADR-D will try to keep its distance and open up components from a safe distance before it moves in to finish the job with a set of Streak SRM2s.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 秉持这款相当缓慢的 35 吨机体的总体主题，Adder-D 以一门 ER 大型激光和一门超速自动炮/5 构成中远程配置。ADR-D 会尽量保持距离，在安全距离上打开对手的部件孔洞，然后推进以一组连续 SRM2 收尾。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Codenamed Puma by Inner Sphere forces who first engaged it, the Adder is a light Clan OmniMech that serves as a direct or an indirect fire-support unit in most of its configurations. The Primary configuration has a basic but powerful arsenal of two ER PPCs which are linked to an advanced Targeting Computer, allowing the Primary configuration of the Adder to strike at long range with deadly accuracy. It also sports a flamer.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 被首次交战的内天体部队代号为"美洲狮"，蝰蛇是一款轻型氏族全能机甲，在多数配置中充当直接或间接火力支援单位。主配置装备一套基础但强大的两门 ER PPC 武器，联接一台先进瞄准计算机，使蝰蛇主配置能以致命精度在远距离打击。它还配有一具火焰喷射器。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Khan Marthe Pryde decided to upgrade the 'Mechs her Clan fielded. Rather than waste precious resources designing a new OmniMech from the ground up, she instructed her scientists to improve upon existing designs. The design the scientists chose to modify was the Adder. Though the two 'Mechs are visually similar and share the same weight, the Cougar is slower and better armed.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 玛尔特·普莱德可汗决定升级其氏族装备的机甲。为不浪费宝贵资源从头设计新型全能机甲，她指示科学家改良现有设计。科学家选择改造的是蝰蛇。尽管两款机甲外观相似且重量相同，美洲狮更慢但武装更强。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Albatross was designed by the Free Worlds League in 3053 with an eye toward a possible future conflict with the then advancing Clans. The 'Mech is built using a Hermes 380 XL Engine to minimize weight and maximize free tonnage for its weapon loadout. The Albatross also uses a variety of weapons in an attempt to make the 'Mech effective at any range. The 'Mech has average mobility with a maximum speed of 64.8 kph and also makes use of double heat sinks for their greater heat dissipation capability.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 信天翁由自由世界联盟于 3053 年设计，着眼点是与当时正在推进的氏族可能发生的未来冲突。机甲采用一台赫尔墨斯 380 XL 引擎建造，以最小化重量并为武器载荷最大化可用吨位。信天翁还使用多种武器，力图使机甲在任何距离上都有效。机甲机动性中等，最高速度 64.8 公里/小时，并使用双倍散热器以获得更强的散热能力。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Albatross does not specialize in one role and is more of a workhorse design than anything else. The 'Mech carries an Irian Weapons Works V7 LRM-15 launcher which gives it long range and indirect fire support capabilities. This is backed up by an Oriente Model O LB-X Autocannon/10 and a Diverse Optics Sunbeam ER Large Laser which give the 'Mech a powerful long-range punch. The 'Mech carries a Tronel PPL-20 Large Pulse Laser which allows the 'Mech to engage an enemy at the edge of the medium to long-range envelope. Finally, for close combat, the 'Mech has an Irian Weapons Works 60mm SRM-6 and two Irian Weapons Works Super 6 Medium Lasers.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 信天翁不专精于某一角色，更像是一款主力设计。机甲携带一具"伊里安兵器工厂 V7"LRM-15 发射器，赋予它远程与间接火力支援能力。它由一门"东方 O 型"LB-X 自动炮/10 和一门"多元光学阳光"ER 大型激光支援，为机甲提供强大的远程打击力。机甲携带一门"特罗内尔 PPL-20"大型脉冲激光，使机甲能在中远程范围边缘交战。最后，近战方面，机甲有一具"伊里安兵器工厂 60 毫米"SRM-6 和两门"伊里安兵器工厂超级 6"中型激光。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Originally developed in the final year of the Amaris Civil War as the ultimate fixed position city defense BattleMech, the Annihilator was built as a sign of the military strength of the Star League in Exile. The -1A was armed with four Autocannon/10s and four Medium Lasers. While less accurate than the original -2A, the 1A was still a highly destructive and dangerous 'Mech that no MechWarrior looked forward to engaging.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 歼灭者最初在阿马里斯内战最后一年被开发为终极固定阵地城市防御战斗机甲，作为流亡星盟军事实力的象征而建造。-1A 装备四门自动炮/10 和四门中型激光。虽然精度不如原版-2A，1A 仍是破坏力惊人、危险至极的机甲，没有哪个机甲战士愿意与它交战。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Still a fearsome and powerful design, where the original Annihilator-1A carries a bevy of powerful autocannons, the -1E instead opts for an all-energy weapon loadout. Four Particle Projection Cannons give the Annihilator-1E a brutal and incredibly powerful punch while the Medium Lasers from the -1A are carried over for in-close protection while increasing the armor protection somewhat to mitigate enemy return fire.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 歼灭者仍是令人生畏的强大设计，原版歼灭者-1A 携带大量强力自动炮，而-1E 则选择全能量武器配置。四门粒子投射炮赋予歼灭者-1E 残暴而惊人的打击力，而-1A 的中型激光被保留用于近身防护，同时装甲防护略有提升以缓解敌方还击。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 歼灭者最初在阿马里斯内战最后一年开发，作为终极固定阵地城市防御战斗机甲，它的建造是流亡星盟与新生的氏族双方军事实力的象征。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Apollo is designed to be a long range fire support BattleMech. This is accomplished by mounting an engine on the 'Mech that gives it a top speed of only 64.8 kph and eleven and a half tons of armor. The 'Mech was then armed with massive missile launchers which can rain destruction down on an enemy. While the Apollo has less than average speed for a medium 'Mech, if it is employed correctly the Apollo should have nothing to fear from enemy fire; it is fully capable of staying at the edge of the battlefield and laying down suppressive LRM fire.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 阿波罗被设计为远程火力支援战斗机甲。为此它搭载的引擎仅能提供 64.8 公里/小时的最高速度和十一吨半装甲。随后它装备了巨型导弹发射器，可将毁灭倾泻到敌人头上。虽然阿波罗的速度低于中型机甲平均水平，但只要运用得当，它便无需惧怕敌方火力；它完全能停留在战场边缘，倾泻压制性 LRM 火力。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Arctic Fox is a light OmniMech reverse engineered by the Kell Hounds from the Clan Uller OmniMech with assistance in the final stages from Clan Wolf-in-Exile. The resulting OmniMech is a powerful light 'Mech that has a top speed of 97.2 km/h that is provided by a GM 180 XL engine, shaving off valuable weight from the Arctic Fox's base chassis while also making the 'Mech vulnerable to becoming a combat kill through the loss of one of its side torsos. The Arctic Fox has ten double heat sinks which are generally enough to handle the 'Mech's heat load, with the ability to add more if needed. To protect itself from enemy fire, the Arctic Fox has six tons of Royal-7 armor.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 极地狐是凯尔猎犬依据氏族乌勒尔全能机甲逆向工程而来的轻型全能机甲，最终阶段得到流亡狼氏族的协助。成品是一款强劲的轻型机甲，由 GM 180 XL 引擎提供 97.2 公里/小时的最高速度，既为极地狐的基础底盘省下宝贵重量，也使它因失去任一侧面躯干而容易被击毁。它装有十台双倍散热器，通常足以应对其热负荷，必要时还可加装。为抵御敌方火力，极地狐拥有六吨 Royal-7 装甲。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The primary configuration of the Arctic Fox is intended to wear an enemy's armor down at long ranges and then close for the kill. To do this, the Arctic Fox carries an ER PPC that can hit a target at up to six hundred and ninety meters. For close combat, two Medium Lasers provide the primary hitting power while two SRM-4 launchers seek out weak points in an enemy's armor.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 北极狐主配置意在远距离磨掉敌人装甲，然后逼近收尾。为此，北极狐携带一门 ER PPC，能在六百九十米外命中目标。近战方面，两门中型激光构成主要打击力，而两具 SRM-4 发射器搜寻敌人装甲上的弱点。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The A configuration is intended for short range engagements and carries four Medium Pulse Lasers and three Small Pulse Lasers. Six jump jets have been added in order to increase mobility.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Useful in anti-aircraft and in vehicle hunting roles, the B configuration has an LB-X Autocannon/10 as its primary weapon. This is backed up by a Medium Laser. This configuration is highly flexible in its roles but also severely handicapped by its reliance on a ballistic weapon.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: B 配置适用于防空与猎杀车辆角色，以一门 LB-X 自动炮/10 为主武器。它由一门中型激光支援。此配置在角色上高度灵活，但也因依赖实弹武器而严重受限。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Arctic Fox is a light OmniMech reverse engineered by the Kell Hounds from the Clan Uller OmniMech with assistance in the final stages from Clan Wolf-in-Exile. The resulting OmniMech is a powerful light 'Mech that has a top speed of 97.2 km/h that is provided by a GM 180 XL engine, shaving off valuable weight from the Arctic Fox's base chassis while also making the 'Mech vulnerable to becoming a combat kill through the loss of one of its side torsos. The Arctic Fox has ten double heat sinks which are generally enough to handle the 'Mech's heat load, with the ability to add more if needed. To protect itself from enemy fire, the Arctic Fox has six tons of Royal-7 armor.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 极地狐是凯尔猎犬依据氏族乌勒尔全能机甲逆向工程而来的轻型全能机甲，最终阶段得到流亡狼氏族的协助。成品是一款强劲的轻型机甲，由 GM 180 XL 引擎提供 97.2 公里/小时的最高速度，既为极地狐的基础底盘省下宝贵重量，也使它因失去任一侧面躯干而容易被击毁。它装有十台双倍散热器，通常足以应对其热负荷，必要时还可加装。为抵御敌方火力，极地狐拥有六吨 Royal-7 装甲。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Another sniper and cleanup 'Mech rolled into one, the C configuration mounts an ER PPC as its primary weapon, giving it superb long range firepower. This is matched up with a Large Pulse Laser, which has a much shorter range but is extremely accurate.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: C 配置把狙击手与清道夫合二为一，以一门 ER PPC 为主武器，赋予它卓越的远程火力。与之搭配的是一门大型脉冲激光，射程短得多但极其精准。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A dedicated fire support configuration, the D configuration carries two LRM-10 missile launchers linked to an Artemis IV fire control system for greater missile accuracy.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: D 配置是专职火力支援配置，携带两具联接 Artemis IV 火控系统的 LRM-10 导弹发射器以提升导弹精度。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Keeping the top speed of the ASN-21 as well as its base weapon load of missiles, the ASN-101 is a rare Federated Suns variant that drops two jump jets and a half ton of armor to mount a trio of Small Lasers, giving the ASN-101 a much better close-in punch compared to its progenitor.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: ASN-101 保留了 ASN-21 的最高速度与基础导弹武器配置，是联邦太阳稀有的变体，它削减两个跳跃推进器和半吨装甲，以装载三门小型激光，使 ASN-101 相比其前身具备强得多的近身打击力。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Keeping the top speed of the ASN-21 as well as its base weapon load of missiles, the ASN-101 is a rare Federated Suns variant that drops two jump jets and a half ton of armor to mount a trio of Small Lasers, giving the ASN-101 a much better close-in punch compared to its progenitor.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: ASN-101 保留了 ASN-21 的最高速度与基础导弹武器配置，是联邦太阳稀有的变体，它削减两个跳跃推进器和半吨装甲，以装载三门小型激光，使 ASN-101 相比其前身具备强得多的近身打击力。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Assassin was designed to complete against the lighter scout mechs like the Wasp and Stinger but is twice as heavy, faster, greater jump range, heavier armor and much more firepower.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 刺客的设计目标是抗衡黄蜂与毒刺等轻型侦察机甲，但它的重量翻倍、速度更快、跳跃距离更远、装甲更厚、火力强得多。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Assassins are a rare mech nowadays with good firepower and armor with great speed and jumping range.  Makes are really good scout mech killer if you ask me. Dangerous to get jumped by one of these from behind no matter your size.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 刺客如今是稀有机甲，火力与装甲都不错，速度与跳跃距离出色。要我说，它们是极好的侦察机甲杀手。无论你体型如何，被这东西从背后跳上来都很危险。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The -23 variant of the Assassin is an upgrade of the original model using Lostech; originally seen as a standardized field modification, in 3067 new production began at Hellespont 'Mech Works. The SRM-2 has been removed to upgrade the Medium Laser to a Medium Pulse Laser and an Artemis IV fire control system has been added for the LRM-5 launcher. Within the CCAF, TDF and MAF it is largely used as a cheap way to rebuild shattered forces and sees service mostly in green and reserve formations. The Capellans in particular use the -23 as a fire-support unit for pursuit and strike lances, though shortages of Artemis munitions means many are forced to use mine-delivery missiles.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 刺客的-23 变体是使用失落科技的原版升级型；最初被视为标准化的野战改装，3067 年由赫勒斯庞特机甲厂开始新的生产。SRM-2 被移除以把中型激光升级为中型脉冲激光，并为 LRM-5 发射器加装 Artemis IV 火控系统。在 CCAF、TDF 和 MAF 中，它主要被用作重建残破部队的廉价手段，多在生疏与预备编队中服役。卡佩兰人尤其把-23 用作追击与打击小队的火力支援单位，不过 Artemis 弹药短缺意味着许多只能使用布雷导弹。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: First fielded in 2765, the Atlas II was designed by the Hegemony Research and Development Department, Weapons Division of the original Star League to maintain the technological edge over the other Great Houses. It was exclusively for the SLDF's Royal Regiments. In 2785, when General Aleksandr Kerensky put out his call for loyal forces to join him in his Exodus, every Atlas II pilot responded and left with him. The Atlas II is armed with an array of weaponry, including an LB-X Autocannon/10, a pair of ER Large Lasers, and a 20-tube Long Range Missile Launcher for long range attacks. For close range combat, the 'Mech is equipped with a pair of Medium Pulse Lasers and a Holly Six Pack. In addition, the 'Mech has been given CASEfor both sides of the torso in order to keep an ammunition cook-off from consuming the 'Mech.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 阿特拉斯 II 于 2765 年首次投入战场，由原星盟的霸权研发部武器司设计，以维持对各大议院的技术优势。它专供星盟防卫军皇家团使用。2785 年亚历山大·克伦斯基将军号召忠诚部队随他出埃及时，每一位阿特拉斯 II 飞行员都响应并随他离开。阿特拉斯 II 装备一系列武器，包括一门 LB-X 自动炮/10、两门 ER 大型激光和一具 20 管远程导弹发射器用于远程攻击。近距离战斗则配备两门中型脉冲激光和一具冬青六联装。此外，机甲两侧躯干都装有 C.A.S.E.，以防弹药殉爆吞噬整机。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 此阿特拉斯 II 变体将两门 ER 大型激光和 LB 10-X 换成一门"屠亲"ER PPC 和一门高斯步枪，仅移除一台双倍散热器

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Atlas A is the first try to be the king of the battlefield, capable of bringing a dizzying array of weapons to bear on targets at any range. It is also noteworthy for normally mounting the maximum amount of armor possible. Few opponents can survive even brief contact with this monster.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 阿特拉斯 A 是成为战场之王的最初尝试，能在任何距离上向目标倾泻令人目眩的各类武器。它还以通常装备可容纳的最大装甲量而著称。很少有对手能在与这头怪物短暂接触后幸存。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Atlas A is the king of short range engagements, capable of bringing a dizzying amount of short range missiles to bear on targets at close range. It is also noteworthy for normally mounting the maximum amount of armor possible. Few opponents can survive even brief contact with this monster.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 阿特拉斯 A 是近程交战之王，能在近距离向目标倾泻令人目眩的大量短程火箭。它还以通常装备可容纳的最大装甲量而著称。很少有对手能在与这头怪物短暂接触后幸存。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Built in 2776, this Atlas variant is the largest 'Mech equipped with a Command Console. To free up the weight required to fit this device, the AS7-D-DC removes one ton of LRM ammunition and the paired rear firing lasers. Effective at Close and Long Range Fire Support. Recommended for use by Experienced Tactical Commanders. Extremely Rare and largely Extinct.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这款阿特拉斯变体于 2776 年建造，是装备指挥控制台的最大机甲。为腾出安装该装置所需的重量，AS7-D-DC 移除一吨 LRM 弹药和成对的后向激光。在近程与远程火力支援上都很有效。推荐由经验丰富的战术指挥官使用。极为稀有且基本绝迹。
指挥机甲、重装 & 近身突击

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: I've heard of these older refits and thankfully our Battalion never faced one. Facing a single Pilot in an Atlas is one thing, but going up against two pilots in one of these is something else altogether; an experienced Commander and MechWarrior is a force to be reckoned with. Its no wonder they were targeted so heavily targeted during the Early Succession Wars. The loss of ammo and medium lasers makes this design no less deadly.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我听说过这些较早的改装，所幸我们营从未遇到过。面对一台阿特拉斯里的单个飞行员是一回事，但面对这种机甲里的两名飞行员就完全是另一回事了；一位经验丰富的指挥官兼机甲战士是股不容小觑的力量。难怪他们在继承战争早期成为重点打击目标。损失弹药和中型激光并没有让这个设计变得不那么致命。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Known as the 'Atlas II,' the D-HT model carries more Energy weaponry and usually a lighter, more flexible Autocannon. It still has unbelievable protection and the same crushing Melee ability as other Atlas models.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: D-HT 型号被称为"阿特拉斯 II"，携带更多能量武器，通常配一门更轻便灵活点的自动炮。它仍拥有难以置信的防护，以及其他阿特拉斯型号同样摧枯拉朽的近战能力。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Atlas D is the king of the battlefield, capable of bringing a dizzying array of weapons to bear on targets at any range. It is also noteworthy for normally mounting the maximum amount of armor possible. Few opponents can survive even brief contact with this monster.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A Combine upgrade of the Atlas that used rediscovered Star League technology, the K model was built with a Vlar 300 XL Engine. Carrying a Shigunga LRM-20 with two tons of ammo in the left torso the 'Mech was rearmed for long range combat with an Imperator Dragon's Fire Gauss Rifle in place of the autocannon, with two tons of gauss rounds carried in the right arm, backed up by a pair of Victory Nickel Alloy ER Large Lasers split between both arms. This armament allowed the AS7-K to keep an enemy at range, though the continued use of twenty single heat sinks caused swift heat buildup if both lasers are fired repeatedly. For close range defense, the K model carried two Victory Heartbeat Medium Pulse Lasers and a Yori Flyswatter Anti-Missile System in the left arm. To round off the AS7-K's defense, CASE was added to the side torsos to protect against an ammunition explosion.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: K 型是联合体利用重新发现的星盟技术对阿特拉斯的升级，采用一台 Vlar 300 XL 引擎建造。左躯干携带一具"紫郡"LRM-20 与两吨弹药，机甲以远程战斗重新武装：用一门"帝皇龙焰"高斯步枪取代自动炮，右臂携带两吨高斯弹，并由分置双肩的两门"胜利镍合金"ER 大型激光支援。这一武器配置使 AS7-K 能让敌人保持在远处，不过继续使用二十台单散热器意味着若两门激光反复开火会迅速积热。近程防御方面，K 型在左臂携带两门"胜利心跳"中型脉冲激光和一套"织部苍蝇拍"反导系统。为完善 AS7-K 的防御，两侧躯干加装了 C.A.S.E. 以防弹药爆炸。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A Combine upgrade of the Atlas that used rediscovered Star League technology. The 'Mechs 300 XL engine makes room for two ER Large -, two Medium Pulse Lasers and an AMS, and the AC-20 was swapped for a huge Gauss Rifle. But due to it's twenty -just- single heat sinks, you have to keep an eye your heat buildup.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是联合体利用重新发现的星盟技术对阿特拉斯的升级。机甲的 300 XL 引擎为两门 ER 大型激光、两门中型脉冲激光和一套 AMS 腾出空间，AC-20 则换成一门巨型高斯步枪。但由于它那"仅仅"二十台单散热器，你必须留意积热。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A Succession Wars era attempt at recreating the Atlas II's loadout, the AS7-RS downgrades the AutoCannon, LRMs and SRMs while trading out the Medium Lasers for a pair of arm mounted Large Lasers.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: AS7-RS 是继承战争时代重现阿特拉斯 II 配置的尝试，它降级了自动炮、LRM 和 SRM，并把中型激光换成两门臂载大型激光。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A Succession Wars era attempt at recreating the Atlas II's loadout, the AS7-RS downgrades the AutoCannon, LRMs and SRMs while trading out the Medium Lasers for a pair of arm mounted Large Lasers.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: AS7-RS 是继承战争时代重现阿特拉斯 II 配置的尝试，它降级了自动炮、LRM 和 SRM，并把中型激光换成两门臂载大型激光。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The first of the Inner Sphere OmniMechs to be conceptualized and one of the last to reach production by the Draconis Combine, the Avatar's design is based on captured Vulture OmniMechs.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 化身是内天体最早被构想、也是联合体最后投产的全能机甲之一，其设计基于缴获的秃鹫全能机甲。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The first of the Inner Sphere OmniMechs to be conceptualized and one of the last to reach production by the Draconis Combine, the Avatar's design is based on captured Vulture OmniMechs.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 化身是内天体最早被构想、也是联合体最后投产的全能机甲之一，其设计基于缴获的秃鹫全能机甲。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Focused on close combat, the A configuration carries an ER Large Laser as its only long range weapon. Mounting a pair of SRM-6 launchers, an Autocannon/20 and the two Medium Lasers mounted on the base chassis, the Avatar A is a fearsome opponent with devastating close range punch.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: A 配置聚焦近战，以一门 ER 大型激光作为唯一的远程武器。它装有一对 SRM-6 发射器、一门自动炮/20，以及基础底盘上的两门中型激光，降世神 A 是个可怕的对手，拥有毁灭性的近程打击力。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Now, this is solid Avatar configuration! An AC20 and pair of SRMs to blast away at the enemy. Just don't run out of ammo, boss.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这才是扎实的降世神配置！一门 AC20 和一对 SRM 轰击敌人。别把弹药打光就行，老大。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A fire support variant, the B configuration carries two LRM-15 racks and two LRM-10 racks. These are all mated to an Artemis IV Fire Control System. The only short range weaponry on the B configuration consists wholly of the two Medium Lasers mounted on the base chassis.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: B 配置是一款火力支援变体，携带两具 LRM-15 挂架和两具 LRM-10 挂架，全部配以 Artemis IV 火控系统。B 配置唯一的近程武器完全由底盘上安装的两门中型激光构成。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A fire support variant, the B configuration carries two LRM-15 racks and two LRM-10 racks. These are all mated to an Artemis IV Fire Control System. The only short range weaponry on the B configuration consists wholly of the two Medium Lasers mounted on the base chassis.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: B 配置是一款火力支援变体，携带两具 LRM-15 挂架和两具 LRM-10 挂架，全部配以 Artemis IV 火控系统。B 配置唯一的近程武器完全由底盘上安装的两门中型激光构成。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: As a command configuration, the C configuration carries a C3 Master Computer into battle. The C configuration attempts to keep enemies at arms length with a PPC and Ultra Autocannon/5 supported by a pair of LRM-10 launchers.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为指挥配置，C 配置把 C3 主控计算机带入战斗。C 配置以一门 PPC 和一门超速自动炮/5 搭配两具 LRM-10 发射器，力求把敌人拒于臂长之外。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: As a command configuration, the C configuration carries a C3 Master Computer into battle. The C configuration attempts to keep enemies at arms length with a PPC and Ultra Autocannon/5 supported by a pair of LRM-10 launchers.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为指挥配置，C 配置把 C3 主控计算机带入战斗。C 配置以一门 PPC 和一门超速自动炮/5 搭配两具 LRM-10 发射器，力求把敌人拒于臂长之外。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The D configuration is intended to act as a sniper. The primary weapon is a Light Gauss Rifle. For close to medium range combat, the Avatar D has two MRM-20 launchers and a pair of ER Medium Lasers in addition to the two hard-wired Medium Lasers. Finally, the D Configuration has a C3 Slave unit that allows it to work in C3 lances.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: D 配置意在担任狙击手。主武器是一门轻型高斯步枪。中近距离战斗方面，降世神 D 除两门固定中型激光外，还有两具 MRM-20 发射器和一对 ER 中型激光。最后，D 配置装有一台 C3 从属单元，使它能在 C3 小队中作战。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The D configuration is intended to act as a sniper. The primary weapon is a Light Gauss Rifle. For close to medium range combat, the Avatar D has two MRM-20 launchers and a pair of ER Medium Lasers in addition to the two hard-wired Medium Lasers. Finally, the D Configuration has a C3 Slave unit that allows it to work in C3 lances.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: D 配置意在担任狙击手。主武器是一门轻型高斯步枪。中近距离战斗方面，降世神 D 除两门固定中型激光外，还有两具 MRM-20 发射器和一对 ER 中型激光。最后，D 配置装有一台 C3 从属单元，使它能在 C3 小队中作战。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A dedicated 'Mech killer, the Avatar G carries a Gauss Rifle with two tons of ammunition in each arm.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 降世神 G 是专职机甲杀手，每臂各携带一门高斯步枪，配两吨弹药。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A dedicated 'Mech killer, the Avatar G carries a Gauss Rifle with two tons of ammunition in each arm.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 降世神 G 是专职机甲杀手，每臂各携带一门高斯步枪，配两吨弹药。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A field upgrade developed in the midst of Operation Bulldog, this configuration utilized captured Clan Smoke Jaguar weapons to help bolster the SLDF forces in later waves. Mounting a mix of Combine and Clan-tech, this config carries an MRM-40 supported by a Clan Gauss Rifle, ER Large Laser and Streak SRM-4.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 此配置是"斗牛犬"行动期间开发的野战升级，利用缴获的烟虎氏族武器帮助增强后期波次的星盟防卫军部队。它混装联合体与氏族科技，携带一具 MRM-40，辅以一门氏族高斯步枪、一门 ER 大型激光和一具连续 SRM-4。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A field upgrade developed in the midst of Operation Bulldog, this configuration utilized captured Clan Smoke Jaguar weapons to help bolster the SLDF forces in later waves. Mounting a mix of Combine and Clan-tech, this config carries an MRM-40 supported by a Clan Gauss Rifle, ER Large Laser and Streak SRM-4.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 此配置是"斗牛犬"行动期间开发的野战升级，利用缴获的烟虎氏族武器帮助增强后期波次的星盟防卫军部队。它混装联合体与氏族科技，携带一具 MRM-40，辅以一门氏族高斯步枪、一门 ER 大型激光和一具连续 SRM-4。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A 'Mech that truly lives up to its name! The Awesome 8Q mounts a frightening trio of PPCs that can destroy, knock down, or debilitate any target in no time. It's ungainly, but it can shrug off huge amounts of incoming fire.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一台真正配得上名字的机甲！神奇 8Q 装备三门的可怕 PPC，能在极短时间内摧毁、击倒或瘫痪任何目标。它笨拙不灵，却也能轻易扛下大量来袭火力。
重型狙击手 & 防御者

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A 'Mech that truly lives up to its name! The Awesome 8Q mounts a frightening trio of PPCs that can destroy, knock down, or debilitate any target in no time. It's ungainly, but it can shrug off huge amounts of incoming fire.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一台真正配得上名字的机甲！神奇 8Q 装备三门的可怕 PPC，能在极短时间内摧毁、击倒或瘫痪任何目标。它笨拙不灵，却也能轻易扛下大量来袭火力。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The AWS-8R replaces the more expensive PPCs with a Large Laser and paired LRM-15s.  While this variant can still dish out a similar amount of damage, it suffers from its dependency on a limited supply of ammunition.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: AWS-8R 以一门大型激光和成对的 LRM-15 取代更昂贵的 PPC。虽然此变体仍能造成相近的伤害，却因依赖有限的弹药储备而吃亏。
重型火力支援 & 防御者

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The main benefit of this variant is its ability to lob indirect fire.  Otherwise this is a case where I prefer the original recipe.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这一变体的主要优势是能投掷间接火力。除此之外，这情况我更偏好原配方。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Awesome 8T is a superb fire support 'Mech, though its heavy armor is a bit wasted in that role. It can still put up a good fight at medium ranges, and it can crush smaller units outright with Melee attacks.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 卓越 8T 是一款出色的火力支援机甲，尽管其厚重装甲在这个角色上略显浪费。它在中距离仍能打出漂亮的一仗，也能用近战攻击直接碾碎较小单位。
重型火力支援 & 防御者

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Awesome 8T is a superb fire support 'Mech, though its heavy armor is a bit wasted in that role. It can still put up a good fight at medium ranges, and it can crush smaller units outright with Melee attacks.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 卓越 8T 是一款出色的火力支援机甲，尽管其厚重装甲在这个角色上略显浪费。它在中距离仍能打出漂亮的一仗，也能用近战攻击直接碾碎较小单位。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Seeking to address the issues with the 8R model, the AWS-8V is a blend of the 8R and 8Q.  This allows a pilot to provide indirect fire support, while still being a potent combatant with its PPC and Large Laser.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 为解决 8R 型号存在的问题，AWS-8V 融合了 8R 与 8Q。这使飞行员既能提供间接火力支援，又能凭借其 PPC 和大型激光成为强悍的战斗者。
重型火力支援 & 防御者

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The best of both worlds, with LRMs and the PPC - Large Laser combo you have a versatile fire support platform.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 两全其美，凭借 LRM 和 PPC-大型激光的组合，你得到了一款多用途火力支援平台。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 9M is an upgrade of the Awesome that uses Star League technologies. The 'Mech is built around a 320 Hermes XL Fusion engine, giving the 'Mech a top speed of 64.8 km/h. The heat sinks were upgraded to double heat sinks to allow this variant to be rearmed with three Fusigon Longtooth ER PPCs. The ER PPCs are backed up by two Hovertec Streak SRM-2s, split between the left arm and center torso and fed by one ton of reloads in the left leg, a Magna 400P Medium Pulse Laser also in the center torso, and a Diverse Optics Type 10 Small Pulse Laser in place of the head-mounted small laser.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 9M 是使用星盟技术对神奇的升级。机甲围绕一台 320 赫尔墨斯 XL 聚变引擎建造，最高速度 64.8 公里/小时。散热器升级为双倍散热器，使此变体得以重新装备三门"富西贡长牙"ER PPC。这些 ER PPC 由两具"气垫"连续 SRM-2 支援（分置左臂与中央躯干，由左腿一吨再装填供弹）、中央躯干一门玛格纳 400P 中型脉冲激光，以及取代头部小型激光的"多元光学 10 型"小型脉冲激光。
重型狙击手 & 防御者

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 9M is an upgrade of the Awesome that uses Star League technologies. Twenty double Heatsinks keeping it cool while firing the three Fusigon Longtooth ER PPCs constantly, and with it's 320 XL engine it is faster and allows in addition a variety of backup weapons, but makes the 'Mech also more fragile.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 9M 是使用星盟技术对神奇的升级。二十台双倍散热器让它在持续发射三门"富西贡长牙"ER PPC 时保持低温；凭借 320 XL 引擎它更快，还允许加装多种备用武器，但也使机甲更脆弱。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Bane is a BattleMech that is based upon a Star League prototype that was never put into production. Tagged the Kraken by Inner Sphere forces who opposed it, the Bane was first built in 2827. It was originally a significant part of many Clan toumans, but was gradually relegated to second-line status following the introduction of the OmniMech. As such, it is still critical to many defensive units.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 灾祸是一款以星盟从未投产的原型为基础的战斗机甲。它被对抗它的内天体部队冠以"海怪"之名，于 2827 年首次建造。它原本是许多氏族图曼的重要组成部分，但随着全能机甲的引入逐渐退居二线。即便如此，它对许多防御单位仍至关重要。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Bane is a BattleMech that is based upon a Star League prototype that was never put into production. Tagged the Kraken by Inner Sphere forces who opposed it, the Bane was first built in 2827. It was originally a significant part of many Clan toumans, but was gradually relegated to second-line status following the introduction of the OmniMech. As such, it is still critical to many defensive units.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 灾祸是一款以星盟从未投产的原型为基础的战斗机甲。它被对抗它的内天体部队冠以"海怪"之名，于 2827 年首次建造。它原本是许多氏族图曼的重要组成部分，但随着全能机甲的引入逐渐退居二线。即便如此，它对许多防御单位仍至关重要。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The original design first produced in 2445, this Banshee variant carries the PPC, Autocannon/5, and Small Laser of the later 3E, as well as a pair of Medium Lasers.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 此女妖变体源于 2445 年首次生产的原始设计，携带后来 3E 型的 PPC、自动炮/5 和小型激光，以及两门中型激光。
重型缠斗者 & 狙击手

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The original design first produced in 2445, this Banshee variant carries the PPC, Autocannon/5, and Small Laser of the later 3E, as well as a pair of Medium Lasers.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 此女妖变体源于 2445 年首次生产的原始设计，携带后来 3E 型的 PPC、自动炮/5 和小型激光，以及两门中型激光。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Banshee 3E was originally designed for close combat, with better speed than most other assault 'Mechs. While it has heavy armor and powerful Melee attack capability, its firepower is severely lacking and it can still be flanked by lighter units.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 女妖 3E 最初为近战而设计，速度优于大多数其他突击机甲。虽然它有厚重装甲和强大的近战攻击能力，火力却严重不足，且仍可能被轻型单位包抄。
重型缠斗者 & 狙击手

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Banshee 3E was originally designed for close combat, with better speed than most other assault 'Mechs. While it has heavy armor and powerful Melee attack capability, its firepower is severely lacking and it can still be flanked by lighter units.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 女妖 3E 最初为近战而设计，速度优于大多数其他突击机甲。虽然它有厚重装甲和强大的近战攻击能力，火力却严重不足，且仍可能被轻型单位包抄。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Banshee 3M mounts respectable weaponry with better-than-average speed and armor. This comes at the cost of very poor heat management. It's good at hunting lighter units, especially if it can close to Melee range.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 女妖 3M 装备可观的武器，速度与装甲优于平均。代价是散热管理极差。它擅长猎杀轻型单位，尤其当它能逼近至近战距离时。
重型缠斗者 & 狙击手

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Banshee 3M mounts respectable weaponry with better-than-average speed and armor. This comes at the cost of very poor heat management. It's good at hunting lighter units, especially if it can close to Melee range.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 女妖 3M 装备可观的武器，速度与装甲优于平均。代价是散热管理极差。它擅长猎杀轻型单位，尤其当它能逼近至近战距离时。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Banshee 3MC was a special design of the Magistracy of Canopus. It replaced the autocannon with a bigger one. To make room for it, most of the original heatsinks had to go.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 女妖 3MC 是卡诺普斯法域的特殊设计。它用一门更大的自动炮替换原有自动炮。为腾出空间，大部分原有散热器不得不被舍弃。
重型缠斗者 & 狙击手

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Banshee 3E was originally designed for close combat, with better speed than most other assault 'Mechs. While it has heavy armor and powerful Melee attack capability, its firepower is severely lacking and it can still be flanked by lighter units. To address this design flaw, the Magistracy of Canopus exchanged the autocannon with a bigger one, at the expense of heat management in the MC variant.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 女妖 3E 最初为近战而设计，速度优于大多数其他突击机甲。虽然它有厚重装甲和强大的近战攻击能力，火力却严重不足，且仍可能被轻型单位包抄。为解决这一设计缺陷，卡诺普斯法域在 MC 变体中用一门更大的自动炮替换了原有自动炮，代价是散热管理。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Banshee 3Q variant lacks the long distance capabilities of its predecessor, replacing its AC10 and PPC with an AC20 and enough ammo to last in a sustained fight.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 女妖 3Q 变体缺乏前代的长距离能力，它以一门 AC20 和足以支撑持久战的弹药取代了 AC10 与 PPC。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Banshee 3Q variant lacks the long distance capabilities of its predecessor, replacing its AC10 and PPC with an AC20 and enough ammo to last in a sustained fight.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 女妖 3Q 变体缺乏前代的长距离能力，它以一门 AC20 和足以支撑持久战的弹药取代了 AC10 与 PPC。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A very recent variant, the 3S downgrades the engine size making the Banshee slower, but more than makes up for this by more than doubling its firepower.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 3S 是极新的变体，它降级引擎尺寸使女妖更慢，但以超过两倍的火力远远弥补了这一点。
重型缠斗者 & 狙击手

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This is some new Steiner variant, and those techs at Defiance Industries really made it a monster.  While not as fast as the original, this damage output on this 'Mech would make an Atlas jealous.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是某种新的施泰纳变体，迪法恩斯工业的那些技师真把它做成了怪物。虽然不如原版快，但这台机甲的伤害输出会让阿特拉斯嫉妒。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The original production variant of this 'Mech, the BKX-7K, utilizes two massive Donal Particle Projection Cannons, which were relatively new at the time. To support the massive cannons, it also has two Federated-5 Shot LRM-5 launchers with one ton of ammo to split between them and a Harpoon-6 SRM-6, giving it something to hit with at all ranges.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这台机甲的最初量产变体 BKX-7K 采用两门巨型多纳尔粒子投射炮，它们在当时相对较新。为支援这两门巨炮，它还装有两具联邦 5 发 LRM-5 发射器，共分一吨弹药，以及一具"鱼叉-6"SRM-6，使它在任何距离上都有可用的武器。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A failed prototype but with a hell of a punch.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 失败的原型机，但威力惊人。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: With the introduction of the BattleAxe’s successor, the Hammerhands, no official variants ever surfaced. However, many MechWarriors, especially those who never quite learned to manage the BattleAxe as it leapt through the air, had technicians remove the temperamental jump jets and install a second LRM 5 in each torso, deeming it the “No Crash” version, or simply 7NC.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 随着战斧的继任者"锤手"问世，再没有官方变体出现过。然而许多机甲战士——尤其是那些始终没学会如何驾驭空中跳跃的战斧的人——让技师拆下反复无常的跳跃推进器，在每侧躯干各装一具 LRM 5，称之为"不摔机"版本，或简称 7NC。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A failed prototype but with a hell of a punch. But be careful with ammo you will run dry fast.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 失败的原型机，但打击力惊人。不过要小心弹药，你会很快打空。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Battle Hawk was originally designed and built at a time when Defiance Industries felt threatened by the large amount of equipment being produced by, and imported from, the Free Worlds League. It was built to prove that Defiance Industries was still an industry leader in BattleMechs. This came from a 'Mech that, while slow for its weight class, is a force to be reckoned with on the modern battlefield. The Battle Hawk has a top speed of 86.4 kph, which puts it on par with 'Mechs fifteen to twenty tons heavier than itself, but it also carries a powerful arsenal for its size. Its five and a half tons of armor give it good protection for a light 'Mech. Additionally, to make the Battle Hawk more maneuverable on the battlefield, it can jump up to one hundred and fifty meters.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 战斗鹰设计与建造之时，迪法恩斯工业正感到被自由世界联盟生产与进口的大量装备所威胁。它的诞生是为了证明迪法恩斯工业仍是战斗机甲行业的领导者。成果是一款虽在同重量级中偏慢、但在现代战场上不容小觑的机甲。战斗鹰最高速度 86.4 公里/小时，与其重十五到二十吨的机甲持平，同时也为此尺寸携带了强大的武器库。五吨半装甲为轻型机甲提供了良好防护。此外，为提升战场机动性，战斗鹰可跳跃至一百五十米。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Battle Hawk is armed with a powerful short-range arsenal. The primary weaponry is a trio of Defiance P5M Medium Pulse Lasers, which provides the Battle Hawk with a blistering short-range laser arsenal. The 'Mech is also armed with a Hovertec Streak SRM-2 which allows the 'Mech to attempt to seek out weak points in an enemy's armor. The 'Mech is also armed with a McArthur Anti-Missile System which provides the Battle Hawk with a degree of protection from missile attacks.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 战鹰装备强大的近程武器库。主武器为三门迪法恩斯 P5M 中型脉冲激光，为战鹰提供炽烈的近程激光武器库。机甲还装备一具"气垫"连续 SRM-2，使机甲能尝试搜寻敌方装甲上的弱点。机甲另装有一套麦克阿瑟反导系统，为战鹰提供一定程度的导弹攻击防护。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A upgrade Battlemaster 1DC Command refit, carrying advanced Technologies and Hardened Armour to stay in the fight as long as possible.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是战斗大师 1DC 指挥型的升级改装，携带先进技术与硬化装甲，以尽可能长时间留在战斗中。
指挥机甲、重型近战 & 近身突击

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A upgrade Battlemaster 1DC Command refit, carrying advanced Technologies and Hardened Armour to stay in the fight as long as possible.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是战斗大师 1DC 指挥型的升级改装，携带先进技术与硬化装甲，以尽可能长时间留在战斗中。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: More of a refit than a production variant, the SRM-6 and two Medium Lasers are removed so that six Heat Sinks and an extra ton of armor could be added.  Making the BLR-1D a formitable opponent.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 它更像是一次改装而非量产变体：SRM-6 与两门中型激光被移除，以便加装六台散热器和一吨额外装甲，使 BLR-1D 成为令人敬畏的对手。
重型缠斗者 & 近程突击

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: More of a refit than a production variant, the SRM-6 and two Medium Lasers are removed so that six Heat Sinks and an extra ton of armor could be added.  Making the BLR-1D a formitable opponent.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 它更像是一次改装而非量产变体：SRM-6 与两门中型激光被移除，以便加装六台散热器和一吨额外装甲，使 BLR-1D 成为令人敬畏的对手。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Command Console refit built in 2855 - The BattleMaster was one of the Federated Suns' preferred 'Mechs to install Command Consoles. Standard refits usually installed the Command Console on the BLR-1G, removing one heat sink and both rear-mounted Medium Lasers.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 2855 年建造的指挥控制台改装型——战将是联邦太阳系首选安装指挥控制台的机甲之一。标准改装通常在 BLR-1G 上安装指挥控制台，移除一台散热器和两门后向中型激光。
指挥机甲、重型近战 & 近身突击

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Thankfully I never faced one of these during my stint with the Second St. Ives Lancers on Kittery. The Fedrats, after all, preferred installing Command Consoles on the BattleMaster, but from my understanding these were relegated to training duties by the late Third Succession War. The loss of only one heat sink and two Medium Lasers is not too bad for a trade-off.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 幸好我在基特里随第二圣艾夫斯枪骑兵服役期间从未遇到过这种机甲。毕竟联邦鼠更喜欢把指挥控制台装在战将上，但据我了解，这些到第三次继承战争后期已被降级用于训练任务。只损失一台散热器和两门中型激光，这样的代价不算太糟。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Versatile and powerful, the BattleMaster 1G is one of the best known BattleMechs in existence. Normally mounting a varied array of Energy weapons, the BattleMaster can engage enemies at any range and packs a powerful punch.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 战斗大师 1G 多才多艺而强大，是现存最知名的战斗机甲之一。它通常装备多样化的能量武器阵列，能在任何距离接敌，打击力很强。
重型缠斗者 & 近程突击

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Versatile and powerful, the BattleMaster 1G is one of the best known BattleMechs in existence. Normally mounting a varied array of Energy weapons, the BattleMaster can engage enemies at any range and packs a powerful punch.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 战斗大师 1G 多才多艺而强大，是现存最知名的战斗机甲之一。它通常装备多样化的能量武器阵列，能在任何距离接敌，打击力很强。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A new variant produced for the Lyran Commonwealth by Red Devil industries which changes its mission profile to be more of a support 'Mech, removing its PPC and SRM-6 and replacing them with an LRM-15, LRM-5 and a pair of SRM-2s.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是红魔工业为莱兰联邦生产的新变体，其任务定位更偏支援机甲，移除 PPC 和 SRM-6，换成一套 LRM-15、LRM-5 和两具 SRM-2。
重型缠斗者 & 近程突击

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A new variant produced for the Lyran Commonwealth by Red Devil industries which changes its mission profile to be more of a support 'Mech, removing its PPC and SRM-6 and replacing them with an LRM-15, LRM-5 and a pair of SRM-2s.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是红魔工业为莱兰联邦生产的新变体，其任务定位更偏支援机甲，移除 PPC 和 SRM-6，换成一套 LRM-15、LRM-5 和两具 SRM-2。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Black Hawk-KU is an Inner Sphere version of the Clan Black Hawk OmniMech. In order to make it possible to copy the Black Hawk, the Black Hawk-KU is built ten tons heavier than its Clan counterpart. The Black Hawk-KU is built on a sixty ton chassis and is powered by a Vlar 300 XL Engine which propels it to a top speed of 86.4 kph.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 黑鹰-KU 是氏族黑鹰全能机甲的内天体版本。为使复制黑鹰成为可能，黑鹰-KU 比其氏族对应型重了十吨。它采用六十吨底盘，由 Vlar 300 XL 引擎驱动，最高速度 86.4 公里/小时。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Blackjack 0s are Primitive downgrades of the BJ-1, replacing both AC's with Medium Rifles, and maximizing armour as best as it can.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 黑杰克 0 是 BJ-1 的原始降级版，将两门 AC 换成中型步枪，并尽可能最大化装甲。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Blackjack 0s are Primitive downgrades of the BJ-1, replacing both AC's with Medium Rifles, and maximizing armour as best as it can.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 黑杰克 0 是 BJ-1 的原始降级版，将两门 AC 换成中型步枪，并尽可能最大化装甲。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Blackjack 1s are solid, well-rounded 'Mechs for their tonnage. They typically mount Jump Jets, which give them an extra edge by repositioning quickly to keep a direct line of fire for their Autocannons.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 黑杰克 1 就其吨位而言是扎实而全面的机甲。它们通常装备跳跃推进器，能迅速重新定位以保持自动炮的直射视野，从而获得额外优势。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Blackjack 1s are solid, well-rounded 'Mechs for their tonnage. They typically mount Jump Jets, which give them an extra edge by repositioning quickly to keep a direct line of fire for their Autocannons.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 黑杰克 1 就其吨位而言是扎实而全面的机甲。它们通常装备跳跃推进器，能迅速重新定位以保持自动炮的直射视野，从而获得额外优势。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A recent Federated Suns variant, the BJ-1DB replaces the AutoCannon with Large Lasers.  In order to assist with the added heat, it also drops some armor and the torso mounted lasers to make room for more Heat Sinks.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: BJ-1DB 是联邦太阳系新近变体，将自动炮换成大型激光。为帮助应对增加的热量，它还削减了一些装甲和躯干激光，为更多散热器腾出空间。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A recent Federated Suns variant, the BJ-1DB replaces the AutoCannon with Large Lasers.  In order to assist with the added heat, it also drops some armor and the torso mounted lasers to make room for more Heat Sinks.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: BJ-1DB 是联邦太阳系新近变体，将自动炮换成大型激光。为帮助应对增加的热量，它还削减了一些装甲和躯干激光，为更多散热器腾出空间。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Sacrificing the Jump Jets, the BJ-1DC adds a Small Laser in each side torso and a Heat Sink to help ease the extra burden.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: BJ-1DC 牺牲跳跃推进器，在两侧躯干各加一门小型激光，并加一台散热器以缓解额外负担。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Sacrificing the Jump Jets, the BJ-1DC adds a Small Laser in each side torso and a Heat Sink to help ease the extra burden.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: BJ-1DC 牺牲跳跃推进器，在两侧躯干各加一门小型激光，并加一台散热器以缓解额外负担。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: In The Periphery Maintaining Mechs Tends To Be A Problem, As A Result The 1P Was Designed Generally As A Downgrade From The Os, But Much Cheaper To Maintain And Repair, Pilots Often Complain About The Structure 'Making Strange Noises', These Remarks Were Usually Ignored.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在外围区，维护机甲往往是个难题。因此 1P 大体上是 O 型的降级版，但维护和修理便宜得多。飞行员常抱怨其结构"发出奇怪的响声"，这些说法通常被无视。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Well Isnt This Just a Bucket of bolts, Look At These Weapons, If You Can Call Them That,The Lasers Are Out Of Alignment And The 'Rifles' Are Dented, They Even Took The Fusion Core Out! Barbarians.. At Least It's Cheap To Replace, Not Sure Why You'd Want To.. Commander
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 好啊，这不就是一堆破铜烂铁吗？看看这些武器，如果还能叫武器的话——激光全都没校准，"步枪"上全是凹痕，他们居然连聚变核心都拆走了！野蛮人……至少替换起来便宜，不过我不确定你为什么会想替换它……指挥官

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This early Blackjack prototype started along a completely different path for the 'Mech.  Focusing on close in weapons, the BJ-1X has four Flamers and four Medium Lasers.  The BJ-1X also focused more on speed than jump manueverability, increasing the engine size while removing the Jump Jets.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这款早期黑杰克原型为该机甲开辟了一条完全不同的道路。BJ-1X 聚焦近程武器，配备四具火焰喷射器和四门中型激光。它还更注重速度而非跳跃机动，增大引擎尺寸并移除跳跃推进器。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This early Blackjack prototype started along a completely different path for the 'Mech.  Focusing on close in weapons, the BJ-1X has four Flamers and four Medium Lasers.  The BJ-1X also focused more on speed than jump manueverability, increasing the engine size while removing the Jump Jets.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这款早期黑杰克原型为该机甲开辟了一条完全不同的道路。BJ-1X 聚焦近程武器，配备四具火焰喷射器和四门中型激光。它还更注重速度而非跳跃机动，增大引擎尺寸并移除跳跃推进器。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The BJ-2 was introduced in 3052 by the Federated Suns as the new production model of the Blackjack, based on earlier experimental designs. It upgrades the 'Mech with two Diverse Optics Sunbeam ER Large Lasers in place of the autocannons and removes the medium lasers for four Hovertec Streak SRM-2 launchers, two each in the left and right sides of the torso. One ton of ammo for the launchers is kept in the left torso while the standard heat sinks were upgraded to double heat sinks.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: BJ-2 由联邦太阳系于 3052 年推出，是黑杰克的新量产型号，基于早期实验设计。它将自动炮换成两门多元光学"日光束"ER 大型激光，并移除中型激光，换成四具霍弗泰克连续 SRM-2 发射器，左右躯干各两具。发射器的一吨弹药存于左侧躯干，标准散热器则升级为双倍散热器。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: In the 3030s, the St. Ives Compact experimented with recovered technology on some of their Blackjacks. One prototype that showed great promise replace the autocannon and one heat sink with a pair of Ceres Arms Smasher PPCs. Three of the remaining heat sinks were replaced with experimental “freezer” double efficiency units.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在 3030 年代，圣艾夫斯共同体在他们的一些黑杰克上试验了找回的技术。一个前景看好的原型以一对"塞雷斯兵器粉碎者"PPC 取代自动炮和一台散热器。剩余散热器中有三台被换成实验性的"冷冻机"双倍效率装置。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Blackjack 1s are solid, well-rounded 'Mechs for their tonnage. This prototype tends to run hot even with the experimental "freezer" double heat sinks.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 黑杰克 1 就其吨位而言是扎实而全面的机甲。这台原型机即便装上了实验性的"冷冻机"双倍散热器，也容易过热。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Blackjack 3T replaces the standard AC/2s with Large Laser, providing greater punch at the cost of some Heat and carries a large collection of Machine guns and 2 Small Lasers.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 黑杰克 3T 以大型激光取代标准 AC/2，以一些热量为代价换取更强的打击力，并携带一大批机枪和 2 门小型激光。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Blackjack 3T replaces the standard AC/2s with Large Laser, providing greater punch at the cost of some Heat and carries a large collection of Machine guns and 2 Small Lasers.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 黑杰克 3T 以大型激光取代标准 AC/2，以一些热量为代价换取更强的打击力，并携带一大批机枪和 2 门小型激光。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Blackjack 5 is a rather unusual refit, replacing the Autocannons with a pair of Mortars to allow indirect firing support and giving AMS coverage.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 黑杰克 5 是一款颇为不寻常的改装型，以两门迫击炮取代自动炮，以提供间接火力支援并配备 AMS 防护。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Blackjack G, unlike the average variant, carries twin Ultra AC/10s. This variant also features an advanced targeting computer, an ultra-light gyro, and a supercharger.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 黑杰克 G 与一般变体不同，携带双联超速 AC/10。此变体还配备先进瞄准计算机、超轻型陀螺仪和增压器。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Blackjack G, unlike the average variant, carries twin Ultra AC/10s. This variant also features an advanced targeting computer, an ultra-light gyro, and a supercharger.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 黑杰克 G 与一般变体不同，携带双联超速 AC/10。此变体还配备先进瞄准计算机、超轻型陀螺仪和增压器。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An upgrade of the Blackjack BattleMech, the Blackjack OmniMech is a powerful and adaptable medium weight workhorse. Much like the Firestarter OmniMech, the genesis of the omni-Blackjack stems from the Combine's technology exchange program during the initial Clan Invasion with Ceres Metals Industries ' St. Ives Compact branch offering Luthien Armor Works specifications and licenses to manufacturer the ill-regarded Blackjack.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为黑杰克战斗机甲的升级版，黑杰克全能机甲是一款强劲且适应性强的中量级主力。与火焰使者全能机甲相似，全能版黑杰克的诞生源于氏族入侵初期联合体的技术交换计划——谷神星金属工业的圣艾夫斯契约分部向卢西恩装甲工厂提供了规格与许可，以制造这款评价不佳的黑杰克。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An upgrade of the Blackjack BattleMech, the Blackjack OmniMech is a powerful and adaptable medium weight workhorse. Much like the Firestarter OmniMech, the genesis of the omni-Blackjack stems from the Combine's technology exchange program during the initial Clan Invasion with Ceres Metals Industries ' St. Ives Compact branch offering Luthien Armor Works specifications and licenses to manufacturer the ill-regarded Blackjack. Even though it received the upgraded and more effective BJ-2 version, LAW manufactured only a few examples before reworking and retooling the line to manufacture an OmniMech version.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 黑杰克全能机甲是黑杰克战斗机甲的升级版，是一款强大而适应性强的中型主力机。与火焰使者全能机甲很像，全能黑杰克的起源来自联合体在氏族入侵初期的技术交换计划——塞雷斯金属工业的圣艾夫斯共同体分部向鲁西恩装甲工厂提供规格与许可，以生产这款评价不佳的黑杰克。尽管它获得了升级且更有效的 BJ-2 版本，LAW 只制造了少数几台，随后就改造并重新装备生产线以制造全能机甲版本。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Black Knight 6-KNT is a dedicated Energy weapon platform. It can shell out hellish damage with its beams and shrug off a lot of damageÔÇª just gotta make sure to keep its heat in check.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 黑骑士 6-KNT 是专职能量武器平台。它能以光束倾泻地狱般的伤害，并轻易承受大量打击……只要确保把热量控制住。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Black Knight 6B was the harder-hitting, cooler-running Star League ancestor to the standard BL-6-KNT we have today. It did everything the 6 does, but better. Mostly thanks to its Double Heat Sinks.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 黑骑士 6B 是我们今天所熟知的标准 BL-6-KNT 的星盟祖先，打击更狠、散热更好。6 型能做到的一切，它都做得更好。这主要归功于它的双倍散热器。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A Free Worlds League variant, the BL-7-KNT-L replaces the rarer PPC with a 3rd Large Laser and 2 additional Heat Sinks.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是自由世界联盟的变体，BL-7-KNT-L 将较稀有的 PPC 换成第三门大型激光和 2 台额外散热器。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Black Knight 7-KNT-L still dishes out almost as much firepower as its namesake, perhaps more, since it can keep firing longer with the combination of the extra heat sinks and the removal of the PPC.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 黑骑士 7-KNT-L 输出的火力几乎与其同名型号相当，也许更多，因为凭借额外散热器和移除 PPC，它能持续开火更久。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Black Knight 7B is a refit made for and sold to Mercenary Commanders deeply in favour with the Federated Commonwealth, sporting advanced technologies and Prototype X-Pulse Laser.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 黑骑士 7B 是为深得联邦联邦青睐的佣兵指挥官制造并出售的改装型，配备先进技术和原型 X 脉冲激光。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Black Knight 7B is a refit made for and sold to Mercenary Commanders deeply in favour with the Federated Commonwealth, sporting advanced technologies and Prototype X-Pulse Laser.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 黑骑士 7B 是为深得联邦联邦青睐的佣兵指挥官制造并出售的改装型，配备先进技术和原型 X 脉冲激光。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Black Knight 9-KNT is essentially a LosTech upgrade to the 6 variant, replacing most of its standard lasers with pulse versions, and the standard PPC with an ER version. This variant also carries double heat sinks to manage the extra heat generated by these weapons.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 黑骑士 9-KNT 实质上是 6 型的失落科技升级版，将其大部分标准激光换成脉冲版本，标准 PPC 换成 ER 版本。该变体还配备双倍散热器以应对这些武器产生的额外热量。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Black Knight 9-KNT is essentially a LosTech upgrade to the 6 variant, replacing most of its standard lasers with pulse versions, and the standard PPC with an ER version. This variant also carries double heat sinks to manage the extra heat generated by these weapons.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 黑骑士 9-KNT 实质上是 6 型的失落科技升级版，将其大部分标准激光换成脉冲版本，标准 PPC 换成 ER 版本。该变体还配备双倍散热器以应对这些武器产生的额外热量。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Black Lanner A is configured for electronic warfare and scouting. It uses an Active Probe to find hidden units, an ECM Suite to counteract enemy electronics, and a TAG spotting laser to designate targets for homing artillery. Offensively, it can call upon an ER PPC and a pair of Medium Pulse Lasers.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 黑猎隼 A 配置为电子战与侦察。它使用主动探测器寻找隐藏单位，ECM 套件反制敌方电子设备，TAG 指示激光为制导炮击标记目标。进攻方面，它可调用一门 ER PPC 和一对中型脉冲激光。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Black Lanner A is configured for electronic warfare and scouting. It uses an Active Probe to find hidden units, an ECM Suite to counteract enemy electronics, and a TAG spotting laser to designate targets for homing artillery. Offensively, it can call upon an ER PPC and a pair of Medium Pulse Lasers.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 黑猎隼 A 为电子战与侦察而配置。它使用主动探测器寻找隐藏单位、ECM 套件对抗敌方电子设备、TAG 侦察激光为寻的炮弹标记目标。攻击方面，它能依靠一门 ER PPC 和两门中型脉冲激光。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The C is a close-support variant that mounts six ER Medium Lasers and a Streak SRM-6. It also uses three additional double heat sinks to help combat heat levels.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: C 型是近距支援变体，装备六门 ER 中型激光和一具连续 SRM-6。它还使用三台额外双倍散热器以帮助控制热量水平。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The C is a close-support variant that mounts six ER Medium Lasers and a Streak SRM-6. It also uses three additional double heat sinks to help combat heat levels.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This close-range brawler mounts pairs of Medium Pulse Lasers, SRM-6s, ER Small Lasers, Flamers, and four Machine Guns. This configuration is devastating to conventional infantry and a serious threat to combat vehicles. An Active Probe ensures that it is rarely surprised.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这款近战近战型装备成对的中型脉冲激光、SRM-6、ER 小型激光、火焰喷射器和四挺机枪。此配置对常规步兵极具毁灭性，对战斗车辆也是严重威胁。主动探测器确保它很少被突袭。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This close-range brawler mounts pairs of Medium Pulse Lasers, SRM-6s, ER Small Lasers, Flamers, and four Machine Guns. This configuration is devastating to conventional infantry and a serious threat to combat vehicles. An Active Probe ensures that it is rarely surprised.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这款近战近战型装备成对的中型脉冲激光、SRM-6、ER 小型激光、火焰喷射器和四挺机枪。此配置对常规步兵极具毁灭性，对战斗车辆也是严重威胁。主动探测器确保它很少被突袭。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The primary configuration of the Black Lanner is effective at all ranges. At long range, it can make use of an ER Large Laser and LRM-10. When it closes in, it can attack with a pair of ER Medium Lasers and an SRM-6 that can exploit holes in its opponent's armor. An ECM Suite protects it from many forms of electronics.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 黑猎隼的主配置在各类距离上都很有效。远距离可用一门 ER 大型激光和一具 LRM-10。接近后，它可用两门 ER 中型激光和一具 SRM-6 攻击，后者能利用对手装甲上的破口。ECM 套件保护它免受多种电子手段干扰。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The primary configuration of the Black Lanner is effective at all ranges. At long range, it can make use of an ER Large Laser and LRM-10. When it closes in, it can attack with a pair of ER Medium Lasers and an SRM-6 that can exploit holes in its opponent's armor. An ECM Suite protects it from many forms of electronics.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 黑猎隼的主配置在各类距离上都很有效。远距离可用一门 ER 大型激光和一具 LRM-10。接近后，它可用两门 ER 中型激光和一具 SRM-6 攻击，后者能利用对手装甲上的破口。ECM 套件保护它免受多种电子手段干扰。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Taking its name from a term meaning 'Lightning War' the Blitzkrieg completely lives up to the name. The Blitzkrieg is built on a lightweight Coventry BTZ-VII Endo Steel chassis and is powered by a Magna 350 XL engine that weighs half as much as a standard fusion engine while giving the 'Mech a top speed of 118.8 km/h.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 闪电战之名取自意为"闪电战争"的术语，而它完全配得上这个名字。它建立在轻量化的考文垂 BTZ-VII 内骨骼底盘上，由一台玛格纳 350 XL 引擎驱动——重量仅为标准聚变引擎的一半，同时赋予机甲 118.8 公里/小时的最高速度。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 血复于世纪之交推出，由烟虎氏族为迎接氏族重返内天体而研制。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The original Bombard mounted a pair of massive Autocannon/20s in place of the Thunderbolt launchers as well as standard Medium Lasers instead of the MBM-013's ER lasers. This version was also equipped with experimental War of 3039-vintage double heat sinks, less bulky than standard double heat sinks, but which utilized corrosive coolant.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 原版轰击者以一对巨型自动炮/20 取代雷霆发射器，并以标准中型激光取代 MBM-013 的 ER 激光。此版本还装备了 3039 年战争时期的实验性双倍散热器——比标准双倍散热器更不笨重，但使用腐蚀性冷却剂。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Brigand is a BattleMech that is surrounded by a sea of controversy as it is the first 'Mech to be produced by a pirate band. Manufactured by a company named Vengeance Incorporated, which is run by the pirates of the Haven Star Cluster and 'Lady Death' Trevaline, the Brigand represents an unprecedented threat because in spite of the fact that it is built by pirates, it uses advanced construction techniques and weapons.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 强盗是一台备受争议的战斗机甲，因为它是首款由海盗团伙生产的机甲。它由一家名为"复仇公司"的企业制造，该企业由避风港星团的海盗与"死亡女士"特雷瓦琳经营。强盗代表着前所未有的威胁，因为尽管它由海盗建造，却使用了先进的建造技术和武器。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Bushwacker was originally a failed BattleMech designed to have a smaller forward profile to make the 'Mech a harder target to hit. The Bushwacker's unique design caused problems with the engine shielding, the side-effects of which manifested themselves as various gremlins in the 'Mech's on board electronics on the prototypes fielded.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 伏击者最初是一款失败的战斗机甲，设计初衷是缩小正面轮廓以使机甲更难被击中。但伏击者独特的设计导致引擎屏蔽出现问题，副作用表现为已部署原型机上各种机载电子设备的莫名故障。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Originally a reverse-engineered version Cataphract the finished design surprisingly enough proving to be a high quality design itself.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 它最初是铁甲舰的逆向工程版本，而最终的成品令人惊讶地被证明本身就是一个高质量设计。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Originally a reverse-engineered version Cataphract the finished design surprisingly enough proving to be a high quality design itself.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 它最初是铁甲舰的逆向工程版本，而最终的成品令人惊讶地被证明本身就是一个高质量设计。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We call the Cataphract a "FrankenMech" because it's got a little bit of everything stitched together on it. The 1X model works well at medium-long to closer range, with good armor and weaponry.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们称铁甲舰为"拼装机甲"，因为它把五花八门的东西缝在了一起。1X 型号在中远到较近距离都表现出色，装甲与武器俱佳。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We call the Cataphract a "FrankenMech" because it's got a little bit of everything stitched together on it. The 1X model works well at medium-long to closer range, with good armor and weaponry.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们称铁甲舰为"拼装机甲"，因为它把五花八门的东西缝在了一起。1X 型号在中远到较近距离都表现出色，装甲与武器俱佳。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 2X replaces the PPC with a heavy laser, while the arm-mounted medium lasers are removed in favor of a SRM-4.  This reduction in heat load also allows for the removal of 2 heat sinks and adding armor in their stead.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 2X 将 PPC 换成重型激光，同时移除臂载中型激光，改为一具 SRM-4。热负荷的降低还允许移除 2 台散热器，并以装甲取而代之。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 2X replaces the PPC with a heavy laser, while the arm-mounted medium lasers are removed in favor of a SRM-4.  This reduction in heat load also allows for the removal of 2 heat sinks and adding armor in their stead.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 2X 将 PPC 换成重型激光，同时移除臂载中型激光，改为一具 SRM-4。热负荷的降低还允许移除 2 台散热器，并以装甲取而代之。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The CTF-4X is the latest variant of this prototype 'Mech.  The 4X downgrades the Engine, making for a slower ride, but adds more long range firepower with two Autocannon 5s, a Large Laser and LRM5.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: CTF-4X 是这款原型机甲的最新变体。4X 降级了引擎，使它跑得更慢，但以两门自动炮 5、一门大型激光和一具 LRM5 增加了更多远程火力。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Honestly Commander, I've never even heard of this thing.  Have to hand it to the Capellans though, these FrankenMechs are nothing if not interesting.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 老实说指挥官，我连听都没听过这东西。不过得佩服卡佩兰人，这些"科学怪机"真是有趣得很。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Catapult A1 was designed as a true support role model.  The CPLT-A1 removes all 4 Medium Lasers in favor of additional LRM ammunition and armor.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 弹射器 A1 被设计为真正的支援型型号。CPLT-A1 移除全部 4 门中型激光，换成额外的 LRM 弹药和装甲。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The A1 model is going to need that extra armor if another 'Mech gets close in, as it doesn't have any real close in defenses.  On the brighter side, you aren't likely to run out of ammo.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: A1 型号若有其他机甲贴近就需要那层额外装甲，因为它没有任何真正的近战防御。好的一面是，你不太可能打光弹药。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Ah, the Catapult C1. Just like its namesake, it's good at lobbing large numbers of missiles over terrain without fear of return fire. Surprisingly, it's also not too shabby at closer ranges in a pinch.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 啊，弹射器 C1。正如其名，它擅长越过地形投掷大量导弹而不必担心回击。令人惊讶的是，必要时刻它在较近距离也相当不赖。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Ah, the Catapult C1. Just like its namesake, it's good at lobbing large numbers of missiles over terrain without fear of return fire. Surprisingly, it's also not too shabby at closer ranges in a pinch.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 啊，弹射器 C1。正如其名，它擅长越过地形投掷大量导弹而不必担心回击。令人惊讶的是，必要时刻它在较近距离也相当不赖。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Royal Catapult, the -C1b was designed to fill the same role as the normal -C1 but better. Thanks to Ferro-Fibrous armor it sports better protection, and thanks to double heat sinks it can jump and fire all day long without problems.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 皇家弹射器-C1b 的设计目标是执行与普通-C1 相同的角色，但做得更好。得益于铁纤维装甲，它拥有更好的防护；得益于双倍散热器，它可以整天跳跃开火而毫无问题。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Royal Catapult, the -C1b was designed to fill the same role as the normal -C1 but better. Thanks to Ferro-Fibrous armor it sports better protection, and thanks to double heat sinks it can jump and fire all day long without problems.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 皇家弹射器-C1b 的设计目标是执行与普通-C1 相同的角色，但做得更好。得益于铁纤维装甲，它拥有更好的防护；得益于双倍散热器，它可以整天跳跃开火而毫无问题。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The CPLT-C4 is an explosive addition to any outfit's arsenal.  Trading out the stock LRM-15s, Medium Lasers and extra Heat Sinks for LRM-20s and Small Lasers - along with 2 extra tons of ammo, the C4 gives the Catapult impressive long range firepower.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: CPLT-C4 是任何部队武器库中的爆炸性补充。它把标准 LRM-15、中型激光和额外散热器换成 LRM-20 与小型激光——外加 2 吨额外弹药，C4 赋予弹射器令人印象深刻的远程火力。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: If you can't find yourself an Archer, this is the next best thing.  While not as potent close in as the standard C1 model, the C4 can still hold its own in a brawl against a lighter opponent.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 如果你找不到弓箭手，这就是次优选择。虽然近战不如标准 C1 型号强悍，C4 在对抗较轻的对手时仍能立足。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Catapult K2 is an outside-the-box redesign that trades the indirect-fire capability for heavier direct-fire PPCs. It doesn't usually mount Jump Jets, though, so it can be a bit more restricted in its use.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 弹射器 K2 是一次跳出常规的重新设计，以更强的直射 PPC 取代间接火力能力。不过它通常不装跳跃推进器，因此在运用上稍有局限。
狙击手 & 直接火力支援

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Catapult K2 is an outside-the-box redesign that trades the indirect-fire capability for heavier direct-fire PPCs. It doesn't usually mount Jump Jets, though, so it can be a bit more restricted in its use.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 弹射器 K2 是一次跳出常规的重新设计，以更强的直射 PPC 取代间接火力能力。不过它通常不装跳跃推进器，因此在运用上稍有局限。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An upgrade of the K2 Catapult, the K2K model changes the engine to an extralight model. The twin PPCs also have been upgraded to ER PPCs. The 'Mech carries two ER Medium Lasers for close range firepower. To handle the added heat from the upgrades, the 'Mech uses 20 double heat sinks. Finally, the K2K model carries thirteen and a half tons of armor. .
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: K2K 型号是 K2 弹射器的升级，把引擎换成超轻型。双联 PPC 也升级为 ER PPC。机甲携带两门 ER 中型激光用于近程火力。为处理升级带来的额外热量，机甲使用 20 台双倍散热器。最后，K2K 型号携带十三吨半装甲。
狙击手 & 直接火力支援

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An upgrade of the K2 Catapult, the K2K model changes the engine to an extralight model. The twin PPCs also have been upgraded to ER PPCs. The 'Mech carries two ER Medium Lasers for close range firepower. To handle the added heat from the upgrades, the 'Mech uses 20 double heat sinks. Finally, the K2K model carries thirteen and a half tons of armor.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: K2K 型号是 K2 弹射器的升级，把引擎换成超轻型。双联 PPC 也升级为 ER PPC。机甲携带两门 ER 中型激光用于近程火力。为处理升级带来的额外热量，机甲使用 20 台双倍散热器。最后，K2K 型号携带十三吨半装甲。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Though this design never reached full production, it was prototyped during the War of 3039. It upgrades the PPCs of the K2 to ER PPCs.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该设计从未进入量产，但在 3039 年战争期间被作成原型。它将 K2 的 PPC 升级为 ER PPC。
狙击手 & 直接火力支援

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Though this design never reached full production, it was prototyped during the War of 3039. It upgrades the PPCs of the K2 to ER PPCs.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该设计从未进入量产，但在 3039 年战争期间被作成原型。它将 K2 的 PPC 升级为 ER PPC。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Another Kuritan variant, the -K5 goes back to its roots by carrying two MRM-30 launchers as its primary weapon.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 又一款库瑞塔变体，-K5 回归本源，以两具 MRM-30 发射器为主武器。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Another Kuritan variant, the -K5 goes back to its roots by carrying two MRM-30 launchers as its primary weapon.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 又一款库瑞塔变体，-K5 回归本源，以两具 MRM-30 发射器为主武器。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The CattleMaster was created at the turn of the thirty-first century as an IndustrialMech to handle large herd animals. The concept for the Rancher 'Mech dates back to the twenty-fourth century. The 'Mech is noted for its durability and flexible Internal Combustion Engine.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 牧牛人于三十一世纪之交被制造为工业机甲，用于处置大型畜群。这类"牧场主"机甲的概念可追溯至二十四世纪。此机甲以其耐用性和灵活的内燃引擎著称。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A somewhat radical departure from the stock Centurion, the CN9-AH Variant trades out the stock AC10 and Medium Lasers for a single AC20.  While this amounts to the same degree of firepower, it has the benefit of concentrating the damage to a single location.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The AH model gives the Centurion more of a focused punch, but I still prefer the original for keeping the OpFor at arm's reach.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: AH 型号赋予百夫长更集中的打击力，但我仍偏好原版，因为它能让对手保持在臂长之外。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The D variant of the Centurion, introduced in 3049, is the first of many upgrades using Star League technology. The chassis was re-engineered to use Endo Steel construction techniques. Next the power plant was changed from the standard engine to an GM 300 extralight engine, increasing its maximum speed to 97.2 km/h. Finally, the weapons were upgraded. The Autocannon/10 was swapped for a Mydron Excel LB-X Autocannon/10 and an Artemis IV fire control system was added to the LRM launcher. The two medium lasers were retained.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 百夫长的 D 变体于 3049 年推出，是众多星盟科技升级中的首个。底盘经重新设计以采用内骨骼构造工艺。随后动力装置从标准引擎改为 GM 300 超轻型引擎，最高速度提升至 97.2 公里/小时。最后武器也获升级：自动炮/10 换成迈德龙 Excel LB-X 自动炮/10，LRM 发射器加装 Artemis IV 火控系统，两门中型激光予以保留。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The CN9-D3 variant introduced in 3052 is identical to the CN9-D Centurion with one exceptional difference. The D3 uses Triple Strength Myomer to increase its top speed up to 118.8 kph while it is running hot.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The D3D variant of this 'Mech is a potent long-range sniper, first built in 3060. For added long range assistance, the 'Mech carries an LRM-10 launcher and for close range combat it carries an ER Medium Laser. This is all protected with eight tons of Ferro-Fibrous armor.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Chameleon was designed to help a new MechWarrior master the skills of maneuvering and heat management, with a top speed of 97.2 kph and a jumping distance of one hundred and eighty meters. The 'Mech also had an almost all energy weapons loadout, but cooled only by ten standard heat sinks. This paucity of freezers forces MechWarriors to concentrate on the 'Mech's heat levels. In some instances, the Chameleon had been forced into combat situations, notably during the Dragoon Civil War. Production of the Chameleon halted briefly in 3052 when Defiance Industries decided to switch its production to the Nightsky, but was quickly resumed when J.B. BattleMechs Incorporated purchased the rights to the design. J.B. BattleMechs also introduced two battle-worthy variants of the Chameleon. The Chameleon is a training 'Mech, intended to simulate a variety of opponents by mounting a wide variety of weapon systems. A Chameleon is a medium 'Mech, but it doesn't always look like one. It can be fitted out with extra plates to modify its appearance, and carries special electronics to falsify its signature; these special abilities let it look and scan as something other than what it is, hence the machine's name.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 变色龙旨在帮助新手机甲战士掌握机动与散热管理技巧，最高速度 97.2 公里/小时，跳跃距离一百八十米。该机甲还配备几乎全能量的武器配置，但仅由十台标准散热器冷却。散热器的匮乏迫使机甲战士专注于机甲的热量水平。某些情况下，变色龙被迫投入实战，尤其是在龙骑兵内战期间。变色龙的生产曾在 3052 年短暂中断，当时迪法恩斯工业决定将生产转向夜空，但在 J.B. 机甲公司购得该设计权后迅速恢复。J.B. 机甲还推出了两款具备战斗力的变色龙变体。变色龙是一款训练机甲，旨在通过搭载多种武器系统来模拟各类对手。变色龙是中型机甲，但不总是看起来像。它可以加装额外装甲板改变外观，并携带特殊电子设备伪造自身信号；这些特殊能力让它看起来和扫描起来都不像自己，因此得名。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Chameleon carried a basic arsenal that allowed a MechWarrior-in-training to learn the skill of heat management. The 'Mech's reliable low-tech arsenal had proven effective when forced into combat. The primary weapon was a Cyclops Eye Large Laser. This was backed up by two Intek Medium Lasers and a trio of Defiance B3S Small Lasers. To make the threat of overheating more real to the new MechWarrior, the 'Mech carried two Scatter Gun Light Machine Guns that can be used for anti-infantry training.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 变色龙携带基础武器库，让受训中的机甲战士学习散热管理技巧。机甲可靠的低技术武器库在被拖入战斗时证明有效。主武器是一门"独眼巨人眼"大型激光。它由两门英泰克中型激光和三门"迪法恩斯 B3S"小型激光支援。为使过热威胁对新手机甲战士更真实，机甲携带两挺"散射枪"轻型机枪，可用于反步兵训练。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 变色龙旨在帮助新手机甲战士掌握机动与散热管理技巧，最高速度 97.2 公里/小时，跳跃距离一百八十米。该机甲还配备几乎全能量的武器配置，但仅由十台标准散热器冷却。散热器的匮乏迫使机甲战士专注于机甲的热量水平。某些情况下，变色龙被迫投入实战，尤其是在龙骑兵内战期间。变色龙的生产曾在 3052 年短暂中断，当时迪法恩斯工业决定将生产转向夜空，但在 J.B. 机甲公司购得该设计权后迅速恢复。J.B. 机甲还推出了两款具备战斗力的变色龙变体。变色龙是一款训练机甲，旨在通过搭载多种武器系统来模拟各类对手。变色龙是中型机甲，但不总是看起来像。它可以加装额外装甲板改变外观，并携带特殊电子设备伪造自身信号；这些特殊能力让它看起来和扫描起来都不像自己，因此得名。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Another combat variant of the Chameleon, the 7Z carried as its primary weapons two Large Lasers and a single ER Large Laser. The 7Z carried no other secondary weapons on its chassis and used twelve double heat sinks to handle its massive heat load.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为变色龙的另一战斗变体，7Z 以两门大型激光和一门 ER 大型激光为主武器。7Z 底盘上没有其他次要武器，并使用十二台双倍散热器处理其庞大热负荷。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Chameleon was designed to help a new MechWarrior master the skills of maneuvering and heat management, with a top speed of 97.2 kph and a jumping distance of one hundred and eighty meters. The 'Mech also had an almost all energy weapons loadout, but cooled only by ten standard heat sinks. This paucity of freezers forces MechWarriors to concentrate on the 'Mech's heat levels. In some instances, the Chameleon had been forced into combat situations, notably during the Dragoon Civil War. Production of the Chameleon halted briefly in 3052 when Defiance Industries decided to switch its production to the Nightsky, but was quickly resumed when J.B. BattleMechs Incorporated purchased the rights to the design. J.B. BattleMechs also introduced two battle-worthy variants of the Chameleon. Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: (also referred to as the CHM-3 Chameleon Training Scout) A formerly common but now obscure training 'Mech, the TRC-4B was armed with one Large Laser, two Medium Lasers, four Small Lasers and two Machine Guns. With only 10 normal heat sinks this 'Mech was quite prone to overheating.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: （又称 CHM-3 变色龙训练侦察型）TRC-4B 曾是常见而如今鲜为人知的训练机甲，装备一门大型激光、两门中型激光、四门小型激光和两挺机枪。由于只有 10 台普通散热器，这台机甲极易过热。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Where the CHP-2N is the downgraded Succession Wars variant of the Champion, the -1N is the fully powered Star League variant and is the original one the designers introduced. The high speed for a mech its size remains as does the somewhat anemic armor, the main benefit the mech gets from Star League technology is found in the weaponry: a LB-10X Autocannon, a SRM 6 with an Artemis IV system, and a pair each of Medium and Small Lasers. Otherwise, the -1N is much the same as the -2N and performs the same in many ways.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: CHP-2N 是冠军在继承战争中的降级版，而-1N 则是完整的星盟版本，也是设计师最初推出的原始型号。对如此尺寸的机甲而言速度依旧很高，装甲依然略显单薄，机甲从星盟科技中获得的主要好处体现在武器上：一门 LB-10X 自动炮、一具配 Artemis IV 系统的 SRM 6，以及成对的中型与小型激光。除此之外，-1N 与-2N 大体相同，表现也多有相似。
