Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: During the Star League when the Champion-1N was in full production, there was a frequent pilot modification that turned into a production variant. This mech, the -1N2, is exactly the same as the -1N with the exception of the heat sinks, which have been upgraded to doubles. In all other respects, the -1N2 is the same as the -1N.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 星盟时期，冠军-1N 全速生产时，有一种常见的飞行员改装后来变成了量产变体。这台机甲就是-1N2，除散热器升级为双倍外，与-1N 完全相同。其他方面-1N2 与-1N 一致。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A variant reserved for SLDF Royal units, this Champion was introduced in 2751 and replaces all the standard weaponry with a Gauss Rifle and ER PPC. It also uses double heat sinks. This gave the -1Nb an extremely long range weapon profile and a serious punch while also solving its heat issues.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是为星盟防卫军皇家部队保留的变体，2751 年推出，将所有标准武器换成一门高斯步枪和一门 ER PPC。它还使用双倍散热器。这使-1Nb 拥有极远射程的武器配置和强悍打击力，同时解决了散热问题。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Champion debuted in 2602 as a generalist combat 'Mech with a focus on heavy reconnaissance and fast strike capabilities. While definitely faster and more maneuverable than other heavy 'Mechs, it was criticized by many for being too large, underarmed and underarmored. The armament on the Champion is considered by many to be feeble for its size, especially after losing its advanced technology from the Star League. Carrying an AC/10, a SRM 6, and a pair each of Medium and Small Lasers, the Champion is woefully underarmed for its size.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 冠军于 2602 年首次亮相，是一款通用战斗机甲，侧重重型侦察与快速打击能力。虽然确实比其他重型机甲更快更灵活，它却被许多人批评体型过大、武装与装甲不足。许多人认为冠军的武器就其尺寸而言过于孱弱，尤其在失去星盟的先进技术之后。它携带一门 AC/10、一具 SRM 6，以及成对的中型与小型激光，就尺寸而言武装弱得可怜。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Charger is seen as an example of abject failure in BattleMech design. Wells Technologies originally wanted to produce an ultra-heavy scout 'Mech for the Star League Defense Force that was not only fast but could survive contact with the enemy. This was done by building the Charger on an 80-ton frame, making it the heaviest scout 'Mech in existence, and powering it with a massive LTV 400 fusion engine that took up almost sixty percent of the Charger's mass. With a top speed which allowed it to outrun most other 'Mechs the Charger was then given ten tons of Durallex Heavy armor, enough to survive repeated hits from a Class 20 Autocannon. However these features left very little room for offensive capability, an intentional deficiency on the part of the design team as they saw any task other than gathering data a distraction.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 冲锋者被视为战斗机甲设计中彻底失败的例子。威尔斯科技原本想为星盟防卫军生产一款超重型侦察机甲，不仅快速，还能在与敌接触中存活。为此他们把冲锋者建在 80 吨骨架上，使其成为现存最重的侦察机甲，并以一台占据冲锋者近百分之六十质量的巨大 LTV 400 聚变引擎驱动。凭借使其能跑赢大多数其他机甲的极高速度，冲锋者随后获得十吨杜拉莱克斯重型装甲，足以反复承受 20 级自动炮的命中。然而这些特性几乎没给进攻能力留下空间——这是设计团队有意为之的缺陷，因为他们认为除收集数据之外的任何任务都是干扰。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Because the designers of the Charger wanted to discourage any activities that would put the 'Mech in danger, the engineers at Wells Technologies equipped the Charger with five Magna Mk I Small Lasers, mounted in its arms, torso and head. As these leave the 'Mech dangerously undergunned, arguably its most potent weapons are its fists; if the Charger is able to close the distance and get within hand-to-hand combat, it is more than capable of pounding to pieces other 'Mechs, especially lightweight ones.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 由于冲锋者的设计者想阻止任何让机甲陷入危险的活动，威尔斯科技的工程师为冲锋者装备了五门玛格纳 Mk I 小型激光，装在臂部、躯干和头部。这让机甲火力严重不足，因此可以说它最有力的武器是拳头；若冲锋者能拉近距离进入肉搏，它完全有能力把其他机甲——尤其是轻型机甲——砸成碎片。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 1A5 variant of the Charger was one of the first variants of the Charger made to take it from the role of scout to assault 'Mech. A Capellan modification to the CGR-1Ls they received as part of the Kapteyn Accords, the engine was downgraded to a 320 version, which reduced the maximum speed of the 'Mech to 64.8 km/h, and four of the small lasers were removed. In their place was a Tomodzuru Autocannon/20 as its primary weapon, two Bical SRM-6 launchers and an Argra 3L Medium Laser, while the 'Mech's armor was increased by five tons. This made the CGR-1A5 extremely dangerous at close ranges and gave it a speed comparable to most 'Mechs in the heavy weight class, while carrying armor on par with other eighty-ton 'Mechs.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 冲锋者 1A5 变体是最早把冲锋者从侦察角色转变为突击机甲的变体之一。它是卡佩兰对作为卡普坦协定一部分所获 CGR-1L 的改装，引擎降级为 320 版本，把机甲最高速度降至 64.8 公里/小时，并移除四门小型激光。取而代之的是作为主武器的"友鹤"自动炮/20、两具比卡尔 SRM-6 发射器和一门阿尔格拉 3L 中型激光，机甲装甲增加五吨。这使 CGR-1A5 在近程极为危险，速度可与多数重型机甲相当，同时装甲与其他八十吨机甲持平。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A Combine-LAW attempt to make the Charger more effective at long ranges, the 1A9 used a reduced 320-rated engine, lowering its top speed to 64.8 km/h, and its arsenal was overhauled. All of the smaller lasers (except for the head mounted one) were replaced with medium lasers and a single LRM-20 launcher was mounted in the right torso, with two tons of reloads carried in the left torso. To make up for the lost mobility, four jump jets were also installed, two in each leg, to allow the Charger to jump up to one hundred and twenty meters. This variant was fielded in time to surprise the Armed Forces of the Federated Suns during the War of 3039, but in years since the design fell into the hands of the Outworlds Alliance thanks to a legal snafu which gave Ravenna Electronics a production license.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 1A9 是联合体-LAW 为使冲锋者在远程更有效所做的尝试，它采用缩小的 320 级引擎，把最高速度降至 64.8 公里/小时，并全面改造了武器库。所有较小激光（除头部那门）都换成中型激光，右躯干安装一具 LRM-20 发射器，左躯干携带两吨再装填。为弥补丧失的机动性，还安装了四个跳跃推进器（每腿两个），使冲锋者可跳跃至一百二十米。该变体及时投入战场，在 3039 年战争中令联邦太阳系武装部队大为意外，但此后数年因一次法律纠纷授予雷文纳电子生产许可，该设计落入外域联盟之手。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An export model sold to the Capellan Confederation as part of the Kapteyn Accords, the CGR-1L was a simple modification of the Charger in an attempt to make it more effective following their disastrous use on Chara in 3023. In place of four and a half tons of armor and all five Small Lasers, the 1L mounts a Large Laser in its right arm and two medium lasers in either side torso. While more prone to overheating and less protected - mounting armor comparable to that of a traditional scout 'Mech - it was better capable of defending itself against other scout 'Mechs, and at the time that was good enough for the desperate warriors of the Capellan Confederation Armed Forces. Since then, the CGR-1L has remained in Capellan service as a training 'Mech and, according to rumor, punishment assignment for dissident soldiers.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: CGR-1L 是作为卡普坦协定一部分出售给卡佩兰邦联的出口型号，是对冲锋者的简单改装，试图在 3023 年查拉星上的灾难性使用之后让它更有效。1L 以四吨半装甲和全部五门小型激光为代价，在右臂装一门大型激光，两侧躯干各两门中型激光。虽然更易过热、防护也更差——装甲水平堪比传统侦察机甲——但它更能抵御其他侦察机甲，而在当时，对卡佩兰邦联武装部队绝望的战士而言已经足够。此后 CGR-1L 一直留在卡佩兰服役，作为训练机甲，据传也是对付异见士兵的惩罚性差事。

While more prone to overheating and less protected - mounting armor comparable to that of a traditional scout 'Mech - it was better capable of defending itself against other scout 'Mechs, and at the time that was good enough for the desperate warriors of the Capellan Confederation Armed Forces. Since then, the CGR-1L has remained in Capellan service as a training 'Mech and, according to rumor, punishment assignment for dissident soldiers.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: CGR-1L 是作为卡普坦协定一部分出售给卡佩兰邦联的出口型号，是对冲锋者的简单改装，试图在 3023 年查拉星上的灾难性使用之后让它更有效。1L 以四吨半装甲和全部五门小型激光为代价，在右臂装一门大型激光，两侧躯干各两门中型激光。虽然更易过热、防护也更差——装甲水平堪比传统侦察机甲——但它更能抵御其他侦察机甲，而在当时，对卡佩兰邦联武装部队绝望的战士而言已经足够。此后 CGR-1L 一直留在卡佩兰服役，作为训练机甲，据传也是对付异见士兵的惩罚性差事。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This radical modification looks to turn the Charger into a traditional assault 'Mech by reducing the 'Mechs speed to 54 km/h, which allows the use of a smaller engine (incidentally, the commonplace Pitban 240 reactor). The 'Mech is armored with fifteen and a half tons of armor and is armed with four Large Lasers, one in each arm and side torso, and a Medium Laser in its head; twenty-eight heat sinks kept the 'Mech cool.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这项激进的改装试图把冲锋者变成传统的突击机甲：将机甲速度降至 54 公里/小时，从而得以使用更小的引擎（顺带一提，是常见的皮特班 240 反应堆）。机甲披挂十五吨半装甲，武装为四门大型激光（每臂与每侧躯干各一）以及头部一门中型激光；二十八台散热器使机甲保持凉爽。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Called Challenger by its designers, the -SB modification is not remarkable because it is not particularly difficult to apply.  Using a common and well-know reactor in the refit and essentially only upgrading the existing lasers to heavier versions, in turn requiring the Targeting-Tracking System to be tampered with.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: -SB 改装被设计者称为"挑战者"，它并不起眼，因为实施起来并不特别困难。改装中使用了常见且知名的反应堆，本质上只是把现有激光升级为更重的版本，相应地需要对瞄准追踪系统进行调整。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: In all honesty, Cicadas as a rule are very fragile. The 2A model was designed to be as fast as any light 'Mech, but that massive engine leaves little room for much else. Still, if you use it cautiously, it can be a successful scout and diversion.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 说实话，蝉总体上非常脆弱。2A 型号被设计得与任何轻型机甲一样快，但那台庞大的引擎几乎没给其他东西留下空间。不过只要谨慎使用，它仍能成为成功的侦察与佯动机甲。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: In all honesty, Cicadas as a rule are very fragile. The 2A model was designed to be as fast as any light 'Mech, but that massive engine leaves little room for much else. Still, if you use it cautiously, it can be a successful scout and diversion.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A swap out of the 2A's Small Laser and half a ton of armor for a Flamer, this 'Mech can be quickly maneuvered in to heat up an opponent that is already having issues.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 它以一台火焰喷射器换掉 2A 的小型激光和半吨装甲，可以迅速机动上去给本就散热吃紧的对手再加把火。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Not much of an improvement over the 2A model, if anything, the removal of half a ton of armor just makes you a bit more vulnerable.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 相比 2A 型号没什么改进，反而移除半吨装甲只让你更脆弱一点。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A typical Periphery raider, the Cicada 2P is fast and hard hitting but lacks endurance and cannot survive long once it has delivered it's payload. 4 RL-20's make up the bulk of the mechs firepower, capable of threatening even an Assault mech if used correctly. The secondary weapons are a pair of medium chem lasers with a ton of ammo between them. Achieving almost identical speeds to its Inner Sphere counterparts, the 2P is designed as a heavy scout and head hunter with a nasty alpha strike capable of shredding most opponents regardless of the target. Designed to be easy to maintain and even easier to replace, the 2P is built with parts that can be salvaged from most battlefields or brought in any number of back street bazaars or disreputable arms markets. Indeed, most new 2P’s are often repurposed wrecks hauled off the battlefield and rebuilt as quickly as possible.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 蝉 2P 是典型的外围区袭扰型，速度快、打击狠，但缺乏耐久，一旦倾泻完弹药就难以久撑。4 具 RL-20 构成机甲火力的主体，运用得当甚至能威胁突击机甲。次要武器是两门中型化学激光，共一吨弹药。2P 的速度几乎与内天体同类相当，被设计为重型侦察与猎头机甲，具备凶悍的全力齐射，不论目标是谁都能撕碎大多数对手。它易于维护、更易替换，用可从大多数战场回收或在任何后街集市、不名誉军火市场上买到的零件建造。事实上，大多数新的 2P 都是被拖离战场的残骸重新拼装，尽快重建而成。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Cicada 3C is slightly slower than the 2A but has more room for weaponry and armor. It still generally underperforms in most areas except speed, but it can put up more of a fight, with better survival rates.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 蝉 3C 比 2A 略慢，但有更多空间容纳武器和装甲。除速度外它在多数方面仍普遍表现不佳，但它更能一战，生存率也更高。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Cicada 3C is slightly slower than the 2A but has more room for weaponry and armor. It still generally underperforms in most areas except speed, but it can put up more of a fight, with better survival rates.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 蝉 3C 比 2A 略慢，但有更多空间容纳武器和装甲。除速度外它在多数方面仍普遍表现不佳，但它更能一战，生存率也更高。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A somewhat unusual design, this fire support mech is popular among the more advanced periphery states and with many mercenary commands. Refitting a standard 2A with an XL Engine, Gibson Federated stripped the weapons and replaced them with a pair of LRM-15’s and 3 tons of ammunition. Conceived as a relatively cheap support mech, with the speed to keep up with lighter scout elements and enough ammunition to last most engagements, it has maintained steady sales since it’s introduction and convinced Gibson to refit one of their older 2A production lines; to produce this variant. Deployed by everyone from the FWL to the Outworlds Alliance, this mech has been spreading across the IS and is a common sight among defensive garrisons. Critics of the design note it’s lack of armour and CASE whilst proponents praise it’s low cost and tactical flexibility.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是一款略显另类的设计，这款火力支援机甲在较先进的外围区国家和许多佣兵部队中颇受欢迎。吉布森联邦将一个标准 2A 换上 XL 引擎，拆除武器代之以两具 LRM-15 和三吨弹药。它被构想为一款相对廉价的支援机甲，速度足以跟上轻型侦察部队，弹药也足以支撑大多数交战，自推出以来销量稳定，并说服吉布森改装了他们一条较老的 2A 生产线以生产此变体。从自由世界联盟到外域联盟都在部署，这款机甲已遍布内天体，在防御驻军中十分常见。批评者指出它缺乏装甲与 C.A.S.E.，支持者则称赞其低成本与战术灵活性。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 3F Cicada is one of the most advanced versions of this 'Mech, its upgrades based on combat reports from the front lines of the Clan Invasion, and was introduced in 3052. The chassis has been constructed using Endo Steel construction techniques and the 'Mech is protected with six and a half tons of Ferro-Fibrous armor. The 3F is powered by an extralight engine and carries a weapons loadout that appears to be a cross between the 2A and 3C models. The primary weapon is an ER PPC, which is backed up by two medium lasers. What's more the Cicada can now jump up to two hundred and forty meters thanks to the inclusion of eight jump jets.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 3F 蝉是该机甲最先进的版本之一，其升级基于氏族入侵前线的战斗报告，于 3052 年推出。底盘采用内骨骼建造技术，机甲由六吨半铁纤维装甲保护。3F 由超轻型引擎驱动，武器配置看起来介于 2A 与 3C 型号之间。主武器是一门 ER PPC，辅以两门中型激光。更重要的是，得益于八个跳跃推进器的加入，蝉如今能跳起至二百四十米。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Based off of the same chassis as the 3F, the 3G was introduced in 3056 to transform the chassis into a more dedicated recon platform. It trades in the PPC for an ER Large Laser, a Beagle Active Probe, and additional armor.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 3G 与 3F 使用相同底盘，于 3056 年推出，旨在把底盘改造为更专注的侦察平台。它把 PPC 换成 ER 大型激光、比格犬主动探测器和额外装甲。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Based off of the same chassis as the 3F, the 3G was introduced in 3056 to transform the chassis into a more dedicated recon platform. It trades in the PPC for an ER Large Laser, a Beagle Active Probe, and additional armor.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A Combine rebuild of captured 3E’s, this design swaps the LRM-15’s for a pair of MRM-20’s and 2 tons of ammo, augmented by an Artemis IV system. Assigned to the Ghost Regiments and the Legions of Vega, these Cicadas are typically employed as scout-skirmishers and scout hunters. Unfortunately the limited ammo and lack of serious protection has lead to many mechwarriors petitioning for reassignment to other units or refusing to pilot these mechs. The Procurement Department on the other hand, is thrilled that it can offload these retrofitted Cicadas to units who have no choice in the matter. Nonetheless pilots who can master this design, report satisfaction with it’s performance and many have turned to field conversions to improve it’s endurance. The most commonly one reported is the installation of an Endosteel skeleton allowing another ton of ammo or the installation CASE II.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这款设计是联合体对缴获 3E 的重建，把 LRM-15 换成一对 MRM-20 和 2 吨弹药，并加装 Artemis IV 系统。这些蝉被配属给幽灵团与维加军团，通常作为侦察散兵和侦察猎手使用。遗憾的是，有限的弹药和缺乏像样的防护导致许多机甲战士申请调往其他单位或拒绝驾驶这些机甲。另一方面，采购部门却为能把这些改装蝉甩给别无选择的单位而欣喜若狂。尽管如此，能驾驭此设计的飞行员报告对其性能满意，许多人转而进行野战改装以提升其续航力。最常被报告的改装是安装内骨骼骨架以多带一吨弹药，或加装 C.A.S.E. II。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Cicada 3L is a succession war refit turning it into a fire support platform.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 蝉 3L 是继承战争时期的改装型，将其改造为火力支援平台。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Cicada 3L is a succession war refit turning it into a fire support platform.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 蝉 3L 是继承战争时期的改装型，将其改造为火力支援平台。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 3M upgrade of this older BattleMech uses some of the newest technology available at its introduction in 3049. It uses an extralight version of the same Pitban 320 engine, freeing up extra space to upgrade the small laser to a Small Pulse Laser and adding an Ultra Autocannon/5 to the left torso. The new ballistic weapon is fed by one ton of ammunition stored in the right torso and protected by CASE in the event of an ammunition explosion. The Star Slab armor has also been replaced with Durallex Light, although the amount of protection is the same as in the 2A.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这款较老战斗机甲的 3M 升级版使用了 3049 年推出时可获得的部分最新技术。它采用同款皮特班 320 引擎的超轻型版本，腾出额外空间把小型激光升级为小型脉冲激光，并在左躯干加装一门超速自动炮/5。这门新实弹武器由右躯干储存的一吨弹药供弹，并在弹药爆炸时由 C.A.S.E. 保护。"星板"装甲也已换成杜拉莱克斯轻型，尽管防护量与 2A 相同。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 3M upgrade of this older BattleMech uses some of the newest technology available at its introduction in 3049. It uses an extralight version of the same Pitban 320 engine, freeing up extra space to upgrade the small laser to a Small Pulse Laser and adding an Ultra Autocannon/5 to the left torso. The new ballistic weapon is fed by one ton of ammunition stored in the right torso and protected by CASE in the event of an ammunition explosion. The Star Slab armor has also been replaced with Durallex Light, although the amount of protection is the same as in the 2A.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Clint was primarily designed as a cheap recon unit, with the capabilities of a well-armed, low-end medium weight 'Mech, and in this regard it served well. With a top speed of 97.2 km/h and a jumping capability of one hundred and eighty meters, the Clint can easily keep up with other recon elements and maneuver through mountainous or urban terrain. The 1-2R Clint was the original prototype variant that carried an Armstrong Buster Autocannon/10 with a single Medium Laser as a secondary weapon and no jump jets.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 克林特主要被设计为廉价的侦察单位，具备武装良好的入门级中量级机甲的能力，在这方面它表现出色。凭借 97.2 公里/小时的最高速度和一百八十米的跳跃能力，克林特能轻松跟上其他侦察单位，并能穿越山地或城市地形。1-2R 克林特是最初的原型变体，携带一门阿姆斯特朗"破坏者"自动炮/10，以一门中型激光为次要武器，且没有跳跃推进器。
狙击手 & 轻型缠斗者

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Clint was primarily designed as a cheap recon unit, with the capabilities of a well-armed, low-end medium weight 'Mech, and in this regard it served well. With a top speed of 97.2 km/h and a jumping capability of one hundred and eighty meters, the Clint can easily keep up with other recon elements and maneuver through mountainous or urban terrain. The Clint 2-3U is a Capellan field upgrade of the Clint that strips all of the armaments from the chassis and replaces them with more potent and enduring weaponry, the most radical of which is the primary weapon. The AC/5 has been replaced with an ER PPC while both the Medium Lasers were replaced with Medium Pulse Lasers; as a result, it runs much hotter than the original. The 3U also packs double heat sinks in place of single models and is more deadly in combat.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: When General Aleksandr Kerensky led most of the Star League Defense Force into exile in 2784, they brought prototypes of the Clint BattleMech with them. After the annihilation of Clan Wolverine, Clan Snow Raven revisited these prototypes and was able to begin mass-production of the 'Mech in 2830 and introduced 2842. They ensured that it kept up with advances in Clan technology, eventually becoming the design that is now known as the Clint IIC. This speedy medium 'Mech is armed with a Type KOV LB-10X Autocannon and a pair of Series 2d ER Medium Lasers. This makes the Clint IIC an effective light 'Mech killer. It is capable of ranging far beyond supply lines thanks to its four tons of ammunition, though it only uses ten standard heat sinks and seven tons of standard armor.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 2784 年亚历山大·克伦斯基将军率领星盟防卫军大部流亡时，带上了克林特战斗机甲的原型机。在狼獾氏族被灭绝后，雪鸦氏族重新审视这些原型，于 2830 年得以开始量产并于 2842 年推出。他们确保其跟上氏族技术的进步，最终演变为如今被称为克林特 IIC 的设计。这款高速中型机甲装备一门 KOV 型 LB-10X 自动炮和两门 2d 系列 ER 中型激光，使其成为高效的轻型机甲杀手。凭借四吨弹药，它能远离补给线长期作战，不过它仅使用十台标准散热器和七吨标准装甲。
氏族狙击手与轻型近战

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The predesessor to the 2D, the Commando 1D was meant to give the MechWarrior a little more long range punch with a Large Laser. at the cost of some of its armor.  While the 2D is superior in most aspects, there are still a number of this older design still in service today.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为 2D 的前身，突击队员 1D 意在用一门大型激光为机甲战士提供更多远程打击力，代价是部分装甲。虽然 2D 在多数方面更优，但这款较老设计至今仍有不少在役。
轻型攻击手 & 侦察兵

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: You don't see many of these outside of Lyran space.  While I like the added range, the reduced armor and increased heat profile make this a troublesome 'Mech.  There is a reason they moved on to the 2D.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在莱兰空间之外你见不到多少这种机甲。虽然我喜欢它增加的射程，但减少的装甲和升高的热量曲线使它成为一台麻烦的机甲。他们转向 2D 是有原因的。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Dubbed the 'Blazing Inferno', this variant of the 2D chassis removes all the missiles and instead adds three more Medium Lasers and six Small Lasers, along with an extra ton of armor.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 此变体绰号"炽烈地狱"，基于 2D 底盘，移除全部导弹，改为加装三门中型激光和六门小型激光，以及额外一吨装甲。
轻型攻击手 & 侦察兵

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: When the say Inferno, no one realized they were referring to the temperature inside the cockpit.  I suggest removing some of the lasers and adding a heat sink or two.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 当人们说"燃烧弹"时，没人意识到他们指的是驾驶舱内的温度。我建议移除一些激光，加一两台散热器。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: With all those SRMs, the COM-2D is like a small, highly mobile shotgun that can take down 'Mechs twice its size or bigger. You've gotta be careful with it, though, because it's not meant to take much of a beating.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 凭借这些 SRM，COM-2D 就像一把小型、高度机动的霰弹枪，能放倒体型两倍于己或更大的机甲。不过你得小心使用，因为它经不起多少打击。
轻型攻击手 & 侦察兵

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: With all those SRMs, the COM-2D is like a small, highly mobile shotgun that can take down 'Mechs twice its size or bigger. You've gotta be careful with it, though, because it's not meant to take much of a beating.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 凭借这些 SRM，COM-2D 就像一把小型、高度机动的霰弹枪，能放倒体型两倍于己或更大的机甲。不过你得小心使用，因为它经不起多少打击。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: In 3055 the Taurian Concordat's Vandenburg Mechanized Industries produced limited runs of this factory refit of the Commando COM-2D using stealth and sensor packages imported from the Cappelan Confederation. While the result was an effective scout, with respectable ambush capabilities, the expense compared to the base model, and the difficulties of multinational production, kept it from widespread adoption.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 3055 年，陶里安协约的范登堡机械化工业公司限量生产了这款突击队 COM-2D 的工厂改装型，使用从卡佩兰邦联进口的隐形与传感器组件。成果是一款有效的侦察机甲，具备可观的伏击能力，但与基础型号相比的高昂成本以及跨国生产的困难，使其未能被广泛采用。
轻型攻击手 & 侦察兵

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Well Commander, as outfitted from the factory it's certainly a superior Commando. At the chassis level it's not much different than it's cheaper cousins. But the custom Null Signature system puts it on another level.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 嗯，指挥官，按出厂配置它的确是一台更优秀的突击队员。在底盘层面它与其较廉价的表亲区别不大。但定制的"虚无信号"系统让它上升到了另一个层次。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Commando 2I features modified SRMs with an Inferno payload. This pirate favorite is notorious for its ability to harass and disable, while also packing a punch with its two RL-10s.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 突击队员 2I 采用装有燃烧弹载荷的改装 SRM。这款海盗最爱以骚扰与瘫痪能力而臭名昭著，同时凭借两具 RL-10 也有相当打击力。
轻型攻击手 & 侦察兵

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Commando 2I features modified SRMs with an Inferno payload. This pirate favorite is notorious for its ability to harass and disable, while also packing a punch with its two RL-10s.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 突击队员 2I 采用装有燃烧弹载荷的改装 SRM。这款海盗最爱以骚扰与瘫痪能力而臭名昭著，同时凭借两具 RL-10 也有相当打击力。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A very recent variant, the 3A mounts a pair of SRM-6 racks and supplements its close in firepower with a Flamer.  It is an excellent quick strike 'Mech, but suffers in drawn out fights due to a limited supply of ammunition for the SRMs.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 3A 是极新的变体，装备一对 SRM-6 挂架，并以一具火焰喷射器补充其近距火力。它是出色的快速打击机甲，但由于 SRM 弹药有限，在持久战中会吃亏。
轻型攻击手 & 侦察兵

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: For a light 'Mech, the COM-3A can dish out a lot of damage in a single volley.  Though it is bound to chew up that ammo faster than my crew would go through a case of Triple-F Burgers.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为轻型机甲，COM-3A 单次齐射就能造成大量伤害。不过它肯定会比我手下那帮人吃"三重 F 汉堡"还快地耗光弹药。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Commando 4H is the Marian Hegemony's primary garrison mech, often sent out against pirates twice the weight with surprising success. 90 Rockets ensure that even out weighed it isn't out gunned.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 突击队员 4H 是马里安霸权的首要驻防机甲，常被派去对抗两倍重量的海盗并取得惊人成功。90 枚火箭确保它即便体重落于下风，火力也不落于下风。
轻型攻击手 & 侦察兵

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Commando 4H is a periphery pilots dream as far as light mechs go. All mechs are equal under such a ridiculous rocket barrage.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 就轻型机甲而言，突击队员 4H 是外围区飞行员的梦想。在如此荒谬的火箭弹幕之下，所有机甲都是平等的。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The COM-5S was introduced in 3050 and was the first Commando to feature Star League technology. Its new Cyclops MultiTasker 10 Targeting System links an Artemis IV Fire Control System to the Coventry 90 mm SRM-6, which replaces the Shannon Six-Shooter, and exchanges the SRM-4 with a Coventry T4H Streak SRM-2 launcher. Additionally, the chassis has been upgraded with Endo Steel, the armor has been upgraded to Ferro-Fibrous, and CASE has been added to protect the ammunition.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: COM-5S 于 3050 年推出，是首款采用星盟科技的突击队。其新的独眼巨人 MultiTasker 10 瞄准系统将 Artemis IV 火控系统与考文垂 90 毫米 SRM-6（取代香农六发左轮）联动，并将 SRM-4 换成考文垂 T4H 连续 SRM-2 发射器。此外底盘升级为内骨骼，装甲升级为铁纤维，并加装 C.A.S.E. 保护弹药。
轻型攻击手 & 侦察兵

Its new Cyclops MultiTasker 10 Targeting System links an Artemis IV Fire Control System to the Coventry 90 mm SRM-6, which replaces the Shannon Six-Shooter, and exchanges the SRM-4 with a Coventry T4H Streak SRM-2 launcher. Additionally, the chassis has been upgraded with Endo Steel, the armor has been upgraded to Ferro-Fibrous, and CASE has been added to protect the ammunition.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This update of the COM-5S introduced in 3059 is also built on an Endo Steel chassis but uses a new Light Fusion engine. The 'Mech carries two Streak SRM-2 launchers, an SRM-4 with an Artemis IV Fire Control System, and an ER Medium Laser in each arm
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 3059 年推出的这款 COM-5S 更新版同样建立在内骨骼底盘上，但采用新的轻型聚变引擎。机甲携带两具连续 SRM-2 发射器、一具配 Artemis IV 火控系统的 SRM-4，每臂各一门 ER 中型激光
轻型攻击手 & 侦察兵

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This update of the COM-5S introduced in 3059 is also built on an Endo Steel chassis but uses a new Light Fusion engine. The 'Mech carries two Streak SRM-2 launchers, an SRM-4 with an Artemis IV Fire Control System, and an ER Medium Laser in each arm
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 3059 年推出的这款 COM-5S 更新版同样建立在内骨骼底盘上，但采用新的轻型聚变引擎。机甲携带两具连续 SRM-2 发射器、一具配 Artemis IV 火控系统的 SRM-4，每臂各一门 ER 中型激光

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: During the Amaris Civil War, several Lyran MechWarriors joined the SLDF in defiance of their government's policy of neutrality. With this came the coup that the Star League Defense Force had attempted to pull off for decades: the acquisition of the Lyran Commando. Long considered one of the better scout 'Mechs in the Inner Sphere, at least one of these Commandos accompanied Kerensky into exile and several of them appeared in the forces assigned to Operation Klondike. As newer weapons and 'Mechs made their way into the Clan arsenal, these Commandos began to show their age, so Clan Goliath Scorpion began a program to upgrade theirs. Dubbed the Commando IIC, this upgrade used newer technologies to outperform its venerable cousin. With the proliferation of OmniMechs, most Commando IICs were relegated to second line status, though the Scorpions still continue to outfit some of their pirate hunters with these 'Mechs.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 阿马里斯内战期间，数名莱兰机甲战士不顾政府中立政策加入星盟防卫军。随之而来的是星盟防卫军数十年来一直试图实现的目标：获得莱兰突击队。突击队长期被视为内天体最好的侦察机甲之一，至少有一台随克伦斯基流亡，数台出现在"克朗代克行动"的部队中。随着更新式武器与机甲进入氏族武库，这些突击队开始显露老态，于是歌利亚蝎氏族启动了升级计划。命名为突击队 IIC，该升级利用更新技术超越了它古老的表亲。随着全能机甲普及，大多数突击队 IIC 退居二线，但蝎氏族仍继续用它们装备部分猎杀海盗的部队。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: First produced in late fall of 3054, the Copperhead is a finely honed arena 'Mech. The design rose to fame when Silver Dragons Stables MechWarrior Brendon Frazer piloted his Copperhead, the Silver Snake, into the Solaris Top Twenty prior to his untimely death. The Silver Dragons commissioned Solaris Arms to develop a new exclusive variant to try and repeat the feat, but the new model's expensive experimental weaponry forced them to allow sales to other interested parties. The Draconis Combine Mustered Soldiery snapped up a number of the original CPR-HD-002 models. While not increasing the original model's meager four and half tons of armor coverage, Solaris Arms chose to replace the original Durallex plating with ArcShield Reflective Armor to enhance its endurance against the large volume of energy weapons carried by Arena 'Mechs. Already a relatively speedy design, the addition of a Supercharger enhanced its ground speed. Its extremely short jumping distance was neither improved nor removed; instead it was retained to expand a pilot's options in tight terrain. An extra Double Heat Sink, bringing the total to thirteen, is still not enough to keep up with the increased heat produced by the CPR-HD-003's advanced laser weaponry. Allowing the designers to squeeze in the new systems, a cramped Small Cockpit is used, which is less of a liability in the short duration arena battles than on an actual battlefield.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 铜斑蛇于 3054 年深秋首次生产，是一台精炼的竞技场机甲。当银龙马疚的机甲战士布伦登·弗雷泽驾驶他的铜斑蛇"银蛇"齐身索拉里斯前二十名后，这一设计声名大噪——随后他不幸身亡。银龙委托索拉里斯兵工厂开发一款新的独家变体以图重现这一壮举，但新型号昂贵的实验性武器迫使他们允许向其他有意方销售。德拉科尼斯联合体征募兵部队迅速抢购了若干原版 CPR-HD-002 型号。索拉里斯兵工厂并未增加原型那可怜的四吨半装甲覆盖，而是选择把原有的杜拉莱克斯装甲板换成"弧盾"反射装甲，以增强其对竞技场机甲所携带大量能量武器的耐久力。这本来就已是相对高速的设计，加装增压器后地面速度进一步提升。它极短的跳跃距离既未改进也未取消，而是保留下来以拓展飞行员在狭窄地形中的选择。增加一台双倍散热器使总数达到十三台，仍不足以应对 CPR-HD-003 先进激光武器产生的更高热量。为让设计者塞进这些新系统，采用了狭窄的小型驾驶舱——在短时的竞技场战斗中，这比在真实战场上危害更小。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The original model lacked the CPR-HD-003's supercharger and small cockpit. Instead of the Reflective armor, it was fitted with Ferro-Fibrous armor and carried only twelve heat sinks. The weapons loadout consisted of four Medium Lasers, a Small Pulse Laser, a standard SRM-4, and a one-shot Streak SRM-2.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 原版型号没有 CPR-HD-003 的增压器和小型驾驶舱。它没有采用反射装甲，而是装铁纤维装甲，仅携带十二台散热器。武器载荷包括四门中型激光、一门小型脉冲激光、一具标准 SRM-4 和一具一次性连续 SRM-2。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: While Corsair is supposedly a generic Periphery term referring to heavy and assault class FrankenMechs cobbled together out of desperation as the Succession War era dragged on, with no specific weight or base chassis, the most successful of these are ninety-five ton brutes modeled in a generally similar style, usually marked with a COR designation. Armed with a grab-bag array of weaponry, the Corsair's primary weapons are an AC/10 and LRM-15 mounted in its right torso, supported by a trio of Medium Lasers split between its left and center torsos and a SRM-6 and Large Laser mounted in its vestigial left arm.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 虽然"海盗船"据称是外围区的泛称，指继承战争时代拖长过程中因绝望而拼凑起来的重型与突击级"科学怪机"，没有特定重量或基础底盘，但其中最成功的那些是九十五吨的猛兽，造型大体相似，通常标以 COR 编号。海盗船装备五花八门的武器，主武器为装在右躯干的一门 AC/10 和一具 LRM-15，辅以分置左、中躯干的三门中型激光，以及装在退化左臂上的一具 SRM-6 和一门大型激光。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Boss, what on earth is this thing? I'm all one for a challenge but this thing looks like a pirate deathtrap. Somehow it works but I couldn't begin to tell you why or how it works. I guess we should be grateful that it works at all.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 老大，这到底是什么玩意儿？我向来乐意接受挑战，但这东西看起来像个海盗版的死亡陷阱。不知怎的它居然能用，但我说不清为什么或怎么用的。我想我们该庆幸它至少还能用。

For close-range backup, the -5T mounts four Medium Lasers.

Armed with a grab-bag array of weaponry, the Corsair-7A's primary weapons are geared towards long-range combat, with a pair of AC/5s, a Large Laser, and a PPC for extended range engagements while a pair of Medium Lasers cover short-range defense. To defeat enemy missile fire, the COR-7A carries a quartet of Anti-Missile Systems.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 虽然"海盗船"据称是外围区的泛称，指继承战争时代拖长过程中因绝望而拼凑起来的重型与突击级"科学怪机"，没有特定重量或基础底盘，但其中最成功的那些是九十五吨的猛兽，造型大体相似，通常标以 COR 编号。海盗船-7A 装备五花八门的武器，主武器偏重远程战斗：一对 AC/5、一门大型激光和一门 PPC 负责远距交战，另有一对中型激光覆盖近程防御。为击破敌方导弹火力，COR-7A 携带四套反导系统。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Boss, what on earth is this thing? I'm all one for a challenge but this thing looks like a pirate deathtrap. Somehow it works but I couldn't begin to tell you why or how it works. I guess we should be grateful that it works at all. And what's with all the AMS on this one?!.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 老大，这到底是什么玩意儿？我向来乐意接受挑战，但这东西看起来像个海盗版的死亡陷阱。不知怎的它居然能用，但我说不清为什么或怎么用的。我想我们该庆幸它至少还能用。还有这台上的 AMS 是怎么回事？！。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: While Corsair is supposedly a generic Periphery term referring to heavy and assault class FrankenMechs cobbled together out of desperation as the Succession War era dragged on, with no specific weight or base chassis, the most successful of these are ninety-five ton brutes modeled in a generally similar style, usually marked with a COR designation. Armed with a grab-bag array of weaponry, the Corsair-7R's primary weapons are an AC/20 and a pair of Large Lasers. However, the -7R's real punch comes from 70 Rocket Launcher tubes scattered across the mech in a pair of RL 20s and a trio of RL 10s.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 虽然"海盗船"据称是外围区的泛称，指继承战争时代拖长过程中因绝望而拼凑起来的重型与突击级"科学怪机"，没有特定重量或基础底盘，但其中最成功的那些是九十五吨的猛兽，造型大体相似，通常标以 COR 编号。海盗船-7R 装备五花八门的武器，主武器为一门 AC/20 和两门大型激光。然而-7R 真正的打击力来自散布全身的 70 个火箭发射管——两具 RL 20 和三具 RL 10。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Boss, what on earth is this thing? I'm all one for a challenge but this thing looks like a pirate deathtrap. Somehow it works but I couldn't begin to tell you why or how it works. I guess we should be grateful that it works at all. And look at all those crazy rockets, what will the pirates think of next?
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 老大，这到底是什么玩意儿？我向来乐意接受挑战，但这东西看起来像个海盗版的死亡陷阱。不知怎的它居然能用，但我说不清为什么或怎么用的。我想我们该庆幸它至少还能用。再看看那一堆疯狂的火箭，海盗们下次又会想出什么来？

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: At its core this is still a typical Periphery FrankenMech, but it received a lot of care from 'Her' owner, named after a infamous Terran Pirate Queen, does this specific design sport a Thumper Artillery Piece and munitions from the Barrymore Munitions manufacturers, granting superior Tactical Flexibility.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 本质上它仍是典型的外围区拼装机甲，但它得到了"她"的主人——以一位臭名昭著的泰拉海盗女王命名——的精心照料。这款特定设计装备一门重锤火炮与巴里摩尔弹药公司的弹药，赋予其卓越的战术灵活性。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: At its core this is still a typical Periphery FrankenMech, but it received a lot of care from 'Her' owner, named after a infamous Terran Pirate Queen, does this specific design sport a Thumper Artillery Piece and munitions from the Barrymore Munitions manufacturers, granting superior Tactical Flexibility
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 本质上这仍是一台典型的外围区"科学怪机"，但它得到了"她"主人的悉心照料——这台机甲以一位臭名昭著的泰拉海盗女王命名。这款特定设计装有一门重锤火炮和巴里摩尔弹药公司出品的弹药，赋予其卓越的战术灵活性

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Cossack is named after the mercenary unit Khorsakov's Cossacks in honor of their faithful service to the St Ives Compact. The Cossack is a practice in compromise. Originally requested as the fastest 'Mech that Ceres Metals Industries could produce, the emphasis of the design changed throughout its development to a slow moving, heavily armored light 'Mech. The final design that was accepted became the current incarnation of the Cossack. The Cossack is built on a Taijian Series X Endo Steel chassis to save weight. More weight was cut from the design by using a lightweight Hermes 120 XL engine that gives the 'Mech a top speed of 97.2 km/h. Six Pitban LFT-65 jump jets allow the Cossack to jump up to hundred and eighty meters, allowing the 'Mech to easily handle most rough terrain. For protection, the Cossack has three tons of armor and has ten heat sinks to handle the heat produced by the weapons payload carried by the 'Mech. Overall, the compromise that created the Cossack has turned it into a light trooper 'Mech that works well as part of a team but alone excels at no one role.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 哥萨克以佣兵部队霍尔萨科夫的哥萨克命名，以表彰他们对圣艾夫斯共同体的忠诚服役。哥萨克是妥协的实践。它最初被要求成为塞雷斯金属工业所能生产的最快机甲，但在开发过程中设计重心转变为一款缓慢、重装甲的轻型机甲。最终被采纳的设计成为哥萨克现在的模样。哥萨克基于"太极 X 系列"内骨骼底盘建造以减轻重量。设计还通过使用轻量化的赫尔墨斯 120 XL 引擎进一步减重，赋予机甲 97.2 公里/小时的最高速度。六个皮特班 LFT-65 跳跃推进器使哥萨克能跳起至一百八十米，使机甲能轻松应对大多数崎岖地形。防护方面，哥萨克有三吨装甲和十台散热器，以处理机甲武器载荷产生的热量。总体而言，造就哥萨克的妥协把它变成了一款轻型通用机甲，作为团队成员表现良好，但单独行动时在任何角色上都不出众。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The primary weapons on the Cossack are a Kajuka Type 2 Bright Blossom Medium Laser and a MilDouglas Duke SRM-6. These are backed up by a pair of Jackson Model 12 Small Lasers. While this is not an impressive arsenal, the Cossack is capable of defending itself from most light 'Mechs and vehicles.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 哥萨克的主武器是一门"卡尤卡 2 型亮花"中型激光和一具"米尔道格拉斯公爵"SRM-6。它们由一对"杰克逊 12 型"小型激光支援。虽然这算不上出色的武器库，哥萨克仍有能力抵御大多数轻型机甲与车辆。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: With a focus on indirect fire support, the COU-A fields a pair of Artemis IV guided LRM-20s. If the pilot finds itself in a position with direct line of sight he or she can also rely on a pair of ERML's and a single backup Small Pulse Laser. In total this makes for a lot of firepower in a very small package.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: COU-A 聚焦间接火力支援，装备一对 Artemis IV 制导的 LRM-20。若飞行员处于有直射视野的位置，还可依靠两门 ER 中型激光和一门备用小型脉冲激光。总而言之，这在极小的机体中汇聚了极其可观的火力。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Cougar-B is a classic clan direct fire support / sniper build. Dual ERPPCs and a backup ERML make for a formidable punch. With a set of six additional Double Heatsinks the COU-B runs reasonably cool and is able to keep its barrage up for quite a while.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 美洲狮-B 是经典的氏族直射火力支援/狙击配置。双 ER PPC 加一门备用 ER 中型激光构成强大的打击力。凭借六台额外双倍散热器，COU-B 散热相当理想，能长时间维持火力倾泻。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A mix of long and medium range weaponry is what makes the Cougar-C variant quite unique. A Gauss Rifle is an absolutely scary main weapon system for a mech of just 35 tons and even the backup weapons are more than enough to strike fear in its enemies heart: 5 ERML will allow the COU-C to stay active and dangerous even after the ammo for the Gauss is depleted.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 长中程武器的混合让美洲狮-C 变体相当独特。对一台仅 35 吨的机甲而言，一门高斯步枪绝对是令人恐惧的主武器系统，而备用武器也足以让敌人心中生畏：5 门 ER 中型激光使 COU-C 在高斯弹药耗尽的仍能保持活跃与危险。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Conceptualized to be a sniper with a good near field defense the Cougar-D variant relies on a single ERLL and an Ultra Autocannon/10 for long range and dual SRM4 launchers for close range fire. The COU-D might not be quick, but if he closes in after ripping the armor open, these Short Range Missiles have great finishing potential.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 美洲狮-D 变体的构想是具备良好近场防御的狙击手，它依靠一门 ER 大型激光和一门超速自动炮/10 负责远程，双联 SRM4 发射器负责近程。COU-D 也许不算迅速，但如果它撕开装甲后贴近，这些短程火箭有很强的收尾能力。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Huntress configuration of the Cougar is a rare sight, designed to be a scout hunter and Heavy Hitter is most of its capability shifted to advanced electronics and the ability to detect and effectively kill even stealthed units in a single devastating Blow.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 美洲狮的"女猎手"配置十分罕见，旨在作为侦察猎手与重击手，其大部分能力都转向先进电子设备以及侦测并一击致命地干掉即使处于隐形状态的单位。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Khan Marthe Pryde decided to upgrade the 'Mechs her Clan fielded. Rather than waste precious resources designing a new OmniMech from the ground up, she instructed her scientists to improve upon existing designs. The design the scientists chose to modify was the Adder. Though the two 'Mechs are visually similar and share the same weight, the Cougar is slower and better armed.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 玛尔特·普莱德可汗决定升级其氏族装备的机甲。为不浪费宝贵资源从头设计新型全能机甲，她指示科学家改良现有设计。科学家选择改造的是蝰蛇。尽管两款机甲外观相似且重量相同，美洲狮更慢但武装更强。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Cronus was designed by Angus Gilmour to be a cost-effective 'Mech for use by mercenaries and small Periphery units using scrapped military equipment. After retiring from service with the Free Worlds League Military in the 3rd Succession War, Gilmour and many ex-technicians he recruited began working for the family business, Gilmour MilTech, on his home planet Talitha. While Gilmour MilTech would spend much of its time rebuilding/restoring wrecked equipment, technicians with free time constructed small numbers of the Cronus. An inexpensive, hand-built design, the Cronus combines design aspects of many different 55-ton BattleMechs seen on the modern battlefield.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 克洛诺斯由安格斯·吉尔摩设计，旨在为佣兵和小型外围区单位提供一款使用报废军用装备、成本效益高的机甲。第三次继承战争中从自由世界联盟军队退役后，吉尔摩和他招募的许多前技师开始在其母星塔利莎为家族企业吉尔摩军工工作。虽然吉尔摩军工大部分时间用于重建/修复报废装备，有余力的技师们小批量地制造克洛诺斯。作为一款廉价的手工打造设计，克洛诺斯融合了现代战场上多种 55 吨战斗机甲的设计特点。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An older variant of the Cronus, the 3M uses all standard technologies that have been available to the Inner Sphere in 3031. As its primary weapon, the 3M has a Large Laser which is backed up by three Medium Lasers and a SRM-4 launcher. The 3M is slightly slower than the 5M, with a top speed of 86.4 km/h and it carries a price tag of 4,896,656 C-Bills, which is less than the 5M by of 7,754,522.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 3M 是克洛诺斯的较老变体，使用 3031 年内天体可获得的全套标准技术。作为主武器，3M 有一门大型激光，辅以三门中型激光和一具 SRM-4 发射器。3M 比 5M 略慢，最高速度 86.4 公里/小时，售价 4,896,656 C 币，比 5M 便宜 7,754,522。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Cronus was designed by Angus Gilmour to be a cost-effective 'Mech for use by mercenaries and small Periphery units using scrapped military equipment. After retiring from service with the Free Worlds League Military in the 3rd Succession War, Gilmour and many ex-technicians he recruited began working for the family business, Gilmour MilTech, on his home planet Talitha. While Gilmour MilTech would spend much of its time rebuilding/restoring wrecked equipment, technicians with free time constructed small numbers of the Cronus. An inexpensive, hand-built design, the Cronus combines design aspects of many different 55-ton BattleMechs seen on the modern battlefield.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 克洛诺斯由安格斯·吉尔摩设计，旨在为佣兵和小型外围区单位提供一款使用报废军用装备、成本效益高的机甲。第三次继承战争中从自由世界联盟军队退役后，吉尔摩和他招募的许多前技师开始在其母星塔利莎为家族企业吉尔摩军工工作。虽然吉尔摩军工大部分时间用于重建/修复报废装备，有余力的技师们小批量地制造克洛诺斯。作为一款廉价的手工打造设计，克洛诺斯融合了现代战场上多种 55 吨战斗机甲的设计特点。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The upgraded Cronus is built on a lightweight Earthwerk SHD II Endo Steel chassis that carries a VOX 330 XL engine, providing a top speed of 97.2 km/h. The Cronus has enhanced mobility with six Northrup 12000 jump jets that allow the 'Mech to jump up to one hundred and eighty meters. It is protected with ten and a half tons of Maximillian 43 armor, with CASE. The Cronus is able to handle the heat from its weapons with fourteen double heat sinks and is fitted with a C3 slave unit, allowing it to be integrated into a C3 unit. The Cronus has a Magna Sunspot ER PPC as its primary long ranged weapon. The ER PPC is capable of delivering consistent damage at all of its range brackets. For close combat, the Cronus has two Diverse Optics Type ER Medium Lasers and a single Diverse Optics Type ER Small Laser. Finally, to seek out weak points in an enemy's armor, the Cronus carries a Harpoon-4S Streak SRM-4.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 升级版克洛诺斯基于轻量化的"地球工厂 SHD II"内骨骼底盘建造，搭载一台 VOX 330 XL 引擎，最高速度 97.2 公里/小时。克洛诺斯有六个"诺斯罗普 12000"跳跃推进器增强机动性，使机甲能跳起至一百八十米。它由十吨半"马克西米利安 43"装甲保护，并配 C.A.S.E.。克洛诺斯能用十四台双倍散热器处理武器热量，并装有 C3 从属单元，可被整合进 C3 单位。克洛诺斯以一门"玛格纳太阳黑子"ER PPC 为主要远程武器。这门 ER PPC 能在其所有射程段稳定输出伤害。近战方面，克洛诺斯有两门"多元光学 ER 型"中型激光和一门"多元光学 ER 型"小型激光。最后，为搜寻敌方装甲上的弱点，克洛诺斯携带一具"鱼叉-4S"连续 SRM-4。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Introduced in 2596, this variant was originally produced for the SLDF during the Reunification War. It upgraded the heat sinks to double heat sinks and utilized an Endo Steel internal structure to save mass. All of the ammunition is located in the side torsos and protected by CASE.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 此变体于 2596 年推出，最初在统一战争期间为星盟防卫军生产。它把散热器升级为双倍散热器，并采用内骨骼内部结构以节省质量。全部弹药都位于两侧躯干并由 C.A.S.E. 保护。
重型伏击手 & 缠斗者

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Crusader received its baptism of fire during the Reunification War and remained a common fixture in the regiments of the SLDF for many centuries.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 十字军在统一战争中接受了战火洗礼，并在许多世纪里一直是星盟防卫军各团的常见装备。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Crusader was initially designed as a close combat BattleMech for the Star League Defense Force, but soon proved itself to be a very adaptable, multi-role design.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 十字军最初为星盟防卫军设计为近战战斗机甲，但很快证明自己是一款适应性极强的多用途设计。
重型伏击手 & 缠斗者

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This Mech was built with an advanced Prototype Fire control System.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 此机甲配备了先进的原型火控系统。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 3D variant of the Crusader is a simple modification to make the 'Mech's heat load more manageable. Introduced in 2756 and used mostly by House Davion, the two SRM-6 launchers were replaced with two SRM-4 launchers and the machine guns were removed so that the number of heat sinks could be increased by four.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 十字军 3D 变体是一次简单改装，旨在让机甲的热负荷更易管理。它于 2756 年推出，主要供达维昂家族使用，将两具 SRM-6 发射器换成两具 SRM-4，并移除机枪，以便把散热器数量增加四台。
重型伏击手 & 缠斗者

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 3D variant of the Crusader is a simple modification to make the 'Mech's heat load more manageable. Introduced in 2756 and used mostly by House Davion, the two SRM-6 launchers were replaced with two SRM-4 launchers and the machine guns were removed so that the number of heat sinks could be increased by four.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 十字军 3D 变体是一次简单改装，旨在让机甲的热负荷更易管理。它于 2756 年推出，主要供达维昂家族使用，将两具 SRM-6 发射器换成两具 SRM-4，并移除机枪，以便把散热器数量增加四台。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Crusader was initially designed as a close combat BattleMech for the Star League Defense Force, but soon proved itself to be a very adaptable, multi-role design.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 十字军最初为星盟防卫军设计为近战战斗机甲，但很快证明自己是一款适应性极强的多用途设计。
重型伏击手 & 缠斗者

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Crusader received its baptism of fire during the Reunification War and remained a common fixture in the regiments of the SLDF for many centuries.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 十字军在统一战争中接受了战火洗礼，并在许多世纪里一直是星盟防卫军各团的常见装备。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 4D variant of the Crusader was a common field modification kit, utilizing Star League technology recovered from the Helm Memory Core, used by both Davion and Liao forces starting in 3049. This variant has had the medium lasers and the SRM-6 launchers removed and in their place has two Streak SRM-2 launchers and two Medium Pulse Lasers mounted.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 十字军 4D 变体是常见的野战改装套件，采用从赫尔姆记忆核心找回的星盟技术，自 3049 年起为达维昂与廖势力双方使用。此变体移除了中型激光和 SRM-6 发射器，在原位安装了两具连续 SRM-2 发射器和两门中型脉冲激光。
重型伏击手 & 缠斗者

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 4D variant of the Crusader was a common field modification kit, utilizing Star League technology recovered from the Helm Memory Core.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 十字军 4D 变体是常见的野战改装套件，采用从赫尔姆记忆核心找回的星盟技术。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 5M was the official production-model upgraded variant of the Crusader for the Free Worlds League, introduced in 3049 and using recovered Star League technology. Though using the same Crucis-B chassis as before the 'Mech was powered by a Hermes 260 XL Engine and carried thirteen double heat sinks to vent its heat more efficiently.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 5M 是自由世界联盟十字军的官方量产升级变体，于 3049 年推出，采用重新找回的星盟技术。虽然仍使用与先前相同的"十字-B"底盘，机甲改由赫尔墨斯 260 XL 引擎驱动，并携带十三台双倍散热器以更高效地排热。
重型伏击手 & 缠斗者

Though using the same Crucis-B chassis as before the 'Mech was powered by a Hermes 260 XL Engine and carried thirteen double heat sinks to vent its heat more efficiently.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Equiped with 4 Imperator Smoothie AC/2s, 2 Holly LRM-10 Launchers and 2 Large Lasers this 'Mech was nothing more than a laughingstock when it was first released. It served as the basis for the more successful Mauler
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 装备 4 门"帝皇奶昔"AC/2、2 具"冬青"LRM-10 发射器和 2 门大型激光，这台机甲首次发布时不过是个笑柄。它成为后来更成功的重击者的基础

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Equiped with 4 Imperator Smoothie AC/2s, 2 Holly LRM-10 Launchers and 2 Large Lasers this 'Mech was nothing more than a laughingstock when it was first released. It served as the basis for the more successful Mauler
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 装备 4 门"帝皇奶昔"AC/2、2 具"冬青"LRM-10 发射器和 2 门大型激光，这台机甲首次发布时不过是个笑柄。它成为后来更成功的重击者的基础

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Daimyo is named for the title used for warlords from the medieval Japanese empire. The 'Mech, first produced in 3053, attempts to live up to the heritage of its name admirably. It is armed primarily for long range combat but can hold its own if the situation warrants it. The Daimyo's maximum speed of 86.4 kph and its Nissan 200 fusion engine make the Daimyo a rugged 'Mech that can survive an amazing amount of damage, while bringing the fight to the enemy.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 大名之名取自中世纪日本帝国对军阀的称号。该机甲于 3053 年首次生产，竭力不负其名的传承。它以远程战斗为主要武装，但必要时也能自保。大名 86.4 公里/小时的最高速度与日产 200 聚变引擎，使它成为一款坚固的机甲，能承受惊人的损伤并将战斗带到敌人面前。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The primary long range weapon on the Daimyo is a Lord's Light 2 ER PPC, which allows the 'Mech to strike at an enemy from extreme ranges. Once the 'Mech closes with its enemy, it is able to bring its close range arsenal to bear. This consists of two Victory 23R Medium Lasers, which are backed up by a Shannon SH-60 SRM-6 missile launcher.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 大名的主要远程武器是一门"主之光 2"ER PPC，使机甲能从极远距离打击敌人。一旦机甲接近敌人，它便能动用其近程武器库。这包括两门"胜利 23R"中型激光，由一具"香农 SH-60"SRM-6 导弹发射器支援。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Daimyo is named for the title used for warlords from the medieval Japanese empire. The 'Mech, first produced in 3053, attempts to live up to the heritage of its name admirably. It is armed primarily for long range combat but can hold its own if the situation warrants it. The Daimyo's maximum speed of 86.4 kph and its Nissan 200 fusion engine make the Daimyo a rugged 'Mech that can survive an amazing amount of damage, while bringing the fight to the enemy.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An attempt to make the Daimyo a cooler running 'Mech, the 2K variant removes the ER PPC and replaces it with an ER Large Laser and a double heat sink. While this does give the Daimyo a better heat profile, it also shortens the distance at which the Daimyo can strike an enemy.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 2K 变体试图让大名成为一台更凉的机甲，它移除 ER PPC，换成一门 ER 大型激光和一台双倍散热器。这确实改善了大名的热量曲线，但也缩短了大名打击敌人的距离。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Daimyo is named for the title used for warlords from the medieval Japanese empire. The 'Mech, first produced in 3053, attempts to live up to the heritage of its name admirably. It is armed primarily for long range combat but can hold its own if the situation warrants it. Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 4K variant of the Daimyo is also an attempt to modify the 'Mech to make it more heat efficient. This variant accomplishes this by removing the SRM-6 launcher and replacing it with an additional Medium Laser. The saved weight is used to add four more double heat sinks, making the Daimyos heat curve much more manageable.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 大名 4K 变体同样是为了让机甲更散热而进行的改装。此变体通过移除 SRM-6 发射器并换成一门额外中型激光来实现。节省的重量用于加装四台更多双倍散热器，使大名的热量曲线好驾驭得多。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Dart was built when the Federated Commonwealth was looking for BattleMechs that were not ammunition dependent. The 'Mech was built with an all energy weapon arsenal on an extremely high-speed chassis. The 'Mech is capable of speeds of up to 151 kph and is armored with three and a half tons of armor. The 'Mech, while lightly armed, is an exceptional recon 'Mech and also works well in a guerrilla force where its use of energy weapons allows it to operate independently.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 飞镖诞生于联邦联邦寻找不依赖弹药的机甲之时。它以全能量武器配置建立在极高速底盘上。机甲速度可达 151 公里/小时，并有三吨半装甲。虽然武器轻，飞镖却是出色的侦察机甲，在游击队中也很管用——能量武器让它能独立作战。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Dart is armed with three Magna 200P Small Pulse Lasers which do not have a long range but provide the Dart with highly accurate short range firepower.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 飞镖装备三门"玛格纳 200P"小型脉冲激光，射程不长，但为飞镖提供极为精准的近程火力。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Dart was built when the Federated Commonwealth was looking for BattleMechs that were not ammunition dependent. The 'Mech was built with an all energy weapon arsenal on an extremely high-speed chassis. The 'Mech is capable of speeds of up to 151 kph and is armored with three and a half tons of armor. The 'Mech, while lightly armed, is an exceptional recon 'Mech and also works well in a guerrilla force where its use of energy weapons allows it to operate independently.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 4S modifies the Dart in an attempt to add much needed firepower to the design without sacrificing the 'Mechs independence from ammunition. This is done by removing the three Small Pulse Lasers and replacing them with three Medium Lasers. While this reduces the 'Mech's accuracy, the range and damage profiles are both increased over the 3S model.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 4S 对飞镖进行改装，试图在不牺牲机甲弹药独立性的情况下为其增加急需的火力。它移除三门小型脉冲激光，换成三门中型激光。虽然这降低了机甲的精度，但相比 3S 型号，射程与伤害都得到提升。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Dart was built when the Federated Commonwealth was looking for BattleMechs that were not ammunition dependent. The 'Mech was built with an all energy weapon arsenal on an extremely high-speed chassis. The 'Mech is capable of speeds of up to 151 kph and is armored with three and a half tons of armor. The 'Mech, while lightly armed, is an exceptional recon 'Mech and also works well in a guerrilla force where its use of energy weapons allows it to operate independently.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 6S variant of the Dart increases both its firepower and armor protection. The 'Mech carries four and a half tons of Ferro-Fibrous armor. The 'Mech is armed with two Medium Lasers. Even with one less Medium Laser than the 4S model, the 6S brings more overall firepower to the field than the 3S.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 飞镖 6S 变体同时提升了火力与装甲防护。机甲携带四吨半铁纤维装甲。机甲装备两门中型激光。即便比 4S 型号少一门中型激光，6S 带来的战场总火力仍高于 3S。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Dervish carries as its main weapons two Federated 10-Shot LRM launchers. These missile launchers give the Dervish the long-range capability needed to provide fire support to friendly units and are safely embedded in the torso as opposed to the exposed launchers on other 'Mechs. A ton of ammunition per launcher provides sufficient endurance for any but the most prolonged battles. For close combat, the Dervish carries two Federated 2-Shot SRM launchers and two ChisComp 39 Medium Lasers. The SRM launchers are completely self-contained within the forearms, allowing them to be aimed quickly, and fed by a ton of ammunition each. The lasers are placed just above the launchers and ensure the 'Mech is still capable of fighting should it run out of missiles. The Dervish is capable of jumping 150 meters and is protected by seven and a half tons of armor.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 苦行僧以两具联邦 10 发 LRM 发射器为主武器。这些导弹发射器为苦行僧提供了向友军提供火力支援所需的远程能力，且安全嵌入躯干内，不像其他机甲那样外露。每具发射器一吨弹药，除最持久的战斗外足以支撑。近战方面，苦行僧携带两具联邦 2 发 SRM 发射器和两门 ChisComp 39 中型激光。SRM 发射器完全内嵌于前臂，可迅速瞄准，各由一吨弹药供弹。激光位于发射器正上方，确保机甲在导弹耗尽后仍能作战。苦行僧能跳 150 米，并由七吨半装甲保护。

A ton of ammunition per launcher provides sufficient endurance for any but the most prolonged battles. Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This Star League era variant uses an XL Engine, twelve single heat sinks, and upgrades the LRM-10s to LRM-15s. Three tons of ammunition are in a CASE protected torso bin.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 此星盟时代变体使用 XL 引擎、十二台单散热器，并将 LRM-10 升级为 LRM-15。三吨弹药存于有 C.A.S.E. 保护的躯干弹药箱中。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This Star League era variant uses an XL Engine, twelve single heat sinks, and upgrades the LRM-10s to LRM-15s. Three tons of ammunition are in a CASE protected torso bin.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 此星盟时代变体使用 XL 引擎、十二台单散热器，并将 LRM-10 升级为 LRM-15。三吨弹药存于有 C.A.S.E. 保护的躯干弹药箱中。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 7D Dervish is a 3047 upgrade of the design using Star League technology. The 'Mech is built with an Endo Steel chassis and also uses eight tons of Ferro-Fibrous armor with CASE for protection against ammunition explosions. With the saved weight, the SRM-2s have been upgraded to Federated SuperStreak SRMs and the 'Mech uses double heat sinks. This variant was first produced by Achernar BattleMechs on New Avalon.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 7D 苦行僧是 3047 年使用星盟技术对该设计的升级。机甲采用内骨骼底盘建造，并使用八吨铁纤维装甲及 C.A.S.E. 以防弹药爆炸。凭借节省的重量，SRM-2 升级为联邦超级连续 SRM，机甲也改用双倍散热器。此变体最初由新阿瓦隆上的阿克尔纳战斗机甲公司生产。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 7D Dervish is a 3047 upgrade of the design using Star League technology. The 'Mech is built with an Endo Steel chassis and also uses eight tons of Ferro-Fibrous armor with CASE for protection against ammunition explosions. With the saved weight, the SRM-2s have been upgraded to Federated SuperStreak SRMs and the 'Mech uses double heat sinks. This variant was first produced by Achernar BattleMechs on New Avalon.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 7P is a Medium Range Missile Boat, carrying an MRM-20 and MRM-10 in each arm, supported by a Medium Laser in each arm and side torso. Such a heavy loadout while retaining the Dervish's usual seven and half tons of armor and five jump jets is made possible with an 275 rated extralight engine and Endo Steel frame. The 7P is fitted with ten double heat sinks and carries a combined four tons of MRM reloads.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 7P 是一款中程导弹平台，每臂携带一具 MRM-20 和 MRM-10，由每臂及每侧躯干各一门中型激光支援。在保留苦行僧惯常的七吨半装甲和五个跳跃推进器的同时实现如此沉重的载荷，要归功于一台 275 额定超轻型引擎和内骨骼框架。7P 装有十台双倍散热器，并携带共四吨 MRM 再装填。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 7P is a Medium Range Missile Boat, carrying an MRM-20 and MRM-10 in each arm, supported by a Medium Laser in each arm and side torso. Such a heavy loadout while retaining the Dervish's usual seven and half tons of armor and five jump jets is made possible with an 275 rated extralight engine and Endo Steel frame. The 7P is fitted with ten double heat sinks and carries a combined four tons of MRM reloads.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Dervish IIC, a 55-ton Clan refit of the Star-League-era Dervish, was first seen in 3058 along the Smoke Jaguar front bordering the Draconis Combine. It has similar movement and jump capabilities to the original Dervish, but carries significantly more firepower.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 苦行僧 IIC 是星盟时代苦行僧的 55 吨氏族改装版，于 3058 年首次出现在烟虎氏族与德拉科尼斯联合体接壤的前线。它的移动与跳跃能力与原版苦行僧相似，但火力显著更强。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Dervish IIC, a 55-ton Clan refit of the Star-League-era Dervish, was first seen in 3058 along the Smoke Jaguar front bordering the Draconis Combine. It has similar movement and jump capabilities to the original Dervish, but carries significantly more firepower.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 苦行僧 IIC 是星盟时代苦行僧的 55 吨氏族改装版，于 3058 年首次出现在烟虎氏族与德拉科尼斯联合体接壤的前线。它的移动与跳跃能力与原版苦行僧相似，但火力显著更强。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Dire Wolf is one of the OmniMechs that became feared throughout the Inner Sphere during the initial Clan Invasion and rightly so. The Dire Wolf weighs in at an impressive one hundred tons and has a relatively slow cruising speed of 54 km/h provided by a 300 XL engine. Its speed and armor protection matches that of an Atlas, but it has superior potential firepower with fifty and a half tons of free pod space for weapons and equipment. It is these traits which saw the 'Mech christened Daishi (pseudo-Japanese for 'Great Death') by the criminal underbelly of the Draconis Combine, a name that would be proven grimly accurate time and time again.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 恐狼是氏族入侵初期令整个内天体闻之色变的全能机甲之一，实至名归。它重达惊人的一百吨，由 300 XL 引擎驱动，巡航速度相对缓慢，仅 54 公里/小时。它的速度与装甲防护与阿特拉斯相当，但凭借五十吨半的自由吊舱空间搭载武器与装备，拥有更强的火力潜力。正因如此，德拉科尼斯联合体的黑道将其命名为"大师"（伪日语"伟大的死亡"），而这名字一次又一次被证明冷酷地精准。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This Direwolf Commander is a piece of work by a nutcase clanner and I have seen many weird stuff. The madman or whoever designed this, must have been clearly out of his mind. Sacrificing everything for pure firepower this mech mounts 11 clan ERPPCs, that will instantly shut down your mech, if you try to alpha strike as well bringing lot of pain to the target. If the mech doesn't get destroyed while being shutdown it will definitely blow up by all the excess heat by firing all those PPCs.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这台"恐狼指挥官"是某个疯子氏族人的杰作，而我已经见过很多古怪的东西。这个疯子——或不管是谁设计的——显然完全失去了理智。为了纯粹的火力牺牲一切，这台机甲装了 11 门氏族 ER PPC，如果你试图齐射，它会立刻让你的机甲停机，同时给目标带来巨大痛苦。如果机甲在停机状态下没被摧毁，它也会因发射所有这些 PPC 产生的过量热量而爆炸。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The DRG-1C uses an AC2 instead of the more standard AC5.  This allows it to have extreme reach across the battlefield, but at a reduced damage rate.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: DRG-1C 使用一门 AC2 取代更标准的 AC5。这使它能在战场上拥有极远射程，但伤害率降低。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: I always had a soft spot for the DRG, it was one of the 'Mechs I first trained on.  Though it is a little bittersweet, as a hiccup in the controls caused me to lose my right foot.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我一直对 DRG 情有独钟，那是我最初受训时用的机甲之一。不过这有点苦乐参半，因为控制装置的一次故障让我失去了右脚。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Dragon 1N is a beefy machine that can take a serious beating but tends to be a bit light on weaponry. It moves fast for a heavy 'Mech, though, which makes it well suited to closing for Melee attacks against slower targets.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 大龙 1N 是一台结实的机器，能承受重击，但武器略显单薄。不过它作为重型机甲移动很快，这使它非常适合逼近较慢的目标进行近战。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Dragon 1R is a beefy machine that can take a serious beating, mounting twin Inferno SRMs to complement its CQC capabilities.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Once fielded in great numbers by the Smoke Jaguars, the Ebon Jaguar has proliferated to many of Kerensky's Clans, though some, like the Wolves, Jade Falcons and Coyotes, continue to field Hellbringers instead.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 黑玉美洲豹曾由烟虎氏族大量装备，如今已扩散至克伦斯基的众多氏族，不过狼、翡翠猎鹰与郊狼等氏族仍继续装备地狱使者。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The standard against which all battle armor is measured, the Elemental battle armor was first introduced in 2868 by Clan Wolf in a Trial of Possession against the Nova Cats. It was a marvel of Clan engineering that allowed a small group of operators to take down large 'Mechs and survive the encounter. While it is possible for a normal-sized human to use the battle armor, this design is tailored for the Clans' giant Elemental warriors and only they can bring out its fullest potential.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 元素战斗装甲是所有战斗装甲的衡量标准，由狼氏族于 2868 年在对抗诺瓦猫的占有试炼中首次推出。它是氏族工程的奇迹，能让一小队操作员击倒大型机甲并幸存下来。虽然普通体型的人也能使用这种战斗装甲，但该设计是为氏族巨人般的元素战士量身打造，唯有他们才能发挥其全部潜力。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Emperor is one of the earliest assault BattleMechs, dating back to 2502. The Emperor also bears the distinction of being the first 90+ ton BattleMech to mount jump jets (the famed Highlander began production in 2592).
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 皇帝是最早的突击战斗机甲之一，可追溯至 2502 年。它还享有另一项殊荣：首款装备跳跃推进器的 90 吨以上战斗机甲（著名的高地人于 2592 年开始生产）。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Emperor is one of the earliest assault BattleMechs, dating back to 2502. The Emperor also bears the distinction of being the first 90+ ton BattleMech to mount jump jets (the famed Highlander began production in 2592).
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 皇帝是最早的突击战斗机甲之一，可追溯至 2502 年。它还享有另一项殊荣：首款装备跳跃推进器的 90 吨以上战斗机甲（著名的高地人于 2592 年开始生产）。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Enfield was originally designed to replace the Wyvern as an urban combat 'Mech, but the design never made it to mass production. The plans for the Enfield were lost during the Succession Wars and were recovered by the Federated Suns on the world of Achernar in 2870. Knowledge of the design was kept hidden until the 3050s, when the NAIS selected the Enfield as a companion 'Mech to the Enforcer. The Enfield began production in 3055 and has seen heavy deployment to the Lyran Alliance because of the constant threat presented by the Clans. The 'Mech carries eleven tons of StarGuard III armor with CASE to protect against ammunition explosions. The Enfield is built on a Blackstone MD2E Endo Steel chassis and uses a Magna 250 XL engine which gives the 'Mech a top speed of 86.4 km/h to save weight, allowing it to carry a heavy arsenal. Due its extra-light engine, however, the 'Mech developed an undeserved reputation for being fragile in heavy combat.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 恩菲尔德最初旨在取代双足飞龙成为城市战斗机甲，但从未进入量产。其图纸在继承战争中遗失，2870 年由联邦太阳系在阿克尔纳星上寻回。该设计的知识一直被保密到 3050 年代，NAIS 选定恩菲尔德作为执法者的搭档机甲。恩菲尔德于 3055 年开始生产，因氏族的持续威胁而在莱兰联盟大量部署。机甲携带十一吨星卫 III 装甲并配 C.A.S.E. 以防弹药爆炸。恩菲尔德建立在黑石 MD2E 内骨骼底盘上，使用玛格纳 250 XL 引擎，最高速度 86.4 公里/小时，以节省重量从而搭载重型武器库。然而由于使用超轻型引擎，它在激烈战斗中落下了"脆弱"的冤枉名声。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 6J variant of the Enfield removes the Small Laser from the 'Mech and exchanges the Large Pulse Laser for a Large Laser. The saved weight is used to add five jump jets, allowing the Enfield to jump up to one hundred and fifty meters. This variant of the Enfield is very reliable, and although it loses some firepower and accuracy in the Large Laser, the addition of the jump jets gives it a high degree of mobility and survivability.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 英菲尔德的 6J 变体移除机甲上的小型激光，并把大型脉冲激光换成大型激光。节省的重量用于加装五个跳跃推进器，使英菲尔德能跳起至一百五十米。英菲尔德此变体非常可靠，虽然大型激光损失了一些火力与精度，但跳跃推进器的加入赋予它高度机动性与生存性。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Enfield was originally designed to replace the Wyvern as an urban combat 'Mech, but the design never made it to mass production. The plans for the Enfield were lost during the Succession Wars and were recovered by the Federated Suns on the world of Achernar in 2870. Knowledge of the design was kept hidden until the 3050s, when the NAIS selected the Enfield as a companion 'Mech to the Enforcer. The Enfield began production in 3055 and has seen heavy deployment to the Lyran Alliance because of the constant threat presented by the Clans. The 'Mech carries eleven tons of StarGuard III armor with CASE to protect against ammunition explosions. The Enfield is built on a Blackstone MD2E Endo Steel chassis and uses a Magna 250 XL engine which gives the 'Mech a top speed of 86.4 km/h to save weight, allowing it to carry a heavy arsenal. Due its extra-light engine, however, the 'Mech developed an undeserved reputation for being fragile in heavy combat.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 恩菲尔德最初旨在取代双足飞龙成为城市战斗机甲，但从未进入量产。其图纸在继承战争中遗失，2870 年由联邦太阳系在阿克尔纳星上寻回。该设计的知识一直被保密到 3050 年代，NAIS 选定恩菲尔德作为执法者的搭档机甲。恩菲尔德于 3055 年开始生产，因氏族的持续威胁而在莱兰联盟大量部署。机甲携带十一吨星卫 III 装甲并配 C.A.S.E. 以防弹药爆炸。恩菲尔德建立在黑石 MD2E 内骨骼底盘上，使用玛格纳 250 XL 引擎，最高速度 86.4 公里/小时，以节省重量从而搭载重型武器库。然而由于使用超轻型引擎，它在激烈战斗中落下了"脆弱"的冤枉名声。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Enfield carries a Defiance Disintegrator LB-X Autocannon/10 as its primary weapon. This weapon can fire both solid and cluster ammunition, making it a highly effective anti-aircraft weapon. For close combat, the Enfield has a Thunderbolt-12 Large Pulse Laser, two Defiance B3M Medium Lasers, and a ChisComp 32 Small Laser.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 英菲尔德以一门"迪法恩斯粉碎者"LB-X 自动炮/10 为主武器。该武器可发射实心弹与集束弹，使它成为极为有效的防空武器。近战方面，英菲尔德有一门"雷霆-12"大型脉冲激光、两门"迪法恩斯 B3M"中型激光和一门 ChisComp 32 小型激光。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The precursor to the Enforcer 4R, the 3R models originally mounted twin Medium Lasers in the left arm along with 2 extra Heat Sinks to help the 'Mech dissipate heat.  It was also slightly better protected, as it had an additional ton of armor.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为执法者 4R 的前身，3R 型号最初在左臂装双联中型激光，并配 2 台额外散热器帮助机甲散热。它的防护也略好，因为多了一吨装甲。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The old 3R didn't see much action, as it was quickly supplanted by the 4R model.  But, I don't think it is all that bad, especially in a close in or city fight situation.  Though I think most pilots will miss the extra long distance punch of the Large Laser.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 老式 3R 服役时间不长，很快就被 4R 型号取代。不过我觉得它并不那么差，尤其在近距或城市战情境中。只是我想大多数飞行员会怀念大型激光那份额外的远距离打击力。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Enforcer 4R models combine the hefty power of an Autocannon and massive Laser with the mobility of Jump Jets, a deadly combination. Able to engage at medium-long all the way to point-blank range, these 'Mechs are flexible and surprising in combat.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 执法者 4R 型号把自动炮与巨型激光的沉重威力与跳跃推进器的机动性结合起来，是致命的组合。它能在中远距离一直到抵近射击的交战，这些机甲在战斗中灵活而令人意外。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: First walking off the production line in late 3050, the 5D Enforcer is a major upgrade to the standard 'Mech, meeting many of its pilots' desire for something faster, better-protected and with more endurance. The Nissan 200 engine has been removed and replaced with a Magna 250 Extralight Engine, increasing the Enforcer's top speed to 86.4 km/h and the amount of space available for other additions. The armor has been stripped from the 'Mech and replaced with StarGuard CIV Ferro-Fibrous armor with CASE to protect against an ammunition explosion while the weapons payload has also been changed. Retaining the small laser both the Autocannon/10 and the Large Laser were replaced for a new Mydron Excel LB-X Autocannon/10, fed by two tons of ammunition, and a BlazeFire Sweetshot ER Large Laser. Finally, an additional jump jet was added, increasing the jumping distance by thirty meters to keep up with the Enforcer's new speed profile.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 5D 执法者于 3050 年末首次下线，是标准机甲的重大升级，满足了许多飞行员对更快、防护更好、续航更久的需求。日产 200 引擎被移除，换成玛格纳 250 超轻型引擎，将执法者最高速度提升至 86.4 公里/小时，并腾出更多空间用于其他加装。装甲被剥离，改为星卫 CIV 铁纤维装甲并配 C.A.S.E. 以防弹药爆炸，武器配置也作了更改。保留小型激光的同时，自动炮/10 和大型激光换成一门迈德龙 Excel LB-X 自动炮/10（由两吨弹药供弹）和一门烈焰"甜射"ER 大型激光。最后加装一个跳跃推进器，使跳跃距离增加三十米，以跟上执法者新的速度曲线。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Executioner A reduces the overall engagement ranges compared to its PRIME variant by dropping the Gauss Rifle and replacing it with a massive collection of Large Pulse Lasers, backed up by four ERML's. This variant is the nightmare for every light mech out there.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 与主型号相比，行刑者 A 缩短了总体交战距离：它去掉高斯步枪，换成一大批大型脉冲激光，辅以四门 ER 中型激光。此变体是外面所有轻型机甲的噩梦。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Jack-of-all-trades variant. The Executioner B is set up to be effective in all ranges the battlefield can offer. With an ERPPC for extreme and long ranges and an absolutely devastating UAC/20 for closer range brackets, the B just executes its foes by brute force. Advanced targeting systems will make sure that there is nowhere to run...nowhere to hide.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 样样通吃的变体。行刑者 B 被设定为在战场能提供的所有射程上都有效。极端与远程有 ER PPC，较近射程则有绝对毁灭性的 UAC/20，B 以蛮力处决它的敌人。先进瞄准系统确保无处可逃……无处可藏。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Sometimes you just need to lob some missiles at them. The Executioner C trades direct hit firepower of its sister variants for a set of Artemis IV guided Long Range Missiles. But for everyone who believes to be able to sneak up on this monster: be warned it still fields the massive close range punch in form of an UAC/20.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 有时你就是需要朝他们甩几发导弹。行刑者 C 以一套 Artemis IV 制导远程导弹取代其姊妹变体的直击火力。但要提醒所有以为能偷偷接近这头怪物的人：它仍然以 UAC/20 的形式保留着庞大的近距离打击力。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Fast, precise, deadly. The Executioner D(isco) makes use of its phenomenal agility to close in on its enemies...just to unleash a hell of fire on them in form of pulse lasers in all colors and sizes. LPL, MPL, SPL ... you name it, the EXE-D has it. Pilots be warned though, you better bring som chilled drinks as this one is running HOT!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 快速、精准、致命。行刑者 D(isco) 利用其惊人的敏捷逼近敌人……只为以各种颜色和尺寸的脉冲激光向它们倾泻地狱之火。LPL、MPL、SPL……你点得出来的，EXE-D 都有。不过警告飞行员们：最好带上冰镇饮料，因为这玩意儿热得发烫！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: In a logical step up from other, earlier variants the Executioner E sticks with the idea of being effective and deadly at all ranges. ERLLs and ATMs will grant massive firepower at long and medium ranges while a bunch of Heavy Medium and Heavy Small Lasers will grant close perimeter defense...or the bit of extra damage to finish an already damaged oponent.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 行刑者 E 是对其他早期变体的合理升级，坚持在所有距离上都有效而致命。ER 大型激光和 ATM 将在远距离与中距离提供巨量火力，而一批重型中型激光和重型小型激光将提供近距离环形防御…或者用于给已受损对手补上那一点额外伤害。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Fast and powerful, the Executioner, known as the Gladiator in the Inner Sphere, is an assault OmniMech developed by Clan Ghost Bear. As one of the fastest assault mechs available, the Executioner surprises its prey by being able to alter the engagement ranges way quicker than expected from a mech of this weight. The Executioner PRIME uses its speed to stay at distance to make full use of its long range weaponry.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 行刑者快速而强大，在内天体被称为角斗士，是由鬼熊氏族开发的突击全能机甲。作为可用的最快突击机甲之一，行刑者能比人们对该重量机甲的预期更快地改变交战距离，从而突袭猎物。行刑者主型号利用其速度保持距离，以充分发挥远程武器的威力。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Inner Sphere Standard was developed following the initial thrust of the Clan invasion, as Inner Sphere powers rushed to duplicate the battle armor technology the Clans fielded. Lacking any battlefield salvage on which to base their development though, engineers were forced to work off of ancient rumors of early power armor suits like the Nighthawk, more akin to armored Exoskeletons than the 'Toads' currently rampaging through known space, and these prototypes fared poorly during testing. It took salvage from the first victories over the Clans to truly kick-start the development of battle armor. The New Avalon Institute of Science was the first to reproduce in part the Clans' Elemental armor as the Inner Sphere Standard.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 内天体标准型是在氏族入侵首轮攻势后开发的，当时内天体各势力竞相复制氏族装备的战斗装甲技术。然而由于缺乏战场缴获作为研发基础，工程师们只能依据"夜鹰"等早期动力装甲的古老传闻着手——它们与其说是当前肆虐已知空间的"蟾蜍"式装甲，更像是带装甲的外骨骼。这些原型在测试中表现糟糕。直到从对氏族的首次胜利中获得缴获品，战斗装甲的研发才真正起步。新阿瓦隆科学研究院率先部分复制了氏族的元素战士装甲，即内天体标准型。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Exterminator is a BattleMech that was designed in 2630 for the most dubious, but necessary, of purposes: Headhunting. Advanced systems allowed it to easily infiltrate enemy lines. Once the Exterminator had breached the enemy's rear, its mission was to find and destroy as much of the enemy's command structure as possible. This mission profile included attacking Mobile Headquarters, field bases and command level officers. Rather than be part of the standard formation, Exterminators were attached to a regimental or higher headquarters unit, often as a fifth member of the command lance itself, before being assigned to individual units.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 灭绝者在 2630 年设计，用途最可疑却也最必要：猎杀指挥官。先进系统使它易于渗透敌线。一旦突入敌后，灭绝者的任务就是尽可能多地寻找并摧毁敌方指挥体系，包括攻击机动指挥部、野战基地和指挥级军官。灭绝者不编入标准编制，而是配属团级或更高指挥部，往往是指挥连的第五名成员，然后才被分配至具体单位。

The 4Db was the most guarded secret of the SLDF, combining even more advanced Electronics with a Chameleon Light Polarization shield, giving it unparalleled stealth capabilities.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Originally developed as an anti-infantry and Bug Hunter 'Mech, the Falcon is a highly popular light recon and skirmisher 'Mech. Initially created for the newly formed Star League Defense Force's use in the Reunification War, the popular design remained in production until the destruction of Stormvanger's Hesperus II Falcon line during the Third Battle of Hesperus II in 2789, becoming all but extinct until the arrival of Wolf's Dragoonsin 3005. Well regarded by the mercenaries, the Dragoons upgraded their dwindling number of Falcons in the early 3050s before eventually commissioning Blackwell Industries to restart production of the design in early 3060 to produce advanced Clan-tech versions for their exclusive use, as well as more mundane and affordable versions for the general mercenary market. While originally sporting a weapons array similar to the Locust, Stinger and Waspit was charged to defeat, the Falcon's six tons of StarGuard Type II armor provided it with vastly superior protection, allowing it to outlast them and remain combat effective longer. When it was originally developed, the 'Mech's top speed of 97.2 kph and a jumping distance of one hundred and fifty meters allowed it to keep up with other light recon 'Mechs. But by the 3060s the Falconwas outclassed by newer and faster designs, only its use of a cheaper standard Fusion Engine rather than a more expensive and fragile Light or XL Engine kept buyers interested.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 猎鹰最初是作为反步兵与"猎虫者"机甲开发的，是一款极受欢迎的轻型侦察与游骑机甲。它最初为新成立的星盟防卫军用于统一战争而制造，这款广受欢迎的机型一直生产到 2789 年第三次赫斯佩鲁斯 II 战役中斯托姆万格的赫斯佩鲁斯 II 猎鹰生产线被毁，此后几乎灭绝，直到 3005 年狼之龙骑兵到来。这支佣兵团对它评价甚高，于 3050 年代初升级了日益减少的猎鹰，最终在 3060 年代初委托布莱克威尔工业重启生产，为其独家生产先进的氏族科技版本，也为普通佣兵市场提供更朴素实惠的版本。猎鹰原本的武器配置与其要击败的蝗虫、毒刺和黄蜂相似，但其六吨星卫 II 型装甲提供了远为优越的防护，使其能比对手更持久、更久地保持战斗力。初研制时，它 97.2 公里/小时的最高速度和一百五十米的跳跃距离使其能跟上其他轻型侦察机甲。但到 3060 年代，猎鹰已被更新更快的设计超越，唯有其使用较便宜的标配聚变引擎而非更昂贵脆弱的轻型或 XL 引擎，才让买家保持兴趣。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The original Falcon designed in 2582, the 4N model has a lighter arsenal more akin to 'Mechs 10 tons lighter. The primary weapon is a SunGlow Type 1 Medium Laser with two Omnicron 1000 Small Lasers as secondary weapons. To deter infantry attacks, the 'Mech carries two rear mounted Reginald Mark VI Machine Guns with a shared single ton of ammo. The 4N was equipped with a Garret T20C communications system and a Dynatec 150A targeting and tracking system.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 4N 型号是 2582 年设计的原版猎鹰，武器较轻，更像轻 10 吨的机甲。主武器是一门"阳光 1 型"中型激光，次要武器为两门奥米克戎 1000 小型激光。为威慑步兵攻击，机甲携带两挺后向"雷金纳德 Mark VI"机枪，共用一吨弹药。4N 装备加勒特 T20C 通讯系统和 Dynatec 150A 瞄准追踪系统。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Built for the Royal SLDF Divisions at the captured Roe Weapon Systemsplant on Apollo during the Amaris Civil War, the so-called Royal Falconcarried an experimental Parti-Kill Snub-Nose PPC backed up by two medium lasers. It was also equipped with double heat-sinks, and was built on a Duralyte 300 Endo-Steel chassis. All known examples and design specs were taken with the Exodus Fleet.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这款所谓的皇家隼在阿马里斯内战期间于阿波罗缴获的罗伊武器系统工厂为星盟防卫军皇家师建造，携带一门实验性"党杀"短管 PPC，辅以两门中型激光。它还装双倍散热器，基于"杜拉莱特 300"内骨骼底盘建造。所有已知样机与设计规格都随出埃及舰队一同离去。
