Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Originally developed as a field upgrade before becoming Blackwell's standard production model, the 4P Falcon carries a light arsenal that is primarily based around energy weapons. While the two Omnicron 1000 Small Lasers were retained, the original standard Medium Laser was swapped for a short-ranged but highly accurate Magna 400P Medium Pulse Laser. Finally, for protection from missiles, the rear-facing machine guns were dropped for a forward facing Sure Fire 444 Anti-Missile System and a single ton of ammunition.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 4P 猎鹰最初是作为野战升级开发的，后来成为布莱克韦尔的标准量产型号，它携带一套主要基于能量武器的轻型武器。它保留两门奥米克戎 1000 小型激光，但原有的标准中型激光被换成射程较短却极为精准的玛格纳 400P 中型脉冲激光。最后，为防御导弹，后向机枪被拆掉，换成一具前向"必火 444"反导系统和一吨弹药。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Fireball was a quick response BattleMech built as a direct result of the Clans' Elemental infantry. As the Clans swept through the Inner Sphere, members of the Armed Forces of the Federated Commonwealth met with scientists from the New Avalon Institute of Science to discuss, among other things, how to counter their new Battle Armored foes. The result was a 'Mech which on paper met many of the criteria for successfully dealing with Elementals: it had weapons with a high rate-of-fire for taking on swarms of Toads as they were known, had ammunition stores to maintain that rate for extended periods, and an extremely high speed so it could quickly come to the aid of heavier units. These Fireballs were given to units with prior experience fighting the Clans but assigned to rookie pilots, partly because the 'Mech's capabilities fit the personality of many of these new Mechwarriors, partly to more quickly build up their combat experience. The Crucis Lancers, Deneb Light Cavalry and Ceti Hussars were the first regiments to receive these 'Mechs in 3053, employing them immediately on the front lines as raiding along the border between the Inner Sphere and Occupation Zones commenced following the Truce of Tukayyid.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 火球是为直接应对氏族元素步兵而建造的快速反应战斗机甲。当氏族席卷内天体时，联邦联邦武装部队成员与新阿瓦隆科学研究院的科学家会面，讨论如何对抗这些新的战斗装甲敌人等问题。成果是一款在纸面上满足成功应对元素战士多项标准的机甲：它拥有高射速武器以对付成群的"蟾蜍"，有足以长时间维持该射速的弹药储备，以及极高的速度以便迅速支援较重的单位。这些火球被分配给有对抗氏族经验但机师为新手的部队，部分原因是机甲的特性契合许多新机甲战士的性格，部分原因是为了更快积累他们的实战经验。克鲁西斯枪骑兵、德内布轻骑兵和塞提骠骑兵是 3053 年首批接收这些机甲的团，图卡伊德休战协定后内天体与占领区边境的袭扰战开始，它们立即被投入前线。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Fireball is built around a massive 5-ton DAV 220 extra light fusion engine, which propels the 'Mech to a cruising speed of 119 km/h and top speed of 184 km/h, allowing it to respond to a call from anywhere in the line for immediate support. The high speed of the Fireball comes at a price though, as the 'Mech only has four tons of armor protection and a very light weapons array. A Hovertec Streak SRM-2 serves as its primary weapon, giving it highly accurate short-range firepower. The launcher is mounted over the left shoulder along with one ton of reloads. The 'Mech is also armed with a LFN Lindblad Machine Gun for anti-infantry combat, carried over the right shoulder with one ton of ammunition. Aiming these weapons is the Corean B-Tech Targeting-Tracking System, a proven component chosen because of previous battlefield experience and because it was manufactured on New Avalon as well, cutting down on shipping time.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 火球围绕一台巨大的 5 吨 DAV 220 超轻型聚变引擎建造，推动机甲达到 119 公里/小时的巡航速度和 184 公里/小时的最高速度，使其能响应战线任何地方的召唤立即支援。但火球的高速也带来代价，机甲只有四吨装甲防护和极轻的武器阵列。一具"气垫"连续 SRM-2 是其主武器，赋予它极为精准的近程火力。发射器装在左肩上方，配一吨再装填。机甲还装备一挺 LFN 林德布拉德机枪用于反步兵作战，位于右肩上方，配一吨弹药。为这些武器瞄准的是"科里安 B-Tech"瞄准追踪系统——这一经过验证的组件之所以被选中，既因为过往的实战经验，也因为它同样在新阿瓦隆制造，缩短了运输时间。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 8D variant of the Fireball released in 3054 was built with the hope of reducing the Fireballs ammunition dependence as well as increasing its firepower. This is done by removing the Streak launcher and replacing it with two Medium Lasers, vastly increasing the raw firepower of the Fireball. The 'Mech has also received an additional half ton of armor.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 3054 年发布的火球 8D 变体，其建造初衷是降低火球对弹药的依赖并提升火力。它移除连续发射器，换成两门中型激光，大幅提升火球的原始火力。机甲还多获得半吨装甲。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Fireball was a quick response BattleMech built as a direct result of the Clans' Elemental infantry. As the Clans swept through the Inner Sphere, members of the Armed Forces of the Federated Commonwealth met with scientists from the New Avalon Institute of Science to discuss, among other things, how to counter their new Battle Armored foes. The result was a 'Mech which on paper met many of the criteria for successfully dealing with Elementals: it had weapons with a high rate-of-fire for taking on swarms of Toads as they were known, had ammunition stores to maintain that rate for extended periods, and an extremely high speed so it could quickly come to the aid of heavier units. These Fireballs were given to units with prior experience fighting the Clans but assigned to rookie pilots, partly because the 'Mech's capabilities fit the personality of many of these new Mechwarriors, partly to more quickly build up their combat experience. The Crucis Lancers, Deneb Light Cavalry and Ceti Hussars were the first regiments to receive these 'Mechs in 3053, employing them immediately on the front lines as raiding along the border between the Inner Sphere and Occupation Zones commenced following the Truce of Tukayyid.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 9D is a compromise between the 7D and 8D models. Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The original Firestarter model, the FS9-A used Small Lasers instead of Machine Guns and mounted an extra ton of armor.  This caused some heat issues and led to the development of the more familiar FS9-H, with its Machine Guns.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Originally designed as a companion model for the Firestarter FS9-H, the FS9-K has proved popular in its own right with the Large Laser giving the FS9-K the reach that its companion lacked.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Nicknamed the Mirage, the FS9-M was a late Succession Wars attempt to turn the Firestarter into a frontline 'Mech by swapping out the Flamers for Small Lasers, adding a Heat Sink and adding armor.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: FS9-M 绰号"幻影"，是继承战争晚期把火焰使者改造成前线机甲的尝试：它以小型激光替换火焰喷射器，加装一台散热器并增加装甲。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Not a bad conversion of the original, with the increased firepower and armor allowing it to act as a Scout Hunter.  You really don't see many of these around, guess that is why they are called the Mirage.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 原版的改装相当不错，增加的火力与装甲使它成为侦察猎手。你真的很少见到这种机甲，我想这就是它被称为"幻影"的原因。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The FS9-S is an overhaul of the FS9-H introduced in 3049. The structure has been upgraded to use an Endo Steel chassis. The weapons carried are four flamers, two medium lasers, and a single small laser. An Anti-Missile System with one ton of ammo has been added to protect against missile attacks, and a Beagle Active Probe has been installed to enhance the Firestarter's scouting role.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: FS9-S 是 3049 年推出的 FS9-H 全面翻修版。结构升级为内骨骼底盘。武器为四具火焰喷射器、两门中型激光和一门小型激光。加装一套反导系统（配一吨弹药）以防导弹攻击，并安装比格犬主动探测器以增强火焰使者的侦察作用。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Firestarter A carries, as its primary weapon, an LB-X Autocannon/10 that allows the 'Mech to work in an anti-aircraft or vehicle hunting role. As a secondary weapon in the A configuration, the 'Mech carries a Small Laser and retains two Flamers for anti-personnel combat.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Configured as a close combat and spotting 'Mech, the Firestarter B carries, as its primary weapon, a Large Pulse Laser, which is backed up by a pair of Medium Pulse Lasers and a Small Laser. The 'Mech also carries two Flamers to deter infantry attacks and also allow the 'Mech to start fires for cover. The centerpiece of the B configuration is its electronics package, which consists of a TAG spotting laser for directing artillery fire and a C3 Slave unit that allows the Firestarter to share targeting data with allied units.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Intended as a long-range fire support configuration, the Firestarter C carries a pair of LRM-10 launchers. The 'Mech has two Flamers and a Small Laser for close combat. Additionally, a C3 Slave Unit is carried so that the Firestarter C can benefit from sharing targeting data with allied units.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The D configuration is intended for long-range direct fire support and sniping. This is done by using an ER PPC as its primary weapon. Backing this up is an LRM-5 launcher, a Medium Laser, and two Flamers for direct fire support. The D Configuration carries a Guardian ECM Suite to protect itself from an enemy's electronic warfare equipment. The 'Mech also carries a C3 Slave Unit.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The E configuration of the Firestarter is intended for close combat and carries as its primary weapon an MRM-20 launcher. This is backed up by a Medium Pulse Laser, a Small Pulse Laser, and two Flamers. A Sword provides superb accuracy in melee combat situations.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Ultimately overcoming a somewhat politically troubled birth, the OmniMech Firestarter has proven to be an highly effective and flexible design, with the Combine using it to replace other aging medium-weight workhorses such as the Phoenix Hawk
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 全面型火焰使者最终克服了诞生时的政治波折，被证明是一款高效灵活的设计，联合体用它替代了凤凰鹰等老化的中量级主力机甲

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: In its primary configuration the Firestarter is built to stay at long ranges when facing an enemy. The primary weapons are a pair of Large Lasers. The Large Lasers provide the 'Mech with respectable long-range firepower. To allow the 'Mech to create cover for itself and to clear woods, the Firestarter Prime carries two extra flamers on top of its fixed pair, bringing the total to four. Finally, to allow the 'Mech to search out hidden units, the Prime carries a Beagle Active Probe.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 主配置中，火焰使者被设计为面对敌人时保持远程。主武器为一对大型激光。这两门大型激光为机甲提供可观的远程火力。为让机甲能为自己制造掩护并清除林地，火焰使者主型号在固定的一对之外另装两具火焰喷射器，共四具。最后，为让机甲能搜寻隐藏单位，主型号携带一具比格犬主动探测器。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A field upgrade developed in the midst of Operation Bulldog, this configuration utilized captured Clan Smoke Jaguar weapons to help bolster the SLDF forces in later waves, mounting an Artemis IV FCS-enhanced Clan LRM-10 and a pair of Clan-tech ER Large Lasers.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 此配置是"斗牛犬"行动期间开发的野战升级，利用缴获的烟虎氏族武器支援后续波次的星盟防卫军部队，装备一具 Artemis IV 火控系统增强的氏族 LRM-10 和一对氏族技术 ER 大型激光。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 全面型火焰使者最终克服了诞生时的政治波折，被证明是一款高效灵活的设计，联合体用它替代了凤凰鹰等老化的中量级主力机甲

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This version carries several experimental systems. Reminiscent of the Firestarter H, it's equipped with an Angel ECM Suite and Bloodhound Active Probe. It carries the twin center torso Flamers common to all Firestarter variants, and augments them with a Streak SRM-2 and a Large X-Pulse Laser.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 此版本携带若干实验性系统。它让人想起火焰使者 H，装备天使 ECM 套件和猎犬主动探测器。它携带所有火焰使者变体通用的中央躯干双联火焰喷射器，并以一具连续 SRM-2 和一门大型 X 脉冲激光加以增强。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Entering production in 2519 the FLE-14 Flea was an attempt to create an ultra-light BattleMech. Weighing a mere fifteen tons, it could arguably be regarded as a different 'Mech design than the true Flea. It was capable of a maximum ground speed of nearly 150km/h with a 120 meter jump capability. Its weapons and armor however were very light: Only one ton of armor protected the unit, and the single Medium Laser mounted in the right arm was barely enough to make it a viable battlefield unit.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: FLE-14 跳蚤于 2519 年投产，是打造超轻型战斗机甲的一次尝试。它仅重十五吨，可以说算得上是与真正的跳蚤不同的一款机甲设计。它能达到近 150 公里/小时的最大地面速度，跳跃能力 120 米。然而其武器与装甲都极轻：只有一吨装甲保护该单位，右臂上那门孤零零的中型激光勉强使它成为可用的战场单位。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An expensive mech that is good against other 20 ton mechs and infantry but not able to stand up to any major threat from larger mechs.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一台昂贵的机甲，对付其他 20 吨机甲和步兵不错，但无力抵御更大机甲的任何重大威胁。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Flea has a good weapon loadout to use against other smaller light mechs but man I would not want to be caught in one, just like a Locust, not a lot of protection.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 跳蚤有不错的武器配置用于对付其他较小的轻型机甲，但老天，我可不想被逮在里面——就像蝗虫一样，防护不多。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Built as part of the Wolf's Dragoons exclusive contract with Earthwerks Incorporated to replenish the Dragoon's losses at the end of the Fourth Succession War, alongside renewed production of original Fleas, the FLE-16 was the first new production model of the extremely rare 'Mech in centuries. The variant remedied the earlier FLE-14's weaknesses by combining incredible speed with additional armor and weaponry on a 20 ton chassis. The engine was upgraded to a GM 180 in order to reach a similar maximum ground speed of nearly 150 km/h. It mounts two Medium Lasers and an Flamer while retaining an armor profile like the earlier FLE-15.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: FLE-16 是作为狼之龙骑兵与地球工厂公司独家合同的一部分而建造的，该合同旨在第四次继承战争结束时补充龙骑兵的损失，与重新生产的原版跳蚤一同问世，是这款极为稀有机甲数世纪以来首个新量产型号。此变体通过在 20 吨底盘上结合惊人的速度与额外的装甲和武器，弥补了早期 FLE-14 的弱点。引擎升级为 GM 180，以达到近 150 公里/小时的相近最高地面速度。它装有两门中型激光和一具火焰喷射器，同时保留与早期 FLE-15 相似的装甲配置。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Built as part of the Wolf's Dragoons exclusive contract with Earthwerks Incorporated to replenish the Dragoon's losses at the end of the Fourth Succession War, alongside renewed production of original Fleas, the FLE-16 was the first new production model of the extremely rare 'Mech in centuries. Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Originally produced exclusively for the Dragoons until the Capellan Confederation acquired the design's blueprints via a Maskirovka raid during the 3040s, the post-Helm Memory Core FLE-17 variant is based on the older FLE-15 model. Since the Dragoons used the Flea in a recon role more than an antipersonnel 'Mech, Earthwerks conceived a new design by incorporating recovered technology. Retaining the design's maximum speed of 97.2 km/h, the addition of an Endo Steelchassis frees up weight for a MASC system that allows the 'Mech's speed to be pushed up to 129.6 km/h in short bursts. The increase of speed is required to ensure survival on the modern battlefield, as the FLE-17 is only clad in a pitiful three tons of Livingston Ceramics armor plating.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该设计最初专为龙骑兵生产，直到卡佩兰邦联在 3040 年代通过一次马斯克罗夫卡突袭获得其图纸。赫尔姆记忆核心之后的 FLE-17 变体以较老的 FLE-15 型号为基础。由于龙骑兵更多将跳蚤用作侦察而非反人员机甲，地球工厂通过融入回收技术构想出新设计。在保持 97.2 公里/小时最高速度的同时，加装内骨骼底盘腾出重量用于 MASC 系统，使机甲速度可在短促爆发中推至 129.6 公里/小时。速度的提升是确保在现代战场生存所必需的，因为 FLE-17 仅披着可怜的三吨利文斯顿陶瓷装甲。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A very light sniper mech with a very big laser but cannot take a hit.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 极轻型狙击机甲，装备超大型激光但不堪一击。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This Flea is a glass cannon with a large laser and no armor, so better keep it away from the direct combat or I'll be rebuilding it and we will saying good-bye to whoever you assigned to pilot it.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这台跳蚤是门玻璃大炮，一门大型激光、毫无装甲，所以最好让它远离直接战斗，否则我就得重建它，而我们就得跟被派去驾驶它的人告别了。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Franky is a typical periphery Frankenmech sporting a weird array of weaponry and being cobbled together from many different MechParts
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 弗兰基是典型的外围区拼装机甲，装备着奇异的武器组合，由许多不同机甲零件拼凑而成

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Born from the Terran Hegemony's attempts to create a medium fire-support platform that would be more advanced than the RLN-1N Rifleman, Mitchell Vehicles unveiled the GLH-1D Galahad in 2570. Though it outgunned the earlier design and found significant acceptance within the Hegemony Armed Forces, the Galahad suffered from the same heat issues as the BattleMech it was meant to replace. This variant uses the original 50 ton mech weapon loadout.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 源自地球霸权打造比 RLN-1N 步枪手更先进的中型火力支援平台的尝试，米切尔车辆于 2570 年推出 GLH-1D 加拉哈德。虽然它的火力强于先前设计并在霸权武装部队中获得相当认可，但加拉哈德同样受制于它本该取代的那款机甲的热量问题。此变体使用原本 50 吨机甲的武器配置。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Born from the Terran Hegemony's attempts to create a medium fire-support platform that would be more advanced than the RLN-1N Rifleman, Mitchell Vehicles unveiled the GLH-1D Galahad in 2570. Though it outgunned the earlier design and found significant acceptance within the Hegemony Armed Forces, the Galahad suffered from the same heat issues as the BattleMech it was meant to replace. This variant uses the original 50 ton mech weapon loadout.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Born from the Terran Hegemony's attempts to create a medium fire-support platform that would be more advanced than the RLN-1N Rifleman, Mitchell Vehicles unveiled the GLH-1D Galahad in 2570. Though it outgunned the earlier design and found significant acceptance within the Hegemony Armed Forces, the Galahad suffered from the same heat issues as the BattleMech it was meant to replace. With the development of the new Gauss Rifle, Mitchell Vehicles decided in 2594 to redesign the Galahad around these new weapons. The Galahad utilizes special building materials in the form of eleven tons of Ferro-Fibrous armor and Endo Steel internals. To fit the massive weapons on the Galahad, the engine was dropped to a GM 180, giving it a maximum speed of only 54 km/h, making it difficult for the 'Mech to keep up with its companions in most cases. The GLH-2D carries two massive M-7 Gauss Rifles, with two tons of ammo for each rifle. It was a showing of the powerful new weapons at the time and earned it the nickname of Gausszilla.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 源自地球霸权打造比 RLN-1N 步枪手更先进的中型火力支援平台的尝试，米切尔车辆于 2570 年推出 GLH-1D 加拉哈德。虽然它的火力强于先前设计并在霸权武装部队中获得相当认可，但加拉哈德同样受制于它本该取代的那款机甲的热量问题。随着新型高斯步枪的发展，米切尔车辆于 2594 年决定围绕这些新武器重新设计加拉哈德。它采用特殊建造材料：十一吨铁纤维装甲与内骨骼内部结构。为在加拉哈德上装下这些巨型武器，引擎降至 GM 180，最高速度仅 54 公里/小时，使机甲在多数情况下难以跟上同伴。GLH-2D 携带两门巨型 M-7 高斯步枪，每门配两吨弹药。它在当时展示了这种强大的新武器，并为它赢得"高斯斯拉"的绰号。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Also an effective all around 'Mech, the A configuration ups the firepower with two ER PPCs as its primary long-range weapons. These are supported by a Large Pulse Laser for intermediate range engagements and a Medium Pulse Laser, ER Medium Laser, and ER Small Laser for close combat.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: A 配置同样是全能有效的机甲，以两门 ER PPC 为远程主武器提升火力。中距离交战由一门大型脉冲激光支援，近战则由一门中型脉冲激光、一门 ER 中型激光和一门 ER 小型激光负责。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Configured almost exclusively for long range combat, the B configuration of the Gargoyle carries a powerful Gauss Rifle backed up by an LRM-10 launcher linked to an Artemis IV FCS, allowing it to keep its distance from enemy units. For self defense at short ranges, the 'Mech has an SRM-4 launcher which is also enhanced with an Artemis IV FCS. The main drawback to this configuration is its over reliance on ammunition based weaponry, making it effective only so long as it has sufficient ammunition for its weapons.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 石像鬼 B 配置几乎专为远程战斗而设，携带一门强力高斯步枪，辅以一具联接 Artemis IV 火控系统的 LRM-10 发射器，使其能与敌方单位保持距离。近程自卫方面，机甲有一具同样加装 Artemis IV 火控系统的 SRM-4 发射器。此配置的主要缺点是过度依赖弹药类武器，使它只在弹药充足时有效。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A dedicated close combat configuration, the Gargoyle C carries as its primary weapon a powerful Ultra Autocannon/20 that has twice the rate of fire as a standard Autocannon. This is supported by a brace of six ER Medium Lasers that make the 'Mech a highly effective brawler.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 石像鬼 C 是专职近战配置，主武器为一门强力超速自动炮/20，射速是标准自动炮的两倍。它由六门 ER 中型激光支援，使机甲成为极为高效的缠斗者。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A dedicated close combat configuration, the Gargoyle C carries as its primary weapon a powerful Ultra Autocannon/20 that has twice the rate of fire as a standard Autocannon. This is supported by a brace of six ER Medium Lasers that make the 'Mech a highly effective brawler.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 石像鬼 C 是专职近战配置，主武器为一门强力超速自动炮/20，射速是标准自动炮的两倍。它由六门 ER 中型激光支援，使机甲成为极为高效的缠斗者。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This variant makes use of Clan technology developed in the 3060s. An ATM 12 in the right arm has enough ammunition bins to make use of all of the types available to an Advanced Tactical Missile Launcher. Four Heavy Medium Lasers provide a powerful punch as short range, while a Streak SRM-6 can exploit those holes. A pair of ER Micro Lasers round out the offensive armament. A Targeting Computer makes the lasers more accurate.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 此变体使用 3060 年代开发的氏族技术。右臂的一具 ATM 12 拥有足够的弹药箱以使用高级战术导弹发射器可用的全部弹种。四门重型中型激光在近距离提供强大打击，而一具连续 SRM-6 可利用这些破口。两门 ER 微型激光为攻击武器收尾。一台瞄准计算机让激光更为精准。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The first homegrown BattleMech produced by the Draconis Combine was the Gladiator. The 55-ton 'Mech took seven years to design, as Coordinator Kozo Von Rohrs refused to open up the process to anybody but a select group at New Samarkand Armor Works (the predecessor of Luthien Armor Works) who were under constant surveillance by DEST. 2468 finally saw the GLD-1R Gladiator hit mass-production. Following the Battle of Nox in 2475, the dishonored 'Mech was retired from official production, with NSAW closing down the production lines by 2488. Merryweather Industries was the first private company to attempt BattleMech production without governmental support. Despite their location in the Terran Hegemony, they acquired the plans to the Gladiator and produced a new run in 2490. They were unable to raise the capital to finish their second run, the 4R, and nearly went bankrupt before moving into IndustrialMechs. The GLD-4R production lines were closed down in 2495. A few salvaged Gladiator -1Rs were still in service with militaries across the Inner Sphere and Periphery, though these relics were finally pushed to extinction during the Reunification War. The 55-ton Gladiator has a top speed of 86 km/h, comparable to many other 'Mechs of the same weight. Nine and a half tons of armor provides a respectable amount of protection. Five jump jets enables the 'Mech to jump up to 150 meters at a time.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 联合体自主生产的第一款战斗机甲是角斗士。这款 55 吨机甲耗时七年设计，因为协调官科佐·冯·罗尔斯拒绝将此过程向除新萨马尔坎德装甲工厂（卢西恩装甲工厂的前身）一小批人之外的任何人开放，这批人还处于 DEST 的持续监视之下。2468 年 GLD-1R 角斗士终于进入量产。在 2475 年诺克斯战役后，这款蒙羞的机甲被正式停产，NSAW 于 2488 年关闭生产线。梅里韦瑟工业是第一家在没有政府支持下尝试生产战斗机甲的私营公司。尽管位于地球霸权境内，他们仍取得了角斗士的图纸，并于 2490 年生产了新一轮机型。他们无力筹集资金完成第二轮生产（4R 型），几乎破产，随后转向工业机甲。GLD-4R 生产线于 2495 年关闭。少数回收的角斗士-1R 仍在内外天体的军队中服役，但这些老古董最终在统一战争中彻底消亡。55 吨的角斗士最高速度达 86 公里/小时，与同重量的许多机甲相当。九吨半装甲提供了可观的防护。五个跳跃推进器使机甲一次可跳跃至 150 米。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The original Gladiator used primitive technologies, so it only had a Large Laser and two Medium Lasers. In addition, it could only manage a top speed around 64 km/h. It was protected by sixteen and a half tons of Primitive Armor. The GLD-1R went out of production by 2488. During the Jihad, several companies began producing this primitive design of Gladiator as a part of the appearance of RetroTech on the battlefield, driven by the need for war materiel; companies which produced the primitive Gladiator during this era included Rastaban Agricultural Products, Metals of the Earth and Sword of the Prophet Enterprises although many of these manufacturing lines had closed down by 3079.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 原版角斗士使用原始技术，因此只有一门大型激光和两门中型激光。此外它最高速度仅约 64 公里/小时。它由十六吨半原始装甲保护。GLD-1R 于 2488 年停产。圣战期间，随着"复古技术"在战场上出现，若干公司出于战争物资需求开始生产这一原始设计的角斗士；此时期生产原始角斗士的公司包括拉斯塔班农产品、大地金属和先知之剑企业，不过其中许多生产线到 3079 年已关闭。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A Lord's Light P1 PPC provides long range firepower. Two Argra 1L Medium Lasers is just as powerful up close and adds a Thunderstroke SRM-6 to exploit any holes in an enemy's armor.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一门"主之光 P1"PPC 提供远程火力。两门"阿尔格拉 1L"中型激光在近距同样强劲，另加一具"雷霆一击"SRM-6 以利用敌方装甲上的破口。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Affectionately known as the 'Grand Dragon', the DRG-1G replaces the AC5 with a PPC, Medium Laser and 2 extra Heat Sinks.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: DRG-1G 被亲切地称为"大龙"，它将 AC5 换成一门 PPC、一门中型激光和 2 台额外散热器。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Grand Dragon 3K is a beefy machine that can take a serious beating and carries heavier weaponry than its smaller cousin. Equipped with a heavy-duty gyro, a PPC and Gauss rifle, this variant is a formidable heavy weapons platform.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 大龙 3K 是一台强壮的机器，能承受严重打击，并携带比其小型表亲更重的武器。它配备重型陀螺仪、一门 PPC 和一门高斯步枪，是令人敬畏的重型武器平台。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Don't be fooled by its whimsical name, the Grasshopper is a killer that specializes in hunting down light and medium 'Mechs. Its superb jump ability and good armor allow it to get behind foes easily to bring its all-Energy weapons to bear.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 别被它古怪的名字骗了，蚱猛是个专精猎杀轻中型机甲的杀手。其卓越的跳跃能力与良好的装甲使它轻易绕到敌后，倾泻全能量武器。
重型伏击手 & 装甲兵

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An upgrade of the Grasshopper using Star League technology, the 5J replaces the Diplan large laser with a Diverse Optics Sunbeam ER Large Laser, replaces the Conan/S launcher with a Hovertech Streak SRM-2 model, and removes the two torso-mounted medium lasers for a SureFire 444 Anti-Missile System.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 5J 是使用星盟科技的蚱猛升级版，将迪普兰大型激光换成多元光学"日光束"ER 大型激光，将柯南/S 发射器换成霍弗泰克连续 SRM-2，并移除两门躯干中型激光，改为一套必火 444 反导系统。
重型伏击手 & 装甲兵

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 5N is a very basic field upgrade of the Grasshopper introduced around 3040. The large laser and missile launcher have both been removed and in their place was added a PPC and a fifth medium laser respectively. Though the change increases the design's firepower, it also comes at a greater risk of overheating the 'Mech, especially if the pilot is careless.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 5N 是约 3040 年推出的蚱猛非常基础的野战升级。大型激光和导弹发射器均被移除，分别换成一门 PPC 和第五门中型激光。虽然这一改动提升了设计的火力，但也带来了更高的过热风险，尤其当飞行员粗心大意时。
重型伏击手 & 装甲兵

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A basic modification of the 5J model introduced by the Combine in 3052, the Grasshopper-C carries a C3 slave unit to allow it to be integrated into a C3 lance. These models often served as the point 'Mech in a C3 lance, where its speed and armor allowed it to get close enough to the enemy and share this targeting data with friendly units. To make room for the addition of the C3 unit, ammunition for the Streak SRM-2 launcher was reduced by one ton, though since the Streak launcher was already an ammo-efficient design this resulted in no drop in performance
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为联合体 3052 年推出的 5J 型号的基础改装，蚱猛-C 携带一台 C3 从属单元以便编入 C3 小队。这些型号常作为 C3 小队中的尖兵机甲，其速度与装甲使它能够逼近敌人并把瞄准数据共享给友军单位。为腾出空间加装 C3 单元，连续 SRM-2 发射器的弹药减少了一吨，不过由于连续发射器本就是弹药效率很高的设计，这并未导致性能下降
重型伏击手 & 装甲兵

These models often served as the point 'Mech in a C3 lance, where its speed and armor allowed it to get close enough to the enemy and share this targeting data with friendly units. To make room for the addition of the C3 unit, ammunition for the Streak SRM-2 launcher was reduced by one ton, though since the Streak launcher was already an ammo-efficient design this resulted in no drop in performance.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为联合体 3052 年推出的 5J 型号的基础改装，蚱猛-C 携带一台 C3 从属单元以便编入 C3 小队。这些型号常作为 C3 小队中的尖兵机甲，其速度与装甲使它能够逼近敌人并把瞄准数据共享给友军单位。为腾出空间加装 C3 单元，连续 SRM-2 发射器的弹药减少了一吨，不过由于连续发射器本就是弹药效率很高的设计，这并未导致性能下降。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Griffin 1Ns use their Jump Jets to stay at range and pelt their opponents from relative safety. 1Ns can run hot if they spend all their time bounding around the battlefield taking potshots, though.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 狮鹫 1N 利用跳跃推进器保持距离，在相对安全处向对手投掷火力。不过，如果它们整场都在战场上蹦跳打冷枪，也可能过热。

Using a sixty ton frame, engineers fitted Prototype Improved Jump Jets to the 'Mech to compensate for its reduced speed.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 3M Griffin was an upgraded version of the design built for House Marik by Earthwerks and Brigadier Corps starting in 3049. With production lines on Keystone and Oliver this variant sought to enhance the original's long-range capabilities. The engine was exchanged for a Hermes 275 extralight model and carried fourteen double heat sinks to improve heat management. The normal PPC was replaced by a Fusigon Longtooth ER PPC, for longer reach at the expense of more heat, and the LRM launcher had been upgraded to a Doombud LRM-20 launcher, for more indirect fire support capabilities. Finally a ChrisComp Small Laser was mounted in the head and the two tons of LRM reloads in the left torso were protected by CASE. While intended for the Free Worlds League Military the capture of Oliver by FedCom forces meant the 3M also appeared in large numbers in the Armed Forces of the Federated Commonwealth.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 3M 狮鹫是为马里克家族打造的升级版，由地球工厂与准将兵团自 3049 年起生产。借助基斯通与奥利弗的生产线，该变体力图强化原版的远程能力。引擎换成赫尔墨斯 275 超轻型，并携带十四台双倍散热器以改善散热管理。标准 PPC 换成"富西贡长牙"ER PPC，以更多热量换取更远射程；LRM 发射器升级为末日芽 LRM-20，以增强间接火力支援能力。最后，头部安装一门克里斯康小型激光，左躯干的两吨 LRM 再装填由 C.A.S.E. 保护。虽然原为自由世界联盟军队设计，但联邦联邦部队夺取奥利弗意味着 3M 也大量出现在联邦联邦武装部队中。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Created by a pilot who lost the LRM rack off his Griffin, the -6CV replaces the long-range payload with a mid-range weapon system: a MRM 30. Backing up the MRM rack is an ER PPC with a PPC Capacitor for extra punch. To keep the heat under control, the -6CV mounts double heat sinks and is powered by a Light Fusion Engine for speed. It also has gained a little armor for extra survivability
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: -6CV 由一位失去了格里芬 LRM 挂架的飞行员创造，它以一套中程武器系统取代远程载荷：一具 MRM 30。支援 MRM 挂架的是一门带 PPC 电容器的 ER PPC，以提供额外打击力。为控制热量，-6CV 装双倍散热器，并由一台轻型聚变引擎提供速度。它还增加了一点装甲以提升生存性

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Grim Reaper was a 'Mech designed by ComStar to help replenish the heavy material losses suffered by the Com Guards during the Battle of Tukayyid, with the Word of Blake maintaining production after it captured Terra to help rebuild and expand the Word of Blake Militia. Thus the Grim Reaper is seen in moderate numbers in both secular and fanatical militaries. Designed to be a generic trooper 'Mech, the Grim Reaper carries a varied and non specialized weapons payload.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 死神是康星设计的机甲，用于补充康卫在图卡伊德战役中遭受的严重物资损失，布雷克之言在夺取地球后维持生产，以协助重建和扩充布雷克之言民兵。因此死神在世俗与狂热两方的军队中都有中等数量的装备。作为一款通用士兵机甲，死神携带多样而非专精的武器配置。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Grizzly is a BattleMech that was developed by Clan Ghost Bear scientists in the 30th century. Unfortunately, the design excels at no one thing, so it never carved a niche in the Clan's touman.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 灰熊是鬼熊氏族科学家在三十世纪开发的战斗机甲。遗憾的是，该设计在任何方面都不出众，因此从未在氏族的图曼中占据一席之地。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Grizzly actually packs a solid long-range punch with a Omega 12-coil Gauss Rifle and a Type X Short Bow LRM-10 Launcher.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 灰熊实际上拥有扎实的远程打击力：一具"欧米茄 12 线圈"高斯步枪和一具"X 型短弓"LRM-10 发射器。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Hammer is a 'Mech that was built to provide fire support for light 'Mechs. The 'Mech is built around a long-range arsenal that can provide both direct and indirect fire support. It is also often paired with the Anvil, using its missiles to soften up the enemy at a distance until the Anvil can bring its lasers to bear. The Hammer has a maximum speed of 86.4 kph, which is enough for a 'Mech intended to stay at the edges of a battlefield acting in a fire support role. Additionally, the 'Mech has a respectable six tons of armor protection. With its average speed and good armor protection combined with its long-range weapons, the Hammer is a good overall light fire support 'Mech.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 战锤是为轻型机甲提供火力支援而制造的机甲。它以远程武器库为核心，可提供直射与间接火力支援。它常与铁砧搭档，在远距离用导弹削弱敌人，直到铁砧能以激光发起攻击。战锤最高速度 86.4 公里/小时，对于一款意在战场边缘执行火力支援角色的机甲而言已足够。此外，它还拥有可观的六吨装甲防护。凭借平均速度、良好装甲与远程武器的组合，战锤是一款整体出色的轻型火力支援机甲。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Called the Claw-Hammer, the 3C is built to make the Hammer capable of better defending itself when an enemy closes on the battlefield. This is done by removing one of the LRM launchers and replacing it with four additional Medium Lasers, which gives the Hammer the ability to attack the enemy with an overwhelming laser barrage at close ranges. This variant also works well as a bodyguard 'Mech in a lance of Hammer 'Mechs.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 3C 被称为"爪锤"，其设计目标是让锤式在敌人逼近时能更好地自卫。它移除一具 LRM 发射器，换成四门额外中型激光，使锤式能在近距离以压倒性的激光弹幕攻击敌人。这一变体在锤式小队中也很好地充当护卫机甲。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The primary weaponry that the Hammer employs is a pair of Coventry Five-Tube LRM-5 launchers that allow the Hammer to rain destruction down on a target at up to 630 meters. These launchers are supplied with a ton of ammo each and both are augmented with an Artemis IV fire control system for greater accuracy. For close combat the 'Mech carries three Martell Medium Lasers.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Also called the Pein-Hammer, the 3P is an extensive modification of the Hammer. The entire arsenal has been removed from the 'Mech. The 'Mech is armed with a short-range assortment of weapons making it an excellent brawler. The primary weapons are a pair of Streak SRM-4 launchers. These are backed up by two ER Medium Lasers and two Small Pulse Lasers which provide the 'Mech with excellent close range protection.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 3S is commonly called the Slammer. The 'Mech looks to increase the longevity of the Hammer on the battlefield as a fire support 'Mech. This is done by removing two of the Medium Lasers and replacing them with two more tons of ammunition. The 'Mech can fire a sustained barrage of LRM fire for up to eight minutes.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 3S 通常被称为"重击者"。这台机甲力求提升锤式作为火力支援机甲的战场续航力。它移除两门中型激光，换成两吨额外弹药。机甲可连续发射 LRM 弹幕长达八分钟。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The original version produced during 3039. Though lacking the LosTech of the HTM-27, the single production run of the original field-test Hatamoto-Chi completed on the verge of the War of 3039 came as a total shock to the attacking Lyran and Davion Forces. Since it was built on a standard chassis, the 26T had less armor, one less heat sink, and single ton of SRM ammunition in a standard ammo bin.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 最初版本于 3039 年生产。尽管缺少 HTM-27 的失落科技，原版野战测试型旗本-血的唯一一次量产恰在 3039 年战争前夕完成，令进攻的莱兰与达维昂部队大为震惊。由于建立在标准底盘上，26T 装甲较少、少一台散热器，SRM 弹药也仅有一吨存于标准弹药箱中。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 最初版本于 3039 年生产。尽管缺少 HTM-27 的失落科技，原版野战测试型旗本-血的唯一一次量产恰在 3039 年战争前夕完成，令进攻的莱兰与达维昂部队大为震惊。由于建立在标准底盘上，26T 装甲较少、少一台散热器，SRM 弹药也仅有一吨存于标准弹药箱中。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Constructed with an Earthwerks VOL Endo Steel chassis, fitted with CASE protected ammo bins and clad in fifteen and a half tons of Mitchell Argon armor, the Hatamoto-Chi shared the features which made its parent design a nearly indestructible zombie 'Mech. The main area that Combine was unable to replicate the Thug was the older design's advanced Double Heat Sinks, eighteen standard Heat Sinks giving the Hatamoto-Chi a high heat curve in heavy combat.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 旗本-血采用地球工厂 VOL 内骨骼底盘建造，装有 C.A.S.E. 保护的弹药箱，披挂十五吨半米切尔氢装甲，共享了使其母设计成为近乎不可摧毁的"僵尸"机甲的特征。联合体唯一无法复制"暴徒"的地方是那款老设计的先进双倍散热器，十八台标准散热器使旗本-血在激烈战斗中热量曲线偏高。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The first OmniMech both designed and built by the Lyran Alliance. The inspiration for the Hauptmann is drawn from the Daishi OmniMech used by the Clans. Using information from captured Daishis and data gleaned from the construction of the Firestarter OmniMech, which was shared by the Draconis Combine, the end result is a powerful OmniMech capable of defending itself in most combat situations. The Hauptmann is built on a standard chassis and powered by a 285 fusion engine, adding to the 'Mech's durability as it cannot be killed by a side torso loss. The Hauptmann has eleven double heat sinks fixed on the chassis and can add more if needed in its various configurations. For protection, the Hauptmann carries eighteen and a half tons of armor and has CASE fixed in the right torso to protect against an ammunition explosion.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 首款由莱兰联盟自行设计并制造的全能机甲。上尉的灵感源自氏族使用的"大师"全能机甲。利用缴获的"大师"资料以及由德拉科尼斯联合体分享的火焰使者全能机甲建造数据，最终成果是一款强大的全能机甲，能在大多数战斗情形下自保。上尉采用标准底盘，由 285 聚变引擎驱动，这增强了它的耐久性，使其不会因失去侧面躯干而被击毁。它底盘上固定有十一台双倍散热器，必要时可在各配置中加装更多。防护方面，上尉携带十八吨半装甲，并在右侧躯干固定 C.A.S.E. 以防弹药爆炸。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The primary configuration carries a varied and powerful arsenal. For long range combat, the Hauptmann carries two ER Large Lasers as its primary long range weapons. These give the Hauptmann Prime a good long range damage capability. For close combat, the 'Mech has an LB-X Autocannon/20 for devastating close range firepower backed up by two Medium Pulse Lasers, an ER Small Laser, and a pair of Streak SRM-2 launchers. Finally, to protect the 'Mech against enemy electronic warfare systems, the Hauptmann Prime has a Guardian ECM Suite.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 主配置携带多样而强大的武器库。远程战斗方面，上尉以两门 ER 大型激光为主要远程武器。这赋予上尉主型号良好的远程伤害能力。近战方面，机甲有一门 LB-X 自动炮/20 提供毁灭性近程火力，辅以两门中型脉冲激光、一门 ER 小型激光和一对连续 SRM-2 发射器。最后，为保护机甲免受敌方电子战系统干扰，上尉主型号装有守护者 ECM 套件。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Intended for close combat, the Hauptmann A is armed with four ER Medium Lasers as its primary short-ranged weapons with a pair of SRM-6 launchers linked to an Artemis IV fire control system for increased missile accuracy. For increased mobility, the Hauptmann A has three jump jets that allow the 'Mech to jump up to ninety meters. Finally, to defend itself if it ends up in a long range firefight, the Alpha configuration mounts a Gauss Rifle. To handle the massive heat load, it carries an additional six double heat sinks.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The second BattleMech model introduced by the Free Worlds League, the Hector entered service in 2471, only one year after the original Icarus. Built by Corean Enterprises on Stewart, it used a simple design suited for mass production and quickly became the workhorse of the Free Worlds League.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 赫克托是自由世界联盟推出的第二款战斗机甲型号，于 2471 年服役，仅比原始伊卡洛斯晚一年。它由科里安企业在斯图尔特制造，设计简洁、适合量产，很快成为自由世界联盟的主力。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Despite its initial success, the combat service of the Hellfire has not be flaw free. Aside from the sensor interference caused by firing its signature Heavy Lasers, a number of battlefield reports indicate the heavy laser tubes can violently rupture in the heat of battle. The 'Mech also experiences a fifteen percent higher rate of MASC failure than usual, though technicians have yet to determine whether this is due to the age of the Lupus chassis or if this is something caused by the Heavy Lasers.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 尽管初期成功，地狱火的战场服役并非毫无瑕疵。除了其标志性重型激光开火造成的传感器干扰外，若干战场报告指出重型激光管在激战中可能剧烈爆裂。该机甲的 MASC 故障率也比通常高出百分之十五，不过技师们尚未确定这是源于狼人底盘的老化，还是重型激光造成的问题。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Highlander 732B is an ancient model from the Star League days! Its Gauss Rifle was a terrifying weapon that gave it a huge punch at almost any range, but you can't find those anymore. And of course, it still has the jump capability it's always been known for.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 高地人 732B 是星盟时代的古老型号！它的高斯步枪是件可怕武器，几乎在任何距离都能打出重击，但如今再也找不到那种东西了。当然，它仍具备一直为人称道的跳跃能力。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Highlander 733 is one of the few jump-capable assault 'Mechs. A mixture of medium- and long-range weaponry ensures that while the Highlander excels at no particular role, it is decent at all of them.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Highlander 733C is a simple variant of the 733 model that removes 2 tons of missile ammunition and upscales its Autocannon 10 to an Autocannon 20.  This sacrifices some of its long range functionality, but give it a true brawler profile.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 高地人 733C 是 733 型号的简单变体，移除 2 吨导弹弹药并把自动炮 10 升级为自动炮 20。这牺牲了一些远程功能，却赋予它真正的缠斗者特质。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Highlander 733C sacrifices some of the 733s long range ability, but give it a true brawler profile.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 高地人 733C 牺牲了 733 的部分远程能力，却赋予它真正的缠斗者特质。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Highlander 733P is a variant of the 733 model that removes its Autocannon and replaces it with a PPC. It also handles heat buildup better.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 高地人 733P 是 733 型号的变体，移除自动炮并换成 PPC。它对积热的处理也更好。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This ComStar version of the Highlander introduced in the late 3050s has been upgraded to carry the improved C3 computer, as well as upgrading the LRM-20 with an Artemis IV fire control system and replacing the SRM-6 to a Streak SRM-4.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这款康星版高地人于 3050 年代末推出，已升级为携带改进型 C3 计算机，并把 LRM-20 升级为配 Artemis IV 火控系统，SRM-6 则换成连续 SRM-4。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: One of the most popular Star League BattleMechs, many a Highlander accompanied General Aleksandr Kerensky into exile. Some were mothballed, but many found their way into the toumans of the Clans. As technology advanced, the weapons systems were upgraded until the design known as the Highlander IIC finally emerged. With the use of newer, lighter weapons, the damage potential of the Highlander has roughly doubled. The IIC also contains enough ammunition that it rarely needs to conserve any during Trials. Clan scientists were forced to rearrange the placement of some weapons within the 'Mech to allow it proper ammo feeds, but the design is largely unchanged. It carries the maximum amount of Ferro-Fibrous armor that can be crammed on the frame, fourteen and a half tons. As with the original, the IIC carries enough jump jets to move up to ninety meters at a time, allowing MechWarriors to execute the Highlander Burial.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 高地人是星盟最受欢迎的战斗机甲之一，许多随亚历山大·克伦斯基将军流亡。有些被封存，但许多进入了氏族的图曼。随着技术进步，武器系统不断升级，最终诞生了被称为高地人 IIC 的设计。凭借更新更轻的武器，高地人的伤害潜力几乎翻倍。IIC 还携带充足弹药，在试炼中几乎无需节省。氏族科学家被迫重新安排机内部分武器的位置以使其供弹顺畅，但设计大体未变。它携带了框架所能容纳的最大量铁纤维装甲——十四吨半。与原版一样，IIC 携带足以一次移动九十米的跳跃推进器，使机甲战士能施展"高地人埋葬"。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Hitman was designed to work as a spotter 'Mech for advanced Arrow IV missile artillery rounds. In order to do this, the 'Mech is built to be able to close to effective range for its Forward-1 Target Acquisition Gear spotting gear rapidly with a Kagushima 210 XL propelling it up to 118.8 kph and a MASC system pushing the 'Mech up to 151.2 kph in short bursts. The 'Mech also carries an Apple Churchill Guardian ECM Suite to foul any enemy electronics warfare equipment and a Wunderland Beagle Active Probe to detect any hidden enemy units. With the recent invention of semi-guided LRMs the Hitman can also guide LRM fire to a unit targeted with its TAG unit. The Hitman carries five tons of armor protection to protect it against any attacks that may hit it.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 杀手被设计为先进箭矢 IV 导弹炮弹的侦察机甲。为此，机甲能迅速接近其 Forward-1 目标捕获指示器的有效距离：管岛 210 XL 引擎推动它达到 118.8 公里/小时，MASC 系统则在短促爆发中推至 151.2 公里/小时。机甲还携带苹果·丘吉尔守护者 ECM 套件以干扰敌方电子战设备，以及旺德兰比格犬主动探测器以侦测隐藏的敌方单位。随着半制导 LRM 的问世，杀手还能将其 TAG 标记的目标引导给 LRM 火力。杀手携带五吨装甲防护，以抵御可能命中它的攻击。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Hitman carries an arsenal that is capable of striking an enemy regardless of the ranges they are at. For long range engagements while closing with an enemy the Hitman is armed with a Thunderstroke-L LRM-5 with Artemis IV fire control system for increased missile accuracy. When the Hitman closes to the effective range for its TAG it is able to use its three Argra 3L Medium Lasers to defend itself.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 杀手携带的武器库能在任何距离打击敌人。在接近敌人时用于远程交战，杀手装备一具带 Artemis IV 火控系统以提升导弹精度的"雷霆-L"LRM-5。当杀手接近其 TAG 的有效射程时，它可用三门"阿尔格拉 3L"中型激光自卫。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 杀手被设计为先进箭矢 IV 导弹炮弹的侦察机甲。为此，机甲能迅速接近其 Forward-1 目标捕获指示器的有效距离：管岛 210 XL 引擎推动它达到 118.8 公里/小时，MASC 系统则在短促爆发中推至 151.2 公里/小时。机甲还携带苹果·丘吉尔守护者 ECM 套件以干扰敌方电子战设备，以及旺德兰比格犬主动探测器以侦测隐藏的敌方单位。随着半制导 LRM 的问世，杀手还能将其 TAG 标记的目标引导给 LRM 火力。杀手携带五吨装甲防护，以抵御可能命中它的攻击。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The HM-2 Hitman is a field refit that is popular with units that do not have a large number of artillery assets but do have C3 lances. The TAG unit has been removed in favor of a C3 Slave unit and the LRM-5 launcher has been removed in favor of a Narc Missile Beacon. The 'Mech is able to work as a lead unit in a C3 lance or as a spotter for a fire support lance with its Narc Missile Beacon.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: HM-2 杀手是野战改装型，深受那些没有大量火炮资产但拥有 C3 小队的单位欢迎。TAG 单元被移除，换成一台 C3 从属单元；LRM-5 发射器被移除，换成一具 NARC 导弹信标。机甲可作为 C3 小队的领队单位，或凭借其 NARC 导弹信标充当火力支援小队的目标指示者。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The F5 variant, called the Hollander II, is a variant of the Hollander that looks to alleviate the 'Mech's problems by building it on a chassis ten tons heavier than the original, pushing it into the medium weight class. First built in 3058 the 'Mech still carries a Gauss Rifle as its primary weapon, but is backed up by a single Medium Laser and a Streak SRM-2 launcher.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The F7, debuting in 3061 is a modification of the F5 that takes advantage of the Hollander II's larger weapons payload to mount the Lyran Alliance's new Heavy Gauss Rifle, which is capable of causing a great deal of damage at short to medium ranges. While improving upon the firepower of the variant, the removal of backup weaponry to fit these massive weapon leaves it with the same problems as the original Hollander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: F7 于 3061 年亮相，是 F5 的改型，利用荷兰人 II 更大的武器负载能力搭载莱兰联盟新型重型高斯步枪，能在中近距离造成大量伤害。虽然火力优于前型，但为容纳这些巨型武器而移除备用武器，使它仍带有原版荷兰人的同样问题。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Hollander was introduced in 3054 specifically to carry a Gauss Rifle into combat and act as a sniper. The Federated Commonwealth was in dire need of a response to the fast-moving, long-range firepower of the Clan Invaders at the time, and looked at a number of light 'Mech designs featuring PPCs or LRMs as a potential answer. It was Coventry's unorthodox decision to mount such a large weapon, one that had neither the overheating or ammunition explosion drawbacks of the other designs, which won them the contract. With its single massive cannon and use of rediscovered technology, the Hollander can destroy another light 'Mech in a single hit at extreme range and threaten heavier targets easily.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 荷兰人于 3054 年推出，专门为了把高斯步枪带上战场并担任狙击手。当时联邦联邦急需应对氏族入侵者快速机动的远程火力，考察了多款装备 PPC 或 LRM 的轻型机甲设计方案。考文垂大胆决定装上如此巨大的武器——既没有其他设计那样的过热或弹药爆炸缺陷——从而赢得了合同。凭借其单门巨型火炮和对重新发现技术的运用，荷兰人能在极远距离一炮摧毁另一台轻型机甲，并轻易威胁更重的目标。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The G1 variant of the Hollander is built to address concerns about the Hollander's lack of back up weapons. First debuting in 3056 the 'Mech replaces the heavy Gauss Cannon with an LB-X Autocannon/10 as its primary weapon, freeing up weight to mount two Defiance B3M Medium Lasers in its arms as backup weapons and add two tons of Ferro-Fibrous armor. The G1 is an excellent 'Mech for vehicle hunting as well as anti-aircraft use with its LB-X cluster rounds.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 荷兰人的 G1 变体旨在解决人们对荷兰人缺乏备用武器的担忧。它于 3056 年首次亮相，将重型高斯炮换成 LB-X 自动炮/10 作为主武器，腾出重量在双臂装两门迪法恩斯 B3M 中型激光作为备用，并加两吨铁纤维装甲。凭借 LB-X 集束弹，G1 是出色的反车辆兼防空机甲。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Conceived by Martinson Armaments of Terra in 2578 as an infantry support 'Mech, the Hoplite first saw service with the newly formed Star League Defense Force during the Reunification War before being relegated to Terran Hegemony militia units in the twenty-seventh century. Intended for infantry support, the Hoplite is slow for a medium 'Mech with a top speed of only 64.8 km/h. However its eleven and a half tons of armor and heavy arsenal, both impressive for a 'Mech of its size, makes the Hoplite a rugged machine able to fight its way out of most situations using superior firepower. The original Reunification War era model, save for using an older Dalban Sniper targeting and tracking system, was all but identical to the 4C.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 重装步兵由泰拉的马丁森军械于 2578 年构想为步兵支援机甲，在统一战争中首次随新成立的星盟防卫军服役，后在二十七世纪被降级至地球霸权民兵单位。作为步兵支援机甲，重装步兵对中型机甲而言偏慢，最高速度仅 64.8 公里/小时。然而其十一吨半装甲与重型武器库对如此尺寸的机甲都堪称出色，使重装步兵成为一台凭借优势火力就能从大多数困境中杀出重围的坚固机器。统一战争时代的原始型号除了使用较老的达尔班狙击瞄准追踪系统外，与 4C 几乎完全相同。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Essentially a Royal variant in everything but name, the Double B Hoplite was put into production at Strana Mechty MechWorks and Eden Weaponry Consolidated just before the death of Aleksandr Kerensky and found its way both into the forces of the Pentagon Powers and the infant toumans of the Clans. Keeping the LRM rack of the 4B, the Double B upgrades the Holly LRM-15 launcher with an Artemis IV system, swaps the PPC for an Kinslaughter H-Class ER PPC, and increases the 'Mech's survivability with a Guardian ECM system, CASE in both torsos, double heat sinks, and an anti-missile system. However, the design's speed and armor were not upgraded, enforcing the need to deploy the 4Bb as a fire-support unit.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 双 B 重装步兵实质上除名字之外一切皆为皇家变体，在亚历山大·克伦斯基去世前夕于斯特拉纳·麦赫蒂机甲工厂与伊甸兵器联合体投产，既进入五角势力部队，也进入氏族初生的图曼。双 B 保留 4B 的 LRM 挂架，把"冬青"LRM-15 发射器升级加装 Artemis IV 系统，把 PPC 换成"族杀 H 级"ER PPC，并通过守护者 ECM 系统、两侧躯干的 C.A.S.E.、双倍散热器和一套反导系统提升机甲生存力。然而该设计的速度与装甲并未升级，因此 4Bb 必须作为火力支援单位使用。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Conceived by Martinson Armaments of Terra in 2578 as an infantry support 'Mech, the Hoplite first saw service with the newly formed Star League Defense Force during the Reunification War before being relegated to Terran Hegemony militia units in the twenty-seventh century. Intended for infantry support, the Hoplite is slow for a medium 'Mech with a top speed of only 64.8 km/h. However its eleven and a half tons of armor and heavy arsenal, both impressive for a 'Mech of its size, makes the Hoplite a rugged machine able to fight its way out of most situations using superior firepower. Refitted by the Dragoons after the Inner Sphere's recovery of the Helm Memory Core, the HOP-4D Hoplite is armed with an impressive Mydron Excel LB-X Autocannon/10, which allows it to fire either standard rounds or cluster rounds, which are similar to the blast from a shotgun, only on a 'Mech scale. As a secondary weapon, the Hoplite carries a Conan/5 LRM-5 launcher, which also allows it to keep the enemy at long ranges.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 重装步兵由泰拉的马丁森军械于 2578 年构想为步兵支援机甲，在统一战争中首次随新成立的星盟防卫军服役，后在二十七世纪被降级至地球霸权民兵单位。作为步兵支援机甲，重装步兵对中型机甲而言偏慢，最高速度仅 64.8 公里/小时。然而其十一吨半装甲与重型武器库对如此尺寸的机甲都堪称出色，使重装步兵成为一台凭借优势火力就能从大多数困境中杀出重围的坚固机器。内天体找回赫尔姆记忆核心后，龙骑兵改装了 HOP-4D 重装步兵，装备一门令人印象深刻的迈德龙 Excel LB-X 自动炮/10，可发射标准弹或集束弹——后者类似霰弹枪的散射，只是机甲级别。作为次要武器，重装步兵携带一具柯南/5 LRM-5 发射器，同样能迫使敌人远距离交战。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Developed after the Battle of Luthien, the Hoplite C is a variant exclusively used by the Wolf's Dragoons that uses all Clan technology. Clad in 10 tons of Ferro-Fibrous and fitted with double heat sinks, the 'Mech carries as its primary weapon an Ultra Autocannon/10. This is supported for long-range engagements by an LRM-15 launcher and for close range combat the 'Mech carries two Medium Pulse Lasers and an ER Medium Laser.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 重装步兵 C 在卢西恩战役后开发，是狼之龙骑兵独家使用的变体，全部采用氏族科技。它披挂 10 吨铁纤维装甲并配双倍散热器，主武器为一门超速自动炮/10。远程交战由一具 LRM-15 发射器支援，近战则有两门中型脉冲激光和一门 ER 中型激光。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Hornet debuted in 2760 as an urban recon 'Mech, but lack of interest forced the design to be shelved two years later. In 2990, Kallon Industriesrediscovered the blueprints and resumed production. The upgraded HNT-171 started production in 3051. The production line was destroyed by the Capellans in 3069. The 'Mech is designed around the concept of being able to swiftly move through an urban environment with relatively heavy armor. Overall, because of its eclectic mix of weapons and relatively slow speed, the Hornet is only somewhat effective when inside of a city. When caught outside an urban environment the 'Mech is hard pressed to defend itself.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 大黄蜂于 2760 年作为城市侦察机甲首次亮相，但因缺乏兴趣，两年后该设计被搁置。2990 年，卡隆工业重新发现了图纸并恢复生产。升级版 HNT-171 于 3051 年开始生产。生产线于 3069 年被卡佩兰人摧毁。此机甲的设计理念是能以相对厚重的装甲在城市环境中快速机动。总体而言，由于武器配置杂糅且速度相对缓慢，大黄蜂仅在城内表现尚可。一旦身陷城外环境，它便难以自保。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The version of the Hornet that debuted in 2990, the 151, has standard armor and a standard internal structure. It also lacks the advanced Anti-Missile System, CASE, and a ton of LRM ammunition, though the jumping capacity is one hundred fifty meters and the weapons also include a small laser.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 大黄蜂于 2990 年首次亮相的版本 151 使用标准装甲和标准内部结构。它也缺少先进反导系统、C.A.S.E. 和一吨 LRM 弹药，不过跳跃能力为一百五十米，武器还包括一门小型激光。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Hornet carries as its primary long-range weapon a Holly LRM-5launcher. This allows the Hornet to strike at an enemy at a distance of over six hundred meters. In an urban environment the LRM launcher becomes more of a liability than an asset. As a secondary weapon the Hornet carries a Martell Medium Laser, and finally the 'Mech is armed with a MainFire Point Defense Anti-Missile System to defend against missile attacks.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 大黄蜂以"冬青"LRM-5 发射器为主要远程武器。这使大黄蜂能在六百多米外打击敌人。在城市环境中，LRM 发射器更像是负担而非资产。作为次要武器，大黄蜂携带一门马特尔中型激光，最后机甲还装备一套"主火点防御"反导系统以抵御导弹攻击。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Hunchback 1G is a primitive refit trying to retain the 4G's impressive firepower by replacing the weapons with a Medium and Heavy Rifle inplace of the AC/20.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 驼背 1G 是原始改装型，试图以一门中型和一门重型步枪取代 AC/20，从而保留 4G 令人印象深刻的火力。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Hunchback 1G is a primitive refit trying to retain the 4G's impressive firepower by replacing the weapons with a Medium and Heavy Rifle inplace of the AC/20.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 驼背 1G 是原始改装型，试图以一门中型和一门重型步枪取代 AC/20，从而保留 4G 令人印象深刻的火力。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Hunchback 4G is a tried and tested juggernaut on the field. One of the lightest 'Mechs to mount such a massive Autocannon, it is capable of destroying some lighter units in a single volley. It tends to mount heavy armor to boot.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 驼背 4G 是战场上久经考验的巨兽。它是最轻的、装备如此巨型自动炮的机甲之一，能一轮齐射摧毁一些较轻单位。它还倾向于配备厚重装甲。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Hunchback 4G is a tried and tested juggernaut on the field. One of the lightest 'Mechs to mount such a massive Autocannon, it is capable of destroying some lighter units in a single volley. It tends to mount heavy armor to boot.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 驼背 4G 是战场上久经考验的巨兽。它是最轻的、装备如此巨型自动炮的机甲之一，能一轮齐射摧毁一些较轻单位。它还倾向于配备厚重装甲。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: During the War of 3039, the 9th Ghost regiment was engaged by the Screaming Eagles mercenary company during the Elidere IV campaign, when they decided to modify two of their Hunchbacks to carry prototype Gauss Rifles. Thus, the HBK-4GG was born, able to cause tremendous damage at ranges beyond anyone's expectations.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 3039 年战争中，第 9 幽灵团在埃利代尔 IV 战役期间与"尖叫之鹰"佣兵团交战，当时他们决定改装两台驼背以搭载原型高斯步枪。HBK-4GG 由此诞生，能在超出所有人预期的距离上造成巨大伤害。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: During the War of 3039, the 9th Ghost regiment was engaged by the Screaming Eagles mercenary company during the Elidere IV campaign, when they decided to modify two of their Hunchbacks to carry prototype Gauss Rifles. Thus, the HBK-4GG was born, able to cause tremendous damage at ranges beyond anyone's expectations.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A 'Swayback' variant, the 4H replaces the AC20 with the lighter AC10 and two Medium Lasers.  While this reduces its overall raw firepower, it gives the Hunchback some much needed ranged capabilities.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为"摇摆背"变体，4H 以更轻的 AC10 和两门中型激光取代 AC20。虽然这降低了整体原始火力，却赋予驼背急需的远程能力。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A 'Swayback' variant, the 4H replaces the AC20 with the lighter AC10 and two Medium Lasers.  While this reduces its overall raw firepower, it gives the Hunchback some much needed ranged capabilities.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为"摇摆背"变体，4H 以更轻的 AC10 和两门中型激光取代 AC20。虽然这降低了整体原始火力，却赋予驼背急需的远程能力。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Modified to aid with indirect fire support as well as being able to act as a guardian for fire support lances, the HBK-4J succeeds at both roles.  With its twin LRM-10s it can contribute to the barrage, witlst its five Medium Lasers allow it to fend off the Light 'Mechs that tend to harass fire support teams.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: HBK-4J 经改装既能协助间接火力支援，又能充当火力支援小队的护卫，两个角色都胜任。凭借双联 LRM-10 它能加入弹幕，而五门中型激光使它能击退惯于骚扰火力支援组的轻型机甲。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Another Swayback 'Mech, this variant was first employed in 2856, and changed the Hunchback's focus from short range combat to fire support by removing the AC/20 and replacing it with an LRM-20 launcher.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 又是一款"驼背佬"机甲，此变体于 2856 年首次使用，它移除 AC/20 代之以一具 LRM-20 发射器，把驼背的重心从近战转向火力支援。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Another Swayback 'Mech, this variant was first employed in 2856, and changed the Hunchback's focus from short range combat to fire support by removing the AC/20 and replacing it with an LRM-20 launcher.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 又是一款"驼背佬"机甲，此变体于 2856 年首次使用，它移除 AC/20 代之以一具 LRM-20 发射器，把驼背的重心从近战转向火力支援。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A Kurita Refit of the Swayback J Hunchback that replaces the LRM with a MRM40 and vastly upgrades the chassis.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是库瑞塔对"驼背佬 J"驼背的改装，把 LRM 换成 MRM40，并大幅升级底盘。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A Kurita Refit of the Swayback J Hunchback that replaces the LRM with a MRM40 and vastly upgrades the chassis.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是库瑞塔对"驼背佬 J"驼背的改装，把 LRM 换成 MRM40，并大幅升级底盘。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Combining elements of the 4H and 4J 'Swaybacks', the HBK-4N uses an AC5 and two LRM-5s to give it range, while the four Medium Lasers give it punch up close.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: HBK-4N 融合了 4H 与 4J"驼背佬"的元素，用一门 AC5 和两具 LRM-5 提供射程，四门中型激光则负责近身打击。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Combining elements of the 4H and 4J 'Swaybacks', the HBK-4N uses an AC5 and two LRM-5s to give it range, while the four Medium Lasers give it punch up close.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: HBK-4N 融合了 4H 与 4J"驼背佬"的元素，用一门 AC5 和两具 LRM-5 提供射程，四门中型激光则负责近身打击。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 4P version of the Hunchback trades the singular impact of a massive Autocannon for a frightening array of lighter Energy weaponry that is actually capable of dealing more damage overall. This all comes at the cost of greatly increased heat buildup, of course.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 驼背 4P 版本以一批令人生畏的轻型能量武器取代巨型自动炮的单点冲击，实际上整体伤害更高。当然，代价是热量积累大幅增加。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 4P version of the Hunchback trades the singular impact of a massive Autocannon for a frightening array of lighter Energy weaponry that is actually capable of dealing more damage overall. This all comes at the cost of greatly increased heat buildup, of course.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 驼背 4P 版本以一批令人生畏的轻型能量武器取代巨型自动炮的单点冲击，实际上整体伤害更高。当然，代价是热量积累大幅增加。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 4SP variant of the Hunchback replaces the Autocannon with two SRM6 launchers. This has the potential of doing more damage than the standard model, though the damage is more spread out.  This firepower is supplemented by two Medium Lasers in each arm.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 驼背 4SP 变体以两具 SRM6 发射器取代自动炮。这有可能造成比标准型号更多的伤害，虽然伤害更分散。这一火力由每臂两门中型激光补充。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 4SP is a pretty solid close in 'Mech.  That being said, sitting 2 tons of ammo in the engine compartment worries me a bit.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 4SP 是一台相当扎实的近战机甲。话虽如此，把 2 吨弹药放在引擎舱里让我有点担心。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Originally a refit line converted to full production, the -5S is a complete overhaul of the Hunchback design developed by Norse-Storm BattleMechs in 3058. The structure has been modified to use Endo Steel construction techniques, the engine has been upgraded to a Light Fusion Engine, and four Jump Jets were added for increased mobility. The 'Mech carries, as its primary weapon, an LB-X Autocannon/20 with CASE-protected ammunition supported by two medium pulse lasers and a single small laser.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: -5S 最初是一条改装线，后转为全面量产，是诺斯-风暴战斗机甲公司于 3058 年开发的驼背设计全面翻新。结构已改用内骨骼建造技术，引擎升级为轻型聚变引擎，并加装四个跳跃推进器以提升机动性。机甲的主武器为一门 LB-X 自动炮/20，弹药由 C.A.S.E. 保护，辅以两门中型脉冲激光和一门小型激光。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Hunchback IIC is a ClanTech refit of the venerable Hunchback. Its meager armor, coupled with paltry ammunition and lack of long-range weapons, led Inner Sphere observers to conclude that this 'Mech was a last-ditch effort for failed warriors to die with glory. In truth, the assignment of a Hunchback IIC was essentially a death sentence. Warriors given this machine were not expected to survive their next battle.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 驼背 IIC 是古老的驼背的氏族科技改装版。它可怜的装甲，加上稀少的弹药和缺乏远程武器，让内天体观察家断定这款机甲是失败战士求取荣耀战死的最后一搏。事实上，被分配驼背 IIC 基本等于死刑。获得此机的战士不被指望能活过下一场战斗。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Useful at all ranges, the first alternate configuration uses an LRM-10 and an LB-X Autocannon/2 at long range. A pair of Large Pulse Lasers are accurate at all ranges, though they necessitated the addition of two double heat sinks.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Huntsman B uses an ER PPC at long range. Close in, it can call upon an LB-X Autocannon/10 and a pair of Medium Pulse Lasers. Two Machine Guns can make short work of unarmored infantry.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 猎人 B 在远距离使用一门 ER PPC。近距离可依靠一门 LB-X 自动炮/10 和两门中型脉冲激光。两挺机枪能轻松对付无装甲步兵。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This long-range support variant uses an LRM-20, LRM-15, and an Ultra Autocannon/5 for most of its work. An ER Medium Laser, ER Small Laser, and Streak SRM-4 handle units that get in close. A Flamer provides defense against infantry and combat vehicles.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 此远程支援变体主要使用一具 LRM-20、一具 LRM-15 和一门超速自动炮/5。一门 ER 中型激光、一门 ER 小型激光和一具连续 SRM-4 负责对付逼近的单位。一具火焰喷射器提供对步兵与战斗车辆的防御。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 此远程支援变体主要使用一具 LRM-20、一具 LRM-15 和一门超速自动炮/5。一门 ER 中型激光、一门 ER 小型激光和一具连续 SRM-4 负责对付逼近的单位。一具火焰喷射器提供对步兵与战斗车辆的防御。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The primary weapon that the Huron Warrior carries is a Grizzard Gauss Rifle (Modified 210 Version) that is capable of stripping off a ton of armor with each shot at extremely long ranges. The Gauss Rifle is backed up by a Martell ER Large Laser that provides good supplemental firepower at long ranges. Finally, it is armed with a Martell Medium Pulse Laser, which gives the Huron Warrior the ability to protect itself at short ranges.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 休伦战士的主要武器是一门格里扎德高斯步枪（210 改进版），能在极远距离一枪削掉一吨装甲。高斯步枪辅以一门马特尔 ER 大型激光，在远距离提供良好的补充火力。最后它还装备一门马特尔中型脉冲激光，使休伦战士具备近距离自保能力。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Icarus II was the first homegrown BattleMech design to be mass-produced by the Free Worlds League. It was originally designed as a speedy striker to compliment the Mackie and combat vehicles with a similar speed profile.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 伊卡洛斯 II 是自由世界联盟首个量产的自主战斗机甲设计。它最初被设计为一款高速突击机甲，以配合麦基和速度相近的战斗车辆。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Wow, boss. This is an old design. She may be old but she is solid and that AC10 has some serious punch.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 哇，老大。这可是个老设计。她也许老旧，但很扎实，而那门 AC10 打击力相当可观。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The A configuration carries a single LB-X Autocannon/2 for its excellent long range sniping capabilities. This is backed up by two ER Medium Lasers for close combat capabilities and a single Anti-Missile System for added defense against missile weapons.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: A 配置携带一门 LB-X 自动炮/2，具备出色的远程狙击能力。它辅以两门 ER 中型激光提供近战能力，以及一套反导系统增加对导弹武器的防御。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Ice Ferret B has an ER Large Laser as its only long-range weapon. For close combat, the B configuration carries an SRM-4 and an SRM-6 launcher as well as a highly accurate Small Pulse Laser.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 冰貂 B 只有一门 ER 大型激光作为远程武器。近战方面，B 配置携带一具 SRM-4 和一具 SRM-6 发射器，以及一门极为精准的小型脉冲激光。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A fire support configuration of the Ice Ferret, the C configuration has a trio of LRM-5 launchers, each linked to an Artemis IV fire control system for increased missile accuracy. For close range defense, the 'Mech has a single ER Small Laser.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 冰貂 C 是冰貂的火力支援配置，装备三具 LRM-5 发射器，每具联接一套 Artemis IV 火控系统以提升导弹精度。近程防御方面，机甲有一门 ER 小型激光。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A fire support configuration of the Ice Ferret, the C configuration has a trio of LRM-5 launchers, each linked to an Artemis IV fire control system for increased missile accuracy. For close range defense, the 'Mech has a single ER Small Laser.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: In its primary configuration, the Ice Ferret is capable of acting in a variety of roles. The Ice Ferret carries an Active Probe allowing the 'Mech to detect hidden enemy units. For close combat, the Ice Ferret prime has a Streak SRM-2 launcher and an ER Small Laser. For long range engagements, the 'Mech is armed with a single ER PPC, giving it excellent long range hitting power for its size.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 主配置中，冰貂能胜任多种角色。它携带主动探测器，可侦测隐藏的敌方单位。近战方面，冰貂主型号有一具连续 SRM-2 发射器和一门 ER 小型激光。远程交战时，机甲装备一门 ER PPC，就其尺寸而言拥有出色的远程打击力。

For long range engagements, the 'Mech is armed with a single ER PPC, giving it excellent long range hitting power for its size.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A second line mech designed for settling clan duels, the laser armed Incubus has found considerable success with Clan Hell's Horses'49th Battlemech Cluster as a protomech hunter..
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为一款为裁定氏族决斗而设计的二线机甲，装备激光的梦魇在地狱马氏族第 49 战斗机甲集群中作为原机甲猎手取得了相当成功。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A second line mech designed for settling clan duels, the laser armed Incubus has found considerable success with Clan Hell's Horses'49th Battlemech Cluster as a protomech hunter..
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为一款为裁定氏族决斗而设计的二线机甲，装备激光的梦魇在地狱马氏族第 49 战斗机甲集群中作为原机甲猎手取得了相当成功。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Initiate started production after the Word of Blake retook Terra. This medium 'Mech has been produced in record numbers by the Word of Blake with no shortage of pilots. It is built on a Geometric 1000 Endo Steel chassis to save weight and is powered by a LTV 160 fusion engine that gives it a top speed of 64.8 km/h. For protection from enemy fire, the Initiate carries eight and a half tons of armor that allows the 'Mech to stand up to fire from most other 'Mechs of the same weight class or lower, and enjoys increased durability because of its CASE system that protects against ammunition explosions. Overall, the Initiate is a reliable trooper 'Mech that is capable of filling a variety of roles on the modern battlefield.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 启蒙者在布雷克之言重夺泰拉后开始生产。这款中型机甲被布雷克之言以创纪录的数量生产，飞行员从不短缺。它基于"几何 1000"内骨骼底盘建造以减重，由 LTV 160 聚变引擎驱动，最高速度 64.8 公里/小时。为抵御敌方火力，启蒙者携带八吨半装甲，使机甲能承受同重量级或更低级别大多数机甲的射击，并因其 C.A.S.E. 系统防护弹药爆炸而拥有更高耐久度。总体而言，启蒙者是一台可靠的通用机甲，能在现代战场上胜任多种角色。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Initiate has a diverse weapons mix that allows it to engage an enemy at a variety of ranges. For long-range combat, the Initiate has an Irian Weapons Works V7 LRM-15 launcher that gives the Initiate the ability to strike at an enemy at long ranges as well as giving an indirect fire capability to the 'Mech. For medium range combat, the Initiate has two Irian Weapons Works Super 6 Medium Lasers and an Irian Weapons Works 60mm SRM-6 launcher. For close ranges, the 'Mech has three Diverse Optics Type ER Small Lasers. Finally, to protect against missile attacks, the 'Mech has a McArthur Anti-Missile System.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 启蒙者的武器搭配多样，能在多种距离上交战。远程战斗方面，启蒙者有一具"伊里安兵器工厂 V7"LRM-15 发射器，使启蒙者能在远距离打击敌人，并为机甲提供间接火力能力。中程战斗方面，启蒙者有两门"伊里安兵器工厂超级 6"中型激光和一具"伊里安兵器工厂 60 毫米"SRM-6 发射器。近程方面，机甲有三门"多元光学 ER 型"小型激光。最后，为防御导弹攻击，机甲装有一套麦克阿瑟反导系统。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The JagerMech A model attempts to provide an indirect-fire support platform that can dish out damage without ever being seen. It has lower overall focused damage capability, but it usually mounts decent armor.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 猎手机甲 A 型试图提供一款能在大发雷霆却始终不被看见的间接火力支援平台。它的整体集中伤害能力较低，但通常装备可观的装甲。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The JagerMech A model attempts to provide an indirect-fire support platform that can dish out damage without ever being seen. It has lower overall focused damage capability, but it usually mounts decent armor.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 猎手机甲 A 型试图提供一款能在大发雷霆却始终不被看见的间接火力支援平台。它的整体集中伤害能力较低，但通常装备可观的装甲。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A recent variant to the JagerMech, the JM6-B removes most of the ammunition dependencies of the original model by swapping out the AutoCannons for Lasers.  To make up for the loss in range, a pair of LRM-15 launchers have been added.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为猎手机甲的新近变体，JM6-B 把自动炮换成激光，从而消除了原型号大部分的弹药依赖。为弥补射程损失，加装了一对 LRM-15 发射器。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: While I like the overall lack of ammunition dependence, this beast runs HOT.  I'd suggest we swap out the LRM-15s for LRM-10s and add in another 4 Heat Sinks to help cool her down to a manageable level.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 虽然我喜欢它整体上不依赖弹药，但这头猛兽太热了。我建议我们把 LRM-15 换成 LRM-10，再加 4 台散热器，把它降到可控水平。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The JagerMech S model is highly specialized at long-range Autocannon fire support. It doesn't have much in the way of protection or closer-range weapons, though, so keep it distant and out of harm's way.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 猎手机甲 S 型号高度专精于远程自动炮火力支援。它的防护与近程武器都不多，所以让它保持距离、远离危险。
狙击手 & 直接火力支援

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Jenner R was downgraded to accommodate a lack of replacement parts, carrying 2 SRM6, 2 Rocketlauncher and 2 Medium laser.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 詹纳 R 因缺乏替换零件而遭降级，携带 2 具 SRM6、2 具火箭发射器和 2 门中型激光。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The original Jenner model mounted a Large Laser with a pair of Medium Lasers in a torso mounted turret.  While it was a solid fast moving 'Mech, its Argra 27C Medium Lasers suffered from a targetting defect.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 原版詹纳型号在躯干炮塔中装有一门大型激光和一对中型激光。虽然它是一台扎实的高速机甲，其"阿尔格拉 27C"中型激光却存在瞄准缺陷。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: I like the idea of mounting the Large Laser - those old Drac techs had the right idea, but they executed it poorly.  We should yank out the extra Medium Lasers and replace them with Heat Sinks.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我喜欢装大型激光这个主意——那些老联合体技师的想法是对的，但执行得很糟。我们应该拆掉那些多余的中型激光，换成散热器。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The JR7-C was a basic upgrade of the JR7-K, removing one of the Medium Lasers and replacing it with a C3 Slave Unit. Combined with its speed this made the Jenner an ideal spotter for a C3 company.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: JR7-C 是 JR7-K 的基础升级，移除其中一门中型激光，换成一台 C3 从属单元。结合其速度，这使詹纳成为 C3 连的理想目标指示者。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The JR7-C was a basic upgrade of the JR7-K, removing one of the Medium Lasers and replacing it with a C3 Slave Unit. Combined with its speed this made the Jenner an ideal spotter for a C3 company..
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: JR7-C 是 JR7-K 的基础升级，移除其中一门中型激光，换成一台 C3 从属单元。结合其速度，这使詹纳成为 C3 连的理想目标指示者。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Jenner Ds run hot, and they run fast but can quickly bound into combat to deliver a knockout punch, even against heavier units. Their capability with speed and weaponry tends to come at the expense of lower armor capacity, though.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 詹纳 D 散热偏热、跑得很快，能迅速跃入战斗打出致命一击，即使对更重的单位也是如此。不过它在速度与武器上的本事，往往是以较低装甲容量为代价的。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Jenner F drops the SRM in favor of increasing armor across the entire 'Mech, producing a more durable striker.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 詹纳 F 舍弃 SRM，转而增强整台机甲的装甲，造就了一款更耐久的突击手。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 詹纳 F 舍弃 SRM，转而增强整台机甲的装甲，造就了一款更耐久的突击手。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Jenner was first fielded in September 2784, the same year the Exodus fleet that would eventually become the Clans left the Inner Sphere in November. How exactly they acquired this design in that short timeframe is not known, but what is known is that the Clan version fields Clan weaponry.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 詹纳首次投入战场是在 2784 年 9 月，同年 11 月，最终演变为氏族的出埃及舰队离开了内天体。他们如何在如此短的时间内获得该设计不得而知，但已知氏族版本装备的是氏族武器。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The JR7-K adds a higher degree of survivability to the Jenner by upgrading the armor to Ferro-Fibrous, while removing a half ton of the armor. This provides virtually the same armor protection while allowing space for CASE to protect the SRM-4 ammunition.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: JR7-K 通过把装甲升级为铁纤维并削减半吨装甲，为詹纳提升了生存性。这提供了几乎相同的装甲防护，同时腾出空间加装 C.A.S.E. 以保护 SRM-4 弹药。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A lumbering mountain of armor and weaponry, Solaris Arms' massive assault 'Mech definitely lives up to the name of Juggernaut in the Solaris Games. While not a flashy design, Solaris Arms kept up steady production of the design since the early 3050s. Sixteen and half tons of Valiant Chainmail armor protect a GM 270 Fusion Engine, propelling the 'Mech at fairly standard assault 'Mech speed of 54 kph.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为一座笨重的装甲与武器之山，索拉里斯兵工厂的巨型突击机甲在索拉里斯竞技场上绝对配得上"主宰者"之名。虽然设计并不炫目，索拉里斯兵工厂自 3050 年代初以来一直稳定生产该设计。十六吨半的"勇武锁子甲"装甲保护着一台 GM 270 聚变引擎，推动机甲以相当标准的突击机甲速度——54 公里/小时——行进。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Juggernaut's main armament is a trio of Large X-Pulse Lasers, one in each arm with one in its center torso, backed up by three Sutel Precision Line Medium X-Pulse Lasers divided between each arm and the head. Due to the 'Mech's lack of hand actuators, at knife-fighting range the Juggernaut is protected by a staggering twelve Machine Guns fed from two tons of reloads.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 重装的主要武装是三门大型 X 脉冲激光，每臂各一，中央躯干一门，辅以三门苏特尔精准线中型 X 脉冲激光，分列每臂与头部。由于机甲没有手部驱动器，在贴身距离上重装靠十二挺机枪（由两吨再装填供弹）提供惊人的防护。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Developed by Diplan mechyards as an easy to repair, scout and ambusher. This mech can deliver a nasty punch, before having to withdraw.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 由迪普兰机甲船坞开发，作为一款易于修理的侦察与伏击机甲。这台机甲能打出凶狠一击，然后不得不撤离。
轻型攻击手 & 侦察兵

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: For a scout this kabuto does the job with the benefit of a quick mission kill on other lights in it's weight bracket. We can work with it boss.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为侦察机甲，这台"兜"能完成任务，还有能迅速击杀同重量级其他轻型机甲的优点。我们能凑合用，老大。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An upgrade of the base model. This mech is sold only to the DCMS and fills the ranks if a number of elite units.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 基础型号的升级版。此机甲仅售予 DCMS，充实了若干精锐单位的编制。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Kanazuchi, Japanese for 'hammer', is a Draconis Combine battle armor design, one of the heaviest to come from that realm.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 金锤（日语"锤子"）是德拉科尼斯联合体的战斗装甲设计，是该势力出品中最重的一种。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The King Crab KGC-0 is a badly maintained primitive version of one of the most heavily armed and armored 'Mechs ever constructed. While carrying lesser weaponry is its arsenal still able to deliver a crushing Blow.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 帝王蟹 KGC-0 是维护不良的原始版本，属史上武装与装甲最厚重的机甲之一。虽然武器较弱，其火力库仍能造成毁灭性打击。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: One of the most heavily armed and armored 'Mechs ever constructed, the King Crab 0000 is capable of massive burst damage. A pair of heavy, close-range Autocannons form its primary weaponry, backed up by ranged weaponry to fire as it closes distance.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 帝王蟹 0000 是史上武装与装甲最厚重的机甲之一，能造成巨大的爆发伤害。一对重型近程自动炮构成其主要武器，辅以远程武器在接近过程中开火。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: One of the most heavily armed and armored 'Mechs ever constructed, the King Crab 0000 is capable of massive burst damage. A pair of heavy, close-range Autocannons form its primary weaponry, backed up by ranged weaponry to fire as it closes distance.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: One of the so-called Clanbuster variants developed in 3052 during the lead-up to the Battle of Tukayyid, ComStar's techs replaced the twin autocannons with two M-7 Gauss Rifles and four tons of ammo in the arms, trading a minor reduction in destructive capacity for greatly increased range. While retaining the LRM launcher the large laser was upgraded to a Tronel XIII Large Pulse Laser and two Hovertec Streak SRM-2s, split between the side torsos with a single ton of reloads each, were added. These changes were accomplished by using an extralight engine in place of the standard model.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是 3052 年图卡伊德战役前夕开发的所谓"破氏族"变体之一。康星技师将双联自动炮换成两门 M-7 高斯步枪，臂部携带四吨弹药，以略微降低的破坏力换取大幅提升的射程。保留 LRM 发射器的同时，大型激光升级为特罗内尔 XIII 大型脉冲激光，并加装两具霍弗泰克连续 SRM-2，分列两侧躯干、各配一吨再装填。这些改动通过以超轻型引擎取代标准引擎实现。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 帝王蟹 0002 变体是史上武装与装甲最厚重的机甲之一，装备双 UAC10 与 MRM。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The King Crab-000b, the Star League's Royal variant, is every bit as powerful as its downgraded cousin, the -0000. Still armed with twin AC/20s, the -000b's double heat sinks and doubled ammo keeps the massive cannons firing far longer and more frequently making the -000b a true terror on the battlefield.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 帝王蟹-000b 是星盟的皇家变体，威力丝毫不逊于其降级版表亲-0000。它仍装备双 AC/20，其双倍散热器与双倍弹药让这对巨炮能更持久、更频繁地开火，使-000b 成为战场上真正的恐怖。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This version of the King Crab was created by the Star League to be a command 'Mech and introduced alongside the original 000 model in 2743. Conceived in secret between Cosara and the Terran Hegemony, it was an attempt to produce a deadly command 'Mech by mounting a pair of newly-developed Hellstar Magna PPCs in either side torso backed by bya pair of SRM-6's. A pair of newly developed LBX/10's replaced the standard autocannon. The 010 model was more than capable of taking down an Atlas, but the entire line left with Kerensky during the Exodus and even knowledge of the design's existence became lost during the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 此版帝王蟹由星盟打造为指挥机甲，与原始 000 型于 2743 年一同推出。它由科萨拉与地球霸权秘密构想，试图通过在两肋各装一对新研制的"地狱星"大型 PPC 并辅以两具 SRM-6，打造一款致命的指挥机甲。一对新研制的 LBX/10 取代了标准自动炮。010 型完全有能力击杀一台阿特拉斯，但整条生产线随克伦斯基一同出走，连该设计存在的知识也在继承战争中失传。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Kintaro 18 isÔÇª a beast of a machine. It's fast for its size, mounts heavy armor, and can literally shred most other 'Mechs with its almost ridiculous amount of close-range weaponry. But, it runs hotter than Hell's saunas.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 金太郎 18 是……一台猛兽般的机器。就体型而言它很快，装备厚重装甲，凭其近乎荒谬的近程武器数量，几乎能把大多数其他机甲撕成碎片。不过，它比地狱的桑拿房还热。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This Marik refit of the Kintaro was built in cooperation with Holly as a testbed for Streak and NARC missiles.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这款马里克对金太郎的改装是与冬青公司合作建造的，用作连续导弹与 NARC 导弹的试验台。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This Marik refit of the Kintaro was built in cooperation with Holly as a testbed for Streak and NARC missiles.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这款马里克对金太郎的改装是与冬青公司合作建造的，用作连续导弹与 NARC 导弹的试验台。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Kintaro 19 isÔÇª a beast of a machine. It's fast for its size, mounts heavy armor, and can literally shred most other 'Mechs with its almost ridiculous amount of Narc supported close-range weaponry. But, it runs hotter than Hell's saunas.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 金太郎 19 是……一台猛兽般的机器。就体型而言它很快，装备厚重装甲，凭其近乎荒谬的、由 NARC 支援的近程武器数量，几乎能把大多数其他机甲撕成碎片。不过，它比地狱的桑拿房还热。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The KTO-19b was an upgrade utilized by the Royal Brigades of the SLDF. It used an XL Engine and Double Heat Sinks to free up space to upgrade the KTO-19's LRM-5 launcher to a larger LRM-15.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: KTO-19b 是星盟防卫军皇家旅使用的升级型。它使用 XL 引擎和双倍散热器腾出空间，把 KTO-19 的 LRM-5 发射器升级为更大的 LRM-15。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The KTO-19b was an upgrade utilized by the Royal Brigades of the SLDF. It used an XL Engine and Double Heat Sinks to free up space to upgrade the KTO-19's LRM-5 launcher to a larger LRM-15.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The KTO-20, used to good effect in the War of 3039, was the slightly downgraded version of the KTO-19 given to the Draconis Combine by ComStar as part of Operation Rosebud. The KTO-20 was nearly identical to its Star League era cousin, the only real difference being the loss of the Narc Missile beacon in exchange for a Magna Mk III Large Laser. It was equipped with double heat sinks.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: KTO-20 在 3039 年战争中发挥了良好作用，是康星作为"玫瑰花蕾"行动一部分交给德拉科尼斯联合体的 KTO-19 的轻度降级版。KTO-20 与其星盟时代的表亲几乎相同，唯一真正的差别是失去了 NARC 导弹信标，换成一门玛格纳 Mk III 大型激光。它装备了双倍散热器。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Developed by both ComStar and the Word of Blake, the KTO-21 was the first 'Mech to utilize both the new Improved Narc Missile Beacon (iNarc for short) and the improved C3 computer system. In order to utilize these new systems, the KTO-21 was refitted with an Endo Steel chassis and carried half a ton less armor than the KTO-19. Retaining only the two SRM launchers, the LRM launcher was dropped and the standard medium lasers were upgraded to more advanced ER Medium Lasers, enhanced by a switch to Double Heat Sinks.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: KTO-21 由康星与布雷克之言共同开发，是首款同时使用新型改进型 NARC 导弹信标（简称 iNarc）和改进型 C3 计算机系统的机甲。为使用这些新系统，KTO-21 改装了内骨骼底盘，装甲比 KTO-19 少半吨。它只保留两具 SRM 发射器，去掉了 LRM 发射器，标准中型激光升级为更先进的 ER 中型激光，并改用双倍散热器加以强化。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A variant of the Combine's KTO-20, the KTO-C was one of the test bed 'Mechs for the C3 Slave Unit, one of the Medium Lasers being removed in order to free up the necessary weight.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: KTO-C 是联合体 KTO-20 的变体，是 C3 从属单元的试验台机甲之一，它移除一门中型激光以腾出所需重量。
