Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An upgrade to the KTO-C, the KTO-K removed the Large Laser and LRM launcher to upgrade the short-range missiles to Streak SRM-6s. The lasers were upgraded to ER Medium Lasers and a third was added. The most significant difference was the addition of Jump jets to allow the unit to leap up to 150 meters.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: KTO-K 是 KTO-C 的升级版，移除大型激光和 LRM 发射器，把短程火箭升级为连续 SRM-6。激光升级为 ER 中型激光，并加装第三门。最显著的区别是加装跳跃推进器，使单位能跃至 150 米。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The A configuration of the Kit Fox uses a Gauss Rifle as its primary long-range weapon. Two ER Medium Lasers provide medium and short-range firepower.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 小狐 A 配置以一门高斯步枪为主要远程武器。两门 ER 中型激光提供中近程火力。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The A configuration of the Kit Fox uses a Gauss Rifle as its primary long-range weapon. Two ER Medium Lasers provide medium and short-range firepower.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The B configuration of the Kit Fox boasts a rapid-fire Ultra Autocannon-10 as its primary weapon, startling considering the 'Mech's tonnage. An ER Medium Laser, ER Small Laser, and an SRM-6 rack allow the Kit Fox B to finish off anything that manages to close ranges.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 小狐 B 配置以一门速射超速自动炮-10 为主武器，就机甲的吨位而言令人吃惊。一门 ER 中型激光、一门 ER 小型激光和一具 SRM-6 挂架使小狐 B 能干掉任何设法接近的目标。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Kit Fox D is configured for indirect fire support, mounting dual LRM-15 racks as well as a LRM-5. A Narc Missile Beacon is also carried, which may be exploited by the Kit Fox D itself, as the targeting systems of Clan LRMs lack a minimum range; this literally allows the Kit Fox D to run up to an enemy and mark them for increased accuracy, and then fall back, firing the entire time.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 小狐 D 配置为间接火力支援，装备双联 LRM-15 挂架以及一具 LRM-5。它还携带一具 NARC 导弹信标，且此信标可被小狐 D 自己利用——因为氏族 LRM 的瞄准系统没有最小射程，这实际上让小狐 D 能冲到敌人跟前为其标记以提升精度，然后一面后撤一面持续开火。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: In its primary configuration, the Kit Fox mounts an ER Large Laser and Small Pulse Laser on the left arm as its primary source of firepower. These are supplemented by an LB 5-X Autocannon for tactical flexibility and a Streak SRM-4 rack for close range combat.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 主配置中，小狐左臂装备一门 ER 大型激光和一门小型脉冲激光作为主要火力。它们由一门 LB 5-X 自动炮（提供战术灵活性）和一具连续 SRM-4 挂架（用于近战）作补充。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Kit Fox S is a Clan Snow Raven variant based for space combat. The primary weapon is a Large Pulse Laser, while a Medium Pulse Laser and a Small Pulse Laser complement this, with a Streak SRM-4 for additional firepower.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 小狐 S 是雪鸦氏族的太空战变体。主武器为一门大型脉冲激光，辅以一门中型脉冲激光和一门小型脉冲激光，另有一具连续 SRM-4 提供额外火力。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A fast moving assault Mech, the Kodiak was originally designed by Clan Ghost Bear as a second-line mech and represents the epitome of Ghost Bear thinking: mostly defensive but capable of surprising speed and a devastating attack when launched.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 科迪亚克是一款高速突击机甲，最初由鬼熊氏族设计为二线机甲，体现了鬼熊思维的精髓：偏重防御，但在发动时能展现出惊人的速度和毁灭性的攻击。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Komodo was designed in 3053 to hunt and kill Clan Elemental Battle Armor. The 'Mech is built to be able to catch up to and destroy them with exceptional speed and maneuverability. The 'Mech is powered by a VOX 225 XL Engine that propels the 'Mech to a maximum speed of 86.4 kph. The Komodo can jump up to one hundred and fifty meters allowing it to traverse just about any terrain with ease, and is armored with seven and a half tons of armor. The 'Mech is also equipped with a Matabushi Guardian ECM Suite to defend against any enemy electronic warfare systems and also a Forward-1 TAG allowing the Komodo to designate a target for an Arrow IV artillery strike.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 科莫多于 3053 年设计，专为猎杀氏族元素战斗装甲。机甲能以卓越的速度与机动性追上并消灭它们。它由 VOX 225 XL 引擎驱动，最高速度 86.4 公里/小时。科莫多可跳跃至一百五十米，轻松跨越几乎任何地形，并有七吨半装甲。它还配备马塔布希守护者 ECM 套件以防御敌方电子战系统，以及 Forward-1 TAG 使科莫多能为箭矢 IV 炮击标记目标。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Komodo is armed with ten Victory 23R Medium Lasers as its primary weapons. While these have a range of only 270 meters, the 'Mech has enough firepower to annihilate an entire point of Elementals. The 'Mech is also armed with two Yori Flyswatter Anti-Missile Systems to defend against missile attacks.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 科莫多以十门"胜利 23R"中型激光为主武器。虽然这些武器射程仅 270 米，机甲却有足够火力歼灭整整一"点"元素步兵。机甲还装备两套"织部苍蝇拍"反导系统以抵御导弹攻击。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 2A variant of the Komodo is a modification that looks to increase the 'Mechs reach by replacing five of the Medium Lasers with a single ER Large Laser, allowing the Komodo to strike at a much farther range at the cost of raw firepower.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 科莫多 2A 变体是一项改装，旨在通过以一门 ER 大型激光取代五门中型激光来提升机甲的打击距离，使科莫多以牺牲原始火力为代价能在远得多的距离上攻击。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Configured similarly to the Timber Wolf Prime, the Linebacker A carries, as its primary long-range weapons, a pair of ER Large Lasers that are backed up by an LRM-5 launcher and LRM-15 launcher, both of which allow the Linebacker to bombard its target at long range. For close combat, the 'Mech carries two ER Medium Lasers.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 中后卫 A 配置与木材狼主型号相似，其主要远程武器为一对 ER 大型激光，辅以一具 LRM-5 和一具 LRM-15 发射器，使中后卫能在远距离轰击目标。近战方面，机甲携带两门 ER 中型激光。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Configured similarly to the Timber Wolf Prime, the Linebacker A carries, as its primary long-range weapons, a pair of ER Large Lasers that are backed up by an LRM-5 launcher and LRM-15 launcher, both of which allow the Linebacker to bombard its target at long range. For close combat, the 'Mech carries two ER Medium Lasers.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Linebacker B is a sniper configuration. The 'Mech carries a powerful Gauss Rifle for fearsome long range hitting power. For close combat, the 'Mech has three ER Medium Lasers and a single ER Small Laser.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 中后卫 B 是狙击配置。机甲携带一门强劲的高斯步枪，具备可怕的远程打击力。近战方面，它有三门 ER 中型激光和一门 ER 小型激光。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Linebacker B is a sniper configuration. The 'Mech carries a powerful Gauss Rifle for fearsome long range hitting power. For close combat, the 'Mech has three ER Medium Lasers and a single ER Small Laser.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Linebacker D is a committed close-combat configuration with four highly accurate Streak SRM-6 launchers providing an overwhelming close range missile barrage. The launchers are backed up by two ER Medium Lasers and a rear-mounted ER Small Laser, making this configuration a ferocious short-range brawler - until its three ammunition bins run dry.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 中后卫 D 是一款彻底的近战配置，四具极为精准的连续 SRM-6 发射器提供压倒性的近程导弹弹幕。发射器辅以两门 ER 中型激光和一门后向 ER 小型激光，使此配置成为凶悍的近距离缠斗者——直到三个弹药箱打空为止。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Lineholder was the first BattleMech design to come from Kressly Warworks. The Lineholder is designed around a set of Common Sense Rules for 'Mech design. This approach has produced a 'Mech with a good ground speed and respectable amount of armor and firepower. The 'Mech has a top speed of 86.4 km/h, allowing it to keep up with all but the fastest light and medium 'Mechs. The Lineholder also carries ten tons of armor protection and has fourteen heat sinks. Its mix of off-the-shelf weapons and equipment makes the Lineholder a reliable 'Mech that is easy to repair and is dependable in battle. However, the ultimate selling point for the Lineholder, especially to its target audience of small units and minor nobles, is value and price. In the first year of sales, the Lineholder was historically successful compared with other 55-ton BattleMechs. For minor factions able to afford brand new BattleMechs, the Lineholder has become the garrison machine of choice.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 战线守护者是克雷斯利兵工厂出品的第一款战斗机甲设计。它围绕一套"机甲设计常识规则"构建。这一思路造就了一台地面速度良好、装甲与火力都相当可观的机甲。它最高速度 86.4 公里/小时，除最快的轻中型机甲外都能跟上。战线守护者还携带十吨装甲防护并有十四台散热器。它采用的现货武器与装备组合使其成为易于修理、作战可靠的机甲。然而其终极卖点——尤其对小型单位与末等贵族这类目标客户——是性价比。在销售第一年，战线守护者的业绩与其他 55 吨战斗机甲相比堪称历史性成功。对买得起全新战斗机甲的小势力而言，它已成为驻防机型的首选。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The primary weapons on the Lineholder are a pair of LongFire V LRM-5 launchers. These allow the Lineholder to keep an enemy at long range and enable the 'Mech to provide limited indirect fire support. The LRMs are backed up by a BlazeFire Systems Large Laser. Finally, the Lineholder carries four Intek Medium Lasers to protect itself in close combat.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 战线守护者的主武器是一对"长火 V"LRM-5 发射器。它们让战线守护者能把敌人保持在远距离，并使机甲能提供有限的间接火力支援。LRM 由一门"烈焰系统"大型激光支援。最后，战线守护者携带四门英泰克中型激光以在近战中自卫。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An upgrade of the Lineholder to make it more viable on the modern battlefield, the LH3 variant replaces the Large Laser with an ER Large Laser and the four Medium Lasers with two Medium Pulse Lasers.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: LH3 变体是对战线守护者的升级，使其在现代战场上更具生存力：它以一门 ER 大型激光取代大型激光，以两门中型脉冲激光取代四门中型激光。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Developed by the Capellan Confederation at the same time as the Cataphract this prototype 'Mech never entered full production. Its designs were eventually sold and used to create the Daboku and Mauler. It carries two Medium Lasers, four AC/2s, and two LRM-15
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 此原型机甲由卡佩兰邦联与铁甲舰同期开发，从未进入量产。其设计最终被出售，用于打造打木与重击者。它携带两门中型激光、四门 AC/2 和两具 LRM-15

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Loader King is one of the few IndustrialMechs still being manufactured in the Inner Sphere. This is due in large part to the fact that Achernar BattleMechs, the parent company of Achernar Heavy Industries, chose to maintain their IndustrialMech output rather than retool the lines for BattleMech production. Achernar BattleMechs already produces the Locust, Wasp, Phoenix Hawk and the Enforcer at their headquarters on New Avalon.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 装载之王是内天体仍在制造的少数工业机甲之一。这在很大程度上是因为阿克尔纳战斗机甲的母公司阿克尔纳重工选择维持其工业机甲产量，而非将生产线改装用于战斗机甲生产。阿克尔纳战斗机甲已在其新阿瓦隆总部生产蝗虫、黄蜂、凤凰鹰和执法者。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: I'm sure we can do something with this Commander, but we are pretty limited without completely gutting and rebuilding it as a whole new 'Mech.  First thing we'd have to do, is get rid of that I.C.E. and get a proper fusion engine in it.  Not sure this will be worth it.  Might not be bad for moving things around the bays though...
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我相信我们能对它做点什么，指挥官，但如果不彻底掏空并作为全新机甲重建，我们的余地相当有限。首先我们得扔掉那台内燃机，换上正经的聚变引擎。不确定这值不值得。不过用来在机库里搬搬东西也许不错……

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Clan Jade Falcon version carries CASE with an Extended Range Medium Laser in the center torso section and two Streak SRM-2s in each arm.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 翡翠猎鹰氏族版本携带 C.A.S.E.，中央躯干有一门 ER 中型激光，每臂两具连续 SRM-2。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This Clan Smoke Jaguar version is set up to sport an Extended Range Large Laser in its center torso, with a Small Pulse Laser in each arm, making this variant a quite capable infantry killer in addition to its role as a fast sniper.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 此烟虎氏族版本在中央躯干装备一门 ER 大型激光，每臂一门小型脉冲激光，使该变体除了担任快速狙击手外，还是相当出色的步兵杀手。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This version was redesigned so that it could be produced in the Inner Sphere by Clan Jade Falcon on their Occupation Zone headquarters world of Sudeten. It replaces the small lasers of the standard variant with three General Systems Heavy Small Lasers in each arm. The medium pulse laser has been downgraded to a Series 7Ja ER Medium Laser, while a pair of additional double heat sinks are added to help deal with the increased heat.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 此版本经过重新设计，以便翡翠猎鹰氏族能在其占领区总部世界苏德滕于内天体生产。它将标准变体的小型激光换成每臂三门通用系统重型小型激光。中型脉冲激光被降级为 7Ja 系列 ER 中型激光，同时加装两台额外双倍散热器以应对增加的热量。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: One of the best known BattleMechs in the Inner Sphere for its low production and operation costs, the Locust is also well known in the Clans. In 2832, Clan Mongoose unleashed an upgraded version of the venerable 'Mech on the Clans, known as the Locust IIC. The speedy design complemented Mongoose tactics, enabling them to win many Trials.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 蝗虫因其低廉的生产与运营成本成为内天体最知名的战斗机甲之一，在氏族中同样广为人知。2832 年，猫鼬氏族向氏族推出这款古老机甲的升级版，称为蝗虫 IIC。该高速设计与猫鼬战术相得益彰，使他们赢下许多试炼。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Locust 0P is a primitive downgrade, favored among Bandits and Local Security forces for it's easy to maintain Internal Combustion Engine.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 蝗虫 0P 是原始降级版，因其易于维护的内燃引擎而受匪帮与地方保安部队青睐。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Locust 1E was an attempt to turn the Locust into a viable front line mech by increasing its firepower with an additional Medium Laser.  Having removed its reliance on ammunition, the Locust is able to operate for an extended amount of time without supplies.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 蝗虫 1E 试图通过加装一门额外中型激光提升火力，把蝗虫变成可行的前线机甲。摆脱对弹药的依赖后，蝗虫能在无补给的情况下长时间作战。
轻型攻击手 & 侦察兵

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Locust's 1M model is interesting in that it can churn out a decent volley of LRMs for such a small 'Mech. It's a great harasser, especially if you can use its speed to lob missiles into the weaker rear armor of targets. But it normally has almost no armor itself.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 蝗虫 1M 型号有趣之处在于，如此小的机甲竟能喷出可观的 LRM 齐射。它是出色的骚扰者，尤其当你能用速度把导弹甩进目标较薄弱的后方装甲时。但它自身通常几乎无装甲。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Locust 1S models tend to sacrifice the little armor they normally mount to fire respectable SRM salvos. Definitely useful for hit-and-runs, especially if those shots provide the extra punch to knock down a target.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 蝗虫 1S 型号倾向于牺牲本来就不多的装甲，以倾泻可观的 SRM 齐射。对打了就跑的战术绝对有用，尤其当这些射击能提供击倒目标的额外打击力时。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The basic Locust 1V has one big advantage: speed. It's not meant to put up much of a fight, but you'd be hard-pressed to find a 'Mech that goes further and is harder to hit.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 基础型蝗虫 1V 有一个巨大优势：速度。它本就不为硬拼而设，但你也很难找到另一台跑得更远、更难被击中的机甲。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Royal Locust-1Vb was used by the Star League's Royal brigades as a scout and makes use a bevy of advanced technologies that now lostech.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 皇家蝗虫-1Vb 曾被星盟皇家旅用作侦察机甲，采用了一批如今已成失传技术的先进技术。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Royal Locust-1Vb was used by the Star League's Royal brigades as a scout and makes use a bevy of advanced technologies that now lostech.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 2S variant was designed by Majesty Metals of the Magistracy of Canopus as a fast raider and tank hunter suitable for export throughout the periphery. Armed with twin SRM6s, loaded with 2 tons of munitions and fitted with MASC; the 2S is a fearsome knife fighter that can quickly close in and cripple it’s opponents. To make room for the missiles, the standard engine was substituted for an XL engine and paired with an endo steel chassis. Unfortunately the low armour and lack of CASE protected magazines has lead to a high mortality rate among it’s pilots; earning it the nickname dead woman's coffin. As the pilot often goes down with their mech – usually in a fiery explosion as the ammunition magazines detonate. Considered an expensive failure by the Magistracy, the design is nonetheless in high demand throughout the periphery with back orders sufficient to keep Magistracy Metals supplying the design for years to come.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 2S 变体由卡诺普斯法域的 Majesty Metals 设计，作为适合向外围区各地出口的快速劫掠者与坦克猎手。它装备双联 SRM6，装填 2 吨弹药并配备 MASC；2S 是一名令人生畏的短兵相接者，能迅速逼近并瘫痪对手。为给导弹腾出空间，标准引擎被换成 XL 引擎，并搭配内骨骼底盘。遗憾的是，薄弱的装甲和缺乏 C.A.S.E. 保护的弹仓导致其飞行员死亡率很高；为它赢得了"死人棺材"的绰号——飞行员常常随座机一同陨落，通常是弹药库殉爆时的猛烈爆炸。法域认为这是一次昂贵的失败，但该设计在外围区仍需求旺盛，积压订单足以让 Majesty Metals 在未来数年继续供应这一设计。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The LCT-0S, or Dead Woman's Coffin, is designed to unleash a withering fusillade of SRMs, and then it will likely be destroyed. Since the only SRMs its armed with are unguided, it's unlikely to score any hits. Carrying subsequent salvos is only wasted tonnage
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: LCT-0S，又称"死人棺材"，其设计目的是倾泻一阵猛烈的 SRM 弹雨，然后它很可能会被摧毁。由于它装备的 SRM 都是无制导的，很可能一发都打不中。携带后续齐射只是浪费吨位

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 3D Locust introduced in 3049 used Star League technology to take the concept of the 1M further. Although it carried only two Magna Longbow-5 launchers, the engineers at Achernar BattleMechs on New Avalon upgraded the armor to Ferro-Fibrous and the structure to Endo Steel. Completely lacking in close-range weaponry this variant was suitable for harassing the enemy at long range then fleeing before they could get too close.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 3D 蝗虫于 3049 年推出，使用星盟科技把 1M 的理念推进得更远。虽然它只携带两具玛格纳长弓-5 发射器，但新阿瓦隆阿克尔纳战斗机甲的工程师把装甲升级为铁纤维、结构升级为内骨骼。该变体完全没有近程武器，适合在远距离骚扰敌人，然后在对方逼近前逃离。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 3M Locust was built for the Free Worlds League in 3050, with production carried out at both Corean Enterprises on Stewart and Free Worlds Defense Industries on Gibson. It retained the Martell medium laser but replaced the machine guns with four Magna Small Lasers and added a Voelkers Parasol Anti-Missile System in the left arm for missile defense. The armor was upgraded to Kallon FWL Special Ferro-Fibrous with CASE in the left torso to protect the one ton of AMS ammo and utilized a Corean-II Delux Endo Steel chassis. The electronics were also updated to a Garrett T10 B communications system and a Corean CalcMaster targeting-tracking system.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 3M 蝗虫于 3050 年为自由世界联盟建造，在斯图尔特上的科里安企业与吉布森上的自由世界防务工业同时生产。它保留马特尔中型激光，但把机枪换成四门玛格纳小型激光，并在左臂加装一套"沃克斯阳伞"反导系统用于导弹防御。装甲升级为卡隆 FWL 特种铁纤维，左躯干的 C.A.S.E. 保护一吨 AMS 弹药，底盘则采用科里安-II 豪华内骨骼。电子设备也更新为加勒特 T10 B 通讯系统和科里安 CalcMaster 瞄准追踪系统。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Longbow, introduced in 2480, has seen service in the armies of the Inner Sphere since the days of the Star League and is one of the most well-known fire support 'Mechs in existence. As a fire-support 'Mech though, the Longbow is a trusted and reliable machine that can be counted on to carry out the mission it is designed for. The primary weapons on the Longbow are its LRM launchers, four in all, a pair of 20s and a pair of 5s, letting the Longbow put out 50 LRMs into any target it can see.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 长弓于 2480 年推出，自星盟时代起就在内天体各军服役，是现存最知名的火力支援机甲之一。作为火力支援机甲，长弓是一台值得信赖的可靠机器，能被指望完成其设计使命。长弓的主要武器是其 LRM 发射器——共四具，成对的 20 型和成对的 5 型——让它能向任何看得见的目标倾泻 50 枚 LRM。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 7V variant of the Longbow upgrades the design to more modern specifications. The 'Mech is powered by an XL engine that weighs half as much as the original engine. The 'Mech also removes the two LRM-5 launchers and adds Artemis IV to the LRM-20 launchers, and CASE for added protection. For close combat, the 7V has 5 Medium Pulse Lasers. To add a little more long range firepower, the 7V has also has an ER Large Laser.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 长弓 7V 变体将该设计升级至更现代的规格。机甲由一台重量仅为原引擎一半的 XL 引擎驱动。它还移除两具 LRM-5 发射器，为 LRM-20 发射器加装 Artemis IV，并用 C.A.S.E. 增加保护。近战方面，7V 有 5 门中型脉冲激光。为进一步增加远程火力，7V 还配备一门 ER 大型激光。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A favorite tool of planetary governments through out the Periphery, the Louse is designed for riot suppression. Capable of dispersing riots with lethal and non lethal options, it works well against civilians and lightly armed vehicles while posing no significant threat to actual battlemechs or military grade vehicles. Dual grenade launchers and a mixed laser package provide the bulk of the firepower, whilst a pair of flare launchers provides additional deterrent and can be used defensively in combat. Spall lined armour provides additional protection against infantry grade weapons and a set of sensors designed specifically for peering through cluttered urban environments round out the package. Often deployed as scouts and support forces; this mech is a common sight amongst the pirate bands who find themselves facing it across the battlefield. Not designed for battle, it is nonetheless pressed into service by desperate militias and governments that lack real battlemechs.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为外围区各行星政府钟爱的工具，虱子专为镇压暴乱而设计。它能以致命与非致命手段驱散暴乱，对付平民和轻武装车辆效果良好，而对真正的战斗机甲或军用级车辆不构成显著威胁。双联榴弹发射器和混合激光组提供主要火力，另有一对照明弹发射器提供额外威慑，也可在战斗中用于防御。防崩落内衬装甲提供对步兵级武器的额外防护，一套专为穿透杂乱城市环境而设计的传感器补全了整套配置。它常作为侦察与支援部队部署；在那些与它战场相见的强盗团伙中也很常见。它并非为战斗设计，却仍被缺乏真正战斗机甲的绝望民兵与政府强行投入使用。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This configuration was used for direct fire support roles. A Large Pulse Laser in one arm supported an Ultra AC/10 in the other. A pair of ER Medium Lasers gave the Lupus A additional firepower in case the 'Mech went through all 30 reloads for the autocannon. Twelve double heat sinks kept the heat manageable.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This version also used an autocannon, but it was a massive LB 20-X AC with three tons of ammunition. This was supported by a pair each of Medium Pulse Lasers, ER Small Lasers, and ER Medium Lasers. This variant carried eleven double heat sinks.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The primary configuration of the Lupus replaces the Archer and Bombardier 'Mechs. A pair of LRM-20 launchers with improved Artemis IV guidance systems allows the warrior to destroy a foe before they can reach close range. The Lupus Prime also carries a set of jump jets which allowed a smart warrior the opportunity to hold the range open, bombarding the enemy with heavy missile barrages. The only drawback is the limited ammunition supply: A mere three tons of ammunition allows for only a brief engagement. Should the enemy close with the Lupus all is not lost. The ER Medium Laser in each arm allow the Lupus to slice off armor, and the ECM Suite makes the Lupus Prime more difficult to target.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 狼人的主配置取代了弓箭手与轰炸机两款机甲。两具配改进型 Artemis IV 制导系统的 LRM-20 发射器，让战士能在敌人接近前将其摧毁。狼人主型号还携带一套跳跃推进器，让聪明的战士有机会保持距离，用重型导弹弹幕轰炸敌人。唯一缺点是弹药有限：仅三吨弹药只够短暂交战。若敌人逼近狼人，也并非无计可施。每臂的 ER 中型激光让狼人能削切装甲，而 ECM 套件使狼人主型号更难被锁定。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The initial prototype Mackie was designated the MSK-5S, and carried a slightly different weapons load than the production model MSK-6S. Using an Autocannon/5 in the right arm instead of the AC/10, the MSK-5S also mounted a Large Laser in the center torso, rather than the twin Medium Lasers, and had two more heat sinks. Twenty tons of Primitive Armor protected the first generation Mackie. This armor, though heavier, provided less protection than later models. The MSK-5S was used by Colonel Kincaid in his now-famous combat trial versus the Merkava tanks.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 最初的麦基原型被定名为 MSK-5S，武器载荷与量产型号 MSK-6S 略有不同。它在右臂使用一门自动炮/5 而非 AC/10，中央躯干也装一门大型激光而非双联中型激光，并多两台散热器。二十吨原始装甲保护着第一代麦基。这种装甲虽然更重，提供的防护却少于后来的型号。MSK-5S 被金凯德上校用于他如今著名的对抗梅卡瓦坦克的战斗试验。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Developed by the Terran Hegemony in the 25th century, the Mackie was the first true BattleMech. Based on advanced technology that the Hegemony Armed Forces (HAF) had been developing for decades under Director-General Jacob Cameron, the Mackie was the ultimate manifestation of Hegemony military might.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 麦基由地球霸权在二十五世纪开发，是首款真正的战斗机甲。基于霸权武装部队在总监雅各布·卡梅隆治下数十年研发的先进技术，麦基是霸权军事力量的终极体现。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This catchall series of Mackies was used to designate -6S's retrofitted with a wide variety of more modern components.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这一"杂项"麦基系列用于指代以各种更现代组件改装的-6S。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This catchall series of Mackies was used to designate -6S's retrofitted with a wide variety of more modern components.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Though most nations got rid of their cloned Mackies in favor of their own 'Mechs, the Hegemony was proud of their achievement. Moreover, many Hegemony militia units made extensive use of the first BattleMech, resulting in a continuous production of the first BattleMech right up until the Amaris Coup. Many of the various militia upgrades coalesced into the -9H, helped by the fact that Skobel continued to produce small quantities of this design. It mounts two Donal PPCs and an Imperator Autocannon/20, backed up by the pair of Starflash Medium Lasers. Nineteen tons of armor gave it full protection, allowing the 9Hs longevity.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Though most nations got rid of their cloned Mackies in favor of their own 'Mechs, the Hegemony was proud of their achievement. Moreover, many Hegemony militia units made extensive use of the first BattleMech, resulting in a continuous production of the first BattleMech right up until the Amaris Coup. It mounts two Donal PPCs and an Imperator Autocannon/20, backed up by the pair of Starflash Medium Lasers. Nineteen tons of armor gave it full protection, allowing the 9Hs longevity.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Mad Dog A can bring devastating fire on targets at any range, mounting an ER PPC and an LB 5-X AC, with which it can easily cripple enemies from long range. Should it get close enough, its six SRM-6 racks ensure the demise of nearly any foe.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 疯狗 A 能在任何距离上向目标倾泻毁灭火力，装备一门 ER PPC 和一门 LB 5-X AC，凭此可轻易在远距离瘫痪敌人。一旦它贴近，六具 SRM-6 挂架几乎能确保任何敌人的灭亡。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Mad Dog's most distinctive feature is its side torso and arm pods, which are practically full modules by themselves, suggesting that the mech was conceived as a long-range support unit. The torso modules, angled high, are ideal for missiles while the arms serve as extended turrets suited for direct-fire weaponry.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 疯狗最显著的特征是其侧面躯干与臂部吊舱——它们本身几乎就是完整模块，暗示这款机甲最初是作为远程支援单位构想的。高高倾斜的躯干模块非常适合导弹，而臂部则如同延伸炮塔，适合直射武器。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This variant uses a pair of ATM 12s that are powerful at all ranges. It also uses paired ER Medium Lasers, Medium Pulse Lasers, and ER Small Lasers. An extra heat sink helps to keep heat levels under some control.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 此变体使用两具在所有距离上都强劲的 ATM 12。它还配有成对的 ER 中型激光、中型脉冲激光和 ER 小型激光。一台额外散热器有助于将热量水平控制在某种程度的掌握之中。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Built with new Heavy Laser technology, the Mad Dog H downgrades the LRM-20 launchers to LRM-15s, so it can mount it's arsenal of a Heavy Large Laser and three Heavy Medium Lasers, making it much more capable at close range.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 疯狗 H 采用新型重型激光技术建造，将 LRM-20 发射器降级为 LRM-15，以便搭载由一门重型大型激光和三门重型中型激光组成的武器库，使其在近距离强大得多。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A modern Clan take on the classic Succession Wars era MAR-3R Marauder, the A variant retains the arm-mounted weaponry of the standard Marauder IIC, removing the torso-mounted ER PPC and ER Small Lasers in exchange for a LB 5-X AC in its right torso supplied with single ton of ammo.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是氏族对经典继承战争时代 MAR-3R 掠夺者的现代演绎。A 变体保留标准掠夺者 IIC 的臂载武器，去掉躯干搭载的 ER PPC 与 ER 小型激光，换取右侧躯干一具 LB 5-X AC，配一吨弹药。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A modern Clan take on the classic Succession Wars era MAR-3R Marauder, the A variant retains the arm-mounted weaponry of the standard Marauder IIC, removing the torso-mounted ER PPC and ER Small Lasers in exchange for a LB 5-X AC in its right torso supplied with single ton of ammo.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是氏族对经典继承战争时代 MAR-3R 掠夺者的现代演绎。A 变体保留标准掠夺者 IIC 的臂载武器，去掉躯干搭载的 ER PPC 与 ER 小型激光，换取右侧躯干一具 LB 5-X AC，配一吨弹药。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Built around the Extended Range Particle Projector Cannon, one of the most powerful weapons in the Clan arsenal, the Marauder IIC's weapon layout is typical of the standard Marauder, each pod-like forearm carrying an ER PPC paired with Medium Pulse Lasers. Where the Marauder IIC differs is with its torso weaponry, replacing the top-mounted autocannon and its vulnerable ammunition-feed linkage with another ER PPC, and adding a set of four ER Small Lasers. Twenty-one double heat sinks keep heat levels manageable, with an enterprising MechWarrior able to use volley fire to keep up a steady barrage of fire.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 掠夺者 IIC 以 ER 粒子投射炮——氏族武库中最强大的武器之一——为核心，其武器布局与标准掠夺者一致：每只吊舱式前臂各载一门 ER PPC 并配以中型脉冲激光。不同之处在于躯干武器：以另一门 ER PPC 取代顶部自动炮及其脆弱的供弹连接，并加装一组四门 ER 小型激光。二十一台双倍散热器将热量维持在可控水平，有进取心的机甲战士可用齐射维持稳定的火力倾泻。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Marauder II was first built in 3012 in an attempt to take the firepower of the Marauder and combine it with the reliability and ruggedness of an assault chassis. This Variant was captured and rebuilt by Kurita to carry 2 Heavy and 2 Light PPC.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 掠夺者 II 于 3012 年首次建造，旨在将掠夺者的火力与突击底盘的可靠性和坚固性相结合。此变体被库瑞塔缴获并重建，携带 2 门重型与 2 门轻型 PPC。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Marauder II was first built in 3012 in an attempt to take the firepower of the Marauder and combine it with the reliability and ruggedness of an assault chassis. This Variant was captured and rebuilt by Kurita to carry 2 Heavy and 2 Light PPC.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 掠夺者 II 于 3012 年首次建造，旨在将掠夺者的火力与突击底盘的可靠性和坚固性相结合。此变体被库瑞塔缴获并重建，携带 2 门重型与 2 门轻型 PPC。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Marauder II was first built in 3012 in an attempt to take the firepower of the Marauder and combine it with the reliability and ruggedness of an assault chassis. This was achieved by generally upgrading the entire 'Mech's chassis to allow it to carry a much heavier armor and weapons load. The 'Mech was then armored with nineteen tons of armor, giving it protection that rivals that of the Atlas. Finally, to make up for the reduced mobility of the Marauder II, the 'Mech was outfitted with jump jets that give it a jumping capability of up to ninety meters. Blackwell Heavy Industries produced the design exclusively for Wolf's Dragoons until the end of the Fourth Succession War, when Jaime Wolf allowed them to sell to others.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 掠夺者 II 于 3012 年首次建造，旨在将掠夺者的火力与突击底盘的可靠性和坚固性相结合。为此整机底盘全面升级，以承载重得多的装甲与武器。机甲配备了十九吨装甲，防护水平可与阿特拉斯匹敌。最后，为弥补掠夺者 II 机动性的下降，它装上了跳跃推进器，可跳跃至九十米。布莱克威尔重工一直为狼之龙骑兵独家生产该设计，直到第四次继承战争结束，海梅·沃尔夫才允许他们对外销售。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Marauder II was first built in 3012 in an attempt to take the firepower of the Marauder and combine it with the reliability and ruggedness of an assault chassis. This variant of the Marauder II, the -4B, is a rare introtech variant that carries a ballistic-heavy loadout while maintaining the -4A's armor and speed profile. The -4B carries a pair of AC/10s for its main firepower with 4 tons of ammo while a Large Laser and a pair of Medium Lasers back the autocannons up.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 掠夺者 II 于 3012 年首次建造，旨在将掠夺者的火力与突击底盘的可靠性和坚固性相结合。此-4B 变体是罕见的入门科技变体，携带偏重弹道的配置，同时保持-4A 的装甲与速度。它装备两门 AC/10 作为主要火力，配 4 吨弹药，另有大型激光与两门中型激光支援自动炮。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Take your average Marauder.  Pump it up, and make it even more maddening.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 拿一台普通的掠夺者。强化它，让它更加疯狂。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: While the standard Marauder II, the MAD-5A, was built to spec for the Wolf's Dragoons to be a line combat unit and a traditional assault mech, the MAD-4HB is only one step removed from being a pirate design. Constructed by pirates after stealing a shipment of Marauder IIs meant for someone else, they removed the fancy equipment they couldn't maintain and filled in the holes with a frankly ungodly number of rockets, allowing the -4HB a punch that can instantly delete lesser mechs and even seriously damage mechs of its own caliber. After the rockets though, the -4HB has little firepower for an assault mech.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 标准的掠夺者 II（MAD-5A）是按狼之龙骑兵的规格打造的战线作战单位与传统的突击机甲，而 MAD-4HB 离海盗设计只差一步。海盗们截获了一批本应交给他人的掠夺者 II 后自行建造，拆掉了他们无力维护的精良装备，用简直骇人的火箭数量填补空缺，使-4HB 拥有一击秒杀较弱机甲、甚至重创同级机甲的打击力。不过打完火箭之后，作为突击机甲它的火力就很有限了。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Boss, I've got no words. Those damn Marian pirates are absolutely nuts. It's a miracle this thing doesn't blow itself in half when it fires all those rockets but at least it usually blows its target in half instead.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 老大，我无话可说。那些该死的马里安海盗简直疯了。这东西在发射那一堆火箭时居然没把自己炸成两半，简直是奇迹，不过至少它通常会把目标炸成两半。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Marauder II 5D is a Davion refit to showcase both UAC10 and a Massive 400XXL Engine.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 掠夺者 II 5D 是达维昂改装型，用以展示 UAC10 与庞大的 400XXL 引擎。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Marauder II 5D is a Davion refit to showcase both UAC and a Massive 400XXL Engine.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 掠夺者 II 5D 是达维昂的改装型，用于展示超速自动炮和一台巨大的 400XXL 引擎。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Marauder II 6A is a Wolf's Dragoon upgrade to the 4A fielding an incredibly strong Engine with a Composite Structure under Reactive Plating to bring its terrible Weaponry to bear.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 掠夺者 II 6A 是狼之龙骑兵对 4A 的升级型，配备极其强劲的引擎，在反应装甲之下使用复合结构，以发挥其可怕的火力。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Marauder II 6A is a Wolf's Dragoon upgrade to the 4A fielding an incredibly strong Engine with a Composite Structure under Reactive Plating to bring its terrible Weaponry to bear.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 掠夺者 II 6A 是狼之龙骑兵对 4A 的升级型，配备极其强劲的引擎，在反应装甲之下使用复合结构，以发挥其可怕的火力。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Marauder is among the most classic of all Mech designs, venerable, powerful, respected. However, the original Marauder, the -1R, is mostly forgotten today. Clad in Ferro-Fibroous armor, it is otherwise the same as the downgraded -3R and is just as formidable.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 掠夺者是所有机甲设计中最经典者之一：古老、强大、受人尊敬。然而原版掠夺者-1R 如今几乎被遗忘。它披挂铁纤维装甲，除此之外与降级版-3R 相同，同样令人生畏。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Marauder is among the most classic of all Mech designs, venerable, powerful, respected. However, the original Marauder, the -1R, is mostly forgotten today. Clad in Ferro-Fibroous armor, it is otherwise the same as the downgraded -3R and is just as formidable.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 掠夺者是所有机甲设计中最经典者之一：古老、强大、受人尊敬。然而原版掠夺者-1R 如今几乎被遗忘。它披挂铁纤维装甲，除此之外与降级版-3R 相同，同样令人生畏。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Marauder-2R is the Star League Royal regiments variant of the classic and powerful Marauder. It makes minimal changes, simply upgrading the PPCs to ER PPCs and the heat sinks to doubles, but those changes are enough to give the -2R much better staying and hitting power.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 掠夺者-2R 是经典而强大的掠夺者的星盟皇家团变体。它改动极小，只是把 PPC 升级为 ER PPC、散热器升级为双倍，但这些改动已足以让-2R 拥有好得多的续航力与打击力。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Marauder-2R is the Star League Royal regiments variant of the classic and powerful Marauder. It makes minimal changes, simply upgrading the PPCs to ER PPCs and the heat sinks to doubles, but those changes are enough to give the -2R much better staying and hitting power.!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 掠夺者-2R 是经典而强大的掠夺者的星盟皇家团变体。它改动极小，只是把 PPC 升级为 ER PPC、散热器升级为双倍，但这些改动已足以让-2R 拥有好得多的续航力与打击力。！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 3D Marauder was a modification of the 'Mech introduced for House Davion in 2834 which removed its ammunition dependency. In order to do this, the 3D replaced the Autocannon/5 and with a Large Laser. The saved weight was used to add four more heat sinks to the 'Mech to handle the added heat burden from the large laser.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 3D 掠夺者是 2834 年为达维昂家族推出的改装型，它消除了机甲对弹药的依赖。为此，3D 以一门大型激光取代自动炮/5。节省的重量用于为机甲增加四台散热器，以处理大型激光带来的额外热负担。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Built for House Liao in 2905, the 3L attempted to make the Marauder more heat efficient (and make up for a shortage in reliable PPCs) by replacing one of the arm-mounted particle cannons with a large laser. Additionally, two more heat sinks were added to further increase the Marauder's heat efficiency.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 3L 于 2905 年为廖家族建造，它试图通过把一门臂载粒子炮换成大型激光来提升掠夺者的散热效率（并弥补可靠 PPC 的短缺）。此外还增加两台散热器，进一步提升掠夺者的散热效率。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 3M was introduced in 2873 specially for the Free Worlds League. Because of the abundance of large lasers built by that realm, the 3M model carried two large lasers in place of the PPCs. While running cooler than the weapons they replaced, the large lasers also caused slightly less damage. Additionally, the 3M added four heat sinks to the design, making the 'Mech much more manageable for pilots who have trouble with overheating their 'Mechs.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 3M 于 2873 年专为自由世界联盟推出。由于该势力生产的大型激光数量充裕，3M 型号以两门大型激光取代 PPC。虽然比被替换的武器更凉，大型激光造成的伤害也略低。此外，3M 为设计增加了四台散热器，使这台机甲对那些容易让机甲过热的飞行员而言好驾驭得多。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Marauder was first built by General Motors in 2612 for use as an attack and direct fire support BattleMech. The first 'Mech to diverge from the traditional humanoid shape of previous machines, the Marauder was one of the most well-known 'Mechs in existence and originally meant to usher in a new generation of 'Mechs. Unfortunately, with the fall of the Star League, this new generation never quite materialized. On its own merits though, the Marauder was a devastatingly powerful 'Mech, outclassed only by larger machines like the Stalker and BattleMaster.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 掠夺者最初由通用汽车于 2612 年建造，用作攻击与直射火力支援战斗机甲。作为首款偏离以往机种传统人形外形的机甲，掠夺者是现存最知名的机甲之一，原本意在开启新一代机甲。遗憾的是，随着星盟的陨落，这一代新机从未真正成为现实。不过就自身而言，掠夺者是一台破坏力惊人的强大机甲，只有潜行者和战将之类更大的机种能压过它。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Built for the budget conscious mercenary, the 3S is designed for prolonged operations and utilises an all energy loadout that is cheaper to maintain than the standard 3R; whilst using widely available components cuts down on repair costs. The maintenance intensive Autocannon and it’s infamously bad ammunition feed are replaced with an extra trio of Medium Lasers and 6 heat sinks, dramatically increases the amount of time the mech can go without resupply. The extra heat sinking helps offset the increased heat profile added by the lasers, whilst the increased number of medium lasers act as a strong deterrent to any lighter mechs seeking to get inside the PPC’s firing arc. Debuting in 2955, production has remained steady; with two dozen of these machines being built a year at the General Motors Kathil facility. Sold exclusively to the mercenary market, the 3S is a common site on worlds like Outreach and Galatia and remains a favorite of mercenaries everywhere despite it's age.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 3S 为预算有限的佣兵打造，专为长期作战设计，采用全能量武器配置，维护成本低于标准 3R；使用随处可得的组件也降低了修理费用。维护密集的自动炮及其臭名昭著的糟糕供弹系统被另外三门中型激光和 6 台散热器取代，大幅延长了机甲无需补给即可作战的时间。额外的散热能力有助于抵消激光带来的更高热负荷，而更多数量的中型激光则对任何试图钻进 PPC 射界的轻型机甲构成强力威慑。3S 于 2955 年首次亮相，生产一直稳定；通用汽车卡西尔工厂每年建造两打这样的机器。它专供佣兵市场，在"外联"和"加拉提亚"等世界随处可见，尽管年代久远，仍是各地佣兵的最爱。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This experimental variant was made at Ronin Incorporated's facility on Wallis in 3039. Techs removed the standard weaponry from a Marauder and replaced the arm mounted weapons with a Binary Laser Cannon in each arm, while the torso mounted autocannon was replaced by twin SRM-6 launchers backed by one ton of ammunition. The Marauder-4X was also noteworthy because it used a Prototype Endo Steel chassis. To keep the heat under control, technicians installed twelve single heat sinks and six prototype Double Heat Sinks.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 此实验变体于 3039 年在浪人公司位于沃利斯的工厂制造。技师从一台掠夺者上拆除标准武器，把臂载武器换成每臂一门双联激光炮，躯干自动炮则换成双联 SRM-6 发射器（配一吨弹药）。掠夺者-4X 还以使用原型内骨骼底盘而著称。为控制热量，技师安装了十二台单散热器和六台原型双倍散热器。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Built for Solaris by Barrymore Munitions, this Marauder replaces the usual Autocannon with a unique Mech mortar capable of launching 10 Shells per Salvo.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这款掠夺者由巴里摩尔弹药公司为索拉里斯建造，以一门独特的机甲迫击炮取代通常的自动炮，每次齐射可发射 10 发炮弹。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A Clan-tech retrofit of the classic MAD-3R Marauder, designed for use by second-line garrison and solahma forces, the Marauder C replaced some of the Inner Spheroid weaponry with Clan equivalents. The Marauder C swapped the PPCs for a pair of Clan-tech Large Pulse Lasers and the standard autocannon for a Ultra AC/5 model, but retained the IS medium lasers. The munitions for the autocannon were also protected with CASE.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 掠夺者 C 是经典 MAD-3R 掠夺者的氏族技术改装版，供二线驻军与"索拉赫马"部队使用，它以氏族同类武器替换了部分内天体武器。掠夺者 C 把 PPC 换成一对氏族技术大型脉冲激光，把标准自动炮换成超速 AC/5，但保留内天体中型激光。自动炮弹药也由 C.A.S.E. 保护。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: When the Treaty of Taurus was signed, it established the New Colony Region in co-operation between the Magistracy of Canopus and the Taurian Concordat and also created the Colonial Marshals.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 陶鲁斯条约签署后，卡诺普斯法域与陶里安协约合作建立了新殖民地地区，并创设了殖民地法警。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This is a Sherrifs mech, It brings a peice of mind to folk, but is not heavy on technology.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是治安官的机甲，它让人安心，但在技术上并不复杂。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The MAL-1P utilizes just about the same weapons as stock maulers, except this version carries a PPC in each arm. It retains both LRMs, downgrading these from the LRM-15s to LRM-10s, and keeps the MAL-1R's four Autocannon/2s. A extra-light 270 engine keeps it moving and eleven Double Heat Sinks keep the heat at bay.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: MAL-1P 使用的武器与原装重击者几乎相同，只是此版本每臂携带一门 PPC。它保留两具 LRM（从 LRM-15 降级为 LRM-10），并保留 MAL-1R 的四门自动炮/2。一台 270 超轻型引擎让它保持机动，十一台双倍散热器则将热量挡在外面。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Mauler is armed with four Imperator Smoothie-2 Autocannon/2s as its longest ranged primary weapons. Individually, the damage the AC/2s deal is insignificant, but together they can steadily whittle away armor at extreme range. The 'Mech also carries two Shigunga LRM-15 launchers, adding much needed punch to the extreme reach of its four autocannons. The 'Mech also carries two Victory Nickel Alloy ER Large Lasers for added long range punch.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 重击者装备四门"帝皇奶昔-2"自动炮/2 作为最远程的主武器。单门 AC/2 的伤害微不足道，但合在一起便能在极远距离持续削弱敌方装甲。它还携带两具"紫郡"LRM-15 发射器，为四门自动炮的极远射程增添急需的打击力。机甲还携带两门"胜利镍合金"ER 大型激光以增加远程打击力。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Mauler MAL-2P should be considered a prototype. Unlike the -1P or MX90, the -2P carries a pair of Lasers in each arm; it's rumored that more than two can affixed if need be. Its twin LRM-10s allow it to send missiles at a greater distance and two Ultra Autocannon/5s give it long to close range support. Both the LRMs and UAC/5s have two tons of ammunition a piece, and like the -1P and MX90, the 2P has Cellular Ammunition Storage Equipment to help protect it from ammo explosions. Eleven Double Heat Sinks and a 270 Standard Engine round out the rest of it load out.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 重击者 MAL-2P 应被视为原型机。与-1P 或 MX90 不同，-2P 每臂携带两门激光；据传必要时可加装两门以上。其双联 LRM-10 使其能将导弹投送到更远距离，两门超速自动炮/5 提供远至近程支援。LRM 与 UAC/5 各配两吨弹药，且与-1P 和 MX90 一样，2P 拥有蜂窝式弹药储存设备以防弹药爆炸。十一台双倍散热器与 270 标准引擎构成其配置的其余部分。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The -2R variant of the Mauler uses relatively new weapons. The standard AC/2s are replaced with Ultra versions, doubling their potential damage. Paired ER Medium Lasers are fitted in arms formerly housing the ER Large Lasers. The missile launchers are reduced to smaller LRM-10s. A heavier standard fusion engine is utilized instead of the expensive XL.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 重击者-2R 变体使用相对较新的武器。标准 AC/2 换成超速版本，潜在伤害翻倍。原本安装 ER 大型激光的臂部改装成对的 ER 中型激光。导弹发射器缩减为较小的 LRM-10。它采用较重的标准聚变引擎，而非昂贵的 XL。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The -C variant of the Mauler is a modification that was made to the -1R model to allow it to carry a C3 Slave unit into battle. This is achieved by removing one ton of autocannon ammunition. This small modification allows the Mauler to share targeting data with friendly units and makes the 'Mech a highly effective sniper.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 重击者的-C 变体是对-1R 型号的改装，使其能携带一台 C3 从属单元进入战斗。这通过移除一吨自动炮弹药实现。这一小小改动让重击者能与友军共享瞄准数据，使其成为高效的狙击手。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The -C variant of the Mauler is a modification that was made to the -1R model to allow it to carry a C3 Slave unit into battle. This is achieved by removing one ton of autocannon ammunition. This small modification allows the Mauler to share targeting data with friendly units and makes the 'Mech a highly effective sniper.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Named for the door guards who serve to ward off evil spirits from a home, the Men Shen is the first OmniMech to come from the Capellan Confederation, it borrows heavily from the Raven BattleMech for its basic design concept. The 'Mech is built on a lightweight Endo Steel chassis and is powered by a vulnerable but light VOX 330 XL Engine that gives it a top speed of 97.2 km/h that is augmented by MASC system allowing the 'Mech to be pushed up to 129.6 km/h in short bursts. The Men Shen comes with eleven tons of armor, giving it a respectable amount of protection. The Men Shen carries on its base chassis a Beagle Active Probe allowing it to serve in a recon role regardless of its configuration. For weapons and equipment the Men Shen has seventeen tons of free pod space.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 门神之名取自守护家宅驱除邪灵的门卫，它是卡佩兰邦联的首款全能机甲，基本设计概念大量借鉴渡鸦战斗机甲。该机甲建立在轻量化内骨骼底盘上，由脆弱但轻便的 VOX 330 XL 引擎驱动，最高速度 97.2 公里/小时，并可由 MASC 系统在短促爆发中推至 129.6 公里/小时。门神配有十一吨装甲，防护相当可观。其基础底盘搭载比格犬主动探测器，使其无论何种配置都能胜任侦察任务。武器与装备方面，门神拥有十七吨自由吊舱空间。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: In its primary configuration the Men Shen is a powerful close combat 'Mech and is capable of providing indirect fire support to friendly units. For close-range combat, the primary configuration has four highly accurate Medium Pulse Lasers. To provide both direct and indirect long range fire support, the primary configuration of the Men Shen has an LRM-15 launcher with an Artemis IV fire control system for increased missile accuracy.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 主配置中，门神是一台强大的近战机甲，并能向友军单位提供间接火力支援。近程战斗方面，主配置有四门极为精准的中型脉冲激光。为提供直接与间接的远程火力支援，门神主配置装有一具带 Artemis IV 火控系统以提升导弹精度的 LRM-15 发射器。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Mongoose BattleMech was introduced in 2660 as a deep recon 'Mech and a direct competitor (and hopeful replacement) for the Locust.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 猫鼬战斗机甲于 2660 年推出，作为深入侦察机甲，是蝗虫的直接竞争者（也是有望的替代者）。
轻型攻击手 & 侦察兵

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This is one fast mech. Well armed and armoured for it's size and the sensors; who wouldnt want to drive one.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是一台很快的机甲。就其尺寸和传感器而言武装与装甲都不错；谁不想驾驶一台呢。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 66b is an upgraded version of the 66 that was used by the SLDF Royal units in 2740.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 66b 是 66 的升级版，于 2740 年由星盟防卫军皇家单位使用。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Built by Krupp Armament Works under contract for the ComGuard, the 66C was intended for deployment on Tukayyid. Unfortunately the design was unable to be finished in time and Krupp was left with a finished mech that had no prospective buyers. In a deal brokered by Comstar, the company agreed to sell it's finished production to the reformed SLDF and provide them with additional production runs as requested. Built as a fast interdiction unit, the design was designed to chase down and annihilate elemental formations. Armed with 4 small pulse lasers, a medium pulse laser and a Streak SRM-2; the variant performed with distinction throughout the post Tukayyid years and then through Operations Bulldog and Serpent. The Word of Blake invasion choked off the flow of new mechs, as Krupp’s production shifted to the newer designs demanded by the Word.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 66C 由克虏伯兵工厂按康卫合同建造，原计划部署于图卡伊德。遗憾的是设计未能按时完成，克虏伯手上留下一台没有潜在买家的成品机甲。在康星撮合的交易中，公司同意把已完成的产量卖给重组的星盟防卫军，并按需提供额外生产批次。它被打造为快速拦截单位，旨在追击并歼灭元素编队。装备 4 门小型脉冲激光、一门中型脉冲激光和一具连续 SRM-2；该变体在图卡伊德之后的岁月中表现出色，此后又历经"斗牛犬"与"蛇"行动。布雷克之言的入侵切断了新机甲的供给，因为克虏伯的生产转向了布雷克派要求的新设计。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The MON-67 is the downgraded version of the MON-66 Mongoose introduced in 2830.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: MON-67 是 MON-66 猫鼬的降级版，于 2830 年推出。
轻型攻击手 & 侦察兵

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Another downgraded version, this one is still a danger; espcially if you it catches you from behind.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 又一个降级版本，但这个仍然危险；尤其当它从背后逮住你时。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An upgrade to the Mongoose 67, the 67L is a locally produced model used by the Outworlds Alliance. Assigned to the First and Second Long Road Legions, every part of the mech is manufactured in the Alliance, save for the imported TAG system. The Alliance Military Corps provides the Mongoose chassis from their reserve stocks of Mon-67 models. The original medium lasers are swapped for 3 of the Alliances new ER Medium lasers and the small laser is removed altogether. The addition of locally produced Ferro-Fibrous armour allows for a minor gain in protection and the addition of the TAG system. Developed as a fast harasser and spotter, designed to work in concert with the Alliance Air Wings and Planetary garrisons; the design has proven popular among Mongoose pilots as much for it's improved capabilities as it's locally made parts.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 67L 是对猫鼬 67 型的升级，是外域联盟使用的本地生产型号。它们被配属给第一与第二"长路"军团，除进口的 TAG 系统外，机甲的每个部件都在联盟制造。联盟军事军团从其储备的 Mon-67 型中提供猫鼬底盘。原有中型激光换成 3 门联盟新型 ER 中型激光，小型激光则被完全移除。加装本地生产的铁纤维装甲带来防护上的小幅提升，并加装了 TAG 系统。它被开发为快速骚扰者与目标指示者，设计上与联盟空军联队和行星驻军协同作战；该设计在猫鼬飞行员中广受欢迎，既因性能提升，也因部件是本地制造。
轻型攻击手 & 侦察兵

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This variant of the downgraded MON-67, removes all the standard weaponry in exchange for a single Large Laser, the swap to a lighter 175 rated engine reducing the MON-68's ground speed by 10kmph but freeing up the weight to mount two additional heat sinks.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是降级版 MON-67 的变体，它移除全部标准武器，换成一门大型激光；改用较轻的 175 额定引擎使 MON-68 的地面速度降低 10 公里/小时，但腾出的重量足以安装两台额外散热器。
轻型攻击手 & 侦察兵

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Another downgraded version, this one is still a danger; espcially if you it catches you from behind.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 又一个降级版本，但这个仍然危险；尤其当它从背后逮住你时。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An upgrade to the ageing 68 model, this Mongoose was one of the first models to trial the Combines new C3 Slave unit. Featuring a characteristically minimalist upgrade package, this Mongoose variant served with distinction during Operation Bulldog. An ER Large Laser servers as the sole weapons system, augmented by a new fire control system and the C3 unit. A cheap upgrade, this is a favorite of pilots who were previously assigned a 68; with many praising the enhanced range and accuracy of the Laser. Paired into demi lances, and assigned a C3 Master equipped mech to coordinate, these Mongoose's are deployed as head hunters and long range harassers; both roles that make use of their high ground speed and manoeuvrability. Fast and deadly, they have already made a name for themselves, with one Mongoose formation accounting for 5 kills, including a Star Colonel in a Timberwolf during the Great Refusal.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这款猫鼬是对老旧的 68 型的升级，也是首批试用联合体新型 C3 从属单元的型号之一。它以典型的极简升级方案为特色，在"斗牛犬"行动中表现出色。一门 ER 大型激光是唯一的武器系统，辅以新的火控系统和 C3 单元。作为廉价的升级方案，它深受此前配属 68 型的飞行员喜爱；许多人称赞其激光提升后的射程与精度。它们成对编入半小队，并配属一台装 C3 主控的机甲进行协调，作为猎头者与远程骚扰者部署——这两个角色都能发挥其高地面速度与机动性。快速而致命，它们已经闯出名号：在大拒绝期间，一支猫鼬编队拿下了 5 个战果，其中包括一名驾驶木材狼的星上校。
轻型攻击手 & 侦察兵

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这款猫鼬是对老旧的 68 型的升级，也是首批试用联合体新型 C3 从属单元的型号之一。它以典型的极简升级方案为特色，在"斗牛犬"行动中表现出色。一门 ER 大型激光是唯一的武器系统，辅以新的火控系统和 C3 单元。作为廉价的升级方案，它深受此前配属 68 型的飞行员喜爱；许多人称赞其激光提升后的射程与精度。它们成对编入半小队，并配属一台装 C3 主控的机甲进行协调，作为猎头者与远程骚扰者部署——这两个角色都能发挥其高地面速度与机动性。快速而致命，它们已经闯出名号：在大拒绝期间，一支猫鼬编队拿下了 5 个战果，其中包括一名驾驶木材狼的星上校。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A variant of the MON-66 introduced in 2819, the MON-69 replaced the LosTech active probe with an SRM-2 and one ton of reloads since the advanced electronics were difficult to come by during the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: MON-69 是 2819 年推出的 MON-66 变体，它把失传技术的主动探测器换成了一具 SRM-2 和一吨再装填，因为先进电子设备在继承战争期间难以获得。
轻型攻击手 & 侦察兵

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Another downgraded version, this one is still a danger; espcially if you it catches you from behind.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 又一个降级版本，但这个仍然危险；尤其当它从背后逮住你时。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Originating from the short lived Concord of Kapteyn, this design was designed to showcase each realms newly rediscovered technology in one show-piece design. Unfortunately the Concord fell apart before the design could be put into production. The Clan Invasion left the Free Worlds League scrambling for new designs that could be used in the fight against the Clans. Among the designs pushed into production was the 69K, redesigned to use modern technologies from across the Inner Sphere. The chassis is sourced from the Combine, whilst the engine is of Lyran make; paired with a FWL built Streak SRM-2 and one of the Capellan Confederation’s newly rediscovered Beagle Probes. Produced at Irian technologies Shiro III facility until the early 3060’s, the mech was sold at cost to buyers; with the FWL subsidising production as part of their contributions to the war.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 此设计源自短暂的卡普坦协约，旨在用一款展示型设计展现各势力新近重新发现的技术。遗憾的是协约在该设计投产前便瓦解。氏族入侵使自由世界联盟急于寻找可用于对抗氏族的新设计。被推入量产的方案中包括 69K，它经过重新设计以使用来自内天体各地的现代技术。底盘取自联合体，引擎为莱兰制造；搭配 FWL 制造的连续 SRM-2 和卡佩兰邦联新近重新发现的比格犬探测器。该机甲在伊里安科技的白三工厂生产至 3060 年代初，以成本价卖给买家；FWL 将其生产补贴作为对战争的贡献。
轻型攻击手 & 侦察兵

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Night Gyr B seeks to destroy opponents before they can return fire. A pair of Gauss Rifles and LB-X Autocannon/2s carry out that mandate. Ammo is somewhat lacking, however, so this design cannot stray far from supply, especially as it has no backup energy weapons.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 夜隼 B 力求在对手还击之前将其摧毁。两门高斯步枪和两门 LB-X 自动炮/2 执行这一使命。然而弹药稍显不足，因此该设计不能远离补给，尤其因为它没有备用能量武器。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This missile boat carries four LRM-20 launchers, each of which is slaved to an Artemis IV FCS. Six tons of ammunition is barely enough to keep it firing for a minute. A Large Pulse Laser and Medium Pulse Laser are effective backup weapons.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这款导弹平台携带四具 LRM-20 发射器，每具都从属于一套 Artemis IV 火控系统。六吨弹药勉强够它持续开火一分钟。一门大型脉冲激光和一门中型脉冲激光是有效的备用武器。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The primary configuration is hard-hitting, mounting a pair of ER PPCs located in the left arm and an Ultra Autocannon/10 in the right. This blistering firepower can often take down an opponent before they are in range. Three Medium Pulse Lasers serve as accurate backups. Eight additional double heat sinks keep the 'Mech fairly cool.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 主配置打击力强劲，左臂装两门 ER PPC，右侧一门超速自动炮/10。这种炽烈火力往往能在对手进入射程前将其击倒。三门中型脉冲激光作为精准备用。八台额外双倍散热器使机甲相当凉爽。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: In the aftermath of the Amaris Civil War and the chaos of the Succession Wars, the Nightstar which was already rare and prized began to be unable to be repaired with its advanced components. Thus, the -7J downgrade was created to make use of damaged Nightstars that lacked the proper components. Without the delicate XL engine, the -7J could no longer carry its massive Gauss Rifles, instead carrying a pair of AC/10s. The remaining weaponry was downgraded, as well as the heat sinks being replaced with the weaker standard versions of the day. The two things that stayed the same however was the mech's ponderous speed and tremendous armor capability.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在阿马里斯内战之后与继承战争的混乱中，本就稀有而珍贵的夜星开始无法用其先进组件修复。因此-7J 降级版应运而生，以利用缺少相应组件的受损夜星。失去了精密的 XL 引擎，-7J 无法再携带其巨型高斯步枪，改为一对 AC/10。其余武器也一并降级，散热器则换成当时较弱的标准型号。然而有两点保持不变：机甲沉重的速度与惊人的装甲能力。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The genesis of the Nightstar lies in the Amaris Civil War. The 'Mech itself was only produced until the the First Succession War, when both of the factories and engineers capable of producing the Nightstar were destroyed or killed. The Nightstar is armed to keep an enemy at standoff ranges. The primary weapons carried are a pair of Gauss Rifles, each of which can strip almost a ton of armor off an enemy unit. These are backed up by a ER PPC that is capable of hitting a target at six hundred and ninety meters. For defense at short ranges, the 'Mech has two Medium Pulse Lasers and an Small Laser.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 夜星的起源在阿马里斯内战。该机甲只生产到第一次继承战争，能制造夜星的两座工厂与工程师或被毁或被杀。夜星的武装意在把敌人压制在远距离。主武器为两门高斯步枪，每门都能削掉敌人近一吨装甲。它们由一门能在六百九十米外击中目标的 ER PPC 支援。近距离防御则有两门中型脉冲激光和一门小型激光。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: In the late 3050's the Federated Commonwealth developed this offshoot of the standard NSR-9J in response to the proliferation of stealth technology. High end senors, targeting systems and actuators enable the NSR-9JC to deliver devastatingly accurate gauss rounds to even the most challenging targets. The XL engine of it's parent has been replaced with a standard model, greatly increasing survivability, which is further enhanced with spall liner and hardened arms. A C3 Master computer aids tactical coordination. For close range defense a pair of Medium X-Pulse lasers is mounted in each arm and an ER Small laser sits below the cockpit.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在 3050 年代后期，联邦联邦针对隐身技术的扩散开发了标准 NSR-9J 的这一分支。高端传感器、瞄准系统与驱动器使 NSR-9JC 能向即使最棘手的目标投送精准得惊人的高斯弹。它母型的 XL 引擎已换成标准型号，大幅提升生存性，并进一步以防崩落内衬和加固臂部加以强化。一台 C3 主控计算机辅助战术协调。近程防御方面，每臂各装一对中型 X 脉冲激光，驾驶舱下方还有一门 ER 小型激光。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This doesn't have quite as much firepower as some Night Star variants, but what it has is highly accurate and it can take more of a pounding than most. It's no slouch as a command unit either.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 它没有某些夜星变体那样的火力，但它拥有的武器极为精准，而且比大多数都能承受更多打击。作为指挥单位它也不含糊。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Since it was the chosen BattleMech of the Great Father, the venerable Orion has always held a special place in the mystique of the Clans. Out of respect for General Kerensky's legacy, all the Clans maintained the design for several decades even as the development of newer and more advanced technologies increasingly left it less effective on the battlefield. Not a radical reworking of the design, as some Clan upgrades are, the Orion IIC replaces much of the innards and weapons of the original, while preserving its mass and aesthetics. This IIC upgrade utilizes an Endo Steel chassis and twelve tons of Ferro-Fibrous armor, while also making use of twelve double heat sinks, freeing up weight for heavier weapons loadout. This variant switches the Gauss Rifle to an Ultra Autocannon/5.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 由于它是"伟大之父"选用的战斗机甲，古老的猎户座在氏族的神秘传统中始终占有特殊地位。出于对克伦斯基将军遗产的尊重，所有氏族都维持该设计数十年，即便更新更先进技术的发展日益令它在战场上失去效力。猎户座 IIC 并非像某些氏族升级那样彻底重做，而是更换了原版的大部分内部结构与武器，同时保留其质量与外观。此次 IIC 升级采用内骨骼底盘和十二吨铁纤维装甲，并使用十二台双倍散热器，腾出重量以搭载更重的武器。此变体将高斯步枪换成超速自动炮/5。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Orion K was the first true heavy 'Mech. As a multirole brawler, the Orion can engage enemies at a variety of ranges, and with plenty of armor, it can survive combined fire for quite some time. Slow, yes, but powerful.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 猎户座 K 是首款真正的重型机甲。作为多用途缠斗者，猎户座能在多种距离上交战，凭借充裕装甲，它能在集中火力下存活相当长时间。慢，是的，但强大。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The M variant is an upgrade using Star League technology first fielded in 3049. Replacing the standard engine with a Hermes 300 XL Engine and shaving off a half-ton of armor allows the 'Mech to retain the same speed while mounting a number of upgrades.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: M 变体是 3049 年首次投入战场的星盟科技升级版。以赫尔墨斯 300 XL 引擎取代标准引擎，并削减半吨装甲，使机甲在保持相同速度的同时搭载多项升级。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Command Console refit built in 2913 - Standard refits usually installed the Command Console on a ON1-V, requiring the removal of one ton of SRM, LRM, and AC ammunition. The loss of ammunition reduces its capability to maintain fire for long, but a Commander will typically not be located at the head of a formation.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 2913 年建造的指挥控制台改装型——标准改装通常在 ON1-V 上安装指挥控制台，需要移除一吨 SRM、LRM 和 AC 弹药。弹药的损失降低了它长时间持续开火的能力，但指挥官通常不会处在队列最前方。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Orion is already a challenging opponent, but I heard these late Third Succession War refits from the Free Worlds League were especially dangerous to encounter. It appears they fit a Command Console by removing one ton of each ammo type. However, unless you have the ability to resupply in the field, I would advise conserving ammunition if possible.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 猎户座本就是难缠的对手，但我听说这些自由世界联盟在第三次继承战争后期的改装尤其危险。看来他们通过移除每种弹药各一吨来安装指挥控制台。不过，除非你有能力在战场上补给，我建议尽可能节约弹药。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Orion V trades some of the armor the K model is known for to mount additional weaponry. This increases its overall damage output, but many pilots consider the loss of armor to be risky.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 猎户座 V 以 K 型闻名的部分装甲为代价搭载额外武器。这提升了总体伤害输出，但许多飞行员认为失去装甲颇为冒险。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Orion V trades some of the armor the K model is known for to mount additional weaponry. This increases its overall damage output, but many pilots consider the loss of armor to be risky.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 猎户座 V 以 K 型闻名的部分装甲为代价搭载额外武器。这提升了总体伤害输出，但许多飞行员认为失去装甲颇为冒险。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Instead of sacrificing armor, the Orion VA trades out some of it's long range punch by removing the LRM-15.  This allows it to not only maintain the stock armor, but also add 6 Heat Sinks for better heat management.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 猎户座 VA 不以装甲为代价，而是通过移除 LRM-15 换掉部分远程打击力。这使它不仅能维持原装装甲，还能加装 6 台散热器以改善散热管理。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Ostroc carries as its primary weapons two Fuersturm-C Large Lasers in the left and right torsos. These give the Ostroc good medium to long range damage capabilities. The Ostrocs secondary weapons are two Fuersturm-b Medium Lasers also mounted in the side torsos and a Totschlagen SRM-4 launcher in the right torso for close-range combat, with one ton of reloads carried in the center torso. While the Ostroc's laser-heavy weapons payload allows it to operate well as a guerrilla fighter since it has limited dependency on supply lines, its short arms are a handicap in close combat, and the shocks of hand-to-hand fighting can easily damage the Fuersturm systems.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 奥斯特罗克以左右躯干的两门"元首-C"大型激光为主武器。这赋予奥斯特罗克良好的中远程伤害能力。奥斯特罗克的次要武器是同样装在两侧躯干的两门"元首-b"中型激光，以及右躯干一具"重击"SRM-4 发射器用于近程战斗，中央躯干携带一吨再装填。虽然奥斯特罗克偏重激光的武器载荷使它对补给线依赖有限、能很好地充当游击战士，但其短小的手臂在近战中是个缺陷，肉搏的冲击很容易损坏"元首"系统。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This upgrade of the 2C was used by the SLDF Royals starting in 2729. The large lasers are upgraded to ER Large Lasers, and the SRM-4 is replaced with a pair of Streak SRM-2s. Fourteen double heat sinks keep this 'Mech cool, while Ferro-Fibrous armor gives it additional protection.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 此 2C 的升级版自 2729 年起供星盟防卫军皇家部队使用。大型激光升级为 ER 大型激光，SRM-4 换成两具连续 SRM-2。十四台双倍散热器使机甲保持凉爽，铁纤维装甲则提供额外防护。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An experimental model produced by Kong Interstellar for the Free Worlds League in 2793, the 2M variant of the Ostroc focuses on the 'Mech's maneuverability. Five jump jets, two in each leg and one in the rear torso, have been added to the design, giving it a maximum jumping distance of one hundred and fifty meters. In order to make this change, the medium lasers and the SRM-4 launcher were removed. Relatively few of these were built between the League's annexation of Connaught and the factory's destruction.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 2M 变体是康格星际于 2793 年为自由世界联盟生产的实验型号，聚焦于机甲的机动性。设计中加入五个跳跃推进器（每腿两个、后躯干一个），使最大跳跃距离达一百五十米。为做此改动，中型激光和 SRM-4 发射器被移除。在联盟吞并康诺特到工厂被毁之间，这样的机甲建造得相当少。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 3C variant looks to improve the long-range direct firepower of the Ostroc. Introduced in 2876, the two medium lasers and the SRM-4 have been removed in order to add a third large laser mounted in the right torso.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Ostscout was designed as a pure recon BattleMech by Ostmann Industries. To that end, it was built entirely around gathering data and getting out of trouble, tasks for which it is exceptional. The Ostscout is quick enough to escape most traps, and very few other designs can match it in terms of speed and maneuverability. However its ability to run and leap out of danger came at the expense of offensive capability. In fact were it not for aggressive lobbying on the part of its test pilots the final production model would have been completely weaponless. As it is, the Ostcout would be hard-pressed to win a fight against all but the lightest 'Mechs. A poor combatant, the 'Mech excels at operating deep behind enemy lines, gathering as much information as possible about the terrain and the disposition of enemy forces. Besides the Great Houses, ComStar also utilized the Ostscout, and in the aftermath of the Clan Invasion and ComStar Schism began developing a new Ostscout variant for their Com Guards. This new model would maintain the same maneuverability and intelligence-gathering capabilities of the original while improving its offensive and defensive capabilities. Debuting with success in 3064, within the next three years nearly half of all Com Guard Ostscouts had been upgraded to the new variant; however it was soon discovered that both the Lyran Alliance and Word of Blake were fielding their own updated Ostscouts identical to ComStar's. The intelligence leak would be confirmed and traced back to Dag Kesselring, former Precentor of the 66th Division, who passed on information about the program to both the Lyrans and Blakists.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 奥斯特侦察由奥斯特曼工业设计为纯侦察战斗机甲。为此它完全围绕收集数据与脱离险境而构建，而它在这两项任务上表现卓越。奥斯特侦察速度快到足以逃出大多数陷阱，几乎没有其他设计能在速度与机动性上与之匹敌。然而它跑得快、跳得远的能力是以攻击力为代价换来的。事实上，若不是测试飞行员积极游说，最终量产型本会完全没有武器。即便如此，奥斯特侦察除了对抗最轻的机甲外，很难赢下任何战斗。作为战斗者它很差，但在敌后深处行动、尽可能收集地形与敌军部署情报方面却极为出色。除各大议院外，康星也使用奥斯特侦察，在氏族入侵与康星分裂之后，他们开始为其康卫开发新的奥斯特侦察变体。新机型将保持原版同样的机动性与情报收集能力，同时提升攻防能力。该型于 3064 年成功亮相，此后三年内近半数康卫奥斯特侦察都升级到了新型号；然而很快发现莱兰联盟与布雷克之言都在装备与康星型号完全相同的自家更新版奥斯特侦察。泄密最终被确认并可追溯到达格·凯塞尔林——第 66 师的前任主祭——他将该计划的信息同时传给了莱兰人与布雷克派。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Ostscout carries a single Tronel II Medium Laser mounted in its center torso. This weapon, while not extremely powerful, is enough to dissuade most light scout assets from attempting to pursue. The ten heat sinks the 'Mech carries is more than enough to handle the heat output of this single laser - indeed the Ostscout can jump 210 meters and fire laser at the same time without overheating at all. While it is protected by four and a half tons of armor, the real protection for the 'Mech is its speed and maneuverability. A massive sixteen-ton fusion engine more commonly seen in 'Mechs twice its size propels the Ostscout to a cruising speed of 86.4 km/h. Eight jump jets built into the left and right legs give it a maximum jumping distance of 240 meters, rivaling that of the Spider.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 东探在中央躯干装有一门"特罗内尔 II"中型激光。这门武器虽不特别强大，却足以劝阻大多数轻型侦察资产不要追击。机甲携带的十台散热器远超处理这单门激光热量所需——事实上东探能一边跳 210 米一边发射激光而完全不过热。虽然它由四吨半装甲保护，但机甲真正的防护是其速度与机动性。一台通常见于两倍体型机甲的巨型十六吨聚变引擎推动东探达到 86.4 公里/小时的巡航速度。装在左右腿的八个跳跃推进器赋予它 240 米的最大跳跃距离，可与蜘蛛相匹敌。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Introduced at the same time as the original model and used by the SLDF Royal units, the 7Jb is the only variant of the Ostscout built prior to the Clan Invasion. This variant uses Endo Steel to free up enough mass to add a Beagle Active Probe.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 与原型同期推出并由星盟防卫军皇家单位使用，7Jb 是氏族入侵前建造的唯一东探变体。此变体使用内骨骼腾出足够质量加装一具比格犬主动探测器。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 7K Ostscout was introduced in 3050 and replaces the medium laser with a Garret Mole TAG laser designator, sacrificing its limited offensive capability to allow it to designate targets for Arrow IV artillery missiles. Otherwise, the 7K Ostscout is identical to the 7J model, and while utterly defenseless is still swift enough to escape from most danger.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 7K 东探于 3050 年推出，以"加勒特偃鼠"TAG 激光指示器取代中型激光，牺牲其有限的进攻能力，以换取为箭矢 IV 火炮导弹指示目标的能力。除此之外，7K 东探与 7J 型号完全相同，虽然完全无防御能力，速度却仍足以逃开大多数危险。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Nine tons of armoring is considered decent for a heavy 'Mech, while its fast cruising speed of 54 km/h is thanks to a nineteen-ton Vlar 300 fusion engine. Besides speed though it's the 'Mech's highly-sensitive TRSS.2L3 targeting-tracking system, able to detect enemies over several kilometers in even the most difficult terrain, which makes it a good command platform for scouting missions. Sixteen heat sinks also help manage the heat output of its all-energy weapons payload.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 对重型机甲而言九吨装甲称得上不错，而 54 公里/小时的快速巡航速度要归功于一台十九吨的 Vlar 300 聚变引擎。不过除速度之外，真正亮点是机甲高度灵敏的 TRSS.2L3 瞄准追踪系统——即便在最困难的地形中也能探测数公里外的敌人，这使它成为侦察任务的优良指挥平台。十六台散热器也有助于管理其全能量武器载荷的热量输出。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 4F Ostsol introduced in 2871 was the only common variant of the 'Mech pre-Clan Invasion, completely removing the laser weapons and replacing them with two Dominion-V PPCs in the side torsos. The 'Mech is seen as, in some ways at least, a poor man's Marauder or Warhammer, and the PPC array can quickly overload the sixteen heat sinks. Though, on its own merits, the variant is a good long-range direct fire support 'Mech which uses its top speed of 86.4 kph to dictate combat ranges against most heavier 'Mechs.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 4F 奥斯特索尔于 2871 年推出，是氏族入侵前该机甲唯一常见的变体，它完全移除激光武器，在两侧躯干换成两门"自治领-V"PPC。该机甲在某种程度上被视为穷人版的掠夺者或战锤，而 PPC 阵列会迅速让十六台散热器过载。不过就自身而言，该变体是一款优秀的远程直射支援机甲，能利用 86.4 公里/小时的最高速度对抗大多数更重的机甲来决定交战距离。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 5M variant of the Ostsol is an upgrade of the design using Star League technology and is built for close-range combat with production starting in 3050. The original engine, heat sinks, and weapons have been stripped from the chassis and replaced with a Hermes 300 XL engine and sixteen double heat sinks. Taking the place of its standard weapons, the 5M Ostsol carries two Tronel XIII Large Pulse Lasers and four Tronel XII Medium Pulse Lasers, two of which remain rear-mounted to discourage attacks against the 'Mech's weak rear armor. Finally, for added protection against missile attacks, the 5M carries a Lindblad Shotgun Anti-Missile System in its right torso with one ton of ammo in the left.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 奥斯特索尔 5M 变体是使用星盟技术对该设计的升级，专为近程战斗而造，自 3050 年起生产。原有引擎、散热器和武器已从底盘上拆除，换成赫尔墨斯 300 XL 引擎和十六台双倍散热器。5M 奥斯特索尔以两门"特罗内尔 XIII"大型脉冲激光和四门"特罗内尔 XII"中型脉冲激光取代标准武器，其中两门仍为后向安装，以遏制对机甲薄弱后方装甲的攻击。最后，为加强对导弹攻击的防护，5M 在右躯干装一套林德布拉德霰弹反导系统，左躯干配一吨弹药。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An updated version of the primitive Ostwar developed in 2620, this variant carries 12 tons of standard BattleMech armor and a modern cockpit. The chassis has been upgraded to use Endo Steel, while an XL Engine increases the Ostwar's ground speed to 84 kmh. Eighteen double heat sinks dissipate the heat from three ER Large Lasers and twin SRM-6 launchers.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 此变体是 2620 年开发的原始奥斯特战争的更新版，携带 12 吨标准战斗机甲装甲和现代驾驶舱。底盘升级为内骨骼，XL 引擎把奥斯特战争的地面速度提升至 84 公里/小时。十八台双倍散热器散发三门 ER 大型激光和双联 SRM-6 发射器的热量。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Owens is intended to be an OmniMech upgrade of the Jenner BattleMech. The intended role for the Owens is as a cavalry 'Mech that can move along the enemy lines and designate targets for bombardment with Arrow IV artillery attacks. The Owens is a strong spotting unit as well as a point 'Mech for C3 lances with its permanently mounted TAG laser designator, Beagle Probe and C3 Slave unit.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 10K Panther is a high tech upgrade of the 9R model introduced by Wakazashi Enterprises. The chassis has been rebuilt using Endo Steel construction techniques and the saved weight used to add an Artemis IV fire control system to the missile launcher, as well as upgrading the PPC to a Lord's Light 2 ER PPC. Since its introduction the 10K has gone on to replace the 9R as the most common model employed by the DCMS.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 10K 黑豹是若林重工推出的 9R 型号高科技升级版。底盘以日式建筑技术重建，节省的重量用于为导弹发射器加装 Artemis IV 火控系统，并把 PPC 升级为"主之光 2"ER PPC。自推出以来，10K 已取代 9R 成为 DCMS 最常用的型号。
狙击手 & 轻型缠斗者

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Panther 5T is a Taurian refit, replacing the PPC and SRM with a low-tech Heavy Rifle and Flamer. Born from extreme shortages of replacement parts, this is a cheap alternative favoured by mercenaries and hired security.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An early version of the Panther that is occasionally seen in the Periphery, it is armed with the ancient Tronel Large Laser in place of the PPC.  This laser suffers from faulty heat exchangers and generates more heat than a standard Large Laser.  Most of these have long since been retrofitted.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是黑豹的早期版本，偶尔在外围区可见，它以古老的"特罗内尔"大型激光取代 PPC。这门激光受热交换器故障困扰，比标准大型激光产生更多热量。其中大多数早已被改装。
狙击手 & 轻型缠斗者

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: First thing I am doing is ripping out that piece of crap laser and replacing it with something more reliable...
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我第一件事就是把那门垃圾激光拆掉，换上点更可靠的东西……

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Known for their highly mobile nature, the Draconis Combine's Amphigean Light Assault Group upgrade the engines by removing the Jump Jets.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 德拉科尼斯联合体的安菲吉亚轻型突击集群以高度机动著称，它们通过移除跳跃推进器来升级引擎。
狙击手 & 轻型缠斗者

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Not a bad upgrade, really allows this model to keep up with other lights in open ground - though it also suffers from the loss of those same Jump Jets when in rough terrain.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 升级不差，确实让这个型号能在开阔地形跟上其他轻型机甲——不过在崎岖地形上它也因失去同样的跳跃推进器而吃亏。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Panther 9Rs are solid all-around 'Mechs, if a bit on the slow side. They make up for it with Jump Jets, considerable armor, and a hefty punch from their trademark PPC. They've even been used in physical slugging matches to good effect.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 黑豹 9R 是扎实的全能机甲，只是稍偏慢。它靠跳跃推进器、可观的装甲和标志性 PPC 的沉重打击来弥补。它们甚至被用于近身肉搏，效果不俗。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Perseus is the product of a program begun by the League Central Coordination and Command to create an OmniMech completely indigenous to the Free Worlds League from concept to production. The Perseus shares much with the venerable Orion, a staple of Free Worlds League Military, both broadly resembling the older design visually and using a number of the same components. This similarity prompted more than a few FWLM technicians to nickname the new design the Omni-Orion and the deployment of Perseus has largely been to front-line units that fielded large concentrations of its progenitor, replacing older Orions on a one-for-one basis. Built on a lightweight Endo Steel chassis, the Perseus is powered by a Hermes 300 XL engine helping save even more weight and giving the 'Mech a top speed of 64.8 km/h. The advanced structure and engine save a great deal of weight for weapons and equipment. The Perseus is protected by fourteen tons of Valiant Lamellor armor, giving it around average armor protection for a 'Mech of its size. It also has twelve double heat sinks that are fixed on the chassis.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 珀尔修斯是联盟中央协调与指挥部发起的一项计划的产物，旨在从概念到生产打造一款完全属于自由世界联盟的全能机甲。珀尔修斯与备受尊崇的猎户座共享诸多特征——后者是自由世界联盟军队的中坚，两者不仅外观上大体相似，还使用了若干相同部件。这种相似让不少联盟军技师将新设计戏称为"全能猎户座"，而珀尔修斯的部署也主要面向那些大量装备其前身的精锐部队，一对一替换老旧猎户座。珀尔修斯采用轻量化内骨骼底盘，由赫尔墨斯 300 XL 引擎驱动，进一步节省重量，最高速度 64.8 公里/小时。先进的结构与引擎为武器和装备腾出大量重量。它以十四吨英勇拉梅洛装甲防护，装甲水平约为此尺寸机甲的平均值。它还固定配备十二台双倍散热器。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Configured for long range fire support, the A configuration carries a pair of LRM-20 launchers in its arm, both of which are linked to an Artemis IV FCS for increased accuracy. For close range defense, the 'Mech carries two Medium Pulse Lasers and has an SRM-6 launcher linked to an Artemis IV FCS. The 'Mech also has a leg-mounted TAG laser designator, allowing it to call in Semi-Guided LRM and Arrow IV attacks from friendly units and has an ECM Suite to defend itself from enemy electronic warfare systems.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: A 配置为远程火力支援而设，臂部装一对 LRM-20 发射器，均联接 Artemis IV 火控系统以提升精度。近程防御方面，机甲携带两门中型脉冲激光和一具联接 Artemis IV 火控系统的 SRM-6 发射器。机甲还有一具装在腿部的 TAG 激光指示器，使其能召唤友军单位的半制导 LRM 和箭矢 IV 攻击，并有一套 ECM 套件防御敌方电子战系统。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Capable of fighting at close and long ranges, the B configuration has a Gauss Rifle and ER Large Laser for long range combat, though only a single ton of reloads relegates the Gauss to use as a secondary rather than primary weapon. The Perseus B is also capable of handling close combat with two Large Pulse Lasers and has an Anti-Missile System to protect itself from missile attacks.

This similarity prompted more than a few FWLM technicians to nickname the new design the Omni-Orion and the deployment of Perseus has largely been to front-line units that fielded large concentrations of its progenitor, replacing older Orions on a one-for-one basis. Built on a lightweight Endo Steel chassis, the Perseus is powered by a Hermes 300 XL engine helping save even more weight and giving the 'Mech a top speed of 64.8 km/h. The advanced structure and engine save a great deal of weight for weapons and equipment. The Perseus is protected by fourteen tons of Valiant Lamellor armor, giving it around average armor protection for a 'Mech of its size. It also has twelve double heat sinks that are fixed on the chassis.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An all around configuration, the C is built to be capable of engaging an enemy at both long and short ranges. To do this, the Perseus C carries a Light Gauss Rifle, giving the 'Mech an extremely long reach. This is backed up by an Ultra Autocannon/10 capable of engaging the enemy as they close. For close combat, the Perseus C has three ER Medium Lasers, a Medium Pulse Laser, and a Streak SRM-2 launcher. Two tons of gauss reloads, three tons of Ultra autocannon ammunition and a ton of missile reloads give the design adequate field endurance.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Configured specifically for close combat, the D configuration has an LRM-20 launcher with an Artemis IV FCS for increased accuracy as well as an LB-X Autocannon/10 for long range combat. The D also has an ECM suite to protect itself from enemy electronic warfare systems and a Beagle Active Probe that allows it to find hidden units in close combat situation.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The primary configuration of the Perseus shares a great deal with the Orion. For long range direct and indirect fire support, the Perseus carries an LRM-20 with Artemis IV for increased missile accuracy. For long range direct fire, the Perseus carries a powerful Ultra Autocannon/10 that is capable of firing at twice the rate as a standard autocannon. The Perseus has a devastating short range arsenal with a highly accurate Medium Pulse Laser, four ER Medium Lasers , an ER Small Laser, and finally an SRM-4 launcher that is linked to an Artemis IV FCS. The primary configuration mounts two tons each of both Ultra Autocannon and LRM munitions as well as single ton of SRM reloads in CASE protected ammunition bays in both its side torsos.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 英仙座主配置与猎户座有诸多共通之处。远程直接与间接火力支援方面，英仙座携带一具带 Artemis IV 以提升导弹精度的 LRM-20。远程直射火力方面，英仙座携带一门强力超速自动炮/10，射速可达标准自动炮的两倍。英仙座拥有毁灭性的近程武器库：一门极为精准的中型脉冲激光、四门 ER 中型激光、一门 ER 小型激光，最后一具联接 Artemis IV 火控系统的 SRM-4 发射器。主配置在两侧躯干受 C.A.S.E. 保护的弹药舱中各携带两吨超速自动炮弹药和两吨 LRM 弹药，以及一吨 SRM 再装填。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Developed for the Star League Defense Force Royal Divisions in 2692, this variant of the Phoenix Hawk LAM used four Medium Lasers and a single ER Large Laser as its main firepower. Twelve double heat sinks kept the heat curve low, but the limited fuel, armor, and maneuverability made the Phoenix Hawk LAM easy prey for AeroSpace Fighters of the same weight. It could maneuver fast enough to evade heavier foes however
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 此型凤凰鹰 LAM 于 2692 年为星盟防卫军皇家师开发，以四门中型激光和一门 ER 大型激光为主要火力。十二台双倍散热器将热量曲线维持在低位，但有限的燃料、装甲与机动性使凤凰鹰 LAM 成为同重量航空战斗机的易捕猎物。不过它的机动速度足以避开更重的敌人

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This version was created before the introduction of the PHX-HK2, in 2695. It removed the ER Large Laser, a Medium Laser, and two heat sinks, replacing them with an experimental Snub-Nose PPC, Beagle Active Probe, and an additional half ton of armor.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Phoenix Hawk LAM was the largest Land-Air 'Mech produced during the Star League. Allied Aerospace reworked their designs for conversion equipment and the size of the LAM, learning from their mistake with the Shadow Hawk LAM and the success of the Stinger LAM. The resulting LAM was the largest LAM ever constructed capable of remaining in AirMech mode. Unfortunately, large Land-Air 'Mech conversion technology was not fully researched before the fall of the Star League, and the Phoenix Hawk LAM frequently met its end due to the occasional glitch. The end of the Star League and destruction of the Allied Aerospace facilities at the beginning of the First Succession War prevented further development and refinement.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 凤凰鹰 LAM 是星盟时期生产的最大陆空机甲。联合航空重做了其变身设备与 LAM 尺寸的设计，吸取了影鹰 LAM 的教训与毒刺 LAM 的成功经验。成品是有史以来最大的、能在机甲空中模式维持飞行的 LAM。遗憾的是，大型陆空机甲变身技术在星盟覆灭前未获充分研究，凤凰鹰 LAM 常因偶发故障而殒命。星盟的终结与第一次继承战争初期联合航空设施的毁灭，阻断了进一步的开发与改良。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: House Marik produced a variant of the Phoenix Hawk LAM which replaces the Large Laser and Machine Guns with a Holly LRM-10.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 马里克家族生产了一款凤凰鹰 LAM 变体，将大型激光和机枪换成冬青 LRM-10。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: House Marik produced a variant of the Phoenix Hawk LAM which replaces the Large Laser and Machine Guns with a Holly LRM-10.
