Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: First introduced by the Terran Hegemony in 2568, the Phoenix Hawk is one of the most well known BattleMechs in the Inner Sphere. The 'Mech began life when Orguss Industries realized that it could reinforce the Stinger chassis to create a larger version, one with the same speed and maneuverability as the Stinger but with superior armor, firepower and electronics. Though not without its own drawbacks, the Phoenix Hawk is still the standard by which all other reconnaissance 'Mechs are measured.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 凤凰鹰由地球霸权于 2568 年首次推出，是内天体最知名的战斗机甲之一。这台机甲的诞生始于奥古斯工业意识到它可以强化毒刺底盘造出更大版本——一个与毒刺速度与机动性相同，但拥有更优装甲、火力与电子设备的型号。尽管并非毫无缺点，凤凰鹰至今仍是衡量所有其他侦察机甲的标准。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 1D variant of the Phoenix Hawk is commonly used by the forces of House Davion, though it is slowly being phased out by the upgraded 3D. Contrasted with the base PXH-1, it removes the machine guns and replaces them with two additional heat sinks. While removing a small amount of the 'Mech's short-range firepower, the additional heat sinks make the 1D's heat load more manageable.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 凤凰鹰 1D 变体常为达维昂家族部队使用，不过正被升级版 3D 逐步淘汰。与基础 PXH-1 相比，它移除机枪并换上两台额外散热器。这虽然削减了机甲少量近程火力，额外散热器却让 1D 的热负荷更易管理。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: After the destruction of their main production line in 2928, Solaris 7 based Blue Shot Weapons looked for other means of income. They took the idea behind the STR-3G Stinger variant and created a similar variant of the Phoenix Hawk by adding a second Large Laser in the left arm. To free up the necessary weight the PXH-1GS removes the Medium Lasers and Machine Guns and sacrifices some speed & maneuverability, but also adds 3 Heat Sinks and two Small Lasers. Both the primary lasers are mounted in gunpods giving the variant its "Gunslinger" nickname.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在 2928 年主生产线被毁后，驻扎索拉里斯 7 的蓝射武器公司寻找其他收入来源。他们借鉴 STR-3G 毒刺变体的思路，通过在左臂加装第二门大型激光，为凤凰鹰打造了类似变体。为腾出所需重量，PXH-1GS 移除中型激光和机枪，并牺牲部分速度与机动性，但也增加 3 台散热器和两门小型激光。两门主激光都装在枪袋中，为该变体赢得了"枪手"的绰号。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Sacrificing speed on the battlefield is usually a bad idea.  The Gunslinger is still plenty fast for the confines of the Solaris arenas, and can dish out a good amount of damage with its two large lasers.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在战场上牺牲速度通常是个坏主意。"枪手"对索拉里斯竞技场的封闭空间而言仍然足够快，并可用两门大型激光造成可观的伤害。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 1K variant is particularly favored by House Kurita, though when it was introduced in 2603 it represented a departure from the traditional thinking of the Phoenix Hawk. By removing all jump jets from the 'Mech, room is freed up to install three additional heat sinks and another one and a half tons of armor. The machine guns and ammunition have also been removed from the design and replaced with a single Small Laser carried in the center torso.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 1K variant is particularly favored by House Kurita, though when it was introduced in 2603 it represented a departure from the traditional thinking of the Phoenix Hawk. By removing all jump jets from the 'Mech, room is freed up to install three additional heat sinks and another one and a half tons of armor. The machine guns and ammunition have also been removed from the design and replaced with a single Small Laser carried in the center torso.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Based on the PXH-1, this electronic warfare variant introduced in 2599 drops the machine guns and ammunition in favor of a Guardian ECM Suite and another half-ton of armor.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Phoenix Hawk 2L is compete overhaul designed to be compatible with the myriad PXH-1 variants found throughout the Periphery, upgrading them to a standard beyond the PXH-2. An endo-steel chassis means that an ER large laser and heat sinks can be mounted whilst the machineguns are sacrificed in favour of Guardian ECM. Available for export throughout the Periphery, the only constraint to production is the lack of a production facility for the PXH chassis, though Alliance Mech Works has plans to build a dedicated PHX line should the design prove popular. Until then the current output is limited to in-situ conversions of existing mechs and the restoration of battlefield salvage.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 凤凰鹰 2L 是一次彻底翻新，设计上与外围区各地无数 PXH-1 变体兼容，把它们升级到超越 PXH-2 的标准。内骨骼底盘意味着可以安装 ER 大型激光和散热器，同时牺牲机枪以换取守护者 ECM。它可向外围区各地出口，唯一的生产制约是缺乏 PXH 底盘的生产设施，不过联盟机甲厂计划在该设计受欢迎时建造一条专用的 PHX 生产线。在此之前，当前产量仅限于对现有机甲的就地改装和战场残骸的修复。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Phoenix Hawk 2L is compete overhaul designed to be compatible with the myriad PXH-1 variants found throughout the Periphery, upgrading them to a standard beyond the PXH-2. An endo-steel chassis means that an ER large laser and heat sinks can be mounted whilst the machineguns are sacrificed in favour of Guardian ECM.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Like all PXH-3 models, the 3D is an upgraded Phoenix Hawk using rediscovered technology. By upgrading Davion's favorite 1D variant with an Endo-Steel chassis and XL engine, Davion scouts can cram quite a lot of firepower into their scout 'Mechs. To sustain the extra laser firepower the design replaces all single heat sinks with doubles, further improving upon the cooling upgrades from its parent variant. Whilst it lacks the Ferro-Fibrous armor of its Kuritan counterpart, the design does make room for an AMS system, allowing it to dive behind cover without having to worry about indirect fire.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 与所有 PXH-3 型号一样，3D 是使用重新发现技术的凤凰鹰升级版。通过给达维昂最爱的 1D 变体升级内骨骼底盘和 XL 引擎，达维昂侦察兵能在侦察机甲中塞进相当多的火力。为支撑额外的激光火力，该设计把所有单散热器换成双倍散热器，在母变体的散热升级基础上更进一步。虽然缺少其库瑞塔对应型的铁纤维装甲，该设计却腾出空间装了一套 AMS 系统，使它能躲到掩体后而不必担心间接火力。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 3K Phoenix Hawk is another upgrade of the design that uses rediscovered technologies. Inspired by the 1K variant, the 3K uses an XL engine to upgrade the firepower to Medium Pulse and ER Large Lasers as well as reintroducing House Kurita to jump jets. Taking the 1K's additional heat sinks and upgrading those to doubles alongisde an Ferro-Fibrous armor upgrade means that the 'Mech can stay in the fight for longer, though it remains a scout at heart. It is notably the only PXH-3 variant that does not include AMS.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 3K 凤凰鹰是该设计又一次使用重新发现技术的升级。受 1K 变体启发，3K 用 XL 引擎把火力升级为中型脉冲激光和 ER 大型激光，也把跳跃推进器重新带回库瑞塔家族。它继承 1K 的额外散热器并升级为双倍，同时升级铁纤维装甲，意味着机甲能在战斗中坚持更久——尽管它本质上仍是侦察机甲。值得注意的是，它是唯一不含 AMS 的 PXH-3 变体。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 3M variant of the Phoenix Hawk was introduced in 3048 alongside everyone else's attempt to upgrade the 'Mech with LosTech, built by Earthwerks Incorporated from their Keystone factory. Endo-Steel, double heat sinks and an XL engine allow the design to carry ER Large Lasers and Medium Pulse Lasers. The 'Mech retains a machinegun from the original design, whilst the other is replaced with an Anti Missile System. This gives it slightly more firepower then its Kuritan and Davion brethren, at the cost of fewer heat sinks and slightly worse armor.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 凤凰鹰 3M 变体于 3048 年推出，与各方用失传技术升级该机甲的尝试同期，由地球工厂公司在其基斯通工厂生产。内骨骼、双倍散热器和 XL 引擎使该设计得以携带 ER 大型激光与中型脉冲激光。机甲保留原设计的一挺机枪，另一挺换成反导系统。这使它的火力略强于库瑞塔与达维昂的同门，代价是散热器更少、装甲略差。

Endo-Steel, double heat sinks and an XL engine allow the design to carry ER Large Lasers and Medium Pulse Lasers. The 'Mech retains a machinegun from the original design, whilst the other is replaced with an Anti Missile System. Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 3S model of this 'Mech, first deployed in 3042, is another upgrade using rediscovered technology that attempts to make the Phoenix Hawk even more effective for reconnaissance. The engine is upgraded to an ExtraLight version and double heat sinks improve heat management. The armor has both been strengthened and replaced with the lighter Ferro Fibrous armor. A large pulse laser adds extra firepower, though it still retains the two medium lasers and machine guns of the original. Additionally an anti-missile system is mounted on the right arm, with CASE protection for its ammo. Its primary difference from other variants is the addition of a MASC system, which allows the 'Mech to reach higher speeds in short bursts.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该机甲的 3S 型号于 3042 年首次部署，是又一次利用重新发现技术的升级，力图让凤凰鹰在侦察上更有效。引擎升级为超轻型版本，双倍散热器改善散热管理。装甲既被强化，也换成了更轻的铁纤维装甲。一门大型脉冲激光增加额外火力，同时仍保留原版的两门中型激光和机枪。此外右臂还安装一套反导系统，其弹药有 C.A.S.E. 保护。它与其他变体的主要区别在于加装了 MASC 系统，使机甲能在短促爆发中达到更高速度。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 3S model of this 'Mech, first deployed in 3042, is another upgrade using rediscovered technology that attempts to make the Phoenix Hawk even more effective for reconnaissance. The engine is upgraded to an ExtraLight version and double heat sinks improve heat management. The armor has both been strengthened and replaced with the lighter Ferro Fibrous armor. A large pulse laser adds extra firepower, though it still retains the two medium lasers and machine guns of the original. Additionally an anti-missile system is mounted on the right arm, with CASE protection for its ammo. Its primary difference from other variants is the addition of a MASC system, which allows the 'Mech to reach higher speeds in short bursts.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The PXH-1b, or Phoenix Hawk 'Special' is a Star League model that manages to be far scarier then even the PHX-3 variants that were introduced not so long ago. Beyond the Endo-Steel chassis and ExtraLight engine that is now more commonly found across the Inner Sphere, the 1b sports a Guardian ECM system and IFF jammer. Its large laser has been upgraded to an ER variant, but on top of its original weaponry the SLDF somehow managed to get an ER PPC in there as well.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: PXH-1b，即凤凰鹰"特种"，是一款星盟型号，比不久前推出的 PHX-3 变体还要可怕得多。除内骨骼底盘和如今在内天体更常见的超轻型引擎之外，1b 还装有守护者 ECM 系统和 IFF 干扰器。它的大型激光已升级为 ER 版本，而在原有武器之上，星盟防卫军不知怎的还设法塞进了一门 ER PPC。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A classic for a reason! Very mobile with good punch for it's tonnage. New pilots need to be careful not to overheat though.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 经典自有其道理！机动性极佳，就其吨位而言打击力也不错。不过新手飞行员要小心别过热。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Phoenix Hawk Special! This upgraded model of the scout 'Mech represents the peak of Star League technology, still being tested when the Exodus happened. Contrasted to the already spectacular 1b, this variant uses an experimental snub nose PPC to bring the weight down for additional armour, making it the most heavily armoured variant of the Phoenix Hawk that I know of. Just like the 1b it carries a full ECM suite.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 凤凰鹰"特种"！这款侦察机甲的升级型号代表星盟技术的巅峰，在出埃及发生时仍在测试中。与已经出色的 1b 相比，此变体使用一门实验性短管 PPC 以降低重量换取额外装甲，使其成为我所知装甲最厚重的凤凰鹰变体。与 1b 一样，它携带全套 ECM 套件。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A classic for a reason! Very mobile with good punch for it's tonnage. New pilots need to be careful not to overheat, but in this case they are protected with some extra armor.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 经典自有其道理！机动性极佳，就其吨位而言打击力也不错。新手飞行员要小心别过热，不过这台机甲多了一层装甲保护。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Piranha was developed by Clan Diamond Shark to combat conventional infantry and light vehicles. The sheer speed that the BattleMech is capable of has also made it something of a scout, though it lacks sophisticated electronic equipment. The Piranha is protected mostly by its speed.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 食人鱼由钻石鲨氏族开发，用于对抗常规步兵和轻型车辆。这台战斗机甲所能达到的纯粹速度也使它多少充当侦察兵，尽管它缺乏精密电子设备。食人鱼主要靠速度自保。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Piranha was developed by Clan Diamond Shark to combat conventional infantry and light vehicles. The sheer speed that the BattleMech is capable of has also made it something of a scout, though it lacks sophisticated electronic equipment. The Piranha is protected mostly by its speed.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 食人鱼由钻石鲨氏族开发，用于对抗常规步兵和轻型车辆。这台战斗机甲所能达到的纯粹速度也使它多少充当侦察兵，尽管它缺乏精密电子设备。食人鱼主要靠速度自保。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Piranha's main threat is its twelve Series XII Rotary Machine Guns. These are a serious threat to any foe on such a speedy 'Mech, especially if a Star of Piranhas operate in a pack, and such a large array allows the 'Mech to chew through an opponent's rear armor almost instantly. They are most deadly, however, to unarmored infantry, capable of wiping out an entire company in seconds. For work against hardened targets, the Piranha mounts a pair of Mk. 3 ER Medium Lasers and a single Series 1 ER Small Laser. Since the design only uses ten single heat sinks, the MechWarrior must still manage heat levels. The ammunition dependency of the Machine Guns ensure that Piranhas must stay close to supply lines, so most have been relegated to solahma or garrison roles.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 食人鱼的主要威胁是它的十二挺 XII 系列旋转机枪。在一台如此快速的机甲上，这对任何敌人都是严重威胁，尤其当一个"星"的食人鱼成群作战时；如此庞大的阵列让机甲几乎瞬间啃穿对手的背部装甲。不过它们对无装甲步兵最为致命，能在数秒内歼灭一整连。对付硬化目标时，食人鱼装有双联 Mk. 3 ER 中型激光和一门 1 系列 ER 小型激光。由于该设计仅使用十台单散热器，机甲战士仍须管理热量水平。机枪对弹药的依赖使食人鱼必须靠近补给线，因此大多数被降级到索拉马或驻防任务。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Quickdraw 4Gs are among the fastest and most maneuverable of heavy 'Mechs, with decent weaponry. They suffer from problematic heat buildup when using all their features at once, so some caution is needed.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 快枪手 4G 是重型机甲中最快、最机动的一类，武器也相当不错。同时使用全部功能时会出现棘手的过热问题，因此需要一些谨慎。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Quickdraw 5A was designed to give the 'Mech more endurance than the stock 4G. By removing the LRM-10, two additional Medium Lasers and four additional Heat Sinks could be mounted. Unfortunately, the 5A still runs too hot for most pilots.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 快手 5A 的设计目标是为机甲提供比标准 4G 更强的续航力。通过移除 LRM-10，可以加装两门额外中型激光和四台额外散热器。遗憾的是，5A 对大多数飞行员而言仍然过热。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 5K Quickdraw is an upgraded variant using Star League technology produced by Luthien Armor Works in 3049. Carrying the same weaponry as the 5A model, its use of seventeen double heat sinks solves the problem of excessive waste heat. It also uses Ferro-Fibrous armor, giving the 5K superior armor protection to the 5A model, with no added weight.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 5K 快枪手是卢西恩装甲工厂于 3049 年使用星盟科技生产的升级变体。它携带与 5A 型号相同的武器，但使用十七台双倍散热器解决了废热过多的问题。它还使用铁纤维装甲，使 5K 在不增加重量的情况下拥有优于 5A 的装甲防护。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Rakshasa was designed by engineers at the New Avalon Institute of Science in an attempt to copy the Mad Cat. The finished product, while not as powerful as the OmniMech it emulates, is a powerful 'Mech with an undeserved bad reputation. The Rakshasa is powered by a GM 375 XL engine and built on a GM Marauder Special MD Endo Steel chassis to save weight and allow the 'Mech to carry as similar a weapons payload as possible to the Mad Cat.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 罗刹由新阿瓦隆科学院的工程师设计，试图复制疯猫。成品虽然不如它所模仿的全能机甲强大，却是一台强悍的机甲，背负着不该有的坏名声。罗刹由一台 GM 375 XL 引擎驱动，基于"GM 掠夺者特种 MD"内骨骼底盘建造，以减轻重量并使机甲能携带尽可能接近疯猫的武器载荷。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Raptor began as a proof of concept design by Luthien Armor Works that turned into a respected recon and fast strike OmniMech. The Raptor is built on an Alshain Type KR140 Endo Steel chassis and uses a weight-saving Omni 175 XL Engine, which gives the Raptor a top speed of 118.8 kph.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 猛禽最初是卢西恩装甲工厂的概念验证设计，后来成为广受尊重的侦察与快速打击全能机甲。它建立在 Alshain KR140 型内骨骼底盘上，使用节省重量的 Omni 175 XL 引擎，最高速度达 118.8 公里/小时。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Raptor A is intended for extended operations from supply lines. The Raptor A carries as its primary weapons two Large Lasers and for close range combat the A configuration carries three Small Lasers.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The B configuration carries three SRM-6 launchers and a Small Laser. This configuration is intended for close combat and works well in a vehicle-hunting role as well as in mop up operations.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: B 配置携带三具 SRM-6 发射器和一门小型激光。此配置为近战设计，在反车辆任务和清剿行动中都表现出色。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Configured for medium to close range combat, the C configuration of the Raptor is built to swoop in on a target and overwhelm an enemy with fire from its six Medium Lasers and two Small Pulse Lasers and adds two more double heat sinks. For missile defense the Raptor C carries an Anti-Missile System.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 猛禽 C 配置为中近距离战斗而设，旨在扑向目标，用六门中型激光和两门小型脉冲激光压制敌人，并加装两台额外双倍散热器。导弹防御方面，猛禽 C 携带一套反导系统。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Configured for medium to close range combat, the C configuration of the Raptor is built to swoop in on a target and overwhelm an enemy with fire from its six Medium Lasers and two Small Pulse Lasers and adds two more double heat sinks. Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Loaded with advanced electronic equipment, the D configuration carries a TAG laser designator, a Beagle Active Probe, and a C3 Slave unit. The Raptor D is armed with a short-range arsenal of three Streak SRM-2 launchers and two Small Lasers. To deter infantry attacks, the D configuration has two Machine Guns. The combination of a Beagle Active Probe with TAG and a C3 slave make the Raptor D an excellent point 'Mech for light C3 lances, since it is able to share targeting information with allied units and also find hidden units and designate them for highly accurate artillery fire.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: D 配置装载先进电子设备，携带 TAG 激光指示器、比格犬主动探测器和一台 C3 从属单元。猛禽 D 以三具连续 SRM-2 发射器和两门小型激光构成近程武器库。为威慑步兵攻击，D 配置有两挺机枪。比格犬主动探测器加 TAG 与 C3 从属单元的组合，使猛禽 D 成为轻型 C3 小队的优秀先锋机甲，因为它能与友军共享瞄准信息，也能发现隐藏单位并为高精度炮火标记它们。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A medium range missile barrage 'Mech, the E configuration carries three MRM-10 launchers with a single Small Laser as a backup weapon.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: E 配置是一款中程导弹弹幕机甲，携带三具 MRM-10 发射器，以一门小型激光作为备用武器。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Similar to the C configuration, the F configuration of the Raptor carries five ER Medium Lasers and adds three additional double heat sinks. The Raptor F has added maneuverability with the addition of seven jump jets, allowing it to jump up to two hundred and ten meters.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 与 C 配置相似，猛禽 F 配置携带五门 ER 中型激光，并加装三台额外双倍散热器。猛禽 F 通过加装七个跳跃推进器提升机动性，可跳跃至二百一十米。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A field upgrade developed in the midst of Operation Bulldog, this configuration utilized captured Clan Smoke Jaguar weapons to help bolster the SLDF forces in later waves. This configuration mounts an array of Clan-tech Extended Range Lasers, with an ER Large and medium in each arm and a ER Small Laser beside a C3 Slave unit in the center torso.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 此配置是"斗牛犬"行动期间开发的野战升级，利用缴获的烟虎氏族武器帮助增强后期波次的星盟防卫军部队。此配置装备一系列氏族科技增程激光：每臂一门 ER 大型和一门 ER 中型，中央躯干一门 ER 小型激光与一台 C3 从属单元并列。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Rifleman II was an upgrade fielded by the SLDF Royals in 2720, adding twenty tons to its overall mass. The Rifleman II used an Endo Steel structure and an XL Engine, and carried a pair of LB-X Autocannon/10s and Large Pulse Lasers, one in each arm, as well as a pair of Medium Lasers, a Beagle Active Probe, and fourteen Double Heat Sinks.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 步枪手 II 是星盟防卫军皇家部队于 2720 年装备的升级型，整体质量增加二十吨。步枪手 II 采用内骨骼结构和 XL 引擎，每臂各携带一门 LB-X 自动炮/10 和一门大型脉冲激光，另有两门中型激光、一具比格犬主动探测器和十四台双倍散热器。
狙击手 & 直接火力支援

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This Chassis is weird boss, it definitely was a Star League Era Design, but it seems to have been rebuilt and repaired so many times that barely anything is left of it, dont even want to speculate how a bunch of Pirates got their hands on it.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这个底盘很奇怪，老大。它绝对是星盟时代的设计，但似乎被重建和修理过太多次，几乎没剩下什么了。我甚至不想猜测一群海盗是怎么弄到它的。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Designed as a medium fire-support platform, the Rifleman was plagued with a variety of problems since its debut and was ill-suited as a front-line combatant.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 步枪手被设计为中型火力支援平台，自问世以来便受各种问题困扰，并不适合担任前线战斗单位。
狙击手 & 直接火力支援

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Rifleman is highly specialized at long-range direct-fire support. It doesn't have much in the way of protection or closer-range weapons, though, so keep it distant and out of harm's way.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 步枪手高度专精于远程直射支援。它的防护与近程武器都不多，所以让它保持距离、远离危险。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 4D was one of two variants designed by Hanse Davion; it was intended to compete with the heavier Warhammer. It replaced the autocannon/5s with PPCs and removed the medium lasers, using the freed-up weight to mount an five extra heat sinks. In spite of the extra heat sinks, this model suffered from significant overheat problems.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 4D 是汉斯·达维昂设计的两款变体之一，意在对抗更重的战锤。它把自动炮/5 换成 PPC 并移除中型激光，用腾出的重量加装五台额外散热器。尽管增加了散热器，该型号仍受严重过热问题困扰。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This variant removes all of the weapons and equipment, and replaces them with four Ultra Autocannon/2s and six tons of ammunition. The weight saved, plus a half ton from armor, is used to upgrade the engine to allow the 'Mech a top speed of 64 km/h. MechWarriors must be exceptionally wary of the large, vulnerable ammo bins.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 此变体移除全部武器与装备，换成四门超速自动炮/2 和六吨弹药。节省的重量加上半吨装甲用于升级引擎，使机甲最高速度达 64 公里/小时。机甲战士必须格外警惕那些庞大而脆弱的弹药箱。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A modern Clan take on the classic Succession Wars era RFL-3N Rifleman, the A variant carries a Large Pulse Laser and Ultra Autocannon/5 in each arm, supported by an ER Medium Laser in each side torso. Built around a 260-rated XL Engine, Endo Steel frame, and ten tons of Ferro-Fibrous armor, the A is fitted with sixteen Double Heat Sinks and four tons of UAC ammo.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是氏族对经典继承战争时代 RFL-3N 步枪手的现代演绎。A 变体在每臂装备一门大型脉冲激光和一门超速自动炮/5，两侧躯干各由一门 ER 中型激光支援。它以 260 级 XL 引擎、内骨骼框架和十吨铁纤维装甲为基础，配十六台双倍散热器和四吨 UAC 弹药。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Simple, straightforward, and accurate; the Rifleman IIC is armed with four Large Pulse Lasers. This allows it to pick apart enemies from a respectable range, as well as easily target incoming aircraft. A single ER Small Laser is installed, seemingly as an afterthought. Nineteen double heat sinks keep heat mostly in check, though volley fire should be used.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 简单、直接而精准；步枪手 IIC 装备四门大型脉冲激光，使其能在相当远的距离拆解敌人，也能轻松瞄准来袭飞行器。一门 ER 小型激光像是事后想起才装上的。十九台双倍散热器基本能压制热量，不过仍应使用齐射。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A militarized BattleMech version of Achernar's Loader King IndustrialMech, the Roughneck is a low-cost heavy 'Mech intended for price conscious buyers such as planetary militias and down-on-their-luck mercenary units. Featuring a mixed if short ranged weapons loadout, the Roughneck's primary weapons are an AC/10 and SRM-4 in its torsos, supported by a trio of Machine Guns and a head-mounted Small Laser. While tying it to supply lines, two tons of SRM and autocannon rounds provide adequate field endurance, only a ton and a half of rounds supporting three machine guns run dry quickly.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: he Savage Coyote OmniMech was created as a showcase OmniMech. The 'Mech was also part of Khan Koga's attempts to revitalize the fading Clan that invented the OmniMech.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 野蛮郊狼全能机甲是作为展示型全能机甲而打造的。这台机甲也是可汗科加重振发明全能机甲却日渐衰落的氏族的努力之一。
重型火力支援 & 防御者

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The primary configuration of the Savage Coyote makes use of a pair of the largest ATM, An ER PPC, an LB-X Autocannon/10, three ER Medium Lasers, and a pair of ER Small Lasers. MechWarriors must carefully manage heat levels, even with three additional double heat sinks
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 野蛮郊狼主配置使用一对最大的 ATM、一门 ER PPC、一门 LB-X 自动炮/10、三门 ER 中型激光和一对 ER 小型激光。即便有三台额外双倍散热器，机甲战士也必须小心管理热量水平

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Sentry was developed under pressure from the Draconis and Capellan marches for a more advanced 'Mech to defend the borders of the Federated Suns. The 'Mech is built on a light weight Dorwinion hyperactive 3 Endo Steel chassis. This chassis saves weight, allowing the 'Mech to carry heavier weapons and equipment. The Sentry is powered by a Nissan 200 fusion engine that gives it a top speed of 86.4 km/h that is augmented by five HildCo Model 12 jump jets that make it possible for the Sentry to jump up to one hundred and fifty meters. To compensate for its less than average mobility, the Sentry has an impressive eight and a half tons of Starshield A armor that has been fitted with CASE to protect the 'Mech from an ammunition explosion.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 哨兵是在德拉科尼斯与卡佩兰边疆区压力下开发的，旨在为保卫联邦太阳系边境提供一款更先进的机甲。机甲基于轻量化的"多温尼恩亢奋 3"内骨骼底盘建造。这一底盘节省重量，使机甲能携带更重的武器和装备。哨兵由一台日产 200 聚变引擎驱动，最高速度 86.4 公里/小时，并由五个希尔德科 12 型跳跃推进器增强，使哨兵能跳起至一百五十米。为弥补其低于平均的机动性，哨兵拥有令人印象深刻的八吨半"星盾 A"装甲，并加装 C.A.S.E. 以保护机甲免受弹药爆炸。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Sentry has a diverse mix of weapons that allow it to carry out a wide variety of missions. For anti-'Mech and vehicle combat the Sentry carries a Parti-Kill PPC and a pair of Magna 200P Small Pulse Lasers which can double as anti-infantry weapons. For anti-infantry and crowd control missions, the Sentry has a quartet of Sperry Browning Machine Guns and a Zippo Flamer.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 哨兵武器搭配多样，能执行多种任务。反机甲与车辆战斗方面，哨兵携带一门"党杀"PPC 和两门"玛格纳 200P"小型脉冲激光，后者可兼任反步兵武器。反步兵与人群控制任务方面，哨兵有四挺"斯佩里-勃朗宁"机枪和一具"芝宝"火焰喷射器。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The original and considerably flawed prototypes were completed in 2680. Based on the Shadow Hawk SHD-2H, the 'Mech carried a Class 2 Autocannon in place of the Class 5. The SHD-X1 carried only 6.5 tons of armor for protection. Only one chassis survived multiple crashes caused by its faulty schematics. It had a top ground speed of 86.4 km/h like its progenitor, the SHD-2H, and used ten single heat sinks.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 最初且缺陷颇多的原型机于 2680 年完成。以影鹰 SHD-2H 为基础，该机甲以一门 2 级自动炮取代 5 级。SHD-X1 仅有 6.5 吨装甲用于防护。因其图纸错误导致多次坠机，仅有一台机体幸存。它的最高地面速度与前辈 SHD-2H 相同，为 86.4 公里/小时，并使用十台单散热器。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Allied Aerospace won the SLDF's contract to produce a series of Land-Air mechs with a design based on the venerable Shadow HawkBattleMech. Allied gave their new Land-Air 'Mech the ability to convert directly into an Aerospace Fighter. While construction was completed in 2680, thanks to the chassis' numerous flaws, lackluster performance and a number of ill-fated and publicly witnessed test-flights disasters during SLDF reviews in 2682, Allied Aerospace was forced to go back to the drawing board. The more refined X2 variant faced considerable scrutiny by SLDF evaluators in 2684, successfully meeting the SLDF's requirements but still rejected thanks to its high fuel consumption and the bad press generated by the earlier X1. Twenty SHD-X2 were built for trials with potential customers, but failed to attract any interest. Ultimately Allied scrapped the Shadow Hawk LAM program in favor of what became the considerably more successful Phoenix Hawk LAM.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 联合航空赢得星盟防卫军生产一系列陆空机甲的合同，设计以古老的影鹰战斗机甲为基础。联合航空让新型陆空机甲能直接变身为航空战斗机。虽然制造于 2680 年完成，但由于底盘缺陷众多、性能不佳，加上 2682 年星盟防卫军评审期间一系列不幸且公开可见的试飞灾难，联合航空被迫重头再来。更精细的 X2 变体于 2684 年接受了星盟评审员的严格审查，虽然成功满足星盟要求，却仍因高燃料消耗和早期 X1 造成的负面报道而被否决。二十台 SHD-X2 被造出来供潜在客户试用，却未能引起任何兴趣。最终联合航空放弃了影鹰 LAM 项目，转而投向后来相当成功的凤凰鹰 LAM。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Shadow Hawk 2D is an interesting model. Its default payload sacrifices a lot of armor to mount a bit more firepower, though some argue the tradeoff isn't worth it. Its Alpha Strikes are better, though, soÔÇª I guess you can be the judge.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Shadow Hawk 2H is the perfect example of a 'jack-of-all-trades.' It supports weaponry for all ranges, has respectable speed and jump capability, and mounts decent armor. This comes at the cost of excelling at nothing in particular.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 暗影鹰 2H 是"样样通吃"的完美范例。它具备适用于所有射程的武器，速度与跳跃能力可观，装甲也相当不错。代价是它在任何方面都不特别出众。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Shadow Hawk 2H is the perfect example of a 'jack-of-all-trades.' It supports weaponry for all ranges, has respectable speed and jump capability, and mounts decent armor. This comes at the cost of excelling at nothing in particular.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Shadow Hawk 2Hb was designed for the Star League's Royal regiments, which changed the mission profile to favor close range engagements exclusively. The -2Hb has little at range but is deadly dangerous up close thanks to its heavy weapons load.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 影鹰 2Hb 为星盟皇家团设计，任务定位改为专门偏好近距离交战。-2Hb 在远距离几乎无能为力，但凭借重型武器装载，近身时极为凶险。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Shadow Hawk 2I variant comes with a UAC/10 coupled with a nasty Inferno Launcher, but in doing so sacrifices its jump capabilities.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 影鹰 2I 变体配备一门 UAC/10 和一具凶恶的燃烧弹发射器，但为此牺牲了跳跃能力。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Shadow Hawk 2I variant comes with a UAC/10 coupled with a nasty Inferno Launcher, but in doing so sacrifices its jump capabilities.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 影鹰 2I 变体配备一门 UAC/10 和一具凶恶的燃烧弹发射器，但为此牺牲了跳跃能力。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Shadow Hawk 2K removes all the armaments of the original, aside from its LRM-5, and replaces them with a single PPC.  Five additional Heat Sinks are also added to help with the excess heat.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 影鹰 2K 移除原版除 LRM-5 之外的全部武器，换成单门 PPC，并加装五台额外散热器以应对多余热量。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 2K model is a poor man's Griffin, and is underarmed for its weight class.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 2K 型号是穷人版的狮鹫，火力配置低于其重量级别。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Shadow Hawk 2Ki was conceived during the First Succession War by the Draconis Combine in 2803. As the enraged Federated Suns pushed the Kuritan troops back, the Draconis Combine dramatically overhauled the chassis by replacing almost all of its original armaments, most notably swapping in an upgraded PPC in place of an Autocannon.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 影鹰 2Ki 由德拉科尼斯联合体于 2803 年第一次继承战争期间构想。当愤怒的联邦太阳系将库瑞塔部队击退时，联合体大幅改造底盘，替换了几乎所有原始武器，最显著的是用一门升级版 PPC 换下自动炮。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Shadow Hawk 2Ki was conceived during the First Succession War by the Draconis Combine in 2803. As the enraged Federated Suns pushed the Kuritan troops back, the Draconis Combine dramatically overhauled the chassis by replacing almost all of its original armaments, most notably swapping in an upgraded PPC in place of an Autocannon.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 影鹰 2Ki 由德拉科尼斯联合体于 2803 年第一次继承战争期间构想。当愤怒的联邦太阳系将库瑞塔部队击退时，联合体大幅改造底盘，替换了几乎所有原始武器，最显著的是用一门升级版 PPC 换下自动炮。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 5M Shadow Hawk is the first complete overhaul and upgrade of the design, unveiled in 3048 by Earthwerks for the Free Worlds League. The chassis has been upgraded to an Earthwerks SHD II Endo Steel frame, an additional ton of armor was added, two additional jump jets were fitted for a total jumping distance of 150 meters, the engine replaced with an extralight version of the Hermes 275, and the weapons load has undergone an almost complete renovation. The original autocannon has been updated to an Imperator Ultra Autocannon/5, the LRM launcher to a Doombud LRM-20, and the head-mounted SRM launcher to a Hovertec Streak SRM-2. The amount of ammunition carried and the left-arm medium laser are maintained, and while the number of heat sinks was reduced to ten these were upgrade to double-strength models.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 5M 影鹰是该设计的首次彻底翻修与升级，由地球工厂于 3048 年为自由世界联盟推出。底盘升级为地球工厂 SHD II 内骨骼框架，增加一吨装甲，加装两个跳跃推进器使总跳跃距离达 150 米，引擎换成赫尔墨斯 275 的超轻型版本，武器配置几乎全面翻新。原始自动炮升级为帝皇超速自动炮/5，LRM 发射器换为末日芽 LRM-20，头部 SRM 发射器换为霍弗泰克连续 SRM-2。弹药携带量与左臂中型激光保持不变，散热器数量虽减至十台但升级为双倍强度型号。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Created by Maverick Industries, the 5MI is a redesign of House Marik’s 5M model. Designed to compete with the Griffin 1DS and other new designs, the 5MI was Mavericks attempt to win over the recalcitrant FedCom military. Focusing on improving survivability and battlefield endurance, the 5MI used new technology like DHS and an Artemis IV FSC to give it an edge. Unfortunately the design was deemed to expensive too produce and as a result the military declined to purchase any of the initial production run. Such poor performance led to the second manufacturing run being cancelled and resources diverted to more promising lines. The surviving models were sold off to various mercenary groups, though the Maverick Industries scion would use one during her time in the 10th Lyran Guards; netting the company the occasional conversion or custom order from fellow members of the regiment.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 5MI 由马弗里克工业打造，是马里克家族 5M 型号的重新设计。为与狮鹫 1DS 及其他新设计竞争，马弗里克试图借此赢得固执的联邦联邦军方青睐。5MI 聚焦于提升生存性与战场续航，采用 DHS 与 Artemis IV 火控系统等新技术以获得优势。遗憾的是该设计被认为生产成本过高，军方因此拒绝采购首批量产的任何一台。如此糟糕的表现导致第二轮生产被取消，资源被转投更有前途的生产线。幸存的型号被卖给各佣兵团，不过马弗里克工业的继承人在第 10 莱兰卫队服役期间使用过一台，为公司从团队袍泽那里赢得了零星的改装或定制订单。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 5S is a variant of the 5M used by the Special Forces. It replaces all standard weapons with one Large Laser, one medium pulse laser and four medium lasers. In addition, it carries a Beagle Active Probe and an ECM Suite.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 5S 是特种部队使用的 5M 变体。它将所有标准武器换成一门大型激光、一门中型脉冲激光和四门中型激光。此外还携带比格犬主动探测器和一套 ECM 套件。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 5S is a variant of the 5M used by the Special Forces. It replaces all standard weapons with one Large Laser, one medium pulse laser and four medium lasers. In addition, it carries a Beagle Active Probe and an ECM Suite.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 5S 是特种部队使用的 5M 变体。它将所有标准武器换成一门大型激光、一门中型脉冲激光和四门中型激光。此外还携带比格犬主动探测器和一套 ECM 套件。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A Clan Tech Shadowhawk. The first version of the Shadow Hawk IIC that Inner Sphere forces encountered is meant for close-range fighting, and appears to be designed with urban warfare in mind.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 氏族科技影鹰。内天体部队遭遇的第一版影鹰 IIC 是为近战而设，看起来在设计时考虑了城市战。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 氏族科技影鹰。此变体为远程直射支援而设计。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A Clan Tech Shadowhawk. A newer variant that dates to the late 3050s, the IIC 3's main gun is a Heavy Large Laser.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 氏族科技影鹰。较新的变体，可追溯至 3050 年代末，IIC 3 的主炮是一门重型大型激光。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A Clan Tech Shadowhawk. First fielded in 3060, the IIC 4 was resulted in a 'Mech that is visually very different from the design it is considered a variant of.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 氏族科技影鹰。于 3060 年首次投入战场，IIC 4 造就了一台在外观上与其所归属的设计大相径庭的机甲。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A Clan Tech Shadowhawk. First fielded in 3060, the IIC 4 was resulted in a 'Mech that is visually very different from the design it is considered a variant of.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 氏族科技影鹰。于 3060 年首次投入战场，IIC 4 造就了一台在外观上与其所归属的设计大相径庭的机甲。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Shootist first saw service in 2621 as a heavily armored, electronic warfare-capable command 'Mech for SLDF Royal BattleMech Regiments. However, the Shootist's upgraded electronic suites proved no match for the cutting edge of electronic warfare of its own time. When the BattleMaster eclipsed the Shootist in its intended role as a command vehicle merely ten years after its introduction, the SLDF changed the Shootist's mission parameters. The Shootist's balanced mix of weapons and speed, and its heavy armor allowed it a new role: juggernaut for close-combat heavy lances, and later, a bodyguard unit for command lances. This role never proved favorable to the longevity of the Shootist; since the Succession Wars, this BattleMech is rarely seen outside of the ComGuards, Word of Blake Militia, and ancient Clan Brian Caches.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 射击手于 2621 年首次服役，作为星盟防卫军皇家战斗机甲团的重视装甲、具备电子战能力的指挥机甲。然而射击手升级后的电子套件被证明敌不过同代最前沿的电子战。当战将在射击手推出仅十年后就在其预定的指挥车辆角色上超越它时，星盟防卫军改变了射击手的任务参数。射击手均衡的武器与速度搭配以及厚重装甲让它获得了新角色：近战重型小队的主宰者，后来又成为指挥小队的护卫单位。这一角色从未有利于射击手的长久存续；自继承战争以来，这台战斗机甲在康卫、布雷克之言民兵和古老的氏族布莱恩仓库之外已很少见到。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Shootist has a top speed of 64.8 km/h, giving it an average level of mobility for a heavy 'Mech. The 'Mech has thirteen double heat sinks that allow the Shootist to dissipate the waste heat that is produced by its heavy weapons payload. The Shootist carries twelve tons of MV Ferro-Fibrous armor with CASE to protect the 'Mech in the event of an ammunition explosion. The Shootist is armed to engage an enemy at various ranges. The only long-range weapon on the 'Mech is a Blankenburg ER Large Laser that has an effective range of five hundred and seventy meters. For medium to close range combat, the Shootist carries a devastating Deathgiver Autocannon/20 which is capable of downing most light and even some medium 'Mechs in a single salvo. Finally, for point blank defense, the 'Mech has two Blankenburg Medium Pulse Lasers and a Dinatech Mark III Small Laser.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 射击手最高速度 64.8 公里/小时，对重型机甲而言机动性属中等水平。机甲有十三台双倍散热器，使射击手能散发其沉重武器载荷产生的废热。射击手携带十二吨 MV 铁纤维装甲并配 C.A.S.E.，在弹药爆炸时保护机甲。射击手武装到能在多种距离交战。机甲上唯一的远程武器是一门"布兰肯堡"ER 大型激光，有效射程五百七十米。中近程战斗方面，射击手携带一门毁灭性的"死亡赐予者"自动炮/20，单次齐射就能击倒大多数轻型甚至某些中型机甲。最后，抵近防御方面，机甲有两门"布兰肯堡"中型脉冲激光和一门"迪纳科技 Mark III"小型激光。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Meant mostly as a high-speed fire support unit, the minimally-armored Sling was meant to remain out of the way of enemy fire, saturating the target area with its fifteen long-range missile tubes.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 投石索主要作为高速火力支援单位，装甲极少，意在远离敌方火力，用十五根远程导弹发射管饱和覆盖目标区域。
轻型攻击手 & 侦察兵

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: With all those Thunder LRM's, the SL-1G can lay a minefield anywhere and anytime you need one. You've gotta be careful with it, though, because it's not meant to take much of a beating.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 凭借那些雷霆 LRM，SL-1G 能在你需要布雷的任何时间地点布设雷场。不过你得小心使用它，因为它可经不起多少打击。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Meant as a more traditional skirmish unit, the SL-1H replaced all three missile launchers with a pair of standard medium lasers and a single medium pulse laser.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: SL-1H 意在成为更传统的散兵单位，它以一对标准中型激光和一门中型脉冲激光取代了全部三具导弹发射器。
轻型攻击手 & 侦察兵

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This one packs a nasty punch for a light mech.  You've gotta be careful with it, though, because it's not meant to take much of a beating.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这台机甲作为轻型机甲打击力凶狠。不过你得小心使用它，因为它可经不起多少打击。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Snake is a 'Mech that was built under the aegis of an Elemental hunter. With the power of hindsight though the Snake is clearly designed to hunt Inner Sphere Battle Armor suits. The 'Mech is built using a Vox 225 XL Engine to move at a top speed of 86.4 kph. The Snake also has a jumping capability of one hundred and fifty meters making it capable of outmaneuvering any battle armor suit and also keeping it on par with most medium 'Mechs. The Snake is also armored with seven tons of armor and uses double heat sinks to cool the 'Mech's excess heat.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 蛇是一台在"元素猎手"名义下建造的机甲。不过事后看来，蛇显然是为猎杀内天体战斗装甲服而设计的。机甲采用 VOX 225 XL 引擎，最高速度 86.4 公里/小时。蛇还具备一百五十米的跳跃能力，使其能胜过任何战斗装甲服，也能与大多数中型机甲并驾齐驱。蛇还披挂七吨装甲，并使用双倍散热器散发机甲的多余热量。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Snake's primary weapon is a Mydron Excel LB-X Autocannon/10 which can fire both standard rounds as well as firing cluster rounds which act like 'Mech sized shotgun shells. The 'Mech is also armed with three Hovertec Streak SRM-2s which are highly effective in finding weak spots in an enemy's armor or against Inner Sphere battle armor.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 蛇的主武器是一门迈德龙 Excel LB-X 自动炮/10，可发射标准弹，也能发射类似机甲级霰弹的集束弹。机甲还装备三门"气垫"连续 SRM-2，在寻找敌方装甲弱点或对付内天体战斗装甲时极为有效。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Spector was originally designed by Norse-Storm BattleMechs to be a lighter version of the Exterminator BattleMech, made to hunt down light command 'Mechs. The first Spector rolled off the assembly line on 6 June, 2639, and following extensive testing the SLDF ordered 600. The Star League's enthusiasm for the Spector is due to the BattleMechs stealth capabilities, a Chameleon Light Polarization Shield

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 5D Spider is geared towards anti-infantry work, removing one of the medium lasers and replacing it with a Flamer in the right arm.  However, the combination of its speed with the Flamer can deliver an unpleasant surprise.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Spider 5V is hands down the most maneuverable 'Mech you can fieldÔÇª but it's made of paper. It's an excellent scout, though, and can even jump into the rear arc of most enemies for surprise back shots.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 7M was Nimakachi's upgrade of the venerable Spider with recovered Star League technology. Released in 3051 it uses a Crucis-II Delux Endo Steel chassis and three tons of Kallon FWL Special Ferro-Fibrous armor, freeing up weight to replace the two medium lasers with two Tronel XII medium pulse lasers. Many of the components were also replaced with proprietary technology, including Rawlings 75 jump jets, an Omicron 4002 Networking Channel, and a TRSS Eagle Eye targeting system. One thing they could not do however was include an ejection system for the pilot.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 7M 是尼玛卡奇用回收的星盟科技对古老蜘蛛的升级。它于 3051 年发布，使用十字-II 豪华内骨骼底盘和三吨卡隆 FWL 特制铁纤维装甲，腾出重量把两门中型激光换成两门特罗内尔 XII 中型脉冲激光。许多部件也换成自有技术，包括罗林斯 75 跳跃推进器、奥米克戎 4002 网络通道和 TRSS 鹰眼瞄准系统。然而有一件事他们做不到：为飞行员加装弹射系统。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Stalker 3F mounts a ridiculous amount of weaponry, even for an assault 'Mech. It is also notable for its incredibly poor heat management, which is the cost it pays for such amazing damage output. Powerful, but to be used wisely.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 潜行者 3F 装备的武器数量即便对突击机甲而言也荒唐得多。它还以极其糟糕的散热管理著称，这是它为如此惊人的伤害输出付出的代价。强大，但需明智使用。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Due to ongoing structual weakness issues with the aging Stalker chassis, it was necessary to reduce the load by 10 tons by removing a LRM launcher effectively reclassifying this variant as a Heavy 'Mech.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Stealth is a heavy scout 'Mech that is in use by the Federated Suns and the Lyran Alliance. The 'Mech has a GM 315 XL Engine that allows the Stealth to move at speeds of 118.8 kph and the MASC system on board can push the 'Mech to 151.2 kph in short bursts. This amazing mobility is augmented by jump jets which the Stealth can use to jump up to two hundred and ten meters. The Stealth is also outfitted with a Cyclops-Beagle Sensory Active Probe that the Stealth can use to find hidden enemy units.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 隐形是联邦太阳系与莱兰联盟使用的重型侦察机甲。它采用 GM 315 XL 引擎，速度可达 118.8 公里/小时，机上的 MASC 系统可在短促爆发中推至 151.2 公里/小时。这一惊人机动性由跳跃推进器进一步增强，隐形可跳跃至二百一十米。它还配备了独眼巨人-比格犬主动探测器，可用于寻找隐藏的敌方单位。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Stealth is armed with an eclectic short range weapons arsenal. The primary weapons in this arsenal are a pair of Diplan M3 Medium Lasers which are backed up by a Shannon SH-60 SRM-6 and a Federated SuperStreak Streak SRM-2 which both allow the 'Mech to find weak spots in an enemy 'Mech's armor.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 潜行者装备一套兼收并蓄的近程武器。这套武器的主武器是一对"迪普兰 M3"中型激光，辅以一具"香农 SH-60"SRM-6 和一具"联邦超级连续"连续 SRM-2，两者都让机甲能寻找敌方机甲装甲上的弱点。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 2D 移除了潜行者的武器但保留主动探测器。潜行者重新武装为一具连续 SRM-6 发射器和三门 ER 中型激光，使这台机甲在中近距离强得可怕。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Stiletto was engineered in a similar vein as the Black Hawk-KU or the Rakshasa, using examples of Fire Falcon OmniMechs salvaged from the battlefield immediately following the Battle of Coventry. The Stiletto has an identical speed profile as the Fire Falcon with a VOX 280 Light Engine giving it a top speed of 129.6 km/h.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 短剑的设计思路与黑鹰-KU 或罗刹相似，采用了在考文垂战役后立即从战场回收的火隼全能机甲样本。短剑的速度曲线与火隼相同，VOX 280 轻型引擎赋予它 129.6 公里/小时的最高速度。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The original Stinger LAM used by the Star League Defense Force Royal Divisions, this version carried a Medium Pulse Laser and replaced the Machine Guns with Small Pulse Lasers. Double heat sinks kept the temperature manageable. It was also more heavily armored than its forerunner, carrying five tons of protection.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是星盟防卫军皇家师使用的原始毒刺 LAM，此版本携带一门中型脉冲激光，并以轻型脉冲激光取代机枪。双倍散热器使温度可控。它的装甲也较前型更厚，携带五吨防护。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: In 2680, the Star League requested designers to develop 'Mechs which could fly as well as function as standard 'Mechs. The first Land-Air 'Mech off the drawing board, the Shadow Hawk LAM, proved so fatally flawed, the concept was almost shelved. However, LexaTech Industries reworked the conversion equipment and unveiled the first viable LAM, the Stinger LAM in 2688, based on the old Stinger design. LexaTech's reworking of the concept proved so successful, the Land-Air 'Mech became highly sought after, especially for space combat operations. In fact, the Stinger LAM first saw combat destroying a nuclear weapons facility in the Oort Cloud orbiting Sol, Terra's star. Found in the Draconis Combine, this variant uses two pairs of Martell Small Lasers on the arms instead of a single Medium Laser.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 2680 年，星盟要求设计师开发既能飞行又能作为标准机甲运作的机甲。首款走下绘图板的陆空机甲——影鹰 LAM——被证明缺陷致命，该概念几乎被搁置。然而莱克萨科技工业重做了变身设备，于 2688 年推出首款可用的 LAM——毒刺 LAM，以老式毒刺设计为基础。莱克萨对概念的改造极为成功，陆空机甲变得极受追捧，尤其是在太空作战中。事实上，毒刺 LAM 首次参战就是摧毁太阳系恒星泰拉轨道上奥尔特云中的一处核武器设施。此变体见于德拉科尼斯联合体，臂部使用两对马特尔小型激光取代单门中型激光。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This upgraded version of the Stinger produced by Earthwerks Incorporated on Keystone and Calloway VI took advantage of several technologies that were rediscovered, thanks in part to the Helm Memory Core. The chassis was upgraded to an Earthwerks STG II Endo Steel model, allowing it to carry an additional half-ton of armor. The 'Mech retained the Omicron medium laser but swapped the machine guns for a Lindblad Shotgun Anti-Missile System on its right arm and a Flame Tech Flamer on its left. One ton of AMS ammo was carried in the right torso, while the Datacom 26 and Dynatec 990 electronic systems remain unchanged.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这款毒刺升级版由地球工厂公司在基斯通与卡洛威 VI 生产，得益于多项重新发现的技术，其中部分要归功于赫尔姆记忆核心。底盘升级为地球工厂 STG II 内骨骼型号，使其能多携带半吨装甲。机甲保留奥米克戎中型激光，但把机枪换成右臂的林德布拉德霰弹反导系统和左臂的火焰科技火焰喷射器。右躯干携带一吨 AMS 弹药，而 Datacom 26 与 Dynatec 990 电子系统保持不变。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The design featured Large Pulse Lasers in each arm, twin Gauss Rifles mounted behind flip-open circular firing ports on each side torso, and an almost superfluous Small Pulse Laser located above the cockpit. The Stone Rhino also sported an interesting feature; each arm contained a retractable, shock-absorbing cowl covering the weapon barrels. This allowed MechWarriors to use the arms as battering rams without damaging the weaponry.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该设计在每臂装备大型脉冲激光，两侧躯干各在翻开式圆形射击口后安装两门高斯步枪，驾驶舱上方还有一门近乎多余的轻型脉冲激光。石犀牛还有一个有趣特征：每臂都包含一个可伸缩的减震罩盖住炮管，使机甲战士能把手臂当攻城锤使用而不损坏武器。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: In order to plug holes in their touman, Clan Goliath Scorpion scientists revisited the Behemoth. Like Clan Smoke Jaguar before them, they upgraded and improved upon the design. This version used an Extra-light Engine to mount a pair of Thunderstroke Series 2b Gauss Rifles along the top of the 'Mech. Each arm carried a Series 4D-2 Heavy Large Laser, a Series 22a Heavy Medium Laser, and a General Systems Heavy Small Laser. It retained the shock-absorbing cowls of the original. Another pair of Heavy Mediums protected the rear of the 'Mech. A head-mounted Shield-3 Anti-Missile System defended against missiles, while an Anti-Personnel Pod in each leg discouraged unarmored infantry. This design had jump jets, nineteen tons of armor, and a meager sixteen double heat sinks.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 为填补图曼的缺口，歌利亚蝎氏族科学家重新审视了巨兽。如烟虎氏族先前所做，他们升级改进了该设计。此版本使用超轻型引擎，在机甲顶部安装两门雷霆系列 2b 高斯步枪。每臂携带一门 4D-2 系列重型大型激光、一门 22a 系列重型中型激光和一门通用系统重型小型激光。它保留了原版的减震罩盖。另外两门重型中型激光保护机甲后方。头部安装的盾-3 反导系统防御导弹，每条腿上的反人员荚舱则用于威慑无装甲步兵。该设计配有跳跃推进器、十九吨装甲和仅十六台双倍散热器。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A variable range variant, the Stone Rhino 4 uses an XL Engine to provide weight savings for four LRM 10s to lay down impressive long range fire. Backing these up are a pair of Ultra AC-10s for mid-range engagements. From there, four ER Medium Lasers provide a solid short range punch. Lastly, four Machine Guns provide anti-infantry support. These combine to make a solid and well rounded configuration.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 石犀牛 4 是一款全能射程变体，它使用 XL 引擎节省重量以搭载四具 LRM 10，倾泻可观远程火力。中距离交战由两门超速 AC-10 支援，四门 ER 中型激光提供扎实的近距离打击，最后四挺机枪提供反步兵支援。这些组合成一套扎实而均衡的配置。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Strider OmniMech is based on the older Cicada BattleMech. The Strider is built on an Alshain Type KR240 Endo Steel chassis to help save on weight. Built with the rugged GM 240 fusion engine, the Strider has a top speed of 97.2 km/h. Outfitted with CASE, built around the durable GM 240, and protected with seven and a half tons of armor, the Strider is a durable 'Mech for its weight class; capable of suffering considerable damage before being disabled or destroyed.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 疾行者全能机甲以较老的蝉战斗机甲为基础。它采用 Alshain KR240 型内骨骼底盘以减轻重量。配备坚固的 GM 240 聚变引擎，疾行者最高速度达 97.2 公里/小时。它装有 C.A.S.E.、以耐用的 GM 240 为核心，并有七吨半装甲防护，在同重量级中属耐久型机甲；在瘫痪或被摧毁前能承受相当可观的损伤。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: For long range combat, the Summoner A has a powerful Gauss Rifle which is supported by a Large Pulse Laser for intermediate ranges and an SRM-6 launcher for close combat.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 远程战斗中，召唤者 A 有一门强劲的高斯步枪，配一门大型脉冲激光负责中距离，以及一具 SRM-6 发射器负责近战。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: For long range combat, the Summoner A has a powerful Gauss Rifle which is supported by a Large Pulse Laser for intermediate ranges and an SRM-6 launcher for close combat.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 远程战斗中，召唤者 A 有一门强劲的高斯步枪，配一门大型脉冲激光负责中距离，以及一具 SRM-6 发射器负责近战。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A missile bombardment configuration, the B configuration carries a pair of LRM-20 launchers for long range engagements. For close combat, the Summoner B has two SRM-4 launchers. A Narc Missile Beacon allows the Summoner to designate targets for missile fire from other friendly units. The Summoner B has further protection through the use of an Anti-Missile System which gives it increased protection from missile attacks.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 召唤者 B 是一款导弹轰炸配置，携带两具 LRM-20 发射器用于远程交战。近战方面，它有两具 SRM-4 发射器。一具 NARC 导弹信标让召唤者能为其他友军单位的导弹火力标记目标。召唤者 B 还通过一套反导系统获得进一步保护，提升对导弹攻击的防御。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A close range brawler, the Summoner C is armed with a single ER Large Laser for long range sniping at enemy targets but truly comes into its own at close range. The 'Mech relies on a powerful Ultra Autocannon/20 for quick kill capabilities at close ranges. This is backed up by a highly accurate Streak SRM-6 launcher to seek out weak points in an enemy's armor and an ER Small Laser.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 召唤者 C 是一款近战近战型，装备一门 ER 大型激光用于对敌方目标的远程狙击，但真正发挥威力是在近距离。机甲依靠一门强劲的超速自动炮/20 在近距离快速击杀。它辅以一具极为精准的连续 SRM-6 发射器以寻找敌方装甲弱点，以及一门 ER 小型激光。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: In its primary configuration the Summoner has a basic yet effective arsenal. The primary direct fire weapon is an ER PPC backed up by an LB 10-X Autocannon that can fire both standard and cluster ammunition. For fire support and bombardment, the Summoner has an LRM-15 launcher.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 召唤者的主配置拥有基础却有效的武器库。主要直射武器是一门 ER PPC，辅以一门 LB 10-X 自动炮，可发射标准弹与集束弹。火力支援与炮击方面，召唤者有一具 LRM-15 发射器。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A short-ranged brawler, the Sun Spider D carries a mammoth Ultra AC/20 in each arm, with just a pair of Heavy Machine Guns in the right torso as supporting weapons. Lacking in ranged weapons, an ECM Suite is fitted in the left torso to try and assist in closing with its foes so it can make full use of the four tons of Ultra ammunition and single ton HMG bin.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 太阳蜘蛛 D 是一款近战近战型，每臂携带一门巨型超速 AC/20，右躯干仅以两挺重机枪作为支援武器。由于缺乏远程武器，左躯干装有 ECM 套件以协助接近敌人，从而充分利用四吨超速弹药与一吨重机枪弹药。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The F model of the Sun Spider can lay down some significant fire at long range, but watch out for enemies closing the distance, it has no backup or close combat weapons.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 太阳蜘蛛 F 型号能在远距离倾泻相当可观的火力，但要小心敌人拉近距离，它没有备用或近战武器。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Almost a direct counter-point to the Prime, the A Config mounts twin Ultra AC/2s in each side torso, supported by an ER Large Laser in each arm if the two tons of Ultra reloads run dry. The config is rounded out by an extra Double Heat Sink.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: A 配置几乎与主型号针锋相对，两侧躯干各装双联超速 AC/2，若两吨超速弹药耗尽，则每臂一门 ER 大型激光可顶上。配置以一台额外双倍散热器收尾。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Almost a direct counter-point to the Prime, the A Config mounts twin Ultra AC/2s in each side torso, supported by an ER Large Laser in each arm if the two tons of Ultra reloads run dry. The config is rounded out by an extra Double Heat Sink.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A mixed-range combatant, the Sun Spider B is built around a right-torso mounted Gauss Rifle, supported by a left-torso ER Large Laser and matched Streak SRM-6 and ER Medium Lasers in each arm. An Anti-Missile System and a Light Active Probe in the left torso prevent the B from being caught unaware, carrying two tons of Gauss and Streak reloads along with a single ton of AMS ammo and an extra double heat sink.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 太阳蜘蛛 B 是一款混合射程战斗型，以右躯干的高斯步枪为核心，左躯干的 ER 大型激光以及每臂配对的连续 SRM-6 和 ER 中型激光为支援。左躯干的反导系统与轻型主动探测器使 B 不会被打个措手不及，它携带两吨高斯与连续导弹再装填、一吨 AMS 弹药和一台额外双倍散热器。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The C configuration is a classic LRM Missile Boat, fitted with a pair of LRM-15s in each arm and supported by an LRM-20 in each side torso. Carrying six tons of LRM missiles, an extra double heat sink strives to try and keep the Sun Spider firing.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: C 配置是经典的 LRM 导弹平台，每臂装两具 LRM-15，每侧躯干各一具 LRM-20 支援。携带六吨 LRM 导弹，一台额外双倍散热器努力让太阳蜘蛛保持开火。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Sun Spider Prime is built for short-range combat and carries a pair of Streak SRM-6 launchers in each arm, supported at range by Ultra AC/10 and an ER Large Laser in the right and left torsos, respectively. Two tons of Ultra Autocannon reloads and three tons of Streak SRM missiles are more than adequate for Clan Trials.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 太阳蜘蛛主型号为近战而设，每臂携带两具连续 SRM-6 发射器，远程则由右躯干的超速 AC/10 和左躯干的 ER 大型激光支援。两吨超速自动炮再装填与三吨连续 SRM 导弹对氏族试炼而言绰绰有余。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Sun Spider Prime is built for short-range combat and carries a pair of Streak SRM-6 launchers in each arm, supported at range by Ultra AC/10 and an ER Large Laser in the right and left torsos, respectively. Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 太阳蜘蛛主型号为近战而设，每臂携带两具连续 SRM-6 发射器，远程则由右躯干的超速 AC/10 和左躯干的 ER 大型激光支援。两吨超速自动炮再装填与三吨连续 SRM 导弹对氏族试炼而言绰绰有余。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Apparently based on the Supernova-2, the Supernova-A retains only a single ER Large Laser in each arm, mounting an Artemis IV FCS-equipped LRM-20 and Streak SRM-6 launcher in each torso. With a targeting computer linked to the large lasers, three tons of LRM missiles and four tons of Streak reloads give the A variant good endurance. Keeping the classic jump jets and boosting armor over primary variant, an Endo Steel frame and fitting only seventeen double heat sinks are used to free up the extra weight required for the missile launchers.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 超新星-A 显然以超新星-2 为基础，每臂只保留一门 ER 大型激光，每个躯干装备一具配 Artemis IV 火控系统的 LRM-20 和连续 SRM-6 发射器。大型激光联动的瞄准计算机、三吨 LRM 导弹和四吨连续导弹再装填赋予 A 变体良好的续航。保留经典的跳跃推进器并在主变体基础上加强装甲，使用内骨骼框架并只装十七台双倍散热器，以腾出导弹发射器所需的额外重量。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Apparently based on the Supernova-2, the Supernova-A retains only a single ER Large Laser in each arm, mounting an Artemis IV FCS-equipped LRM-20 and Streak SRM-6 launcher in each torso. With a targeting computer linked to the large lasers, three tons of LRM missiles and four tons of Streak reloads give the A variant good endurance. Keeping the classic jump jets and boosting armor over primary variant, an Endo Steel frame and fitting only seventeen double heat sinks are used to free up the extra weight required for the missile launchers.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 超新星-A 显然以超新星-2 为基础，每臂只保留一门 ER 大型激光，每个躯干装备一具配 Artemis IV 火控系统的 LRM-20 和连续 SRM-6 发射器。大型激光联动的瞄准计算机、三吨 LRM 导弹和四吨连续导弹再装填赋予 A 变体良好的续航。保留经典的跳跃推进器并在主变体基础上加强装甲，使用内骨骼框架并只装十七台双倍散热器，以腾出导弹发射器所需的额外重量。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Somewhat of an anomaly, unlike its brothers the Supernova-C mounts its primary weapons in its torsos and secondary weapons in its arms; twin Large Pulse Lasers in each side torso supported by a ER Medium and Medium Pulse Laser in each arm. Built on the framework of the Supernova-2, the C mounts twenty-two double heat sinks.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 超新星-C 有些反常，与其兄弟们不同，它把主武器装在躯干、次要武器装在臂部：每侧躯干各两门大型脉冲激光，每臂则由一门 ER 中型激光和一门中型脉冲激光支援。C 型基于超新星-2 的框架建造，装备二十二台双倍散热器。

Built on the framework of the Supernova-2, the C mounts twenty-two double heat sinks.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: While an exceptionally early design, the Talos by Vandenberg MilTech was a financial success and a long-standing general mech for the Taurian Defense Forces from its production in the 2530's well into the Succession Wars. An Autocannon/10, two LRM-5s, and an SRM-6 give the Talos weapons effective at multiple range bands while its 8.5 tons of armor give it some longevity on the battlefield.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 虽然设计极早，但范登堡军工的塔洛斯取得了商业成功，自 2530 年代投产直到继承战争，一直是陶里安防卫军长期使用的通用机甲。一门自动炮/10、两具 LRM-5 和一具 SRM-6 使塔洛斯的武器在多个射程段都有效，而其 8.5 吨装甲赋予它在战场上一定的持久力。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Talos is extremely old but reliable Taurian design. I'm pretty sure they stopped making these things before the Succession Wars but here we are, one in the flesh. Complete with an AC10, two LRM-5s, and a SRM-6, the Talos was a go-to mech for the Taurians for a good reason.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 塔洛斯是极为古老但可靠的陶里安设计。我很确定他们在继承战争之前就停产了，但现在我们眼前就有一台。配有一门 AC10、两具 LRM-5 和一具 SRM-6，塔洛斯成为陶里安人的首选机甲是有充分理由的。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A relic of an earlier age, it’s a minor miracle this antique is still functional. Occasionally found through the frontier, surviving Taloses are a strange mix of new and old technology, bodged together by generations of different mectechs. Rarely seen and even more rarely fielded in battle, very few of these 500 year old designs still grace the modern battlefield, but those that do are treated with the respect and reverence, due to a centuries old design. The 1P is the ‘‘modern’’ adaption of the older 1B design and has proliferated in recent years, leading some to speculate that a cache of Talos or Talos parts has been found. Armed with a variety of local tech and a knock-off ecm suite, the 1P is a versatile design outfitted as a mid range brawler.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为更早时代的遗物，这台古董还能运转已是小小奇迹。偶尔能在边疆见到，幸存的塔洛斯是新旧技术奇异的混合体，由一代代不同的机甲技师拼凑而成。它们很少见，更罕见于战场，这些五百年前的设计几乎已不再现身现代战场，但少数仍在服役者因这数世纪之久的设计而备受敬重。1P 是较老 1B 设计的"现代"改型，近年数量激增，让一些人猜测有人发现了塔洛斯或其部件的储藏库。1P 装备多种本地技术与一套仿制 ECM 套件，是一款多用途设计，定位为中距离缠斗者。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Armed with a mixed ba of weapons, the LRM-10 provides suppressive fire at range; whilst the Rifle and the Chemical Lasers make up the bulk of the mech’s heavy firepower. A pair of Rocket Launchers can deliver a coup de grâce against damaged opponents or serve as a backup weapon if the mech is engaged at close range.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 混合武器配置下，LRM-10 提供远程压制火力；而步枪与化学激光构成机甲重型火力的主体。一对火箭发射器能对受损对手施以致命一击，或在机甲陷入近距交战时充当备用武器。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: With the reintroduction of Helm Core LosTech, the Taurian Defense Force found themselves lagging behind their neighbours. Just as they did during the Age of War, the Taurians turned to the home grown Talos. With a reputation as an easy to maintain and easy to manufacture mech, the design was just what the TDF needed. Lacking the resources to turn the newly redesigned Talos into a viable production model, the Taurians enlisted the aid of their neighbours, in exchange for joining the ongoing Trinity Alliance negotiations. Aided by the expertise of Capellan engineers and financial investment from the Magistracy of Canopus, Vandenburg started limited manufacturing of the Talos; at their New Vandenburg plant: in late 3059. The formal signing of the Trinity Alliance, in 3062; awarded production licenses to both Majesty Metals and Detroit Consolidated Mech Works. Both companies swiftly opened their own lines, producing multiple variants of the Talos for their own use and for export further afield.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 随着赫尔姆核心失落科技的重现，陶里安防卫军发现自己落后于邻国。正如战争时代一样，陶里安人转向了本土成长的塔洛斯。这款机甲以易于维护和易于制造著称，正是陶里安防卫军所需。由于缺乏资源将新设计的塔洛斯转为可行的量产型号，陶里安人以加入正在进行的"三位一体同盟"谈判为交换，寻求邻国援助。在卡佩兰工程师的专业知识与卡诺普斯女权国的资金投入协助下，范登堡于 3059 年末在其新范登堡工厂开始了塔洛斯的限量生产。3062 年三位一体同盟正式签署，授予陛下金属公司与底特律联合机工厂生产许可。两家公司迅速开设了自己的生产线，为自用与远销生产了塔洛斯的多种变体。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The original TDF redesign, the 4A is almost identical to the 1B. The AC/10 is swapped for a newer UAC/10, whilst an Artemis IV FCS enhances the accuracy of the missile launchers. Endo Steel is used to free up the weight needed.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为 TDF 最初的重新设计，4A 与 1B 几乎相同。AC/10 换成了更新的 UAC/10，而 Artemis IV 火控系统提升了导弹发射器的精度。内骨骼用于腾出所需重量。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Developed for export to the Magistracy of Canopus, the 4B swaps the 4A’s weapons for a pair of LBX/2’s and a pair of LRM-10’s. Designed as a long range sniper and anti aircraft mech, the 4B was initially limited in manufacture; as resources were devoted to the TDF ordered 4A model. The signing of the Trinity Alliance enabled the MOC to start production themselves and the design proved successful.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 4B 为出口至卡诺普斯法域而开发，以一对 LBX/2 和一对 LRM-10 替换 4A 的武器。4B 设计为远程狙击与防空机甲，最初生产受限，因为资源优先用于 TDF 订购的 4A 型号。三一联盟的签署使 MOC 得以自行开始生产，该设计被证明是成功的。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Intended to emulate the Thor OmniMech used by the Clans, the Thanatos is an incredibly sturdy and hard-hitting design. Copying both the looks and the capabilities of the Clan Thor, the Thanatos is a fast all-range design, though it skimps on armor a bit for a mech its size. Carrying an ER Large Laser for long range and a brace of advanced medium lasers and a MRM-20 for medium to close range, the Thanatos has a weapon for any situation. Combined with a fast 86.4 km/h top speed and five jump jets, the Thanatos can often catch what it cannot out-range.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 塔纳托斯旨在模仿氏族使用的雷神全能机甲，是一款极其坚固、打击力极强的设计。它同时复制了氏族雷神的外观与能力，是一款快速的全射程机甲，尽管就其尺寸而言装甲略显单薄。远程携带一门 ER 大型激光，中近程则有一批先进中型激光和一具 MRM-20，塔纳托斯拥有应对任何情况的武器。加上 86.4 公里/小时的快速最高速度和五个跳跃推进器，塔纳托斯常常能追上它无法在射程上压制的对手。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This was the original Thunderbolt design produced in 2491 by Earthwerks Limited, built with Primitive Technology, until the introduction of the modern TDR-5S in 2505.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是地球工厂有限公司于 2491 年生产的原始雷霆设计，采用原始技术建造，直到 2505 年现代 TDR-5S 问世为止。
重型伏击手 & 缠斗者

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This was the original Thunderbolt design produced in 2491 by Earthwerks Limited, built with Primitive Technology, until the introduction of the modern TDR-5S in 2505.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是地球工厂有限公司于 2491 年生产的原始雷霆设计，采用原始技术建造，直到 2505 年现代 TDR-5S 问世为止。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The so-called "Lost Thunderbolt", the 5L was a downgraded version of the Royal 5Sb Thunderbolt developed by Earthwerks Tikonov in 2823. Built on a more basic standard chassis, the now LosTech ER PPC was swapped for a Diverse Optics Sunbeam ER Large Laser but most of the 5Sb's systems were preserved with only the loss of one double heat sink and the head-mounted Small Laser. Production of the design only lasted a mere twenty-seven years before further technology decline resulted in the 5LS.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 5L 即所谓的"失落雷霆"，是地球工厂提科诺夫于 2823 年为皇家 5Sb 雷霆开发的降级版。它建立在更基础的标准底盘上，如今已成失落科技的 ER PPC 被换成多元光学"日光束"ER 大型激光，但 5Sb 的大部分系统得以保留，仅损失一台双倍散热器和头部小型激光。该设计仅生产了短短二十七年，技术进一步衰退便催生了 5LS。

Production of the design only lasted a mere twenty-seven years before further technology decline resulted in the 5LS.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Developed in 2850 as the Second Succession War saw more and more technologies disappear, the 5LS was a downgraded field refit and a factory model of the now impossible to build 5L. While the ER Large Laser and Starfish Small Pulse Lasers were retained, the standard LRM-15 and Bical SRM-2 rack were noticeably less accurate than the 5L's more advanced launchers, but nothing compared to the replacement of the 5L's double heat sinks with fifteen standard models and the heat management issues that resulted. Production of even the "primitive" 5LS would end during the Third Succession War.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 5LS 于 2850 年开发，当时第二次继承战争让越来越多的技术消失，它是对如今已无法建造的 5L 的降级野战改装与工厂型号。虽然保留了 ER 大型激光和"海星"小型脉冲激光，标准 LRM-15 和比卡尔 SRM-2 挂架的精度明显不如 5L 更先进的发射器，但这与把 5L 的双倍散热器换成十五台标准型号、以及由此产生的散热问题相比，根本不算什么。即便是"原始"的 5LS 也在第三次继承战争期间停产。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Thunderbolt 5S is well armored and heavily armored for its size. It's often deployed as a frontline 'Mech where the fighting is heavy, and it needs to give as good as it gets.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 雷霆 5S 就其尺寸而言装甲精良且厚重。它常被部署在战斗最激烈的前线，而它也必须能承受多少就还击多少。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Thunderbolt SE models lose a little of their firepower in exchange for mounting Jump Jets. The greater mobility is intended to allow for more precision attacking maneuvers, though it all depends on the battlefield terrain.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Build from derelict Thunderbolt chassis abandonded during Amaris Revolt carries this mech a cheap AC10 alongside 2 MRM10.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这台机甲由阿马里斯叛乱期间被遗弃的雷霆底盘重建而成，携带一门廉价 AC10 和 2 具 MRM10。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Timber Wolf is a fast, heavy OmniMech. A signature design of the Clans' military might, it was arguably the first Clan OmniMech encountered by Inner Sphere forces on The Rock by Phelan Kell. Vaguely resembling a cross-over between the MAD (Marauder) and CAT (Catapult) series, the Timber Wolf was tagged with the Inner Sphere reporting name Mad Cat on first contact.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 森林狼是一款高速重型全能机甲。作为氏族军事力量的标志性设计，它可以说是内天体部队在"岩石"星上由菲兰·凯尔首次遭遇的氏族全能机甲。因其隐约呈现出 MAD（掠夺者）与 CAT（投石机）系列的杂交特征，森林狼在首次接触时被内天体冠以"疯猫"的报告代号。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Built due to an awkward exchange of technology between the Free Worlds League and the Word of Blake, the Toyama was designed by Dr. Thaddeus Anable and then given to the Word of Blake through an agreement made by Captain-General Thomas Marik. The Toyama is intended to be a multi-role BattleMech that can operate somewhat independently of supply lines. The 'Mech is built on a lightweight Endo Steel chassis which supports a Vlar 300 XL engine. The Toyama has a top speed of 64.8 km/h, making it capable of keeping pace with most heavy 'Mechs. The Toyama has an impressive twelve tons of Durallex Heavy armor. To dissipate heat, the Toyama carries fourteen double heat sinks. The 'Mech also carries a Garret/Guardian Interface Guardian ECM Suite to protect the 'Mech from advanced enemy electronic warfare systems.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 由于自由世界联盟与布雷克之言之间一次尴尬的技术交换，丰山由撒迪厄斯·阿纳布尔博士设计，然后通过总队长托马斯·马里克达成的协议交给了布雷克之言。丰山意图成为一款能在一定程度上独立于补给线作战的多用途战斗机甲。机甲基于轻量化内骨骼底盘建造，搭载一台 Vlar 300 XL 引擎。丰山最高速度 64.8 公里/小时，使其能与大多数重型机甲并驾齐驱。丰山拥有令人印象深刻的十二吨杜拉莱克斯重型装甲。为散发热量，丰山携带十四台双倍散热器。机甲还装有一套加勒特/守护者接口 ECM 套件，以保护机甲免受敌方先进电子战系统干扰。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Toyama has a Doombud LRM-20 launcher for long range direct and indirect bombardment capabilities. The Toyama also has two Diverse Optics Sunbeam ER Large Lasers and an Imperator Code Red LB-X Autocannon/10, which can fire both standard ammunition and cluster rounds, for long range combat. For close range engagements, the Toyama has three Magna Mk II Medium Lasers.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 丰山有一具"末日芽"LRM-20 发射器，具备远程直接与间接轰炸能力。丰山还有两门"多元光学阳光"ER 大型激光和一门"帝皇红色代码"LB-X 自动炮/10（可发射标准弹与集束弹）用于远程战斗。近程交战方面，丰山有三门"玛格纳 Mk II"中型激光。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The original Trebuchet as produced for the SLDF, it consisted of two Artemis IV-equipped LRM-15s with CASE, four medium lasers, double heat sinks, an Endo-Steel chassis and a 300-rated Extra Light Fusion Engine. However, the attrition of the First Succession War forced Corean Enterprises into redesigning the 'Mech without advanced technology to keep the production lines running.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 最初为星盟防卫军生产的投石机由两具配 Artemis IV 的 LRM-15（带 C.A.S.E.）、四门中型激光、双倍散热器、内骨骼底盘和 300 级超轻型聚变引擎组成。然而第一次继承战争的消耗迫使科里安企业将该机甲重新设计为不含先进技术的版本，以维持生产线运转。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: One of the lightest dedicated fire support 'Mechs to be found, the Trebuchet 4M comes with Deadfire ammo and is among the cooler-running 'Trenchbuckets'.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Trading off firepower for mobility, the Trebuchet 5J removes one of the LRM-15 launchers and adds in jump capabilities and 5 extra heat sinks.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 投石机 5J 以火力换机动，移除一具 LRM-15 发射器，加装跳跃能力与 5 台额外散热器。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: One of the lightest dedicated fire support 'Mechs to be found, the Trebuchet 5N can mount enough missiles to give even heavy units pause. However, 'Trenchbuckets' are known for running hot and don't have much in the way of protection.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 投石机 5N 是最轻的专用火力支援机甲之一，能搭载足以让重型单位也犹豫的导弹。不过"战壕桶"以散热偏高著称，防护也不多。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The TBT-5S shifts from long range to short range support. With SRM6s instead of LRM15s and eight extra Heat Sinks, the 5S is able to dish out a tremendous amount of close range damage.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: TBT-5S 从远程支援转向近程支援。以 SRM6 取代 LRM15，并加装八台额外散热器，5S 能造成巨量的近程伤害。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: TBT-5S 从远程支援转向近程支援。以 SRM6 取代 LRM15，并加装八台额外散热器，5S 能造成巨量的近程伤害。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Rebuilt from the salvaged remains of a Trebuchet 5S, this low tech refit is a common sight throughout the battlefields of the Deep Periphery. Mounting between 2 and 4 Rocket pods and backed up by a pair of Large Chem Lasers; makes the 5SP into a fearsome short range brawler. Some designs include scavenged or salvaged Endo Steel or Ferro Fibrous, either for increased protection or to mount additional rocket pods. Limited by the 4 tons of Chemical Laser ammunition and the single salvos of the rocket pod, the SP lacks the endurance for protracted engagements. Fortunately these are rarely a concern in the Deep Periphery and this design is commonally seen during raids and border skirmishes, where its heavy fire power can give it an edge over less durable opponents.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这款低技术改装型由一台 5S 投石机的回收残骸重建而成，在深外围区战场上随处可见。装备 2 至 4 个火箭吊舱，辅以两门大型化学激光，使 5SP 成为令人生畏的近距缠斗者。部分设计包含收集或回收的内骨骼或铁纤维，用于提升防护或加装更多火箭吊舱。受限于 4 吨化学激光弹药和火箭吊舱的一次性齐射，SP 缺乏持久交战所需的续航力。所幸在深外围区这很少成为问题，此设计常见于劫掠与边境冲突中，其沉重火力能让它在对抗耐久性较差的对手时占得先机。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The TBT-6X 'Katyusha' is a slightly heavier Trebuchet designed as a testbed for the Artemis IV Smart Missile System.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Almost an entirely new 'Mech, the Trebuchet 7K moves away from its missile support to direct fire support, using a PPC and AC5 along with a SRM-2 for some close in support.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 投石机 7K 几乎是一台全新的机甲，它从导弹支援转向直射火力支援，使用一门 PPC 和一门 AC5，另配一具 SRM-2 提供一些近距支援。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Almost an entirely new 'Mech, the Trebuchet 7K moves away from its missile support to direct fire support, using a PPC and AC5 along with a SRM-2 for some close in support.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 投石机 7K 几乎是一台全新的机甲，它从导弹支援转向直射火力支援，使用一门 PPC 和一门 AC5，另配一具 SRM-2 提供一些近距支援。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Upgraded with Star League technology, the 7M variant is built with on an Endo Steel chassis and uses a 250 Magna XL engine, giving it the same performance but allowing the design to mount ten double heat sinks and five Rawlings 50 jump jets for a jumping distance of one hundred and fifty meters. It also allows for the Zeus LRM-15s' ammo to be protected by CASE and for a Narc Missile Beacon with two tons of ammo, improving not only the Trebuchet's accuracy but allowing it to share targeting information with other similarly-equipped 'Mechs.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 7M 变体以星盟技术升级，基于内骨骼底盘建造，并使用玛格纳 250 XL 引擎，性能相同，但允许该设计安装十台双倍散热器和五个罗林斯 50 跳跃推进器，跳跃距离达一百五十米。它还使宙斯 LRM-15 的弹药得以由 C.A.S.E. 保护，并加装一具 NARC 导弹信标与两吨弹药，不仅提升投石机的精度，还使它可与其他同样装备的机甲共享瞄准信息。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 9K variant of the Trebuchet is a field refit of the 7M with a distinctive Kurita feel to it. Built on an Endo Steel chassis and powered by an XL engine, the 9K replaced the LRMs for two MRM-20launchers with three tons of ammo total. The medium lasers in the right arm are replaced with two Medium Pulse Lasers while the left arm-mounted medium laser is kept, and a C3 slave unit in the left torso allows it to share targeting telemetry with other units. The jump jets are also kept, giving it a jumping distance of one hundred and fifty meters.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 投石机 9K 变体是 7M 的野战改装，带有鲜明的库瑞塔风格。它基于内骨骼底盘建造，由 XL 引擎驱动，以两具 MRM-20 发射器（共三吨弹药）取代 LRM。右臂的中型激光换成两门中型脉冲激光，左臂中型激光则保留，左躯干的 C3 从属单元使它可与其他单位共享瞄准遥测数据。跳跃推进器也得以保留，使其跳跃距离达一百五十米。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Turkina is named after Turkina, the first Jade Falcon to be tamed, who inspired the leaders of Clan Jade Falcon in its early days.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 图尔基娜以图尔基娜命名——第一只被驯服的翡翠隼，她在早期激励了翡翠隼氏族的领袖们。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: the Turkina mounts enough jump jets to vault 90 meters hardwired onto the frame, rather than using them in modular pods. While this simplified repair, it also uses tonnage that could be devoted to other systems when a mission does not call for jumping.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 图尔基娜装有足以跃过 90 米的跳跃推进器，且是硬接在框架上而非使用模块化吊舱。这虽然简化了维修，但也占用了在任务无需跳跃时可分配给其他系统的吨位。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The UrbanMech IIC is a Clan IIC-style upgrade of the original UrbanMech. Around the same time as the development of the OmniMech during the Golden Century, Clan Coyote technicians reworked this venerable design. They studied battle data from as far back as the Amaris Civil War and used this research as the basis for their upgrades.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 城市机甲 IIC 是原版城市机甲的氏族 IIC 式升级版。在黄金世纪全能机甲发展的同期，郊狼氏族技师重制了这款古老的设计。他们研究了可追溯至阿马里斯内战的作战数据，并以此为基础进行升级。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The product of an aborted series of experiments into LAM technology, the Urbanmech LAM is not surprisingly; poorly suited for either role. Designed by the self proclaimed professor of Cluffs Stand, Mencius Horvat; using a mixture of stolen Urbanmech parts and Lostech recovered from throughout the Periphery. Slow by LAM standards and drastically under gunned by Urbanmech standards, this mech struggles to fill either role. That said, the shock factor of an Urbanmech LAM deployed against uninformed opponents, has allowed it a measure of success when used as a raider. Dual ER Mediums and a bevy of rockets provide a nasty punch at close quarters, but prove mediocre at longer ranges. The only known examples of this mech were were recovered by the DMI and were turned over to the NAIS, though their current status is unknown.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为一系列夭折的 LAM 技术实验的产物，都市机甲 LAM 不出意外地对两种角色都不擅长。它由克拉夫斯站自封教授的孟修斯·霍瓦特设计，混用了偷来的都市机甲部件与从外围区各地找回的失传技术。按 LAM 标准它很慢，按都市机甲标准它火力严重不足，这台机甲难以胜任任一角色。话虽如此，都市机甲 LAM 面对不知情的对手时带来的震撼效果，使它在作为劫掠者使用时取得了一定成功。双联 ER 中型激光和一批火箭在近距能造成凶狠打击，但在较远距离上表现平庸。已知仅有的几台此类机甲被 DMI 收回并移交 NAIS，不过它们目前的状况不明。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Urbie LAM does something no UrbanMech should ever do. Fly.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 城市 LAM 做了任何城市机甲都不该做的事。飞行。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Don't let the stubby 'Urbie' fool you, it may look like a walking trash can, but it can mount heavy armor and a grown-up-sized Autocannon. R60s aren't known for their speed, but they are very useful if you can draw the enemy into their firing range.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 别被矮胖的"都市"骗了，它也许看起来像个会走路的垃圾桶，却能装备厚重装甲和成人尺寸的自动炮。R60 不以速度著称，但如果你能把敌人引到它的射程内，它们就非常有用。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A Capellan 'variant' when some factories were unable to keep up with production due to a shortage of Small Lasers, engineers replaced it with a MG and the unofficial R60C variant was born.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 当一些工厂因小型激光短缺而无法跟上生产时，工程师用一挺机枪将其替换，非官方的 R60C 变体就此诞生——这是卡佩兰的"变体"。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This thing barely qualifies as a variant - hell, give me that spare Machine Gun and any standard Urbie and I'll make you a 'C'.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这东西勉强算是变体——得了，给我那挺备用机枪和任何一台标准"都市"，我就给你造一台"C"。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Meant for close in city fighting, the R60L variant sacrifices armor to upscale its Autocannon 10 to an Autocannon 20.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: R60L 变体为近距离城市战而设，它牺牲装甲把自动炮 10 升级为自动炮 20。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: While this is the lightest 'Mech to carry an AC-20 in a stock variant, it isn't geared toward long range or extended engagements.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 虽然这是标准变体中携带 AC-20 的最轻机甲，它并不适合远程或持久交战。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Meant for close in city fighting, the R60LL replaces its Autocannon 20 with a Ultra version.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: R60LL 为城市近战而设，将自动炮 20 换成超速版本。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Meant for close in city fighting, the R60LL replaces its Autocannon 20 with a Ultra version.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: R60LL 为城市近战而设，将自动炮 20 换成超速版本。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This UrbanMech has been extensively modified by an apparently madman for reasons unknown. In place of its usual weaponry are a pair of gauss weapons: the Silver Bullet Gauss Rifle providing the main punch and a lone Magshot Gauss Rifle providing quiet backup. To make these weapons possible on the chassis, this Urbie has been made with an Endo-Steel structure and Ferro-Fibrous armor. Truly, the mind that created this was quite unhinged.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这台城市机甲被某个显然是疯子的人出于不明原因大幅改装。原本的武器被替换为一对高斯武器：银弹高斯步枪提供主要打击，一门单独的磁射高斯步枪提供安静的备用。为在底盘上装下这些武器，这台"城佬"采用了内骨骼结构与铁纤维装甲。创造出它的那个人，心智实在相当不正常。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A Capellan experimental 'variant' that was created when engineers removed the largely superfluous 11th heat sink and installed a Machine Gun with half a ton of ammunition in its place.  While it has no official designation, it is typically referred to as the R60X.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是卡佩兰的实验性"变体"：工程师移除基本多余的第十一台散热器，并在原位装上一挺机枪和半吨弹药。它没有官方编号，通常被称为 R60X。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Not a bad improvement on the design, but, if it were me, I would have added an extra ton of AC ammo instead to give the trashcan some longevity in the field.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 设计改进得不错，但要是我的话，我会多装一吨自动炮弹药，让这个垃圾桶在战场上更有持久力。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Meant for close in city fighting the R61L got upgraded with Stealth Equipment alongside its less expensive R60L cousins AC20.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: R61L 为城市近战而设，在较廉价的 R60L 表亲的 AC20 之外，还加装了隐形装备。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Meant for close in city fighting the R61L got upgraded with Stealth Equipment alongside its less expensive R60L cousins AC20.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: R61L 为城市近战而设，在较廉价的 R60L 表亲的 AC20 之外，还加装了隐形装备。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Designed by Cataclysm, a former freeborn Clan Wolf MechWarrior turned Mercenary, and infamous UrbanMech fanatic, this refit is designed to be a cost-effective and logistically reliable way to garrison cities. For the price of a single Awesome, one could afford to refit an entire lance of UrbanMechs to the R8Q standard.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 此改装型由"灾变"设计——一位前自由出身氏族狼机甲战士转行的佣兵，也是臭名昭著的城市机甲狂热分子——旨在提供一种成本效益高、后勤可靠的城池驻防方案。一台卓越的价钱，就足以把整整一个小队的城市机甲改装到 R8Q 标准。
