Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The UM-R90 'SuburbanMech' adapts the traditional UrbanMech R60 into an energy weapon platform for higher performance. Because its weapons aren't limited by ammunition concerns, the R90 is better-suited to longer engagements.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: UM-R90"郊区机甲"把传统的都市机甲 R60 改造为性能更高的能量武器平台。由于武器不受弹药限制，R90 更适合长时间交战。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This is an UrbanMech variant I've never even heard of before. It's got the same armor as a standard R60, but this R90 is armed entirely with energy weapons, including a PPC for long-range power. I'm not sure why nobody thought of this sooner.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是我从未听说过的城市机甲变体。它的装甲与标准 R60 相同，但这台 R90 完全以能量武器武装，包括一门用于远程威力的 PPC。我不明白为什么以前没人想到这个。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A uniquely Lyran take on the VLK-QD, this refit transforms the fire support mech into a light scout hunter with the firepower to engage much heavier prey. The standard LRM is swapped for a streak-6 and a second pulse laser, providing a heavy punch, at the expense of range. Produced by Corean Enterprises at their New Avalon facility exclusively for the Arcturan Guards, the design never saw wide spread deployment. Designed to complement the QD, standard tactics called for mixed lances of QD and QE’s; with the E’s flushing units out for the D’s LRMs and then finishing off damaged opponents. A cheap upgrade, the design had many detractors; most of whom criticised the lack of long range fire power or the over heating issues that stemmed from the refusal to upgrade to DHS. The design ceased production during the FedCom Civil War, with the Guards choosing to invest in newer Lyran made variants following the war.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是莱兰对 VLK-QD 的独特演绎，此改装把火力支援机甲变成轻型侦察猎手，具备与远为重型的猎物交战的火力。标准 LRM 换成连续 6 与第二门脉冲激光，提供沉重打击，代价是射程。该设计由科里安企业在其新阿瓦隆工厂为小熊卫队独家生产，从未广泛部署。为与 QD 互补，标准战术要求 QD 与 QE 混编小队；由 E 型把单位逼出来供 D 型的 LRM 打击，然后收拾受损对手。作为一项廉价升级，该设计招致众多批评者；多数人批评其缺乏远程火力，或拒绝升级 DHS 导致的过热问题。该设计在联邦联邦内战期间停产，战后卫队选择投资更新的莱兰制造变体。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Vapor Eagle features an eclectic and close-ranged weapons load-out, mounting a Large Pulse Laser in its right arm, supported by a single Machine Gun, two Streak SRM-2s and three Medium Pulse Lasers split between its side torsos and rounded out by a trio of Machine Guns in a handgun shaped housing in the left arm. The addition of a Targeting Computer makes its firepower even more deadly as long as it can get its weapons into range. Eleven Double Heat Sinks, half a ton of machine gun ammunition and one Streak missiles are more than adequate for the average Clan trial.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 蒸汽鹰拥有杂糅而偏近程的武器配置：右臂一门大型脉冲激光，辅以一挺机枪、两具连续 SRM-2 和三门中型脉冲激光分列两侧躯干，左臂手枪形护罩内还有三挺机枪收尾。加装瞄准计算机后，只要武器能进入射程，其火力更为致命。十一台双倍散热器、半吨机枪弹药和一吨连续导弹弹药，对一般的氏族试炼而言绰绰有余。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This variant of the Vapor Eagle removes two of the Medium Pulse Lasers, both Streak Missile pods, and the Large Pulse Laser as well as one of the 'Mechs double heat sinks in exchange for an Ultra Autocannon/10. Mounted in an over the shoulder arrangement like the venerable Shadow Hawk, the weapon fires at twice the rate of a standard Autocannon/10 and carries enough ammunition to continuously fire at its maximum rate of fire for over a minute and a half.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Venom was built in direct response to losses suffered by the Draconis Combine and to boost sales for Nimakachi Fusion Products Limited. The 8C carries only standard jump jets and replaces 3 Pulse Lasers with a Snub Nose PPC.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Few assault 'Mechs can really fly, but the Victor 10B is one of 'em. With an Ultra AC/20 and improved Jump Jets, the 10B boasts incredible mobility for its weight, at the cost of some durability.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 能真正"飞"的突击机甲不多，但胜利者 10B 是其中之一。凭借一门超速 AC/20 和改进的跳跃推进器，10B 就其重量而言拥有惊人的机动性，代价是部分耐久性。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Another anti-infantry and brawler variant, the VTR-9A1 adds twin Machine Guns and retains most of its armor.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Few assault 'Mechs mount Jump Jets, but the Victor 9B is one of 'em. With a large ballistic gun and supporting close-range weaponry, the 9B is a deadly opponent with superior mobility for its size. Unfortunately, this comes at the cost of armor.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 很少有突击机甲装备跳跃推进器，但胜利者 9B 是其中之一。凭借一门大型弹道炮和支援用近程武器，9B 是致命的对手，且就其尺寸而言机动性出众。遗憾的是，这是以装甲为代价换来的。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Victor 9S trades some of its already subpar armor to mount more weaponry. It's terrifying for enemy forces to see this 'Mech rocketing over a hill to unleash its considerable firepower, but it also needs to really worry about any return fire.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 维克多 9S 以其本就不佳的装甲换取更多武器。看到这台机甲从山丘上疾冲而出倾泻可观火力，对敌军而言极为可怕，但它也必须认真地担心任何回击。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Viking began production shortly after the Beowulf in a joint effort by the Free Rasalhague Republic and ComStar. The 'Mech is intended to take over in the role that has been traditionally filled by the Bombardier.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 维京在贝奥武夫之后不久由自由拉萨尔哈格共和国与康星联合投产。这台机甲意在接替传统上由轰炸机担任的角色。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Viking has a singular mission of long-range missile fire support. To do this, the Viking carries two Shigunga LRM-15 launchers and two Shigunga LRM-20 launchers, all of which are linked to an Artemis IV fire control system.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 维京有一个明确的任务：远程导弹火力支援。为此，维京携带两具"紫郡"LRM-15 发射器和两具"紫郡"LRM-20 发射器，全部联接一套 Artemis IV 火控系统。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Known as the 'Avenging Angel', the VND-1AA was an attempt to increase the Vindicator's mobility - which succeeded.  However, the cost was to reduce its armor to that of a Light 'Mech.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 号称"复仇天使"的 VND-1AA 试图提升维护者的机动性——这一点成功了。然而代价是把它的装甲削减到轻型机甲的水平。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Vindicator 1Rs tend to deal their damage at range while moving in for closer attacks. Typically well armored, they're capable of some surprise attacks due to their jump capability and above-average heat efficiency.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 维护者 1R 倾向于在远距离输出伤害，同时逐步逼近发动近战。它们通常装甲良好，凭借跳跃能力和高于平均的散热效率，能打出一些出人意料的攻击。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A standardized modification of Michael Jones' St. Ives Blue adopted by the newly formed St. Ives Compact in 3031, the VND-1SIC downgrades the PPC to a Large Laser while upgrading the LRM rack to a LRM-10.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: VND-1SIC 是迈克尔·琼斯"圣艾夫斯蓝"的标准化改装，由新成立的圣艾夫斯共同体于 3031 年采用，它把 PPC 降级为大型激光，同时把 LRM 挂架升级为 LRM-10。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A very minor modification, replacing the Small Laser with a pair of Machine Guns, giving it a little more punch in a close range fight.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 3L variant is a basic upgrade using recovered Star League technology.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 3L 型号是使用回收的星盟科技的基础升级版。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 3L variant is a basic upgrade using recovered Star League technology introduced in 3051. The PPC was upgraded to a Ceres Arms Warrior ER PPC and the medium and small lasers have been removed in favor of a single Ceres Arms Model W Medium Pulse Laser. To handle the extra heat from the new ER PPC double heat sinks were added while CASE was installed to protect the LRM's ammunition.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 3L 变体是使用找回的星盟技术的基础升级，于 3051 年推出。PPC 升级为"塞雷斯兵器武士"ER PPC，中型与小型激光被移除，换成一门"塞雷斯兵器 W 型"中型脉冲激光。为处理新 ER PPC 带来的额外热量加装了双倍散热器，并安装 C.A.S.E. 以保护 LRM 的弹药。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Vulcan is lightly armored at only five tons, though this is typically sufficient when facing infantry forces and its narrow profile makes it a harder target to hit. A cruising speed of 64.8 km/h is enhanced with by six jump jets mounted in the rear of the Vulcan's torso, specially vented to reduce heat build-up in the rear, giving it a jumping range of 180 meters.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 火神装甲轻薄，仅五吨，不过面对步兵部队时通常够用，其狭窄轮廓也使它更难被击中。64.8 公里/小时的巡航速度由六具装在火神躯干后部的跳跃推进器增强，这些喷射器经特殊排气设计以减少后部积热，赋予它 180 米的跳跃距离。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: One of the most common of the Vulcan's early variants, the 5T was introduced a year after the original model debuted. It removes the Autocannon/2 and replaces it with three Maxum medium lasers, using the mass saved to add two additional tons of armor. The majority of the Federated Suns' Vulcans were 5T models.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 5T 是火神早期变体中最常见者之一，在原型号首次亮相一年后推出。它移除自动炮/2，换上三门"马克西姆"中型激光，并用节省的质量增加两吨装甲。联邦太阳系的大多数火神都是 5T 型号。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: One of the most common of the Vulcan's early variants, the 5T was introduced a year after the original model debuted. Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 5M Vulcan is an upgrade of the 2T version used by House Marik that makes the 'Mech far more effective in close range combat. The 'Mech uses a Crucis-II Delux Endo Steel chassis and removes the autocannon for a Tronel PPL-20 Large Pulse Laser and also upgrades the Medium Laser to a Tronel XII Medium Pulse Laser. Eleven double heat sinks were also incorporated. This version of the Vulcan began production in 3052 and ceased only with the destruction of Nimakachi's Tematagi plant in 3069.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 5M 火神是马里克家族所使用 2T 版本的升级，使机甲在近程战斗中有效得多。机甲采用"十字-II 豪华"内骨骼底盘，移除自动炮换成"特罗内尔 PPL-20"大型脉冲激光，并把中型激光升级为"特罗内尔 XII"中型脉冲激光。还加入了十一台双倍散热器。这款火神于 3052 年开始生产，直到 3069 年尼玛卡奇的特马塔吉工厂被毁才停止。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 5S Vulcan is a 3050 upgrade of the 2T version used by House Steiner which replaces the standard fusion engine with an extralight engine and also upgrades the armor to Lexington Ltd. High Grade Ferro-Fibrous with CASE to protect itself from ammunition explosions. The inclusion of MASC enables the 5S to move up to 129 km/h in short bursts. Additionally, the Autocannon/2 has been replaced with an Imperator Ultra Autocannon/5.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 5S 火神是施泰纳家族所使用 2T 版本的 3050 升级，它把标准聚变引擎换成超轻型引擎，并将装甲升级为列克星敦公司高等级铁纤维，配 C.A.S.E. 以防弹药爆炸。加装 MASC 使 5S 能在短促爆发中移动至 129 公里/小时。此外，自动炮/2 已换成帝皇超速自动炮/5。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An alteration of the 6R model introduced in 2835, the 6D removed the machine guns and the SRM-6 launcher to add an additional four tons of armor to the design, increasing its leg protection, as well as two more heat sinks. The 6D was particularly favored by the Federated Suns.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 6D 是 2835 年推出的 6R 型号改动版，它移除机枪和 SRM-6 发射器，为设计增加四吨装甲（提升腿部防护）以及两台额外散热器。6D 尤其受联邦太阳系青睐。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: One of the mainstays of the heavy 'Mechs.  Solid, dependable, and heavy hitting.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 重型机甲的中坚之一。坚固、可靠、打击力强。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Another basic modification to the Warhammer, the 6K was favored by the Draconis Combine after its introduction in 2830. The 6K removed the machine guns and their volatile ammunition to make room for two heat sinks, allowing it to more easily dissipate waste heat from its PPCs.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为战锤的另一项基础改装，6K 在 2830 年推出后受到德拉科尼斯联合体的青睐。6K 移除机枪及其易爆弹药以腾出空间安装两台散热器，使它能更轻易地散发 PPC 产生的废热。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: One of the mainstays of the heavy 'Mechs.  Solid, dependable, and heavy hitting.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 重型机甲的中坚之一。坚固、可靠、打击力强。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 6L was a very basic weapons swap of the 6R model used by Capellan armed forces. Known as the "Hot Hammer" and debuting in 2825, the two machine guns and their ammunition were removed in order to mount two Flamers added for anti-infantry use.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 6L 是卡佩兰武装部队所使用 6R 型号的极基础武器替换。它被称为"热火锤"，于 2825 年首次亮相，移除两挺机枪及其弹药，以安装两具用于反步兵的火焰喷射器。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: One of the mainstays of the heavy 'Mechs.  Solid, dependable, and heavy hitting.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 重型机甲的中坚之一。坚固、可靠、打击力强。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Warhammer BattleMech was introduced by StarCorps Industries in 2515 to be "a mobile 'Mech with enough firepower to destroy or severely damage any 'Mech of the same weight class or lower." In the mission it was designed for, the Warhammer proved to be a very capable 'Mech, and for centuries practically defined the entire class of heavy 'Mechs. Boasting incredible firepower and respectable armoring, the Warhammer served prominently in the Star League Defense Force and was one of the premier 'Mechs in the Gunslinger Program. Indeed, many of the greatest MechWarriors in history were Warhammer pilots.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 战锤战斗机甲由星团公司于 2515 年推出，定位为"一台具备足够火力摧毁或重创任何同重量级或更低级机甲的机动型机甲"。在其设计所针对的任务中，战锤被证明是一台极为出色的机甲，并在数世纪里几乎定义了整个重型机甲类别。凭借惊人的火力与可观的装甲，战锤在星盟防卫军中表现突出，也是"枪手计划"中的首要机甲之一。事实上，历史上许多最伟大的机甲战士都是战锤飞行员。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: One of the mainstays of the heavy 'Mechs.  Solid, dependable, and heavy hitting.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 重型机甲的中坚之一。坚固、可靠、打击力强。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Warhammer-6Rb is a variant made for the Star League's Royal regiments. Highly similar to the Warhammer-6R, the -6Rb's differences lie in the armor and heat dissipation systems that have been upgraded to the Star League standard with Ferro-Fibrous and double heat sinks respectively.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 战锤-6Rb 是为星盟皇家团打造的变体。它与战锤-6R 高度相似，-6Rb 的差异在于装甲与散热系统分别升级为星盟标准的铁纤维和双倍散热器。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Warhammer-6Rb is a variant made for the Star League's Royal regiments. Highly similar to the Warhammer-6R, the -6Rb's differences lie in the armor and heat dissipation systems that have been upgraded to the Star League standard with Ferro-Fibrous and double heat sinks respectively.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 战锤-6Rb 是为星盟皇家团打造的变体。它与战锤-6R 高度相似，-6Rb 的差异在于装甲与散热系统分别升级为星盟标准的铁纤维和双倍散热器。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Warhammer-6Rb was the first Royal Warhammer but the -7A takes the mech to its logical conclusion. With advanced weapons and construction materials, combined with double heat sinks, the Warhammer-7A is a walking death machine for mechs and vehicles alike.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 战锤-6Rb 是首款皇家战锤，但-7A 把这款机甲推向其逻辑终点。凭借先进武器与建造材料，加上双倍散热器，战锤-7A 是行走的死亡机器，对机甲与车辆一视同仁。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Warhammer-6Rb was the first Royal Warhammer but the -7A takes the mech to its logical conclusion. With advanced weapons and construction materials, combined with double heat sinks, the Warhammer-7A is a walking death machine for mechs and vehicles alike.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 战锤-6Rb 是首款皇家战锤，但-7A 把这款机甲推向其逻辑终点。凭借先进武器与建造材料，加上双倍散热器，战锤-7A 是行走的死亡机器，对机甲与车辆一视同仁。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The original Warhammer was designed as an assault BattleMech. However, it had been superseded by later and heavier 'Mech designs, though it remained a powerful weapons platform. The Clans wisely maintained and built on this solid frame a real assault 'Mech, the Warhammer IIC. This variant turns the Warhammer IIC into a fire support 'Mech. Clan scientists replaced the Medium Pulse Lasers with a pair of LRM-15s and four tons of ammunition.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 最初的战锤被设计为突击战斗机甲。尽管后来被更重的机甲设计取代，它仍是一个强大的武器平台。氏族明智地在这一坚固框架上维护并建造出真正的突击机甲——战锤 IIC。此变体将战锤 IIC 改造为火力支援机甲。氏族科学家将中型脉冲激光换成两具 LRM-15 和四吨弹药。

The Clans wisely maintained and built on this solid frame a real assault 'Mech, the Warhammer IIC. This variant turns the Warhammer IIC into a fire support 'Mech. Clan scientists replaced the Medium Pulse Lasers with a pair of LRM-15s and four tons of ammunition.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The original Warhammer was designed as an assault BattleMech. However, it had been superseded by later and heavier 'Mech designs, though it remained a powerful weapons platform. The Clans wisely maintained and built on this solid frame a real assault 'Mech, the Warhammer IIC. Designed by Clan Diamond Shark, this variant replaces the PPCs and missile launcher of the original design with a pair of arm-mounted Heavy Large Lasers, two additional heat sinks, and a half ton of armor. An advanced Targeting Computer was also added to help ensure that the hard-to-use heavy lasers hit.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 最初的战锤被设计为突击战斗机甲。尽管后来被更重的机甲设计取代，它仍是一个强大的武器平台。氏族明智地在这一坚固框架上维护并建造出真正的突击机甲——战锤 IIC。此变体由钻石鲨氏族设计，将原设计中的 PPC 与导弹发射器换成一对臂载重型大型激光、两台额外散热器和半吨装甲。还加装了先进瞄准计算机以确保难以驾驭的重型激光能够命中。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This variant, used by the SLDF, has a LTV 150 engine, slightly lower maximum ground speed (84km/h), a 120 meter jump capability, and replaces the SRM-2 with a rear-facing One-Shot version. In exchange the WSP-100 was equipped with a five ton bomb bay. This Bomb Bay allowed the WSP-100 to carry Arrow IVmissiles and conventional bombs without losing any speed.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Developed by General Mechanics on Mars in 2464 as the first generation Wasp, this version used several primitive components. The primitive engine reduced the top speed to 85 km/h and meant that only a single medium laser was carried. The prototype jump jets could only cover 150 meters in a jump. The primitive armor provided much less protection than the later Succession Wars-era Wasps, even though it carried three and a half tons of armor.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 此版本由通用机械于 2464 年在火星开发，是第一代黄蜂，使用了若干原始组件。原始引擎把最高速度降至 85 公里/小时，且只能携带一门中型激光。原型跳跃推进器一次只能跳 150 米。尽管携带三吨半装甲，原始装甲提供的保护远不如后来的继承战争时代黄蜂。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Designed as a fast, jump-capable reconnaissance platform for delivery of special munitions by House Liao, the Wasp 1L have fallen out of favor.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 1L 黄蜂本被廖家族设计为投送特种弹药的快速、可跳跃侦察平台，如今已失宠。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A big focus on short range missiles and not really much else.  Kind of fell of out favor with none of the specialized munitions anymore.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 重点全在近程导弹上，别的几乎没什么。随着特种弹药不再可用，它有点失宠了。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A common Periphery rebuild, this mech is a mix of different weapons systems. A primitive medium laser copied from the original Wasp model provides subpar fire power, backed up by the one shot punch of an RL15. A small calibre rifle makes for a semi effective sniper weapon whilst its ammo lasts. The rest of the mech is almost standard spec, rebuilt by a succession of engineers to specs nearly identical to Inner Sphere counterparts. Surprisingly enough, this rebuild offers somewhat superior capabilities compared to most Inner Sphere models. Produced in any number of Periphery junk yards and back alley chop shops, this mech is incredibly common amongst periphery factions;  who field the mech in vast quantities, praising its cheap firepower and easily repaired chassis.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是一款常见的外围区重建型，混合了不同的武器系统。仿自原版黄蜂的原始中型激光提供欠佳的火力，辅以 RL15 的一次性打击。小口径步枪在弹药耗尽前算是半有效的狙击武器。机甲其余部分几乎是标准规格，由历任工程师重建至与内天体同类几乎相同的规格。相当令人惊讶的是，这款重建型的能力比大多数内天体型号略胜一筹。它在外围区无数废品场和后巷改装铺中生产，在外围势力中极为普遍；这些势力大量列装该机甲，称赞其廉价的火力与易于修理的底盘。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An improved 1-P, this upgrade package uses scavenged tech to improve the 1-Ps scouting ability.  Using minimal upgrades, all purchased or acquired at great cost, this refit package is available for anyone with the contacts or cash to afford it. The new active probe is capable of spotting most threats long before they can see the Wasp, whilst the removal of the RL-15 takes away most of it’s offence punch, it allows for the addition of a knock-off AMS system to better protect the mech. Endo Steel is used to provide the weight savings for the probe, though it’s limited availability and high cost limit the number of these conversions produced. Popular among pilots and the chop shop owners refitting them, this upgrade is expected to spread through the Periphery in the near future, as the technology required becomes easier to acquire.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为改进型 1-P，这套升级套件使用收集来的技术提升 1-P 的侦察能力。它只做最小幅度的升级，所有部件都以高价购得或获取，这套改装套件可供任何有门路或有钱的人使用。新的主动探测器能在大多数威胁看到黄蜂之前很久就发现它们；移除 RL-15 虽然带走了大部分进攻打击力，却允许加装一套仿制 AMS 系统以更好地保护机甲。内骨骼用于为探测器腾出重量，尽管其有限的可得性与高成本限制了此类改装的产量。它在飞行员和改装它们的改装铺老板中都很受欢迎，预计随着所需技术更易获取，这套升级将在不久的将来传遍外围区。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Standing at ten meters tall, the Watchman is a 'Mech that was born of necessity. The idea for the design came when the bulk of the AFFS was moved to the Clan front. Because this seriously undermined the ability of the Federated Suns to keep its borders secure, the Watchman was designed to be distributed to militia units within the border marches to bulk up their strength. In its own right the Watchman is a durable and reliable 'Mech that is built with off the shelf components and is very easy to repair. The 'Mech is armored with eight and a half tons of standard armor, has a top speed of 86.4 km/h, and can jump up to one hundred and fifty meters. This, combined with the Watchman's varied arsenal, makes it an excellent trooper or trainer.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 守望者高十米，是一台因需而生的机甲。这一设计的构想出现在 AFFS 主力被调往氏族前线之时。由于这严重削弱了联邦太阳系守备边界的能力，守望者被设计用于分发给边境边疆区的民兵单位以充实其力量。就自身而言，守望者是一台耐用可靠的机甲，采用现货组件建造，极易于修理。机甲披挂八吨半标准装甲，最高速度 86.4 公里/小时，能跳起至一百五十米。加上守望者多样化的武器库，使它成为出色的通用机或训练机。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The primary weapon on the Watchman is a ChisComp 43 Special Large Laser which gives the Watchman good medium to long range striking power. To defend itself at close ranges, the 'Mech carries two ChisComp 39 Medium Lasers. Finally, to deter infantry attacks, the 'Mech has two Sperry Browning Machine Guns.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 守望者的主武器是一门"ChisComp 43 特种"大型激光，赋予守望者良好的中远程打击力。为在近程自卫，机甲携带两门"ChisComp 39"中型激光。最后，为威慑步兵攻击，机甲有两挺"斯佩里-勃朗宁"机枪。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Whitworth is something of an ugly duckling, known among both critics and fans as the Tin Woodsman. It was originally produced in 2610 as a BattleMech that was meant to fill the weight gap between the lighter Wasp and the heavier Phoenix Hawk 'Mechs. The Whitworth, though, is slower than either of these designs by over 30 km/h and plagued with a faulty actuator system in its hips and legs which could cause the legs to tear loose during strenuous maneuvers. Replacing the actuators would require a complete reworking of the lower half of the torso and leg assembly. However, the Whitworth carried eight tons of armor, utilized four reliable Whitworth Jetlift jump jets split between both legs for improved mobility, and featured excellent long-range firepower. The result was a 'Mech which could stand up in combat to another 'Mech of its equivalent mass and less. The original WTH-1S Whitworth model saw combat in the Age of War, however since it was armed with SRMs, many were lost when their pilots rushed into close-range combat to effectively use them. The Whitworth's lack of hand actuators, low speed curve, poor armor distribution and less-than-effective weapon loadout doomed them to the scrap pile. At the insistence of the Star League, the Whitworth Company replaced these weapons with LRMs in 2689 and the WTH-1 would serve in the Star League Defense Force as an able if mediocre scout and light strike platform. Whitworths often took part in reconnaissance-in-force missions and raids against well-defended areas, often alongside Wolverines and Phoenix Hawks, or provided fire support for heavy attack forces with Riflemans and Warhammers.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This incredibly rare version of the Whitworth was made exclusively for the Amaris Dragoons in 2754 as a terror weapon. Only twenty-four of these variants were ever built by Whitworth's Republic branch, carrying two SRM-6 racks in place of the LRM-10 launchers along with fourteen heat sinks and replacing the left arm laser with a Flamer. These Whitworths were painted matte black and became infamous for razing entire cities with their inferno-loaded SRMs and flamers.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这款极其罕见的惠特沃斯版本于 2754 年专为阿马里斯龙骑兵作为恐怖武器制造。惠特沃斯的共和国分厂仅建造了二十四台此类变体，以两具 SRM-6 挂架取代 LRM-10 发射器，配十四台散热器，并把左臂激光换成火焰喷射器。这些惠特沃斯涂成哑光黑，因其燃烧弹头 SRM 和火焰喷射器夷平整座城市而臭名昭著。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Whitworth is something of an ugly duckling, known among both critics and fans as the Tin Woodsman. It was originally produced in 2610 as a BattleMech that was meant to fill the weight gap between the lighter Wasp and the heavier Phoenix Hawk 'Mechs. The Whitworth, though, is slower than either of these designs by over 30 km/h and plagued with a faulty actuator system in its hips and legs which could cause the legs to tear loose during strenuous maneuvers. Replacing the actuators would require a complete reworking of the lower half of the torso and leg assembly. However, the Whitworth carried eight tons of armor, utilized four reliable Whitworth Jetlift jump jets split between both legs for improved mobility, and featured excellent long-range firepower. The result was a 'Mech which could stand up in combat to another 'Mech of its equivalent mass and less. The original WTH-1S Whitworth model saw combat in the Age of War, however since it was armed with SRMs, many were lost when their pilots rushed into close-range combat to effectively use them. The Whitworth's lack of hand actuators, low speed curve, poor armor distribution and less-than-effective weapon loadout doomed them to the scrap pile. At the insistence of the Star League, the Whitworth Company replaced these weapons with LRMs in 2689 and the WTH-1 would serve in the Star League Defense Force as an able if mediocre scout and light strike platform. Whitworths often took part in reconnaissance-in-force missions and raids against well-defended areas, often alongside Wolverines and Phoenix Hawks, or provided fire support for heavy attack forces with Riflemans and Warhammers.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Whitworth carries as its primary weapons two Longbow LRM-10 launchers with one ton of ammo each in both right and left torsos. These missile launchers allow the Whitworth to strike an enemy at long ranges with a moderate amount of missiles. While against heavier units it is somewhat effective, when used to provide LRM support to a recon lance, the Whitworth's LRMs can deter pursuit by other light units. For secondary weapons, the Whitworth has three Intek Medium Lasers, one mounted in the head and in either arm, that allow it to effectively defend itself from units of the same weight class and lighter at short ranges.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The WTH-2 Whitworth is a very basic upgrade of the original design introduced in 3050 in response to the Clan invasion. Two Medium Lasers have been removed from the 'Mech and replaced with Artemis IV fire control systems for the LRM-10 launchers making it deadlier at long ranges in exchange for short range defense capabilities.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: WTH-2 惠特沃斯是对原设计极为基础的升级，于 3050 年为应对氏族入侵而推出。机甲移除两门中型激光，换成 LRM-10 发射器的 Artemis IV 火控系统，以近程防御能力换取更致命的远程打击力。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The original Wolfhound model, produced from 3028 until the introduction of the WLF-2 variant. The pre-Helm Memory Core WLF-1's primary weapon is a standard Setanta Large Laser, making its striking distance shorter than that of the later model, while its ten standard heat sinks did not dissipate as much waste heat as the newer double heat sinks used on the WLF-2.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是狼犬的最初型号，自 3028 年生产至 WLF-2 变体问世。赫尔姆记忆核心之前的 WLF-1 主武器是标准"塞坦塔"大型激光，打击距离短于后来的型号，其十台标准散热器散发废热的能力也不如 WLF-2 使用的较新型双倍散热器。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Th 6M boasts an increase in firepower and endurance as a raider by dropping the AC5 and replacing it with a Large Laser.  This also allowed for the addition of another Medium Laser and extra Heat Sinks.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: While the addition of the Lasers removes its reliance on ammunition, the WVR-6M tends to run a bit hot, especially if you are using the Jump Jets.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Wolverine 6Rs are fairly flexible in terms of weaponry ranges, tending somewhat more toward closer engagements. This is supported by their jump capability and pretty decent heat management.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A Taurian variant, the WVR-6T design was created to capitalize on the less expensive ballistic weapons that were readily available within the Concordat to reduce their reliance on Star League member states. The 6T was also meant to act as anti-pirate garrison 'Mech, utilizing its long range AC/5 and LRM-5 combo to engage raiders at range.  While the swap out of the Medium Laser for a Small Laser and the addition of two Machine Guns allow this Wolverine variant to better engage with the light vehicles and infantry common to raiding forces.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为陶里安变体，WVR-6T 的设计意图是利用协约国内易于获得的较廉价实弹武器，以减少对星盟成员国的依赖。6T 也意在充当反海盗驻防机甲，利用其远程 AC/5 与 LRM-5 组合在远距离迎击劫掠者。而把中型激光换成小型激光并加装两挺机枪，则让这款狼獾变体能更好地对付劫掠部队常见的轻型车辆与步兵。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Not sure I totally agree with the mixed loadout on the 6T, but it seems like it can stay at range to harass the enemy, while being able to dish out some serious damage if things get up close and personal.  Now, imagine what I could do with these specs on a Shadow Hawk chassis...
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我不完全认同 6T 的混合武器配置，但它似乎能保持距离骚扰敌人，同时在近身搏斗时也能造成严重伤害。现在，想想我要是把这些规格用到暗影鹰底盘上会怎样……

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 7D variant of the Wolverine is a major upgrade to the design introduced in 3050 by the Federated Suns' new Nanking factory. The standard engine on the 'Mech was replaced with a Nissan 275 XLversion and the armor has been upgraded to Kallon Unity Weave Ferro-Fibrous material with an extra half-ton added. To increase the Wolverine's speed, MASC has been added, allowing it to move up to 108 km/h in bursts. Finally, the weapons payload has been upgraded as well. The autocannon has been upgraded to a General Motors Nova-5 Ultra Autocannon/5 and the medium laser is now a Sutel Precision Line Medium Pulse Laser. The design retains its jumping capability, as well as the SRM-6, although CASE now protects the SRM reloads
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 狼獾 7D 变体是该设计的重大升级，由联邦太阳系的新南京工厂于 3050 年推出。机甲的标准引擎换成日产 275 XL 版本，装甲升级为卡隆统一编织铁纤维材料并额外增加半吨。为提升狼獾速度，加装了 MASC，使其能在爆发中移动至 108 公里/小时。最后武器配置也得到升级：自动炮升级为通用汽车新星-5 超速自动炮/5，中型激光换为苏特尔精准线中型脉冲激光。设计保留跳跃能力与 SRM-6，不过 SRM 再装填现由 C.A.S.E. 保护

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Star League changed so much from the WVR-6R that they called this the Wolverine II. It carries a similar weapon load but enhanced by the Star League's superior technology, making this a far deadlier machine.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 星盟对 WVR-6R 的改动如此之大，以至于他们把它称为狼獾 II。它携带相似武器载荷，但在星盟优越技术的强化下，成为一台致命得多的机器。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Another major upgrade of the Wolverine, this one for the Combine and first rolling off Marduk's production lines, the 7K model is also built with an XL Engine for power with the saved weight used to increase and upgrade its arsenal.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是狼獾的又一次重大升级，此次为联合体打造，首批从马尔杜克生产线下线。7K 型号同样采用 XL 引擎提供动力，节省的重量用于扩充与升级其武器库。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Another major upgrade of the Wolverine, this one for the Combine and first rolling off Marduk's production lines, the 7K model is also built with an XL Engine for power with the saved weight used to increase and upgrade its arsenal.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是狼獾的又一次重大升级，此次为联合体打造，首批从马尔杜克生产线下线。7K 型号同样采用 XL 引擎提供动力，节省的重量用于扩充与升级其武器库。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 7M variant of the Wolverine has aspects of both the 7D and the 7K versions but is much closer to the original model. Introduced by FWDI in 3050 the 'Mech uses an XL engine, which is augmented with MASC, so as to push the machine up to 108 km/h in bursts. The 7M has twelve double heat sinks and, for a weapons package, it carries two Diverse Optics Sunbeam ER Large Lasers in the right arm and two Magna 400P medium pulse lasers in the head mount while retaining the SRM-6 for close range work.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 狼獾 7M 变体兼具 7D 与 7K 版本的特征，但更接近原始型号。该机甲由 FWDI 于 3050 年推出，使用 XL 引擎并配 MASC，可在爆发中把机器推至 108 公里/小时。7M 有十二台双倍散热器，武器方面右臂装两门多元光学"日光束"ER 大型激光，头部安装两门玛格纳 400P 中型脉冲激光，同时保留 SRM-6 用于近战。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This BattleMech was solely designed to spite Clanners' distaste for everything Wolverine.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这款战斗机甲的设计目的只有一个：专门气一气氏族对狼獾一切事物的厌恶。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This BattleMech was solely designed to spite Clanners' distaste for everything Wolverine.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这款战斗机甲的设计目的只有一个：专门气一气氏族对狼獾一切事物的厌恶。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Wraith marked Curtiss Militech's entry into BattleMech production. When the design was announced, many felt that the design would be little more than a walking water cooler. What the critics got was a shock. The Wraith is a 'Mech that, when properly employed, can wreak havoc on an enemy with its astounding speed and maneuverability. It is built around a massive LTV 385 XL Engine that allows it to reach speeds of just under 119 kph. The Wraith has a simple, yet effective, pulse weapons payload. Pulse laser weaponry allows the Mech to negate most of the side effects on accuracy that are introduced by the Wraith's heavy use of jump jets, making it incredibly accurate and powerful for such a lightly armed Mech.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 幽灵标志着柯蒂斯军工进军战斗机甲生产。该设计公布时，许多人以为它不过是台会走路的水冷器。批评者得到的却是震惊。若运用得当，幽灵能凭借惊人的速度与机动性在敌阵中肆虐。它以庞大的 LTV 385 XL 引擎为核心，速度可达略低于 119 公里/小时。幽灵配有简单却有效的脉冲武器配置。脉冲激光武器能让机甲抵消跳跃推进器大量使用所带来的大部分精度副作用，使这款轻武装机甲变得异常精准而强大。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Zeus 5S is an original model Zeus, carrying a similar loadout to the normal -6S but making good use of Star League technology to increase both its hitting power and its heat management, making the -5S a terrifying mech on the battlefield.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 宙斯 5S 是原版宙斯型号，携带与普通-6S 相似的有效载荷，但善用星盟技术同时提升打击力与散热管理，使-5S 成为战场上一台可怕的机甲。
火力支援 & 远距离突击

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: TThe Zeus 5S is an original model Zeus, carrying a similar loadout to the normal -6S but making good use of Star League technology to increase both its hitting power and its heat management, making the -5S a terrifying mech on the battlefield.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 宙斯 5S 是原版宙斯型号，携带与普通-6S 相似的有效载荷，但善用星盟技术同时提升打击力与散热管理，使-5S 成为战场上一台可怕的机甲。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Zeus 5T is an original model Zeus and makes use of Star League technology to make a much more deadly mech. Just as fast as the -6S, the -5T switches the autocannon for a devastating array of energy weapons which combined with the -5T's double heat sinks is a brutal combination.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 宙斯 5T 是原始型号宙斯，利用星盟科技打造成致命得多的机甲。速度与-6S 相同，-5T 把自动炮换成一整套毁灭性的能量武器，配合-5T 的双倍散热器，是极为凶悍的组合。
火力支援 & 远距离突击

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Zeus 5T is an original model Zeus and makes use of Star League technology to make a much more deadly mech. Just as fast as the -6S, the -5T switches the autocannon for a devastating array of energy weapons which combined with the -5T's double heat sinks is a brutal combination.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 宙斯 5T 是原始型号宙斯，利用星盟科技打造成致命得多的机甲。速度与-6S 相同，-5T 把自动炮换成一整套毁灭性的能量武器，配合-5T 的双倍散热器，是极为凶悍的组合。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A rare variant of the ZEU-6S, the 6S-DC incorporates a Command Console at the cost of 1 Medium Laser and 2 Heat Sinks.  The 'Mech is all but extinct these days, but they make a large impact on any battlefield they are deployed on.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 6S-DC 是 ZEU-6S 的稀有变体，代价是一台中型激光和两台散热器，换来一台指挥控制台。如今这台机甲几乎绝迹，但它们一旦投入战场便会造成巨大影响。
火力支援 & 远距离突击

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: These were typically a Lyran variant, allowing their 'Social Generals' to more safely take to the field, since an actual qualified MechWarrior could be at the helm.  I honestly wouldn't be surprised if this variant came with a minibar and humidor.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这通常是莱兰变体，让他们的"社交将军"能更安全地上战场，因为真正的合格机甲战士可以坐在驾驶位上。老实说，要是这个变体还配了迷你吧和雪茄柜，我一点都不会惊讶。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Zeus 6S moves faster than many other assault 'Mechs and mounts decent long-range weaponry. Its armor is very good, but it can get stuck in a tight spot if forced into closer-range fights.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 宙斯 6S 比许多其他突击机甲都快，并装备不错的远程武器。它的装甲非常好，但若被迫近身作战，可能会陷入困境。
火力支援 & 远距离突击

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Zeus 6S moves faster than many other assault 'Mechs and mounts decent long-range weaponry. Its armor is very good, but it can get stuck in a tight spot if forced into closer-range fights.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 宙斯 6S 比许多其他突击机甲都快，并装备不错的远程武器。它的装甲非常好，但若被迫近身作战，可能会陷入困境。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A relatively new development, the Zeus 6TS removes the Autocannon and replaces it with a PPC.  To help mitigate the additional heat, 2 Heat Sinks were also added.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 宙斯 6TS 是相对较新的发展，它移除自动炮，换成一门 PPC。为帮助缓解额外热量，还加装了 2 台散热器。
火力支援 & 远距离突击

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A relatively new development, the Zeus 6TS removes the Autocannon and replaces it with a PPC.  To help mitigate the additional heat, 2 Heat Sinks were also added.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 宙斯 6TS 是相对较新的发展，它移除自动炮，换成一门 PPC。为帮助缓解额外热量，还加装了 2 台散热器。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An experiment in logistical support, the Zeus 6Y retains the AC5, but downgrades the LRM15 to a LRM10.  This allowed for the Large Laser to be 'upgraded' to a Binary Laser Cannon.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为后勤支援的一次实验，宙斯 6Y 保留 AC5，但把 LRM15 降级为 LRM10。这使得大型激光得以"升级"为一门双联激光炮。
火力支援 & 远距离突击

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: 'Upgraded' my ass.  For the weight and heat, I'd suggest we rip out that Binary Laser Cannon and let me slap two Large Lasers in there.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: "升级"个屁。就这重量和热量，我建议我们把那门双联激光炮拆掉，让我塞两门大型激光进去。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Zeus IS moves faster than many other assault 'Mech, but mounts mostly low tech, cheap industrial weapons. Still, it's well armoured, and a common sight among the more broke and disgraced units in the Periphery.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 宙斯 IS 比许多其他突击机甲都快，但主要装备低技术、廉价的工业武器。不过它装甲良好，在外围区较穷困落魄的部队中很常见。
火力支援 & 远距离突击

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Zeus IS moves faster than many other assault 'Mech, but mounts mostly low tech, cheap industrial weapons. Still, it's well armoured, and a common sight among the more broke and disgraced units in the Periphery.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 宙斯 IS 比许多其他突击机甲都快，但主要装备低技术、廉价的工业武器。不过它装甲良好，在外围区较穷困落魄的部队中很常见。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: For a mech of just 35 tons this little turtle sports a lot of long range fire support in the form of FORTY LRM tubes, which can scare away even much much larger enemies. For close range, self defense or a last effort push if the ammo bins are empty, the ADR-A carries 2 Small Pulse Lasers and the standard Flamer.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 区区 35 吨的小乌龟却拥有大量远程火力支援——四十个 LRM 发射管，足以吓退远比它庞大的敌人。近程自卫、或在弹药打空时的最后一搏，ADR-A 携带 2 门小型脉冲激光和标准火焰喷射器。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Every time the Adder-B is spotted you can't stop wondering how the clans fit all that firepower on a tiny 35 ton chassis. With an extremely accurate Large Pulse Laser this mid to long range configuration softens up the armor of an enemy to finish it at medium range with its powerful LB-X AC/5, backed up by a pair of ERML's. Never underestimate the power of an ADR-B, it might be a mistake you can't recover from..
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 每次看到 Adder-B，你都会忍不住想知道氏族是怎么把那么多火力塞进区区 35 吨底盘的。凭借一门极其精准的大型脉冲激光，这套中远程配置能软化敌方装甲，然后在中距离以强力 LB-X AC/5 予以了结，另有两门 ER 中型激光支援。永远不要低估一台 ADR-B 的实力，那可能是个你无法挽回的错误。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: As a slightly lighter armed long range bombardment variant, the Adder-C 'only' sports two LRM-15 launchers as the main armament...but also has an additional launcher for a NARC Homing Beacons. You can't hide anywhere if you have one of those stuck on your hull. For CQC and as a non ammo-dependent backup weapon, a single Medium Pulse Laser can absolutely ruin the day for ambushers who think the LRM support mech might be an easy kill.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为一款搭载略轻武装的远程轰炸变体，Adder-C"仅仅"以两具 LRM-15 发射器为主武器……不过还多装了一具发射 NARC 自导信标的发射器。只要有那玩意儿粘在你船壳上，你无处可藏。用于近距近战并作为不依赖弹药的备用武器，一门中型脉冲激光足以彻底毁掉那些以为这台 LRM 支援机甲是软柿子的伏击者的好日子。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Sticking to the general theme for this rather slow 35 tonner, the Adder-D fields a mid to long range setup in form of an ER Large Laser and an Ultra Autocannon/5. The ADR-D will try to keep its distance and open up components from a safe distance before it moves in to finish the job with a set of Streak SRM-2's.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 秉持这款相当缓慢的 35 吨机体的总体主题，Adder-D 以一门 ER 大型激光和一门超速自动炮/5 构成中远程配置。ADR-D 会尽量保持距离，在安全距离上打开对手的部件孔洞，然后推进以一组连续 SRM-2 收尾。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Codenamed Puma by Inner Sphere forces who first engaged it, the Adder is a light Clan OmniMech that serves as a direct or an indirect fire-support unit in most of its configurations.The Primary configuration has a basic but powerful arsenal of two ER PPCs which are linked to an advanced Targeting Computer, allowing the Primary configuration of the Adder to strike at long range with deadly accuracy, this is alongside the standard flamer.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 被首次交战的内天体部队代号为"美洲狮"，蝰蛇是一款轻型氏族全能机甲，在多数配置中充当直接或间接火力支援单位。主配置装备一套基础但强大的两门 ER PPC，联接一台先进瞄准计算机，使蝰蛇主配置能以致命精度在远距离打击，此外还配有标准火焰喷射器。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Albatross was designed by the Free Worlds League in 3053 with an eye toward a possible future conflict with the then advancing Clans. The 'Mech is built using a Hermes 380 XL Engine to minimize weight and maximize free tonnage for its weapon loadout. The Albatross also uses a variety of weapons in an attempt to make the 'Mech effective at any range. The 'Mech has average mobility with a maximum speed of 64.8 kph and also makes use of double heat sinks for their greater heat dissipation capability.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 信天翁由自由世界联盟于 3053 年设计，着眼点是与当时正在推进的氏族可能发生的未来冲突。机甲采用一台赫尔墨斯 380 XL 引擎建造，以最小化重量并为武器载荷最大化可用吨位。信天翁还使用多种武器，力图使机甲在任何距离上都有效。机甲机动性中等，最高速度 64.8 公里/小时，并使用双倍散热器以获得更强的散热能力。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Originally developed in the final year of the Amaris Civil War as the ultimate fixed position city defense BattleMech, the Annihilator was built as a sign of the military strength of the Star League in Exile. The -1A was armed with four Autocannon/10s and four Medium Lasers. While less accurate than the original -2A, the 1A was still a highly destructive and dangerous 'Mech that no MechWarrior looked forward to engaging.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 歼灭者最初在阿马里斯内战最后一年被开发为终极固定阵地城市防御战斗机甲，作为流亡星盟军事实力的象征而建造。-1A 装备四门自动炮/10 和四门中型激光。虽然精度不如原版-2A，1A 仍是破坏力惊人、危险至极的机甲，没有哪个机甲战士愿意与它交战。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Still a fearsome and powerful design, where the original Annihilator-1A carries a bevy of powerful autocannons, the -1E instead opts for an all-energy weapon loadout. Four Particle Projection Cannons give the Annihilator-1E a brutal and incredibly powerful punch while the Medium Lasers from the -1A are carried over for in-close protection while increasing the armor protection somewhat to mitigate enemy return fire.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 歼灭者仍是令人生畏的强大设计，原版歼灭者-1A 携带大量强力自动炮，而-1E 则选择全能量武器配置。四门粒子投射炮赋予歼灭者-1E 残暴而惊人的打击力，而-1A 的中型激光被保留用于近身防护，同时装甲防护略有提升以缓解敌方还击。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Originally developed in the final year of the Amaris Civil War as the ultimate fixed position city defense BattleMech, the Annihilator was built as a sign of the military strength of both the Star League in Exile and the newly created Clans.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 歼灭者最初在阿马里斯内战最后一年开发，作为终极固定阵地城市防御战斗机甲，它的建造是流亡星盟与新生的氏族双方军事实力的象征。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Originally developed in the final year of the Amaris Civil War as the ultimate fixed position city defense BattleMech, the Annihilator was built as a sign of the military strength of both the Star League in Exile and the newly created Clans.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 歼灭者最初在阿马里斯内战最后一年开发，作为终极固定阵地城市防御战斗机甲，它的建造是流亡星盟与新生的氏族双方军事实力的象征。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Apollo is designed to be a long range fire support BattleMech. This is accomplished by mounting an engine on the 'Mech that gives it a top speed of only 64.8 kph and eleven and a half tons of armor. The 'Mech was then armed with massive missile launchers which can rain destruction down on an enemy. While the Apollo has less than average speed for a medium 'Mech, if it is employed correctly the Apollo should have nothing to fear from enemy fire; it is fully capable of staying at the edge of the battlefield and laying down suppressive LRM fire.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 阿波罗被设计为远程火力支援战斗机甲。为此它搭载的引擎仅能提供 64.8 公里/小时的最高速度和十一吨半装甲。随后它装备了巨型导弹发射器，可将毁灭倾泻到敌人头上。虽然阿波罗的速度低于中型机甲平均水平，但只要运用得当，它便无需惧怕敌方火力；它完全能停留在战场边缘，倾泻压制性 LRM 火力。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 2K Archer was a modification built for House Kurita in 2856, designed to increase its direct firepower capability and give it more staying power on the battlefield once it had run out of ammunition
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 2K 弓箭手是 2856 年为库瑞塔家族建造的改装型，旨在提升其直射火力，并在弹药耗尽后仍能在战场上坚持更久

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A contemporary of 'Mechs such as the Thunderbolt and the Banshee, the Archer's primary role was fire support
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为雷霆和女妖等机甲的同时代产物，弓箭手的主要角色是火力支援

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 2Rb variant of the Archer was built for SLDF Royal units starting in 2752. A contemporary of 'Mechs such as the Thunderbolt and the Banshee, the Archer's primary role was fire support.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 弓箭手 2Rb 变体自 2752 年起为星盟防卫军皇家单位建造。作为雷霆和女妖等机甲的同时代产物，弓箭手的主要角色是火力支援。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A another modification made to allow the Archer to defend itself more easily against an enemy that managed to close range with it. Built for House Steiner in 2915
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是另一项改装，使弓箭手能更轻易地抵御设法逼近的敌人。2915 年为施泰纳家族建造

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Carrying a pair of SRM-4s in place of two medium lasers, this was the trademark variant used by the Wolf's Dragoons, which they produced in the assembly plant aboard their space station Hephaestos until its destruction in 3028. It was once stated by Jaime Wolf that all of the Dragoons' Archers were of this variant.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 此变体以两具 SRM-4 取代两门中型激光，是狼之龙骑兵的标志性变体，他们在空间站"赫菲斯托斯"上的装配厂生产，直到 3028 年该站被毁。海梅·沃尔夫曾表示，龙骑兵所有的弓箭手都是这一变体。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 4M variant of the Archer was built using rediscovered Star League technology. A contemporary of 'Mechs such as the Thunderbolt and the Banshee, the Archer's primary role was fire support
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 弓箭手 4M 变体使用重新发现的星盟技术建造。作为雷霆和女妖等机甲的同时代产物，弓箭手的主要角色是火力支援

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A contemporary of 'Mechs such as the Thunderbolt and the Banshee, the Archer's primary role was fire support.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为雷霆和女妖等机甲的同时代产物，弓箭手的主要角色是火力支援。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A sleek, mobile, and versatile design, the Clan Arctic Cheetah was long suspected to be one of the first OmniMechs produced by the Clans.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为一款流线型、机动且多用途的设计，氏族极地猎豹长期被认为是最早由氏族生产的全能机甲之一。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Arctic Fox is a light OmniMech reverse engineered by the Kell Hounds from the Clan Uller OmniMech with assistance in the final stages from Clan Wolf-in-Exile. The resulting OmniMech is a powerful light 'Mech that has a top speed of 97.2 km/h that is provided by a GM 180 XL engine, shaving off valuable weight from the Arctic Fox's base chassis while also making the 'Mech vulnerable to becoming a combat kill through the loss of one of its side torsos. The Arctic Fox has ten double heat sinks which are generally enough to handle the 'Mech's heat load, with the ability to add more if needed. To protect itself from enemy fire, the Arctic Fox has six tons of Royal-7 armor.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 极地狐是凯尔猎犬依据氏族乌勒尔全能机甲逆向工程而来的轻型全能机甲，最终阶段得到流亡狼氏族的协助。成品是一款强劲的轻型机甲，由 GM 180 XL 引擎提供 97.2 公里/小时的最高速度，既为极地狐的基础底盘省下宝贵重量，也使它因失去任一侧面躯干而容易被击毁。它装有十台双倍散热器，通常足以应对其热负荷，必要时还可加装。为抵御敌方火力，极地狐拥有六吨 Royal-7 装甲。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Keeping the top speed of the ASN-21 as well as its base weapon load of missiles, the ASN-101 is a rare Federated Suns variant that drops two jump jets and a half ton of armor to mount a trio of Small Lasers, giving the ASN-101 a much better close-in punch compared to its progenitor.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: ASN-101 保留了 ASN-21 的最高速度与基础导弹武器配置，是联邦太阳稀有的变体，它削减两个跳跃推进器和半吨装甲，以装载三门小型激光，使 ASN-101 相比其前身具备强得多的近身打击力。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Assassin was designed to complete against the lighter scout mechs like the Wasp and Stinger but is twice as heavy, faster, greater jump range, heavier armor and much more firepower.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 刺客的设计目标是抗衡黄蜂与毒刺等轻型侦察机甲，但它的重量翻倍、速度更快、跳跃距离更远、装甲更厚、火力强得多。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The -23 variant of the Assassin is an upgrade of the original model using Lostech; originally seen as a standardized field modification, in 3067 new production began at Hellespont 'Mech Works. The SRM-2 has been removed to upgrade the Medium Laser to a Medium Pulse Laser and an Artemis IV fire control system has been added for the LRM-5 launcher. Within the CCAF, TDF and MAF it is largely used as a cheap way to rebuild shattered forces and sees service mostly in green and reserve formations. The Capellans in particular use the -23 as a fire-support unit for pursuit and strike lances, though shortages of Artemis munitions means many are forced to use mine-delivery missiles.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 刺客的-23 变体是使用失落科技的原版升级型；最初被视为标准化的野战改装，3067 年由赫勒斯庞特机甲厂开始新的生产。SRM-2 被移除以把中型激光升级为中型脉冲激光，并为 LRM-5 发射器加装 Artemis IV 火控系统。在 CCAF、TDF 和 MAF 中，它主要被用作重建残破部队的廉价手段，多在生疏与预备编队中服役。卡佩兰人尤其把-23 用作追击与打击小队的火力支援单位，不过 Artemis 弹药短缺意味着许多只能使用布雷导弹。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Assassin was designed to complete against the lighter scout mechs like the Wasp and Stinger but is twice as heavy, faster, greater jump range, heavier armor and much more firepower.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 刺客的设计目标是抗衡黄蜂与毒刺等轻型侦察机甲，但它的重量翻倍、速度更快、跳跃距离更远、装甲更厚、火力强得多。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: First fielded in 2765, the Atlas II was designed by the Hegemony Research and Development Department, Weapons Division of the original Star League to maintain the technological edge over the other Great Houses. It was exclusively for the SLDF's Royal Regiments. In 2785, when General Aleksandr Kerensky put out his call for loyal forces to join him in his Exodus, every Atlas II pilot responded and left with him. The Atlas II is armed with an array of weaponry, including an LB-X Autocannon/10, a pair of ER Large Lasers, and a 20-tube Long Range Missile Launcher for long range attacks. For close range combat, the 'Mech is equipped with a pair of Medium Pulse Lasers and a Holly Six Pack. In addition, the 'Mech has been given CASEfor both sides of the torso in order to keep an ammunition cook-off from consuming the 'Mech.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 阿特拉斯 II 于 2765 年首次投入战场，由原星盟的霸权研发部武器司设计，以维持对各大议院的技术优势。它专供星盟防卫军皇家团使用。2785 年亚历山大·克伦斯基将军号召忠诚部队随他出埃及时，每一位阿特拉斯 II 飞行员都响应并随他离开。阿特拉斯 II 装备一系列武器，包括一门 LB-X 自动炮/10、两门 ER 大型激光和一具 20 管远程导弹发射器用于远程攻击。近距离战斗则配备两门中型脉冲激光和一具冬青六联装。此外，机甲两侧躯干都装有 C.A.S.E.，以防弹药殉爆吞噬整机。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This variant of the Atlas II exchanges both ER Large Lasers and its LB 10-X for a Kinslaughter ER PPC and a Gauss Rifle while removing only one double heat sink
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 此阿特拉斯 II 变体将两门 ER 大型激光和 LB 10-X 换成一门"屠亲"ER PPC 和一门高斯步枪，仅移除一台双倍散热器

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Atlas A is the first try to be the king of the battlefield, capable of bringing a dizzying array of weapons to bear on targets at any range. It is also noteworthy for normally mounting the maximum amount of armor possible. Few opponents can survive even brief contact with this monster.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 阿特拉斯 A 是成为战场之王的最初尝试，能在任何距离上向目标倾泻令人目眩的各类武器。它还以通常装备可容纳的最大装甲量而著称。很少有对手能在与这头怪物短暂接触后幸存。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Built in 2776, this Atlas variant is the largest 'Mech equipped with a Command Console. To free up the weight required to fit this device, the AS7-D-DC removes one ton of LRM ammunition and the paired rear firing lasers. Effective at Close and Long Range Fire Support. Recommended for use by Experienced Tactical Commanders. Extremely Rare and largely Extinct.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这款阿特拉斯变体于 2776 年建造，是装备指挥控制台的最大机甲。为腾出安装该装置所需的重量，AS7-D-DC 移除一吨 LRM 弹药和成对的后向激光。在近程与远程火力支援上都很有效。推荐由经验丰富的战术指挥官使用。极为稀有且基本绝迹。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Known as the 'Atlas II,' the D-HT model carries more Energy weaponry and usually a lighter, more flexible Autocannon. It still has unbelievable protection and the same crushing Melee ability as other Atlas models.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: D-HT 型号被称为"阿特拉斯 II"，携带更多能量武器，通常配一门更轻便灵活点的自动炮。它仍拥有难以置信的防护，以及其他阿特拉斯型号同样摧枯拉朽的近战能力。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Atlas D is the king of the battlefield, capable of bringing a dizzying array of weapons to bear on targets at any range. It is also noteworthy for normally mounting the maximum amount of armor possible. Few opponents can survive even brief contact with this monster.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 阿特拉斯 D 是战场之王，能在任何距离向目标施加令人眼花缭乱的武器阵列。它还以通常装备最大可能的装甲量而著称。很少有对手能在与这头巨兽的短暂接触中幸存。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A Combine upgrade of the Atlas that used rediscovered Star League technology, the K model was built with a Vlar 300 XL Engine. Carrying a Shigunga LRM-20 with two tons of ammo in the left torso the 'Mech was rearmed for long range combat with an Imperator Dragon's Fire Gauss Rifle in place of the autocannon, with two tons of gauss rounds carried in the right arm, backed up by a pair of Victory Nickel Alloy ER Large Lasers split between both arms. This armament allowed the AS7-K to keep an enemy at range, though the continued use of twenty single heat sinks caused swift heat buildup if both lasers are fired repeatedly. For close range defense, the K model carried two Victory Heartbeat Medium Pulse Lasers and a Yori Flyswatter Anti-Missile System in the left arm. To round off the AS7-K's defense, CASE was added to the side torsos to protect against an ammunition explosion.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: K 型是联合体利用重新发现的星盟技术对阿特拉斯的升级，采用一台 Vlar 300 XL 引擎建造。左躯干携带一具"紫郡"LRM-20 与两吨弹药，机甲以远程战斗重新武装：用一门"帝皇龙焰"高斯步枪取代自动炮，右臂携带两吨高斯弹，并由分置双肩的两门"胜利镍合金"ER 大型激光支援。这一武器配置使 AS7-K 能让敌人保持在远处，不过继续使用二十台单散热器意味着若两门激光反复开火会迅速积热。近程防御方面，K 型在左臂携带两门"胜利心跳"中型脉冲激光和一套"织部苍蝇拍"反导系统。为完善 AS7-K 的防御，两侧躯干加装了 C.A.S.E. 以防弹药爆炸。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A Succession Wars era attempt at recreating the Atlas II's loadout, the AS7-RS downgrades the AutoCannon, LRMs and SRMs while trading out the Medium Lasers for a pair of arm mounted Large Lasers.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: AS7-RS 是继承战争时代重现阿特拉斯 II 配置的尝试，它降级了自动炮、LRM 和 SRM，并把中型激光换成两门臂载大型激光。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The first of the Inner Sphere OmniMechs to be conceptualized and one of the last to reach production by the Draconis Combine, the Avatar's design is based on captured Vulture OmniMechs.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 化身是内天体最早被构想、也是联合体最后投产的全能机甲之一，其设计基于缴获的秃鹫全能机甲。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Focused on close combat, the A configuration carries an ER Large Laser as its only long range weapon. Mounting a pair of SRM-6 launchers, an Autocannon/20 and the two Medium Lasers mounted on the base chassis, the Avatar A is a fearsome opponent with devastating close range punch.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: A 配置聚焦近战，以一门 ER 大型激光作为唯一的远程武器。它装有一对 SRM-6 发射器、一门自动炮/20，以及基础底盘上的两门中型激光，降世神 A 是个可怕的对手，拥有毁灭性的近程打击力。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A fire support variant, the B configuration carries two LRM-15 racks and two LRM-10 racks. These are all mated to an Artemis IV Fire Control System. The only short range weaponry on the B configuration consists wholly of the two Medium Lasers mounted on the base chassis.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: B 配置是一款火力支援变体，携带两具 LRM-15 挂架和两具 LRM-10 挂架，全部配以 Artemis IV 火控系统。B 配置唯一的近程武器完全由底盘上安装的两门中型激光构成。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: As a command configuration, the C configuration carries a C3 Master Computer into battle. The C configuration attempts to keep enemies at arms length with a PPC and Ultra Autocannon/5 supported by a pair of LRM-10 launchers.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为指挥配置，C 配置把 C3 主控计算机带入战斗。C 配置以一门 PPC 和一门超速自动炮/5 搭配两具 LRM-10 发射器，力求把敌人拒于臂长之外。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The D configuration is intended to act as a sniper. The primary weapon is a Light Gauss Rifle. For close to medium range combat, the Avatar D has two MRM-20 launchers and a pair of ER Medium Lasers in addition to the two hard-wired Medium Lasers. Finally, the D Configuration has a C3 Slave unit that allows it to work in C3 lances.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: D 配置意在担任狙击手。主武器是一门轻型高斯步枪。中近距离战斗方面，降世神 D 除两门固定中型激光外，还有两具 MRM-20 发射器和一对 ER 中型激光。最后，D 配置装有一台 C3 从属单元，使它能在 C3 小队中作战。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A dedicated 'Mech killer, the Avatar G carries a Gauss Rifle with two tons of ammunition in each arm.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 降世神 G 是专职机甲杀手，每臂各携带一门高斯步枪，配两吨弹药。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A field upgrade developed in the midst of Operation Bulldog, this configuration utilized captured Clan Smoke Jaguar weapons to help bolster the SLDF forces in later waves. Mounting a mix of Combine and Clan-tech, this config carries an MRM-40 supported by a Clan Gauss Rifle, ER Large Laser and Streak SRM-4.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 此配置是"斗牛犬"行动期间开发的野战升级，利用缴获的烟虎氏族武器帮助增强后期波次的星盟防卫军部队。它混装联合体与氏族科技，携带一具 MRM-40，辅以一门氏族高斯步枪、一门 ER 大型激光和一具连续 SRM-4。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A 'Mech that truly lives up to its name! The Awesome 8Q mounts a frightening trio of PPCs that can destroy, knock down, or debilitate any target in no time. It's ungainly, but it can shrug off huge amounts of incoming fire.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一台真正配得上名字的机甲！神奇 8Q 装备三门的可怕 PPC，能在极短时间内摧毁、击倒或瘫痪任何目标。它笨拙不灵，却也能轻易扛下大量来袭火力。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The AWS-8R replaces the more expensive PPCs with a Large Laser and paired LRM-15s.  While this variant can still dish out a similar amount of damage, it suffers from its dependency on a limited supply of ammunition.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: AWS-8R 以一门大型激光和成对的 LRM-15 取代更昂贵的 PPC。虽然此变体仍能造成相近的伤害，却因依赖有限的弹药储备而吃亏。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Awesome 8T is a superb fire support 'Mech, though its heavy armor is a bit wasted in that role. It can still put up a good fight at medium ranges, and it can crush smaller units outright with Melee attacks.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 卓越 8T 是一款出色的火力支援机甲，尽管其厚重装甲在这个角色上略显浪费。它在中距离仍能打出漂亮的一仗，也能用近战攻击直接碾碎较小单位。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Seeking to address the issues with the 8R model, the AWS-8V is a blend of the 8R and 8Q.  This allows a pilot to provide indirect fire support, while still being a potent combatant with its PPC and Large Laser.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 为解决 8R 型号存在的问题，AWS-8V 融合了 8R 与 8Q。这使飞行员既能提供间接火力支援，又能凭借其 PPC 和大型激光成为强悍的战斗者。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 9M is an upgrade of the Awesome that uses Star League technologies. The 'Mech is built around a 320 Hermes XL Fusion engine, giving the 'Mech a top speed of 64.8 km/h. The heat sinks were upgraded to double heat sinks to allow this variant to be rearmed with three Fusigon Longtooth ER PPCs. The ER PPCs are backed up by two Hovertec Streak SRM-2s, split between the left arm and center torso and fed by one ton of reloads in the left leg, a Magna 400P Medium Pulse Laser also in the center torso, and a Diverse Optics Type 10 Small Pulse Laser in place of the head-mounted small laser.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 9M 是使用星盟技术对神奇的升级。机甲围绕一台 320 赫尔墨斯 XL 聚变引擎建造，最高速度 64.8 公里/小时。散热器升级为双倍散热器，使此变体得以重新装备三门"富西贡长牙"ER PPC。这些 ER PPC 由两具"气垫"连续 SRM-2 支援（分置左臂与中央躯干，由左腿一吨再装填供弹）、中央躯干一门玛格纳 400P 中型脉冲激光，以及取代头部小型激光的"多元光学 10 型"小型脉冲激光。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Bane is a BattleMech that is based upon a Star League prototype that was never put into production. Tagged the Kraken by Inner Sphere forces who opposed it, the Bane was first built in 2827. It was originally a significant part of many Clan toumans, but was gradually relegated to second-line status following the introduction of the OmniMech. As such, it is still critical to many defensive units.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 灾祸是一款以星盟从未投产的原型为基础的战斗机甲。它被对抗它的内天体部队冠以"海怪"之名，于 2827 年首次建造。它原本是许多氏族图曼的重要组成部分，但随着全能机甲的引入逐渐退居二线。即便如此，它对许多防御单位仍至关重要。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The original design first produced in 2445, this Banshee variant carries the PPC, Autocannon/5, and Small Laser of the later 3E, as well as a pair of Medium Lasers.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 此女妖变体源于 2445 年首次生产的原始设计，携带后来 3E 型的 PPC、自动炮/5 和小型激光，以及两门中型激光。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Banshee 3E was originally designed for close combat, with better speed than most other assault 'Mechs. While it has heavy armor and powerful Melee attack capability, its firepower is severely lacking and it can still be flanked by lighter units.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 女妖 3E 最初为近战而设计，速度优于大多数其他突击机甲。虽然它有厚重装甲和强大的近战攻击能力，火力却严重不足，且仍可能被轻型单位包抄。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Banshee 3M mounts respectable weaponry with better-than-average speed and armor. This comes at the cost of very poor heat management. It's good at hunting lighter units, especially if it can close to Melee range.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 女妖 3M 装备可观的武器，速度与装甲优于平均。代价是散热管理极差。它擅长猎杀轻型单位，尤其当它能逼近至近战距离时。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Banshee 3MC was a special design of the Magistracy of Canopus. It replaced the autocannon with a bigger one. To make room for it, most of the original heatsinks had to go.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 女妖 3MC 是卡诺普斯法域的特殊设计。它用一门更大的自动炮替换原有自动炮。为腾出空间，大部分原有散热器不得不被舍弃。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Banshee 3Q variant lacks the long distance capabilities of its predecessor, replacing its AC10 and PPC with an AC20 and enough ammo to last in a sustained fight.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 女妖 3Q 变体缺乏前代的长距离能力，它以一门 AC20 和足以支撑持久战的弹药取代了 AC10 与 PPC。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A very recent variant, the 3S downgrades the engine size making the Banshee slower, but more than makes up for this by more than doubling its firepower.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 3S 是极新的变体，它降级引擎尺寸使女妖更慢，但以超过两倍的火力远远弥补了这一点。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The original production variant of this 'Mech, the BKX-7K, utilizes two massive Donal Particle Projection Cannons, which were relatively new at the time. To support the massive cannons, it also has two Federated-5 Shot LRM-5 launchers with one ton of ammo to split between them and a Harpoon-6 SRM-6, giving it something to hit with at all ranges.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这台机甲的最初量产变体 BKX-7K 采用两门巨型多纳尔粒子投射炮，它们在当时相对较新。为支援这两门巨炮，它还装有两具联邦 5 发 LRM-5 发射器，共分一吨弹药，以及一具"鱼叉-6"SRM-6，使它在任何距离上都有可用的武器。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: With the introduction of the BattleAxe’s successor, the Hammerhands, no official variants ever surfaced. However, many MechWarriors, especially those who never quite learned to manage the BattleAxe as it leapt through the air, had technicians remove the temperamental jump jets and install a second LRM 5 in each torso, deeming it the “No Crash” version, or simply 7NC.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 随着战斧的继任者"锤手"问世，再没有官方变体出现过。然而许多机甲战士——尤其是那些始终没学会如何驾驭空中跳跃的战斧的人——让技师拆下反复无常的跳跃推进器，在每侧躯干各装一具 LRM 5，称之为"不摔机"版本，或简称 7NC。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Battle Hawk was originally designed and built at a time when Defiance Industries felt threatened by the large amount of equipment being produced by, and imported from, the Free Worlds League. It was built to prove that Defiance Industries was still an industry leader in BattleMechs. This came from a 'Mech that, while slow for its weight class, is a force to be reckoned with on the modern battlefield. The Battle Hawk has a top speed of 86.4 kph, which puts it on par with 'Mechs fifteen to twenty tons heavier than itself, but it also carries a powerful arsenal for its size. Its five and a half tons of armor give it good protection for a light 'Mech. Additionally, to make the Battle Hawk more maneuverable on the battlefield, it can jump up to one hundred and fifty meters.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 战斗鹰设计与建造之时，迪法恩斯工业正感到被自由世界联盟生产与进口的大量装备所威胁。它的诞生是为了证明迪法恩斯工业仍是战斗机甲行业的领导者。成果是一款虽在同重量级中偏慢、但在现代战场上不容小觑的机甲。战斗鹰最高速度 86.4 公里/小时，与其重十五到二十吨的机甲持平，同时也为此尺寸携带了强大的武器库。五吨半装甲为轻型机甲提供了良好防护。此外，为提升战场机动性，战斗鹰可跳跃至一百五十米。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A upgrade Battlemaster 1DC Command refit, carrying advanced Technologies and Hardened Armour to stay in the fight as long as possible.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是战斗大师 1DC 指挥型的升级改装，携带先进技术与硬化装甲，以尽可能长时间留在战斗中。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: More of a refit than a production variant, the SRM-6 and two Medium Lasers are removed so that six Heat Sinks and an extra ton of armor could be added.  Making the BLR-1D a formitable opponent.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 它更像是一次改装而非量产变体：SRM-6 与两门中型激光被移除，以便加装六台散热器和一吨额外装甲，使 BLR-1D 成为令人敬畏的对手。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Command Console refit built in 2855 - The BattleMaster was one of the Federated Suns' preferred 'Mechs to install Command Consoles. Standard refits usually installed the Command Console on the BLR-1G, removing one heat sink and both rear-mounted Medium Lasers.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 2855 年建造的指挥控制台改装型——战将是联邦太阳系首选安装指挥控制台的机甲之一。标准改装通常在 BLR-1G 上安装指挥控制台，移除一台散热器和两门后向中型激光。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Versatile and powerful, the BattleMaster 1G is one of the best known BattleMechs in existence. Normally mounting a varied array of Energy weapons, the BattleMaster can engage enemies at any range and packs a powerful punch.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 战斗大师 1G 多才多艺而强大，是现存最知名的战斗机甲之一。它通常装备多样化的能量武器阵列，能在任何距离接敌，打击力很强。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A new variant produced for the Lyran Commonwealth by Red Devil industries which changes its mission profile to be more of a support 'Mech, removing its PPC and SRM-6 and replacing them with an LRM-15, LRM-5 and a pair of SRM-2s.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是红魔工业为莱兰联邦生产的新变体，其任务定位更偏支援机甲，移除 PPC 和 SRM-6，换成一套 LRM-15、LRM-5 和两具 SRM-2。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Black Hawk-KU is an Inner Sphere version of the Clan Black Hawk OmniMech. In order to make it possible to copy the Black Hawk, the Black Hawk-KU is built ten tons heavier than its Clan counterpart. The Black Hawk-KU is built on a sixty ton chassis and is powered by a Vlar 300 XL Engine which propels it to a top speed of 86.4 kph.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 黑鹰-KU 是氏族黑鹰全能机甲的内天体版本。为使复制黑鹰成为可能，黑鹰-KU 比其氏族对应型重了十吨。它采用六十吨底盘，由 Vlar 300 XL 引擎驱动，最高速度 86.4 公里/小时。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Blackjack 0s are Primitive downgrades of the BJ-1, replacing both AC's with Medium Rifles, and maximizing armour as best as it can.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 黑杰克 0 是 BJ-1 的原始降级版，将两门 AC 换成中型步枪，并尽可能最大化装甲。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Blackjack 1s are solid, well-rounded 'Mechs for their tonnage. They typically mount Jump Jets, which give them an extra edge by repositioning quickly to keep a direct line of fire for their Autocannons.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 黑杰克 1 就其吨位而言是扎实而全面的机甲。它们通常装备跳跃推进器，能迅速重新定位以保持自动炮的直射视野，从而获得额外优势。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A recent Federated Suns variant, the BJ-1DB replaces the AutoCannon with Large Lasers.  In order to assist with the added heat, it also drops some armor and the torso mounted lasers to make room for more Heat Sinks.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: BJ-1DB 是联邦太阳系新近变体，将自动炮换成大型激光。为帮助应对增加的热量，它还削减了一些装甲和躯干激光，为更多散热器腾出空间。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Sacrificing the Jump Jets, the BJ-1DC adds a Small Laser in each side torso and a Heat Sink to help ease the extra burden.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: BJ-1DC 牺牲跳跃推进器，在两侧躯干各加一门小型激光，并加一台散热器以缓解额外负担。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: In The Periphery Maintaining Mechs Tends To Be A Problem, As A Result The 1P Was Designed Generally As A Downgrade From The Os, But Much Cheaper To Maintain And Repair, Pilots Often Complain About The Structure 'Making Strange Noises', These Remarks Were Usually Ignored.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在外围区，维护机甲往往是个难题。因此 1P 大体上是 O 型的降级版，但维护和修理便宜得多。飞行员常抱怨其结构"发出奇怪的响声"，这些说法通常被无视。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This early Blackjack prototype started along a completely different path for the 'Mech.  Focusing on close in weapons, the BJ-1X has four Flamers and four Medium Lasers.  The BJ-1X also focused more on speed than jump manueverability, increasing the engine size while removing the Jump Jets.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这款早期黑杰克原型为该机甲开辟了一条完全不同的道路。BJ-1X 聚焦近程武器，配备四具火焰喷射器和四门中型激光。它还更注重速度而非跳跃机动，增大引擎尺寸并移除跳跃推进器。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The BJ-2 was introduced in 3052 by the Federated Suns as the new production model of the Blackjack, based on earlier experimental designs. It upgrades the 'Mech with two Diverse Optics Sunbeam ER Large Lasers in place of the autocannons and removes the medium lasers for four Hovertec Streak SRM-2 launchers, two each in the left and right sides of the torso. One ton of ammo for the launchers is kept in the left torso while the standard heat sinks were upgraded to double heat sinks.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: BJ-2 由联邦太阳系于 3052 年推出，是黑杰克的新量产型号，基于早期实验设计。它将自动炮换成两门多元光学"日光束"ER 大型激光，并移除中型激光，换成四具霍弗泰克连续 SRM-2 发射器，左右躯干各两具。发射器的一吨弹药存于左侧躯干，标准散热器则升级为双倍散热器。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The BJ-2 was introduced in 3052 by the Federated Suns as the new production model of the Blackjack, based on earlier experimental designs. It upgrades the 'Mech with two Diverse Optics Sunbeam ER Large Lasers in place of the autocannons and removes the medium lasers for four Hovertec Streak SRM-2 launchers, two each in the left and right sides of the torso. One ton of ammo for the launchers is kept in the left torso while the standard heat sinks were upgraded to double heat sinks.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: BJ-2 由联邦太阳系于 3052 年推出，是黑杰克的新量产型号，基于早期实验设计。它将自动炮换成两门多元光学"日光束"ER 大型激光，并移除中型激光，换成四具霍弗泰克连续 SRM-2 发射器，左右躯干各两具。发射器的一吨弹药存于左侧躯干，标准散热器则升级为双倍散热器。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: In the 3030s, the St. Ives Compact experimented with recovered technology on some of their Blackjacks. One prototype that showed great promise replace the autocannon and one heat sink with a pair of Ceres Arms Smasher PPCs. Three of the remaining heat sinks were replaced with experimental “freezer” double efficiency units.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在 3030 年代，圣艾夫斯共同体在他们的一些黑杰克上试验了找回的技术。一个前景看好的原型以一对"塞雷斯兵器粉碎者"PPC 取代自动炮和一台散热器。剩余散热器中有三台被换成实验性的"冷冻机"双倍效率装置。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Blackjack 3T replaces the standard AC/2s with Large Laser, providing greater punch at the cost of some Heat and carries a large collection of Machine guns and 2 Small Lasers.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 黑杰克 3T 以大型激光取代标准 AC/2，以一些热量为代价换取更强的打击力，并携带一大批机枪和 2 门小型激光。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Blackjack 5 is a rather unusual refit, replacing the Autocannons with a pair of Mortars to allow indirect firing support and giving AMS coverage.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 黑杰克 5 是一款颇为不寻常的改装型，以两门迫击炮取代自动炮，以提供间接火力支援并配备 AMS 防护。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Blackjack G, unlike the average variant, carries twin Ultra AC/10s. This variant also features an advanced targeting computer, an ultra-light gyro, and a supercharger.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 黑杰克 G 与一般变体不同，携带双联超速 AC/10。此变体还配备先进瞄准计算机、超轻型陀螺仪和增压器。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An upgrade of the Blackjack BattleMech, the Blackjack OmniMech is a powerful and adaptable medium weight workhorse. Much like the Firestarter OmniMech, the genesis of the omni-Blackjack stems from the Combine's technology exchange program during the initial Clan Invasion with Ceres Metals Industries ' St. Ives Compact branch offering Luthien Armor Works specifications and licenses to manufacturer the ill-regarded Blackjack.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为黑杰克战斗机甲的升级版，黑杰克全能机甲是一款强劲且适应性强的中量级主力。与火焰使者全能机甲相似，全能版黑杰克的诞生源于氏族入侵初期联合体的技术交换计划——谷神星金属工业的圣艾夫斯契约分部向卢西恩装甲工厂提供了规格与许可，以制造这款评价不佳的黑杰克。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Black Knight 6-KNT is a dedicated Energy weapon platform. It can shell out hellish damage with its beams and shrug off a lot of damage… just gotta make sure to keep its heat in check.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 黑骑士 6-KNT 是专职能量武器平台。它能以光束倾泻地狱般的伤害，并轻易承受大量打击……只要确保把热量控制住。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Black Knight 6B was the harder-hitting, cooler-running Star League ancestor to the standard BL-6-KNT we have today. It did everything the 6 does, but better—mostly thanks to its Double Heat Sinks.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 黑骑士 6B 是我们今天所熟知的标准 BL-6-KNT 的星盟祖先，打击更狠、散热更好。6 型能做到的一切，它都做得更好——主要归功于它的双倍散热器。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A Free Worlds League variant, the BL-7-KNT-L replaces the rarer PPC with a 3rd Large Laser and 2 additional Heat Sinks.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是自由世界联盟的变体，BL-7-KNT-L 将较稀有的 PPC 换成第三门大型激光和 2 台额外散热器。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Black Knight 7-KNT is a dedicated Energy weapon platform. It can shell out hellish damage with its beams and shrug off a lot of damage… just gotta make sure to keep its heat in check.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 黑骑士 7-KNT 是专职能量武器平台。它能以光束倾泻地狱般的伤害，并轻易承受大量打击……只要确保把热量控制住。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Black Knight 7B is a refit made for and sold to Mercenary Commanders deeply in favour with the Federated Commonwealth, sporting advanced technologies and Prototype X-Pulse Laser.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 黑骑士 7B 是为深得联邦联邦青睐的佣兵指挥官制造并出售的改装型，配备先进技术和原型 X 脉冲激光。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Black Knight 9-KNT is essentially a LosTech upgrade to the 6 variant, replacing most of its standard lasers with pulse versions, and the standard PPC with an ER version. This variant also carries double heat sinks to manage the extra heat generated by these weapons.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 黑骑士 9-KNT 实质上是 6 型的失落科技升级版，将其大部分标准激光换成脉冲版本，标准 PPC 换成 ER 版本。该变体还配备双倍散热器以应对这些武器产生的额外热量。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Black Lanner A is configured for electronic warfare and scouting. It uses an Active Probe to find hidden units, an ECM Suite to counteract enemy electronics, and a TAG spotting laser to designate targets for homing artillery. Offensively, it can call upon an ER PPC and a pair of Medium Pulse Lasers.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 黑猎隼 A 配置为电子战与侦察。它使用主动探测器寻找隐藏单位，ECM 套件反制敌方电子设备，TAG 指示激光为制导炮击标记目标。进攻方面，它可调用一门 ER PPC 和一对中型脉冲激光。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The C is a close-support variant that mounts six ER Medium Lasers and a Streak SRM-6. It also uses three additional double heat sinks to help combat heat levels.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: C 型是近距支援变体，装备六门 ER 中型激光和一具连续 SRM-6。它还使用三台额外双倍散热器以帮助控制热量水平。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This close-range brawler mounts pairs of Medium Pulse Lasers, SRM-6s, ER Small Lasers, Flamers, and four Machine Guns. This configuration is devastating to conventional infantry and a serious threat to combat vehicles. An Active Probe ensures that it is rarely surprised.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这款近战近战型装备成对的中型脉冲激光、SRM-6、ER 小型激光、火焰喷射器和四挺机枪。此配置对常规步兵极具毁灭性，对战斗车辆也是严重威胁。主动探测器确保它很少被突袭。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The primary configuration of the Black Lanner is effective at all ranges. At long range, it can make use of an ER Large Laser and LRM-10. When it closes in, it can attack with a pair of ER Medium Lasers and an SRM-6 that can exploit holes in its opponent's armor. An ECM Suite protects it from many forms of electronics.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 黑猎隼的主配置在各类距离上都很有效。远距离可用一门 ER 大型激光和一具 LRM-10。接近后，它可用两门 ER 中型激光和一具 SRM-6 攻击，后者能利用对手装甲上的破口。ECM 套件保护它免受多种电子手段干扰。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Taking its name from a term meaning 'Lightning War' the Blitzkrieg completely lives up to the name. The Blitzkrieg is built on a lightweight Coventry BTZ-VII Endo Steel chassis and is powered by a Magna 350 XL engine that weighs half as much as a standard fusion engine while giving the 'Mech a top speed of 118.8 km/h.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 闪电战之名取自意为"闪电战争"的术语，而它完全配得上这个名字。它建立在轻量化的考文垂 BTZ-VII 内骨骼底盘上，由一台玛格纳 350 XL 引擎驱动——重量仅为标准聚变引擎的一半，同时赋予机甲 118.8 公里/小时的最高速度。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Though bearing a remarkable outward resemblance to the Timberwolf, this BattleMech is a new and powerful creation. Carrying thirteen tons of ferro-fibrous armor, the Mad Cat MK II is an incredibly resilient design. A pair of arm mounted Gaussrifles supported by torso mounted LRM racks give it complete command over the battlefield.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 虽然外观与森林狼极为相似，这款战斗机甲却是全新而强大的创造。疯猫 MK II 携带十三吨铁纤维装甲，是极为坚固的设计。臂载的双高斯步枪配以躯干搭载的 LRM 挂架，使其能完全掌控战场。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The original Bombard mounted a pair of massive Autocannon/20s in place of the Thunderbolt launchers as well as standard Medium Lasers instead of the MBM-013's ER lasers. This version was also equipped with experimental War of 3039-vintage double heat sinks, less bulky than standard double heat sinks, but which utilized corrosive coolant.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 原版轰击者以一对巨型自动炮/20 取代雷霆发射器，并以标准中型激光取代 MBM-013 的 ER 激光。此版本还装备了 3039 年战争时期的实验性双倍散热器——比标准双倍散热器更不笨重，但使用腐蚀性冷却剂。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Brigand is a BattleMech that is surrounded by a sea of controversy as it is the first 'Mech to be produced by a pirate band. Manufactured by a company named Vengeance Incorporated, which is run by the pirates of the Haven Star Cluster and 'Lady Death' Trevaline, the Brigand represents an unprecedented threat because in spite of the fact that it is built by pirates, it uses advanced construction techniques and weapons.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 强盗是一台备受争议的战斗机甲，因为它是首款由海盗团伙生产的机甲。它由一家名为"复仇公司"的企业制造，该企业由避风港星团的海盗与"死亡女士"特雷瓦琳经营。强盗代表着前所未有的威胁，因为尽管它由海盗建造，却使用了先进的建造技术和武器。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Bushwacker was originally a failed BattleMech designed to have a smaller forward profile to make the 'Mech a harder target to hit. The Bushwacker's unique design caused problems with the engine shielding, the side-effects of which manifested themselves as various gremlins in the 'Mech's on board electronics on the prototypes fielded.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 伏击者最初是一款失败的战斗机甲，设计初衷是缩小正面轮廓以使机甲更难被击中。但伏击者独特的设计导致引擎屏蔽出现问题，副作用表现为已部署原型机上各种机载电子设备的莫名故障。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Bushwacker was originally a failed BattleMech designed to have a smaller forward profile to make the 'Mech a harder target to hit. The Bushwacker's unique design caused problems with the engine shielding, the side-effects of which manifested themselves as various gremlins in the 'Mech's on board electronics on the prototypes fielded.
