Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 疾行者全能机甲以较老的蝉战斗机甲为基础。它采用 Alshain KR240 型内骨骼底盘以减轻重量。配备坚固的 GM 240 聚变引擎，疾行者最高速度达 97.2 公里/小时。它装有 C.A.S.E.、以耐用的 GM 240 为核心，并有七吨半装甲防护，在同重量级中属耐久型机甲；在瘫痪或被摧毁前能承受相当可观的损伤。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Strider OmniMech is based on the older Cicada BattleMech. The Strider is built on an Alshain Type KR240 Endo Steel chassis to help save on weight. Built with the rugged GM 240 fusion engine, the Strider has a top speed of 97.2 km/h. Outfitted with CASE, built around the durable GM 240, and protected with seven and a half tons of armor, the Strider is a durable 'Mech for its weight class; capable of suffering considerable damage before being disabled or destroyed.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 疾行者全能机甲以较老的蝉战斗机甲为基础。它采用 Alshain KR240 型内骨骼底盘以减轻重量。配备坚固的 GM 240 聚变引擎，疾行者最高速度达 97.2 公里/小时。它装有 C.A.S.E.、以耐用的 GM 240 为核心，并有七吨半装甲防护，在同重量级中属耐久型机甲；在瘫痪或被摧毁前能承受相当可观的损伤。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: For long range combat, the Summoner A has a powerful Gauss Rifle which is supported by a Large Pulse Laser for intermediate ranges and an SRM-6 launcher for close combat.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 远程战斗中，召唤者 A 有一门强劲的高斯步枪，配一门大型脉冲激光负责中距离，以及一具 SRM-6 发射器负责近战。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A missile bombardment configuration, the B configuration carries a pair of LRM-20 launchers for long range engagements. For close combat, the Summoner B has two SRM-4 launchers. A Narc Missile Beacon allows the Summoner to designate targets for missile fire from other friendly units. The Summoner B has further protection through the use of an Anti-Missile System which gives it increased protection from missile attacks.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 召唤者 B 是一款导弹轰炸配置，携带两具 LRM-20 发射器用于远程交战。近战方面，它有两具 SRM-4 发射器。一具 NARC 导弹信标让召唤者能为其他友军单位的导弹火力标记目标。召唤者 B 还通过一套反导系统获得进一步保护，提升对导弹攻击的防御。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A close range brawler, the Summoner C is armed with a single ER Large Laser for long range sniping at enemy targets but truly comes into its own at close range. The 'Mech relies on a powerful Ultra Autocannon/20 for quick kill capabilities at close ranges. This is backed up by a highly accurate Streak SRM-6 launcher to seek out weak points in an enemy's armor and an ER Small Laser.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 召唤者 C 是一款近战近战型，装备一门 ER 大型激光用于对敌方目标的远程狙击，但真正发挥威力是在近距离。机甲依靠一门强劲的超速自动炮/20 在近距离快速击杀。它辅以一具极为精准的连续 SRM-6 发射器以寻找敌方装甲弱点，以及一门 ER 小型激光。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: In its primary configuration the Summoner has a basic yet effective arsenal. The primary direct fire weapon is an ER PPC backed up by an LB 10-X Autocannon that can fire both standard and cluster ammunition. For fire support and bombardment, the Summoner has an LRM-15 launcher.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 召唤者的主配置拥有基础却有效的武器库。主要直射武器是一门 ER PPC，辅以一门 LB 10-X 自动炮，可发射标准弹与集束弹。火力支援与炮击方面，召唤者有一具 LRM-15 发射器。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A short-ranged brawler, the Sun Spider D carries a mammoth Ultra AC/20 in each arm, with just a pair of Heavy Machine Guns in the right torso as supporting weapons. Lacking in ranged weapons, an ECM Suite is fitted in the left torso to try and assist in closing with its foes so it can make full use of the four tons of Ultra ammunition and single ton HMG bin.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 太阳蜘蛛 D 是一款近战近战型，每臂携带一门巨型超速 AC/20，右躯干仅以两挺重机枪作为支援武器。由于缺乏远程武器，左躯干装有 ECM 套件以协助接近敌人，从而充分利用四吨超速弹药与一吨重机枪弹药。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Almost a direct counter-point to the Prime, the A Config mounts twin Ultra AC/2s in each side torso, supported by an ER Large Laser in each arm if the two tons of Ultra reloads run dry. The config is rounded out by an extra Double Heat Sink.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: A 配置几乎与主型号针锋相对，两侧躯干各装双联超速 AC/2，若两吨超速弹药耗尽，则每臂一门 ER 大型激光可顶上。配置以一台额外双倍散热器收尾。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A mixed-range combatant, the Sun Spider B is built around a right-torso mounted Gauss Rifle, supported by a left-torso ER Large Laser and matched Streak SRM-6 and ER Medium Lasers in each arm. An Anti-Missile System and a Light Active Probe in the left torso prevent the B from being caught unaware, carrying two tons of Gauss and Streak reloads along with a single ton of AMS ammo and an extra double heat sink.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 太阳蜘蛛 B 是一款混合射程战斗型，以右躯干的高斯步枪为核心，左躯干的 ER 大型激光以及每臂配对的连续 SRM-6 和 ER 中型激光为支援。左躯干的反导系统与轻型主动探测器使 B 不会被打个措手不及，它携带两吨高斯与连续导弹再装填、一吨 AMS 弹药和一台额外双倍散热器。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The C configuration is a classic LRM Missile Boat, fitted with a pair of LRM-15s in each arm and supported by an LRM-20 in each side torso. Carrying six tons of LRM missiles, an extra double heat sink strives to try and keep the Sun Spider firing.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: C 配置是经典的 LRM 导弹平台，每臂装两具 LRM-15，每侧躯干各一具 LRM-20 支援。携带六吨 LRM 导弹，一台额外双倍散热器努力让太阳蜘蛛保持开火。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A short-ranged brawler, the Sun Spider D carries a mammoth Ultra AC/20 in each arm, with just a pair of Heavy Machine Guns in the right torso as supporting weapons. Lacking in ranged weapons, an ECM Suite is fitted in the left torso to try and assist in closing with its foes so it can make full use of the four tons of Ultra ammunition and single ton HMG bin.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 太阳蜘蛛 D 是一款近战近战型，每臂携带一门巨型超速 AC/20，右躯干仅以两挺重机枪作为支援武器。由于缺乏远程武器，左躯干装有 ECM 套件以协助接近敌人，从而充分利用四吨超速弹药与一吨重机枪弹药。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Sun Spider Prime is built for short-range combat and carries a pair of Streak SRM-6 launchers in each arm, supported at range by Ultra AC/10 and an ER Large Laser in the right and left torsos, respectively. Two tons of Ultra Autocannon reloads and three tons of Streak SRM missiles are more than adequate for Clan Trials.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 太阳蜘蛛主型号为近战而设，每臂携带两具连续 SRM-6 发射器，远程则由右躯干的超速 AC/10 和左躯干的 ER 大型激光支援。两吨超速自动炮再装填与三吨连续 SRM 导弹对氏族试炼而言绰绰有余。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Apparently based on the Supernova-2, the Supernova-A retains only a single ER Large Laser in each arm, mounting an Artemis IV FCS-equipped LRM-20 and Streak SRM-6 launcher in each torso. With a targeting computer linked to the large lasers, three tons of LRM missiles and four tons of Streak reloads give the A variant good endurance. Keeping the classic jump jets and boosting armor over primary variant, an Endo Steel frame and fitting only seventeen double heat sinks are used to free up the extra weight required for the missile launchers.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 超新星-A 显然以超新星-2 为基础，每臂只保留一门 ER 大型激光，每个躯干装备一具配 Artemis IV 火控系统的 LRM-20 和连续 SRM-6 发射器。大型激光联动的瞄准计算机、三吨 LRM 导弹和四吨连续导弹再装填赋予 A 变体良好的续航。保留经典的跳跃推进器并在主变体基础上加强装甲，使用内骨骼框架并只装十七台双倍散热器，以腾出导弹发射器所需的额外重量。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Somewhat of an anomaly, unlike its brothers the Supernova-C mounts its primary weapons in its torsos and secondary weapons in its arms; twin Large Pulse Lasers in each side torso supported by a ER Medium and Medium Pulse Laser in each arm. Built on the framework of the Supernova-2, the C mounts twenty-two double heat sinks.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 超新星-C 有些反常，与其兄弟们不同，它把主武器装在躯干、次要武器装在臂部：每侧躯干各两门大型脉冲激光，每臂则由一门 ER 中型激光和一门中型脉冲激光支援。C 型基于超新星-2 的框架建造，装备二十二台双倍散热器。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: While an exceptionally early design, the Talos by Vandenberg MilTech was a financial success and a long-standing general mech for the Taurian Defense Forces from its production in the 2530's well into the Succession Wars. An Autocannon/10, two LRM-5s, and an SRM-6 give the Talos weapons effective at multiple range bands while its 8.5 tons of armor give it some longevity on the battlefield.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 虽然设计极早，但范登堡军工的塔洛斯取得了商业成功，自 2530 年代投产直到继承战争，一直是陶里安防卫军长期使用的通用机甲。一门自动炮/10、两具 LRM-5 和一具 SRM-6 使塔洛斯的武器在多个射程段都有效，而其 8.5 吨装甲赋予它在战场上一定的持久力。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A relic of an earlier age, it’s a minor miracle this antique is still functional. Occasionally found through the frontier, surviving Taloses are a strange mix of new and old technology, bodged together by generations of different mectechs. Rarely seen and even more rarely fielded in battle, very few of these 500 year old designs still grace the modern battlefield, but those that do are treated with the respect and reverence, due to a centuries old design. The 1P is the ‘‘modern’’ adaption of the older 1B design and has proliferated in recent years, leading some to speculate that a cache of Talos or Talos parts has been found. Armed with a variety of local tech and a knock-off ecm suite, the 1P is a versatile design outfitted as a mid range brawler.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为更早时代的遗物，这台古董还能运转已是小小奇迹。偶尔能在边疆见到，幸存的塔洛斯是新旧技术奇异的混合体，由一代代不同的机甲技师拼凑而成。它们很少见，更罕见于战场，这些五百年前的设计几乎已不再现身现代战场，但少数仍在服役者因这数世纪之久的设计而备受敬重。1P 是较老 1B 设计的"现代"改型，近年数量激增，让一些人猜测有人发现了塔洛斯或其部件的储藏库。1P 装备多种本地技术与一套仿制 ECM 套件，是一款多用途设计，定位为中距离缠斗者。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: With the reintroduction of Helm Core LosTech, the Taurian Defense Force found themselves lagging behind their neighbours. Just as they did during the Age of War, the Taurians turned to the home grown Talos. With a reputation as an easy to maintain and easy to manufacture mech, the design was just what the TDF needed. Lacking the resources to turn the newly redesigned Talos into a viable production model, the Taurians enlisted the aid of their neighbours, in exchange for joining the ongoing Trinity Alliance negotiations. Aided by the expertise of Capellan engineers and financial investment from the Magistracy of Canopus, Vandenburg started limited manufacturing of the Talos; at their New Vandenburg plant: in late 3059. The formal signing of the Trinity Alliance, in 3062; awarded production licenses to both Majesty Metals and Detroit Consolidated Mech Works. Both companies swiftly opened their own lines, producing multiple variants of the Talos for their own use and for export further afield.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 随着赫尔姆核心失传技术的重新引入，陶里安防卫军发现自己在邻国面前落后了。正如战锤时代那样，陶里安人转向了本土的塔洛斯。凭借易于维护、易于制造的名声，这一设计正是 TDF 所需。由于缺乏资源把重新设计的塔洛斯变成可行的量产型号，陶里安人向邻国求助，以换取加入正在进行的"三一联盟"谈判。在卡佩兰工程师的专业知识与卡诺普斯法域的财政投资帮助下，范登堡于 3059 年底在其新范登堡工厂开始限量制造塔洛斯。3062 年"三一联盟"正式签署，把生产许可授予 Majesty Metals 与 Detroit Consolidated Mech Works。两家公司迅速开设了自己的生产线，为自身使用并向外更远处出口而生产多种塔洛斯变体。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: With the reintroduction of Helm Core LosTech, the Taurian Defense Force found themselves lagging behind their neighbours. Just as they did during the Age of War, the Taurians turned to the home grown Talos. With a reputation as an easy to maintain and easy to manufacture mech, the design was just what the TDF needed. Lacking the resources to turn the newly redesigned Talos into a viable production model, the Taurians enlisted the aid of their neighbours, in exchange for joining the ongoing Trinity Alliance negotiations. The formal signing of the Trinity Alliance, in 3062; awarded production licenses to both Majesty Metals and Detroit Consolidated Mech Works. Both companies swiftly opened their own lines, producing multiple variants of the Talos for their own use and for export further afield.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Intended to emulate the Thor OmniMech used by the Clans, the Thanatos is an incredibly sturdy and hard-hitting design. Copying both the looks and the capabilities of the Clan Thor, the Thanatos is a fast all-range design, though it skimps on armor a bit for a mech its size. Carrying an ER Large Laser for long range and a brace of advanced medium lasers and a MRM-20 for medium to close range, the Thanatos has a weapon for any situation. Combined with a fast 86.4 km/h top speed and five jump jets, the Thanatos can often catch what it cannot out-range.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 塔纳托斯旨在模仿氏族使用的雷神全能机甲，是一款极其坚固、打击力极强的设计。它同时复制了氏族雷神的外观与能力，是一款快速的全射程机甲，尽管就其尺寸而言装甲略显单薄。远程携带一门 ER 大型激光，中近程则有一批先进中型激光和一具 MRM-20，塔纳托斯拥有应对任何情况的武器。加上 86.4 公里/小时的快速最高速度和五个跳跃推进器，塔纳托斯常常能追上它无法在射程上压制的对手。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This was the original Thunderbolt design produced in 2491 by Earthwerks Limited, built with Primitive Technology, until the introduction of the modern TDR-5S in 2505.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是地球工厂有限公司于 2491 年生产的原始雷霆设计，采用原始技术建造，直到 2505 年现代 TDR-5S 问世为止。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The so-called "Lost Thunderbolt", the 5L was a downgraded version of the Royal 5Sb Thunderbolt developed by Earthwerks Tikonov in 2823. Built on a more basic standard chassis, the now LosTech ER PPC was swapped for a Diverse Optics Sunbeam ER Large Laser but most of the 5Sb's systems were preserved with only the loss of one double heat sink and the head-mounted Small Laser. Production of the design only lasted a mere twenty-seven years before further technology decline resulted in the 5LS.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 5L 即所谓的"失落雷霆"，是地球工厂提科诺夫于 2823 年为皇家 5Sb 雷霆开发的降级版。它建立在更基础的标准底盘上，如今已成失落科技的 ER PPC 被换成多元光学"日光束"ER 大型激光，但 5Sb 的大部分系统得以保留，仅损失一台双倍散热器和头部小型激光。该设计仅生产了短短二十七年，技术进一步衰退便催生了 5LS。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Developed in 2850 as the Second Succession War saw more and more technologies disappear, the 5LS was a downgraded field refit and a factory model of the now impossible to build 5L. While the ER Large Laser and Starfish Small Pulse Lasers were retained, the standard LRM-15 and Bical SRM-2 rack were noticeably less accurate than the 5L's more advanced launchers, but nothing compared to the replacement of the 5L's double heat sinks with fifteen standard models and the heat management issues that resulted. Production of even the "primitive" 5LS would end during the Third Succession War.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 5LS 于 2850 年开发，当时第二次继承战争让越来越多的技术消失，它是对如今已无法建造的 5L 的降级野战改装与工厂型号。虽然保留了 ER 大型激光和"海星"小型脉冲激光，标准 LRM-15 和比卡尔 SRM-2 挂架的精度明显不如 5L 更先进的发射器，但这与把 5L 的双倍散热器换成十五台标准型号、以及由此产生的散热问题相比，根本不算什么。即便是"原始"的 5LS 也在第三次继承战争期间停产。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Thunderbolt 5S is well-armed and heavily armored for its size. It's often deployed as a frontline 'Mech where the fighting is heavy, and it needs to give as good as it gets.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 雷霆 5S 就其尺寸而言武装精良、装甲厚重。它常被部署在战斗最激烈的前线，而它也必须能承受多少就还击多少。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This SLDF Royal variant of the Thunderbolt was introduced in 2753 and uses Star League technology. An Endo Steel chassis provides more space for an updated weapon mix.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这款星盟防卫军皇家版雷霆于 2753 年推出，使用星盟技术。内骨骼底盘为更新后的武器搭配提供了更多空间。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Thunderbolt SE models lose a little of their firepower in exchange for mounting Jump Jets. The greater mobility is intended to allow for more precision attacking maneuvers, though it all depends on the battlefield terrain.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 雷霆 SE 型号牺牲些许火力以加装跳跃推进器。更高的机动性意在实现更精准的攻击机动，不过这一切都取决于战场地形。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Known for its superb heat management, the Thunderbolt 5SS hits hard at long range with its PPC and then closes to disable or destroy its target with close-range weaponry.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 雷霆 5SS 以出色的散热管理著称，先用 PPC 在远距离重击，然后逼近以近程武器瘫痪或摧毁目标。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Build from derelict Thunderbolt chassis abandoned during Amaris Revolt carries this mech a cheap AC10 alongside 2 MRM10.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这台机甲由阿马里斯叛乱期间被遗弃的雷霆底盘重建而成，携带一门廉价 AC10 和 2 具 MRM10。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Timber Wolf is a fast, heavy OmniMech. A signature design of the Clans' military might, it was arguably the first Clan OmniMech encountered by Inner Sphere forces on The Rock by Phelan Kell. Vaguely resembling a cross-over between the MAD (Marauder) and CAT (Catapult) series, the Timber Wolf was tagged with the Inner Sphere reporting name Mad Cat on first contact.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 森林狼是一款高速重型全能机甲。作为氏族军事力量的标志性设计，它可以说是内天体部队在"岩石"星上由菲兰·凯尔首次遭遇的氏族全能机甲。因其隐约呈现出 MAD（掠夺者）与 CAT（投石机）系列的杂交特征，森林狼在首次接触时被内天体冠以"疯猫"的报告代号。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Timber Wolf is a fast, heavy OmniMech. A signature design of the Clans' military might, it was arguably the first Clan OmniMech encountered by Inner Sphere forces on The Rock by Phelan Kell. Vaguely resembling a cross-over between the MAD (Marauder) and CAT (Catapult) series, the Timber Wolf was tagged with the Inner Sphere reporting name Mad Cat on first contact.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 森林狼是一款高速重型全能机甲。作为氏族军事力量的标志性设计，它可以说是内天体部队在"岩石"星上由菲兰·凯尔首次遭遇的氏族全能机甲。因其隐约呈现出 MAD（掠夺者）与 CAT（投石机）系列的杂交特征，森林狼在首次接触时被内天体冠以"疯猫"的报告代号。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Built due to an awkward exchange of technology between the Free Worlds League and the Word of Blake, the Toyama was designed by Dr. Thaddeus Anable and then given to the Word of Blake through an agreement made by Captain-General Thomas Marik. The Toyama is intended to be a multi-role BattleMech that can operate somewhat independently of supply lines. The 'Mech is built on a lightweight Endo Steel chassis which supports a Vlar 300 XL engine. The Toyama has a top speed of 64.8 km/h, making it capable of keeping pace with most heavy 'Mechs. The Toyama has an impressive twelve tons of Durallex Heavy armor. To dissipate heat, the Toyama carries fourteen double heat sinks. The 'Mech also carries a Garret/Guardian Interface Guardian ECM Suite to protect the 'Mech from advanced enemy electronic warfare systems.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 由于自由世界联盟与布雷克之言之间一次尴尬的技术交换，丰山由撒迪厄斯·阿纳布尔博士设计，然后通过总队长托马斯·马里克达成的协议交给了布雷克之言。丰山意图成为一款能在一定程度上独立于补给线作战的多用途战斗机甲。机甲基于轻量化内骨骼底盘建造，搭载一台 Vlar 300 XL 引擎。丰山最高速度 64.8 公里/小时，使其能与大多数重型机甲并驾齐驱。丰山拥有令人印象深刻的十二吨杜拉莱克斯重型装甲。为散发热量，丰山携带十四台双倍散热器。机甲还装有一套加勒特/守护者接口 ECM 套件，以保护机甲免受敌方先进电子战系统干扰。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The original Trebuchet as produced for the SLDF, it consisted of two Artemis IV-equipped LRM-15s with CASE, four medium lasers, double heat sinks, an Endo-Steel chassis and a 300-rated Extra Light Fusion Engine. However, the attrition of the First Succession War forced Corean Enterprises into redesigning the 'Mech without advanced technology to keep the production lines running.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 最初为星盟防卫军生产的投石机由两具配 Artemis IV 的 LRM-15（带 C.A.S.E.）、四门中型激光、双倍散热器、内骨骼底盘和 300 级超轻型聚变引擎组成。然而第一次继承战争的消耗迫使科里安企业将该机甲重新设计为不含先进技术的版本，以维持生产线运转。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: One of the lightest dedicated fire support 'Mechs to be found, the Trebuchet 4M comes with Deadfire ammo and is among the cooler-running 'Trenchbuckets'.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 投石机 4M 是最轻的专用火力支援机甲之一，配备死火弹药，是散热较好的"战壕桶"之一。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Trading off firepower for mobility, the Trebuchet 5J removes one of the LRM-15 launchers and adds in jump capabilities and 5 extra heat sinks.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 投石机 5J 以火力换机动，移除一具 LRM-15 发射器，加装跳跃能力与 5 台额外散热器。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: One of the lightest dedicated fire support 'Mechs to be found, the Trebuchet 5N can mount enough missiles to give even heavy units pause. However, 'Trenchbuckets' are known for running hot and don't have much in the way of protection.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 投石机 5N 是最轻的专用火力支援机甲之一，能搭载足以让重型单位也犹豫的导弹。不过"战壕桶"以散热偏高著称，防护也不多。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The TBT-5S shifts from long range to short range support.  This 'Mech is a true beast at short range.  With SRM-6s instead of LRM-15s, and eight extra Heat Sink, the TBT-5S is able to dish out a tremendous amount of close range damage.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: TBT-5S 从远程支援转向近程支援。这台机甲在近程是一头真正的猛兽。以 SRM-6 取代 LRM-15，并加装八台散热器，TBT-5S 能造成巨量的近程伤害。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Rebuilt from the salvaged remains of a Trebuchet 5S, this low tech refit is a common sight throughout the battlefields of the Deep Periphery. Mounting between 2 and 4 Rocket pods and backed up by a pair of Large Chem Lasers; makes the 5SP into a fearsome short range brawler. Some designs include scavenged or salvaged Endo Steel or Ferro Fibrous, either for increased protection or to mount additional rocket pods. Limited by the 4 tons of Chemical Laser ammunition and the single salvos of the rocket pod, the SP lacks the endurance for protracted engagements. Fortunately these are rarely a concern in the Deep Periphery and this design is commonally seen during raids and border skirmishes, where it’s heavy fire power can give it an edge over less durable opponents.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这款低技术改装型由一台 5S 投石机的回收残骸重建而成，在深外围区战场上随处可见。装备 2 至 4 个火箭吊舱，辅以两门大型化学激光，使 5SP 成为令人生畏的近距缠斗者。部分设计包含收集或回收的内骨骼或铁纤维，用于提升防护或加装更多火箭吊舱。受限于 4 吨化学激光弹药和火箭吊舱的一次性齐射，SP 缺乏持久交战所需的续航力。所幸在深外围区这很少成为问题，此设计常见于劫掠与边境冲突中，其沉重火力能让它在对抗耐久性较差的对手时占得先机。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The TBT-6X 'Katyusha' is a slightly heavier Trebuchet designed as a testbed for the Artemis IV Smart Missile System.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: TBT-6X"喀秋莎"是略重的投石机，作为 Artemis IV 智能导弹系统的试验平台而设计。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Almost an entirely new 'Mech, the Trebuchet 7K moves away from it's missile support to direct fire support, using a PPC and AC5 along with a SRM-2 for some close in support.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 投石机 7K 几乎是一台全新的机甲，它从导弹支援转向直射火力支援，使用一门 PPC 和一门 AC5，另配一具 SRM-2 提供一些近距支援。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Upgraded with Star League technology, the 7M variant is built with on an Endo Steel chassis and uses a 250 Magna XL engine, giving it the same performance but allowing the design to mount ten double heat sinks and five Rawlings 50 jump jets for a jumping distance of one hundred and fifty meters. It also allows for the Zeus LRM-15s' ammo to be protected by CASE and for a Narc Missile Beacon with two tons of ammo, improving not only the Trebuchet's accuracy but allowing it to share targeting information with other similarly-equipped 'Mechs.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 7M 变体以星盟技术升级，基于内骨骼底盘建造，并使用玛格纳 250 XL 引擎，性能相同，但允许该设计安装十台双倍散热器和五个罗林斯 50 跳跃推进器，跳跃距离达一百五十米。它还使宙斯 LRM-15 的弹药得以由 C.A.S.E. 保护，并加装一具 NARC 导弹信标与两吨弹药，不仅提升投石机的精度，还使它可与其他同样装备的机甲共享瞄准信息。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A FWL export for the DCMS does the 8K Carry an upgraded load of Missiles and Tracking Systems
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为自由世界联盟对德拉科尼斯联合体的出口型号，8K 是否携带了升级的导弹与追踪系统载荷

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 9K variant of the Trebuchet is a field refit of the 7M with a distinctive Kurita feel to it. Built on an Endo Steel chassis and powered by an XL engine, the 9K replaced the LRMs for two MRM-20launchers with three tons of ammo total. The medium lasers in the right arm are replaced with two Medium Pulse Lasers while the left arm-mounted medium laser is kept, and a C3 slave unit in the left torso allows it to share targeting telemetry with other units. The jump jets are also kept, giving it a jumping distance of one hundred and fifty meters.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 投石机 9K 变体是 7M 的野战改装，带有鲜明的库瑞塔风格。它基于内骨骼底盘建造，由 XL 引擎驱动，以两具 MRM-20 发射器（共三吨弹药）取代 LRM。右臂的中型激光换成两门中型脉冲激光，左臂中型激光则保留，左躯干的 C3 从属单元使它可与其他单位共享瞄准遥测数据。跳跃推进器也得以保留，使其跳跃距离达一百五十米。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The predecessor to the original Flea FLE-4 model, the Trooper TP-1R prototype was built in 2475, by Toddlette Industries, on a primitive chassis and maintained ground speeds of nearly 100 kph.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为原版跳蚤 FLE-4 型号的前身，步兵 TP-1R 原型由托德莱特工业于 2475 年在原始底盘上建造，能维持近 100 公里/小时的地面速度。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Turkina is named after Turkina, the first Jade Falcon to be tamed, who inspired the leaders of Clan Jade Falcon in its early days.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 图尔基娜以图尔基娜命名——第一只被驯服的翡翠隼，她在早期激励了翡翠隼氏族的领袖们。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Turkina is named after Turkina, the first Jade Falcon to be tamed, who inspired the leaders of Clan Jade Falcon in its early days.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 图尔基娜以图尔基娜命名——第一只被驯服的翡翠隼，她在早期激励了翡翠隼氏族的领袖们。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Turkina is named after Turkina, the first Jade Falcon to be tamed, who inspired the leaders of Clan Jade Falcon in its early days.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 图尔基娜以图尔基娜命名——第一只被驯服的翡翠隼，她在早期激励了翡翠隼氏族的领袖们。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The UrbanMech IIC is a Clan IIC-style upgrade of the original UrbanMech. Around the same time as the development of the OmniMech during the Golden Century, Clan Coyote technicians reworked this venerable design. They studied battle data from as far back as the Amaris Civil War and used this research as the basis for their upgrades.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 城市机甲 IIC 是原版城市机甲的氏族 IIC 式升级版。在黄金世纪全能机甲发展的同期，郊狼氏族技师重制了这款古老的设计。他们研究了可追溯至阿马里斯内战的作战数据，并以此为基础进行升级。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The UrbanMech IIC is a Clan IIC-style upgrade of the original UrbanMech. Around the same time as the development of the OmniMech during the Golden Century, Clan Coyote technicians reworked this venerable design. They studied battle data from as far back as the Amaris Civil War and used this research as the basis for their upgrades.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 城市机甲 IIC 是原版城市机甲的氏族 IIC 式升级版。在黄金世纪全能机甲发展的同期，郊狼氏族技师重制了这款古老的设计。他们研究了可追溯至阿马里斯内战的作战数据，并以此为基础进行升级。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The product of an aborted series of experiments into LAM technology, the Urbanmech LAM is not surprisingly; poorly suited for either role. Designed by the self proclaimed professor of Cluffs Stand, Mencius Horvat; using a mixture of stolen Urbanmech parts and Lostech recovered from throughout the Periphery. Slow by LAM standards and drastically under gunned by Urbanmech standards, this mech struggles to fill either role. That said, the shock factor of an Urbanmech LAM deployed against uninformed opponents, has allowed it a measure of success when used as a raider. Dual ER Mediums and a bevy of rockets provide a nasty punch at close quarters, but prove mediocre at longer ranges. The only known examples of this mech were were recovered by the DMI and were turned over to the NAIS, though their current status is unknown.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为一系列夭折的 LAM 技术实验的产物，都市机甲 LAM 不出意外地对两种角色都不擅长。它由克拉夫斯站自封教授的孟修斯·霍瓦特设计，混用了偷来的都市机甲部件与从外围区各地找回的失传技术。按 LAM 标准它很慢，按都市机甲标准它火力严重不足，这台机甲难以胜任任一角色。话虽如此，都市机甲 LAM 面对不知情的对手时带来的震撼效果，使它在作为劫掠者使用时取得了一定成功。双联 ER 中型激光和一批火箭在近距能造成凶狠打击，但在较远距离上表现平庸。已知仅有的几台此类机甲被 DMI 收回并移交 NAIS，不过它们目前的状况不明。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Don't let the stubby 'Urbie' fool you—it may look like a walking trash can, but it can mount heavy armor and a grown-up-sized Autocannon. R60s aren't known for their speed, but they are very useful if you can draw the enemy into their firing range.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 别被矮胖的"都市"骗了——它也许看起来像个会走路的垃圾桶，却能装备厚重装甲和成人尺寸的自动炮。R60 不以速度著称，但如果你能把敌人引到它的射程内，它们就非常有用。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A Capellan 'variant' when some factories were unable to keep up with production due to a shortage of Small Lasers, engineers replaced it with a MG and the unofficial R60C variant was born.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 当一些工厂因小型激光短缺而无法跟上生产时，工程师用一挺机枪将其替换，非官方的 R60C 变体就此诞生——这是卡佩兰的"变体"。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Meant for close in city fighting, the R60L variant sacrifices armor to upscale its Autocannon 10 to an Autocannon 20.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: R60L 变体为近距离城市战而设，它牺牲装甲把自动炮 10 升级为自动炮 20。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Meant for close in city fighting, the R60LL replaces its Autocannon 20 with a Ultra version.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: R60LL 为城市近战而设，将自动炮 20 换成超速版本。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This UrbanMech has been extensively modified by an apparently madman for reasons unknown. In place of its usual weaponry are a pair of gauss weapons: the Silver Bullet Gauss Rifle providing the main punch and a lone Magshot Gauss Rifle providing quiet backup. To make these weapons possible on the chassis, this Urbie has been made with an Endo-Steel structure and Ferro-Fibrous armor. Truly, the mind that created this was quite unhinged.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这台城市机甲被某个显然是疯子的人出于不明原因大幅改装。原本的武器被替换为一对高斯武器：银弹高斯步枪提供主要打击，一门单独的磁射高斯步枪提供安静的备用。为在底盘上装下这些武器，这台"城佬"采用了内骨骼结构与铁纤维装甲。创造出它的那个人，心智实在相当不正常。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A Capellan experimental 'variant' that was created when engineers removed the largely superfluous 11th heat sink and installed a Machine Gun with half a ton of ammunition in its place.  While it has no official designation, it is typically referred to as the R60X.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是卡佩兰的实验性"变体"：工程师移除基本多余的第十一台散热器，并在原位装上一挺机枪和半吨弹药。它没有官方编号，通常被称为 R60X。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Meant for close in city fighting the R61L got upgraded with Stealth Equipment alongside its less expensive R60L cousins AC20.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: R61L 为城市近战而设，在较廉价的 R60L 表亲的 AC20 之外，还加装了隐形装备。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Designed by Cataclysm, a former freeborn Clan Wolf MechWarrior turned Mercenary, and infamous UrbanMech fanatic, this refit is designed to be a cost-effective and logistically reliable way to garrison cities. For the price of a single Awesome, one could afford to refit an entire lance of UrbanMechs to the R8Q standard.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 此改装型由"灾变"设计——一位前自由出身氏族狼机甲战士转行的佣兵，也是臭名昭著的城市机甲狂热分子——旨在提供一种成本效益高、后勤可靠的城池驻防方案。一台卓越的价钱，就足以把整整一个小队的城市机甲改装到 R8Q 标准。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The UM-R90 'SuburbanMech' adapts the traditional UrbanMech R60 into an energy weapon platform for higher performance. Because its weapons aren't limited by ammunition concerns, the R90 is better-suited to longer engagements.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: UM-R90"郊区机甲"把传统的都市机甲 R60 改造为性能更高的能量武器平台。由于武器不受弹药限制，R90 更适合长时间交战。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A uniquely Lyran take on the VLK-QD, this refit transforms the fire support mech into a light scout hunter with the firepower to engage much heavier prey. The standard LRM is swapped for a streak-6 and a second pulse laser, providing a heavy punch, at the expense of range. Produced by Corean Enterprises at their New Avalon facility exclusively for the Arcturan Guards, the design never saw wide spread deployment. Designed to complement the QD, standard tactics called for mixed lances of QD and QE’s; with the E’s flushing units out for the D’s LRMs and then finishing off damaged opponents. A cheap upgrade, the design had many detractors; most of whom criticised the lack of long range fire power or the over heating issues that stemmed from the refusal to upgrade to DHS. The design ceased production during the FedCom Civil War, with the Guards choosing to invest in newer Lyran made variants following the war.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是莱兰对 VLK-QD 的独特演绎，此改装把火力支援机甲变成轻型侦察猎手，具备与远为重型的猎物交战的火力。标准 LRM 换成连续 6 与第二门脉冲激光，提供沉重打击，代价是射程。该设计由科里安企业在其新阿瓦隆工厂为小熊卫队独家生产，从未广泛部署。为与 QD 互补，标准战术要求 QD 与 QE 混编小队；由 E 型把单位逼出来供 D 型的 LRM 打击，然后收拾受损对手。作为一项廉价升级，该设计招致众多批评者；多数人批评其缺乏远程火力，或拒绝升级 DHS 导致的过热问题。该设计在联邦联邦内战期间停产，战后卫队选择投资更新的莱兰制造变体。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Vapor Eagle features an eclectic and close-ranged weapons load-out, mounting a Large Pulse Laser in its right arm, supported by a single Machine Gun, two Streak SRM-2s and three Medium Pulse Lasers split between its side torsos and rounded out by a trio of Machine Guns in a handgun shaped housing in the left arm. The addition of a Targeting Computer makes its firepower even more deadly as long as it can get its weapons into range. Eleven Double Heat Sinks, half a ton of machine gun ammunition and one Streak missiles are more than adequate for the average Clan trial.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 蒸汽鹰拥有杂糅而偏近程的武器配置：右臂一门大型脉冲激光，辅以一挺机枪、两具连续 SRM-2 和三门中型脉冲激光分列两侧躯干，左臂手枪形护罩内还有三挺机枪收尾。加装瞄准计算机后，只要武器能进入射程，其火力更为致命。十一台双倍散热器、半吨机枪弹药和一吨连续导弹弹药，对一般的氏族试炼而言绰绰有余。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This variant of the Vapor Eagle removes two of the Medium Pulse Lasers, both Streak Missile pods, and the Large Pulse Laser as well as one of the 'Mechs double heat sinks in exchange for an Ultra Autocannon/10. Mounted in an over the shoulder arrangement like the venerable Shadow Hawk, the weapon fires at twice the rate of a standard Autocannon/10 and carries enough ammunition to continuously fire at its maximum rate of fire for over a minute and a half.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 此蒸汽鹰变体移除两门中型脉冲激光、两具连续导弹荚舱、大型脉冲激光以及一台双倍散热器，换成一门超速自动炮/10。该武器以如同古老的影鹰那样的过肩方式安装，射速是标准自动炮/10 的两倍，并携带足以以最高射速连续射击一分半钟以上的弹药。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Venom was built in direct response to losses suffered by the Draconis Combine and to boost sales for Nimakachi Fusion Products Limited. The 8C carries only standard jump jets and replaces 3 Pulse Lasers with a Snub Nose PPC.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 毒液是为直接回应德拉科尼斯联合体的损失并提振尼玛卡奇聚变产品公司的销量而制造。8C 仅携带标准跳跃推进器，并将 3 门脉冲激光换成短鼻 PPC。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Venom was built in direct response to losses suffered by the Draconis Combine and to boost sales for Nimakachi Fusion Products Limited. This earlier Model trades Jump Capability for a Capacitator boosted Heavy PPC.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 毒液是为直接回应德拉科尼斯联合体的损失并提振尼玛卡奇聚变产品公司的销量而制造。此早期型号以跳跃能力换取一门电容增强的重型 PPC。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Venom was built in direct response to losses suffered by the Draconis Combine and to boost sales for Nimakachi Fusion Products Limited. The company, which at the time was producing only the Spider, was forced to comply with an order by the Coordinator himself that 'Mech manufacturers make up for the losses suffered by the Draconis Combine Mustered Soldiery.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 毒液是为直接回应德拉科尼斯联合体的损失并提振尼玛卡奇聚变产品公司的销量而制造。该公司当时只生产蜘蛛，被迫服从协调官本人的命令：机甲制造商必须弥补德拉科尼斯联合体征募兵部队遭受的损失。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Few assault 'Mechs can really fly, but the Victor 10B is one of 'em. With an Ultra AC/20 and improved Jump Jets, the 10B boasts incredible mobility for its weight, at the cost of some durability.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 能真正"飞"的突击机甲不多，但胜利者 10B 是其中之一。凭借一门超速 AC/20 和改进的跳跃推进器，10B 就其重量而言拥有惊人的机动性，代价是部分耐久性。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An early variant of the Victor, the 9A adds on a Machine Gun and twin Flamers - making it an effective anti-infantry and brawler 'Mech.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为维克多的早期变体，9A 加装一挺机枪和双联火焰喷射器——使它成为高效的反步兵与近战机甲。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Another anti-infantry and brawler variant, the VTR-9A1 adds twin Machine Guns and retains most of its armor.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为另一款反步兵与近战变体，VTR-9A1 加装双联机枪并保留大部分装甲。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Few assault 'Mechs mount Jump Jets, but the Victor 9B is one of 'em. With a large ballistic gun and supporting close-range weaponry, the 9B is a deadly opponent with superior mobility for its size. Unfortunately, this comes at the cost of armor.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 很少有突击机甲装备跳跃推进器，但胜利者 9B 是其中之一。凭借一门大型弹道炮和支援用近程武器，9B 是致命的对手，且就其尺寸而言机动性出众。遗憾的是，这是以装甲为代价换来的。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Victor 9S trades some of its already subpar armor to mount more weaponry. It's terrifying for enemy forces to see this 'Mech rocketing over a hill to unleash its considerable firepower, but it also needs to really worry about any return fire.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 维克多 9S 以其本就不佳的装甲换取更多武器。看到这台机甲从山丘上疾冲而出倾泻可观火力，对敌军而言极为可怕，但它也必须认真地担心任何回击。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Viking began production shortly after the Beowulf in a joint effort by the Free Rasalhague Republic and ComStar. The 'Mech is intended to take over in the role that has been traditionally filled by the Bombardier.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 维京在贝奥武夫之后不久由自由拉萨尔哈格共和国与康星联合投产。这台机甲意在接替传统上由轰炸机担任的角色。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Known as the 'Avenging Angel', the VND-1AA was an attempt to increase the Vindicator's mobility - which succeeded.  However, the cost was to reduce its armor to that of a Light 'Mech.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 号称"复仇天使"的 VND-1AA 试图提升维护者的机动性——这一点成功了。然而代价是把它的装甲削减到轻型机甲的水平。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Vindicator 1Rs tend to deal their damage at range while moving in for closer attacks. Typically well armored, they're capable of some surprise attacks due to their jump capability and above-average heat efficiency.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 维护者 1R 倾向于在远距离输出伤害，同时逐步逼近发动近战。它们通常装甲良好，凭借跳跃能力和高于平均的散热效率，能打出一些出人意料的攻击。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A standardized modification of Michael Jones' St. Ives Blue adopted by the newly formed St. Ives Compact in 3031, the VND-1SIC downgrades the PPC to a Large Laser while upgrading the LRM rack to a LRM-10.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: VND-1SIC 是迈克尔·琼斯"圣艾夫斯蓝"的标准化改装，由新成立的圣艾夫斯共同体于 3031 年采用，它把 PPC 降级为大型激光，同时把 LRM 挂架升级为 LRM-10。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A very minor modification, replacing the Small Laser with a pair of Machine Guns, giving it a little more punch in a close range fight.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一次极小的改装，用一对机枪取代小型激光，让它在近距离战斗中多几分打击力。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 3L variant is a basic upgrade using recovered Star League technology.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 3L 型号是使用回收的星盟科技的基础升级版。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Utilizing a heavier mix of shorter ranged weapons among many of the configurations, the Viper saw success when paired with other light platforms.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 毒蛇的多种配置都偏向更重型的短程武器组合，与其他轻型平台搭配时表现出色。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Utilizing a heavier mix of shorter ranged weapons among many of the configurations, the Viper saw success when paired with other light platforms.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 毒蛇的多种配置都偏向更重型的短程武器组合，与其他轻型平台搭配时表现出色。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Utilizing a heavier mix of shorter ranged weapons among many of the configurations, the Viper saw success when paired with other light platforms.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 毒蛇的多种配置都偏向更重型的短程武器组合，与其他轻型平台搭配时表现出色。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Vulcan is lightly armored at only five tons, though this is typically sufficient when facing infantry forces and its narrow profile makes it a harder target to hit. A cruising speed of 64.8 km/h is enhanced with by six jump jets mounted in the rear of the Vulcan's torso, specially vented to reduce heat build-up in the rear, giving it a jumping range of 180 meters.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 火神装甲轻薄，仅五吨，不过面对步兵部队时通常够用，其狭窄轮廓也使它更难被击中。64.8 公里/小时的巡航速度由六具装在火神躯干后部的跳跃推进器增强，这些喷射器经特殊排气设计以减少后部积热，赋予它 180 米的跳跃距离。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: One of the most common of the Vulcan's early variants, the 5T was introduced a year after the original model debuted. It removes the Autocannon/2 and replaces it with three Maxum medium lasers, using the mass saved to add two additional tons of armor. The majority of the Federated Suns' Vulcans were 5T models.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 5T 是火神早期变体中最常见者之一，在原型号首次亮相一年后推出。它移除自动炮/2，换上三门"马克西姆"中型激光，并用节省的质量增加两吨装甲。联邦太阳系的大多数火神都是 5T 型号。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 5M Vulcan is an upgrade of the 2T version used by House Marik that makes the 'Mech far more effective in close range combat. The 'Mech uses a Crucis-II Delux Endo Steel chassis and removes the autocannon for a Tronel PPL-20 Large Pulse Laser and also upgrades the Medium Laser to a Tronel XII Medium Pulse Laser. Eleven double heat sinks were also incorporated. This version of the Vulcan began production in 3052 and ceased only with the destruction of Nimakachi's Tematagi plant in 3069.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 5M 火神是马里克家族所使用 2T 版本的升级，使机甲在近程战斗中有效得多。机甲采用"十字-II 豪华"内骨骼底盘，移除自动炮换成"特罗内尔 PPL-20"大型脉冲激光，并把中型激光升级为"特罗内尔 XII"中型脉冲激光。还加入了十一台双倍散热器。这款火神于 3052 年开始生产，直到 3069 年尼玛卡奇的特马塔吉工厂被毁才停止。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 5S Vulcan is a 3050 upgrade of the 2T version used by House Steiner which replaces the standard fusion engine with an extralight engine and also upgrades the armor to Lexington Ltd. High Grade Ferro-Fibrous with CASE to protect itself from ammunition explosions. The inclusion of MASC enables the 5S to move up to 129 km/h in short bursts. Additionally, the Autocannon/2 has been replaced with an Imperator Ultra Autocannon/5.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 5S 火神是施泰纳家族所使用 2T 版本的 3050 升级，它把标准聚变引擎换成超轻型引擎，并将装甲升级为列克星敦公司高等级铁纤维，配 C.A.S.E. 以防弹药爆炸。加装 MASC 使 5S 能在短促爆发中移动至 129 公里/小时。此外，自动炮/2 已换成帝皇超速自动炮/5。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An alteration of the 6R model introduced in 2835, the 6D removed the machine guns and the SRM-6 launcher to add an additional four tons of armor to the design, increasing its leg protection, as well as two more heat sinks. The 6D was particularly favored by the Federated Suns.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 6D 是 2835 年推出的 6R 型号改动版，它移除机枪和 SRM-6 发射器，为设计增加四吨装甲（提升腿部防护）以及两台额外散热器。6D 尤其受联邦太阳系青睐。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Another basic modification to the Warhammer, the 6K was favored by the Draconis Combine after its introduction in 2830. The 6K removed the machine guns and their volatile ammunition to make room for two heat sinks, allowing it to more easily dissipate waste heat from its PPCs.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为战锤的另一项基础改装，6K 在 2830 年推出后受到德拉科尼斯联合体的青睐。6K 移除机枪及其易爆弹药以腾出空间安装两台散热器，使它能更轻易地散发 PPC 产生的废热。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 6L was a very basic weapons swap of the 6R model used by Capellan armed forces. Known as the "Hot Hammer" and debuting in 2825, the two machine guns and their ammunition were removed in order to mount two Flamers added for anti-infantry use.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 6L 是卡佩兰武装部队所使用 6R 型号的极基础武器替换。它被称为"热火锤"，于 2825 年首次亮相，移除两挺机枪及其弹药，以安装两具用于反步兵的火焰喷射器。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Warhammer BattleMech was introduced by StarCorps Industries in 2515 to be "a mobile 'Mech with enough firepower to destroy or severely damage any 'Mech of the same weight class or lower." In the mission it was designed for, the Warhammer proved to be a very capable 'Mech, and for centuries practically defined the entire class of heavy 'Mechs. Boasting incredible firepower and respectable armoring, the Warhammer served prominently in the Star League Defense Force and was one of the premier 'Mechs in the Gunslinger Program. Indeed, many of the greatest MechWarriors in history were Warhammer pilots.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 战锤战斗机甲由星团公司于 2515 年推出，定位为"一台具备足够火力摧毁或重创任何同重量级或更低级机甲的机动型机甲"。在其设计所针对的任务中，战锤被证明是一台极为出色的机甲，并在数世纪里几乎定义了整个重型机甲类别。凭借惊人的火力与可观的装甲，战锤在星盟防卫军中表现突出，也是"枪手计划"中的首要机甲之一。事实上，历史上许多最伟大的机甲战士都是战锤飞行员。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Warhammer-6Rb is a variant made for the Star League's Royal regiments. Highly similar to the Warhammer-6R, the -6Rb's differences lie in the armor and heat dissipation systems that have been upgraded to the Star League standard with Ferro-Fibrous and double heat sinks respectively.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 战锤-6Rb 是为星盟皇家团打造的变体。它与战锤-6R 高度相似，-6Rb 的差异在于装甲与散热系统分别升级为星盟标准的铁纤维和双倍散热器。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Warhammer-6Rb was the first Royal Warhammer but the -7A takes the mech to its logical conclusion. With advanced weapons and construction materials, combined with double heat sinks, the Warhammer-7A is a walking death machine for mechs and vehicles alike.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 战锤-6Rb 是首款皇家战锤，但-7A 把这款机甲推向其逻辑终点。凭借先进武器与建造材料，加上双倍散热器，战锤-7A 是行走的死亡机器，对机甲与车辆一视同仁。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The original Warhammer was designed as an assault BattleMech. However, it had been superseded by later and heavier 'Mech designs, though it remained a powerful weapons platform. The Clans wisely maintained and built on this solid frame a real assault 'Mech, the Warhammer IIC. This variant turns the Warhammer IIC into a fire support 'Mech. Clan scientists replaced the Medium Pulse Lasers with a pair of LRM-15s and four tons of ammunition.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 最初的战锤被设计为突击战斗机甲。尽管后来被更重的机甲设计取代，它仍是一个强大的武器平台。氏族明智地在这一坚固框架上维护并建造出真正的突击机甲——战锤 IIC。此变体将战锤 IIC 改造为火力支援机甲。氏族科学家将中型脉冲激光换成两具 LRM-15 和四吨弹药。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The original Warhammer was designed as an assault BattleMech. However, it had been superseded by later and heavier 'Mech designs, though it remained a powerful weapons platform. The Clans wisely maintained and built on this solid frame a real assault 'Mech, the Warhammer IIC. Designed by Clan Diamond Shark, this variant replaces the PPCs and missile launcher of the original design with a pair of arm-mounted Heavy Large Lasers, two additional heat sinks, and a half ton of armor. An advanced Targeting Computer was also added to help ensure that the hard-to-use heavy lasers hit.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 最初的战锤被设计为突击战斗机甲。尽管后来被更重的机甲设计取代，它仍是一个强大的武器平台。氏族明智地在这一坚固框架上维护并建造出真正的突击机甲——战锤 IIC。此变体由钻石鲨氏族设计，将原设计中的 PPC 与导弹发射器换成一对臂载重型大型激光、两台额外散热器和半吨装甲。还加装了先进瞄准计算机以确保难以驾驭的重型激光能够命中。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The original Warhammer was designed as an assault BattleMech. However, it had been superseded by later and heavier 'Mech designs, though it remained a powerful weapons platform. The Clans wisely maintained and built on this solid frame a real assault 'Mech, the Warhammer IIC.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 最初的战锤被设计为突击战斗机甲。尽管后来被更重的机甲设计取代，它仍是一个强大的武器平台。氏族明智地在这一坚固框架上维护并建造出真正的突击机甲——战锤 IIC。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Introduced at the turn of the century, the Warhawk was created by the Smoke Jaguars in anticipation of the Clans’ return to the Inner Sphere.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 战鹰于世纪之交推出，由烟虎氏族为迎接氏族重返内天体而研制。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 战鹰于世纪之交推出，由烟虎氏族为迎接氏族重返内天体而研制。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Though bearing a remarkable outward resemblance to the Timberwolf, this BattleMech is a new and powerful creation. Carrying thirteen tons of ferro-fibrous armor, the Mad Cat MK II is an incredibly resilient design. A pair of arm mounted Gaussrifles supported by torso mounted LRM racks give it complete command over the battlefield.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 虽然外观与森林狼极为相似，这款战斗机甲却是全新而强大的创造。疯猫 MK II 携带十三吨铁纤维装甲，是极为坚固的设计。臂载的双高斯步枪配以躯干搭载的 LRM 挂架，使其能完全掌控战场。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This variant, used by the SLDF, has a LTV 150 engine, slightly lower maximum ground speed (84km/h), a 120 meter jump capability, and replaces the SRM-2 with a rear-facing One-Shot version. In exchange the WSP-100 was equipped with a five ton bomb bay. This Bomb Bay allowed the WSP-100 to carry Arrow IVmissiles and conventional bombs without losing any speed.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 此变体由星盟防卫军使用，配备 LTV 150 引擎，最高地面速度略低（84 公里/小时），跳跃能力 120 米，并将 SRM-2 换成后向的单次发射版本。作为交换，WSP-100 配备了五吨炸弹舱。该炸弹舱使 WSP-100 能在不损失速度的情况下携带箭矢 IV 导弹和常规炸弹。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This version of the Wasp LAM replaces the bomb bay with an LRM-10 launcher and an extra jump jet. This variant was later used as the inspiration for the Valkyrie..
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 此版黄蜂 LAM 以一具 LRM-10 发射器和一台额外跳跃推进器取代弹舱。该变体后来成为女武神的设计灵感。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This variant was designed for the SLDF's "Blackhearts" teams. Based on the standard WSP-100, it replaced the medium laser and bomb bay with an extra jump jet, Medium Pulse Laser, Streak SRM-2, and Guardian ECM Suite. The armor protection was also increased slightly.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 此变体为星盟防卫军"黑心"小队设计。以标准 WSP-100 为基础，它将中型激光和炸弹舱换成一个额外跳跃推进器、一门中型脉冲激光、一具连续 SRM-2 和守护者 ECM 套件。装甲防护也略有增强。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Wasp LAM is similar to the Stinger LAM, maintaining the same ground and air speed. The only real difference is in the armament - the Wasp LAM is armed with a Martell Medium Laser and a Holly SRM-2..
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 黄蜂 LAM 与毒刺 LAM 相似，保持相同的地面与空中速度。唯一真正的差别在武器——黄蜂 LAM 装备一门马特尔中型激光和一具"冬青"SRM-2。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This variant of the "standard" Wasp 105 replaced the SRM-2 and one heat sink with a single LRM-5.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 此型"标准"黄蜂 105 将 SRM-2 和一台散热器换成单具 LRM-5。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Developed by General Mechanics on Mars in 2464 as the first generation Wasp, this version used several primitive components. The primitive engine reduced the top speed to 85 km/h and meant that only a single medium laser was carried. The prototype jump jets could only cover 150 meters in a jump. The primitive armor provided much less protection than the later Succession Wars-era Wasps, even though it carried three and a half tons of armor.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 此版本由通用机械于 2464 年在火星开发，是第一代黄蜂，使用了若干原始组件。原始引擎把最高速度降至 85 公里/小时，且只能携带一门中型激光。原型跳跃推进器一次只能跳 150 米。尽管携带三吨半装甲，原始装甲提供的保护远不如后来的继承战争时代黄蜂。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Best to keep these units moving and at range for flanking and spotting.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 最好让这些单位保持移动并在远距离进行侧翼与侦察。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Developed in response to logistical attrition during the later years of the First Succession War, this House Davion variant developed in 2823 exchanges the SRM-2 launcher for two ChisComp 32 Small Lasers in the left torso and a Olympian Flamer in the left leg. While firing these additional weapons leads to an increased heat output, it is not enough to pose a serious risk.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 为应对第一次继承战争后期后勤损耗而开发，这款达维昂家族于 2823 年推出的变体把 SRM-2 发射器换成左躯干两门 ChisComp 32 小型激光和左腿一具"奥林匹亚"火焰喷射器。虽然发射这些额外武器会导致热量输出增加，但不足以构成严重风险。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Another variant intended to ease logistical requirements as the First Succession War dragged on, House Kurita's 1K Wasp was introduced in 2818, improving protection while sacrificing firepower. It retains the medium laser but replaces the missile launcher with a SperryBrowning Machine Gun and one ton of reloads in the left torso. The saved weight was used to upgrade the armor by half a ton.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为第一次继承战争拖长过程中为缓解后勤需求而设计的另一变体，库瑞塔家族的 1K 黄蜂于 2818 年推出，在提升防护的同时牺牲火力。它保留中型激光，但以左躯干的一挺"斯佩里-勃朗宁"机枪和一吨再装填取代导弹发射器。节省的重量用于把装甲提升半吨。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A variant of the Wasp produced by Hellspoint for House Liao in 2799, the 1L replaced the medium laser and SRM-2 launcher with a single Holly SRM-4 launcher carried in the right arm supplied with a single ton of reloads in the right torso. Envisioning a variant highly adaptable to the raiding actions of the First Succession War, the Capellan Strategios deployed the 1L with multiple munition types based on their intended mission role, such as incendiary or gas SRMs for anti-infantry support or smoke SRMs for recon-concealment. The reduction in overall firepower made the 1L a adequate though not spectacular combatant.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是赫尔斯波因特于 2799 年为廖家族生产的黄蜂变体，1L 把中型激光和 SRM-2 发射器换成装在右臂的一具"冬青"SRM-4 发射器，右躯干配一吨再装填。卡佩兰战略局预想出一款高度适应第一次继承战争劫掠行动的变体，因此按预定任务角色为 1L 配备多种弹药，如用于反步兵支援的燃烧弹或毒气 SRM，或用于侦察隐蔽的烟雾 SRM。整体火力的下降使 1L 成为一台尚可但不出色的战斗单位。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A common Periphery rebuild, this mech is a mix of different weapons systems. A primitive medium laser copied from the original Wasp model provides subpar fire power, backed up by the one shot punch of an RL15. A small calibre rifle makes for a semi effective sniper weapon whilst its ammo lasts. The rest of the mech is almost standard spec, rebuilt by a succession of engineers to specs nearly identical to Inner Sphere counterparts. Surprisingly enough, this rebuild offers somewhat superior capabilities compared to most Inner Sphere models. Produced in any number of Periphery junk yards and back alley chop shops, this mech is incredibly common amongst periphery factions;  who field the mech in vast quantities, praising its cheap firepower and easily repaired chassis.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是一款常见的外围区重建型，混合了不同的武器系统。仿自原版黄蜂的原始中型激光提供欠佳的火力，辅以 RL15 的一次性打击。小口径步枪在弹药耗尽前算是半有效的狙击武器。机甲其余部分几乎是标准规格，由历任工程师重建至与内天体同类几乎相同的规格。相当令人惊讶的是，这款重建型的能力比大多数内天体型号略胜一筹。它在外围区无数废品场和后巷改装铺中生产，在外围势力中极为普遍；这些势力大量列装该机甲，称赞其廉价的火力与易于修理的底盘。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An improved 1-P, this upgrade package uses scavenged tech to improve the 1-Ps scouting ability.  Using minimal upgrades, all purchased or acquired at great cost, this refit package is available for anyone with the contacts or cash to afford it. The new active probe is capable of spotting most threats long before they can see the Wasp, whilst the removal of the RL-15 takes away most of it’s offence punch, it allows for the addition of a knock-off AMS system to better protect the mech. Endo Steel is used to provide the weight savings for the probe, though it’s limited availability and high cost limit the number of these conversions produced. Popular among pilots and the chop shop owners refitting them, this upgrade is expected to spread through the Periphery in the near future, as the technology required becomes easier to acquire.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为改进型 1-P，这套升级套件使用收集来的技术提升 1-P 的侦察能力。它只做最小幅度的升级，所有部件都以高价购得或获取，这套改装套件可供任何有门路或有钱的人使用。新的主动探测器能在大多数威胁看到黄蜂之前很久就发现它们；移除 RL-15 虽然带走了大部分进攻打击力，却允许加装一套仿制 AMS 系统以更好地保护机甲。内骨骼用于为探测器腾出重量，尽管其有限的可得性与高成本限制了此类改装的产量。它在飞行员和改装它们的改装铺老板中都很受欢迎，预计随着所需技术更易获取，这套升级将在不久的将来传遍外围区。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Federated Commonwealth's model of choice starting in 3049, Defiance Industries of Furillo upgraded the chassis to Endo Steel and the armor to three and a half tons of Ferro-Fibrous. This variant carries a Medium Pulse Laser in its right arm, two Defiance B3S small lasers in the right torso, and a Zippo flamer in the left torso.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 联邦联邦自 3049 年起的首选型号，富里洛的迪法恩斯工业把底盘升级为内骨骼，装甲升级为三吨半铁纤维。此变体右臂装一门中型脉冲激光，右躯干两门"迪法恩斯 B3S"小型激光，左躯干一具"芝宝"火焰喷射器。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Associated with Wolf's Dragoons and debuting in 3009, the 1W Wasp replaced all of the weapons with six small lasers, two each split between the right arm, right torso and left torso. While sacrificing long-range capability this gives the 1W superior close-range firepower.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 与狼之龙骑兵相关联、于 3009 年首次亮相的 1W 黄蜂以六门小型激光取代全部武器，右臂、右躯干和左躯干各两门。虽然牺牲了远程能力，但这赋予 1W 更优越的近程火力。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The post-Helm Memory Core House Marik variant introduced in 3051, the 3M Wasp upgrades the chassis to Irian Chassis Second Generation Class 20 Endo Steel and the armor to Ferro-Fibrous. This variant carries an Intek medium pulse laser in its right arm and a single Irian Weapons Works SRM-2 launcher in the right torso. The variant is also equipped with the potent Irian E.A.R. communications system and the Wasat Aggressor targeting-tracking system.[
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 3M 黄蜂是赫尔姆记忆核心之后马里克家族于 3051 年推出的变体，将底盘升级为伊里安底盘第二代 20 级内骨骼，装甲升级为铁纤维。该变体右臂携带一门因泰克中型脉冲激光，右躯干一具伊里安武器工厂 SRM-2 发射器。它还配备强劲的伊里安 E.A.R. 通信系统与瓦萨特侵略者瞄准追踪系统。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Standing at ten meters tall, the Watchman is a 'Mech that was born of necessity. The idea for the design came when the bulk of the AFFS was moved to the Clan front. Because this seriously undermined the ability of the Federated Suns to keep its borders secure, the Watchman was designed to be distributed to militia units within the border marches to bulk up their strength. In its own right the Watchman is a durable and reliable 'Mech that is built with off the shelf components and is very easy to repair. The 'Mech is armored with eight and a half tons of standard armor, has a top speed of 86.4 km/h, and can jump up to one hundred and fifty meters. This, combined with the Watchman's varied arsenal, makes it an excellent trooper or trainer.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 守望者高十米，是一台因需而生的机甲。这一设计的构想出现在 AFFS 主力被调往氏族前线之时。由于这严重削弱了联邦太阳系守备边界的能力，守望者被设计用于分发给边境边疆区的民兵单位以充实其力量。就自身而言，守望者是一台耐用可靠的机甲，采用现货组件建造，极易于修理。机甲披挂八吨半标准装甲，最高速度 86.4 公里/小时，能跳起至一百五十米。加上守望者多样化的武器库，使它成为出色的通用机或训练机。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Whitworth is something of an ugly duckling, known among both critics and fans as the Tin Woodsman. It was originally produced in 2610 as a BattleMech that was meant to fill the weight gap between the lighter Wasp and the heavier Phoenix Hawk 'Mechs. The Whitworth, though, is slower than either of these designs by over 30 km/h and plagued with a faulty actuator system in its hips and legs which could cause the legs to tear loose during strenuous maneuvers. Replacing the actuators would require a complete reworking of the lower half of the torso and leg assembly. However, the Whitworth carried eight tons of armor, utilized four reliable Whitworth Jetlift jump jets split between both legs for improved mobility, and featured excellent long-range firepower. The result was a 'Mech which could stand up in combat to another 'Mech of its equivalent mass and less. The original WTH-1S Whitworth model saw combat in the Age of War, however since it was armed with SRMs, many were lost when their pilots rushed into close-range combat to effectively use them. The Whitworth's lack of hand actuators, low speed curve, poor armor distribution and less-than-effective weapon loadout doomed them to the scrap pile. At the insistence of the Star League, the Whitworth Company replaced these weapons with LRMs in 2689 and the WTH-1 would serve in the Star League Defense Force as an able if mediocre scout and light strike platform. Whitworths often took part in reconnaissance-in-force missions and raids against well-defended areas, often alongside Wolverines and Phoenix Hawks, or provided fire support for heavy attack forces with Riflemans and Warhammers.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 惠特沃斯有点像丑小鸭，被批评者和爱好者共同称为"铁皮伐木工"。它最初于 2610 年生产，旨在填补较轻的黄蜂与较重的凤凰鹰机甲之间的重量空缺。然而惠特沃斯比这两款设计都慢 30 多公里/小时，且髋部与腿部的驱动器系统存在故障，在剧烈机动时可能导致腿部脱落。要更换驱动器，必须彻底重做躯干下半部与腿组。不过惠特沃斯携带八吨装甲，使用四个可靠的惠特沃斯 Jetlift 跳跃推进器（分列双腿）以提升机动性，并具备出色的远程火力。结果是一款能在战斗中与同级乃至更轻的机甲抗衡的机体。最初的 WTH-1S 型惠特沃斯曾在战争时代参战，但由于装备 SRM，许多在飞行员冲入近距离以有效使用时被击毁。惠特沃斯缺乏手部驱动器、速度曲线低、装甲分布不佳以及武器配置不够有效，都注定它被丢进废料堆。在星盟的坚持下，惠特沃斯公司于 2689 年将这些武器换为 LRM，WTH-1 遂作为称职但平庸的侦察与轻型打击平台在星盟防卫军服役。惠特沃斯常参与武力侦察任务和对防御严密地区的突袭，常与狼獾和凤凰鹰同行，或以步枪手和战锤为重装突击部队提供火力支援。

It was originally produced in 2610 as a BattleMech that was meant to fill the weight gap between the lighter Wasp and the heavier Phoenix Hawk 'Mechs. The Whitworth, though, is slower than either of these designs by over 30 km/h and plagued with a faulty actuator system in its hips and legs which could cause the legs to tear loose during strenuous maneuvers. Replacing the actuators would require a complete reworking of the lower half of the torso and leg assembly. However, the Whitworth carried eight tons of armor, utilized four reliable Whitworth Jetlift jump jets split between both legs for improved mobility, and featured excellent long-range firepower. The result was a 'Mech which could stand up in combat to another 'Mech of its equivalent mass and less. The original WTH-1S Whitworth model saw combat in the Age of War, however since it was armed with SRMs, many were lost when their pilots rushed into close-range combat to effectively use them. The Whitworth's lack of hand actuators, low speed curve, poor armor distribution and less-than-effective weapon loadout doomed them to the scrap pile. At the insistence of the Star League, the Whitworth Company replaced these weapons with LRMs in 2689 and the WTH-1 would serve in the Star League Defense Force as an able if mediocre scout and light strike platform. Whitworths often took part in reconnaissance-in-force missions and raids against well-defended areas, often alongside Wolverines and Phoenix Hawks, or provided fire support for heavy attack forces with Riflemans and Warhammers.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 惠特沃斯有点像丑小鸭，被批评者和爱好者共同称为"铁皮伐木工"。它最初于 2610 年生产，旨在填补较轻的黄蜂与较重的凤凰鹰机甲之间的重量空缺。然而惠特沃斯比这两款设计都慢 30 多公里/小时，且髋部与腿部的驱动器系统存在故障，在剧烈机动时可能导致腿部脱落。要更换驱动器，必须彻底重做躯干下半部与腿组。不过惠特沃斯携带八吨装甲，使用四个可靠的惠特沃斯 Jetlift 跳跃推进器（分列双腿）以提升机动性，并具备出色的远程火力。结果是一款能在战斗中与同级乃至更轻的机甲抗衡的机体。最初的 WTH-1S 型惠特沃斯曾在战争时代参战，但由于装备 SRM，许多在飞行员冲入近距离以有效使用时被击毁。惠特沃斯缺乏手部驱动器、速度曲线低、装甲分布不佳以及武器配置不够有效，都注定它被丢进废料堆。在星盟的坚持下，惠特沃斯公司于 2689 年将这些武器换为 LRM，WTH-1 遂作为称职但平庸的侦察与轻型打击平台在星盟防卫军服役。惠特沃斯常参与武力侦察任务和对防御严密地区的突袭，常与狼獾和凤凰鹰同行，或以步枪手和战锤为重装突击部队提供火力支援。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The original Wolfhound model, produced from 3028 until the introduction of the WLF-2 variant. The pre-Helm Memory Core WLF-1's primary weapon is a standard Setanta Large Laser, making its striking distance shorter than that of the later model, while its ten standard heat sinks did not dissipate as much waste heat as the newer double heat sinks used on the WLF-2.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是狼犬的最初型号，自 3028 年生产至 WLF-2 变体问世。赫尔姆记忆核心之前的 WLF-1 主武器是标准"塞坦塔"大型激光，打击距离短于后来的型号，其十台标准散热器散发废热的能力也不如 WLF-2 使用的较新型双倍散热器。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A common field refit employed by some MechWarriors, this model simply removes the rear mounted medium laser and adds an extra heat sink.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是一些机甲战士常用的野战改装，此型号只是移除后向中型激光并加装一台额外散热器。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: As a 'laser boat' the Wolfhound's very basic weapons array frees it from supply lines and allows for superior endurance during extended campaigns. The primary long-range weapon is a Cyclops XII ER Large Laser mounted in the right arm, which allows the Wolfhound to strike at ranges of nearly 600 meters.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为一台"激光平台"，狼犬极为基础的武器阵列使它摆脱了补给线的束缚，在长期战役中拥有卓越的续航能力。主要远程武器是右臂的"独眼巨人 XII"ER 大型激光，使狼犬能在近 600 米的距离上发起攻击。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Introduced in 3052 the WLF-2 Variant upgrades the 10 heat sinks to double strength and the Large laser is upgraded also to ER version.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: WLF-2 变体于 3052 年推出，把 10 台散热器升级为双倍强度，大型激光也升级为 ER 版本。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A Solaris refit of the Wolfhound, trading the energy weapons for a Massive LBX/10, Stealth Gear and a large Claw.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是太阳系 VII 的猎狼犬改装版，用能量武器换得一具巨型 LBX/10、隐形装备和一只大型爪。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Infamously nicknamed the ''Varnay-1R'' the original primitive Wolverine was introduced in 2471.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 原始的原始型狼獾于 2471 年推出，被戏称为"瓦尔内-1R"而臭名昭著。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Wolverine 6K models don't usually include Jump Jets in order to mount more Energy weaponry, Heat Sinks, and armor.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 狼獾 6K 型号通常不装跳跃推进器，以便搭载更多能量武器、散热器和装甲。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 6M boasts an increase in firepower and endurance as a raider by dropping the AC5 and replacing it with a Large Laser.  This also allowed for the addition of another Medium Laser and extra Heat Sinks.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 6M 通过舍弃 AC5 换成一门大型激光，作为劫掠者提升了火力与续航力。这也使得可以再加装一门中型激光和额外散热器。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Wolverine 6Rs are fairly flexible in terms of weaponry ranges, tending somewhat more toward closer engagements. This is supported by their jump capability and pretty decent heat management.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 狼獾 6R 在武器射程上相当灵活，偏向近距交战一些。其跳跃能力和相当不错的散热管理对此形成支撑。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A Taurian variant, the WVR-6T design was created to capitalize on the less expensive ballistic weapons that were readily available within the Concordat to reduce their reliance on Star League member states. The 6T was also meant to act as anti-pirate garrison 'Mech, utilizing its long range AC/5 and LRM-5 combo to engage raiders at range.  While the swap out of the Medium Laser for a Small Laser and the addition of two Machine Guns allow this Wolverine variant to better engage with the light vehicles and infantry common to raiding forces.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为陶里安变体，WVR-6T 的设计意图是利用协约国内易于获得的较廉价实弹武器，以减少对星盟成员国的依赖。6T 也意在充当反海盗驻防机甲，利用其远程 AC/5 与 LRM-5 组合在远距离迎击劫掠者。而把中型激光换成小型激光并加装两挺机枪，则让这款狼獾变体能更好地对付劫掠部队常见的轻型车辆与步兵。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 7D variant of the Wolverine is a major upgrade to the design introduced in 3050 by the Federated Suns' new Nanking factory. The standard engine on the 'Mech was replaced with a Nissan 275 XLversion and the armor has been upgraded to Kallon Unity Weave Ferro-Fibrous material with an extra half-ton added. To increase the Wolverine's speed, MASC has been added, allowing it to move up to 108 km/h in bursts. Finally, the weapons payload has been upgraded as well. The autocannon has been upgraded to a General Motors Nova-5 Ultra Autocannon/5 and the medium laser is now a Sutel Precision Line Medium Pulse Laser. The design retains its jumping capability, as well as the SRM-6, although CASE now protects the SRM reloads
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 狼獾 7D 变体是该设计的重大升级，由联邦太阳系的新南京工厂于 3050 年推出。机甲的标准引擎换成日产 275 XL 版本，装甲升级为卡隆统一编织铁纤维材料并额外增加半吨。为提升狼獾速度，加装了 MASC，使其能在爆发中移动至 108 公里/小时。最后武器配置也得到升级：自动炮升级为通用汽车新星-5 超速自动炮/5，中型激光换为苏特尔精准线中型脉冲激光。设计保留跳跃能力与 SRM-6，不过 SRM 再装填现由 C.A.S.E. 保护

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Star League changed so much from the WVR-6R that they called this the Wolverine II. It carries a similar weapon load but enhanced by the Star League's superior technology, making this a far deadlier machine.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 星盟对 WVR-6R 的改动如此之大，以至于他们把它称为狼獾 II。它携带相似武器载荷，但在星盟优越技术的强化下，成为一台致命得多的机器。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Another major upgrade of the Wolverine, this one for the Combine and first rolling off Marduk's production lines, the 7K model is also built with an XL Engine for power with the saved weight used to increase and upgrade its arsenal.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是狼獾的又一次重大升级，此次为联合体打造，首批从马尔杜克生产线下线。7K 型号同样采用 XL 引擎提供动力，节省的重量用于扩充与升级其武器库。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 7M variant of the Wolverine has aspects of both the 7D and the 7K versions but is much closer to the original model. Introduced by FWDI in 3050 the 'Mech uses an XL engine, which is augmented with MASC, so as to push the machine up to 108 km/h in bursts. The 7M has twelve double heat sinks and, for a weapons package, it carries two Diverse Optics Sunbeam ER Large Lasers in the right arm and two Magna 400P medium pulse lasers in the head mount while retaining the SRM-6 for close range work.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 狼獾 7M 变体兼具 7D 与 7K 版本的特征，但更接近原始型号。该机甲由 FWDI 于 3050 年推出，使用 XL 引擎并配 MASC，可在爆发中把机器推至 108 公里/小时。7M 有十二台双倍散热器，武器方面右臂装两门多元光学"日光束"ER 大型激光，头部安装两门玛格纳 400P 中型脉冲激光，同时保留 SRM-6 用于近战。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This BattleMech was solely designed to spite Clanners' distaste for everything Wolverine.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这款战斗机甲的设计目的只有一个：专门气一气氏族对狼獾一切事物的厌恶。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Wraith marked Curtiss Militech's entry into BattleMech production. When the design was announced, many felt that the design would be little more than a walking water cooler. What the critics got was a shock. The Wraith is a 'Mech that, when properly employed, can wreak havoc on an enemy with its astounding speed and maneuverability. It is built around a massive LTV 385 XL Engine that allows it to reach speeds of just under 119 kph. The Wraith has a simple, yet effective, pulse weapons payload. Pulse laser weaponry allows the Mech to negate most of the side effects on accuracy that are introduced by the Wraith's heavy use of jump jets, making it incredibly accurate and powerful for such a lightly armed Mech.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 幽灵标志着柯蒂斯军工进军战斗机甲生产。该设计公布时，许多人以为它不过是台会走路的水冷器。批评者得到的却是震惊。若运用得当，幽灵能凭借惊人的速度与机动性在敌阵中肆虐。它以庞大的 LTV 385 XL 引擎为核心，速度可达略低于 119 公里/小时。幽灵配有简单却有效的脉冲武器配置。脉冲激光武器能让机甲抵消跳跃推进器大量使用所带来的大部分精度副作用，使这款轻武装机甲变得异常精准而强大。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Wraith marked Curtiss Militech's entry into BattleMech production. When the design was announced, many felt that the design would be little more than a walking water cooler. What the critics got was a shock. The Wraith is a 'Mech that, when properly employed, can wreak havoc on an enemy with its astounding speed and maneuverability. It is built around a massive LTV 385 XL Engine that allows it to reach speeds of just under 119 kph. The Wraith has a simple, yet effective, pulse weapons payload. Pulse laser weaponry allows the Mech to negate most of the side effects on accuracy that are introduced by the Wraith's heavy use of jump jets, making it incredibly accurate and powerful for such a lightly armed Mech. A simple modification of the Wraith, the TR2 simply replaces the Large Pulse Laser with an ER PPC, turning the 'Mech into a highly capable sniper.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 幽灵标志着柯蒂斯军工进军战斗机甲生产。该设计公布时，许多人以为它不过是台会走路的水冷器。批评者得到的却是震惊。若运用得当，幽灵能凭借惊人的速度与机动性在敌阵中肆虐。它以庞大的 LTV 385 XL 引擎为核心，速度可达略低于 119 公里/小时。幽灵配有简单却有效的脉冲武器配置。脉冲激光武器能让机甲抵消跳跃推进器大量使用所带来的大部分精度副作用，使这款轻武装机甲变得异常精准而强大。作为幽灵的简单改型，TR2 仅将大型脉冲激光换成 ER PPC，把机甲变成极具能力的狙击手。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Zeus 5S is an original model Zeus, carrying a similar loadout to the normal -6S but making good use of Star League technology to increase both its hitting power and its heat management, making the -5S a terrifying mech on the battlefield.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 宙斯 5S 是原版宙斯型号，携带与普通-6S 相似的有效载荷，但善用星盟技术同时提升打击力与散热管理，使-5S 成为战场上一台可怕的机甲。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Zeus 5T is an original model Zeus and makes use of Star League technology to make a much more deadly mech. Just as fast as the -6S, the -5T switches the autocannon for a devastating array of energy weapons which combined with the -5T's double heat sinks is a brutal combination.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 宙斯 5T 是原始型号宙斯，利用星盟科技打造成致命得多的机甲。速度与-6S 相同，-5T 把自动炮换成一整套毁灭性的能量武器，配合-5T 的双倍散热器，是极为凶悍的组合。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Zeus 6S-DC moves faster than many other assault 'Mechs and mounts decent long-range weaponry. Its armor is very good, but it can get stuck in a tight spot if forced into closer-range fights.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 宙斯 6S-DC 比许多其他突击机甲都快，并装备不错的远程武器。它的装甲非常好，但若被迫近身作战，可能会陷入困境。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Zeus 6S moves faster than many other assault 'Mechs and mounts decent long-range weaponry. Its armor is very good, but it can get stuck in a tight spot if forced into closer-range fights.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 宙斯 6S 比许多其他突击机甲都快，并装备不错的远程武器。它的装甲非常好，但若被迫近身作战，可能会陷入困境。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A relatively new development, the Zeus 6TS removes the Autocannon and replaces it with a PPC.  To help mitigate the additional heat, 2 Heat Sinks were also added.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 宙斯 6TS 是相对较新的发展，它移除自动炮，换成一门 PPC。为帮助缓解额外热量，还加装了 2 台散热器。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An experiment in logistical support, the Zeus 6Y retains the AC5, but downgrades the LRM15 to a LRM10.  This allowed for the Large Laser to be 'upgraded' to a Binary Laser Cannon.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为后勤支援的一次实验，宙斯 6Y 保留 AC5，但把 LRM15 降级为 LRM10。这使得大型激光得以"升级"为一门双联激光炮。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Zeus IS moves faster than many other assault 'Mech, but mounts mostly low tech, cheap industrial weapons. Still, it's well armoured, and a common sight among the more broke and disgraced units in the Periphery.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 宙斯 IS 比许多其他突击机甲都快，但主要装备低技术、廉价的工业武器。不过它装甲良好，在外围区较穷困落魄的部队中很常见。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This version of the Emperor was a model introduced in the Age of War. It carried an Autocannon/5 in each arm instead of the LB10-Xs that were used in later versions. It also carried sixteen single heat sinks.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 此版皇帝是战锤时代推出的型号。它在每臂装一门自动炮/5，而非后来版本使用的 LB10-X。它还携带十六台单散热器。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This version of the Emperor was a model introduced in the Age of War. It carried an Autocannon/5 in each arm instead of the LB10-Xs that were used in later versions. It also carried sixteen single heat sinks.Restricted Actuators-Right: Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 此版皇帝是战锤时代推出的型号。它在每臂装一门自动炮/5，而非后来版本使用的 LB10-X。它还携带十六台单散热器。限制驱动器-右：下部

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Emperor is one of the earliest assault BattleMechs, dating back to 2502. The Emperor also bears the distinction of being the first 90+ ton BattleMech to mount jump jets (the famed Highlander began production in 2592). In 2612, StarCorps introduced an upgraded Emperor, EMP-6A designed for and distributed exclusively to Star League Defense Forces Royal Units. The Emperor was produced continuously until Marik forces destroyed StarCorps Industries facility with nuclear arms on Son Hoa during the Second Succession War. Production of the Emperor resumed in 3057 alongside the legendary Highlander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 皇帝是最早的突击战斗机甲之一，可追溯至 2502 年。它还享有另一项殊荣：首款装备跳跃推进器的 90 吨以上战斗机甲（著名的高地人于 2592 年开始生产）。2612 年，星团公司推出升级版皇帝 EMP-6A，专为星盟防卫军皇家部队设计并独家供应。皇帝一直持续生产，直到第二次继承战争中马里克部队用核武器摧毁了星团公司在子华星的工厂。皇帝的生产于 3057 年与传奇的高地人一同恢复。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Emperor is one of the earliest assault BattleMechs, dating back to 2502. The Emperor also bears the distinction of being the first 90+ ton BattleMech to mount jump jets (the famed Highlander began production in 2592). In 2612, StarCorps introduced an upgraded Emperor, EMP-6A designed for and distributed exclusively to Star League Defense Forces Royal Units. The Emperor was produced continuously until Marik forces destroyed StarCorps Industries facility with nuclear arms on Son Hoa during the Second Succession War. Production of the Emperor resumed in 3057 alongside the legendary Highlander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 皇帝是最早的突击战斗机甲之一，可追溯至 2502 年。它还享有另一项殊荣：首款装备跳跃推进器的 90 吨以上战斗机甲（著名的高地人于 2592 年开始生产）。2612 年，星团公司推出升级版皇帝 EMP-6A，专为星盟防卫军皇家部队设计并独家供应。皇帝一直持续生产，直到第二次继承战争中马里克部队用核武器摧毁了星团公司在子华星的工厂。皇帝的生产于 3057 年与传奇的高地人一同恢复。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Utilizing locally produced components such as the Kali Yama Big Bore autocannon and Hellion-V medium lasers, the Kali Yama-produced 5M Hunchback is a simple upgrade of the original 4G model that first saw production in 3046. The most notable changes saw the heat sinks upgraded to double-strength models, while the small laser was upgraded to a Sunglow Prism-Optic Small Pulse Laser, and CASE was added to protect against ammunition explosions. The extra weight required to add the newer systems forced Kali Yama to reduced ammunition storage to a single ton of reloads, making it unpopular with MechWarriors and spawning the unofficial HBK-5N variant.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 5M 驼背由卡利亚马生产，使用本地制造的部件如卡利亚马大口径自动炮和海利昂-V 中型激光，是原 4G 型号的简单升级，于 3046 年首次投产。最显著的变化是散热器升级为双倍强度型号，小型激光升级为"日辉"棱镜光学小型脉冲激光，并加装 C.A.S.E. 以防弹药爆炸。加装新系统所需的额外重量迫使卡利亚马把弹药储存减至一吨再装填，这让机甲战士颇为不满，也催生了非官方的 HBK-5N 变体。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Utilizing locally produced components such as the Kali Yama Big Bore autocannon and Hellion-V medium lasers, the Kali Yama-produced 5M Hunchback is a simple upgrade of the original 4G model that first saw production in 3046. The most notable changes saw the heat sinks upgraded to double-strength models, while the small laser was upgraded to a Sunglow Prism-Optic Small Pulse Laser, and CASE was added to protect against ammunition explosions. The extra weight required to add the newer systems forced Kali Yama to reduced ammunition storage to a single ton of reloads, making it unpopular with MechWarriors and spawning the unofficial HBK-5N variant.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Emperor is one of the earliest assault BattleMechs, dating back to 2502. The Emperor also bears the distinction of being the first 90+ ton BattleMech to mount jump jets (the famed Highlander began production in 2592). In 2612, StarCorps introduced an upgraded Emperor, EMP-6A designed for and distributed exclusively to Star League Defense Forces Royal Units. The Emperor was produced continuously until Marik forces destroyed StarCorps Industries facility with nuclear arms on Son Hoa during the Second Succession War. Production of the Emperor resumed in 3057 alongside the legendary Highlander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 皇帝是最早的突击战斗机甲之一，可追溯至 2502 年。它还享有另一项殊荣：首款装备跳跃推进器的 90 吨以上战斗机甲（著名的高地人于 2592 年开始生产）。2612 年，星团公司推出升级版皇帝 EMP-6A，专为星盟防卫军皇家部队设计并独家供应。皇帝一直持续生产，直到第二次继承战争中马里克部队用核武器摧毁了星团公司在子华星的工厂。皇帝的生产于 3057 年与传奇的高地人一同恢复。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Archer 8L is a prototype chassis designed to provide fire support with 2 Arrow IV Launchers loaded with Incendiary Missiles and the newly developed Guardian ECM and Stealth Armor.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 弓箭手 8L 是原型底盘，旨在以 2 具装填燃烧弹的箭矢 IV 发射器，加上新研制的守护者 ECM 与隐形装甲提供火力支援。
重型火力支援 & 防御者

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The C3 variant takes the 'Mech's long range fire support to a new level by removing both of the LRM-15 launchers and replacing them with an Arrow IV artillery system, allowing the Catapult to stay a safe distance from the battlefield.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 此 C3 变体将机甲远程火力支援提升到新层次：拆掉两具 LRM-15 发射器，换成一套箭矢 IV 火炮系统，使投石机得以与战场保持安全距离。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Dragon II is a Heavy BattleMech built by LAW for the armed forces of the Draconis Combine during the post-Jihad era. Built as a successor to the aging Dragon, the 'Mech was designed with Advanced Technology to allow it to handle threats of the new era. The design was phased in as a replacement to the older Dragons, which were nearing the end of their service lives.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 龙 II 是 LAW 为德拉科尼斯联合体武装力量在后圣战时代建造的重型战斗机甲。作为老化的龙的继任者，该机甲以先进技术设计，以应对新时代的威胁。它被逐步引入，以替换寿命将至的老旧龙。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: First unleashed by the Terran Hegemony in 2460, the Helepolis is a ponderous BattleMech designed to deliver artillery fire. The 'Mech was proven ineffective on multiple occasions and, following the destruction of the production facilities in 2775, the design was lost during the Succession Wars. The HEP-2H dates to 2488.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 攻城塔于 2460 年由地球霸权首次推出，是一款笨重的战斗机甲，用于投送炮火。它多次被证明效果不佳，2775 年生产设施被毁后，该设计在继承战争中失传。HEP-2H 可追溯至 2488 年。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Designed by the Explorer Corps to provide heavy fire support in environments unsuited to a normal tank or support unit, the 4E is a field refit that mounts a Thumper Artillery piece in place of the standard AC/20. Removing a mostly superfluous s heat sink, frees up the weight for the 4E retain it’s secondary weaponry should it be engaged by head hunter units. By 3010, the Explorer Corps had entered into a long term contract with Kali Yama Weapons to produce limited numbers of this design under licence. The design spread to other interested parties, after the Corps relaxed their licensing arrangements, following the Scarlet Fist debacle; in which the a lone Corps pilot – Larissa ‘‘Raza’’ Brooks – managed to successfully evaded the pirate band responsible for the destruction of her lance, before stalking them back to their base and levelling it with repeated Thumper volleys in the middle of the night.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 由探险队设计，用于在不适于常规坦克或支援单位的环境提供重型火力支援。4E 是战地改装型，以一门重锤火炮取代标准 AC/20。拆掉一只基本多余的散热器腾出重量，使 4E 在被猎杀单位接战时仍保留次要武器。到 3010 年，探险队已与卡利亚马武器公司签订长期合同，授权限量生产该设计。在"赤拳"事件后，探险队放宽了授权安排，此设计遂扩散至其他有意方；在那次事件中，探险队唯一幸存的飞行员——拉里萨·"拉扎"·布鲁克斯——成功避开了摧毁她小队的海盗团，随后追踪他们回到基地，并在深夜以反复的重锤齐射将基地夷平。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Developed during the Clan Invasion, the 5A takes advantage of the newly reintroduced Arrow IV and an Artemis IV FCS. Intended to operate in support of a lance or as part of a dedicated battery, the 5A carries a mix of homing missiles and utility ammo; enabling it to bombard targets that have been tagged by supporting forces or deploying FASCAM and other speciality ammo as and when needed. Guardian ECM confuses and blinds enemy sensors, vastly reducing the chances of accurate counter battery fire, whilst the use of CASE protects against catastrophic ammunition explosions. Sold to any interested buyer as part of Kali Yama’s contribution to the war effort, the design has been seen all across the Inner Sphere and is increasingly found in the Periphery, where reliable and cheap Artillery assets are in high demand.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 5A 在氏族入侵期间开发，利用了新近重新引入的箭矢 IV 与 Artemis IV 火控系统。它旨在支援一个小队或作为专用炮组的一员，混合携带寻的导弹与多用途弹药；既能轰击被友军标记的目标，也能按需布撒 FASCAM 等特种弹药。守护者 ECM 扰乱并致盲敌方传感器，大幅降低其精准反炮击的可能，而 C.A.S.E. 的使用则防止灾难性的弹药爆炸。作为卡利亚马对战争努力的贡献，该设计向任何有意买家出售，已遍布内天体，并越来越多地出现在对可靠廉价火炮资产需求旺盛的外围区。
箭矢 IV 火力平台

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Combining elements of the 4H and 4J 'Swaybacks', the HBK-4N uses an AC5 and two LRM-5s to give it range, while the four Medium Lasers give it punch up close.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: HBK-4N 融合了 4H 与 4J"驼背佬"的元素，用一门 AC5 和两具 LRM-5 提供射程，四门中型激光则负责近身打击。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Debuting in 3063, the 5E is a Word of Blake designed upgrade to the older 4E design. Intended for deployment with Protectorate Militia units and Free Worlds League formations, the Blakists sought to rebuild the design with newer technology and correct some of the flaws apparent in the older design. Installing a new Light Fusion Engine and Endo Steel enabled the designers to swap the Thumper for the much larger and more powerful Sniper Artillery Canon. Defensively the design mounts CASE to protect against the ammunition explosions that plagued the older 4E model. A swap to ER Lasers and DHS round out the design, giving it increased range and striking power. Popular with Hunchback pilots and Artillery units, the design is slated for continuous production; with Kali Yama having to expand their Hunchback line to keep up with demand.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 5E 于 3063 年亮相，是布雷克之言为较老的 4E 设计所作的升级。为在保护国民兵单位与自由世界联盟编队中部署，布雷克派谋求用更新的技术重建该设计，并纠正旧设计中明显的缺陷。安装新的轻型聚变引擎与内骨骼，使设计师得以把重锤换成大得多、威力也强得多的狙击炮。防御方面，该设计装设 C.A.S.E. 以防困扰旧 4E 型号的弹药爆炸。激光换成 ER 型号并配 DHS，为设计收尾，赋予其更远的射程与更强的打击力。它受驼背飞行员与炮兵单位欢迎，被排入持续生产；卡利亚马不得不扩建其驼背生产线以满足需求。
