Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We call the Cataphract a "FrankenMech" because it's got a little bit of everything stitched together on it. The 1X model works well at medium-long to closer range, with good armor and weaponry.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们称铁甲舰为"拼装机甲"，因为它把五花八门的东西缝在了一起。1X 型号在中远到较近距离都表现出色，装甲与武器俱佳。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The longest ranged weapon carried by the CTF-3D Cataphract is a General Motors Nova-5 Ultra AC-5 in its right arm, boasting a rate of fire twice that of a standard autocannon. This is backed up by a Mydron Excel LB-X Autocannon/10 in its right torso, capable of firing both solid and cluster rounds. It is a more popular weapon than the Ultra AC-5, especially for use in an anti-conventional and anti-aircraft role without the possibility of jamming. Finally, the 'Mech has four Intek Medium Lasers for close range defense, one in each arm firing forward and two in its torso covering the rear. With only two tons of ammo for the LB-X 10 and one ton for the Ultra, if it runs dry the Cataphract must fall back to be reloaded before continuing the fight. Eleven tons of armor combined with CASE allowed the Cataphract to easily absorb damage. Sixteen heat sinks keep it cool while four HildCo Model 12 jump jets gave it a jumping distance of one hundred and twenty meters. Room for these improvements was made by using a GM 280 XL Engine.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: CTF-3D 铠装骑兵携带的最远射程武器是右臂的一门通用汽车"新星-5"超速 AC-5，射速是标准自动炮的两倍。它由右躯干一门迈德龙 Excel LB-X 自动炮/10 支援，可发射实心弹与集束弹。它比超速 AC-5 更受欢迎，尤其用于反常规与防空任务且不会卡壳。最后，机甲有四门英泰克中型激光用于近程防御，每臂一门向前，躯干两门覆盖后方。LB-X 10 只有两吨弹药、超速炮一吨，一旦打空，铠装骑兵必须后撤装填才能继续作战。十一吨装甲结合 C.A.S.E. 使铠装骑兵能轻易吸收伤害。十六台散热器使其保持低温，四个希尔德科 12 型跳跃推进器赋予它一百二十米的跳跃距离。这些改进所需的空间来自一台 GM 280 XL 引擎。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Produced by the Capellans based on stolen Davion designs, the 3L is an upgraded version of the Cataphract that follows more in line with the prototype 1X model. It is propelled by an XL Engine with MASC instead of jump jets allowing it to reach speeds of 86.4 km/h in short bursts. While it is also armed with an LB-X Autocannon/10 as its primary weapon this is instead matched with a Ceres Arms Warrior ER PPC for powerful striking capabilities at long range. Other differences include the use of four Medium Pulse Lasers and double heat sinks in place of the standard models. This design was produced by the Confederation at Grand Base following the ascension of Chancellor Romano Liao.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 3L 由卡佩兰人基于窃取的达维昂设计生产，是铁甲舰的升级版，更贴近原型 1X 型号。它由配 MASC 的 XL 引擎驱动而非跳跃推进器，可在短促爆发中达到 86.4 公里/小时。虽然主武器同为 LB-X 自动炮/10，但它改配一门谷神星军械"战士"ER PPC，具备强大的远程打击能力。其他差异包括使用四门中型脉冲激光和双倍散热器取代标准型号。此设计在罗曼诺·廖大臣登位后由邦联在格兰德基地生产。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The C3 variant takes the 'Mech's long range fire support to a new level by removing both of the LRM-15 launchers and replacing them with an Arrow IV artillery system, allowing the Catapult to stay a safe distance from the battlefield.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 此 C3 变体将机甲远程火力支援提升到新层次：拆掉两具 LRM-15 发射器，换成一套箭矢 IV 火炮系统，使投石机得以与战场保持安全距离。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An upgrade of the C4 model. The standard fusion engine is replaced with an extralight engine. With the extra freed tonnage, a large laser and Beagle Active Probe can be mounted. The two Small Lasers are replaced with a single pulse version. The heat sinks are upgraded to double strength models.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: C4 型号的升级。标准聚变引擎换成超轻型引擎。凭借腾出的额外吨位，可安装一门大型激光和一具比格犬主动探测器。两门小型激光换成一门脉冲版本。散热器升级为双倍强度型号。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An upgrade of the C3 model, this variant first appeared during the St. Ives Conflict. It retains the Arrow IV artillery system, but its chassis has been upgraded to Endo Steel and its heat sinks to improved versions. This allows the C5 to increase its armor coverage to twelve and a half tons, upgrade its lasers to ER Medium Lasers, and quadruple the amount of ammo carried with protection provided by CASE.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 此变体是 C3 型号的升级版，首次出现在圣艾夫斯冲突期间。它保留箭矢 IV 火炮系统，但底盘升级为内骨骼，散热器升级为改进型。这使 C5 能把装甲覆盖增至十二吨半，将激光升级为 ER 中型激光，并把弹药携带量翻两番，同时以 C.A.S.E. 提供保护。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The CattleMaster was created at the turn of the thirty-first century as an IndustrialMech to handle large herd animals. The concept for the Rancher 'Mech dates back to the twenty-fourth century. The 'Mech is noted for its durability and flexible Internal Combustion Engine.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 牧牛人于三十一世纪之交被制造为工业机甲，用于处置大型畜群。这类"牧场主"机甲的概念可追溯至二十四世纪。此机甲以其耐用性和灵活的内燃引擎著称。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A heavier 55-ton version of the venerable Centurion, the CN10-B was built in 3057 and uses an Endo Steel chassis to save weight on the design while retaining the CN9-A's original ground speed through the use of a 220-rated standard fusion engine. Much like the CN9-D, the 10-B carries an LB-X Autocannon/10 as its primary weapon with an LRM-10 launcher with an Artemis IV fire control system, but these are backed up by a medium laser and a medium pulse laser.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: CN10-B 是经典百夫长的 55 吨加重版本，于 3057 年建造，使用内骨骼底盘为设计减重，同时通过 220 额定标准聚变引擎保留 CN9-A 原有的地面速度。与 CN9-D 十分相似，10-B 以一门 LB-X 自动炮/10 为主武器，配一具带 Artemis IV 火控系统的 LRM-10 发射器，另有中型激光和中型脉冲激光作为后备。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This radical modification looks to turn the Charger into a traditional assault 'Mech by reducing the 'Mechs speed to 54 km/h, which allows the use of a smaller engine (incidentally, the commonplace Pitban 240 reactor). The 'Mech is armored with fifteen and a half tons of armor and is armed with four Large Lasers, one in each arm and side torso, and a Medium Laser in its head; twenty-eight heat sinks kept the 'Mech cool.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这项激进的改装试图把冲锋者变成传统的突击机甲：将机甲速度降至 54 公里/小时，从而得以使用更小的引擎（顺带一提，是常见的皮特班 240 反应堆）。机甲披挂十五吨半装甲，武装为四门大型激光（每臂与每侧躯干各一）以及头部一门中型激光；二十八台散热器使机甲保持凉爽。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Draconis Combine's 3K was an upgrade of the 1A9 that used an uprated XL engine to raise the Charger's top speed back to 86.4 km/h. The head-mounted small laser was removed, the medium lasers were swapped out for Medium Pulse Lasers, and the LRM-20 launcher was mated with an Artemis IV fire control system to improve accuracy. The addition of a fifth jump jet mounted in the rear torso gave the 'Mech a jumping distance of up to one hundred and fifty meters. This variant was confirmed to have been deployed on An Ting in the War of 3039 and may have been what Davion forces initially dubbed the Charger II; however, descriptions of the Charger II suggest that it was more likely a LRM-equipped variant of the Hatamoto-Chi (presumably the -Kaze).
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 联合体的 3K 是 1A9 的升级版，使用升级的 XL 引擎把冲锋者最高速度重新提升至 86.4 公里/小时。头部小型激光被移除，中型激光换成中型脉冲激光，LRM-20 发射器配以 Artemis IV 火控系统以提升精度。在后躯干加装的第五个跳跃推进器使机甲跳跃距离达一百五十米。该变体被证实曾在 3039 年战争中部署于安廷，也许正是达维昂部队最初称为冲锋者 II 的机型；不过对冲锋者 II 的描述表明，它更可能是旗本-血的 LRM 装备变体（推测是-风）。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An upgrade of the 3K, the Charger C was modified to carry a C3 Slave unit that allowed it to share targeting data with other 'Mechs in its unit. In order to add the slave unit, a medium pulse laser had to be removed from the design. The left over mass went towards extra ammunition for the LRM launcher.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为 3K 的升级，冲锋者 C 经改装携带一台 C3 从属单元，使其能与本单位的其他机甲共享瞄准数据。为加装从属单元，必须从设计中移除一门中型脉冲激光。剩下的质量用于为 LRM 发射器增加额外弹药。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A succession wars attempt at turning the Cicada into a fire support platform, the 3D is widely considered as failure. Armed with 2 lrm-5's and 2 medium lasers, it relies on a 280 rated engine to fit the heavier arsenal. Despite possessing more firepower and armour than other Cicada models, it's lack of speed and raw fire proved a major draw back and only a few survived through succession wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是继承战争时期把蝉改造为火力支援平台的尝试，3D 被普遍认为是失败之作。它装备 2 具 lrm-5 和 2 门中型激光，依靠一台 280 额定引擎来容纳更重的武器库。尽管拥有比其他蝉型号更多的火力与装甲，它缺乏速度与原始打击力成为主要缺点，只有少数在继承战争中幸存。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: When General Aleksandr Kerensky led most of the Star League Defense Force into exile in 2784, they brought prototypes of the Clint BattleMech with them. After the annihilation of Clan Wolverine, Clan Snow Raven revisited these prototypes and was able to begin mass-production of the 'Mech in 2830 and introduced 2842. They ensured that it kept up with advances in Clan technology, eventually becoming the design that is now known as the Clint IIC. This speedy medium 'Mech is armed with a Type KOV LB-10X Autocannon and a pair of Series 2d ER Medium Lasers. This makes the Clint IIC an effective light 'Mech killer. It is capable of ranging far beyond supply lines thanks to its four tons of ammunition, though it only uses ten standard heat sinks and seven tons of standard armor.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 2784 年亚历山大·克伦斯基将军率领星盟防卫军大部流亡时，带上了克林特战斗机甲的原型机。在狼獾氏族被灭绝后，雪鸦氏族重新审视这些原型，于 2830 年得以开始量产并于 2842 年推出。他们确保其跟上氏族技术的进步，最终演变为如今被称为克林特 IIC 的设计。这款高速中型机甲装备一门 KOV 型 LB-10X 自动炮和两门 2d 系列 ER 中型激光，使其成为高效的轻型机甲杀手。凭借四吨弹药，它能远离补给线长期作战，不过它仅使用十台标准散热器和七吨标准装甲。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: During the Amaris Civil War, several Lyran MechWarriors joined the SLDF in defiance of their government's policy of neutrality. With this came the coup that the Star League Defense Force had attempted to pull off for decades: the acquisition of the Lyran Commando. Long considered one of the better scout 'Mechs in the Inner Sphere, at least one of these Commandos accompanied Kerensky into exile and several of them appeared in the forces assigned to Operation Klondike. As newer weapons and 'Mechs made their way into the Clan arsenal, these Commandos began to show their age, so Clan Goliath Scorpion began a program to upgrade theirs. Dubbed the Commando IIC, this upgrade used newer technologies to outperform its venerable cousin. With the proliferation of OmniMechs, most Commando IICs were relegated to second line status, though the Scorpions still continue to outfit some of their pirate hunters with these 'Mechs.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 阿马里斯内战期间，数名莱兰机甲战士不顾政府中立政策加入星盟防卫军。随之而来的是星盟防卫军数十年来一直试图实现的目标：获得莱兰突击队。突击队长期被视为内天体最好的侦察机甲之一，至少有一台随克伦斯基流亡，数台出现在"克朗代克行动"的部队中。随着更新式武器与机甲进入氏族武库，这些突击队开始显露老态，于是歌利亚蝎氏族启动了升级计划。命名为突击队 IIC，该升级利用更新技术超越了它古老的表亲。随着全能机甲普及，大多数突击队 IIC 退居二线，但蝎氏族仍继续用它们装备部分猎杀海盗的部队。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A sleek, mobile, and versatile design, the Clan hellhound was long suspected to be one of the first OmniMechs produced by the Clans.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为一款流线型、机动且多用途的设计，氏族地狱犬长期被认为是最早由氏族生产的全能机甲之一。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Considered to be a middleweight machine compared to the heavier Mackies and Ymirs already in circulation, the Crossbow was built to be a fast missile support unit. As was the case with the Coventry Defense Conglomerate, Arcturan Arms’ engineers initially failed to make their prototype Crossbow live up to expectations, but as the techniques for producing BattleMechs grew more refined, the Crossbow received an upgrade worthy of its original concept.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 与当时已在使用的更重型的麦基和伊米尔相比，弩弓被视为中量级机体，被造成快速导弹支援单位。与考文垂防务集团的情况类似，大熊座军械的工程师最初未能让原型弩弓达到预期，但随着战斗机甲生产技术日趋精良，弩弓获得了与其原始构想相称的升级。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Developed during the Golden Century by Clan Steel Viper as an early second-generation OmniMech, the Crossbow is a relatively cheap OmniMech. The Crossbow was Clan Steel Viper's first attempt to crash-start their OmniMech manufacturing capability, and was initiated in part by a small cadre of captured Clan Snow Raven scientist caste.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 弩弓是钢蛇氏族在黄金世纪开发的早期第二代全能机甲，造价相对低廉。它是钢蛇氏族首次尝试速成其全能机甲制造能力，部分工作由一小批被俘的雪鸦氏族科学家种姓发起。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Developed during the Golden Century by Clan Steel Viper as an early second-generation OmniMech, the Crossbow is a relatively cheap OmniMech. Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A variant of the Crusader concentrating on lessening its heat burden, the 3K was introduced by the Draconis Combine in 2765. It downsized the LRM launchers to LRM-10 models and removed the machine guns to make room for an additional six heat sinks.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为专注减轻热负担的十字军变体，3K 由德拉科尼斯联合体于 2765 年推出。它把 LRM 发射器缩小为 LRM-10 型号，并移除机枪，以腾出空间安装另外六台散热器。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 3L variant of the Crusader takes concepts from both the 3D and the 3K models to save weight with a twist. Built for the Capellan Confederation starting in 2753, the 'Mech has removed the LRM-15 and SRM-6 launchers and replaced them with two LRM-10 launchers and two SRM-4 launchers. This frees up room for two additional heat sinks as well as the inclusion of four GM Jetstar jump jets, two each in either side torso, giving it a jumping distance of one hundred and twenty meters.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 十字军 3L 变体借鉴 3D 与 3K 两种型号的思路来减重，并别出心裁。它自 2753 年起为卡佩兰邦联建造，移除了 LRM-15 和 SRM-6 发射器，换成两具 LRM-10 和两具 SRM-4 发射器。这腾出空间容纳两台额外散热器，并加装四个通用"喷气星"跳跃推进器（两侧躯干各两个），使其跳跃距离达一百二十米。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A field modification kit based on the 3K variant and introduced for Kuritan forces in 3049, the 4K removes two heat sinks and replaces the two medium lasers of the 3K with Magna 400P medium pulse models.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 4K 是基于 3K 变体的野战改装套件，于 3049 年引入库瑞塔部队，它移除两台散热器，并把 3K 的两门中型激光换成玛格纳 400P 中型脉冲型号。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The original version of the Dervish that was produced in 2520 was not up to the same standards as contemporary Terran Hegemony designs. The use of comparatively "primitive" parts resulted in a heavier cockpit, engine, and less efficient armor. Consequently, the 1S had a top speed of 64 km/h and could only jump ninety meters. While the missile launchers were the same as the 6M, it did not have that version's lasers. 1S variants continued to exist in militias, but were raided for parts during the Succession Wars. It was not intended for front line use, but for Militia units.  Though there were few, if any, remaining by the end of the 2990s, they once again began to be produced on low-tech worlds during the Jihad due to that conflict's disruption of supply lines.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 2520 年生产的原版苦行僧未达到当时地球霸权设计的同等标准。使用相对"原始"的部件导致驾驶舱与引擎更重、装甲效率更低。因此 1S 的最高速度为 64 公里/小时，且只能跳九十米。虽然导弹发射器与 6M 相同，但它没有该型号的激光。1S 变体继续存在于民兵部队中，但在继承战争期间被拆解取件。它并非为前线使用而设计，而是供民兵单位使用。尽管到 2990 年代末所剩无几，圣战期间由于供应链被打断，低技术世界再次开始生产它们。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Dervish IIC, a 55-ton Clan refit of the Star-League-era Dervish, was first seen in 3058 along the Smoke Jaguar front bordering the Draconis Combine. It has similar movement and jump capabilities to the original Dervish, but carries significantly more firepower.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 苦行僧 IIC 是星盟时代苦行僧的 55 吨氏族改装版，于 3058 年首次出现在烟虎氏族与德拉科尼斯联合体接壤的前线。它的移动与跳跃能力与原版苦行僧相似，但火力显著更强。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Dire Wolf is one of the OmniMechs that became feared throughout the Inner Sphere during the initial Clan Invasion and rightly so. The Dire Wolf weighs in at an impressive one hundred tons and has a relatively slow cruising speed of 54 km/h provided by a 300 XL engine. Its speed and armor protection matches that of an Atlas, but it has superior potential firepower with fifty and a half tons of free pod space for weapons and equipment. It is these traits which saw the 'Mech christened Daishi (pseudo-Japanese for 'Great Death') by the criminal underbelly of the Draconis Combine, a name that would be proven grimly accurate time and time again.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 恐狼是氏族入侵初期令整个内天体闻之色变的全能机甲之一，实至名归。它重达惊人的一百吨，由 300 XL 引擎驱动，巡航速度相对缓慢，仅 54 公里/小时。它的速度与装甲防护与阿特拉斯相当，但凭借五十吨半的自由吊舱空间搭载武器与装备，拥有更强的火力潜力。正因如此，德拉科尼斯联合体的黑道将其命名为"大师"（伪日语"伟大的死亡"），而这名字一次又一次被证明冷酷地精准。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A simple direct fire configuration of the Dire Wolf, the H configuration carries a pair of Gauss Rifles as its primary long range weaponry. These are backed up by two Heavy Large Lasers for medium to short ranges. Finally, for short range combat, the H configuration has a Medium Pulse Laser and a Flamer. All of this configuration's weapons are linked to a Targeting Computer, increasing their accuracy.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 恐狼 H 配置是一款简单的直射配置，携带两门高斯步枪作为主要远程武器。它们由两门重型大型激光支援中近距离。最后，近战方面 H 配置有一门中型脉冲激光和一具火焰喷射器。此配置的所有武器都联动一台瞄准计算机，以提升精度。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The S configuration is intended for the close confines of urban and jungle warfare. The S configurations primary weapon is a massive LB-X Autocannon/20 which is capable of disabling most light and medium 'Mechs in a single blast. This is backed up by a single Large Pulse Laser to provide some long range firepower should the Dire Wolf S be caught in the open. Additional short range firepower is provided by five Medium Pulse Lasers and two Streak SRM-4 launchers. Two Anti-Personnel Pods and two Machine Guns provide exceptional anti infantry capabilities. The S configuration has added mobility with three jump jets allowing it to jump up to ninety meters.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: S 配置为城市与丛林战的狭窄环境而设。S 配置的主武器是一门巨型 LB-X 自动炮/20，能一击瘫痪大多数轻中型机甲。它辅以一门大型脉冲激光，若恐狼 S 身陷开阔地可提供一些远程火力。额外近程火力来自五门中型脉冲激光和两具连续 SRM-4 发射器。两个反人员荚舱和两挺机枪提供出色的反步兵能力。S 配置通过三个跳跃推进器提升机动性，可跳跃至九十米。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This Wolf's Dragoons variant is effective at both long and short range. For long range, it uses a Gauss Rifle, an ER Large Laser, and an LRM-20. At close range, an Ultra Autocannon/20, ER Small Laser, and a pair of Medium Pulse Lasers provide devastating firepower. Twenty double heat sinks allow the design to almost continually fire all of its weapons.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这款狼之龙骑兵变体在远程与近程都很有效。远程使用一门高斯步枪、一门 ER 大型激光和一具 LRM-20。近程则由一门超速自动炮/20、一门 ER 小型激光和一对中型脉冲激光提供毁灭性火力。二十台双倍散热器使该设计几乎能持续发射全部武器。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This variant carries a Targeting Computer to guide the fire of a Large Pulse Laser, Heavy Medium Laser, twin ER Micro Lasers, an Ultra AC/10 and the solid shot of an LB 5-X autocannon. To provide missile support, the Daishi X carries an ATM 6 with a ton of each ammunition type, a head mounted Streak SRM-2, and an SRM-4 and LRM-15. The SRM-4 and LRM-15 are each equipped with an Artemis IV FCS.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 此变体携带一台瞄准计算机，用于引导一门大型脉冲激光、一门重型中型激光、两门 ER 微型激光、一门超速 AC/10 以及一门 LB 5-X 自动炮的实心弹。为提供导弹支援，大石 X 携带一具 ATM 6（每种弹药各一吨）、一门头部安装的连续 SRM-2，以及一具 SRM-4 和一具 LRM-15。SRM-4 与 LRM-15 均配备 Artemis IV 火控系统。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 5N variant of the Dragon was used as a bridge between it and the Grand Dragon. This field upgrade, which utilizes formerly lost technology, upgrades its normal autocannon to an Ultra Autocannon/5, which is capable of firing at twice the rate of a standard model. Additionally, the rear facing Medium Laser has been removed from the 'Mech.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 龙的 5N 变体是它与大龙之间的过渡型号。这项野战升级利用了曾经失传的技术，将普通自动炮升级为超速自动炮/5，射速可达标准型号的两倍。此外，机上的后向中型激光被移除。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Once fielded in great numbers by the Smoke Jaguars, the Ebon Jaguar has proliferated to many of Kerensky's Clans, though some, like the Wolves, Jade Falcons and Coyotes, continue to field Hellbringers instead.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 黑玉美洲豹曾由烟虎氏族大量装备，如今已扩散至克伦斯基的众多氏族，不过狼、翡翠猎鹰与郊狼等氏族仍继续装备地狱使者。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Once fielded in great numbers by the Smoke Jaguars, the Ebon Jaguar has proliferated to many of Kerensky's Clans, though some, like the Wolves, Jade Falcons and Coyotes, continue to field Hellbringers instead.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 黑玉美洲豹曾由烟虎氏族大量装备，如今已扩散至克伦斯基的众多氏族，不过狼、翡翠猎鹰与郊狼等氏族仍继续装备地狱使者。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The standard against which all battle armor is measured, the Elemental battle armor was first introduced in 2868 by Clan Wolf in a Trial of Possession against the Nova Cats. It was a marvel of Clan engineering that allowed a small group of operators to take down large 'Mechs and survive the encounter. While it is possible for a normal-sized human to use the battle armor, this design is tailored for the Clans' giant Elemental warriors and only they can bring out its fullest potential.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 元素战斗装甲是所有战斗装甲的衡量标准，由狼氏族于 2868 年在对抗诺瓦猫的占有试炼中首次推出。它是氏族工程的奇迹，能让一小队操作员击倒大型机甲并幸存下来。虽然普通体型的人也能使用这种战斗装甲，但该设计是为氏族巨人般的元素战士量身打造，唯有他们才能发挥其全部潜力。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The standard against which all battle armor is measured, the Elemental battle armor was first introduced in 2868 by Clan Wolf in a Trial of Possession against the Nova Cats. It was a marvel of Clan engineering that allowed a small group of operators to take down large 'Mechs and survive the encounter. While it is possible for a normal-sized human to use the battle armor, this design is tailored for the Clans' giant Elemental warriors and only they can bring out its fullest potential.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Emperor is one of the earliest assault BattleMechs, dating back to 2502. The Emperor also bears the distinction of being the first 90+ ton BattleMech to mount jump jets (the famed Highlander began production in 2592).
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 皇帝是最早的突击战斗机甲之一，可追溯至 2502 年。它还享有另一项殊荣：首款装备跳跃推进器的 90 吨以上战斗机甲（著名的高地人于 2592 年开始生产）。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Developed by Cappellan Engineers just before the Clan Invasion, this Emperor is a retrofit of the standard 5A. Armed with the newly introduced Arrow IV launcher and a pair of large lasers, the 5B is built to provide fire support at long range.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这款皇帝由卡佩兰工程师在氏族入侵前夕开发，是标准 5A 的改装型。它装备新推出的箭矢 IV 发射器和两门大型激光，5B 旨在提供远程火力支援。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Executioner A reduces the overall engagement ranges compared to its PRIME variant by dropping the Gauss Rifle and replacing it with a massive collection of Large Pulse Lasers, backed up by four ERML's. This variant is the nightmare for every light mech out there.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 与主型号相比，行刑者 A 缩短了总体交战距离：它去掉高斯步枪，换成一大批大型脉冲激光，辅以四门 ER 中型激光。此变体是外面所有轻型机甲的噩梦。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Jack-of-all-trades variant. The Executioner B is set up to be effective in all ranges the battlefield can offer. With an ERPPC for extreme and long ranges and an absolutely devastating UAC/20 for closer range brackets, the B just executes its foes by brute force. Advanced targeting systems will make sure that there is nowhere to run...nowhere to hide.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 样样通吃的变体。行刑者 B 被设定为在战场能提供的所有射程上都有效。极端与远程有 ER PPC，较近射程则有绝对毁灭性的 UAC/20，B 以蛮力处决它的敌人。先进瞄准系统确保无处可逃……无处可藏。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Sometimes you just need to lob some missiles at them. The Executioner C trades direct hit firepower of its sister variants for a set of Artemis IV guided Long Range Missiles. But for everyone who believes to be able to sneak up on this monster: be warned it still fields the massive close range punch in form of an UAC/20.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 有时你就是需要朝他们甩几发导弹。行刑者 C 以一套 Artemis IV 制导远程导弹取代其姊妹变体的直击火力。但要提醒所有以为能偷偷接近这头怪物的人：它仍然以 UAC/20 的形式保留着庞大的近距离打击力。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Fast, precise, deadly. The Executioner D(isco) makes use of its phenomenal agility to close in on its enemies...just to unleash a hell of fire on them in form of pulse lasers in all colors and sizes. LPL, MPL, SPL ... you name it, the EXE-D has it. Pilots be warned though, you better bring som chilled drinks as this one is running HOT!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 快速、精准、致命。行刑者 D(isco) 利用其惊人的灵活性逼近敌人…只为用各种颜色与尺寸的脉冲激光向它们倾泻地狱之火。LPL、MPL、SPL…你能想到的，EXE-D 都有。不过要提醒飞行员：最好带上些冰镇饮料，因为这家伙跑起来很热！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: In a logical step up from other, earlier variants the Executioner E sticks with the idea of being effective and deadly at all ranges. ERLLs and ATMs will grant massive firepower at long and medium ranges while a bunch of Heavy Medium and Heavy Small Lasers will grant close perimeter defense...or the bit of extra damage to finish an already damaged oponent.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 行刑者 E 是对其他早期变体的合理升级，坚持在所有距离上都有效而致命。ER 大型激光和 ATM 将在远距离与中距离提供巨量火力，而一批重型中型激光和重型小型激光将提供近距离环形防御…或者用于给已受损对手补上那一点额外伤害。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Fast and powerful, the Executioner, known as the Gladiator in the Inner Sphere, is an assault OmniMech developed by Clan Ghost Bear. As one of the fastest assault mechs available, the Executioner surprises its prey by being able to alter the engagement ranges way quicker than expected from a mech of this weight. The Executioner PRIME uses its speed to stay at distance to make full use of its long range weaponry.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 行刑者快速而强大，在内天体被称为角斗士，是由鬼熊氏族开发的突击全能机甲。作为可用的最快突击机甲之一，行刑者能比人们对该重量机甲的预期更快地改变交战距离，从而突袭猎物。行刑者主型号利用其速度保持距离，以充分发挥远程武器的威力。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The original Firebee used a single LRM-5 backed up by a trio of SRM-2s. The Primitive Engine provided a top speed of 85 km/h, more than enough to engage armored vehicles and infantry, and supporting heavier units. The lack of jump jets, combined with six and a half tons of Primitive Armor, forced pilots to pay attention to the terrain to insure they could move effectively.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 原版火蜂使用一具 LRM-5，辅以三具 SRM-2。原始引擎提供 85 公里/小时的最高速度，足以与装甲车辆和步兵交战，并支援较重的单位。缺少跳跃推进器，加上六吨半的原始装甲，迫使飞行员注意地形以确保有效机动。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 2E Firebee mounts a Star Cutter 80cm Large Laser, giving it respectable firepower. Up close, four Maui Crossbow SRM-2 launcher can unleash eight missiles. Whether it is using Inferno rounds or not, something that its two tons of ammunition allows MechWarriors to utilize on a regular basis, the Firebee is a potent anti-vehicle platform.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 2E 火蜂装备一门"星切"80 厘米大型激光，火力可观。近距离则四具毛伊弩炮 SRM-2 发射器可倾泻八枚导弹。无论是否使用燃烧弹——其两吨弹药让机甲战士能经常使用——火蜂都是威力强大的反车辆平台。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Designed with the aim of upgrading the ageing Firebee with more advanced Star League technology, the 2Ep was still a prototype when the Succession Wars began. The only completed models of this design were lost with the destruction of the Exedor factory in the First Succession War. The design was briefly revived in the 3045, with a few surviving Firebee’s being converted as a showcase of home grown Capellan science and engineering. Armed with an ER Large Laser, dual Streak SRM-2's and augmented with the addition of a Beagle Probe, the 2Ep is a fast scout hunter and skirmisher.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 2Ep 旨在用更先进的星盟科技升级老化的火蜂，在继承战争爆发时仍是原型机。该设计仅有的成品随第一次继承战争中埃克塞多工厂的毁灭而遗失。该设计在 3045 年短暂复兴，几台幸存的火蜂被改装以展示卡佩兰本土科学与工程的水平。2Ep 装备一门 ER 大型激光、双联连续 SRM-2，并加装比格犬探测器，是一款快速的侦察猎手与游骑机甲。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Ultimately overcoming a somewhat politically troubled birth, the OmniMech Firestarter has proven to be an highly effective and flexible design, with the Combine using it to replace other aging medium-weight workhorses such as the Phoenix Hawk
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 全面型火焰使者最终克服了诞生时的政治波折，被证明是一款高效灵活的设计，联合体用它替代了凤凰鹰等老化的中量级主力机甲

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: In 3055 the Taurian Concordat's Vandenburg Mechanized Industries produced limited runs of this factory refit of the Commando COM-2D using stealth and sensor packages imported from the Cappelan Confederation. While the result was an effective scout, with respectable ambush capabilities, the expense compared to the base model, and the difficulties of multinational production, kept it from widespread adoption.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 3055 年，陶里安协约的范登堡机械化工业公司限量生产了这款突击队 COM-2D 的工厂改装型，使用从卡佩兰邦联进口的隐形与传感器组件。成果是一款有效的侦察机甲，具备可观的伏击能力，但与基础型号相比的高昂成本以及跨国生产的困难，使其未能被广泛采用。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The D configuration of the Gargoyle is armed with two ER Large Lasers for long range combat. These are backed up for short range engagements with three highly accurate Medium Pulse Lasers and an ER Small Laser. The 'Mech is frighteningly accurate due to its advanced Targeting Computer, which increases the accuracy of all the weapons in this configuration.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 石像鬼 D 配置装备两门 ER 大型激光用于远程战斗。近程则由三门极为精准的中型脉冲激光和一门 ER 小型激光支援。由于配备先进瞄准计算机，该机甲精准得令人恐惧——它会提升此配置下所有武器的精度。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Configured to take advantage of new Heavy Laser technology, the H configuration is a capable 'Mech at any range. For long range jousting with an enemy, the 'Mech has an LRM-10 launcher. This is backed up by an Ultra Autocannon/10 and a new Heavy Large Laser for intermediate ranges. Finally, for added punch at close range, the 'Mech has two ER Medium Lasers.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: H 配置旨在利用新型重型激光技术，在任何距离上都能胜任。与敌人远程周旋时，它有一具 LRM-10 发射器。它由中距离的一门超速自动炮/10 和一门新型重型大型激光支援。最后，为增强近距离打击，机甲配有两门 ER 中型激光。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: At its core this is still a typical Periphery FrankenMech, but it received a lot of care from 'Her' owner, named after a infamous Terran Pirate Queen, does this specific design sport a Thumper Artillery Piece and munitions from the Barrymore Munitions manufacturers, granting superior Tactical Flexibility.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 本质上它仍是典型的外围区拼装机甲，但它得到了"她"的主人——以一位臭名昭著的泰拉海盗女王命名——的精心照料。这款特定设计装备一门重锤火炮与巴里摩尔弹药公司的弹药，赋予其卓越的战术灵活性。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The DGR-5K Grand Dragon introduced in 3050 incorporates a number of lostech improvements over the original DRG-1G.Mounted in its right arm is a Lord's Light 2 ER PPC. The ER PPC is backed up by a LRM-10 in the center torso, which gives the 'Mech an impressive and formidable long-range striking capability. The launcher is fed by a two-ton reload bin in the left torso protected by CASE. If an enemy 'Mech gets into close ranges, the Grand Dragon carries three Victory 23R Medium Lasers for defense, one in the left arm and two split between the rear-facing left and right torso. Protected by ten tons of armor, the Grand Dragon uses thirteen double heat sinks for excellent heat management and uses a 16.5 ton Hermes 360 XL engine to achieve a moderate cruising speed of 64 km/h.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 3050 年推出的 DGR-5K 大龙在原版 DRG-1G 基础上融入了多项失传技术改进。右臂装一门"主之光 2"ER PPC。这门 ER PPC 由中央躯干一具 LRM-10 支援，为机甲带来惊人而强劲的远程打击能力。发射器由左躯干一个受 C.A.S.E. 保护的两吨弹药箱供弹。若敌方机甲逼近，大龙携带三门"胜利 23R"中型激光用于防御，一门在左臂，两门分置于后向左、右躯干。由十吨装甲保护，大龙使用十三台双倍散热器实现出色的散热管理，并采用一台 16.5 吨的赫尔墨斯 360 XL 引擎达到 64 公里/小时的中等巡航速度。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Modified specifically to carry a C3 slave unit into combat, the C is a modification of the DRG-5K introduced in 3050. The 'Mech carries a C3 slave in the place of its rear-facing medium laser. While this does reduce the Grand Dragons short range firepower somewhat, it also makes the machine far more accurate when working in a C3 lance.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: C 型专为把 C3 从属单元带入战斗而改装，是 3050 年推出的 DRG-5K 的改装版。机甲用后向中型激光的位置安装一台 C3 从属单元。这虽在一定程度上降低了大龙的近程火力，却使它在 C3 小队中作战时精准得多。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Grand Dragon 3K is a beefy machine that can take a serious beating and carries heavier weaponry than its smaller cousin. Equipped with a heavy-duty gyro, a PPC and Gauss rifle, this variant is a formidable heavy weapons platform.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 大龙 3K 是一台强壮的机器，能承受严重打击，并携带比其小型表亲更重的武器。它配备重型陀螺仪、一门 PPC 和一门高斯步枪，是令人敬畏的重型武器平台。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 1DS variant of the Griffin, built by Defiance Industries, Kallon Industries and Norse BattleMech Works from their respective production lines starting in 3049, was intended to become the new standard model for the Federated Commonwealth. The engine was upgraded to Hermes 275 extralight engine, fourteen double heat sinks improved cooling and the weapons were stripped from the chassis. The 'Mech now carried a Doombud LRM-20 launcher over the right shoulder and a Thunderbolt-12 Large Pulse Laser in the right arm. It also employed CASE to protect the two tons of missile reloads stored in the left torso. The capture of Norse BattleMech on Marduk by the Draconis Combine meant this variant was also employed by the Draconis Combine Mustered Soldiery.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 狮鹫的 1DS 变体由迪法恩斯工业、卡隆工业和北欧战斗机甲厂自 3049 年起在各自生产线上制造，意在成为联邦联邦的新标准型号。引擎升级为赫尔墨斯 275 超轻型引擎，十四台双倍散热器改善散热，武器则从底盘上全部拆除。机甲右肩上方安装末日芽 LRM-20 发射器，右臂装备雷霆-12 大型脉冲激光。它还使用 C.A.S.E. 保护存于左躯干的两吨导弹再装填。北欧战斗机甲在马尔杜克被德拉科尼斯联合体夺取，意味着该变体也被德拉科尼斯联合体征募兵部队使用。
装备氏族科技升级的狮鹫。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Grim Reaper was a 'Mech designed by ComStar to help replenish the heavy material losses suffered by the Com Guards during the Battle of Tukayyid, with the Word of Blake maintaining production after it captured Terra to help rebuild and expand the Word of Blake Militia. Thus the Grim Reaper is seen in moderate numbers in both secular and fanatical militaries. Designed to be a generic trooper 'Mech, the Grim Reaper carries a varied and non specialized weapons payload.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 死神是康星设计的机甲，用于补充康卫在图卡伊德战役中遭受的严重物资损失，布雷克之言在夺取地球后维持生产，以协助重建和扩充布雷克之言民兵。因此死神在世俗与狂热两方的军队中都有中等数量的装备。作为一款通用士兵机甲，死神携带多样而非专精的武器配置。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Grizzly is a BattleMech that was developed by Clan Ghost Bear scientists in the 30th century. Unfortunately, the design excels at no one thing, so it never carved a niche in the Clan's touman.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 灰熊是鬼熊氏族科学家在三十世纪开发的战斗机甲。遗憾的是，该设计在任何方面都不出众，因此从未在氏族的图曼中占据一席之地。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Developed in parallel with the standard Hammer 3M, the 3G is a cheap side grade designed for garrison and budget conscious buyers. The expensive Endo Steel is removed along with the Artemis IV system, dramatically decreasing the cost and relatability of the mech. Popular with many smaller mercenary units and on backwater garrisons every where through Marik space, the design is liked by Mektechs everywhere for the ease of maintenance and ready supply of replacement parts.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 3G 与标准战锤 3M 同期开发，是一款面向驻防与预算敏感买家的廉价副线产品。它去掉了昂贵的内部骨骼与 Artemis IV 系统，大幅降低成本并提升可维护性。它在许多较小佣兵部队和马里克空间各处偏远驻军中广受欢迎，也因易于维护、备件供应充足而受各地机甲技师的喜爱。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The original version produced during 3039. Though lacking the LosTech of the HTM-27, the single production run of the original field-test Hatamoto-Chi completed on the verge of the War of 3039 came as a total shock to the attacking Lyran and Davion Forces. Since it was built on a standard chassis, the 26T had less armor, one less heat sink, and single ton of SRM ammunition in a standard ammo bin.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 最初版本于 3039 年生产。尽管缺少 HTM-27 的失落科技，原版野战测试型旗本-血的唯一一次量产恰在 3039 年战争前夕完成，令进攻的莱兰与达维昂部队大为震惊。由于建立在标准底盘上，26T 装甲较少、少一台散热器，SRM 弹药也仅有一吨存于标准弹药箱中。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Constructed with an Earthwerks VOL Endo Steel chassis, fitted with CASE protected ammo bins and clad in fifteen and a half tons of Mitchell Argon armor, the Hatamoto-Chi shared the features which made its parent design a nearly indestructible zombie 'Mech. The main area that Combine was unable to replicate the Thug was the older design's advanced Double Heat Sinks, eighteen standard Heat Sinks giving the Hatamoto-Chi a high heat curve in heavy combat.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 旗本-血采用地球工厂 VOL 内骨骼底盘建造，装有 C.A.S.E. 保护的弹药箱，披挂十五吨半米切尔氢装甲，共享了使其母设计成为近乎不可摧毁的"僵尸"机甲的特征。联合体唯一无法复制"暴徒"的地方是那款老设计的先进双倍散热器，十八台标准散热器使旗本-血在激烈战斗中热量曲线偏高。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 27V, known within the Combine as the Hatamoto-Kaze, is a variant focused on long range combat. The 'Mech removes both of the SRM-6 launchers and replaces them with a pair of LRM-5 launchers, giving the Hatamoto-Kaze the ability to stay back from the battlefield and provide indirect fire.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 27V 在联合体内部被称为旗本-风，是一款专注远程战斗的变体。它移除两具 SRM-6 发射器，换成两具 LRM-5，使旗本-风能远离战场提供间接火力。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 27W, also known as the Hatamoto-Ku, removes both of the SRM-6 launchers and replaces them with an Autocannon5. The 'Mech has a powerful direct fire capability.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 27W 又称旗本-空，移除两具 SRM-6 发射器，换成一门自动炮5。该机甲具备强大的直射火力。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The precursor to the 1H, the 0H was a flawed design that ran too hot and had insufficient armament or heat sinks for sustained combat. Armed with a Howitzer in place of the iconic Sniper piece, it lacks the range and stopping power of the later versions, whilst running significantly hotter due to the second large laser it mounted. Only a couple of test models were every introduced and the design was lost to the mists of history with the debut of the 1H and then the 2H, in 2480. Occasionally Helepolises in the periphery will be rebuilt along similar lines, the prized Sniper artillery pieces stripped off for other uses and local hardware retrofitted in its place.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为 1H 的前身，0H 是一个有缺陷的设计：过热严重，武器与散热器都不足以支撑持续战斗。它以一门榴弹炮取代标志性的狙击炮，既缺乏后期版本的射程与停止力，又因装有第二门大型激光而热得多。仅制造过几台测试型号，随着 2480 年 1H 与 2H 的问世，该设计湮没于历史迷雾中。外围区偶尔会按类似思路重建攻城塔，把珍贵的狙击炮拆下另作他用，改装本地硬件顶上。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The earliest version used standard heat sinks and its Primitive Engine could only manage 30 km/h. This proved to be a challenge as the early Helepolis needed to completely stop to fire the Sniper artillery and then start moving again before counter-battery fire could destroy the unit. Twenty and a half tons of Primitive Armor protected the Helepolis from enemy fire. The weight and bulk of the primitive systems prevented the designers from installing the long range missiles used on later models.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 最早版本使用标准散热器，其原始引擎仅能维持 30 公里/小时。这构成了挑战：早期攻城塔必须完全停下才能发射狙击炮，然后在对炮反击摧毁它之前再次启动。二十吨半的原始装甲保护攻城塔免受敌方火力。原始系统的重量与体积使设计师无法安装后期型号使用的远程导弹。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: First unleashed by the Terran Hegemony in 2460, the Helepolis is a ponderous BattleMech designed to deliver artillery fire. The 'Mech was proven ineffective on multiple occasions and, following the destruction of the production facilities in 2775, the design was lost during the Succession Wars. The HEP-2H dates to 2488.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 攻城塔于 2460 年由地球霸权首次推出，是一款笨重的战斗机甲，用于投送炮火。它多次被证明效果不佳，2775 年生产设施被毁后，该设计在继承战争中失传。HEP-2H 可追溯至 2488 年。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Helepolis is built around an Armstrong Industries Sniper Artillery Piece. The accurate, long-range fire makes it effective against static defenses. The 'Mech does carry some backup weapons to augment its screening forces. It can defend itself with a Coventry Starfire LRM-10 and Nova Large Laser. If an enemy gets close, the MechWarrior can call upon a Thunderstroke SRM-6 and a Starflash Medium Laser. This 2625 model upgrades the Large Laser to an ER Large Laser.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 攻城塔以阿姆斯特朗工业的狙击炮为核心。精准的远程火力使其对固定防御极为有效。该机甲确实携带一些备用武器以增强其掩护部队。它可用一门考文垂"星火"LRM-10 和一门新星大型激光自卫。若敌人逼近，机甲战士还能依靠一门雷霆 SRM-6 和一门星光中型激光。此 2625 型号将大型激光升级为 ER 大型激光。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Hellbringer A bears similarities in design and appearance to the classic Warhammer. The primary weapons are indeed a pair of ER PPCs.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 地狱使者 A 在设计上与经典战锤相似，外观也近似。主武器确实是两门 ER PPC。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: With a high damage profile at long and short range, the Hellbringer B does not utilize energy weapons as much, and so has few issues with heat buildup.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 凭借远程与近程的高伤害曲线，地狱使者 B 不太使用能量武器，因此在积热上问题不大。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Hellbringer C is a Mech that appears to be a Jack of all trades. It does not accel at any one role but can apply damage at any range.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 地狱使者 C 是一台看似样样通吃的机甲。它在任何单一角色上都不出众，却能在任何距离上施加伤害。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This variant carries a pair of LB 10-X's, one in each arm, supported by an ER Medium Laser. Another pair of ER Medium Lasers and a single SRM-6 launcher round out the weapons.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 此变体携带两门 LB 10-X，每臂一门，由一门 ER 中型激光支援。另有一对 ER 中型激光和一具 SRM-6 发射器补全武器配置。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Hellbringer GP is a laser heavy version of the mech. Designed for sustained duration combat, this mech can always go the distance.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 地狱使者 GP 是该机甲的重激光版本。它为持久战而设计，总能坚持到底。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Hellbringer H bears similarities in design and appearance to the classic Warhammer. The primary weapons are indeed a pair of ER PPCs.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 地狱使者 H 在设计上与经典战锤相似，外观也近似。主武器确实是两门 ER PPC。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Hellbringer Prime bears similarities in design and appearance to the classic Warhammer. The primary weapons are indeed a pair of ER PPCs.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 地狱使者主型号在设计上与经典战锤相似，外观也近似。主武器确实是两门 ER PPC。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Highlander is one of the most well-known Star League Defense Force assault 'Mechs, serving with distinction for almost two centuries since first entering service in 2592. Initially designed as a dedicated city and installation defender, the original model featured a variety of weaponry along with fifteen and a half tons of Ferro-Fibrous armor, but perhaps its most useful asset were the three Hildco jump jets giving it a jumping range of 90 meters. The heaviest 'Mech design to feature jump jets at the time, their original task was to allow the Highlander the ability to jump over inconvenient obstacles such as buildings and outpace other 'Mechs with a faster ground speed, but because of this increased mobility and its versatile weaponry the Highlander proved to be a capable fighter on any battlefield and within decades nearly every BattleMech regiment of the Regular and Royal Armies featured them. However it was during the design's initial trial runs that pilots began using these 'Mechs in what would infamously become known as the "Highlander Burial". Leaping into the air and landing directly on their enemy, a Highlander could literally drive a light 'Mech into the ground. So successful was this maneuver that the design team re-engineered the legs to withstand repeated death-from-above attacks and turned what had been a desperation move into an art form, giving Highlander pilots an additional psychological edge.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 高地人是星盟防卫军最知名的突击机甲之一，自 2592 年首次服役以来已光荣服役近两个世纪。它最初被设计为专职的城市与设施防御者，原版型号装备多种武器与十五吨半铁纤维装甲，但也许最宝贵的资产是三个希尔德科跳跃推进器，赋予它 90 米的跳跃距离。作为当时配备跳跃推进器的最重机甲设计，它们最初的任务是让高地人能跃过建筑之类碍事的障碍，并追上地面速度更快的其他机甲；但由于这一增强的机动性和多用途武器，高地人在任何战场上都证明是能干的战士，数十年内常备军与皇家军几乎每个战斗机甲团都装备了它。然而在该设计的初期试跑中，飞行员开始以后来臭名昭著的"高地人葬礼"方式使用这些机甲。跃入空中并直接落在敌人头上，高地人能真把一台轻型机甲踩进地里。这一战术如此成功，设计团队重新设计了腿部以承受反复的"从天而降之死"，把原本的绝望之举变成了一门艺术，为高地人飞行员增添了额外的心理优势。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: One of the most popular Star League BattleMechs, many a Highlander accompanied General Aleksandr Kerensky into exile. Some were mothballed, but many found their way into the toumans of the Clans. As technology advanced, the weapons systems were upgraded until the design known as the Highlander IIC finally emerged. With the use of newer, lighter weapons, the damage potential of the Highlander has roughly doubled. The IIC also contains enough ammunition that it rarely needs to conserve any during Trials. Clan scientists were forced to rearrange the placement of some weapons within the 'Mech to allow it proper ammo feeds, but the design is largely unchanged. It carries the maximum amount of Ferro-Fibrous armor that can be crammed on the frame, fourteen and a half tons. As with the original, the IIC carries enough jump jets to move up to ninety meters at a time, allowing MechWarriors to execute the Highlander Burial.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 高地人是星盟最受欢迎的战斗机甲之一，许多随亚历山大·克伦斯基将军流亡。有些被封存，但许多进入了氏族的图曼。随着技术进步，武器系统不断升级，最终诞生了被称为高地人 IIC 的设计。凭借更新更轻的武器，高地人的伤害潜力几乎翻倍。IIC 还携带充足弹药，在试炼中几乎无需节省。氏族科学家被迫重新安排机内部分武器的位置以使其供弹顺畅，但设计大体未变。它携带了框架所能容纳的最大量铁纤维装甲——十四吨半。与原版一样，IIC 携带足以一次移动九十米的跳跃推进器，使机甲战士能施展"高地人埋葬"。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: One of the most popular Star League BattleMechs, many a Highlander accompanied General Aleksandr Kerensky into exile. Some were mothballed, but many found their way into the toumans of the Clans. As technology advanced, the weapons systems were upgraded until the design known as the Highlander IIC finally emerged. With the use of newer, lighter weapons, the damage potential of the Highlander has roughly doubled. The IIC also contains enough ammunition that it rarely needs to conserve any during Trials. Clan scientists were forced to rearrange the placement of some weapons within the 'Mech to allow it proper ammo feeds, but the design is largely unchanged. It carries the maximum amount of Ferro-Fibrous armor that can be crammed on the frame, fourteen and a half tons. As with the original, the IIC carries enough jump jets to move up to ninety meters at a time, allowing MechWarriors to execute the Highlander Burial. This version introduced 3077 carries a HAG/20 with 4 tons of ammunition for long battlefield endurance and ECM Suite instead of the standard Gauss Rifle.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为最受欢迎的星盟战斗机甲之一，许多高地人随亚历山大·克伦斯基将军流亡。有些被封存，但许多进入了氏族的图曼。随着技术进步，武器系统不断升级，直到名为高地人 IIC 的设计最终出现。凭借更新更轻的武器，高地人的伤害潜力大致翻了一倍。IIC 还携带足够多的弹药，在试炼中几乎无需节约。氏族科学家不得不重新安排机内部分武器的位置以保证正常的供弹，但设计大体未变。它在框架上塞满了铁纤维装甲所能容纳的最大量——十四吨半。与原版一样，IIC 携带足够的跳跃推进器，一次可移动至九十米，使机甲战士能施展"高地人葬礼"。这个 3077 年推出的版本携带一门 HAG/20 与 4 吨弹药以实现长久的战场续航，并以 ECM 套件取代标准高斯步枪。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: One of the most popular Star League BattleMechs, many a Highlander accompanied General Aleksandr Kerensky into exile. Some were mothballed, but many found their way into the toumans of the Clans. As technology advanced, the weapons systems were upgraded until the design known as the Highlander IIC finally emerged. With the use of newer, lighter weapons, the damage potential of the Highlander has roughly doubled. The IIC also contains enough ammunition that it rarely needs to conserve any during Trials. Clan scientists were forced to rearrange the placement of some weapons within the 'Mech to allow it proper ammo feeds, but the design is largely unchanged. It carries the maximum amount of Ferro-Fibrous armor that can be crammed on the frame, fourteen and a half tons. As with the original, the IIC carries enough jump jets to move up to ninety meters at a time, allowing MechWarriors to execute the Highlander Burial. Like the original Highlander IIC, the B retains the Gauss Rifle and twin Streak SRM-6 racks, but replaces the single LRM-20 with twin LRM-15 racks in the right torso, removing one of the Medium Pulse Lasers to help free up the weight needed.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 高地人是星盟最受欢迎的战斗机甲之一，许多随亚历山大·克伦斯基将军流亡。有些被封存，但许多进入了氏族的图曼。随着技术进步，武器系统不断升级，最终诞生了被称为高地人 IIC 的设计。凭借更新更轻的武器，高地人的伤害潜力几乎翻倍。IIC 还携带充足弹药，在试炼中几乎无需节省。氏族科学家被迫重新安排机内部分武器的位置以使其供弹顺畅，但设计大体未变。它携带了框架所能容纳的最大量铁纤维装甲——十四吨半。与原版一样，IIC 携带足以一次移动九十米的跳跃推进器，使机甲战士能施展"高地人埋葬"。与原版高地人 IIC 一样，B 型保留高斯步枪和双联连续 SRM-6 挂架，但将单具 LRM-20 换成右侧躯干的双联 LRM-15，并移除一门中型脉冲激光以腾出所需重量。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: One of the most popular Star League BattleMechs, many a Highlander accompanied General Aleksandr Kerensky into exile. Some were mothballed, but many found their way into the toumans of the Clans. As technology advanced, the weapons systems were upgraded until the design known as the Highlander IIC finally emerged. With the use of newer, lighter weapons, the damage potential of the Highlander has roughly doubled. The IIC also contains enough ammunition that it rarely needs to conserve any during Trials. Clan scientists were forced to rearrange the placement of some weapons within the 'Mech to allow it proper ammo feeds, but the design is largely unchanged. It carries the maximum amount of Ferro-Fibrous armor that can be crammed on the frame, fourteen and a half tons. As with the original, the IIC carries enough jump jets to move up to ninety meters at a time, allowing MechWarriors to execute the Highlander Burial. The Highlander IIC C trades the standard variant's Gauss Rifle for a pair of Ultra Autocannon/10s, retaining the trio of Medium Pulse Lasers while removing the LRM-20's Artemis module and one of the left-arm Streak SRM-6 launchers.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 高地人是星盟最受欢迎的战斗机甲之一，许多随亚历山大·克伦斯基将军流亡。有些被封存，但许多进入了氏族的图曼。随着技术进步，武器系统不断升级，最终诞生了被称为高地人 IIC 的设计。凭借更新更轻的武器，高地人的伤害潜力几乎翻倍。IIC 还携带充足弹药，在试炼中几乎无需节省。氏族科学家被迫重新安排机内部分武器的位置以使其供弹顺畅，但设计大体未变。它携带了框架所能容纳的最大量铁纤维装甲——十四吨半。与原版一样，IIC 携带足以一次移动九十米的跳跃推进器，使机甲战士能施展"高地人埋葬"。高地人 IIC C 将标准型的高斯步枪换成两门超速自动炮/10，保留三门中型脉冲激光，同时移除 LRM-20 的 Artemis 模块和一门左臂连续 SRM-6 发射器。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The F5 variant, called the Hollander II, is a variant of the Hollander that looks to alleviate the 'Mech's problems by building it on a chassis ten tons heavier than the original, pushing it into the medium weight class. First built in 3058 the 'Mech still carries a Gauss Rifle as its primary weapon, but is backed up by a single Medium Laser and a Streak SRM-2 launcher.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 名为荷兰人 II 的 F5 变体是荷兰人的改型，试图通过把底盘加重十吨、跨入中量级来解决机甲的问题。它于 3058 年首次建造，仍以高斯步枪为主武器，但辅以一门中型激光和一具连续 SRM-2 发射器。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The F7, debuting in 3061 is a modification of the F5 that takes advantage of the Hollander II's larger weapons payload to mount the Lyran Alliance's new Heavy Gauss Rifle, which is capable of causing a great deal of damage at short to medium ranges. While improving upon the firepower of the variant, the removal of backup weaponry to fit these massive weapon leaves it with the same problems as the original Hollander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: F7 于 3061 年亮相，是 F5 的改型，利用荷兰人 II 更大的武器负载能力搭载莱兰联盟新型重型高斯步枪，能在中近距离造成大量伤害。虽然火力优于前型，但为容纳这些巨型武器而移除备用武器，使它仍带有原版荷兰人的同样问题。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Designed by the Explorer Corps to provide heavy fire support in environments unsuited to a normal tank or support unit, the 4E is a field refit that mounts a Thumper Artillery piece in place of the standard AC/20. Removing a mostly superfluous s heat sink, frees up the weight for the 4E retain it’s secondary weaponry should it be engaged by head hunter units. By 3010, the Explorer Corps had entered into a long term contract with Kali Yama Weapons to produce limited numbers of this design under licence. The design spread to other interested parties, after the Corps relaxed their licensing arrangements, following the Scarlet Fist debacle; in which the a lone Corps pilot – Larissa ‘‘Raza’’ Brooks – managed to successfully evaded the pirate band responsible for the destruction of her lance, before stalking them back to their base and levelling it with repeated Thumper volleys in the middle of the night.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 由探险队设计，用于在不适于常规坦克或支援单位的环境提供重型火力支援。4E 是战地改装型，以一门重锤火炮取代标准 AC/20。拆掉一只基本多余的散热器腾出重量，使 4E 在被猎杀单位接战时仍保留次要武器。到 3010 年，探险队已与卡利亚马武器公司签订长期合同，授权限量生产该设计。在"赤拳"事件后，探险队放宽了授权安排，此设计遂扩散至其他有意方；在那次事件中，探险队唯一幸存的飞行员——拉里萨·"拉扎"·布鲁克斯——成功避开了摧毁她小队的海盗团，随后追踪他们回到基地，并在深夜以反复的重锤齐射将基地夷平。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: During the War of 3039, the 9th Ghost regiment was engaged by the Screaming Eagles mercenary company during the Elidere IV campaign, when they decided to modify two of their Hunchbacks to carry prototype Gauss Rifles. Thus, the HBK-4GG was born, able to cause tremendous damage at ranges beyond anyone's expectations.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 3039 年战争中，第 9 幽灵团在埃利代尔 IV 战役期间与"尖叫之鹰"佣兵团交战，当时他们决定改装两台驼背以搭载原型高斯步枪。HBK-4GG 由此诞生，能在超出所有人预期的距离上造成巨大伤害。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Developed during the Clan Invasion, the 5A takes advantage of the newly reintroduced Arrow IV and an Artemis IV FCS. Intended to operate in support of a lance or as part of a dedicated battery, the 5A carries a mix of homing missiles and utility ammo; enabling it to bombard targets that have been tagged by supporting forces or deploying FASCAM and other speciality ammo as and when needed. Guardian ECM confuses and blinds enemy sensors, vastly reducing the chances of accurate counter battery fire, whilst the use of CASE protects against catastrophic ammunition explosions. Sold to any interested buyer as part of Kali Yama’s contribution to the war effort, the design has been seen all across the Inner Sphere and is increasingly found in the Periphery, where reliable and cheap Artillery assets are in high demand.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 5A 在氏族入侵期间开发，利用了新近重新引入的箭矢 IV 与 Artemis IV 火控系统。它旨在支援一个小队或作为专用炮组的一员，混合携带寻的导弹与多用途弹药；既能轰击被友军标记的目标，也能按需布撒 FASCAM 等特种弹药。守护者 ECM 扰乱并致盲敌方传感器，大幅降低其精准反炮击的可能，而 C.A.S.E. 的使用则防止灾难性的弹药爆炸。作为卡利亚马对战争努力的贡献，该设计向任何有意买家出售，已遍布内天体，并越来越多地出现在对可靠廉价火炮资产需求旺盛的外围区。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Hunchback IIC is a ClanTech refit of the venerable Hunchback. Its meager armor, coupled with paltry ammunition and lack of long-range weapons, led Inner Sphere observers to conclude that this 'Mech was a last-ditch effort for failed warriors to die with glory. In truth, the assignment of a Hunchback IIC was essentially a death sentence. Warriors given this machine were not expected to survive their next battle.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 驼背 IIC 是古老的驼背的氏族科技改装版。它可怜的装甲，加上稀少的弹药和缺乏远程武器，让内天体观察家断定这款机甲是失败战士求取荣耀战死的最后一搏。事实上，被分配驼背 IIC 基本等于死刑。获得此机的战士不被指望能活过下一场战斗。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Hunchback IIC is a ClanTech refit of the venerable Hunchback. Its meager armor, coupled with paltry ammunition and lack of long-range weapons, led Inner Sphere observers to conclude that this 'Mech was a last-ditch effort for failed warriors to die with glory. In truth, the assignment of a Hunchback IIC was essentially a death sentence. Warriors given this machine were not expected to survive their next battle.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 驼背 IIC 是古老的驼背的氏族科技改装版。它可怜的装甲，加上稀少的弹药和缺乏远程武器，让内天体观察家断定这款机甲是失败战士求取荣耀战死的最后一搏。事实上，被分配驼背 IIC 基本等于死刑。获得此机的战士不被指望能活过下一场战斗。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The CattleMaster was created at the turn of the thirty-first century as an IndustrialMech to handle large herd animals. The concept for the Rancher 'Mech dates back to the twenty-fourth century. The 'Mech is noted for its durability and flexible Internal Combustion Engine.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 牧牛人于三十一世纪之交被制造为工业机甲，用于处置大型畜群。这类"牧场主"机甲的概念可追溯至二十四世纪。此机甲以其耐用性和灵活的内燃引擎著称。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The primary weapon that the Huron Warrior carries is a Grizzard Gauss Rifle (Modified 210 Version) that is capable of stripping off a ton of armor with each shot at extremely long ranges. The Gauss Rifle is backed up by a Martell ER Large Laser that provides good supplemental firepower at long ranges. Finally, it is armed with a Martell Medium Pulse Laser, which gives the Huron Warrior the ability to protect itself at short ranges.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 休伦战士的主要武器是一门格里扎德高斯步枪（210 改进版），能在极远距离一枪削掉一吨装甲。高斯步枪辅以一门马特尔 ER 大型激光，在远距离提供良好的补充火力。最后它还装备一门马特尔中型脉冲激光，使休伦战士具备近距离自保能力。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Hussar has a single weapon on its chassis in a unique turreted mount on the center torso, an Extended Range Large Laser. While the use of a single weapon limits the defensive capabilities of the Hussar, the superior reach of the ER laser allows the 'Mech to engage enemies at a standoff range and its speed means the Hussar can dictate the range of the engagement, forcing enemies to fight on its terms. If enemies do get too close the Hussar can still engage in physical combat with kicks and punches but this is less than ideal. Ten double heat sinks are enough to keep the 'Mech cool in combat, but only one and a half tons of Ferro-Fibrous armor makes the Hussar among the least-protected 'Mechs ever built.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 轻骑兵在中央躯干上一个独特的炮塔式挂架上装有其唯一武器：一门增程大型激光。虽然只有一门武器限制了轻骑兵的防御能力，但 ER 激光的优越射程使机甲能在对峙距离上交战，而其速度意味着轻骑兵能决定交战距离，迫使敌人按它的条件作战。若敌人确实逼近，轻骑兵仍能以踢击和拳击进行肉搏，但这并不理想。十台双倍散热器足以让机甲在战斗中保持低温，但仅一吨半铁纤维装甲使轻骑兵成为史上防护最少的机甲之一。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An upgrade of the 200 introduced in 2735 and used exclusively by SLDF Royal units, the 200Db is powered by an XL Engine. This enables an upgrade of the 'Mech's electronics with a Beagle Active Probe and a Guardian ECM Suite in the side torsos. In addition, the armor coverage is increased to five and a half tons.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 200Db 是 200 型的升级版，于 2735 年推出，专供星盟防卫军皇家部队使用，由 XL 引擎驱动。这使其得以在两侧躯干加装比格犬主动探测器和守护者 ECM 套件来升级电子设备。此外装甲覆盖增至五吨半。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 300-D Hussar is a simple downgrade of the 200-D Hussar, gifted to the Draconis Combine by ComStar in 3035. The primary changes in the design are the replacement of the ER large laser with a standard Defiance B3L Large Laser, standard heat sinks in place of the double-strength models, and replacement of the Ferro-Fibrous armor with standard Riese Reliable armor at a negligible cost to the already weak armor protection.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 300-D 骠骑兵是 200-D 骠骑兵的简单降级版，由康星于 3035 年赠予德拉科尼斯联合体。设计的主要变化是将 ER 大型激光换成标准的迪法恩斯 B3L 大型激光，双倍强度散热器换为标准型号，铁纤维装甲换成标准里瑟可靠装甲，对本就脆弱的防护影响微乎其微。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This Combine variant on the 300-D was introduced in 3038. It lowers the Hussar's top speed to 126 km/h by replacing the engine with a Pitban 240. The weight saved from the smaller power plant was used to add a Medium Laser to each arm and an extra ton of armor.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这款联合体版本的 300-D 于 3038 年推出。它用皮特班 240 替换引擎，把轻骑兵的最高速度降至 126 公里/小时。较小动力装置节省的重量用于为每臂加装一门中型激光和一吨额外装甲。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: One of the Clanbuster upgrades developed by ComStar in 3052, the 400-D is an extreme modification of the original Hussar. The ER large laser and the engine have both been stripped from the chassis to make room for a LB-X Autocannon/10 with one ton of ammo, an additional 1.5 tons of armor and a GM 240 XL Engine, reducing the Hussar's speed to 129.6 km/h. This variant of the Hussar, due to the cluster rounds that can be fired from the LB-X Autocannon, performs admirably in anti-vehicle screening forces.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 400-D 是康星 3052 年开发的"破氏族"升级之一，是对原版骠骑兵的极端改装。ER 大型激光与引擎都被从底盘上剥离，以腾出空间装载一门 LB-X 自动炮/10（配一吨弹药）、额外 1.5 吨装甲和一台 GM 240 XL 引擎，把骠骑兵的速度降至 129.6 公里/小时。由于 LB-X 自动炮可发射集束弹，此骠骑兵变体在反车辆掩护部队中表现出色。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Built with lessons learned from the Battle of Tukkayid, the 450-D is armed with an LB-5X mounted in the Right Torso. 2 tons of ammo keep the main gun well supplied, whilst a pair of ER Medium Lasers offer provide some degree of deterrence against foes closing in. Rounding out the design is an extra ton of armour, allowing it to weather heavier damage than it's predecessor.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 450-D 汲取图卡伊德战役的教训建造，右躯干装有一门 LB-5X。两吨弹药让主炮补给充足，两门 ER 中型激光则对逼近的敌人提供一定威慑。设计以额外一吨装甲收尾，使其比前型能承受更重的打击。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 500-D Hussar, built by Bonn Mekarmorwerks and introduced in 3060, is armed with an ER PPC. The targeting system has been mated to an Improved C3 Computer, making it deadly accurate at long range when working closely with other units.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 500-D 骠骑兵由波恩机甲兵工厂制造，3060 年推出，装备一门 ER PPC。其瞄准系统与改进型 C3 计算机联动，与其他单位密切协同时可在远距离实现致命精准。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Icarus II was the first homegrown BattleMech design to be mass-produced by the Free Worlds League. It was originally designed as a speedy striker to compliment the Mackie and combat vehicles with a similar speed profile.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 伊卡洛斯 II 是自由世界联盟首个量产的自主战斗机甲设计。它最初被设计为一款高速突击机甲，以配合麦基和速度相近的战斗车辆。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The original prototype Icarus was developed at the Happen Military Reservation on Xanthe III in 2466, and was first deployed on Alula Australis in 2469. Its premiere date in official documents is listed as 2470. The prototype used primitive equipment and lacked jump jets. It had a Large Laser to complement the Small Laser. Two SRM-2s and twin Machine Guns could prove devastating to conventional troops. Only six of these were ever produced and they are all long gone. The primitive engine drove it to a maximum of 64 km/h. Ten and a half tons of Primitive Armor provided protection.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 伊卡洛斯的原始原型于 2466 年在赞瑟 III 的哈彭军事保留地开发，2469 年在南十字星首次部署。官方文件中其首秀日期列为 2470 年。原型使用原始装备且没有跳跃推进器。它有一门大型激光配合小型激光。两具 SRM-2 和双联机枪对常规部队极具毁灭性。这样的机甲只造过六台，且早已消失。原始引擎驱动它最高只到 64 公里/小时。十吨半的原始装甲提供防护。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The A configuration carries a single LB-X Autocannon/2 for its excellent long range sniping capabilities. This is backed up by two ER Medium Lasers for close combat capabilities and a single Anti-Missile System for added defense against missile weapons.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: A 配置携带一门 LB-X 自动炮/2，具备出色的远程狙击能力。它辅以两门 ER 中型激光提供近战能力，以及一套反导系统增加对导弹武器的防御。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Ice Ferret B has an ER Large Laser as its only long-range weapon. For close combat, the B configuration carries an SRM-4 and an SRM-6 launcher as well as a highly accurate Small Pulse Laser.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 冰貂 B 只有一门 ER 大型激光作为远程武器。近战方面，B 配置携带一具 SRM-4 和一具 SRM-6 发射器，以及一门极为精准的小型脉冲激光。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A fire support configuration of the Ice Ferret, the C configuration has a trio of LRM-5 launchers, each linked to an Artemis IV fire control system for increased missile accuracy. For close range defense, the 'Mech has a single ER Small Laser.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 冰貂 C 是冰貂的火力支援配置，装备三具 LRM-5 发射器，每具联接一套 Artemis IV 火控系统以提升导弹精度。近程防御方面，机甲有一门 ER 小型激光。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: In its primary configuration, the Ice Ferret is capable of acting in a variety of roles. The Ice Ferret carries an Active Probe allowing the 'Mech to detect hidden enemy units. For close combat, the Ice Ferret prime has a Streak SRM-2 launcher and an ER Small Laser. For long range engagements, the 'Mech is armed with a single ER PPC, giving it excellent long range hitting power for its size.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 主配置中，冰貂能胜任多种角色。它携带主动探测器，可侦测隐藏的敌方单位。近战方面，冰貂主型号有一具连续 SRM-2 发射器和一门 ER 小型激光。远程交战时，机甲装备一门 ER PPC，就其尺寸而言拥有出色的远程打击力。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The original Imp, introduced in 2793, carries an ER PPC and Medium Pulse Laser in the right and left torso. Supporting these weapons are 2 Medium Pulse Lasers mounted in the center torso and a Small Laser in the head. The left arm mounts another Medium Pulse Laser, while the right arm carries an Artemis IV enhanced LRM-20. The engine is a standard fusion model, and the missile ammunition is protected by CASE. This version was the original Imp design specified by Nicholas Kerensky and was intended for battlefield commanders.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 原版 Imp 于 2793 年推出，右躯干装一门 ER PPC，左躯干一门中型脉冲激光。支援这些武器的是中央躯干两门中型脉冲激光和头部一门小型激光。左臂另装一门中型脉冲激光，右臂则携带一具 Artemis IV 增强的 LRM-20。引擎为标准聚变型号，导弹弹药由 C.A.S.E. 保护。此版本是尼古拉斯·克伦斯基指定的原始 Imp 设计，供战场指挥官使用。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Similar to the Imp 1A variant, this model trades the Medium Pulse Lasers for Medium Lasers. It also trades the head mounted Small Laser for a Medium Pulse Laser. It keeps the ER PPCs and LRM-20 and Artemis IV system. The biggest change is the addition of a Guardian ECM suite in the 'Mech's right torso.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 与 Imp 1A 变体相似，此型号把中型脉冲激光换成中型激光。它还把头部小型激光换成中型脉冲激光。它保留 ER PPC、LRM-20 和 Artemis IV 系统。最大的变化是在机甲右躯干加装了守护者 ECM 套件。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Another early version based on the Imp 1B, this variant mounts a Gauss Rifle in the right arm. The Imp 1C uses the head mounted Small Laser of the Imp 1A in place of the Medium Pulse Laser. The Guardian ECM suite is still in the right torso. One heat sink is removed, giving the Imp 1C a total of seventeen double heat sinks.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是基于 Imp 1B 的另一早期版本，此变体在右臂装一门高斯步枪。Imp 1C 用 Imp 1A 的头部小型激光取代中型脉冲激光。守护者 ECM 套件仍在右躯干。移除一台散热器，使 Imp 1C 共有十七台双倍散热器。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An early variant of the Imp and the first version to be seen by the Inner Sphere, the 2E model uses all non-Star League technology. The 'Mech is armed with a pair of PPCs and an LRM-15 launcher for long range combat. For close combat, the 'Mech carries five Medium Lasers.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Imp 的早期变体 2E 型号是内天体首见的版本，全部采用非星盟技术。它对远程战斗装备两门 PPC 和一具 LRM-15 发射器，近战则携带五门中型激光。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An upgrade to the 2E model, the 3E carries, a pair of Magna Firestar ER PPCs and a Mitchell Systems LRM-15 as it's primary weapons. For closer range combat, the 'Mech relies on a Thunderbolt-12 Large Pulse Laser, backed up by two Magna 400P Medium Pulse Lasers and two Martell Model 5 Medium Lasers.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 3E 是 2E 型号的升级版，主武器为两门玛格纳"火之星"ER PPC 和一具米切尔系统 LRM-15。近距离战斗则依靠一门雷霆-12 大型脉冲激光，辅以两门玛格纳 400P 中型脉冲激光和两门马特尔 5 型中型激光。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A massive upgrade of the Imp, the 4E model carries two ER PPCs for long range direct fire, as well as an LRM-20 launcher with an Artemis IV Fire Control System. The 'Mech carries three ER Medium Lasers for intermediate range combat. The 'Mech also carries two Medium Pulse Lasers and two ER Small Lasers for close combat. Much like the original Clan models, the 21 heat sinks are double-strength and the engine is a standard model.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 4E 型号是 Imp 的大幅升级版，携带两门 ER PPC 用于远程直射，以及一具配 Artemis IV 火控系统的 LRM-20 发射器。机甲携带三门 ER 中型激光负责中距离战斗，还有两门中型脉冲激光和两门 ER 小型激光负责近战。与原始氏族型号很像，它的 21 台散热器是双倍强度，引擎则是标准型号。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This upgrade of the Imp is built exclusively for Wolf's Dragoons using only Clan technology. The 'Mech is armed with two ER PPCs and an LRM-20 launcher with an Artemis IV Fire Control System for long range combat. For close ranges, the 'Mech carries five Medium Pulse Lasers. The Imp C is also armored with nineteen tons of armor.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这款 Imp 升级版专为狼之龙骑兵建造，仅使用氏族技术。机甲装备两门 ER PPC 和一具带 Artemis IV 火控系统的 LRM-20 发射器用于远程战斗。近程方面，机甲携带五门中型脉冲激光。Imp C 还披挂十九吨装甲。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A second line mech designed for settling clan duels, the laser armed Incubus has found considerable success with Clan Hell's Horses'49th Battlemech Cluster as a protomech hunter.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是一款为氏族决斗而设计的二线机甲，以激光武装的梦魔在鬼马氏族第 49 战斗机甲集群中作为原型机甲猎手取得了相当大的成功。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Inner Sphere Standard was developed following the initial thrust of the Clan invasion, as Inner Sphere powers rushed to duplicate the battle armor technology the Clans fielded. Lacking any battlefield salvage on which to base their development though, engineers were forced to work off of ancient rumors of early power armor suits like the Nighthawk, more akin to armored Exoskeletons than the 'Toads' currently rampaging through known space, and these prototypes fared poorly during testing. It took salvage from the first victories over the Clans to truly kick-start the development of battle armor. The New Avalon Institute of Science was the first to reproduce in part the Clans' Elemental armor as the Inner Sphere Standard.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 内天体标准型是在氏族入侵首轮攻势后开发的，当时内天体各势力竞相复制氏族装备的战斗装甲技术。然而由于缺乏战场缴获作为研发基础，工程师们只能依据"夜鹰"等早期动力装甲的古老传闻着手——它们与其说是当前肆虐已知空间的"蟾蜍"式装甲，更像是带装甲的外骨骼。这些原型在测试中表现糟糕。直到从对氏族的首次胜利中获得缴获品，战斗装甲的研发才真正起步。新阿瓦隆科学研究院率先部分复制了氏族的元素战士装甲，即内天体标准型。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Inner Sphere Standard was developed following the initial thrust of the Clan invasion, as Inner Sphere powers rushed to duplicate the battle armor technology the Clans fielded. Lacking any battlefield salvage on which to base their development though, engineers were forced to work off of ancient rumors of early power armor suits like the Nighthawk, more akin to armored Exoskeletons than the 'Toads' currently rampaging through known space, and these prototypes fared poorly during testing. It took salvage from the first victories over the Clans to truly kick-start the development of battle armor. The New Avalon Institute of Science was the first to reproduce in part the Clans' Elemental armor as the Inner Sphere Standard.
