Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Jenner was first fielded in September 2784, the same year the Exodus fleet that would eventually become the Clans left the Inner Sphere in November. How exactly they acquired this design in that short timeframe is not known, but what is known is that the Clan version fields Clan weaponry.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 詹纳于 2784 年 9 月首次投入战场，同年的 11 月，最终成为氏族的出埃及舰队离开了内天体。他们究竟如何在如此短的时间内获得这一设计尚不清楚，但已知的是氏族版本装备的是氏族武器。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This support variant replaces the short-range missile launchers with an ER Large Laser and an LRM-5. A Small Pulse Laser provides defense against conventional infantry and other units that stray too close. Its jumping capacity is increased to 270 meters.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 此支援变体将短程火箭发射器换成一门 ER 大型激光和一具 LRM-5。一门小型脉冲激光提供对常规步兵和靠得太近的其他单位的防御。其跳跃能力提升至 270 米。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Jenner was first fielded in September 2784, the same year the Exodus fleet that would eventually become the Clans left the Inner Sphere in November. How exactly they acquired this design in that short timeframe is not known, but what is known is that the Clan version fields Clan weaponry.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 詹纳于 2784 年 9 月首次投入战场，同年的 11 月，最终成为氏族的出埃及舰队离开了内天体。他们究竟如何在如此短的时间内获得这一设计尚不清楚，但已知的是氏族版本装备的是氏族武器。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Clan Nova Cat, the primary users of the Jenner IIC, created this variant after they moved to the Inner Sphere. Though it changes the appearance of the 'Mech, the actual specifications of the design changed little. It retains the Streak SRM-4, but replaced the standard missile launchers with a pair of ATM 3s, each of which is accompanied by a ton of ammunition.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为詹纳 IIC 的主要使用者，新星猫氏族在迁入内天体后打造了此变体。虽然它改变了机甲的外观，设计的实际规格却变化甚微。它保留连续 SRM-4，但把标准导弹发射器换成一对 ATM 3，每具各配一吨弹药。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Jenner R was downgraded to accommodate a lack of replacement parts, carrying 2 SRM6, 2 Rocket Launchers and 2 Medium laser.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 詹纳 R 因缺乏替换部件而降级，携带 2 具 SRM6、2 具火箭发射器和 2 门中型激光。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Kanazuchi, Japanese for 'hammer', is a Draconis Combine battle armor design, one of the heaviest to come from that realm.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 金锤（日语"锤子"）是德拉科尼斯联合体的战斗装甲设计，是该势力出品中最重的一种。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The King Crab KGC-0 is a badly maintained primitive version of one of the most heavily armed and armored 'Mechs ever constructed. While carrying lesser weaponry is its arsenal still able to deliver a crushing Blow.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 帝王蟹 KGC-0 是维护不良的原始版本，属史上武装与装甲最厚重的机甲之一。虽然武器较弱，其火力库仍能造成毁灭性打击。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The King Crab-000b, the Star League's Royal variant, is every bit as powerful as its downgraded cousin, the -0000. Still armed with twin AC/20s, the -000b's double heat sinks and doubled ammo keeps the massive cannons firing far longer and more frequently making the -000b a true terror on the battlefield.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 帝王蟹-000b 是星盟的皇家变体，威力丝毫不逊于其降级版表亲-0000。它仍装备双 AC/20，其双倍散热器与双倍弹药让这对巨炮能更持久、更频繁地开火，使-000b 成为战场上真正的恐怖。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: One of the so-called Clanbuster variants developed in 3052 during the lead-up to the Battle of Tukayyid, ComStar's techs replaced the twin autocannons with two M-7 Gauss Rifles and four tons of ammo in the arms, trading a minor reduction in destructive capacity for greatly increased range. While retaining the LRM launcher the large laser was upgraded to a Tronel XIII Large Pulse Laser and two Hovertec Streak SRM-2s, split between the side torsos with a single ton of reloads each, were added. These changes were accomplished by using an extralight engine in place of the standard model.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是 3052 年图卡伊德战役前夕开发的所谓"破氏族"变体之一。康星技师将双联自动炮换成两门 M-7 高斯步枪，臂部携带四吨弹药，以略微降低的破坏力换取大幅提升的射程。保留 LRM 发射器的同时，大型激光升级为特罗内尔 XIII 大型脉冲激光，并加装两具霍弗泰克连续 SRM-2，分列两侧躯干、各配一吨再装填。这些改动通过以超轻型引擎取代标准引擎实现。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: One of the most heavily armed and armored 'Mechs ever constructed, the King Crab 0002 variant mounts twin UAC10 with MRM's.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 帝王蟹 0002 变体是史上武装与装甲最厚重的机甲之一，装备双 UAC10 与 MRM。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This version of the King Crab was created by the Star League to be a command 'Mech and introduced alongside the original 000 model in 2743. Conceived in secret between Cosara and the Terran Hegemony, it was an attempt to produce a deadly command 'Mech by mounting a pair of newly-developed Hellstar Magna PPCs in either side torso backed by bya pair of SRM-6's. A pair of newly developed LBX/10's replaced the standard autocannon. The 010 model was more than capable of taking down an Atlas, but the entire line left with Kerensky during the Exodus and even knowledge of the design's existence became lost during the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 此版帝王蟹由星盟打造为指挥机甲，与原始 000 型于 2743 年一同推出。它由科萨拉与地球霸权秘密构想，试图通过在两肋各装一对新研制的"地狱星"大型 PPC 并辅以两具 SRM-6，打造一款致命的指挥机甲。一对新研制的 LBX/10 取代了标准自动炮。010 型完全有能力击杀一台阿特拉斯，但整条生产线随克伦斯基一同出走，连该设计存在的知识也在继承战争中失传。
氏族科技升级的金太郎。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The A configuration of the Kit Fox uses a Gauss Rifle as its primary long-range weapon. Two ER Medium Lasers provide medium and short-range firepower.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 小狐 A 配置以一门高斯步枪为主要远程武器。两门 ER 中型激光提供中近程火力。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The B configuration of the Kit Fox boasts a rapid-fire Ultra Autocannon-10 as its primary weapon, startling considering the 'Mech's tonnage. An ER Medium Laser, ER Small Laser, and an SRM-6 rack allow the Kit Fox B to finish off anything that manages to close ranges.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 小狐 B 配置以一门速射超速自动炮-10 为主武器，就机甲的吨位而言令人吃惊。一门 ER 中型激光、一门 ER 小型激光和一具 SRM-6 挂架使小狐 B 能干掉任何设法接近的目标。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Kit Fox D is configured for indirect fire support, mounting dual LRM-15 racks as well as a LRM-5. A Narc Missile Beacon is also carried, which may be exploited by the Kit Fox D itself, as the targeting systems of Clan LRMs lack a minimum range; this literally allows the Kit Fox D to run up to an enemy and mark them for increased accuracy, and then fall back, firing the entire time.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 小狐 D 配置为间接火力支援，装备双联 LRM-15 挂架以及一具 LRM-5。它还携带一具 NARC 导弹信标，且此信标可被小狐 D 自己利用——因为氏族 LRM 的瞄准系统没有最小射程，这实际上让小狐 D 能冲到敌人跟前为其标记以提升精度，然后一面后撤一面持续开火。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: In its primary configuration, the Kit Fox mounts an ER Large Laser and Small Pulse Laser on the left arm as its primary source of firepower. These are supplemented by an LB 5-X Autocannon for tactical flexibility and a Streak SRM-4 rack for close range combat.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 主配置中，小狐左臂装备一门 ER 大型激光和一门小型脉冲激光作为主要火力。它们由一门 LB 5-X 自动炮（提供战术灵活性）和一具连续 SRM-4 挂架（用于近战）作补充。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Kit Fox S is a Clan Snow Raven variant based for space combat. The primary weapon is a Large Pulse Laser, while a Medium Pulse Laser and a Small Pulse Laser complement this, with a Streak SRM-4 for additional firepower.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 小狐 S 是雪鸦氏族的太空战变体。主武器是一门大型脉冲激光，另有一门中型脉冲激光和一门小型脉冲激光作配合，并以一具连续 SRM-4 提供额外火力。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A fast moving assault ’Mech, the Kodiak was originally designed by Clan Ghost Bear as a second-line mech and represents the epitome of Ghost Bear thinking: mostly defensive but capable of surprising speed and a devastating attack when launched.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 科迪亚克是一款高速突击机甲，最初由鬼熊氏族设计为二线机甲，体现了鬼熊思维的精髓：偏重防御，但在发动时能展现出惊人的速度和毁灭性的攻击。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A fast moving assault ’Mech, the Kodiak was originally designed by Clan Ghost Bear as a second-line mech and represents the epitome of Ghost Bear thinking: mostly defensive but capable of surprising speed and a devastating attack when launched.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 科迪亚克是一款高速突击机甲，最初由鬼熊氏族设计为二线机甲，体现了鬼熊思维的精髓：偏重防御，但在发动时能展现出惊人的速度和毁灭性的攻击。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A sleek, mobile, and versatile design, the Lacerator comes equiped with 2 Clan AC5's with 2 medium lasers as backup. An AMS is installed for defense.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 撕裂者是一款流畅、机动而多用途的设计，装备 2 门氏族 AC5，另有 2 门中型激光备用。为防御还安装了 AMS。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Developed by the Capellan Confederation at the same time as the Cataphract this prototype 'Mech never entered full production. Its designs were eventually sold and used to create the Daboku and Mauler. It carries two Medium Lasers, four AC/2s, and two LRM-15
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 此原型机甲由卡佩兰邦联与铁甲舰同期开发，从未进入量产。其设计最终被出售，用于打造打木与重击者。它携带两门中型激光、四门 AC/2 和两具 LRM-15

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Loader King is one of the few IndustrialMechs still being manufactured in the Inner Sphere. This is due in large part to the fact that Achernar BattleMechs, the parent company of Achernar Heavy Industries, chose to maintain their IndustrialMech output rather than retool the lines for BattleMech production. Achernar BattleMechs already produces the Locust, Wasp, Phoenix Hawk and the Enforcer at their headquarters on New Avalon.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 装载之王是内天体仍在制造的少数工业机甲之一。这在很大程度上是因为阿克尔纳战斗机甲的母公司阿克尔纳重工选择维持其工业机甲产量，而非将生产线改装用于战斗机甲生产。阿克尔纳战斗机甲已在其新阿瓦隆总部生产蝗虫、黄蜂、凤凰鹰和执法者。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: One of the best known BattleMechs in the Inner Sphere for its low production and operation costs, the Locust is also well known in the Clans. In 2832, Clan Mongoose unleashed an upgraded version of the venerable 'Mech on the Clans, known as the Locust IIC. The speedy design complemented Mongoose tactics, enabling them to win many Trials.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 蝗虫因其低廉的生产与运营成本成为内天体最知名的战斗机甲之一，在氏族中同样广为人知。2832 年，猫鼬氏族向氏族推出这款古老机甲的升级版，称为蝗虫 IIC。该高速设计与猫鼬战术相得益彰，使他们赢下许多试炼。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Clan Jade Falcon version carries CASE with an Extended Range Medium Laser in the center torso section and two Streak SRM-2s in each arm.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 翡翠隼氏族版本携带 C.A.S.E.，中央躯干装一门增程中型激光，每臂各两具连续 SRM-2。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This Clan Smoke Jaguar version is set up to sport an Extended Range Large Laser in its center torso, with a Small Pulse Laser in each arm, making this variant a quite capable infantry killer in addition to its role as a fast sniper.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 此烟虎氏族版本在中央躯干装备一门 ER 大型激光，每臂一门小型脉冲激光，使该变体除了担任快速狙击手外，还是相当出色的步兵杀手。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This version was redesigned so that it could be produced in the Inner Sphere by Clan Jade Falcon on their Occupation Zone headquarters world of Sudeten. It replaces the small lasers of the standard variant with three General Systems Heavy Small Lasers in each arm. The medium pulse laser has been downgraded to a Series 7Ja ER Medium Laser, while a pair of additional double heat sinks are added to help deal with the increased heat.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 此版本经过重新设计，以便翡翠猎鹰氏族能在其占领区总部世界苏德滕于内天体生产。它将标准变体的小型激光换成每臂三门通用系统重型小型激光。中型脉冲激光被降级为 7Ja 系列 ER 中型激光，同时加装两台额外双倍散热器以应对增加的热量。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The original Longbow built in 2480, carried twin LRM-20s each with three tons of ammunition, supported by two Medium Lasers and a Small Laser. The Primitive Technology used limited the design's top speed to 54km/h, but this was deemed acceptable for a fire support unit.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 原版长弓于 2480 年建造，携带双联 LRM-20（各配三吨弹药），辅以两门中型激光和一门小型激光。所使用的原始技术把该设计的最高速度限制在 54 公里/小时，但这对于火力支援单位而言可以接受。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This configuration was used for direct fire support roles. A Large Pulse Laser in one arm supported an Ultra AC/10 in the other. A pair of ER Medium Lasers gave the Lupus A additional firepower in case the 'Mech went through all 30 reloads for the autocannon. Twelve double heat sinks kept the heat manageable.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 此配置用于直射火力支援角色。一臂的大型脉冲激光支援另一臂的超速 AC/10。两门 ER 中型激光为狼人 A 在自动炮的 30 发再装填打完后提供额外火力。十二台双倍散热器使热量保持在可控范围。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This version also used an autocannon, but it was a massive LB 20-X AC with three tons of ammunition. This was supported by a pair each of Medium Pulse Lasers, ER Small Lasers, and ER Medium Lasers. This variant carried eleven double heat sinks.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 此版本同样使用自动炮，但是一门巨型 LB 20-X AC，配三吨弹药。它由成对的中型脉冲激光、ER 小型激光和 ER 中型激光支援。该变体携带十一台双倍散热器。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The primary configuration of the Lupus replaces the Archer and Bombardier 'Mechs. A pair of LRM-20 launchers with improved Artemis IV guidance systems allows the warrior to destroy a foe before they can reach close range. The Lupus Prime also carries a set of jump jets which allowed a smart warrior the opportunity to hold the range open, bombarding the enemy with heavy missile barrages. The only drawback is the limited ammunition supply: A mere three tons of ammunition allows for only a brief engagement. Should the enemy close with the Lupus all is not lost. The ER Medium Laser in each arm allow the Lupus to slice off armor, and the ECM Suite makes the Lupus Prime more difficult to target.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 狼人的主配置取代了弓箭手与轰炸机两款机甲。两具配改进型 Artemis IV 制导系统的 LRM-20 发射器，让战士能在敌人接近前将其摧毁。狼人主型号还携带一套跳跃推进器，让聪明的战士有机会保持距离，用重型导弹弹幕轰炸敌人。唯一缺点是弹药有限：仅三吨弹药只够短暂交战。若敌人逼近狼人，也并非无计可施。每臂的 ER 中型激光让狼人能削切装甲，而 ECM 套件使狼人主型号更难被锁定。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Built during the Amaris civil war, the Mackie 9Hb was a stopgap attempt to solve the SLDF's sudden dearth of advanced assault mechs. By taking Mackie 9H's from the remaining Hegemony stockpiles and upgrading them with surplus parts, the SLDF hoped to create a multi role assault mech for rear echelon and support duties; potentially freeing up better equipped machines that could be used on the frontlines. Equipped with 2 Thumper Artillery pieces and a cockpit command console, the 9Hb functions as both a command mech and an Artillery support platform. Though this design functions well as a support unit, it performs poorly in direct combat. Particularly devastating is the lack of CASE around the ammo magazines, a consequence of the rushed design process.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 麦基 9Hb 在阿马里斯内战期间建造，是为解决星盟防卫军先进突击机甲突然短缺的权宜之计。通过从霸权剩余库存中取用麦基 9H 并以剩余部件升级，星盟防卫军希望打造一款用于后方梯队与支援任务的多用途突击机甲，从而腾出装备更精良的机器用于前线。9Hb 装备两门重锤火炮与一个驾驶舱指挥台，兼具指挥机甲与火炮支援平台的功能。虽然作为支援单位表现出色，但在直接战斗中表现糟糕。尤其致命的是弹药匣周围缺乏 C.A.S.E.，这是设计过程仓促的后果。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A clan buster refit developed with Comstar’s mothballed 9Hb’s, the 9Hc was an attempt to fix the failings of it’s predecessor design in a cheap and easy to maintain upgrade package. Identifying the lack of CASE and adequate secondary weapons as the key weaknesses, the Comguard designers disregarded the other weakness – the designs slow ground speed – as being of lesser importance. The designers selected an Endo Steel skeleton as the preferred option, rejecting other more expensive solutions. CASE was installed for both ammo magazines and the designers upgraded the medium lasers to ER versions; installing an extra 3 in the process with double heat sinks incorporated to balance out the heat spike. The 5 completed prototypes served with distinction on Tukayyid, though the design never reached production status; with only 2 other conversions finished before the Word of Blake seized Terra and the remaining stocks of 9Hb’s. .
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 9Hc 是利用康星封存的 9Hb 开发的"破氏族"改装型，旨在以廉价易维护的升级包修正前型设计的缺陷。康卫设计师认定缺乏 C.A.S.E. 与足够的次要武器是关键弱点，而将设计的另一缺陷——地面速度缓慢——视为次要。设计师选择内骨骼骨架为首选方案，否决了其他更昂贵的解决途径。两个弹匣都安装了 C.A.S.E.，并将中型激光升级为 ER 版本；过程中还额外加装 3 门，并配以双倍散热器以平衡热量尖峰。5 台完成的原型机在图卡伊德表现出色，尽管该设计从未进入量产；在布雷克之言夺取地球及其剩余的 9Hb 库存前，仅又完成了 2 台改装。.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Mad Dog A can bring devastating fire on targets at any range, mounting an ER PPC and an LB 5-X AC, with which it can easily cripple enemies from long range. Should it get close enough, its six SRM-6 racks ensure the demise of nearly any foe.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 疯狗 A 能在任何距离上向目标倾泻毁灭火力，装备一门 ER PPC 和一门 LB 5-X AC，凭此可轻易在远距离瘫痪敌人。一旦它贴近，六具 SRM-6 挂架几乎能确保任何敌人的灭亡。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Mad Dog’s most distinctive feature is its side torso and arm pods, which are practically full modules by themselves, suggesting that the mech was conceived as a long-range support unit. The torso modules, angled high, are ideal for missiles while the arms serve as extended turrets suited for direct-fire weaponry.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 疯狗最显著的特征是其侧躯干与臂部吊舱——它们本身几乎就是完整模块，暗示这台机甲在设计时就构想为远程支援单位。躯干模块高高倾斜，非常适合安装导弹，而臂部则充当适于直射武器的延伸炮塔。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Mad Dog C greatly differs from the other configurations, having replaced its entire weapon load with two massive Gauss Rifles for a powerful long-range punch.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 疯狗 C 与其他配置差异极大，它把全部武器载荷换成两门巨型高斯步枪，换取强大的远程打击力。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This variant uses a pair of ATM 12s that are powerful at all ranges. It also uses paired ER Medium Lasers, Medium Pulse Lasers, and ER Small Lasers. An extra heat sink helps to keep heat levels under some control.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 此变体使用两具在所有距离上都强劲的 ATM 12。它还配有成对的 ER 中型激光、中型脉冲激光和 ER 小型激光。一台额外散热器有助于将热量水平控制在某种程度的掌握之中。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Built with new Heavy Laser technology, the Mad Dog H downgrades the LRM-20 launchers to LRM-15s, so it can mount it's arsenal of a Heavy Large Laser and three Heavy Medium Lasers, making it much more capable at close range.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 疯狗 H 采用新型重型激光技术建造，将 LRM-20 发射器降级为 LRM-15，以便搭载由一门重型大型激光和三门重型中型激光组成的武器库，使其在近距离强大得多。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Mad Dog’s most distinctive feature is its side torso and arm pods, which are practically full modules by themselves, suggesting that the mech was conceived as a long-range support unit. The torso modules, angled high, are ideal for missiles while the arms serve as extended turrets suited for direct-fire weaponry.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 疯狗最显著的特征是其侧躯干与臂部吊舱——它们本身几乎就是完整模块，暗示这台机甲在设计时就构想为远程支援单位。躯干模块高高倾斜，非常适合安装导弹，而臂部则充当适于直射武器的延伸炮塔。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Built around the Extended Range Particle Projector Cannon, one of the most powerful weapons in the Clan arsenal, the Marauder IIC's weapon layout is typical of the standard Marauder, each pod-like forearm carrying an ER PPC paired with Medium Pulse Lasers. Where the Marauder IIC differs is with its torso weaponry, replacing the top-mounted autocannon and its vulnerable ammunition-feed linkage with another ER PPC, and adding a set of four ER Small Lasers. Twenty-one double heat sinks keep heat levels manageable, with an enterprising MechWarrior able to use volley fire to keep up a steady barrage of fire.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 掠夺者 IIC 以 ER 粒子投射炮——氏族武库中最强大的武器之一——为核心，其武器布局与标准掠夺者一致：每只吊舱式前臂各载一门 ER PPC 并配以中型脉冲激光。不同之处在于躯干武器：以另一门 ER PPC 取代顶部自动炮及其脆弱的供弹连接，并加装一组四门 ER 小型激光。二十一台双倍散热器将热量维持在可控水平，有进取心的机甲战士可用齐射维持稳定的火力倾泻。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A modern Clan take on the classic Succession Wars era MAR-3R Marauder, the A variant retains the arm-mounted weaponry of the standard Marauder IIC, removing the torso-mounted ER PPC and ER Small Lasers in exchange for a LB 5-X AC in its right torso supplied with single ton of ammo.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是氏族对经典继承战争时代 MAR-3R 掠夺者的现代演绎。A 变体保留标准掠夺者 IIC 的臂载武器，去掉躯干搭载的 ER PPC 与 ER 小型激光，换取右侧躯干一具 LB 5-X AC，配一吨弹药。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Marauder II was first built in 3012 in an attempt to take the firepower of the Marauder and combine it with the reliability and ruggedness of an assault chassis. This Variant was captured and rebuilt by Kurita to be an excellent PPC Boat.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 掠夺者 II 于 3012 年首次建造，旨在把掠夺者的火力与突击底盘的可靠性和坚固性结合起来。此变体被库瑞塔缴获并重建，成为一台出色的 PPC 平台。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Marauder II was first built in 3012 in an attempt to take the firepower of the Marauder and combine it with the reliability and ruggedness of an assault chassis. This was achieved by generally upgrading the entire 'Mech's chassis to allow it to carry a much heavier armor and weapons load. The 'Mech was then armored with nineteen tons of armor, giving it protection that rivals that of the Atlas. Finally, to make up for the reduced mobility of the Marauder II, the 'Mech was outfitted with jump jets that give it a jumping capability of up to ninety meters. Blackwell Heavy Industries produced the design exclusively for Wolf's Dragoons until the end of the Fourth Succession War, when Jaime Wolf allowed them to sell to others.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 掠夺者 II 于 3012 年首次建造，旨在将掠夺者的火力与突击底盘的可靠性和坚固性相结合。为此整机底盘全面升级，以承载重得多的装甲与武器。机甲配备了十九吨装甲，防护水平可与阿特拉斯匹敌。最后，为弥补掠夺者 II 机动性的下降，它装上了跳跃推进器，可跳跃至九十米。布莱克威尔重工一直为狼之龙骑兵独家生产该设计，直到第四次继承战争结束，海梅·沃尔夫才允许他们对外销售。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Marauder II was first built in 3012 in an attempt to take the firepower of the Marauder and combine it with the reliability and ruggedness of an assault chassis. This variant of the Marauder II, the -4B, is a rare introtech variant that carries a ballistic-heavy loadout while maintaining the -4A's armor and speed profile. The -4B carries a pair of AC/10s for its main firepower with 4 tons of ammo while a Large Laser and a pair of Medium Lasers back the autocannons up.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 掠夺者 II 于 3012 年首次建造，旨在将掠夺者的火力与突击底盘的可靠性和坚固性相结合。此-4B 变体是罕见的入门科技变体，携带偏重弹道的配置，同时保持-4A 的装甲与速度。它装备两门 AC/10 作为主要火力，配 4 吨弹药，另有大型激光与两门中型激光支援自动炮。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: While the standard Marauder II, the MAD-5A, was built to spec for the Wolf's Dragoons to be a line combat unit and a traditional assault mech, the MAD-4HB is only one step removed from being a pirate design. Constructed by pirates after stealing a shipment of Marauder IIs meant for someone else, they removed the fancy equipment they couldn't maintain and filled in the holes with a frankly ungodly number of rockets, allowing the -4HB a punch that can instantly delete lesser mechs and even seriously damage mechs of its own caliber. After the rockets though, the -4HB has little firepower for an assault mech.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 标准的掠夺者 II（MAD-5A）是按狼之龙骑兵的规格打造的战线作战单位与传统的突击机甲，而 MAD-4HB 离海盗设计只差一步。海盗们截获了一批本应交给他人的掠夺者 II 后自行建造，拆掉了他们无力维护的精良装备，用简直骇人的火箭数量填补空缺，使-4HB 拥有一击秒杀较弱机甲、甚至重创同级机甲的打击力。不过打完火箭之后，作为突击机甲它的火力就很有限了。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Marauder II 5D is a Davion refit to showcase both UAC10 and a Massive 400XXL Engine.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 掠夺者 II 5D 是达维昂改装型，用以展示 UAC10 与庞大的 400XXL 引擎。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Marauder II 6A is a Wolf's Dragoon upgrade to the 4A fielding an incredibly strong Engine with a Composite Structure under Reactive Plating to bring its terrible Weaponry to bear.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 掠夺者 II 6A 是狼之龙骑兵对 4A 的升级型，配备极其强劲的引擎，在反应装甲之下使用复合结构，以发挥其可怕的火力。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Named for the door guards who serve to ward off evil spirits from a home, the Men Shen is the first OmniMech to come from the Capellan Confederation, it borrows heavily from the Raven BattleMech for its basic design concept. The 'Mech is built on a lightweight Endo Steel chassis and is powered by a vulnerable but light VOX 330 XL Engine that gives it a top speed of 97.2 km/h that is augmented by MASC system allowing the 'Mech to be pushed up to 129.6 km/h in short bursts. The Men Shen comes with eleven tons of armor, giving it a respectable amount of protection. The Men Shen carries on its base chassis a Beagle Active Probe allowing it to serve in a recon role regardless of its configuration. For weapons and equipment the Men Shen has seventeen tons of free pod space.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 门神之名取自守护家宅驱除邪灵的门卫，它是卡佩兰邦联的首款全能机甲，基本设计概念大量借鉴渡鸦战斗机甲。该机甲建立在轻量化内骨骼底盘上，由脆弱但轻便的 VOX 330 XL 引擎驱动，最高速度 97.2 公里/小时，并可由 MASC 系统在短促爆发中推至 129.6 公里/小时。门神配有十一吨装甲，防护相当可观。其基础底盘搭载比格犬主动探测器，使其无论何种配置都能胜任侦察任务。武器与装备方面，门神拥有十七吨自由吊舱空间。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A close combat configuration, the Mist Lynx B has two ER Medium Lasers and two SRM-6 launchers for its primary weapons. These are backed up by a single ER Small Laser as a weapon for extremely close ranges.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 雾豹 B 是近战配置，以两门 ER 中型激光和两具 SRM-6 发射器为主武器。它们由一门 ER 小型激光作为极近距离武器支援。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The C configuration of the Mist Lynx is armed with a single ER Large Laser as its primary weapon backed up by an ER Medium Laser for close combat. For added protection, the Mist Lynx C has an Anti-Missile System for protection from missile fire and an ECM Suite to protect it from enemy electronic warfare systems.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 雾豹 C 配置以一门 ER 大型激光为主武器，辅以一门 ER 中型激光用于近战。为增强防护，雾豹 C 装有反导系统以抵御导弹火力，以及 ECM 套件以抵御敌方电子战系统。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: In its primary configuration the Mist Lynx is armed to engage an enemy at any range. For long range combat, the Mist Lynx carries a single LRM-10 launcher, which is backed up by a Streak SRM-4 launcher for close combat. Finally, to protect itself from infantry, the Mist Lynx carries two Machine Guns.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 主配置中，雾豹可在任何距离接敌。远程方面，雾豹携带一具 LRM-10 发射器，辅以一具连续 SRM-4 发射器用于近战。最后，为防御步兵，雾豹携带两挺机枪。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Naga is a fire-support successor to the first-generation Woodsman OmniMech, but is an oddity in many ways. Most of what could be pod space for the design is actually taken up by a pair of fixed Arrow IV Artillery Systems.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 娜迦是第一代樵夫全能机甲的支援后继型，但在许多方面都颇为另类。本可作为吊舱空间的大部分位置，实际被两套固定式箭矢 IV 火炮系统占据。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Naga is a fire-support successor to the first-generation Woodsman OmniMech, but is an oddity in many ways. Most of what could be pod space for the design is actually taken up by a pair of fixed Arrow IV Artillery Systems.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Night Gyr B seeks to destroy opponents before they can return fire. A pair of Gauss Rifles and LB-X Autocannon/2s carry out that mandate. Ammo is somewhat lacking, however, so this design cannot stray far from supply, especially as it has no backup energy weapons.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 夜隼 B 力求在对手还击之前将其摧毁。两门高斯步枪和两门 LB-X 自动炮/2 执行这一使命。然而弹药稍显不足，因此该设计不能远离补给，尤其因为它没有备用能量武器。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This missile boat carries four LRM-20 launchers, each of which is slaved to an Artemis IV FCS. Six tons of ammunition is barely enough to keep it firing for a minute. A Large Pulse Laser and Medium Pulse Laser are effective backup weapons.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这款导弹平台携带四具 LRM-20 发射器，每具都从属于一套 Artemis IV 火控系统。六吨弹药勉强够它持续开火一分钟。一门大型脉冲激光和一门中型脉冲激光是有效的备用武器。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The primary configuration is hard-hitting, mounting a pair of ER PPCs located in the left arm and an Ultra Autocannon/10 in the right. This blistering firepower can often take down an opponent before they are in range. Three Medium Pulse Lasers serve as accurate backups. Eight additional double heat sinks keep the 'Mech fairly cool.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 主配置打击凶猛，左臂装一对 ER PPC，右侧装一门超速自动炮/10。这种炽烈火力常常能在对手进入射程前将其击倒。三门中型脉冲激光作为精准的备用武器。八台额外双倍散热器使机甲保持相当凉爽。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Variant A: This Cat can Pounce, equipped with 4 jump jets, and a targeting computer.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: A 变体：这只"猫"能猛扑，配备 4 个跳跃推进器和一台瞄准计算机。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This variant of the NovaCat trades lasers for missles, sporting 6 Clan LRM 15's
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 此型号的诺瓦猫用导弹替换了激光，装备 6 具氏族 LRM 15。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This variant of NovaCat introduces Clan ballistic capeability to the Onmimech.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 此型号的诺瓦猫为全能机甲引入了氏族弹道武器能力。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: 3 Large Heavy Lasers and an LBX Autocannon require extra heatsinks and a targeting computer to compensate.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 3 门大型重型激光与一门 LBX 自动炮需要额外散热器和一台瞄准计算机来平衡。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This variant of the 12 meter tall Totem Mech of Clan Nova cat runs hot.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 此型号是氏族诺瓦猫 12 米高的图腾机甲，散热较差。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A sleek, mobile, and versatile design, the Clan Nova was long suspected to be one of the first OmniMechs produced by the Clans.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为一款流线型、机动且多用途的设计，氏族诺瓦长期被认为是最早由氏族生产的全能机甲之一。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Since it was the chosen BattleMech of the Great Father, the venerable Orion has always held a special place in the mystique of the Clans. Out of respect for General Kerensky's legacy, all the Clans maintained the design for several decades even as the development of newer and more advanced technologies increasingly left it less effective on the battlefield. Not a radical reworking of the design, as some Clan upgrades are, the Orion IIC replaces much of the innards and weapons of the original, while preserving its mass and aesthetics. This IIC upgrade utilizes an Endo Steel chassis and twelve tons of Ferro-Fibrous armor, while also making use of twelve double heat sinks, freeing up weight for heavier weapons loadout.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 由于它是"伟大之父"选用的战斗机甲，古老的猎户座在氏族的神秘传统中始终占有特殊地位。出于对克伦斯基将军遗产的尊重，所有氏族都维持该设计数十年，即便更新更先进技术的发展日益令它在战场上失去效力。猎户座 IIC 并非像某些氏族升级那样彻底重做，而是更换了原版的大部分内部结构与武器，同时保留其质量与外观。此次 IIC 升级采用内骨骼底盘和十二吨铁纤维装甲，并使用十二台双倍散热器，腾出重量以搭载更重的武器。

This variant switches the Gauss Rifle to an Ultra Autocannon/10 and downgrading the LRM-20 rack into an LRM-15.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The original primitive Orion 'Mech as it was first commissioned lacked an LRM launcher and used an Autocannon/5 in place of the AC/10.  A massive 360 engine allowed the 'Mech to obtain a maximum speed of nearly 64.8 km/h, however there was not enough saved weight to mount additional weaponry besides two Medium Lasers, one in each arm. In addition it only mounted 14.5 tons of armor, and ultimately would be considered too lightly armed and armored with the prototype dismissed as a candidate for production.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 初版原始猎户座机甲在被首次定型时没有 LRM 发射器，并以一门自动炮/5 取代 AC/10。一台巨大的 360 引擎使机甲能达到近 64.8 公里/小时的最高速度，但节省的重量不足以在每臂各一门中型激光之外加装更多武器。此外它只披挂 14.5 吨装甲，最终被认为武装与装甲都过于薄弱，该原型被排除在量产候选之外。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Built by General Mechanics, the ON1-H was the third known primitive prototype of the Orion 'Mech that was eventually accepted for mass production in 2456. While slower than the first iterations, with a top speed of only 54 km/h (the same as that of a Mackie or Banshee), due to the inclusion of a smaller 275-class engine, the additional weight saved allowed the designers to mount far more firepower. A newly developed Class-10 Prototype Autocannon was installed and two tons of ammo in place of the AC/5. This was backed up by two 5-tube Long-Range Missile launchers with one ton of reloads in the left torso for striking enemies at range and a short-range SRM-4 missile launcher and a ton of ammunition installed in the left arm for close-in defense. It was also heavily protected by 21 tons of armor. A minimal amount of heatsinks, however, could cause build-up of heat within crippling levels, but could be avoided by competent MechWarriors.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: ON1-H 由通用机械制造，是猎户座机甲第三个已知的原始原型，最终于 2456 年被批准量产。虽然比最初几版更慢，最高速度仅 54 公里/小时（与麦基或女妖相当），因为采用了更小的 275 级引擎，但节省的额外重量让设计师能装上多得多的火力。它安装了新研制的 10 级原型自动炮和两吨弹药，取代 AC/5。远程打击方面辅以两具 5 管远程导弹发射器（左躯干一吨再装填），近身防御则有左臂的一具短程 SRM-4 导弹发射器和一吨弹药。它还有 21 吨装甲的重型防护。然而散热器数量极少，热量可能累积到致残水平，但能干的机甲战士可以避免这一点。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This is one of the many minor variants of the ON1-M model introduced in 3052. The Narc Missile Beacon is removed to allow a larger SRM-6 to replace the four pack. Both missile racks also have Artemis IV Fire Control System to increase accuracy. Finally, medium pulse lasers are mounted in place of original mediums.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是 3052 年推出的 ON1-M 型号众多次要变体之一。它移除 NARC 导弹信标，以便用更大的 SRM-6 取代四联装。两个导弹挂架也都配有 Artemis IV 火控系统以提升精度。最后，原来的中型激光换成中型脉冲激光。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A second minor variant of the ON1-M introduced in 3058. The LB-X Autocannon/10 is swapped for a Light Gauss Rifle with a single ton of ammunition while the medium lasers are upgraded to extended range versions.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是 3058 年推出的 ON1-M 第二个次要变体。LB-X 自动炮/10 换成一门轻型高斯步枪（配一吨弹药），中型激光则升级为增程版本。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Upgraded with Star League technology, the 2D variant of the Ostroc extends the 'Mechs maximum range by replacing the Large Lasers with two ER Large Lasers. The 2D retains the Medium Lasers and SRM-4 of the 2C model. To handle the heat burden it is also equipped with double heat sinks. Being a relatively rare design, the Ostroc had no official field refit kit but the 2D variant was a common upgrade in 3050 if the parts could be obtained.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 奥斯特洛克 2D 变体以星盟科技升级，将大型激光换成两门 ER 大型激光，从而拓展机甲的最大射程。2D 保留 2C 型号的中型激光和 SRM-4。为应对热负荷它还配备双倍散热器。作为一个相对罕见的设计，奥斯特洛克没有官方野战改装套件，但 2D 变体在 3050 年是常见的升级方案——前提是能弄到零件。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 2L variant of the Ostroc introduced in 2884 is modified for long range combat. The SRM-4 launcher has been replaced with an LRM-5 launcher, increasing the 'Mechs long-range damage capabilities slightly by sacrificing some of its close range firepower.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 奥斯特罗克 2L 变体于 2884 年推出，为远程战斗而改装。SRM-4 发射器换成 LRM-5 发射器，以牺牲部分近程火力为代价略微提升机甲的远程伤害能力。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 2M Ostwar was armed with a twenty-tube Doombud Long Range Missile launcher for its long range attacks. In close range, the 'Mech was armed with two four-tubed Shannon SH-40 Short-Range Missile launchers in each of its paddle shaped forearms. It also mounted two Martell Medium Lasers mounted on the left torso. The 'Mech carried three tons of ammunition for the LRM rack, while carrying a ton of SRM ammunition in its left arm.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 2M 奥斯特战争装备一具 20 管末日芽远程导弹发射器用于远程攻击。近距离方面，它的两只桨形前臂各装备两具四管香农 SH-40 短程火箭发射器。左躯干还装有两门马特尔中型激光。机甲为 LRM 挂架携带三吨弹药，左臂则携带一吨 SRM 弹药。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Owens is intended to be an OmniMech upgrade of the Jenner BattleMech. The intended role for the Owens is as a cavalry 'Mech that can move along the enemy lines and designate targets for bombardment with Arrow IV artillery attacks. The Owens is a strong spotting unit as well as a point 'Mech for C3 lances with its permanently mounted TAG laser designator, Beagle Probe and C3 Slave unit.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 欧文斯旨在作为詹纳战斗机甲的全能机甲升级型。其定位是骑兵机甲，可沿敌方战线机动并为我方箭矢 IV 炮击标记目标。凭借固定安装的 TAG 激光指示器、比格犬探测器与 C3 从属单元，欧文斯既是优秀的侦察单位，也是 C3 小队的先锋机甲。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Pack Hunter is the first new design produced by Clan Wolf-in-Exile on Arc-Royal. It also represents a new partnership between Phelan's Wolves and the Kell Hounds, as the armor and communications gear are Kell Hound products, traded to the Wolves in exchange for Endo Steel. Reflecting their Khan's bias towards light, fast designs, Wolf scientists designed the Pack Hunter to be fast and have a sharp bite. Though its four tons of armor are light, the BattleMech is supposed to use its speed and maneuverability to stay out of trouble.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 猎群者是流亡狼氏族在弧-皇家星生产的第一款新设计。它也代表费兰的狼群与凯尔猎犬之间的新合作——装甲与通讯设备均为凯尔猎犬的产品，用来向狼群换取内骨骼。狼族科学家遵循其可汗对轻型快速设计的偏爱，把猎群者设计得又快又利齿。尽管四吨装甲偏薄，这台战斗机甲本应依靠速度与机动性避免陷入麻烦。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Perseus is the product of a program begun by the League Central Coordination and Command to create an OmniMech completely indigenous to the Free Worlds League from concept to production. The Perseus shares much with the venerable Orion, a staple of Free Worlds League Military, both broadly resembling the older design visually and using a number of the same components. This similarity prompted more than a few FWLM technicians to nickname the new design the Omni-Orion and the deployment of Perseus has largely been to front-line units that fielded large concentrations of its progenitor, replacing older Orions on a one-for-one basis. Built on a lightweight Endo Steel chassis, the Perseus is powered by a Hermes 300 XL engine helping save even more weight and giving the 'Mech a top speed of 64.8 km/h. The advanced structure and engine save a great deal of weight for weapons and equipment. The Perseus is protected by fourteen tons of Valiant Lamellor armor, giving it around average armor protection for a 'Mech of its size. It also has twelve double heat sinks that are fixed on the chassis.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Developed for the Star League Defense Force Royal Divisions in 2692, this variant of the Phoenix Hawk LAM used four Medium Lasers and a single ER Large Laser as its main firepower. Twelve double heat sinks kept the heat curve low, but the limited fuel, armor, and maneuverability made the Phoenix Hawk LAM easy prey for AeroSpace Fighters of the same weight. It could maneuver fast enough to evade heavier foes however
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 此型凤凰鹰 LAM 于 2692 年为星盟防卫军皇家师开发，以四门中型激光和一门 ER 大型激光为主要火力。十二台双倍散热器将热量曲线维持在低位，但有限的燃料、装甲与机动性使凤凰鹰 LAM 成为同重量航空战斗机的易捕猎物。不过它的机动速度足以避开更重的敌人

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This version was created before the introduction of the PHX-HK2, in 2695. It removed the ER Large Laser, a Medium Laser, and two heat sinks, replacing them with an experimental Snub-Nose PPC, Beagle Active Probe, and an additional half ton of armor.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 此版本在 PHX-HK2 推出之前（2695 年）就被制造。它移除了一门 ER 大型激光、一门中型激光和两台散热器，换成一门实验型短鼻 PPC、比格犬主动探测器和额外半吨装甲。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Phoenix Hawk LAM was the largest Land-Air 'Mech produced during the Star League. Allied Aerospace reworked their designs for conversion equipment and the size of the LAM, learning from their mistake with the Shadow Hawk LAM and the success of the Stinger LAM. The resulting LAM was the largest LAM ever constructed capable of remaining in AirMech mode. Unfortunately, large Land-Air 'Mech conversion technology was not fully researched before the fall of the Star League, and the Phoenix Hawk LAM frequently met its end due to the occasional glitch. The end of the Star League and destruction of the Allied Aerospace facilities at the beginning of the First Succession War prevented further development and refinement.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 凤凰鹰 LAM 是星盟时期生产的最大陆空机甲。联合航空重做了其变身设备与 LAM 尺寸的设计，吸取了影鹰 LAM 的教训与毒刺 LAM 的成功经验。成品是有史以来最大的、能在机甲空中模式维持飞行的 LAM。遗憾的是，大型陆空机甲变身技术在星盟覆灭前未获充分研究，凤凰鹰 LAM 常因偶发故障而殒命。星盟的终结与第一次继承战争初期联合航空设施的毁灭，阻断了进一步的开发与改良。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: House Marik produced a variant of the Phoenix Hawk LAM which replaces the Large Laser and Machine Guns with a Holly LRM-10.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 马里克家族生产了一款凤凰鹰 LAM 变体，将大型激光和机枪换成冬青 LRM-10。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Piranha's main threat is its twelve Series XII Rotary Machine Guns. These are a serious threat to any foe on such a speedy 'Mech, especially if a Star of Piranhas operate in a pack, and such a large array allows the 'Mech to chew through an opponent's rear armor almost instantly. They are most deadly, however, to unarmored infantry, capable of wiping out an entire company in seconds. For work against hardened targets, the Piranha mounts a pair of Mk. 3 ER Medium Lasers and a single Series 1 ER Small Laser. Since the design only uses ten single heat sinks, the MechWarrior must still manage heat levels. The ammunition dependency of the Machine Guns ensure that Piranhas must stay close to supply lines, so most have been relegated to solahma or garrison roles.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 食人鱼的主要威胁是它的十二挺 XII 系列旋转机枪。在一台如此快速的机甲上，这对任何敌人都是严重威胁，尤其当一个"星"的食人鱼成群作战时；如此庞大的阵列让机甲几乎瞬间啃穿对手的背部装甲。不过它们对无装甲步兵最为致命，能在数秒内歼灭一整连。对付硬化目标时，食人鱼装有双联 Mk. 3 ER 中型激光和一门 1 系列 ER 小型激光。由于该设计仅使用十台单散热器，机甲战士仍须管理热量水平。机枪对弹药的依赖使食人鱼必须靠近补给线，因此大多数被降级到索拉马或驻防任务。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Pouncer was originally a test bed design that was upgraded to combat specifications on the orders of then-IlKhan Ulric Kerensky, as it was realized that a more mobile 'Mech was needed when combating Inner Sphere forces. The Pouncer is built on a lightweight DSAM Endo 4 Endo Steel chassis and is powered by a 240 XL engine which gives it a maximum speed of 97.2 km/h. The 'Mech's mobility is enhanced with five Grandthrust Mk. Four jump jets that allow it to jump up to one hundred and fifty meters. For protection from enemy fire, the Pouncer has a respectable six tons of Forging ZM15 Ferro-Fibrous armor. Overall, the Pouncer is an excellent OmniMech with fifteen and a half tons of pod space, allowing it to carry a wide variety of weapons payloads.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 猛扑者原本是试验台设计，因意识到对抗内天体部队需要更机动的机甲，遂奉时任伊尔汗乌尔里克·克伦斯基之命升级至作战规格。它采用轻量化的 DSAM Endo 4 内骨骼底盘，由 240 XL 引擎驱动，最大速度 97.2 公里/小时。五个 Grandthrust Mk. Four 跳跃推进器使其机动性提升，可跳跃至一百五十米。为抵御敌方火力，猛扑者装备了可观的六吨 Forging ZM15 铁纤维装甲。总体而言，猛扑者是一款出色的全能机甲，拥有十五吨半的吊舱空间，可搭载多种武器配置。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Technicron's replacement for the original 4G model, the 5M was introduced in 3049 as an answer to the original's heat problems by replacing the thirteen normal heat sinks with double-strength versions. It also improved the design's defenses by swapping out the regular armor with Kallon FWL Special Ferro-Fibrous and installing CASE for the LRM's ammunition. The space necessary for these upgrades was provided for by removing the SRM launcher for a one-shot Hovertec SRM-4 Launcher, a disposable missile launcher more commonly found on VTOLs, hovercraft and similar combat vehicles. The loss in sheer short-range firepower is more than made up for by the other upgrades to the design.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 5M 是泰克尼创为原 4G 型号打造的替代品，于 3049 年推出，以双倍强度散热器取代十三台普通散热器来回应原版的热量问题。它还通过把常规装甲换成卡隆 FWL 特制铁纤维、并为 LRM 弹药安装 C.A.S.E. 来改善设计的防御。这些升级所需的空间来自移除 SRM 发射器，换成单次发射的霍弗泰克 SRM-4 发射器——一种在垂直起降机、悬浮车及类似战斗车辆上更常见的可弃导弹发射器。近程火力上的损失，被其他升级远远补偿。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Simple, straightforward, and accurate; the Rifleman IIC is armed with four Large Pulse Lasers. This allows it to pick apart enemies from a respectable range, as well as easily target incoming aircraft. A single ER Small Laser is installed, seemingly as an afterthought. Nineteen double heat sinks keep heat mostly in check, though volley fire should be used.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 简单、直接而精准；步枪手 IIC 装备四门大型脉冲激光，使其能在相当远的距离拆解敌人，也能轻松瞄准来袭飞行器。一门 ER 小型激光像是事后想起才装上的。十九台双倍散热器基本能压制热量，不过仍应使用齐射。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This variant removes all of the weapons and equipment, and replaces them with four Ultra Autocannon/2s and six tons of ammunition. The weight saved, plus a half ton from armor, is used to upgrade the engine to allow the 'Mech a top speed of 64 km/h. MechWarriors must be exceptionally wary of the large, vulnerable ammo bins.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 此变体移除全部武器与装备，换成四门超速自动炮/2 和六吨弹药。节省的重量加上半吨装甲用于升级引擎，使机甲最高速度达 64 公里/小时。机甲战士必须格外警惕那些庞大而脆弱的弹药箱。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A modern Clan take on the classic Succession Wars era RFL-3N Rifleman, the A variant carries a Large Pulse Laser and Ultra Autocannon/5 in each arm, supported by an ER Medium Laser in each side torso. Built around a 260-rated XL Engine, Endo Steel frame, and ten tons of Ferro-Fibrous armor, the A is fitted with sixteen Double Heat Sinks and four tons of UAC ammo.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是氏族对经典继承战争时代 RFL-3N 步枪手的现代演绎。A 变体在每臂装备一门大型脉冲激光和一门超速自动炮/5，两侧躯干各由一门 ER 中型激光支援。它以 260 级 XL 引擎、内骨骼框架和十吨铁纤维装甲为基础，配十六台双倍散热器和四吨 UAC 弹药。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A variant reserved for SLDF Royal units, this Champion was introduced in 2751 and replaces all the standard weaponry with a Gauss Rifle and ER PPC. It also uses double heat sinks. This gave the -1Nb an extremely long range weapon profile and a serious punch while also solving its heat issues.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是为星盟防卫军皇家部队保留的变体，2751 年推出，将所有标准武器换成一门高斯步枪和一门 ER PPC。它还使用双倍散热器。这使-1Nb 拥有极远射程的武器配置和强悍打击力，同时解决了散热问题。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 'Mech was also part of Khan Koga's attempts to revitalize the fading Clan that invented the OmniMech.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这台机甲也是可汗科加重振发明全能机甲却日渐衰落的氏族的努力之一。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: At the beginning of this century, the leaders of Clan Nova Cat commissioned a new medium Mech that could compete with and outperform the Fenris. The Shadow Cat was the result.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 本世纪初，氏族诺瓦猫的领袖委托研制一款能与芬里斯竞争并超越它的新型中型机甲。影猫由此诞生。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: At the beginning of this century, the leaders of Clan Nova Cat commissioned a new medium Mech that could compete with and outperform the Fenris. The Shadow Cat was the result.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 本世纪初，氏族诺瓦猫的领袖委托研制一款能与芬里斯竞争并超越它的新型中型机甲。影猫由此诞生。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: At the beginning of this century, the leaders of Clan Nova Cat commissioned a new medium Mech that could compete with and outperform the Fenris. The Shadow Cat was the result.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 本世纪初，氏族诺瓦猫的领袖委托研制一款能与芬里斯竞争并超越它的新型中型机甲。影猫由此诞生。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: At the beginning of this century, the leaders of Clan Nova Cat commissioned a new medium Mech that could compete with and outperform the Fenris. The Shadow Cat was the result.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 本世纪初，氏族诺瓦猫的领袖委托研制一款能与芬里斯竞争并超越它的新型中型机甲。影猫由此诞生。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: At the beginning of this century, the leaders of Clan Nova Cat commissioned a new medium Mech that could compete with and outperform the Fenris. The Shadow Cat was the result.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 本世纪初，氏族诺瓦猫的领袖委托研制一款能与芬里斯竞争并超越它的新型中型机甲。影猫由此诞生。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A Clan Tech Shadowhawk. The first version of the Shadow Hawk IIC that Inner Sphere forces encountered is meant for close-range fighting, and appears to be designed with urban warfare in mind.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 氏族科技影鹰。内天体部队遭遇的第一版影鹰 IIC 是为近战而设，看起来在设计时考虑了城市战。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A Clan Tech Shadowhawk. This variant is designed for long-range, direct-fire support.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 氏族科技影鹰。此变体为远程直射支援而设计。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A Clan Tech Shadowhawk. A newer variant that dates to the late 3050s, the IIC 3's main gun is a Heavy Large Laser.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 氏族科技影鹰。较新的变体，可追溯至 3050 年代末，IIC 3 的主炮是一门重型大型激光。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A Clan Tech Shadowhawk. First fielded in 3060, the IIC 4 was resulted in a 'Mech that is visually very different from the design it is considered a variant of.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 氏族科技影鹰。于 3060 年首次投入战场，IIC 4 造就了一台在外观上与其所归属的设计大相径庭的机甲。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The original and considerably flawed prototypes were completed in 2680. Based on the Shadow Hawk SHD-2H, the 'Mech carried a Class 2 Autocannon in place of the Class 5. The SHD-X1 carried only 6.5 tons of armor for protection. Only one chassis survived multiple crashes caused by its faulty schematics. It had a top ground speed of 86.4 km/h like its progenitor, the SHD-2H, and used ten single heat sinks.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 最初且缺陷颇多的原型机于 2680 年完成。以影鹰 SHD-2H 为基础，该机甲以一门 2 级自动炮取代 5 级。SHD-X1 仅有 6.5 吨装甲用于防护。因其图纸错误导致多次坠机，仅有一台机体幸存。它的最高地面速度与前辈 SHD-2H 相同，为 86.4 公里/小时，并使用十台单散热器。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Allied Aerospace won the SLDF's contract to produce a series of Land-Air mechs with a design based on the venerable Shadow HawkBattleMech. Allied gave their new Land-Air 'Mech the ability to convert directly into an Aerospace Fighter. While construction was completed in 2680, thanks to the chassis' numerous flaws, lackluster performance and a number of ill-fated and publicly witnessed test-flights disasters during SLDF reviews in 2682, Allied Aerospace was forced to go back to the drawing board. The more refined X2 variant faced considerable scrutiny by SLDF evaluators in 2684, successfully meeting the SLDF's requirements but still rejected thanks to its high fuel consumption and the bad press generated by the earlier X1. Twenty SHD-X2 were built for trials with potential customers, but failed to attract any interest. Ultimately Allied scrapped the Shadow Hawk LAM program in favor of what became the considerably more successful Phoenix Hawk LAM.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 联合航空赢得星盟防卫军生产一系列陆空机甲的合同，设计以古老的影鹰战斗机甲为基础。联合航空让新型陆空机甲能直接变身为航空战斗机。虽然制造于 2680 年完成，但由于底盘缺陷众多、性能不佳，加上 2682 年星盟防卫军评审期间一系列不幸且公开可见的试飞灾难，联合航空被迫重头再来。更精细的 X2 变体于 2684 年接受了星盟评审员的严格审查，虽然成功满足星盟要求，却仍因高燃料消耗和早期 X1 造成的负面报道而被否决。二十台 SHD-X2 被造出来供潜在客户试用，却未能引起任何兴趣。最终联合航空放弃了影鹰 LAM 项目，转而投向后来相当成功的凤凰鹰 LAM。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: First introduced in 2467, this first generation of the Shadow Hawk employs early BattleMech technology in its weaponry, equipment and its armor. This design was first produced by Lang Industries on Caph, where it was designed as part of the Hegemony's efforts to keep ahead of the Inner Sphere's newly stolen BattleMech technology.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 影鹰的第一代于 2467 年首次推出，其武器、装备与装甲都采用早期战斗机甲技术。该设计最初由卡夫星上的朗工业制造，是霸权为保持领先于内天体新近窃取战斗机甲技术的努力的一部分。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Shadow Hawk 2Hb was designed for the Star League's Royal regiments, which changed the mission profile to favor close range engagements exclusively. The -2Hb has little at range but is deadly dangerous up close thanks to its heavy weapons load.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 影鹰 2Hb 为星盟皇家团设计，任务定位改为专门偏好近距离交战。-2Hb 在远距离几乎无能为力，但凭借重型武器装载，近身时极为凶险。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Shadow Hawk 2I variant comes with a UAC/10 coupled with a nasty Inferno Launcher, but in doing so sacrifices its jump capabilities.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 影鹰 2I 变体配备一门 UAC/10 和一具凶恶的燃烧弹发射器，但为此牺牲了跳跃能力。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Shadow Hawk 2K removes all the armaments of the original, aside from its LRM-5, and replaces them with a single PPC.  Five additional Heat Sinks are also added to help with the excess heat.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 影鹰 2K 移除原版除 LRM-5 之外的全部武器，换成单门 PPC，并加装五台额外散热器以应对多余热量。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Shadow Hawk 2Ki was conceived during the First Succession War by the Draconis Combine in 2803. As the enraged Federated Suns pushed the Kuritan troops back, the Draconis Combine dramatically overhauled the chassis by replacing almost all of its original armaments, most notably swapping in an upgraded PPC in place of an Autocannon.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 影鹰 2Ki 由德拉科尼斯联合体于 2803 年第一次继承战争期间构想。当愤怒的联邦太阳系将库瑞塔部队击退时，联合体大幅改造底盘，替换了几乎所有原始武器，最显著的是用一门升级版 PPC 换下自动炮。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 5M Shadow Hawk is the first complete overhaul and upgrade of the design, unveiled in 3048 by Earthwerks for the Free Worlds League. The chassis has been upgraded to an Earthwerks SHD II Endo Steel frame, an additional ton of armor was added, two additional jump jets were fitted for a total jumping distance of 150 meters, the engine replaced with an extralight version of the Hermes 275, and the weapons load has undergone an almost complete renovation. The original autocannon has been updated to an Imperator Ultra Autocannon/5, the LRM launcher to a Doombud LRM-20, and the head-mounted SRM launcher to a Hovertec Streak SRM-2. The amount of ammunition carried and the left-arm medium laser are maintained, and while the number of heat sinks was reduced to ten these were upgrade to double-strength models.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 5M 影鹰是该设计的首次彻底翻修与升级，由地球工厂于 3048 年为自由世界联盟推出。底盘升级为地球工厂 SHD II 内骨骼框架，增加一吨装甲，加装两个跳跃推进器使总跳跃距离达 150 米，引擎换成赫尔墨斯 275 的超轻型版本，武器配置几乎全面翻新。原始自动炮升级为帝皇超速自动炮/5，LRM 发射器换为末日芽 LRM-20，头部 SRM 发射器换为霍弗泰克连续 SRM-2。弹药携带量与左臂中型激光保持不变，散热器数量虽减至十台但升级为双倍强度型号。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Created by Maverick Industries, the 5MI is a redesign of House Marik’s 5M model. Designed to compete with the Griffin 1DS and other new designs, the 5MI was Mavericks attempt to win over the recalcitrant FedCom military. Focusing on improving survivability and battlefield endurance, the 5MI used new technology like DHS and an Artemis IV FSC to give it an edge. Unfortunately the design was deemed too expensive to produce and as a result the military declined to purchase any of the initial production run. Such poor performance led to the second manufacturing run being cancelled and resources diverted to more promising lines. The surviving models were sold off to various mercenary groups, though the Maverick Industries scion would use one during her time in the 10th Lyran Guards; netting the company the occasional conversion or custom order from fellow members of the regiment.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 5MI 由马弗里克工业打造，是马里克家族 5M 型号的重新设计。为与狮鹫 1DS 及其他新设计竞争，5MI 是马弗里克试图赢得顽固的联邦联邦军方青睐的尝试。它聚焦于提升生存性与战场续航力，采用双倍散热器和 Artemis IV 火控系统等新技术以取得优势。遗憾的是该设计被认为生产成本过高，军方因此拒绝购买首批量产的任何一台。如此糟糕的表现导致第二批生产被取消，资源转向更有前景的产品线。幸存的型号被卖给各佣兵团体，不过马弗里克工业的继承人曾在第十莱兰卫队服役期间使用过一台；这为公司偶尔从该团同僚那里赢得改装或定制订单。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 5S is a variant of the 5M used by the Special Forces. It replaces all standard weapons with one Large Laser, one medium pulse laser and four medium lasers. In addition, it carries a Beagle Active Probe and an ECM Suite.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 5S 是特种部队使用的 5M 变体。它将所有标准武器换成一门大型激光、一门中型脉冲激光和四门中型激光。此外还携带比格犬主动探测器和一套 ECM 套件。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Reintroduced in 3053, the Spector mounts a Magna 245 XL engine in combination with an XL Engine and an  Endo Steel chassis. It carries seven and a half tons of armor along with seven jump jets. The Spector carries a Nightwind Large Laser as its primary weapon,  backed up by a pair of Defiance B3M Medium Lasers and a single Defiance B4S Small Laser for close combat. Defensively the Spector carries a Norse Guardian ECM Suite that allows it to defend itself against advanced enemy targeting and range finding equipment.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 幽灵于 3053 年重新推出，采用玛格纳 245 XL 引擎，结合 XL 引擎与内骨骼底盘。它携带七吨半装甲和七个跳跃推进器。幽灵以一门风夜大型激光为主武器，辅以两门迪法恩斯 B3M 中型激光和一门迪法恩斯 B4S 小型激光用于近战。防御方面，幽灵携带北欧守护者 ECM 套件，可防御敌方先进的瞄准与测距设备。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An upgrade originating from the Free Worlds League, the 5M variant of the Stalker was introduced in 3050 using moderate amounts of Star League technology. Most of the weaponry was retained but both large lasers were removed for a single Diverse Optics Sunbeam ER Large Laser placed in the 'Mech's centerline and a Narc Missile Beacon in the left torso accompanied by two tons of reloads, allowing the Stalker to tag enemy units with homing beacon and direct friendly missile fire onto them. The seventeen double heat sinks of the 5M afford it far greater heat efficiency than the twenty single heat sinks of previous models, although it still could not handle firing all of its weaponry simultaneously, and an additional ton of armor was added for survivability. Other changes included the use of proprietary components such as an Irian E.A.R. communications system, Riese-456 armor and a Irian Chassis Class 30. Unfortunately the designers of the new 5M dismissed the inclusion of CASE, a factor which led directly to the deaths of several Stalkers during the Clan Invasion due to ammunition cook-offs caused by overheating and weapon penetrations.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 5M 变体源自自由世界联盟，是潜行者的升级版，于 3050 年推出，使用了适度数量的星盟技术。大部分武器得以保留，但两门大型激光被移除，换成一门装在机甲中线上的"多元光学阳光"ER 大型激光，以及左躯干一具 NARC 导弹信标配两吨再装填，使潜行者能为敌方单位打上自导信标并把友军导弹火力引导到它们身上。5M 的十七台双倍散热器赋予它远胜前型号二十台单散热器的散热效率，尽管它仍无法同时发射全部武器，另加了一吨装甲以提升生存性。其他改动包括采用专有组件，如"伊里安 E.A.R."通讯系统、里泽-456 装甲和伊里安 30 级底盘。遗憾的是，新 5M 的设计者放弃了 C.A.S.E.，这一因素直接导致氏族入侵期间数台潜行者因过热与武器穿透引发弹药殉爆而损毁。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The original Stinger LAM used by the Star League Defense Force Royal Divisions, this version carried a Medium Pulse Laser and replaced the Machine Guns with Small Pulse Lasers. Double heat sinks kept the temperature manageable. It was also more heavily armored than its forerunner, carrying five tons of protection.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是星盟防卫军皇家师使用的原始毒刺 LAM，此版本携带一门中型脉冲激光，并以轻型脉冲激光取代机枪。双倍散热器使温度可控。它的装甲也较前型更厚，携带五吨防护。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: In 2680, the Star League requested designers to develop 'Mechs which could fly as well as function as standard 'Mechs. The first Land-Air 'Mech off the drawing board, the Shadow Hawk LAM, proved so fatally flawed, the concept was almost shelved. However, LexaTech Industries reworked the conversion equipment and unveiled the first viable LAM, the Stinger LAM in 2688, based on the old Stinger design. LexaTech's reworking of the concept proved so successful, the Land-Air 'Mech became highly sought after, especially for space combat operations. In fact, the Stinger LAM first saw combat destroying a nuclear weapons facility in the Oort Cloud orbiting Sol, Terra's star. Found in the Draconis Combine, this variant uses two pairs of Martell Small Lasers on the arms instead of a single Medium Laser.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 2680 年，星盟要求设计师开发既能飞行又能作为标准机甲运作的机甲。首款走下绘图板的陆空机甲——影鹰 LAM——被证明缺陷致命，该概念几乎被搁置。然而莱克萨科技工业重做了变身设备，于 2688 年推出首款可用的 LAM——毒刺 LAM，以老式毒刺设计为基础。莱克萨对概念的改造极为成功，陆空机甲变得极受追捧，尤其是在太空作战中。事实上，毒刺 LAM 首次参战就是摧毁太阳系恒星泰拉轨道上奥尔特云中的一处核武器设施。此变体见于德拉科尼斯联合体，臂部使用两对马特尔小型激光取代单门中型激光。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: In 2680, the Star League requested designers to develop 'Mechs which could fly as well as function as standard 'Mechs. The first Land-Air 'Mech off the drawing board, the Shadow Hawk LAM, proved so fatally flawed, the concept was almost shelved. However, LexaTech Industries reworked the conversion equipment and unveiled the first viable LAM, the Stinger LAM in 2688, based on the old Stinger design. LexaTech's reworking of the concept proved so successful, the Land-Air 'Mech became highly sought after, especially for space combat operations. In fact, the Stinger LAM first saw combat destroying a nuclear weapons facility in the Oort Cloud orbiting Sol, Terra's star. The standard production model uses three Magna Medium Lasers mounted on the head and arms.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 2680 年，星盟要求设计师开发既能飞行又能作为标准机甲运作的机甲。首款走下绘图板的陆空机甲——影鹰 LAM——被证明缺陷致命，该概念几乎被搁置。然而莱克萨科技工业重做了变身设备，于 2688 年推出首款可用的 LAM——毒刺 LAM，以老式毒刺设计为基础。莱克萨对概念的改造极为成功，陆空机甲变得极受追捧，尤其是在太空作战中。事实上，毒刺 LAM 首次参战就是摧毁太阳系恒星泰拉轨道上奥尔特云中的一处核武器设施。标准量产型使用三门玛格纳中型激光，分装于头部与双臂。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The design featured Large Pulse Lasers in each arm, twin Gauss Rifles mounted behind flip-open circular firing ports on each side torso, and an almost superfluous Small Pulse Laser located above the cockpit. The Stone Rhino also sported an interesting feature; each arm contained a retractable, shock-absorbing cowl covering the weapon barrels. This allowed MechWarriors to use the arms as battering rams without damaging the weaponry.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该设计在每臂装备大型脉冲激光，两侧躯干各在翻开式圆形射击口后安装两门高斯步枪，驾驶舱上方还有一门近乎多余的轻型脉冲激光。石犀牛还有一个有趣特征：每臂都包含一个可伸缩的减震罩盖住炮管，使机甲战士能把手臂当攻城锤使用而不损坏武器。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: In order to plug holes in their touman, Clan Goliath Scorpion scientists revisited the Behemoth. Like Clan Smoke Jaguar before them, they upgraded and improved upon the design. This version used an Extra-light Engine to mount a pair of Thunderstroke Series 2b Gauss Rifles along the top of the 'Mech. Each arm carried a Series 4D-2 Heavy Large Laser, a Series 22a Heavy Medium Laser, and a General Systems Heavy Small Laser. It retained the shock-absorbing cowls of the original. Another pair of Heavy Mediums protected the rear of the 'Mech. A head-mounted Shield-3 Anti-Missile System defended against missiles, while an Anti-Personnel Pod in each leg discouraged unarmored infantry. This design had jump jets, nineteen tons of armor, and a meager sixteen double heat sinks.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 为填补图曼的缺口，歌利亚蝎氏族科学家重新审视了巨兽。如烟虎氏族先前所做，他们升级改进了该设计。此版本使用超轻型引擎，在机甲顶部安装两门雷霆系列 2b 高斯步枪。每臂携带一门 4D-2 系列重型大型激光、一门 22a 系列重型中型激光和一门通用系统重型小型激光。它保留了原版的减震罩盖。另外两门重型中型激光保护机甲后方。头部安装的盾-3 反导系统防御导弹，每条腿上的反人员荚舱则用于威慑无装甲步兵。该设计配有跳跃推进器、十九吨装甲和仅十六台双倍散热器。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A variable range variant, the Stone Rhino 4 uses an XL Engine to provide weight savings for four LRM 10s to lay down impressive long range fire. Backing these up are a pair of Ultra AC-10s for mid-range engagements. From there, four ER Medium Lasers provide a solid short range punch. Lastly, four Machine Guns provide anti-infantry support. These combine to make a solid and well rounded configuration.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 石犀牛 4 是一款全能射程变体，它使用 XL 引擎节省重量以搭载四具 LRM 10，倾泻可观远程火力。中距离交战由两门超速 AC-10 支援，四门 ER 中型激光提供扎实的近距离打击，最后四挺机枪提供反步兵支援。这些组合成一套扎实而均衡的配置。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A design based off of early specifications for Amaris's Folly, the Stone Rhino 5 uses a 400XL engine to reach speeds up up to 64.8kph. It is armed with four LB-5X Autocannons mounted in the torsos backed up by six ER Medium Lasers in the arms.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 石犀牛 5 基于"阿马里斯之愚"的早期规格设计，使用 400XL 引擎达到最高 64.8 公里/小时的速度。它在躯干安装四门 LB-5X 自动炮，并以臂部六门 ER 中型激光作为补充。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A close combat design based on the Stone Rhino 5, the Stone Rhino 6 is armed with a simple yet effective loadout of 14 Medium Pulse Lasers. These are backed up by a single ER Small Laser.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 石犀牛 6 是基于石犀牛 5 的近战设计，装备简单却有效的 14 门中型脉冲激光，并由一门 ER 小型激光支援。
氏族重新设计的"阿马里斯之愚"。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Stormcrow A is configured mainly for close combat.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 风暴鸦 A 主要配置为近战。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Stormcrow B is another close combat configuration.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 风暴鸦 B 是另一种近战配置。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Stormcrow C is armed with some of the most accurate weapons available to the clans.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 暴风鸦 C 装备了氏族所能获得的一些最精准的武器。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A long range support configuration, the Stormcrow D has, as its primary weapons, a pair of LRM-20 launchers. These are backed up by two SRM-2 launchers for close combat.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 风暴鸦 D 是一款远程支援配置，主武器为两具 LRM-20 发射器。它们由两具 SRM-2 发射器支援用于近战。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Capable of engaging an enemy at any range, the Stormcrow E's primary weapons are a pair of ATM-9 launchers. These are capable of firing short, medium, and long range munitions. The launchers are backed up, for added close range firepower, by four ER Small Lasers and two ER Medium Lasers.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 暴风鸦 E 能在任何距离上交战，主武器为一对 ATM-9 发射器。它们能发射短程、中程和远程弹药。为增强近程火力，这些发射器由四门 ER 小型激光和两门 ER 中型激光支援。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A heavy laser-toting version of the primary configuration, the H has, as its main weapons, two Heavy Large Lasers. These are backed up by three ER Medium Lasers.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: H 是主配置的重型激光版本，以两门重型大型激光为主武器。它们由三门 ER 中型激光支援。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A pair of LRM-15 launchers provide long range firepower while each arm carries an ER Large Laser and ER Medium Laser. To ferret out hidden enemy forces, the Stormcrow I configuration mounts an Active Probe in the head.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 两具 LRM-15 发射器提供远程火力，每臂则携带一门 ER 大型激光和一门 ER 中型激光。为搜出隐藏的敌军，暴风鸦 I 配置在头部安装一具主动探测器。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A pair of LRM-15 launchers provide long range firepower while each arm carries an ER Large Laser and ER Medium Laser.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 两具 LRM-15 发射器提供远程火力，每臂则携带一门 ER 大型激光和一门 ER 中型激光。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A sleek, mobile, and versatile design, the Clan Stormcrow was long suspected to be one of the first OmniMechs produced by the Clans.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为一款流线型、机动且多用途的设计，氏族风暴鸦长期被认为是最早由氏族生产的全能机甲之一。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: For long range combat, the Summoner A has a powerful Gauss Rifle which is supported by a Large Pulse Laser for intermediate ranges and an SRM-6 launcher for close combat.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 远程战斗中，召唤者 A 有一门强劲的高斯步枪，配一门大型脉冲激光负责中距离，以及一具 SRM-6 发射器负责近战。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A missile bombardment configuration, the B configuration carries a pair of LRM-20 launchers for long range engagements. For close combat, the Summoner B has two SRM-4 launchers. A Narc Missile Beacon allows the Summoner to designate targets for missile fire from other friendly units. The Summoner B has further protection through the use of an Anti-Missile System which gives it increased protection from missile attacks.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 召唤者 B 是一款导弹轰炸配置，携带两具 LRM-20 发射器用于远程交战。近战方面，它有两具 SRM-4 发射器。一具 NARC 导弹信标让召唤者能为其他友军单位的导弹火力标记目标。召唤者 B 还通过一套反导系统获得进一步保护，提升对导弹攻击的防御。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A close range brawler, the Summoner C is armed with a single ER Large Laser for long range sniping at enemy targets but truly comes into its own at close range. The 'Mech relies on a powerful Ultra Autocannon/20 for quick kill capabilities at close ranges. This is backed up by a highly accurate Streak SRM-6 launcher to seek out weak points in an enemy's armor and an ER Small Laser.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 召唤者 C 是一款近战近战型，装备一门 ER 大型激光用于对敌方目标的远程狙击，但真正发挥威力是在近距离。机甲依靠一门强劲的超速自动炮/20 在近距离快速击杀。它辅以一具极为精准的连续 SRM-6 发射器以寻找敌方装甲弱点，以及一门 ER 小型激光。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: In its primary configuration the Summoner has a basic yet effective arsenal. The primary direct fire weapon is an ER PPC backed up by an LB 10-X Autocannon that can fire both standard and cluster ammunition. For fire support and bombardment, the Summoner has an LRM-15 launcher.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 主配置中，召唤者拥有基础却有效的武器库。主要直射武器是一门 ER PPC，辅以一门 LB 10-X 自动炮，后者可发射标准弹与集束弹。用于火力支援与轰炸，召唤者有一具 LRM-15 发射器。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Almost a direct counter-point to the Prime, the A Config mounts twin Ultra AC/2s in each side torso, supported by an ER Large Laser in each arm if the two tons of Ultra reloads run dry. The config is rounded out by an extra Double Heat Sink.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: A 配置几乎与主型号针锋相对，每侧躯干装双联超速 AC/2，若两吨超速弹药耗尽，则由每臂一门 ER 大型激光支援。该配置另有一台额外双倍散热器补全。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A mixed-range combatant, the Sun Spider B is built around a right-torso mounted Gauss Rifle, supported by a left-torso ER Large Laser and matched Streak SRM-6 and ER Medium Lasers in each arm. An Anti-Missile System and a Light Active Probe in the left torso prevent the B from being caught unaware, carrying two tons of Gauss and Streak reloads along with a single ton of AMS ammo and an extra double heat sink.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 太阳蜘蛛 B 是一款混合射程战斗型，以右躯干的高斯步枪为核心，左躯干的 ER 大型激光以及每臂配对的连续 SRM-6 和 ER 中型激光为支援。左躯干的反导系统与轻型主动探测器使 B 不会被打个措手不及，它携带两吨高斯与连续导弹再装填、一吨 AMS 弹药和一台额外双倍散热器。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The C configuration is a classic LRM Missile Boat, fitted with a pair of LRM-15s in each arm and supported by an LRM-20 in each side torso. Carrying six tons of LRM missiles, an extra double heat sink strives to try and keep the Sun Spider firing.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: C 配置是经典的 LRM 导弹平台，每臂装备两具 LRM-15，两侧躯干各以一具 LRM-20 支援。它携带六吨 LRM 导弹，一台额外双倍散热器尽力维持太阳蜘蛛的火力。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A short-ranged brawler, the Sun Spider D carries a mammoth Ultra AC/20 in each arm, with just a pair of Heavy Machine Guns in the right torso as supporting weapons. Lacking in ranged weapons, an ECM Suite is fitted in the left torso to try and assist in closing with its foes so it can make full use of the four tons of Ultra ammunition and single ton HMG bin.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 太阳蜘蛛 D 是一款近战近战型，每臂携带一门巨型超速 AC/20，右躯干仅以两挺重机枪作为支援武器。由于缺乏远程武器，左躯干装有 ECM 套件以协助接近敌人，从而充分利用四吨超速弹药与一吨重机枪弹药。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Sun Spider F configuration mounts an ERPPC in each arm and an LBX10 Autocannon in the right torso. A single AP Gauss rifle and anti-Battlearmor pod help deal with enemy infantry. A pair of anti-missile systems and an ECM suite enhance defense.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 太阳蜘蛛 F 配置在每臂装一门 ER PPC，右躯干一门 LBX10 自动炮。一门单装 AP 高斯步枪和反战斗装甲荚舱帮助对付敌方步兵。两套反导系统和一套 ECM 套件增强防御。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Sun Spider Prime is built for short-range combat and carries a pair of Streak SRM-6 launchers in each arm, supported at range by Ultra AC/10 and an ER Large Laser in the right and left torsos, respectively. Two tons of Ultra Autocannon reloads and three tons of Streak SRM missiles are more than adequate for Clan Trials.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 太阳蜘蛛主型号为近战而设，每臂携带两具连续 SRM-6 发射器，远程则由右躯干的超速 AC/10 和左躯干的 ER 大型激光支援。两吨超速自动炮再装填与三吨连续 SRM 导弹对氏族试炼而言绰绰有余。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Inner Sphere Standard was developed following the initial thrust of the Clan invasion, as Inner Sphere powers rushed to duplicate the battle armor technology the Clans fielded. Lacking any battlefield salvage on which to base their development though, engineers were forced to work off of ancient rumors of early power armor suits like the Nighthawk, more akin to armored Exoskeletons than the 'Toads' currently rampaging through known space, and these prototypes fared poorly during testing. It took salvage from the first victories over the Clans to truly kick-start the development of battle armor. The New Avalon Institute of Science was the first to reproduce in part the Clans' Elemental armor as the Inner Sphere Standard.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 内天体标准型是在氏族入侵首轮攻势后开发的，当时内天体各势力竞相复制氏族装备的战斗装甲技术。然而由于缺乏战场缴获作为研发基础，工程师们只能依据"夜鹰"等早期动力装甲的古老传闻着手——它们与其说是当前肆虐已知空间的"蟾蜍"式装甲，更像是带装甲的外骨骼。这些原型在测试中表现糟糕。直到从对氏族的首次胜利中获得缴获品，战斗装甲的研发才真正起步。新阿瓦隆科学研究院率先部分复制了氏族的元素战士装甲，即内天体标准型。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Thorn carries a weapons array that is not usually seen on light 'Mechs: a Zeus-5 LRM launcher mounted in the right arm with one ton of reloads in the right torso, paired with two Hellion Spitfire Medium Lasers split between the head and left arm. Four and a half tons of armor provides the Thorn with good protection, especially when mated with CASE to contain any ammunition explosions.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 荆棘携带轻型机甲上不常见的武器阵列：右臂一具宙斯-5 LRM 发射器（右躯干一吨再装填），配以分列头部与左臂的两门海利昂"喷火"中型激光。四吨半装甲为荆棘提供良好防护，尤其配合 C.A.S.E. 遏制弹药爆炸时。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Developed in 3051 on the orders of Precentor Martial Anastasius Focht to try and close the gap between the Clans and Com Guards, the factory refit THE-N1 received its baptism of fire during the Battle of Tukayyid. Having reached a similar conclusion that resulted in the THE-Nb, the CASE was dropped and the standard engine was swapped for an XL Engine to allow the standard weaponry to be stripped for an all energy weapon array: a right arm mounted Kinslaughter H-Class ER PPC and a head-mounted Intek Small Laser. This new weapons array, enhanced by double heat sinks, added a level of lethality never seen before on the Thorn.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: THE-N1 于 3051 年根据战务长官阿纳斯塔修斯·福赫特的命令开发，试图缩小氏族与康卫之间的差距，这款工厂改装型在图卡伊德战役中接受了战火洗礼。它得出了与 THE-Nb 相似的结论，因此舍弃 C.A.S.E. 并把标准引擎换成 XL 引擎，以便剥离标准武器、改用全能量武器阵列：右臂一门"族杀 H 级"ER PPC 和头部一门英泰克小型激光。这一新武器阵列在双倍散热器的强化下，为荆棘带来了前所未有的杀伤力。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A new production variant of the THE-N1 developed by the Word of Blake in 3071, the THE-N2 took its cues from both the THE-N and THE-T variants, swapping the ER-PPC with an MML 7 and the standard small laser for a Diverse Optics ER Small Laser. A two-ton CASE protected ammo bay allowed the THE-N2 to carry both LRM and SRM munitions to make best use of the Multi-Missile Launcher.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: THE-N2 是布雷克之言于 3071 年开发的 THE-N1 新量产变体，它同时借鉴了 THE-N 与 THE-T 变体，把 ER PPC 换成 MML 7，标准小型激光换成多元光学 ER 小型激光。一个两吨、有 C.A.S.E. 保护的弹药舱使 THE-N2 能同时携带 LRM 与 SRM 弹药，以最大化利用多用途导弹发射器。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The advanced model employed by the Star League Defense Force Royal Divisions in 2743 changed the role of the 'Mech from a missile to an energy boat, replacing the LRM launcher with an ER Large Laser, retaining one medium laser and downgrading the other to a Small Laser. Dropping the no longer required CASE, the 'Mech also used a MASC system for temporary speed bursts and Double Heat Sinks to vent its increased waste heat output. The THE-Nb mounted an XL Engine to save the weight to mount this extra equipment, at the cost of reduced survivability.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这款先进型号于 2743 年由星盟防卫军皇家师使用，它把机甲的角色从导弹平台改为能量平台，以一门 ER 大型激光取代 LRM 发射器，保留一门中型激光，另一门降级为小型激光。舍弃不再需要的 C.A.S.E.，机甲还使用 MASC 系统实现临时速度爆发，并以双倍散热器排出增加的废热。THE-Nb 装 XL 引擎以省出重量安装这些额外装备，代价是生存性降低。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Supplied by ComStar to the Draconis Combine as part of Operation Rosebud in 3035, the THE-S was a downgraded factory refit of the THE-N. Stripping out the advanced Endo Steel chassis and CASE, the use of a heavier standard chassis forced a reduction in the Thorns armor protection by half a ton, most of which was removed from the head and rear torso. The communications system was also changed to a more primitive Olmstead 30, although the Omicron VII targeting-tracking system was similar in capabilities to the Orion 80 it replaced.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: THE-S 由康星作为 3035 年"玫瑰花蕾"行动的一部分提供给德拉科尼斯联合体，是 THE-N 的降级工厂改装型。它拆除了先进的内骨骼底盘和 C.A.S.E.，改用较重的标准底盘，迫使荆棘的装甲防护减少半吨，其中大部分从头颅和后躯干扣除。通讯系统也换成更原始的奥姆斯特德 30，尽管奥米克戎 VII 瞄准追踪系统的性能与被它取代的猎户座 80 相近。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Developed in 3038 by the Draconis Combine in an attempt to upgrade the 'Mech's short range firepower prior to the War of 3039, the THE-T is a field refit of the downgraded THE-S that swaps out the LRM launcher for an SRM-4.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: THE-T 由德拉科尼斯联合体于 3038 年开发，试图在 3039 年战争前升级机甲的近程火力，它是对降级版 THE-S 的野战改装，把 LRM 发射器换成 SRM-4。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Timber Wolf is a fast, heavy OmniMech. A signature design of the Clans' military might, it was arguably the first Clan OmniMech encountered by Inner Sphere forces on The Rock by Phelan Kell. Vaguely resembling a cross-over between the MAD (Marauder) and CAT (Catapult) series, the Timber Wolf was tagged with the Inner Sphere reporting name Mad Cat on first contact.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 森林狼是一款高速重型全能机甲。作为氏族军事力量的标志性设计，它可以说是内天体部队在"岩石"星上由菲兰·凯尔首次遭遇的氏族全能机甲。因其隐约呈现出 MAD（掠夺者）与 CAT（投石机）系列的杂交特征，森林狼在首次接触时被内天体冠以"疯猫"的报告代号。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Timber Wolf is a fast, heavy OmniMech. A signature design of the Clans' military might, it was arguably the first Clan OmniMech encountered by Inner Sphere forces on The Rock by Phelan Kell. Vaguely resembling a cross-over between the MAD (Marauder) and CAT (Catapult) series, the Timber Wolf was tagged with the Inner Sphere reporting name Mad Cat on first contact.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 森林狼是一款高速重型全能机甲。作为氏族军事力量的标志性设计，它可以说是内天体部队在"岩石"星上由菲兰·凯尔首次遭遇的氏族全能机甲。因其隐约呈现出 MAD（掠夺者）与 CAT（投石机）系列的杂交特征，森林狼在首次接触时被内天体冠以"疯猫"的报告代号。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Turkina is named after Turkina, the first Jade Falcon to be tamed, who inspired the leaders of Clan Jade Falcon in its early days.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 图尔基娜以图尔基娜命名——第一只被驯服的翡翠猎鹰，它在翡翠猎鹰氏族早期激励了其领袖。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The UrbanMech IIC is a Clan IIC-style upgrade of the original UrbanMech. Around the same time as the development of the OmniMech during the Golden Century, Clan Coyote technicians reworked this venerable design. They studied battle data from as far back as the Amaris Civil War and used this research as the basis for their upgrades.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 城市机甲 IIC 是原版城市机甲的氏族 IIC 式升级版。在黄金世纪全能机甲发展的同期，郊狼氏族技师重制了这款古老的设计。他们研究了可追溯至阿马里斯内战的作战数据，并以此为基础进行升级。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Don't let the stubby 'Urbie' fool you—it may look like a walking trash can, but it can mount heavy armor and a grown-up-sized Autocannon. R63s aren't known for their speed, but they are very useful if you can draw the enemy into their firing range.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 别被矮胖的"都市"骗了——它也许看起来像个会走路的垃圾桶，却能装备厚重装甲和成人尺寸的自动炮。R63 不以速度著称，但如果你能把敌人引到它的射程内，它们就非常有用。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Valkyrie II project originated as an assignment for two NAIS student design teams to create a new heavy scout and skirmisher mech based on the Valkyrie VLK-QA. A rivalry between the two teams and outside pressures from Davion bureaucrats pushed both designs far beyond a replacement for the VLK-QA. Achernar BattleMechs was contracted to construct the Valkyrie II-1A which sports a Hermes 360XL Engine, six Jump Jets, an ER PPC, a LRM10, and over eleven tons of armor.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 女武神 II 项目最初是给两个 NAIS 学员设计小组的作业：基于女武神 VLK-QA 打造一款新的重型侦察与散兵机甲。两队之间的竞争以及达维昂官僚的外来压力，把两个设计都推得远超 VLK-QA 的替代品。阿克尔纳战斗机甲公司获得合同建造女武神 II-1A，它配备一台赫尔墨斯 360XL 引擎、六个跳跃推进器、一门 ER PPC、一具 LRM10 以及超过十一吨装甲。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Vapor Eagle features an eclectic and close-ranged weapons load-out, mounting a Large Pulse Laser in its right arm, supported by a single Machine Gun, two Streak SRM-2s and three Medium Pulse Lasers split between its side torsos and rounded out by a trio of Machine Guns in a handgun shaped housing in the left arm. The addition of a Targeting Computer makes its firepower even more deadly as long as it can get its weapons into range. Eleven Double Heat Sinks, half a ton of machine gun ammunition and one Streak missiles are more than adequate for the average Clan trial.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 蒸汽鹰拥有杂糅而偏近程的武器配置：右臂一门大型脉冲激光，辅以一挺机枪、两具连续 SRM-2 和三门中型脉冲激光分列两侧躯干，左臂手枪形护罩内还有三挺机枪收尾。加装瞄准计算机后，只要武器能进入射程，其火力更为致命。十一台双倍散热器、半吨机枪弹药和一吨连续导弹弹药，对一般的氏族试炼而言绰绰有余。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This variant of the Vapor Eagle removes two of the Medium Pulse Lasers, both Streak Missile pods, and the Large Pulse Laser as well as one of the 'Mechs double heat sinks in exchange for an Ultra Autocannon/10. Mounted in an over the shoulder arrangement like the venerable Shadow Hawk, the weapon fires at twice the rate of a standard Autocannon/10 and carries enough ammunition to continuously fire at its maximum rate of fire for over a minute and a half.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 此蒸汽鹰变体移除两门中型脉冲激光、两具连续导弹荚舱、大型脉冲激光以及一台双倍散热器，换成一门超速自动炮/10。该武器以如同古老的影鹰那样的过肩方式安装，射速是标准自动炮/10 的两倍，并携带足以以最高射速连续射击一分半钟以上的弹药。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Venom was built in direct response to losses suffered by the Draconis Combine and to boost sales for Nimakachi Fusion Products Limited. The 8C carries only standard jump jets and replaces 3 Pulse Lasers with a Snub Nose PPC.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 毒液是为直接回应德拉科尼斯联合体的损失并提振尼玛卡奇聚变产品公司的销量而制造。8C 仅携带标准跳跃推进器，并将 3 门脉冲激光换成短鼻 PPC。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Venom was built in direct response to losses suffered by the Draconis Combine and to boost sales for Nimakachi Fusion Products Limited. This earlier Model trades Jump Capability for a Capacitator boosted Heavy PPC.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 毒液是为直接回应德拉科尼斯联合体的损失并提振尼玛卡奇聚变产品公司的销量而制造。此早期型号以跳跃能力换取一门电容增强的重型 PPC。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An upgrade using Star League technology, the 9K replaces the Autocannon/20 with a Gauss Rifle which can do serious damage at much greater ranges. The 'Mech also carries two Medium Pulse Lasers and a SRM-4 launcher for close combat. In order to make these changes possible, the 9K is built on an Endo Steel chassis. With the weight saved the 'Mech also carries an additional ton of armor.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 9K 是使用星盟技术的升级，以一门高斯步枪取代自动炮/20，能在远得多的距离上造成严重伤害。机甲还携带两门中型脉冲激光和一具 SRM-4 发射器用于近战。为实现这些改动，9K 基于内骨骼底盘建造。凭借节省的重量，机甲还多携带一吨装甲。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: After his son was killed in the Taurian Concordat invasion of the Federated Suns, Benedict St. James had his VTR-9K refitted with experimental weapons and equipment to allow him to take his revenge. Replacing the standard weapons with a Long Tom Cannon and two Medium X-Pulse Lasers, St. James' Victor can inflict massive amounts of damage on his prey. The 'Mech's jump jets had to be removed to make way for the weapons load, and technicians equipped it with a patchwork of Ferro-Fibrous and Standard Armor as another weight saving measure. A Supercharger mounted on the engine provides the Victor with unexpected bursts of speed.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在陶里安协约入侵联邦太阳系时儿子被杀后，本尼迪克特·圣詹姆斯将自己的 VTR-9K 改装上实验性武器与装备以复仇。他把标准武器换成一门长汤姆炮和两门中型 X 脉冲激光，使圣詹姆斯的胜利者能对猎物造成巨量伤害。为给武器腾出空间，机甲的跳跃推进器不得不拆除，技师还为其配上铁纤维与标准装甲的拼装方案作为另一项减重措施。引擎上加装的增压器为胜利者提供了出其不意的速度爆发。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Utilizing a heavier mix of shorter ranged weapons among many of the configurations, the Viper saw success when paired with other light platforms.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 毒蛇的多种配置都偏向更重型的短程武器组合，与其他轻型平台搭配时表现出色。
