Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The original Warhammer was designed as an assault BattleMech. However, it had been superseded by later and heavier 'Mech designs, though it remained a powerful weapons platform. The Clans wisely maintained and built on this solid frame a real assault 'Mech, the Warhammer IIC.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 最初的战锤被设计为突击战斗机甲。尽管后来被更重的机甲设计取代，它仍是一个强大的武器平台。氏族明智地在这一坚固框架上维护并建造出真正的突击机甲——战锤 IIC。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The original Warhammer was designed as an assault BattleMech. However, it had been superseded by later and heavier 'Mech designs, though it remained a powerful weapons platform. The Clans wisely maintained and built on this solid frame a real assault 'Mech, the Warhammer IIC. This variant turns the Warhammer IIC into a fire support 'Mech. Clan scientists replaced the Medium Pulse Lasers with a pair of LRM-15s and four tons of ammunition.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 最初的战锤被设计为突击战斗机甲。尽管后来被更重的机甲设计取代，它仍是一个强大的武器平台。氏族明智地在这一坚固框架上维护并建造出真正的突击机甲——战锤 IIC。此变体将战锤 IIC 改造为火力支援机甲。氏族科学家将中型脉冲激光换成两具 LRM-15 和四吨弹药。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The original Warhammer was designed as an assault BattleMech. However, it had been superseded by later and heavier 'Mech designs, though it remained a powerful weapons platform. The Clans wisely maintained and built on this solid frame a real assault 'Mech, the Warhammer IIC. Designed by Clan Diamond Shark, this variant replaces the PPCs and missile launcher of the original design with a pair of arm-mounted Heavy Large Lasers, two additional heat sinks, and a half ton of armor. An advanced Targeting Computer was also added to help ensure that the hard-to-use heavy lasers hit.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 最初的战锤被设计为突击战斗机甲。尽管后来被更重的机甲设计取代，它仍是一个强大的武器平台。氏族明智地在这一坚固框架上维护并建造出真正的突击机甲——战锤 IIC。此变体由钻石鲨氏族设计，将原设计中的 PPC 与导弹发射器换成一对臂载重型大型激光、两台额外散热器和半吨装甲。还加装了先进瞄准计算机以确保难以驾驭的重型激光能够命中。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This House Kurita variant, introduced in 3054, was built on an Endo Steel skeleton. It carried ER PPCs, two medium lasers, and two small pulse lasers. The SRM-6 was replaced by a pair of Streak SRM-2 launchers, while a TAG system allowed the 7K to spot for friendly artillery units.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这款库瑞塔家族变体于 3054 年推出，建立在内骨骼骨架上。它携带 ER PPC、两门中型激光和两门小型脉冲激光。SRM-6 换成两具连续 SRM-2 发射器，TAG 系统则使 7K 能为友军炮兵单位侦察。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 7M variant was introduced in 3047 by Ronin Inc. as the official upgraded variant of the Warhammer for the Free Worlds League. Built around a Magna 280 fusion engine, the 7M had a top speed of 64.5 km/h and carried eighteen double heat sinks to handle the waste heat generated by its two Fusigon Longtooth ER PPCs. Backing up these new weapons were two Martell medium lasers in the side torsos and a Shannon SH-60 SRM-6 launcher over the right shoulder. A LFN Lindblad machine gun was carried in the right torso, while the left mounted an LFN Lindblad Shotgun Anti-Missile System. One ton of machine gun rounds were carried in the center torso, while one ton each of missile reloads and AMS rounds were carried in the right.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 7M 变体由浪人公司于 3047 年推出，是自由世界联盟战锤的官方升级变体。它围绕玛格纳 280 聚变引擎建造，最高速度 64.5 公里/小时，携带十八台双倍散热器以处理两门"富西贡长牙"ER PPC 产生的废热。支援这些新武器的是两侧躯干的两门马特尔中型激光和右肩上方一具"香农 SH-60"SRM-6 发射器。右躯干携带一挺 LFN 林德布拉德机枪，左侧则装一套 LFN 林德布拉德霰弹反导系统。中央躯干携带一吨机枪弹，右侧则各携带一吨导弹再装填和一吨 AMS 弹药。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 7S Warhammer was the official upgraded version built for the Federated Commonwealth by Olivettie Weaponry. Built out of their Sudeten factory starting in 3050, the 7S retained the small lasers of the original but updated the rest of the weaponry. It carried two arm-mounted ER PPCs, two Defiance P5M medium pulse lasers in the side torsos, and two Coventry T4H Streak SRM-2 launchers in place of the SRM-6 launcher. Eighteen double heat sinks handled the additional waste heat and one ton of reloads for the Streak launchers was carried in the center torso.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 7S 战锤是奥利维蒂兵器为联邦联邦建造的官方升级版。自 3050 年起在其苏德滕工厂生产，7S 保留了原版的小型激光，但更新了其余武器。它携带两门臂载 ER PPC、两侧躯干各两门迪法恩斯 P5M 中型脉冲激光，以及两具考文垂 T4H 连续 SRM-2 发射器取代 SRM-6。十八台双倍散热器处理额外废热，中央躯干携带一吨连续发射器再装填。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Introduced at the turn of the century, the Warhawk was created by the Smoke Jaguars in anticipation of the Clans’ return to the Inner Sphere.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 战鹰于世纪之交推出，由烟虎氏族为迎接氏族重返内天体而研制。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Introduced at the turn of the century, the Warhawk was created by the Smoke Jaguars in anticipation of the Clans’ return to the Inner Sphere.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 战鹰于世纪之交推出，由烟虎氏族为迎接氏族重返内天体而研制。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 战鹰于世纪之交推出，由烟虎氏族为迎接氏族重返内天体而研制。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Apparently designed to reduce heat, this configuration of the Warhawk carries a single ER PPC in each arm backed up by an LRM-20 and LRM-10. A torso-mounted Ultra AC/2 rounds out the weapons. Like most Warhawk variants, this version carries an advanced Targeting Computer.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 此战鹰配置显然是为降低热量而设计，每臂一门 ER PPC，辅以一具 LRM-20 和一具 LRM-10。躯干搭载的是一门超速 AC/2。与大多数战鹰变体一样，此版本配备先进瞄准计算机。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Introduced at the turn of the century, the Warhawk was created by the Smoke Jaguars in anticipation of the Clans’ return to the Inner Sphere.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 战鹰于世纪之交推出，由烟虎氏族为迎接氏族重返内天体而研制。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Though bearing a remarkable outward resemblance to the Timberwolf, this BattleMech is a new and powerful creation. Carrying thirteen tons of ferro-fibrous armor, the Mad Cat MK II is an incredibly resilient design. A pair of arm mounted Gaussrifles supported by torso mounted LRM racks give it complete command over the battlefield.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 虽然外观与森林狼极为相似，这款战斗机甲却是全新而强大的创造。疯猫 MK II 携带十三吨铁纤维装甲，是极为坚固的设计。臂载的双高斯步枪配以躯干搭载的 LRM 挂架，使其能完全掌控战场。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This version of the Wasp LAM replaces the bomb bay with an LRM-10 launcher and an extra jump jet. This variant was later used as the inspiration for the Valkyrie.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 此版黄蜂 LAM 将炸弹舱换成一具 LRM-10 发射器和一个额外跳跃推进器。该变体后来成为瓦尔基里的灵感来源。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This variant was designed for the SLDF's "Blackhearts" teams. Based on the standard WSP-100, it replaced the medium laser and bomb bay with an extra jump jet, Medium Pulse Laser, Streak SRM-2, and Guardian ECM Suite. The armor protection was also increased slightly.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 此变体为星盟防卫军"黑心"小队设计。以标准 WSP-100 为基础，它将中型激光和炸弹舱换成一个额外跳跃推进器、一门中型脉冲激光、一具连续 SRM-2 和守护者 ECM 套件。装甲防护也略有增强。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This variant, used by the SLDF, has a LTV 150 engine, slightly lower maximum ground speed (84km/h), a 120 meter jump capability, and replaces the SRM-2 with a rear-facing One-Shot version. In exchange the WSP-100 was equipped with a five ton bomb bay. This Bomb Bay allowed the WSP-100 to carry Arrow IVmissiles and conventional bombs without losing any speed.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 此变体由星盟防卫军使用，配备 LTV 150 引擎，最高地面速度略低（84 公里/小时），跳跃能力 120 米，并将 SRM-2 换成后向的单次发射版本。作为交换，WSP-100 配备了五吨炸弹舱。该炸弹舱使 WSP-100 能在不损失速度的情况下携带箭矢 IV 导弹和常规炸弹。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Wasp LAM is similar to the Stinger LAM, maintaining the same ground and air speed. The only real difference is in the armament - the Wasp LAM is armed with a Martell Medium Laser and a Holly SRM-2.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 黄蜂 LAM 与毒刺 LAM 相似，保持相同的地面与空中速度。唯一真正的区别在于武器：黄蜂 LAM 装备一门马特尔中型激光和一具冬青 SRM-2。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This variant of the "standard" Wasp 105 replaced the SRM-2 and one heat sink with a single LRM-5.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 此型"标准"黄蜂 105 将 SRM-2 和一台散热器换成单具 LRM-5。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Wraith marked Curtiss Militech's entry into BattleMech production. When the design was announced, many felt that the design would be little more than a walking water cooler. What the critics got was a shock. The Wraith is a 'Mech that, when properly employed, can wreak havoc on an enemy with its astounding speed and maneuverability. It is built around a massive LTV 385 XL Engine that allows it to reach speeds of just under 119 kph. The Wraith has a simple, yet effective, pulse weapons payload. Pulse laser weaponry allows the Mech to negate most of the side effects on accuracy that are introduced by the Wraith's heavy use of jump jets, making it incredibly accurate and powerful for such a lightly armed Mech. A simple modification of the Wraith, the TR2 simply replaces the Large Pulse Laser with an ER PPC, turning the 'Mech into a highly capable sniper.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 幽灵标志着柯蒂斯军工进军战斗机甲生产。该设计公布时，许多人以为它不过是台会走路的水冷器。批评者得到的却是震惊。若运用得当，幽灵能凭借惊人的速度与机动性在敌阵中肆虐。它以庞大的 LTV 385 XL 引擎为核心，速度可达略低于 119 公里/小时。幽灵配有简单却有效的脉冲武器配置。脉冲激光武器能让机甲抵消跳跃推进器大量使用所带来的大部分精度副作用，使这款轻武装机甲变得异常精准而强大。作为幽灵的简单改型，TR2 仅将大型脉冲激光换成 ER PPC，把机甲变成极具能力的狙击手。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Wraith marked Curtiss Militech's entry into BattleMech production. When the design was announced, many felt that the design would be little more than a walking water cooler. What the critics got was a shock. The Wraith is a 'Mech that, when properly employed, can wreak havoc on an enemy with its astounding speed and maneuverability. It is built around a massive LTV 385 XL Engine that allows it to reach speeds of just under 119 kph. The Wraith has a simple, yet effective, pulse weapons payload. Pulse laser weaponry allows the Mech to negate most of the side effects on accuracy that are introduced by the Wraith's heavy use of jump jets, making it incredibly accurate and powerful for such a lightly armed Mech.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Yu Huang, named for the Jade Emperor that rules the Heavenly Court in the ancient Chinese pantheon, debuted with the promise from Sun-Tzu Liao that 'it shall sit in judgment over a battlefield, meting out justice to those who would transgress against us'. To live up to the promise of the Chancellor of the Capellan Confederation, the Yu Huang carries some of the most advanced technologies available at the time of its initial production. The Yu Huang is built on a Chariot Type II Endo Steel chassis and carries a Hermes 360 XL engine that gives the 'Mech a top speed of 64.8 km/h. The 'Mech is capable of jumping up to one hundred and twenty meters with its four Rodan 90 jump jets.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 玉皇以中国古代神话中主宰天庭的玉皇大帝命名，首次亮相时孙泰子承诺"它将坐镇战场之上，向那些侵犯我们的人施以正义"。为不负卡佩兰邦联大臣的承诺，玉皇在首次生产时携带了当时最先进的技术。它建立在战车型 II 内骨骼底盘上，搭载赫尔墨斯 360 XL 引擎，使机甲最高速度达 64.8 公里/小时。凭借四个罗丹 90 跳跃推进器，机甲可跳跃至一百二十米。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This was a Turhan Urban Assault Vehicle. Someone stuffed most of a space to ground microwave power transmission system into it's infantry bay. This large red button worries me.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是一台图尔汗城市突击车辆。有人把一套空对地微波输电系统的大部分塞进了它的步兵舱。这个大红按钮让我担心。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 那是辆坦克，老板，对我来说它们都一个样。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This rebadged Sleipnir replaces one of the standard medium lasers with a TAG to mark targets for allied strikes. APCs are not fighting vehicles, their main function is to transport infantry squads from one battle to another. However, many APC variants sacrifice troop capacity to mount significant weaponry.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这款换牌的斯雷普尼尔以一门 TAG 取代一门标准中型激光，为友军打击标记目标。装甲运兵车不是战斗车辆，其主要功能是把步兵班从一个战场运到另一个战场。不过许多 APC 变体牺牲载员能力以安装相当的武器。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This rebadged Vargr replaces one of the standard medium lasers with a TAG to mark targets for allied strikes. APCs are not fighting vehicles, their main function is to transport infantry squads from one battle to another. However, many APC variants sacrifice troop capacity to mount significant weaponry.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这款换牌的瓦格以一门 TAG 取代一门标准中型激光，为友军打击标记目标。装甲运兵车不是战斗车辆，其主要功能是把步兵班从一个战场运到另一个战场。不过许多 APC 变体牺牲载员能力以安装相当的武器。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Heavy APC is twice is big as it's standard cousin, but otherwise similar. APCs are not fighting vehicles, their main function is to transport infantry squads from one battle to another. However, many APC variants sacrifice troop capacity to mount significant weaponry.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 重型 APC 的体积是标准型表亲的两倍，其他方面相似。APC 不是战斗车辆，其主要功能是将步兵班从一个战场运送到另一个战场。不过许多 APC 变体牺牲载员能力以搭载可观的武器。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The J-27 Ordnance Transport was the backbone of the Star League Defense Force and remains a common sight in Inner Sphere and Periphery armies. Consisting of a tracked cab and wheeled trailer unit driven by two crewmen, each J-27 can carry eleven tons of ammo in total.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: J-27 弹药运输车曾是星盟防卫军的脊梁，至今仍常见于内天体与外围区的军队中。它由一辆履带式驾驶舱和一个轮式拖车组成，由两名乘员驾驶，每辆 J-27 总共可运载十一吨弹药。
